tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The church under the lights is full of exotic atmosphere; Harbin Landmark Building
summary:
Hagia Sophia, founded in 1907, is a landmark building in Harbin, and its green onion-shaped dome is very eye-catching. 
· This magnificent Byzantine building no longer has the function of a church, and the night view of the church is more beautiful than it is during the day. 
Hagia Sophia was once the largest Orthodox church in the Far East, and now it is the most completely preserved Byzantine building in China. 
After being transformed into an art gallery, it reflects the history, present situation and future of Harbin by displaying nearly a thousand pictures and urban planning sand tables. 
There is a "Square Pigeon" in the square in front of the church, and there is also a large series of musical fountains. Many people like to take wedding photos here.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The noisy street shines in the night; Walk through the Russian-style neighborhood
summary:
Central Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Harbin. This commercial street with a history of more than one hundred years is home to many classic European buildings. 
· It is full of all kinds of department stores, and the whole street is rendered with lights every night. It is a must-visit place in Harbin. 
When you come to Central Street, you must try authentic Russian western food and the famous Madier popsicles.

This section of the Songhua River flowing through Harbin has become an important landscape of the city. 
Every winter, the ice layer of Songhua River is roughly half a meter thick, and the river surface has become a resort for people to play. 
Every year, the materials used in Harbin Ice and Snow World are carved from the ice on the Songhua River.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids.; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Summer for escaping the heat, winter for enjoying snow sculptures.
summary:
- Sun Island Park is located on the northern bank of the Songhua River in Harbin, across from Stalin Park, and is known by visitors as a summer resort.
- The island features numerous European-style villas, which were once summer retreats for the Russians. These architectural structures are nestled amidst lush green trees.
- This is the largest winter theme park in China with a snow theme, and in winter, it becomes a world of snow.

tagNameList: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Ice and Snow Parks
shortFeatures: After lighting up, the crystal ice sculpture is more dreamy; Ice and Snow Theme Carnival
summary:
· In the world of ice and snow, you can enjoy the tallest, longest and largest ice and snow landscape in the world; And every session will have a new theme. 
· There are world-renowned buildings, classic cartoon characters, and you can also watch European-style song and dance performances. 
There are all kinds of ice sports in the park. When the colorful lights are turned on at night, it is like being in a fairy tale world of ice lanterns. 
· Due to its particularity, it is only open from December to February in winter every year.

Harbin Polarland is one of the few original cultural and tourism resort areas in China. The design of the park's buildings, overall planning, and product creativity were all developed by the company's in-house team. The project is located in the national-level tourist scenic area of Sun Island, with a total investment of one billion RMB. It is a cultural and tourism resort area in China centered on polar-themed performances and interactive science education experiences. It is also a well-known brand in China's polar oceanarium industry and a world-class tourism landmark created by Heilongjiang Province. 

The park includes five major venues: the Polar Pavilion, the Ocean Pavilion, the Penguin Learning Pavilion, the Polar Bear Experience Pavilion, and the Dinosaur Pavilion. Seven themed performances are featured: the Beluga Whale Show, Dolphin Show, Glacier Aurora Show, Walrus Stand-up Comedy Show, Penguin Performance, Water Dance, and Stingray Performance.
opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Kid-Friendly Hidden Gems; Zoos
shortFeatures: Close-up Observation of Amur Tiger's Habitat
summary:
The Northeast Tiger Park is located on the north bank of the Songhua River, covering an area of approximately 1.2 million square meters, and is only separated by a small body of water from the famous summer resort, Sun Island Scenic Area. The Tiger Park occupies 360,000 square meters and is currently the world's largest wild natural park for Northeast Tigers. It was established to save and protect the endangered Northeast Tiger species.

The park currently has 10 sightseeing areas: the Wild Training Area, Adult Tiger Area, Young Tiger Area, Tiger King Area, Breeding Tiger Area, Breeding Male Tiger Area, Lion and Tiger Area, African Lion Area, Walking Area, and Tiger Viewing Platform. Visitors can see over 100 purebred Northeast Tigers, 8 white tigers, 1 snow tiger, 2 white lions, 2 liger hybrids, 3 black jaguars, and 20 African lions. Except for the Walking Area and Tiger Viewing Platform, the other areas require visitors to travel in vehicles to search for the tigers and appreciate their majesty.

shortFeatures: Quiet Russian town
summary:
· The Russian-style town is located at the core of the famous Sun Island Scenic Area in Harbin, an ice city, close to the scenic spot along the river. 
· The whole town consists of 27 villas and houses with Russian style. 
The town is hidden among flowers and green trees, scattered at random, each with its own style, forming a unique natural and architectural features.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

summary:
National AAAA scenic spot, located in the vast hinterland surrounded by mountains in the remaining veins of Zhangguang Cailing, a branch of Changbai Mountain. 
· Yabuli Ski Resort is currently the largest ski resort in China and the largest comprehensive snow training center in China. 
· The ski resort has complete facilities, with more than 50 ski trails of different levels to meet the requirements of all kinds of ski enthusiasts. The alpine ski trails are the longest in Asia. 
The snow quality is perfect, with an annual snow period of 170 days and a snow season of 5 months. All skiing facilities and comprehensive service levels are at the top level in the country.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Theater Theatre
shortFeatures: New landmark of online celebrity, night scene space feeling; A landmark building like flowing clouds
summary: Harbin Grand Theatre is a newly completed theater in Harbin, and it will soon become the best place for concerts, stage plays, dramas and other performances in Harbin. This Harbin Grand Theatre, which is inspired by the ice and snow landscape of Northern China, is also a rookie in Harbin architecture. The undulating architectural lines are rich in natural rhythm, like continuous snow-capped mountains. Even if you don't watch the show, this unique architectural beauty is worth visiting.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Observation Deck; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The high-altitude rotating restaurant offers a view of the night scene; overlooking the panoramic view of Harbin from a height of 100 meters.
summary:
Long Tower, with a height of 336 meters, ranks second in the world and first in Asia among steel towers. It is a comprehensive multi-functional tower integrating broadcast and television transmission, tourism, dining and entertainment, advertising, environmental and meteorological monitoring, microwave communication, and wireless communication. It is an iconic landmark of Harbin, Northeast China. 

The total area of Long Tower is 16,600 square meters, with the base covering 13,000 square meters and the tower building covering 3,600 square meters. The tower base consists of one underground floor and four above-ground floors, forming a spherical crown shape. The tower body is an octagonal prism, with a parabolic shape and a cylindrical shaft in the center. The structure is surrounded by seven silver-white aluminum alloy panels and nine dark blue coated glass panels. The tower's lower and upper levels are located at 181 meters and 206 meters, respectively, consisting of a disc-shaped lower tower and a circular upper tower. The antennas are positioned between 220.5 meters and 336 meters. 

Long Tower has meticulously created an "honorable hospitality" service, adhering to aviation service standards and forming a team with international service capabilities. It has successfully hosted many central government leaders, including Li Changchun, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and He Guoqiang, Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, as well as foreign dignitaries such as Russian Deputy Prime Minister Sergey Khristenko and former South Korean Prime Minister Lee Soo-sung. Large-scale delegations from Hong Kong, Macau, and the business and professional sectors, as well as celebrities from the entertainment and business industries, often visit the tower. Visitors often praise the tower’s unique features, beautiful scenery, delicious food, and excellent service. Long Tower has become a must-visit tourist destination for both domestic and international travelers.

shortFeatures: Look at animal fossils and historical relics
summary:
Heilongjiang Provincial Museum is a large comprehensive provincial museum. In 1962, Mr. Guo Moruo inscribed the name of the museum. It is the center of collecting historical relics, works of art and animal and plant specimens in Heilongjiang Province. There are about 110,000 pieces in various collections. Neolithic jade articles, Tang Dynasty Bohai gilded bronze Buddha and golden Buddha, Jin Dynasty silk clothing, etc. are all fine products. The late Cretaceous flat-headed hadrosaur unearthed in Longgushan, Jiayin County, Heilongjiang Province, and three large fossil skeletons of Quaternary woolly rhinoceros and mammoth collected from Qinggang County, dating back 20,000 years, are also precious cultural relics.  
The main building of Heilongjiang Provincial Museum, founded in 1906, is a European Baroque building and the former site of the former Russian shopping mall.

shortFeatures: Russian Style Manor
summary:
The Volga Manor is located on the banks of the Ashi River in the suburban area of Harbin, covering an area of over 600,000 square meters. It is a national AAAA-level cultural tourism attraction, a base for China-Russia cultural exchange, a creative base for the Russian Artists Association, and an international exchange center of Moscow University. The manor advocates the business philosophy of "cultural depth for long-term success, and taste for true value." The reconstructed St. Nicholas Church and the riverside restaurant carry the memories of the old Harbin residents; the Petrov Art Palace and the Pushkin Exhibition Hall provide platforms for cultural and artistic exchange. It is a cultural destination for tourists, a vacation manor.

The manor can accommodate approximately 1,000 people for dining and 800 people for accommodation, offering high-quality services for tourism, leisure vacations, exhibitions, business meetings, study tours, weddings, outdoor sports, and other activities.

tagNameList: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
shortFeatures: Tropical garden scenery indoor hot spring
summary:
· Yabuli Forest Hot Spring is located in Yabuli Tourist Resort, Heilongjiang Province. The hot spring is divided into two areas: indoor pavilion and outdoor hot spring. 
The indoor pavilion takes tropical garden scenery as the theme of hot springs, and combines the abundant Chinese herbal medicine resources in local mountainous areas to create local characteristic medicinal hot springs. There are more than 20 kinds of characteristic hot springs such as ginseng spring, ganoderma lucidum spring, astragalus spring and schisandra spring. 
· Outdoor hot spring pools are distributed in the original birch forest and pine forest, and you can experience the hot spring experience of spring flowers, summer green, autumn yellow and winter snow.

tagNameList: Hi Fun Park; Treasure Spot for Kids; Amusement Parks
shortFeatures: Fusion of Northeast folk customs and amusement attractions.
summary:
Harbin Sunac Land mainly includes four major attractions: the outdoor theme park, Snow World, the Central Grand Theatre, and Movie World, along with a high-end hotel cluster and Sunac Mall, featuring world-renowned brands.  
On November 23, 2019, Harbin Sunac Land grandly opened its new winter project, the Lantern World!

Sun Island International Snow Sculpture Art Expo is the birthplace and leader of national snow sculpture art, an important part of Harbin Ice and Snow Festival, and the biggest highlight of Harbin's ice and snow tourism. Because of its long exhibition period (60-70 days), high quality, new content, large scale and strong interest, it is known as the largest ice and snow carnival in the world.

shortFeatures: Songhua River Open Landscape Park
summary:
Formerly known as Riverside Park, located on the south bank of Songhua River, it is a belt-shaped open park built along the embankment and near the water. It imitates the Russian classical architectural style and the "five-color grass flower beds" all over the park, as well as the sixteen groups of artistic sculptures distributed among green spaces, such as "Swan Spreading Wings", "Three Teenagers", "Starting", "Diving" and "Sword Dancing", each with its own characteristics. It faces the famous Sun Island across the river. In addition, the center of the park is the symbol of Harbin city-the Flood Control Memorial Tower, which was built to commemorate the victory of Harbin people over the catastrophic flood in 1957.  
· The riverside restaurant in the park was built before liberation (Puppet Manchukuo period), located on the west side of the Flood Control Memorial Tower and near the yacht dock. It was built after Russian classical wooden structures. The roof ridge is strewn at random, with sharp edges and corners, and colorful. The appearance is in the shape of building blocks. The transparent outer corridor facing the river and the indoor European architectural pattern reflect the simple and elegant European architectural style. In the 1950s, Changchun Film Studio used its modeling structure to shoot several sets of shots in the movie Xu Qiuying Case, and other film and television organizations also successively shot shots of movies and TV dramas such as Black Triangle, Ming Girl, Harbin at Night, The Story of Church Street and Annual Rings in Stalin Park, which shows how attractive the scenery of Stalin Park is. 
In summer, the river is refreshing, the green willows are shaded, and the natural bathing beach is wide along the river, which is a summer resort for tourists; In winter, watching the ice and snow world in the north is pleasing to the eye and wonderful.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Snow Mountains; Villages
shortFeatures: Original ecology open snowfield, good snow quality
summary:
"Snow Valley" has the original charm of deep mountains and old forests, without any pollution sources, and is a good choice for four-season eco-tourism in Longjiang. You can climb mountains for photography in spring; Summer leisure, eco-sightseeing and rafting; Watch Wuhua Mountain and explore mountaineering in autumn; Cross China's snow valley in winter and climb the peak for thousands of meters; Ten thousand meters of snow floating. 
Above the starting point of the snow valley, you can enjoy the original ecological beauty by hiking, go-karting, sightseeing bus and horse sledge. At the foot of Dadingzi Mountain, about 13 kilometers away from the field, there are many snow mushrooms, and the grass is covered with snow, just like the grasslands in Europe.

poiName: Sun Island Ice and Snow Art Museum
tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries
shortFeatures: Appreciate precious calligraphy and painting works
summary:
The Ice and Snow Art Museum is currently the largest indoor ice and snow art venue in the world. 
The ice scene in the museum is made of natural ice and artificial snow of Songhua River, so that the ice and snow landscape that is only available in winter can be realized indoors in spring, summer and autumn. 
If you come here in summer and the temperature difference between indoor and outdoor is too big, you must rent cotton-padded clothes and trousers.

shortFeatures: The first batch of 211 key universities in China
summary: Harbin Institute of Technology, referred to as Harbin Institute of Technology for short, is located in Harbin, an ice city in northern China. It is a university directly under the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology of the People's Republic of China. It is one of the first batch of key construction institutions of Project 211 and Project 985. The Soviet-style main building is very distinctive. The Russian architectural style is classical, absorbing and compromising various European architectural styles, and wins with its tall, solemn and mysterious momentum. The movie "Lover's Knot" was shot here.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: Forest oxygen bar in urban area
summary: Harbin Forest Botanical Garden is a large-scale botanical garden in the north, which is famous for planting woody and herbaceous plants in cold temperate zones. It is a good place for weekend vacation and leisure and fully appreciate the tranquility and mystery of the big forest. Visitors can enjoy the cold temperate plants with strange scenery in the park, have forest entertainment and camping, and fish leisurely in the quiet artificial lake. This place is attracting more and more people in cities. Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, the whole street is full of delicious food, and there are all kinds of snack shops with authentic flavors, including radish beef brisket, fish Dan, spicy chicken kidney, pearl powder and other Cantonese snacks.

shortFeatures: Famous Buddhist sites in Northeast China
summary: Kek Lok Temple is one of the four famous Buddhist monasteries in the three northeastern provinces. It is also known as the four Buddhist jungles in Northeast China together with Changchun Prajna Temple, Shenyang Ci'en Temple and Yingkou Shengyan Temple. In fact, Kek Lok Temple is not big, and most of them are old people doing their homework. The most worth seeing are the Five Hundred Arhat Hall and the seven-level pagoda behind the temple. Every May, it is beautiful when lilac blooms. Every year on the eighth day of the fourth lunar month, April 18th and April 28th, there will be temple fairs, and there will be many small vendors selling food and play at the door, which will make it even more lively.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Art Museums
summary: Heilongjiang Art Museum, adjacent to the famous Santa Sophia Church, was founded in 1912 and has a typical 19th century European architectural style. There are many award-winning art and calligraphy works in the museum, which is especially suitable for friends who like art works.

Sun Island Stupid Bear Paradise, located in the ecological woodland of Sun Island, is a theme amusement park integrating sightseeing and leisure, amusement experience, catering service and other functions. It is equipped with more than 20 amusement facilities such as flying boat surfing, hanging pulley, speed windmill, double-decker turntable, bounce machine, bumper car, disco turntable, whirlwind rider, children's naughty castle, children's mountain climbing car, etc. 
Transportation Harbin Railway Station: Railway Station-Minyi Street-Zhaolin Street-Stalin Street-Jingbei Street-Sun Island Scenic Area Harbin Municipal Government: Municipal Government-Jiangwan Road-G202-Sun Avenue-Jingbei Street-Sun Island Scenic Area

shortFeatures: Feel a unique beer culture experience
summary: Harbin Beer Museum is located in Pingfang District, Harbin. On September 20th, 2014, Harbin Beer Museum officially opened. Sun Honglei, a famous actor, appeared at the event and was awarded the honorary curator of Harbin Beer Museum. Harbin Beer Museum has a total construction area of 6,258 square meters and has three floors. It uses innovative high-tech and multimedia interactive devices to vividly restore beer history, interestingly show beer culture, and convey the most unique beer culture experience to consumers. At the same time, Harbin Beer Museum has special multimedia interactive devices such as dynamic cinema, and the first ice bar and beer college, which has a "one-stop" brand interactive experience.

shortFeatures: A great place for weekend relaxation
summary: The opportunity to take photos with animals, leaving beautiful childhood memories

shortFeatures: Learn about the history of trains
summary: Harbin Middle East Railway Park is located in the section from Forest Street to Daxin Street in Daoli District. With the theme of related elements of Middle East Railway, it connects the south of the Yangtze River and the north of the Yangtze River. It is a good place for citizens to relax, sightseeing and keep fit. Here people can learn about the history of trains, feel the changes of the times and the development of science and technology. The park is divided into north and south districts. The southern district takes "Railway and City" as its theme, retains the traces of railway history, and forms a green living axis through the broken road network on the east side of the railway line, which perfectly combines railway culture and life. The theme of the North District is "Middle East Railway Culture Exhibition". Through Binzhou railway bridge, blockhouse, old railway station shape railway museum, station pavilion, railway track, steam locomotive and other Middle East railway buildings and facilities, as well as landscape walls, signs, sculptures and exhibition spaces, the development history of Middle East railway construction and Harbin urban development history are systematically displayed.

shortFeatures: National Grade II Museum
summary: Harbin Century Automobile History Museum is located in Shuangcheng City, Heilongjiang Province. It was built in 2007 with self-raised funds by Mr. Liu Bo, a member of the Shuangcheng CPPCC, a director of the World Classic Car Alliance, and a vice chairman of the China Classic Car Alliance. It took three years to build and covers an area of 7,000 square meters. With a building area of 3,800 square meters, it is the first professional classic car museum in China. The museum introduces the development process of automobiles by displaying more than 100 precious historical models. Its architectural style is characterized by the combination of East and West, elegance and modernity, with dignified and simple gray as the main tone, which makes visitors feel the attraction of tradition in the strong modern atmosphere.

Harbin Railway Museum is located at No.86 Xidazhi Street, nangang district, Harbin. It used to be the Workers' Cultural Palace, and the earliest was the Middle East Railway Club. Since its completion in December 1911, it has gone through 106 years of vicissitudes. I used to rehearse cultural programs and watch staff cultural performances here. At the end of last year, on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the establishment of Harbin Railway Bureau, it was transformed into a railway museum after the approval of the municipal government.

poiName: Heilongjiang Provincial Museum of Ethnic Groups
shortFeatures: Characteristic architecture of museum site in Qing Dynasty
summary: Heilongjiang Ethnic Museum was established in 1985 with Harbin Confucian Temple as its building. China's first provincial professional ethnic museum aims at collecting, researching and exhibiting Manchu, Mongolian, Hui, Korean, Hezhe, Oroqen, Ewenki, Daur, Xibe and Kirgiz nationalities in our province. These ethnic fish skin culture, birch skin culture, shaman culture, etc., all have strong national characteristics, are unique and charming. The basic exhibition of cultural relics of ethnic minorities in Heilongjiang Province mainly introduces the cultural relics of Manchu, Mongolian, Ewenki, Oroqen, Hezhe, Korean, Daur and Xibe nationalities in various aspects, such as production tools, living utensils, culture, religion and social life.

poiName: Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army Memorial Park
summary: "Northeast Anti-Union Memorial Park" is located in the core area of Sun Island Scenic Area. It is the largest anti-Japanese education and memorial base in Northeast China. With the sculpture of anti-alliance soldiers, lake water and green grass as the core scenic spots, the performance content is different from the solemn commemorative mode in the past. The keynote is undulating terrain, towering trees and winding flowing water, which indicates the anti-Japanese battlefield between white mountains and black waters. The theme sculptures, anti-alliance camps and boulders reflected in the blue sky constitute a historical picture of the fighting life of the anti-alliance.

tagNameList: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
summary: Relying on the bank of Majiagou River, Russian River Garden is built between Gogol Street and Guangguang Bridge. The river garden spans 108 meters and has 6,000 square meters of leisure and shopping space. On the basis of the Russian civil trade block, a number of water landscapes were built on the south bank of Fendou Bridge and Majiagou River, large-scale musical fountains and water curtain movies were built, and bars with different styles were built for tourists to relax and sightseeing. All the facades of buildings on both sides of the river have been decorated, and cultural sculptures embodying humanistic connotations, Russian-style colonnades and pavilions will be built around the river garden.

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
shortFeatures: Appreciate a variety of rare animals.
summary:
The Harbin Northern Forest Zoo is located in the Pigeon Cave area in the southeast of Acheng, Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province, close to National Highway 301, 43 kilometers from downtown Harbin, with convenient transportation. 

The zoo is home to more than twenty modern animal enclosures, including those for birds of prey, the Bird Language Forest, Monkey Mountain, the Primate House, the Medium-sized Carnivore House, and the Polar Animal House, as well as five large free-range areas for lions and tigers, deer, bears, wolves, and African animals. The unique isolation methods in the free-range areas bring people closer to the animals. The zoo showcases over 300 species of animals, with more than 50,000 individual animals, including rare species such as the white tiger, white lion, polar bear, African cheetah, and national first-class protected animals like the Siberian tiger, Asian elephant, white-lipped deer, and red-crowned crane. Additionally, there are nearly 300 antelope species introduced from Africa, forming a spectacular African animal free-range area.

tagNameList: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; City Parks
shortFeatures: A park and green space primarily for leisure and entertainment.
summary: Harbin Amusement Park is famous for its unique and novel attractions. Among them is the latest Sino-Japanese cooperative project—the giant Ferris wheel, the 19th tallest in the world and the 12th tallest in China, standing at 110 meters. Riding the Ferris wheel offers a breathtaking panoramic view of the beautiful "Little Paris of the East." The four major imported attractions include the "Fast Line Station," which lifts 24 meters into the air before diving and spiraling in rapid loops; the "Brave Turntable," which spins you at high altitudes for a thrilling experience; the "Arabian Flying Carpet," which rises 6.5 meters and performs a 360-degree horizontal loop; and the "Crazy Train," which delivers heart-stopping excitement with its 3D flips. The "Super Spaceship" takes you on a tour through space, while the "Raging Rapids" canoe lets you navigate through turbulent waters. The "Head-Shaking Flying Chairs" let you soar in the sky, and the "Thunderbolt Space Car" takes you on a journey through space. Other fun rides include the Disco Turntable, Bumper Cars, Gasoline Go-Karts, High-Flying Pedal Bikes, the Grand Carousel, Pirate Ship, and more, making it an unforgettable experience. In the leisure area, trees are abundant, the grass is lush, flowers are vibrant, and the water sparkles. The newly built free-fall ride in 2011 lifts riders 60 meters into the air before plummeting them down, offering a thrilling adventure through the ruins of the lost Mayan civilization.

Changqing Forest Farm is located in the east of Phoenix Mountain National Forest Park, in Longzhaogou Forest Management Area of Shanhetun Forestry Bureau, Wuchang City, Heilongjiang Province, 248KM away from Harbin, bordering Xuexiang, China in the southeast, Weihe Forestry Bureau in the north and Dongsheng Forest Farm.

Heilongjiang Provincial Library is located at No.216 Changjiang Road, nangang district, Harbin. It was founded in 1906 (the 32nd year of Guangxu in Qing Dynasty). It was formerly the library founded in Qiqihar by the Academic Affairs Office of Heilongjiang General Administration. Heilongjiang Library has a collection of more than 3.51 million volumes (pieces). Among them, there are more than 2.81 million books in Chinese and foreign languages; More than 130,000 ancient books; More than 330,000 copies of newspapers; More than 180,000 microforms; More than 20,000 audio-visual materials; The total amount of digital resources reaches 402.96 TB. Due to geographical relations, there are also a large number of Russian and Japanese materials; There are nearly 20,000 kinds of local documents in the collection, which reflect the geology and mineral landforms, property resources, industrial and agricultural production and local customs of Northeast China and the province.

poiName: Museum of the Imperial Palace of the Manchukuo
tagNameList: Exploration Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
shortFeatures: Puyi's Imperial Palace
summary:
· The Puppet Manchurian Imperial Palace Museum is established on the site of the former Puppet Manchurian Imperial Palace, where the last emperor, Aisin Gioro Puyi, resided as the puppet emperor of the Manchukuo state. It displays cultural relics such as the imperial car.  
· The palace is divided into the Outer Court for political activities and the Inner Court for daily life, which are now separately designated as the Manchukuo Palace Exhibition Hall and the Imperial Palace Exhibition Hall, with architectural landmarks including the Jixi Building, Zhonghe Gate, Huaiyuan Building, and Tongde Hall.  
· Part of the Imperial Palace has been designated as the Jilin Provincial Museum, showcasing historical materials of feudal dynasties established in Northeast China, such as Goguryeo, Balhae, Liao, and Jin.

Jingyuetan is named after its crescent shape, with a forest coverage rate of 96%. It is known as the sister pool of Sun Moon Lake in Taiwan Province and is known as "the largest artificial forest sea in Asia". 
The park has lush trees and fresh air. It is not only an ecological leisure center, but also a sports and fitness center, suitable for hiking, renting bicycles or go on road trip. 
In winter, it becomes a natural ice rink after freezing. There are many ice events, such as dog-pulled sled, ice cross-country motorcycles, etc., which are very eye-catching. 
There is also a large ski resort here, which is the venue of the annual China Changchun Ice and Snow Tourism Festival and Changchun Jingyuetan Vasa International Cross-Country Ski Festival.

tagNameList: Hi Fun Park; Kid's Treasure Spot; Film Studios
shortFeatures: A movie theme park with a rich variety of attractions.
summary:
- Changchun Movie Century City is a film and television theme park that integrates the most advanced special effects from around the world, and it can be regarded as the "Hollywood of the East."
- Built by drawing inspiration from the essence of Universal Studios and Disneyland in the United States, it features: 3D giant screens, 4D special effects, the world's first 5D cinema, laser suspension, dynamic domes, orthogonal multi-screens, and other special effect theaters.
- It boasts the world's largest screen, considered the greatest in the world, and is known as the "Giant Screen Cinema."

shortFeatures: The Cradle of New China's Film Industry
summary:
Changchun Film Studio is the first film studio in New China, the cradle of New China's film industry, and has created seven firsts in the history of New China's films. He has shot more than 900 story films and translated more than 1,000 films from various countries. 
The museum introduces the history of Changying, the films shot, the props used, and the stars that Changying went out. The content is very rich. 
A large number of outstanding works such as Five Golden Flowers, Shangganling, Heroic Sons and Daughters, Sister Liu and White-Haired Girl have influenced the growth of several generations.

tagNameList: Enjoy autumn leaves; Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A large city park with views all seasons
summary: Nanhu Park is the second largest urban park in China at present, second only to the Summer Palace in Beijing. It was called Huanglong Royal Park during the puppet Manchukuo period. Overlooking Nanhu Park from the air, you can clearly see its whole picture, which is shaped like a dumbbell, narrow from east to west and long from north to south. The lake in the park is clear, with green willows on the shore, curved bridges and pavilions, birds singing and flowers fragrant, and four distinct seasons, which is better than Jiangnan. If you stand on the Nanhu Bridge and look north against the railing, a colorful picture will appear in front of you, which looks like clusters of fluttering flowers blooming on the water. All kinds of bridge pavilions and pavilions are in charm with the lake and forest colors, which makes people linger.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; City Coordinates; Statues/Sculptures
shortFeatures: A Collection of World-Class Sculptures
summary:
-- Changchun World Sculpture Park is a modern urban sculpture park that integrates contemporary sculpture art, showcases various global sculpture styles, and blends natural landscapes with cultural scenery.  
-- The large group sculpture "Friendship • Peace • Spring," created by Ye Yushan, Pan He, Cheng Yunxian, Wang Keqing, and Cao Chunsheng, is exquisitely designed and spectacular in scale.  
-- The park features over 320 sculptures created by more than 270 sculptors from over 110 countries. These works include pieces reflecting Eskimo culture, Maya culture, Maori culture, Indian culture, and Eastern culture, as well as realistic, abstract, modern, and postmodern styles. These sculptures are diverse in style, meticulously carved, and are considered world-class masterpieces.  
-- The park is large and has many exhibits, so it's recommended to check the guide map at the service center first and plan your route.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Outdoor Skiing
shortFeatures: Tourist ski resorts in cities
summary:
Jingyuetan Ski Resort is located in Jingyuetan National Scenic Area in the southeast of Changchun City. It is surrounded by forests on three sides and water on one side, with a beautiful natural environment. 
The snow in the ski resort is soft and suitable for all kinds of skiers. There are five snow trails, which are divided into beginner, intermediate, advanced and cross-country snow trails. It also has a high-altitude cableway and a 1314-meter-long pipe rail slide, which is known as the world's first. 
In summer, you can also experience the ropeway in the ski resort, that is, take the ropeway up the mountain first, and then take the 1.6-kilometer-long pipe-rail slide down the mountain through layers of forest, which is quite exciting.

shortFeatures: Eight Institutions of Puppet Manchukuo
summary:
--The eight major departments of Puppet Manchukuo are the collective names of the eight ruling institutions of Puppet Manchukuo, namely, the Ministry of Public Security (Military Department), the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the Ministry of Communications, the Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Culture and Education, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of People's Livelihood. 
--Each building has different architectural styles, including magnificent buildings and elegant courtyards. These buildings form a complex of buildings centered on the Geological Palace.

poiName: Museum of the History of Northeast China's Occupation
shortFeatures: A special exhibition hall reflecting the history of the occupation
summary: --The Northeast Occupied History Exhibition Hall is a historical special exhibition hall integrating collection, exhibition and academic activities. This exhibition is the most authoritative, objective, comprehensive, novel and unique special large-scale exhibition in China at present, which reveals Japanese militarism's invasion of Northeast China and its bloody and cruel colonial rule.

shortFeatures: It used to be the capital square of Manchuria
summary:
--Cultural Square is the largest leisure square in Changchun. Historically, Geological Palace Square was once planned as the capital square of puppet Manchukuo. 
--The center of the square is the sunbird sculpture, the north is the open-air music scene, the vestibule square of the main building across the east-west main road, and the northernmost point is the main building of the Geological Palace. The whole square gives people a natural and solemn feeling.

tagNameList: Night Tour of Scenic Views; Botanical Gardens; Zoos; Nighttime sightseeing

summary:
- Changchun Botanical and Zoological Park, with its lush trees, rare birds and animals, exotic flowers and trees, and picturesque landscapes, offers a delightful environment that makes visitors linger. It is an excellent place for leisure, entertainment, and gatherings.
- The artificial lake divides the park into three natural areas: the eastern area features the Rare Birds and Animals Pavilion, which houses over 200 species of northern flora and fauna, known as a "miniature kingdom of nature"; the western area simulates the vertical distribution of plants with artificial soil mountains, and includes a miniature "Changbai Wilderness" scenic area; the northern part is home to the tropical botanical garden.
- The park is home to over 140 species of woody plants, including rare tree species such as the "Beauty Pine" native to Changbai Mountain, as well as plant viewing areas like the Flower Garden, Rose Garden, and Osmanthus Garden.
- From the high mountain in the western part of the park, visitors can enjoy a bird's-eye view of the entire park and the city center of Changchun.

Famous Buddhist Temple in Changchun
summary:
--Huguo Prajna Temple is the largest Buddhist temple in Changchun. The mountain gate of the temple is composed of three juxtaposed arches. The eaves and corners of the gatehouse are flying, strewn at random, and the construction is exquisite. The red wall on the side of the door is written with the six characters "Nanwu Amitabha Buddha". The halls in the temple stand towering and trees are shaded, which is spectacular. 
--The whole temple is three floors deep. The first floor is the Maitreya Hall, where the sitting statue of Maitreya Buddha is enshrined. There is a white marble tablet in front of the hall, and the inscription records the detailed process of building the temple. The second floor is the Daxiong Hall, which is the center of the whole temple and the largest building; The third floor is the Western Three Holy Temple, which is a two-story Xieshan-style building. The upstairs is the Tibetan Sutra Building, and the downstairs is dedicated to the three holy statues of Amitabha, Mahashizhi Bodhisattva and Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. 
--On the 8th, 18th and 28th day of the fourth lunar month, believers hold temple fairs here, and tens of thousands of people often come here for sightseeing. 
--Incense is strong, there is a place to invite incense in the temple, and there is a fortune teller at the door.

poiName: Former Site of the Manchukuo State Council
shortFeatures: The administrative central organ of the puppet Manchukuo
summary: It is the main building in the Puppet Eight Building Complex. It is located at No.2 Xinmin Street. It was founded in February 1933 and completed in 1936. It was originally the office building of the General Affairs Office and the Senate, and now it is the basic teaching building of Jilin University Medical College. In 1983, the pseudo site was announced as a key cultural relics protection unit in Jilin Province. Now it is one of the 126 national key points, Changchun Patriotism Education Base, and a national second-class key cultural relics protection unit. As the central organ of the puppet regime of Puppet Manchukuo, during the 40 years of the fall of Northeast China, the State Council of Puppet Manchukuo took control of the administrative affairs of Puppet Manchukuo and committed heinous crimes in serving Japanese militarism's invasion of Northeast China. The appearance of the former site shares the same "Xingya" style as the Japanese Parliament Building at the same time, and has historical, artistic and scientific values. The architectural design style imitates the Japanese parliament building. The whole building is in the shape of Sichuan, with a tower roof, and the roof is covered with smoky glazed tiles. There are gates in the north, south and west, with five floors on the ground and four floors on the two wings.

People's Square was built in 1933. It was originally built according to Howard's garden city theory and was named Datong Square. In 1945, the Soviet army entered Changchun and was renamed Stalin Square. In 1946, it was renamed Zhongzheng Square. After the liberation of Changchun, it was renamed People's Square. The center of the square was originally the horizontal origin of the puppet Manchukuo. During the Soviet occupation in 1945, the stone mark of the horizontal origin was destroyed, and the Soviet Red Army Martyrs Memorial Tower was built to commemorate 23 Soviet pilots who died for the liberation of Northeast China in the anti-fascist war.

shortFeatures: The garden is covered with famous flowers and trees and nebulae
summary: There are nebulae of famous flowers and precious trees all over the peony garden, including more than 10,000 peonies, more than 2,000 peonies, dahlias, thorny plums and other flowers. The fish pond in the park also stocks all kinds of ornamental fish in summer for visitors to enjoy. Pavilions and benches in the garden can be used for rest, and there are various shapes of strange stones for viewing. Every year, during the blooming season, the number of people visiting the garden reaches more than 100,000 every day.

shortFeatures: One of the famous historical and cultural streets in Jilin
summary: Changchun Xinmin Street is the first "famous Chinese historical and cultural street" in Jilin Province. It was the political center of the puppet Manchukuo period. Xinmin Street is not only the central axis of the Puppet Manchuria Palace, but also the "Central Avenue", the political center of the Puppet Manchuria capital. After its completion in 1933, it was named "Shuntian Street", which comes from the Bible "People should follow heaven"; In 1946, during the Kuomintang period, it was changed to "Minquan Street", which was named after Dr. Sun Yat-sen's Three People's Principles. After the founding of New China, it was changed to Xinmin Street and is still in use today. On both sides of the street, there are more than ten historical buildings standing, which are well preserved. It was rated as a historical and cultural block in Changchun.

shortFeatures: Octagonal thirteen-story solid dense eaves stupa
summary: In Changchun, there is an ancient pagoda, located at the two gates of Nong'an Town, Nong'an County, 70 kilometers northwest of Changchun. This is Nong'an Ancient Pagoda, also known as Stupa, Liao Pagoda and Golden Pagoda. Nong'an County is the seat of Huanglong Mansion in Jin Dynasty. The Liao and Jin Dynasties were the most prosperous period in history here, leaving behind many historical relics. The ancient pagoda of Liao Dynasty is the most representative ancient building. It was built in 983-1030 AD. It is made of solid bricks, with thirteen octagons and a height of nearly 40 meters. There are brick-carved bucket arches under the eaves, pot doors on eight sides, the tower body is divided layer by layer, and the treasure top plunges straight into the sky. The eaves of the tower fly layer by layer, and the wind chimes in the corner of the coffin are cong cong. The renovated King Kong Temple and buildings are strewn at random, simple and elegant, and unique. The famous sentence of Yue Fei, a famous anti-gold general, reached Huanglong Mansion and drank with all the armies. How many tourists have come to realize their long-cherished wish, and how many tourists have been drunk and peaceful.

poiName: Former Site of the Manchukuo Ministry of Military Affairs
tagNameList: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Xingya eclectic architecture
summary:
The predecessor of the Puppet Manchukuo Military Department was the Preparatory Office of the Military and Political Department in Shenyang. It was established in March 1932 and moved to Changchun in April of the same year. It actively cooperated with the Japanese aggressive forces and forcibly recruited soldiers. On July 1, 1937, the Police Department of the Puppet Military Affairs Ministry and the Puppet Civil Affairs Ministry merged and changed it into the Ministry of Public Security, promoting the doctrine of public security first (that is, suppressing anti-Japanese forces). In April, 1943, as the Japanese imperialist war of aggression went from bad to worse, the puppet public security department was changed to the military department, which was in charge of national defense, military affairs and military affairs, and the police department was changed to the police headquarters directly under the leadership of the puppet State Council. 
After the completion of the puppet military department building, it became the center of suppressing the anti-Japanese people by force, commanding the army, police, constitution and special forces in Northeast China to suppress the people and brutally encircle and suppress the anti-Japanese forces. 
In 1970, the building was built on one floor as a whole, and the top was changed to a Xieshan-style roof. The glazed tiles on the roof and cornice were changed to green, and the huge decorative relief pattern was added later, which further aggravated the existing contradictions of the building. 
The puppet Ministry of Public Security has been reorganized and renamed many times, and successively renamed the Ministry of Military Affairs and the Ministry of Military Affairs. The Puppet Military Political Department once built another consultant conference room, which is on the second floor and equipped with large and small conference rooms, entertainment, reading and other functional places. Brick and wood structure, local platforms are set on the facade to form a staggered architectural shape. The population canopy has a unique form, with arched doors on three sides, rough slate edges, and two slopes on the top. The roof is dark brown glazed tiles, and the cornice is made for free drainage. Other exterior wall finishes are plastered and brushed with cement mortar, and even three chimneys are used as a means of architectural composition.

summary: The head office of the Central Bank of Manchukuo is located at "No.501 Datong Street, Xinjing City" (now No.2219 Renmin Street, northwest of People's Square). It covers an area of 30,000 square meters and has a building area of 26,800 square meters. Construction began on April 22, 1934 and was completed on June 15, 1938. The original planned cost was 6 million Manchurian coins, but the actual expenditure was 10 million yuan. Steel consumes more than 5,000 tons. It is famous for its majesty, solemnity and firmness in architectural and financial circles. It has high artistic and historical value. Now it is the office and business place of financial institutions such as the People's Bank of China and Industrial and Commercial Bank of China. Important historical figures such as Pu Yi, Song Meiling, Jiang Jingguo, Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De, Soong Ching Ling and Panchen Lama have all visited this building, and it is still one of the tourist attractions in Changchun.

shortFeatures: Cultural ecological park with distinctive characteristics
summary: Changchun Water Purification Plant, once located at the intersection of Yatai Street and Jingshui Road, has become an important mark of Changchun's water supply culture because of its important responsibilities and precious industrial relics. After redesign and construction, Changchun Water Culture Ecological Park, a good place that gathers water culture elements so that people can better understand water, utilize water, treat water well and get close to water, will be born here.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Military organs during the War of Resistance against
summary:
"Xinjing" Headquarters: The former site is located at No.577 Xinfa Road, Kuancheng District, Changchun City, and is now used by Jilin Provincial Party Committee. In 1983, the former site of the Japanese Kwantung Army Command was announced by the Jilin Provincial People's Government as the third batch of provincial cultural relics protection units. The former site of the Japanese Kwantung Army Headquarters was designed and supervised by the Kwantung Army Management Department and constructed by the Dalin Group. Construction started in August 1932 and was completed in August 1934, with a cost of 1.7 million yuan. The former site has three floors on the theme, one floor underground, four floors on two wings and five floors on the tower, covering an area of 76,500 square meters and a building area of 13,424 square meters. The highest point of the building is 31.50 meters away from the ground. There are 221 rooms in the building, and the project cost is 1.7 million yuan. The whole project took two years, and the number of people working on the project reached 300,000. 
The Japanese Kwantung Army Command is the highest authority of the Japanese Kwantung Army. It moved from Shenyang to Changchun on October 30, 1932, and moved to the former site in 1934. On August 9, 1945, the Japanese Kwantung Army Headquarters moved to the Japanese Nanling Underground Command Office. 
After Japan surrendered unconditionally in August 1945, the Soviet General Headquarters in Northeast China was set up at the former site. From 1946 to October 1948, the Kuomintang New First Army and New Seventh Army headquarters were successively established here. After the liberation of Changchun in October 1948, the former site was used by the Chinese People's Liberation Army Space Ninth Aviation School. In 1955, the former site was placed under the use of Jilin Provincial Party Committee of China.

shortFeatures: Taste the Palaces and Cultural Relics of the Ming and Qing Dynasties.
summary:

· There are 114 ancient buildings, over 500 rooms, and numerous precious cultural relics from the Ming and Qing dynasties displayed in various exhibition halls, all well-preserved to this day.  
· The entire palace is imposing and magnificent, with every corner reflecting the grandeur of the royal family. Its unique architectural style of "high palaces and low halls" is unparalleled in Chinese palace architecture history.  
· There are two baggage storage areas and two service stations, located at the entrances of Daqingmen and Siwenmen.

- Inside the various buildings, there are photographs, wax figures, and various items once used by the Zhang father and son, showcasing their life trajectories.
- The luxurious mansion contains numerous stone carvings, wood carvings, brick carvings, murals, and many priceless calligraphic works by the Zhang family, all of which are well worth appreciating.

tagNameList: Historical buildings; City Parks; Historical Architectures

- Unlike other imperial tombs, Beiling is directly built on flat ground and is surrounded by a defensive wall, resembling a small city.
- The entire tomb complex is divided into three sections. The main structure is the archway at the front, and the rear section is the square city, which features a宝顶 (precious dome) that allows for a panoramic view of the entire Beiling area.
- During holidays and festivals, there are performances of traditional Qing cultural customs and sacrificial rites, making it a great opportunity to learn about Qing culture.

- The internationally top-tier large-scale MR Ride, the dinosaur resurrection disaster experience "Dinosaur Crisis," is definitely worth trying.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems: Enjoy Autumn Leaves; Botanical Gardens

summary:
- Built on the original site of Shenyang Botanical Garden, it hosted the World Horticultural Exposition in 2006, which remains the largest World Horticultural Exposition in terms of land area to date.  
- It features 53 domestic pavilions, 23 international pavilions, and 24 specialized exhibition areas, including themed gardens such as the Rose Garden, Rhododendron Garden, Peony and Herbaceous Peony Garden, Aquatic Plant Garden, and the Plant Specimen Museum.  
- During the construction of the Shenyang Expo Garden, many design concepts and construction techniques were used for the first time, such as the three-layer laminated glass bridge deck, the tilted tower in the shape of a phoenix wing, and the Lily Tower, which is the largest sculptural building in China.  
- The most vibrant time for flowers to bloom is from April to October, which is also the best period for flower viewing and sightseeing. Each month, different flower exhibitions are held, such as the Tulip Exhibition in April-May and the Blue-themed Flower Exhibition in August, attracting many tourists.

shortFeatures: The collection includes numerous historical and artistic artifacts.
summary: The Liaoning Provincial Museum is the best place to learn about the history of the provincial capital. As one of China's large art and history museums, it houses national treasures such as the Shang Dynasty bronze ding with a beast face and taotie pattern, and a duck-shaped zun from the Western Zhou Dynasty. Visitors can also explore exhibits of ancient ethnic relics unique to the Liao River culture, such as those of the Khitan, Manchu, and Xianbei peoples, as well as occasional temporary exhibitions of precious treasures, such as the Tang Dynasty painting "Lady with Hairpin" (簪花仕女图), the only surviving wild cursive work by the great Tang calligrapher Zhang Xu, "Four Poems in Cursive Script" (古诗四帖), Ouyang Xun's "Dream Dedication" (梦奠帖), and Zhao Ji (Emperor Huizong of the Song Dynasty)'s "Auspicious Cranes" (瑞鹤图). Each of these is sure to bring you surprises and insights.

tagNameList: Close to nature; A hidden gem for walking kids; Mountains
shortFeatures: A scenic destination with beautiful landscapes in all four seasons.
summary:
· Chessboard Mountain is part of the Changbai Mountain Hada Mountain Range. It is named after a stone on the mountain that is engraved with a chessboard pattern. The area consists of Chessboard Mountain, Hui Mountain, Dayang Mountain, and Xiu Lake, collectively known as the "Three Mountains and One Water."

· The scenic area features a harmonious blend of mountains and waters, with lush trees. In summer, visitors can enjoy lotus flowers, while autumn is perfect for capturing the beauty of maple leaves. At the summit, there is a Pavilion for Viewing the Lake. From the pavilion, visitors can enjoy a panoramic view of the surrounding landscapes.

· A cable car and slideway have been built on Chessboard Mountain, with a round trip taking 20 minutes. Visitors can experience a variety of activities, including hiking, alpine speed skiing, outdoor CS games, and picnicking.

· Every winter, the "Chessboard Mountain Ice and Snow World" becomes a paradise for ice sculpture viewing and snow activities like skiing. The scenic area also has other attractions such as the Northeast China Film and Television City, making it a very interesting destination.

shortFeatures: Reappear the development history of Northeast financial industry
summary: Shenyang Financial Museum is located on the east side of Zhang's Shuai Mansion. It was originally the private bank of Zhang's father and son-Bianye Bank, which is the largest museum of its kind in China. The museum, founded in 1930, not only has various original exhibition rooms, but also has a number of exhibition areas to introduce the history of financial development. It collects currencies from all over the world, and is a good place to know about currency and history. In the hall of the museum, wax figures of people are used to simulate the real work scene of the bank in those days. When you look at it, you will be frightened by these statues, and you have the illusion of being in "Wonderful Night in the Museum".

shortFeatures: Experience the Wonder of Easy Uphill and Strenuous Downhill
summary:
- The "Strange Slope" is a unique scenic spot in Shenyang, discovered in April 1990. It is a slope 80 meters long and about 15 meters wide, with a west-to-east descending gradient.
- The most magical aspect is that when a car is turned off and parked, it will automatically slide uphill. The effect is even more noticeable when riding a bicycle.
- It has now become part of a large scenic area, which also includes natural and cultural attractions such as Xiang Mountain, Wengding, and the Strange Slope.
- The Strange Slope Scenic Area holds a major locust flower festival every year in late May. If you visit during this time, you can witness the spectacular "June Snow" scenery.

shortFeatures: Reproduce the life scene of Zhang Xueliang and his wife
summary: Zhao Yidi's former residence is commonly known as Miss Zhao Si Building. Miss Zhao Si is Zhang Xueliang's second wife, who has been with Zhang Xueliang for 72 years all her life. She is a mysterious woman in modern Chinese history. The whole former residence is quiet and elegant, small and exquisite, and it belongs to the typical European aristocratic style, which truly restores the living situation of General Zhang Xueliang and Ms. Zhao Yidi at the beginning. Compared with the exquisiteness of Zhao Yidi's former residence, what touches tourists more is the touching love story between Zhao Yidi and Zhang Xueliang. Those who like the history of the Republic of China and envy this legendary life must not miss this place.

shortFeatures: Has hosted many celebrity concerts
summary: The Shenyang Olympic Sports Center project is a three-hall layout, with "one" as the main stadium; The "three halls" are comprehensive gymnasium, swimming pool and tennis hall. The main stadium is the top priority in the construction of the Olympic Sports Center. The main stadium of the Olympic Sports Center has a building area of 140,000 square meters, accounting for more than half of the total area of the Olympic Sports Center. After completion, 60,000 spectators can watch the game in the stadium at the same time.

shortFeatures: It was once an important palace in Nurhachi
summary:
Dazheng Hall, commonly known as the Octagonal Hall, is an important palace built by Nurhachi, the emperor of the Qing Dynasty, and the most solemn and sacred place in Shengjing Palace. 
Dazheng Hall is a unique octagonal ancient imperial building in China. Two dragons are carved on the two pillars in front of the hall. There are exquisite Sanskrit ceilings and dragon-descending caissons in the hall, which are magnificent. 
This hall is the place where Emperor Taizong Huang Taiji of the Qing Dynasty held major ceremonies and important political activities. In 1644 (the first year of Shunzhi), Emperor Fulin ascended the throne here.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Ice and Snow Park; Outdoor Skiing
shortFeatures: Winter ice and snow resort
summary: Qipanshan Ski Resort is divided into the south area and the north area. The south area is mainly an alpine ski area, equipped with multiple ski trails, two traction ski ropeways and a 1016-meter alpine tube-rail slide. For beginners and children, it is safer to choose short track ski driving range and children's ski driving range. The north area is mainly a skating area, with a 400-meter-long international standard ring skating rink, which is suitable for skating enthusiasts and professional skiers to compete. In addition, if you take children to play, you can go to the Ice Children's Amusement City and racetrack in the North District to experience all kinds of interesting animal sledge projects. For adult tourists, you can rent a variety of amusement equipment such as snowmobiles and go-karts to enjoy the surging passion of flying in the snow. But be sure to pay attention to safety when playing, otherwise you will fall badly. Besides entertainment projects, there are many snow sculptures and ice sculptures in the Ice and Snow World. When skiing, you can take the alpine cableway cable car to the starting point of the mountain, and at the same time, you can climb to enjoy the northern scenery covered with snow and ice pine forest. The Ice and Snow World is open to night skiing, so skiers may wish to experience a different ski resort experience from that during the day.

tagNameList: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Kid-Friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
shortFeatures: Understanding the Development of China's Industrial Civilization
summary: The China Industrial Museum is located in Shenyang, the largest city in Northeast China and one of the six regional center cities of the country. Shenyang is known as the "Eldest Son of the Republic" and the "Eastern Ruhr." It is the largest industrial center city in China and Northeast Asia. The museum opened on May 18, 2012, on International Museum Day. It currently has the Machine Tool Hall, Foundry Hall, General History Hall, and the Ten-Year Hall of the Tiexi New District, among others. The museum covers a total area of 80,000 square meters, with a building area of 60,000 square meters. The China Industrial Museum's collection includes relics from more than 20 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities, as well as the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, including one national-level first-class cultural relic, ten national-level second- and third-class relics. Currently, the museum holds over 1,300 physical artifacts.

shortFeatures: Collecting nearly 10,000 Neolithic relics
summary: Xinle Site is a Neolithic matriarchal clan settlement site. There are three layers of cultural accumulation in the site: upper, middle and lower, and the upper culture is mainly represented by plain pottery, pottery and pottery. Middle-level culture, mainly represented by grinding stone axes. The lower-level culture is mainly represented by making stone tools and embossing deep-belly jars with zigzag patterns, which have rich cultural connotations and distinctive local characteristics. Among them, the "woodcarving bird" collected at the lower level is a treasure of Chinese woodcarving art and a typical representative of Xinle culture. In Xinle Site Museum, you can not only learn about Shenyang's "indigenous" Xinle people, but also experience the life of primitive people and increase your knowledge.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Outdoor Skiing

summary:
· Shenyang Northeast Asia Ski Resort is located in Shenyang National Forest Park in Magang Township, Xinchengzi District, Shenyang City, 28 kilometers away from downtown Shenyang. It is the largest ski resort with the most snowy trails in Liaoning Province. 
The snow resort has built eight snow trails for high, middle, primary, children and teaching. The total length of the snow trails is 8,000 meters, and the slope of the snow trails is between 4 and 30 degrees. The curvature is appropriate, safe and comfortable. 
· The newly-built 2,200-square-meter ski hall has sound service facilities and a large parking lot at the back. After the renovation and expansion, the snow resort has reasonable design, perfect facilities, multi-level snow trails, rich content and human service.

The Brilliance BMW Tiexi Plant is the 25th factory of the BMW Group globally, located in the Economic and Technological Development Zone of Shenyang, Liaoning Province. Construction began in June 2010, and trial production started in October 2011. Brilliance BMW completed the project in just 16 months—China's speed, Germany's quality, and a miraculous construction timeline for BMW plants. The Tiexi plant operates with a unified phased construction approach. The first phase has an annual production capacity of 100,000 units, and the mid-term capacity is 200,000 units annually.

The Brilliance BMW Tiexi Plant is one of the most advanced and sustainable automobile factories in China. Covering an area of over 2 square kilometers, the plant features the four main processes of modern automotive manufacturing. Currently, the Tiexi plant produces the BMW 3 Series (including both standard and long wheelbase versions), BMW 2 Series Touring, BMW 1 Series Sports Sedan, the all-new BMW X1, the hybrid BMW X1, and the self-owned brand ZINORO.

In February 2017, after an evaluation by the Liaoning Provincial Tourism Scenic Spot Quality Rating Committee, the Brilliance BMW Tiexi Plant was officially approved as a national AAAA-level tourist attraction, becoming the first and only automobile manufacturing plant in China to receive this honor, setting a benchmark for industrial tourism projects.

**Environmental Concept**  
To achieve sustainable development, the Tiexi plant is designed with high environmental standards, incorporating more than sixty energy-saving and emission-reducing measures. It is one of the three most sustainable BMW plants, alongside the Spartanburg plant in the U.S. and the Leipzig plant in Germany. The environmental concepts are applied throughout the factory:
- A 2-kilometer-long "Energy Tunnel" was completed early in the construction, centralizing electrical, water supply, heating, and ventilation systems in one tunnel, saving significant labor, materials, and financial resources for future plant expansions.
- The main factory building uses a single-roof design and walls made from easy-to-install thermal insulation materials, which regulate indoor temperatures and facilitate future expansions.
- The plant uses natural ventilation and utilizes groundwater for temperature regulation, greatly reducing electricity consumption.
- Lighting is provided by natural light from the roof and adjustable intelligent lighting systems.
- The Skywalk design completely separates pedestrian traffic from logistics.
- The specialized wastewater treatment system significantly reduces industrial wastewater pollution, and the plant also has facilities for recycling waste.

**Beauty of Technology**  
The Tiexi plant is equipped with advanced stamping, body, painting, and final assembly workshops, offering the public a rare opportunity to get close to advanced automotive manufacturing technology:
- **Stamping workshop**: Steel sheets are expertly shaped with high-speed, efficient, precise, and environmentally friendly stamping production lines.
- **Body workshop**: A futuristic world "dominated" by robots, the birthplace of high-precision bodywork.
- **Painting workshop**: Ensures a perfect paint finish with innovative technologies that set an example for energy efficiency.
- **Final assembly workshop**: Spacious, comfortable, and ergonomic, highlighting individuality.

**Interactive Experience**  
The main office building of the Tiexi plant is designed with a dynamic layout. Upon entering, visitors can observe colorful car bodies moving from the painting workshop, through a conveyor system, to the final assembly workshop via the second floor of the office building. The entire transport process is "silent" and "pollution-free," allowing visitors to experience the vibrant energy of the modern factory. The open-design office building also features a unique multifunctional area, cultural display zone, and other spaces, providing employees with a spacious, comfortable, and human-centric working environment.

To provide a comfortable and enjoyable environment for employees and visitors, the factory is equipped with a restaurant, medical center, fitness center, café, and art exhibition areas, fully reflecting BMW's human-centered brand philosophy.

At the same time, a digitalized visitor experience developed by Brilliance BMW’s IT department offers a more convenient and unique tour experience. The factory tour app allows for online reservations, seamless entry with facial recognition technology, self-service entry, online payments, precise point-based information push via LBS technology, and visitor satisfaction surveys.

shortFeatures: Entering Liaoning's three billion-year geological river
summary: It is the largest paleontological museum in China so far. The architectural appearance looks like a clever fusion of a huge geological body and a giant dinosaur: faults cut the geological body vertically, and volcanic lava flows from top to bottom, taking us into Liaoning's more than 3 billion years of geological history. The long river of billion years. The arched building on the south side represents the body of the huge dinosaur in Liaoning, the steel frame in the middle represents the dinosaur spine, the ribs of the dinosaur on both sides, and the sphere is the dinosaur egg. The steel frame of 21 dinosaur ribs symbolizes the tall and straight body of Liaoning people in the 21st century, indicating a bright future for Liaoning. The Museum is mainly scientific, focusing on displaying the origin and evolution of life in the geohistory period, and focusing on introducing the "Top Ten Paleontological Groups" in Liaoning in the past 3 billion years. It has distinctive international characteristics. The museum has 8 exhibition halls and 16 exhibition areas. Hall 3 introduces the "Top Ten Paleontological Groups in Liaoning" in the past 3 billion years, among which the early life of Anshan Group, Yanliao Biota, Jehol Biota and ancient humans in Liaoning are the four "bright spots". Hall 4 introduces the world-famous "Jehol Biota" and takes you into the wonderful prehistoric world such as "Dinosaur Kingdom", "Ancient Bird World" and "Cradle of Flowers" in western Liaoning more than 100 million years ago. The 8th hall is the magnificent "Liaoning Large Dinosaur Hall". Eight large dinosaurs produced in Liaoning collectively "appeared" for the first time. Among them, the 15-meter-long "Liaoning Dragon" is the latest achievement discovered and researched by our museum for the first time, and it is also the first time to meet the audience in China and the world.

shortFeatures: Imitation Roman architecture in Zhang's handsome mansion
summary: Daqinglou is the landmark building of Zhang's handsome mansion. It was built near Shengjing Road in Shenyang from 1918 to 1922. It is an imitation Roman building. Because the building is made of blue bricks, it is called Daqinglou. With a total construction area of 2,460 square meters and a building height of 37 meters, it is one of the highest points of the popular Four Fengtian City. The whole building is magnificent, with vivid external three-dimensional relief shapes and exquisite craftsmanship. The stroke decoration skills of the main rooms inside are unique, which has high artistic value. Daqinglou can be called a classic of northeast architecture in the Republic of China. On the south door of the rockery, there is a plaque of "Heaven's Justice and People's Heart" written by Zhang Zuolin, and on the north side, there is a plaque of "Prudence". There are pavilions and stone steps on the mountain, surrounded by phoenix trees and saponaria trees. The rockery gate is facing the main entrance of Daqinglou, which is built under Zhang Zuolin's personal command and has a defensive effect.

Eight Banners + Left and Right Yiwang Pavilions, a total of ten rooms, are distributed in the shape of "eight", which is the reflection of Manchu Eight Banners system in palace architecture. The arrangement order is based on the theory of Yin-Yang and Five Elements of Han nationality, with two yellows in the north, two blues in the south, two reds in the west and two whites in the east. 
These pavilions and Dazheng Hall form a group of courtyards on East Road, which are an important part of the temple architecture in Nurhachi period. There are different exhibitions, including the Eight Banners system, various military weapons, etc.

poiName: The Former Site of the Russo-Japanese Prison Museum
tagNameList: Museum; Venue Exhibition Hall; Military Sites
summary: The Lushun Russo-Japanese Prison was first constructed by Russia in 1902 and expanded by Japan in 1907. The prison occupies an area of 26,000 square meters within its walls, with 275 cells, 15 workshops, and the capacity to hold over 2,000 prisoners at the same time. Outside the prison walls, there were forced labor sites, such as kilns, forests, orchards, and vegetable fields. The total area is approximately 226,000 square meters. Anti-war and peace activists from countries like China and Korea were imprisoned and massacred here. In August 1945, with Japan's defeat and surrender, the prison was dismantled.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches
shortFeatures: A wide and long natural bathing beach
summary:
Located in the middle of Jinshitan, with a total length of 10 miles, it is the largest natural bathing beach in Northeast China. Its biggest feature is that the beach is wide and long. 
· You can experience motorboat, beach motorcycle, windsurfing, beach volleyball, beach football and other entertainment projects on the beach. 
· The best time for sunbathing and sea bathing is from July to September every year, in which a month-long international beach culture festival is held in July every year.

· Fujiazhuang Bathing Beach is 550 meters long, with wide beaches, gentle slopes and fine sand, clean sea water, clear water and flat waves, and complete bathing service facilities. It is one of the four major bathing beaches in Dalian. 
The surrounding bathing beach is surrounded by mountains, islands, reefs and forests, and the environment is quiet and beautiful. It is the main seaside resort area in Dalian, with many hotels and resort villages. 
There are also a wealth of water entertainment projects at sea. There are many rental umbrellas and recliners on Fujiazhuang Beach, which is a good choice for parent-child travel.

shortFeatures: Japanese style characteristic neighborhood
summary:
Japanese Style Street, also known as Nanshan Tourist Style Street by Dalian people, is located in the prime location of Dalian. The street is about 700 meters long and has more than 120 villas of different styles. 
· There are also Japanese restaurants, hotels, tea ceremony halls, flower shops, bookstores, coffee shops, etc. on both sides of the street, all of which are leisure places operated and managed according to Japanese planning concepts. 
When you come to Japan Style Street, you can not only learn about the history of Dalian's urban development, but also feel the strong Japanese cultural atmosphere.

shortFeatures: Watch the flag-raising ceremony
summary:
Located opposite the Dalian Municipal Government, the east and west are the Public Security Bureau, the Court and the Procuratorate respectively. It is the political center of Dalian and one of the landmarks. 
· You can watch the flag raising and lowering in the morning and evening, and there is a beautiful musical fountain to enjoy 
Usually, this is a leisure place for citizens. You can come here for a walk, fly kites and feed square pigeons. 
· The large musical fountain in the square will sound with the music in the square. The 6-meter-high water curtain of the musical fountain poures down, which is very beautiful.

tagNameList: Seaside beach; City Parks; Beaches; Seashores
shortFeatures: One of the four major bathing beaches in Dalian
summary:
Located in the middle of Dalian Seaside Scenic Area, the park covers an area of 400,000 square meters, including Fujiazhuang Bathing Beach, one of the four major bathing beaches in Dalian. 
It is very popular among locals. Every summer, many people come to Fujiazhuang. The water here is clear and it is a cobblestone beach. 
It's very pleasant to set up a tent and have a barbecue at the seaside of Fujiazhuang.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
shortFeatures: A museum shaped like a shell
summary: The Shell Museum, located in the southeast corner of Xinghai Square in Dalian, is the shell museum with the largest number of exhibits in Asia. There are more than 5,000 kinds of rare marine shells from all over the world on display here. When you visit the museum, you will be amazed by all kinds of shells here. Some shells weigh hundreds of pounds, while others are only tiny. I believe you will not be disappointed when you visit the museum.

shortFeatures: A group of black reefs formed one billion years ago
summary:
Heishijiao Park is a famous karst landscape, formed about 1 billion years ago, and it is the nearest geological attraction to the center of Dalian. 
At high tide, Black Rock Reef looms, and from time to time it is submerged by the deep blue sea water; At low tide, Blackstone Reef stands on the beach again, quietly gazing at this mysterious sea... 
Coming to the park may bring some small surprises. Many people pick up conches and catch sea crabs here. There is also a unique natural museum near the park, which is also a good place to take photos. After visiting the park, you can also taste some special snacks in the snack street next to it, which is cost-effective and authentic in taste.

shortFeatures: The specimens of plants, animals, and fossils are very abundant.
summary:
The Dalian Natural History Museum, established in 1907, is a natural science museum that combines collections and exhibitions of geology, paleontology, animal, and plant specimens. It currently mainly showcases marine biological specimens and dinosaur fossils. 

The museum has 12 exhibition halls, including those dedicated to Earth, dinosaurs, marine life, wetlands, and more. The most eye-catching exhibit is the dinosaur fossils in the dinosaur hall, which also features a 40-meter-long panoramic painting and ecological models of dinosaurs.
