These displays illustrate the entire process of dinosaur emergence, development, and extinction, offering visitors both expanded knowledge and a deeper understanding.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Enjoy the fountain performance of sound, light and water
summary: The Music Fountain Square in Donggang Business District is adjacent to Dalian Port Jetty Wharf in the west and International Yacht Port in the east, echoing Dalian International Convention Center. It is a landmark square in Donggang Business District and even Dalian. Looking down from the air, the outline of the whole square resembles a flying seagull, which is the shape radiated from the international conference center designed according to the Austrian blue sky combination, so as to fully demonstrate the romantic and enterprising marine culture, colorful coastal scenery and green and modern development theme.

shortFeatures: Binhai Wedding Theme Park
summary:
Bird's Nest Ridge is located in the middle section of Binhai Road in Dalian. It is named after some black swallows often fly here to build nests. 
The coastal landform here is well developed, and the shore wall formed after the tensile fracture is cut straight into the seabed, and the landscape is very peculiar. 
· The path up and down the mountain leads to seclusion. Walking on it, there is the sea on one side and the mountain on the other, which can be described as between mountains and seas. 
Standing on Bird's Nest Ridge, you can see the magnificent scenery of Laohutan, Beidaqiao and Shicao Village in the east, and the beautiful sea and sky of Fujiazhuang and East and West Dalian Island in the west.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
shortFeatures: Collection of Millennium Xinjiang Mummies
summary: Lushun Museum is a merger of the former Lushun Zoo, Lushun Botanical Garden and Lushun Museum. It was founded in 1917 and is now a historical and artistic museum in Dalian. There are nearly 100,000 collections in the museum, including bronzes, Xinjiang cultural relics, ceramics and other fine works, as well as some rare foreign cultural relics. Among them, Indian Gandhara stone carvings are the only collection in China at present, which is very interesting. At the same time, Lushun Museum is also one of the largest garden museums in China. There are many precious trees in the museum, and many national leaders have visited it successively.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Bridges
shortFeatures: "Lover's Bridge" symbolizing long-lasting love
summary:
· Located between Laohutan and Bird's Nest Ridge, it is a dry bridge offshore to the mountains and across the valley, and it is also the hub running through the entire east-west Binhai Road. 
· Completed in 1987, it has a total length of 230 meters and a bridge width of 12 meters. It is magnificent. Enjoy the scenery from the walking trails on either side of the bridge with excellent views. 
The North Bridge was built to commemorate the sister city between Dalian and Kitakyushu, Japan, and now it is also the location for many newlyweds to take wedding photos. 
It is said that the love of couples who walk on the bridge together will last forever. You might as well take your him or her and try it.

shortFeatures: Rich in Ezo scallops
summary: Guanglu Island is located in the west of Changshan Island outside Changhai County, Dalian, and in the north of the Yellow Sea. It is composed of 23 large islands, mounds and reefs, and is the largest island in Changshan Islands. Guanglu Island is adjacent to Dalian Jinshitan National Tourism Resort in the west, and faces Pikou, Dengsha River and other important towns in southern Liaoning across the sea in the north. It is the nearest island to Dalian in Changshan Islands and is known as the "Gateway to Dalian". Guanglu Island has a bathing beach with clean water and clean sand, Xiaozhushan cultural site, which represents the history of human development in Dalian, Mazu Temple built in Ming Dynasty and mysterious fairy cave. Its unique sea erosion landscape, astronomical historical landscape, fairy lake, golden beach, moon bay, rainbow beach and other scenic spots also make tourists forget to leave. Guanglu Island has a vast sea area and rich specialty products, producing ginseng, shrimp, shellfish, algae and other seafood. The island's specialty "Yezo Scallop" is the best among scallops. In addition, Guanglu Island has fertile soil and abundant fresh water resources, making it the island with the most fresh water among many islands in Changhai County.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
shortFeatures: Flower viewing resorts in Dalian city
summary: Labor Park is the largest modern urban garden with European style in Dalian, which integrates sightseeing, amusement, rest and cultural activities. Known as "the symbol of Dalian", a large football architecture art museum is located in the park. Labor Park organically combines cheerful and transparent gardening techniques with China's refined and delicate gardening techniques, which makes people linger. At the same time, the modern amusement park with advanced equipment and large scale will bring endless fun to tourists.

tagNameList: Climbing and Hiking; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; National Parks
shortFeatures: Shifeng peaks rise sharply, with lush trees providing ample shade.
summary: Dahai Mountain, originally named Dahe Mountain and Tiger Mountain, was called by the ancients as "the most scenic spot in the southeast corner of Liaozuo." Dahai Mountain is magnificent in scale, with towering ancient trees on its slopes. It is home to many famous historical sites, such as Xiangshui Temple, Chaoyang Temple, and Shengshui Temple, and is known as the top scenic spot in southern Liaoning, attracting countless visitors.

shortFeatures: An island with beautiful scenery and the shape of an ingot
summary: Haxian Island is located six nautical miles southwest of Dachangshan Island, Changhai County, Dalian. It is an administrative village belonging to Dachangshan Island Town. It is located in the north of the Yellow Sea, opposite Seri Island in the east and Guanglu Island in the southwest. The island has a land area of about 4.72 square kilometers and a coastline of about 14.3 kilometers. It is the eighth largest island in Changhai. Haxian Island is about 4.84 kilometers long and 1.02 kilometers wide, and it is shaped like an ingot. On Haxian Island, two Elephant Trunk Mountain and Dawang Mountain, which are above 100 meters above sea level, are separated at the east and west ends. The mountains are lush with forests and rich vegetation, with shrubs such as pine, tussah, locust, wild chestnut and pepper, and wild vines and climbing plants intermingled. Wild flowers are constantly blooming all the year round, including winter jasmine (locally called monk's head flower), yellow flowers and other wild flowers. In autumn, there are wild chrysanthemums all over the mountains, red bean fruits and red wild vines all over cliffs. The south side of Haxian Island is semi-surrounded by sea-eroded rocks, reefs and caves, with a peculiar landform.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Bus sightseeing; Bus Tours
shortFeatures: Feel the romantic vicissitudes of a century ago
summary:
· The history of trams in Dalian began in 1909, and Dalian is the only city in mainland China whose tram history has never been interrupted. 
There are still two tram bus lines, No.201 and No.202. You can feel the urban charm of Dalian along the road. 
· The tram has a simple appearance, and the distinctive wooden interior can still be seen in the carriage. It travels slowly in the central city of Dalian. 
The current tram lines in Dalian are 201 and 202, and you can choose according to your own lines.

shortFeatures: There are hundreds of bird species stocked in the forest
summary: The most beautiful thing is the bird singing forest, which is a deep stream path. The stream trickles down, the secluded path seeks the mountain up, walks among green trees and red flowers, and hundreds of birds sing their companions. Red ibis, flamingo, gray-crowned crane, hornbill, black swan and other characteristic rare birds gather here. Wonderful performances such as peacock flying southeast, golden eagle hunting, pelican gatekeeping, etc. will make you linger, and various parrot performances in "Parrot Theater" will also add color to your parent-child trip.

The Dalian Museum is located on the north side of Xinghai Square in Shahekou District, Dalian. It is a uniquely designed modern building that displays a large number of historical and military artifacts, with rich images and textual descriptions. The exhibits present a century of changes in Dalian from multiple perspectives, including history, urban development, and economy. The museum consists of four floors above ground and one underground level. There are free guided tours available at scheduled times. If you wish to gain a deeper understanding of Dalian's history, it is recommended to follow a guide. The first floor is a temporary exhibition hall, often showcasing works of famous calligraphy and painting. The third floor features a science exhibition on nuclear power and environmental protection. The fourth floor also hosts temporary exhibits, frequently changing their themes. The second floor is the main exhibition hall, which displays nearly a century of Dalian's history and urban development. The main exhibits are divided into four themes: "Cityscape," "Thriving Economy," "Romantic City," and "A Century in Retrospect," as well as a special exhibition on "Modern Dalian." Visitors can see historical artifacts such as the Beiyang Navy Monument and the gate of the Navy Office from the First Sino-Japanese War, as well as Russian naval mines from the Russo-Japanese War, and learn about the city's contemporary urban development.

tagNameList: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Film Studios
shortFeatures: Revisiting the classic scenes in film and television dramas
summary: Located in Sanliqiao Village, Lushunkou District, Dalian, it was designed and built in July 2008 and completed in October 2008. The total planned area is 1.8 square kilometers, of which the shooting area of the film and television city is 3.8 square meters and the building area is 20,000 square meters.

shortFeatures: A charming sea town
summary: Dachangshan Island is located in the middle of Changshan Islands in Changhai County, Dalian, and is the seat of Changhai County Government. Dachangshan Island is named after its long and mountainous island. The coast of the island is tortuous, the bays are linked, and there are many natural and cultural landscapes. There is a garden around the sea on Dachangshan Island. The architecture combines European and Northeast Asian styles, and it is a charming sea town. Dachangshan Island Tourist Scenic Spot consists of 28 islands including Dachangshan Island, Haxian Island and Seri Island. Looking at Dachangshan Island from a distance, such as a dragon lying on the waves, the dragon's head is slightly raised, and the middle is the wriggling dragon's body; Jinchan Tuo in Jinchan Port and Yuanyang Tuo in Yuanyang Port on the island are also vivid. At the southern end of Dachangshan Island, there is the Prayer Garden, which is dedicated to the patron saint of fishermen's hearts-Poseidon. The Empress of the Sea God held high the lotus lantern and gazed kindly at the sea area hundreds of miles ahead, ensuring the peace of hundreds of boats and blessing the peace of all people. Every year, the 13th day of the first month is the birthday of the empress of the sea god. Men, women and children come out of the city, burning incense and kowtowing with blessings and prayers. Thousands of sea lanterns are put into the sea, drifting with the tide, flickering. Sanyuan Palace is a newly built building on the island. Standing at the gate of Sanyuan Palace, it faces the vast sea and is backed by lush green hills. The scenery is quite beautiful. There are Yinniuwan Tourist Area in the east of Dachangshan Island Scenic Area, Beihai Bathing Beach in the north-central part, Huanhai Park, Sanyuan Palace and Shuangfeng Chaoyang Tower in the middle part, and "Sea People" Resort, Yuanyang Bay Resort and Shoudao Jiandao Memorial Park in the west. There are many fishermen's music on Dachangshan Island and Haxian Island.

Baiyushan Pagoda was originally known as Biaozhong Pagoda, but later renamed Baiyu Pagoda, Baiyushan Pagoda. It was built in June 1907 and completed in November 1909. The overall shape is round, like a candle, and the tower body has an iron spiral ladder to climb to the top of the tower. The tower is 66 meters high and the top of the tower is 9 meters high. A bronze medal is embedded on the top of the tower, and the inscription of the tower is cast on the bronze medal.

shortFeatures: Famous for the flying dragon sculpture in the center of the square
summary: The square is located at the entrance of the northeast section of Binhai Road and the north entrance of Haizhiyun Park. Echoing Xinghai Square. In the center of the square, there are five sculptures with white steel pipes with different curvatures as the main body. 21 flying seagulls symbolize flying to the 21st century. 50 spheres of different sizes represent the atomic structure and symbolize the 50th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is like a leaping dragon, and its title is "Rhyme of the Sea". The sculpture square is all made of modern building materials such as cast steel, stainless steel and granite. Make the square appear modern atmosphere, lively, rhythmic and full of natural interest.

shortFeatures: Adhering to the architectural style of royal monasteries in Ming and Qing
summary:
Hengshan Temple is located in Hengshan North Putuo Scenic Area, Dashidong, Longwangtang, Lushunkou District, Dalian, covering an area of 20,000 square meters, with a building area of 12,000 square meters. It is the largest Buddhist temple in the north of the Yangtze River in China. The temple is adjacent to the main peak of Hengshan Mountain in the north, and the three peaks are connected on the same line. The middle peak is slightly protruding, and the two peaks are flush, which is very similar to the ancient gold ingot shape and more like the big-bellied Maitreya Buddha statue. It can really be described as the shape of a mountain, and the Buddha's fate is given by heaven. 
Hengshan has a long history and a profound cultural heritage. The Yuan Dynasty flourished in the Ming and Qing Dynasties, and it rose and fell several times, and was later destroyed by war. Reconstruction began in 2003 and was fully completed in November 2004.

shortFeatures: Built to commemorate Sino-Soviet friendship
summary: Friendship Square is a circular closed roundabout square located in the center of Dalian. It was built in commemoration of Sino-Soviet friendship after 50 years of love. In the center of the square is a huge crystal ball weighing 117 tons and having a diameter of 15 meters, which is enclosed by 3,120 pieces of coated glass. There are 7,852 colorful lanterns in the ball, which can change into red, yellow and green lights at night, which are charming and charming. It is a good place for tourists to take photos.

shortFeatures: Golden sandy, soft and flat beach
summary: Jinshitan Beach Bathing Beach doesn't have as many stones as other places in Dalian. It is said that it has the best sand in Dalian beach, and it is also known as the "Shili Gold Coast". In summer, it looks like a lively resort, with crowds and many beach festival-themed activities. In winter, Jinshitan becomes quiet again, and the long coastline greatly highlights the unique romance of this seaside city.

One of the largest squares in the world, located on the south side of Chang'an Street, on the traditional central axis of Beijing. 
The center of the square is the Monument to the People's Heroes, the Great Hall of the People on the west side, the National Museum on the east side, and the Tiananmen Gate Tower on the opposite side of the square. 
· Every morning and evening, a flag-raising ceremony will be held. For those who are new to Beijing, watching a flag-raising ceremony is a must-do. 
There are many people coming to watch the flag-raising ceremony in the early morning, so be sure to go out early or travel at the wrong peak.

tagNameList: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Palaces; Museums; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
shortFeatures: A royal palace complex spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties.
summary:
- The Treasure Gallery, which opened in 1958, is one of the important year-round exhibition halls of the Palace Museum.
- A wide variety of gemstones are gathered here, along with gold, silver, jade, pearls, jadeite, and other treasures that are unparalleled in the world.
- The collection includes treasures ranging from precious decorative items to everyday objects, most of which are made from expensive materials and crafted by designers from various regions.
- Among these, the 14 cm tall red coral lion and the 17.5 cm tall golden "Fengtian Zhi Bao" seal are rare and invaluable treasures.

tagNameList: Ruins of ancient monuments; enjoy the autumn leaves; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true hero.
summary:
- Known as one of the "Nine Strategic Passes of the World," it is the essence of the Ming Great Wall scenery, with an elevation of about 1,015 meters, and also serves as the outpost of Juyongguan.
- It is divided into the South Wall and the North Wall. The South Wall has seven enemy towers, with relatively fewer tourists, while the North Wall has twelve enemy towers and is more difficult to climb.
- A must-visit site for tourists in Beijing, more than 300 world-renowned figures, including Nixon and Margaret Thatcher, have ascended the Great Wall.
- It is a 5A-level scenic spot and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its popularity second only to Tiananmen Square.

tagNameList: Hidden gems for kids; Historical sites; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Enter the imperial garden of the Qing dynasty emperors.
summary:
- The Summer Palace is located in the western suburbs of Beijing and is considered the foremost example of Chinese classical gardens. It was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage site on December 2, 1998.
- The palace consists of Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake, with the Western Hills as the backdrop. The architectural complex and the landscape of mountains and lakes are seamlessly integrated, creating ever-changing scenic views.
- The entire park is divided into three areas: the political activity area centered around the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity; the imperial and empress living area, centered around the Hall of Jade Ripples and the Hall of Joyful Longevity; and the scenic tourism area formed by Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake.
- In the Long Corridor of the Summer Palace, there is a dreamy, niche purple "waterfall," with delicate vines covered in blooming purple flowers, creating a romantic and enchanting atmosphere.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The place where emperors held the Heaven Sacrifice during the Ming and Qing dynasties.
summary:
- The Temple of Heaven was the dedicated altar where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties performed rituals to pray for rain and a good harvest. It is divided into two parts: the Inner Altar and the Outer Altar, with main structures such as the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests and the Hall of Imperial Heaven.
- In addition to admiring the exquisite architecture of the various halls, the Echo Wall, the Three-Sound Stone, and other clever designs also make one marvel at the wisdom of the ancients.
- Visitors typically enter through the South Gate and exit through the North (or East) Gate, following a route that includes the Circular Mound Altar, the Imperial Vault of Heaven, the Danbi Bridge, the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, and the Hall of Imperial Heaven before departing.
- Around April each year, the February orchid in the Temple of Heaven covers the ground, offering a rich rural atmosphere that can be enjoyed without leaving the city.

tagNameList: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Gardens; Historical Sites
shortFeatures: Qing Dynasty imperial garden destroyed in the war.
summary:
- Adjacent to the Summer Palace, it consists of the Old Summer Palace, the Garden of Everlasting Spring, and the Garden of Peaceful Spring, forming a large royal palace complex established and managed by the Qing emperors over a span of more than 150 years.
- In 1860, the Anglo-French forces set the main buildings ablaze, leaving them in ruins. Today, visitors can only pay tribute to the site and search for traces of the former glory of the empire amidst the remnants.
- The Garden of Peaceful Spring contains many small scenic spots and is a collection of miniature water feature gardens. It is now the main venue for the Annual Lotus Festival of the Old Summer Palace.
- The Garden of Everlasting Spring is centered around large water features, with the famous "Grand Waterworks" located here.
- In spring, the apricot blossoms bloom, as described in the imperial poetry: "In the depth of spring, flowers bloom brightly like the glow of the dawn." The blossoms appear from March to April and can be seen throughout the garden, with main viewing areas at the Flower God Temple, Mingchun Gate, and Apricot Blossom Spring Pavilion.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Lived in two emperors Yongzheng and Qianlong
summary:
Located in the northeast corner of the inner city of Dongcheng District, Beijing, that is, east of Yonghegong Street Road, it is the largest Tibetan Buddhist temple in Beijing. 
In the thirty-second year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, it became the residence of Yinzhen, the fourth son of the emperor. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Zhaotai Gate, Bell Tower, Drum Tower, Yonghe Gate, Lama Temple, Lecture Hall and Tantric Hall present the standard layout of "seven halls and blue blues" in Chinese Buddhist temples. 
· From the east-west memorial archway with cornices and arches to the antique east-west Shunshan Tower, there are more than a thousand halls in total, which are very luxurious and worth visiting

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries; Art Districts
shortFeatures: A punch-in resort for literary youth in Beijing
summary:
· 798 Art District is located in Dashanzi area, Jiuxianqiao Street, Chaoyang District, Beijing, so it is also called Dashanzi Art District. It was originally the location of the old factories of electronic industries such as the former state-owned 798 Factory. 
· 798 Art District is favored by many artists because of its Bauhaus-style factory style, which also combines idle factory buildings with modern art, and is an art distribution center in Beijing. 
· A multicultural space integrating galleries, cultural companies, bars and shops has been formed here, with a strong artistic atmosphere, and various exhibitions are held here all the year round.

tagNameList: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Beijing-style old commercial street
summary:
· Beijing's famous commercial street, located on the central axis of Beijing, starts from Moon Bay and ends at Tianqiao intersection, connecting with Tianqiao South Street. 
The street is about 845 meters long. It was called Zhengyangmen Street from the Ming Dynasty, Qing Dynasty to the Republic of China, and it was commonly known as Qianmen Street by the people. In 1965, it was officially named Qianmen Street. 
There are many famous time-honored shops, such as Quanjude and Donglaishun, including Dashilan and Xianyukou Hutong. 
While the original time-honored stores and traditional business characteristics have basically been preserved, new stores such as clothing department stores, food, clocks and clocks have been opened one after another.

shortFeatures: Experience the rustic charm of the mountains and the natural oxygen bar; a top autumn destination with mountains covered in red leaves.
summary:
- It is a royal garden with mountain and forest features. In ancient times, the emperor would come here for hunting and to cool off during the summer and autumn seasons.  
- The garden is home to numerous cultural relics and historical sites, such as "Xishan Qingxue" (Clear Snow on the Western Mountains), one of the Eight Views of Yanjing, and the "Biyun Temple," a monastery that blends the architectural styles of the Ming and Qing dynasties.  
- The red leaves of Xiangshan are famous both at home and abroad. In 1986, it was named one of the "Sixteen New Scenic Spots of Beijing," becoming the city's most iconic autumn scenery.  
- The Laimei Valley in Xiangshan Park has been established for more than 10 years, and over 100 wintersweet trees are now flourishing there. The petals of wintersweet are small, and their bright yellow color shines under the warm winter sunlight, emitting a subtle, fragrant aroma.

tagNameList: Meadow Autumn Reed; Enjoy autumn leaves; City Parks
summary:
Located at the northernmost end of the extension line of Beijing's central axis, it is the largest urban greening landscape in Asia and a well-deserved "green lung" in Beijing. 
It is divided into north and south gardens, connected by an ecological bridge across the Fifth Ring Road. The south garden is dominated by natural landscape, while the north garden is dominated by small stream landscape. 
· The most famous landscapes in the courtyard are "Yangshan Mountain" and "Olympic Sea", as well as the Olympic Declaration Square, where flowers bloom every year and are very beautiful. 
In addition to the beautiful scenery, it is also a place for local residents to relax and entertain. While watching the scenery, you can also see the authentic life of Beijingers.  
Every year in April and May, February orchids bloom all over the ground, and romantic atmosphere is everywhere.

tagNameList: Adorable animals; a hidden gem for kids.; Zoos
shortFeatures: Admire a variety of rare and exotic animals.
summary:
- Located on Xizhimenwai Street in the Xicheng District of Beijing, it is one of the largest urban zoos in China with the most diverse range of animals, boasting a history of over a century since the 32nd year of the Guangxu reign.
- The zoo is divided into three areas: East, South, and North. The main entrance is in the East area, and the North area also houses the Beijing Aquarium (separate admission required).
- The zoo is home to precious Chinese native animals such as the giant panda, golden snub-nosed monkey, Siberian tiger, and red-crowned crane, as well as animals from around the world, including African chimpanzees, Australian kangaroos, leopards, and Mexican manatees.
- There is also a Science Popularization Hall, where visitors, including children, can learn about animals. The hall frequently hosts various educational lectures.
- The zoo is lush with greenery, offering large areas of green space, making it ideal for spring outings and family activities. The famous Beijing brand "Huguo Temple Snacks" has a branch inside the zoo, so you can enjoy both sightseeing and delicious food.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
shortFeatures: Looking at Chinese Treasures through Millenniums
summary:
With a total construction area of nearly 200,000 square meters and a collection of more than 1 million pieces, it is the largest museum in the world. 
The museum is divided into five floors and has 48 exhibition halls. It is one of the museums with the richest collection of Chinese cultural relics. 
The exhibition system consists of basic exhibition, special exhibition, international exchange exhibition and temporary exhibition, covering all stages from ancient times to the present. 
· There are a large number of visitors, so you can make an appointment online before going to save time.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Mix and match between old Beijing Hutong and petty bourgeoisie
summary:
· Nanluoguxiang is listed among the 25 old city protected areas, with a total length of 786 meters, and is one of the oldest neighborhoods in Beijing. 
It is the only chessboard-style traditional residential area in China that completely preserves the hutong courtyard structure of Yuan Dynasty, with the largest scale, the highest grade and the richest resources. 
Nowadays, there are personalized shops with ever-changing styles, all kinds of exquisite and fashionable private restaurants, and the combination of old Beijing hutongs and petty bourgeoisie sentiment has become a fashion landmark in Beijing. 
If you want to experience the old Beijing customs quietly, you can look for it in several hutongs on both sides. Many former residences and historical buildings of celebrities will definitely make you live up to what you did.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Art Museums
shortFeatures: Art exhibition updates frequently
summary:
The National Art Museum of China is a plastic arts museum focusing on collecting, researching and displaying the works of modern Chinese artists. The museum displays paintings, sculptures, handicrafts and other works of art, which can be called a treasure house of art. 
The art museum has a collection of nearly 70,000 works of various kinds of art, mainly works before and after the founding of New China, as well as masterpieces by artists in the Qing Dynasty and the late Ming Dynasty. Among them, there are 410 works by Qi Baishi, and works by famous art masters such as Shi Tao, Xu Gu, Ren Bonian, Wu Changshuo, Huang Binhong, Xu Beihong, Liu Haisu, Fu Baoshi, Pan Tianshou, Li Keran, Jiang Zhaohe and Wu Guanzhong, as well as representative works of a large number of famous Chinese artists and award-winning works in major art exhibitions. 
There are dozens of categories of collections, such as paintings, sculptures, ceramics, New Year pictures, paper-cuts, toys, shadow puppets, colored sculptures, performing tools, puppets, kites, folk paintings, embroidery and other folk arts. In addition, there are many overseas works of art including Europe and Africa.

tagNameList: Hi Fun Park; Treasure Spot for Strolling with Kids; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Play a variety of exciting amusement rides.
summary:
- Located on the East Fourth Ring Road in Beijing, it is one of the largest theme parks in Beijing combining sea, land, and air attractions.
- It features seven themed areas: Fjord Forest, Atlantis, Lost Maya, Aegean Harbor, Shangri-La, Dessert Kingdom, and Happy Time.
- It offers over 40 entertainment facilities, nearly 100 scenic spots, performances, and themed games, providing an exhilarating and exciting experience.

Beijing Xishan Ski Resort covers an area of about 130,000 square meters, with a total length of 2,089 meters and a drop of about 120 meters. The slope of the intermediate track is about 14 degrees, so you are not afraid of being unsatisfied. 
In addition to intermediate snow trails, there are also primary snow trails, advanced snow trails and parent-child snow circle trails, which are clearly divided and easy to find. There are also special snowboard parks and flag gate practice tracks, which can fully satisfy skiers of different levels. 
Professional snow pressing and suitable winter temperature make the snow trail ultra-smooth and the snow quality is delicate. Whether you are playing in the snow or practicing skiing, you can be in the real world of ice and snow and enjoy the fun of ice and snow.

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Kid-Friendly Hidden Gems; Zoos
shortFeatures: Close-up view of wildlife
summary:
- Beijing Wildlife Park is located in the vast forest area of Daxing District and houses more than 200 species of animals, with a population of over ten thousand, making it a paradise for children to visit and learn.
- The zoo is divided into two main routes: the southern and northern lines. The southern line features the Lion and Tiger Pavilion, the Lion and Baboon Pavilion, the Monkey Pavilion, and more, where visitors can see lions and baboons living together.
- The northern line mainly consists of bird exhibits, where visitors can see beautiful birds like flamingos and peacocks, as well as parrots that can talk to people.
- Many animals in the park are raised in open environments. Visitors can take a caged vehicle for a close-up view of the animals, and enjoy performances such as bear acrobatics, monkeys riding bicycles, and lions jumping through hoops.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Amusement Park; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: A miniature version of famous buildings from around the world.
summary:
- One of the most famous theme parks in Beijing, featuring miniature versions of iconic buildings from around the world.
- The park is divided by continents, with famous landmarks such as the White House of the United States, the Eiffel Tower, and the Sphinx of Egypt all on display.
- During peak season, there are daily performances of exotic dance, music shows, and animal performances, offering a unique experience of traveling around the world in one day.
- Visiting here gives you the feeling of a world tour, and parents often bring their children to learn about the architecture of different countries. It's definitely worth a visit.
- Every year in mid-April, the tulips at Beijing World Park reach their peak bloom, with over 200,000 tulips in more than 50 varieties, including "Crystal Beauty," "Miss Rose," and "Olympic Flame," all competing to bloom in vibrant colors.
opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:50; admission ends at 17:00)

tagNameList: Garden garden; Featured exhibition hall; Wax Museums
shortFeatures: The location of the 87 edition of A Dream of Red Mansions
summary:
It is a comprehensive tourist area built to imitate the classic A Dream of Red Mansions, which is mainly focused on film and television shooting, and has the functions of sightseeing, leisure, culture and entertainment. 
The scenery is elegant, with the style of a large courtyard in the south of the Yangtze River, with pavilions, pavilions, small bridges and flowing water. Walking in it makes people feel relaxed and happy. 
· 87 CCTV version of the TV series "A Dream of Red Mansions" is the location. Many buildings in the park have wax figures of characters in "A Dream of Red Mansions", imitating the life scenes in the book. 
The temple fair from the first day to the fifth day of the first month will stage many programs such as Yuan Fei's relatives and Baodai's marriage, as well as folk arts such as sugar man and Facebook. 
In summer nights, there are cultural and artistic performances of the Red Mansion, shadow puppet performances, large musical fountains, laser water curtain movies, etc., which are also worth experiencing.

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Aquariums
shortFeatures: View thousands of aquatic animals.
summary:
- Located in Beijing Zoo, it is currently the largest inland aquarium in the world and the perfect place to observe marine animals.
- The building is shaped like a giant sea shell and consists of two floors, divided into seven main areas: Rainforest Wonders, Bering Town, National Treasure Chinese Sturgeon Hall, Underwater Tour, Whale and Dolphin Bay, Ocean Theater, and more.
- The aquarium features a wide variety of aquatic animals, including dolphins and sea lions, with captivating and romantic performances.
- There are also fast food restaurants and a souvenir shop within the aquarium, offering a complete experience of entertainment, shopping, and dining.
opening_hours: Open at 10:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:30)

summary:
· The oldest existing stone-made arch bridge in Beijing is located on the Yongding River in Fengtai District, southwest Beijing. It is named after spanning the Lugou River (Yongding River). 
· With a total length of 266.5 meters and a width of 7.5 meters, there are 10 piers and 11 bridge holes in total. The bridge body is a stone structure, all connected by silver ingots and iron tenons. It is the longest ancient stone bridge in North China. 
On July 7, 1937, Japanese imperialism launched a full-scale war of aggression against China here. The Chinese garrison in Wanping City rose up to resist, which was known in history as the "Lugouqiao Incident" (also known as the "July 7th Incident").  
There are many beautifully carved stone lions on the bridge, big and small, with different shapes. Therefore, there is a saying that "there are countless lions on Lugou Bridge". 
"Xiaoyue in Lugou" is one of the famous "Eight Scenic Spots of Yanjing" in Beijing. It is visited before and after the Mid-Autumn Festival, and the Lugou Bridge under the moonlit night has a unique flavor.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; City coordinates; Exhibition Halls; Modern Architecture
shortFeatures: European architectural style exhibition center
summary: Founded in 1954, Beijing Exhibition Hall is located in the bustling business district of Xizhimen, Beijing. The main building complex is magnificent, tall and elegant, with a unique European architectural style. There are four business units in the museum: Exhibition Center, Moscow Restaurant, Beizhan Theater and Beizhan Hotel. It is a comprehensive enterprise integrating exhibition, catering, performance and accommodation. Beijing Exhibition Hall is committed to the professional development of exhibition business. Since its establishment, it has received more than a thousand large-scale exhibitions at home and abroad, with hundreds of millions of visitors. The exhibitions cover various fields of international economy, trade, science and technology, culture, politics and military affairs.

poiName: Military Museum of the Chinese People's Revolution
tagNameList: Venue exhibition hall; Military Sites; Museums
summary:
Founded in 1959, China's only large-scale comprehensive military history museum is one of the top ten buildings in the capital dedicated to the 10th anniversary of the National Day. 
The whole building is upright and magnificent, with 7 floors in the center, 4 floors on both sides, and a tall military emblem on the top floor. 
The exhibition is divided into the Agrarian Revolutionary War Hall, the War of Resistance against Japan Hall, the National Liberation War Hall, the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea Hall, the Ancient War Hall, etc.

shortFeatures: A place of blessings, also a great spot for enjoying autumn.
summary:
- The largest Buddhist garden in northern China, it is said that "in the south there is Putuo, and in the north there is Hongluo." Since ancient times, it has been a sacred place for people in the Beijing area to worship Buddha and pray for blessings.
- Hongluo Temple is divided into two parts: one is the main temple area near the main hall, along with the Five Hundred Arhats Forest, and the other is the Guanyin Temple at the top of the mountain. It is said that the Guanyin Temple is highly effective for those praying for children, while Hongluo Temple is particularly effective for those praying for marriage.
- The "Imperial Bamboo Forest," "Male and Female Ginkgo Trees," and "Wisteria Entwined with Pine Trees" are known as the three most famous scenic spots in Hongluo Temple.
- The temple is home to towering ancient trees, and "spring flowers, summer heat avoidance, autumn red leaves, and winter appreciation of the three friends of winter" are the unique features of Hongluo Temple.
opening_hours: Open from 03/25-10/31,8:30am-5:00pm;Open from 8:00am-6:00pm during China's national day

shortFeatures: It used to be the place where the emperors of the Ming and Qing Dynasties worshipped their ancestors
summary: Ancestral Temple is located in Dongjiaomin Lane, Dongcheng District. The plane of Ancestral Temple is rectangular, with three walls. The front, middle and back halls form a three-story closed courtyard. The main hall stands in the center of the entire Ancestral Temple complex, with eleven rooms wide and four rooms deep, with double eaves and verandah roof, triple white marble Xumi-style platform foundation and stone guardrails around it; The main beams in the hall are covered with agarwood, and other building components are precious golden nanmu.

tagNameList: Perfect Places to Stroll with Kids; Enjoy Autumn Leaves; City Parks
summary:
- Located within the East Fourth Ring Road in Beijing, it is one of the largest urban parks in the city.
- The park features lakes, trees, pavilions, towers, European-style castles, and other buildings, creating a beautiful environment, with children's play areas also available.
- On the southern side of the park, there are various amusement rides, including a simple roller coaster, a brave carousel, and a merry-go-round.
- The northern area is dominated by trees and open lawns, ideal for relaxing, picnicking, or strolling and sightseeing.
- The center of the park is built along the lake, with sculptures, squares, and lakeside promenades. There is also a boat dock where visitors can rent boats and enjoy a leisurely paddle on the lake.
- Every April, the February orchid blooms, and the purple sea of flowers is breathtakingly beautiful.

shortFeatures: The tomb complex that houses the thirteen Ming Dynasty emperors.
summary:
- The collective name for the tombs of the 13 emperors of the Ming Dynasty after the capital was moved to Beijing, it is also one of the largest imperial tomb complexes in China, with the most imperial and empress tombs still extant.
- The scenic area is a unified whole, while each tomb is independent. Each tomb is located in front of a mountain, with Changling being the first of the Ming Thirteen Tombs. It is the tomb of the Ming Emperor Chengzu, Zhu Di, and the largest imperial tomb among the Thirteen Tombs.
- The Changling Museum exhibits various burial artifacts, including phoenix crowns, civil officials' hats, men's jade belts, and hairpins, all of which are worth seeing.
- Only four scenic areas are open to the public: Changling, Zhao Tomb, Ding Tomb, and the Sacred Way. Although these are tombs, only the Ding Tomb has been excavated so far.
- In addition to history, it is also nice to take a walk along the Zhao Tomb and Sacred Way. The Sacred Way is lined with various vivid stone statues, and the Zhao Tomb area is quiet and less crowded, perfect for a peaceful stroll.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Treasure Spot for Strolling with Kids; Meadow Autumn Reed; City Parks
shortFeatures: Gather various types of gardens from home and abroad.
summary: The Beijing Garden Expo Park is the venue for the 9th China International Garden Expo, located in the southwestern part of Beijing, within the Fengtai District, along the green ecological development belt of the Yongding River. It is bordered to the east by the new right embankment of the Yongding River, to the west by Eagle Mountain Park, to the south by Meishikou Road, and to the north by Lianshi West Road. Relying on the Yongding River and echoing the Lugou Bridge, the park is rich in historical and cultural atmosphere, with varied terrain, interdependent mountains and waters, and distinctive features. The Beijing Garden Expo Park utilizes green technology for ecological restoration on a former construction waste landfill, making it a large urban park that integrates garden art, cultural landscapes, ecological recreation, and popular science education.

tagNameList: A treasure spot for taking kids; Playground.; Amusement Parks
shortFeatures: There are many entertainment activities to enjoy.
summary: Beijing Shijingshan Amusement Park is located on the western extension of Chang'an Street, 15 km from Tiananmen Square. It features more than 100 large and medium-sized amusement attractions, making it one of the earliest amusement parks in Beijing and a childhood memory for a generation. The Shijingshan Amusement Park Temple Fair is one of the eight major temple fairs in Beijing. Currently, the park has two main themed areas: the "Adventure World" on the eastern side, primarily aimed at young people, showcasing mystery, excitement, and thrills, and the "Fantasy World" on the western side, catering to family visitors of all ages, with a fairytale atmosphere.

shortFeatures: Experience the 3,000-year history of the capital city's establishment.
summary:
The exhibition showcases Beijing's 3,000-year history of city-building and 800 years of being the capital, with seven floors, mainly divided into permanent and special exhibition halls.  
The interior is divided into two exhibition areas: the eastern area is a circular exhibition zone. Upon entering, there is a cinema on the first floor that shows a promotional video about the city's background.  
The western area is the museum's main exhibition zone, focusing on the historical recreation of Beijing, as well as folk customs, ceramics, and Buddhist culture.  
The museum also features facilities such as a restaurant, café, tea room, souvenir shop, bookstore, ATMs, and a mailbox, making it very convenient.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Everywhere with golden sands and green trees
summary:
There are more than 250 species of plants in Xishan National Forest Park, belonging to 73 families. The park has a vast area of vegetation and mountain forest, and there are many kinds of wild animals, including more than 10 kinds of mammals, more than 50 kinds of birds, and many amphibians and reptiles. Among them, the forest area is about 80,000 mu, releasing about 178,000 tons of oxygen every year, spanning Haidian, Shijingshan and Mentougou districts. Based on Beijing Xishan Experimental Forest Farm, it has a total area of about 5,970 hectares, and is an important part of the scenic spot in the suburbs of Beijing. 
Every year around mid-March, more than 20,000 mountain peaches and apricots bloom for the first time. They look like clouds from a distance and look like snow near, showing one of the "eight scenic spots of Yanjing"-the grand scenery of sunny snow in Xishan.

tagNameList: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Planetariums
summary:
- China's first planetarium, where visitors can watch fascinating high-tech films and learn various astronomical knowledge.
- It is divided into two sections: Hall A and Hall B. Hall A includes exhibition halls, a public observatory, and other displays such as the origin of the universe and the history of the invention of the compass. It also offers observational functions, allowing visitors to view the beauty of space through telescopes.
- The Planetarium Hall is the most important area in Hall A, featuring a 23.5-meter diameter dome. Advanced instruments are used to realistically reproduce around 9,000 stars visible to the naked eye from Earth, allowing visitors to observe the changes in the starry sky and experience its beauty.
- Hall B mainly features spectacular theatrical displays. Using dome and multidimensional technology, it presents stunning astronomical films. The 3D theater is located on the B1 floor, providing a thrilling, immersive experience as if one were truly there.

tagNameList: Climbing to a high place and hiking.; Mountains
shortFeatures: Touring mountains and rivers, visiting ancient temples.
summary:
- The scenery of the outskirts, the roads of the near suburbs, and Beijing’s natural oxygen bar make it an ideal destination for sightseeing, vacation, and conferences.
- The natural landscapes, such as peaks, rocks, forests, and springs, complement the cultural landscapes, including temples, inscriptions, pagodas, and incense rituals, creating a harmonious and mutually enhancing effect.
- The scenic area has three routes: the northern route offers views of flowing springs and cascading waterfalls, the central route leads to the famous Longquan Temple in western Beijing, and the southern route is a place where the cultures of Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism converge.
- Every year, from the end of March to the beginning of April, nearly a thousand acres of apricot flowers bloom in competition, creating a magnificent sight.

shortFeatures: Witness China's century-old history and culture
summary:
One of the landmark buildings in Beijing, the ancient capital, is a group of ancient buildings located at the northern end of Beijing's north-south central axis, located at the northern end of Di'anmenwai Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing. 
The Bell and Drum Tower originated in the Han Dynasty. According to historical records, there was a morning drum and evening bell system in the Han Dynasty, in which "beating the drum at dawn to urge people to get up and ringing the bell at night to urge people to rest". The two floors are placed vertically in front and back, magnificent and majestic. 
As the time telling center of the capitals of Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties, the Bell and Drum Tower has a very important position. The two buildings are placed vertically in front and back, which is magnificent and magnificent. 
In the establishment history of the city's bell and drum tower, Beijing's bell and drum tower is the largest in scale and the tallest in shape, and it is also an important building that witnessed the history of China in the past hundred years.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly treasures; Autumn leaf viewing; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: Admire the various flowers in different seasons.
summary:
· Beijing International Flower Port takes the 7th Flower Expo as an opportunity for development, focusing on the strategic positioning of "using flowers as a medium, greenery as an intermediary, science as a platform, and innovation as the soul," integrating the flower industry with the cultural and tourism industries.
· The "Beijing Tulip Cultural Festival" is held every spring, the "Beijing Rose Cultural Festival" and "Beijing Lily Cultural Festival" are held every summer, and the "Beijing Chrysanthemum Cultural Festival" is held every autumn.
· The scenic area and supporting facilities are divided into four functional zones: outdoor flower display area, facility production area, R&D and support service area, and urban agriculture sightseeing area.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Science & Technology Museums
shortFeatures: Science Paradise for Children
summary:
· Located next to Beijing Olympic Forest Park, it is the only national comprehensive science and technology museum in China. 
· The museum is divided into five floors, including one underground floor and four above ground floors. The main open venues include the main exhibition hall of Hall A, the ball screen cinema of Hall B, the children's science park of Hall C, the temporary exhibition hall and the special effects cinema. 
· In addition to science and technology exhibitions, there is also a science park suitable for children in the museum, where they can learn scientific knowledge through interactive games. 
In addition, the underground floor is Cosmic Theater, Dynamic Theater and 4D Theater, where you can watch three-dimensional giant screen movies and feel the magical effects of high technology.

tagNameList: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: See the old Tianjin through the old foreign-style houses.
summary:
- Once an British concession, it retains buildings with various architectural styles from different countries, and has now become one of the most iconic scenic spots in Tianjin.
- The most unique areas are Machangdao and Humnandao. Although the streets are narrow, they are lined with 300 small Western-style houses, each with its own history. A leisurely tour reveals even more surprises.
- The most distinctive way to explore the Five Avenues is by horse-drawn carriage. Alternatively, you can take a rickshaw or an electric car, with a guide providing explanations throughout the journey.
- Strolling around or renting a bicycle is also a great option. If your schedule is not too tight, it’s worth taking the time to relax and explore at a leisurely pace.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; neighborhood stroll; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Experience the classic Tianjin culture and traditional cuisine
summary:
The Ancient Culture Street is located in the Nankai District of Tianjin, centered around the Tianhou Temple. It is a hub for Tianjin's famous time-honored brands and handicraft shops, making it one of the must-visit places in Tianjin.  
The street is home to many of Tianjin's old-established stores with strong local characteristics, such as Qiao Xiang Ge, which sells Cloisonné, Su embroidery, and lacquerware.  
While shopping, visitors can also enjoy Tianjin's unique food, including "Goubuli" steamed buns, Jianbing Guozi (Chinese pancake), and Tianjin's twisted fried dough, all sure to satisfy any food lover's appetite.  
Every year, from before the Chinese New Year to the Lantern Festival, the Ancient Culture Street is the liveliest, with various activities and temple fairs taking place.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
summary:
It starts from Tianjin Jingang Bridge, ends at Dagukou and enters Bohai Bay, and runs through Tianjin city. It is the "mother river" of Tianjin. 
· There are Jingang Bridge, Lion Forest Bridge, Jintang Bridge, Bei'an Bridge, Jiefang Bridge and other bridges built on the Haihe River, which are very spectacular. 
There are all kinds of high-rise buildings and more than 20 historical and cultural buildings on both sides of the strait, which are worth visiting. There are also cruise docks in tianjin railway station, Ancient Culture Street and Great Beiyuan, where you can board the boat. 
Night is a good time to watch the Haihe River. The lights on both sides are on, and the scenery is very beautiful. I recommend Tianjin Eye, Jinta Jinmen and other places to take beautiful photos.

shortFeatures: French architecture decorated with ancient porcelain
summary:
Porcelain House is a French-style building decorated with tens of thousands of antique porcelain tiles, and it is one of the landmark buildings in Tianjin. 
The building was designed by Zhang Lianzhi, the owner of the porcelain house, and the age of the porcelain and porcelain pieces used spanned from the Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty. Almost all kinds of official kiln and folk kiln porcelain in China can be seen here. 
More than 20 tons of crystal stone and agate, more than 4,000 pieces of ancient porcelain, more than 300 stone statues of past dynasties, etc. were used during the construction, and it is called a priceless "Chinese Ancient Porcelain Museum". 
· The small room where the exit is located has the "treasure of the town hall". Don't miss it. Photography is not allowed in this room.

tagNameList: Parenting Treasure Spot; Playground; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Visit the aircraft carrier to watch the combat performance.
summary:
- A large military-themed park integrating eight major sections, including sightseeing, themed performances, and entertainment, based on the Soviet aircraft carrier "Kiev."
- The ship features dozens of attractions, such as the combat command center, intelligence room, aircraft carrier technology museum, history of naval ship development, sailor tilt room, and the Warrior's Corridor.
- Whether standing beside it or entering its interior, one can feel the overwhelming impact of the massive steel structure! It is perfect for military enthusiasts.
- The park also includes the World Aircraft Carrier Museum, weapon model exhibition, Expo Tianjin Pavilion, dock square, 4D cinema, and many other attractions.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The bustling area of Tianjin with charming night scene
summary:
· Jinwan Square is located beside the Haihe River, opposite Tianjin Station across the Haihe River. It is one of the most prosperous areas in Tianjin. 
The biggest highlight is its cultural heritage. The diverse composition of Tianjin's modern architectural style highlights the characteristics of the times when Chinese and western cultures converge.  
In addition, it is also the best place to enjoy the day and night scenery of Haihe River. The tall buildings backed by it are a bustling modern city, which is gorgeous and charming when lit at night. 
The European buildings around the square and on both sides of the river also constitute the whole landscape, which is one of the iconic viewing spots in Tianjin.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
shortFeatures: The former residence of the last emperor Puyi
summary:
Jingyuan, which combines Spanish and Japanese styles, is a typical representative of courtyard-style private mansion in Tianjin Concession period. 
It used to be the residence of Lu Zongyu, the minister of Beiyang government in Japan. Later, the last emperor Puyi lived here with Queen Wanrong and Shu Fei Wenxiu. 
· The noise of the city center is blocked out, only bursts of birdsong, which is very leisurely and suitable for tourists who like history and architecture to meditate and travel slowly. 
Reed flowers bloom in late autumn (October-December) every year, which is an excellent season to watch reed flowers.

Located in the northwest of Jixian County, Tianjin, and in the east of Beijing, it has the reputation of "the first mountain in JD.COM" and is a national key scenic spot. 
Panshan Scenic Area integrates secluded forests, ancient caves, strange peaks and beautiful waters, and has opened five scenic spots with more than 130 scenic spots. 
Three passenger ropeways, Panshan, Yunsong and Guayue, have been opened. Visitors can reach the peak of Panshan and Guayue Peak by taking the ropeways. 
Panshan Mountain is not only a beautiful scenery, but also a Buddhist holy place. There are more than 100 pagodas and monk bone pagodas. Some of these temples and pagodas are still there today, and they have become places of interest visited by people.
opening_hours:
08:00-16:30 (Monday-Sunday, January 1-December 31) 
tips: 
* The specific opening hours are subject to the scenic spot.

shortFeatures: A city park composed of lakes and islands
summary:
- A 4A-level scenic area and one of the Ten Scenic Views of Tianjin, also known as "Dragon Pond Floating Verdancy," is the largest park in Tianjin, ideal for leisurely strolls and dating in the morning and evening.
- The park features beautiful surroundings, with corridors and pavilions, and its biggest highlight is the large area of lakes. In summer, visitors can enjoy boating and view vast lotus flowers.
- On the central island of the lake, there is the Ten Thousand Buddha Island, a sightseeing area focused on Buddhist culture, which interested visitors can explore.
- In addition, the park has amusement facilities (such as roller coasters and a Ferris wheel) and a zoo, making it suitable for visitors with children.
- The park is home to a large number of flowers and trees, which bloom vibrantly in early spring, particularly the diverse varieties of magnolia, making it the main flower-viewing attraction of the Water Park.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Military Sites; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: One of Tianjin Weizong Treasures
summary:
· The landmark building of Tianjin Old City, located in the center of the old city. The Tianjin Acropolis was built in the second year of Yongle in Ming Dynasty, and the Drum Tower was built in the center of the old city. 
There are 2 floors in total. The first floor is dedicated to Guanyin, Our Lady of Heaven, Guan Yu Yuefei, etc. On the second floor, there is an iron bell weighing 300 pounds. 
The bell is 1.4 meters in diameter, 2.3 meters high and weighs about 1,500 kilograms. It is known as the "King of Bells" in Tianjin and is also a beautifully cast work of art. 
Coupon gates are opened on all sides under the Drum Tower to communicate the four streets in the city.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Witness the history of Tianjin
summary:
· Jiefang Bridge is a hub bridge connecting Hebei, Hedong and Heping districts and communicating with tianjin railway station. 
· Originally known as "Wanguo Bridge", it was known as "a country within a country" because there was a concession of nine countries in Tianjin at that time. After the liberation of Tianjin, this bridge was renamed "Jiefang Bridge". 
· Jiefang Bridge will be opened during important festivals. When the bridge opens, luxury yachts will sail across the opened Jiefang Bridge, accompanied by the colorful Haihe River, which is intoxicating and the most beautiful time. 
If you are lucky, you may even meet the scene of taking wedding photos in the middle of Jiefang Bridge while stopping at the red light, which is novel and interesting.

tagNameList: Hi Playland; Kids' Treasure Spot; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Interactive experience amusement attractions
summary:
- Located in the Eco-Island of the Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city in Binhai New Area, it is a unique fourth-generation high-tech theme park in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, with attractions suitable for all ages.
- It consists of 27 themed areas, including Extreme Flight, Magic Castle, Bear Adventures, Blue Earth, Eastern Charm, Conch Bay, Tanggula Snow Mountain, and Tianjin Grand Canyon.
- Known for its focus on science fiction and interactive experiences, most of the attractions are at the top level of global theme park projects today, earning the titles of "Eastern Dreamland" and "Asian Sci-Fi Wonderland."

The predecessor of Tianjin Museum can be traced back to the Tianjin Museum established in 1918. Although it was newly built in recent years and has lost a lot of ancient flavor, it is still the main place to inherit the local history and culture of Tianjin. 
There are 4 floors in the museum. The first floor is "The Origin of Tianjin Humanities", the second floor is the exhibition of fine cultural relics, the third floor is "A Hundred Years of China Seeing Tianjin", and the fourth floor is the painting and calligraphy exhibition. Learn about the historical changes, local culture, etc. of the entire Tianjin here, and the treasures of the town hall such as Fan Kuan's "Snow Scene and Cold Forest Picture" axis in the Northern Song Dynasty, the enamel colored peony and young chicken pattern jade pot spring bottle in the Qing Qianlong Dynasty, the Taibao tripod in the Western Zhou Dynasty, and the topaz pig dragon will also make it worth your trip. Various themed exhibitions will be held from time to time.

Zhang Xueliang's Former Residence Museum, also known as Shaoshual's Mansion, lived here in the 1920s and 1930s. This building is luxurious, beautiful and generous, mainly in western Baroque style. The rooms are elegantly decorated, and the stairs, floors, doors and windows are all made of Philippine wood. 
Zhang Xueliang's former residence, which has been renovated for more than two years, reappears today. The music, decoration, clothing, furniture and characters here reappear the original appearance of the Zhang family's life in the French Concession in Tianjin.

tagNameList: English: Hidden gems for strolling with kids; historic sites; Historical Sites
shortFeatures: The Great Wall in the towering mountains.
summary:
- Located on the northern side of Jixian, it is an important pass of the Ming Dynasty's Jizhen Great Wall and the only fortified pass in the county.
- The rocks on the eastern cliff are mostly yellow-brown, and under the glow of the setting sun, they shine brilliantly, earning the name "Sunset Yellow Cliff," and the pass is named accordingly.
- From the Huangya Tianti ancient watchtower to the Three Border Monument, there remain well-preserved sections of the Northern Qi border wall, the Ming Dynasty's steep mountain walls, nearly intact towers, watchtowers, beacon towers, and parapets.
opening_hours: Open at 08:00-16:30(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Spots for Strolling with Kids; Mountains; National Parks
shortFeatures: Stroll through the mountains and savor the fresh nature.
summary:
- Located at the northernmost tip of Tianjin, it is known as the "Arctic of Tianjin" and is one of the three major scenic areas of Tianjin Jiulong Mountain National Forest Park.
- Large areas of wild rhododendrons bloom in early spring, covering the mountainsides in red, hence the name "Yingshanhong" (Mountain Red).
- The scenic area features typical quartzite peak forest and canyon landscapes, naturally formed geological wonders such as Rock Painting Ridge, Teng Tianfeng, Wuzhi Mountain, and Wanjun Tian Shu.
- The distance from the entrance of the scenic area to Teng Tianfeng is short, and the main attraction is Teng Tianfeng, where the cliffs on both sides rise steeply, making it very dangerous.
- Climbing the stone steps between the Tianfeng to the mountain top, the view opens up, and there are remains of the ancient Great Wall that can be carefully observed.

There is an old saying in Tianjin: Tianhou Temple first, followed by Tianjin Guard. It can be seen the position of Tianhou Temple in the minds of Tianjin people. It is one of the three major Tian Hou temples in China and the oldest surviving building in Tianjin. 
Tianhou Temple is actually a temple where ordinary people worship the Empress of Tianhou, commonly known as the "Empress Palace". In the past, Tianhou Palace was dedicated to the Lord God, of course, the Empress of Tianhou. Due to historical reasons, Tianhou Temple has formed a complicated situation in which Buddhism and Taoism are mixed and hundreds of gods gather in the long years. 
Every year on the 23rd of March of the lunar calendar, a grand "Imperial Meeting" is held here, performing Dragon Lantern Dance, Lion Dance, Shaolin Club, Gao Jian, Dharma Drum, Dry Boat, Yangko, Wushu, Beijing Opera, Pingju, Bangzi, etc.

poiName: Zhou Enlai and Deng Yingchao Memorial Museum
summary:
The Zhou Enlai and Deng Yingchao Memorial Hall is located in the scenic and picturesque Water Park Scenic Area, covering an area of approximately 70,000 square meters with a building area of about 13,000 square meters. It was built on the eve of the 100th anniversary of Zhou Enlai's birth, on February 28, 1998. 

The museum houses a rich collection of artifacts, with many items of great historical value. The main exhibition is divided into three major sections: the main hall, a replica of the Western Flower Hall of Zhongnanhai in Beijing built to a 1:1 scale, and a special exhibition hall for the aircraft.

In the main hall, there are the exhibition "Zhou Enlai: Premier of the People" and the special exhibition "Deng Yingchao: Pioneer of the Women's Movement in 20th Century China." The Western Flower Hall features a restored exhibition and thematic cultural relics display titled "Great Sentiments." The aircraft exhibition hall displays the Il-14 aircraft, No. 678, a gift from the Soviet government to Premier Zhou Enlai, which is now a national second-class cultural relic.

The museum’s exhibitions are themed clearly and distinctly reflect the regional characteristics of Tianjin. They vividly depict the brilliant lives of the great leaders Zhou Enlai and Deng Yingchao, as well as their excellent qualities and noble spirit in serving the country and the people with unwavering dedication.

tagNameList: Hi Playland; Hidden gems for kids; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Classic Family Fun Destinations
summary:
- Tianjin Happy Valley is located by the Dongli Lake in Tianjin, and it is a well-known amusement park in the city, a great destination for all ages.  
- It consists of four uniquely themed amusement areas: the Performance Center, Happy Time, Viking Harbor, and Christmas Village.  
- The park features over 30 fun and adventurous rides suitable for all ages, as well as more than 50 colorful, exotic-themed landscapes.  
- In addition to the diverse rides, spectacular performances such as "Jin Xiu," "Heroes of Tianjin: Huo Yuanjia," and the "Mediterranean Light Show" are also very impressive.  
- In the summer, you can visit Maya Beach Water Park to enjoy water activities and cool off.

shortFeatures: The famous ancient temple in Tianjin.
summary:
It is a temple dedicated to the Eight Directions Buddha, originally built during the Shunzhi period of the Qing Dynasty. The temple once housed the relic bones of the Tang monk Xuanzang. The temple originally featured a cypress wood sculpture of the Thousand-Hand Guanyin, which was destroyed during the "Ten Years of Chaos." Today, there is a 3.6-meter-high, 4-meter-wide gilded statue of Thousand-Hand Guanyin in the rear hall, which was created in modern times. 

The temple's two notable features are: first, the Great Hero Hall in the center of the temple once housed hundreds of copper, wood, and stone-carved statues from the Wei, Jin, Northern and Southern Dynasties to the Ming and Qing Dynasties, making it a rare collection of artistic treasures; second, the vegetarian dishes at the temple have long been famous, transforming soy-based products into exquisitely delicious dishes. The Great Compassion Zen Temple also has a memorial hall for Master Hongyi, which contains many photos of the master after he took monastic vows, along with his calligraphy works. This is an important venue for Buddhists in Tianjin to hold religious activities.

shortFeatures: Visit the giant colored Guanyin statue.
summary:
Dule Temple, also known as the Great Buddha Temple, is located in Jizhou District, Tianjin, China. It is one of the three remaining Liao Dynasty temples in China and one of the famous ancient buildings still standing in the country. Although Dule Temple is a millennium-old monastery, its history is unclear and its origins cannot be traced. The earliest recorded history of the temple dates back to the 10th year of the Zhenguan era (636 AD). 

The temple covers an area of approximately 16,000 square meters. The main gate is three bays wide and four bays deep, with two levels. There is a flat concealed layer in the middle, and the total height is about 23 meters. The two oldest structures within the temple, the main gate and the Guanyin Pavilion, were rebuilt in the second year of the Shengzong era of the Liao Dynasty (984 AD). In the 19th year of the Republic of China (1930), Dule Temple gained international recognition after being investigated and published by Japanese scholar Seki Shige and Chinese scholar Liang Sicheng.

Dule Temple is a national AAAA tourist attraction, one of the first batch of national key cultural heritage sites, and a historically protected building approved by the Tianjin Municipal People's Government.

shortFeatures: Admire the statue of the goddess of
summary:
· Tianjin Kyle Polo Square is located in the original Italian concession in Hebei District, Tianjin. It is the only Italian concession in modern China and the only concession that Italy once had abroad. 
· Marco Polo Square covers an area of 2,200 square meters. The sculpture of the Goddess of Peace is located in the center of the square. It was built to commemorate the victory of the First World War. After completion, it was transported from Italy to Tianjin via Shanghai. 
· The square consists of the sculpture of the Goddess of Peace and 6 typical Mediterranean style villas in southern Italy. The main sculpture includes a fountain pool, a pedestal, a Roman column and a statue of the Goddess of Peace. It is 13.6 meters high and all made of granite stone. The upper part of the pedestal is decorated with 4 European figures. The top of the column is a bronze statue of the Goddess of Peace flying with wings, holding an olive branch in her hand. It symbolizes the eternal theme of "friendship and peace".

shortFeatures: Independent art exhibition on the theme of the Republic of China
summary: The Story Museum of the Republic of China was established in December, 2017, with an exhibition hall area of 1,500 square meters. It is an independent art exhibition space in Tianjin with the theme of social and historical stories of the Republic of China, and it is also a cultural landmark in Tianjin South Railway Station area with multiple experience functions such as history, culture, art and entertainment. Through multiple interactive experience forms such as immersive multimedia interactive scenes, 3D art wall paintings, dream paper carvings, etc., it uses modern artistic expression techniques to present the historical changes and glimpses of the Republic of China society, and conveys the diversity and collision of "tradition and modernity", "western and oriental", "retro and trend". Bring you an "interesting and informative" journey through the Republic of China.

tagNameList: Science and Technology Museum; Museum; Science & Technology Museums
shortFeatures: A long history and a rich collection
summary:
Tianjin Museum of Natural History has a wide area with three floors, including permanent exhibition area, temporary exhibition area, experience entertainment area and popular science education area. 
There are many exhibits in the museum. If you first enter the exhibition area, you can first see a long scroll of life evolution. A pair of "mother and son" giant Shandong dragon skeletons in the center of the hall will immediately bring you into the situation of natural legends. On the left side of the hall is the living butterfly garden in the first museum in China. You can not only watch the colorful living butterflies flying all over the sky, but also observe the transformation process from caterpillars to beautiful butterflies, and truly experience "emerging into butterflies". 
The most unmissable thing is the exhibition hall on the third floor, which displays about 300 precious specimens of world wildlife, such as precious Chinese animal specimens such as crested ibis, giant panda, golden monkey and takin, which are known as the "Four Treasures of Qinling Mountains".

shortFeatures: Characteristic architecture combining Chinese and Western
summary:
· Built in 1937 and designed by Italian designer Paolo Bonetti, it is a western apartment townhouse building with a strong Italian style. 
It used to be the apartment of the British Huanong Company at the earliest, and later the former residence of Ma Lianliang, a Peking Opera performing artist, in Tianjin. 
The main building, commonly known as the "Bumble Building", is called the "Huayun Museum". It used to be an "edible museum", but now it no longer operates catering. 
More than 3,000 pieces of cultural relics of more than 100 kinds are displayed inside, which are valuable, including the most typical bronzes in various historical periods from the Western Zhou Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty.

tagNameList: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
summary: The main building of the National Museum of Marine Science and Technology has 3 floors, with some areas extending to 4 floors. The exhibition hall covers an area of approximately 23,000 square meters and is divided into six major exhibition zones, including: the Marine Nature Exhibition Zone, the Chinese Marine Civilization Exhibition Zone, the Marine Interactive Exhibition Zone, the Education and Public Outreach Center, the Marine Ecology Exhibition Zone, and the High-End Cooperation and Temporary Exhibition Zone. The museum also features public service facilities such as a museum shop, restaurant, café, and cinema. The National Museum of Marine Science and Technology will present Earth, the ocean, life, humans, and their interdependent and symbiotic systems, revealing the true meaning of harmony between humanity and the sea, guiding the public to better understand, love, and protect the ocean.

tagNameList: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Beaches; Seashores
shortFeatures: Artificially constructed large beach resort.
summary:
- The artificial beach at Dongjiang Port, invested and constructed by Tianjin Port Group, is the first artificial beach in Tianjin Binhai New Area.
- The specialized beach sand "Golden Sand" transported from Fujian has an average thickness of 1.2 meters, and dozens of large amusement facilities have been set up.
- A stage is also set up on the beach, where visitors can enjoy free performances including variety shows, shadow puppetry, and dance performances.
- Providing metropolitan-level services for visitors from Beijing and Tianjin, it only takes a little over an hour to experience the sunshine, beach, and sea.

tagNameList: Crosstalk Quyi; Venue exhibition hall; Quyi crosstalk
summary:
Where you can experience Tianjin's traditional cultural crosstalk on the spot, there will be different crosstalk teams performing on Friday and Saturday. It's best to book it in official website, and it may be sold out on the spot. 
The audience sits around a square table for four people, giving away snacks and white water, and ordering tea separately. There are three different seats, and the prices range from 40 to 90 yuan. 
Many locals will also come here to listen to cross talk. New and old cross talk actors will perform here, and Yun-peng Yue has also appeared here. It should be noted that the old actors have a heavy accent. 
 
 
Tips 
The Spring Festival ticket price will be higher than usual, usually 70/100/150 yuan.

It is one of the three ancient coastal wetlands in the world, and it is also a newly opened scenic spot in 2012. It has been popular in recent two years. Although there are not many things to play, it is better than the artistic conception and atmosphere. Under the blue sky, take a boat tour in the reeds with fragrant grass, full of fresh breath, and if you are lucky, you can see birds fluttering. You can feed in the wild duck pond, watch carp in the fish pond, and catch crabs in October. 
In addition, there are hot air balloons, hydrophilic viewing corridors, children's playground, fairy tale castles and bicycles, which are suitable for children to play. There are also special dining cabins, central water spray stage and Rose Manor to enjoy the beautiful scenery composed of romantic flowers. Many newcomers also choose to take photos here. It is the shooting venue of a series adapted from the famous novel Red Flag Spectrum nearby.  
Qilihai Wetland Park is located in the red line of permanent ecological protection designated by Tianjin. According to the Regulations on the Administration of Permanent Protection Ecological Areas in Tianjin, tourism activities are not allowed within the red line of permanent protection ecological areas.
