Therefore, Qilihai Wetland Park was closed in September 2015, and tourism operations will no longer be carried out in the future.

shortFeatures: European-style foreign goods trading market
summary: Tianjin Foreign Commodities Market is located on Fushun Road, Hebei Road, Hangzhou Road Street, Binhai New Area, Tianjin, on the southwest side of Hebei Road overpass of Jintang Highway. It is the first market established in North China specializing in import goods trading. After three phases of expansion, this market has a building area of about 16,000 square meters and more than 2,000 fixed booths. Its main business varieties are automobiles, motorcycles, household appliances, photographic equipment, clothing, watches, lighters, stereos, etc.

Jintang Bridge, originally built in 1906, is the earliest large-scale steel structure bridge in Tianjin. Because the People's Liberation Army victoriously joined forces here in the Battle of Pingjin, it became a landmark bridge symbolizing the liberation of Tianjin. 
Bridges are made of glass, so they are also called "glass bridges". The white bridge is covered with lamp posts, which all light up at night. The night view is very beautiful and worth visiting.

tagNameList: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Famous historical towns in northern China
summary:
This famous historical town in northern China has a thousand-year-old cultural heritage. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, Yangliuqing was the distribution center of folk art in northern China, which gave birth to wonderful folk art works such as Yangliuqing New Year pictures, the first of the four woodcut New Year pictures in China, Yangliuqing kites and paper-cutting, which are well-known in Tianjin and Beijing. Ancient Painting Society is also the only folk art exhibition hall of New Year pictures in Yangliuqing, where visitors can appreciate the evolution of Yangliuqing New Year pictures, the treasures of Yangliuqing New Year pictures in past dynasties and experience the whole production process of traditional New Year pictures. 
The old theater, memorial archway and Wenchang Pavilion in the town, which are called the three treasures of Yangliuqing. Now only Wenchang Pavilion still exists; In addition, there are Puliang Pagoda, Baoen Temple and Baitan Temple sites in Qing Dynasty. There are also nearby scenic spots such as Shijia Courtyard, one of the "Eight Great Masters" in Tianjin, Tianjin Tropical Plant Sightseeing Park, a national 4A-level scenic spot, and the exhibition hall of the former site of Tianjin Front Command of Pingjin Campaign, a national scenic spot. 
After visiting Yangliuqing Town, you must try the siomai in Majiaguan.

tagNameList: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
shortFeatures: There are many rare animals suitable for parent-child travel
summary:
Tianjin Zoo is full of lush trees, green grass, sky and water, and beautiful scenery. Viewing the museum area, walking in the forest, boating on the water, fishing by the lake, delicious food and various recreational activities in Xian Yi for all ages are enough to make visitors linger and make it worthwhile. 
There are also open animal exhibition areas, Sanqia Garden, Lingyu and Bird Language Forest, where people and animals coexist harmoniously and are naturally close. Tianjin's "Ten Scenic Spots" are famous far and near, and the zoo Range Rover is the icing on the cake. Every year, more than 2 million Chinese and foreign tourists come here. 
Tianjin Zoo integrates wildlife protection in different places, popular science education, scientific research, leisure and entertainment. It integrates animal medical treatment, animal performances, entertainment and catering.

shortFeatures: Appreciate various precious cultural relics
summary:
Tianjin Post Museum is the former site of Tianjin Daqing Post Office. On February 2, 1897, Tianjin Daqing Post Office was listed for business, becoming the first official office of Daqing Post Office in China, and issued the first set of stamps in China-Dalong Stamps. Today, this European-style building is still well preserved. 
This first local postal museum in Chinese mainland is divided into four exhibition halls: preface hall, postal office and other communication organization halls, postal office and philatelic hall. You can see the "rut stone" in Qin and Han Dynasties, the "brick painting" in Tang Dynasty, the actual envelope of the "Prime Minister's Yamen" in the early days of modern postal service, the "postal carriage" in Chunghwa Post period, and postcards circulating in Qing Dynasty. There are also rare treasures "Ferrar Manuscript" and "Red print with small print as a round" in the 23rd year of Guangxu in Qing Dynasty. 
Finally, you can also stamp a precious and special commemorative postmark.

tagNameList: Historical site; Military Sites; Historical Sites
shortFeatures: The Old Fort at the Mouth of the Haihe River
summary:
In modern Chinese history, the Dagu Fort has become an important maritime defense barrier in China, often referred to as "Humen in the South, Dagu in the North."  
In the Boxer Protocol signed in 1901, the Qing government was forced to demolish the Dagu Fort. The two well-preserved sites are the "Wei" character South Fort and the "Hai" character Old Fort.  
It is now rated as one of the "Ten Scenic Spots of Tianjin" and designated as a patriotic education base in Tianjin.  
Adjacent to the Dagu Mouth are the Haimen Bridge and Dagu Lighthouse. During the day, visitors can explore the fort ruins and take speedboats out to sea; at night, they can enjoy the sight of the countless colorful lights on the bridge.

shortFeatures: Visit the lions of various shapes on the bridge
summary:
Lion Forest Bridge is located across the Haihe River, connecting the ancient culture street scenic spot and Wanghailou area. It is a landmark bridge on the Haihe River. 
Each of the lions on the bridge is different in shape, lively, black and white, and very cute.

shortFeatures: Known as Eastern Wall Street
summary: Tianjin Jiefang North Road (Dafrench Road) goes westbound from tianjin railway station, crosses Haihe Jiefang Bridge, and then enters Jiefang Road Financial Street, which is known as the "Wall Street" of the East. This is a not very wide road, along which the French plane trees are densely leaved, and the road is covered by green shade. The buildings on both sides have unique shapes, such as Gothic, Romanesque, Romanesque, Germanic, Russian classical and other western buildings in the Middle Ages, so that you can appreciate the exotic style and interest.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn leaves; Mountains; Pick-Your-Own
shortFeatures: Experience the leisurely life of mountain people
summary:
Jiushan Peak Natural Scenic Area is located in Xiaying Town, Jixian County. It is an ideal place for people to return to nature and a wild paradise for seeking strange and secluded places. 
Beside the mountain stream, walking into the valley, you entered the boundary of the top of Nine Mountains. The Great Wall of Huangyaguan undulates among the mountains like a dragon. On the hillsides on both sides of the valley, peach and willow are green, the mountain flowers are rotten, the fruits are fragrant, and the charm is graceful; Brick houses, with unique small buildings, are scattered at random. Looking south from Changzhou Village, Dadongshan has a palm of gods reaching the sky and a colorful phoenix rising in the sun. The dancing between two lions in Yutou Mountain is indeed strange, wonderful and wonderful.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Enjoy autumn leaves; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Beautiful natural spring lake park
summary:
It integrates water scenery, garden landscape and ancient buildings, and is known as "the first spring lake in China". 
Known as "one pavilion, three gardens, three floors, four temples, six islands, seven bridges and ten pavilions", there are 16 famous scenic spots of Minghu Lake to enjoy. 
Besides walking, cruise is also a good choice to visit Daming Lake. Boating on Daming Lake is both relaxed and sightseeing. 
· There are exhibitions of winter jasmine, orchids and bonsai from time to time every year; It is recommended to focus on the lotus exhibition, with the flowering period from July 15th to August 31st.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Treasure for Kids; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The summit offers a panoramic view of downtown Jinan.
summary:
- It is known as one of the "Three Major Scenic Spots of Jinan" alongside Baotu Spring and Daming Lake. It is part of the Taishan mountain range, not very high, but with undulating peaks and lush forests.
- The Thousand Buddha Cave here houses nearly 30,000 Buddhist statues, with the largest reclining Buddha measuring 28 meters in length. The cave also features exquisite murals that showcase the profound cultural connotations of Buddhism.
- Visitors usually enter Qianfo Mountain through the North Gate and begin the climb. It generally takes less than an hour to reach the summit, where they can enjoy a panoramic view of downtown Jinan.
- A temple fair is held every year on the 3rd day of the 3rd lunar month and the 9th day of the 9th lunar month, lasting for a week, featuring performances such as gong and drum, martial arts, and Shandong kuaishu (a fast-paced storytelling art).

tagNameList: Close to nature; a hidden gem for kids.; Springs; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Springs of Jinan.
summary:
- It contains a natural cave with massive stones lying within, resembling a fierce tiger hidden deep inside, and the sound of the spring is eerily similar to a tiger's roar, hence named Black Tiger Spring.
- Black Tiger Spring is majestic and powerful, with a flow rate second only to Baotu Spring, ranking second among all the springs in Jinan.
- Many locals come here to collect water, which is crystal clear. Bees might also want to try the spring water here.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Jinan city prominent sign
summary:
Quancheng is the alias of Jinan. The design of the whole square closely follows the theme of "Spring", and the shape of the word "Spring" in seal script is located in the center. 
There is a lotus statue in the middle of the lotus music fountain in the east of the square. The fountain will change different shapes, and each fountain lasts about 30 minutes. 
There is Ginza Shopping Plaza underground in Quancheng Plaza, and Furong Snack Street is not far away. It is a good choice to come here for leisure in the evening.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks; Memorial Temples
shortFeatures: Splendid Spring Water Park
summary:
Located outside the west gate of Jinan Old City, it is bordered by Baotu Spring in the south and Daming Lake in the north. There are many famous springs around the pool, forming Wulongtan Spring Group. 
The main landscape is named after Wulongtan. Legend has it that Wulongtan is the mansion of Qin Qiong, a hero of Sui and Tang Dynasties, and then it fell and sank due to heavy rain to become today's Wulongtan. 
The garden style combines the essence of gardening in the north and south. It is composed of pools, pools, streams, ports and other landscapes, and 27 springs and pools around the springs are connected as a whole. 
The places of interest and historical sites and newly-built landscapes in the park include: the site of Qin Qiong's former residence, the former site of the leading organs of the Communist Party of China in Shandong Province, the famous pavilion, etc.

shortFeatures: Old street with historical and cultural characteristics in Jinan
summary:
Qushuiting Street is a famous old street with historical and cultural characteristics at home and abroad in Jinan, Quancheng. 
On one side is an old house with blue bricks and red tiles, and on the other side is a clear spring flowing calmly, where people facing the street wash rice and wash laundry, making the old street vibrant. 
At present, the spring city style of "every household springs water, every household hangs poplars" in Travels of Lao Can is still completely retained.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
shortFeatures: A large collection of ancient cultural relics
summary: Shandong Museum, located in the east of Jinan, is the earliest provincial-level comprehensive geographical museum established in China, covering an area of about 34,000 square meters and a building area of about 21,000 square meters. Up to now, there are more than 140,000 pieces of cultural relics in the collection, and nearly 10,000 pieces of natural specimens in the collection, with rich display categories. The magnificent and elegant architectural complex embodies the combination of national style and modern art, and has become a major landscape of Jinan, a famous historical and cultural city in China. Here, you can see a large number of ancient ceramics, bronzes, ancient paintings and calligraphy books, Oracle bones, Han portrait stones and other cultural relics. Among them, the red pottery animal-shaped pot unearthed at Dawenkou site, Oracle Bone Inscriptions in Shang Dynasty, the great jade bi of Lu State in Warring States Period, the bamboo slips of Sun Tzu's Art of War and Sun Bin's Art of War, and the murals of Dongping Han Tomb are all treasures of the town hall, which are very rare, and only some of them are exhibited occasionally. There are souvenir shops and coffee shops on the first floor of the museum, which can provide light meals; There are water fountains on each floor to provide boiling water. If you are tired of visiting, there are many rest seats in the museum for resting your feet.

shortFeatures: Beautiful and elegant garden architecture
summary: Jinan Huancheng Park is built along the moat, with a total length of 6.26 kilometers. The park is mainly composed of three parts: first, the east moat, a four-season garden scenic spot dominated by plant landscape, which is divided into four areas: spring, summer, autumn and winter; Second, the west moat, the southern section of the river is the "May 3rd" Flower Memorial Garden, and the northern section of the river is the Quanxi Waterscape Garden; Third, the eastern section of the south moat is a spring stone garden dominated by Black Tiger Spring.

shortFeatures: Pearl-white bubbles poured out from the bottom of the pool
summary: Pearl Spring is one of the four famous springs in Jinan (Baotu Spring, Black Tiger Spring, Pearl Spring and Wulongtan). It is located in the courtyard of Shandong Provincial People's Congress (also called Pearl Spring Courtyard) on the south side of Daming Lake Park. It used to be the residence of the governor of Shandong during the Ming and Qing Dynasties. Compared with Baotu Spring, which is full of tourists, the courtyard where Pearl Spring is located is much quieter. It is very pleasant to enjoy the spring and take a walk here. Come and see Pearl Fountain. The spring water of Pearl Spring is as clear as blue. Standing on the floating pavilion on the south bank of the pool, you can see a string of white bubbles pouring out from the bottom of the pool not far from the pool, like floating pearls, so it is known as "Pearl Spring". Legend has it that the strings of "pearls" in the Pearl Spring were turned into the tears of Shun's two concubines, E Huang and Nv Ying. There are many fish in the spring pool (most of the fish in the spring water in Jinan are brocade scales), showing great vitality. You can also see kind people feeding them with big white steamed buns. Compared with Daming Lake, this place is really a paradise for fish.

shortFeatures: Commercial street combining ancient and modern times
summary: Combining ancient and modern commercial streets, the scenery is different during the day and night, so you can walk around.

tagNameList: Climbing mountains; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Enjoy the view of red leaves covering the entire mountain.
summary:
Hongye Valley is known as "the source of springs, the hometown of clouds, the world of flowers, the ocean of forests, and a paradise for leisure and vacation." Its unique wild yellow-leaf forest, which is covered in red leaves every late autumn, creates a rare and exceptional natural landscape.

Hongye Valley experiences four distinct seasons within a single valley. In spring, various flowers bloom on trees, and flocks of warblers fly around. Red peaches, white pear blossoms, and yellow forsythias dot the vibrant mountain forest. In summer, the valley is lush and vibrant, with rushing waterfalls, cool mountain breezes, deep scenery, and babbling streams. In autumn, the view from the heights is breathtaking, with the mountains turning crimson, the forests dyed in rich colors, and the beauty overwhelming. In winter, the valley is blanketed in snow, with jade-like trees and crystalline flowers, and the sunshine is pure and bright.

tagNameList: Climbing mountains; appreciating autumn leaves; Mountain Climbing; Temples
shortFeatures: One of the Four Great Buddhist Temples of China.
summary:
The Lingyan Temple in Jinan is a national scenic area and a Buddhist holy site, established during the Eastern Jin Dynasty, with a history of over 1,600 years.  
Standing in the midst of the beautiful scenery of Lingyan, you will see the surrounding mountains, steep cliffs, and secluded caves; the layered pines and cypress, the sweet springs, and fragrant tea; the numerous ancient sites, with the sounds of Buddhist chanting filling the air. Here, you can find the towering Biji Pagoda, the legendary Iron Kasaya, the Banzhou Hall from the Sui and Tang Dynasties, and the colorful clay sculptures of arhats from the Song Dynasty. There are also natural wonders such as the "Mirror Pool in Spring Dawn," "Fang Mountain Covered in Green," and "Bright孔晴雪." Therefore, the Ming Dynasty writer Wang Shizhen said, "Lingyan is the most secluded place behind Mount Tai; if one travels to Mount Tai without visiting Lingyan, the journey is incomplete."

Wangfu Pool, also known as Zhuoying Spring, is more than 30 meters long from north to south and 20 meters wide from east to west, with a water surface of more than 600 square meters. Walk from Furong Street to Donghuaqiangzi Street, go east to Qifengqiao Street, then walk to Wangfu Chizi Street, walk to the middle section of Wangfu Chizi Street, turn west, and a large area of green pool water appears in front of you. This is Wangfu Chizi, and the bank of the pool is made of large bluestone, which is filled with a strong civilian atmosphere. In the eyes of many people, among many famous springs, Wangfu Pool may be the most common and friendly. 
On the west side of Wangfu Pool is a two-story building. The foundation is all made of bluestone, which is tall and imposing. Most of the foundations of the east and west bungalows are immersed in water. After many years, the green trees around the pool are shaded, which has the charm of Jiangnan water town.

tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Nature and Adventure; Caves; Grottoes
shortFeatures: Admire the exquisite murals in the cave
summary: Wanfo Cave, located at the northern foot of Qianfo Mountain, is a great scenic spot of Qianfo Mountain. It was built in 1992. It combines the essence of the four major grottoes in Dunhuang, Longmen, Maijishan and Yungang. After selection, condensation and reconstruction by artists, nearly 30,000 Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, disciples and heavenly kings were shaped by imitation. The largest reclining Buddha is 28 meters long, the giant Buddha standing in front of the cave is 15 meters high, and the murals in the cave are more than 10,000 square meters. Each of them complement each other with different styles such as exquisite and magnificent, simple and majestic, implicit and beautiful, magnificent and rugged, which reproduces the artistic charm of Chinese grotto statues and opens the door to history for future generations to explore the past civilization. Wanfo Cave consists of four parts, namely: Mogao Collection, Longmen Essence, Maiji Wonders and Yungang Gathering. The 500-meter-long cave records the historical changes of Chinese Buddhism development and contains profound cultural connotations.

tagNameList: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
shortFeatures: A beautiful city zoo
summary: Jinan Zoo, located in the north of the city, is one of the largest urban zoos in China. Here, you can see giraffes, hippos, chimpanzees, zebras and other animals and birds, as well as rare animals such as giant pandas, golden monkeys, Asian elephants, Tibetan wild donkeys, white-lipped deer, black langurs, red-crowned cranes and white storks. Jinan Zoo is full of trees, hills, lakes and rivers, and the environment is very good. It's nice to take children for a walk. There are ferris wheels, rapids, roller coasters and other projects here.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: A city park with a wide variety of plants
summary: Quancheng Park, located in the middle of Jinan city, was built in September 1989 and opened to the public free of charge in September 1997. Formerly known as Jinan Botanical Garden, it was renamed Quancheng Park on September 22, 2006. The total area of the park is 46.7 hectares, with a green space rate of 81.7%. According to the groups with high ornamental value in the process of plant evolution, there are pine and cypress, peony, rose, bamboo, willow, chrysanthemum, clove and other gardens in this area. Through the classification of plants, people are shown with the peculiar tree posture, abundant flowers and fruits and colorful colors of various plants in different seasons. The ornamental greenhouse area is located in the western part of the garden, which is a large building complex composed of tropical, subtropical, sandy plant greenhouses and bonsai gardens. The introduction and domestication area is responsible for introducing foreign plants, saving and cultivating rare and endangered plants, and providing services for greening scientific research. There are also refreshment service department and photography department in the park, and large-scale flower exhibitions and bonsai root carving art exhibitions are organized to enrich the content of the masses' tour.

Shuyuquan is now located in Baotu Spring Park, not far from Cangyuan, and there is a clear water in the northeast, which gushes out from the ground like a bright mirror. This is Shuyuquan among the seventy-two springs. The edge of Shuyu Spring is shaded by willows, the spring water is crystal clear, the water and stones are excited, and there is a gurgling sound, just like Shuyu. 
Shuyuquan is famous because Li Qingzhao, a famous female poet in Song Dynasty, lived here. Its name comes from Li Qingzhao's Shuyu Collection, and there is a Li Qingzhao Memorial Hall in Quanbei to show its nostalgia.

tagNameList: Resorts; Experience Slow Life; Golf Courses; Lakes
shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery of lakes and mountains

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Art Museums
shortFeatures: Large modern art gallery with perfect functions
summary: Founded in June, 1977, Shandong Art Museum is a national institution under the leadership of Shandong Provincial Department of Culture. It is located in the prosperous area of Jinan, covering an area of about 12,000 square meters, with an exhibition building of about 2,300 square meters and an office building of about 2,000 square meters. There are seven functional departments: exhibition department, art creation department, New Year picture research department, mass art work department, custody department, office and administrative department. Shandong Art Museum, a museum of plastic arts, is a non-profit social welfare undertaking. It has many functions, such as collecting and displaying fine arts, meeting the aesthetic needs of the masses, organizing academic research, and carrying out international cultural exchanges. Under the leadership of the Party and governments at all levels, Shandong Art Museum adheres to the direction of "literature and art serving the people and socialism" and the principle of "letting a hundred flowers blossom and a hundred schools of thought contend", and has done a lot of work in exhibition and exchange, collection and research, creation and service, etc., and has become an important window for cultural exchanges between China and foreign countries in our province and an important position for the construction of socialist spiritual civilization. Since its establishment, the museum has collected more than 500 modern and modern works of art and more than 2,000 works of folk art through collection, acquisition and acceptance of donations. About 800 exhibitions were held and more than 3 million visitors were received. Shandong Art Museum has a strong creative team, shouldering the tasks of creation, research and social service. According to incomplete statistics, their art works have been selected in more than 280 national and national art exhibitions, and won more than 60 awards; Selected for more than 260 foreign art exhibitions and won more than 20 awards; Their works are collected by 200 art institutions at home and abroad; More than 50 works of art were presented to foreign friends as important gifts by national and provincial leaders; He designed, created and painted hundreds of large murals, reliefs and huge paintings and calligraphy works for the Great Hall of the People in the capital, Zhongnanhai, Tiananmen Gate Tower, Diaoyutai State Guesthouse, Chinese embassies abroad, Capital Airport and many important places in our province.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Playground; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Intangible Cultural Heritage Themed Park
summary: Jinan Fantawild Oriental Heritage is located on Jiqi Road in the Huaiyin District of Jinan, north of the West Railway Station. The park is divided into eight major thematic areas, featuring 29 unique attractions and over 1,000 cultural subcategories. It is a fourth-generation high-tech theme park that combines intangible cultural heritage as its core with modern advanced scientific research technology. Visit Jinan Fantawild Oriental Heritage to experience an extraordinary cultural feast, feel the magic of high-tech innovation, enjoy thrilling amusement rides, and taste a variety of Chinese delicacies and snacks. Visitors can fully enjoy the charm of Eastern culture without leaving the park, experiencing a thousand years of Chinese spirit in one place.

tagNameList: Historical Sites; Nature and Adventure; Springs; Memorial Temples
shortFeatures: Composed of one river, one lake, three springs, and four gardens.
summary: The First Spring in the World Scenic Area is located in the center of Jinan City. It consists of "one river (the city moat), one lake (Daming Lake), three springs (Baotu Spring, Black Tiger Spring, and the Five Dragon Pool), and four parks (Baotu Spring Park, City Moat Park, Five Dragon Pool Park, and Daming Lake Park)." The scenic area is centered around Baotu Spring, known as the "First Spring in the World," with the spring water flowing into a river, then merging into a lake, and is closely connected with the ancient Mingfu city. To the north of Baotu Spring is the Five Dragon Pool, and to the east is the City Moat Park (which contains Black Tiger Spring and other springs), both of which are also highly renowned in Jinan. These springs are famous for their excellent water quality. Daming Lake is a natural lake formed by the convergence of many springs, with spring water flowing in from the southern shore. When the lake is full, water flows out from the North Water Gate, built in the Song Dynasty, on the northern shore. The lakebed is made of impermeable igneous rock, ensuring that it does not rise during heavy rainfall or dry up during prolonged droughts. It is known as the "Pearl of the Spring City" and has been praised for the saying, "All the springs converge here, feeding the Ji and Luo rivers." The City Moat, also formed by spring water, wraps around the ancient city like a jade belt, and visitors can take boat rides to explore the moat.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: Ming Dynasty village ruins with ancient style and appearance
summary: Zhujiayu is a typical mountain village-type ancient settlement in northern China and the only "Chinese Historical and Cultural Village" in Shandong Province. It is known as the "First Village of Qi and Lu." Here, there are numerous scenic spots such as ancestral halls, pavilions, ancient bridges, and cultural relic sites scattered across the area. Surrounded by green peaks and serene streams, with the Longbai and Hushan mountains guarding it like a picturesque scene, Zhujiayu attracts a large number of domestic and foreign tourists and scholars with its rich history, diverse cultural resources, and scenic beauty. To them, Zhujiayu is like a thick "book," covering subjects such as politics, history, ethnicity, religion, culture, gardens, architecture, art, nature, and geography. According to expert research, pottery unearthed from the site suggests that the area was inhabited during the Xia and Shang Dynasties, over 3,800 years ago. Since the Ming Dynasty, despite over six centuries of changes, Zhujiayu has largely preserved its ancient architecture, including old bridges, roads, ancestral halls, temples, houses, schools, springs, and watchtowers. There are nearly 200 ancient buildings, 99 stone bridges, 66 wells and springs, and over 100 natural scenic spots in the area. With its elegant natural environment and profound cultural heritage, Zhujiayu remains a place of significant historical and cultural value.

shortFeatures: The famous Haiyou Ancient Pavilion
summary:
Lixia Pavilion is one of the famous pavilions in Jinan. It was awarded the "Lixia Pavilion" because it is adjacent to Lishan (Qianfoshan) in the south, also known as the ancient calendar pavilion. 
The whole island where Lixia Pavilion is located is surrounded by green willows, flowers and trees are sparse, pavilions and corridors are strewn at random, and bamboos and flowers are dotted among them. 
· In spring, bamboo trees are dancing, and green willows are caged with smoke; In autumn, the lake ripples, the lotus flowers are fragrant, and the cool breeze blows. It is called "the autumn wind under the calendar" and is one of the eight scenic spots in ancient Licheng.

tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Historic buildings; Ancient Pagodas; Historical Sites
shortFeatures: Existing stone pagodas of Sui Dynasty in China
summary:
Four Gate Pagoda has a history of nearly 1,400 years and is a treasure of Jinan culture. 
The wonders of the cliff and the solemnity of the Tallinn, the most beautiful is the four-gate tower, which is majestic, strong and solemn. It is the oldest single-story pavilion-style stone tower in China at present. Sitting a Buddha in each direction is awe-inspiring. The towering bamboo forest is rare in the north. 
There are completely preserved ancient brick towers in the forest, with clear ornamentation and majestic tower bodies. Besides, ancient towers record the stories of immortality of monks who died one by one.

tagNameList: Treasured Places for Strolling with Kids; Appreciating Autumn Leaves; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: Jinan Suburban Eco-Resort Area
summary: The new botanical garden is located in Zhangqiu District, Jinan, about 35 kilometers from the city center, covering an area of approximately 100 hectares, which is about 2.5 times the size of the old botanical garden in downtown Jinan (now Quancheng Park). It is bordered by West Mountain to the west, Jinping Mountain to the south, Hushan Mountain to the east, and Weishan Mountain to the north. The Balou River lies to the southeast. Surrounded by mountains on all sides and facing water, the new botanical garden features six lakes—Chunhua Lake, Xiaxiang Lake, Qiushi Lake, Dongyun Lake, Wangyun Lake, and Yunying Lake—formed by water diverted from the Duozhuang Reservoir in Zhangqiu. This creates a picturesque and refreshing environment for visitors, with mountains and water complementing each other.

Hero Mountain Scenic Area is located in Shizhong District, Jinan City, Shandong Province. It is a veritable city mountain. Hero Mountain is also known as "Sili Mountain". Hero Mountain is located in a very superior natural environment, with beautiful scenery and rich forests. It is an ideal place for Jinan citizens to climb mountains, exercise and have fun. 
The Martyrs Cemetery and Jinan Campaign Memorial Hall in the Heroic Mountain Scenic Area are famous patriotic education bases in Jinan, and they are holy places for people to cherish the memory of martyrs and carry out revolutionary traditional education. In addition, there are scenic spots such as Liuchun Garden, Ma'anshan and the statue of Chairman Mao to visit.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; garden park; Gardens
shortFeatures: Flower Viewing and Hiking Large Scenic Park
summary:
The total number of exhibition gardens reaches 108, including 17 from provincial cities, 45 from other cities, regions of Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, as well as 21 from foreign cities, in addition to 9 designer gardens and 13 specialty gardens.  
Here, you can see the Mongolian yurts of Inner Mongolia, touch the prayer wheel in Lhasa, admire the St. Sophia Cathedral in Harbin, and experience the water-and-bridge scenery of Jiangnan.  
Jinan International Garden has eight functional zones: public area, central lake area, domestic exhibition area, international future exhibition area, Qilu exhibition area, leisure and entertainment area, fun garden area, and seedling reserve area. The three main architectural landmarks are the Water Gate, the main exhibition hall, and the Science and Technology Museum.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn leaves; Mountains; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Named after the juxtaposition of five beautiful peaks
summary:
This mountain belongs to Mount Tai Mountain, and is called "Three Mountains in Central Shandong" together with Mount Tai and Lingyan Mountain. It is named after the juxtaposition of five beautiful mountain peaks: Huixian, Zhixian, Qunxian, Wangxian and Juxian. 
In the thick shade of green trees surrounded by five peaks, the palace, the temple, the pavilion and the platform are hidden from each other, and the scenery is excellent. It is said that there are eight scenic spots, namely, the green cliff, the seven peaks of Runyu, the early shining of Mingquan, the misty rain in Fengshan, the morning glow of rolling chestnut, the moon fishing in Yutai, the spring dawn of Xingdi, and the woodcutting in Xueling. Here, the mountains stretch and the mountains and waters are beautiful, which is a rare geomantic omen treasure land. 
In ancient times, Taoism was very prosperous, and Taoist temples were large in scale, so they were divided into southern and northern views. The north view is the true view of the cave. There are many steles and stones in the view, and there are hundreds of palaces and temples, mainly including Jade Emperor Hall, Zhenwu Hall, Sanyuan Hall, Qingling Pavilion and Stone Memorial Arch. In particular, "Mr. Cui's Portrait Praise Monument" is the most precious. This monument has excellent calligraphy and paintings, and most of them have been recorded by epigraphs of past dynasties. Known as Yuandu Temple in the south, also known as Xuandu Temple, is the cemetery of Dewang Mansion in the Ming Dynasty. There are six tombs of Ming Dezhuang King, Deyi King, Dehuai King, Degong King, Deding King and Deduan King in the mausoleum. The recently excavated tomb of Dezhuang King is almost the same in scale as that of Ming Tombs.

shortFeatures: View the ancient stone Buddha heads
summary: Big Buddha Head, located in Fohui Mountain, southeast of Qianfo Mountain, Jinan City, Shandong Province, has a huge stone Buddha statue on the mountain. It was built in the Song Dynasty and is a key cultural relics protection unit announced by Jinan City in 1979. There is a Buddhist niche on the Buddha statue, which was inscribed "Daxiong Hall" by Zhang Yinglin, a scholar in the late Qing Dynasty. Fohui Mountain is 460 meters above sea level, with steep mountains, dangerous boulders and lingering valleys. It is said that every autumn, wild chrysanthemums all over the mountains are dotted among green pines and cypresses, and "Foshan Chrysanthemum Appreciation", one of the eight scenic spots in Jinan in the past, is here

poiName: Jiudingta Chinese Folk Custom Amusement Park
shortFeatures: Experience the folk customs of China's various ethnic groups.
summary: The Jiuding Tower Chinese Folk Customs Happy Park is located in Liucheng District, Jinan City, Shandong Province, in Liubu Town, 26 kilometers south of downtown Jinan. It is a comprehensive cultural, ecological, and tourist attraction built to 4A scenic area standards. In the Jiuding Tower Chinese Folk Customs Happy Park, you can experience the customs, architectural styles, ethnic dances, traditional clothing, ethnic cuisine, and handicrafts of various minority groups. The park consists of 16 ethnic villages, including Dai, Wa, Zhuang, Miao, Hani, and Buyi, among others. It is home to ethnic minorities from all over the country. Hundreds of folk artists from across the country perform live, showcasing their unique skills and tricks. In the Jiuding Tower Chinese Folk Customs Happy Park, you can gain a thorough understanding of the customs and traditions of China's various ethnic minorities.

Lao She Memorial Hall is located in the newly expanded Daming Lake Scenic Area, which was built on the basis of the original reserved No.12 courtyard of Xueyuan Street. 
The memorial hall is not big, with an old-fashioned quadrangle with a blue brick roof. The plaque of "Lao She Memorial Hall" at the entrance was written by Lao She's son Shu Yi himself. 
The white wall inside the door of the memorial hall is also carved with Lao She's masterpiece Autumn in Jinan, which evokes countless people's memories. 
Daming Lake, written by Lao She, has become a highlight in the exhibition, and attracts tourists to participate in it through various means such as video images, recitation and reading.

Jinxiangshan Ski Resort was founded in 2003 and is managed and operated by Jinan Jinxiangshan Tourism Development Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Luhan Group. It is located in Jinxiangshan Scenic Spot, a national AAAA-level large-scale amusement scenic spot in Shangchang Village, Zhonggong Town, southern mountainous area of Jinan City, Shandong Province, and focuses on the top ski resorts in East China. And it has always been praised as a skiing paradise by skiers from all over the country for its abundant snow, delicate snow quality and international-level skiing facilities. From the site selection to the development of ski pistes, the ski resort has been investigated and carefully designed by Paul, a famous French international ski resort planning expert, for many years. For many years, it has been leading the fitness concept of "health, fashion and sports" in winter. 
Jinxiangshan Ski Resort has a total area of 100,000 square meters, with open landform and unique geographical location and traffic conditions. It has an alpine skiing environment that meets international standards, and has built a number of junior, intermediate and advanced ski trails, as well as professional skiing facilities such as towing and empty cables. It is the widest skiing area, the most complete facilities and the strongest professional technology in East China. It has become one of the major ski resorts in China. Moreover, over the years, Jinxiangshan Ski Resort has firmly occupied 70% of the provincial ski market with its fine management, professional coaching service team and high-quality alpine skiing environment, which has effectively promoted the development of domestic skiing. 
Golden Elephant Mountain Ski Resort is equipped with Golden Elephant Mountain Specialty Restaurant, Golden Elephant Mountain Restaurant, Golden Elephant Mountain Conference Resort Center, Golden Elephant Mountain Development Training Base and Golden Elephant Mountain Paradise.

shortFeatures: Collect Xu Beihong and other famous monuments
summary: Jinan Museum is a local comprehensive museum located on the west side of Qianfoshan Park, a scenic tourist attraction. The museum now has more than 20,000 pieces of cultural relics and more than 2,000 rare books. The collections mainly come from archaeological excavations, state allocations, donations from social organizations and people from all walks of life, and funds from the municipal government. Many cultural relics in the collection are rare treasures in China, such as the "ivory comb with revolving pattern" in the Neolithic Age, the bronze pattern with wrong gold eyes in the Shang Dynasty, the "bronze gui of Lu Bo's father Betty Jiji" in the Spring and Autumn Period, the jade spoon in the Warring States Period, and the "painted music, dance and acrobatic pottery figurines" unearthed in the tomb in the early Western Han Dynasty, which are all the only ones in the whole country.

shortFeatures: The whole route is paved with a long stone foundation
summary: Quancheng Road is located in the bustling central business district, with a long history and developed commerce. It is the main axis of the east-west development of Quancheng. The intersection of the natural landscape of the north and south is surrounded by the four spring groups in Jinan, and it has the status of "Cross Golden Street". It is the symbol road of Jinan, the city of Shandong Province.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Natural oxygen bar with beautiful scenery
summary: Qixingtai Tourist Resort is located at the junction of Zhangqiu, Licheng, Tai'an and Laiwu, with an average altitude of 680 meters and a forest coverage rate of over 85%. With beautiful scenery and elegant environment, the content of negative oxygen ions per cubic centimeter in the air is as high as 2,000. It is an excellent natural oxygen bar. It is a tourist attraction integrating ecological leisure and history and culture.

Hongshi Park, located in the center of Laiwu District, Jinan City, is a comprehensive open park for citizens in Laiwu District, Jinan City. It was founded in 1987. It is named after a large area of exposed red stones generated in the Jurassic era. It is a good place for citizens to camp and relax.

shortFeatures: Clear spring with green algae and white stones
summary: Baishi Spring is located in the northeast of Heihu Spring, on the river bank on the south side of Jiefang Pavilion, and adjacent to Jiunv Spring in the west. Because there are many rocks in the spring week, it is named "White Stone Spring". There are white natural stones lying prone beside Baishi Spring, and the water is as sweet as the wind, which can be irrigated and drunk. During the water season, strings of blisters emerge, rippling, and confusing with the green algae and white stones in the water, weaving a water pattern.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Enjoy autumn leaves; City Parks; Wetlands
shortFeatures: Urban parks that blend into multiple landscapes
summary: Jinan Forest Park is a "Spring City"-the only comprehensive urban park in the west of Jinan, which integrates various landscapes such as woodland, wetland, water stream and sculpture, and integrates various functions such as recreation, popular science, fitness and risk avoidance. Jinan Forest Park is located in Zhangzhuang Road, Huaiyin District, Jinan City, Shandong Province, adjacent to Xingji River in the east, Second Ring West Road in the west and Jixi Road in the north.
