poiName: Jinan Confucian Temple of Prefectural School
summary: Jinan Fuxue Confucian Temple is adjacent to Daming Lake in the north and near Furong Street and other old city streets. It was founded in Xining of Song Dynasty (AD 1068-1077), collapsed at the end of Yuan Dynasty, and was rebuilt in Hongwu in Ming Dynasty (AD 1369). Many renovations were carried out in the Qing Dynasty, basically maintaining the scale and architectural layout of the Confucian Temple in the Ming Dynasty. According to textual research, Jinan Fuxue Confucian Temple was built earlier than Qufu Confucian Temple in Shandong Province, Pingxiang Confucian Temple in Jiangxi Province, Liuhe Confucian Temple in Nanjing and Suzhou Confucian Temple.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Autumn viewing resort with red leaves in autumn
summary:
Badaguan refers to eight roads named after the eight passes of the Great Wall (now it has been increased to ten). Because there are villas with architectural styles from more than 20 countries, such as Russia, Britain, France, Germany and Mai, it is known as the "World Architecture Expo". 
Huashi Building and Princess Building in Guannei are the most famous, with unique architectural styles and need to charge tickets. They are must-punch places here. 
In addition to viewing buildings, you can also enjoy the beautiful scenery of Badaguan in the four seasons. Shaoguan Road is full of peaches, which bloom in spring; Lagerstroemia indica is planted all over Zhengguan Road, which blooms in summer; Juyongguan Road is a five-angled maple, which is dyed with maple red in autumn frost; There are rows of cedar trees on both sides of Zijingguan Road, which are evergreen all year round.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; City coordinates; Bridges; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A century-old sea promenade
summary:
· Qingdao's earliest military-specific artificial wharf is a landmark building and a famous scenic spot in Qingdao. 
The octagonal building inside the breakwater at the southern end is called "Huilan Pavilion". Standing here, you can enjoy the "Flying Pavilion Huilan", one of the ten scenic spots in Qingdao. 
The north coast is called "Zhanqiao Park", with lush flowers and plants, and stone chairs for tourists to rest and enjoy the scenery of the sea and sky.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Famous Western Architecture in Qingdao
summary:
· Built in 1930, formerly known as "St. Miel Church", it is the largest Romanesque building in Qingdao and the only consecrated church in China. 
· Designed by German designer Biloha, according to Gothic and Romanesque architectural styles. It is a masonry twin tower building with four bells inside. 
· The church is spacious and bright. The hall is about 18 meters high. There are two confession booths on both sides of the corridors for priests to receive believers to confess and confess.  
• The church has a valuable organ imported from Germany, which is played only during Sunday Mass.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Built to commemorate the May 4th Movement
summary:
Named after the May 4th Movement, it is the most iconic central square in Qingdao. 
Backed by the municipal government building, facing Fushan Bay in the south, with a length of 700 meters from north to south, it is a modern square integrating lawns, fountains and sculptures. 
Divided into north and south parts, sculptures such as "The Wind in May" distributed on the central axis show a solemn, solid and upward magnificent scenery rhythmically.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Kid-friendly hidden gems; Mountains; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Appreciating the red leaves and sunset glow at a famous Taoist mountain.
summary:
- Located in the eastern part of Qingdao, Mount Laoshan is known as the "First Famous Mountain on the Sea." Its highest peak, Jufeng, rises to about 1,133 meters above sea level. The mountain is famous for its grandeur, magnificence, uniqueness, and beauty, and is a renowned Taoist sacred mountain.
- The Taoist temples of Laoshan, the sunrise, and the sea of clouds are all highly famous; the southern route includes Liqing River and Yakou; the eastern route leads to Yangkou; the central route passes through Beijiushui; visitors arriving by sea mainly explore the Taiqing and Shangqing scenic areas.
- The Laoshan Mountaineering Festival is held every April; the Laoshan Cherry Blossom Festival takes place every May, attracting large numbers of tourists and creating a lively atmosphere.
- In late March every year, the cherry blossoms bloom all over Laoshan, turning the entire area into a sea of flowers.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
shortFeatures: Climb the Red Top Mushroom Building to enjoy the panoramic view of the island city
summary:
· Signal Hill Park is located in the center of Qingdao. It is named after the signal station built on the top of the mountain for ship pilotage. 
The three red-roofed mushroom buildings on the top of the mountain are particularly conspicuous, the tallest of which is the rotating viewing building, where you can overlook Qingdao in 360 degrees. 
· The Treading Observation Deck is a little below Lianxin Bridge, which is the best place to photograph the German castle-style Guesthouse in the south.

tagNameList: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; A Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
shortFeatures: Decoding the Production Process of Tsingtao Beer
summary:
Qingdao Beer Museum  
Happiness · Surprise · Sharing  
Discover the birthplace of Qingdao Beer  
Taste the finest beer that only brewers can enjoy  
· National Key Cultural Relic Protection Unit  
· National First-Class Museum  
· One of China’s Top 300 Most Valuable Brands  
· National AAAA Tourist Attraction  
· First National Industrial Tourism Demonstration Site  
· National Industrial Tourism Innovation Unit  
· National Science Popularization Education Base  

The Qingdao Beer Museum, which blends ancient precious collections with modern design, officially opened on August 15, 2003, the 100th anniversary of Qingdao Beer, and is located at 56 Dengzhou Road, the birthplace of Qingdao Beer. As an important part of the century-old Qingdao Beer corporate culture, the museum integrates the history and development of Qingdao Beer, its rich cultural heritage, advanced brewing processes, beer tasting, entertainment, and shopping. It is the first professional beer museum in China and a world-class institution. It has been praised by Sun Gang, Deputy Director of the National Tourism Administration, as "a flag bearer of industrial tourism in China," and by former Director of the State Administration of Cultural Heritage, Shan Jixiang, as "a model for the protection and utilization of industrial heritage in China."

The Qingdao Beer Museum covers an exhibition area of over 6,000 square meters, divided into three sections: Century-Old History and Culture, Brewing Process Development, and Beer Experience Charm.  
In the Century-Old History and Culture section, visitors can follow the thread of time and space to explore Qingdao Beer's 100-year history through detailed pictures and texts, holographic images, and interactive videos. They can learn about the numerous honors of Qingdao Beer, its exports, factories across the country, as well as the relationship between Qingdao Beer and celebrities, the beer culture in Qingdao, and other aspects.

The Brewing Process Development section showcases the full set of brewing equipment from a century ago and scenes from the modern production lines. Each representative step in the brewing process is equipped with video devices, providing comparisons between old and new methods. Visitors can experience the traditional brewing techniques, such as the brewer Mr. Augut's greetings from a century ago, the replica of the old laboratory, and scenes of workers turning malt, which recreate the historical production process of Qingdao Beer. Visitors can also tour the modern filtration and packaging production lines and experience the spectacular 4.0 modern production lines.

In the Beer Experience Charm section, visitors can enjoy surprises through technological and creative projects like holographic projections, dynamic bicycles, a drunken house, and AR interactions. The museum's gift shop offers a variety of beer culture products, including specialty beers, exclusive beer accessories, various bottle openers, beer bottle chocolates, and delicious beer beans. On the first floor, the Qingdao Beer Museum Music Bar can accommodate nearly 200 guests and offers authentic German roast pork knuckles, German sausages, local Qingdao seafood, and creative beer dishes.

In the 1903 Bakery located on Dengzhou Road's Beer Street, the bakery uses Qingdao Beer's century-old yeast to create a unique "breathing" beer yeast bread that smells of malt, resonates with music, and is healthier, making it a must-try food in Qingdao. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of Qingdao fresh beers at the Encounter Bar and visit Shandong's first Cloud QuickPass Smart Convenience Store, enriching the experience at the Qingdao Beer Museum with creativity and excitement.

The Qingdao Beer Museum’s mission is to deliver passion and create happiness, with customer satisfaction at the core of its work. The museum advocates a service philosophy of "Happiness, Surprise, Sharing," offering unique services such as flash dances, drinking competitions, and beer tastings to bring joy and excitement to visitors. The museum’s guiding team, proficient in Chinese, English, Russian, French, Japanese, Korean, and other languages, is praised as "National May Day Women's Exemplary Position" and provides in-depth explanations about Qingdao Beer for international visitors, becoming a unique feature of the museum.

Visit Qingdao, taste Qingdao Beer, and uncover the century-old secrets of Qingdao Beer. Inside the museum, you can enjoy freshly brewed, pure Qingdao Draft Beer, and a variety of specialty beers like Qingdao Black Beer, IPA, Whole Wheat White Beer, and Pilsner. The Qingdao Beer Museum is a hall of knowledge about beer culture and a happy destination where you can savor great beer and imagine joyful moments.

With its beautiful environment, high-quality service, and unique charm, the Qingdao Beer Museum has attracted guests from over 100 countries and regions, with more than 10 million visitors since its opening. During this time, it has successfully hosted national leaders such as Xi Jinping, Yu Zhengsheng, Liu Yunshan, Wang Qishan, and Zhang Gaoli, as well as foreign dignitaries, bringing honor to both Qingdao Beer and the city of Qingdao.

tagNameList: Close to nature; a treasure spot for strolling with kids.; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Visit the landmark lighthouse on Qingdao Island.
summary:
· Xiao Qingdao is named for its shape, which resembles an ancient zither, and is also known as "Qin Island." The white conical lighthouse standing at the highest point is the landmark building.  
· At night, the red light on the lighthouse and the lights on the pier float on the turquoise waves, creating the scene known as "Qin Island Floating Lights," which is regarded as one of Qingdao's top ten scenic spots and has become one of the city's symbols.  
· Now open to the public as a park, the island is mainly planted with black pines, along with seasonal flowering ornamental plants.  
· On the relatively flat southern part of the island, there is a small square, in the center of which stands a sculpture of a woman holding a zither, facing the sea.

shortFeatures: German castle architecture
summary:
· Jiangsu Road Christian Church, formerly known as Evangelical Church, is a famous religious building in Qingdao. 
· Typical German castle-style architecture, with a fairy tale feeling, is a good place to overlook the sea. 
The Christian Church is made of stone piles and is divided into two parts: the auditorium and the bell tower. 
There are giant clocks on three sides of the clock tower, and the time of the clock is still the same.

shortFeatures: Open Seaside Park with Beautiful Scenes
summary:
Lu Xun Park is a free and open coastal park in Qingdao, with large reddish-brown reefs on the seaside. 
The park stretches from east to west along the long and narrow bedrock coast, adjacent to Qingdao Aquarium and First Bathing Beach in the east, with a total length of about 2 kilometers.  
The park has colorful red reefs, clear water, green pines, secluded paths, pavilions and pavilions, and charming scenery. It is a scenic spot with both garden beauty and natural beauty.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; City Parks
shortFeatures: Qingdao's famous autumn resort
summary:
This is the largest cherry blossom viewing place in Qingdao, with more than 20,000 plants. Every April and May are the annual cherry blossom viewing events. 
Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea in the south, and lush forests, it is the most distinctive scenic spot in Qingdao's urban vegetation landscape. 
There is an amusement park "Happy World" in the park. You can also visit Qingdao Zoo and Qingdao Botanical Garden.

shortFeatures: Popular locations for spy movies
summary:
Huashi Building is located at a headland extending into the sea at the southern end of Badaguan scenic spot, facing the sea on three sides, and the terrain is abrupt. 
European castle-style architecture, which combines various western architectural art styles, integrates the characteristics of multinational styles. 
The main body of Huashi Building is divided into five floors, with the top floor as a sea viewing platform and an iron spire on the side, which is unique and orderly. 
· Built by Belarusian designers, it is said that Chiang Kai-shek lived here before liberation, and now it is a holy place for location shooting of wedding photos.

Located on the bank of Huiquan Bay, it has a beach with a length of 580 meters and a width of more than 40 meters. It was once the largest bathing beach in Asia. 
Every year from July to September, tourists are full of people. People swim in the sea here or lie on the beach to enjoy the sea breeze. 
Here, you can also ride a jet ski or speedboat to fly by the waves and enjoy the excitement of summer. 
Although the first bathing beach in spring and autumn is not suitable for going into the water, it is a good place to walk and enjoy the scenery on the seaside.

tagNameList: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Cute Animals; Aquariums
shortFeatures: Stroll through the underwater tunnel and enjoy the dance of humans and sharks.
summary:
Qingdao Underwater World is a national 4A-level tourist attraction and a national science popularization education base, operated by Qingdao Huiquan Marine Technology Development Co., Ltd. The scenic area is located along Huiquan Bay in Qingdao, adjacent to Luxun Park and the First Bathing Beach. It is a landmark attraction on the golden coastal tourism route between Zhanqiao Pier and Badaguan, representing Qingdao's iconic image of "red tiles, green trees, blue seas, and blue skies."

Qingdao Underwater World was expanded from China’s first aquarium—the Qingdao Aquarium (built in 1932). The scenic area consists of seven major exhibition halls: the Dreamy Jellyfish Palace, the Oceanarium, the Seal Pavilion, the Freshwater Aquarium, the Whale Pavilion, the Underwater World, and the Ocean Science Museum. It integrates marine tourism and science education, showcasing the richness and diversity of marine life. Here, you can see about 2,000 species and over 20,000 rare marine specimens. You can also view thousands of rare marine creatures from around the world, such as the 4-meter-long South African Sand Tiger Shark, the 2-meter-diameter Black-spotted Stingray known as the "devil fish," and many more. The 82.6-meter-long underwater tunnel immerses visitors in a "harmonious blend of nature and humanity," offering a dreamlike experience.

With its beautiful natural environment, rich history and culture, profound humanistic heritage, unique science popularization advantages, and convenient metro access, Qingdao Aquarium and Qingdao Underwater World Scenic Area—referred to as "the first of our country" by Cai Yuanpei—boasts a unique marine cultural essence, numerous newly renovated venues, and abundant marine life. It is also home to stories like "The Dragon Tooth Integrity Story," "The Sea Oath and Mountain Vow Love Story," and "The Battle Between the Squid and the Sperm Whale." The scenic area features many heartwarming "heart-to-heart" services provided by "underwater people." It is the only "mountain-surrounded, ocean-surrounded" underwater aquarium in China, entirely located underground. Here, visitors can experience the dreamlike blue ocean and truly feel the essence of the sea—truly a "marine family, a place of science popularization; vast and profound, magical and enchanting!"

The 21st century is the century of the ocean. To understand the ocean and learn about Chinese marine science culture and development, it all starts here!

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Old Nordic buildings with fairy tale shapes
summary:
The Consul General of Denmark in Qingdao designed and built this small building, which was named "Princess Building" when the Danish princess came to Qingdao for summer vacation. 
Princess Building is a western-style small building with Nordic style, with sky blue all around and red church tower eaves with a big slope on its roof. 
Walking along the brick path and across the garden-like courtyard into the building is like walking into the palace of Andersen's fairy tales. 
The blue color of the wall is very beautiful, with the surrounding green plants. This year, it has become one of the places where everyone rushes to take photos and miss it.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 17:00)

shortFeatures: Visit vintage telephones and communication equipment
summary:
· It is a European-style building with red exterior walls. It is the former site of the German Empire Post Office in Jiaoao. It is the earliest existing post and telecommunications business building in Qingdao. 
· The museum covers an area of about 2,500 square meters, and now it has three floors: the first floor is the reception hall, antique telephone wall and souvenir shop; The second floor is the main exhibition hall. 
The fourth floor is Tower Hall 1901, which is the only century-old wooden tower currently open in Qingdao. Tower Hall 1901 shows the building technology 120 years ago. 
All kinds of telephones can be visited in the museum, and bees can learn about the development journey of Qingdao's post and telecommunications in the past century through pictures and objects.

shortFeatures: Classic German castle architecture
summary:
The German Prison Site Museum is a German castle-style building with thick red brick walls and pointed towers, which is classical and mysterious. 
• Inside, you will get a glimpse of the inner structure of the "Castle" and learn about its history when it was used as a prison and detention center, as well as the prison environment. 
· The former prison site consists of five prison cells, namely "benevolence", "righteousness", "courtesy", "wisdom" and "faith". At present, the prison cell with the word "benevolence" is mainly open to visiting. 
The interior is not big, mainly including prison guard duty room, prison cell, water prison and other scene facilities.
opening_hours: Open at  09:00-11:30,13:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

shortFeatures: Local earlier modern roads
summary:
Daxue Road was built after Germany invaded Qingdao. A modern road was laid along Qingdao River, and a stone bridge was built at the intersection of today's Huangxian County to extend the road northward, named Ospas Street. But Qingdao people call it Dongguan Street. 
University Road connects Longkou Road, Yushan Road, Huangxian Road, Huashan Road and Yexian Road from south to north; On both sides are residential buildings that combine Chinese and Western; Along the road are Qingdao Yucai Middle School, People's Hall, Oriental Hotel, Qingdao Urban Construction Archives, Qingdao Museum, Daxue Road Primary School, Ocean University of China (Yushan Campus), etc. 
University Road is located in Shinan District, Qingdao. Its architecture has obvious western style. There are many scenic spots such as Ocean University, Art Museum, Wen Yiduo's former residence and Kang Youwei's former residence.

tagNameList: Waterfront beach; Night tour viewing; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Plank road in the sea suitable for couples dating
summary:
· Located on the south side of the port area of the Olympic Sailing Center, it is about 534 meters long and 47 meters wide. It is like a giant dragon rising into the blue sea, which is very spectacular. 
Standing on the dam, looking at the sea in the wind, and looking around, the central area of Charming Island City comes into view. 
· It not only provides a safe haven for ships, but also is brightly lit at night. 
· It has also formed Lover's Dam Bar Street, a street with distinctive marine characteristics and romantic characteristics, which is very lively at night.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn leaves; Taoist Temples; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Visit the world-famous Taoist Taiqing Palace
summary:
Also known as "Xiaqing Palace" or "Xiagong", it is located at the foot of Laojun Peak at the southern foot of Laoshan Mountain and has a history of more than 2,000 years. 
Including Taiqing Palace archway, old mountain gate and three courtyards-Sanguan Hall, Sanqing Hall, Sanhuang Hall, Yuanjun Pavilion, Bell Tower, Drum Tower, etc. 
Sanguan Hall is dedicated to the three statues of Heavenly Officials, Earthly Officials and Water Officials; Sanqing Hall is dedicated to Moral Tianzun, Yuanshi Tianzun and Lingbao Tianzun; The Sanhuang Hall is dedicated to Fuxi, Shennong and Xuanyuan.

· Jiaozhou Bay Bridge is a super-large sea-crossing bridge designed, constructed and built by my country. 
· Jiaozhou Bay Bridge starts from Licun River Interchange in the east, crosses Jiaozhou Bay in the upper, connects Hongdao Interchange in the middle, and ends at Huangdao East Hub Interchange in the west; The total length of the line is about 42.23 kilometers, and the total length of the bridge is about 31.630 kilometers. 
· It is the "one bridge" in the "one road, one bridge and one tunnel" of the cross-sea passage on the east and west banks of Jiaozhou Bay planned by Qingdao.

shortFeatures: Experience the unique waterfront plank road
summary: A good place to relax after dinner, with a quiet environment and perfect greening, sanitation and other facilities.

shortFeatures: Stroll under the changing and colorful sky
summary:
Qingdao Tianmu City is an indoor pedestrian commercial street integrating tourism, catering, entertainment, leisure and other functions. 
· This street with a total length of about 460 meters is equipped with a giant canopy, which changes the sky effect of various colors from time to time. 
The pedestrian street integrates more than 20 famous buildings in Qingdao, such as Jiaoao Governor's Mansion and Huashi Building, into the design, forming a landscape of international architecture. 
· There are food restaurants and shopping shops from various countries on both sides of the main street. Many street performers wear fancy clothes, but there is a fee for taking photos.

tagNameList: Hi Fun Park; Kid-Friendly Treasure Spot; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Explore the Oriental Culture Theme Park
summary: This theme park features high-tech large-scale amusement rides, with the high-flying experience "Fly Beyond Limits" taking you on a world tour, the "Terracotta Warrior Tomb" offering an adventurous exploration of the mysterious tomb of Emperor Qin Shi Huang, the magical experience at the "Magic Castle" for those who want to learn magic, and the "Flooding Jinshan" where towering waves will roar and crash above your head... There are also the Fire Meteor, Challenger's Journey, Brave Spinner, High-Flying Adventure, and Speedy Windmill... Come, Fantawild will take you into a dreamlike paradise and let you experience the wonders of science fiction!

shortFeatures: The famous commercial center of old Qingdao
summary: Zhongshan Road in Qingdao is a commercial street with a history of 100 years and is famous all over the country. It used to be the "business card" of Qingdao, and it can also be said to be the "mother vein" of Qingdao's business. There are not only high-grade famous products, but also low-end small commodities, as well as many famous time-honored shops and various beautiful European-style buildings in Qingdao. Most tourists who walk across the trestle will visit Zhongshan Road.

tagNameList: Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
shortFeatures: The Birthplace of the Novel Camel Xiangzi
summary: From 1934 to 1937, Mr. Lao She lived and worked in Qingdao for three years. Mr. Shu Yi introduced that this was the golden age of Lao She's life and literary creation. This is one of his three borrowing residences in Qingdao, the other two are on Laiwu Road and Jinkou Road. This former residence of Lao She is located in a quiet alley. The house is small, but it is very elegant. Lao She's eldest daughter Shu Ji lived here when she was three to four years old. The former residence is a two-story building, facing south from the north, and the downstairs is the residence of Lao She's family. Different from that year, the sculpture of "Camel Xiangzi" and the bust statue of Lao She were installed in the courtyard, and 26 pottery prints were used to move the Biography of Camel Xiangzi created by Mr. Sun Zhiyi to the wall. There are not many visitors here on weekdays, so you can walk and watch slowly inside.

Lingshan Island is located in Lingshan Bay, southeast of Huangdao District, Qingdao. It is isolated from the world, with a primitive lifestyle and natural island landscape. You can also enjoy the fishermen's customs here through various ways of playing. 
 
You need to take a boat to enter and leave Lingshan Island. After you go to the island, you can charter a boat for sea fishing, usually to the northeast Yadaozi waters of the island. It is said that some people caught more than 100 Spanish mackerel there a day, while others caught about 30 pounds of big bass. 
 
The variety of seafood on the island is very rich. When the tide falls at night, you can find many spicy snails and eccentric snails at the stone beach in the north of the island. The delicacies here are even more delicious, and CCTV's "Beautiful Countryside, China" was filmed for this reason. 
 
Lingshan Island is located in the open sea, with minimal pollution, and most of the local residents retain their traditional lifestyle. The visibility here is high, and the starry sky at night is particularly beautiful, attracting countless astronomy enthusiasts to come here. In addition, there are scenic spots on the island, such as Beilaishi and Tiger Mouth, which can also be enjoyed together.

poiName: Former Site of the Jiaozhou Governor's Office
tagNameList: Historic buildings; Buildings by Famous Architects; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: It was once the seat of Qingdao's power organs
summary: The former site of the Governor's Palace in Jiaoao, Germany is a modern German building. After Germany captured Qingdao in 1897, the Governor's Palace was built in 1906. The building has the characteristics of 19th century European public buildings, with a "concave" shape and a roof covered with red tube tiles. Later, it became the office of Qingdao Municipal Government and CPPCC, and was later terminated with the completion of the new building of the municipal government. Now it is not allowed to visit here, so you can take photos at the door.

shortFeatures: Visit ancient handicrafts and paintings and calligraphy
summary: Qingdao Museum is quite large in area, with rich and diverse collections. There are four exhibition halls here: porcelain, painting and calligraphy, jade and Qingdao History, among which Qingdao History Museum is the most attractive. Apart from the display of many old objects in Qingdao, there are also the historical restoration landscape of Qingdao. The large-scale basic exhibition here includes The Light of Qingdao's Historical Civilization, and seven exhibitions, such as Exhibition of Paintings and Calligraphy of Ming and Qing Dynasties, Exhibition of Rubbings of Ancient Inscriptions, Exhibition of Modern Paintings and Calligraphy, Exhibition of Ancient Porcelain Art, Exhibition of Currency of Past Dynasties, Exhibition of Ancient Handicrafts and Exhibition of International Communication Gifts, are on display all the year round.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Cute animals; Aquariums; Museums
shortFeatures: More than 20,000 specimens of marine life on display
summary: Qingdao Aquarium is located in the center of Qingdao Luxun Park, surrounded by mountains and seas, with pleasant scenery. It is bordered by Qingdao No.1 Bathing Beach and Huiquan Square in the east, Qingdao Naval Museum and Xiaoqingdao in the west, and Xiaoyushan in the north. Golden beaches, ochre reefs, red tiles and green trees, blue sea and blue sky, mountains, seas and cities are organically integrated into one, which is a must-see for tourists who come to Qingdao. Qingdao Aquarium started construction in January 1931 and officially opened to the public on May 8, 1932. It is the first aquarium in China and Asia, and the cradle of modern aquarium in China.

shortFeatures: Natural strange caves from bottom to top
summary:
· Mitian Cave is made up of many boulders in the cracks between two big cliffs. It looks artificial, but it is not artificial. It is a natural strange cave from bottom to top, with a strange configuration and unique style. 
The strange cave of Mitian is divided into five floors from bottom to top. The cave is twisting, strange, thrilling and blurred, which can be described as a combination of strange, secluded, dangerous and interesting. 
· It is said that in the early years, local people hid in caves to avoid soldiers, which could accommodate hundreds of people.

shortFeatures: Surrounded by two headlands
summary: Tang Island Bay is surrounded by two headlands, and the mouth of the bay is the famous Tang Island. Tang Island is very small, only 0.07 square kilometers, but it is very famous. According to legend, during the Tang Dynasty, Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty personally led the navy to march eastward and was once stationed on this island, so it is called Tang Island. Many years ago, many ancient weapons such as knives, swords and arrowheads were unearthed on the island. However, the existing historical data can't prove that Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty did station the navy here, and there was a famous maritime war in Chinese history here during the Southern Song Dynasty.

poiName: The National Datum Point Scenic Area
shortFeatures: The reference point for sea level in China.
summary:
The China Datum Zero Point Scenic Area integrates surveying culture, maritime culture, and ocean culture.  
The Zero Point Monument Sculpture is 6 meters tall, weighs over 10 tons, and its base resembles a plumb bob, symbolizing the hard work of previous generations of surveyors. The globe at the top features six small spheres, representing the six famous geodetic reference points around the world.  
Additionally, this is the first domestic scenic spot centered around a yacht club, combining knowledge of the Olympics, ocean, sailing, and surveying, as a new type of tourism resource.

tagNameList: Observation deck; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Climb to the top of the tower and enjoy the scenic view of
summary:
Qingdao TV Tower is the most advanced and largest in China at present, and its comprehensive functions rank third in the world. You can take the high-speed elevator to the 160-meter revolving restaurant, overlooking the sunrise on the sea, the moonlight on the sea and the sky, and the panoramic view of the island city. 
However, because the TV Tower is located at the top of Victoria Peak, there is no suitable direct bus. However, there is a free service bus directly to the TV Tower at the entrance of Sanbaihui Commercial Building on Yan'an Road, so you can take the bus up the mountain. 
As the TV Tower is very close to Zhongshan Park, it is also recommended to visit it together with Zhongshan Park. The cableway in Zhongshan Park can directly lead to the base of the TV Tower. In fact, it's only ten minutes to walk from the park to the TV.
opening_hours: Opens at Daytime 09:00-17:00,Opens at Evening 17:00-20:00(Tickets available until 19:30)

tagNameList: Climbing high and scaling mountains; Mountains; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Visit Shimen Temple and taste the sweet Yuling Spring water.
summary:
The Dazhu Mountain Scenic Area is located in the southwest coastal area of Huangdao District, Qingdao. The area features towering peaks and lush vegetation. Visitors can ascend the mountain via hiking trails, where they can see various奇峰异石 (unique peaks and odd stones), and visit ancient sites such as Shimen Temple and ancient Buddhist sculpture caves. If you feel tired, you can taste the sweet Yuling Spring water.

Spring is the most beautiful season at Dazhu Mountain. Before the Qingming Festival, cherry blossoms, peach blossoms, and apricot blossoms will adorn the entrance to the valley in a colorful display. By mid-April, the mountains will be covered with a sea of azaleas, providing a feast for the eyes, earning it the title of "The first mountain for flying red in spring."

shortFeatures: Brick and wood structure buildings in Ming and Qing Dynasties
summary:
Folk Museum "is the oldest existing brick and wood structure complex of Ming and Qing Dynasties in Qingdao. As the saying goes," Tianhou Temple came first, then Qingdao ". 
Except for the theater, which is covered with glazed tiles, other buildings are clear-water walls and small gray tiles, and they are stained with Suzhou-style painting, carved beams and painted buildings, which are magnificent. Among the ancient buildings in the whole Qingdao area, the architectural art and painting art of Qingdao Tianhou Palace are second to none. The main attractions are: Shanmen, Fuding, Our Lady Temple, God of Wealth Temple, Dragon King Temple, Sixty Jiazi Constellation Temple, Folk Museum, Bell Tower and Drum Tower.

Qingdao International Beer Festival was founded in 1991. The festival is co-sponsored by relevant state ministries and commissions and Qingdao Municipal People's Government. It is a national-level large-scale festival integrating tourism, culture, sports, economy and trade. The theme slogan of Oktoberfest is "Cheers Qingdao and the world!". After 14th sessions, Qingdao International Beer Festival has gradually become a bright city card of Qingdao, a beautiful coastal city, and has considerable popularity and influence at home and abroad. 
 
The festival consists of opening ceremony, beer tasting, literary evening, art parade, cultural and sports entertainment, drinking contest, tourism and leisure, economic and trade exhibition, closing ceremony evening and other activities. During the festival, the streets and alleys of Qingdao are decorated, and the city is carnival; The international beer city, which covers an area of nearly 500 mu and has nearly 30 world-advanced large-scale entertainment facilities, is full of wine fragrance and passion. Every year, the festival attracts more than 20 world-renowned beer manufacturers to participate in the festival, and nearly 3 million tourists from home and abroad to raise their glasses.

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
summary: Qingdao Forest Wildlife World is located in the Zhushan Scenic Area of the Qingdao Economic and Technological Development Zone (Huangdao Liuhua Bo). It is a large-scale, comprehensive theme park that combines wildlife displays, popular science education, dining, and leisure entertainment. The park features free-range, semi-captive, and caged animal exhibits, and is developed in harmony with the surrounding ecological environment. This creates a high-quality ecological park where the green mountains, clear waters, animals, and people are naturally integrated. It is closely connected with major tourist attractions such as Laoshan and Jinha Beach, forming a wildlife park with distinctive Qingdao tourism characteristics and a scale effect. The air is fresh, and the environment is elegant, with small bridges and flowing water, cliffs and waterfalls, and lakes and mountains reflecting each other. The free-viewing bridge meanders through the valley, weaves through the jungle, and passes over wild beasts. Walking on the pedestrian observation bridge, one can enjoy the green mountains and trees, hear the roar of tigers and lions, and spot traces of bears and leopards, offering a unique and charming experience.

shortFeatures: With the theme of Olympic sailing and Olympic sailing culture
summary:
· Located between the mountains and the sea in the Olympic Sailing Center, it has a building area of 9,359.8 square meters, with two floors above ground and one floor underground. 
It is divided into two parts: indoor exhibition area and outdoor exhibition area, and eight parts: exhibition area, interactive teaching area, exchange exhibition hall, academic activity hall and public service area.  
The sunshine hall on the west side of the building has a unique shape, just like a camera recording the moment of the sail rotating frame by frame and merging it in the same time and space. 
In addition to the exhibition area, there are also small gifts related to sailing boats for sale inside. If you like them, you can take them away as souvenirs.

shortFeatures: Octagonal Pavilion with Double Floor Cornices
summary:
This pavilion is a two-story octagonal pavilion. The pavilion is covered with colored glazed tiles and supported by 24 red lacquer pillars. There is a spiral staircase in the center of the pavilion, and the upstairs is surrounded by glass windows. There is a saying that "one window, one scene, one painting". We can look out from the window and see the beautiful Qingdao Bay and the surrounding scenic spots and famous buildings in all directions. 
The three words on the plaque of "Hui Lan Pavilion" were originally inscribed by Shen Honglie, the former mayor of Qingdao. This plaque was plundered to Japan during the second Japanese occupation of Qingdao and exhibited in the Army Museum in Tokyo, Japan, to show its "achievements" in the war of aggression against China. Now the word "Huilan Pavilion" is written by Shu Tong, a famous calligrapher.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical buildings; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The birthplace of the Legend of the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea
summary:
· Penglai Pavilion, along with Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is known as one of China's Four Great Towers.  
· Known as the "Fairyland on Earth," the well-known myth of "The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea" originates here.  
· Penglai Pavilion is located by the sea, often shrouded in mist, making it feel like being in a fairyland. On a good day, one can even witness a "mirage."  
· In addition to Penglai Pavilion, the scenic area also includes Tianheng Mountain, Dengzhou Museum, Ancient Ship Museum, and the dividing line between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea.  
· From the mountain top, one can enjoy a distant view of the junction between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, where the boundary line between the yellow and blue waters is very distinct, and one can also see Changdao Island in the distance.

shortFeatures: Towering and steep seaside cliffs
summary:
Because of sea erosion, the cliffs by the sea stand upright, and some places are greater than 90 degrees, which is unique in the domestic seaside landscape. 
The cliffs and reefs here are in various shapes. They are places for catching the sea and fishing, and they are also rare materials for artistic creation such as photography. 
A crown-shaped observation platform was also built on the cliff head of Jiuzhang Cliff. It's also a great place to watch the sunset and sunrise.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Mountains; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Climb the iconic lighthouse to enjoy a panoramic view of Yantai.
summary:
- Located at the northern end of the city, it integrates mountains, sea, city, and port, making it a seaside mountain park with three sides facing the sea. It is also a landmark scenic spot in Yantai.
- Within the scenic area and its surroundings, there are consulates, foreign trade firms, and numerous villas, forming the most complete and densely packed modern foreign consulate cluster in Asia.
- The lighthouse at the top of the mountain is the highest point in Yantai, and visitors can take an elevator inside the lighthouse to the 11th-floor observation deck, where they can enjoy a magnificent view of the sea, coastline, and cityscape.
- Below the lighthouse is a beacon tower, where live performances are held with actors dressed in Ming Dynasty costumes, holding torches and lighting signal fires, which are very exciting.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Spots for Strolling with Kids; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Enjoying the sunrise and sunset over the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea.
summary:
- Changdao consists of 151 islands, resembling a string of delicate pearls scattered across the Bohai Strait, often praised as the "Mirage of the Sea" and the "Fairy Mountain of the Sea." The land area of Changdao is approximately 56 square kilometers, with a sea area of about 3,541 square kilometers and a coastline of about 187.8 kilometers. There are 10 inhabited islands. The area enjoys a pleasant climate, beautiful scenery, and rich cultural resources, making it an ideal destination for tourism and summer vacations.
- Situated between the Liaodong Peninsula and the Shandong Peninsula, in the Bohai Strait, lies a group of 32 emerald-like islands, known as the beautiful archipelago often referred to as the "Fairy Mountain of the Sea"—Changdao. Also known as the Miaodao Islands, it features blue skies, clear waters, sunny beaches, fresh air, and picturesque landscapes, with each island possessing its own unique charm.
- Islands of Changdao include Changshan Island (South and North Changshan Islands), Gaoshan Island, Houji Island, Cheyou Island, Dahuishan Island, Xiaohui Island, and others.
- Changdao tourist attractions include Jiuzhang Cliff, Crescent Bay, Forest Sea, Wangfu Reef, the convergence line of the Yellow Sea and Bohai Sea, and other scenic spots. With the continuous improvement of tourism infrastructure and services, the area’s reputation and recognition have greatly increased, and it has been successively designated as a National Scenic Area, National Nature Reserve, National Forest Park, and National Geopark.
- Visitors to Changdao must first take a ferry from the Penglai Wharf to the island. To truly experience the charm of Changdao, it is recommended to spend a night on the island.

shortFeatures: Revisiting the Rise and Fall of the Mou Family
summary:
The Qixia Mushi Manor was established in the first year of the Yongzheng era (1723) during the Qing Dynasty. It served as the residence for several generations of the Muo Molin family, the largest landowner family in northern China during the Qing period. This courtyard-style architectural complex, with typical Jiaodong residential features, is divided into three main courtyards with six courtyards in total. It includes a main gate, a living room, sleeping quarters, workshops, powder storage, and other buildings, forming multiple courtyards. It is known as the "Jiaodong Folk Museum."

If the Grand View Garden in *Dream of the Red Chamber* is a miniature of the social structure at the end of the Ming and early Qing dynasties, then the Mushi Manor is a miniature of the feudal society in the late Qing Dynasty.

The owner of this manor, the Muo family, originally came from Gong'an County in Hubei Province. The family’s ancestor, Muo Jingzu, began his official career in the early Ming Dynasty and settled in the ancient town of Du Village in Qixia. Subsequent generations of the family capitalized on his success, amassing wealth. By the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, the Muo family's estate reached its peak, with 60,000 acres of land and 120,000 acres of mountain ranges, generating an annual income of over 3.3 million kilograms of grain. The family became one of the richest in Jiaodong and renowned across Qilu, dominating as a large landowner.

Wealthy families often built houses, which was a common practice among rural families. The Muo family, being affluent and powerful, invested heavily in constructing the manor.

tagNameList: Island Stroll; Seaside Beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: A rugged offshore island
summary:
Mystic Island - Dahei Mountain Island

This is an island surrounded by the sea, where silence prevails, and the thick soil of the island buries the distant memories; it is also a place of awe, where the turbulent waves along the coastline turn the pages of history. This is Dahei Mountain Island, a picturesque and pleasant island located in Changdao, with unique coastal erosion landscapes, strange reefs and rocks, maritime culture, and fishing customs.

Dahei Mountain Island is situated at the westernmost point of the Miao Island Archipelago. It covers an area of about 7.47 square kilometers. Located deep in the Bohai Sea, Dahei Mountain Island is one of over 30 islands under the jurisdiction of Changdao County, with a permanent population of just over 1,000 residents.

Surrounded by clear waters, Dahei Mountain Island is secluded and independent. The vast surrounding sea is rich in marine resources. The island is known for producing over 100 kinds of algae, more than 30 species of economic fish and shrimp, and over 20 types of shellfish, especially sea cucumbers, abalones, and scallops, which are renowned both domestically and internationally for their high quality.

The intelligent and resourceful residents of Dahei Mountain Island have, over many years of accumulated experience, developed a unique architectural style. They build walls with thick stone and use sun-dried seaweed to cover the roofs, creating "seaweed houses." The seaweed used is a type resembling chives, growing in shallow waters along the coast, and is known locally as "kelp grass." Walking through the village on Dahei Mountain Island, one can often spot such seaweed houses, many of which are over a century old.

The world's largest tin-bronze sitting Buddha (approximately 38.66 meters tall and weighing about 380 tons), the Nanshan Giant Buddha, and the country's largest indoor Jade Buddha (approximately 13.66 meters tall and weighing about 660 tons), the Nanshan Medicine Master Jade Buddha, are the two major highlights of the scenic area.

The best time for birding is around May every year, when seagulls and various other birds hatch and brood. Watching seabirds is not only near this island, but also in several surrounding islands. The general sea tour route will also pass through several small islands, and some will leave some time for tourists to go to the island. Therefore, when taking part in the sea tour, don't forget to bring some hard bread to feed the seagulls.

summary:
Wonderland Scenic Spot is located in Wanggou Village, on the east coast of Changdao County. It is famous for the unearthed human skull fossil and nearly 100 tombs dating back 2,500 years, and is known as the first village in northern China. It combines primitive natural scenery and beautiful myths and legends, showing the charming charm of natural landscape. The sea and sky in the scenic spot are vast, which makes people feel refreshed and linger. 
It is said that the source of fairyland used to be the place where the Eight Immortals lived, and the place where Qin Emperor and Hanwu sought immortals and medicine. Step into the source of fairyland, watch the sunrise of the Yellow Sea in the east, the majestic sunset of the Bohai Sea in the west, the Penglai Pavilion where the Eight Immortals gather in the south, and the Laotieshan Mountain in Liaodong Peninsula in the north.

The three restored ancient ships on the roof are built using traditional Chinese shipbuilding technology, creating a scene of warships moored in the harbor, with numerous sails, which is spectacular; The seabed shipwreck is the core exhibition content, and the main exhibition is four ancient ships of Yuan and Ming Dynasties unearthed during the dredging of Xiaohai in Shuicheng in 1984 and 2005. shortFeatures: At the top of Mount Tai, overlooking the beautiful scenery of the surrounding mountains.
summary:
The Kunyu Mountains, with a radius of one hundred miles, are characterized by continuous peaks, deep forests, serene valleys, towering ancient trees, numerous clear springs, and cascading waterfalls. The area is rich in cultural relics and historical sites. It is the birthplace of the Quanzhen School of Taoism in China and is often referred to as a natural ecological museum, earning the title of the "Ancestor of the Sacred Mountains of the Sea."  
Notable landscapes: A convergence of northern and southern tree species, pristine forests with no pollution; the ancestral home of the Quanzhen sect, red pines of the north, cypress trees of the south, thousand-year-old ginkgo trees, mountain villages, hundred-meter waterfalls, Eighteen Pools, and primeval forests.  
Attractions and highlights:  
- Jiulong Pool (hundred-meter waterfall)  
- Taibo Peak (primeval forest, natural oxygen bar, Water Curtain Cave)  
- Yanxia Cave (where Qiu Chuji and six other Taoist masters practiced during the Jin Dynasty, the birthplace of the Quanzhen sect)  
- Magu Hall (the place where Magu of Jianchang practiced)  
- Wuran Temple (a ten-thousand-meter canyon, riverbed, smooth pebble stones, water pools as clear as jade, emerald peaks and beautiful ridges, forests covering the area, known as the "Jiuzhaigou of the North").

Among them, while remembering the national heroes, I can feel the culture of Qifu and taste those things in the Ming Dynasty. You can also experience Jiaodong folk customs and watch Qi Jiajun's unique performance. If you are interested in gardens, you can turn to the back garden, where there are pavilions, small bridges and flowing water. It is very clean, and you can taste some flavors slowly. 
It is worth mentioning that around the hometown, there are two imperial archways built in Jiajing period of Ming Dynasty and Qi Jiguang ancestral temple built in Chongzhen period. tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings; Castles
shortFeatures: The shooting location of "The Richest Man in Xihong City"
summary:
Wencheng Castle, located next to Yanpeng Tourist Avenue, was built by Mr. Li Wencheng, an overseas Chinese from Canada, and Penglai Wencheng Architectural Decoration Co., Ltd. with an investment of 600 million RMB. The castle is a skillful combination of European architectural elements, mainly in Baroque style, and the building materials mainly based on precious cave stones carry the essence of European architecture and decorative arts, embodying a unique aristocratic atmosphere. Surrounded by a moat, it is filled with seawater, which can raise sea cucumbers and abalones, and can also be used for people to play in the water and row boats, which is full of fun. Coupled with the design of concave front and convex back, the castle presents unique variability whether it is forward-looking or rear-looking, whether it is flat or three-dimensional. Although it is only 4 storeys high, its incomparable diversity of other buildings brings unlimited imagination. The shape is elegant and generous, the round roof points directly to the blue sky, the trapezoidal and tapered roofs on both sides are interspersed with each other, superimposed and staggered, and the fireplace chimney is dotted among them, which fully shows the unique romantic feelings and heroic spirit of European technology. 
In July, 17, Mahua FunAge's team traveled all over the country to find a venue to shoot the fourth comedy film "The Richest Man in Xihong City", and finally "stepped through the iron shoes and found nowhere, but it took no effort to get it". By chance, they met Wencheng Castle, which has great European classical architectural artistic characteristics, and finally were amazed by such a unique European-style castle group in China, taking it as the most ideal interior shooting location.

It is shaded by pines and cypresses, and the temple and pavilion are beautiful and elegant, overlooking the urban area and the sea.

tagNameList: Venue exhibition hall; Memorial Halls; Museums
shortFeatures: Recreating the historical features of the Sino-Japanese War of
summary:
China Sino-Japanese War Museum Exhibition Hall is a comprehensive exhibition hall that comprehensively displays the history of Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895. The main building was designed by Professor Peng Yigang, a famous architectural design master and academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. The building is bold in conception and unique in shape. It creatively integrates the main building symbolizing Beiyang naval ships with the majestic statue of Beiyang naval admirals, and is known as "a century-old Chinese architectural classic in the 20th century". 
The museum takes Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895 as its basic display, exhibiting more than 650 precious historical pictures of the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895, copying a large number of weapons and equipment during the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895, and restoring and reproducing a number of hyper-realistic figure statue scenes, such as "the scene of Qu's family throwing into a well in Jinzhou" and "the scene of Li Hongzhang negotiating in Shimonoseki". The first 3D film and television hall of "Yellow Sea Naval Battle" in China was opened, and the shocking war scenes of "Weihaiwei Defense Battle" were reproduced by sound, light and multimedia, as well as a large number of huge oil paintings and sculptures reflecting the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895. The whole exhibition hall is divided into five parts: Preface Hall, China and Japan before the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895, Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895, Abyss and Resistance and Tail Hall.

shortFeatures: Waterfront park built by the sea
summary:
Weihai Park is one of the largest waterfront parks in domestic cities. The park starts from Sifang Road in the north and ends at Pingdu Road in the south, facing Weihai Bay. 
From north to south, the park has four theme scenic spots: Haiya, Hailian, Haisong, Haihui and a central cultural square. Weihai Park is built along the sea. The total length of the seawall is about 3,200 meters. It is built in three structural forms: big cylinder, big steps and big slope. There is a platform for sightseeing and watching the sea on the shore. In the middle of the park, a large cultural square with a length of about 580 meters from north to south and an extension of about 107 meters from the seawall revetment is set up. Each square expresses its theme with sculptures of different sizes and shapes, and sets off the sculptures with ups and downs and dense greening. Two green belts are formed along both sides of Haibin South Road in the park, which is a belt-shaped open park with a width of about 30 meters on the west side of the road and a width of 70 meters on the east side of the road. Greening adopts European brocade technique, with lawn as the keynote and evergreen tall trees as the mainstay. About 130,000 trees such as ginkgo biloba, Fatong tree, cedar and metasequoia glyptostroboia and more than 900,000 flowering shrubs are planted. The whole project combines roads, parks and buildings for overall environmental design, forming a regional landscape in which architecture, greening, sculpture, revetment and sea are interdependent and organically integrated, forming a beautiful picture of ecological coastal city.

shortFeatures: Truly restored Dingyuan Sea Ship
summary:
Dingyuan Ship Scenic Area is located in the bustling urban area of Weihai, a beautiful coastal city in Shandong Province. The main landscape is the flagship "Dingyuan" of Beiyang Navy in the late Qing Dynasty, which is reproduced according to its original appearance. 
The current Dingyuan ship is a 1: 1 copy of the Dingyuan of the Beiyang Navy in the late Qing Dynasty. It was the flagship of the Yellow Sea War during the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895 and witnessed a glorious past of the Chinese Navy. The warship reproduced the practical daily necessities of soldiers at that time, such as machine guns, torpedoes and other military supplies. The ring screen cinema used film and television materials to restore many historical scenes, and also collected many historical documents. The situation of a hundred years ago is gone, but history is still stirring in the hearts of every Chinese.

tagNameList: A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids
shortFeatures: Stroll through the magnificent ancient-style Chinese architectural complex.
summary:
Weihai Huaxia City is located in the beautiful coastal resort city of Weihai. It is a large-scale ecological and cultural scenic area primarily showcasing Eastern classical culture. 

The main highlights of the scenic area include the largest archway in China — the First Archway of Huaxia, the unique three-faced Sacred Water Avalokitesvara, and the largest temple in Jiaodong with a history of over 1,000 years — Taiping Chan Temple.

In Huaxia City, visitors can enjoy the magnificent Sacred Water Avalokitesvara Musical Fountain performance, take a stroll in the "Summer Garden," an ancient-style exhibition hall that blends the essence of classical architecture from both the North and South, watch exciting acrobatics, cavalry battles, and martial arts performances, and not to be missed is the grand mountain and water live performance "Divine Journey of Huaxia" in the evening, which will surely leave a deep impression on your soul.

shortFeatures: Ecological scenic spots with both Chinese and Western styles
summary:
The Sea Park is located on the east side of Crown Community of Weihai Economic and Technological Development Zone, and connects with Weihai Park in the north. It includes six parts: amusement park, artificial lake, strange stone garden, forest ecological park, bathing beach and Kowloon Bay tourist resort.  
With the theme of maritime culture, ecological sightseeing, tourism and vacation, the park not only has the characteristics of water towns in the south of the Yangtze River in China, but also has the scenery of islands in Japan and South Korea, forming a unique style of combining Chinese and Western cultures. The whole park has six parks with complete functions and unique characteristics, and has become a large-scale maritime amusement park area integrating tourists' leisure, children's entertainment, ecological sightseeing, tourism and vacation, maritime culture and other functions.

shortFeatures: Climbing the Tower to Gaze at the Panoramic View of Weihai
summary:
The Huancui Tower Park is located on the western foothills of the ancient Gu Mountain in the city center of Weihai. The park is built against the mountain with an ascending terrain, covering an area of more than 300 acres, including both Huancui Park and Huancui Tower Square. It is named after the classical building "Huancui Tower" located within the park.

Huancui Tower has undergone two major reconstructions. The original tower, built during the Ming Dynasty, featured painted beams and carved rafters, with flying eaves and a plank door. In 1931, it was rebuilt, but in 1944, it was destroyed by Japanese forces. In 1978, the Weihai Municipal People's Government planned to rebuild the tower, creating a classical architectural complex consisting of pavilions, towers, and corridors. The main building is three stories high, measuring 16.8 meters, with a glazed tile roof and a hip-and-gable style with carved floral patterns. From the top of the tower, one can see "the vast green waves to the east of the city, surrounded by lush greenery, and the beautiful scenery of the sea and mountains," hence the name "Huancui" (meaning "green waves").

tagNameList: Climbing mountains; seaside beach; Mountains; Beaches
shortFeatures: Scenic Coastal Resort Area
summary:
The Darius Mountain Seaside Resort Area is located at the western tip of the Haiyangsuo Peninsula, in the southern part of Rushan city. The Darius Mountain within the scenic area resembles a woman's breast, which is the origin of Rushan's name and a local tourism landmark. The resort area is nestled between mountains and the sea, with beautiful scenery. You can swim in the sea, collect seashells, or take a walk on the clean beach. The scenic area also features many beautiful Buddhist buildings and sculptures, which make for stunning photo opportunities with the backdrop of green mountains and blue sea.

The Darius Mountain Scenic Area is quite large and is divided into several sections, including the Maternal Love Culture Experience Zone, Health Culture Experience Zone, Religious Culture Tour Zone, Seaside Leisure Resort Community, and Amusement Park Zone. There are electric carts to connect the various attractions within the area. The best time to visit is during the summer, when you can escape the heat and even stay in one of the seaside cabins within the resort to enjoy a few days of leisurely and peaceful life.

The scenic area has nearly two kilometers of beach, where the water is shallow and the waves are gentle. The sand quality is also good, and the number of tourists is much lower than the beaches in nearby Qingdao and Weihai. You can set up a tent on the beach to sleep, or dig sandcastles and collect seashells with children, or go swimming in the sea. Additionally, there are restaurants like Moulin Rouge and Donghai Restaurant in the area, but prices are relatively high, so it’s a good idea to bring your own drinks and snacks.

Due to the presence of Darius Mountain, maternal love culture is the core theme of the resort area. Here, you can see many sculptures related to virtuous mothers, and you can also climb the "Mother Mountain" to admire the 24 Filial Piety Relief, visit the "Respecting Mother Platform" to view the Nuwa statue, and see sculptures of the four ancient holy mothers. Darius Mountain has an elevation of 216.6 meters, and the view from the top is said to be excellent, making it a great place to watch the sunrise. However, to protect the mountain and vegetation, the scenic area prohibits tourists from climbing to the top.

The scenic area also features a temple called Hongxing Temple, which was originally built during the Northern Wei period of the Northern and Southern Dynasties. The temple is not large, but its architecture is orderly and magnificent, and it is a good place for incense offerings and Buddhist prayers. Additionally, the scenic area has newly built the Sun and Moon Twin Towers, the Medicine Buddha Hall, and the Lingguang Tower. These three buildings are splendid in appearance and house many Buddhist statues, contributing to the Buddhist cultural theme of the resort area.

Motianling is close to the seaside, which is a rolling mountain. A seaside plank road has been built along the mountain. You can lean on the railing to watch the sea, and you can have a panoramic view of the sea and sky and the mountain and sea landscape. The scenic spot is rich in crystals, with crystal exhibition halls on the ground and dense underground crystal caves, which is amazing, but now it is not allowed to be developed, only for visiting. There is an aerial plank road between the cliffs on the mountainside. People walk on the plank road, and huge waves roar under their feet. It is very exciting and extremely tests courage. There is also the longest cross-sea ropeway in Asia leading to Chengshantou. You can take the suspended ropeway through the peaks and cypresses on the seaside, experience the shuttle between clouds and overlook the blue sea fairyland.

shortFeatures: Named for its shape like a cat
summary: Located in Sunjiatuan Town, east-north of Weihai City, Shandong Province, on the north bank of Liushuwan. Named after the shape of a cat. It is the main peak of Wuliang Mountain, which is located in the two branches of the southern extension of Yunling Mountains, and the fault block mountain.

It can accommodate approximately 1,500 people bathing in the hot springs at the same time, with a daily maximum reception capacity of up to 10,000 people. The outdoor hot spring area includes the "Yuanshan Five Blessings Spring," "Yuanshui Six Virtues Soup," "Mei Aloe Vera Hot Spring Area," "Forest Tranquil Soak Zone," "Herbal Health Valley," "SPA Dynamic Hot Spring Area," outdoor infinity swimming pool, slate hot spring, and the "Kiss Fish Therapy" hot spring, with a total of 66 outdoor specialty functional hot spring baths for visitors to enjoy.

shortFeatures: Understand the history and culture of Liu Gong Island
summary: Liugong Island Expo Park is a comprehensive scenic spot that combines the long history and rich culture of Liugong Island, and integrates high-tech and exquisite art. The total investment is 126 million yuan, covering an area of 50,000 square meters. Huge colorful jade wall carvings and large-scale Dongyang wood carvings focus on Liu Gong culture, the root culture of Liu Gong Island.

Liugongdao Qidingshan Fort is located on Qidingshan, the highest point of Liugongdao. It was built in the 16th year of Guangxu in the Qing Dynasty (1890). It is equipped with 4 flat-fire guns with a caliber of 24 cm, 3 rapid-fire guns and 2 camp guns. The underground passage is more than 260 meters long and leads to various gun positions. The tunnel is a masonry structure, cement grouting, arch dome, 3 meters high and about 1.5 meters wide, and the door partition is equipped with ventilation holes. Most of the stones used are red granite transported from Shidao. The soldier house, ammunition depot and tunnel are integrated into one, which is strong and hidden. Artillery can directly enter the gun position from four entrances and exits. At present, the fort still exists, the tunnel is intact, and lighting equipment is installed. Visitors can visit at will. There is still a German Krupp cannon.

Taking Mr. Wen Yiduo's Song of Seven Sons as an introduction, the museum introduces the historical process of Weihaiwei being forcibly rented by Britain for 32 years (of which Liu Gongdao was rented for 42 years) to visitors in chronological order. The wax figures inside are exquisite, and there are many oil paintings. The exhibition hall covers an area of 1,890 square meters. Through wax figures and room layout, many scenes of daily life in those days have been restored, such as people playing in China's first golf course, the scene of Weihai Governor's office, and so on.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Mountains; Mountain Climbing

summary: Rongcheng Chashan Scenic Area is located on the coast of the Yellow Sea in the south of Rongcheng, with a total area of 45 square kilometers and a coastline of 86 nautical miles. The main peak Qingliangding is 539.8 meters above sea level. The word "cha" in Rongchashan Scenic Area was used as the word "raft" in ancient times, which means boat. Here, in spring, summer and autumn, from time to time, sea fog comes ashore with the wind, rolling and rising, forming a sea of fog. Sometimes, only the nine high tops of Chashan Mountain are placed on the sea of clouds, just like a flat boat with leaves. "Mountains are like Chashan on the sea", hence the name Rongcheng Chashan Scenic Area. Because there are nine steep and beautiful peaks in Rongcheng Chashan Scenic Area, and the rocks all over the mountains are as black and iron-like, Rongcheng Chashan Scenic Area is also called "Rongcheng Jiuding Tiechashan Scenic Area".

shortFeatures: Longevity culture research base
summary: Weihai Duofushan International Health Tourism Resort is located in Rushan City, a famous "hometown of longevity" in Shandong Province. It is now invested and developed by Ribai Group Holding Company and Weihai Duofushan Tourism Development Co., Ltd., with a planned area of more than 10 square kilometers and an estimated total investment of about 1.19 billion yuan. The scenic spot started construction in 2009, was rated as a national AAA tourist attraction in August 2012, and officially opened on May 1, 2013. It has been rated as the first "longevity culture research base" in Shandong Province. Duofushan Scenic Area is a typical warm temperate maritime climate, with four distinct seasons, sufficient sunlight, no severe cold in winter and no scorching heat in summer, and an average annual temperature of 12.3 ℃. It is one of the most suitable areas for human habitation. Duofushan has been a famous mountain of Buddhist and Taoist culture since ancient times, and is known as the "Little Mount Tai". Duofushan Temple Fair is very famous in Jiaodong area and has great influence. It lasts for three days from the 15th day of the fourth lunar month every year. People who come to the temple fair mainly come from the three northeastern provinces, Hebei, Henan, Jiangsu, Zhejiang and other places, and there are an endless stream, up to 100,000 people. During the temple fair, some people come to offer sacrifices and worship, some participate in performances, entertainment and other activities, and some trade in local specialties and Chinese herbal medicines.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Natural stone carving garden lined with strange stones
summary:
Yushan Mountain is a national forest park, located about 18 kilometers southwest of Rushan City, with a total area of 12 square kilometers. It is surrounded by mountains, and a "herringbone" canyon is formed in the middle, hence the name of the Mountain. The man, the mountain; It is the place where the mountain curves. Its main peak, Yuhuang Mountain, is 589.5 meters above sea level, and its watershed is on the border between Rushan and Haiyang. The mountain has a peculiar geology and is composed of magmatic rocks. It was originally a submarine mountain range. Later, due to the orogeny and Yanshan movement from Archean to Mesozoic, the crust uplifted and became a terrestrial mountain range. It suffered two earthquakes in 495 and 1046 AD. The ancient Mountain, after experiencing the vicissitudes of geological activities, has formed today's natural features with beautiful natural beauties and strange stones.

shortFeatures: Many citizens will come here for morning exercises or walks

summary:
Shidaowan Resort is surrounded by mountains and seas, with beautiful scenery and pleasant climate. It has a monsoon warm temperate climate, with an average annual temperature of 11 degrees, no severe cold in winter, no scorching heat in summer, and four distinct seasons. The area is divided into four functional areas: Binhai Recreation Area, Kongdao International Amusement Center, Chaoyang Mountain Forest Park and Fenghuang Lake Scenic Area. Roads, water, electricity and communication are all opened, and all facilities are basically sound. It is an ideal leisure resort. 、 
Shidao has a long history and culture, and Shidao Bay has occupied an important position in maritime transportation, trade and cultural exchanges between China and foreign countries since ancient times. Today, similar to Xixiakou, it is also a fishing village with many scenic spots. There is Shidao Fishing Port, the largest fishing port in northern China; Tianhou Temple built in the Qianlong period of Qing Dynasty; Chishan Fahua Institute, which loves the friendship between the people of China, Japan and South Korea; Dayu Island, the largest natural fishing village in China, with seagrass as the top and bluestone as the wall; Everyone is a gardener, and every household has a flower village-Nanche Village; Muyun'an, a painting village where everyone learns calligraphy and every household paints... also has landscapes such as Phoenix Lake, Sea Paradise, Bathing Beach and Chaoyang Cave.

Weihai Mao Zedong Badge Collection Museum is the largest Mao Zedong Badge Museum in China, covering an area of 20,000 square meters and a total construction area of about 48,000 square meters. It is located on the west side of Weihai New Industrial Zone Management Committee. The museum collects more than 1.5 million medals, military medals, medals, medals and commemorative medals of Mao Zedong in various periods, and the collection can be called "the largest in the world and the unique in China". At the same time, it also collects tens of thousands of statues of Mao Zedong, red porcelain, red books and posters. As a unique historical and cultural witness, Mao Zedong's badge is an artistic treasure of the Chinese nation. Especially after the Cultural Relics Protection Law passed by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress in 1982 defined Mao Zedong's badge as a modern cultural relic, Mao Zedong's badge has special commemorative significance, containing rich historical value, artistic value and collection value.  
For example, the badge contains the sunrise Shaoshan Dongfanghong, the First Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC), Chairman Mao went to Anyuan to launch the workers' movement after the first meeting, Mao Zedong's Guangdong Farmers' Workshop during the cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, the August 1st Nanchang Uprising after the breakdown of the cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, the Autumn Harvest Uprising on August 7, 1927, the establishment of Jinggangshan base area on September 9, 1927, the establishment of Jinggangshan base area on April 28, 1929. It records more than 1,000 topics such as party history, military history, social development history and character history of the Communist Party of China (CPC) from its founding in 1921 to the 1970s.  
Through the display of badges, we explain modern Chinese history and carry forward Mao Zedong Thought, and let the elderly remember history through profound thinking and interpretation of history and culture; Let young people learn history, and then learn the fine traditions and Chinese virtues of the older generation of revolutionaries. Weihai Mao Zedong Badge Collection Museum will become a large-scale comprehensive exhibition hall integrating educational exhibitions, visits and tourism, study and seminars, etc. The first thing you see on the first floor of the exhibition hall is the statue of the chairman made of plaster. The second floor of the exhibition hall is mainly for the display of badges. Through the explanation of badges, we can let everyone know a whole modern Chinese history. The badges on the third floor of the exhibition hall mainly show military medals, medals and commemorative medals after the founding of the People's Republic of China and from the Revolution of 1911 to the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea. The fourth floor of the exhibition hall is mainly a multi-functional hall, which can hold cultural forums, cultural performing arts, meetings and so on. The fifth floor of the exhibition hall shows you 184 paintings of General Mo Bao.

Weihai Botanical Garden is planned to cover an area of 30,000 mu, and now 10,000 mu has been built, with more than 280 kinds of trees, flowers and shrubs and more than 10 million seedlings. The scenic spot covers leisure picking, parent-child activities, popular science education, leisure fishing, four-star catering and accommodation, special farm banquet, health wooden house, expansion activities, splendid flower sea, wedding photography and other projects. It is a comprehensive large-scale botanical garden integrating popular science, catering and leisure.

When you arrive at Wawushi Village, Lidao Town, Rongcheng City in autumn, you can experience a different style. There are blue sea and golden beach here. Rushankou is centered on Darushan Mountain, with the endless Yellow Sea in the south, the calm Rushankou Bay in the north, and Duoshan Mountain, Xiaorushan Mountain and Xirushan Mountain across the sea in the west. To the south of Haikou, there is an island that runs from east to west-Xiaoqingdao, which is the natural barrier of Rushan Pass. The climate here is pleasant, with mountains and islands, green trees and green vines, and broad waves and green waters. In history, there was a metaphor of "Lushunkou in the north and Rushankou in the south".

Rongchishan Mountain, located on the northwest side of Shidao Port, covers a radius of 12.8 square kilometers, connected by mountains and seas, and has beautiful scenery.
