tagNameList: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
summary: Donghong Fort, also known as Dongfengshao Fort, is the easternmost fort on Liugong Island. It is equipped with 2 24cm and 12cm flat-fire guns, 6 75cm camp guns, and 4 rapid-fire guns. Artillery fire can reach the eastern sea surface of Liugong Island and the north and south seas, mainly blocking the south entrance together with Ridao and Nanbang Fort. In the Sino-Japanese War of Weihai, the fort was severely damaged by the Japanese army, but was later destroyed by Japanese artillery fire and abandoned. Donghong Fort has a tunnel leading to the military house, and artillery can reach the fort directly from the tunnel. The tunnel is a masonry structure, with an arch dome, made of granite, with the highest point of 4 meters and a width of 32 meters. There is intact ventilation equipment in the tunnel. In front of the fort, there are 11 soldiers built according to the situation, each of which is about 22 square meters. They are located at the exit of the tunnel and connected with the tunnel. The soldiers are connected with each other, making it easy to enter and exit.

shortFeatures: Jin State Ancestral Hall and Garden Architectural Complex
summary:
Jinci, located 25 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City in Shanxi Province, at the foot of Xuanyong Mountain and the source of Jinshui River, is a precious historical and cultural heritage that integrates ancient Chinese sacrificial architecture, gardens, sculptures, murals, and碑刻 art. It is also a magnificent chapter in world architecture, garden, and sculpture art from the 7th to the 12th century. Jinci is a shrine dedicated to Ji Yu, the first Duke of the Jin State in the early Western Zhou Dynasty. The cultural relics at Jinci are abundant, with more than 100 buildings from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, including halls, pavilions, towers, bridges, and terraces. There are over 100 sculptures since the Song and Yuan dynasties, more than 30 cast artworks, over 400 steles, and more than 200 poems and couplets. It also boasts 96 ancient and famous trees, including 30 trees over a thousand years old. The preservation of so many cultural relics in one heritage site is extremely rare. In 1961, it was designated as a national key cultural relics protection unit by the State Council. In 2001, it was rated as a 4A national tourist attraction by the National Tourism Administration.

The historical, artistic, scientific, and aesthetic value of Jinci makes it the longest-lasting and most representative example of the integration of ancient ancestral temples and garden art. It is a priceless heritage in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese culture and human architectural art.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
shortFeatures: Gathering the essence of Shanxi cultural relics
summary:
Shanxi Museum covers an area of 168 mu with a total investment of nearly 400 million yuan. It is one of the few large-scale modern and comprehensive museums in China at present. 
The main museum has four floors, with the basic exhibition theme of "Jin Soul". There are special exhibitions of history and culture on the second and third floors, and special exhibitions of art on the fourth floor. 
There are about 400,000 precious collections, among which cultural relics of Taosi site in Neolithic Age, cultural relics of Fangguo in Shang Dynasty and cultural relics of Shanxi merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are quite distinctive. 
The museum will also hold some temporary exhibitions from time to time, and there are also restaurants and teahouses in the main museum for visitors to use. At present, the regular exhibitions such as Jin State Hegemony, Hometown of Opera, and Shanxi Merchants in Ming and Qing Dynasties are closed, and the explanation time is 9:30, 10:30, 14:30 and 15:30, with a total of 4 sessions

tagNameList: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Historical Ruins; Historical Sites; Statues/Sculptures
shortFeatures: The Thousand-Year-Old Buddha in the suburbs of Taiyuan.
summary:
· The Mount Meng Giant Buddha, also known as the West Mountain Giant Buddha, was originally a cliff-side Buddha statue behind the Kaihua Temple on Mount Meng. It was destroyed during the late Yuan Dynasty.
· In 1980, the Mount Meng Giant Buddha was rediscovered. By the time of its discovery, the Buddha's head was missing, and the body was buried in soil and stone, severely weathered.
· The height from the bottom of the legs to the neck is about 30 meters, while the original height was approximately 46 meters. The current Buddha head was carved by later generations.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A place for Taiyuan citizens to relax and entertain
summary:
Yingze Park, with convenient transportation and wide vision, is the largest park in Taiyuan. 
There are flower exhibition hall, aquarium, calligraphy and painting exhibition hall, bonsai garden, peony, peony, rose and other specialized botanical gardens in the park, as well as tennis courts, miniature golf courses, amusement parks and other entertainment venues.  
This is a Jin Dynasty building, which moved here from other places, adding a quaint style to Yingze Park.

shortFeatures: Watch the brewing process of aged Shanxi vinegar.
summary:
Donghu Vinegar Garden is the first company-based, factory-style museum in Shanxi Province that showcases the traditional and modern production processes of aged vinegar and the historical and cultural connotations of aged vinegar.

The Exhibition Hall and Vinegar Therapy Garden collect various vinegar brewing tools, farming implements, and over 700 vinegar therapy recipes dating back to the Western Han Dynasty, providing a comprehensive understanding of the historical and cultural heritage of Shanxi aged vinegar.

Visitors can participate in part of the production process and enjoy free tastings of various aged vinegars.

As this is a food industry site, for hygiene reasons, visitors are not allowed to wander or touch production tools during the tour.

shortFeatures: A gorgeous feast of tulips
summary: Jinci Park is located in front of the east gate of Jinci Ancient Buildings, and it is the only place to visit Jinci. After the liberation of Taiyuan in 1949, the park was formed by three private villas, namely Chenjiaxilu, Zhoujiade Yinzhai and Rongjia Taoran Village. It has experienced three large-scale expansions in history, and now it has been built into a self-contained urban large-scale park landscape with ancient buildings near Jinci in the west.

shortFeatures: Ancient buildings built in the Northern Song Dynasty
summary:
This is the main hall of Jinci Temple. The Temple of Our Lady was built to worship Jiang, the daughter of Jiang Ziya, the wife of King Wu of Zhou and the mother of King Cheng of Zhou. 
The temple was built in the Northern Song Dynasty and has a history of nearly a thousand years. 
There is no load-bearing bright pillar in the hall, which increases the space in the hall a lot. This peculiar construction is quite rare. 
The colored sculptures in the Song Dynasty are the treasures of the Temple of Notre Dame, especially the maid statues, which are vivid and have different expressions, which shows the superb handicraft skills in the Song Dynasty.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Hidden gems for kids.; Museums
shortFeatures: Reproduced Underground Simulation Mine
summary: The China Coal Museum is the only professional museum in China dedicated to the coal industry and is a symbol of science and civilization. Due to its unique function and status, it has been awarded the title of "National First-Class Museum" by the National Cultural Heritage Administration. Here, visitors can also view dozens of coal specimens, including long flame coal, poor coal, lignite, and gas coal. The museum's most distinctive feature is the "Coal Amusement Palace." The "Coal Amusement Palace" is a large-scale underground simulated mine, recreated using numerous real-life prototypes or 1:1 replicas. The visitor route spans several hundred meters and is said to be the largest in Asia.

tagNameList: Historic site; Historical Sites; Memorial Temples
shortFeatures: An exquisite ancient bridge in Jinci Temple
summary: Yumao Feiliang is located in front of the Our Lady of Jinci Temple in the southwest of Taiyuan City, Shanxi Province. It is an exquisite ancient bridge building. In the Northern Song Dynasty, it was built in the Northern Wei Dynasty with the Temple of Notre Dame, which has a history of more than 1,500 years. The whole beam frame is a relic of the Song Dynasty. This cross-shaped bridge is also an isolated case among the existing ancient bridges in China, and it is the first batch of national first-class cultural relics announced by the State Council. There are hook rails around to rely on. The ancients regarded the round as a pool and the square as a marsh. Because the Central Plains of Marsh is the second largest source of Jinshui River, the flow rate is even large, and there are many swimming fish, so it is named Fish Marsh. There are thirty-four small octagonal stone pillars in the marsh, with bucket arches and pillow beams at the top of the pillars, supporting the cross-shaped bridge deck, which is flying beams.

shortFeatures: Temple with Ming Dynasty statues
summary: Chongshan Temple is located in Dilianggong Street, Yingze District, Taiyuan City, Shanxi Province. Founded in Don. It was first named Baima Temple, then changed to Yanshou Temple and Zongshan Temple, and changed to Chongshan Temple in the Ming Dynasty. In the fourteenth year of Hongwu (1381), Zhu Yuanzhang's third son, King Gong of Jin, Zhu Kuanxiang. Before the Ming Dynasty, it was just a small temple. Some said that it was Emperor Yangdi's palace when he visited Taiyuan, while others said that it was the former site where Wu Zetian became a monk when he was young. Now, the word "Zongtang Site" on the right forehead of the mountain gate probably originated from these legends.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn leaves; Mountains
summary:
Juewei Mountain is located in the west of Huyan Village, Chaicun Town, Jiancaoping District, 24 kilometers northwest of Taiyuan City, running north-south, with an altitude of about 1,400 meters. There is Qingfeng in the south and Feiyun Peak in the north. The two peaks are tall and straight, sandwiched by a deep ditch running from east to west, facing each other across the ditch, which is like a gateway to the mountain. Especially the beautiful red leaves in autumn are the most famous, so they are called the rising red leaves. Qing Daoguang's "Yangqu County Chronicles" contains the saying "frost falls in late autumn, and all the red leaves in the mountains turn into vermilion purple". 
There is Duofu Temple at the top of Juewei Mountain, and there are seven existing halls, including the mountain gate, the bell tower, the Daxiong Hall, the Manjusri Pavilion, the Tibetan Sutra Building and the East and West Duo Hall. The Daxiong Hall is the main hall, with a magnificent scale, with 84 murals and some statues, all of which are relics of the Ming Dynasty. There is a frost red niche in the temple, which is the seclusion of Fu Shan, a famous Taiyuan scholar in the late Ming and early Qing Dynasties. 
Internal attractions: Stupa, Duofu Temple, Juewei Red Leaves (one of the eight scenic spots in Taiyuan), Fu Qingzhu Reading Office

The whole building complex of Qinglong Town is like a soaring dragon. The curved road-shaped building complex in the south of the town is the dragon tail; The curved building in the west of the town is the right leg of the dragon that bends backward; The road leading to the collapsed cliff slope in the east of the town is the left leg of the dragon. Therefore, the road goes to the river, just like a dragon's claw just emerges from the water; Feng shui slope bow old road is the right front leg of the dragon; The curved ramp of the Dragon King Temple is the left front leg of the dragon, the lower street is the dragon's neck, and the grand cross is the dragon's claw; The slope is the dragon head, the five-mile long street is the dragon body, and the wells of two temples, such as the Shanghe Temple on the dragon head, are longan. A big river in the east of the town rolled from south to north. From a distance, Qinglong Town was like a dragon emerging from the water, soaring into the sky.  
There is an earth tower outside the town, which was originally a beacon tower for transmitting military information in the Spring and Autumn Period. From a distance, it looks like a giant pen. There are many shops on both sides of Qinglong Town, all of which are buildings of Ming and Qing Dynasties. Laoye Temple, Taishan Temple, Grandma Temple, River Temple, Wenchang Temple, Dragon King Temple, Dawang Temple, Chahuang Temple and other temples dominate the ancient town, and their temples are magnificent, either like eagles spreading their wings or like strange beasts, protecting the auspiciousness and peace of the ancient town.

Tianlong Mountain Grottoes, formerly known as Fangshan, have beautiful scenery. In history, they used to be the summer palace of Emperor Shang Huan of the Northern Qi Dynasty. 
The surrounding mountains are undulating, the mountains are lush with pines and cypresses, the spring water of the Dragon King Stone Cave on the top of the mountain is rippling, and the streams in front of the mountain are gurgling. 
Tianlong Mountain Grottoes, with their mature, full, refined skills and meticulous expression of feelings, are close to the life breath of workers, are characterized by strong nationality and locality, and are famous for being "small but refined". 
At present, some areas of the scenic spot are under maintenance, and the road up the mountain is rugged. Self-driving tourists should pay attention to safety.

Covering an area of 42 hectares, the zoo houses over 150 species of animals, with nearly 2,000 individual animals. It attracts more than 2 million visitors from both China and abroad each year. 

The zoo has well-connected paths, and once inside, visitors can follow the signs to various scenic spots within the park. Families with children can also visit the amusement area, where they can enjoy attractions like bumper cars (some of which require an additional fee).

Shanxi Folk Museum is located in the former Confucian Temple in Taiyuan. It was originally the abandoned site of Chongshan Temple, and the Confucian Temple was moved here in the eighth year of Guangxu (1882). As a Confucian temple, the main buildings such as Zhaobi, Welling Pavilion, Star Gate, Dacheng Gate and Dacheng Hall are well preserved; The Dacheng Hall and the side hall are now used as exhibition halls. The ancient trees in the courtyard are towering, and cultural relics such as classics and stone carvings collected from all over the world are displayed. At present, the permanent exhibitions include Qianqiu Confucius Exhibition, the exhibition of fine costumes in the late Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China, the exhibition of cultural relics and the models of ancient buildings. In addition, there are theme exhibitions such as old textbook exhibition, folk handicraft exhibition, Lantern Shadow Spring and Autumn Shadow Play Exhibition, etc.

summary:
Located in the north of Fengyugou, 23 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City. Surrounded by jungles, ancient cypresses, and temples hidden in the middle, it is not easy to see unless you climb. The name of Taishan first appeared in Song Shu written by Shen Yue. It is said that in the Northern Han Dynasty, there was a mountain man Shi Gandang, who was famous for his bravery, and the mountain where he lived was also famous all over the world. 
It is particularly worth mentioning that on May 8th, 2008, a hexagonal underground palace was discovered in Longquan Temple in Taishan, which amazed the archaeological community. There were five relics buried in the underground palace. Taiyuan TV broadcast live the whole process of archaeologists opening the stone letter and golden coffin. In the amazed eyes of the audience, five coffins were opened heavily... silver coffins and golden coffins were dazzling and ingenious, and the answer was finally kept in the golden coffins. Experts said that for fear that the technical means are imperfect and the precious cultural relics in the golden coffin cannot be properly protected, the last layer of the coffin will be opened at another time. Even so, Shanxi people still feel the mystery of archaeological excavation of cultural relics in a brand-new way. Even the soft ribbon on the silver coffin has inspired many people's associations. More than 1300 years later, you can still see the true appearance of Tang Dynasty silk, and the audience is excited. The underground palace of Longquan Temple is the only underground palace where relics of the Tang Dynasty have been buried so far in Shanxi. 
Internal attractions: Daxiong Hall, Longquan Temple, Li Cunxiao Tomb and so on

The Wanzi Building is a landmark building with historical value in Taiyuan. The Wanzi Building was a library built by Yen Hsi-shan in memory of his father Yan Ziming in the spring of the 26th year of the Republic of China before the War of Resistance against Japan in Taiyuan. It was planned to be the "Ziming Library", so it was also called Ziming Library. However, soon after Taiyuan fell, the Wanzi Building was used for other purposes by Japanese aggressors. After liberation, the people's government set up Taiyuan Library on the basis of this place, which restored its original use.

summary: Kaihua Temple Lianli Pagoda is located on the west mountain beam of Jiusidi Village, Luocheng Street Office. It was built in the first year of Chunhua in the Northern Song Dynasty (990). Two tomb towers, facing east, were originally the relics of the lower temple of Kaihua Temple founded by the Northern Qi Dynasty. Single-story brick, with a square plane and a total height of about 11 meters. The two towers are similar in shape, with an interval of 1.7 meters. They are connected to the base, commonly known as "Lianli Tower". The pedestal is 1 meter high and is built with overlapping seats. The side of the pagoda is 3.3 meters wide and 2.5 meters high, with a bluestone door embedded on the front, and the lintel of the south pagoda is inscribed "Incarnation Buddha Stupa". The north pagoda is titled "Dingguang Buddha Stupa Pagoda". The remaining three sides have a false door, half-opened, and a false window with a straight lattice. The upper part is made of astringent astringency. The eaves of the tower are picked out by 0.5 meters, and the height is 1 meter. The top of the tower is retracted layer by layer, and the tower brake is in the shape of an octagonal pavilion, which has the characteristics of the transition from the Tang Dynasty technique to the Song Dynasty technique, and its structure and shape are unique in China. In June 2004, it was announced by the provincial government as a provincial key cultural relics protection unit. Kaihua Temple Lianli Pagoda is located at the foot of Mengshan Mountain, 17 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan, Shanxi Province. The temple was built in the second year of Tianbao in the Northern Qi Dynasty (AD 551), and a Buddha statue was carved on a cliff. It is about 60 meters high and has a magnificent scale, which is as famous as Longshan Tongzi Temple. In the first year of Sui Renshou (601), the Buddha Pavilion was built and renamed Jingming Temple. Both Emperor Gaozu and Emperor Gaozong went to Bi to pay homage and changed their names to Civilization. In the first year of Chunhua in the Northern Song Dynasty (990), two brick pagodas of Shijia and Tathagata were built. There are existing brick pagodas and brick coupon Buddhist halls in Song Dynasty and several iron Buddhas. The two brick towers are square and their bases are connected, so they are called Lianli towers. Above the waist seat is a square tower body, with a semicircular door arch on the front, a flame-shaped coupon face, and hidden engraved curly grass and petals. The eaves of the tower are stacked and astringent, the brake at the top of the tower is exquisitely carved, with a pavilion style, carved rails, Pubai Fang and bucket arch, and the top of the tower is octagonal eaves and orbs. Beautiful in appearance and beautiful in carving, it has both the simple legacy of the Tang Dynasty and the fine carving method of the Song Dynasty.

shortFeatures: Large-scale personal calligraphy stele forest
summary:
Beilin Park is located on the east bank of Fenhe River, west of Jinsong Road, from Kangle Street in the north and Shuangta West Street in the south. With collection, display, appreciation, social education and tourism as its main functions, it integrates culture and leisure. 
The overall layout of the park is divided into north and south gardens, which are in a belt-shaped form. [It covers an area of 13,728 square meters, a building area of 4,577.01 square meters, a stele gallery of 489.6 square meters, a lawn of 5,800 square meters and a water surface of 1,100 square meters. There are 2,134 plants in the park, 400 flowers of various types and 88 varieties. The green space rate and plant integrity rate reach 52.7% and 98%. It is a new and professional cultural park that has begun to take shape. 
The Forest of Steles Garden is simple and solemn, elegant and unique, with fragrant ink and beautiful scenery. In the garden, green pines and bamboos, fruit fragrance, red flowers and green grass, the simple and colorful natural scenery is reflected everywhere. In the park layout and plant configuration, landscapers pay attention to the reasonable zoning and the creation of scenic spots. Combining with the typical environment, they make use of plant configuration to make the limited space show an infinitely rich landscape. In the application of plants, we should pay attention to posture and seasonal changes, and make full use of the functions of plants in viewing shapes, appreciating colors, smelling fragrance and listening to sounds in landscaping, so as to achieve the goal of blooming spring flowers, rich summer shade, gorgeous autumn colors, green winter scenery, scenery in all seasons and scenery everywhere, which can be called a model of gardening in our province. The North Garden emphatically embodies the courtyard style with symmetrical central axis in classical garden landscaping in China, and consists of monument hall, monument pavilion, rockery, small bridge, pool and monument gallery; South Garden is based on natural landscaping techniques, and consists of management room, creation room and monument gallery. 
With collection, display, appreciation, social education and tourism as its main functions, Beilin Park integrates culture and leisure. Among many garden scenic spots in Forest of Steles resorts in China, it is coquettish and unique, and has won the reputation of "Three Jin Dynasties and One Priceless Treasure" and "Good Position of Traditional Education". It was once named "Moral Education Base" by the provincial and municipal education commissions. Up to now, the Forest of Steles has collected 418 steles, which may be a microcosm of the vitality of Chinese traditional culture.

summary: Chunyang Palace is a famous Taoist temple. In the northwest corner of Wuyi Square, Taiyuan City, Shanxi Province. Also known as Lu Zu Temple. It was built in Yuan Dynasty, rebuilt in Wanli period of Ming Dynasty (1573-1620), and renovated and expanded in Qianlong period of Qing Dynasty (1736-1795). There is a wooden memorial archway with four columns and three floors in front, and the main buildings in it are Lv Zu Hall, Cloister Pavilion, Wei Pavilion, auxiliary room, brick coupon cave dwelling, Guan Gong Pavilion, etc. The main building, Lu Zu Hall, is three rooms wide and magnificent. The hall originally housed the statue of Lu Dongbin; The two courtyards at the back of the palace, each composed of pavilion-style buildings, are strewn at random, twists and turns, and have a unique form; The Wei Pavilion in the backyard is the tallest building in the palace. Looking around the pavilion, the scenery of the urban area is vivid in my mind. Each of the four corners of the palace is built with an octagonal Zanjian pavilion. It used to be one of the famous Taoist temples in Taiyuan.

shortFeatures: Well-preserved century-old classical garden
summary:
Yu Garden is located in the northeastern part of the Yu Garden Tourist and Commercial Area in Shanghai, adjacent to the City God Temple of Shanghai and the Yu Garden Tourist Mall. It is a classical southern Chinese garden, renowned both at home and abroad as a famous scenic spot and tourist attraction. In 1982, it was approved by the State Council as a national key cultural relics protection unit. 

Originally a private garden from the Ming Dynasty, Yu Garden was built during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns, making it over 450 years old. The garden's owner, Pan Yunduan, was once the governor of Sichuan. 

Today, Yu Garden covers an area of approximately 2 hectares, with pavilions, rock formations, and trees arranged in picturesque and harmonious ways. It is known for its serene beauty, delicate designs, and the distinctive feature of "greatness within smallness," reflecting the artistic style of Jiangnan gardens from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Within the garden, historical sites such as the "Zangshu Tower," the birthplace of "Shanghai School" painting and calligraphy, and the "Dianchun Hall," the headquarters of the Shanghai Xiaodao Hui uprising, are still preserved. Throughout history, Yu Garden has been praised by scholars, being called "the most exquisitely beautiful in the southeast" and "the crown of southeastern gardens."

There are three theaters in the theater: a large theater with 1,800 seats for performing ballet, opera and symphony; A 550-seat middle theater is suitable for the performance of local opera and chamber music; There is also a small 250-seat theater for drama and song and dance performances. shortFeatures: Experience the ancient town of Shanghai amidst the green bricks and white walls.
summary:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu District, Shanghai, adjacent to the scenic area of Dianshan Lake. It is a typical water town in the Jiangnan region, characterized by interconnected waterways between streets and alleys, creating a very elegant environment. The town features gardens, historical sites, and numerous traditional snacks and boutique shops, making it the top choice for visiting ancient towns around Shanghai. Zhujiajiao is not very large and can be explored on foot, with a casual tour taking about half a day.  

Entering the town from the southern entrance, visitors first encounter Zhuxi Garden and the Cultural and Arts Museum. Zhuxi Garden is a delicate and compact garden open to the public for free. The Cultural and Arts Museum, on the other hand, is a uniquely designed modern white building that documents the local history and culture of Zhujiajiao through oil paintings and sculptures.  

After the museum, visitors reach North Street, bustling with pedestrians. Here, many snack shops offer famous treats such as Grandma’s Zongzi, Ancient Town Rice Balls, Braised Pork Knuckles, and various exquisite pastries. Walking slowly northward along North Street, visitors will find several uniquely designed bridges on the right, including Yongfeng Bridge and Taian Bridge. Across the river is Caohe Street, where attractions like the Qing Dynasty Post Office, Wang Chang Memorial Hall, Chenghuang Temple, and Yuanjin Zen Temple are located, all worth exploring.  

In addition to the attractions, the street also features many boutique shops, including the famous bookstore "Cat’s Sky Castle." On the right side of North Street, a large bridge spans the main river channel—this is the well-known Fangsheng Bridge of Zhujiajiao. Crossing Fangsheng Bridge to the other side of Caogang River, visitors will still find small waterways crisscrossing, with riverside boutique shops and snacks scattered around.  

Kezhi Garden, another notable attraction in Zhujiajiao, is a model of exquisite Jiangnan garden design, showcasing the essence of this architectural style and worth a visit.

tagNameList: Ancient Town and Village; Night Tour and Sightseeing; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The ancient towns of Jiangnan with rich historical connotations.
summary:
· Built during the Northern Song Dynasty, it is located 5 kilometers from the city center of Shanghai and is an ancient town in Jiangnan that integrates tourism, sightseeing, dining, and leisure.

· The town is named after seven "treasures" said to be found there: the Golden Lotus Sutra, the Divine Tree, the Floating Bell, the Flying Buddha, the Golden Rooster, the Jade Chopsticks, and the Jade Axe.

· Qibao Old Street retains the characteristics of a Jiangnan water town within the metropolis, showcasing a blend of new and ancient cultural atmosphere, and has become one of Shanghai's scenic spots.

· The area is not large, consisting of only a few small streets. Its main attractions include Qibao Old Street, Qibao Pawnshop, Zhou's Micro Sculpture Museum, and Cricket Grass Hall.

· Qibao Old Street is also a food street, lined with famous local snacks such as Qibao square cakes, Qibao lamb, and rice wine marinated pork.

shortFeatures: A museum that comprehensively displays the special topics of the Expo
summary:
· The World Expo Museum is not only the first truly international museum in China, but also the unique museum in the world that comprehensively displays the special topics of the World Expo. 
The exhibition area of the museum is about 12,000 square meters, with 8 permanent exhibition halls and 3 temporary exhibition halls, gathering hundreds of precious cultural relics from all over the world. 
· You don't need to travel all over the world to experience the history of the World Expo for more than 150 years in Shanghai and learn about the host cities of previous World Expos.

tagNameList: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Shanghai Folk Customs Cultural Attractions
summary:
The Chenghuang Temple tourist area includes a large area such as the Old Chenghuang Temple, Yuyuan Garden and shopping, food and small commodities. It is a must-visit attraction for many people to come to Shanghai. 
"Yuyuan Garden" and "Old Town God's Temple" are private gardens and Taoist temples in Ming Dynasty, and they need to buy tickets to visit. Other areas are basically open scenic spots. 
When night falls, the whole pedestrian street will become more magnificent, and bees who like photography must not miss it. 
For visitors who visit Shanghai for the first time, Chenghuang Temple is the first window to fully appreciate Shanghai's history, culture and customs, and taste authentic Shanghai snacks.

tagNameList: Adorable animals; a hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Zoos
shortFeatures: Observe Rare Animals and Spend Quality Time with Family
summary:
- Shanghai Zoo, located near Hongqiao Airport, was originally named Xijiao Park. It is a place full of memories for many old Shanghai residents and is the second largest zoo in China.
- The entire park is lush with flowers and greenery, offering a tranquil environment. A small river runs through the area, and walking within the park, one can experience the rare natural ecological atmosphere in the midst of a bustling metropolis.
- The zoo is home to over 620 species of animals, with exhibition areas for amphibians, reptiles, herbivores, carnivores, and birds, as well as educational and butterfly pavilions.
- Children can feed the small animals, or enjoy playing on the large lawn, sunbathing, boating, or riding the Ferris wheel.

shortFeatures: Former China National Pavilion at Shanghai World Expo
summary:
It used to be the China National Pavilion of Shanghai World Expo, with a collection of more than 8,000 pieces, including a large number of paintings by famous painters such as Zhang Yuguang and Wu Guanzhong. 
The exhibition halls of the Art Palace are mainly located on the 0m floor, 5m floor, 33m floor, 41m floor and 49m floor. It is recommended to visit them from top to bottom. 
The most interesting thing is the treasure of the town hall-the multimedia version of Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival, which is located on the 49m floor, but you need to pay extra tickets to watch it. 
In addition, there are many exhibition halls for viewing, such as Shadow Art Exhibition, Modern Art Exhibition and Shanghai Artists Invitational Exhibition.

shortFeatures: Shanghai's largest Catholic church
summary: Xujiahui Catholic Church is adjacent to the bustling Xujiahui Commercial District. Its red brick walls and two towering bell towers make this century-old medieval Gothic building particularly eye-catching. The simple exterior shape and gorgeous interior decoration carry a strong religious atmosphere, and you can also feel the rare tranquility in the city here. The window frames and eaves on the exterior of the church are all lined with granite, and the roof is paved with graphite tiles and decorated with many stone carvings of the Son and God. It is very solemn. Every night, the church is particularly charming against the external lights. The interior of the church is even more magnificent. It is supported by 64 pillars, with a large altar transported from Paris in 1919 in the middle. The huge space can accommodate nearly 3,000 people to celebrate Mass at the same time; the pointed arches doors and windows are inlaid with colorful glass, and when the sun passes through, colorful light and shadow will be reflected in the church, which is very beautiful. This church was built by the French Jesuits and is also known as the "St. Ignatius's Church". It is a relatively large Catholic church in Shanghai. Nowadays, many believers come here every day to say Mass and pray, and the green space in front of the church has become a scenic spot for newlyweds to take wedding photos.

· Chongming Island, located at the estuary of the Yangtze River, is the third largest island in China. It is known as the "gateway to the Yangtze River and Yingzhou in the East China Sea". It is the largest estuary alluvial island in the world and the largest sand island in the world. 
The water is clean and the wind is clear, and there are natural scenery everywhere that has not been chiseled by artificial axes. The tree-lined levee around the island is like a green dragon, crouching on the Yangtze River estuary. 
· In the early morning, climb the east end of the levee and enjoy the sunrise in the East China Sea; In the evening, standing on the west side of the levee, enjoying the setting sun on the long river and listening to the returning boat singing at night, it is refreshing and happy. 
· The island has many historical sites and cultural landscapes. There are Yingzhou Park and Chengqiao Town Garden; There are also sites such as Jin'ao Mountain and the ancient battlefield where Zheng Chenggong fought bloody Qing soldiers. 
In addition, there are many farmhouses, such as Avantgarde Ecological Village, Yingdong Village and Gaojiazhuang Ecological Park, where you can come to eat farm food, fish, etc., which is very pleasant.

tagNameList: A hidden gem for strolling with kids; enjoy the autumn leaves; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: The Grand Garden in downtown Shanghai
summary:
- Shanghai Botanical Garden houses 17 themed areas, including the Bonsai Garden, Peony Garden, and Osmanthus Garden, making it one of the popular outdoor photography spots for enthusiasts.  
- The Bonsai Garden is one of the largest bonsai gardens in the world, and the Cherry Blossom area in the Rose Garden is the most concentrated area for cherry blossoms in Shanghai.  
- The garden hosts the "Winter Orchid Exhibition" every year, where nearly 200 species of orchids can be seen, showcasing their stunning beauty.  
- Spring is the peak season for flower-viewing visitors, especially between March and May when cherry blossoms, peach blossoms, and tulips are in full bloom.  
- The Shanghai Botanical Garden has introduced cultivated species of Baohua Yulan, a species endemic to China. With a small population, it is classified as "Critically Endangered" by the IUCN and is currently listed as a National Level I Protected Plant.

tagNameList: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; Film and TV base; Film Studios; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Old Shanghai film shooting location
summary:
- It is one of the top ten film and television bases in China. It has the local flavor of old Shanghai and European-style standard courtyards. The characteristic features of old Shanghai are one of its highlights.
- Riding the park's tram or rickshaw, walking through the traditional streets of old Shanghai from the 1930s, and tasting the flavors of old Shanghai snacks are all very interesting.
- TV dramas such as *Deeply in Love with You* and *Sparrow*, and films like *The Founding of a Republic* and *Kung Fu* were all filmed in this park.
- Around 10:30 AM or 2:30 PM, if you hear gunfire or explosions, don't be afraid, as filming is still taking place here.

tagNameList: Climbing mountains; Nature and adventure.; Mountains; Forests; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: Climb Mount Haiming to Enjoy Astronomical Wonders
summary:
· She Mountain is divided into East She Mountain and West She Mountain, located in the ancient city of Songjiang in the western suburbs of Shanghai. It is a Catholic pilgrimage site in Southeast Asia.
· The twelve peaks within the park extend from the southwest to the northeast, winding over approximately 13 kilometers, creating a beautiful mountainous landscape in the otherwise flat Shanghai plain.
· East She Mountain National Forest Park features elegant peaks, lush forests, and rich biodiversity, particularly known for the bamboo shoots produced in the mountains, which are fragrant with the scent of orchids.
· The park has developed and opened the following scenic areas to the public: East She Mountain Garden, West She Mountain Garden, Tianma Mountain Garden, and Xiao Kunshan Garden.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Location of old Shanghai film and television dramas
summary:
· The Waibaidu Bridge, erected at the confluence of the Suzhou River and the Huangpu River in Shanghai, is a steel frame underbearing bridge and the largest steel bridge in Shanghai. 
Waibaidu Bridge has a history of one hundred years, bearing the history and culture of old Shanghai, and witnessing the rapid development of new Shanghai. It can be seen in many TV dramas of old Shanghai. 
· To enjoy the bridge, you need to stand in the distance to see the panoramic view, or you can stand on the bridge to get in close contact and enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Suzhou River. 
If you are lucky, you may also be able to see new couples taking photography, and take unique wedding photos on the bridge when there is no car at the red light.

shortFeatures: Elegant environment and rich books
summary: The environment is "gorgeous" and "elegant", the functions are "complete", and the collection of books is "rich". The 1st and 2nd floors are used for "public services and academic exchanges"; the 3rd and 4th floors are mainly used for general document lending areas, which are always "full". Most of the people who "come early to occupy seats" are students, either writing homework or writing papers; the 5th and 6th floors are the "Special Reading Department","Audio-visual Reading Department" and "Digital Reading Department", which are "quiet and pleasant" and have a "good" atmosphere.

tagNameList: Observation deck; City coordinates; Modern Architecture; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Shanghai Landmark Buildings
summary:
Shanghai Tower is a super high-rise landmark skyscraper. Lujiazui Trade Center in Shanghai. 
· The building is about 632 meters high, with 119 floors above the ground. The shape is similar to the pick of a guitar, and each rising layer twists nearly 1 degree to form a spiral appearance. 
Among them, "Top of the World" is the functional experience area, which has the functions of city exhibition and viewing platform, entertainment, VIP small bar, catering, sightseeing meeting, etc. 
There are also landscape lights and theme light shows on the outside of high-rise buildings. In addition to the normal light display, they also echo the landscape lights of surrounding buildings.

tagNameList: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Military Sites; Museums
shortFeatures: Understanding China's Maritime History Simulation Model; The First Domestic Maritime-themed Museum
summary: The China Maritime Museum is the largest and highest-ranking comprehensive maritime museum in China. The museum focuses on "maritime" as its main theme and "museum" as its foundation. It is divided into six main exhibition halls: Maritime History, Ships, Maritime and Ports, Maritime Affairs and Maritime Safety, Seafarers, and Military Maritime. There are also two special exhibition areas: Fishing Vessels and Fishing, and Maritime Sports and Leisure. Additionally, the museum features a Planetarium, a 4D Cinema, and a Children's Activity Center, covering functions such as artifact collection, academic research, social education, and exhibitions.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Forests; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: Barbecue, horseback riding, cycling
summary:
Shanghai Haiwan National Forest Park is the third national forest park in Shanghai and the largest one currently. The park boasts the best 5.3 kilometers of coastline within the city's jurisdiction. The park is mainly divided into three tourist sections: the amusement area (including an amusement park, forest go-karting, forest horse riding, forest barbecue, etc.), the water activity area (featuring farm-style cuisine, a boat dock, etc.), and the cultural viewing area (with various folk art museums).  
The park is home to over 2,000 acres of plum blossoms, which, when in full bloom, form dense clusters, creating a scene as beautiful as clouds or rosy clouds.

shortFeatures: Reflecting the life of Jewish refugees during World War II.
summary: The Shanghai Jewish Refugees Museum commemorates the nearly 30,000 Jewish refugees who were accepted by Shanghai during World War II to escape Nazi massacres and persecution. Shanghai became their "Noah's Ark." The "Tilanqiao Historical and Cultural Area" still preserves much of the appearance of the Jewish settlement at that time. It is the only historical site in China that reflects the life of Jewish refugees during World War II.
opening_hours: Open at  09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

shortFeatures: An ancient temple with a long history and a large scale
summary:
Most of the temples in Longhua Temple today belong to buildings dating from the Tongzhi and Guangxu periods of the Qing Dynasty, followed by Maitreya Hall, Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, Three Sacred Hall, Abbot Room and Sutra Tower.
The Qinglong bronze bell cast during the Guangxu period, as the "Longhua Late Bell", was one of the "Eight Scenes in Shanghai" in the past. During the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty, 718 letters of the Tripitaka, Fan Jin Chiba Baolian Piluzana Buddha and the royal gold seals were awarded as the "Three Treasures of Temple Protection" of Longhua Temple.

shortFeatures: The larger Jiangnan garden in Shanghai, Guyi Garden.
summary:
Nanxiang Ancient Town is one of the four historical towns of Shanghai. The town was named after the Baihe Nanxiang Temple, which was built in the fourth year of the Liang Tianjian era (505 AD). It was historically praised as "a small Nanxiang rivaling Suzhou" and boasts a long history, rich cultural heritage, and numerous historical sites, making it a popular tourist destination.

The town is home to several historical relics, including the Guyi Garden, one of the four classical gardens of Jiangnan, the Tian'en Bridge built during the Qing Shunzhi period, the thousand-year-old Yunxiang Temple, and the Five Dynasties Brick Pagoda. The famous Nanxiang Xiaolongbao, with a history of over 100 years, remains delicious and has become one of the town's specialties and symbols. Additionally, Nanxiang has produced many outstanding figures throughout history, such as Li Liufang, one of the "Four Scholars of Jiading" in the Ming Dynasty, the Qing Dynasty bamboo carving master Wu Zhifan, and the contemporary Chinese painting master Lu Yanshao.

tagNameList: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
shortFeatures: Appreciate various exquisite glass artworks.
summary: This is the first glass museum in the country, transformed from a glass factory site. Upon entering the museum, designed in the shape of an old glass furnace workshop, you can gain a deeper understanding of the commonly seen glass: not only can you appreciate exquisite glass exhibits and watch the glass-making process live, but you can also try your hand at coloring finished glass products, or purchase finely crafted glass items to take home. It is a great place to visit with children, but safety precautions should be observed.

tagNameList: Night tour and sightseeing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Landscape project along the Huangpu River
summary: Binjiang Garden is a riverside landscape project that integrates sightseeing, greening, transportation and service facilities, focusing on the urban ecological environment and functions. The Binjiang Garden consists of hydrophilic platforms, slope greening, landscape roads and the 50-year-old Binjiang Garden (formerly Pudong Park). It is the East Bund of Shanghai in the 21st century.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems: Nature and Adventure; City Parks; Botanical Gardens; Flower Fields
shortFeatures: Horticultural Farming Island, Waterfront Camping
Shanghai large circus city
summary: The building of Shanghai Circus, known as the landmark building in Zhabei District, is a yellow round dumpling. In Circus City, you can watch circus performances and performances of Journey to Time and Space. After watching the performances, you can drink some hot drinks and buy souvenirs in the shopping rest area. The first half of the circus is animal performances, such as monkeys riding bicycles, black bears driving, lions and tigers. After the end of the first half, there was a ten-minute break in between. In the second half, you can see performances such as dancing with ropes in the air and riding horses. Many positions in the middle of the stage are occupied by tour groups, so try to book tickets in advance for individual tours. The scene of "Journey to Time and Space" is very grand, with sound effects and lighting combined with superb performance skills, even the audience in the stands will feel very exciting. There will be a blind spot for a few minutes in 120 yuan's position of "Journey to Time and Space", and the illumination lights of odd numbers in Area C will also affect people with even numbers.

shortFeatures: High street shopping spree
summary:
Huaihai Road Commercial Street is known as the "Champs Elysé es of the East" and is full of luxury shops. 
It used to be a French concession, leaving behind many French buildings, which are very charming. 
There are not only various shopping malls, but also various old restaurants and snack restaurants on the street.

shortFeatures: Records the history of Shanghai symphony music
summary: One of the largest private gardens in central Shanghai City was originally the residence of Shanghai Beach dye king Zhou Zongliang. On October 1, 2017, the Shanghai Symphony Music Museum located here was officially put into trial operation and opened to the public. It is the first museum in China with the theme of symphony music. There are more than 300 precious documents and physical exhibits in the museum, which are composed of three major sections: "Le Zhihe" combs the long history of the development of Shanghai's symphony music,"Le Zhihua" focuses on introducing China conductors, composers and representative works of symphonies, and "Le Zhi Zhi" popularizes symphony knowledge to the public in an easy-to-understand way.

Shanghai Planetarium (Shanghai Science and Technology Museum Branch) is a large-scale science museum invested and built by the Shanghai City Government. It is located in Lingang New Area of China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone, close to Dishui Lake Station of Metro Line 16. The Shanghai Planetarium covers an area of 58603 square meters and a building area of 37741 square meters. It is the largest planetarium in the world. With the vision of "shaping a complete view of the universe", the Shanghai Planetarium strives to stimulate people's curiosity and encourage people to feel the stars, understand the universe, and think about the future.
The main building of the Shanghai Planetarium forms a "celestial orbit" in a beautiful spiral shape. The unique three circular elements of the round hole skylight, inverted dome and dome theater form a "three-body" structure, which jointly interpret the basic laws of celestial movement. Outdoor greening outlines the spiral arm shape of the galaxy and naturally connects with the "Starry Sky" park, fully reflecting the organic integration of architecture and ecology.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the sea view and watch the sunrise
summary: Fengxian Bay Tourist Area is located at the southern tip of Shanghai City, facing the East China Sea, 40 kilometers away from the city center, and a 13.7-kilometer-long coastline spans east and west.

tagNameList: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums
summary: Shanghai Changfeng Ocean World belongs to the British Merlin Entertainment Group, which is the first in Europe and the second in the world. It is located in Changfeng Park, a national 4A-level scenic spot. Shanghai Changfeng Ocean World has more than 300 species and more than 10,000 marine aquatic organisms. It is divided into areas such as dancing with rays, touching the star zone, wonders of the world tropical rain forest, seahorse kingdom, colorful coral belt, deep sea secret, shark tunnel, penguin paradise, art aquarium and turtle VR. As an international ocean theme park, Shanghai Changfeng Ocean World has a wide variety of marine life, lifelike theme landscaping and creative interaction between education and entertainment, which perfectly integrates man and nature.
opening_hours: Open at 09:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:15)

tagNameList: Hidden Gems for Kids' Outings; City Parks
shortFeatures: It is suitable for both leisure outings and team-building activities.
summary:
· Located near the picturesque Dianshan Lake, Oriental Land is a large park in Shanghai that integrates outdoor training, youth social practice, team activities, and leisure tourism.  
· Visitors can explore the National Defense Park, view a simulated aircraft carrier, visit the Military Weapons Exhibition Hall and naval submarines, participate in simulated shooting and target practice, ride amphibious vehicles, and enjoy thrilling 3D dynamic movies.  
· Stroll along Ginkgo Avenue, Green Energy Road, Lakeside Boulevard, Moon Bay, and Fisherman’s Wharf to admire the serene and elegant beauty of Dianshan Lake's waterscape.  
· Families of three can enjoy activities such as the "Brave Path," challenge the "Wisdom Maze," explore the "Fun Bridge World," and walk along the world's first sculpture avenue featuring 168 great minds of wisdom.  
· The park is home to over 3,000 plum trees, and from an aerial view, the 200-meter-long red plum blossom belt resembles a haze of smoke or clouds.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Meadow Autumn Reed; Botanical Gardens; Wetlands
shortFeatures: A popular spot for watching the sunrise.
summary: Dongtan Wetland Park is located at the easternmost tip of Chongming Island, at the mouth of the Yangtze River. The area is known for its fresh air and vast reed beds that cover the mudflats. Walking along the wooden boardwalk offers a close connection to nature. Dongtan is a famous spot for watching the sunrise, and during the autumn and winter seasons, when migratory birds pass through, visitors can stand at the birdwatching platform in the park to observe flocks of birds either flying or resting in the distance, providing a lively and natural experience. Dongtan Wetland is a critical migratory route for birds in the Asia-Pacific region and serves as a wintering ground for waterfowl. The park's facilities are quite complete, with options for boat tours, barbecuing, camping, and fishing. The best time for birdwatching is from November to March, when thousands of geese, herons, and other birds can be seen, which is truly spectacular. The optimal birdwatching time is in the early morning, which also coincides with the sunrise, offering a two-in-one experience. The park features a Heron Viewing Platform at its center, providing a good vantage point for birdwatching. However, Dongtan's remote location makes transportation inconvenient, so if you wish to visit early in the morning for both sunrise and birdwatching, it is recommended to stay in nearby towns and, preferably, drive there. Upon entering Dongtan Wetland Park, visitors pass through several areas, including the wetland landscape zone, habitat restoration zone, waterfowl habitat, and rainwater collection area. The park offers expansive reed beds and wetland lakes. In the spring and summer, visitors can see various flowers and plants in the grasslands, though migratory birds are hard to spot.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Autumn Leaf Viewing; City Parks; Botanical Gardens; Flower Fields
shortFeatures: Experience the joy of picking.
summary: Changxing Island Suburban Park follows the principles of "nature, ecology, and wild charm," respecting, adapting to, and protecting nature. Built on high-quality ecological resources such as the existing ecological cedar forests and organic orange orchards, the park highlights ecological effects, showcases suburban features, and focuses on leisure and recreation. Through the protection and development of rich vegetation, abundant water systems, moderately varied terrain, and natural rural landscapes, it provides urban dwellers with an ecological oasis of cedar forests, birdsong, pleasant orange fragrance, and a return to nature for relaxation and vacation. It aims to become the "backyard garden of Shanghai citizens."

tagNameList: Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
shortFeatures: Enjoy the patches of garden houses
summary:
The name of Sinan Mansion comes from Sinan Road. Sinan Road dates back to the road name of the French Concession in Shanghai-Route Massenet, and the English name of Sinan Mansion Hotel comes from this. 
This area began to be developed in the 1920s as the core area of the French Concession at that time. This year, the first batch of garden houses rose along Lafide Road (now Fuxing Middle Road) south of French Park (now Fuxing Park). 
In the following ten years, garden houses in the area south of Lafeide Road, east of Mas South Road (now Sinan Road) and west of Luban Road (now Chongqing South Road) were built one after another, attracting a large number of military and political dignitaries, entrepreneurs, professionals and famous artists at that time to move in. Zhou Enlai, Liu Yazi, Mei Lanfang and other celebrities once lived here, making this area a residence and gathering place of the upper class at that time. 
Today, Sinan Mansion combines 49 renovated historic buildings and 9 new buildings into four complementary functional areas: hotel, commercial, residential and office. Sinan Mansion has become one of the preservation and protection projects of Shanghai's historical and cultural features and excellent historical buildings. It has 51 garden houses with a long history, and at the same time, it gathers various architectural styles such as independent garden houses, corridor buildings and garden lanes. It combines humanities, fashion and historical heritage.

poiName: The Memorial Hall of the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders
summary:
- A special memorial hall dedicated to the Nanjing Massacre, showcasing the tragedy through historical documents, artifacts, architecture, sculptures, films, and other forms, is located at one of the original massacre sites, the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses."
- In the semi-subterranean, tomb-like exhibition hall, historical materials displayed include photos of the massacre site, a list of survivors and their testimonies, military supplies used by the Japanese army during the massacre, diaries and confessions of Japanese soldiers involved in the crimes, and more.
- The exhibition hall also contains several movie theaters that screen documentaries and films related to the Nanjing Massacre and the War of Resistance Against Japan.
- In the coffin-shaped relic display room, visitors can see the remains of victims exhumed from the "Pit of Ten Thousand Corpses," which serve as irrefutable evidence of the atrocities committed by the Japanese army during the Nanjing Massacre.
- The "12-second" meteor installation releases a meteor from high above every 12 seconds, symbolizing the loss of 300,000 lives over six weeks. If calculated by seconds, every 12 seconds represents a life lost. The memorial hall holds a national public memorial ceremony on December 13 each year.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Cemeteries
shortFeatures: The Tomb of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma; A great place for enjoying plum blossoms and cherry blossoms; Strolling along the Sacred Way to admire the autumn ginkgo trees.
summary:
- In the Zhongshan Scenic Area, there is the mausoleum of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and Empress Ma, which is magnificent and one of the largest imperial tombs in ancient China.  
- The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum took 38 years to complete, setting the standard for the imperial tombs of both the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The existing site only represents the final part of the mausoleum complex.  
- The overall layout of the mausoleum is grand and the craftsmanship is exceptional, especially the Sacred Way of the Ming Xiaoling, which stretches for 2,400 meters, winding and deep.  
- When visiting the Ming Xiaoling, visitors typically enter from the south, pass through the S-shaped Sacred Way, and continue northward to the Bao Ding.  
- The Ming Xiaoling’s Weixiu Pavilion is surrounded by blooming magnolias and plum blossoms, creating a breathtaking sight against the deep blue sky.

tagNameList: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Strolls; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Take a boat tour on the Qinhuai River to enjoy the beautiful scenery.
summary:
· The Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt is a national AAAA-level tourist area that integrates natural scenery, landscape gardens, temples and academies, street markets, local customs, and traditions. The scenic area centers around the ancient architecture group of the Confucius Temple, with the Qinhuai River as its axis stretching for ten miles. It starts from Dongshuiguan Park in the east and extends to Xishuiguan Park (now known as Shuixi Gate) in the west.

· Nanjing Confucius Temple is located on Gongyuan Street on the north bank of the Qinhuai River in Qinhuai District, Nanjing, west of Jiangnan Gongyuan, and includes Nanjing Confucian Temple, Nanjing Wen Temple, and Wenxuan Wang Temple. It is a place dedicated to the worship and commemoration of Confucius, China’s first national higher learning institution, and one of the Four Great Confucian Temples of China. It is a cultural hub of ancient Chinese civilization and a historical and cultural landmark in Jinling. Not only was it the cultural and educational center of Nanjing during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, but it is also the largest cultural and educational architectural complex in the southeastern provinces, now an important part of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Qinhuai River is known as the "Mother River" of Nanjing and is the cradle of the ancient culture of Jinling. The inner Qinhuai River is five kilometers long and historically referred to as "Ten Miles of Qinhuai." This area is the essence of the Confucius Temple - Qinhuai Scenic Belt.

· Boating on the Qinhuai River and touring China’s first historical and cultural river has become a distinctive Nanjing tourist brand. "Night Mooring by the Qinhuai" is considered a classic waterway tour of Nanjing.

shortFeatures: The Treasure of Shang Town: Ming Gilded Bronze Tibetan-style Pagoda
summary:
· The Nanjing Museum is one of China's top three museums and the earliest museum established in China. It is composed of the History Hall, Art Hall, Special Exhibition Hall, Digital Hall, Republic of China Hall, and Intangible Cultural Heritage Hall.  
· The museum houses over 420,000 items, including various precious treasures, which serve not only for public viewing but also for historical discovery and research.  
· The large archway of the Liuli Pagoda from the Baogao Temple, featured in the program "National Treasures," is part of the museum’s collection.  
· The museum offers free admission, and visitors can enter by registering with valid identification to receive tickets.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Appreciate folk culture and taste authentic snacks
summary:
Nanjing Confucius Temple, or Confucius Temple, is one of the four major Confucian temples in China. It was built in 1034 AD and expanded from the Eastern Jin Academy Palace. 
The Confucius Temple complex is mainly composed of Confucius Temple, Xuegong and Jiangnan Gongyuan. It is a landmark building on the banks of Qinhuai River. 
The stone railing in front of the Confucius Temple was built during the Zhengde period of the Ming Dynasty, and it is the only best-preserved ancient building in the Confucius Temple complex. Among them, the big Zhaobi is 110 meters long, which is the highest in the country. 
Sometimes some folk activities, lantern festivals and so on are held in scenic spots. There will also be a variety of snacks for everyone to choose from.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: The Buddhist Center of China in the Southern Dynasties
summary:
The cherry blossoms on both sides of the road leading to Jiming Temple are particularly famous. Every Qingming Festival, there is a sea of cherry blossoms, which is very beautiful. 
Jiming Temple, founded in the Western Jin Dynasty, is one of the oldest and most popular Buddhist temples in Nanjing. 
The environment in the temple is very elegant, surrounded by incense. On the left is the food-giving platform, in front of the platform is the Maitreya Hall, and above it are the Daxiong Hall and Guanyin Tower. 
There is a rouge well in the northeast of the temple. It is said that Chen Shubao and his concubines Zhang Lihua and Kong Guipin once hid in the well. Because of this past event, many tourists came here.

- The mountain winds and undulates like a roaming dragon, with the landscapes of mountains, water, the city, and forests seamlessly integrated, encompassing the cultures of the Six Dynasties, the Ming Dynasty, the Republic of China, and Buddhism within one mountain.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Linggu Temple, and Toudouling, with Zhongshan Mountain (Zijin Mountain) and Xuanwu Lake as the central focus.

The former body can be traced back to Nanjing Taixue, which originated in the first year of Wu Yongan after the Han Dynasty. It has gone through many changes in history and is the first modern university in China. 
Gulou Campus is one of the three campuses of Nanjing University, and the former site of Jinling University, a national key cultural relics protection unit, is located. 
It is divided into South Garden and North Garden. The South Garden is the student dormitory living area, the North Garden is the teaching and research area, and the Jinling Garden area of the North Garden is a traditional Chinese style building complex. There are Sun Yat-sen's former residence when he became the interim president of the Republic of China, Pearl Buck's former residence, He Yingqin's former residence, etc.

- Located in the southern part of Zhonghua Gate in Nanjing, it consists of three beautiful hills surrounded by pine and cypress trees, and is a red tourism site in Nanjing.
- The entire scenic area is divided into six main zones: the Martyrs’ Cemetery Area, the Historical Sites Area, the Yuhuashi Stone Cultural Area, the Yuhuacha Tea Culture Area, the Amusement Activity Area, and the Ecological Forest Area.

It was originally the residence of the chairman of the National Government, where Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling often lived, so it was called Meiling Palace, which is one of the most spectacular and elegant buildings in Nanjing. 
The main building is a three-story mountain palace with double eaves, covered with green glazed tiles, magnificent appearance, luxurious interior, surrounded by trees and fragrant flowers all year round. 
At present, the interior furnishings are arranged as they are. On the east is the bedroom of Chiang Kai-shek and Song Meiling couple, and there is a Meiling art exhibition on the ground floor. 
There is a "First Lady Cafe" on the second floor. After learning about history, you can sit here and feel the artistic conception of the past.

Zhonghua Gate, the south gate of the capital of Ming Dynasty, is also the best preserved gate in Nanjing. 
The Wengcheng project is magnificent and has a complex structure. The city is divided into two floors, with four gates, and there are 27 soldier-hiding holes, which can hide 3,000 soldiers. It is the largest urn city in China. 
Zhonghua Gate was the traffic throat in the south of the old city of Nanjing in the old days. Laomen East and Laomen West, bounded by Zhonghua Gate, have been prosperous places in the south of the Yangtze River since ancient times. 
The former gate pass is now covered with jasper green onions. Facing us are magnificent city walls, weathered and peeling bricks and overgrown pavements.

shortFeatures: Enjoy a wide variety of plum blossoms
summary:
Meihua Mountain, located opposite Xiaoling Road in Ming Dynasty, has the reputation of "the first plum mountain in the world", ranking first among the four major plum gardens in China. 
Today, the plum planting area of Meihua Mountain is more than 1,533 mu, with more than 40,000 plum trees of nearly 400 varieties. It is one of the famous plum viewing resorts in China. 
During the Three Kingdoms, Emperor Wu Sun Quan and Mrs. Bu were buried here, which is the earliest mausoleum of the Six Dynasties in Nanjing. 
Nanjing International Plum Blossom Festival is held here every year, and there are many tourists here at this time.

shortFeatures: Key Buddhist Monasteries in Han Area
summary:
Linggu Temple was founded in the 13th year of Tianjian (514). It was a "Kaishan Jingshe" built by Liang Wudi in the Southern Dynasty to commemorate the famous monk Zen Master Baozhi. It was originally named Kaishan Temple. 
In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang personally named it "Linggu Zen Temple" and named it "the first Zen forest in the world", which was one of the three major Buddhist temples in the Ming Dynasty. 
The mini golden pagoda enshrined in Daojuetang (Xuanzang Memorial Hall) in the main hall contains Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can you have the honor to see the true face. 
Climb the Linggu Pagoda, the iconic scenic spot of Linggu Temple, and you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding scenery. 
Two magnolia trees in front of the Daxiong Hall bloomed first. According to scholars' investigation, a magnolia tree in front of the temple is nearly a thousand years old, so you must look at it.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Mountains
shortFeatures: Autumn shooting of the red leaves on the mountains
summary:
- Qixia Mountain, also known as She Mountain, was named after the "Qixia Retreat" built on the mountain during the Southern Dynasties. Surrounded by mountains on three sides and bordered by the Yangtze River to the north, the mountain features three peaks.  
- Qixia Mountain is renowned for its stunning scenery and numerous historical sites, earning it the title of "The Most Beautiful Mountain in Jinling." The maple forests covering the mountain turn bright red in late autumn, creating a spectacular view.  
- Historical relics here include not only Qixia Temple but also the Thousand-Buddha Cliff stone carvings from the Southern Dynasties and the Sui Dynasty Sarira Pagoda. This area contains the easternmost "Dunhuang Relics" discovered in China.  
- Northeast of Qixia Temple, on the southern slope of Pingshan Peak, there is a unique gray limestone formation with a wavelike surface, known as "Die Lang Rock" (Wave Rock), which is extremely rare.

- The Yuejiang Tower in Nanjing, along with the Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower, and Tengwang Pavilion, is collectively known as the Four Famous Towers of Jiangnan. It features a distinctive Ming Dynasty style and classical royal grandeur.
- The most unique feature of Yuejiang Tower is that the tower was built based on the "Yuejiang Lou Ji" (Record of Yuejiang Tower) by Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang of the Ming Dynasty.
- From the top of Yuejiang Tower, one can enjoy a panoramic view of the vast Yangtze River, the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge, and the entire city of Jinling.

· The core theme of the exhibition is to show the elegant demeanor of "Oriental Metropolis", with four exhibitions: Emperors of the Six Dynasties, Eternal Romance, Elegant Demeanor of the Six Dynasties and Outstanding People of the Six Dynasties. 
The museum site is a part of Jiankang City in the original Six Dynasties. It is precisely because of the excavation of this thousand-year-old site that today's Six Dynasties Museum exists.

The first double-decker railway and highway bridge on the Yangtze River designed and built by China itself.

· The railings on both sides of the bridge are embedded with various cast iron reliefs, and there are two high bridgeheads at the north and south ends, which is one of the landmarks of Nanjing. 
There is the Nanbao Park of the bridge under the bridge. Every night, the lights on the bridge are all lit up, and the whole bridge is like a rainbow flying over the river, which is very spectacular.

This street is also famous for its architecture and delicious food. The blue brick without decoration and glitz is both the wall and the external decoration. On the smoky gray wall, the white brick joints are outlined. Therefore, 1912 is definitely a place where photography enthusiasts in Nanjing often create and gather, and it is also an excellent place to take wedding photos.

shortFeatures: A famous lane where talented people come forth in large numbers and literati praise
summary:
Wuyi Lane is located in the south of Confucius Temple. During the Three Kingdoms, it was the location of Wu Guomao's army barracks guarding Stone City. 
· At that time, all the sergeants were wearing black uniforms, so the alley name was "Wuyi". 
Scholars and tourists are constantly visiting, and it has become a resort to pay tribute to the famous appearances of the Eastern Jin Dynasty and express their nostalgia for the past. 
At present, it is a narrow street, and the paved houses on both sides are folk handicraft shops.

summary: The Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Area is located in Jiangning District, Nanjing City, covering a planned total area of 49.37 square kilometers. Its core design concept includes "Repairing the Heavenly Gate, Restoring the Sacred Path, Preserving the Underground Palace, Displaying the Twin Towers, Promoting Buddhist Temples, and Expanding Culture," with a focus on the comprehensive protection of the historical and cultural heritage of Niushou Mountain, and the restoration of its natural ecological landscape. Niushou Mountain, also known as Tianque Mountain, is one of the Four Famous Scenic Spots of Jinling. It is named after the twin peaks on its summit, which resemble the horns of a cow's head. Niushou Mountain represents half of Nanjing’s history. The mountain is renowned for its beautiful scenery, earning the nickname "Spring Niushou." It is home to many famous scenic spots of Jinling, such as Niushou Mist and Smoke, Xianhua Clearing, and Zutang Zhenxi. There are also many historical sites, including the former stronghold of Yue Fei’s anti-Jin resistance, cliff carvings, the Hongjue Temple Pagoda, and the Zheng He Cultural Park, which have attracted numerous emperors, generals, scholars, and poets who came here to cultivate their minds and compose poems, leaving behind more than 400 pieces of poetry.

shortFeatures: Explore Jiangnan Yunjin and appreciate precious cultural relics

Cao Xueqin was born in the government, and now it is a modern museum built on the former weaving site of Jiangning. The book powder of A Dream of Red Mansions must be punched in. 
There are Cao Xueqin's birthplace, Cao Xueqin's former residence exhibition hall and on-site weaving Nanjing Yunjin Museum, and the Dream of Red Mansions Literature Museum is also located in it. 
The museum collects ancient Chinese cultural relics such as dragon robes and cheongsam collected from overseas, among which the Tang Dynasty brocade is extremely precious.

The music station is located in the south of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum Square. It was completed in August, 1933. It is mainly used for music performances and assembly speeches during the ceremony to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen. 
The architectural layout is the first in China. The whole plane is semicircular, the center of the circle is the stage, and there is a large curved illumination wall behind the stage to collect sound waves. 
There is a crescent-shaped lotus pond in front of the platform, and there is a spring at the bottom of the pond. In front of the pool is a semicircular lawn, where the audience can enjoy singing and dancing. 
Surrounded by green grass, weeping willows and towering poplars, there are many white pigeons in the music station. You can buy feed at the music station to feed these cute elves.

Mochou Lake, located in the west of Qinhuai River in Nanjing, is a famous classical garden in the south of the Yangtze River with a long history of 1,500 years and rich human resources. It is a scenic spot of the Six Dynasties. 
According to legend, Mochow was a beautiful girl in Luoyang in the Qi Dynasty in the Southern Dynasty. Her family was poor and sold herself to bury her father. She married Jinling far away, and she was not allowed to be in the lake with her aunt. She committed suicide. Hence the name Mochou Lake. 
Mochou Lake has been known as "the first lake in the south of the Yangtze River", "the first scenic spot in Jinling" and "the first forty-eight scenic spots in Jinling" since ancient times.  
The park is dominated by lakes, and the buildings, pavilions, pavilions and pavilions in the park are staggered. Shengqi Building, Yujintang, Waterside Pavilion and Baoyue Building are hidden in the shade of rocks, pines, bamboos, flowers and trees.

summary:
- The legendary construction of this grand and magnificent complex, resembling a palace, was said to be built by Emperor Yongle (Zhu Di) of the Ming Dynasty in memory of his tragically deceased biological mother.  
- The temple houses over 20 halls and pavilions, 118 galleries, and 38 scripture rooms. The construction took 19 years, consumed 2.5 million taels of silver, and involved more than 100,000 workers.  
- The Glazed Pagoda of the Great Bao'en Temple was built in the 10th year of the Yongle reign and completed in the 3rd year of the Xuande reign. It has nine stories and eight sides, standing at a height of 78.2 meters, visible even from the Yangtze River several dozen miles away.  
- This pagoda is one of the Forty-Eight Scenic Views of Jinling and was also regarded by Western missionaries entering China in the 17th century as one of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World.
