tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Sites
shortFeatures: Admire exquisite stupas and Buddha statues in grottoes
summary:
Sheshan Qixia Temple is located on Qixia Mountain in the northeast of Nanjing. It is one of the four famous temples in China and the birthplace of the "Three Theories" of Jiangnan Buddhism. Qixia Temple is not only large in scale and magnificent in style, but also the best scenery in Nanjing. It is also famous for its important position in the history of Chinese Buddhism. In 1983, it was designated by the State Council as a national key Buddhist temple in Han areas. 
Qixia Temple Feng covers an area of more than 40 mu, and there are three courtyards of Pilu Temple Tibetan Sutra Building, which rise layer by layer according to the mountain, and the pattern is neat and beautiful. Main attractions: Stupa The Qixia Temple Stupa is a relic of the Southern Tang Dynasty. It is one of the oldest stone pagodas south of the Yangtze River and the largest stupa in my country. The stone pagoda is eight-angled and five-level, about fifteen meters high. The base is surrounded by a stone railing with a hook line, which is restored for the original objects of the Five Dynasties excavated in modern times. The floor of the base is carved with seawater, dragon, phoenix, fish, shrimp and other figures, and only a part of it remains. The eight phases of Sakyamuni are embossed on all sides of the Sumeru seat under the pagoda. After thousands of years of wind and rain, although some stone eaves have been destroyed, they still stand tall, becoming a witness to the prosperity of Buddha spirit in Jinling. The Great Buddha Pavilion, also known as the Three Holy Temples, is dedicated to the Buddha of Infinite Life and was excavated for Shiyi in the Southern Qi Dynasty. The Buddha statue is 10.8 meters high, and its seat is 13.3 meters high. Guanyin is 11 meters high to stand on the left and right side of the Bodhisattva. The pleated style of the Buddha statue is quite similar to the stone Buddha in Yungang, Datong. The original two Buddhas next to the stupa are more than three meters high, beautiful and elegant, similar to the Longmen Stone Buddha in Luoyang, and are also peerless treasures in the golden age of Chinese Buddhist art. Qianfoyan, known as "Yungang in the south of the Yangtze River", is the only Southern Dynasty grottoes in China. Wuliang Hall Wuliang Hall is the earliest and largest Buddhist shrine in Qianfo Rock. The Buddha of Infinite Life is in the middle, and Guanyin is on both sides. The statue is well-proportioned and the lines are smooth. The fold style of the three Buddhas' clothes is similar to that of Yungang Grottoes, and the excavation date is seventeen years earlier than that of Yungang Grottoes. The statue is exquisite and simple, which can be compared with Datong Longmen. Its value lies in preserving the original rhyme of Buddha statues in the Southern Dynasties, which is especially rare in the south of the Yangtze River.

On the Cherry Blossom Road near Jiming Temple in Nanjing, there will be patches of cherry blossoms in March, April and May for tourists to take photos and enjoy. 
The wonderful cherry blossom road from Jiming Temple to Hepingmen sets off the quaint Jiming Temple, which is particularly charming. 
In the cherry blossom season, the flow of people is relatively large, and the road is not very spacious. The middle road should be allowed to pass by cars, so safety must be paid attention to.

The blueprint of the Forbidden City in Beijing is the imperial palace in the early Ming Dynasty, the largest palace complex in the medieval world, and is called "the first palace in the world". 
Due to historical weathering and the combat operations between the Taiping Army and the Qing Army, the above-ground buildings no longer exist except for the stone component foundation buried underground. 
Nowadays, the Ming Palace Square and Wuchaomen Park have been built on the site of the Ming Palace City, which have become places for citizens to rest.

summary: Shixiang Road is an integral part of Xiaoling Mausoleum in Ming Dynasty. In the first half, there are 12 pairs of 6 kinds of stone beasts standing on both sides, in turn: lion, seed, camel, elephant, unicorn and horse, with 4 of each species, two standing and two lying. At the end of the stone beast, there is a pair of stone pillars, and after this, it turns north. There are eight stone Wengzhong bodies, four civil servants and military commanders each, and they are separated by the road. Xiaoling stone man and stone beast are all carved from a whole stone, which is tall, vivid and rough. They are classic works in the stone carvings of imperial tombs in Ming Dynasty.

shortFeatures: One of the thirteen gates of Nanjing Ming City Wall
summary: Nanjing Ming City Wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, built in 1366 and completed in the late years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty. It lasted for 28 years. It is the largest city wall in the world, forming a pattern of four walls surrounded by Miyagi, Imperial City, Beijing and Waiguo from the inside to the outside. It does not follow the old system of square or rectangle in ancient capitals, with unique design ideas, exquisite construction technology and magnificent scale.

The observatory was built in 1934. It was the only observatory in China before liberation and was known as "the cradle of modern astronomy in China". 
· The observatory contains precious astronomical instruments in ancient China, as well as many modern instruments and equipment for measuring celestial bodies, such as my country's self-made 60cm catadioptric telescope and solar telescope. 
· This is the first modern astronomy research institution established by China itself, and it has won the reputation of "the first in East Asia".  
Boarding the observatory overlooks the whole city of Jinling.

After Chiang Kai-shek rebelled against the revolution in 1927, Yuhuatai was regarded as an execution ground for massacres and revolutionary fighters. Countless outstanding Chinese sons and daughters such as Deng Zhongxia and Hui Daiying were killed in Yuhuatai. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, the Nanjing Municipal Government established the Martyrs Cemetery, the Revolutionary Martyrs Monument and the Revolutionary Martyrs Deeds Exhibition Hall here. Yuhuatai Martyrs Cemetery is built along Donggang and Zhonggang. A granite mausoleum gate is built on the north side, and inside the gate is a giant sculpture of martyrs at the southern end of Guangchang Square. After the sculpture, it was one of the execution grounds where martyrs were killed at that time, which was called "North Martyrdom Place". At the east and west foothills of Zhonggang, there were also "East Martyrdom Place" and "West Martyrdom Place". The Revolutionary Martyrs Monument is built on the top of the main peak, and you can reach it by sliding up the Mausoleum Avenue on the right side of the statue. The original monument is the foundation stone monument, and the six characters "Long live the dead martyrs" on the monument are a collection of Mao Zedong's calligraphy. The eight characters "Yuhuatai Martyrs Monument" on the newly-built monument were inscribed by Deng Xiaoping.

shortFeatures: One of the longest ancient city walls in the world
summary:
Nanjing City Wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, built in 1366 and completed in the late years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty. It lasted 28 years before and after. It is the largest city wall in the world, forming a pattern of four walls surrounded by imperial city, Miyagi, Beijing and Waiguo from the inside to the outside. It does not follow the old system of square or rectangle in ancient capitals, with unique design ideas, exquisite construction technology and magnificent scale. 
Nanjing City Wall is not only the largest city wall in China, but also the largest city wall in the world, and was selected as the largest city wall in the world by the World Records Association. Nanjing City Wall is built by mountains and rivers "because of the favorable weather and place". It is a model of the combination of Chinese ethical system and nature, an outstanding representative of ancient capital construction, and a common cultural heritage of mankind. 
Nanjing City Wall is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese military defense facilities and city wall construction technology. Regardless of historical value, ornamental value, archaeological value, architectural design, scale, function and other aspects, it is unmatched by domestic and foreign city walls. It can be described as another historical wonder after the Great Wall of Qin Dynasty in China. 
In 1988, Nanjing City Wall was recognized as a national key cultural relics protection unit. In November, 2012, as the project of "China's Ming and Qing City Wall", it was included in the preparatory list of China's application for World Heritage.

Nanjing Yunjin Museum is the only professional Yunjin museum in China, which mainly displays Chinese national brocade art represented by Nanjing Yunjin, and is one of the "Forty-Eight Scenes of New Jinling". The Yunjin Museum displays the weaving technology of Yunjin, the fine objects of Yunjin in Ming and Qing Dynasties, and the replicas of ancient Chinese silk weaving cultural relics. Nanjing Yunjin, which has a history of hand-woven for more than 1,500 years, expresses its special aesthetic realm and cultural and artistic charm with its special relief and inlay skills, reflecting the unique cultural connotation of the Chinese nation. The first floor of the museum is the sales area of brocade products, and the second floor is the models of various looms and the physical display of brocade weaving technology.

Buddha Palace is located in Niushoushan Ruins Park, Jiangning District, Nanjing. Buddha Palace is a deep pit building, with a length of about 220 meters, a width of about 160 meters, an overall height of about 89.3 meters, and a single building area of about 136,000 square meters. The Buddha Palace building is based on the theme of offering, and its inner space is divided into nine floors, three floors above ground and six floors underground. The underground floor consists of two major spaces: the Relic Hall and the Relic Tibetan Palace. 
With the theme of support, the Buddha Palace is divided into two parts: big and small domes, which mean external support and internal support. The length of the big dome is about 120 meters, shaped like the Buddha's cassock, which not only echoes the east peak of Niushou, but also covers the small dome of the underground palace, symbolizing the boundless blessing of the Buddha. The whole small dome is like the Buddha's bun, and the single dome is shaped with folded hands, which means that thousands of believers support the Buddha. 
The base of the small dome is shaped in the shape of a lotus throne. The whole lotus throne is composed of 56 flying Bodhi gates symbolizing Buddha's boundless wisdom and 56 cloud gate Ruyi pillars symbolizing good luck. They are combined with the small dome Mani orb to form the sacred image of "lotus holding treasures". 
The Relic Tibetan Palace is located about 44 meters underground. The central area of the Tibetan Palace belongs to a religious site, which is called the Tibetan Palace Hall. The Buddha's top bone relic will be enshrined in the Tibetan Palace Hall for a long time. Relic Tibetan Palace is dominated by dark tones, creating a solemn and mysterious atmosphere. The corridor is about 66 meters long. According to the connotation layout of Six Parami's support, Six Parami is the six behaviors of Bodhisattva, namely, keeping precepts, giving, forbearing humiliation, diligence, meditation and wisdom.

shortFeatures: Eight-sided and nine-storey pagoda
summary:
Linggu Pagoda is the tallest and most beautiful pagoda with eight sides and nine stories in Nanjing. It is built of reinforced concrete and granite from Jinshan Mountain in Suzhou. Lingu Tower, formerly known as Memorial Tower for the Fallen Soldiers, was built in 1931 as an important organizational part of the cemetery complex for the Fallen Soldiers. 
Designed by Mao Fei and Dong Dayou, Linggu Pagoda is beautiful in shape, elegant and solemn, with national style and characteristics, and has been highly praised by people from all walks of life. 
According to the "Report of the Prime Minister's Cemetery Management Committee", after leading the Northern Expedition, establishing the capital in Nanjing, and completing the reunification, in 1928, the National Government "remembered the previous labor, and all those who returned triumphantly were awarded to Yong, and those who died tragically received additional penalties. However, the fallen soldiers were killed and bones were everywhere, and loyal souls had no support. It is planned to collect the bones of the fallen soldiers and build a cemetery. Comfort the loyal soul. ”

Meiyuan New Village Memorial Hall consists of the former site of the CPC delegation office, the exhibition hall of historical materials of Nanjing negotiations between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, the bronze statue of Zhou Enlai and the Zhou Enlai library. From May 1946 to March 1947, the Communist Party of China (CPC) delegation headed by Zhou Enlai held negotiations with the Kuomintang government here for 10 months and 4 days.  
No.30 and No.35 were the residences of Zhou Enlai, Dong Biwu, Li Weihan, Liao Chengzhi, Deng Yingchao, the leading members of the delegation, and Qian Ying, the organization minister of Nanjing Bureau. No.17 is the residence of the delegation office. In Zhou Enlai's former residence (No.30), there are also writing desks, swivel chairs, maps of provinces and letterheads of the Chinese Communist delegation used by Zhou Enlai.

tagNameList: Stroller-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Gardens; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
shortFeatures: The exquisitely designed Suzhou landmark gardens.
summary:
- The largest representative classical garden in Suzhou, it is regarded as one of China's four famous gardens alongside Beijing's Summer Palace, Chengde Summer Resort, and Suzhou's Lingering Garden.
- The garden is centered around water, surrounded by mountains and trees. The eastern part is open and spacious, the western part features exquisite buildings, and the central area is focused around a pond with a rockery, which represents the essence of the entire garden.
- The southern part of the garden follows the traditional architectural style of the Jiangnan region, and it houses the only specialized garden museum in China—the Suzhou Garden Museum.
- Every year, special events such as the Azalea Festival, Lotus Festival, and off-season Chrysanthemum Exhibition are held in spring, summer, and autumn.
opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums
shortFeatures: A museum as delicate as a garden
summary:
Traditional Suzhou garden style, with scattered heights, dark gray roofs and white walls, makes the whole museum look like a small garden. 
· It consists of two parts: the new museum and the Zhongwangfu (old museum). In the new museum, you can see pottery from ancient to modern times, and in the Zhongwangfu, you can see Soviet-style paintings. 
There are four permanent exhibitions with Suzhou characteristics in the museum, namely, Wu Di Heritage, Wu Pagoda National Treasure, Wu Zhong Fengya and Wu Men Painting and Calligraphy. 
In addition, there are folk exhibitions for visitors to learn about the customs and habits of Suzhou, and they can also visit the ancient buildings of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and feel the scenes at that time.

tagNameList: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Boat Tours; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Stroll through Shuangqiao Water Alley to trace the footsteps of Shen Wansan.
summary:
- It is a small town in the Jiangnan region, known as "China's First Water Town."
- Historical landmarks such as Shen Hall, Zhang Hall, Mi Tower, the former residence of Ye Chuchang, Chengxu Taoist Temple, and Quanfus Temple, have great historical value and are highly scenic.
- There are many ancient bridges, and each bridge faces and connects with others. The stone bridges built in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties are still well-preserved.
- It is quite enjoyable to tour by boat, passing under bridges and through tunnels.

shortFeatures: The famous Suzhou garden known for its rockeries.
summary:
- Built in 1342 AD, it is one of the representatives of classical private Han Chinese garden architecture.
- The garden is divided into three parts: the ancestral hall, the residence, and the garden. The current entrance was originally the Beishi Ancestral Hall.
- The garden features numerous scenic views, with mountains and forests just a step away. From the overall layout to the smallest details like pavilions and towers, everything is characterized by its delicacy and exquisite design.
opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoying the Autumn Foliage; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The delicate and graceful water towns of Jiangnan.
summary:
- One of the six ancient towns in the Jiangnan region, established during the Song Dynasty, with a history of over 1,000 years.
- Surrounded by five lakes, with a network of rivers dividing the ancient town into seven islands, offering beautiful scenery and water on all sides.
- Here, one can enjoy tea, chat, listen to music, walk across the three bridges, take a boat ride, and experience the slow-paced life of Tongli.
- With many waterways and bridges, numerous Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, and a rich presence of famous scholars and literati, the town appears ancient yet blends harmoniously with modern elements.

tagNameList: Child-friendly treasure spot; garden park; Gardens; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: The delicate, refined Suzhou garden.
summary:
- Built during the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, it is known as one of China's four most famous gardens, alongside Suzhou's Zhuozheng Garden, Beijing's Summer Palace, and Chengde's Mountain Resort.
- It is famous for the exquisite layout of its architecture and the numerous unique rocks; within one garden, visitors can experience four different sceneries: mountains and waters, rural landscapes, forests, and courtyards.
- The garden is divided into four scenic areas: the Central, Eastern, Western, and Northern zones, with the winding corridors connecting them, featuring famous calligraphy from renowned masters on the walls.
- The central area is renowned for its water features, representing the essence of the entire garden; the Guanyun Peak in the eastern part is one of the garden's three marvels, gathering the "four wonders" of Taihu stones: "thin, wrinkled, perforated, and transparent."
opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical buildings; Temples; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: The thousand-year-old famous temple in "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge"
summary:
- Located in the western suburbs of Suzhou, it was first built during the Southern Dynasties and has a history of over 1,400 years. It belongs to the Linji school of Chan Buddhism.  
- It is renowned worldwide for the famous verse in Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ji's poem *Mooring by Maple Bridge at Night*: "Outside the Gusu City, at Hanshan Temple, the midnight bell rings to the boats of the travelers."  
- The site is rich in historical relics, including the stone inscription of Zhang Ji's poem, stone carvings of Hanshan and Shide, as well as remnants of inscriptions by Wen Zhengming and Tang Yin.  
- It is a famous destination for blessings, and every year on December 31, Hanshan Temple hosts a New Year’s Eve bell-ringing ceremony, striking the bell 108 times.

tagNameList: Close to nature; a hidden gem for strolling with kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Stroll by the lake during the day and take a boat ride to enjoy the scenery at night.
summary:
- The largest inland lake in China, with a steady stream of visitors who come daily to walk along the lakeside, shop, and taste local delicacies. Newlyweds also love to come here to take wedding photos.
- The scenic area has four entrances, with the western entrance being the most commonly used. There is a bike rental station right outside the subway exit, and a walking path surrounds the lake.
- Li Gong Causeway is the only long causeway in Jinji Lake, Suzhou. It retains traditional Suzhou-style residential architecture, and nearby is the Li Gong Causeway International Commercial Water Street.

shortFeatures: The garden known for its delicate and intricate design.
summary:
- Wangshi Garden is a representative example of a medium-sized classical Chinese garden, featuring traditional landscape and residential architecture. It was established during the Southern Song Dynasty.
- Initially named "Yuyin" (Fisherman's Retreat), it was renamed "Wangshi Garden" in 1765, reflecting the owner's intention to retreat into a life of seclusion.
- Despite the garden's many buildings, they are not crowded, and although the pond is less than one mu in size, it does not feel small. It can be considered a model of Chinese gardens where simplicity triumphs over complexity.
- From the main gate to the carriage hall, Wanjuantang, and Xiexiu Tower, the buildings unfold along the central axis. The main hall, Wanjuantang, is spacious with elegant decorations.
- In addition to understanding the layout's intricacies, another highlight of the garden is enjoying the traditional opera performances during the annual night garden events.
opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to explore the classical gardens.
summary:
· Mudu Ancient Town, known as the "First Town of Wu" in the Wu region, is famous for its small bridges, flowing water, and ancient trees, offering a unique charm among many other ancient towns.  
· The town is crisscrossed by waterways such as the Muguang River, and its stone embankments create an ancient waterway landscape. The old streets and narrow alleys are home to many traditional courtyards.  
· Inside the Hongyin Mountain Villa, there is a grand stage where Emperor Qianlong watched performances during his six visits to Jiangnan. The villa also displays twenty imperial edicts from the emperor.  
· The town is a food lover's paradise, with the recommended Shijia Restaurant serving its signature dish, Fish Lung Soup, made by simmering fish liver in chicken broth. The fish liver is tender, and the soup is extremely delicious.  
· Local crafts in Mudu include silk, double-sided embroidery, redwood carvings, Chengni inkstones, calligraphy and paintings, and stone carvings, all available for purchase as souvenirs.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Visit the Wansheng Rice Shop in Ye Shengtao's Writings
summary:
· Lùzhí Ancient Town has a history of over 2,500 years. The town is crisscrossed by waterways, with numerous bridges, and is known for its "Hall of Five Lakes" and "Confluence of Six Marshes."  
· There are 41 ancient bridges in the town, each with unique and elegant designs. Among them, five pairs of bridges connected at right angles stand out and are truly remarkable.  
· The most notable attractions include the Baosheng Temple from the Tang Dynasty, as well as the Shen Residence, Xiao Fangfang Performing Arts Center, Wang Tao Memorial Hall, and the famous Wansheng Rice Mill.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
shortFeatures: Classic gardens with rockery scenery
summary:
It is the oldest garden in Suzhou and one of the four famous gardens in Suzhou. It was originally the pool pavilion of King Guangling of Wu Yue in the Five Dynasties. 
· Built by the water, the various window styles and bamboo in the garden are the biggest attractions. 
The biggest difference between the layout and other gardens in Suzhou lies in its transparency, and the rockery is integrated with the pool water outside the garden. 
The rockery in the garden is integrated with the pool water outside the garden, and the bamboo and wood are quiet, full of ancient meaning, natural harmony, which can be called clever conception.
opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Visit the Folk Art Museum and Explore the Tomb of Consort Chen
summary:
·Located on the southern outskirts of Kunshan, by the shores of Dianshan Lake, it is an ancient water town with a history of over a thousand years. It offers both historical culture and natural landscapes.  
·The town's folk museums include the Ancient Brick and Tile Museum, the Zisha Pottery Museum, and the Teapot Museum, as well as a collection of Cultural Revolution-era exhibits for visitors to reflect on.  
·Street snacks include local specialties such as sock-bottom pastry from Jinxi, Changlong mooncakes, begonia cake, as well as other Jiangnan delicacies like lotus seed cake and braised pork and trotters.  
·The town is crisscrossed by lakes and rivers, with waterways connecting the town's streets, forming a typical Jiangnan water town landscape, where rivers, lakes, and streets intertwine, with bridges linking the alleys.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
shortFeatures: One of the top five freshwater lakes in China
summary:
· Located on the southern edge of the Yangtze River Delta, it spans Suzhou, Wuxi and Changzhou, and contains many scenic spots. It is one of the five largest freshwater lakes in China. 
· It is a large shallow lake in the plain water network area. The lake area claims to have 48 islands and 72 peaks, and the lakes and mountains are beautiful. 
The main scenery is concentrated in Xishan Scenic Area and Dongshan Scenic Area in Suzhou and Lihu Scenic Area in Wuxi, especially Yuantouzhu Park in Wuxi.

tagNameList: Historical sites; enjoy autumn leaves; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: From a height, overlook the full view of the Water and Land Gate.
summary:
- It is the only remaining ancient city gate relic in Suzhou and the only water-and-land dual-purpose city gate still in existence in China.
- Built in 514 BC, it was one of the eight city gates of Suzhou built by Wu Zixu, and the present Panmen was rebuilt during the Yuan Dynasty.
- The essence of the Panmen Scenic Area lies in the "Three Scenic Spots of Panmen": the ancient Panmen, Wumen Bridge, and Ruiguang Pagoda.
- To the west of Panmen is the Wuxiang Temple, dedicated to commemorating Wu Zixu, consisting of a hall, corridor pavilion, and garden. The eastern courtyard often hosts performances of Pingtan, a form of traditional storytelling and ballad singing.

tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Garden Garden; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
shortFeatures: Classical gardens built in the late Qing Dynasty
summary:
Built in the Guangxu period of Qing Dynasty, it was a mansion built after Lan Sheng, the director of the garden, was impeached and dismissed. The name of the garden is "retreating", which means "making up for it". 
Compared with the four famous gardens in Suzhou, Tuisi Garden is a small garden with a small area but fine design. 
· The layout of the park is unique, with pavilions, terraces, buildings, pavilions, corridors, squares, bridges, pavilions, halls, halls, houses and pavilions. 
The whole collection of Qing Dynasty gardens is small and exquisite, and it is a classic of classical gardens in the south of the Yangtze River. It has been used as the shooting location of many film and television dramas, and it is a must-see place when you come to Tongli.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The beautiful ancient bridge is a landmark of Zhouzhuang
summary:
The Shuangqiao is composed of Shide Bridge and Yongan Bridge. It was built in the Ming Dynasty. The two bridges are connected and look like ancient keys, also known as key bridges. 
The special significance here is that the reflection through the lake forms a standard circle with the bridge itself, which is very distinctive. 
Shuangqiao can best reflect the charm of the ancient town. Chen Yifei created an oil painting titled Memories of Hometown with Shuangqiao as the background. 
Although the commercial development is serious and there are many people here, the flowing water and ancient buildings in the south of the Yangtze River have been preserved.

tagNameList: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
