summary: Located in the center of Suzhou ancient city, the area is prosperous in commerce, famous shops gather and numerous historic sites. There are all kinds of clothing, skirts, flower jewelry, shoes, hats, towels and socks, fruit food, bonsai art, glassware and so on. It is an urban commercial, cultural, religious and tourist center with strong local colors.

tagNameList: Ancient Town and Village; Night Tour and Sightseeing; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Walk on Stone Slab Street to see the ancient architecture.
summary:
· Qian Deng Ancient Town has a history of over 2,500 years, with its white walls and black tiles reflecting the charm of Kunqu opera.
· The town still preserves buildings from the Ming, Qing, and Republic of China periods, and retains ancient features such as “parallel water and land routes” and “river streets adjacent to each other.”
· This is the birthplace of Kunqu opera and Jiangnan silk and bamboo music, as well as the hometown of Gu Yanwu, and the birthplace of Tao Xian, the ninth-generation descendant of the famous poet Tao Yuanming.
· The town preserves the Yu family's pawnshop, which is considered the “first pawnshop in China.” The Ming and Qing stone-paved street is a “unique treasure of Jiangnan” and is the best-preserved stone-paved street in the province.

tagNameList: Historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Historical Sites; Memorial Temples
shortFeatures: Exploring the Relics of Fan Zhongyan in the Mountains and Forests
summary:
The Tianping Mountain Scenic Area is located in the southwest of the ancient city of Suzhou, by the shores of Taihu Lake. It is the core scenic area of the Taihu National Scenic Area and is known as the "First Mountain of Wu" and "A Beautiful Place in Jiangnan." The mountain has an elevation of about 201 meters, with steep and perilous terrain. It was formerly known as Baiyun Mountain, and also called Cishan Mountain, as it is the ancestral burial site of Fan Zhongyan, a renowned official of the Northern Song Dynasty.

The scenic area covers nearly 100 hectares and is famous for its three attractions: red maple trees, strange rocks, and clear springs. It features eighteen scenic spots, including "Wanhui Chao Tian," "Gao Yi Die Cui," "Wan Zhang Hong Xia," and "Yu Quan Qing Yin." The red maples are especially well-known, and every year in autumn, the mountain is covered with red leaves, creating a breathtakingly beautiful scene. It is often hailed as "The Best Red Maple in the World." The best time to view the red maples is at the end of October during the Suzhou Tianping Red Maple Festival.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Close to nature; a hidden gem for taking kids out; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Climb the peak to enjoy the beautiful view of Taihu Lake.
summary:
- Xishan is the largest island in Taihu Lake. On the island, one can enjoy the misty view of Taihu Lake as well as visit the Biaomiao Peak, which ranks first among the 72 peaks of Taihu.
- Shigong Mountain is known for its unique and beautiful rocks, lush green cypress trees, and an ethereal island-like atmosphere. When enveloped in clouds or light rain, it feels transcendent and mysterious.
- The area features four scenic layers: the islands in the lake, the lake bay and mountains, valleys in the mountains, and peaks on the mountain tops.
- The entire area is planned to include 12 scenic spots, such as the Biaomiao Cloud Field, Shuiyue Tea-Waiting, Linwu Evening Smoke, and Xiaoxia Fisherman's Song.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
summary:
Yangcheng Lake spans Suzhou and Kunshan, and is famous for its hairy crabs listed in autumn. Suzhou people mainly go to Lianhua Island and Weiting Town to eat crabs, while Shanghai people mostly go to Bacheng in Kunshan. 
When hairy crabs are not on the market, you can enjoy the lake scenery and rural scenery in Yangcheng Lake and taste other lake freshness. You can go to Lotus Island by speedboat from Lotus Island Pier, where there are many crab farms. 
The native chicken soup, pumpkin porridge, braised pork, sugar carp and hairy crabs provided by Crab Village are as delicious. Lotus Island is only open to business when hairy crabs are on the market. Fruits and melons are planted on both sides of the path on the island, and stocked poultry walk on the road. Rape flowers can be enjoyed in March and April, and lotus flowers and sunflowers can be enjoyed in summer, which is particularly pleasant. · Tips: Authentic Yangcheng Lake hairy crabs have green backs, white bellies, yellow hair and golden claws, and some crab farms will make up for it.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes
shortFeatures: The forest oasis in the city.
summary:
- An important component of the Taihu Lake Scenic Area, also known as "Shanghu Bay," it is a national key scenic area.
- It is geographically advantageous, with Shanghai to the east, Suzhou to the south, Wuxi to the west, and the Yangtze River to the north.
- The area is primarily composed of seven natural scenic spots, including Hexiangzhou, Diaoyu Island, and Taohua Island, with plant landscapes as a supplement. The lake features islands, and the islands contain lakes.
- It is a marshland wetland dominated by pond cypress, serving as a major habitat for wintering birds.

poiName: Palace of Loyalty, Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences; Historical Sites
summary:
Zhongwangfu is the palace of Li Xiucheng, the loyal king of Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, the peasant uprising regime in Qing Dynasty. 
· It is the most complete building surviving from the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, and it is also the most complete palace of the peasant rebel army surviving in the history of our country. 
The Soviet-style painting of Zhongwangfu is a must, with a large number and high artistic level, which is rare in the whole country. 
There are 343 complete paintings, of which 323 are originals from the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom period, and the rest are later altered.

shortFeatures: Simple and elegant small garden
summary:
Art Garden, also known as Zuiyingtang and Medicine Garden, is located at No. 5, Wenya Lane, Tianku, Changmen, Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province, China. It was founded during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty (1541). 
The art garden covers a total area of about 3,300 square meters, with residential buildings accounting for most of them, and the garden area is about 1,300 square meters. 
The front of the art garden is a residential area. The west of the house is a garden, covering an area of more than 3,000 square meters. There are courtyards between the front and back halls of the residential area, which are connected by brick gatehouses. 
Art Garden preserves the style, layout and gardening techniques of Ming Dynasty gardens. It is concise and clear, natural and simple, exquisite in construction and secluded in landscape. It can be called a masterpiece of residential gardens in Ming Dynasty, and it is the former residence of celebrities such as Wen Zhenmeng, so it has high historical and artistic value.
opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

shortFeatures: A poetic garden that symbolizes the natural birth of a couple
summary:
Coupling Garden, formerly known as Sheyuan, is located in Xiaoxinqiao Lane, Cangjie, Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province. It was built by Lu Jin, the magistrate of Baoning during the Shunzhi period of Qing Dynasty. It takes the meaning of "the garden is involved in the day to become interesting" in Tao Yuanming's "Return to Lai Xi Ci". Huangshi Rockery is the characteristic of Coupling Garden. This garden is named Coupling Garden because there is a garden on the east and west sides of the house. The north-south revetment wharf is one of the characteristics of the coupling garden, which shows the characteristics of "people sleep on the river" in Gusu. 
Coupling Garden is a national key cultural relics protection unit and has been listed as a World Cultural Heritage by UNESCO.
opening_hours: Open at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

summary:
· The Third Bridge refers to Taiping Bridge, Jili Bridge and Changqing Bridge, located in the center of Tongli Town, in a "pin" shape, standing at the intersection of three small rivers. 
There are flower stone rails on both sides of the river, boats come and go in the river, and people come and go on the bridge, laughing and rippling. This place has become a unique landscape in the ancient town. 
In the life of Tongli people, the full moon, marriage and 60th birthday must take the Third Bridge, so the Third Bridge is regarded as the treasure land of geomantic omen in Tongli. 
· As the saying goes, "Walking through Taiping Bridge will be in good health all year round; Walking through Geely Bridge, business is booming BBK; Walking through Changqing Bridge, youth will never grow old.

shortFeatures: According to legend, it is the place where Wu King Helu was buried
summary:
· The most fascinating historic site in Tiger Hill is the Sword Pond, which is known as the tomb of He Lv, King Wu. 
Looking north from the stone of thousands of people, the four characters "Tiger Hill Sword Pond" are engraved next to the door of the round cave "There is a different cave", which is vigorous and vigorous. It was originally written by Yan Kai, the only son of Yan Zhenqing, a great calligrapher in the Tang Dynasty. 
The stone wall inside the round cave is also engraved with "Fenghe Yunquan", which is elegant and handsome. It was written by Mi Fei, one of the four great calligraphers in the Song Dynasty. On the left wall of the cliff, there is the word "Jianchi" in seal script, which was written by Wang Xizhi, a great calligrapher. 
According to the local chronicles, below the sword pool is the place where Wu Wang He Lv was buried. The sword pool is about 45 meters wide and 6 meters deep. It doesn't dry all year round, and it is crystal clear and can be drunk. Li Xiuqing in the Tang Dynasty was once named "the fifth spring in the world".

tagNameList: Garden garden; Enjoy autumn leaves; Temples
shortFeatures: Combining temples with gardens
summary: Xiyuan Jiezhuanglu Temple, referred to as Xiyuan Temple for short, is located outside Changmen in the west of Suzhou. It was founded from Yuan Dynasty to Yuan Dynasty and has a history of 700 years. The temple has deep ancient trees, heavy Brahma universe, green water, birds singing and flowers fragrant. Most of the existing temples were built in the late Qing Dynasty and the early Republic of China, and they are the largest temples in Suzhou. On the central axis, from south to north, there are three-room memorial archway, mountain gate, King Kong Hall, release pool, Daxiong Hall and Tibetan Sutra Building. There is Guanyin Hall on the east side of King Kong Hall and Arhat Hall on the west side. There are also Buddhist Chanting Hall, Fayun Hall, Guest Hall, Zhai Hall, warehouse and other buildings in the temple. There are four complete books of Dragon Tibet in the Tibetan Sutra Building, which were later given to Baolian Temple in Hong Kong, and more than 80,000 Buddhist scriptures such as Huayan Sutra written by Master Shan Ji in the Yuan Dynasty. Xiyuan Temple is a large temple with complete scale, magnificent temple, solemn Buddha statues and garden characteristics.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hi Play Park; Film Studios; Wetlands
shortFeatures: The birthplace of the Peking opera "Sha Jiabang"
summary: Shajiabang Town is located in the southern part of Changshu City, with the picturesque Yangcheng Lake to the south and the shimmering Kunshan Lake to the north. It faces the Yushan Mountain across the lake. The town covers an area of approximately 33.13 square kilometers. With a pleasant climate, fertile land, beautiful water, abundant resources, and simple folk customs, it is known as the "Land of Fish and Rice in Jiangnan." During the Second Sino-Japanese War, amidst the green reeds of the marshes, the soldiers of the New Fourth Army and the people of Shajiabang jointly wrote magnificent battle poems. The Peking opera *Shajiabang*, based on these events, became widely known and reached its peak popularity across China, making Shajiabang famous far and wide.
opening_hours: Opens at Set times 08:30-16:30(Admission ends at 16:00)

shortFeatures: Entering Suzhou Garden Culture
summary: Suzhou Garden Museum was first located in the residential area of Humble Administrator's Garden. It was built and opened in the autumn of 1992. It is the first garden museum in China. The new museum of Suzhou Garden Museum is now located on the west side of the Humble Administrator's Garden. It was built in October 2005 and has a building area of 3,390 square meters. The Garden Art Hall also shows in detail the gardening techniques such as stacking mountains, water management, flowers and trees, and architecture. The whole new museum is divided into preface hall, garden history hall, garden art hall, garden culture hall and end hall.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Jinji Lake by Ferris wheel
summary:
At present, the world's largest water ferris wheel is located on the east bank of Jinji Lake, with a height of 120 meters. Sitting on it, you can overlook the panoramic view of the park and Jinji Lake. 
Because the buildings in the garden are designed to look like European-style castles, the feeling of riding the Ferris wheel is particularly romantic, attracting many newcomers who take wedding photos. 
· The ordinary cockpit can seat 6 people. The cockpit is equipped with air conditioning and the environment is comfortable. It takes about 25 minutes to turn around. If you want to charter a cabin, you need to pay another 200 yuan/cabin. 
· You can watch movies in Cinema 4D, 09:30-16:00, one show every hour. The roller coaster beside the Ferris wheel is also a popular project in the park. On the side of the butterfly roller coaster, you can experience the feeling of flying like a bird, which is very exciting.

tagNameList: Celebrity residence; Night tour viewing; Famous Residences; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Introducing Shen Wanshan's legendary life
summary:
Shen Wansan's former residence, located in Zhouzhuang Happy World, was built according to Shen Wansan's legendary experience. 
Here, various techniques are used to restore the life scene of this rich man in the south of the Yangtze River, so that people can get to know him personally. 
The old house is very big and antique, and it is worth visiting to know its history.

Beita Baoen Temple is the oldest temple in Suzhou, which has been around for more than 1,700 years. It was founded in the Chiwu period of the Three Kingdoms (238-251). According to historical records, it was built by Sun Quan for the nurse Chen, and it was first called Tongxuan Temple. In the early Tang Dynasty, it was renamed Kaiyuan Temple, and later Baoen Temple. 
Traffic 
Bus: Bus tour lines 1, 2 and 4, and No.1, No.313 (formerly No.3), No.8, No.502 (formerly No.20), No.38, No.101, No.102 and No.103 can be reached.

tagNameList: Road trips; Night tour viewing; Roads/Highways; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A model of domestic mixed hydrophilic community
summary:
Ligongdi is one of the scenic spots of Jinji Lake, and it is also the core scenic spot, with a total length of 1,400 meters. It was built by Li Chaoqiong, the magistrate of Yuanhe County in Guangxu period, hence the name "Ligongdi". 
· Ligong Embankment is not a simple long embankment for viewing. There are countless restaurants on the embankment. Walking through the long embankment, you can not only enjoy the lake view, but also live, eat and take photos in the restaurants. 
The lake and water color, the lights and feasts complement each other, which is intoxicating. Suzhou people often drive here with their families for leisure spending, get together with friends, and stage the grand scene of "Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival" in the new era.

shortFeatures: The sedan chair entered the boat in front of the door and passed through the house
summary:
Zhang Hall, formerly known as Yishun Hall, was built in the Ming Dynasty. In the early Qing Dynasty, Zhang's surname was transferred to Yuyan Hall, commonly known as Zhang Hall. 
After more than 500 years of vicissitudes, solid stone pillars and exquisite carvings, it is still not difficult to see the former elegant demeanor of Zhang Hall. 
The hall is spacious and bright, with a rare wooden drum pier under the court pillar, which is an obvious symbol of Ming Dynasty architecture. 
The backyard of Zhang Hall is a quiet and clean small garden, surrounded by dwellings with white walls and black tiles. 
Enter with the ticket of the day and listen to the story with the tour guide. Although things have changed, you can still feel the details of the life of large families.

tagNameList: Ancient Town and Village; Night Tour and Scenic Views; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Strolling through the intertwined ancient streets and alleys.
summary: Shaxi Ancient Town preserves Ming and Qing dynasty riverside buildings, long ancient streets, old alleys, ancient bridges, and the former residences of historical and cultural figures. Shaxi Ancient Town is located in the central part of Taicang City and is a water town in Jiangnan with a history of over 1,300 years.

tagNameList: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Understand the historical facts of Chen Wangdao's marriage to a daughter
summary:
Pearl Tower is the prototype of Chen's old house in the tin opera Pearl Tower. In fact, Pearl Tower is not a tower, but a garden of a big official. 
This is the largest garden in Tongli. There are mountains, water and rockery in the garden. There are also schools of fish. It is said that "Joking about Qianlong" once took scenes here. 
The story of Pearl Tower originated from Tongli. The historical facts that Fang Qing, the hero of the story, met his aunt, Cui'e gave the tower, and Chen Wangdao married his daughter were handed down from generation to generation in Tongli. 
There are only part of the ruins of Chen Cui'e Bookstore in the whole scenic spot, and there is a model of Pearl Tower in the backyard. In order to keep this story passed on forever, the others were built in modern times.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Film and TV base; Theme Parks; Film Studios
shortFeatures: Immersive cinematic world
summary:
Huayi Brothers Film World is the first world-class film cultural experience project in China with the theme of self-sustaining film intellectual property rights. It is located in Yangcheng Lake Peninsula National Tourist Resort. The project covers an area of 460,000 square meters, with a total investment of 2 billion yuan. 
Huayi Brothers Movie World is based on seven classic Huayi Brothers movies, and has created five theme areas: Avenue of Stars District, If You Are the One District, Assembly District, Tongtian Empire District and Taiji District. In each area, you can watch movies, play movies and walk into movies: in the Avenue of Stars area with "the first movie children's professional experience hall in the whole park", you can Do not forget your initiative mind and realize your star dream; In the 50-meter-high bungee jumping event in If You Are the One area, you can jump and express your unswerving love; In the assembly area with "the world's first VR-Ride project", the iron-blooded military soul and the customs of the Republic of China will surely touch your heart; In Taiji District, the first movie-themed live show in China, "Weird Coffee Breaks through the Sky", restores the mobile prop "Troy" in the movie one to one, bringing you unprecedented audio-visual shock; In the "Swallow Building" in Tongtian Empire District, you can not only taste the tail-burning banquet in the prosperous times of the Tang Dynasty, but also see the beauty of the oiran.

shortFeatures: Mountain top overlooking Suzhou city view
summary:
The towers, pavilions and pavilions in Lingshan Scenic Area are built according to the mountains, and the Jiuqu Corridor is a famous tourist attraction in Wuzhong because of the terrain. The clear pool trickles and the shore winding water returns. 
The most important thing to climb Lingyan Mountain is Lingyan Mountain Temple. According to legend, the former site of the "Guanwa Palace" built by Wu Wang Fucha for Xi Shi is in the temple hall, and the Lingyan Pagoda in the temple is the symbol of Lingyan Mountain. The temple is magnificent, with many treasure pagodas and building halls in the Song Dynasty. The mountain trails in the mountains are tortuous and interesting, passing through Jilu Pavilion, Yingxiao Pavilion, Luohong Pavilion and Shizhuang. There is Guanyin Cave in the middle of the mountain, commonly known as Xi Shi Cave. There are strange stones of different shapes on the mountain; There is a piano platform on the top of the mountain.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The ambassador of Hangzhou's beauty.
summary:
- The first batch of national 5A-level tourist attractions and one of the top ten scenic spots in China, it was included in the World Heritage List in 2011.
- With the basic layout of one mountain, two towers, three islands, three dikes, and five lakes, the famous "Ten Scenic Spots of West Lake" are interspersed, creating a harmonious blend of nature and culture, offering breathtaking beauty.
- The "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" scene, featured on the back of the one-yuan RMB banknote, also reflects the unique status of West Lake among China's scenic spots.
- Visitors can explore West Lake by walking, taking a boat tour, riding an electric cart, driving, or cycling.
- The Hangzhou Botanical Garden at West Lake is hosting the 2022 "Song Dynasty Charm and Plum Blossom Fragrance" Spring Flower Festival event.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Wetlands
shortFeatures: Take a boat ride through the reed marsh.
summary:
- Xixi Wetland, famous for its "a stream of water, a puff of smoke," was once known alongside West Lake and Xiling as the "Three Xis of Hangzhou."
- Xixi National Wetland Park is located to the west of the city center. It boasts a serene environment with numerous waterways and is one of the few natural wetlands within the city, often referred to as the "kidney of Hangzhou."
- Xixi Wetland is divided into the East and West Zones. The East Zone consists of Phase I and Phase II, while the West Zone is the Phase III Hongyuan Scenic Area.
- The East Zone is the essence of Xixi Wetland's natural scenery. Traveling by boat through its intricate waterways is the best way to experience its natural ecosystem.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

tagNameList: Watch a show; have fun at the amusement park.; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Watch the performance of "Songcheng Eternal Love"
summary:
English translation:

"Give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!"

Hangzhou Songcheng is a scenic area that bridges the ancient and the modern, exceeding your imagination. With twenty theaters and hundreds of performances, you can't see it all in one day, but there's always something for everyone.

The area is crisscrossed with East Street, West Street, North Street, Market Street, Hongqiao, Fenghua Alley, and other streets, creating a bustling scene full of Song Dynasty charm. The air is thick with traditional Chinese and ancient styles. From Punk Street, Songcheng Gate, Sky Tree, Time Tree, Acacia Tree, Cloud Ladder Walk, to the Performance Plaza, every step reveals a new scene that transcends time and space. Take a boat on Song River and immerse yourself in the picturesque Jiangnan vibe. Revel in the Forest Theater or feel the wind sing in the Cliff Theater.

The main show, "The Eternal Song of Songcheng," is a must-see in a lifetime, with scenes of battle, beauty, and grandeur. It is known alongside Las Vegas’s "O" Show and the Moulin Rouge in Paris as one of the "three great world shows."

Other performances like "Lijiang Love Song," "Captain Cook," "Phantom," "Water Music Concert," "Cliff Music Concert," "Throwing the Embroidered Ball," "Guozhuang," and "Flash Mob" offer diverse styles. Major experience projects such as the "Qingming Riverside Picture" Cinema, Light and Shadow Museum, "Strange Tales of Liaozhai" Haunted House, "Virtual Space," and "Fantasy Space" offer immersive experiences in otherworldly realms. Real-life performances like "The Earthquake," "Shangganling," and "Mountain Red" bring dramatic moments of earth-shattering crashes and war, providing a soul-stirring journey through history.

Songcheng is a family-friendly destination where parents can share precious moments with their children. Moms can travel through the Jurassic era and enjoy a dinosaur party, sparking creativity. Dads can take kids to the Fairy Valley and challenge the aerial adventures to unleash their potential. Seniors can revisit childhood memories in the densely packed workshops.

The entire park is centered around the visitor experience, with most theaters and attractions connected by covered walkways, offering comfort and protection from the weather. It's a perfect blend of tourism, live performances, and leisure, becoming a popular place for social media check-ins.

The nearby Qianguqing Hotel provides convenient resort experiences. With a combined ticket for the scenic area and hotel, visitors can enter the park multiple times and enjoy discounts.

Songcheng, give me one day, and I'll return you a thousand years!

tagNameList: Stroller-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Capture the full view of West Lake and admire the graceful silhouette of the pagoda.
summary:
- It is the iconic landmark of West Lake, built by King Qian Hongchu of the Wuyue Kingdom for his queen when she gave birth to a son. Today, it is more famous because of the legend of the "Legend of the White Snake."
- "Leifeng is like an old monk, and Baochu like a beautiful woman." Leifeng Pagoda and Baochu Pagoda stand opposite each other across the lake, presenting a beautiful scene of "One lake reflecting two pagodas, facing each other north and south."
- Every time the sun sets, the shadow of the pagoda stretches across the sky, creating a unique view, which is why it is called "Leifeng Sunset Glow."

shortFeatures: Take a real sea of flowers
summary:
Prince Bay Park is located in the southwest corner of West Lake, a romantic park, where tulips in spring are most famous. 
Every year from the end of March to the beginning of April, hundreds of thousands of tulips, cherry blossoms and flower nobuzos bloom in the park, which is particularly beautiful. 
Even if it is not the flowering period, the autumn colors and winter snow scenery of Pipa Island and Emerald Garden in the middle of the park have their own characteristics. 
At any time, you can see many new couples taking wedding photos and dating couples, which makes the whole park full of romance.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Rivers; Mountains
shortFeatures: The smoke in the woods after the rain is really beautiful
summary:
Commonly known as "Nine Streams and Eighteen Streams", it is a "Y"-shaped stream formed by the confluence of many small streams. After the rain, the smoke of the woods on the nearby Bajue Mountain rises and the valley is hazy, forming a beautiful "smoke tree" landscape. 
· Jiuxi is about 5.5 kilometers long. Along the stream are lush trees and large tea gardens, making it an excellent summer resort. 
There are three entrances and exits, namely Longjing Village on the upper left of the "Y" word, Yangmeiling on the upper right, and Jiuxi Road below. The intersection in the middle is called "Creek in the Creek", where Jiuxi Yanshu Park, Li'an Temple, waterfall and other scenic spots are concentrated. 
You can choose your own route, but the recommended way is Jiuxi Road-Xizhongxi-Longjing Village. In addition to walking, Jiuxi Road-Xizhongxi-Yangmeiling section can be driven by yourself, and there is a parking lot in the scenic spot.

shortFeatures: The place where living Buddha Jigong became a monk
summary:
Adjacent to the West Lake, it is the earliest Buddhist temple in China and one of the top ten ancient temples in China, with many exquisite cultural relics of various dynasties. 
The plaque of "Yunlin Zen Temple" hangs on the Hall of Heavenly Kings, which was inscribed by Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty, and the treasures in the temple are collected. 
There are many fantastic and changeable caves and valleys on the mountain, with Buddhist grotto statues all over the Five Dynasties, which are rare treasures of ancient grottoes in the south of China. 
This is the place where Jigong became a monk. It is said that asking for wishes is very effective, and there are an endless stream of pilgrims who come to worship Buddha every day.

tagNameList: Island walk; Night tour viewing; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Landing on the island and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the West Lake from a new perspective
summary:
Also known as Xiaoyingzhou, it is the largest island among the three islands in the West Lake and the only island that can be visited. It is known as the first scenic spot in the West Lake. 
The outline is like the word "Tian", the outer ring is Jiangnan garden, and the inside is divided into four small lakes by cross-shaped islands and bridges, which are full of poetry and painting. 
The whole island is densely covered with flowers and trees, mainly green willow, lotus, red maple and hibiscus, which is the representative work of water courtyard art in the south of the Yangtze River. 
The back of the RMB one-dollar banknote adopts the grand scene of three pools reflecting the moon, which shows that it plays an extremely important symbolic role in my country's scenic spots.

poiName: Quyuan Fenghe (Lotus in the Breeze at Crooked Courtyard)
shortFeatures: Lotus flowers are different red in summer
summary:
One of the ten scenic spots of the West Lake, hundreds of varieties of lotus flowers are cultivated in Fenghe Park, where it is located, which is particularly attractive in summer. 
In the Southern Song Dynasty, there was a wine-making workshop here, which took streams to make koji wine. Whenever the wind blows in summer, the fragrance of wine and lotus is refreshing, so it is called "Quyuan Fenghe".  
· Lotus leaves and fields are enchanting, and small bridges of different shapes are erected on the water. People cross the bridges, like walking in the lotus flowers.

shortFeatures: A quiet garden on a lonely mountain
summary:
There are a large number of precious seals and calligraphy and paintings, because it is the prototype of Wu Xie Antique Shop in Tomb Raiding Notes, and many book fans come to visit. 
· There are many buildings and full of humanistic atmosphere. Famous buildings include Guanle Building (Wu Changshuo Memorial Hall), Shijiao Pavilion, Moss Pavilion, and Tijin Pavilion. 
There is a stone room on the mountain that contains the "Three Old Stone Tablets of Han Dynasty" of the Eastern Han Dynasty, and there is also a Huayan Sutra Pagoda on the top of the mountain, which is the landmark building of the Printing Society.

shortFeatures: Luxury Mansion of Hu Xueyan, a giant merchant with red roof in the late Qing Dynasty
summary:
Hu Xueyan was the richest man in the late Qing Dynasty. His former residence was cleverly combined with Chinese and western architectural styles, and the extremely luxurious Jiangnan garden was the first residence of Chinese giants in the late Qing Dynasty. 
Among the residential communities, Zhiyuan Garden was its main building. At that time, Hangzhou had the reputation of "a flying peak, like a shrinkage of Lion Grove". 
The pavilions, small bridges, flowing water and bright corridors in the garden are ingeniously conceived, and the rockery in the garden is the largest existing artificial cave in China. 
There are also calligraphy stone carvings by famous artists such as Dong Qichang, Zheng Banqiao, Tang Bohu and Wen Zhiming in the former residence, as well as two rare mahogany official sedan chairs worth seeing.

shortFeatures: The place where Xu Xian and White Snake met on the broken bridge
summary:
It is the meeting place of Xu Xian and White Lady in The Legend of the New White Lady, which adds a lot of romantic color to this long bridge. 
At the beginning of winter snow, the snow and ice on the sunny side of the bridge melt, but the shady side is still covered with residual snow. From a height, the bridge seems to be broken but not broken, forming the famous "broken bridge with residual snow". 
It can be used as the starting point for visiting the West Lake, from Baidi on the Broken Bridge to Gushan, and then visit various scenic spots around the West Lake in turn.

shortFeatures: The long embankment of West Lake suitable for strolling
summary:
Formerly known as Baishadi, it is the link hub between the city and scenic spots. Bai Juyi's famous sentence "The favorite lake is not enough to travel eastward, but Baishadi in the shade of green poplars" is here. 
There are neat willows and peach trees planted on both sides of the road, and you can see the beautiful view of the West Lake, which is very suitable for a leisurely stroll. 
Visiting Baidi is suitable for all seasons. Go there in spring and watch the panoramic view of Baidi on the opposite Beishan Road. The photos taken are also the most beautiful. 
The total length of Baidi is about 1km, and it can be visited on foot. It is most appropriate to come here in the morning and evening after staggering the peak period of tourists.

tagNameList: Island walk; Climb a mountain; Mountains; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: The West Lake is a place with profound heritage
summary:
Gushan is a natural island in the north of the West Lake. It is not big and has many historical monuments, including sculptures, museums and memorial halls. It can be called the place with the most concentrated cultural landscape in the West Lake. 
On the island, you can not only feel the profound cultural heritage, but also enjoy the beautiful scenery of the West Lake. Almost every day, new people take wedding photos here. 
· There are some exhibition halls concentrated on Gushan Road along the lake in the south. The Zhejiang Provincial Museum (Gushan Museum District) and several art galleries around it mostly focus on calligraphy and painting and other works of art. 
Lin Bu, a poet of the Northern Song Dynasty, once lived in seclusion in the Fanghe Pavilion here. He took Mei as his wife and crane as his son all his life, and he could still see a small piece of plum blossom in full bloom at the turn of winter and spring every year. 
Gushan is one of the three major plum blossom places in Hangzhou.

shortFeatures: Buy feed to feed big, red carp
summary:
Huagang Fish Watching, located in the south of the West Lake, was once the private garden of officials in the Southern Song Dynasty. 
The whole park is divided into five scenic spots: Red Fish Pond, Peony Garden, Flower Harbor, Big Lawn and Dense Forest. 
· The most famous thing in the garden is the swarms of red carp in the red fish pond. There are always adults and children feeding the fish with feed and bread crumbs, which is a great pleasure. 
There are three main entrances to the park. The south gate is on Nanshan Road, the west gate is on Yanggong Causeway, and you can also walk north to Su Causeway.

shortFeatures: Once praised by Wang Anshi's poems in the Northern Song Dynasty
summary:
Feilaifeng means flying stone. The shape of the mountain peak is strange, graceful and moving. 
· Volley on all sides, with a very wide field of vision. Looking at the majestic posture of seven peaks in the west and the stone scenery of Yuping Peak in the east. 
According to legend, this Ishihara is in Penglai Wonderland, and Tieguai Li, one of the Eight Immortals, flew drunk and landed here.

tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Walk along the West Lake and enjoy the scenery along the way
summary:
Su Causeway runs through the north and south of the West Lake. It was built by Su Dongpo when he was an official in Hangzhou, also called "Su Gong Causeway". 
Because of its charming spring scenery, it is called "Spring Dawn on Su Causeway" and is the first of the ten scenic spots of West Lake. 
· With a total length of nearly 3 kilometers, there are six stone bridges from south to north: Yingbo, Suolan, Wangshan, Yidi, Dongpu and Kuahong. 
The embankment bridge is suitable for viewing the panoramic view of the West Lake. The imperial tablet pavilion in the south of the bridge has the inscription "Spring Dawn on Su Causeway" inscribed by Emperor Kangxi. 
There are concentrated scenic spots at both ends of Su Causeway. There is Su Dongpo Memorial Hall at the south end, which can be visited for free, and Yuewang Temple, Quyuan Fenghe and other scenic spots at the north end.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Hiking; Forests; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: The location of the movie Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
summary:
Yunqi Bamboo Trail has the most beautiful bamboo sea around the West Lake, and is famous for its "green, clear, cool and quiet" bamboo scenery. 
In the park, you can still find the preservation of Yunqi Ancient Temple in ancient times, as well as scenic spots such as Huiyanfeng, Baodaolong and Biguan Peak, as well as thousand-year-old Liquidambar formosana trees. 
The bluestone slab in the center of the bamboo path is separated from the pebbles on both sides by black bricks. According to legend, Kangxi and Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty came to Yunqi. 
Next to the path, there are pavilions such as washing heart and Sanju. At the end of the bamboo path, there are rows of ancient trees, pavilions to rest, and tea rooms to sit and enjoy tea.

poiName: Thousand Island Lake Central Lake Area
tagNameList: Island walk; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful landscape by boat
summary:
The central lake area of Qiandao Lake is a part of Qiandao Lake, which is famous for its green mountains, beautiful waters, strange caves, strange stones and beautiful people. 
· It has a vast area, with 1,078 green islands, and the reflection of the distant mountains in the lake seems to be a painting. 
· The central lake area is the best place to take a boat tour. When sailing, white waves keep splashing on the blue waves. 
· This is also the best place to climb the Range Rover in Qiandao Lake. The lake bay is deep and colorful, and the scenery is colorful.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Spots for Strolling with Kids; Lakes
shortFeatures: Stroll through the ancient village with white walls and black tiles.
summary:
- Xiang Lake is known as the "sister lake" of West Lake. It was once the hometown of the Tang Dynasty poet He Zhizhang, and both Li Bai and Lu You left immortal poems here.
- The lake's shape is roughly that of a gourd, surrounded by many ancient-style buildings, giving it a classical charm. The main attractions are concentrated in the northern part of the lake.
- The scenic area is divided into several zones, including the Cross-Lake Bridge Scenic Area, Lower Sun Cultural Area, and Hangzhou Polar Ocean Park. Strolling along the lake is very pleasant.
- The entire Xiang Lake Scenic Area is quite large. You can try taking a boat tour, or cycling around the lake, both of which are great options.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn flowers; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: A good place to go for an outing
summary:
Hangzhou Botanical Garden, located in the northwest of the West Lake, has nine exhibition areas and four experimental areas, including economic plants, ornamental plants, trees and landscape gardens. 
The Botanical Garden has scenery to see in all seasons, and the most worth seeing is the plum exploration in Lingfeng. A large-scale flower show will be held here in early spring every year. 
More than 1,000 kinds of medicinal plants, including "Zhejiang Eight Flavors", are planted in Baicao Garden, which is highly popular in science. 
· The spring pool in Yuquan is full of fat herring and red and yellow carp, which is a good place to have a nap and wins the favor of children.
opening_hours: Opens at Daylight saving time 07:00-17:30,Opens at Standard time 07:00-17:00

shortFeatures: Small village with character for stop-and-go
summary:
Qingzhiwu, located on Yugu Road, is a village adjacent to Yuquan Campus of Zhejiang University. Nowadays, restaurants, hotels, coffee bars and teahouses are all available, with different styles and full of personalities, which have earned enough limelight in Weibo. 
The architecture is smart and interesting. There are houses with white walls and black tiles scattered along the mountain road. A long stream flows down from Lingfeng Tanmei and passes through the village. There is a trace of unique agility in the south of the Yangtze River in the gurgling water. 
At the end of the village is Hangzhou Botanical Garden. You can set Qingzhiwu as the "center of the circle", then spread it around and play slowly.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Neighborhood Walk; Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Visit local specialty shops in quaint commercial street
summary: Royal Street in the Southern Song Dynasty is a main street paved in the capital of the Southern Song Dynasty. According to the records of Xianchun Lin'an Zhi and other documents, more than 10,000 stone slabs were used to lay the Imperial Street in the Southern Song Dynasty, but only fragrant cake bricks were found in previous archaeological excavations. Royal Street starts from the north gate and Ningmen of Huangcheng (now the intersection of Wansongling and Fenghuangshanjiao Road) in the south, passes through Chaotianmen (now Gulou), Zhongshan Middle Road, Zhongshan North Road, Guanqiao (now Guanqiao) to the intersection of Fengqi Road and Wulin Road, which is the central axis of Lin'an City in the Southern Song Dynasty, with a total length of about 4,185 meters. It is a special road for the emperor to worship his ancestors in the "Simencius" (Meng Chun, Meng Xia, Meng Qiu and Meng Dong) to Jingling Palace (now the west side of Wulin Road, where the statues of royal ancestors are enshrined).

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Standing on the bridge and watching the Qiantang River rush
summary:
· Qiantang River Bridge was designed by Mao Yisheng, a famous bridge expert. It is also the first railway and highway bridge designed and built by my country. You can also see the statue of Mr. Mao Yisheng at the bridge. 
It is suggested as the southern starting point of sightseeing in Hangzhou; Standing on the not wide bridge deck, you can have a panoramic view of the Six Harmonies Pagoda and experience the taste of Hang Cheng surrounded by mountains and rivers.  
You can overlook the whole picture of the bridge from the Pagoda of Six Harmonies, and then walk over to get a close look at the heroic appearance of the bridge; Standing on the bridge and watching the rolling Qiantang River is a unique taste.

shortFeatures: Climbing the tower and overlooking the Qiantang River
summary:
From the outside, the nearly 60-meter ancient pagoda has 13 floors, but in fact there are only seven floors inside the pagoda, and the structure of "seven bright and six dark" is very unique. 
You can climb inside the Pagoda of Six Harmonies. The further you go up, the narrower the stairs are. Each floor can go out to observe the scenery and look out into the distance from different heights. 
Climbing to the top floor of the tower, you can see that the rolling Qiantang River is right now. The Qiantang River Bridge spans both sides of the river, and you can have a panoramic view of the buildings and greening on both sides of the river. 
The Pagoda of Six Harmonies has been a favorite place for literati to watch the river and recite poems since ancient times. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty visited here and once erected inscriptions and plaques for each floor.
opening_hours: Opens at Daylight saving time 07:00-17:30,Opens at Standard time 07:00-16:55

poiName: Autumn Moon over the Calm Lake
tagNameList: Garden garden; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
shortFeatures: West Lake Tea and Moon Appreciation Resort
summary:
Pinghu Qiuyue, located at the west end of Baidi, is a long and narrow garden along the lake, and it is the best place to enjoy the moon in the West Lake. 
Backed by a lonely mountain, facing the outer lake of the West Lake, the landscape is open along the lake, which is one of the ten scenic spots of the West Lake. 
· Pinghu Qiuyue includes buildings such as Royal Stele Pavilion, Water Platform, Four-sided Hall, Octagonal Pavilion, Hutianyibi Building, etc.  
In the 38th year of Kangxi's reign, the original Dragon King Hall here was changed into the Imperial Book Building, and the plaque of "Pinghu Autumn Moon" inscribed by Kangxi was hung in front of the building.

shortFeatures: A beautiful park by the West Lake for strolling
summary:
Liulang Wenying is one of the ten scenic spots of the West Lake. It is located in the southeast bank of the West Lake and a large park at Qingbo Gate. It is a good place for people to relax. 
In the Southern Song Dynasty, it was the imperial garden of the emperor, which was called Jujing Garden. In the Qing Dynasty, the old scene of smelling warblers in willow waves was restored. 
· The garden layout is cheerful, fresh, elegant and simple. Willow bush sets off Purple Phoebe, Cedar, Magnolia grandiflora, peach, begonia, rose and other famous flowers. It's a beautiful place to enjoy Xizi's heavy makeup and light wear.  
· The quiet environment is also very popular with the elderly, and tourists who come and go will also have a rest here.

tagNameList: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
shortFeatures: Watch great animal acrobatics
summary:
· A mountain zoo integrating wildlife protection, scientific research, popular science, education and sightseeing. 
· The layout of the zoo is clever, with more than 150 kinds of animals on display, including golden monkeys, black langurs, tigers, pandas, peacocks, etc. 
There are elephant pavilion, giant panda pavilion, goldfish pavilion, giraffe pavilion, precious monkey room, songbird pavilion, and wonderful animal performances in the park. 
In addition to animals, there are also many gardens in the garden, which has an excellent environment and is a viewing place suitable for all seasons.

Located in Tiger Run Park, the name of Tiger Run, because the eminent monks in the Tang Dynasty were ready to move away because of the shortage of water. This scene appeared in my dream, and there was really spring water the next day. 
· Hupao Spring is one of the famous springs in Hangzhou, with pure water quality, sweet and mellow water. Soaking Longjing tea with tiger running water is fragrant and refreshing, and it is known as "the double unique of the West Lake". 
It is said that Jigong died in Hupao Temple. There is also a Jidian Pagoda in memory of Jigong in the park, as well as some vivid life reliefs.

tagNameList: Ancient Town and Village; Night Tour and Scenic Viewing; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The quaint and traditional town.
summary:
Tangqi Ancient Town is located in the northern part of Hangzhou, about 20 kilometers from the city center. Tangqi developed along the Grand Canal and has served as the water gateway to Hangzhou throughout history. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, it was prosperous and was considered the most famous among the ten great towns of Jiangnan. The town is crisscrossed with waterways and features a dense water network, making it a typical water town of Jiangnan.

Today, Tangqi Ancient Town has become a popular tourist destination, with streets such as Shui Bei Fengqing, a characteristic street by the water, and Shui Nan Riverside Food Street attracting many visitors. 

The most famous street in Tangqi is Langyan Street, which exudes a strong water town charm and is a prime example of Jiangnan's uniqueness. A poem by Qing Dynasty poet Wang Shi describes the corridors of Tangqi, saying: "Shoulder to shoulder, the crowd mingles and follows each other; the winding and straight alleys lead everywhere; it’s wonderfully convenient to go out, no need for hats or clogs even in the rain." This refers to how the winding and straight corridors connect the entire town, making it so convenient that even rainy days don't require a hat or clogs. Along the riverside, there is a unique row of wooden long benches called "Meiren Kào," complementing the covered walkways and adding to the charm. Of course, you can also choose to sit in a teahouse, stroll through the alleys, or walk across the old bridges to experience the deep cultural heritage of the ancient town.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites
shortFeatures: Appreciate the precious cultural relics of Liangzhu period
summary:
Liangzhu National Heritage Park is located in Liangzhu and Pingyao towns in the northwest suburb of Hangzhou. It is the site of Liangzhu Cultural Center. 135 sites have been found, with a protection area of about 42 square kilometers. It is one of the most important large-scale archaeological sites in China and has outstanding significance in the development of oriental civilization. 
Heritage Park is different from ordinary parks. It is a comprehensive project to protect, utilize, develop and display cultural relics. The park takes Liangzhu Ancient City in Mojiao Mountain as the core, and includes cultural sites such as Fanshan Mountain, Huiguan Mountain, Tangshan Mountain and Yaoshan Mountain. Through the cross-section display and restoration display of the site site, a popular Liangzhu cultural cognitive system combining points, lines and surfaces is formed. According to the original intention of "Beautiful Island" in Liangzhu and the living area in Liangzhu culture period, it has the characteristics of hills, lonely hills, swamp plains with alternating rivers and lakes, and warm and humid subtropical climate. 
Liangzhu National Heritage Park will take the existing new Liangzhu Museum as the axis, and set up an "S"-shaped north-south green belt with a width of about 200 meters from east to west and a length of about 1,100 meters from north to south, as an important gateway and prelude to the heritage park. Visitors can visit Liangzhu Site through two different routes: water and land, or on foot or boating.

shortFeatures: Natural oxygen bar to experience the wild fun in the mountains
summary:
· With the best forest vegetation, the most beautiful natural scenery and the best ecological environment in Qiandao Lake, it is a good place for the forest to inhale oxygen and wash lungs. 
The scenic spots are divided into five blocks: hydrophilic leisure area, tea room leisure area, forest negative ion respiration area, forest recreation area, forest camping area and forest science popularization area. 
Streams and waterfalls can be seen everywhere in the scenic spot; You can walk the rope bridge and take photos with peacocks in the forest; Or enjoy all kinds of wild mountain interests while bathing in the forest by grass skiing.

shortFeatures: Visiting tea by the West Lake, tasting tea and asking tea
summary:
Longjing Wencha is one of the ten scenic spots in the New West Lake. There is Longjing Spring, which is listed among the three famous springs in the West Lake. Longjing tea brewed by Longjing spring water is absolutely a must. 
Longjing is divided into Laolongjing and Xialongjing. After the transformation, Xialongjing has become a unified rural settlement with many farmhouses, which is a holy place for holiday and leisure. 
· There are Longjing Spring and abandoned Longjing Temple in Laolongjing, as well as the "Eighteen Imperial Tea Trees" collected when Qianlong went to the south of the Yangtze River. 
Every year around the Qingming Festival, tourists come here to visit, drink and ask for tea, which is a very "Hangzhou" experience.

tagNameList: Hi Fun Park; Kid's Treasure Spot; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Exciting and thrilling large-scale theme park
summary: Hangzhou Paradise is a large-scale comprehensive theme park in the Yangtze River Delta region. The park is divided into themed areas such as Maya Tribe, Lost Jungle, and Adventure Island. It features thrilling and exciting large amusement rides like the Wind God’s Hand, Twin Pirate Ships, Sky Cross, High-Flying, and Fashionable Flying Man, as well as fun and engaging children’s attractions such as the Music Boat and Mother-Child Observation Car. Interactive shows like "Horror Circus Ship" and "Fairy Fancy Parade" provide entertainment for the whole family!

shortFeatures: Understanding the Past and Present of Silk Weaving
summary:
The China National Silk Museum is located by the West Lake in Hangzhou. It is the first national silk museum and also the largest silk museum in the world. The architecture is graceful and ethereal, with mulberry gardens and dyeing fields inside, along with small bridges and flowing water, allowing visitors to fully appreciate the beauty of nature.

The museum is divided into five halls, each telling a different story about silk—its origins and development, the main types of silk, the production process, the Silk Road, and the role of silk in ancient social life. The museum also has temporary exhibition halls where various special exhibitions are held. Visitors interested in silk can also purchase it here.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: The location of Where's Dad Going 2
summary:
Xinye Ancient Village is located in Daciyan Town, southwest of Jiande, 6 kilometers away from Daciyan Scenic Spot and about 11 kilometers away from Zhuge Bagua Village. It can be reached by National Highway 330. 
Xinye Village was built in the 12th year of Jiading in the Southern Song Dynasty (1219). Because the town is dominated by Yuhua Mountain behind the village, the sub-family of Xinye Village is called Yuhua Ye Shi. According to textual research, Xinye Village is also the largest Ye family village in China at present. Up to now, 16 ancient ancestral halls, halls, pagodas, temples and about 200 ancient residential buildings are well preserved here. Because of its long age and rich architectural types, it is praised as "Open-air Museum of Ming and Qing Architecture in China" by ancient architecture experts at home and abroad. 
Walking into Xinye, you will experience its long history, simple folk customs, and feel the nature and tranquility that are rare in modern society. There are hundreds of streets and lanes in the village, and the dense streets and lanes criss-cross. Households and houses are connected into an organic and orderly whole, forming a three-dimensional image that embodies the mysterious culture of the East.  
In addition, the popular variety show "Where's Dad Going 2" was also filmed here.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Spots for Strolling with Kids; Caves
shortFeatures: The filming locations of the 1983 version of *Journey to the West*
summary: The Lingqi Cave Scenic Area is the earliest open scenic spot in Jiande City (Xin'an River), located 35 kilometers southwest of the city. It is an important part of the Fuchun River-Xin'an River Scenic Area. Covering an area of 1.2 square kilometers, the scenic area consists of Lingquan Cave, Qingfeng Cave, Aiyun Cave, and Lingqi Stone Forest. The main attractions are Karst landscapes, with each of the three caves offering unique features: Lingquan Cave is known for its water, Qingfeng Cave for its wind, Aiyun Cave for its clouds, and Lingqi Stone Forest for its lifelike stone formations that resemble human figures and animals.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn flowers; Mountains
shortFeatures: Full of Longguiyu, you can have a panoramic view of the tea garden scenery
summary:
Juelong, also known as Manlong and Manjialong, is located in the south of the West Lake in Hangzhou, a valley at the southern foot of the southern peak. In the fourth year of Tianfu in the later Jin Dynasty (AD 939), Yuanxing Courtyard was built, and in the second year of Zhiping in the Northern Song Dynasty (AD 1065), it was changed to Manjue Courtyard. Manjue means "perfect consciousness", and the place was named after the temple. 
Juelong is famous for its sweet-scented osmanthus. Every autumn, sweet-scented osmanthus blooms, the fragrance fills the empty mountains, and falls like rain, so it has the reputation of "Manlong Guiyu". In 1985, "Manlong Guiyu" was rated as one of the ten scenic spots of the New West Lake.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn leaves; Mountains
shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful view of the West Lake
summary: Geling and Baoshi Mountain are self-contained and have peculiar scenery. The mountain rocks here are ochre red, and there are many shining red minerals in the rock mass. Whenever the sun shines, the mountains are full of colorful clouds, especially when the sunrise or setting sun shines, it is delicate and beautiful, and the glow is particularly dazzling, as if countless gems are shining brightly.

shortFeatures: Jiangnan Garden Built Adjacent to West Lake
summary: Guozhuang is a key cultural relics protection unit in Zhejiang Province. Located in the north of Wolong Bridge, Xishan Road, West Lake, Hangzhou. It was built by Song Duanfu, a silk merchant in Qing Dynasty. Commonly known as Songzhuang, it is also known as "Duanyou Villa". In the Republic of China, Songzhuang was mortgaged to Kongfengchun Powder Shop in Qinghefang, and later sold to Guo's family in Fenyang, renamed "Fenyang Villa", commonly known as Guozhuang. After 1950, Guozhuang was used for other purposes, and the buildings and gardens were damaged and deserted. In October 1989, it was taken over and renovated by the garden department, and its old appearance was restored according to the principle of repairing the old as before. It was reopened on October 1, 1991. The manor covers an area of about 9,788 square meters, with a water surface of nearly 3,000 square meters and a total building area of about 1,629 square meters.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; hidden gem for kids; Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: The ancient private library.
summary:
- Located in the city of Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, it is the oldest existing private library in China, as well as the oldest library in Asia and one of the world's earliest family libraries.
- Built in the mid-Ming Dynasty, it was overseen by Fan Qin, a retired Deputy Minister of the Ministry of War. Many exhibition halls display books collected by the Fan family from all corners of the world.
- The architecture combines various traditional folk crafts such as wood carving, brick carving, stone carving, gilding, and embossing, making it a masterpiece of Ningbo's residential architecture.
- Inside the Tianyi Pavilion, there is also an interesting Mahjong Museum, which has become a popular spot for many to take photos.

tagNameList: A hidden gem for strolling with kids; neighborhood walk.; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Enjoying drinks at a bar while admiring the beautiful European-style architecture.
summary:
- The Ningbo Old Bund opened to the public in 1844 and is currently one of the few Bunds in China with a history of over a century. It serves as the gateway to the ancient city of Ningbo.  
- The Old Bund still preserves many European-style old buildings that have been converted into bars and restaurants. The Gothic-style Catholic Church in Jiangbei is one of the landmarks of Ningbo.  
- What makes the Old Bund unique is that it is not enclosed; citizens can experience their daily life at the Sanjiang Port of the Old Bund.  
- At the same time, the Old Bund is also a bar street, bustling with activity in the evening, and many foreigners enjoy relaxing and socializing here.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn leaves; Mountains; Temples
shortFeatures: Enjoy streams and waterfalls and attend the Maitreya Buddha
summary:
National 5A-level scenic spot, famous for its shanshui, ancient temples and valley waterfalls, was known as "Penglai on the Sea" as early as the Han Dynasty.  
Scenic spots include Xuedou Mountain, Xuedou Temple, one of the ten Zen temples in the world, and the tallest sitting bronze open-air statue of Maitreya Buddha in the world. 
Standing on the observation deck of Qianzhangyan Waterfall, you can see lush trees, which is a veritable natural oxygen bar.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; a hidden gem for kids.; Lakes
shortFeatures: Cycling along the lake to see the Waterborne Guanyin
summary:
· It is the largest freshwater lake in Zhejiang, composed of Guzi Lake, Mei Lake, and Outer Lake, and is four times the size of West Lake in Hangzhou.  
· The most popular attraction at Dongqian Lake is the long causeway near Xiaoputuo, which is highly recommended for a walk to enjoy the scenic beauty of Dongqian Lake.  
· Apart from visiting attractions, cycling around Dongqian Lake is arguably the most popular activity, allowing visitors to leisurely admire the lakeside landscapes, mountain views, and natural villages along the way.  
· The Plum Garden by Dongqian Lake is renowned as one of the most beautiful spots in Ningbo for appreciating plum blossoms.

tagNameList: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Kid-Friendly Hidden Gems; Science & Technology Museums
shortFeatures: A lot of interesting interactive experiences.
summary: The Ningbo Science Exploration Center is located in the central corridor of Ningbo East New City and the northwest area of Ningbo Cultural Plaza. Covering a ground area of 55,000 square meters, the center features various distinctive experiential exhibition spaces, including permanent exhibition halls, temporary exhibition halls, a dome theater, a lecture hall, and a multifunctional hall, spread across six floors. On the third floor, there are three permanent exhibition halls: "Ocean," "Harmonious Home," and "Universe." On the fourth floor, there are three more permanent exhibition halls: "Human Body and Brain," "Human Skills," and "The Fun of Science." Most of the exhibits in the six permanent exhibition halls are making their debut in China, offering highly interactive and engaging experiences. Design Concept.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly treasure spots; autumn leaf viewing; City Parks
shortFeatures: Strolling through the city's green lungs and visiting the vintage mansion.
summary:
The park is centered around Moon Lake, with over sixty sculptures scattered along the shore, themed around the four seasons of spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The lakeside is divided into four seasonal docks, each with its own unique scenery.  
The spring shore is made up of the Water Curtain Bridge, a limestone cave, and a water stage. The restroom inside the limestone cave is quite interesting, resembling a cave, with faucets designed like stalactites.  
The autumn shore is a vast lawn with buildings like the Autumn Moon Pavilion Restaurant and the Moon Lake Art Museum. The museum regularly hosts art exhibitions, including painting exhibitions, art displays, and large-scale car shows, showcasing award-winning artworks from both domestic and international artists.  
The park offers a shuttle that circulates every fifteen minutes between the four seasonal dock stations. There are also restaurants and cafés in the park, where one can sit and enjoy a cup of coffee while admiring the view outside the window.

tagNameList: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Reappear the century-old business life in Ningbo
summary: Ningbo Nantang Old Street, developed and constructed by Ningbo City Travel Investment Development Co., Ltd., is located outside the south gate of Ningbo Ancient City, Zhejiang Province. It used to be the "Three Cities at the South Gate" of the old Ningbo trade and culture gathering place, ranking one of the eight historical districts in Ningbo, and it is also the protected area of Ningbo's "Purple Line Planning". It runs north-south, bounded by Zuguanshan Road, and is divided into two streets: south and north streets. The block retains more than 300 meters of traditional streets and lanes, with one cultural protection unit and six cultural protection points. The descendants of Yuan Xie, a famous scholar in the Song Dynasty, have lived here for generations. The existing residential buildings of the Yuan family in the area are the largest, including residential courtyards, ancestral halls, schools, etc., and others include cultural protection buildings such as Yongshui Bridge, Yongshan Pavilion and Guansheng Temple. North Street takes traditional culture as its keynote, commerce as its content and urban tourism as its development direction. South Street focuses on the concept of "urban leisure", highlighting leisure life.

tagNameList: Hi Fun Park; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Film Studios
shortFeatures: Filming locations of "Nirvana in Fire"
summary:
- Located in the picturesque Datang Port Ecotourism Area in Xiangshan County, Zhejiang, with Lingyan Mountain as the backdrop, it cleverly integrates the local natural landscapes such as mountains, rocks, caves, water, and forests.
- It consists of five main scenic areas: the Main Gate Plaza Area, Village Workshop Area, Tomb Mountain Cave Area, Manor Lake Area, and Shop Town Residential Area.
- The film studio, with its unique and numerous architectural designs, can shoot historical themes from the Spring and Autumn Period, the Qin and Han Dynasties, the Tang and Song Dynasties, as well as the Ming and Qing Dynasties, offering suitable settings for various historical films.
- It has hosted well-known TV dramas such as "The Return of the Condor Heroes," "The Blood Sword," "Young Yang Family Generals," and "Investiture of the Gods," blending film culture with tourism and leisure.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
summary:
- Qiantong Ancient Town is known as the "First Confucian Town in Jiangnan," "Little Lijiang of Jiangnan," and "Living Folk Museum."
- It is the largest settlement of the Tong family in Jiangnan. The town preserves a complete set of Ming and Qing Dynasty architecture, with white walls and black tiles, exuding grandeur.
- The entire town resembles a countryside painting rich in ancient charm, with every household featuring carved beams, every home having flowing water, and an octagonal water system running throughout the village.
- The village follows a "return" style layout with a nine-square, eight-trigram arrangement. The streets and alleys are narrow, and the buildings are densely packed, making it feel like walking through a maze.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns
shortFeatures: The ancient fishing port city with a history of over a hundred years.
summary:
- With a history of over 600 years, the city is built along the mountain, facing the sea, and is known as "the city on the harbor, with the mountain in the city."
- One end connects to the fishing port, while the other is nestled in the valley between the mountains. The city walls rise and fall with the terrain, and the city gates are shaped by the landscape. The old houses are built in terraces, winding and winding.
- The main feature of the ancient city of Shipu, a "key coastal defense stronghold," is its high elevation overlooking the harbor.
- Visitors can explore distinctive venues showcasing fishing culture, commercial culture, and coastal defense culture, weave fishing nets, make fishing lanterns, and experience the life of fishermen.

shortFeatures: Colorful seven-color railings
summary: Hangzhou Bay Cross-sea Bridge starts from Zhengjiadai, Haiyan, Jiaxing City in the north and ends at Cixi Shuilu Bay, Ningbo City, with a total length of 36 kilometers. It is a fast track between Shanghai, southern Jiangsu and the north gate of Ningbo. It is very convenient to drive to Ningbo and Zhoushan to eat seafood and enjoy gardens in Suzhou on weekends via the cross-sea bridge. It looks even better when the lights are on at night. Needless to say, the winding bridge body of the bridge spans Hangzhou Bay, which gives people a visual shock. The railings along the way are painted in seven rainbow-like colors, which is not only an interesting and beautiful scenery, but also can remind the driver of the mileage distance. Haitian Yizhou in the middle of the bridge is the landmark building of the bridge. The architectural shape is unique like an eagle spreading its wings (platform + sightseeing tower 100 yuan). You can board the observation deck to overlook the bridge and the scenery of Hangzhou Bay, and you can also buy Jinhua ham, Putuoshan Guanyin cakes and other special foods

The Hemudu site is divided into four cultural layers. The fourth cultural layer is about 7,000-6,500 years ago, the third cultural layer is about 6,500-6,000 years ago, the second cultural layer is about 6,000-5,500 years ago, and the first cultural layer is about 5,500-5,000 years ago. 
The late Neolithic site in China, which was excavated in 1973, is one of the earliest Neolithic cultural sites discovered in China. 
It is mainly composed of two parts: the cultural relics exhibition hall and the site exhibition area, where you can watch the unearthed cultural relics. 
There is a touch-screen computer in the museum, which can inquire about some information about Hemudu. If you travel with children, it is a good opportunity to gain knowledge.

shortFeatures: Burning incense and praying for blessings and paying tribute to precious relics
summary: Ashoka Temple was founded in the Western Jin Dynasty. It is known as the six special victories and eight auspicious plots. It has always been ranked among the five Zen mountains in the world. It is the only existing thousand-year-old temple named after Ashoka in China. There is a world-famous Buddha relic pagoda in the temple. There are only two remaining Yuan Pagodas in the province, as well as inscriptions in Tang, Song, Ming, Qing, Republic of China and modern times, among which the Tablet of Permanent Residence of Ashoka Temple, the Inscription of Chenkui Pavilion and the Inscription of Miaoxiquan are the most precious.

tagNameList: Ancient town and ancient village; Ancient Towns
shortFeatures: A thousand-year-old ancient town with mountains and rivers.
summary:
- Minghe Ancient Town is located in the southeastern part of Cixi, Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, about 50 kilometers east of Ningbo, and borders National Highway 329 to the north. It was built during the Tang Dynasty in the Kaiyuan era, with a history of over 1,200 years. It is one of the ancient towns in the Sanbei area and the only remaining ancient town in Cixi that retains the typical features of a Jiangnan water town. It is renowned for its scenic beauty, often praised as "Hegao's scenery rivals that of Suzhou."

- Minghe Ancient Town is situated by Baiyang Lake and is close to the Wulei Mountain Scenic Area, making it a true water-and-mountain town. The rivers in the town flow from west to east, with seven ancient bridges from the Ming Dynasty spanning the river. Along the river, there are traditional Ming and Qing Dynasty residences that showcase the unique characteristics of Jiangnan water towns. These residences are mostly grand houses built by the Ye family of Minghe after their success in the national medicine business. The Yan Cang Zuo Ma Lou (Salt Warehouse Horse Tower) is an ancient building with a distinctive character among the courtyard groups in southern China. The Shen family ancestral hall still preserves news of the family members' achievements in the imperial examinations, with the lingering scent of scholarly achievement on the victory notices, which is a testament to the town's cultural heritage. The Wulei Temple, the oldest Buddhist temple in eastern Zhejiang with a history of 1,700 years, and the Jinshan Temple, established during the Liang Dynasty, are both nearby, with the morning bell and evening drum, along with the sound of chanting, accompanying the town.

It attracts worldwide attention because it is the hometown of Chiang Kai-shek and Jiang Jingguo's father and son. It is a bright pearl on the main tourist line in East China. It is one of the first batch of "National 5A-level tourist areas" and "Top Ten Beautiful Paradises in Zhejiang", and has won the favor of tourism enthusiasts.
