summary: The Catholic Church was founded in the 21st year of the Republic of China (1932), and was funded by the Vatican Holy See. The church sits from west to east, 15 meters high, with three rooms on the front 17 meters wide and three rooms 21 meters deep. There is a cross directly above the gate, with the word "Catholic Church" written under it, and a plum blossom-shaped round window on the middle floor. Stone-wood reinforced concrete mixed structure, herringbone roof truss, purlin rafter wooden structure, canopy dome type, 12 windows on the left and right sides, square roof in the back hall, and a pair of drum stones on both sides of the gate, with a building area of 600 square meters. Fifteenth-century Renaissance Spanish Gothic architectural style, redecorated in 1996. On the right side of the church, there is a gathering building, which is the residence of clergy. It is listed as a key cultural relics protection unit in Zhejiang Province and is the sixth batch of national key cultural relics protection units.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Wetlands
shortFeatures: Walk Jiuqu Bridge to enjoy the beauty of wetlands
summary:
· Hangzhou Bay National Wetland Park is located near the southern end of Hangzhou Bay Cross-sea Bridge. It is a wetland park with long grass and flying warblers in the suburbs of Ningbo. There are not only open tidal flats, but also large reeds and grasslands. Every year, many migratory birds inhabit and breed here, and the photos taken are very impressive. In Chen Kaige's movie "Search", a Gao Yuanyuan play was shot here. Fans might as well look for the scenes in the play. 
At present, the one-vote system is implemented in the scenic spot, and battery cars and cruise ships are included in the big ticket. There are two types of tour routes: A and B. Line A takes the bus first and then the boat, while line B is just the opposite. The tour contents of the two are exactly the same, so you can choose as you like. 
The first impression of the wetland park is that it is full of green. Tour along Line B and walk through the lotus pond, there is a tortuous open-air tunnel. Through the transparent fish tanks as high as one person on both sides of the road, you can see fish swimming leisurely around you, which feels like an aquarium. Not far ahead is the cruise ship dock. You can roam on the wetland river by awning boat, and occasionally you can see egrets and cormorants playing on the lake. The scenery is beautiful. The whole tour takes about ten minutes, and the cruise ship basically goes with you, which is more convenient. Not far after landing is the elk park, and small animals are foraging on the island not far from you, which is quite wild. Crossing a section of gravel road is a lotus pond, as well as a wooden nine-curved bridge and reeds. The classic shot of Gao Yuanyuan looking back and smiling on the trestle in Search was shot here. The reeds in autumn are the most beautiful. There is a stills of "Search" standing at the entrance of the wooden bridge. Girls might as well use the same shape to take a photo as a souvenir. The love hut in the play, as well as some temporary scenes for shooting, are also nearby. If you are interested, you can "search" it. After passing the circular Butterfly Island, you can take a tour bus to the Migratory Bird Museum. Behind the transparent glass in the museum, specimens of various birds are displayed, with graphic materials to introduce the migration routes and habits of migratory birds. There is a 6D cinema on the first floor of the venue, where you can participate in the interactive experience project (50 yuan) with the theme of migratory bird migration. In an environment that combines virtual and real, start from Siberia, follow the migratory bird "Jiajia" to fly over the mountains and seas, and arrive at the warm and comfortable Hangzhou Bay to experience the migration journey of thousands of miles. Cycling in the wetland park is also a leisurely and pleasant thing. There are bicycle rental in the scenic spot, with a deposit of 100 yuan, a single car rental of 10 yuan/hour and a double car rental of 20 yuan/hour. 
Daqiao Ecological Farm opposite the Wetland Park is a good ecological attraction. Parent-child trip or family trip may wish to arrange a tour in the same itinerary.

shortFeatures: Popular Guanyin Dojo around Ningbo
summary:
Little Putuo in Ningbo, also known as Xiayu, is located in the center of Dongqian Lake. It is one of the main scenic spots in Dongqian Lake Tourist Resort and has a profound cultural heritage. 
The main landscapes of the scenic spot are: Butuo Cave Sky, Qiandi Smoke Wave, Taogong Diaoyi, Qingfeng Xianggui, Chenghu Lake Bright Moon, Xiayu Suolan, Mountain Monk Hubo, Erling Snapshot 
You can drink tea at the Moonwave Building in the square, or play live CS and barbecue at the paintball center 
Guanyin on the water is the landmark landscape of Xiaoputuo. There is a stone building "Western Ship" in the temple. It is very nice to board the boat and see the scenery of Dongqian Lake from a height. 
Every year in March and April, peach blossoms bloom in Taohuawu between Suolan Bridge and Guanyin on the Water, which is the best time to visit Xiaoputuo.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Enjoy autumn leaves; Lakes
shortFeatures: Stroll through the quaint and quiet Yutu Island
summary: Siming Lake is located in Liangnong Town, Yuyao City, in the north of Siming Mountain, more than 10 kilometers away from the urban area. It has beautiful scenery, rippling blue waves, lakes and mountains complement each other, and the lake area is nearly 20 square kilometers. Siming Lake collects streams, springs and waterfalls, with a volume of about 120 million cubic meters, irrigating 300,000 mu of fertile land in the northwest of Yuyao. The lake is rich in fishery resources and attracts a large number of birds. There are Bazi Bridge, Wildcat Bay, Dingshan, etc. in the lake, forming five islands in the center of the lake, which are like emeralds embedded in a mirror, adding to the charm of Siming Lake. Yutu Island in the center of the lake is the largest island in Siming Lake, covering an area of about 270 mu. Its shape resembles a jade rabbit, especially on the night of the moon. Overlooking from the lake, it looks like a jade rabbit worshipping the moon. There are pines and bamboos on the island, orchards and tea gardens all over the mountains and plains, and winding mountain paths, wandering, simple and quiet, which makes people feel refreshing and happy.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Military Sites
shortFeatures: Looking for red footprints and enjoying a cool summer
summary: Xiaojiuzhai in East Zhejiang Province is located at the northern foot of Siming Mountain, in Zhilin Village, Dayin Town, Yuyao. The territory has continuous mountains, winding mountains, abundant bamboo forests, criss-crossing streams, valleys, streams, ancient trees and bamboo forests, and attractive scenery, so it is known as Xiaojiuzhai in eastern Zhejiang. Xiaojiuzhai is named after the stream.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Art Museums
shortFeatures: An art ark moored in the port city
summary: Ningbo Art Museum is located on the north side of the bustling Sanjiangkou, adjacent to the vast Yongjiang River in the east, the quaint old Bund in the south and Renmin Road in Jiangbei in the west. The main building of the art museum is designed with a double-layer shell, and its outline is on the bank of Yongjiang River, just like an "art ark" moored in the port city. Ningbo Art Museum consists of the main building, the stage square, the cafe, the underground garage, the dock and other parts. The large and small exhibition halls cover an area of 5,300 square meters, and the art collection library is more than 1,500 square meters. It can hold exhibitions of different types and themes at the same time or separately. In addition, the art gallery also has advanced supporting facilities such as exhibition hall, art gallery, VIP lounge, academic lecture hall, artist studio, art salon, art education center, gallery, art supplies store, etc. It is a modern and high-grade plastic arts museum integrating exhibition, collection and protection, academic research, art exchange, art education, cultural leisure and other functions. It is known as: "Oriental Port, Art Hall"

shortFeatures: The pool water poured down to form a three-level waterfall
summary: The scenery integrates peaks, caves, pools and streams, which is particularly beautiful. Sanyintan is divided into upper, middle and lower pools. The water of the hidden pool jumped out from the three cliffs and turned into three waterfalls. There was a pool under the waterfall, which was faint and bottomless. There are two boulders standing on the flowing water of the upper hidden pool, steep walls and deep valleys, moss mottled on the rocks, and pines standing on the edge of the ditch. A stone bridge was built on the pool, and the waterfall poured down the cliff. The flowing water was in the shape of lines. The water hit the two cliffs and echoed loudly. On the bridge at the bottom of the valley, fog filled the air and the water mist evaporated, giving people a cool feeling. The stones in the middle hidden pond are vertical and horizontal, with strange ups and downs. The flowing water circles the stones, circles and twists, and rushes out of the rock formation through thousands of difficulties and dangers. Then, in one go, it sprayed out of the cliff mouth and refracted to the east, forming an elegant waterfall. The mountain wind blew water foam and splashed in all directions. It was impossible to tell whether it was fog or rain, and it was poetic and picturesque. There are piles of huge stones in the lower hidden pond, overlapping each other, and the large and small stones are piled up for more than ten square meters. Among them, there is a stalagmite peak, which is more than 20 meters high. The stalagmite peak is on the pool, and the deep pool is at the bottom of the peak, revealing half.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes; Mountains; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Ideal for outings
summary:
Siming Mountain National Forest Park is located in the five urban areas of Yuyao, Yinzhou, Fenghua, Shengzhou and Shangyu in the hinterland of Siming Mountain in eastern Zhejiang Province. It is distributed in a long and narrow shape from east to west, with a total area of 6,665 hectares, and the provincial highway Huxi line passes through it. 
There are many low mountains and hills in the park, with undulating peaks and cascading hills. The altitude is between 600-900 meters. The main peak, Jinzhong Mountain, is about 1018 meters above sea level. The climate of the park is slightly cold and humid, with four distinct seasons, abundant sunshine, abundant rainfall, obvious alternation of winter and summer monsoons, and cool summer. 
The park is densely treed, flowers and plants are fragrant, and cliffs and boulders often appear among pines and cypresses. The park is particularly rich in species. After preliminary investigation, there are nearly 1,000 species of plants and 106 species of main animals. There are evergreen broad-leaved forest, cedar promenade, money pine forest, cypress forest, Huangshan pine forest, the hometown of red maple in Siming Mountain-10,000 mu of red maple forest and various bird landscapes.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A paradise for shopaholics and foodies
summary: If you come to Ningbo, you generally know that you want to visit Tianyi Square, which is also a landmark building in Ningbo. Modern buildings with strong European style in the square. The transparent square, a pool of clear water and urban green space make Tianyi Square full of modern commercial atmosphere. Outside the square, ancient buildings such as Medicine Emperor Hall, Spirit Pavilion and Catholic Church complement each other, which is another flavor. Known as the number one musical fountain in Asia is staged almost every day, so don't miss it.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Outdoor Skiing
shortFeatures: There are more than ten ice and snow entertainment projects
summary:
· Shishigang Ski Resort is located in Shishigang Tourist Resort. Relying on the unique climate and geographical advantages of "Siming First Mountain", it is a comprehensive alpine outdoor ecological ice and snow club integrating tourism, leisure and vacation, ice and snow entertainment, fitness and health care, alpine conference and catering and accommodation. 
The ski resort adheres to the business philosophy of "green ecology". The snow-making area of the ski resort is 16,000 square meters. The end line of the main ski trail is 42 meters wide, the bottom line is 80 meters wide, and the total length is about 500 meters. The appearance of Shang Lianggang Ski Resort is trapezoidal, with a maximum slope of 18 degrees and a drop of more than 30 meters. 
· The snow resort now has nearly ten ice and snow entertainment projects such as skiing, skating, sliding circle, snow flying saucer, snowman building, snowball fight, ice slide, etc., which are extremely entertaining and challenging.

shortFeatures: It was once an important water transport beacon of Mingzhou Port
summary: Tianfeng Pagoda is the tallest ancient building in Ningbo city and a landmark building in Ningbo ancient city. The tower is a Tang Dynasty style with six-edged multi-storey cornices and spires, which is somewhat similar to the Tang Dynasty Twin Towers in Suzhou. It is a long-live tower built to commemorate Wu Zetian's accession to the throne. After many rebuildings, it gradually became a brick tower without cornices. The present tower is rebuilt according to the small tower unearthed in the underground palace in 1980s.

Tantoushan Island is made of volcanic tuff, with continuous hills and peaks. There are fourteen peaks below 100 meters, and there are few flat lands. Shan Ye has good vegetation, bushes, birds and flowers. There are many bays in the island, and natural strange rocks, caves and beaches are placed among them, just like a beautiful sea scenery picture scroll.

poiName: Dongqian Lake Fuquan Mountain Scenic Area
tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains
summary:
Fuquan Mountain Scenic Area is an eco-tourism resort that integrates tea culture, blessing culture and Buddhist culture in natural mountains and forests, and integrates famous tea, famous trees and famous springs. 
The scenic spot is divided into eight scenic spots: Wanghu Pavilion, Phoenix Lake, Wutai Guanri, Longtan Fuquan, Phoenix Drunken Valley, Ancient Gui Piaoxiang, Daci Xunyi and Tiandayan. 
Whenever the sun sets and dusk comes, the scenic spot presents a charming and beautiful scenery, which can be described as "a mountain views the lake and sea, and thousands of greens embrace the blessing spring".

shortFeatures: Cliff abyss, climb high to enjoy lakes and mountains
summary: Miaogaotai, also known as Miaofeng Peak and Tianzhu Peak, is the main landscape in Xuedou Mountain Scenic Area. Although the altitude is only 396 meters, it is backed by mountains, raised in the middle, cliffs on three sides, and faces an abyss. The terrain is very steep. Miaogao Terrace in a narrow sense refers to a platform with an area of about 350 square meters. Standing at the front of the platform, you can watch the natural scenery of the lake under the pavilion. Miaogaotai is a thoughtful summer resort with dense ancient trees, green bamboos blocking the sun and cool breeze.

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
shortFeatures: The Cute and Interesting Animal World
summary: The Ningbo Wildlife Park, formerly known as the Dongqian Lake Wildlife Park in Ningbo, is located within the Dongqian Lake Tourism and Resort Area, which is renowned for its "West Lake charm and Taihu grandeur." It is the "largest wildlife park in China by water area." In 2004, it was acquired by the Ningbo Yageer Group, which invested nearly 200 million yuan to renovate the park. The park has developed into one of the "top three zoos in East China," covering more than 1,900 acres and housing over 200 species and nearly 10,000 animals. It officially opened to the public in early June 2004.

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Aquariums
shortFeatures: Three types of underwater sightseeing tunnel combination
summary: Ningbo Ocean World is located at 936 Sangtian Road, Jiangdong District, Ningbo (at the eastern end of Children's Park). It is a large marine aquarium in East China that integrates marine life displays, marine scenery exhibitions, large marine animal performances, and marine ecological science education. Since its opening on November 16, 2006, it has won numerous honors, including the National 4A-Level Tourist Attraction, the Chinese Fisheries Society Popular Science Education Base, Zhejiang Provincial Science Popularization Education Base, Zhejiang Provincial Ecological Environment Education Demonstration Base, and Zhejiang Provincial Marine Science Popularization Education Base. It is also a member unit of the National Marine Rare and Endangered Wildlife Rescue Network and the Ningbo Aquatic Wildlife Rescue Center.

shortFeatures: Tour the Lake Park and View World Wonders
summary:
Located near the Jiulong Lake Scenic Area, visitors can not only see historical sites commemorating Xu Fu, but also enjoy recreational facilities such as an amusement park and a resort hotel, making it an ideal weekend getaway.  
The resort has two main scenic spots: the Xianfo Valley Scenic Area on the mountain and the Dapengshan Lakeside Amusement Park at the foot of the mountain. It takes about two days and one night to fully explore the entire resort. The lakeside park is especially popular with children, while adults can enjoy hiking in Xianfo Valley, visiting temples on the mountain, and admiring ancient stone carvings.  
Dining and accommodations are concentrated near the two scenic spots at the foot of the mountain, where guests can enjoy views of the lakeside park and the nearby Jiaohu Lake from their rooms.  
In addition to being close to the attractions, guests can generally exchange their room cards for tickets to the two scenic areas mentioned above, offering great value for money.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: The well-preserved ancient village of stone houses
summary:
Xujiashan Village is a model of stone house building community in the coastal mountains of eastern Zhejiang. When you enter Xujiashan Village, you will be paved with stone walls, stone lanes, stone roads, stone bridges and stone steps. The village is very small, and most of them are local elderly people. It is very historical to walk around casually. 
Xujiashan Stone Village was named the fifth batch of "Famous Chinese Historical and Cultural Villages" on December 13th, 2010. Different from ordinary water villages, the buildings in Xujiashan village are all made of local unique bronze-colored "copper slab stone". The villagers' houses are all made of stone-wood structures, and there are few reinforced concrete houses in the village. Because the color of the slate in Xujiashan Village is bronze, the local people also call it "copper slate stone", which is a good building material. 
There are stone houses, stone lanes, stone courtyards, stone walls, stone bridges, stone roads, stone benches and other combined resources in the village. On the whole, it is a world of stones with very distinctive features. The existing ancient buildings in Xujiashan, Sanheyuan and Siheyuan, have a complete pattern, and more than 85% of them maintain their original historical features.

shortFeatures: View spectacular waterfalls
summary:
Qianzhangyan is a famous resort in Xuedou Mountain Scenic Area since ancient times. Qianzhangyan Waterfall, with a drop of 186 meters, is famous for its magnificence and grandeur. Zhao Heng, emperor Zhenzong of the Northern Song Dynasty, once named it "Dongzhe Waterfall". Standing on the Flying Snow Pavilion, you can see the waterfall plummeting down the cliff in front of you. The three characters "Qianzhangyan" in the rock wall were written by Mr. Huang Qi, vice chairman of Chinese Calligraphers Association, and carved in 1992. 
Feixue Pavilion has been the best place to watch Qianzhangyan Waterfall since ancient times. Because the water of Qianzhangyan Waterfall is like flying snow, it was called Flying Snow Waterfall in ancient times, so this pavilion was named Flying Snow Pavilion.

shortFeatures: Garden-style countryside, surrounded by green hills and clear waters
summary:
Tengtou Village is a small village in the south of the Yangtze River with the characteristics of a water town. It is also a well-known "Top 500 Global Ecology" village and the only rural case of the World Expo. 
Tengtou Village highlights the interactive experience between man, nature and culture. Village planning and garden construction will make people have a completely different new experience.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Mountains; Military Sites; Temples
shortFeatures: Exploring Military Relics from the Ming and Qing Dynasties
summary: Zhaobaoshan is located on the banks of the Yongjiang River and faces the East China Sea. The mountain and sea landscape is spectacular and beautiful, with unique scenic features. Due to its strategic terrain, it was one of the main battlefields for China's southeastern coastal defense against the Japanese, English, French, and against pirates. It is home to the nationally important cultural heritage site, the Zhenhai Kou coastal defense ruins (including Wei Yuan City, the Ming and Qing Dynasty inscription group, Yuecheng, Anyuan Battery, and the memorial of the Battle of Zhenhai Kou during the Sino-French War), the Zhenhai Kou Coastal Defense Historical Relics Memorial Hall, the Xiashan Ji Zhenhu area, Aozhu Tower, Baotu Temple, Guanyin Pavilion, Zhaobaoshan Bridge, the ancient seawall, and the Wanghailou Pavilion.

shortFeatures: Junfeng strange rocks, strange rocks and secluded caves
summary: Hua'ao Island is located on the ocean surface of Sanmen Bay in the south of Xiangshan Mountain. The island has handsome peaks and strange rocks, strange rocks and secluded caves, especially the crystal stone forest arranged on the coast about one kilometer, which is magnificent. All kinds of thin-surface strip-shaped stones are densely packed together, arranged in an orderly manner, with different lengths. The thick ones need two people to hug each other, and the taller ones can reach five or six stories high; Some are like swords leaning against the sky, while others are like cranes near the sea. They are called "Immortal Sawing Rock". After textual research, experts believe that the stone forest in Hua'ao Island is actually the channel of central volcanic magma in the late Jurassic. The four-sided or hexagonal stone pillar group is dense black fine-grained basalt, and the surface is yellowish-brown due to seawater erosion and weathering. It is an important primary structure of volcanic rock, that is, after the volcanic eruption, the magma produces a kind of vertical fission under the conditions of uniform cooling and slow contraction, thus forming a peculiar "sea stone forest" landscape.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Lakes; Gardens; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: The essence of Taihu Lake's scenery.
summary:
- The Yuantouzhu International Cherry Blossom Festival is held annually from mid-March to early May. Recommended spots for cherry blossom viewing include Cherry Blossom Valley, Chongshan Hidden Beauty, and Changchun Bridge.
- Visitors can explore the garden clusters, take a boat on Taihu Lake, and enjoy the cherry blossoms, experiencing the poetic beauty praised by Guo Moruo: "The most beautiful spot of Taihu Lake is, after all, Yuantouzhu."
- Yuantouzhu is a peninsula located in the northern part of Taihu Lake, named for its shape resembling a turtle head, and is known as "the most famous scenic spot of Taihu Lake."
- The island features a Taoist palace, Taoist and Buddhist cave sculptures, as well as many historical sites and private gardens built by former renowned figures and aristocrats.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Visit the Big Buddha of Bailing Mountain and watch the Buddhist cultural performance.
summary:

- This area consists of Mount Lingshan, Xiangfu Chan Temple, the Lingshan Grand Buddha, and other attractions scattered throughout. It can be simply summarized as one mountain, one temple, and one Buddha.
- Lingshan Scenic Area combines the beauty of lakes, mountains, gardens, squares, Buddhist culture, and historical knowledge, with the entire park reflecting the atmosphere of Buddhist culture.

shortFeatures: Take a boat ride to enjoy the vast lake view
summary:
It is a group of small islands in the lake in Yuantouzhu scenic spot, which is divided into scenic spots such as Dongtianfudi and Tiandu Xianfu, and has the reputation of "Three Mountains Yingbi". 
There are statues of Taoist fairy palace and grottoes of Taoism and Buddhism on the island. Among them, the 18-meter-high statue of the Jade Emperor in the Taoist temple is rare in China and very eye-catching. 
· There are Huaguo Mountain, Mountain Curtain Cave and Performing Arts Field for monkeys to inhabit and perform monkey art, reproducing the scenes in the famous classical novel The Journey to the West. 
Dajue Bay, Xianren Cave and other scenic spots gather the art of Chinese Buddhist and Taoist grottoes, and the scenic spots such as Tiantai, Yuelao Temple and Yuanyang Pavilion are also magnificent.

tagNameList: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Theme park of traditional Jiangnan culture
summary: Wuxi Sunac Park covers an area of 570,000 square meters. With the theme of traditional Jiangnan culture, it has designed six theme parks: Canal People, Bubble Spring Town, Xiake God Travel, Steam Age, Pastoral Happy Song and Adventure Harbor, including 34 sets of amusement equipment, 7 star equipment, 4 large-scale performing arts and 14 atmospheric performing arts. Visitors can experience the shocking effect brought by the large-scale dark ride "Western Waves", the vigorous passion of the large-scale stage play "Steam Age", and the world's top "flying wing roller coaster" to experience the thrill of adrenaline surging.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; City coordinates; Statues/Sculptures
shortFeatures: A magnificent bronze Buddha statue
summary:
- The Lingshan Grand Buddha is located on the southern side of Qinlufeng in Mashan, Wuxi. The site of the Buddha was named "Little Lingshan" by Tang Xuanzang, thus it is called the Lingshan Grand Buddha.
- The Grand Buddha is one of the symbols of Wuxi. Facing Taihu Lake, with its back to Lingshan, it has a compassionate smile, gazing broadly at all beings. It holds significant meaning for the social, cultural, and economic development of the region.
- Inside the base building of the Buddha's seat, two elevators are installed specifically to take pilgrims and tourists up to the lotus seat, where they can approach the Buddha's feet and touch them, a practice known as "embracing the Buddha's feet."

tagNameList: Ancient Towns and Villages; Enjoy Autumn Foliage; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Visit the Ming and Qing Ancient Ancestral Hall Complex
summary:
- Characterized by a dense distribution of ancient ancestral halls, it is considered the only existing project in Wuxi that meets the conditions for applying for World Cultural Heritage status.
- The ancestral halls are mainly concentrated along the Longtou River and Zhijie, with the Yang Oufang Ancestral Hall being particularly special for incorporating Western architectural style.
- The ancient town's food is also a must-try, with Huishan Tofu Flower often having long queues; and the Xiaolongbao from Yiqin Garden, featured on "A Bite of China."
- Combining the essence of culture and the beauty of mountains and rivers, it has long been a spiritual home and a place for travel for the local people over the centuries.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; treasure spot for kids.; Forests
shortFeatures: Stroll through the Bamboo Sea and enjoy a cool summer.
summary:
- The Yixing Bamboo Sea Scenic Area is located in Hufu Town, Yixing, covering nearly 15,000 hectares of bamboo forest that rises and falls with the terrain. The bamboo sways with the mountains, resembling rolling waves that stretch endlessly.
- The scenic area is known for its clear mountains and waters, where the four seasons can be experienced in a single day, offering natural wonders and delights. Major attractions include "The First Source of Taihu Lake," "The First Peak of Southern Jiangsu," "Bamboo Brings Peace," and "The Mirror Lake Scenic View."
- This place is a natural oxygen bar and an excellent location for film and TV shooting. It has been used in the production of notable works such as *Romance of the Three Kingdoms*, *The Flying Hero White Dragon*, and *The Founding of the Song Dynasty*.
- Visitors can now take a cable car to the mountain top, where they can enjoy a panoramic aerial view of the bamboo sea. If the wind is strong, one can experience the magnificent and tumultuous waves of the bamboo forest.

poiName: Taihu Yuantouzhu Scenic Area - Cherry Blossom Valley
shortFeatures: Appreciate the cherry blossoms in the mountains from many angles in spring
summary: Located at the northern foot of Luding Mountain in Yuantouzhu Scenic Area, it is adjacent to the Sino-Japanese Cherry Blossom Friendship Forest and integrated into one. It covers an area of 200,000 square meters and has more than 30,000 cherry blossoms of 68 varieties. It is the largest cherry blossom garden in China. Cherry Blossom Valley has buildings such as Cherry Blossom Viewing Building, Tianyun Pavilion, Fanyingxuan and Cuchun Bridge. It is a good place for people to enjoy cherry blossoms and carry out friendly exchange activities.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; garden parks; Gardens
shortFeatures: Fang Li and Xi Shi Themed Water Garden
summary:
- Li Garden is a well-known park in Wuxi, famous for its water scenery and featuring the traditional Jiangnan garden style.
- According to legend, during the Spring and Autumn period, Fan Li and Xi Shi retreated to Taihu Lake, and many of the garden's buildings are themed around Fan Li and Xi Shi, with exquisite landscaping. In spring and summer, visitors can also come here to enjoy the flowers.
- The Li Garden scenic area includes attractions such as the Four Seasons Pavilion, Xi Shi Manor, Tao Zhu Mansion, Thousand-Step Long Corridor, and the Spring and Autumn Pavilion, all offering great visual appeal.
- To the east of Li Garden, there is a Ferris wheel at Li Lake Park. With Li Garden in the foreground and the Ferris wheel as the background, the photos taken here are very artistic.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Made of granite piles
summary:
The scenic spot is formed by the intersection of two "Ya"-shaped thousand-year-old ancient rivers and two ancient streets along the river, which gathers rich historical relics and cultural landscapes. Among them, the most famous one is "Jiangnan Water Alley", which has the reputation of "the out-of-print essence of the ancient canal". The sound of paddles, lights, ancient bridges and dwellings along the coast constitute a natural ancient canal "water painting outline of folk customs". 
Qing Mingqiao is an ancient bridge with a long history, which was built in the Wanli period of Ming Dynasty in the late 16th century. It was donated by the two sons of Qin Yao, the owner of Jichang Garden in Wuxi. Because the names of the two brothers are Taiqing and Taining respectively, they are called Qingning Bridge. This stone bridge was rebuilt by Wu Xingzuo, the magistrate of Wuxi County, in the eighth year of Kangxi of Qing Dynasty (AD 1666). In the Daoguang period, Minning, the name of Emperor Daoguang, was renamed Qingming Bridge, and some people called it "Qingming Bridge".

shortFeatures: Early spring to see plum blossoms covering the mountains and fields.
summary:
The Plum Garden is located on the southern slopes of Dongshan and Hushan in the western suburbs of Wuxi, 7 kilometers from the city center and 1.5 kilometers from Taihu Lake. The garden is filled with plum trees and is one of the famous plum blossom viewing spots in Jiangnan.  
It is a national AAAA-level tourist attraction, a key national cultural heritage site, and a national key park. The landscape designer took advantage of the terrain’s elevation changes, combining the characteristics of the Plum Garden to adorn the mountain with plums, plant plums along the mountain, where the plums enhance the mountain's beauty and the mountain adds to the plums' charm, creating a unique landscape.  
The garden is home to over 5,500 plum trees of various varieties. There are also scenic spots such as Tianxin Platform, Xixin Spring, Qingfen Pavilion, and Zhahe Pavilion, which offer elevated views as visitors ascend.

Jichang Garden is located at the east foot of Huishan Mountain on the east side of the western suburbs of Wuxi, in Xihui Park on Huishan Hengjie, adjacent to Huishan Temple. In the 19th year of Wanli (AD 1591), Qin Yao took Wang Xizhi's poem "Answer Xu Rafter": "Take joy, benevolence, wisdom and music, and send smooth mountains and rivers" to the famous garden. In 1952, Qin Lianggong, a descendant of the Qin family, dedicated the garden to the country, and Wuxi Municipal People's Government renovated and protected it, gradually restoring the ancient garden style. 
Jichang Garden is a villa-type garden at the foothills, which is unique among Jiangnan gardens with ingenious borrowing scenery, superb stacked stones, exquisite water management and refined architecture. Emperor Kangxi and Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty visited here many times and wrote poems again and again, which shows their affection and appreciation. The Harmony Garden in the Summer Palace in Beijing and the Grand Duke Kuoran in the Yuanmingyuan (later also known as Shuanghezhai) were all built after the Jichang Garden in Huishan, Wuxi.

You can stop and meditate in front of the chapel here, or sing in front of the Arc de Triomphe. summary:
- Zhanggong Cave is located at the foot of Mengfeng Mountain, southwest of Yixing City. It is one of the "Three Wonders" of Yixing and a famous limestone karst cave.  
- According to legend, Zhang Daoling, a Taoist of the Han Dynasty, practiced Taoism here, and Zhang Guolao, an immortal from the Tang Dynasty, lived here in seclusion, hence the name Zhanggong Cave.  
- The cave consists of two sections: the front and rear caves. The halls are vast, with many chambers interconnected. There are caves within caves, all connected, and the temperature varies from one cave to another. It is known as a "marvel of the world."  
- The cave features thrilling underground river exploration and offers rafting, but visitors must wear raincoats, or they will be splashed with water by other tourists.

shortFeatures: Cycling, Walking, and Parent-Child Tour
summary:
The park is located in the urban area of Yixing and is the largest urban forest park in East China, divided into four sightseeing zones.  
The entire Longbeishan Forest Park features a harmonious blend of lake and mountain scenery, with pavilions and towers interspersed. The natural vegetation is dense, and the ecological environment is excellent, offering vibrant colors and fragrances throughout the year.  
There are ponds scattered throughout the park, with spring water flowing all year round, flowing through the valleys and mountains.  
Longbeishan Forest Park also boasts the only Ferris wheel in Yixing, and many newlyweds like to come here for photos to commemorate the occasion.

tagNameList: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
shortFeatures: Appreciate various precious ceramic products.
summary: The Yixing Ceramic Museum is the earliest established professional ceramic museum in China, founded by the first director, Shi Shunhua, and has a history of nearly fifty years. The museum complex is built on the mountainside, with magnificent architecture, integrating exhibitions, research, displays, tourism, shopping, and academic exchanges in ceramics. It houses treasures from various periods, including works by famous Yixing clay artists and an exhibition of the "Five Golden Flowers," both of which are highly recommended. The museum's admission fee is 20 yuan, and the best part is that parking nearby is free of charge.

The buildings in Shuihu City are exquisite and gorgeous, and the main scenic spots are Imperial Palace, Fanlou, Qingming Shanghe Street, Royal Street, Zishi Street, Shuibo Liangshan, etc. 
Every day, a variety of performances will be staged. The film and television stunt performance "Fighting Ximen Qing" in Shuihu City shows the audience the mystery of the shooting of ancient costume martial arts drama.

shortFeatures: The mountain is winding, shaped like a goose stretching out in the river
summary:
"The mountain is surrounded by Furong City, and the private strange goose nose is shaped". The beautiful Ebizui Park is located in the northwest of Jiangyin Yangtze River Bridge Tourist Area, only two kilometers away from the urban area. It is meandering near the river. It is named after the winding mountains and the shape of geese stretching out in the nose river.  
The park covers an area of 350 mu, dominated by mountains, with dense forests and rich wild interest. The park is composed of business service area, riverside tourist area, forest leisure area, fort museum area and other functional areas, with many scenic spots with their own features.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Tang style wooden structure attic-style stupa
summary:
Nianhua Pagoda is a Tang-style wooden pavilion-style stupa. Five floors, consisting of three parts: Xumi platform base, tower body and tower brake. Straight-edged window lattice, heavy-lip tile, corner bucket arch and Shuzhu bucket make Nianhua Pagoda full of Tang style, simple and elegant. Pagoda 
It is 27.98 meters high, with four gates in the southeast, northwest and northwest. The tower is 21.28 meters high, and the tower brake is 6.7 meters high. It is composed of covering bowl, lotus, phase wheel, canopy, three-flower banana leaf, orb, brake chain, wind duo, etc. It is cast of brass and covered with gold foil. Nianhua Pagoda is the highest point of Xiangyuehua Street, the main block of Nianhuawan Town. It perfectly combines Tang style and Zen in its simplicity and solemnity. When it falls at night in Nianhua Bay, Nianhua Pagoda performs the tower lighting ceremony. Under the light and shadow glaze, layers of lights in Nianhua Bay light up, shining in all directions, which is beautiful.

shortFeatures: Exhibits of Wuxi specialties, such as Yixing clay teapots
summary:
The Wuxi Museum is formed by the merger of the Wuxi Science and Technology Museum, the Wuxi Revolutionary Exhibition Hall, and the Wuxi Museum. Its permanent exhibition halls include the Wuxi History Exhibition Area, the Qian Yu Tomb Cultural Relics Exhibition Area, the Zisha Art Exhibition Area, the Huishan Clay Figurine Art Exhibition Area, the Virtual Western Art Gallery, the Wuxi People Carrying the Hope for National Rejuvenation, and the City Memories of Blood and Fire, among others.  
The Wuxi Museum has a collection of nearly 40,000 cultural relics, including 1,487 precious items or sets. Its primary collection features ancient calligraphy and paintings, various dynasties' Zisha pottery, Huishan clay figurines, modern revolutionary artifacts, and industrial and commercial artifacts of the nation. It is especially famous for its collection of calligraphy and paintings, with Ni Zan's hand-painted "Moss and Tree Shadow" being regarded as a "museum treasure."

shortFeatures: Appreciate the unique cave with mountains in the cave
summary:
--Linggu Cave is a giant limestone cave at the southern foot of Shiniu Mountain in the southwest of Yixing City, only 6 kilometers away from Zhanggong Cave. 
--The cave has a 180-degree irregular semicircle. It is known for its "mountains in the cave, which are gorgeous and colorful" and has the reputation of "Lingu Tianfu". 
--Linggu Cave is bigger than Zhanggong Cave, and there are several springs inside. Few people come here to play, and there are often bats in the cave, so be careful. 
--There are still ink left by tourists from Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties on the stone walls inside these caves. In addition, there are some entertainment projects.

shortFeatures: One of the famous historical and cultural blocks in Wuxi
summary: It is about 380 meters long and covers the upper, middle and lower glory, mainly referring to the middle and lower glory. Most of the distinctive and well-preserved ancient buildings are here. Stone street, gray brick wall, old wooden door, narrow alley, deep patio... Walking into Rongxiang Old Street, Wuxi's market atmosphere pounced on her face. She was hidden in private houses south of Liangxi Road and west of Dazhang Lane, Hongqiao Road for a long time and silently. Along the streets and lanes where old and new buildings alternate, more than 150 modern buildings in the late Qing Dynasty and the early Republic of China are scattered. The buildings in Rongxiang Old Street have not changed much in the past hundred years, but they are no longer prosperous. With the changes of the times, many shops on the street have migrated, changed professions or closed down, and almost no shops exist. The only exception is that the shaving shop located at No.67 has still adhered to its original business for a hundred years. The eight mercury mirrors at the beginning of its opening, although mottled, can still shine on people.

shortFeatures: Understand Xu Xiake's life story
summary:
Xu Xiake's former residence is located in Xuxiake Town (Ma Town), Jiangyin City. It was built in the Ming Dynasty and covers an area of 1000 square meters. 
There is a plaque of "Xu Xiake's Former Residence" hanging in Xu Xiake's former residence, which displays Xu Xiake's life stories, various karst specimens, papers and monographs written by modern experts and scholars, and more than 40 scenery photos of "places where Xu Xiake has been". 
In the courtyard on the east side in front of the main hall of the former residence, there stands a Podocarpus with thick poles, bald branches and lush green leaves, which was planted by Xu Xiake himself. At present, the tree is 6.50 meters high, the root diameter is 2.2 meters, and the trunk needs to be hugged by two people. It has a history of more than 400 years. 
The backyard of the former residence is Xu Xiake's Ming-style burial tomb. The cemetery covers an area of 745 square meters, and there are famous branches and beautiful flowers in the south of the Yangtze River, such as Podocarpus, Cypress and Magnolia, on both sides. In front of the altar at the end of the cemetery, there is a 2.70-meter-high statue of Xu Xiake, holding a bamboo hat in his hand, as if he had traveled to his hometown in Qian Shan, the motherland.

shortFeatures: The lake view is beautiful, and there is a Buddhist Zen temple.
summary:
- The scenic area is located in the southwestern mountainous region of Yixing, Jiangsu, and is part of the "Natural Ecological and Ceramic Culture Tourism Area" in the western part of the Taihu Lake tourism circle.
- The Tianshui Bay Resort at Yunhu officially opened on May 1st this year, with over 30 standard rooms and business suites, and can accommodate more than 200 people for dining at the same time.
- To offer more activities for visitors, new attractions such as the Black Dragon Pond and the lakeside trail have been added to the Lakeside Park at Hengshan Reservoir.
- The scenic area is not far from Dajue Temple, and the number of visitors here is relatively small, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation.

poiName: Best Scenic Spot of Taihu Lake

shortFeatures: Named after its shape like a round mirror
summary:
In the bamboo sea, mountain stream water and natural rainwater converge into a small "mirror lake", and the lake water is as clear as a mirror all year round. 
Looking around, bamboos grow in the water, water flows among bamboos, and the mirror lake and the stretching bamboo sea set each other off. 
Peach Blossom Jellyfish, a rare creature that can be called "giant panda in water", also grows in Mirror Lake, which can be seen from August to November every year. The Jellyfish Pavilion in the corner of Mirror Lake is the best place to watch peach blossom jellyfish.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Nighttime Sightseeing; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Enjoy the breeze, cool off, and take a stroll.
summary:
The Tuankui Scenic Area in Yixing is located in the western part of Yixing City and is an important part of the Yangxian Scenic Area in the Taihu Lake Scenic Area. The main landscape of the area is the water surface, and it is planned into three major sections. The sightseeing areas are mainly concentrated on the east and south banks. 

The Yiyuan Garden on the south bank is a modern imitation of an ancient garden, and the Yunxi Building within the garden is its iconic structure. 

This is a free scenic area, and taking a stroll here in the early morning or evening is a delightful experience.

shortFeatures: Construction highlights the characteristics of blending mountains and rivers
summary:
As a landmark project of Taihu New Town, Jinkui Park is located in the south of Gaolang Road, west of Suxi Road, north of Guanshan Road and east of Lide Road, covering an area of 650,000 square meters. 
The construction of the whole park highlights the characteristics of the blending of mountains and rivers, planting trees, flowers and grass in a large area, and introducing aquatic plants according to local conditions, making it the "green lung" of Taihu New City. 
At the same time, public facilities such as sports, humanities, history, business and leisure are properly built in the park to meet the leisure needs of citizens. After completion, Golden Chamber Park will become the largest free theme park in southern Wuxi, and it is also the landmark landscape green space in the center of Taihu New Town.

poiName: Yixing Bamboo Sea - First Peak of Southern Jiangsu
shortFeatures: Climb to the summit and enjoy the boundless bamboo sea and stretching mountains
summary: Jade Girl Peak is located at the junction of Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Anhui, the first peak in southern Jiangsu. Jade Girl Peak is 611.5 meters above sea level, and it is the highest peak in the 800-mile Yinan Mountain Area. At the highest point on the top of the mountain, you can look around, the mountains are gloomy and beautiful, the breeze is blowing, and the three provinces are unobstructed, giving you great momentum to point the mountains and rivers.

shortFeatures: Built in 1936
summary: Changchun Bridge was built in 1936. It is located in a pool of Hanwanxuan and Jiangxuexuan. The front and rear lake embankments of the bridge are separated from Taihu Lake. The bridge is arched, like the Jade Belt Bridge in the Summer Palace, and the bridge opening reflects the sun into a muddy round shape. Japanese cherry blossoms have been introduced on the lake embankment for more than 60 years. Every April, flowers bloom like clouds, light red, pink and white. Under the shade of green mountains and green waters, they are particularly enchanting, and they are called "Changchun Cherry Blossom". In front of Changchun Bridge, there is an ancient building half exposed to the water, with the title "Jiangxuexuan", opposite Hanwanxuan. Next to Jiangxuexuan is Yundou Building, which was built by the owner in memory of the ancestor Yang Duwang, with Cai Yuanpei's inscription on it. Uphill, there is the Flower Temple, which was built in 1931. It offers the statue of "Flower Goddess Yi" in the middle, with a high bun and clouds, and a beautiful posture.

shortFeatures: A sea of colorful flowers can be seen during flowering period
summary: Nianhua Bay "Brahma Flower Sea" is backed by mountains, and there is a clear river flowing in the sea of flowers. There is an elegant and vast sea of auspicious flowers here, which smudges Zen in time. Bright yellow sulfur chrysanthemum, pink zinnia, delicate drunken butterfly flower, one color flower, blindly Zen, interpret beauty and contain goodness. Flowers bloom all over the mountains, swaying gently, time is quiet and happiness is full.

A stone tablet banner was erected at the corner of Huishan Old Street, with the words "Wuli Xiangcheng" engraved on the front brick. Wuli Xiangcheng was originally an avenue from the west gate of Wuxi to Huishan. In 1976, the Wuxi section of the Beijing-Hangzhou Canal was diverted, and Wuli Xiangcheng had been abandoned. A tree-lined boulevard was built near Huishan, which was called Huishan Straight Street. There were old houses in the south of the Yangtze River on the street, and there were many shops selling Huishan clay figurines. There was Huishan clay figurine museum under the faucet, Huishan clay figurine factory on Baoshan Bridge, and Zhang Xun Temple on the street.

tagNameList: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies; Theater
shortFeatures: It looks like eight wings
summary: It is just on the edge of Lihu Lake. It looks very atmospheric from the outside, and the environment inside is quite new. It is regarded as a landmark building in Wuxi. Large and small performances are often held here, including concerts, drama performances or award ceremonies. There are quite rich activities. Occasionally, there are citizens' visiting day activities, which are free and open to citizens, but it is a bit far away from the city.

shortFeatures: There is a school, political and cultural area inside
summary:
Jiangyin Zhongshan Park is located in Jiangyin City, Jiangsu Province. It was formerly known as Jiangsu Xuezheng Yasu Ruins Park, and was renamed to this name in 2002. 
The whole scenic spot covers an area of 7.25 hectares (72,500 square meters), totaling 108 mu of land, and is divided into a number of fully functional areas such as academic, political and cultural areas, ecological recreation areas and recreational activities areas. 
The shapes of many buildings and structures in the garden reflect the architectural characteristics of Chinese classical gardens. The whole project has landscapes such as Lotus Hall, Yongmu House, Sculpture Square in Xuezheng District, Zhongshan Memorial Tower and Shuixi Project. Jiangsu Academic Affairs Office is the official office that presided over the examination of scholars in the imperial examination era.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Beaches; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Historical Architectures; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: World Architecture Expo
summary:
Gulangyu Island is home to over a thousand buildings with a variety of styles, blending both Chinese and Western architecture. There are temples with traditional Chinese flying eaves and curved corners, Minnan-style courtyard houses, the Bagua Tower with a combination of Chinese and Western elements, small and delicate Japanese-style houses, 19th-century European consulates from Western countries, and the Shuzhuang Garden, which is considered a gem of Jiangnan classical gardens. It can be called an exposition of world architecture.

In recent years, several new buildings have been completed, including the former Gulangyu Park transformed into an Underwater World, the tall statue and relief of Zheng Chenggong in Haoyue Park, the marble statue of renowned Chinese gynecologist Lin Qiaozhi in Yuyuan, the subtropical plant introduction garden at Huijiao, with its shrubs, flowers, and fragrant palms, the Xiamen Museum displaying the city's thousand-year history and the development of its special economic zone, the Zheng Chenggong Memorial Hall honoring the hero’s achievements, as well as Yanping Park, Gangzihou Swimming Pool, Zhongshan Library, People’s Stadium, and the Gulangyu villas with garden-style architecture, Guanhaiyuan Resort, Gulangyu Hotel, and more. With so many parks and buildings in just 1.78 square kilometers, the density of these structures is likely rare even in the world.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Schools
shortFeatures: A famous university surrounded by mountains and seas
summary:
Founded in 1921 by Mr. Chen Jiageng, a patriotic overseas Chinese leader, it is one of the most beautiful campuses in China. 
The quaint architecture of overseas Chinese hometown in southern Fujian, lush southern plants and youthful Nanqiang students all retain their original appearance. 
The humanistic charm of Jiannan Auditorium and Songen Building, and the beautiful scenery of Furong Lake and Lover Valley are the campus corners that can best reflect the beauty of Xiamen University.

shortFeatures: Xiamen cultural innovation landmark
summary:
· Zeng Cuo An Village is known as "the most literary village in the country". It used to be a simple fishing village, but now it has become a hot cultural and creative village. 
Modern and quaint neighborhoods are integrated, and there are many unique small shops gathered on the street. You can eat, buy and shoot while shopping, which is enough for you to toss all day. Food is another label here besides literature and art. There are all kinds of snacks and dazzling fruits in five streets and eighteen lanes in Zeng Cuo An Village. 
It is also a gathering place for characteristic homestays, including traditional courtyards, baroque single-family villas, quaint and unique fishing villages, and lively and unique youth hostels. 
· Zeng Cuo An Village late at night belongs to folk songs and bars. Young people talk about their ideals in bars. Under the hoarse voice of folk songs, they drink with emotions and stories to recall the most unforgettable times.

shortFeatures: Famous Buddhist monasteries in the whole country
summary:
Nanputuo Temple is a key Buddhist temple in the Han nationality area. If you are going to pray, you might as well come here to worship. 
The most famous ones are the vegetarian food on the second floor of the vegetarian restaurant and the vegetarian cakes in the temple, with the plaque of the first vegetarian banquet in the world hanging on it, which is about 59 yuan per capita. 
Wulaoshan, the back mountain of Nanputuo Temple, is one of the eight scenic spots in Xiamen, and you can climb the mountain by the way. 
It only takes about 1 hour to walk from the temple to Wulaoshan, and you can also go to Xiamen Botanical Garden from this road. 
There are many inscriptions of celebrities around the temple. There is a huge stone carving of "Buddha" on the cliff behind the temple, and tourists often come to take photos.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Hiking/Biking; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Enjoy riding the coastline
summary:
· Xiamen Huandao Road is built along the coast. It is a section of coast from Xiamen University to the Convention and Exhibition Center, and is called the "Golden Coastline". 
· Also known as Five-Color Road: blue sea, golden beach, green grass, red runway and gray road. 
There are many scenic spots along the way, such as Hulishan Fort, Yefeng Village, International Convention and Exhibition Center, Wuyuan Bay, etc. 
On the side of Huandao Road facing the sea, there are sculptures of different styles such as "Wave of Gulangyu Island", "Meditation Song of the Sea" and "Choice", which are of great ornamental value. 
You can rent a bicycle to ride, which has a unique charm. It is the most beautiful section from Yefengzhai to the Convention and Exhibition Center, and it takes about 40 minutes to ride by bike.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Xiamen Landmark Commercial Street
summary:
Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street is the oldest commercial street in Xiamen. People often buy souvenir gifts here, and there must be exhibitions and sales activities on holidays. 
The buildings here are all arcades, with 　 and milky white as the main colors, with a strong Nanyang style. The colorful night scene and the dazzling array of snacks from Fujian and Taiwan are also a major feature of Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. 
Famous snack bars include eight mothers-in-law burning fairy grass and Huang Zehe peanut soup, etc., which are worth trying.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rock Monuments; Observation Decks
shortFeatures: Commanding heights overlooking Gulangyu Island
summary:
· Sunlight Rock is the highest peak of Gulangyu Island and the iconic scenic spot of Gulangyu Island. 
Sunlight Rock Top is the best place to watch the sunrise and sunset in Gulangyu Island, and you can overlook the whole island of Gulangyu Island and some scenery of downtown Xiamen in 360 °. 
Internal scenic spot Sunlight Rock Temple is one of the four famous monasteries in Xiamen. It was originally a cave, and then a temple was built with a huge stone as the top. 
There will be much fewer tourists going to Sunlight Rock before 9: 00 a.m. or after 17: 00 p.m., and the sunrise and sunset scenery of Sunlight Rock is super beautiful, which is worth seeing.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: The enchanting rainforest world
summary:
- Xiamen Botanical Garden, commonly known as "Wanshi Botanical Garden," is a meticulously designed botanical garden surrounding the Wanshi Rock Reservoir. The garden includes over 20 specialty gardens and planting areas, such as the Pine and Fir Garden, Rose Garden, Palm Garden, Large Cactus Garden, Hundred Flowers Hall, Orchid Garden, and more, cultivating over 6,000 species of tropical and subtropical plants.  
- The Rainforest World and Desert Plant Zone are particularly worth visiting. The misty atmosphere of the Rainforest World, along with the beautiful tropical rainforest scenery, makes it look like a fairyland.  
- The Instagram-worthy cactus in the Desert Plant Zone is a must-photograph spot. In addition to the plants, the garden also features landscapes such as stone carvings, lakes, lawns, and temples. From the highest point of the New Stele Forest, visitors can overlook half of Xiamen Island.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
shortFeatures: Garden Landscape with Western Colors
summary:
Shuzhuang Garden was built in 1913, named after the homophonic word "Shuzang" by Lin Erjia, a wealthy businessman in Taiwan Province. It is divided into two parts: Bushan Garden and Zanghai Garden. 
The main landscape of Bushan Garden is rockery, that is, twelve caves, with a total of 12 caves, inlaid with twelve zodiac signs at each cave entrance. 
The reason why Tibetan Sea Garden is called Tibetan Sea is that only when you turn out of the Moon Cave Gate will the sea appear in front of you, and the Forty-Fourth Bridge is the best point to view the sea. 
The Piano Museum in Tingtao Xuan in Shuzhuang Garden is a highlight. There will be special piano improvisation performances every half hour in the museum, which is worth listening to.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; historical ruins; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A blend of European and Ming-Qing styles.
summary:
- Located near Xiamen University, it was founded in 1894 during the 20th year of the Guangxu era in the Qing Dynasty, and is now a national AAAA-level tourist attraction.
- The total area of the fort is over 70,000 square meters, divided into the battle area, barracks area, and rear area, with hidden tunnels, ammunition depots, soldier quarters, officer's office, and more inside.
- The structure is a combination of a semi-bunker style and a semi-city wall style, featuring architectural styles from both Europe and China's Ming and Qing Dynasties, making it very beautiful.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Night tour viewing; Schools; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A university town with combination of Chinese and Western styles
summary:
Jimei Village, founded by Chen Jiageng, a famous patriotic overseas Chinese leader, is the general name of all kinds of schools and cultural institutions in Jimei District. 
The architecture integrates Chinese and western styles, the most beautiful of which is Jimei Middle School, its Daonan Building and Nanxun Building of Jimei Overseas Chinese School, etc., which are unique in style and highly ornamental. 
Popular scenic spots in the school village include Aoyuan, Dragon Boat Pond, Chen Jiageng's former residence, Jiageng Park, etc., which can be visited on foot.

shortFeatures: Seaside beach adjacent to Xiamen University
summary:
Located at the foot of Baicheng in the south of Xiamen University, it is a beautiful beach between Yanwu Bridge and Hulishan Fort.  
· There are many interesting scenes. The beach is dotted with huge mouse sculptures, and the semi-ring flyover is like a huge clock. 
There are ruins of Zheng Chenggong's era distributed on the beach, which combines beautiful scenery with profound cultural and historical heritage. 
· This is a natural leisure park for Xiamen University students, Xiamen citizens and tourists to stroll, play games, swim and watch the sunset.

shortFeatures: Statue garden commemorating national heroes
summary:
Located in the east of Gulangyu Island, it was built to commemorate Zheng Chenggong's historical achievements in expelling Dutch barbarians and recovering Taiwan Province. 
The name of Haoyue Garden is taken from the word "Haoyue" in Zheng Chenggong's poem "I can't sleep when I miss you, but the bright moon is plain". 
The most eye-catching thing in the park is undoubtedly the statue of Zheng Chenggong, which is 10 times tall. 
Haoyue Garden is very close to Xiamen Island, and it is the best place to watch and shoot the Jinmao Twin Towers.

tagNameList: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums
shortFeatures: Complete sperm whale skeleton
summary:
The venue looks like a blue crystal palace. It is the aquarium with the most complete varieties of fish on display in China, and is known as the Undersea Dragon Palace. 
There are five special exhibition areas in the exhibition hall: Penguin/Freshwater Fish Hall, Whale and Dolphin Herbarium, Aquarium, Undersea Tunnel and Marine Beast Performance Hall. 
It has the largest sperm whale skeleton in China at present, with a length of about 18.6 meters and a weight of about 48 tons. It is also one of the well-preserved large whale specimens in the world.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

shortFeatures: A free park with a nice environment
summary:
· With the theme of Music Fountain Square and the statue of egret and pigeon square as the center, it is the largest fully open square park in Xiamen. 
It is divided into two parts: Central Park and West Park, with the theme of tourists returning to nature viewing requirements. 
The sculpture of egret goddess stands at the yacht pier in the south of the garden and is an iconic sculpture in Xiamen. There are pigeons in the square in front of the statue; There is a musical fountain square and an open-air square in the West Park. 
It is also a shopping and amusement center, a painting and calligraphy art center, and there are also bowling alleys, seafood food, football clubs, nightclubs and other entertainment places.

shortFeatures: Watch the International Marathon
summary:
· Huangcuo Beach is the most natural and cleanest beach on the whole roundabout road, and it is a good place to get close contact with the sea in Xiamen. 
There are many surrounding scenic spots, including International Convention and Exhibition Center, Xiamen University, Nanputuo, Hulishan Fort, etc., with superior geographical location. 
For those who like quietness, this is a good place to watch the sea quietly. It is also a good choice to ride a bike by the seaside and blow the sea breeze.

shortFeatures: Old villas combining Chinese and Western styles
summary:
Haitian was built in 1921 and is listed as one of the top ten villas in Gulangyu Island. It is the only villa complex on Gulangyu Island with a symmetrical layout according to the central axis. It was built at the original site of the Concession Foreigners Club purchased by Huang Xiuxuan, an overseas Chinese in the Philippines. These five villas adopt the traditional symmetrical pattern of Chinese architecture, with the middle building as the mainstay, spreading to both sides, and a square in the center, forming a group of large-scale buildings. The most unique middle building is an antique palace-style building with a large roof, which adopts double eaves to rest on the top of the mountain, and its four corners are tilted high. The doors, windows, corridors and halls are all hung with cement carvings and flying covers, and the eaves and corners are decorated with twisted flowers or water-absorbing dragons and birds to replace all plastic dragon and phoenix ornaments. In particular, there are two caissons decorated under the roof, and Chinese flower-and-bird paintings are painted on the wall of the well, which looks like a pavilion and is very prominent. The outer edge of the corridor is decorated with bucket arches hanging down and flower baskets hanging columns, which makes the middle building very national. From a distance, this building is quite imposing, steady and refined.  
Now, the theme building of Haitian Paradise is Gulangyu Architectural Art Museum, which has free service explanations. In addition to viewing the architecture, you can also enjoy Nanyin performances and puppet performances here, which will definitely shock you.

shortFeatures: Xiufeng Spirit Stone, Exotic Flowers and Herbs
summary:
Formerly known as Siyuan Valley, it is the reservoir of Xiamen University. It has been a drinking water source for teachers and students of Xiamen University for more than 60 years. 
The scenery here is beautiful, and it is regarded as the most romantic place in Xiamen University. It is usually rarely visited, so it is a good place for couples to meet. 
New wooden plank roads and stone steps have been built, so you can stroll leisurely along the forest paths. Seats are set on the roadside, and pavilions, tables and chairs are available for study.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the shocking scenery at an altitude of 100 meters
summary:
Shimao Yunshang Xiamen Sightseeing Hall stands on the 55F of Tower B, Shimao Strait Building, Daxue Road, Siming District, Xiamen, and has the highest altitude view in Xiamen. The sightseeing hall of about 1,300 square meters integrates high-altitude vision, multimedia interaction, leisure and entertainment. At an altitude of about 300 meters, you can overlook Gulangyu Island, the sea garden, and Xiamen-Hong Kong area, which is "the richest Xiamen flavor". Wanshishan, Xiamen University, Nanputuo, Huandao Road and other "Old Xiamen" business cards can be seen at a glance. Kinmen Island and Taiwan Province Strait, which are separated only by a strip of water, have a panoramic view. Shimao Yunshang Xiamen Sightseeing Hall looks at the mountains, the sea, the garden and the waves from a unique perspective, where you can enjoy the pure "private house" sea and sky scenery.

Rotate Xiamen's charming customs 360 degrees, overlooking the graceful city through floor-to-ceiling windows. Famous scenic spots in Xiamen, such as Gulangyu Island, Xiamen University, Nanputuo, Shapowei, Yanwu Bridge, Baicheng Beach and Hulishan Fort, can be seen at a glance, and enjoy the shock of 300 meters at an altitude.

A new perspective for the brave! Step on the high-altitude glass box and feel the trembling 300 meters under your feet, which stimulates your eyeballs and challenges your heartbeat.

Postcards, commemorative shirts, Taiwan Province accompanying gifts, Xiamen souvenirs, and cute themed cute things bring home the beautiful memories of Xiamen on the clouds.
