Explore the beautiful scenery of Xiamen through a telescope. When the weather is fine, you can also overlook Kinmen. Wandering at the low place VS overlooking at the high altitude will tell you a complete story of Xiamen and take you to enjoy the charming scenery of Xiamen.

shortFeatures: Understand Zheng Chenggong's Life
summary:
Zheng Chenggong Memorial Hall was established in 1962 to commemorate the 300th anniversary of Zheng Chenggong's recovery of Taiwan Province. It is the largest collection center and research base of Zheng Chenggong's cultural relics at home and abroad. 
· The memorial hall is located on the mountains and faces the sea, surrounded by lush woods and solemn atmosphere. The museum is divided into seven parts, exhibiting more than 300 pieces of various cultural relics, materials, photos, sculptures and models, systematically displaying Zheng Chenggong's life story. 
Among the poetry and painting materials, there are Zheng Chenggong's poems and their handwritten works, Zheng Chenggong and Wang Zhongxiao's Pictures, Final Edition of Sea Experiences, etc. Among them, Final Edition of Sea Experiences (two volumes in total) is a manuscript discovered in Tong'an in 1960, which is a very precious historical material.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The 55th floor sightseeing hall overlooks Gulangyu Island
summary:
Xiamen Twin Towers is a new landmark in Xiamen. Two independent towers are connected by podiums, which look like sails and incorporate the visual elements of Xiamen's flower "bougainvillea". 
One of them is a five-star hotel and a top office building, the other is a SOHO office building, and the podium building is built into a comprehensive commercial building integrating shopping, leisure, entertainment and catering. 
Be sure to board the Xiamen Viewing Hall on the Yunshang on the 55th floor to experience the invincible 360 view. Overlooking Gulangyu Island and overlooking the whole Ludao customs, it is beautiful. 
The sightseeing hall also has a coffee room, selling all kinds of special souvenirs, handicrafts, etc.

shortFeatures: Adjacent to the picturesque Xinglin Bay
summary:
Aoyuan is located in Jimei Village. It was originally a small island, which looked like a turtle, so it was called Aoyuan. 
There is a small temple on the island called Aotou Palace, also known as Qianli Palace, which was destroyed by the Japanese army during the War of Resistance against Japan period. 
In 1950, Mr. Chen Jiageng expanded the island into the present Ao Garden in the ruins, which consists of a porch, Jimei Liberation Monument and Jiageng Tomb. 
Many carvings in the garden are the soul treasures of Fujian stone carving art, with various figures and vivid images, and can carve various expressions of joy, anger, decline and happiness.

shortFeatures: City parks with playgrounds
summary:
The Bay Park is located between the western sea area of Xiamen and Yundang Lake. It is divided into the North Park and the South Park with the Avenue of Stars as the boundary, facing Gulangyu Island across the sea. 
The "Avenue of Stars" is the biggest highlight in the park, with many LED floor tile lamps and fountains turned on during major festivals, which is very spectacular. 
It is recommended to see the night scene at night, and the nearby bar street is the favorite of clubbing people. You can enjoy the sea breeze, drink beer and enjoy the band performance. 
It is also the only park in Xiamen with an amusement park, with exciting amusement facilities such as jumping machines and traveling in space. It is a good place to take children to play. 
The fountains are open from 9am to 11am, 3pm to 5pm and 7pm to 9pm.

shortFeatures: Standing on the mountain top, you can have a bird's-eye view of Xiamen University
summary:
Wulaofeng is located on the five hills behind Nanputuo Temple, also known as the back mountain of Nanputuo Temple. 
There are white clouds on the top of the five hills, and the jungle under the clouds is lush, faintly like a long beard. From a distance, it seems like five old people with white hair and beard who have experienced all the vicissitudes of the world, looking eagerly at the vast sea. This is one of the eight scenic spots in Xiamen "Five Old Lingxiao" scenic spot. 
It takes about half an hour to one hour to walk from the foot of the mountain to the top of the mountain. There are many viewing platforms along the road, where you can see the panoramic view of Xiamen and take photos. At the highest point, you can see all the buildings of Xiamen University and Gulangyu Island. 
· If Bee Bee goes to Wulaofeng from Xiamen Botanical Garden, it has to pay the admission fee of the Botanical Garden; But if you go from Nanputuo Temple, it is free.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Aquariums; Wetlands; Other Sightseeing Tours
summary:
It is the largest park in Xiamen, with an area equivalent to half of Gulangyu Island. It is also the largest wetland ecological park, known as the urban green lung of Xiamen. 
· It is from the same design company as the seven-star Burj Al Arab Hotel in Dubai, an international landmark building. It has the largest outdoor wooden plank road maze in Xiamen and the only purified sea bathing house in China. 
Every March, a large number of egrets nest and breed, and hundreds of black swans gather here, which is known as the black swan paradise. 
You can watch the five bridges set off each other in the waterside pavilion, watch waterfowl take off and fall on the bird island in the middle of the lake, enjoy fishing on the thousand-step wooden plank road, and enjoy the pleasure of returning to nature. 
In addition, it is also a good choice to take a walk here at night. The night view of Wuyuan Bay at night is even more confusing and romantic under the colorful bridge lights. 
 
Tips 
Wuyuan Bay is the main venue of many international sailing competitions, and it is also the starting point of many sailing boats going out to sea. If you have plenty of time, you can also book a sailing activity to go out to sea and feel the excitement of the sea breeze and sea water blowing your face.

shortFeatures: A park named in memory of Sun Yat-sen
summary:
· The historic Zhongshan Park is also the "park" of Xiamen's population. It was built in 1927. Since the completion of the park, many large-scale political gatherings have been held here. 
· One of the places where Xiamen people live and relax. Young people take a walk in the lake here, and the elderly play cards, make tea and exercise here. Parents can take their children to see animals and play in the amusement park.

shortFeatures: Egret Nature Reserve with Good Water Quality
summary: Dadeng Island is Dadeng Street, Xiang'an District, Xiamen City. It is located on the sea north of Kinmen Island, and the closest distance from Kinmen Island is only 1,800 meters. It is now under the jurisdiction of Xiamen Municipal Government. It covers an area of about 13.2 square kilometers and has 9 administrative villages under its jurisdiction with nearly 20,000 people. It has the purest sea area along the southeast coast, and its water quality and air quality meet the national first-class environmental standards. It is known as the "natural oxygen bar" and is a national egret nature reserve.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Islands with folk architecture in southern Fujian
summary:
Xiaodeng Island is one of the closest places to Kinmen in the mainland of the motherland, only about 1,600 meters away from Kinmen Island. The dwellings on the island are mainly buildings in southern Fujian, which are very folk customs. 
· Xiaodeng Island is surrounded by vast waters, clear sea, and rich in grouper, prawn, etc. It is a natural fishing place. Come here to enjoy fishing and eat seafood. The dwellings on the island are mainly buildings in southern Fujian, which are very folk customs, and you can walk by the seaside. It has experienced the baptism of war, and now there are still original bright blockhouses, dark castles, trenches and the original site of broadcasting to Taiwan on the ground of Xiaodeng. Most tourists travel around the island first, and then stroll around Moon Bay Beach to watch the sea for leisure.

poiName: Former Residence of Mr. Chen Jiageng
shortFeatures: Collection of Mr. Tan Kah Kee's relics
A garden built in memory of Dr. Lin
summary:
Yuyuan is a small garden-style garden built in memory of Dr. Lin Qiaozhi. The "Yu" of Yuyuan means cultivation and nurturing, so the memorial garden is named Yuyuan. 
Dr. Lin Qiaozhi is the founder of modern obstetrics and gynecology in China. In his life, he personally delivered more than 50,000 babies and treated countless gynecological patients, but he was alone. This memorial garden entrusted the reverence of his hometown people for Dr. Lin Qiaozhi. 
There is a white marble statue of Dr. Lin Qiaozhi, a statue holding the hands of a born baby, and a memorial hall with Lin Qiaozhi inside the garden. 
There are two children's sculptures in the garden. The first one is five children side by side, and the second one is a baby in their hands. It is the place where you must take a group photo when you go to Yuyuan.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Fine Art Galleries
shortFeatures: Display many high-level lettering works
summary:
It is the only lettering art gallery in China. The museum officially opened on the morning of March 24, 2008. 
The newly opened Gulangyu International Lettering Art Museum is located in a small building with an area of more than 500 square meters opposite Shuzhuang Garden. The first floor is turned into an international exhibition hall, and the second floor is a China exhibition hall. At present, it is the only large-scale and high-grade international lettering art exhibition hall in the world. There are 407 works from China, Japan, South Korea, Singapore and Malaysia in the museum. Most of these works were selected from the 5th National Lettering Art Exhibition and the 8th International Lettering Art Exhibition in 2004, representing the highest level of lettering art at home and abroad. The modern lettering art, which integrates calligraphy, engraving, painting, color, sculpture and decoration, has a distinctive flavor of the times and unique artistic charm, and is increasingly appreciated and favored by people.
opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:15-17:45,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:15-18:15

tagNameList: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Hot Springs
shortFeatures: Rich in Southeast Asian charm.
summary:
The hot spring water of Sun Moon Valley, praised by ancient people as the "Heaven-kicked Good Spring," is located in the central area of the Minnan tourist circle, exuding a strong Southeast Asian exotic charm. 

With over 100 open-air hot spring pools and more than 40 types of outdoor or indoor specialty hot springs, it promotes a natural and healthy LOHAS lifestyle. It is a paradise for enjoying hot spring health benefits and experiencing a romantic, warm, fashionable, and leisurely resort atmosphere. 

It is said that during the Ming Dynasty's Longqing period, Ding Yizhong, a senior official of the Ministry of Finance, traveled through Fujian's mountains and rivers. Upon learning that Master Wu had used the hot spring water from Tang'an to cure the people of Quanzhou from an epidemic, and that he was revered as the Emperor of Health, Ding went to Tang'an Hot Spring (now Sun Moon Valley Hot Spring) to experience it for himself. After bathing, he felt refreshed and invigorated. He immediately wrote the "Hot Spring Inscription," passionately praising the spring and believing it was a blessing from heaven for the people of Minnan.

There are also fun activities such as children's sand painting, painted round fans, and various DIY crafts, making it an ideal place to visit with children.

shortFeatures: The boundary between Shapotou and Shapowei
summary:
The only remaining ancient port in Xiamen is named because it is the end of a large section of beach, and sand from everywhere will flow here. 
It used to be the most prosperous fishing port in Xiamen. At its peak, there were 10,000 to 20,000 people and nearly 4,000 fishing boats. It is the starting point for sea-seekers to go out to seek the sea, and it is also the end point for returning home. 
After the government dredging and treatment in 2015, the shelter is no longer used as a fishing port, but the lake retains Minnan-style fishing boats. When you are lucky, you can see egrets passing by the water. Friends who like photography must not miss it.

shortFeatures: Visit Guanyin Mountain Sand Sculpture Culture Park
summary:
· Located on the east coast of Xiamen, sitting on a wide blue sea and facing Xiaojinmen, a treasure island, it is the best place to overlook the strait. 
· There is the longest and largest excellent beach bathing beach in Xiamen along the coast, which is equipped with water entertainment activities such as sea tour, sailing, boating, motorboat and sea fishing. 
It is equipped with seven formats: Dream World Paradise, Dream Water World Paradise, Invincible Gold Coast, Dream Ocean Coastal Amusement, Coastal Tourism Resort Hotel, Fujian-Taiwan characteristic theme street and cultural and performing arts center, opening a new era of Xiamen coastal tourism with Gulangyu in the west and Guanyin Mountain in the east.

tagNameList: Garden garden; Nature and Adventure; Caves
shortFeatures: Man-made chain cave, twists and turns
summary:
· Twelve cavern is a rockery made of multi-colored sandstone, rock, conglomerate, etc. It is divided into 12 cavern chambers, which are numbered by 12 branches respectively. 
If you look carefully, you can find the figures of the zodiac signs made of stone. The whole rockery hovers up and down, twists and turns, so it is also called the Ecstasy Cave. 
· You can see the statues of the twelve zodiac signs at the entrance of the cave, so walking through the twelve holes and finding the twelve statues of the zodiac signs is the task of everyone who comes here.

shortFeatures: Great view and beautiful scenery
summary:
· Aberdeen Hou Beach is located in the west of Shuzhuang Garden, and the two are adjacent to each other. 
· Standing on the beach, with the Sunlight Rock on the back, you can see the highest bare rock. 
The bathing beach has soft sand, gentle slopes and flat waves, and low seawater flow rate. Coupled with the beautiful scenery of Gulangyu Island, it is very suitable for seaside leisure and swimming.

shortFeatures: Visit Nine Gardens with Different Styles
summary: The 6th Garden Expo, themed "Harmonious Coexistence and Heritage Development," will create a theme park that integrates garden displays, leisure and vacation, cultural entertainment, and educational living. Its construction goal is to build a "refined exhibition garden, beautiful landscapes, natural harmony, rich cross-strait features, and a sustainable water-based garden expo park."

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Focus on science fiction interactive experience
summary:
· Cultural and technological theme park with high technology as its main form of expression, a large-scale high-tech fourth-generation theme park built by Shenzhen Huaqiang Group with huge investment. 
Science fiction and interactive experience are the biggest features. It skillfully integrates international fashion elements such as animation cartoons and movie stunts with Chinese traditional culture, and is known as the Oriental Dream Park and the magic of Asian science fiction.  
There are more than a dozen large-scale theme project areas in the park, such as Jungle Story, Decisive Battle of Jinshan Temple, Light of Life, Magic Castle, etc., which guarantee you to have fun. 
Among them, the story of the jungle is a large-scale original magic stage play. Visitors who like to watch stage plays should not miss it.

shortFeatures: Walk on the beach and feel the sea sunshine
summary:
Pearl Bay is located in the south of Xiamen Island, Xiamen City, east to Zeng Cuo An Village, west to Huli Mountain Fort, south to Huandao Road and Dadan Island across the sea, north to Yuping Mountain Xiguling, surrounded by mountains on three sides and facing the sea on one side, with beautiful scenery. It is a local beach bathing beach, and there are not many tourists here. 
The sand here is fine and the sea is clear, and the scenery is beautiful. Travelers can stroll on the beach and feel the warmth of the sea sunshine at close range. It is also a good place for many new couples to take wedding photos.

tagNameList: Theatre Theatre; Venue exhibition hall; Theater
shortFeatures: One of the places hosting musical performances
summary:
Gulangyu Concert Hall was built in 1980s and renovated in 2001. Now it is equipped with advanced sound and light control, field recording and other equipment. 
From time to time, some well-known musicians or music groups will perform. For example, they have received art groups from Japan, the United States, Romania, the Philippines, Singapore, Russia, Croatia and other countries, and held performances by Hong Kong Holy Orchestra, Hong Kong Youth Chinese Orchestra, Caotian Choir, Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, Changying Orchestra and China Youth Symphony Orchestra.

shortFeatures: View the strangely shaped clavichord
summary:
· Tingtaoxuan, located in Shuzhuang Garden, Gulangyu Scenic Spot, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, houses many pianos with a long history. 
It is divided into the first hall and the second hall. There will be regular piano explanations in the hall, and there will be piano performances from time to time in the hall. 
As a decoration, candlestick lamps have a history of more than one hundred years. Visiting the Piano Museum is equivalent to browsing the history of piano development in the world.
opening_hours: Opens at Standard time 08:15-17:45,Opens at Daylight saving time 08:15-18:15

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
summary:
Lingyun Jade Museum is the world's first jade-themed building and the only A-level scenic building in Xiamen. It is located in Xiamen Huli High-tech Park, 5 minutes' drive from Gaoqi Airport, and is suitable for the first or last stop of traveling to Xiamen. 
The building combines traditional Chinese elements with the natural smoothness of jade to build the beauty of jade in daily living and living space. It is a veritable jade life palace. 
There are many functional spaces in the building: jade culture corridor, tea art area, furniture area, jewelry area, flower art area, Zen Garden area, modern version of "Yaochi", jade supermarket, adult DIY area, children's jade shopping area, children's DIY area and so on.

tagNameList: Stroller-Friendly Hidden Gems; Celebrity Residences; Famous Residences; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Museum of Ming and Qing Architecture
summary:
- It originated in the Jin Dynasty, flourished during the Tang and Five Dynasties, and reached its peak during the Ming and Qing Dynasties. The layout of its alleys and lanes remains largely intact, making it a living fossil of the ancient Chinese li-bang system.
- Composed of three blocks, seven lanes, and a central street, it has long been known as the "Three Lanes and Seven Alleys."
- The area consists of narrow alleys, white-washed walls and tiled roofs, with an intricate network of lanes. The stone-paved roads are lined with stone archways at the entrances of each block and lane.
- Today, it is home to many time-honored food stalls and traditional crafts, making it a great place to visit, explore the birthplace of famous figures, and enjoy local specialties.

tagNameList: Climbing Heights and Mountains; Nature and Adventure; Forests
shortFeatures: One of the Top Ten National Forest Parks
summary:
- The first national-level forest park in Fujian Province and one of the top ten forest parks in China, its predecessor was the Fuzhou Arboretum.
- The park boasts numerous precious tree species from both China and abroad, with a millennium-old banyan tree being particularly spectacular.
- It is divided into five sections: forest area, nursery, greenhouse, specialty garden, and rest area, making it a great destination for the people of Fuzhou to enjoy weekends and holidays.

tagNameList: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Fuzhou's old city park
summary:
West Lake Park is located on Hubin Road in the northwest of the city. It has a history of more than 1,700 years and is the most complete classical garden in Fuzhou so far. 
In the third year of Jin Taikang, Yan Gao, the county governor, brought water from the northwest mountains here to irrigate farmland. Because it was located in the west of the city wall of Jin Dynasty, it was called the West Lake. 
There are three small islands in the West Lake-Kaihua Island, Xieping Island and Yaojiao Island. Fujian Provincial Museum and Food Exhibition Hall are also located in the West Lake Park.  
Every year during the Dragon Boat Festival, a dragon boat race will be held in the West Lake. At that time, the fierce and spectacular race scene will be launched between the vast water and sky, and the sound of gongs and drums will reach the sky.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The millennium-old temple on the mountain has a thriving incense offering.
summary:
- Located in the eastern suburbs of Fuzhou, it was formed 130 million years ago and has been a popular tourist destination since the Song Dynasty. It is one of the top ten scenic spots in Fujian Province.
- At the summit, there is a large, flat rock shaped like a drum. It is said that when wind and rain approach, the rock produces a rumbling sound, hence the name Drum Mountain.
- A Buddhist sacred site in Fuzhou, Yongquan Temple, located halfway up the mountain, is the most important attraction on Drum Mountain. The temple is known for the thousand-year-old iron tree, the chicken silk wood offering table, and the blood scriptures, collectively known as the "Three Treasures of the Mountain."
- There is no admission fee for hiking Drum Mountain. There are several paths from the foot of the mountain to the summit, and visitors can also take the cable car for convenience.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches; Seashores; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Preserve the original island features
summary:
Haitan Island, also known as Pingtan Island, is the largest island in Fujian and the sixth largest island in China. It is known as the "Qianjiao Island County". 
The coast of the island is winding, with a shoreline of about 408 kilometers, of which more than 100 kilometers are high-quality sea beaches. 
The main attractions on the island are Thirty-Six Foot Lake, Shipai Reef, Xianrenjing and Haitan Tianshen, as well as Longfengtou Resort and Tannan Bay Bathing Beach. 
· In addition, the stone houses on the island are also a major feature. Showing a unique flavor, it is a must-see place for tourists.

· Lin Zexu, the first person to open his eyes to the world in modern China. Lin Zexu Memorial Hall, located on Macao Road, was originally Lin Zexu's ancestral temple. 
· The whole museum is a classical garden building, which is now turned into Lin Zexu's life exhibition room. It is divided into parts such as Lin Zexu's life, Lin Zexu and the Opium War, Lin Zexu and disaster relief, water conservancy, the first person in the world, Lin Zexu's handwriting, etc., and introduces Lin Zexu's life of patriotism and concern for the people. 
There are three bluestone tablets inside, one is the imperial edict, the other is the imperial sacrifice, and the other is the imperial inscription, all of which were given by the emperor when Lin Zexu died, and were engraved when the temple was built.

shortFeatures: A comprehensive museum with Fujian characteristics
summary: Fujian Museum is a provincial comprehensive museum integrating cultural relics protection, cultural relics archaeology, history, natural specimens and art research. It covers an area of 60,000 square meters and has a building area of 35,000 square meters. The museum area consists of four buildings: exhibition hall, nature hall, comprehensive building and cultural and museum training center. The whole building has unique marine cultural characteristics, and at the same time, it combines the stone culture of southern Fujian and the ancient architectural style of Fujian. Fujian Museum has nearly 170,000 cultural relics and natural specimens in its collection, including more than 30,000 precious cultural relics. The exhibition hall covers an area of 10,000 to 20,000 square meters.

tagNameList: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Traditional blocks with rich architectural culture
summary: The blocks of Shanghang Road and Xiahang Road in Taijiang, Fuzhou, are also known as "Shuanghang". A traditional block with strong Chinese and Western architectural cultural characteristics in Fuzhou and typical Fujian merchants' cultural characteristics, including ten scenic spots in Nantai, three bridges and fishing fires.

Xizen Temple, one of the five Zen forests in Fuzhou, is a national key temple. It is located at the foot of Yishan Mountain in the western suburbs and on the south side of Gongye Road. A couplet is engraved on the gate pillar of the ancient temple: "Lishu was passed down from four dynasties to the Song Dynasty, and the bell rang the Tang sound through the ages." This is a couplet written by Zhou Lian in the Qing Dynasty, pointing out that "Xichan Temple" is an ancient temple in the Tang Dynasty. 
According to legend, in the Southern and Northern Dynasties, Wang Ba, an alchemist, lived here to "make alchemy into medicine, and point stone into alchemy". Every hungry year, they rely on selling medicine and gold for rice to help the poor people. Later, Wang Ba's "taking medicine and fairy shedding" people built a temple in his former residence. At the end of the Sui Dynasty, it was abolished. Tang Xiantong was rebuilt in eight years, and it was named "Qingchan Temple". Later, it was changed to "Yanshou Temple" and "Changqing Temple in Yishan West", commonly known as "Xichan Temple". There are 38 large and small buildings in the temple, such as Heavenly King Hall, Daxiong Hall, Tibetan Sutra Pavilion, Jade Buddha Building, guest hall, meditation hall and abbot room, covering an area of 7.7 hectares. There are also the tablet of Tang Qixingjing "The True Body in the Tower of Master Yansheng in Fuzhou Yanshou Zen Temple in Tang Dynasty", the stupa of Zen Master Huiling in Five Dynasties, the imperial pen of Kangxi in Qing Dynasty, and the murals of Qing Dynasty.

shortFeatures: Crown of Fujian Temple
summary: Yongquan Temple in Gushan, Fuzhou is the "crown of temples in Fujian" and one of the key temples in China. The temple is built on the mountainside of Gushan Mountain at an altitude of 455 meters, with Xianglu Peak in front and Baiyun Peak in the back. It has a peculiar architectural pattern of "you can't see the temple when you enter the mountain, but you can't see the mountain when you enter the temple". According to legend, its former site is Huayan Temple. In the fourth year of Tang Jianzhong (783), a dragon lived in Lingyuan Cave ("Gushan Zhi" records: "It was the first pool, and the poisonous dragon lived in it."), Pei Zhou thought that "the divine objects are flat, and it is suitable for the temple to town them", so he asked the eminent monk Ling Qiao to enter the mountain and set up a platform to recite the Huayan Sutra, which became Huayan Temple. From then on, the dragon did no harm. Now, people regard the fourth year of Jianzhong (783) as the beginning of the founding of Yongquan Temple. When Emperor Wuzong of the Tang Dynasty destroyed Buddha, Huayan Temple was destroyed.

shortFeatures: With a history of more than 1,700 years

tagNameList: Climbing to Heights; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; National Parks
shortFeatures: Traverse the Thrilling Stone Corridor
summary: The Qingyun Mountain Scenic Area is located in Yongtai County, Fuzhou City, Fujian Province. The area boasts a unique natural ecological environment, with an average elevation of over 1,000 meters. It consists of five major scenic spots: The Flower Sea Terrace Scenic Area, which is like spring all year round, with vibrant colors and lush greenery, surrounded by layered mountains; The Heavenly Lake Grassland Scenic Area, which is made up of a volcanic crater lake formed by volcanic eruptions millions of years ago and a highland meadow at about 1,100 meters above sea level; The Cloud Waterfall, with its unique formations, is connected by "two paths and three valleys." The Seven-Colored Waterfall Valley, Red River Valley, and Emerald Valley are embedded in the cliffs, with a grand bionic boardwalk linking them. The colorful flying cableway, approximately 1,000 meters long and with a vertical drop of about 360 meters, connects the mountaintop with the upper and lower parts of the canyon.

tagNameList: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A city park with Rongcheng style
summary: Riverside Park is located on Riverside Avenue and was built in 1985. There are pavilions, popular science galleries, flower beds, sculptures, etc. in the park, as well as araucaria, fake betel nut, acacia tree, banyan tree, sweet-scented osmanthus, etc. planted with subtropical scenery. It is an open park and is known as the "Bund" of Fuzhou. The park consists of seven scenic spots, namely Xihe Garden, Jinjiang Garden, Jinsha Garden, Wanglong Garden, Colorful Garden, Minfeng Garden and Minshui Garden from west to east.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
shortFeatures: A wide park in Fuzhou city
summary: Zuohai Park is the largest park in Fuzhou. It is located on the northwest side of Gulou District, adjacent to West Lake in the east, Xiangshan Mountain in the south, Guangtong Road in the west and Tongpan Road in the north, covering an area of 51.11 hectares, of which the water surface accounts for 18.14 hectares. In 1990, it was built by farmers in Hongshan Town, a suburb, with the theme of "Five Continents Scenery". In the inner square, there are sculptures symbolizing the five continents of the world in the middle, as well as the model of the Great Wall of China, the Journey to the West Art Palace, the Japanese Garden, etc.

tagNameList: Hi Play Park; Kid's Treasure Spot; Amusement Parks
shortFeatures: Thrilling Kingdom of Games
summary: Guian Happy World, covering an area of approximately 600 acres, is a nationwide super amusement park. It fully utilizes the natural terrain and landscape, incorporating dreamy and beautiful decorations, modern leisure concepts, and cutting-edge entertainment technologies. The most advanced and exciting amusement equipment and performance projects are seamlessly integrated into themed settings, creating a thrilling, vibrant, and exciting super amusement kingdom that offers visitors endless surprises and extraordinary enjoyment.

Luoyuan Bay Ocean World is located in the southeast of Luoyuan Bay Binhai New City. It gathers eight theme areas, has more than 70 marine life exhibition facilities and more than 300 marine species on display. There are 248 species of marine fish and biological species, totaling 7,562 tails (individuals), 54 species of freshwater fish, totaling 5,525 tails (individuals), nearly 100 species of more than 40 species of mammals, and more than 40 species of amphibians and reptiles. The ocean world is divided into eight theme areas, such as shallow coral reef area, children's interaction area, marine science popularization area, dream jellyfish palace area, ocean area, tropical rain forest area, amphibian area and marine performance theater. Fuzhou Luoyuan Bay Ocean World also includes sea entertainment projects such as sea fighting, yacht club, luxury boat restaurant, sea Diaoyutai, large-scale sea music fountain and water curtain movie.

shortFeatures: Cultural Relics Protection Unit in Fujian Province
summary: Dingguangta Temple, commonly known as Baita Temple, is located at the western foot of Mountain and is a palace-style building. It was founded in the second year of Tang Tianyou (905). Two years later, to congratulate Zhu Wen on his accession to the throne, it was renamed "Long Live Temple" (commonly known as Pagoda Temple). The existing temple was rebuilt during the Qing Daoguang period. The temple is divided into three halls: Heavenly King Hall, Daxiong Hall and Fayu Hall. On the left and right sides of the main hall are Huafeng Hall, abbot's room, living room and monk's house. Next to the temple is the famous white pagoda with a height of 41 meters, seven stories of octagonal angles and white ash. Visitors can climb to the top of the tower overlooking the city.

tagNameList: Climbing to a higher place and hiking up a mountain; Mountains
shortFeatures: Resembling a giant crab
summary:
Yushan is also one of the landmarks of Fuzhou, known as the "Three Mountains and Two Towers," and is located near Wuyi Square in the center of Fuzhou. According to legend, during the Han Dynasty, nine brothers of the He family practiced alchemy and immortality here, hence the name Jiuxian Mountain. Another legend suggests that it was named after a branch of the ancient "Yue" tribe during the Warring States period who lived here.

On the mountain, there are various scenic spots, including the Da Shi Hall, Dingguang Tower, Qigong Temple, and cliff inscriptions. Among them, Da Shi Hall is one of the few temples in China that enshrine a male statue of Guanyin. Yushan has 24 scenic spots, including Jiuxian Temple, the Wansui Temple, Qigong Temple, Da Shi Hall, Dingguang Tower, and over a hundred cliff inscriptions dating from the Song to the modern era. The stone corridor displays inscriptions from the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties.

Upon ascending the mountain, visitors are greeted by towering trees and ancient banyan trees with intertwined roots, creating a spectacular scene. From the top, one can enjoy a panoramic view of Fuzhou.

shortFeatures: View a bronze-cast gold bull more than two meters high
summary: Jinniushan Park covers an area of 130 hectares facing south and is built on the mountain. The first thing you see is a Jinniu Square paved with colored floor tiles. A Golden Bull cast with a height of more than 2 meters lies peacefully on the square, shining with golden light. The gate building of Jinniushan Park stands on the north side of Yangqiao West Road, like a huge white bat spreading its wings, which is particularly magnificent. In front of the park is the mighty Xihe River, a tributary of the "Beigang" of Minjiang River. Jinniu Plaza is covered with sloping lawns covered with Manila grass, and full of green is pleasing to the eye. At the end of the lawn, there is a larger square with colorful trees and flowers. Thousands of pots of chrysanthemums stretch their curly petals, and tulips and Christmas bloom in the wind.

The existing area of Yantai Mountain Park is about 2.11 hectares. It is located at the top of Meiwu in Cangqian Mountain, near the river, and its terrain is simple. According to historical records, artillery bases were built on the mountain in the Yuan Dynasty to choke the Minjiang River; Yantai was restored in the Ming and Qing Dynasties as an alarm to defend the enemy, hence the name Yantai Mountain. Now the park is equipped with stone hole bridge, stacked water rockery, stone carving, flower gallery and other facilities.

shortFeatures: Flowers bloom all year round

shortFeatures: An ancient academy renowned for producing distinguished scholars.
summary:
Songyang Academy was established in the eighth year of the Taihe era of the Northern Wei Dynasty (484 AD). At that time, it was a Buddhist site known as Songyang Temple. During the Sui and Tang Dynasties, it became a Taoist activity center, and Emperor Gaozong of Tang and Empress Wu Zetian both used it as a palace retreat on two occasions. In the Northern Song Dynasty, it became a renowned educational institution, where famous Confucian scholars such as Fan Zhongyan, Cheng Yi, Cheng Hao, and Sima Guang lectured. Part of Sima Guang's monumental historical work, *Zizhi Tongjian*, was completed at the academy. The academic activities of these renowned scholars not only made Songyang Academy the leading academy among the Four Great Academies of the Northern Song Dynasty, but also made it one of the birthplaces of Neo-Confucianism in the Song Dynasty.

The architecture of Songyang Academy follows the style of the Qing Dynasty. The buildings are well-preserved, maintaining the traditional architectural style of academies. The site, layout, and design blend the characteristics of both public buildings and residential structures. The academy covers an area of more than 9,000 square meters, with a central axis consisting of five courtyards, and a total of 106 ancient buildings. The academy is home to many inscriptions, stone tablets, ancient trees, and other cultural relics that are closely related to important events involving famous historical figures. The academy's educational system was abolished at the end of the Qing Dynasty, and as a cultural bearer of this now-defunct system, Songyang Academy plays a crucial role in the study of ancient Chinese academy architecture, educational systems, and Confucian culture. As a historical monument, it also holds significant and far-reaching importance for modern educational culture.

shortFeatures: Holy Land of Chinese Humanities Ancestor
summary:
Yellow Emperor Palace, also known as Yunyan Palace, is located 35 kilometers southwest of Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, in Liuzhai Township, southeast of Xinmi. It used to be the place where Xuanyuan Huangdi built palaces and halls, trained troops and talked about martial arts, and researched and created eight array diagrams. 
According to legend, after the Yellow Emperor lost Chiyou in the first battle, he retreated here and devoted himself to cultivating his ambitions. Using wind queen and animal husbandry as the phase, we study soldiers and practice martial arts, and put in order's soldiers and horses. Up to now, there are still ancient architectural relics such as Yangmazhuang, Cangwu Village, Baijiangtai, Palace, Xuanyuan Gate and Jiangwumen. 
The Yellow Emperor Palace is known as "the holy land of the ancestor of Chinese humanities", "the first palace in the world", and the research and creation place of the eight arts of war. The landscape here is beautiful and the scenery is beautiful. There have been many legendary stories and beautiful ballads circulating since ancient times: "It's not as good as Yunyan Palace from Nanjing to Beijing. There are three cypresses and two stones in a temple, and the queen mother sits in the air. Cypress trees grow in the cracks of the stone, and the old dragon cries endlessly. After the Yellow Emperor's wind, he studied eight arrays, and Yunyan set up a palace to gather heroes." 
Huangdi Palace is located on the north bank of Wuding Lake, surrounded by mountains and rivers, with an elegant environment. In Xuanyuan Cave, the statues of the Yellow Emperor and the Wind Hou are leisurely and vivid, as if they were talking about the past and the present, and discussing peace in the world. The lecture field, the ancestral hall, the meeting pavilion and Lei Zu's thatched cottage, like pearls, are embedded around the main hall, making the whole hall patchwork and the layers are particularly distinct. 
In front of the Yellow Emperor Palace, there is a mirror of water. Clouds take pictures in the water stream, willows and green pearls are reflected, birds and warblers are singing, and the reflection is floating and sinking, sparkling blue waves, just like a crystal palace in the water. There are three castles standing on the other side. There are two seats near the front, left and right, like palaces. Surrounded by water on the left, it is located on Lover Island, shrouded in pines and cypresses. In the castle, there are eight tablets behind the wind and small cabins with unique shapes for people to travel and vacation. The one on the right is located on Qingxin Island. The southernmost city of eight terracotta warriors is just like a screen. Hundreds of terracotta warriors and horses in the castle reproduce the spectacular scene of the Yellow Emperor and the soldiers behind the wind to create eight formations. Behind him, there was a crescent-shaped pool of clear water. From Xuannv Island through Xuannv Gorge, looking up by boat, the cliffs on both sides are amazing, and the pines and cypresses growing in the cracks of the stones are densely covered, just like the epitome of the Three Gorges. This is the "Jiulongtan", the back view of Xuanyuan Huangdi Palace. There is a small island in the pool, on which there is a "Jiulong Temple", also known as "Dragon Catching the King Temple". Next to the temple is a monument of accumulating virtue and doing good deeds. On the sharp stone rock in the north of Tanbei, there is a belt-shaped waterfall. The waterfall is like spraying silver and spitting jade, which keeps going all the year round. The sound of water rushing into the rock is as loud as a dragon's roar, like thunder and roar, and it is called "Xiangshuitan" by the world. 
Some people have made an objective metaphor for the picturesque scenery here, saying that it is "as big as bonsai and as small as West Lake". The Yellow Emperor Palace in the night is more charming and romantic. She condensed the structural relics that occurred 2.5 billion years ago, 1.87 billion years ago and 543 million years ago in Songshan area within less than 20 square kilometers. Within the area of less than 400 square kilometers of Songshan Mountain, the essence of metamorphic rocks and sedimentary rock stratigraphic sequences that are unique in the world in five geological periods: Archean, Proterozoic, Paleozoic, Mesozoic and Cenozoic are completely exposed. It is praised by geologists as a natural geological museum of "five generations under one roof". Songshan Geological Museum was founded in 2003, covering an area of 33,333 and 33 square meters (about 50 mu), with a construction area of 18,000 square meters and a total investment of 28 million yuan. Divided into front courtyard, exhibition hall and back courtyard. The front courtyard consists of gardens, squares, lighted fountains and parking. Recently, two exhibition halls were opened to the public: Earth Science Popularization Hall and Songshan Geopark Hall. The third exhibition hall is under planning and design. The Earth Science Hall uses advanced multimedia to explain the mystery of Songshan Mountain. The exhibition hall displays all minerals, three major rocks and paleontological fossils in Dengfeng area. Songshan Geopark Hall displays rocks from five geological periods, as well as Dengfeng's distinctive 1: 7500 sand table and classic landscape. The back courtyard is mainly composed of a sign tablet, and its shape is an open encyclopedia of geoscience. Rocks taken from rock strata in five different periods form a five-layer annular base, and three groups of steps respectively represent three Precambrian regional crustal tectonic movements (Songyang movement, Zhongyue movement and Shaolin movement). The diameter of the base of the monument is 21 meters (representing the 21st century), and the total height of the building is 15.12 meters (1% of the altitude of Liantianfeng, the highest peak of Songshan Mountain). Moreover, she dominates the Asian Geoscience Museum with its long history, large collection, high treasure rate, exquisite display and fruitful scientific research achievements.  
It not only has three traditional functions: collection, scientific research and social education, but also is full of characteristics of the times. There are dozens of tombs from various periods in ancient China in the museum, all of which were relocated from their original sites and restored and displayed underground according to the shape of tombs.

Inside the cave, there are eight scenic areas, including "Jade Pillar Pond," "Yicai Hall," "Folded Curtain Palace," "Cave Heaven River," "Yaochi Palace," "Hidden Beauty Pavilion," "Carefree Palace," and "Stone Forest Square." The cave is filled with stone pillars, stone pagodas, stone waterfalls, stone rivers, and stone flowers, all resembling a paradise of crystal-clear jade trees, in various shapes. The entire cave feels like a sparkling underwater dragon palace, where one can roam freely as if in a beautiful and elegant fairytale world.

tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Nature and Adventure; Caves; Grottoes
shortFeatures: Fifteen thousand small Buddhas neatly arranged
summary:
The Wanfo Cave is named after 15,000 small Buddhas carved neatly on the north and south sides of the cave. It was built in the Tang Dynasty. The cave has a structure of front and rear chambers, with two powerful men and two lions in the front room and one Buddha, two disciples, two Bodhisattvas and two heavenly kings in the back room. It is the cave with the most complete statue combination in Longmen Grottoes. 
There is a statue of Guanyin Bodhisattva carved on the south wall outside the cave, which is a beautiful example of many Bodhisattva statues in Tang Dynasty in Longmen Grottoes. 
The main Buddha in the cave is Amitabha, sitting upright on a double-layer lotus seat, with a plump and round face and wide shoulders. The simple and smooth clothes pattern uses the carving technique of round knife in Tang Dynasty. The Lord Buddha gives the "Fearless Seal", which means that there is no fear between heaven and earth, and I am the only one. 
The whole cave is magnificent, showing people the ideal land of the western paradise, and setting off a warm and cheerful atmosphere in which all people become Buddhas.

The main Buddha Lushena, 17.14 meters high, is the largest Buddha statue in Longmen Grottoes. This Buddha statue is a typical statue of the Tang Dynasty, wearing a cassock, with a plump face, a slightly curled mouth and a slight smile. 
The statues in the temple show the high achievements of sculpture art in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and are wonders in the history of stone carving art.

shortFeatures: Most of them are statues of Wu Zetian in Tang Dynasty

Dongshan Grottoes are located on the east bank of Yihe River. There used to be a saying that "a mountain in the west is not as good as a bay in the east mountain", but now the grand occasion is difficult. 
The grottoes on the cliff of Dongshan Mountain are all niches in Tang Dynasty, among which there are 20 large and medium-sized caves. Although they are not as numerous as Xishan Grottoes, they are also fine products. 
Kanjing Temple is the largest cave in the East Mountain of Longmen, and 29 Dharma-preaching Arhats are well preserved. 
Siyan Cave Siyan Cave is a medium-sized cave in the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Geese are used as a metaphor for Arhat, which is the only place in Longmen Grottoes.

Qiyun Pagoda was originally called Sakyamuni Stupa Pagoda, Jinfang Pagoda and White Horse Temple Pagoda. It was built in the Yongping period of the Eastern Han Dynasty and rebuilt in the Jin Dynasty. Qiyun Pagoda is the earliest existing ancient building in Luoyang, and it is also one of the few architectural remains of Jin Dynasty in the Central Plains. The shape of the tower has the characteristics of pavilion-style tower with dense eaves in Tang and Song Dynasties, and it adopts the method of imitation wood structure, which provides a rare physical example for studying the architectural characteristics of Jin Dynasty, especially the structural characteristics of brick towers in Jin Dynasty in Central Plains. From the shape and internal structure of the tower, the tower has high historical, scientific and artistic value. In 1961, the State Council announced Baima Temple and Qiyun Pagoda as national key cultural relics protection units.

shortFeatures: Buddha statues shaped in Wu Zetian's image
summary: Lu Shena Buddha, shaped according to the image of Wu Zetian, was built in the fourth year of Emperor Gaozong Xianheng of Tang Dynasty, that is, in 672 AD. It is located in Fengxian Temple on the southern mountainside of Longmen West Mountain in Luoyang, with a height of 17.14 meters. It is the highest artistic level, the strictest overall design and the largest scale in Longmen Grottoes. The stone statue of Great Lushena is 17.14 meters high, with a head height of 4 meters and an ear length of 1.9 meters. The Sanskrit word "Lushena Buddha" means universal light and universal brilliance, which comes from the belief of the sun god worshipped by the ancient sun god. Standing nearby and gazing at the Buddha will make people amazed. The Buddha is dressed in a shoulder-long coat, which wraps from the right shoulder to the left shoulder, covering the soothing pleats of the whole body, which is elegant and mighty. The layout of Fengxian Temple statues consists of nine statues, such as one Buddha, two disciples, two Bodhisattvas, two heavenly kings and two powerful men. According to the rules of Buddhism, the artist carved a large group of statues with different personalities and temperaments, and also showed the internal connection between these groups of statues in perfect harmony and vividly.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

shortFeatures: Peony varieties are very rich
summary: International Peony Garden is the largest late flowering peony garden and Chinese and foreign peony boutique garden in the Central Plains. It consists of Huaxia Garden, Wanfang Garden, Jinxiu Garden, Jiuse Garden and Peony Garden. There are more than 300 precious varieties of peony at home and abroad in the garden, but the flowering period is late, 7-10 days later than the urban viewing time, and 3-5 days later than other peony gardens in Mangshan. The full flowering period is generally after April 20th. In addition, there are more than 300 kinds of peony in the garden, which is also the largest peony ornamental garden in China, and it is worth seeing.

tagNameList: Former residence of celebrity; Famous Residences
shortFeatures: Luxurious arcade-style building backed by green hills
summary: Luoyang Jiang Song Villa is located on the east side of Xiangshan Temple in Longmen Grottoes Scenic Area; In 1936, to celebrate Chiang Kai-shek's 50th birthday, the local government chose to build a two-story building on the south side of Xiangshan Temple, which was called Jiang Song Villa. At that time, Chiang Kai-shek arrived in Luoyang (East Railway Station) by train from Xi'an on October 29th, 1936 in the name of "avoiding life", but actually deployed the "Northwest Communist Suppression Plan". He celebrated his 50th birthday in the villa on October 31. He and his wife Song Meiling went back to Luoyang three times to appease non-direct troops Yen Hsi-shan in Taiyuan, Han Fuju in Jinan and Fu Zuoyi in Suiyuan. I left Luoyang to Xi'an in early December, and stayed in Luoyang for 36 days, basically living in Jiang Song Villa in Xiangshan Temple.

shortFeatures: The top of the cave is carved with a large lotus flower in relief
summary:
Lotus Cave is located in Xishan Grottoes in Longmen Grottoes scenic spot. It is named after a big lotus with high relief carved on the top of the cave. Lotus Cave was excavated around the Northern Wei Dynasty. 
Lotus, as a famous symbol of Buddhism, is widely used in the decoration of grotto roofs, but such a huge and exquisite high-relief lotus flowers as the lotus cave roofs are rare in Longmen Grottoes. Feitian surrounding the lotus flowers had a light figure, a slender waist and a long dress, and his posture was free. 
A Buddha, two disciples and two Bodhisattvas are built on the front wall of the cave, and the main statue is a standing statue of Sakyamuni. One Buddha and two disciples are standing up, showing the image of Sakyamuni leading the two disciples to lobby and give lectures. The eldest disciple Kasyapa holds a tin staff and wears a heavy and wide cassock, which seems to have traveled a long distance after hard years. Unfortunately, its head was stolen in its early years, and it is now in the Guimet Museum in France. 
The left and right Bodhisattvas wear lotus crowns and have a graceful posture. 
On the upper side of the south wall, there is a small thousand Buddhas with a height of only 2cm, which are finely engraved and vivid in shape. There are two exquisite Buddhist stories in the second niche on the lower floor, with flying dancing on them. 
The lintel outside the cave is engraved with a flame pattern, and an animal-shaped shop head is engraved in the middle, with exquisite carving. At the top left, there is the word "Yi Jue" inscribed by Zhao Yan, the censor who patrolled Henan and other places in the Ming Dynasty.

shortFeatures: A large-scale open park
summary:
At present, the North Shore Scenic Spot is about 10 kilometers long and 90 meters wide. The North Shore Scenic Spot is the focus of the whole garden, mainly with large lawns. There are 30 activity squares, 14 historical and cultural squares, 10 botanical gardens and other architectural sketches. 
Transportation: You can get there by bus No.58 and No.81

shortFeatures: Architectural style of prosperous Tang
summary:
Shenzhou Peony Garden, opposite the White Horse Temple, has a strong cultural atmosphere. There are many Tang Dynasty-style buildings and large-scale cultural performances about peony themes. Peony Garden consists of Peony Cultural Zone, High-tech Four-Season Peony Exhibition Zone, Peony Leisure Zone, Peony Viewing Zone and Commercial Peony Comprehensive Zone. 
In the garden, there are rare peony stones naturally formed in the world for hundreds of millions of years, the peony king with a tree age of more than 300 years, the world's longest 100-meter national quintessence corridor-Tang Sancai peony mural and the world's largest white marble statue of Ouyang Xiu.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Museum; Fine Art Galleries
shortFeatures: View the exquisite three-colored art collection
summary: There are hundreds of three-colored art works on display in the museum, all of which are exquisite and full of praise. On the basis of Chinese traditional crafts, the three-color art flat murals in the museum are created by modern scientific and technological means, which originate from Tang Sancai and are better than Tang Sancai. It combines the ancient Tang Sancai art with the modern environmental decoration art, which makes this ancient craft reappear brilliant. Sancai flat murals adopt unique glazing and firing techniques, which make the works rich in color and bright in luster, far exceeding the artistic effect of Tang Sancai and ancient painted pottery, and are known as the treasure of Chinese ceramic art.

Luoyang Music Fountain has many of the best in the world, including the world's longest CNC running spring (369 meters), the world's largest comprehensive waterscape project (the fountain area is about 120,000 square meters), the world's first high-tech water shape (ever-changing fountain), the world's most accurate CNC positioning system (360-degree CNC swing with indiscriminate positioning), and the world's tallest and longest frequency conversion array.

shortFeatures: Di Gong's suspicious tomb next to White Horse Temple
summary: Di Renjie's tomb is a round mound. There are two stone tablets in front of the tomb, and the larger stone is written with the words "There is Tang Zhongchen Diliang Cemetery", which was re-established in the 21st year of Wanli in Ming Dynasty (1593). The two monuments are arranged horizontally from east to west, about 5 meters apart; All of them are skillful and vigorous in the first carving skills of the coiled tablet of Six Kuilong; The class bucket fell down and buried deep in the soil. One to the east, one to the west.

shortFeatures: View the exquisite folk customs
summary: Luoyang Folk Museum, located at the southern end of Xinjie, Luoyang City, Henan Province, is a thematic museum that mainly promotes Heluo culture and displays folk customs. Luoyang Folk Museum was originally Luze Guild Hall, which was built by businessmen from Lu'an Prefecture (now Changzhi) and Zezhou Prefecture (now Jincheng) in Shanxi Province. It was mainly used by businessmen from fellow villagers to transmit information and distribute materials. It was the product of Shanxi merchant culture. Also known as Guandi Temple because it worships Guan Yu, it was built in the ninth year of Qianlong in Qing Dynasty (1744). The existing dance building, bell and drum tower, wearing room, corridor room, main hall, apse hall, side hall, etc. are a group of ancient buildings with rigorous structure and unique style. It was built as Western Henan Museum in 1981, changed to Luoyang Folk Museum in 1987, and opened to the public the following year. There are 1,897 pieces in the museum collection. There are 4 first-class products, including the third Buddha of the Ming Dynasty, which is clamped with gold, 3.5 meters high, beautiful in shape and exquisite in craftsmanship; Qing Dynasty wooden pagoda, golden nanmu, 6 meters high, eight sides and three double eaves. There are 304 statues, which have high artistic value. The embroidery hall mainly displays all kinds of embroidery products such as cloud shoulders, Xiapi, Luo skirts, sachets, waist packs, costumes and gifts in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China; The folk art hall displays woodcarvings, bamboo carvings, feathers, inlays, shadow puppets, dough sculptures, paper-cutting, New Year pictures, etc., among which there are 120 woodcarvings of traditional drama stories and 213 shadow puppets. The belief hall is a restored exhibition. In the large Buddhist niche in the center of the exhibition room, there are treasures of the third generation of Buddha, the front side is the golden nanmu pagoda, and there are also offerings of the Qing Dynasty. The wedding custom hall is a restoration display of the wedding custom scenes of middle families in Luoyang in the late Qing Dynasty. It is divided into three parts: suona band, worship hall and bridal chamber, with 23 colored figures. There are birthday screens, congratulatory tents, birthday gifts, birthday furniture, etc. in the Shoufu Hall, among which the birthday screen was made in Qianlong period, with a height of 3.34 meters and a width of 7 meters.

Yihe River is one of the tributaries of Luohe River, a tributary of the south bank of the Yellow River in China. It originates from Taowan Town, Luanchuan County, at the southern foot of Xiong'er Mountain, flows through Songxian County and Yichuan, winds at the southern foot of Xiong'er Mountain and the northern foot of Funiu Mountain, passes through Yique and enters Luoyang, flows into Luohe River to Yanshi in the northeast, and merges with Luoshui River to form Yiluo River. The total length is 264.88 kilometers, and the drainage area is more than 6,100 square kilometers. Yihe River and Luohe River hold up a thick wing of Heluo culture, and "Yiluo civilization" has been praised by some western historians as "the two rivers civilization in the east". Longmen Grottoes, a famous world cultural heritage in China, are on both sides of the Yihe River.

shortFeatures: Understand the long history and culture of Drum Tower
summary: The Drum Tower of Luoyang Old Town, whose name is "Qiaolou", is located in the middle section of the East Street of Luoyang Old Town. Founded in the Ming Dynasty, it has been repaired several times in the past dynasties and has a history of 350 years. It is one of the landmark buildings in Luoyang Old Town. In ancient times, the Bell and Drum Tower was used to tell the time during the day and tell the time at night. Its foundation was to build a high rolling platform of more than 30 feet with big blue bricks. The arch door opening under the platform was a pedestrian passage, which was one feet and five feet wide and twenty feet high. There were three-foot steps on both sides of the ticket platform to climb the building. Above the arch gate, a stone plaque is inlaid at the east end with the inscription "On the Sun" and the stone plaque at the west end with the inscription "Looking at the Cloud", both of which are in regular script. He wrote a letter to stay behind in Zhongjing in the Jin Dynasty (this is the same as the name of Hangu Pass in Han Dynasty not far east of Xin'an County).

shortFeatures: Feel the Traditional Culture of Zhou Gong's Dream Interpretation
summary: Luoyang Zhougong Temple Museum is a special museum established on the basis of Luoyang Zhougong Temple, which promotes Zhougong culture and displays Zhougong's historical sites. Founded in the late Sui Dynasty and early Tang Dynasty, it is an ancestral temple dedicated to the famous politician, thinker and strategist in the Western Zhou Dynasty, the builder of ancient Luoyi and the founder of Chinese Confucianism-Zhou Gong Jidan, also known as Yuansheng Temple. It is one of the three Zhougong temples in China, and it is also a holy place for more than 150 surnames of Zhougong descendants to seek their roots and ask their ancestors for sacrifice and worship. It is a national key cultural relics protection unit.

poiName: Mausoleum of Emperor Guangwu of Han
shortFeatures: 1458 cypress plants in Sui and Tang Dynasties
summary: Han Guangwuling, also known as Yuanling and Han Mausoleum, is the cemetery of Liu Xiu, the founding emperor of the Eastern Han Dynasty. The cemetery is rectangular, bordering Mang Mountain in the south and the Yellow River in the north. It consists of two parts: the cemetery and the temple, and the tomb is located in the middle of the cemetery. Guangwu Temple, located on the west side of the cemetery, is the sacrificial temple of Emperor Guangwu. It consists of Quemen, stele gallery, twenty-eight accommodations, Guangwu Hall, etc., forming a row upon row of architectural communities of the Han Dynasty. The most distinctive feature in the mausoleum is a large number of thousand-year-old cypresses. There are still 1,458 cypresses planted in Sui and Tang Dynasties in the mausoleum. The thousand-year-old cypresses are solemn and solemn.

shortFeatures: Early excavation, rich content, high calligraphy art
summary:
Guyang Cave was excavated in the Northern Wei Dynasty, with a history of 1,500 years. It is the earliest cave with the richest Buddhist content and the highest calligraphy art in Longmen Grottoes. This cave is said to be a merit cave built by Emperor Xiaowen of the Northern Wei Dynasty for his grandmother Queen Dowager Feng. There are more than 1,000 Buddhist niches carved on the four walls and roof of the cave, with more than 800 inscriptions on tablets. It is the cave with the largest number of statue inscriptions in Chinese grottoes. Nineteen of the world-famous Wei Bei works "Twenty Grades of Dragon Gate" came from Guyang Cave. 
Guyang Cave is excavated from a natural limestone cave. There is no lotus caisson on the top of the cave, and the ground is horseshoe-shaped. A Buddha and two Bodhisattvas are built on the front wall of the cave. The main statue is Sakyamuni, wearing a double-collar drooping cassock, with a thin face and smiling eyes, sitting peacefully on the square platform; Standing on the left side of the main Buddha is Guanyin Bodhisattva with an aquarius in his hand, and on the right side is the Dashizhi Bodhisattva with a Mani orb. Their expressions are quiet and their manners are calm.

Mingtang is a hall built by Wu Zetian in connection with the ancient Mingtang system at Qianyuan Hall, the main palace in Luoyang. It was built in 688 AD. It was excavated by archaeology in 1980s. 
Mingtang is 294 feet high, 300 feet in the north, south and 300 feet in the east and west, with three floors in total: the four sides of the lower floor correspond to four seasons, that is, spring, summer, autumn and winter; At twelve o'clock in the middle layer, the upper layer is a round cover, which is held by Nine Dragons; The upper layer of the twenty-four solar terms is also a round cover, with iron phoenix on it, one foot high and decorated with gold. There is a huge wooden middle pile in the middle of the Mingtang, which serves as the main trunk of the bucket beam frame. It runs up and down and is called Vientiane Shrine.

tagNameList: Climbing to a High Place; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Canyons
shortFeatures: The vegetation is lush, and the environment is serene.
summary: According to legend, Qingyao Mountain was a resting place for the Yellow Emperor during his travels. The peaks here rise in layers, and the mountain is named after its pure blue color at the waist. Since ancient times, it has been renowned for its mysterious allure and beautiful landscapes. The scenic area currently consists of five regions: Chengya Cliff, Shizu Mountain, Zhenhu Lake, Longtan Gorge, Yuan Mountain, and Louming Cliff. Inside the mountain, the peaks are lush and green, the rocks are strange and rugged, and the crystal-clear waters flow endlessly. Rare birds and exotic animals can be seen wandering the mountains. There are numerous Dragon Mountain and Yangshao cultural sites, and traces of ancient human life can be found throughout the area. Other scenic spots include Mulan Mountain, Three Arrows, Wuluo Mountain Pond, and Tongtian Cave, among dozens of others. In spring, visitors can also enjoy the “Three Laughing Rhododendrons” that bloom and fall three times.

tagNameList: Child-friendly Hidden Gem; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Recreate the Splendid Scenery of Qingming Riverside Landscape Garden
summary:
- A large-scale Song Dynasty cultural theme park built based on the famous Song Dynasty painting *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*.
- The park closely replicates the scenes from *Along the River During the Qingming Festival*, consisting of eight functional zones and four cultural zones.
- The Southern Garden recreates the bustling streets of Northern Song Dynasty’s capital, Bianjing (today's Kaifeng), while the Northern Garden showcases the Song Dynasty's royal gardens and court entertainment, with palace architecture adorned in golden and brilliant colors.
- The staff inside the park wear Song Dynasty clothing, creating a time-travel experience. In addition, there are exciting scene performances and folk shows.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Nighttime sightseeing; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Watch the ancient-style performance of Judge Bao solving cases.
summary:
- Kaifeng Fu, also known as the Southern Yamen, was the administrative and judicial office for officials in the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty, and was praised as the "first prefecture under heaven."
- Among the various government offices throughout history, it was the largest in scale, equivalent to the Beijing municipal government today.
- The architecture is grand and magnificent, complementing the waters of the Three Pools Lake, creating the scenic view of "Eastern Prefecture, Western Temple, Pavilion and Clear Water."
- In addition to a large collection of precious historical materials and exhibits, visitors can also enjoy performances such as the "Opening of the Yamen," "Judge Bao’s Rulings," and "Fire-Spitting Face-Changing."
