shortFeatures: Appreciate traditional architecture and experience nostalgic charm; the ancient thousand-year-old culture of Lingnan folk; experience the local customs of Lingnan.
summary:
- Located in the southern part of Xiaoguwei Island, where Guangzhou University Town is situated, it has been rated as the most attractive cultural tourism destination for three consecutive years by the tourism industry.  
- Convenient transportation, surrounded by water on all sides, with Luoxi Island to the west, Bio Island to the north, Changzhou Island to the east, and Pazhou Island, where the convention center is located, across the river.  
- The natural geographical advantages and deep-rooted Lingnan culture make it a leisure cultural tourism destination combining sightseeing, entertainment, dining, and performances.  
- The distinctive streets and alleys in the Impression Park fully showcase the essence of traditional Lingnan culture, serving as a window into the ancient culture of Lingnan.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: Important Customs Trade Port in Ancient Times
summary:
Huangpu Ancient Port is a window of the golden age of China's maritime trade in the 17th and 18th centuries. It is also the hub of economic and cultural exchanges between China and the West, witnessed the prosperity of the "Maritime Silk Road", and is known as "the first pass of Guangdong and Sea". 
· Huangpu Ancient Village is an important historical and cultural relic in Guangzhou and a witness to Guangzhou's glorious maritime trade history. Huangpu Ancient Village is prosperous because of Huangpu Ancient Port, and talented people come forth in large numbers. Up to now, there are still many relics such as ancient ports, ancient ancestral halls, ancient temples, ancient dwellings and former residences of celebrities in Huangpu Village.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Guangzhou New Central Axis Plaza
summary:
· It is the new central axis square of Guangzhou. Children's Palace, Grand Theatre, Library and Museum are all around Huacheng Square. 
· There are artificial landscape lakes, large fountains and lighting squares on the square, and activities such as flower markets and lighting festivals will also be held. 
The underground of Huacheng Square is a super-large commercial square-Huachenghui, with many restaurants in it. 
At night, Huacheng Square is brightly lit, and it is impressive to enjoy the night view of Huacheng here.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Guangzhou New City Center
summary:
· Guangzhou's new urban center, also known as the Zhujiang New Town Central Business District, is a symbol of modern Guangzhou. 
Zhujiang New City, Beijing Central Business District and Shanghai Lujiazui Financial and Trade Zone are three national central business districts recognized by the central government. 
It starts from the South China Expressway in the east, ends at Guangzhou Avenue in the west, borders the Pearl River in the south and reaches Huangpu Avenue in the north, and the central axis of Guangzhou New City runs through it. 
· It is a good place to enjoy the night view of Guangzhou. Along the Pearl River, landmark attractions such as Huacheng Square, Guangzhou Grand Theatre and "Xiaomanyao" can be clearly seen.

tagNameList: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing

The park was built in 1958, bounding Longjin West Road in the east, Xiguankou in the south, Huangsha Avenue in the west and Zhongshan 8th Road in the north, where a large number of lychees were planted. 
· The park is equipped with restaurants, teahouses, dance halls and various amusement facilities, making it a comprehensive park integrating sightseeing, cultural and sports, entertainment and rest. 
Liwan Lake Park is a lake-dominated park that can best reflect the elegant and soft style of southern China. 
· The lake occupies two-thirds. It consists of four lakes: Xiaocui Lake, Yucui Lake, Ruyi Lake and Wuxiu Lake. Visitors can take rental boats and water bikes for a tour.

shortFeatures: The larger Mazu temples in Southeast Asia.
summary:
- Nansha Tianhou Temple, also known as Mazu Temple, is dedicated to the Heavenly Empress Lin Mo, and is the largest Mazu temple in Southeast Asia.
- It consists mainly of two parts: the Tianhou Temple Square and the palace complex, blending the style of the Forbidden City in Beijing with the majestic architecture of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum in Nanjing.
- At the center of Tianhou Temple Square stands a 14.5-meter-high stone statue of the Heavenly Empress, made of 365 finely carved granite pieces, symbolizing the Heavenly Empress's protection throughout the 365 days of the year.
- The highest point of the entire complex is the Nanling Tower, located at the far end. From the Nanling Tower, one can get a panoramic view of the entire Nansha Tianhou Temple, though it is currently not open to visitors.

shortFeatures: Citizen Leisure Park with High Mountains and Clear Water
summary:
Dafushan Forest Park spans Shiqiao and Zhongcun towns, adjacent to Shunde Country Garden and connected to Qifu New Village in the north, with a total area of about 8,700 mu. 
The continuous mountains in the park surround Dafu Mountain, the second highest peak in Panyu, which is 222.6 meters high, as well as large and small mountain ponds and multiple artificial lakes. 
The lakes and mountains in the park, towering trees, green grass, blooming flowers, birds singing and flowers fragrant, and a variety of palm plants create a tropical scene.

- The park has a high forest coverage rate, with verdant peaks, tranquil valleys, and green waters complementing the lush mountains, making it a popular location for wedding photo shoots.
- The park features five scenic areas: the Countryside Scenic Area, Shimen Scenic Area, Shizao Scenic Area, Tiantangding Scenic Area, and Canyon Adventure Area.
- Visitors can choose specific spots to explore, such as Shimen Xiangxue for plum blossom viewing, Shimen Golden Flower Sea for rapeseed flower viewing, and the Heavenly Lake Flower Sea, which is a must-see.

tagNameList: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing

Guangzhou's "City Living Room", which integrates cultural creativity, exhibition and trade, sightseeing, leisure and entertainment and other functions.

Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is the collective name of Shangjiu Road, Xiajiu Road and Shifu Road Pedestrian Street. Shangxiajiu is one of the most prosperous areas in the old city. 
Compared with the high-grade route of Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu's goods, especially clothing, are mainly low-grade and cheaper. 
· The old buildings on the main road are mainly arcades, and the whole street has a unique style. The street is full of high-end department stores, restaurants, etc. 
Walking on Shangxiajiu Road, you can feel the unique Lingnan business culture.

tagNameList: Cute animals; Kid-friendly treasure spots; Zoos
shortFeatures: Rare Animal Viewing and Interactive Amusement Attraction
summary:
- Guangzhou Zoo is located on the eastern section of Xianlie Middle Road and was established in 1958. It is considered one of the top three city zoos in China, along with Beijing Zoo and Shanghai Zoo. The zoo is suitable for family visits, where you can teach children about small animals, visit the aquarium, and enjoy the amusement park.
- Here, you can see China's national treasures, such as the giant panda, golden snub-nosed monkey, South China tiger, milu deer, and black-necked crane, as well as animals from around the world, including hippopotamuses, rhinoceroses, and African elephants.
- In addition to the animal exhibits, the zoo features the Guangzhou Ocean Aquarium, Butterfly House, Golden Carp Pavilion (where you can see goldfish), Amusement Park (with small rides like the carousel, bumper cars, and log flume), Fun Park, and Stone Museum. Separate tickets are required for the aquarium, Golden Carp Pavilion, Stone Museum, and amusement park rides.
- Fun Park is particularly suitable for young children, where they can have close contact with baby camels, lambs, and piglets. Additionally, the zoo's keepers feed animals such as hippos, elephants, and pelicans at scheduled times each day, and visitors can go to watch the feeding sessions.

shortFeatures: Learn about history in the landmark building Zhenhai Tower
summary: Guangzhou Museum is located in Zhenhai Tower, Yuexiu Mountain, Guangzhou. It was officially opened to the public on February 11th, 1929. It is one of the earliest museums in China. It is a specialized institution that collects historical relics of Guangzhou, holds exhibitions and conducts scientific research. Zhenhai Tower, the site of the museum, was built in the 13th year of Hongwu in Ming Dynasty (1380), with a history of more than 600 years. It is a famous ancient building in Guangzhou and is known as "the first floor south of Wuling". "Zhenhai Floor" and "Yuexiu Floor" are one of the eight scenic spots of Yangcheng in Qing Dynasty and modern times respectively. After continuous development, Guangzhou Museum now has three sub-exhibition areas: Guangzhou Art Museum, Sanyuanli People's Anti-British Struggle Memorial Hall and March 29th Uprising Headquarters Memorial Hall, besides Zhenhai Tower exhibition area.

The park is divided into 9 different areas, such as Crocodile Dancing, Xianhe Bay, Amphibian Reptile Hall and Swan Bay. Each area has wonderful performances. 
The most exciting thing is Crocodile Fishing Island, where tens of thousands of crocodiles live, which can interact with crocodiles at zero distance and absolutely challenge courage.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: "Six Themes Based on the Culture of Southern Vietnam"
summary:
Guangzhou Sunac Land covers an area of approximately 596,000 square meters, making it a large outdoor theme park with unique South Yue culture and Lingnan style. The park features six themed areas: Millennium Trading Capital, Maritime Silk Road, Lingnan Impressions, Ancient Kingdom of Nanyue, Legend of the Five Rams, and Dream Garden, which blend ancient and modern elements to offer a delightful and unforgettable experience.

The park boasts 31 high-tech amusement rides, including the immersive 8K flying theater "Fly Over Guangdong," the thrilling dual-track dual-car roller coaster "Double Dragons Flying," and the mysterious 4K+VR experience "Nature Exploration," among others. The rides offer a variety of experiences ranging from exciting to romantic, interactive to educational, ensuring something for every visitor. Additionally, there are 12 spectacular shows, including the eye-catching 3D light and water show "Silk Road Romance," the magical visual effects of "Dog Eating the Sun," and the joyous Dream Parade, all of which provide an immersive visual feast for guests.

The park not only showcases the local culture of Guangdong but also blends Western and Eastern elements, incorporating high-tech amusement features. In addition to the outdoor attractions, a series of indoor innovative temperature-controlled theaters and summer cooling projects have been created, making it a year-round theme park that breaks the limitations of seasons and weather to meet visitors' desires for fun at any time.

★★★Visitor Guide★★★  
**Fly Over Guangdong**  
A cutting-edge 8K flying theater provides a thrilling and immersive experience, with a giant panoramic dome screen and breathtaking visuals. The flight seats, combined with realistic effects like wind, water, sound, and light, allow visitors to soar through the sky, traversing time and space to enjoy the unique and magnificent landscapes of Guangdong.

**Flower Garden Wonderland**  
Enjoy joyful parent-child moments in a dreamlike garden where flowers bloom, and butterflies dance. A family-friendly, magical project designed for children, with a colorful and exciting suspended roller coaster that travels indoors and outdoors, featuring fun media interactions for an enchanting, fairytale-like adventure.

**Flower Sea Surfing**  
Ride the waves down colorful slides, experiencing the thrill of sudden drops while taking in the beauty of the surrounding flower sea, enjoying both the excitement and the refreshing sensations.

**Double Dragons Flying**  
An exhilarating adventure that will get your adrenaline pumping! With multiple thrilling ways to experience the ride, the dual-track dual-car roller coaster at Guangzhou Sunac Land allows you to choose between sitting or hanging, and the two cars race side by side, often crossing paths with intense near-collisions for a truly thrilling experience.

**Raging Seas and Furious Waves**  
A combination of water rapids and roller coaster thrills, this ride takes you through dark water tunnels that suddenly steepen or spin. Meanwhile, floods and fires rush toward you, providing a wet and exhilarating adventure like experiencing the apocalypse.

**Sky Tower**  
Experience the sensation of a space shuttle launch and the weightlessness of free-fall. In just 1.8 seconds, you are launched 59 meters into the air, only to plummet back down in a heart-pounding journey that leaves you breathless.

**Dog Eating the Sun Theater**  
An exciting theatrical performance that blends magic tricks and thrilling storytelling. With stunning visual effects and impressive sleight-of-hand, the magician’s extraordinary skills will leave the audience in awe as the magical show unfolds.

A lively and educational performance featuring animals, plants, and insects, bringing various creatures to life through a fun and engaging storyline, with humorous performances and interactive designs that lead visitors into a magical world of reversals.

**Dream Parade**  
Join the "Flower Queen" and a host of colorful characters from China and around the world in a grand and vibrant parade. Beautifully designed themed floats roll through the streets, with performers dressed in dazzling costumes, offering interactive performances and inviting you to join in the joy of this spectacular party.

**Lake Show Theater**  
A breathtaking 3D light and water show on a giant water screen, enhanced by advanced special effects. Set against the backdrop of the Maritime Silk Road, the show tells a moving story that will captivate the audience with its stunning visuals and emotional depth.

shortFeatures: Known for its compact and delicate layout.
summary: Yuyin Mountain Villa, also known as Yuyin Garden, is a private garden of Wu Bin, a scholar from the Qing Dynasty. It has a history of more than 130 years. The garden is renowned for its exquisite and intricate artistic features, with pavilions, halls, towers, bridges, corridors, and embankments all compactly arranged within a 300-step radius. The garden is rich in four major types of carvings—brick carvings, wood carvings, plaster carvings, and stone carvings—showing off the elegance and charm of the renowned garden. Ancient trees soar, and rare flowers dazzle, bringing vibrant life to the entire garden. The four major wonders of the garden, namely "Bamboo in the Side Wall," "Rainbow Bridge Reflecting the Moon," "Hidden Treasures in the Deep Willows," and "Double Greens Welcoming Spring," leave visitors in awe and make them reluctant to leave.

shortFeatures: The north and south towers are in zigzag shape
summary: The new library has a total construction area of 100,000 square meters, a collection of 3.82 million volumes (pieces) (Guangzhou Library has a total collection of 5.26 million volumes (pieces)), 4,000 reading seats, 500 computers for readers, 4,000 wired network nodes, and 100% wireless network coverage. Realize the integration of collection, borrowing, reading and consultation; With the design concept of "beautiful books", relying on the landscape of the new central axis of the city, the new museum adopts the elegant shape of east-west direction, north-south towers and unique "zigzag", highlighting the layered architectural texture, implying the overlap of books and the deposition of history and culture, and at the same time incorporating cultural elements such as arcades, which reflects the artistic characteristics of Lingnan architecture.

shortFeatures: Large western garden
summary:
Yuntai Garden is named after Yuntai Ridge and the precious flowers at home and abroad in the garden. It is the largest western-style garden in China at present. 
The buildings in the garden combine eastern and western styles, and there are more than ten scenic spots such as Friendship Garden, Glass Greenhouse, Sun Square, Waterfall Liucai and Rose Garden. Among them, the Rose Garden is planted with hundreds of varieties of roses such as Black Rose, Double Happiness, Jejoy and Moroccan Princess. 
Every year, Yuntai Garden holds various large-scale theme flower shows, and a large-scale lantern festival will be held during the Mid-Autumn Festival, all of which are worth visiting.

poiName: The Tomb of the 72 Martyrs at Huanghuagang
summary: The Huanghuagang 72 Martyrs Cemetery, also known as Huanghuagang Park, is one of the most famous martyrs' cemeteries in China, primarily commemorating the martyrs of the Tongmenghui (Chinese Revolutionary Alliance) from the early 20th century. In the cemetery, you can also see the four large characters "Hao Qi Chang Cun" (the righteousness endures forever) written by Dr. Sun Yat-sen. On both sides of the main road, which is over 300 meters long, tall pine and cypress trees are neatly arranged. At the summit of the hill stand the tombs of the 72 martyrs, and behind the tombs, on the monument commemorating their achievements, stands a statue of the Statue of Liberty. Revolutionary martyrs such as Mr. Pan Dawei, Deng Zhongyuan, Yang Xianyi, Feng Ru, and Shi Jianru are also buried here. The park also features Huanghua Well, Huanghua Pavilion, Silent Pool, Square Pool, Octagonal Pavilion, Huanghua Garden, and Tennis Corner.

tagNameList: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas

summary: Seagull Island, located opposite Lianhua Mountain in Panyu District, is an undeveloped original ecological island at the entrance of the Pearl River. It also retains the original farming methods. The main business of the island is planting rice, bananas and fish farming, and it has an idyllic scenery. It is a good place for Guangzhou citizens to travel on weekends.

shortFeatures: Location of Yangcheng Eight Scenic Spots
summary: Luogang Xiangxue Park is located in Luogang Street, Huangpu District, Guangzhou, about 30 kilometers away from downtown Guangzhou, covering an area of about 80 hectares. Luogang Xiangxue, one of the eight scenic spots in Yangcheng, is named after this park. Before the 1960s and 1970s, Luogang Xiangxue was one of the eight scenic spots in Yangcheng, and it was once famous at home and abroad. Guangzhou people formed the custom of going to Luogang to enjoy the snow in the winter solstice, which made up for the regret of no snow in Guangzhou. After traveling to Luogang Xiangxue, the poet Guo Moruo left a good sentence that "plum blossoms in Lingnan are like snow, and Luogang Xiangxue reflects the rising sun".

shortFeatures: Visit the Daxiong Hall, which was built in the Eastern Jin Dynasty
summary: Guangxiao Temple is an ancient and famous temple in Lingnan area. The history of building Guangxiao Temple has a long history. The temple is one of the four major jungles in Guangzhou (Guangxiao, Liurong, Hualin and Haizhuang). The temple has a history of more than 1,700 years. It was built in the Three Kingdoms period, and its name changed repeatedly. It was named today in the 21st year of Shaoxing in the Southern Song Dynasty (1151). In the first year of Yifeng in the Tang Dynasty (676), Huineng, an eminent monk, was ordained under the Bodhi tree in front of the altar in the temple, and opened up the Southern Sect of Buddhism. He was called the "Sixth Patriarch of Zen Buddhism", which added immortal luster to the temple. The temple of Guangxiao Temple is magnificent, with many cultural relics and historical sites, such as the Daxiong Hall built in the Eastern Jin Dynasty, the Xibo Spring excavated by Bodhidharma in the Southern Dynasty, the Skinny Hair Pei and Stone Sutra Building in the Tang Dynasty, the Thousand Buddha Pagoda in the Southern Han Dynasty, the Sixth Patriarch Hall and the Ling Buddha Hall in the Song and Ming Dynasties, as well as inscriptions, Buddha statues, myrobalan trees and linden trees, which are all precious Buddhist relics.

Surrounded by pavilions and pavilions and a lake of about 1,500 square meters, it mainly carries functions such as exhibitions, performances, education, research and public activities;

Guangzhou Liuxihe National Forest Park is one of the first batch of top ten national forest parks approved by the Ministry of Forestry. It has deep forests and lush leaves, peculiar landforms, hundreds of undulating peaks, overlapping mountains, surging clouds and myriad weather conditions. 
The park is evergreen all year round, with picturesque scenery, blooming flowers in spring and splendid mountains; There is plenty of rain in summer, and there is a scene of "silver flowing and jade pearls" in the mountains; In autumn, the golden breeze is refreshing and the maple leaves are as red as fire; In winter, the plum forest is fragrant, and it is known as "the fragrant snow in the stream".

shortFeatures: Streets with epitome of history
summary:

· Due to the advantage of duty-free things are extremely cheap, street shops are numerous with goods from five continents; But buy carefully. 
People who come here will take photos with the boundary monument stone, but due to natural weathering, it has lost its edges and corners, and some handwriting has been blurred.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Coastal defense military fortress in Ming and Qing Dynasties
summary:
The full name of Dapeng City is "Dapeng Shouyu Thousand Households City", and Shenzhen, also known as Pengcheng, originated from this. 
· It used to be a coastal defense military fortress in South China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. 
Today's Dapeng City still retains antique gates, towers, ancient streets and ancient dwellings. 
· Here you can see many former generals' houses, as well as cultural relics related to coastal defense and military affairs. It is a good place to learn about modern military history.

tagNameList: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The coastal leisure belt facing Hong Kong
summary:
It consists of two parts: the opened mangrove coastal ecological park and the Shenzhen Bay coastal leisure belt under construction. 
· Built along the beautiful Binhai Avenue, leaning against the sea and facing Hong Kong, it is a good place for walking and weekend play. 
· It's good to hike and cycle here. The coastal bicycle belt is 13 kilometers long, but motor vehicles are prohibited in the park.

tagNameList: Amusement and entertainment; Night tour viewing; Recreation Centers; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Cruise Ship Transformed Food and Entertainment Center
summary:
· Sea World, known as "Minghua Wheel", is a maritime multi-functional entertainment center with 10,000-ton wheels as the main body. 
· Anchored at Liuwan on the coast of Shekou, Deng Xiaoping stayed here when he inspected Shekou, and wrote the inscription "Sea World" for the ship. 
There are also scenic spots such as Nuwa Binhai Park, 15-kilometer coastal promenade, Time Square, China Merchants History Museum, Tianhou Temple, Left Fort, Song Shaodi Mausoleum, and Lin Zexu Bronze Statue.

shortFeatures: A concentration of oil painters
summary:
Dafen Oil Painting Village was originally just a village in Putuo. A Hong Kong art dealer brought the oil painting industry here, and later became a gathering place for oil painting. 
There are oil painting workshops in the village, and you can watch the process of oil painting on the spot on the street. You can see a lot of things about oil painting. 
You can also buy all kinds of oil paintings or custom-made them here. It's also very good to take pictures on the street. Simply walking inside is also an artistic trip.

tagNameList: Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: Admire a variety of plants and visit Hongfa Temple.
summary:
- To the east, it is bordered by Wutong Mountain, the highest peak in Shenzhen, and to the west, it adjoins Shenzhen Reservoir. The botanical garden integrates species conservation, research, science popularization, and tourism functions.
- The botanical garden is divided into six major scenic areas: Tian Shang Ren Jian (Heaven and Earth), Lake Area, Temple Area, Desert Plant Area, Fossil Forest Scenic Area, and Pine, Cypress, and Rhododendron Scenic Area.
- It features several unique garden attractions, including Bie You Dong Tian (Cave of Hidden Wonders), Liang Yi Pavilion, Yu Dai Bridge, Long Zun Tower, Ting Tao Pavilion, Lan Sheng Pavilion, and Die Gu You Lan (Butterfly Valley with Orchids), among others.
- The garden also houses a distinctive Paleontology Museum, unique garden architecture, and a mysterious plant kingdom, all of which are highly praised.
- Hongfa Temple is located here, known as the most effective temple, with a strong incense offering and frequent visits by locals who come to burn incense.

shortFeatures: Fresh Coastline B&B Town
summary:
· Jiaochangwei is the only village with coastline in Dapeng Peninsula, close to Dapeng Suo City. 
· This is a small and fresh place in the city, which is very popular among young people. 
There are more than 300 homestays of different styles near the beach, which are very distinctive.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: Hometown of famous printmaker Chen Yanqiao
summary:
Guanlan Printmaking Village is a quiet ancient Hakka village with a history of hundreds of years. 
It is the hometown of Chen Yanqiao, a famous printmaker. Now it has become a printmaking industry base, where many practitioners in the printmaking industry have gathered. 
It basically maintains the original ecological rural customs, with a strong humanistic atmosphere and artistic atmosphere. 
There are not many people living there now, only some printmaking studios and small shops. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and quiet, and it is also a good place for sketching.

It is strange and beautiful, with an altitude of about 376 meters and an area of about 1.2 square kilometers. It is like a crescent moon embedded on the coast of the West Sea, overlooking Lingding Ocean in the west and Shenzhen Bay in the south. 
It is one of the eight major forest parks planned and constructed in Shenzhen. It is divided into three parts: Pagoda Scenic Spot, Ancient Temple Scenic Spot and Sunset Scenic Spot. 
It was listed as one of the eight scenic spots in Xin'an in the Qing Dynasty, with a strong humanistic atmosphere. Fenghuang Ancient Village at the foot of the mountain is the ancestral home and folk residence of descendants of Wen Tianxiang people.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Wetlands; Tea Plantations; Towns; Flower Fields
shortFeatures: Swiss town, lake and sea of flowers
summary:
Chaxi Valley is a scenic spot in OCT in the east, which includes four tourist areas: Interlaken, Wetland Garden, Chaweng Ancient Town and Sanzhou Tea Garden. 
The most beautiful wetland garden is the four-season flower field, which is composed of colorful flower ribbons, forming a large sea of colorful flowers. 
Sanzhou Tea Garden is also very good, with hundreds of acres of rolling tea fields. You can pick your own tea, and there are also special people to fry tea, which can be taken away, but there is a charge. 
Interlaken is like a small Swiss town, with beautiful central European mountain buildings, quiet lakes and beautiful small houses. Many people come here to take wedding photos.

One of the largest marine theme parks in China, with four theaters: Undersea Theater, Ocean Theater, Happy Animal Theater and Moby Dick Theater. 
There are eight main venues: Polar Pavilion, Aquarium, Magic Tour Aquarium, Whale Shark Pavilion, Shark Pavilion, Haibei Pavilion, Science Pavilion and Model Airplane Pavilion. 
Highlights include the large polar animal world, variety shows with ocean characteristics and undersea tunnels, etc., to explain the mysterious and magnificent deep-sea world to you. 
· There are also newly upgraded luxury ocean park and other entertainment projects suitable for children in the park. Individual entertainment facilities need to be purchased at an additional fee.

tagNameList: Museums; City coordinates; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Shenzhen municipal government image endorsement
summary: Shenzhen Civic Center, located in Futian District, the central area of Shenzhen, covers an area of 910,000 square meters, bordering Lianhua Mountain in the north and the central business district in the south. It is a comprehensive building integrating the government, the National People's Congress, museums, halls and other functions. It is the administrative center of Shenzhen, the main office of the municipal government, and a place for citizens' entertainment activities. It has become the image endorsement of the Shenzhen Municipal Government and the most iconic building in Shenzhen.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Towns; Featured Neighborhoods
shortFeatures: Dutch style architecture and various flower shops
summary:
Dutch Flower Town is located in Nanshan District, formerly known as Nanshan Flower World, and later transformed into a characteristic block with Dutch characteristics. 
There are many flower shops in the town, as well as Nanshan District Flower Museum, Qianhai Park, Jiangmen Club, Dutch Bar, Shengyi Mingtang and other scenic spots. 
· The buildings here are all based on the architectural style of Dutch towns, with bright colors and amorous feelings. 
Here you can see the authentic Dutch three treasures-wooden shoes, windmills and tulips, which are suitable for taking photos and punching cards.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Art Districts
shortFeatures: Avant-garde art space and creative market
summary: Shenzhen OCT Cultural and Creative Park is a creative industry base integrating "creativity, design and art", the most distinctive creative cultural park in South China, and is committed to becoming a highland of Chinese creative design, culture and art with international influence. Turn the old factory building in OCT into a pioneer studio, dotted with bars, book bars, teahouses and other leisure and entertainment places. Various artistic activities and cultural salons will be held here from time to time. Every year, OCT Real Estate invests a large amount of money in academic research and daily operation for non-profit purposes to promote artistic development, and adheres to the principles of high starting point, high threshold and high grade, redefines and designs factory buildings that grow simultaneously with Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, integrates the diverse fields of "creativity, design and art", and builds creative industrial chains such as art, gallery, design, media, publishing, performing arts, entertainment, exhibition, photography, fashion, boutique, catering, bar and life.

tagNameList: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: See the epitome of global scenic spots and travel around the world
summary:
· A man-made theme park that integrates world wonders, historical sites, ancient and modern places of interest, and folk song and dance performances. 
· Window of the World is divided into eight regions: World Square, Asia, Europe, Africa and America. 
· The park will imitate more than 130 scenic spots such as historical sites, scenic spots, natural scenery, world wonders, dwellings and sculptures in different proportions. 
There are also folk songs and dances, large-scale performances and high-tech participatory entertainment projects, etc. In the evening, there are night shows with rich activities.

shortFeatures: Recreating the Swiss pastoral style
summary:
Interlaken is named after Interlaken, a small town on the Swiss Alps. The architecture of the town perfectly reproduces the Swiss pastoral style, which is romantic and elegant. 
There are the quaint Interlaken covered bridge, the quiet Interlaken lake, the Interlaken hot spring melted in the forest, etc. Walking on the street is like crossing Switzerland. 
Interlaken is so beautiful that it exudes romantic and elegant atmosphere everywhere. Many newcomers choose to come here to take wedding photos. 
· The Goo Goo Bell Stage has many performances every day, such as clown shows, puppet shows and small musical performances.

tagNameList: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Villages; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Hakka Water Town Customs and Farming Experience
summary:
Gankeng Village was originally an ancient village with a long history. Together with Guanlan Printmaking Village, Hehu New Residence, Makan Ancient Village and Dawanshiju, it is known as one of the top ten Hakka ancient villages in Shenzhen. The protection and development direction of Gankeng is to rebuild the central OCT of Shenzhen and give Shenzhen people a slow time. 
More than 350 years ago, Xie Wenming and Zhuo Meifa, the ancestors of Gankeng Village, Hakkas from Meizhou, took a fancy to the natural environment here and settled here and thrived. Nowadays, the Hakka people open their sincere arms and invite tourists from all over the country to Gankeng to experience and explore Shenzhen Hakka culture with an inclusive mind. 
In Gankeng Village, there are Hakka dwellings and many ancient buildings, surrounded by mountains and rivers, and the houses are connected with alleys, which are strewn at random, just like a picture scroll. More amorous style buildings such as gun towers, watchtowers, arcades and diaojiao buildings are blended into the mountains and rivers, forming a unique carrier of Hakka culture with hundreds of years old Hakka houses.

tagNameList: Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Outings; Pick-Your-Own; Farms
summary:
· Qingqing World is a sightseeing farm with a theme of leisure and vacation, and is one of the "Ten Scenic Spots of Pengcheng." It covers an area of approximately 200,000 square meters.  
· The park is divided into areas such as the Tropical Rainforest, Butterfly Farm, Jurassic Park, Forest Wonderland, and Amusement Park, all of which are very popular.  
· The recreational activities in the park include pottery making, fishing, wax sculpture, hand weaving, Chinese knot making, urban farming, making Tangshan colorful pottery prints, batik, and more.  
· Visitors can also participate in various activities at the foot health trail, thrilling suspension bridge, juice house, Butterfly Valley, tea house, barbecue area, and other entertainment facilities.

poiName: Shenzhen International Garden and Flower Expo Park
shortFeatures: Garden landscape with different customs between China and foreign countries
summary: The full name of Shenzhen Garden Expo Park is "Shenzhen International Garden and Flower Expo Park". It is the venue of the 5th China International Garden and Flower Expo, located in Huangniulong on the east side of OCT, Futian District, Shenzhen. Its planning and construction have been widely praised by people in the garden industry. The Garden Expo Park covers an area of about 66 hectares. Based on the concept of "harmony between man and heaven, common prosperity between man and heaven", the overall planning of the park makes use of the natural landform of the original site to create a natural and beautiful overall environment surrounded by mountains and rivers. According to the plan, one tower, two pavilions, three bridges, four lakes and six parks will be built in the park, and a total of 45 construction projects will be completed. At the highest point of the Garden Expo Park, a nine-story octagonal wood-like brick tower has become the landmark building of the Garden Expo Park. In order to reflect the regional characteristics of Futian District, it is named "Futa". The tower is 52 meters high and has nine floors in total. It can overlook the whole garden landscape and have a panoramic view of Shenzhen Bay. There are couplets on the left and right sides of the main entrance of the tower, "Fushan embraces green, fields shine", and the word "Fu" in different fonts is engraved on both sides of each door, fully demonstrating the traditional Chinese Fu culture.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Buildings by Famous Architects; Libraries
shortFeatures: The architectural shape is quite exquisite
summary: The predecessor of Shenzhen Library was Baoan County Library, and the new Shenzhen Library is a large-scale modern cultural facility invested and built by Shenzhen Municipal Government. It is located in front of the beautiful Lianhua Mountain in Shenzhen Administrative and Cultural Center. The new library covers an area of 29,612 square meters, with a total construction area of 49,589 square meters. It has a designed book collection capacity of 4 million volumes, 2,000 reader seats and 3,000 network nodes, and can receive an average of 8,000 readers per day.

shortFeatures: Has more than 500 old lychee trees
summary:
The whole park covers an area of 28.8 hectares, of which lakes, ponds, pools and other water surfaces account for 11 hectares; The stone trail for strolling is 6,363 meters; There are more than 20 tourist attractions such as pavilions, terraces, buildings, pavilions, waterside pavilions, small bridges and flowing water, flower corridors and bamboo paths, ancient and famous trees, strange stones and piles, etc. 
Every weekend, English Corner, spontaneous non-governmental organizations, individual theatrical performances, etc. let people participate in it, making it a good place for cultural exchange and another good place for leisure in the central area. 
Huang Qiuying is golden. At first glance, it looks like an oil painting and a dream, which makes people fall in love at first sight.

shortFeatures: Show Shenzhen History and South Guangdong Culture
summary: There are more than 20,000 pieces of cultural relics in Shenzhen Museum, including paleontological fossil specimens hundreds of millions of years ago, ancient historical and artistic treasures showing 5,000 years of Chinese civilization, and historical materials of great significance in the development history of Shenzhen in modern times. The new pavilion includes five exhibition areas: ancient Shenzhen, modern Shenzhen, Shenzhen folk customs, Shenzhen's reform and opening-up history, and wildlife specimen exhibition. The old pavilion includes two exhibition areas: marine life and wildlife.

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
shortFeatures: Watch rare birds and exotic animals from around the world.
summary: Shenzhen Wild Animal Park is located on the eastern shore of Xili Lake, surrounded by picturesque mountains and clear waters, and on the northern shore of the stormy Dapeng Bay. It is adjacent to Qilin Mountain Resort and Shenzhen University Town. It is the first municipal project in China funded by a private enterprise and the first open zoo dedicated to returning to nature. Covering an area of about 1.2 square kilometers, with a total investment of 250 million RMB, it officially opened on September 28, 1993. As the first free-range zoo in China, it integrates various features, including animals, forests, plants, and science education, within a subtropical new ecological park system. The park was awarded the "China's Best" honor by the State Council, solidifying its status among both domestic and international scenic spots and zoos. It is considered a dazzling green pearl in the Shenzhen-Hong Kong metropolitan area.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Art Museums
shortFeatures: If you like literary style, you can come here to see the exhibition
summary:
It is the first national art museum named after an individual in China, and the second national modern museum after the National Art Museum of China. 
It is located in Shenzhen Overseas Chinese Town, the window city of China's reform and opening up, adjacent to Splendid China, Chinese Folk Culture Village and Window of the World, three famous cultural tourist attractions at home and abroad, and closely connected with the west gate entrance of the Folk Culture Village. 
He Xiangning Art Museum mainly collects, displays and studies He Xiangning's paintings and calligraphy works. It will also pay attention to relevant artists, sort out and preserve historical art materials, and organize high-grade art exhibitions and fine collections at home and abroad. Through academic research on modern art and the promotion of art education, it will carry forward Chinese cultural traditions and promote China's socialist spiritual civilization and cultural and artistic exchanges between China's art circles and overseas countries. On May 13, 1995, He Xiangning Art Museum was approved by the central government for construction; Construction started on March 1, 1996, was completed in April 1997, and officially opened on April 18. General Secretary Jiang Zemin personally inscribed the name of the museum. Provide all-round services for artists, art audiences, connoisseurs and collectors, and integrate with the first-class environment of OCT cultural tourism attractions. Encourage people to ask about art, discuss works, listen to lectures and participate in creation with a comfortable and elegant environment; Pay attention to artists' individual artistic expression, build a bridge between the art circles at home and abroad and the audience, integrate artists, works of art and art appreciators, and truly promote the great development and prosperity of Chinese art. The building area of the art museum is more than 5,000 square meters. Its architectural design strives to reflect Ms. He Xiangning's character and principles of solemnity, effectiveness and moderation throughout her life. The wide square, connected with the entrance of the west gate of the Chinese folk culture village, is a living space for people to communicate and activity, and has also become a prelude to the building. Through more than a dozen wide granite steps and a pedestrian bridge more than 20 meters long, visitors are introduced into the museum step by step. The whole building is gray and white, elegant and solemn; The recessed wall is in strong contrast with the protruding glass box. The long fox-shaped wall has a rectangular hole, and dozens of green bamboos are swaying in the wind behind the wall. Before entering the main exhibition hall, a quadrangle atrium was designed. The north-south central axis of the atrium coincided with the central axis of the pedestrian bridge and the main exhibition hall, making the courtyard an important excessive space. The three sides of the atrium adopt a large area of wooden windows and doors, abandoning the cumbersome decoration, and exuding a modern sense in a simple, simple and rich traditional cultural atmosphere. The interior design fully borrows the beautiful scenery of the external environment. When visitors enjoy the exhibits on the second floor, they climb the stairs to the third floor. Directly in front of the stairs, the transparent large glass borrows the stone forest of the folk village, just like a living landscape painting. The "patio" atrium is not only filled with the interest of the oriental courtyard, but also makes the indoor and outdoor echo each other, thus enriching the visual effect of visitors. Glass ceilings are used on the roofs of public halls and other places. Under the ceiling, visitors can see the blue sky and white clouds. Through the sunlight, the light and shadow produced by the building reflected on the ground and walls add to the interest of the indoor space.

shortFeatures: Classic Citizen Park in Shenzhen
summary: Shenzhen East Lake Park, formerly known as "Reservoir Park", is connected to Wutong Mountain in the east, Yanhe Road in the west, Shensha Highway in the south and Aiguo Road in the north. There are four cultural and entertainment facilities in Shenzhen East Lake Park: Café de Coral Amphitheater, Hongli Painting and Calligraphy Museum, gateball court and tennis court.

shortFeatures: Mountaineering adventure to pursue wild interest
summary: Qiniang Mountain is the main peak of the South Island of Dapeng Peninsula, with an altitude of 869 meters. It is the second highest peak in the mountains of Shenzhen after Wutong Mountain. The forests in the mountains are lush, and there are evergreen broad-leaved forests that have not been damaged by man. Because of the abundant rainfall in Qiniang Mountain, clouds and fog are easy to form, and the cloud peaks shuttle through the endless sea of clouds, and the scene is changing rapidly.

shortFeatures: Rare waterfall scenic spots in Shenzhen
summary: Maluan Mountain has the largest waterfall in Shenzhen. The rocks in the valley form various shapes and sizes due to the erosion of water, and they are crisscrossed. The stream is crystal clear, and the vegetation on both sides of the valley is rich, with vines and wild flowers everywhere. Occasionally, a few birds and insects chirping will make this place more quiet. It is not difficult to cross here, but the scenery is beautiful, and it is a good place for leisure and play.

poiName: Shenzhen Museum of Contemporary Art and Urban Planning
tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries
shortFeatures: The building has a novel appearance and a futuristic feel
summary:
The whole building consists of Shenzhen Contemporary Art Museum and Urban Planning Exhibition Hall, which are independent and organically unified. The underground part of the two pavilions is in the form of reinforced concrete frame shear wall structure, which is divided into two structural systems above the ground-the skin steel structure system and the main structure system within the tower. Among them, the skin skeleton is composed of a large number of inclined, twisted and rotating curved steel members with complex shapes; The outer skin system is mainly composed of outer perforated stainless steel plate + inner glass curtain wall system, glass curtain wall system, slotted stone curtain wall system and main entrance frame curtain wall system. Its design concept is a crystal clear urban boulder with unique and aesthetic shape and rich internal display space. 
On the fifth floor, the two pavilions are connected with the cloud sculpture through an aerial bridge with a span of about 40 meters, forming a relatively independent and organically connected whole. As the functional sharing space of the two pavilions, Cloud Sculpture provides coffee shop, tea room service, etc. From the appearance, the cloud sculpture is a huge seamless mirror stainless steel whole. Through the unique surface and unique mirror treatment, the shapes and lights of the two pavilions are reflected to the audience at another angle. Cloud sculpture is not only a part of the architectural space of the two pavilions, but also a huge and shocking work of art.

shortFeatures: Leisure park with beautiful scenery
summary:
The park is famous for its lotus flowers. Every lotus flowering season, people come here to watch, paint and take photos in an endless stream. 
Every year from June to August is the season when lotus flowers bloom in Honghu Park. There are many varieties of lotus flowers in the lake, either graceful or charming, and their postures are myriad, which makes people linger. If you miss this period, it is also a unique scenery to come here and see lotus leaves floating on the calm water. 
The park has beautiful scenery and is surrounded by pavilions and pools. Countless citizens come here for a walk, fishing and exercise every day.

shortFeatures: Temple scale is second to none in Shenzhen
summary: Shenzhen Hongfa Temple is located in Shenzhen Xianhu Botanical Garden, backed by Wutong Mountain, the "green heart and lung" of Shenzhen, and facing Xianhu. The surrounding natural scenery is very beautiful. The temple was founded in 1985, with a short history, but its scale is second to none in the local area. On the first and fifteenth days of the lunar month, countless believers come to burn incense and worship Buddha. Walk about 2.2 kilometers from the entrance of Xianhu Botanical Garden, you can see the true appearance of Hongfa Temple. Along the way, there are green mountains and green hills, and the scenery is beautiful. There are Tianwang Hall, Daxiong Hall, Tibetan Sutra Building, etc. in the temple, with arches and cornices stacked on top of each other, which is very majestic.

Dameisha Waterfront Plank Road starts from Yantian Donggang District in the west and ends at Dameisha Waterfront Park in the east, with a total length of about 1km. There are hiking trails, trails, landscape platforms, trestles, stone arch bridges and other facilities along the way. Meandering on the steep shore of the mountain, below are jagged and mottled rocks. The rushing current surges and violently impacts the rocks, forming a magnificent landscape. On the wide platform, the experiencers enjoy the natural beauty by the sea and the wind.

shortFeatures: Visit the farmhouse and experience the rural life
summary: There are many lakes and streams, dense forests, green grass, birds and flowers, and fresh air in Shenzhen Maritime Pastoral Tourist Area. There are 10 scenic spots in the park, such as Jitang Garden, Farmhouse Village, Happy World, Garden Square, Ecological Civilization Museum, Ecological Resort, Water Town New Village, Taolinyuan, Ecological Science Popularization Sculpture Group and Mangrove Experimental Base.

shortFeatures: Like the peak of Beacon Hill, the rolling ground
summary: Located on the north side of the center of Shenzhen, adjacent to the central area of Futian, it covers an area of 146 hectares. It is a hilly and undulating land with more than ten small peaks, of which three main peaks stand from east to west, shaped like pen holders, hence their name. The main peak is 178 meters above sea level, facing the Imperial Building in a distance. From the summit, you can overlook the bustling city scenery, Shenzhen Bay, Shekou, Sheung Shui and Yuen Long in Hong Kong.

shortFeatures: White silver beach surrounded by green hills on three sides
summary: Orange Fishing Sand is located in Nan'ao Street, Longgang District, surrounded by green hills on three sides. The beach is very large and crescent-shaped, about 1,000 meters long and 50 meters wide. The sand here is particularly good, and the sand grains are very fine and white. Locals call this beach "Silver Beach" for this reason. The water here is clear and gentle. When the tide surges to the beach, it is still white on the shore. About 50 meters offshore, it turns light blue, further away, it turns dark blue, and then it becomes a blue piece.

tagNameList: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Theme Parks

· Hong Kong Disneyland, located on Lantau Island, is the first theme park based on California Disney (including Sleeping Princess Castle). 
The park includes nine theme parks: American Town Street, Adventure World, Fantasy World, Tomorrowland, Grizzly Valley, Iron Armored Man Headquarters, Anti-Fighting Base Camp, Blurred Manor and Magic Snow World, among which Grizzly Valley and Blurred Manor are unique in the world.

summary:
· A world-class theme park integrating sea and land animal exhibitions, mobile games and large-scale performances. In 2012, it won the World's Best Theme Park Award.  
Covering two major parks: Peak Park and Seaside Park, providing various scenic spots, entertainment and special project experiences.

tagNameList: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing

summary:

Lingxiao Pavilion is the most conspicuous building on the top of the mountain, and the 360 ° viewing skyscraper 428 on the top floor is an excellent place overlooking Victoria Harbour. It is recommended to come at night. The night view is very shocking.

Victoria Harbour, whose name comes from Queen Victoria of England, is the largest seaport in Asia and one of the three largest night scenes in the world.

tagNameList: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing

· It is famous for its many snack bars, including Japanese baked wheat cakes, German sausages, desktop drinks, etc.

tagNameList: A city walk; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Hong Kong Political and Business Centre
summary:
· Central is the political and commercial center of Hong Kong. Many banks, multinational financial institutions and foreign consulates are located in Central. 
· All kinds of skyscrapers and shopping malls are all over Central, with gorgeous lights and neon lights. 
· Popular shopping malls such as Landmark Plaza, Jiaxuan Plaza, Prince Building, Alexander Building and International Financial Center Shopping Mall gather designer brands and international palace-level brand stores. 
· The landscape of Central is a mixture of colonial architecture and modern high-tech buildings. Hong Kong's iconic buildings such as Legislative Council Building, Bank of China Tower and IFC International Financial Center in Central are also located here.

tagNameList: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: A picturesque leisurely outlying island
summary:
· Lamma Island, also known as Boliao Island, is the third largest island in Hong Kong. It was first known as the hometown of Chow Yun Fat. 
Nowadays, it is the first choice for outlying islands. You can walk leisurely among picturesque scenery, visit literary shops and simple fishing villages, and taste seafood feasts. 
There are traditional western food, Indian food, Mediterranean food and other specialty restaurants on Lamma Island. The most famous ones are Chinese restaurants "Longhua Seafood" and "over the rainbow Seafood", which focus on seafood. 
The accommodation on the island is mostly homestays, mainly located in Rongshu Bay, Hong Shing Ye Bay, Sok Kwu Wan, etc. In addition, there are several listed resorts.

shortFeatures: Witness the history of Hong Kong's film industry
summary:
· Designed after the Hollywood Walk of Fame in the United States, the Walk of Fame connects Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui, and extends from the Hong Kong Museum of Art to the New World Center. 
From Hong Kong's highly respected veteran filmmakers to contemporary international Hong Kong film masters, they left their handprints and signatures here, as well as the bronze statue of Bruce Lee. 
With movies as the theme, Literary Stars will be shown on the Avenue of Stars every day.

tagNameList: A boat tour; Night tour viewing; Boat Tours; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Take the Star Ferry to enjoy the sea scenery of Victoria Harbour
summary:
· It is the ferry terminal of Hong Kong Star Ferry Company located on the waterfront of Tsim Sha Tsui at the southern end of Kowloon Peninsula, close to the Ocean Terminal and Tsim Sha Tsui Clock Tower. 
· Provide two routes to Central Pier and Wan Chai Pier on the north coast of Hong Kong Island. 
· Apart from being a maritime transportation hub, it was once an important tourist destination because it was one of the main transportation points across Victoria Harbour.

tagNameList: Night tour viewing; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The temple of the three religions with exuberant incense
summary:
· Wong Tai Sin Temple, formerly known as Sik Sik Yuen, is one of the most popular temples. 
· Wong Tai Sin, where the temple is enshrined, is said to be responsive to requests. There are other buildings rich in Chinese traditional colors in the temple, such as Sansheng Temple, Main Hall and Congxin Garden. 
There is a small park next to the shrine, which is well designed, exquisite and exquisite, and has a garden scenery. The Nine Dragon Wall on the side is modeled after the Forbidden City in Beijing.  
The most distinctive feature of Wong Tai Sin Temple is its "five-shaped" architectural layout. Feiluan Terrace, Sutra Hall, Yuye Pool, Yuxiang Pavilion and Zhaobi in the temple each represent the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire and earth.

tagNameList: Waterfront beach; Night tour viewing; Beaches; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Beautiful beach, cozy and leisurely
summary:
Repulse Bay, Hong Kong, is known as "the first bay in the world" and "Oriental Hawaii". It is the most representative beach in Hong Kong. 
· Repulse Bay's long beach, wide beach bed, fine soft sand and mirror-like sea make it one of the most beautiful beaches in Hong Kong. 
TVB often takes pictures here, where the feng shui is excellent, and Hong Kong's wealthy tycoons all own properties in Repulse Bay.

tagNameList: Cable car ropeway; Night tour viewing; Cable Cars; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Hong Kong-style transportation mode with retro appearance
summary:
· It is the first motorized public transport in Hong Kong, running between Garden Road and Victoria Peak in Central.  
· The Peak Tram has a total length of 1.4 kilometers, a slope of 4 to 27 degrees, and an altitude of 28 meters to 396 meters. The stations include Garden Road Terminus and Kennedy Road Station. 
· When you sit on the cable car at an angle of 30 ° towards the top of the mountain, it feels like flying.

shortFeatures: Enjoy wax figures of many international celebrities
summary:
· Hong Kong's first interactive holographic imaging and augmented reality (AR) experience with superstars! Experience the experience created with our exclusive interactive technology, and interact with your favorite international superstars such as Jackson Wang, Robert Pattinson and Pollywood superstar Varun Dhawan! 
· Fashion Zone: Walk the fashion show under the wonderful dream, AR experience of Starlight Glimmer, and show your fashionable side! 
· Korean Wave Zone: Create unforgettable idolize moments with your beloved Korean star and Korean celebrities! 
Animation Game World: Meet your favorite cartoon characters, especially suitable for you who are still childlike! 
· Coffee Selfie Studio: Check in and take pictures while enjoying fragrant coffee and Japanese Hokkaido milk ice cream, great!

shortFeatures: The area is 35,000 square meters; Taking Garden Pool in Tang Dynasty as the architectural blueprint

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Cable car ropeway; Cable Cars
shortFeatures: Enjoy the magnificent scenery of mountains and seas; Crystal cabin bottom glass fully transparent
summary:
· Ngong Ping 360 Cable Car is the longest outdoor double-cable cable car in Asia, and has won the reputation of Top Ten Surprise Cable Car Tours in the World, Top Ten Best Cable Car Experiences in the World and Top Ten Global Cable Car Tours. 
· A total length of 5.7 kilometers, built on a hill, connecting Tung Chung and Ngong Ping. Overlooking the Hong Kong International Airport and the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, surrounded by the South China Sea, it connects Tung Chung and Ngong Ping Market. 
· After getting off the bus, you will arrive at Ngong Ping Market, which is connected to Po Lin Temple and Tiantan Buddha. It is enjoyed by a vast natural environment and combines Chinese architecture with diversified shopping and dining experiences. 
· In addition to shopping and dining, Ngong Ping Market also provides entertainment programs including: 360VR Experience Hall, 360 Stage, 360 Dynamic Cinema and Walking with Buddha.

shortFeatures: The second largest sitting bronze Buddha in the world
summary: Temple of Heaven Buddha is a statue of Sakyamuni Buddha located on Muyu Peak in front of Po Lin Monastery on Lantau Island, Hong Kong. It is located in Ngong Ping, 520 meters above sea level. The Buddha Temple of Heaven is designed and produced by the Ministry of Aerospace Science and Technology of China. The Buddha statue sits on 268 stone steps and consists of 202 copper pieces (160 Buddha bodies, 36 lotus flowers and 6 cloud heads). It is 26.4 meters high, with a total height of about 34 meters and a weight of 250 metric tons. It sits on a 3-story altar and costs more than HK $60 million. It is the second largest outdoor bronze Buddha in the world. The Temple of Heaven Buddha started construction in 1990, and it was opened on December 29th, 1993 (November 17th of the lunar calendar), the birthday of Buddhist Amitabha. It is now one of the famous tourist attractions in Hong Kong.

shortFeatures: Shooting location of God of Cooking
summary:
It used to be the shooting venue of many films such as "New Love" and "God of Cooking", which contains authentic Hong Kong feelings. 
· The stalls sell a wide variety of items, including men's clothing, handicrafts, tea sets, jade, antiques, and even cheap electronics. 
The only remaining food stalls in Hong Kong are retained, the pillars covered with various small advertisements, and the shaking head fans covered with grease are still swaying tirelessly.

shortFeatures: Rainbow walls and playgrounds set each other off
summary:
One of the earliest public housing estates in Hong Kong, located in Wong Tai Sin District, Kowloon. 
· Located close to MTR Choi Hung Station, the village is as its name suggests. The exterior walls of the buildings are colorful and orderly like a rainbow. 
In recent years, it has become one of the well-known punch-in attractions in online celebrity because of its beautiful photo effects.

tagNameList: Venue pavilion; Night tour viewing; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Multi-functional theater design
summary: The Hong Kong Cultural Centre is a modern performing arts centre located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, next to the Star Ferry Terminal, adjacent to the Hong Kong Space Museum and the Hong Kong Museum of Art. It is strategically located and equipped with advanced equipment. It attracts a wide range of first-class artistic performances, including various concerts, operas, musicals, large-scale dance and drama performances, experimental theatre performances, etc. It is also an ideal venue for film viewing, conferences and exhibitions.

tagNameList: Science and Technology Museum; Science & Technology Museums
shortFeatures: Experience the charm of science for yourself
summary:
· The Hong Kong Science Museum opened in 1992. It is located on Science Museum Road, Tsim Sha Tsui. It is a three-storey building with a sci-fi appearance. 
· Among them, 70% of the exhibits can be touched and operated by the audience, which is suitable for bringing children to play and experience the effects of science and technology on society. 
The most striking exhibit is the 22-meter-high energy shuttle, which is located in the center of the exhibition hall of the Science Museum and runs through the fourth floor.

tagNameList: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: 360-degree bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour
summary:
· Sky100 Hong Kong Observation Deck is located on the 100th floor of the International Commerce Centre (ICC), the tallest building in Hong Kong. It is the tallest indoor observation deck in Hong Kong. 
· Visitors can enjoy a 360-degree bird's-eye view of Victoria Harbour and Kowloon Peninsula from a viewing position at a height of 393 meters above sea level, as far as Macau. 
· Skyline 100 has the "five best", namely, the latest scenic spot, the tallest building, the fastest double-decker elevator, the most complete landscape and the most city center. 
· The observation deck is equipped with stereoscopic projection exhibition and 3D cinema, where you can learn about the development and customs of Hong Kong.

shortFeatures: A gorgeous turn from fishing village to city
summary:
The Hong Kong Museum of History was founded in 1975, focusing on the natural history and human history of Hong Kong, with more than 90,000 exhibits. 
· There are 1 underground floor, 2 above ground floors and attic in the museum. The permanent exhibition halls are mainly concentrated on the second floor and the first underground floor, while the first floor has special exhibition halls and souvenir shops. 
The collections in the museum are divided into four categories: archaeology, local history, folk history and natural history. There are many small projection rooms, which scroll and play relevant video materials in each exhibition area. 
· Among them, the permanent exhibition of Hong Kong Stories also introduces the ancient natural ecology, folk customs and historical development of Hong Kong through three-dimensional landscaping and multimedia theater. The scene is spectacular.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Fine Art Galleries
shortFeatures: A wide variety of ancient and modern collections
summary: The Hong Kong Museum of Art is located on the waterfront of Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, adjacent to the Space Museum. It is about ten times larger than the old museum. There are five floors in total. Each floor has two fixed exhibition areas, which are divided into Chinese cultural relics, Chinese paintings and calligraphy, Hong Kong contemporary art, historical paintings and Chinese paintings and calligraphy in virtual collections, etc., mainly ancient Chinese works of art, and there will be various mobile exhibitions that keep pace with the times from time to time. The equipment is advanced and perfect. There are six exhibition halls, lecture halls, outdoor plastic courtyards, art galleries and art exhibition services in the museum.

shortFeatures: The architecture takes Jiangnan garden as the theme
summary: Kowloon Walled City Park is located in one of the most historic sites in Hong Kong. It consists of a 6.5-acre walled city surrounded by solid stone walls, six lookout towers and four gates. It was built between 1843 and 1847. In the history of Hong Kong, Kowloon Walled City is the only Hong Kong territory that has not been ceded or leased to Britain, covering an area of 29,000 square meters. In 1994, it was built into a Chinese garden with Hong Kong characteristics.

shortFeatures: Old Hong Kong style street with strong market atmosphere
summary:
Temple Street, also known as Men's Street, is named after Tin Hau Temple in Yau Ma Tei. It is a popular location for Hong Kong movies. 
Although it is only a short street, it condenses the most authentic Hong Kong culture. 
· Temple Street is famous for its night market selling cheap goods, and is known as Hong Kong's civilian nightclub.

shortFeatures: Main roads in Kowloon area
summary:
· Nathan Road is one of the most famous streets in Hong Kong, with a total length of about 3.6 kilometers, running through almost the whole central area of Kowloon. 
There are many shops on both sides of the street, and the signs are stacked on top of each other. After the lights are lit at night, it is extremely bustling. 
There are many scenic spots on both sides, such as Yau Ma Tei Police Station, Kowloon Park, Temple Street, etc., which often appear in Hong Kong dramas such as TVB. 
At the end of Nathan Road is the famous Victoria Harbour, where you can enjoy the invincible night view. The surrounding Tsim Sha Tsui Bell Tower, Hong Kong Museum of Art, Space Museum, etc. are also quite good.

shortFeatures: Where the mountains meet the sea
summary:
· Sai Kung is located in the eastern part of the New Territories, with beautiful scenery. Many Hong Kong people like to spend weekends here. It is known as the back garden of Hong Kong. 
· Hundreds of years ago, this place was the business center of nearby guests. The small streets are narrow, like a maze, and it retains a strong former appearance.  
· Immediately after passing the city center, there are country parks and beaches, where you can do leisure activities such as sea activities, hiking and mountaineering.

shortFeatures: Larger city parks in Kowloon
summary:
· Kowloon Park is the largest park in downtown Kowloon. It has been opened since 1989. It has a large area of green forests, attracting a large number of birds to inhabit. 
There are not only lush trees in the park, but also comic walk of stars, cultural relics discovery hall, children's adventure park, maze garden, etc. It is a good place for walking and leisure. 
· There is the world's first cartoon-themed Avenue of Stars here, which displays the handprints of Hong Kong cartoonists and painted sculptures of classic characters in Hong Kong cartoons. 
· In addition, there are also a comic history and development gallery and a comic education gallery to display the history of comic development in Hong Kong, comic production process and comic manuscripts.

tagNameList: Waterfront beach; City Walk; Seashores; Featured Neighborhoods
shortFeatures: Stroll Beach Surf BBQ
summary:
· It is a beautiful town at the southern tip of Hong Kong Island. It was once a British military stronghold and the administrative center of Hong Kong Island. 
· Stanley Main Beach and St. Stephen's Bay are frequented by tourists. Whenever the sun rises, the glow forms a red column on the water surface, which gains the reputation of "Stanley Morning Glow". 
The landmark buildings are Murray Building and Bugong Pier. Murray Building retains the classical Victorian architectural style and is a good choice for shooting retro blockbusters. 
· Most of the goods sold in Stanley Market are tourist souvenirs, such as postcards, T-shirts and accessories printed with Hong Kong scenic spots.

tagNameList: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Play on the beach, watch the sunset and eat seafood food stalls
summary:
· Cheung Chau Island is located between Lantau Island and Lamma Island. Cheung Chau is called Cheung Chau because of its long and narrow island shape, large at both ends and thin in the middle. 
· This is the most densely populated island in the outlying islands district. It is one of the few places in Hong Kong that maintains the characteristics of an old fishing port and lives leisurely. 
Hong Kong film and television dramas are often shot here, retaining the traditional style and having the charm of old villages. This is also the hometown of McDull.

tagNameList: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Ferris Wheels; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A bird's eye view of the beautiful Victoria Harbour
summary:
Hong Kong Central Ferris Wheel is a giant 60-meter-high Ferris wheel in Hong Kong, located on the Central Waterfront Promenade. The ride time of the Ferris wheel is 15 to 20 minutes each time, with about 2 to 4 turns. 
· Sitting on the Ferris wheel, you can overlook Kowloon Peninsula and Hong Kong Island, and you can have a bird's eye view of Victoria Harbour from high altitude. 
· The overpass between the Central MTR and the Central Ferry Terminal is an excellent angle for photographing the Ferris Wheel, and you can get a panoramic view of the Ferris Wheel and the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center without obstruction of sight. 
· There is constant temperature equipment in the carriage, so there is no problem whether you ride in summer or winter.

poiName: Hong Kong Zoological and Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: More than 1000 kinds of tropical and subtropical flora and fauna
summary:
There are more than 1,000 species of plants in the park, most of which come from tropical and subtropical regions. Including major local and foreign varieties in Hong Kong, such as pine and cypress, fig, palm, eucalyptus, magnolia, camellia, rhododendron and spring feather. There is a "Medicinal Botanical Garden" in the south of the park, while shrubs and plants are concentrated in the fountain platform garden, where colorful flowers are often planted. The park collects and records rich animals and plants in detail. The main purpose of the outdoor learning activities is to promote the contribution of the park to fauna and flora, and to enable students and the public to have a better understanding of animals, plants, biodiversity and the environment through explanations and educational labels.

shortFeatures: Larger parks in central Hong Kong
summary:
Causeway Bay for short is one of the busiest areas in Hong Kong, with many shopping malls and endless crowds; You may not have noticed that there is a Victoria Park nearby, which is about the size of Causeway Bay shopping district. The park is lined with trees, and there are many indoor and outdoor sports venues. Many Hong Kong people love to have a rest here. 
 
Victoria Park is also one of the largest parks on Hong Kong Island, covering an area of about 19 hectares. Many large-scale activities are held here throughout the year, such as the Lunar New Year Flower Market, the Mid-Autumn Festival Lantern Gala, and the "Industrial Exhibition" at the end of the year.

shortFeatures: Bird's Eye Point Observation Deck overlooking the park
summary:
This garden has a bird watching garden that simulates the tropical rainforest environment, and raises more than 150 species of birds. There is a 200-meter-long wooden bridge in the park, which is as high as the canopy, and winds the whole park. Visitors can stroll and enjoy it. The cascade garden with rich water features, the garden square for impromptu performances and the center of withered plastic, ceramic and plate painting all give visitors a refreshing feeling.
