tagNameList: Natural landscape; Caves; City Parks; Wetlands
shortFeatures: View wetland landscape, animals and plants
summary: Hong Kong Wetland Park is divided into two parts: visitor center and wetland reserve, and has a wide variety of animals. At the entrance of the visitor center, there are people watching exhibitions, selling goods, watching short films, and a Café de Coral selling food. There is also an indoor play area (swamp adventure), while the wetland reserve is a large wetland environment, including waterwater swamps, pools, reed beds, mudflats, mangroves, grasslands and woodlands, etc., where you can enjoy all kinds of wildlife at close range.

tagNameList: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Shopping, leisure, mountaineering, hydrophilic dream park
summary:
· The largest island in Hong Kong, twice the size of Hong Kong Island. 
There are Tai O fishing village with traditional Lingnan style, as well as the world's largest outdoor bronze sitting Buddha Temple of Heaven and Hong Kong Disneyland. 
· There is also the Ngong Ping Cable Car, the longest double cable road in Asia, overlooking Lantau Island.

shortFeatures: A tall hut built on the water
summary:
· Tai O, located on an outlying island, is the earliest developed fishing village on the island. The tall shacks built on the water are the characteristic of Tai O. 
· Fishing villages are far away from the hustle and bustle of urban areas and less affected by urbanization, so they still retain the features of early Hong Kong fishing villages. 
· The vertical and horizontal waterways and water shacks constitute a unique feeling of water town and fishing village scenery, so it is known as the Venice of Hong Kong. 
· The traditional salted fish, shrimp paste and fish maw here are very famous. When you set foot in Tai O, you will feel the strong taste of the sea.

shortFeatures: Walk on the dock and feel the sea breeze blowing on your face

tagNameList: Landmark viewing; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
summary:
· Golden Bauhinia Square, located next to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center, was set up to commemorate Hong Kong's return to the motherland. 
· The square is surrounded by Victoria Harbour on three sides, in the center of Victoria Harbour, opposite Tsim Sha Tsui on the other side. 
· A must-visit punch-in place in Hong Kong, a flag-raising ceremony will be held every day in the square. 
· GBS is a public open space for all members of the public, residents and tourists, and it is a good place to view.

tagNameList: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: Asia's first water roller coaster
summary:
· It is one of the largest ocean theme parks in the world, and it is also the world's first unique design that combines large-scale amusement facilities with precious animal exhibition areas. 
· It has Asia's first flying roller coaster with the longest track, Asia's first water roller coaster, the world's largest aquarium and acrylic glass, etc. 
The aquarium won five Guinness World Records at the same time, and there are as many as 15,000 exotic fish of different species in the aquarium.

tagNameList: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Strolling in the sea breeze and looking at Macau
summary:
· Lovers Road is the business card of Zhuhai, about 28 kilometers long. Popular attractions along the way include Jiuzhou Port, Seaside Swimming Pool, Zhuhai Fisherman Girl, Xianglu Bay, etc. 
· Walking on the road, you can look at the sea, blow the sea breeze, look at Macau on the other side, and enjoy a leisurely and pleasant time. 
If you are physically strong, you can ride the whole journey. Special bicycle rental services are provided near Gongbei or at the entrance of Mingting Park (Yeli Island).

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Touring the mountains and waters, eating seafood, and overlooking Hong Kong.
summary:
- The only island in Guangdong where you can see the urban area of Hong Kong, with a climate that is spring-like all year round. The island's three beaches—Lingding Bay, Ta Bay, and Dadong Bay—offer the highest quality sand.
- The island provides barbecue and camping facilities. Visitors can enjoy activities such as diving and sea fishing, and can also rent boats to visit nearby small islands. The island is abundant in sea urchins, helmet crabs, and dog’s paw snails, all at affordable prices.
- Climbing to the main peak of Lingding Island offers a panoramic view of the entire island. The unique rock formations and misty clouds at the summit create a captivating scenery. Near the Lingding Bay arch bridge, there is a couple’s path, a great spot for mountain and sea views.
- It is a perfect place to clear your mind, take a leisurely stroll, climb step by step, and explore the island's scenery, where tranquility and bustle coexist, sometimes without even realizing it.

· The Yuanming New Garden is based on the architecture of the Old Summer Palace in Beijing before it was burned down, with 18 of the 40 famous views of Yuanmingyuan selected and built to a 1:1 scale. It is divided into three main scenic areas: the Royal Architecture Group, the Jiangnan Garden Architecture Group, and the Western Architecture Group, showcasing the prosperity of the Qing Dynasty.

· The central axis of the garden includes landmarks such as the Hall of Supreme Harmony, the Nine Provinces' Clear and Tranquil Retreat, and the Pengdao Yao Tai, with more than ten Jiangnan garden-style buildings surrounding the lake. Additionally, performances like "Dreaming Back to the Old Summer Palace" are staged, combining elements like explosions and horse racing, making it worth a visit.

tagNameList: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Walk and ride around the island to watch the sunrise and sunset
summary:
· Connected with the downtown area by Haiyan Bridge, it is the nearest island to Zhuhai. The island is not large, and it only takes about forty minutes to walk around the island. 
The geographical location of Yeli Island is very convenient, and many tourists will stop by when walking along Lovers Road. 
There are four small peaks on the island. Yeli Mountain is the highest mountain on the island, with pleasant scenery. It is suitable for bathing in the sea breeze and enjoying the sunrise and sunset here. 
· Zhuhai Opera House, located on the waterfront of Yeli Island, is the only opera house built on an island in China. Its shell-like design is full of artistic sense.

tagNameList: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Take the ropeway to the summit and overlook the mountains and seas
summary:
Shijingshan Park is surrounded by mountains and rivers, integrating viewing stone scenery, climbing high and looking into the distance, children's play and extreme sports. 
At present, there are five areas in the park: mountain top scenic spot, mountainside stone scenic spot, lakeside recreation area, cableway slide area and large amusement park area. 
· Take the Shijingshan cableway to the top of the mountain, overlooking Xianglu Bay, Macau and Zhuhai, and it is the best sightseeing spot in Zhuhai. 
There is also a 630-meter-long pipe-rail slide from the top of the mountain to the bottom of the mountain, which can experience the fresh excitement of crossing the jungle, but both the cableway and slide need to be paid extra.

tagNameList: Close to nature; A treasure spot for walking kids; Beaches; Seashores; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Experience tropical charm and visit historical sites.
summary:
- Dong'ao Island is lush with vegetation, with a forest coverage rate of about 80%. The island has fully preserved its original natural ecological environment, offering unique natural landscapes and captivating scenery.  
- Nansha Bay is the most famous beach on the island, with warm and fine sand. Visitors can collect seashells, catch crabs, take photos, and play in the water, making it a very pleasant experience.  
- In addition, the island also has historical sites, including the Dong'ao Island Fort, built during the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty to defend against foreign invasions.  
- The island is rich in marine products, and a seafood feast is a must. Most of the fish are caught by the islanders, offering good value for money.

shortFeatures: A bathing beach in the city
summary:
· The seaside swimming pool is located on the east coast of Zhuhai city, and it is one of the places for local people to relax and entertain during holidays. 
The beach environment is good. It is divided into two areas: simple swimming pool and water amusement projects. There are also some water amusement facilities where you can enjoy yourself. 
· The seaside swimming pool is also a good place to enjoy the sun and sea water, and there are bars, restaurants and other leisure facilities and services nearby.  
· At night, there are all kinds of barbecues on the beach, which you can taste.

shortFeatures: The scenery of mountains and sea is integrated
summary:
· Waterfront Park is located between Haibin South Road and Xianglu Bay, and the sculpture of "Zhuhai Fisherman Girl", the symbol of Zhuhai, is erected on the rock of Waterfront Park. 
· This is an ordinary local citizen park. The park environment is very good, with tree-lined roads in the park, a quiet environment, and mountain and sea views are integrated. 
As Yeli Island, Lovers Road and Shijingshan Park are nearby, tourists will visit this free park.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Play Chimelong Ocean Kingdom and visit the Free Trade Zone
summary:
Hengqin Island is divided into two islands: Big Hengqin and Little Hengqin. It is named after its shape like two guqins. It has a natural landscape of ten steps and one waterfall and hundreds of steps and thousands of trees. 
There are still remains of the ancient naval battles between the Song and Yuan armies, as well as Tianhu Scenic Area, Sandie Spring, Ocean Paradise, Shibo Garden and other scenic spots. 
Close to Macau, it is a new urban area with some scenery, suitable for entertainment and shopping. In addition, it is also a famous oyster resort in Zhuhai.

tagNameList: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: The original ecological island with white sand and blue sea
summary:
· Located in the archipelago in the southeast of Zhuhai, south of Wailingding Island, it is named after the sea temple on the island. 
The sand in Miaowan is white and crystal clear, the sea water is clear and blue, and there are red coral groups on the seabed. 
· Mainly playing by the seaside, you can do fishing, diving and other activities. The folk customs are simple, and it is a good place for photographers to collect materials.

shortFeatures: 360-degree immersion experience the romantic underwater world
summary:
· Whale Shark Pavilion is a record-breaking marine fish exhibition hall with five Guinness World Records. It is the "largest marine fish exhibition hall in the world" and has the "largest acrylic glass". 
· Walk along the curved underwater promenade, thousands of rare fish swim by you, and the circular dome reveals the colorful underwater world. 
· If you want to experience the most magnificent view on the seabed, you have to come to the glass viewing screen with a height of 8.3 meters and a length of 39.6 meters. In addition to the largest fish-whale shark, there are also devil fish with a diameter of 4 meters. 
· You can also experience "overnight under the sea" here, "sleep" with eight whale sharks in the premier marine fish exhibition hall, and experience a peculiar journey completely different from daytime.

tagNameList: Theatre Theatre; Venue exhibition hall; Theater
shortFeatures: The Grand Theatre with a prominent marine style
summary:
· A beautiful landscape on Lovers Road, it is the only opera house built on an island in China. 
The design scheme of Zhuhai Grand Theatre not only comes from the unique marine species "Sun Moon Shell", but also refines the image of "shell" and further expresses the significance of space with modern building materials and technologies. 
· The large shell "Ribei" is 90 meters high and can accommodate nearly 1,600 people, while the small shell "Yuebei" is a multi-function hall with a capacity of 500 people. When watching it during the day, it is clear and milky white; When the lights on the shells are on at night, it is a dazzling giant screen light dance show. 
· On the official website, you can check and book the performances of the Opera House, which is also a good pastime to visit Zhuhai.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Statues/Sculptures; Nighttime sightseeing

summary:
· The statue of Zhuhai Fisherman Girl stands on the banks of the beautiful Xianglu Bay in Zhuhai and is an iconic landscape of Zhuhai. 
Pan He, a famous Chinese sculptor, designed this stone sculpture according to the beautiful legend of fishermen in the South China Sea. Generally, tourists who come to Zhuhai will come here to take photos. 
· She wore pearls and fishing nets, and held high in her hands a round and huge pearl-like treasure, with a vivid look of love.

tagNameList: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
shortFeatures: Chinese star-rated hot springs; Gathering different styles of hot springs around the world
summary:
Hot spring water originates from the depths of the sea, and the water quality is clear and transparent. 
The architectural style combines the essence of Chinese and western architectural cultures, such as Turkish-style palace baths, Chinese traditional architectural style Tang Palace Huaqing Pool, Japanese architectural style Atami, and hot spring cultures that can travel around the world without going abroad. 
You can head to the outdoor area and soak in the hot springs while enjoying the stunning sunset at sea under the sea breeze; Or go to the garden area to feel the tropical primitive customs. Indoor hot springs are like spring all the year round, unaffected by weather and seasons, and are also very popular with tourists.

Jintai Temple was formerly known as Jintai Jingshe. At the end of the Southern Song Dynasty, the Song army was severely defeated by Yuan soldiers. Prime Minister Lu Xiufu threw himself into the sea with the young Emperor Xiangxing on his back, while the exiled ministers Gong Xingqing and Deng Guangjian sneaked into Huangyang Mountain to live in seclusion and named their residence Jintai Jingshe. Therefore, it can also be said that Jintai Temple is a symbol of the history of blood and tears in the Southern Song Dynasty. Until the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty, Jintai Temple was renovated and expanded on a large scale. Because of its deep mountains and forests, it was quite Zen, and it was gradually crowded with people and incense. Now it has become one of the famous temples in Zhuhai for good men and women to worship. Nowadays, Jintai Temple is full of green and shade, with pines and cypresses everywhere. It has been rated as one of the 20 Buddhist civilized temples in China. This is also thanks to the good fruits of painstaking afforestation by monks and believers in Jintai Temple for many years. It stems from the fact that the Wubao Reservoir in the temple has been supplied to tens of thousands of people at the foot of the mountain without exceeding the standard of pollution, and it also depends on the awareness of environmental protection of monks. Whenever visitors climb the boxwood and get here, they all feel relaxed and happy.

It has held 16 art exhibitions and 12 educational activities. Guangdong Province's bases for patriotism education, social science popularization, environmental education, confidentiality education and ideological education for students in primary and secondary schools are located in Zhuhai Museum.

You will find that penguins move slowly and awkwardly in the snow, but when they jump into the water, their movements will be as fast as lightning, and they will draw stealth tracks in the water!

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Theater Theatre; Historical Architectures

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Memorial Temples

summary: Tangjiawan is located on the west bank of the Pearl River Estuary, facing Lingding Ocean in the east, and Fenghuang Mountain and Danan Mountain in the west and northwest are towering and steep, all the way east, forming the Tangjia Peninsula. Qi'ao Island in the east echoes Venus Island and Tangjia Peninsula in the sea in the west, and the three are in the trend of "double dragons playing with pearls", forming the natural wonder of Tangjiawan. Tangjiawan is also a place where talented people come forth in large numbers. Tang Guoan, the first president of Tsinghua University, Tang Disheng, a famous Cantonese opera artist, and Gu Yuan, a famous Chinese printmaker, were all born in this treasure land.

tagNameList: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: An island with magical colors
summary: Wanshan Island is an island full of wild interest and magical colors. There is Pumice Bay, which is called "the wonder of Asia". It has the longest history and the largest scale, lasting for more than 100 years, and has strong island characteristics of Mazu Festival. There are also unique sea erosion landforms. There are the only well-preserved island Quaternary glacial nicks in the country.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas

shortFeatures: Enjoy the scenery of Zhuhai and Macau from the top of the top
summary:
Banzhangshan Forest Park, with an altitude of about 274 meters, has a green forest vegetation coverage rate of 80%, and its vegetation type is southern subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forest community. Natural tree species mainly include Yinxiang, Chinese tallow tree, duck's foot tree, microphylla ficus, alpine ficus, peacock bean, mountain longan, Acacia Taiwan Province, Acacia macrophylla, according to tree types, monkey earrings, etc. The southern subtropical monsoon climate is rich in heat and abundant rainfall. 
Banzhangshan Forest Park has a beautiful forest environment, rich biological resources, concentrated natural landscape and cultural landscape, surrounded by green hills, lush and green. It has ornamental, cultural and scientific value and a certain scale. After scientific protection and moderate construction, it is an area for people to visit, rest, recuperate or carry out scientific and cultural activities.

· Nanshawan Beach is the most prestigious beach swimming pool in Wanshan Islands, enjoying the reputation of "Diamond Beach". 
Although the beach is not big, its terrain is gentle, and it has the reputation of sloping beach, white sand, clean water and soft waves. It is suitable for swimming, fishing, berthing and sea entertainment. When the tide is low, you can also pick up crabs and shellfish here, which is very interesting. 
Nansha Bay has opened sports such as motorboat, kayaking, banana boat, sailing, diving, etc. If you are interested, you can also try your skills.

You need to climb to the top of the mountain to get there. Along the way, you will pass through Acacia Forest, Beidi Morning Bell, Wishing Well and other scenic spots. The scenery is very beautiful.

The temple architecture is magnificent
summary: Putuo Temple is one of the four scenic spots in Foshan, which covers an area of more than 400,000 square meters. The ancient architectural art in the scenic spot is exquisite, with yellow walls and tiles in the palace, cornices and cornices, and a "Dalu Bronze Bell" weighing 7,000 kg hanging in the bell tower. The Buddha statue is exquisite in shape and magnificent in posture. There are many long-lived turtles in the pond of the temple, which has become one of the highlights of Putuo Temple.

shortFeatures: Watch the vigorous swimming stroke of polar bears
summary: The main animals on display are brown bear, polar bear and snow fox. tagNameList: Celebrity residence; Historic buildings; Famous Residences; Monuments; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Plant more than 500 century-old trees
summary: The paradise is located at the northwest foot of Efengling, Tangjiawan Town, Zhuhai City, covering an area of 350 mu, including 177 mu of historical land and 50 mu of core scenic spots. It was founded in the second year of Xuantong in Qing Dynasty (1910), and was originally the private garden of Mr. Tang Shaoyi, the first cabinet prime minister of the Republic of China. Originally named Xiaolinglong Mountain Pavilion, it was renamed "Common Paradise" in 1915 to express its willingness to have fun with the people. In 1932, when Mr. Tang Shaoyi was a member of the Standing Committee of the Southwest Administrative Affairs Committee of the National Government and the county magistrate of Zhongshan Model County, he officially donated the garden to Tang villagers for joint ownership. Up to now, there are more than 400 century-old trees in the park, and there are cultural relics such as "Garden Villa", "Stargazing Pavilion", "Carrier Pigeon Nest", "Yipin Stone Lion" and "Yellow Wax Stone". In 2001, Gongyuan was rated as one of the ten scenic spots in Zhuhai; In 2008, it was announced as a cultural relics protection unit in Guangdong Province.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests; Wetlands
shortFeatures: Mountains covered by virgin forests
summary:
Phoenix Mountain, located in the north of Zhuhai City, has a forest vegetation coverage rate of about 90%, and its vegetation type is southern subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forest community. There are many kinds of trees, mainly including Yinxiang, Chinese tallow tree, duck's foot tree, Ficus microphylla, Ficus alpina, Peacock bean, Longan, etc. All the forest lands in Fenghuang Mountain have been classified as national ecological public welfare forests. 
The topography of Phoenix Mountain area is rich and diverse, with many mountains and peaks. The peaks with an altitude of more than 150 meters include Phoenix Mountain, Dananshan Mountain, Xiaonanshan Mountain, Dajingding, Loquat Land, Baiheding, Wangtianshi, Jianshan Mountain, Zhenzipaiding, Honghua Mountain, Nanguoshen Mountain, Zhoukeng Mountain, Jingdong Mountain, Baishaling, Yaguimen, etc.

Lijiang River is a typical area of karst terrain, known as Baili Lijiang River and Baili Gallery. 
The pattern on the back of the new version of RMB 20 yuan is a section of the Lijiang River landscape. 
· The Lijiang River has various flavors in different weather, with reflections of green peaks on sunny days, clouds and mists on cloudy days, and misty rain like a dream on rainy days. 
· The main ways to visit the Lijiang River are boat, bamboo raft and hiking. Boat is divided into essence tour, Yangshuo water upstream and urban water upstream.

Elephant Trunk Mountain is the main body, located at the southern end of Binjiang Road, where the Taohua River flows into the Lijiang River in the city. It is named after its mountain shape resembles a giant elephant drawing water from the river. 
The vivid image is fascinating, and it is regarded as the representative of Guilin's landscape and the symbol of Guilin City. The central design of Guilin's city emblem is Xiangshan Mountain. 
Xiangshan Park is lonely and steep, with ancient rocks, vines climbing between cliffs, and mountain banyan attached. It has always been a tourist attraction, with beautiful scenery, magical images and moving legends, and many scholars have been dumped.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly treasure spots; Nature and adventure; Hiking; Terraced Fields; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The lines are as majestic as flowing clouds and cascading water.
summary:
· The Longji Terraces are a vast network of terraced fields in the Guilin region, divided into three parts: Jinkeng Terraces, Ping'an Zhuang Terraces, and Longji Ancient Zhuang Village Terraces.  
· Visitors to Longji Terraces usually engage in hiking, sightseeing, and photography, with many photography enthusiasts coming specifically for the sunrise. Local farmhouse dishes can also be sampled, offering an experience of the ethnic minority culture.  
· Scattered throughout the terraces are villages of the Yao and Zhuang people. Every year, during the Red Yao "Clothing Drying Festival," families hang out their colorful clothes and skirts to dry, creating a spectacular and vibrant scene.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Rivers; Mountains
shortFeatures: Landscape sightseeing belt suitable for cycling
summary:
Yangshuo Shili Gallery is located in Moon Mountain, Yangshuo. It is called Yangshuo Shili Gallery because of its beautiful scenery and picturesque poetry along the road. 
· The best way to enjoy Shili Gallery is by bicycle. The government has set up many observation decks and rest pavilions along the way for tourists to rest. 
In early spring, this is the best place to see rape blossoms. 
If you have plenty of time, you can combine cycling tour of Shili Gallery with rafting on Yulong River, first drift to Gongnong Bridge, and then ride back.

tagNameList: Treasure spots for kids; historical buildings.; Featured Neighborhoods; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Old Street with a Blend of Chinese and Western Architectural Style for Nightlife
summary:
- West Street, with a history of over 1,400 years, is the oldest and most bustling street in Yangshuo, and one of its important tourist attractions.  
- The name "West Street" is a combination of words like dining, shopping, and bar-hopping. Because of its vibrant and diverse atmosphere, it has become a unique and beautiful scenic spot in Yangshuo.  
- The street, less than 1 km long, is paved with stone slabs and follows a curved S-shape. The buildings on both sides are ancient and elegant, in the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties in northern Guangxi, featuring small green tiles, sloping roofs, whitewashed walls, and hanging balconies.  
- The street is lined with various tourist souvenirs, and the shops on both sides blend Eastern and Western styles. Almost all the signs are bilingual in Chinese and English, and the staff can serve tourists in fluent foreign languages.  
- When visiting West Street, the most famous dish you must try is the Beer Fish, known as the best dish in Yangshuo. There are also many bars here, and as night falls, the street becomes even more lively than during the day.

shortFeatures: A leisure park built on the mountain
summary: Yangshuo Park was formerly known as Shouyang Park, and now the plaque at the main entrance of the park is inscribed by Liu Haisu, a famous calligrapher. In the park, laurel trees are shaded, bamboo forests are lush, flowers and fruits are full of gardens, and they are fragrant at all seasons. Shuangyue Creek lingers through the garden, surrounded by strange peaks. There are Huixian Pavilion, Woyun Pavilion and Fanghe Pavilion on the mountain, as well as Dragon Cave, Bilian Cave and Laixian Cave visited by Xu Xiake, a great traveler in Ming Dynasty. It's suitable for watching the sunrise on the gazebo, and you can get there in ten minutes.

tagNameList: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Towns; Rafting
shortFeatures: 20 yuan RMB back picture location
summary:
· Located on the east bank of the Lijiang River, the Lijiang River detours here and turns away. It is the location of the pattern on the back of the face value of RMB in 20 yuan, China. 
You can come here after rafting in the essence section of Lijiang River. Compared with the bustling West Street, Xingping is simple and vicissitudes, and its smooth bluestone slab shows the original flavor of Yangshuo. There are eight scenic spots and more than 20 scenic spots in the territory, such as Jiuma Painting Mountain, Luosi Mountain, Lianhuayan and Tianshui Village. Clinton once visited Xingping Fishing Village, which aroused many Chinese and foreign tourists to visit. 
· Don't forget to try Xingping's famous "pine flower sugar" after coming. The pine flower sugar with rich brown luster is crisp, dense, sweet and crisp, and melts in your mouth.

tagNameList: Climbing mountains; enjoying autumn leaves; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Overlooking the entire city of Guilin and the stunning landscape of the Li River.
summary:
· Located along the Li River, it is composed of Bright Moon Peak, Crane Peak, Four-Watch Mountain, and Yu Yue Mountain, and is highly favored by photographers.  
· From Diecai Pavilion, you can gaze at Bright Moon Peak, where the layered rocks resemble colorful brocade; you can also climb Bright Moon Peak, the highest peak in the urban area, to enjoy a panoramic view of the entire city.  
· The top of Crane Cave in Diecai Mountain is the best spot to capture the sunrise in Guilin, producing cinematic shots effortlessly.

tagNameList: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Caves
shortFeatures: The vivid and lifelike stalactite formations.
summary:
- The karst landscape's limestone caves penetrate through the peaks, and the stalactites inside resemble the Milky Way, shimmering with a silvery glow, thus known as "Silver Cave."
- The reflection on the water surface forms a boundary, with the stalactites and their reflection perfectly symmetrical, giving the illusion of endless depth. This is the most photographed spot by tourists.
- The Music Stone Screen is currently the most complete set of stone screens in Guangxi. When gently tapped, it produces an ethereal, celestial melody (currently tapping is prohibited for preservation purposes).

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Caves; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The filming locations of the 1987 version of *Journey to the West*
summary:
- It is a scenic area mainly focused on touring caves, with supplementary attractions of mountain and countryside landscapes, and is a brilliant pearl of the Guilin landscape.
- Inside the cave, the stalactites are stunning and varied, magnificent and grand, known for their delicate, gorgeous, and surreal characteristics.
- The widest and most beautiful part of the Reed Flute Cave is the Crystal Palace, located at the deepest part of the ancient underground lake. The stalactites hang like palace lamps, shining brilliantly and nobly.

Two pagodas are located in Shanhu Lake. The sun pagoda is a copper pagoda and the moon pagoda is a glazed pagoda. The two pagodas are connected by a lake tunnel more than 10 meters long at the bottom of the lake. 
The whole body of the tower is decorated with pure copper, which is magnificent. All components of the copper tower, such as the tower body, tile surface, warped corners, columns and beams, ground, etc., are completely decorated with copper murals. 
Every night, the two towers radiate gold and silver light against the background of lights, and the reflection in the lake is particularly beautiful. 
· The best time to watch is at night, when the lights of the twin towers will light up every night, one with golden lights and the other with silver lights.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Ancient Trees
shortFeatures: Location of the movie "Sister Liu"
summary:
It is famous for a thousand-year-old banyan tree that grows here. It looks like a giant umbrella from a distance and is an important part of Lijiang Scenic Area. 
· The big banyan tree is about 17 meters high and dated back about 1,500 years. It is intertwined and forms a forest alone, like a huge mushroom cloud rising from the ground. 
What made her famous was that Sister Liu threw a love hydrangea at Brother A Niu under the tree, where the movie Sister Liu was shot. 
· The Jinbao River flows slowly in front of the ancient banyan tree, and the river is intercepted by the dam. When the tide is high, the water rolls on the dam surface, and when the tide is low, you can run up and play in the water.

poiName: Longji Ancient Zhuang Village Terraces Scenic Area
tagNameList: Ancient towns and villages; Nature and Adventure; Terraced Fields; Ancient Villages
summary: The terraces of Longji Ancient Zhuangzhai are neat and orderly, with rich and colorful lines. The shapes of the lines are mainly curves, which give people a dynamic beauty, especially those long curves and wavy lines, which remind people that these terraces seem to be ribbons falling from the sky. The natural landscape and natural environment are well protected, and the scenery is beautiful and picturesque.

poiName: Ping'an Zhuang Rice Terrace Scenic Area
summary:
· The highest elevation of Ping'an Zhuang terraced fields is about 880 meters, and the lowest elevation is about 380 meters. There are two viewing spots here, namely, Nine Dragons and Five Tigers and Seven Stars with the Moon. 
· "Kowloon Five Tigers Viewing Spot", "Kowloon" means that you can see the backbone of nine mountains along the direction of terraced fields, like nine long dragons leaning down from the sky to drink water in Jinjiang River. Next to him, there are five hills squatting on the ground like five tigers, guarding this water and soil. 
The terraced fields are like chains, coiling from the foot of the mountain to the top of the mountain, with hills like snails and mountains like towers. In this vast world of terraced fields, there are 15,862 terraced fields of different sizes. The largest terraced field is only about 0.62 acres, and the smallest terraced field can only insert three seedlings. There are sayings that "a frog jumps into three fields" and "a bed of coir coat covers the fields". "Seven Stars with the Moon Viewing Spot", "Seven Stars" refers to the seven hills left when the field was opened, like seven twinkling stars, accompanying the silver paddy field at the top of the mountain. From a distance, they look like seven stars accompanying a bright moon, forming a beautiful picture scroll.

shortFeatures: Climb to the summit overlooking Guilin city
summary:
When you climb to the summit, you can look around the urban scenery. From top to bottom, you can see the surrounding peaks and Jingjiang Palace below, and have a bird's-eye view of Guilin City. There are Xuanwu Pavilion, Guanyin Hall, Sanke Temple and Sanshen Temple on the mountain, and there are crescent pond at the foot of the mountain. 
Some stone carvings of ancient and modern celebrities are also highlights. The original work of the famous sentence "Guilin's landscape is the best in the world" is engraved at the foot of the peak. 
At the eastern foot of the mountain, there is Yan Yanyuan, a writer in the Liu and Song Dynasties of the Southern Dynasties, which is the oldest celebrity scenic spot in Guilin. He once wrote a good sentence "If you are not unique, you will be in the bar", hence the name of Duxiu Peak.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountains

Through the clear river water, you can see a big beige stone slab at the bottom of the river, just like a brand-new yellow cloth spread on the riverbed, hence the name of Huangbu Beach. 
On both sides of Huangbu Beach, there are seven peaks of different sizes breaking out of the water, just like seven fairies, which are called "seven immortals descending to earth". 
It is a very sacred thing to take out a 20 yuan RMB and take a photo with it at the landing of Xingping Pier.

shortFeatures: A good place to see the idyllic scenery
summary:
Fuli Bridge, located in the upper reaches of Yulong River, has a history of more than 500 years. It is one of the three ancient bridges in Yangshuo. 
Fuli Bridge is beautiful in shape, with an ancient tree at each bridge head, and the reflection in the water is just like the full moon. The bridge is the best place to watch the scenery of Lijiang River. 
It is also the only place for rafting on the Yulong River. It is surrounded by green hills and green waters around the village, with a southern scenery.

Shili Bamboo Sea Grand Canyon maintains its original natural ecology and high negative ion content. It is a natural oxygen bar. This is the source of the Lijiang River. The water is crystal clear, sweet and delicious, rich in minerals, and the canyon climate is quite distinctive. "One mountain has four seasons, and ten miles are different". There are more than 20 landscapes such as Yingbin Waterfall, Fengge Pavilion, Tiaotan, Fengtan, Big Salamander Pond, Tingtao Xiaozhu, Shoutao Pond, Natural Bathing Beach, Longquan, Pinming Garden, Tingtao Xiaozhu, Jietan, Tianfeiquan, Longtan, Longfeng Pavilion, Rhino Back, Dangerous Rock, Mainstay and Little Swan Lake.

shortFeatures: Show the industriousness and wisdom of Guilin people
summary:
Guilin Museum was founded in 1982, and Mr. Guo Moruo inscribed its name. The museum displays Guilin's historical relics, ethnic folk customs, the quintessence of Jingjiang vassal king and other contents. There are more than 20,000 ancient cultural relics, ethnic folk cultural relics, revolutionary historical cultural relics and artistic treasures in the collection. It is one of the 100 key museums in China. 
The new Guilin Museum is located in Pinggui West Road, Lingui District, with a total construction area of 34,000 square meters. It is a comprehensive museum displaying Guilin's history and culture. There are more than 30,000 pieces of cultural relics in its collection, featuring plum bottles unearthed in Guilin Ming Dynasty, gifts from foreign guests, treasures of paintings and calligraphy in Ming and Qing Dynasties, historical relics in Guilin and cultural relics of Guangxi ethnic minorities. The exhibition hall covers an area of about 12,000 square meters, with a total of 9 exhibition halls. There are four basic exhibitions and two special exhibitions, with the themes of "Spring and Autumn in Lishui, People in Paintings, Jingjiang Legacy, Friendship Guilin, Love Guilin, and Hanmo Huazhang". At the same time, there is a 1,400-square-meter interactive center for minors' education. The new Guilin Museum has now become a window to display Guilin's history and culture, adding luster to the construction of Guilin's international tourist resort. 
Visitors can collect tickets from the automatic ticket collection machine through the west gate and east gate of the new Guilin Museum, or get free tickets by manual ticket collection, and then enter the museum with the tickets. Before entering the museum, please read the Instructions for Visiting Guilin Museum carefully. 
Opening hours of the new Guilin Museum: 09:00-17:00 every Tuesday to Sunday (16:30), closed every Monday (except national statutory holidays)

tagNameList: Climbing mountains; Appreciating autumn leaves; Mountains; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Watch the sunrise and the beautiful sea of clouds.
summary:
Ma'er Mountain Scenic Area is a national-level nature reserve, located in the northern part of Guilin, a world-renowned tourist city.  
Ma'er Mountain lies in the Nanling Range, with its main peak reaching an elevation of 2,141.5 meters, making it the highest peak in South China. It is known as the "Crown of the Five Ranges and the Pinnacle of South China."  
The scenery of Ma'er Mountain is picturesque year-round, with different charms in each season: spring for flower viewing, summer for escaping the heat, autumn for hiking, and winter for snow appreciation. It is a perfect destination for sightseeing, exploration, summer retreat, and photography enthusiasts, especially for capturing sunrises and sunsets. The sea of clouds is vast and magnificent, offering breathtaking views. At the summit, the clouds surge like a herd of galloping horses, creating a mighty spectacle. From the peak, the horizon stretches endlessly, with a landscape as beautiful as a painting. The mist and clouds at the summit create an otherworldly atmosphere, and the vast sea of clouds appears like rolling waves. If lucky, one may also witness the colorful Buddha light at the Buddha Light Platform, a stunning and surprising sight.  
In 1990, Lu Dingyi inscribed a tablet at the old mountain boundary, praising Ma'er Mountain for its grandeur similar to Mount Tai, its perilousness like Mount Hua, its tranquility like Mount Lu, and its elegance like Mount Emei.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 14:00; admission ends at 17:30)
