shortFeatures: Reproduction of Guilin ethnic customs
summary:
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area is jointly created by Songcheng Performing Arts and Guilin Travel Stock, which reproduces Guilin's history, culture and ethnic customs, and is suitable for all ages to have fun with each other, rain or shine. 
The giant song fairy statue is magnificent and integrated with Guilin's landscape. It is the embodiment of the truth, goodness and beauty of Bagui land. Everything in the scenic spot is tourist-centered, with tens of thousands of square meters of No.3 secret tourism complex, wind and rain corridor and five-star standard toilet with all-indoor air conditioning. Haunted House, Qingming Riverside Film Museum, Wonderful Street and other high-tech and children's experience projects are full of fun. Yangshuo Ancient Village has created a unique farming and market life style. Handicraft workshops such as grandfather's wine jar, grandma's cakes and father's toys in Shijing Street and Fengqing Street keep homesickness and look for the memories of parents. Lover's Harbor and No.4 Bay are good places for young people to relax. 
The main show "Eternal Love in Guilin" is a must-see performance in a lifetime. Using advanced high-tech means such as sound, light and electricity and stage machinery, it sings the legend of truth, goodness and beauty in Bagui land through time and space in the three-dimensional space of water, land and air, bringing Bagui culture hidden under the 800-mile Lijiang River into everyone's field of vision, and reproduces a love affair in Guilin for three lives and three lifetimes. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
In the scenic spot, there are splendid performing shows such as National Flash Show, Mo Tusi Recruiting Son-in-Law, Song Fairy Welcomes Guests, Guozhuang Carnival, etc. 
Guilin Eternal Scenic Area, give me one day and give you a thousand years!

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; City Coordinates; Rivers; Water Conservancy Projects
shortFeatures: The man-made canal that began in the Qin Dynasty
summary: The Xing'an Ling Canal, a Qin Dynasty water conservancy project famous alongside the Dujiangyan, stretches 34 km and is divided into the South Canal and the North Canal. The South Canal, which is well-known, is 33.15 km long, utilizing natural river channels with only 5 km excavated manually. Though the Ling Canal is no longer in use, remnants of its former splendor can still be seen. During the off-season, there are fewer tourists, enhancing the tranquility and ancient charm. Visitors can drift along the canal by boat, ride a tricycle at a leisurely pace, or walk along the embankment, wading through the water to get close to the stones from the Qin era... Other attractions include the Three Generals' Tomb, the Qin Embankment, the Flying Stone, and the Four Worthies Temple. The lesser-known North Canal, which is ideal for self-driving tours, can be enjoyed for free. The North Canal starts at the North Duomen Gate at the rear of the Datiangping area and flows into the Xiangjiang River. Although only 4 km long, it is an essential waterway connecting the Xiangjiang and Li River.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Garden Garden
shortFeatures: Rich landscape levels
summary: Guilin Garden Expo Park is located in Yanshan District, south of Guilin, east of Guiyang Highway in Yanshan Town. It is the only way from Guilin to Yangshuo. The total area of the park is 79.65 hectares, including a construction area of about 51,670 square meters, a water area of about 12.3 hectares, and a green space area of about 50.55 hectares. In 2012, the 2nd Guangxi (Guilin) Garden and Horticulture Expo was successfully held here.

tagNameList: Climbing; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Caves
shortFeatures: Tashan Qingying and Chuanshan Karst Cave
summary: The Elephant Trunk Hill and the Chuanshan Hill face each other across the Li River. In front of Chuanshan, there is Ta Mountain, with the Ming Dynasty Shoufo Pagoda on its summit. On Chuanshan, there are Yueyan (Moon Cave) and Chuanyan (Chuanshan Cave). Chuanyan is the third large limestone cave opened to the public in recent years in Guilin, located at the foot of Chuanshan. Its most notable feature is the rare transparent stone crystals formed inside the cave, such as stone branches and goose tubes, which are remarkable karst landforms. Yueyan is located on the mountainside, and from inside the cave, visitors can enjoy a view of the Li River, making it a great spot for photography.
opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Terraced Fields; Observation Decks
summary: Xishanshao Optimistic Scenic Spot can see Maoer Mountain in Xing'an and Fupingbao, the highest peak 1,918 meters above sea level in Longji Scenic Spot in Longsheng County. You can see the terraced landscape of 40-50 square kilometers. You can watch the sunrise in the early morning, and the terraced fields are winding and flowing, like beating notes, playing the movement of the earth in the noise of chickens, insects, birds, pigs, cattle, sheep, people and streams.

Seven Stars with the Moon is one of the two observation decks of Ping'an Zhuangzhai Terrace, and it is also one of its essence landscapes. "Seven Stars" refers to the seven hills left when the field was opened at the beginning. They are like seven twinkling stars, accompanying the silver paddy field at the top of the mountain. From a distance, they look like seven stars accompanying a bright moon, forming a beautiful picture, which makes people feel the greatness of the working people and creating such a wonderful scene invisibly.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Flower Fields
shortFeatures: Many different flowers to watch
Great place to watch the sunrise
summary: The TV tower is behind the Xijiekou post office, which is little known to tourists. However, it belongs to the commanding heights of Yangshuo County. When you climb to the highest peak, you can have a panoramic view of the surrounding area of Yangshuo City, and you can have a panoramic view of West Street, Lijiang River and Yangshuo Park. Of course, it's also a good place to watch the sunrise. It's full of romance. But the entrance is not easy to find, and you need to ask more people to get there.

shortFeatures: Various patterns are engraved at the bottom of the bridge
summary: The most important transportation hub in Guilin, with beautiful shape, is located in the best position in the city center, with a beautiful view of Guilin downtown, especially at night.

poiName: Longji Terraced Fields Scenic Area - Jinzhu Zhuang Village
tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Terraced Fields; Villages
summary: Jinzhuang Village, named after the golden bamboo forest, is the "first village" of the thirteen villages in Longji and a typical Zhuang village, known as the "first village in Beizhuang". The diaojiaolou building in Jinzhuang Village is relatively intact and has a unique style. If you choose to eat in Jinzhu Restaurant, you will also have the opportunity to experience the original toast songs of Zhuang nationality.

shortFeatures: You can have a sweeping view of the Lijiang River

tagNameList: Observation deck; Harvest autumn; Observation Decks
summary: Golden Budding Viewing Spot is one of the famous viewing spots in Jinkeng Terrace Scenic Area, with high altitude and wide vision. It is a good place to watch the panoramic view of terraced fields and watch the sunset. On the top of the golden Buddha, you can also see the landscape of the phoenix turning back, which is composed of hundreds of ridges several hundred meters long stacked together to form a huge phoenix.

tagNameList: Baby outing treasure spot; Hot Springs
shortFeatures: The hot spring pool surrounded by mountains.
summary:
- Longsheng Hot Springs originate from a rock layer approximately 1200 meters underground, formed through long-term natural filtration and mineralization, rich in dozens of natural minerals.
- The water quality has been identified by experts as a silica-heavy bicarbonate calcium-magnesium type natural drinking mineral water, also referred to as "sacred water" by the local Yao people.
- Longsheng Hot Spring's spring water is pure, natural, and pollution-free, with transparent, clear water quality, rich in minerals, and slightly alkaline, with small molecule active properties.
- The small molecule spring water can quickly penetrate the skin, allowing it to fully absorb the nourishment of the spring and aid in skin metabolism.
opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-23:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Autumn leaf viewing; Villages
shortFeatures: Like a human paradise from Tao Yuanming's pen.
summary:
- Composed of the Lotus Pond, Swallow Lake, and the Original Tribe, it is an artificial scenic park built in harmony with the local pastoral landscape.
- While boating on the lake, you can see the water wheel, wind and rain bridge, and the Copper Drum Tower, along with performances of folk dances and other local customs.
- On foot, you can admire the ethnic villages of the northern Guangxi minorities, and learn about the ancient cultural practices of brewing, papermaking, and printing by the ethnic groups of Guangxi.
- For photography enthusiasts and those fond of ethnic styles, visiting in early spring offers the chance to witness the vibrant peach blossoms falling from the trees.

Yulong Bridge is a stone arch bridge on Yulong River. It was built in the Ming Dynasty and has gone through hundreds of years. It is a key cultural relic and historic site in Yangshuo. 
The stone bridge is covered with ivy, and the villagers have been carrying water and washing laundry here for generations. The Yulong Bridge witnesses the world, but it is still as strong as ever. 
There is a monument to the victory of the Anti-Japanese War on the bridge, which is a symbol of the victory of the villagers spontaneously fighting fiercely with the Japanese aggressors for dozens of days in 1944. 
The first set of shots in "Sister Liu" was shot here, which is also the only place for rafting in Yulong River.

poiName: Yangshuo Tea Viewing Garden Scenic Area
shortFeatures: A good place to enjoy and taste tea
summary:
Qixianfeng Tea Farm in Yangshuo, Guilin, is located in the mountainous area more than ten miles north of Yangshuo County, Guilin, a famous tourist county, with an altitude of 800 meters. The main body of the tea garden is composed of seven towering peaks, shaped like the Big Dipper, hence its name. The tea farm was founded in the spring of 2000, and its development goal is to be eco-environmentally friendly tourism tea garden. 
The tea garden is surrounded by a famous kumquat planting base in China. There are no factories that can produce "three wastes", and the air is pollution-free. All tea gardens are applied with pollution-free ecological organic fertilizers and biological chemicals. Select excellent tea varieties recognized by the state. It has been put into trial production in the spring of 2003, and 5,000 kilograms of famous green teas such as "Cuiyu Brand" Cuizhu series (Quhao), Cuizhen series (Maojian), Cuiyu series (Longjing), Qingfeng, Maofeng and Xianghao have been produced.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Kids; Mountains; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A spring outing destination with flowers blooming all year round.
summary:
- Located about 9 kilometers southeast of downtown Nanning, along the Yongjiang River, it is the most famous scenic area in Nanning. The landscape is beautiful, with clear mountains and rivers, and fresh air.  
- Here, visitors can climb the Longxiang Tower for a distant view, ascend to the Guanyin Temple to light incense and pray for blessings, or take a leisurely walk in the garden to admire various flowers and enjoy a pleasant time.  
- The Longxiang Tower, built in the style of the Ming Dynasty, is a landmark of Qingxiu Mountain. From the top of the tower, one can overlook the Yongjiang River and the distant mountains and nearby hills.  
- Other attractions include the Twelve Zodiac Cultural Park, Zhuangyuan Spring, and the Millennium Cycad Garden. In spring, visitors can also go to Peach Blossom Island to enjoy the blooming peach blossoms.

Located in Qingxiu District, southeast of the urban area, it is a park with melted water landscape and subtropical garden scenery. There are palms, cattail, betel nut, etc. with southern characteristics. 
There are three "gardens within gardens", namely, a Chinese herbal medicine garden with more than 200 kinds of precious Chinese herbal medicines, an orchid garden with precious orchids such as Xiahui, Gladiolus, Moran and Flame Orchid, and a bonsai garden.  
The lake in the park accounts for three-quarters of the total area. The lake water is clear and blue, and it is very pleasant to take a boat tour or fish near the lake. 
Spring Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival and other major festivals, you can enjoy fireworks shows, lantern festivals, water curtain movies, etc.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Towns
shortFeatures: Well-preserved ancient buildings of Ming and Qing Dynasties
summary:
Founded in the Song Dynasty, it is an ancient town with the best preserved ancient buildings in Ming and Qing Dynasties in Nanning. 
The ancient town is near the river. When it was prosperous, there were many docks, and it was a commodity distribution center of nearly 100 kilometers. Nowadays, the traffic is blocked and the commercial atmosphere is not strong. 
Walking into the ancient town, there are rows of ancient houses in Ming and Qing Dynasties, and places of interest and historical sites can be seen everywhere. 
In the small ancient town, there are more than 700 ancient buildings of Ming and Qing Dynasties, but many historic sites have disappeared.

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Kid-Friendly Hidden Gems; Zoos
shortFeatures: Visit rare animals such as the giant panda.
summary: Nanning Zoo is the largest zoo in Guangxi and also the location of the largest theme park in Nanning. The zoo is home to over 250 species of animals, including dolphins and elephants, with more than 2,500 individual animals. The theme park offers thrilling attractions such as roller coasters, giant swings, hurricane rides, crazy slides, and magic windmills. The reason the zoo becomes the most popular cool spot in Guangxi during the summer is that it also houses the largest "Water World" theme park in the region—Caribbean Water World.

tagNameList: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
shortFeatures: The museum's treasure, the Lei-patterned Bronze Drum.
summary:
The Guangxi Museum of Nationalities is the largest cultural facility project in terms of both construction and investment in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is an autonomous region-level, publicly owned, non-profit, and professional museum dedicated to ethnic cultures. Its primary tasks include the collection, research, and exhibition of the traditional cultures of approximately 12 indigenous ethnic groups in Guangxi, while also focusing on the cultural research, collection of cultural relics, and promotion of the ethnic groups in neighboring provinces of Guangxi as well as Southeast Asia.

The museum’s exterior is very distinctive, shaped like a Guangxi bronze drum, which holds significant symbolic meaning. Visitors can explore various unique bronze drums, trace their historical development, experience the customs and traditions of multiple ethnic groups, such as the Zhuang, Yao, Dong, and Maonan, and enjoy the beautiful songs of the Zhuang people.

poiName: Nanning International Convention and Exhibition Center
shortFeatures: One of the landmark buildings in Nanning
summary:
Nanning International Convention and Exhibition Center covers an area of 850 mu. It is the permanent venue of China-ASEAN Expo. It is jointly designed by gmp Design Company of Germany and Guangxi Architectural Comprehensive Design and Research Institute. The design of the main building is unique, ingenious in conception, and it is built according to the situation of the mountain, which makes it magnificent. 
When the ASEAN Expo is held here every October, friends from all over the world are welcomed, mostly from Southeast Asia. At the exhibition, you can eat authentic Southeast Asian food, enjoy exotic performances in Southeast Asia, make friends and talk with Southeast Asian friends, and buy special Southeast Asian items. At other times, various exhibitions will not be held from time to time. 
Most importantly, the architectural appearance of the Convention and Exhibition Center, shaped like "Bauhinia", has become one of the classic landmarks in Nanning. It exudes a hazy warm yellow at night, which is especially suitable for photography.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing; Rivers; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A landmark river across Nanning
summary: Yongjiang River has abundant water and good shipping conditions. It is the main urban water source of Nanning, and the main and tributary waterways are also important transportation routes. It is called the mother river of Nanning. It is not only the cultural source of Nanning, but also the basic guarantee for Nanning's urban economic development, which has greatly improved the urban construction and made great contributions to Nanning's urban greening.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Ancient Pagodas; Military Sites
shortFeatures: The landmark building of Qingxiu Mountain
summary:
Located at the top of Qingxiu Mountain, it was built in Wanli period of Ming Dynasty by Xiao Yunju, a Nanning Jinshi who was then the left assistant minister of the official department. It was named "Dragon Elephant Pagoda" after the Buddhist scripture means that "the dragon moving in water is powerful, and the elephant moving in land is powerful". It is 204 meters above sea level, more than ten feet high, with nine octagonal floors and double eaves brick structure. 
The original tower stands tall, more than ten feet high, with an octagonal shape and nine-level double eaves. In the fourth year of Apocalypse in Ming Dynasty (1624), the top two floors of the Dragon Elephant Pagoda were struck by lightning, and it has not been repaired. Until 1937, Yongning County Government was dismantled for fear that the tower would become the navigation target of Japanese planes bombing Nanning. Since then, the Dragon Elephant Pagoda, which had stood on Fengchi Ridge in Qingxiu Mountain for hundreds of years, has completely disappeared from people's sight... After liberation, in order to restore Qingxiu Mountain Scenic Area, Nanning Government rebuilt the Dragon Elephant Pagoda on the basis of the original tower with reference to the Ming Dynasty style pagoda. The rebuilt Dragon Elephant Tower is still octagonal in shape and has nine floors, but its structure is changed to brick-concrete structure. The tower is 52.35 meters high and 12 meters wide, with green glazed tiles. There are 207 spiral ladders directly to the top of the tower. Copper bells (72 in total) are hung under the eaves of each floor. Standing at the top of the tower, with a bird's-eye view of both sides of the Yongjiang River, looking back on the past, I am overwhelmed with emotion.

Lingshui, located in Wuming District, Guangxi, is one of the three constant hot spring lakes in China and one of the "Eight Scenic Spots of Wuming". It is known as "Longjin Tubi", with an area of 29,300 square meters, a circumference of about one kilometer and a water depth of 2-3 meters. It is a natural spring lake. There are nine clear springs in the lake, gurgling and surging, and the lake water is crystal clear all year round. Its water quality and water level remain unchanged all year round, and the water temperature remains around 23 degrees. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, and has the characteristics of constant quantity, constant clarity and constant temperature. There are an endless stream of people looking for coolness in hot summer. Even in cold winter, it greatly satisfies the thirst of many swimmers, and some newcomers have experienced a novel and unforgettable underwater collective wedding here. The lakeshore is rocky and tree-lined, and it is a famous swimming summer resort inside and outside the area. The wonderful thing about Spiritual Water is that no matter the drought or flood, it will never dry up.

shortFeatures: With pastoral ecological scenery and beautiful landscape
summary:
· Sanliyangdu Scenic Area is located in the southeast of Shanglin County, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, about 12 kilometers away from Shanglin County. 
The scenic spot includes most of Sanli Town in Shanglin County, Yangdu Village in Chengtai Township and nearby villages, as well as border towns. 
The scenic spot is known as "Little Guilin" with beautiful mountains and clear waters, different caves and various landscapes. Among them, Shanglin Xiake Ancient Crossing Scenic Spot is the core and essence part of Sanli Yangdu Scenic Spot. The best way is to take a cruise, where the river winds and the breeze blows cool. You can overlook Lovers Mountain and Goddess Peak, as well as Couples Tree and Fushou Bridge. The beautiful mountain makes people feel as if they are in Yulong River. There are also many cultural monuments on the banks of Qingshui River, such as the famous Tang Monument and Zhicheng Temple. 
· In the winter months of December, this is a sea of sunflowers; In spring, there will also be patches of rape fields here, which complement the surrounding karst landforms, forming a beautiful scenery like ink painting, especially suitable for tourists who like outdoor shooting.

People's Park is also known as White Dragon Park. There is a Bailong Lake of about 70,000 square meters in the park, with clear water. The lakeshore is shaded by green bamboos, and weeping willows are swaying. There is a small island in the center of the lake, and the Jiuqu Bridge in the west of the island and the Sankongyue Bridge in the north of the island connect the island with the lakeshore. Yachts on the lake, or racing under the blue sky, or wandering in the green shade, also become a scene. 
Step into the garden gate and follow the 141 steps to the top of Wangxianpo. This is the main body of People's Park. In the 26th year of the Republic of China (1937), Lu Rongting, the tour envoy of Guangdong and Guangxi, demolished the "Liugong Temple" to build Zhenning Fort and set up a cannon with a range of 12,000 meters to guard Nanning and its hometown Wuming. This is a two-story circular castle made of huge stones. The German Kluber cannon made by 　 in 1890 is placed on the fort, and there is an ancient monument gallery at the foot of the fort. Boarding the fort can not only overlook the whole picture of Nanning City, but also evoke a wisp of nostalgia. 
On the hillside in the northeast corner of the park, there is also a magnificent monument to the revolutionary martyrs, which is 25 meters high and engraved with the golden characters "People's heroes are immortal", surrounded by green pines and cypresses. The whole building is solemn and solemn.

Shimen Forest Park, with lush trees and quiet environment, is an urban forest park with forest recreation and leisure as its main functions, and is called "the lung of the city". As one of the few cherry blossom viewing spots in Nanning, many tourists come to watch and photograph every spring. The flowering period of cherry blossoms is very short, only about 4-10 days of opening time. I hope interested friends can confirm their itinerary as soon as possible. 
In addition, the Cherry Blossom Valley Theme Park in the park has large-scale amusement projects, such as carousel, pirate ship, monstrous waves, etc., which can make people relax while enjoying flowers.

shortFeatures: The Garden Attractions Worth Visiting in Nanning
summary:
The main area of the Garden Expo Park covers approximately 263 hectares, with the planned area featuring typical Lingnan hilly landforms. The current terrain consists of around 18 hills, about 16 abandoned quarries, the Nazun River in the north, the Qingshui Spring in the center, and several bodies of water, including a southern mining pit, as well as small-scale villages. 

The overall topography is rich and diverse, with undulating hills, winding rivers, and lush vegetation. It offers excellent conditions for garden creation, including mountains, water, forests, springs, and lakes, and features a national protected freshwater shell mound site typical of the inland river basin. The 12th Garden Expo aims to showcase three distinct characteristics—ecology, culture, and sharing—allowing visitors to "see the mountains, view the water, and remember their roots." It also highlights "three lakes, six bridges, and eighteen ridges."

The park’s water bodies are divided into three major lake areas, from north to south: Linglong Lake, Qingquan Lake, and Qicai Lake. Spanning these lake areas, the park features six uniquely designed bridges, arranged from north to south as follows: three vehicular bridges—Zhujin Bridge, Jinhua Bridge, and Diecui Bridge—and three pedestrian bridges—Zhizhu Bridge, Gule Bridge, and Jinxiu Bridge. The "eighteen ridges" are formed by preserving the existing eighteen hills, enhanced through ecological restoration and landscaping techniques to create three major mountain ridge landscapes: Yong, Long, and Cui.

The park’s planning includes six themed exhibition gardens: the Chinese Urban Exhibition Garden, ASEAN Garden, Silk Road Garden, Guangxi Garden, Designer Garden, and Enterprise Garden, with a total of approximately 80 exhibition gardens.

shortFeatures: A main trans-urban road
summary:
Nanning Minzu Avenue passes through the most important area of Nanning from west to east, which is the pride of Nanning citizens and the business card and face of Nanning. In 1987, Minzu Avenue started from the north of Yongjiang Bridge, and only reached the current Yuanhu intersection of Minzu Avenue; In 1991, Minzu Avenue was repaired from Yuanhu intersection to Nanhu Qiaotou; It wasn't until 2002 that the final expansion of Nation Avenue was completed. 
Nanning Minzu Avenue has a multi-level and three-dimensional green belt: the upper floor is king coconut, the middle floor is shrubs such as hibiscus and palm bamboo, and the lower floor is shade plants such as lush white butterflies. The ecological characteristics of its subtropical rain forest community reflect the ecological landscape corridor of modern urban living environment, and is known as "Forest Avenue" and "the first landscape road in Guangxi". In the cold winter season, when the flowers and trees in the north wither, the ethnic avenue in Nanning, a green town located in the southern part of the motherland, is still full of green, showing the elegant demeanor of green town. In addition to sidewalks, small parks are reserved in some places of Minzu Avenue. Even if pedestrians are tired of walking, there are all kinds of stools, chairs and marble by the pool on the roadside, so you can sit down and rest. Walking along Minzu Avenue is like walking in a park.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Canyons
shortFeatures: Spring flowers, summer waterfalls, autumn clouds, winter snow.
summary:
Daming Mountain in spring offers the opportunity to hike up to the half-mountain level and enjoy the flowers. In summer, you can escape the heat by hiding in its natural icebox. In autumn, hiking to the summit allows you to breathe fresh air and moisturize your lungs. In winter, the frost-covered trees and ice formations on the mountain are stunningly beautiful. 

Daming Mountain attracts numerous self-driving travelers and hikers who come to "steal a moment of leisure" and experience the changing seasons. You can wander through vast primitive forests and explore the wonders of the Luoyue culture, experiencing the marvelous "shadowless noon" phenomenon. Beneath the Tianping grassland on Daming Mountain, there are mysterious ancient symbols waiting to be uncovered.

The microwave station on the summit is an ideal spot for watching the sunrise, and visitors can also enjoy photography from the nearby platform, which provides excellent angles. 

For those who admire snowy landscapes, a visit to Daming Mountain from December to February offers the chance to stand at the peak of the southern border and enjoy the breathtaking northern scenery, with the entire mountain covered in silver and adorned with jade-like trees and flowers.

tagNameList: Observation deck; Night tour viewing; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Overlooking Nanning in a fully transparent corridor
summary: Diwang Genting, with an absolute height of 276 meters, not only refers to the pure building height, but also reveals the challenge of Diwang Genting sightseeing to the height of traditional tourism methods. The grand opening of Diwang Yunding Sightseeing took a new approach when the smoke in the tourism market was thick, adding a fresh impetus to Nanning tourism market, and initiating the first urban high-altitude landscape tourism project in the whole southwest area. On this high-altitude tarmac with an area of 1,270 square meters, we can relax our mood. Here, you can overlook the entire land of Tancheng, overlooking the beautiful Yongjiang River, the green Nanhu Lake, the scenic Qingxiu Mountain Scenic Area, the majestic Nanhu Bridge and Baisha Bridge. In addition to the beautiful scenery, you can also challenge your own limits here. Under the hollow and transparent glass, the scene of an abyss suddenly appears, where timid people can regain their confidence. Bold people can truly realize the true feeling of "above ten thousand people" and be a real king.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Geological Sites; Caves
shortFeatures: The famous Karst caves in the outskirts of Nanning.
summary: Located 21 kilometers from Nanning city, it is a typical Karst limestone cave. Before entering the cave to admire the rock formations, visitors can enjoy a folk performance from the Zhuang ethnic group. Inside the cave, there are remarkable limestone formations such as "Double Lions Welcoming Guests" and "Seaside Park." This is a journey where your imagination will play a key role, and the full tour takes about two hours. If you have more time, you can also visit the nearby Yiling Cave and Lingshui Scenic Area; however, if you are short on time and have already visited large caves, it is not recommended to go.

tagNameList: Hi Playland; Parenting Treasure Spot; Amusement Parks
summary: Fengling Children's Park is adjacent to the center of Nanning. The area is spacious, with lush green grass and a very pleasant environment. What attracts most visitors are the numerous recreational activities available, including an exciting amusement park, a refreshing water park, and the opportunity to ride Nanning's largest Ferris wheel to enjoy the thrill of an aerial view.

shortFeatures: Understanding Guangxi Regional Culture and History
summary:
Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Museum, located on the east side of Nanning National Square, is a provincial (autonomous region) comprehensive historical museum and the only national first-class museum in Guangxi at present. 
There are more than 50,000 cultural relics in the museum collection, including 152 first-class cultural relics and 1,791 second-class cultural relics. Guangxi is one of the main distribution areas of ancient bronze drums, with rich remains and complete kinds of bronze drums. Therefore, our museum has become the museum with the largest collection of bronze drums in the world, with more than 360 collections of bronze drums. Among them, a north-flow bronze drum has a diameter of 165 cm and a weight of 299 kilograms. It is known as the "king of bronze drums". In addition, there are 800,000-year-old hand axes; The collection of ethnic cultural relics is colorful and beautiful.

shortFeatures: Famous for its houses resembling the Potala Palace
summary:
Xiashuiyuanzhuang is located halfway up the mountain of Daming Mountain, at an altitude of more than 500 meters, surrounded by lush forests. Villagers' houses are built on the mountain, scattered at random, and look somewhat like the Potala Palace from a distance. It is far away from the hustle and bustle, with lush forests and fresh air. It is a huge natural oxygen bar. There are also special scenic spots such as natural pools and first-line waterfalls in the valley. The perennial temperature is 2-6 degrees Celsius lower than that at the foot of the mountain, making it an ideal place for summer vacation and leisure. 
The village has a history of 300 years, and it looks like the Potala Palace from a distance. Therefore, Xiashuiyuanzhuang is also known as the "Potala Palace" in Shanglin. 
The villa is surrounded by mountains and rivers, and what is even more rare is that the temperature is 2-6 lower than that in the city all the year round. Even in hot summer, you have to cover a quilt when you sleep at night, so many "donkey friends" come to "camp" to rest or take a vacation to relieve worries. 
Whether you live in a farmhouse or camping, stay here, watch the sea of clouds and Buddha's light while having breakfast, then take a shower and fish in the natural water beach, go back to the river to find its source, explore the virgin forest, and visit Dazhang Waterfall, First Line Waterfall, Green Valley Waterfall, etc. along the Dongchun River to feel the fresh baptism of the waterfall. Enjoy the sunset at night, and it's like being in a peach garden for a few days. How pleasant it is. 
Because of the inconvenience of mountain roads, relatively few people come here, and the environment remains in a natural state.

tagNameList: Historical sites and ruins.; Military Sites; Historical Sites
shortFeatures: Remembering History on the Anti-Japanese Battlefield
summary:
This is the site of the Battle of Kunlun Pass. Located in the Kunlun Mountains, it serves as a natural barrier to the northeast of Nanning and has long been a strategic location fought over by military forces. Nine battles have taken place here throughout history, with the largest and most brutal being the "Battle of Kunlun Pass" during the Second Sino-Japanese War. At the foot of the mountain, there is a three-gate, four-pillar stone archway, and on the mountain, there are memorials such as a cemetery for fallen soldiers, a memorial tower, and a tablet pavilion. From the archway to the summit, there is a stone path with 331 steps.

There are memorial inscriptions by military and political figures of the Kuomintang, including Chiang Kai-shek, Li Zongren, Li Jishen, Bai Chongxi, and Du Yuming, as well as displays of old military aircraft. Between the memorial tower and the cemetery, a large incense burner and altar are set up for visitors to pay their respects. The site is not very large, and it is recommended that those wishing to honor the martyrs, especially with more time, combine the visit with a trip to the Youyiguan Pass.

Wuxiang Square is divided into two parts by Minzu Avenue. The main buildings in the North Square include Wuxiang Spring Sculpture, UFO Star Bar, fountain, etc. The south square is paved with granite, and the main buildings include revolving pool, book city and book market, etc. Wuxiangquan Sculpture is one of the landmark buildings in Nanning, surrounded by tall fashionable office buildings, which is even more quaint. The creativity of Wuxiangquan sculpture is based on a folk legend in Nanning-in ancient times, five idols in the suburbs of Nanning went down to earth to destroy wild animals and poisonous insects without permission to protect ordinary people, and as a result, they violated the rules of heaven and were turned into rocks.

shortFeatures: Display herbs and plants such as Two-leaf Pin.
summary: The Guangxi Medicinal Plant Garden is affiliated with the Health Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. It is located in the eastern suburbs of Nanning, 8 kilometers from the city center. The coordinates are 108°19′E, 22°51′N. The altitude ranges from 72 to 113 meters. The area has a subtropical climate, characterized by abundant heat, ample rainfall, and distinct dry and wet seasons. The average annual temperature is 21.6°C, with a maximum extreme temperature of 40.4°C and a minimum extreme temperature of -2.1°C. The average monthly temperature exceeds 20°C for seven months, with an average temperature of 12.8°C in January and an average maximum temperature of 28.3°C in July. The annual sunshine duration is 1,827 hours, and the annual precipitation is 1,200-1,500 millimeters, mostly concentrated from May to September. The annual average relative humidity is 79%.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Kid-friendly treasure spot; Mountains; Nature Reserves; National Parks
shortFeatures: A well-known monkey mountain in China.
summary:
This is a world of monkeys. There are more than 2,500 semi-captive macaques, known for their thievery and dominance. Be especially careful of children getting scratched, and if you want to feed them, take caution. You can also take a bamboo raft to enjoy the scenery on both sides and watch the Navy's water fortress, as well as see the monkeys perform their "underwater moon grabbing" skill.

From September to December each year is the time for the Monkey King competition, and in early January, the new Monkey King ascends the throne. It is said that new officials are full of energy when they take office, and if you visit around New Year's Day, you might witness the Monkey King's authority and charm. Those who are not fond of animals are advised not to visit.

shortFeatures: Nanning's cultural center
summary:
It is located on Minzu Avenue, the main road of Nanning, with a total area of 26,670 square meters. This is the central square of Nanning, a favorite paradise for the citizens of the capital, and another beautiful landscape of Greentown.  
In summer, Nanning becomes a big stage for the people and the center of civic activities. Many citizens often come here to enjoy the cool air and blow the breeze, and if they are lucky, they will have the opportunity to watch the fountain show. In the square during the day, there are many children flying kites, or chasing and feeding pigeons. Whenever there are major holidays or festivals, the National Square will become a sea of flowers, and many people are used to taking photos here. 
Opposite the square are five great portraits, which echo each other. They are a window of Guangxi's national spirit and the landmark building of Bagui.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems: Nature and Adventure; Pick-Your-Own; Flower Fields
shortFeatures: Admire seasonal flowers and get close to animals.
summary: The location is about 16 kilometers from the center of Nanning. On Coconut Grove Avenue, tall coconut trees line the street, creating a picturesque scene; the reflection of the sky and water at Tianfu Pond and the Wind and Rain Bridge is also beautiful. In addition to enjoying flowers at Huashan Square and Baojin Garden, visitors can feed the black bears, ostriches, sika deer, and goats, as well as pick fresh grapes, strawberries, melons, and other fruits and vegetables by hand.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Agritourism; Pick-Your-Own
shortFeatures: Enjoy a pleasant pastoral view
summary: "Beautiful South" is in Nanning, just in Zhongliang Village, Shibu Sub-district Office, Xixiangtang District, Nanning. Drive from Nanning to Shibu along Jiangbei Avenue. It is not far from the city, but far away from the hustle and bustle of the city. It is a small village full of fresh local flavor, bringing you the beautiful rose manor and the novelty and happiness of picking all kinds of fruits by hand.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Botanical Gardens; Flower Fields
summary: Golden Camellia Park is the first camellia park in China, which mainly plants Golden Camellia, the "Queen of Flowers". It is located on the shore of the beautiful South Lake, covering an area of 23.9 hectares. It was officially opened to the public in December 1995. It is a new multi-functional garden integrating viewing, production, scientific research and entertainment. Camellia japonica Park is dominated by teaceae plants, highlighting the characteristics of Camellia japonica, the "queen of tea clan". It is a rare camellia park in China, which is mainly based on plant gardening, separated and combined by tortuous streams and natural undulating gentle slopes. Every flowering season, the golden flowers make tourists in an endless stream and amazing. The camellia gene bank in the garden collects the largest kinds of camellia in the world.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Exhibition Halls
shortFeatures: Understand the traditional culture of various ethnic groups in Guangxi
summary: Guangxi National Cultural Relics Garden, located beside Guangxi Museum in Nanning, covers an area of 24,000 square meters. It was built at the end of 1988 and is a local and unique open-air exhibition hall of national cultural relics. The National Cultural Relics Garden is a collection of ethnic customs and customs scattered in Guangxi. There are unique residential buildings here, such as Zhuang Ganlan, Yao Bamboo Building, Miao Hanging Building, Dong Fengyu Bridge and Drum Tower, etc., which are either located in dense forests on mountains or built on lawns surrounded by mountains and rivers. Their daily necessities and handicrafts are also displayed in the houses of various ethnic groups. Visitors can also taste snacks of various ethnic groups. In the ethnic workshops, you can also see their traditional performances such as rice milling, oil pressing, paper making, pottery making, sugar pressing and waterwheel. During festivals, there are also colorful ethnic cultural and sports programs.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Shaped like butterfly wings
summary: The total length of Nanning Bridge is 1,314.773 meters, of which the main bridge is 734.502 meters long, the approach roads on both sides are 580.271 meters, the maximum span is 300 meters, and the width of the bridge deck and subgrade is 35 meters. Nanning Bridge adopts the conceptual design of Chinese-American Mr. Lin Tongyan before his death. It has a unique structure and beautiful shape. It is the world's first long-span, curved beam and asymmetric camber arch bridge, and its design is positioned as a landmark building in Nanning.

tagNameList: Science and Technology Museum; Science & Technology Museums
shortFeatures: Experience the fun-filled science education projects.
summary: There are many innovative technological exhibits here, where you can talk to robots, experience being an "Invisible Man," become a "Little Electrician" to help open the curtains of a cartoon house using your palm to conduct electricity, and explore the fascinating world of magic... Many exciting interactions are available, making it a great place for parents to bring their children to learn through play. The park has Southeast Asian style streets, five theme restaurants, eleven indoor projects and more than 30 outdoor amusement projects. There are more than 200 leisure landscape projects such as VR Soaring high-altitude flying experience project "Flying with You", super-large curved giant screen cinema "Into Angkor", magic ball performance theater "Song of Thousand Islands", 360 ° ring screen cinema "Taluan Festival", wooden roller coaster "Jungle Flying Dragon" and classic rotary roller coaster "Polar Express". 
Visit Fante ASEAN God Paintings, experience the wonderful feast of Southeast Asian culture, feel the magic of top high-tech, enjoy thrilling amusement projects, and taste the authentic food of Southeast Asia, so that you can play all over the fantasy ASEAN in one day without going abroad.
