shortFeatures: A relaxing park in the city
summary: Shishan Park is located next to Wucunling Turntable in Nanning, adjacent to Tanbin Road in the south, Tanwu Road in the west and Xiangzhu Avenue in the north. The total area of the park is about 80 hectares, the main part is about 71 hectares, and the water surface area is 45,000 square meters. It is a natural mountain pond with good water quality. The park is roughly surrounded by convex terrain and valley-like low concave in the middle. The highest point is 120.9 meters above sea level at the top of Luosnail Mountain, and the lowest point is 79.5 meters above sea level at the northern valley bottom. The mountains in the park are gentle and undulating, which is a typical hilly terrain. Shishan Park, officially opened in 1997, is one of the eight major parks in Nanning, integrating sightseeing, entertainment, food and fitness. The park has palm garden scenic spot, bamboo culture scenic spot, grassland activity area (big lawn, Fuxiang Garden, Baicao Garden), wild mountain forest area (Yinghongpo, Hexiang Ao, Hongdou Valley, wild barbecue area), water landscape area (Rising Sun Lake, Yueying Lake, Farming Entertainment Park), Fitness and entertainment areas (Bamboo Shadow Villa, field campaign, mountain sports, activities for the elderly and children) and other ten scenic spots. It is surrounded by dense forests, fragrant grass, bright red peach blossoms, relaxing water lilies and playing koi fish. The park focuses on plant landscaping, paying attention to ecological benefits and landscape benefits; Based on the original terrain and conditions, strive to create a natural landscape with outstanding hilly characteristics. The park has the reputation of "green emerald", with 800,000 tourists visiting Shishan Park every year.

tagNameList: Hi Play Park; Treasure place for walking babies; Water Parks
shortFeatures: Exciting water park adjacent to the zoo
summary:
You don't have to fly to the North Sea, but here you can step on the fine sand of Silver Beach, igniting the coolest and strongest summer passion. 
There are more than 20 world-class water games in the park, and rich water experience activities stimulate your sensory nerves. The highlight is the largest tsunami surfing area in the country. Challenge it and you are a warrior. When you are tired, there are also vitality SPA and sauna in the park, which can relax your body all day. Tickets are a little expensive, but definitely worth it!

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: One of the best cycas gardens in China
summary:
Qingxiushan Cycas Garden covers an area of 38 mu, where dozens of extremely precious cycas varieties are gathered. It is the largest specialized cycas garden in Asia, and there are more than a dozen iron trees blooming at the same time every year. More than a dozen dinosaur sculptures in the park are vivid, which makes people feel like entering the Jurassic period. 
Qingxiushan Cycas Garden is located on the west slope of Phoenix Ridge in Qingxiushan, with an altitude of 175-210 meters. It was initially completed and opened in November, 1998, covering an area of more than 50 mu. At present, 28 species of Cycas have been collected, forming the largest ex-situ conservation population of Cycas grate, Cycas Shishan, Cycas Debao and Cycas fork in China, realizing the perfect combination of Cycas protection and landscaping.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Grasslands; Forests
shortFeatures: Enjoy grass skiing and live-action CS.
summary: Liangfengjiang National Forest Park is a national-level forest park, consisting of three scenic areas: Fengjiang Green Wilderness, Bodhi Garden, and Amusement World. It is home to the only Yin-Yang integrated Bodhi tree in China, as well as the largest grass skiing field in Guangxi and the second largest in the country.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Memorial Temples
shortFeatures: A long history and a good choice for blessings
summary:
Confucius Temple is located in Qinghuan Road, Nanning City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, covering an area of about 46 mu and a building area of more than 3,500 square meters. Located at the foot of Qingxiu Mountain, a famous scenic spot in Nanning. Sit north and south, hold the Phoenix Tower on the left, hold the Dragon Elephant Tower on the right, and face Beacon Mountain in the distance. 
Nanning Confucius Temple was built in the Huangyou period of the Northern Song Dynasty (1049-1054). It was originally located in Shashi, outside the west gate of Cangmen in the city (now near the foot of the water tower in Xinhua Street). It was moved to Nanning Hotel in the third year of Baoqing in the Southern Song Dynasty (1227). Nanning Confucius Temple has been relocated three times from its establishment to the early Republic of China. Since the end of the Qing Dynasty, it has gradually collapsed, leaving only Dacheng Hall. In 1982, due to the expansion of Nanning Hotel, the old Confucius Temple was finally demolished. The removed building materials are preserved in Guangxi Exhibition Hall. In May 2007, the main project of Nanning Confucius Temple relocation started construction, and the relocation was completed on January 30, 2011, which lasted more than three years. The newly completed Confucius Temple is one of the largest Confucius temples in Guangxi and even Lingnan.

shortFeatures: The lake is a wheat field in spring and a pasture in summer
summary:
Gengwang Lake, whose source comes from Buquan River, is a seasonal natural lake, located at the junction of Buquan, Nanwei and Pingshan towns. To be exact, it is located near Jiuwangtun, Silian Village, Nanwei Town and Bangning Xinwangtun, Nanwei Town. 
The scenery is different all year round, and it is a "face-changing lake". She often plays the role of "Tianhu Lake in rainy season", "wheat field in spring" and "pasture in summer". With beautiful scenery, beautiful scenery, typical karst terrain and excellent ecological environment, it is an ideal place for go on road trip.

Lianyin Temple was built according to the scale and style of the royal temples in the Tang Dynasty, with a symmetrical layout of the central axis, a magnificent high platform, a shocking architectural construction and a majestic facade shape. The whole temple is built on the mountain and is the largest temple in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Villages; Flower Fields
shortFeatures: There are valleys on three sides and islands in the middle
summary: Peach Blossom Island is located in the northeast of the core scenic spot of Qingxiu Mountain, covering an area of about 200 mu. It is named after its three sides are valleys and islands in the middle, surrounded by clouds and mist all the year round, and it is like a fairy island. Peach Blossom Island has more than 30,000 plants of dozens of kinds, such as hairy peach, fei peach, fragrant peach, human face peach, sun and moon peach and pink jade peach. "The spring breeze arrives once a year, and peach blossoms are red once a year." Every February-March in the spring season, peach blossoms and rhododendrons on the island are in full bloom, colorful and colorful. Tourists come here in an endless stream to go for an outing, enjoy flowers and enjoy blessings, praying for happiness, good luck and good luck. Peach blossoms on human faces are enchanting, and thousands of flowers are competing for beauty and drunk in the spring breeze. What a wonderful picture of a fairyland on earth, and a beautiful scene of "peach blossoms on human faces are red". The Peach Blossom Art Festival was held in the scenic spot in 1995, and it has been successfully held for 19 times so far. It is a major brand of spring tourism in Nanning.

tagNameList: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids
shortFeatures: The year-round evergreen ecological oxygen bar
summary:
Guangxi Longmen Shuidu Cultural Ecological Tourism Scenic Area is located beside the Outer Ring Expressway in the High-tech Zone of Nanning. The scenic area covers an area of approximately 20.14 square kilometers, with a forest coverage rate of 98%. The high gorge and flat lake stretch over more than 700 acres, winding and curving along the mountain, resembling a dragon soaring through the sky.

The area boasts beautiful scenery, with evergreen trees throughout the year and a constant fragrance of flowers. Surrounded by mountains, it is densely forested, with streams crisscrossing and mountain springs flowing continuously. The concentration of negative oxygen ions reaches 30,000 to 60,000 per cubic centimeter of air, making it the largest and highest quality eco-friendly, low-carbon large-scale ecological sightseeing industry in Nanning.

The scenic spots include the Hundred Family Surnames Garden, Longyin Tianxia, Longying Gallery, Gourmet Corridor, Graphite Garden, Top Scholar Bridge, Water Walkway, Nine-Dragon Square, Ba Gui Top Scholar Forest, Longmen Reservoir, and Guixue Building, among others. It also features a conference center equipped with top-tier meeting facilities and a professional one-stop conference butler service. Additionally, there are pure hot springs, mountain spring medicinal baths, SPA treatments, children's water play areas, leisure swimming pools, and entertainment centers, making it a large-scale tourist resort that integrates entertainment, leisure, historical culture, natural scenery, business meetings, fitness activities, science education, and specialty dining.

shortFeatures: European town-style architectural complex
summary: European style town is located on the south side of Chuangxin Road in the hinterland of Nanning High-tech Industrial Development Zone, adjacent to Binhe Road in the west and Luban Road in the east. The total land area of the project is 115,695 square meters, and the total construction area is 81,925 square meters. Through windmills, churches, castle-style entrance gates and other architectural units, European-style towns organically integrate elements such as pointed vaulted ceilings and structures, retro architectural main colors and decorative styles into the town, showing people the unique European historical and cultural customs. Now it is free and open to the public, European style, and it is an excellent place to take photos.

To the east is the bustling downtown Wanda Commercial Plaza, and to the south is the wide Minzu Avenue, from which Deng Yingchao's birthplace faces the road. There are three floors in total. Personally, I think the best one is the letters of Deng Yingchao and Zhou Enlai on display.

Qingxiu Lake Park is adjacent to Zhuxi Avenue in the west, Huizhan Road in the east and Qingxiu Mountain Scenic Area in the south. Qingxiu Lake Park covers an area of 536.88 mu, of which the water area is 190.79 mu. It is a "pearl" at the foot of Qingxiu Mountain. The predecessor of Qingxiu Lake Park was Huangmaoping Reservoir. The park consists of four characteristic scenic spots: Bamboo Park, Waterfront Leisure Area, Recreation and Health Area and Cultural Activity Area. By re-integrating natural resources such as mountain shapes, water bodies and wetlands in the original lake area, Qingxiu Lake Park will be built into a regional urban comprehensive park with landscape gardens and humanistic context as its theme and service, scenery viewing, fitness, leisure, culture and health care as its goal.

tagNameList: Close to nature; love sports; Outdoor Diving; Beaches; Seashores; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Romantic diving resort destination
summary:
Wuzhizhou Island Tourist Area is a famous 5A-level scenic spot, located in Haitang Bay, Sanya City, covering an area of approximately 1.48 square kilometers. It boasts rich underwater ecological resources and a comprehensive water sports product system for "quadruple" ocean experiences. It has become a national coastal island resort integrating island sightseeing, recreational activities, honeymoon vacations, and family tourism, making it one of the most well-known tourist destination brands in China.

Here, you’ll find "China's first tropical marine ranch," which has nurtured and developed leading marine recreation methods. The island offers typical diving activities, such as luxury island circum-navigation diving, advanced diving, and coral reef diving. It also features new entertainment projects introduced from abroad, such as dynamic airships, dolphin submarines, and sky dance. In addition, there are helicopter island tours and an immersive outdoor wind tunnel experience center, catering to tourists' vacation desires and pursuits of "sea, land, air, and underwater" activities. Whether you're a curious diving explorer or an adventurous "extreme enthusiast," you will find the perfect activity here.

In addition to the diverse entertainment options, the island also boasts popular tourist spots like Lover's Bridge, Lover’s Island, Sun Viewing Rock, and custom-made swimming pools, all of which are perfect for capturing breathtaking photos. The winding coastline, crystal-clear waters, and the colorful, vibrant underwater world featuring various corals, mackerels, groupers, sea urchins, sea cucumbers, prawns, luminous snails, and a variety of tropical fish make it a premier diving destination in China. Currently, Wuzhizhou Island offers four main diving spots—Qilin Sea, Back Garden, Glass Fish Planet, and Little Universe—each with its own unique characteristics, attracting diving enthusiasts from around the world.

The only island hotel on the island, Coral Hotel, is one of the few high-end boutique island hotels in China. It consists of five connected buildings designed with coral as the prototype, built to five-star standards. The hotel offers various room types including sea-view, garden-view, poolside, duplex, suites, and wooden houses, totaling 305 rooms. It is a sweet destination for romantic proposals, honeymoon trips, and family vacations, providing a private and pure island leisure experience for visitors.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Golf Courses; Outdoor Diving; Beaches; Seashores; Water Sports
shortFeatures: Clear bay with well-known hotels
summary:
Known as the "No.1 Bay in the World", it is a good place to relax, enjoy delicious food and experience water sports. 
· It has a silver-white beach of about 7,000 meters, with fine sand and clean and transparent sea water. You can clearly see corals, and it shows several different blues from a distance. 
· There are many entertainment projects, such as taking a luxury yacht to the sea and watching sea lions and seals; Enjoy sailing, snorkeling and fishing; Soar into the blue sky with a paraglider on your back. 
The water temperature can reach about 20 ℃ in winter, and you can swim in the water all the year round. There are five-star luxury hotels around, making it a leisure resort to avoid the cold in winter.

poiName: English: The Ends of the Earth
tagNameList: Close to Nature; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Beaches; Rock Monuments
shortFeatures: Take a photo with the Sanya landmark stone carvings.
summary:
- Located at the western end of Sanya Bay, the beach is dotted with various rocks, many of which are engraved with inscriptions left by famous figures from both ancient and modern times.  
- The most famous are two giant stones inscribed with the words "Tianya" (End of the Sky) and "Haijiao" (Cape of the Sea), which have long been regarded as symbols of love and are also one of Sanya's iconic landmarks.  
- Other notable rock carvings include "Nantian Yizhu" (Pillar of the Southern Sky), also known as the "Wealth Stone", and "Riyue Shi" (Sun and Moon Stone), which symbolizes love.  
- The Celebrity Sculpture Park, the Couple Trees, and other unique attractions within the scenic area are also worth visiting.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the sea view and visit Buddhist landmarks.
summary:
- The Nanshan Cultural Tourism Zone is a large park showcasing traditional Chinese Buddhist culture, with numerous attractions inside. The 108-meter-tall Sea Guanyin statue is undoubtedly one of its highlights.
- Major attractions include Nanshan Temple, the Sea Guanyin Buddha statue, the "No Two Dharma Gates", the Ten Directions Pagoda Forest and the Returning to the Roots Garden, the Buddhist Culture Exchange Center, and the Vegetarian Cuisine Shopping Street.
- The world's largest Sea Guanyin statue is also located here. The statue, shaped in the form of Guanyin, faces three directions, is majestic in appearance, stands at 108 meters tall, and cost 190 million RMB to build. It is known as the "Treasure of the Island" throughout Hainan.
- The park has a vegetarian restaurant offering a "Temple Vegetarian Cuisine" buffet, and there are hotels providing accommodation, making it very convenient for sightseeing and Buddhist worship.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Beaches; Seashores
shortFeatures: The crescent-shaped bay near the city center.
summary:
- It is the earliest developed tropical coastal resort area in Sanya and also the closest bay to the city center.
- It is mainly concentrated in a small area by the beach, with accommodation prices much cheaper than Yalong Bay. The cost of living here is moderate, and it is relatively lively at night.
- The beach and water quality are not as good as Yalong Bay, but much better than Sanya Bay. The water visibility is very high, and many people come here to sunbathe.
- Public swimming areas offer rentals for life rings, umbrellas, lounge chairs, etc. Freshwater showers and locker rentals are charged separately.

tagNameList: Watch a show; Treasure place for walking babies
shortFeatures: Appreciate the rich Li culture in Sanya
summary:
Sanya Eternal Scenic Area is a living ancient city of Li and Miao. 
There are dozens of theme areas in the scenic spot, such as Yazhou Ancient Street, Love Street, Licun Miao Village, Interactive Amusement Hall, Virtual Space, Water Playing Area, Eternal Love Inn, etc., which are suitable for both rain and shine, and can enjoy young and old. 
The main show "Eternal Love in Sanya" is a must-see performance in a lifetime. Based on the magnificent history of Sanya for 10,000 years, it breaks through the boundary between traditional space and feeling with its brand-new stage design, making every corner filled with the tension of the performance in full bloom, shaking the audience's visual and auditory nerves. 
The 5D live-action drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, and houses collapsing. Real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
In the scenic spot, the performing arts shows such as "Recruiting Marriage in Lizhai", "Dopamine Flash", "YOLO Carnival" and "Li Miao Celebrating a Harvest Year" are splendid, allowing visitors to feel the history, culture and folk customs of Sanya for thousands of years. With constant activities all year round, it is an ideal destination for Sanya tourism.  
Sanya Eternal Scenic Area, give me one day and give you a thousand years!

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches; Seashores; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful sunset with red clouds
summary:
It is close to the downtown area of Sanya, with the Coconut Tree Binhai Avenue stretching for more than 20 kilometers, where the famous Coconut Dream Promenade is located. 
Sanya Bay is located close to the city and Phoenix Airport, and the hotel price is much affordable. 
Sanya Bay is a good place to enjoy the sunset. When the sun sets, it is very romantic to come to the seaside to watch the tide.  
Sanya Bay is very lively at night, with street performances along the route and beer bars in various hotels full of popularity.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountains; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Climb to a high place to enjoy the scenery and seascape of Sanya.
summary:
- Located on the southern tip of the Luhuitou Peninsula in Sanya, surrounded by the sea on three sides and adjacent to downtown Sanya on the other, it is an ideal viewpoint for overlooking the sea, watching the sunrise and sunset, and getting a panoramic view of the entire city.
- The beautiful love legend of the Li people and the Luhuitou sculpture in the park are among the symbols of Sanya, often referred to as the "Deer City," and they serve as the city's emblem and calling card.
- In the core area of the Sanya Forest Vegetation Nature Reserve, with a greening coverage rate of 96.6%, over 300 plant species, and dozens of wild animals living within.

shortFeatures: Walk through the beautiful seaside coconut grove
summary:
Coconut Dream Promenade is a seaside scenic avenue built around Sanya Bay. Coconut trees are neatly arranged along the roadside, forming a wonderful picture with the beach and sea water. 
· This is a world-class cold shelter and leisure resort; On one side of the sea is a tropical botanical garden forest, and on the other side is a leisure resort. 
Visiting the Coconut Dream Promenade in the evening is the most emotional thing. The golden sunset will cover the whole Coconut Dream Promenade. If there are clouds, it will also form a rare phenomenon of burning clouds.

tagNameList: Waterfront beach; Nature and Adventure; Caves; Beaches; Seashores
shortFeatures: Mountain and sea views complement each other
summary:
The Big and Small Dongtian Scenic Spot has a history of more than 800 years. It is a famous Taoist cultural scenic spot and is known as "the first landscape scenic spot in Qiongya". 
· The mountains in the tourist area have lush vegetation and beautiful scenery, with nearly 30,000 lush dracaena trees (Nanshan immortal pine). 
There are clear springs and all kinds of wild animals in the mountains, and the seven-kilometer coastline below the mountain is winding and full of stone scenery. 
There are strange rocks and secluded caves, and there are large and small Lei groups all over the coast, including Dragon King in the South China Sea, Xiaodongtian, Shenao in the South China Sea and other landscapes.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gem for kids; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas; Water Sports
shortFeatures: Seaside leisure and entertainment resort
summary:
· Xidao is a small island located southwest of Sanya city, with beautiful scenery and crystal-clear water. The number of visitors is relatively low.  
· Various marine recreational activities are available, and it is especially known as a diving destination. Visitors can also travel to Niu Wang Island for sightseeing.  
· There is a Xidao Restaurant on the island, and compared to the city, the prices here are on the higher side.  
· At night, visitors can stay at a seaside hotel or camp, and participate in various night-time activities, such as night fishing, night diving, beach bonfire parties, and more.

poiName: Nanshan Guanyin of the South Sea
tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Statues/Sculptures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Majestic statue of Guanyin Bodhisattva
summary:
The statue of Guanyin on the sea in Nanshan is 108 meters high, and Lingbo stands on the King Kong Island on the sea. It is known as a "world-class and century-class" Buddhist project. 
· Integrated three shapes, with solemn treasure appearance, stepping on a 108-petal lotus throne, under the lotus seat is the Vajra Terrace, and inside the Vajra Terrace is the Yuantong Treasure Hall. 
Jingangzhou is connected with the land bank by Puji Bridge. On the other side of Puji Bridge is Guanyin Square and theme parks on both sides of the square. 
In addition, we also make full use of high-tech techniques to create lighted night scenes, fully displaying the cultural and artistic effects of Guanyin such as "Buddha's light shines everywhere" and "stepping on the sea".

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches; Seashores
shortFeatures: Many high-end hotels gather
summary:
Haitang Bay is ranked among the five famous bays in Sanya along with Yalong Bay, Dadong Bay, Sanya Bay and Yazhou Bay. 
Haitang Bay is beautiful, quiet and comfortable. Compared with Yalong Bay and Dadonghai, it has not been infected with the hustle and bustle of the city. 
Haitang Bay was developed relatively late, and it is far from Sanya city. Compared with Yalong Bay and Dadonghai, there are relatively few people here. 
· Suitable for racing motorboats and scuba diving. There is also the largest duty-free shop in the world-Haitang Bay Duty Free Shop in Sanya, Hainan.

tagNameList: Island walk; Night tour viewing; Islands/Peninsulas; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Sanya Bay Artificial Island Landmark
summary:
Phoenix Island, located at the southeast end of Sanya Bay, is an artificial island filled in the sea reef. The five hotel buildings on the island are magnificent and avant-garde, and they are the most beautiful landscape on the sea. 
· The island is home to super-star hotels, international yacht clubs and international cruise ports. It is known as the Dubai of the East and a holiday paradise on the sea. 
Relying on the mountain scenery on three sides, it has a unique tourism scenery of mountains, seas and sky, and has the conditions for maritime entertainment, water sports and all-season holiday tourism.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Love sports; Beaches; Surfing; Villages
shortFeatures: Watch the sunrise and taste fresh seafood
summary:
Also known as Tenghai Fishing Village, the leisurely fishing village atmosphere, distinctive fishermen's life and authentic seafood ingredients are the characteristics of Houhai Fishing Village. 
Houhai and wuzhizhou island in the north are distant from each other. Shangdao Pier in wuzhizhou island is here, and there is a white lighthouse at the entrance of the bay. 
Looking from the beach every day, there is a quiet and peaceful scenery. There is also a scenery that can't be seen in Sanya Bay, Dadonghai and Yalong Bay-sunrise on the sea.

shortFeatures: Sanya's sandy beach
summary: Wuzhizhou Island Bathing Beach is located in the northwest corner of wuzhizhou Island. It has a white and soft beach, which is the only place on the island suitable for swimming in the sea. It is also known as the white beach. The sand of this bathing beach is fine, and the sea water here gradually changes from faint blue to deep blue, with distinct colors and high clarity.

poiName: Phoenix Ridge Love Vows Scenic Area
tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Mountains; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Climb to the summit and overlook the four bays of Sanya
summary:
Sanya Phoenix Ridge Everyone Scenic Spot is located in the center of Sanya, which is the highest peak in the center of Sanya. It is the only best place to have a full view of the four major bays of Sanya (Sanya Bay, East China Sea, Yulin Bay and Yalong Bay) and a 360 bird's-eye view of the whole city of Sanya. 
· The scenic spot introduces the world's most advanced Austrian ropeway, which is known as the Rolls-Royce of ropeways. It is the aerial ropeway with the largest investment and the best scenery in southern China. The cable car rises slowly, giving you a panoramic view of the entire city. It is known as Asia's No. 1 ropeway for viewing the sea and watching the city. 
The scenic spot has love-themed landscapes such as the stone tablet of eternal vows, Ruying Pavilion, Handle Platform, Yuelaoquan, Lovers Tree, Crystal Temple, etc. It is known as the southernmost love holy place on China's continental shelf, and is also known as the love holy mountain at 18 north latitude.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
summary:
Lover's Bridge is an important shooting location of Private Customization. It was originally an iron chain bridge, and it was the watchpoint of the troops guarding the island at sea. 
Some tourists want to cross the bridge to the lookout point to experience it, but they are afraid of falling into the sea water. When crossing the bridge, they hold on to their friends' hands, so this bridge is nicknamed "Lover's Bridge". 
Later, for the sake of guests' safety, the original chain bridge was transformed into the current wooden bridge. It is still the most desirable place for couples. 
There are also a pair of lovely statues and a photo seat at the beginning of the bridge. Friends who go there should not miss it.

shortFeatures: Popular attractions in Forest Park
summary:
Spanning between two mountains, with a total length of about 168 meters and nearly 40 meters above the ground, it is the longest span and highest cable bridge above the ground in Hainan at present. 
On the poster of If You Are the One 2, Shu Qi is walking barefoot on the suspension bridge, and Ge You is watching from a distance behind her, which is where she is taking pictures. 
Standing on the cable bridge and looking out, you can see the picturesque scenery in the mountains, the vegetation is flourishing and green, and there are forest stone paths at both ends of the bridge. 
Walking over the cable bridge, accompanied by the footsteps, the bridge deck gently shakes, which is full of fun.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Beaches
shortFeatures: A peaceful beach in a quiet environment
summary:
If Sanya sea area is recognized as a diving resort in the world, then Xiaodonghai is a resort among resorts. 
There are beautiful and rich coral populations and tropical fish on the seabed, as well as quaint wooden buildings, and a strong leisure atmosphere. 
· There are various marine recreational activities in the area, such as scuba diving, underwater walking, night diving, sightseeing boat, semi-submarine, parachute towing, deep-sea fishing, underwater camera and beach leisure.  
· Xiaodonghai Sea Area is one of Sanya National Nature Reserves approved by the State Council. The water quality of the sea area is Class I, and there are more than 600 kinds of marine life.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Temples
shortFeatures: Large-scale antique monasteries
summary:
Located in Nanshan Cultural Tourism Zone, Sanya, it is a large temple imitating the style of the prosperous Tang Dynasty and facing the sea. 
There are existing imitation buildings of Tang Dynasty, such as Renwang Hall, Tianwang Hall, Bell Tower, Runwheel Collection, East-West Mountain Climbing Gallery, East-West Side Hall and Golden Hall. 
· The main hall is called Golden Hall. The three main statues enshrined in the golden hall represented the "Buddha of the Three Generations" in space. 
· The whole building is magnificent. It is the largest Buddhist dojo newly built in China in the past 50 years and the largest temple in southern China.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Observation deck; Aquariums; Rock Monuments; Observation Decks
shortFeatures: Good location for watching sunrise at sea
summary:
· Guanri Rock is located on the southeast cliff of wuzhizhou island. Standing on the rock, it faces the sea and the wind, overlooking the whole island, and has a panoramic view of the vast South China Sea. 
• Beneath the cliff, there are strange rocks. Guanri Rock is like a natural big stone Buddha, facing the sea, and practicing day and night. 
· Every day, the first ray of dawn rises here, and the crimson sun rises slowly from the sea, forming an excellent sea viewing point. 
· Guests staying on the island who want to watch the sunrise can check the sunrise time at the hotel front desk.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Love sports; Outdoor Diving; Water Sports
summary:
· This area is very experiential with a wide variety of corals and algae, as well as huge fish schools. 
Projects include Beauty Reef scuba diving, deep-sea diving motorcycle, banana boat, glass sightseeing boat, beach bathing, etc. 
The glass boat sightseeing can dive 1.7 meters, which is suitable for people who don't want to dive or who are physically unsuitable but want to see the underwater world. 
If you don't participate in any water sports, you can also come and play in the water and sand.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

poiName: Sanya Haichang Fantasy Ocean Night City
tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Play, watch shows and enjoy food
summary: With the theme of the Maritime Silk Road, Sanya Haichang Dream Ocean Never Sleeps City has built four theme areas: Haitang Bay, African Sea, Persian Gulf and Bangladesh. It has 16 amusement projects, a theater show, a night float parade, more than 30 global performing arts every day, more than 20 restaurants and more than 30 shops... It integrates Haisi culture, Hainan culture and marine culture with amusement, food and performing arts as the core.
opening_hours: Opens at 14:00-22:00(Tickets available until 21:30; admission ends at 21:30)

shortFeatures: Enjoy the sea view along the wooden corridor
summary: On the west side of wuzhizhou Island, wooden corridors and platforms have been built along the coastal terrain. You can watch the clear sea water of wuzhizhou Island along the corridor. Because there are many reefs in this area, you can see many crabs "walking" on the reefs. If you are lucky, you can also see schools of tropical fish on the platform.

Dadonghai is located between Yulin Port and Luhuitou in Sanya City. Sanya Dadonghai Tourist Scenic Spot has been rated as a 4A-level scenic spot, becoming the first zero-charge open scenic spot in Sanya. Dadonghai Square is the only way to reach Dadonghai. The square has a large free area, green grass and dancing coconut groves, and is a good place for citizens and tourists.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Seaside beach; Flower Fields
shortFeatures: Popular wedding photography resort
summary:
Wedding photography shooting base, rose planting and breeding base.  
Yalong Bay International Rose Valley is located in Yalong Bay National Tourism Resort, Sanya City, Hainan Province. The scenic spot takes beauty, romance and love as its theme, takes colorful roses as its carrier, and is the largest Rose Valley in Asia, integrating rose planting, rose culture display, tourism, leisure and vacation.

shortFeatures: A popular place for leisure
summary:
Adjacent to Coconut Dream Corridor, it is one of the places where the torch relay passes in Sanya. Creative and swaying willow leaf sculptures in the square, and the pool with the bright moon in the sea as the concept, 
Integrated with the beautiful Sanya Bay, it is positioned by people as the "life window" of the public, the "art hall" of the common people and the "happy stage" of the grassroots.  
The word "Haiyue" is taken from the famous sentence in the poem "Looking at the Moon and Huayuan" by Zhang Jiuling of the Tang Dynasty: "The bright moon is born on the sea, and the whole of the earth is at this time". Naming this square with "Haiyue" means that the square is backed by Fushan Mountain and faces the sea. It is magnificent, full of green, and under the bright moonlight, it adds a sense of hazy elegance, softness and harmony.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares
shortFeatures: One of the landmarks of Yalong Bay
summary:
· Yalong Bay landmark, a large waterscape platform on the beach of Yalong Bay, overlooking the whole sea view of Yalong Bay. 
The totem pole, the highest point of the square, is composed of more than 200 huge granite pieces and aluminum alloy columns with a diameter of 2.5 meters, carved with the patterns of dragon, phoenix, sunbird, fish and four gods of wind, rain, thunder and lightning. 
The central sculpture area around the totem pole is composed of three circles of stone formations: the first circle has the four seasons logo of black dragon, white tiger, Suzaku and Xuanwu and the sundial 24 solar terms sculpture; The second circle shows eight ancient myths, such as Pangu opening heaven and earth, Nuwa mending the sky, Chang'e flying to the moon, etc. The third circle reflects astronomy, people, animals, plants and eight ancient Chinese gods. 
· There are food courts and shell pavilions around, which can be used as a resting place.

tagNameList: Island walk; Seaside beach; Beaches; Islands/Peninsulas
shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful seaside scenery with your lover
summary: Two big stones that have experienced thousands of years of ebbs and flows but still stand and face each other quietly. Legend has it that in ancient times, people named it in memory of a pair of infatuated lovers who were turned into stone by the angry dragon king who fell in love. They are Angkor and Zhimei. According to legend, Angkor and Zhimei are here to darn fishing nets and make vows of love. A good place. Now it has become a major scenic spot in wuzhizhou, and it is a good place for young men and women to whisper and listen to the waves.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; City coordinates; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Feel Luhuitou culture
summary: Located opposite the old duty-free shop in Dadonghai, it is a simple leisure square with not many leisure facilities. Several companies in Sanya Night Tour Sanya Bay have ticket sales locations here, which are relatively concentrated. Every afternoon from 17: 00 to 21: 00, there are more guests who come here at night, and it is more lively.

There are clear sea water, clean sandy beaches and strange rocks on strange reefs. It is a quiet and pristine beach, and it is a paradise for outdoor lovers. 
Queen's Bay is located at the southern end of Haitang Bay, between wuzhizhou island and Yalong Bay. Most of the people here are one-day trips to find agents, and the main activities are sea fishing and diving. 
Originally, it was an unknown bay in the outer port of Houhai Fishing Village in Sanya. Because of the complicated seabed environment and dense reefs here, it is not suitable for fishermen to cast nets for fishing. Therefore, the seabed and surrounding environment here preserve the original ecology. Nowadays, people regard it as a back garden far away from Sanya, which is a good place for Sanya citizens to travel around, because the sea water in this sea area is clear and transparent, and the highest visibility is more than 20 meters.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests
shortFeatures: Show the original ecological tropical rainforest landscape
summary:
Orchid Valley is mainly the original ecological tropical rain forest landscape. There is a circular trail of more than 1,000 meters in the valley, with dense vines and gurgling streams. 
There are dozens of kinds of orchids in the valley, blooming brilliantly. Along the walking and climbing route, towering giant banyan trees and century-old vines cover the sun, and you can feel bursts of freshness and coolness.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Towns
shortFeatures: Visit Yazhou Academy and Ancient City Gate
summary:
There are a batch of Buddhist classics left by the famous monk Jian Zhen in the Tang Dynasty to be brought to Japan, which is a magical treasure in the cultural history of Yazhou. 
Yazhou City, now Yacheng Town, Sanya City, is located more than 40 kilometers west of Sanya City. Yazhou has been established since the Southern and Northern Dynasties, and Dezhou, County and County Jun have been located here since the Song Dynasty. Today's Yacheng has become a tourist attraction in Hainan because of its long history and numerous places of interest. Yazhou Ancient City still has ancient city gates, Confucius Temple and other sites. Yacheng Confucius Temple was built in the Ming Dynasty, with Dacheng Hall, Wenming Gate, Chongsheng Temple and Zunjing Pavilion.

shortFeatures: Take a panoramic view of Yalong Bay
summary: The full-seascape glass plank road is located at the top of Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park, with the highest point at an altitude of 450 meters. It is the first full-seascape glass plank road in China. The plank road is built around the world's largest natural Maitreya stone Buddha, with a total length of 400 meters and a widest point of 10 meters. It is composed of 130 tons of ultra-white imported laminated glass, including scenic spots such as volley platform, colorful ladder, colorful lotus Buddha platform, rainbow road, mountain alliance vows and heart-to-heart relationship. The plank road pavement is all paved with 3M * 3M super-large single transparent glass. When walking on the plank road, you can look up at the sky and clouds, look down at the rainforest valley more than 100 meters deep, and look down at Yalong Bay, the "best sea view in the world", from a distance. In addition to being scared, you can enjoy the joy of flying in the air.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nature and Adventure; Flower Fields; Attractions
shortFeatures: Li ethnic culture and folk customs experience
summary:
- Sanya Haitang Bay Rice National Park primarily features large areas of rice fields, including the Yuan Longping Rice Experimental Field. It is hailed as the "back garden" of Haitang Bay National Coast.
- The surrounding area is equipped with supporting facilities such as a charming town, an agricultural museum, a folk art gallery, a large-scale live performance stage, and a rice culture photography base.
- Highlights include scenic rice flower fields, a dinosaur science education base, live performances in the fields, and a parent-child amusement park. Visitors can observe rice growth on the embankments, admire flowers in the flower fields, and interact with dinosaurs in the science park.
opening_hours: Opens at Daytime 08:30-18:00(Admission ends at 17:00),Opens at Evening 17:00-23:00(Admission ends at 22:30)

tagNameList: Waterfront beach; Nature and Adventure; City Parks; Wetlands
shortFeatures: Wetland park suitable for birds
summary:
It is far away from the residential area, and there are few tourists in the park. Egrets walking leisurely by the lake and river can be seen everywhere, which has become a paradise for egrets.  
Egret Park is located on the banks of Linchun River in Sanya City, in the east of Sanya City. The park is divided into several areas, such as Coconut Grove Style Area, Green Island Jincu Area, Jinghu Yinbo Area, Haitian Yise Area, Mangrove Fan Park and Xiande Mingxiang Area. In the center of the park is a small lake named Egret Lake.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Exhibition Halls
summary:
· Yalong Bay Shell Pavilion is located on the ground floor of the central square of Yalong Bay National Tourism Resort. It is currently the first comprehensive exhibition hall in China with the theme of shells and integrating science popularization, exhibition and sales. 
In the exhibition hall, more than 300 kinds of representative shells from all over the world are displayed in five sea areas, including angel-winged seagull clam symbolizing purity, colorful Australian sea fan clam, famous living fossils red snail and nautilus, etc. 
· The museum is equipped with modern and advanced projection equipment, which can continuously show visitors all kinds of fish, shellfish, coral and other peculiar natural landscapes in the ocean. 
There is also a shopping mall inside, and the products are mainly handicrafts and souvenirs based on shells.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
summary: Licun Miao Village is located on the outskirts of Sanya City, Hainan Province, where the most primitive indigenous people in Hainan live, and it is the epitome of Li Miao folk customs in Hainan.

shortFeatures: Rich and diverse vegetation species
summary:
· There are thousands of butterflies naturally growing in Butterfly Valley. Colorful butterflies can be seen dancing among green trees and flowers everywhere. If you are lucky, some butterflies will fall on you.  
Surrounded by mountains on both sides, there is a stream running through the valley bottom in the middle. The vegetation is rich, and there are many precious plants growing, such as dracaena, spectacle bean, water weng, etc., and the environment is very good. 
· There are more than 500 kinds of exquisite butterflies and insect specimens on display in the specimen exhibition hall, including precious world-representative butterflies such as golden-beaked Papilio butterfly, three-tailed Papilio butterfly, three-tailed Papilio butterfly and multi-tailed Papilio butterfly. 
Come here to play. All kinds of beautiful butterflies and exotic insect specimens not only bring people beautiful feelings, but also spread popular science knowledge and ecological awareness of insects.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Nanyang-style old-fashioned architectural street
summary:
Arcade buildings are all over Xinhua Road, Zhongshan Road, Changdi Road and other streets in Haikou. They have a history of more than 90 years and are famous historical and cultural streets. 
There are more than 600 small buildings with several floors, large and small, which were built by returned overseas Chinese from Nanyang in the last century and returned to their hometown by drawing lessons from Nanyang style architecture. 
Deshengsha Road is the largest clothing wholesale market in Hainan, and Xinhua South Road has traditional tailor shops, civilian clothing and shoe shops, teahouses and snack shops. 
Zhongshan Road is full of cafes, galleries, handicraft shops, etc. Small shops on the street of Boai Road sell home appliances, small commodities, etc., and there are many snacks around.

tagNameList: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Tropical Ecological Garden for Citizens' Leisure
summary:
Located in the reclamation area on the north side of Haikou, facing Qiongzhou Strait, it is the largest open tropical seaside ecological garden landscape garden in Haikou. 
· Many tropical ornamental plants are planted in Wanlv Garden, which integrates clear water and blue sky with high-rise buildings. 
The 16 scenic spots and many surrounding supporting facilities in the park are complete. It is a large park for Haikou citizens to exercise in the morning and take a walk in the evening.

poiName: Leiqiong Haikou Volcano Group Global Geopark
tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gem for children; Volcanoes
shortFeatures: The remnants of the volcanic eruption showcase the craftsmanship of nature.
summary: Haikou Shishan Volcanic Cluster Global Geopark is located in Shishan Town, southwest of Haikou City. It can be reached via the Green Corridor from the West Line Expressway, and the Ring Expressway passes through the park. It is a geological relic of fault-rift type basaltic volcanic activity and one of the few dormant volcanic clusters in China from the Holocene epoch (10,000 years ago). The park holds significant value for scientific research, education, and tourism.

tagNameList: Close to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Beaches; Seashores
shortFeatures: Haikou's iconic seaside leisure destination
summary:
- Located in the northern part of Haikou, stretching 6 kilometers, the beach faces the boundless Qiongzhou Strait, with sailboats coming and going, creating a picturesque scene.  
- The beach consists of sunbathing areas, water sports zones, dining areas, and leisure sections, making it a comprehensive seaside tourism and leisure destination in Haikou.  
- The beach also features a dedicated barbecue area and a water park, which are lively and bustling with crowds throughout the day.  
- Nearby, there are yacht rental services and numerous luxury hotels to choose from, while strolling along the clean coastal avenue and enjoying the breeze is incredibly pleasant.

shortFeatures: A leisure park with both entertainment and viewing
summary:
Baishamen Park is located in the north of Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou City, bordering Qiongzhou Strait in the north. There are four tourism theme areas: Haikou Annual Ring, Happy Ocean, Xiban Coast and City Post Station, including Baishamen Children's Amusement Park, Pottery Sculpture Interpretation of Mazu Culture and Baishamen Park Tennis Court. 
The park also has a wetland scenic spot with pastoral ecological characteristics, which is the most distinctive place that distinguishes the park from other parks in Haikou. There is a complete water system, a small sandbar in the water, and a unique wooden bridge connecting the road section, which makes people experience the pastoral fun.

Located in the north of Haikou facing the estuary, it is listed as one of the eight scenic spots in Haikou and an important landmark building in Haikou.  
It was first established to adapt to foreign trade, but now it is rebuilt by Haikou government according to the needs of urban construction. The big clock is set on the top floor, and the Shanghai 555 brand electronic clock is used to tell the time every 30 minutes, and electronic music is broadcast by loudspeakers. 
The old and mottled buildings opposite the bell tower are the famous Qilou Old Street.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Memorial Temples
shortFeatures: Understanding the ancient culture of official demotion in ancient buildings
summary:
Wugong Temple Complex is located at No.169 Haifu Avenue, Haikou City, about 5 kilometers away from the city center. Near the downtown area, it is unique and quiet, and is known as "Qiongtai Scenic Spot", "Yinghai Humanities" and "Hainan's No.1 Scenic Spot". The building complex of Wugong Temple includes: the first floor of Hainan (also known as Wugong Temple), Xuepu Hall, Guanjia Hall, Xizhai (Wugong Jingshe), Dongzhai, Su Gong Temple, Liangfubo Temple, Dongzhuo Pavilion, Fusu Spring, Qiongyuan and the newly-built Wugong Temple Exhibition Hall. 
Wugong Temple is a cultural relic and historic site that displays ancient Chinese demotion culture, Hainan history and culture and ancient architectural art with Hainan characteristics. "Wugong Temple" is the general name of a group of ancient buildings, covering an area of about 100 mu together with gardens, wells and ponds. It was built in the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty, rebuilt in the 15th year of Guangxu in the Qing Dynasty (1889), and then repaired many times, and it is still shining brightly.

shortFeatures: A comprehensive understanding of Hainan's history and culture
summary:
Hainan Museum is located at 68 Guoxing Avenue, Haikou City, covering an area of over 60 mu, with a construction area of 44,500 square meters, an exhibition hall area of 12,000 square meters, and a storage area of 9,300 square meters. It is one of the major cultural construction projects of Hainan Province during the "12th Five-Year Plan" period and has been rated as one of the six most beautiful buildings in Hainan.

The preparation of Hainan Museum began in 1984. The first phase was completed and opened on November 15, 2008, and the second phase fully opened on May 18, 2017. It is a comprehensive museum in Hainan Province and a national first-class museum.

The exhibitions of Hainan Museum are systematically curated with the theme "Nanmeng Qidian" ("The Marvelous Land of the Southern Sea"). The exhibitions consist of three major permanent displays: "Voyage through the Southern Sea: Marine Civilization of the South China Sea," "Frontiers of a Unique Land: Hainan History," and "Between the Mortal and the Divine: Hainan Culture." Additionally, there are two special exhibitions: "The Queen of Wood: Hainan Huanghuali Wood" and "The King of Fragrance: Hainan Agarwood," as well as four intangible cultural heritage exhibitions: "Qiong Workshop: Hainan Traditional Handicrafts," "Qiong Delicacies Street: Hainan Culinary Culture," "Qiong Ethnic Village: Hainan Minority Intangible Cultural Heritage," and "Qiong Stage: Hainan Performing Arts." 

This comprehensive exhibition system vividly brings to life the marvelous Hainan scenery described in Ming Dynasty scholar Qiu Jun's essay *Ode to the Marvelous Land of the Southern Sea* for the public to appreciate.

shortFeatures: Take a pleasant walk on the campus covered with coconut trees
summary: Hainan University is located in Haikou, the capital of Hainan Province, a national historical and cultural city. It is a comprehensive key university in Hainan Province. The campus covers a total area of more than 5,200 mu. It is a university jointly established by Hainan Province, the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Finance, a key construction university of the national "211 Project", a national outstanding engineer education and training plan, a national outstanding legal talent education and training plan, and a national "Comprehensive Strength Improvement Project of Central and Western Universities" were selected as universities. He is a main member of the "Midwest University Alliance".

poiName: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden
tagNameList: Cute Animals; Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens; Zoos
shortFeatures: Close encounters with animals in the tropical jungle
summary: Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden, also known as Dongshan Wildlife Park, is China's first large-scale tropical wildlife park and the country's only island-type tropical rainforest botanical and zoological garden. It is acclaimed as a "natural museum that condenses the essence of Hainan Island's native flora and fauna." The park is located in Dongshan Town, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, approximately 27 kilometers from downtown Haikou. It is themed around tropical wildlife exhibitions and science popularization. The park's landscapes are entirely natural, with vast forested areas and dense vegetation providing an excellent wild environment for animals. Meanwhile, the artificially created jungle trails and a variety of exotic flowers and plants make visitors feel as if they are immersed in a vibrant natural world full of birdsong and floral fragrances.
opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

tagNameList: Waterfront beach; Surf; Beaches; Surfing; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A coastal tourist destination where sailing is popular
summary: Xixiu Beach, formerly known as Haikou Xiuying Beach, is about 6 kilometers away from the city center, with a coastline length of about 1,200 meters, which is close to Holiday Beach. Xixiu Beach was rated as one of the "Eight Scenic Spots in Haikou" by Haikou citizens in 1980s. In 1986, the State Sports Commission designated it as the only national sailing and windsurfing winter training base in China, and trained many Asian Games champions, world medalists and Atlanta Olympic champion Hong Kong athlete Li Lishan, such as Qi Guojian and Li Ke.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Nature Reserves; National Parks
shortFeatures: Take a boat shuttle among half-flooded mangroves
summary: Dongzhaigang Mangrove Nature Reserve is about 30 kilometers away from the city center and 12 kilometers away from Haikou Meilan International Airport. It spans Yanfeng Town, Sanjiang Farm and Sanjiang Town in Meilan District, Haikou City, and borders Luodou Farm in Wenchang City, with a total coastline of 84 kilometers. It is the first mangrove nature reserve in China. Different from mangroves in other places, at high tide in Dongzhai Port, the dense mangroves will be flooded by the tide, exposing only the green canopy rippling with the waves, becoming a spectacular "sea forest". In addition, it is also a "bird paradise" and a "natural farm".
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:30(Tickets available until 18:00; admission ends at 18:00)

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Bridges; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A majestic bridge body
summary: Haikou Century Bridge is located on the northward extension line of Longkun North Road. There are four towers at both ends of the main bridge and bridgehead squares on the north and south banks. Century Bridge is not only a key construction project in Hainan Province, but also a landmark building in Haikou City. The bridge is located at the intersection of "Haikou Bund", Wanlv Garden and Meisha, which have great urban cultural charm. The completion of the bridge will greatly promote the potential accumulated by Qiongbei coastline to extend and expand from the "center" of the bridge to the two wings, forming a coastline with truly infinite charm. Century Bridge is brightly lit at night, and it is another landmark and majestic building in Haikou.

poiName: Haikou Mission Hills Volcanic Hot Spring Valley
tagNameList: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
shortFeatures: Enjoy special hot springs on five continents
summary:
The main building of the hot spring area is inspired by the unique circular earth building in southern China, and a large number of bamboo and volcanic stones are used as materials to create a simple and natural atmosphere. The park includes volcanic rock mineral hot springs with the styles of six continents around the world, uniquely designed spas and outdoor volcanic rock water parks. 
Volcanic mineral hot spring is taken from natural spring water with a depth of about 800 meters underground. The natural water temperature is between 15 ℃ and 43 ℃, and it contains various natural mineral ingredients with health effects. The water quality has been certified by the British International Water Quality Institute.

shortFeatures: Tree-lined popular civic park
summary: Haikou People's Park is the largest park in Haikou at present. It is located in the city center. It was founded in 1954 and covers a total area of 440 mu. It is a platform-shaped hilly land. According to functional zoning, the whole park is divided into East and West Lake tourist area, martyrs memorial area, tropical plant specimen area, quiet rest area, orchid garden, animal area and living area, etc. Looking down at Haikou in the air, the park is like a green Penglai floating in the sea of buildings. Hainan Liberation Monument stands on Daying Mountain at the entrance of the main entrance of the park. It was built in 1954 to commemorate the martyrs who died heroically for a long time in Qiongdao Revolution and crossing the sea. There are statues of General Feng Baiju and Feng Baiju Memorial Pavilion in the park. The "Statue of General Feng Baiju" is carved on the highest of the five peaks made of thirteen granite pieces, with a solemn, resolute and lifelike appearance. The front of the statue base is engraved with the five golden characters "General Feng Baiju" written by Deng Xiaoping. The five peaks symbolize Wuzhishan, represent Qiongya, and symbolize the leadership core of Qiongya Party Organization. Feng Baiju is the leader of this core and the Optimus Prime of Qiongya. The memorial pavilion consists of three pavilions and promenades, which are naturally integrated with the statue in layout. Monuments, statues and pavilions echo each other, adding a solemn and magnificent landscape to the park. There are East Lake and West Lake in front of the main entrance of the park, such as a pair of beautiful eyes in Haikou city. Surrounded by the lakeside coconut groves, the willows are green and shaded, cool and quiet. East Lake has an oval shape. There's an island in the middle of the lake. The pavilions on the island are magnificent. The garden gate is connected by Jiuqu Bridge. The West Lake is a short-necked gourd-shaped, with a wide water surface. Whenever the bright moon is in the sky, the coconut is charming, and the silver scales shine on the east and west lakes, which set off with the towering green of Daying Mountain. The lakes and mountains, the coconut shadow mother-in-law, and the boating are refreshing and happy. There is also a zoo in the park, which is inhabited by tropical and subtropical animals, and now a new aquarium has been opened. The park actually has a green area of 258 mu, which is lined with trees and lush flowers and trees. There are more than 1,000 species of tropical and subtropical plants in 167 families, and more than 50,000 large and small trees and shrubs. The green space area accounts for 87.2% of the land area of the park. It can also be described as a tropical botanical garden. In recent years, a new playground has been built in the park, which usually attracts many adults and children. During festivals, various exhibitions and amusement activities turn the park into a hot spot for amusement.

shortFeatures: A comprehensive park lined with palms
summary: Jinniuling Park is located on the south side of the middle section of Haixiu Avenue in the downtown area of Haikou, covering an area of 105 hectares. The park has green trees and beautiful scenery all year round. Bees flying and butterflies dancing, birds singing and apes singing, and pigeons flying in the air are good places to enjoy the scenery and hunt. There are Jinniu Lake, comprehensive zoo, white pigeon garden, butterfly, bamboo garden, betel nut garden, jackfruit garden, tropical and subtropical orchard, flower garden, martyrs cemetery and fitness square in the park. It is a large garden landscape park with nine gardens and one lake in Haikou. The most beautiful place in Jinniuling Park is the Palm Garden. There are a wide variety of palm trees here, scattered at random, and the tropical scenery is full of them.

shortFeatures: Where the story of Cantonese opera "Searching for the Academy" takes place
summary: Qiongtai Academy is located on the campus of Qiongtai Teachers College, Zhongshan Road, Fucheng Town, Haikou City, about 4 kilometers away from the city center. It is a typical Lingnan architectural layout. The main building "Kuixing Building" is a brick and wood structure with green tiles and red corridors, which is well preserved. On the first floor, the plaque reads "Lecture Hall", and there is a couplet, "The trees are old and the flowers are tender, and the branches melt in spring". When you enter the door, there is another couplet, "Raise the righteousness of Gan Kun and cultivate the talents of the world". On the second floor, one side is the master's bedroom, the other side is the study room, and the middle is the master's living room. The whole building is carved with beams and painted buildings, and the front of the building is lined with trees. There are two statues of Zhang Yuesong, the teacher of the academy, and Xie Bao, the scholar.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
summary: Located behind Xiuying Village on the north side of Haixiu Road, Haikou City. There are five forts: Gongbei, Zhendong, Dingxi, Zhenwu and Zhenwei, which are built in a straight line from east to west on a 200-meter-long coastal hill. The gun gate faces north, facing the sea. Two rows of military houses and ammunition depots are opposite each other, and in the middle is the towering ancient trees on both sides of the Dacaochang playground, lush and full of vitality. The entire fort, together with ancillary buildings, covers an area of about 10,000 square meters. It was built in the 17th year of Guangxu in Qing Dynasty (AD 1891). Although it has gone through a hundred years, it is basically well preserved. This fort was one of the famous coastal forts in China at that time. Together with Wuxiangkou Fort in Shanghai, Dagu Fort in Tianjin and Humen Fort in Guangdong, it was also known as the four major forts in China. It was a historical witness that Hainan people were not afraid of rape and resisted foreign humiliation. In 1985, Haikou Municipal Government announced this fort as a municipal key cultural relics protection unit. In May 2006, it was approved by the State Council and announced as a national key cultural relics protection unit.

Hainan Provincial Library is located in Guoxing Avenue Cultural Park, Haikou City, Hainan Province, with an elegant environment. It is the youngest provincial public library in China and an important public cultural facility in Hainan Province.

Nandu River, also known as Nandu River, was called Limu River in ancient times. It is the largest river in Hainan Island, China. Originating from Nanfeng Mountain in the south of Nankai Township, Baisha Li Autonomous County, Hainan Province, the main stream runs obliquely through the north-central part of Hainan Island, flows through Baisha, Qiongzhong, Danzhou, Chengmai, Tunchang, Ding'an, Qiongshan and other cities and counties, and finally flows into Qiongzhou Strait in Sanlian Community of Meilan District, Haikou City. Songtao Reservoir is built in the upper reaches of the main stream, which is the largest artificial lake and the largest water conservancy project in Hainan Province.

shortFeatures: Steel frame structure building with modern spirit
summary: Invested and built by Hainan Forestry Bureau and Hainan Forestry Corporation, it is located opposite the Gold Coast Garden on Binhai West Road, Haikou City, with a total land area of 1,095 mu. It is a tropical coastal urban forest park with multifunctional functions, including protection and reproduction of tropical exotic plant germplasm resources in Hainan, research and development of tropical forestry biotechnology, exhibition of tropical forest biodiversity and ecological science education, sightseeing and leisure health care. Four landmark constructions: First, Damen and Guangchang are the largest and most modern steel frame structures in Hainan; The second is the Biotechnology Museum. The building area is 2335 ㎡. The circular building adopts a tension membrane structure to imitate the shape of a space flying object; Third, the building area of the ecological museum is 2488.8 ㎡. The layout includes three parts: outdoor, semi-indoor and indoor, which are divided into main exhibition hall, animal exhibition hall, plant exhibition hall, etc. The fourth is the musical fountain. Covering an area of 2,200 square meters, including a dryland fountain of 210 square meters, it is currently the largest musical fountain in Hainan. Ten germplasm gardens: Hainan banyan germplasm garden, Hainan endemic tree species germplasm garden, tropical and subtropical woody fruit germplasm garden (Baiguoyuan), orchid germplasm garden, Hainan native ancient tree species germplasm garden (longevity garden), kapok germplasm garden, bamboo germplasm garden, bird germplasm garden, turtle germplasm garden, "Dragon Iron Tree" germplasm garden. In addition, the park has six centers and one base: Hainan Forestry Plant Tissue Culture Center, Hainan Forestry Seed and Seedling Quality Inspection and Inspection Center, Hainan Forest Pest Forecasting and Quarantine Research Center, Hainan Tropical Forest Biodiversity Exhibition Center, Hainan Tropical Forestry International Cooperation Center, Hainan Wildlife Rescue Center and Orchid Production Base.

poiName: Site of the First CPC Qiongya Congress
tagNameList: Historic buildings; Memorial Halls; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Recalling the glorious revolutionary history
summary: The former site of Qiongya "No.1" is the cradle of Hainan people's revolution and the birthplace of Qiongya revolution's "twenty-three-year red flag never fell". Located at No.131 Zhulinli, Jiefang West Road, Haikou City, the original Qiu ancestral house covers an area of 1,839.09 square meters and a building area of 994.26 square meters. The building is of brick and wood construction and was built in 1920. In June, 1926, the first congress of Qiongya, the Communist Party of China (CPC) was held here secretly, and the congress elected the leading body of Qiongya Local Committee, the Communist Party of China (CPC). Since then, Qiongya's revolutionary cause has a strong leadership core. After the liberation of Hainan in 1950, it successively became the office and accommodation place of the army, Haikou and Hainan government agencies. In 1984, the municipal government identified the former site as the first batch of municipal cultural relics protection units. In November, 1994, the provincial government announced it as the first batch of provincial cultural relics protection units. In August, 1996, Haikou Municipal Government began to repair the old site, relocate residents and demolish buildings after 1920s. On May 1, 2000, the former site of Qiongya "No.1 University" was officially opened to the public as a revolutionary traditional education base and tourist attraction.
