summary: Haikou Tianhou Temple is the earliest Tianhou Temple in Hainan, formerly known as Huanhaifang. It has a history of more than 700 years and is known as the patron saint of old Haikou. Haikou Tianhou Temple is the largest Mazu temple in Hainan, and it is also an important cultural carrier of Haikou, a famous historical and cultural city in China. As an important part of Chinese Mazu culture, Tianhou Temple carries the inseparable context of the old city of Haikou.

shortFeatures: Understand the history and culture of Barcelona
summary: Haikou Barcelona World Exhibition Hall is a football-themed exhibition and experience center opened overseas by Barcelona Football Club for more than 100 years. The museum is located in Mission Hills New Town, Haikou, with a total area of more than 5,000 square meters. With the help of cutting-edge high-tech audio-visual equipment, visitors will be led to experience the frenzied atmosphere of Barcelona Camp Nou's home match day, and experience the interaction with famous stars such as Messi to learn skills. Some trophies, uniforms, sneakers and other exhibits in the exhibition hall come from the original objects provided by the club museum. The whole exhibition hall explains Barcelona's century-old glorious history and strong football culture.

tagNameList: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Aquariums
shortFeatures: Watch rare fish and enjoy the undersea landscape
summary:
Haizhiyu Ocean World is located in Mission Hills New Town, Longhua District, Haikou City. It is the first ocean world in Haikou. It integrates underwater landscape, rare fish, marine animal performances and rare animal viewing, marine environmental protection science popularization, parent-child and DIY education activities, catering and entertainment and other comprehensive ocean parks. 
The park mainly displays fish endemic to Hainan and the South China Sea, supplemented by terrestrial amphibians, as well as ornamental freshwater fish, various corals, jellyfish and rare animals such as sea lions, seals and sea turtles. There are also some interactive areas between animals and people.

shortFeatures: In memory of Su Shi, a great writer in the Northern Song Dynasty
summary: Su Gong Temple is located on the east side of Wugong Temple in Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province. It was built to commemorate Su Shi, a great writer in the Northern Song Dynasty. Here are the ruins of Shuangquan and Dongzhuo Pavilion left by Su Shi. Today's Su Gong Temple is located in the former site of Dongpo Academy. At present, the main hall of Su Gong Temple still displays a plane statue of Su Wenzhong's stone carvings, as well as two handwritten poems "Xingxiangzi" and "Linjiang Fairy" written by Su Shi in those days. The poems and books are very eye-catching.

Haidian Creek is also known as Haidian River. Haidian Creek is a famous river in Haikou City, with Changdi Road, one of the main roads in Haikou City, in the south and Haidian Island in the north. Haidian Creek has beautiful scenery, and the surrounding scenic spots include Haikou Bell Tower and Century Bridge. It is a natural waterway between Haidian Island in Haikou City and the main urban area of Haikou, which is the diversion of Nandu River at the estuary.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
shortFeatures: Take a boat tour to the lake and feel the scenery of the pearl of the plateau
summary:
· Dianchi Lake has beautiful scenery, is a national tourist resort in China and the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. 
Adjacent to Grand View Park, facing Xishan Forest Park and Yunnan Ethnic Village across the water. 
You can stroll along the east coast by the lake, or take a boat tour, and feed red-billed gulls in winter. 
You can also stop by Yunnan Ethnic Village and feel the multi-ethnic customs of Yunnan Province.

shortFeatures: Admire the majestic and壮丽奇异的石峰林
summary:
· The main geological relic type of the Stone Forest World Geopark is karst geomorphology, which is a karst geological park featuring Stone Forest landforms.  
· The Stone Forest displays a variety of karst features, with towering, sword-shaped, columnar, mushroom-shaped, and tower-like limestone pillars being typical representations of the Stone Forest.  
· In addition, there are also limestone caves, stalactites, erosion lakes, natural bridges, cliff waterfalls, conical peaks, and more. Almost all types of karst features in the world are concentrated here, forming a panoramic view of karst geological landforms.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the reputation of the jade of the city
summary:
It used to be a lake bay in Dianchi Lake, but later it became a clear lake due to the drop of water level. It is one of the most beautiful parks in the urban area and is called "the beautiful jade in the city". 
Ruan Di and Tang Di divide Cuihu into five scenic spots, and there are some other scenic spots such as Lecture Hall in the park to visit. 
Every winter, thousands of red-billed gulls flying from the north spend the winter in Cuihu, playing in the water and competing for bait, which adds infinite interest to Cuihu.

tagNameList: Stroller-friendly hidden gems; Nighttime sightseeing; Villages
shortFeatures: Experience the cultures of 25 ethnic groups in Yunnan
summary:
- The Yunnan Ethnic Village mainly features natural village-style residential architecture, integrating garden landscapes, clear waters, and green trees.  
- The park includes 25 ethnic minority villages, such as Dai, Bai, Yi, and Jingpo, each showcasing unique customs and artistic performances.  
- Among them, the Dai Village and Yi Village are the most worth visiting, with distinctive Yi ethnic structures like adobe houses, distilleries, and cultural buildings.  
- During ethnic festivals such as the Water Splashing Festival and Torch Festival, lively celebrations are held in the scenic area, making it an ideal time to visit.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Terraced Fields
shortFeatures: Paradise for photography enthusiasts
summary:
Located in the northeast of Kunming, the soil contains a lot of iron and aluminum, forming a dazzling color. 
· It is considered to be the most imposing red land in the world except Brazil. From a distance, it is colorful and a paradise for photographers. 
The scenic spots are scattered, forming three main viewing routes: northwest line, northeast line and south line. The most convenient way to play is to charter a car. 
The best time to visit the red land is when the wheat is ripe from April to May, when rape flowers grow vigorously from September to December, and when there is occasional residual snow in the fields from February to March.

tagNameList: Ruins and historical sites; hiking and mountain climbing; Mountains; Grottoes
shortFeatures: Hiking and strolling while overlooking Tianchi Lake.
summary:
- Xishan, also known as Biji Mountain, from a distance resembles a woman lying by the shore of Dianchi Lake, earning the nickname "Sleeping Beauty of Xishan."
- The area is densely forested and the environment is refreshing, offering a panoramic view of the vast Dianchi Lake, making it a popular spot for hiking and sightseeing.
- The Longmen Grottoes on the mountain are ancient and precious, a must-visit for those who appreciate cultural heritage.
- "March 3rd at Xishan" is a traditional folk festival in Kunming. Every year on the third day of the third lunar month, locals gather here to sing and dance in a lively celebration.

poiName: Golden Horse and Jade Rooster Archway
tagNameList: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Kunming landmark group photo holy land
summary:
Founded in Xuande period of Ming Dynasty, the existing Golden Horse and Jade Rooster Square was rebuilt in 1998 according to the original style. 
The memorial archway on the east side near Jinma Mountain is called Jinma Square, and the memorial archway on the west side is near Biji Mountain, so it is called Biji Square. 
· It is the landmark and city center of Kunming and one of the symbols of Kunming; The vast majority of tourists to Kunming will visit here and take photos with the memorial archway. 
At night, there are often lively night markets in the surrounding streets. You can go to the vendors to choose what you like.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; A Hidden Spot for Strolling with Kids; Caves; Canyons
shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Myth"
summary:
- Located in Jiuxiang Yi and Hui Autonomous Township, Yiliang County, Yunnan Province, it is a scenic area centered around a cluster of karst caves and is a national key scenic area.
- The area is densely forested with rich plant and animal resources, featuring both magnificent mountains and valleys as well as beautiful underground caves, representing a typical karst landscape.
- The famous Lion Hall covers an area of more than 15,000 square meters, with a huge rock at the cave’s ceiling that has no support, a true miracle.
- In the movie *The Myth*, the scene where Jackie Chan and Kim Hee-sun fly through the tomb was filmed here.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for walking with kids; Lakes; City Parks
shortFeatures: A beautiful park on the northern shore of Dianchi Lake.
summary:
· Daguan Park is located on the north side of Dianchi Lake. It is a beautiful park with lush greenery and elegant pavilions, featuring scenic areas like near Huapu and Daguan Tower, as well as Lou Wai Lou.  
· Built by the water, Daguan Park features a lakeside dam, lotus ponds, and exquisite pavilions and towers, all arranged with great elegance.  
· The Daguan Tower, built during the Kangxi period, offers views of the Western Hills and Dianchi Lake, and was once considered one of the top ten ancient towers in China.  
· During festivals, the park often holds garden parties and sometimes hosts traditional lantern festivals, attracting a steady stream of visitors and creating a lively atmosphere.

tagNameList: Ancient Town and Village; Nighttime Scenic Tour; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Admire ancient temples and cultural landscapes.
summary:
· Guandu Town is one of Kunming's famous historical and cultural ancient towns. During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, it was a bustling market town with developed commerce and handicrafts. In the Tang Dynasty, it was part of the Nanzhao Kingdom, a popular stop for the nobility of the Dali Kingdom when they visited Dianchi Lake.

· The ancient town is rich in cultural landscapes, with five hills, six temples, seven pavilions, and eight shrines, as well as various lively shops. The Miao Zhan Temple, known as the "first of the six temples," is particularly notable, with its Vajra Throne Pagoda standing prominently at the entrance.

· A specialty dish is Guandu Baba, known locally as Mai Baba. The most famous version is the "Eyeglass Baba" on Vajra Tower Commercial Street, with two popular fillings: sesame and peanut.

tagNameList: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos

summary:
Also known as Yuantongshan Zoo, it is the park with the richest viewing content and the largest number of tourists in Kunming. 
There are Xishuangbanna bison, Mengla tiger, peacock, giant panda, Siberian tiger, red-crowned crane and other rare animals in China in the park. 
Cherry blossoms, begonia blossoms, plum blossoms, apricot blossoms, orchids, pines, cypresses, bamboos, etc. are planted. Cherry blossoms are the most worth seeing.

tagNameList: Hidden gems for kids; Garden parks
shortFeatures: The site of the 1999 Kunming Horticultural Exposition.
summary:
The main venue of the 1999 Kunming World Horticultural Exposition is a world-class garden and horticultural exhibition park with Chinese characteristics and local features of Yunnan, and is a national 5A-level scenic spot.  
It has now developed into a world horticultural tourism innovation experience destination that integrates ecological protection, horticultural exposition, horticultural heritage, and horticultural education, while also incorporating cultural tourism experiences and leisure vacation functions, showcasing biodiversity and inheriting the cultural legacy of the World Expo.

The former site of Yunnan Army Lecture Hall is located on Cuihu West Road in Kunming City, close to Cuihu Park and Yunnan University. Tourists usually visit these three places together. 
· The lecture hall was founded in 1909. When it was first built, it was known as one of the three major lecture halls in China. A large number of outstanding military strategists and revolutionaries such as Zhu De and Ye Jianying were students here. 
The building of the former site is well preserved at present, and it is an elegant yellow building in the style of the Republic of China. It is very beautiful to take photos when the sunshine is good. 
The interior of the building is open as an exhibition hall, with the big classroom (auditorium) and weapons depot of that year, as well as a long-term fixed exhibition showing the history of the lecture hall, the Chongjiu Uprising and the national protection movement.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
shortFeatures: A good place to learn about Yunnan's history and culture
summary: The construction project of Yunnan Provincial Museum is one of the top ten landmark key cultural facilities construction projects in our province, located at No.6393 Guangfu Road, Kunming. The new building covers an area of 150 mu, with a building area of 60,000 square meters. The shape of the building is cubic and the plane is zigzag. There is a landscape pool on the left and right sides of the main entrance, with two floors underground and five floors ground, 39 meters high.

shortFeatures: A good place to enjoy seagulls
summary:
· Located next to Dianchi Lake, you can see Dianchi Lake at the foot of Xishan Mountain, and the scenery is beautiful. 
It's a good choice to come here to see seagulls. The dam is full of seagulls flying around, which is very spectacular. 
· The dam is very wide and long, and parking is very convenient. Many newlyweds choose to come here to take wedding photos.

tagNameList: Climbing to a high place and hiking in the mountains.; Snow Mountains
shortFeatures: Spring admire azaleas, winter climb the icy mountain.
summary: Jiaozi Mountain is a national nature reserve, a national AAAA-level tourist attraction, the first tourism destination in China to receive ecological origin certification, and a national sports tourism boutique scenic area. It is also the lowest latitude, closest to the provincial capital, with a distinct vertical climate, rich biodiversity, and a highly representative high-altitude seasonal snow mountain in China. It is named after its highest peak, which resembles a sedan chair. Jiaozi Mountain is part of the Wumeng Mountain range, with the main peak at an elevation of about 4223 meters and a relative height difference of about 2623 meters. The scenic area features rugged and majestic peaks, waterfalls scattered throughout, clear and mysterious lakes, rare flowers and trees, and exotic animals and birds that occasionally appear. It has a unique vertical climate with cold, temperate, and tropical zones, creating the remarkable phenomenon of "one mountain divided into four seasons, with each season offering a distinct view." "Winter to see snow, spring to see ice, summer to admire flowers, and autumn to enjoy water" is a major feature of Jiaozi Mountain. Its wonders, including the peaks, waters, snow, rhododendrons, sea of clouds, sunrises, and Buddha light, are known as the "Seven Wonders of Jiaozi Mountain." The majestic and beautiful landscape blends together, making it an untouched land for seeking adventure and exploration.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; City Parks
shortFeatures: Fresh Park by Dianchi Lake
summary:
· Haigeng Park, located on the east bank of Dianchi Lake, is a beautiful park and the main viewing spot of Dianchi Lake. 
Haigeng refers to a long embankment that goes deep into Dianchi Lake, which divides Dianchi Lake into two lakes. It is very good to visit the lake along the dam. 
Here, there are green trees dancing along the lake, orange-yellow trails and various brightly colored sculptures, and the environment is fresh and beautiful. 
Every winter, Dianchi Lake is a paradise for red-billed gulls, and feeding and watching birds in the park is a popular activity.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; City Parks
shortFeatures: Kunming's famous plum blossom viewing spot
summary:
Heilongtan Park is located at the foot of Wulao Peak in Longquan Mountain in the northern suburb of Kunming. It is a park centered on ancient springs and pools. 
There are many historic sites and dense plants in the park, especially plum blossoms. Thousands of plum blossoms bloom here every winter, making it an excellent resort for citizens and tourists to enjoy plum blossoms. 
This is one of the largest plum gardens in China at present, and "Longquan Plum Exploration" has now become one of the sixteen scenic spots in Kunming.

poiName: Former Site of Southwest Associated University
shortFeatures: Feel the glorious years of famous wartime schools
summary: Southwest United University is jointly established by Peking University, Tsinghua University and Tianjin Nankai University. At first, the three universities moved to Hunan to form the Yangtze River Temporary University, and started classes on November 17th, 1937. This date was later designated as the anniversary of the United Nations General Assembly. With the advance of the Japanese aggressors, Changsha was in danger, and the three schools moved to Kunming, Yunnan.

shortFeatures: Different seasons present different beauty
summary:
· Luoxiagou, also known as Hentangdi, is a depression that suddenly sinks surrounded by Chongshan Mountains. It is said to be one of the most beautiful places in the red land 
The sun rises from the mountain to the east of Luoxiagou, and flashlight may appear on cloudy days. The light from 16:30 to 17:30 is the best, which is suitable for shooting sunrise and sunset.  
· In different seasons, Luoxia Valley will present different beautiful scenery, with red and green color blocks and lines, just like a fairyland on earth.

tagNameList: Hidden gems for strolling with kids; Taoist Temples
shortFeatures: A great place for a refreshing stroll in a pleasant environment.
summary: Jindian Park is named after the main hall, which is made of brass and shines brightly under the sunlight, casting a golden glow over the lush valley and the serene forest. It is also known as the Copper Roof Temple. The renowned Jindian is part of the Taoist Taihe Palace, originally built in the Ming Dynasty (1602), and is one of China's four major copper temples, with the best-preserved structure. In the 10th year of the Kangxi Emperor's reign (1671), the King of the Western Frontier, Wu Sangui, renovated it. With a long history, Jindian offers beautiful natural scenery, with paths winding through forests where towering trees create a canopy, occasionally interrupted by bird songs. The area is deeply infused with the essence of Taoist culture. In early spring, the hundred-acre camellia garden in the "Jindian Botanical Garden" blooms in full, filling the air with a sea of crimson, creating a breathtaking sight.

Kunming Lake occupies three-quarters of the area of the Summer Palace, with beautiful scenery, and is the soul of the whole garden. 
According to the division of the water area, it can be divided into three parts: Great Lake, West Lake and Back Lake. Among them, the famous 17-hole Bridge, Xidi and other scenic spots are worth savoring. 
It takes about 2 hours to walk around the lake a week, and you can take a boat tour around the lake in summer and autumn, which is relaxing and comfortable. The price routes of cruise ships vary, please consult the scenic spot for details.

shortFeatures: An elegant temple like a garden
summary: Yuantong Temple, located in Yuantong Street in downtown Kunming, is one of the oldest Buddhist temples in Kunming, with a history of more than 1,200 years. At the same time, it is also the largest temple in Kunming. It was built in the Nanzhao era of the Tang Dynasty, and was originally named Butuoluo Temple. In the fifth year of Dade in the Yuan Dynasty (AD 1301 (the year of Xin Chou), Yuantong Temple was built, and the emperor of the Yuan Dynasty "gave a seal and a book of great deal". The expansion project lasted 18 years and was not completed until the sixth year of Yuan Yanyou (AD 1319). During the Ming Dynasty, Yuantong Temple was expanded, and a new connection hall was built on the top of the mountain. It was also rebuilt many times during the Qing Dynasty.

shortFeatures: Eat small pot rice noodles to shop for Yunnan antiques
summary: Kunming Old Street is the most authentic old neighborhood in the center of Kunming. There are six streets and ten lanes in the block, and a large number of characteristic residential buildings and old businesses in the Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China are preserved, which has a unique historical charm. Ancient streets, buildings and gatehouses all have a sense of history and age. There are dozens of historical buildings and cultural buildings all over the blocks, which is the best place to feel the history and culture of Kunming.

Yunnan Railway Museum is located at No.913 Beijing Road, Kunming. It was established by using the waiting room of Kunming North Railway Station. It opened in 2004 and mainly displays the development history of Kunming Railway, especially the cultural relics of meter-gauge railway, among which the French Michelin internal combustion power unit is a national first-class cultural relic. This train unit is a high-end commercial train, which was put into operation in 1914. Its tires were made of rubber, and it was exclusively used by senior officials from China and France at that time. 
Yunnan Railway Museum covers a total area of 3,176 square meters, and has collected and displayed more than 9,500 historical materials such as old photos and documents about Yunnan-Vietnam Railway, including "Mixilin Locomotive" and locomotive accessories such as passenger cars and freight cars running on Yunnan-Vietnam Railway in those days. It uses strong color contrast and visual techniques of sound, light and electricity to show the vicissitudes of this section of the railway for a hundred years. Yunnan Railway Museum is the only thematic museum in China so far, which focuses on the history of local railway development. It is the witness of old Chinese history and an indelible page in modern Yunnan history. 
Yunnan Railway Museum is now the national and Yunnan railway patriotism education base. 
Yunnan Railway Museum, which embodies the vicissitudes of the meter-gauge railway in Yunnan section of Yunnan-Vietnam Railway, opened on December 28th, 2004. 
The meter-gauge railway from Kunming to Hekou section of Yunnan-Vietnam Railway, built by French colonialists, started construction in 1903 and officially put into operation in 1910. Because of its arduous and magnificent construction and its operation history spanning the times, it has accumulated rich historical and cultural resources.
