summary: Yunnan National Grand View Garden is a national grand view garden of "Kunming flavor Yunnan style, enjoying it through time and space", which integrates national customs exhibition, intangible cultural heritage expo, in-depth leisure experience and recreation and entertainment. It is a one-stop tourist attraction to experience Yunnan national folk customs and leisure time, and it is also the first choice for weekend leisure and entertainment in Zhou Bianyou. It is a cultural park with distinctive national folk culture and in-depth leisure experience.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; Botanical Gardens
summary: Kunming Botanical Garden, founded in 1938, is a comprehensive botanical garden with obvious regional characteristics, which integrates scientific research, popular science, tourism and teaching practice. It is the largest research base of subtropical plant diversity and germplasm resources preservation in southwest China and the introduction and cultivation center of camellia, magnolia, begonia and other plants.

The sub-scenic spot in Longmen Scenic Area of Xishan Mountain, facing Dianchi Lake in the east of Xishan Mountain, is a large fault with a length of several kilometers. On the south side of this fault, a stone passage was built, and the stone passage was hammered and drilled from the cliff by manpower. There is a tunnel on the way to the stone road, which is in a spiral, and it is about people, etc. The stone cave is like a window, facing the abyss, which is thrilling. Standing on it, you have a panoramic view of Dianchi Lake five hundred miles away. There is a "Kuixing Pavilion" on the top of the mountain. There is the famous "Phoenix Title Book" on the way. Because the word "Longmen" is inscribed on the stone square of "Datian Pavilion" in Tao, people call it Longmen.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Botanical Gardens; Activities
shortFeatures: A comprehensive theme resort full of flowers
summary: Colorful Yunnan Flower City Project is located in Siwa Road, Dongbaishahe, Kunming. It is invested and developed by Kunming Nuoshida Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd., and is committed to relying on Yunnan's rich flower resources and supporting resources to build a tourism and commercial complex based on the tourism market, covering the whole industrial chain of R&D, production, sales, brand building and resource integration. Colorful Yunnan Flower City Project is the first tourism and commercial complex in Kunming, which integrates 4A-level scenic spots, SHOPPINGMALL, hotels, restaurants, SPA, large-scale quality flower markets and connecting services. As the last stop in the itinerary of Yunnan tourism team, it provides high-quality, differentiated and comprehensive tourism experience and services for tourists.

shortFeatures: View from different angles to present different scenery
summary:
Colorful Slope and Splendid Garden are actually the same land, but viewing them from different angles will bring different visual impacts. 
Splendid Garden is known as the fine work of earth embroidery and the masterpiece of farming culture. The color of the colorful slope is very beautiful and the terrain is high. At different angles and seasons, different plots on the hillside have different colors and will have different visual impacts. 
Colorful slope is suitable for partial light shooting, and the best shooting time is in the afternoon.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Historic buildings; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Climb the building overlooking Dianchi Lake
summary: Grand View Building, located near the south of Huapu, is a wooden structure building with triple eaves and glazed corners. In the thirty-fifth year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty (1696), two-story buildings were built. During the Qianlong period, Sun Han wrote a long couplet, which was written and engraved by the famous scholar Lu Shutang. Daguan Building became a famous building in China because of the long couplet. In the eighth year of Daoguang (1828), the Grand View Building was repaired and added to three floors. In the third year of Xianfeng (1853), Emperor Xianfeng inscribed the plaque "Pulling Thousand Layers of Waves", and in the seventh year of Xianfeng (1857), the long couplet and building were destroyed by soldiers. It was rebuilt in the fifth year of Tongzhi (1866), but was flooded again. It was rebuilt in the ninth year of Guangxu (1883). In the fourteenth year of Guangxu (1888), Zhao Fanzhong published long couplets in regular script. In 1983, Daguanlou was announced as a key cultural relics protection unit in Yunnan Province.

shortFeatures: A spectacular artificial waterfall
summary: "Niulan River meets Deze, and crosses mountains and ridges into Dianchi Lake". The waterfall landscape area of the park makes full use of the Niulan River water diversion project into Yunnan to form artificial waterfalls and lakes, which make use of the terrain height difference of about 12.5 meters to build an artificial waterfall with a width of about 400 meters. There is a viewing bridge built on the water in front of the waterfall, which can be viewed up close. It is reported that this artificial waterfall is the largest artificial waterfall in China with the largest width, largest flow and largest scale.

tagNameList: Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Open area park, theme department store
Many ethnic customs exhibits
summary: It is located in the beautiful Kunming Dianchi National Tourism Resort, adjacent to Yunnan Ethnic Village by Dianchi Lake, about 9 kilometers away from Kunming. This is the most concentrated collection and exhibition place of history and culture of all ethnic groups in Yunnan, and it is also the largest ethnic museum in Southeast Asia. Yunnan Provincial Museum of Nationalities is a key construction project in Yunnan Province during the Eighth Five-Year Plan, which was completed and opened on November 9, 1995. It covers an area of more than 130,000 square meters and is divided into four areas: exhibition, demonstration, collection and scientific research. The overall layout is courtyard corridor style, which is rich in local ethnic characteristics.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the Ksitigarbha Temple Sutra Building Exhibition
summary: Kunming Museum is located in Kunming Museum (formerly Ancient Building Park) on the south side of Tuodong Road in Kunming. There is a spacious and bright hall, in the center of which stands Dali National Classics Building in Song Dynasty, which is known as the treasure of ancient Chinese sculpture art. Because the location is the former site of Dizang Temple in the past, it is named "Dizang Temple Sutra Building", commonly known as "Ancient Building". Later, the Dizang Temple collapsed, and the ancient building was buried underground for a long time. In 1919, the ancient building was unearthed from the ruins of Dizang Temple, which shocked China and foreign countries with its peerless exquisiteness, causing "Chinese and foreign people to rush around", and was praised as "the peerless and rare art in the East!" Professor Fang Guoyu, a historian, evaluated the ancient building as "the art of central Yunnan, which is the best!"

shortFeatures: Colorful graffiti wall, a literary gathering place
summary:
M60 Cultural and Creative Park is a creative park transformed from the old industrial plant of Yunfang Group. 
M60 brings together advertising, design, photography, sculpture, animation, performing arts, media, visual arts, handicraft creative products, Yunnan intangible cultural heritage and concept Loft restaurant, coffee bar, bar, diving, trampoline and other characteristic creative formats. 
M60 has a strong artistic atmosphere and literary atmosphere. It has the most Yunnan-characteristic folk craft experience, the most trendy music performances, various art exhibitions, comic-con exhibitions, the latest brand launch conferences, various handicraft experience classes, life aesthetics salon experiences, concerts, etc. There are various literary and fresh shops, coffee bars, bars...... 
This is a secret place hidden in the middle of the downtown, where you can enjoy yourself in a daze, take pictures, hang out...

shortFeatures: Gathering special food from all over the world
summary:
· Wenhua Lane is a famous food street in Kunming, adjacent to several primary schools and universities. 
This alley, which is about two kilometers long, is full of snack bars, clothes shops and bookstores. 
There are many people, and it is often crowded.

The old dragon tree, also known as the sacred tree and the single tree, is a huge and ancient thousand-year-old fir. It once died for three years and spit out new branches. It is honored as a sacred tree by the local stone tablet. 
For thousands of years, the old Nagarjuna has guarded this vast red land alone, dignified and sacred like 　 's mighty God of War.

tagNameList: Experience slow life; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A century-old ancient town with small bridges, flowing water, and a quaint, leisurely atmosphere.
summary:
- One of the most famous towns on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, with a history of nearly 800 or 900 years. The ancient city features wooden buildings with green tiles, ancient streets and stone alleys, and small bridges with flowing water. Standing on the East Street of the ancient city, you can gaze at the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
- One of the two ancient cities in China that successfully applied for World Cultural Heritage status for the entire city, it is also one of the distinctive types of traditional Chinese residential architecture.
- Lijiang Old Town began to take shape in the early Southern Song Dynasty. During the Ming Dynasty, it was known as "Dayanxiang." Located at the center of Lijiang Basin, surrounded by green mountains on all sides, with clear waters meandering through vast green fields, it resembles a large jade inkstone, hence its name.
- TV dramas such as *A Ray of Sunshine* and *The Winds of the Mu Family* were filmed here.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Mountain Climbing; Snow Mountains; Glaciers
shortFeatures: Close-up View of the Magnificent Glacier
summary:
- The sacred mountain in the hearts of the Naxi people, with the main peak, Fanzi Doushui, standing at about 5596 meters above sea level, is often shrouded in mist and remains an unconquered virgin peak.  
- Composed of 12 snow-capped peaks, the snow mountain offers rich natural tourism resources, including snow fields, glaciers, alpine meadows, and pristine forests.  
- Majestic yet graceful, the snow mountain's most beautiful scenery is created by rhododendrons blooming at different altitudes throughout the seasons.  
- The scenic area includes attractions such as Yushui Village, Glacier Park, and Blue Moon Valley, where a large-scale live performance of "Impression Lijiang" is staged at the Blue Moon Valley Square.

tagNameList: Experience slow living; get close to nature.; Ancient Towns; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The tranquil and serene town of Chama Ancient Town.
summary:
- Located northwest of Lijiang Old Town, it is quiet and ancient, with mountains and waters, more tranquil and primitive than Dayan Ancient Town.
- The mountains behind the ancient town are the foothills of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, with lush and beautiful rolling peaks and dense forests.
- The Grand Stone Bridge and the Dajue Palace are well-preserved, with murals depicting figures from Buddhist teachings.
- It is an important part of the UNESCO World Heritage Lijiang Old Town and was selected as a "Charming Town of China" by CCTV in 2005.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: The quiet pool at the foot of the snow-capped mountain
summary:
The predecessor was the well-known "Baishui River" earlier, which is located in the valley north of Ganhaizi and south of Yunshanping at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
· After the snow and ice melted from the snow-capped mountains, it flowed down the cliffs, and finally formed a crystal clear and sweet river in the deep valley in the upper reaches of Blue Moon Valley. 
On sunny days, the color of the water is blue, and the valley is crescent-shaped. From a distance, it looks like a blue moon inlaid at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, so it is called Blue Moon Valley. 
In the process of flowing, four large water surfaces are formed due to the blocking of mountains, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Meadow Autumn Reed; Hiking; Lakes
shortFeatures: Appreciate the Plateau Pearl, experience the folk customs of Yunnan.
summary:
·Lugu Lake is a border lake between Sichuan and Yunnan provinces, shared by both. The area around the lake is mainly inhabited by the Mosuo, Yi, and Pumi ethnic groups.  
·The lake water is clear and blue, making it the highest lake in Yunnan and one of the deepest freshwater lakes in China, full of mystery.  
·The scenic area is surrounded by towering mountains, with a snow-covered period lasting more than three months each year. The rich forest resources have earned it the title "Penglai Wonderland."  
·Major attractions include the Goddess Ge Mu cable car, Xiaocaohai, and Lugu Three Islands. The most popular way to explore the lake is by taking an electric car around it.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Shenlong Three-Tier Waterfall.
summary:
- Located 15 kilometers north of Lijiang Old Town, at the foot of the Yulong Snow Mountain, with an altitude of 2,500 meters, it is one of the main sources of the river water in Lijiang Old Town.
- It is a sacred site for the inheritance of the Dongba culture of Lijiang, as well as the base for the inheritance of Baisha Xiyue music and Leba dance. Inside, it also showcases ancient Naxi architecture.
- In addition, there are many unique scenic spots with ethnic and local characteristics, such as the Shenlong Triple Waterfall Group, salmon farming eco-tourism, ancient trees, and the largest sacred spring of Yulong Snow Mountain.
- Here, you can learn about many local customs and cultures. It is recommended to bring altitude sickness medication when visiting.

tagNameList: Climbing High and Hiking; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: A great place to visit for snow-capped mountains and ancient cities.
summary:
- Black Dragon Pool was originally a Dragon King Temple in Lijiang, with numerous spring wells beside the temple, forming a pool. Because the spring water is as clear as jade and reflects the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, it is also known as "Yuqian Park."
- This is both the water source for the ancient city of Lijiang and the area with the highest concentration of nationally protected cultural relics in Lijiang.
- The classic postcard view of Lijiang consists of the Five-Arch Bridge, Moon-Viewing Tower, the Snow Mountain, and the reflection of the Snow Mountain in Black Dragon Pool.
- Black Dragon Pool is the best location to photograph the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, with the best light for photography in the morning and evening.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Wetlands
summary:
Located about 10 kilometers west of Lijiang City, it is the largest plateau lake in Lijiang and the first nature reserve named after "wetland" in Yunnan Province. 
Every year, tens of thousands of waterfowl come here to spend the winter. Between December and February of the following year, it is the best time to watch birds in Lashihai. 
The lake is surrounded by Naxi villages, and every village near the lake has opened a horse farm, which has become an excellent place for horse riding, boating and bird watching in Lijiang.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Mountain Climbing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Locations for hot dramas such as "Mufu Fengyun"
summary:
The residence of Mu's chieftain in Lijiang in past dynasties, which combines the architectural style of Central Plains in Ming Dynasty with the craftsmanship of Bai and Naxi nationalities, is a landmark of the ancient city. 
After hundreds of years of glory, most of them were destroyed by war, and the remaining parts were seriously damaged in the earthquake in 1996. At present, most of them are rebuilt. 
It is the "Grand View Garden" of the ancient city of Lijiang. Coming to Lijiang without seeing Mufu is almost equivalent to not coming to Lijiang.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountain Climbing; Glaciers
shortFeatures: Experience glaciers and snow-capped mountains up close
summary:
· Located on the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in the north of Lijiang City, Yunnan Province, it is a typical representative of the modern glacier in the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
· The park composed of stone caves and caves eroded by glaciers is a landform relic formed by Quaternary glaciers, and is known as the "Glass Palace of Lucerne".  
In autumn, winter and spring, the snow is vast here. In summer, you can see the glaciers formed more than 40,000 years ago, and you can feel the snow-capped mountains at close range. 
The white mountain at the top of the mountain is magnificent, spectacular, white and delicate, and there is also a marking stone tablet with an altitude of 4,680 meters, which is also a popular group photo place.

Sifang Street is the core of Lijiang Ancient City, with four main streets extending from the center of the street. It is a famous snack street. 
There are snack restaurants everywhere around, and you can eat a lot of Naxi specialty food just by strolling around. 
Xinhua Street next to it is a famous bar street in Lijiang, which is brightly lit and crowded with tourists every night. 
Every morning, many people dance Naxi dance here; In the evening, some people jumped around the bonfire.

shortFeatures: A thousand-year-old sacred mountain by Lugu Lake
summary:
Gem Goddess Mountain, also known as Lion Rock, is 3,754.7 meters above sea level and is the highest mountain around Lugu Lake. 
Lion Mosuo is called "Gem", which means white goddess. In Mosuo legend, it is the incarnation of goddess Gem. 
· Lion Rock is magnificent and towering against the sky; During the Mountain Festival, Mosuo people have to go to Goddess Mountain to worship the goddess. 
You can also enjoy the cave on the mountain, take the exciting slide down the mountain, and take a panoramic view of Lugu Lake.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Night tour viewing; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Unobstructed view of the ancient city and Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
summary:
An important part of the ancient city of Lijiang, named after the mountain looks like a sleeping lion. 
The ancient city complex is surrounded by mountains at the foot of Lion Rock, which is the best place to enjoy the panoramic view of Lijiang ancient city. 
On the top of the mountain, there is the first floor of an all-wooden structure building in China with a column that is not connected to the top-Eternal Building. 
Climb the building and overlook the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in the north. Look at the ancient city of Lijiang in the east, Lijiang New City in the west and rural villages in the south.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Featured performances
shortFeatures: Watch the wonderful performance of eternal love
summary:
Lijiang Eternal Scenic Area is a large performing arts park and a living ancient tea-horse city, located at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. 
In the scenic spot, the theme areas such as Chama Ancient Street, Nacuo Sea, Snow Mountain Beach and ethnic villages show Lijiang's thousand-year-old culture and historical customs. The towers are towering, the business is prosperous, the ringing of horse bells in the ancient tea-horse street, and there are many workshops such as wineries, tea houses, Dongba paper, hand-dyeing and copper shops. The rippling blue waves of Nacuo Sea are like a fairyland, with flowers and weeping willows on both sides of the strait; Enjoy leisure time with yaks in a daze on the snowy mountain beach; Feel the strong ethnic customs in ethnic villages and experience a different tea-horse tour. 
The main show "Lijiang Eternal Love" is a must-see performance in a lifetime, which reproduces the history and legend of Lijiang for thousands of years, leads the audience through the snow-capped mountains, and feels a beautiful moment in the remote and primitive wild land, Mosuo Flower House on the banks of Lugu Lake, the ancient tea-horse road wrapped in wind and rain, the romantic and miserable third country of Yulong, and the paradise-like Shambhala. 
The large-scale live performance "Lijiang Love Songs" tells the beautiful and tragic love story of Tibetan boy Abda and Naxi girl Gajimi. There is a volcano here, which can instantly spew out flames more than ten meters high; Here, there are strong Tibetan boys who bravely climb volcanoes, cut boulders and set off huge waves; There are beautiful dances of all ethnic groups in Yunnan, and you can feel the artistic feast in the south of colorful clouds. 
The real-life experience drama "The Great Earthquake" uses high-tech means to reproduce the scene of the earthquake, with landslides and cracks, houses and houses collapsing. One by one, real stories and touching pictures show the boundless love of the Chinese nation for earthquake relief. 
There are also wonderful performing shows in the scenic spot, such as "Mufu Recruiting Son-in-Law", "Guozhuang Carnival", "National Flash Mob", "Muppet", "Yak in a Daze" and "Wandering Singers Singing in Residence", which are staged in turn. 
Lijiang Eternal Scenic Area, looking for Shambhala in your heart!

shortFeatures: Symbol of Old Town of Lijiang
summary:
· The landmark buildings and landmarks of the ancient city of Lijiang, tourists must go to the place to take photos. 
The oldest agricultural irrigation tool in China is a superb labor skill created by our ancestors and a precious historical and cultural heritage. 
In the past, there were waterwheels in ancient cities, represented by the big waterwheels in ancient cities, which are still used in some remote places today. 
The waterwheel in the ancient city of Lijiang is only used as a landmark building and ornamental function.

There are two lovers' beaches in Lugu Lake, Libai lovers' beach in Sichuan section and Luoshui lovers' beach in Yunnan section. This beach is located in Liangshan, Sichuan. 
The trees on the lakeside grow in pairs, standing by the lakeside like lovers, hence the name of Lovers' Beach. 
People living around will hang prayer flags on the pine forest and grass, fluttering in the wind, which makes people feel particularly mysterious. 
Sunshine, ten miles of sandy shore, and willows, the environment is beautiful. At dusk, couples walk hand in hand, showing tenderness.

shortFeatures: Lakeside Peninsula with Rich Mosuo Style
summary:
It is a beautiful peninsula in the bay of Lugu Lake. The island is surrounded by water on three sides, surrounded by green hills on the left and right, and near Ligem Goddess Mountain. 
· There is a lake with blue waves like a mirror, and the white clouds at high altitude and the surrounding peaks clearly reflect in the water, blending the lake, mountains and sky into a crystal-clear one. 
· More than a dozen Mosuo girls living here are not only smart and capable, but also good at singing and dancing, kind and beautiful, and have the reputation of "daughter country in the water".

shortFeatures: Mosuo-style wooden house building complex
summary:
It is the earliest developed village around Lugu Lake, which is divided into two parts: upper and lower falling water. 
The whole village is a wooden house of Mosuo people, which doesn't need a nail or bricks. It is not only warm in winter and cool in summer, but also particularly earthquake-proof. 
The service facilities in the village are relatively complete, shops are complete, and there are many small shops selling special souvenirs, which is the first choice for tourists to stay in Lugu Lake. 
There are many pig tank boats near the lake. Visitors can pay for a boat tour of the lake and go to two small islands on the lake. 
Every night, the local Mosuo people will wear traditional costumes, perform songs and dances, which is very lively, and they can also have barbecues in tents set up by the lake.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Towns
shortFeatures: Feel the quiet of the original ecological ancient town
summary:
Baisha Ancient Town was once the political, economic and cultural center of Lijiang, and it was also the original settlement of Naxi people in Lijiang Dam, retaining the original Naxi culture. 
The ancient town retains its original appearance, has not been over-developed, is quieter than Dayan and Shuhe, and you can see Yulong Snow Mountain when you look up. 
Baisha Mural is the most famous scenic spot in the town. It lasted for more than 300 years from the early Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty, and it is a good place to learn about Dongba culture. 
You can sit and drink tea in the street shop, hang out slowly, and chat with the local old grandmother in a language that each other doesn't understand, which is relaxed and leisurely.

shortFeatures: The white river water at the foot of the snowy mountain
summary:
Lijiang Baishui River is located next to Yunshanping in Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. It is a river formed by the melted glaciers and snow water of Yulong Snow Mountain. Because its water quality has not been polluted in any way, and its riverbed and platform are made of white marble and limestone gravel, it is a clear mountain stream, and the water seems to be white, hence the name Baishui River. It is said that the water of Baishui River comes from the mouth of Yulong, which is spiritual and a holy place of love. 
Leave Ganhaizi and continue to walk north, walk for about 5 kilometers, turn a corner, and you can see a river flowing out of the snow-capped mountain at the foot of the mountain, which flows eastward. This is Baishui River. After passing the Baishui River Bridge, you can stop here. Follow the road on the right beside the bridge, and you can reach the Baishui River.

Qinglong Bridge was built in Wanli period of Ming Dynasty and has a history of more than 400 years. It is 25 meters long, 4.5 meters wide and 4 meters high. It is all made of stones, making it the longest ancient stone bridge in Lijiang. 
· The landmark building in the heyday of Mu's chieftain, hundreds of years of wind and rain washing, made the bridge deck mottled and old, but it did not lose its solemn and heavy momentum. 
Every spring, the willows beside the bridge sprout new shoots, like smoke and yarn, as if green waves were about to rush to the bridge deck. "Yanliu Pingqiao" refers to the scenery at this time.

shortFeatures: Rippling clear water and quiet environment
summary:
Jiuding Longtan, also known as Longquan, is located in the northwest corner of Shuhe Ancient Town. It is the water source of streams in the ancient town and a must-visit place in Shuhe. 
Longquan is a semicircular stone pool with two semi-circular stone pools. There is a pavilion between the two pools, which is the best place to watch the "Jiuding Longtan". 
The water in Longtan landscape is not deep, but it is not muddy in summer and shallow in winter. You can see the "Reflected Snow Mountain", "Broken Monument Knocking" and "Fish and Water Relatives" among the eight scenic spots of Shuhe River.

shortFeatures: Understanding the long-standing Pu'er tea culture
summary:
The Tea-Horse Road Museum, also known as Dajue Palace, is an integral part of the "Shuheyuan" architectural complex of Mu's chief in Ming Dynasty, and it is a precious ancient building. 
The museum has eight exhibition halls, including Preface Hall, Mural Exhibition Hall, Historical Hall I, Historical Hall II, Shuhe Hall and Leatherman Hall, which are important windows for people to understand the history and culture of the ancient tea-horse road. 
China's first museum dedicated to studying and displaying the history and culture of the ancient tea-horse road, and it is also the first professional institution in Lijiang engaged in the research, publicity and promotion of Pu'er tea culture.

shortFeatures: View the snow peaks in front of the big lawn
summary:
· Located in the east of Yulong Snow Mountain, at an altitude of 3,240 meters, it is a huge lawn hidden in the virgin spruce forest. 
Regarded as the entrance of the "Third Country of Jade Dragon" in Naxi myths and legends, the majestic Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is close at hand, and the Millennium Glacier is clearly visible. 
Legend has it that it is the place where the first pair of lovers of Naxi people died for love, also known as the "Valley of Martyrdom".

tagNameList: Grassland wind collection; Climb a mountain; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Meadow pasture at the foot of snow-capped mountains
summary:
Ganhaizi is an open meadow at the eastern foot of Yulong Snow Mountain and a natural pasture. 
The terrain of the scenic spot is gentle and undulating, and there are low pine trees scattered on the vast meadow, covered by vegetation. From time to time, yaks pass by in front of us, which is a plateau pasture scenery. 
In Ganhaizi, you can see the thirteen peaks of Yulong Snow lined up in turn, which is the nearest and best place to look up at the whole picture of Yulong Snow Mountain. 
There is the only golf course with the longest fairway in the world, the highest altitude in Asia, and the only golf course at the foot of the snow-capped mountains. You can also play after the tour, which is very convenient.

shortFeatures: A good place to watch the scenery and worship Buddha
summary: Liwubi Island faces Snake Island to the northwest. It is the largest island in Lugu Lake. One side of the island is stalagmites, which becomes a natural dock. A winding path leads directly to the top of the island. There are many azaleas and wild cherry trees beside the road. At the end of the flower bush is Liwubi Temple in the courtyard of Lama Huang Jiao. The temple was founded in 1634 AD and rebuilt in 1989. There are Buddha statues such as Buddha Sakyamuni, Guanyin, Buddha with a thousand hands and a thousand eyes, Tsongkhapa, the grandmaster of Gelug Sect of Tibetan Buddhism, and his second disciple Buddha statues, and the guardian god. Every Tibetan calendar festival or Buddhist festival, religious believers along the lake will come here to pray for blessings and pay homage, and the incense is in full swing and it is very lively. In addition, there is a white pagoda on the island, which is the spiritual pagoda of Ayun Mountain, the general manager of Mosuo Tusi Mansion in Yongning. Ayun Mountain was once a famous Mosuo political figure in Yunnan, Sichuan and Tibet.

tagNameList: Grassland wind collection; Nature and Adventure; Lakes
summary:
Jiuzihai (also known as Jiuzihai of Lijiang Ancient City and Jiuzihai of Ancient City) is located in Jiuzihai Village, Lijiang Ancient City, about 26 kilometers away from Lijiang Ancient City. It is named after nine naturally formed pools in the dam. According to legend, it is a relic left by Mu's toast in Ming Dynasty to burn tiles and borrow soil from Jiuzihai. 
On May 31, 2018, Jiuzihai was listed as a provincial important wetland list.

tagNameList: Close to nature; A hidden gem for strolling with kids; Canyons
shortFeatures: A natural masterpiece of stunning craftsmanship.
summary:
The Lijiang Guanyin Gorge Scenic Area is located in Qihe Township, Lijiang City, in the northwestern part of Yunnan Province, 17 kilometers from the Old Town of Lijiang. It is the only gateway and military stronghold on the ancient Tea Horse Road (Yunnan-Tibet route) leading to Lijiang and Tibet.

Lijiang Guanyin Gorge is a scenic area that combines natural landscapes such as mountains, lakes, gorges, and forests, with cultural attractions including the Tea Horse Ancient Street, Naxi villages, folk customs, and religious traditions. It is situated at the "Yulong Pass," one of the three major passes of the Lijiang Basin. The Lijiang chieftain, Mu Lao Ye, once set up customs and military barracks here.

shortFeatures: Immersive somatosensory, appreciate Naxi culture
summary:
Dayanhua Lane is located at the north gate of Dayan Ancient City in Lijiang, a famous tourist destination. The project covers an area of more than 30,000 square meters, and it is the largest tourist complex in Lijiang Ancient City. Covering creative aesthetic blocks, tourist landmark leisure squares, large tourist distribution centers, Yunnan characteristic food blocks, etc., it can meet the needs of tourism in one stop. 
 
1. The new landmark of the ancient city of Lijiang-[Meet Lijiang] Archway Square 
It is the most iconic Naxi archway in Lijiang and the largest tourist distribution center in the ancient city of Lijiang. 
 
2. The best observation platform in online celebrity, Dayan Ancient City-Eye of Lijiang 
The Eye of Lijiang is a landmark attraction that tourists in the ancient city of Lijiang must punch in besides the big waterwheel and Sifang Street. From dawn to dusk, the posture of the ancient city is completely different. Visitors can enjoy the ultimate visual feast brought by the numerous changes of this thousand-year-old city from morning till night only at the observation deck of Dayanhua Lane. 
 
3. New Caravan Cuisine · Authentic Jianghu Flavor-Meet Caravan Cuisine Restaurant 
Cooked by the descendants of the royal chef of the caravan, Lijiang's first long street banquet of "Caravan Return" restored the dining atmosphere of Lijiang caravan in those days, eating meat and drinking wine, the original Yunnan ingredients and characteristic dining performances, and [Meet Caravan Cuisine] took you back to the ancient tea-horse road and tasted the authentic flavor of caravan Jianghu.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Wetlands; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Beautiful grassland wetland
summary: Lashihai, located 10 kilometers west of Lijiang, is the largest plateau lake in Lijiang and the first nature reserve named after "wetland" in Yunnan Province. Every year, tens of thousands of waterfowl come here to spend the winter. Between December and February of the following year, it is the best time to watch birds in Lashihai. The lake is surrounded by Naxi villages, and every village near the lake has opened a horse farm. Lashihai has thus become an excellent place for horse riding, boating and bird watching in Lijiang. Tips: Every morning and evening hour is the best time for bird watching. The services of the surrounding racecourses are mixed, so pay attention to negotiating the price and service details in advance. When riding a horse, try not to put valuables in pockets and other places, which are easy to lose.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Canyons
shortFeatures: Fantastic scenery of strange rocks and cliffs in the canyon
summary:
Lijiang Snow Mountain Canyon Performing Arts Park has joined hands with Mr. Yu Rongguang, a famous Chinese guide, to create "China's first Mufu Fengyun Landscape Scenic Spot", which is a magical scenic spot under the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and takes you back to ancient Lijiang! 
Walking into the scenic spot is like crossing back to ancient Lijiang 400 years ago. You can dress in quaint and simple ethnic costumes, explore the exquisite and magnificent ancient buildings of the chieftain era, meet the classic screen characters of Mufu Fengyun, and encounter all kinds of Lijiang people, become a person in the story and enter the legend! 
In the scenic spot, you can walk with the beautiful scenery of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and Canyon; Watch situational and story-telling cultural shows; Punch in many travel photography bases and Internet celebrity punch-in points with snowy mountains as the background

tagNameList: Grassland wind collection; Nature and Adventure; Geological Sites; Canyons
shortFeatures: Feel the strangeness of stepping on thousands of turtles at your feet
summary:
Laojun Mountain stretches for hundreds of miles, layers on layers, ups and downs, and its main peak is 4,240 meters above sea level. It is called "the ancestor of all mountains in Yunnan Province" by historians of past dynasties, and it is named after the legend that Taishang Laojun once made alchemy here. 
· Laojun Mountain is one of the main parts of the Three Parallel Rivers Scenic Spot. The scenic area covers an area of more than 710 square kilometers, rich alpine vegetation, rare animals and plants, numerous ice-eroded lakes, strange Danxia landform and colorful folk customs of Naxi, Bai, Lisu, Pumi, Yi and other ethnic groups, which constitute a unique landscape of Laojun Mountain Scenic Area with great ornamental value and scientific investigation value. 
Laojun Mountain is mainly composed of Jiujiu Longtan, Jinsi Stone Jinshan Yuhu Scenic Spot, Yunnan Golden Monkey Nature Reserve, Dawn, Meile Danxia Landform Scenic Spot and New Main Botanical Garden Scenic Spot.

shortFeatures: The naturally formed blue lake is fantastic; The blue lake is like a fairyland
summary: In the process of flowing, the river in Blue Moon Valley is blocked by the mountain, forming four large water surfaces, which are called "Yuye" Lake, "Jingtan" Lake, "Blue Moon" Lake and "Tingtao" Lake. Yuye Lake is located in the upper reaches of Jingtan Lake. Perhaps the water level here is deeper, and there are a lot of copper ions in the water, so the lake looks more blue.

Snow Mountain Rose Manor is a flower eco-tourism area integrating flower culture sightseeing, exhibition, leisure, entertainment, vacation and experience. The manor covers an area of nearly 1,000 mu, fully displaying the flowers and national characteristic culture of Splendid Plateau.

Longquan Temple, also known as Sansheng Palace, is named after Longquan Lake next to the temple. It was built in Longqing period by Ming Dynasty Tusi Mudong and rebuilt in 1983. The temple is a courtyard-style courtyard, with the main hall in the north, where the Dragon King is enshrined. The west hall is dedicated to Guanyin, the south building is dedicated to Sun Bin, the ancestor of cobbler, and the foundation of the east building goes directly into the water. There are cloisters on three sides for visitors to overlook by the railing. In ancient times, some scholars and writers often came here to enjoy the moon on moonlight nights. Later, there was a saying of "looking at the moon at the dragon gate".

poiName: Lashi Lake Sunshine Coast Flower Sea
summary: Sunshine Coast Natural Scenic Area, located in Hainan Village Committee of Lashi City, is a wetland tourism complex built by Lijiang Gankun Tourism Ecological Development Co., Ltd. Sunshine Natural Scenic Area covers a total area of 1,500 mu, which is roughly divided into three major areas: Huahai Area, Caohai Area and Ecological Fruit and Vegetable Area. Huahai District covers an area of nearly 500 mu, and the planning concept is "global planning and exquisite building". Huahai industry is used as an ecological complex project, instead of relying on Huahai to sell eyeballs, relying on water resources, living water ecology, relying on natural resources and living green tourism; Caohai District covers an area of nearly 500 mu, which is subdivided into leisure area, migratory bird reserve, camping area, dock area, and rest area: there are seats, recliners and hanging chairs in it, so you can enjoy the warm comfort, experience the good time of leisure and excellent travel, and slow down the pace of life. Migratory bird reserve: Every autumn and winter, a large number of migratory birds come here to spend the winter. There are many kinds of migratory birds, including 9 endemic rare and endangered birds, including spotted geese, an endemic bird of Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, Chinese merganser, black-necked crane, black crane, etc. Camping area: This is an area built for outdoor activities. Every year, spring, summer and autumn are the best camping seasons; The ecological fruit and vegetable area covers an area of nearly 200 mu, which is subdivided into barbecue area, snack area, orchard area and vegetable area. Green environmental protection is also an indispensable development concept of Sunshine Coast Natural Scenic Area. Enjoy the green given by nature, taste the feelings given by delicious food and have health. There are also parking areas, racecourse areas and restaurant areas, covering a total area of 300 mu. In addition to the Sunshine Coast Natural Scenic Area, the surrounding area is a beautiful landscape, with Naxi village scenery, mysterious Zhiyun Temple and so on.

shortFeatures: Incorporating snow-capped mountains and cliff carvings
summary: Yuzhu Qingtian Scenic Area is one of the components of Lijiang Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area. At the southern foot of the main peak of Yulong Snow Mountain, it is also known as the first village at the foot of Yulong Mountain-Wuluken (Baisha Yuhu Village), which is more than ten miles away from the ancient city. Together with Yushui Village, Yufeng Temple, Dongba Valley, Dongba Wanshen Garden and Dongba Kingdom, it is known as "Three Jades and Three East".

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Nature and Adventure; Flower Fields

summary: Yongning Hot Spring is located in the northernmost part of Yongning Dam, adjacent to the front of Sichuan Province. It is a plateau sulfur hot spring, with a constant temperature of 38 degrees throughout the year, and has high medicinal effects. In the slack season after autumn, Mosuo people, as close as Yongning and Labo, and as far away as Muli and Yanyuan, support the old and the young, bring abundant food and enough Solima wine, set up a tent here, soak for a long time to cure diseases, promote blood circulation and dredge collaterals, and generally take as little as one or two days, and as many as ten and a half days. Before the 1960s, due to the closed traffic and cultural exchanges, there was little communication with outside the mountains, and people were simple and flawless. When they went to a hot spring to bathe in an open pond, they didn't need to avoid passers-by, helped the old and the young, regardless of each other, soaked in a pool of water and drank a can of wine in a pure and natural atmosphere, exchanged food with each other, passed wine bowls, talked greetings, and sang folk songs, which was a simple and natural folk customs and harmonious scene. Nowadays, with the opening of the mountain gate, all kinds of cultural differences have invaded. Such cultural phenomena that transcend the secular world have changed their desires in everyone's eyes. For a time, this splendid culture has lost its nutrients for life. In order to block greedy eyes, today's people divide the pond into two and isolate a gap from the middle to warn people not to cross the thunder pool. This gap was first isolated in the 1960s to today, and the partition wall was increased from tens of centimeters to several meters high, and finally the whole pond was sealed and built into a house. Only then did people really pay attention to the wonderful value of Yongning Hot Spring in the past, and the cultural history of the unity of man and nature yesterday gave today's people much envy and yearning, reverie and reflection. Besides, another reason why Yongning Hot Spring is favored by tourists is that it is surrounded by villages with rich ethnic culture. The foil of Mosuo villages such as Walabi, Yimanwa, Aruwa and Aguwa, whose Mosuo amorous feelings are well preserved, has produced the perfect effect of the leisure and recuperation island of hot springs, which enjoys the amorous feelings.

shortFeatures: Watch精彩的歌舞表演
summary:
- Manting Park is the oldest park in Xishuangbanna, a natural village-style park. Locals commonly refer to it as "Chunhuan Garden," meaning the Garden of the Soul.
- The park features eight areas, including the Ethnic Culture Square, the Vine Plant Zone, the Tropical Orchid Garden, the Peacock Garden, the Buddhist Culture Zone, and the Tree Planting Memorial Zone.
- The park also houses over 500 well-preserved ancient ironwood trees and vegetation, as well as a bronze statue of Premier Zhou Enlai and two Bodhi trees planted by the Thai Princess during her visit to Jinghong.
- Additionally, the park's evening performance, "The Lancang River • Mekong River Night," along with the bonfire party, are the park's biggest highlights and are definitely worth seeing.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests; National Parks
shortFeatures: Experience the thrilling skywalk.
summary:
- The core of Xishuangbanna Tropical Rainforest, and the only place in China where you can experience the rainforest from all three perspectives: water, land, and air.  
- The most attractive aerial corridor, built with the trunks of dozens of "Skyward Trees," creates a 34-meter-high suspension bridge that offers an aerial view of the entire tropical rainforest.  
- You can get up close to the five major wonders of the rainforest, including buttress roots, strangler figs, parasitic epiphytes, drip-tip leaves, and old stems in spring.

The wild elephant valley is densely forested, and Asian wild elephants frequent here. A large number of amphibians such as bison, green peacocks and black bears also inhabit here. 
There are regular elephant performances in the scenic spot every day. The naive elephants can dance, cross the wooden bridge, and even play football with their noses. 
There is also an Asian Elephant Museum inside, where you can learn more about elephants. There are Bird Gardens and Butterfly Gardens nearby that you can visit together. 
There are sightseeing walking paths, elevated corridors for tourists to watch wild elephant activities, big tree hotels, forest bars and other facilities in the scenic spot.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: Accept the warm welcome dance of the Dai people.
summary:
- Xishuangbanna Dai Ethnic Park is composed of five well-preserved Dai natural villages, namely Manjiang, Manchunman, Manting, Manzha, and Manga.
- Upon entering the park, the first thing you encounter is the Welcome Square, where you are greeted by warm-hearted Dai people performing welcome dances, singing blessings, and sprinkling water for good wishes.
- The park also houses the Manchunman Ancient Buddhist Temple, one of the oldest temples in Xishuangbanna, with a history of over 1,400 years. Every day, you can hear the sound of chanting inside the temple.
- The grandest festival for the Dai people in Xishuangbanna is the Water-Splashing Festival. At the Water-Splashing Square in the Dai Ethnic Park, you can experience the lively scenes of the festival every day.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Forests
shortFeatures: Experience the natural scenery of the pristine tropical rainforest.
summary:
- It has the best-preserved tropical gully rainforests south of the Tropic of Cancer and is the closest pristine forest to Jinghong City.  
- Inside, there are more than 50 attractions, including Peacock Villa, Monkey Training Base, Large Ethnic Performance Theater, Jiulong Waterfall, and the Man Shuanglong White Pagoda.  
- Visitors can enjoy rare landscapes such as buttress roots, strangler figs, old stem flowers, and ancient vines, as well as the spectacular sight of hundreds of peacocks being released.

- Built in the Ming Dynasty, the current temple was rebuilt on the original site of the ancient Dai Kingdom royal temple, "Jingpiao Buddhist Temple."
- The temple is built along the mountain, with Southeast Asian-style temple architecture and Buddha statues, fully showcasing the history and traditional culture of Theravada Buddhism.
- From the square in front of the Ten Thousand Buddha Tower, one can enjoy a beautiful view of Jinghong City, and also participate in Buddhist activities within the temple, experiencing Buddhist culture.
- On holidays, the Dai king personally visits the temple to hold large-scale ceremonies to commemorate his beloved consort and promote Buddhist teachings.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery and feel the Jinuo customs
summary:
Jinuo Shanzhai is a place where Jinuo people live in concentrated communities, and it is the only live performing arts experience place in China that shows Jinuo culture in the most comprehensive and concentrated way. 
The performances in the scenic spot are concentrated in the Sun Square in the center of the stockade. Young men and women dressed in Jinuo costumes are singing and dancing with props in hand, which is magnificent. 
You can eat the unique local barbecue, enjoy the performances with rich ethnic customs and experience the rich Jinuo folk customs.

shortFeatures: Beams and columns are beautifully carved, and the architecture is magnificent
summary:
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple is the center for Buddhist believers in Xishuangbanna to worship Buddha, and it is also the highest-ranking Buddhist temple in Xishuangbanna. 
The general Buddhist temple is magnificent, with exquisite beams and columns carved, mainly including Weihan Hall, Buddhist College teaching building and other buildings. 
There is an altar in front of the north wall of today's courtyard building, where there are several Buddha statues, and the Buddha's Sutra is painted on the wall. 
Xishuangbanna General Buddhist Temple and Manting Park are connected, and tourists usually enter the General Buddhist Temple from Manting Park.

Mengjinglai was once the religious and cultural center on the China-Myanmar border. The clear Daluo River flows past the western side of the village, forming a natural border line, with Myanmar on the opposite bank. The pagoda forest, sacred tree, and sacred spring at the entrance of Mengjinglai village have a long history. During festivals, many devotees come here to worship the Buddha and seek scriptures, earning it the reputation of "the first village on the China-Myanmar border." In Mengjinglai, the exquisite small buildings and pagodas, the fragrant air filled with flowers and fruits, the soft sounds of the Dai language from the villagers, and the sweet calls of the spiritual birds all combine to create a beautiful and harmonious paradise.

shortFeatures: Science-themed Resort Park
summary: The Xishuangbanna Tropical Flower Garden is located within the Yunnan Tropical Crops Research Institute in the urban area of Jinghong City, covering an area of approximately 80 hectares. The garden is designed around a series of natural water surfaces as the main axis for sightseeing, with attractions such as the Flower Garden, Sky Garden, Premier Zhou Enlai Memorial, Palm Area, Rare Tree and Grassland Area, Bonsai Area, Foliage Plant Area, Tropical Fruit Tree Area, and more. It integrates functions of research, science popularization, tourism, and vacation. The garden preserves nearly 1,000 varieties of flowers and economic plants. As you stroll through the park, you are surrounded by a world of exotic flowers, unique trees, and a colorful array of plants, making it an important tourist destination in Xishuangbanna.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: There are local snacks and special handicrafts
summary:
Starlight Night Market is one of the emerging night markets in Xishuangbanna and one of the scenic spots in Gaozhuang West, a tourist resort. It usually opens at 7 o'clock in the evening. 
Mainly gourmet snacks and various special handicrafts, which is much cleaner than Binjiang Night Market. 
Night markets are all composed of small stall owners, some of whom are locals and some of them come from all corners of the country like tourists. 
There are many stall owners here selling handicrafts, ethnic costumes, gemstone jewelry, etc.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Forests; Nature Reserves
shortFeatures: Air corridor, enjoy rainforest ecology
summary:
China's only tropical rainforest national nature reserve, famous for its magical tropical rainforest landscape and ethnic customs. 
In the scenic spot, there are the largest known banyan fruit in China, the pale hook wind and the strangling king, as well as the "living fossil" of the dinosaur era. 
There are Kemu people living in it, and only more than 3,000 of them are distributed in Mengla and Jinghong counties. 
The annual Songkran Festival is held from April 13 to 15, attracting many tourists from home and abroad, and is known as the "Oriental Carnival".

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Geological Sites; Villages
shortFeatures: The relatively intact tropical rainforest areas
summary:
Mengyuan Wonderland is located in the Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve in Yunnan, within the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, and is one of the first pilot health and wellness towns in Yunnan Province. It is also one of the 20 key cultural and tourism projects in the province.

Mengyuan Wonderland covers an area of approximately 16.4 square kilometers, with a total investment of around 4.8 billion yuan. The project aims to build a world-class "health living destination" and focuses on creating a flagship health and wellness project for Lancang-Mekong cooperation. The development targets high-net-worth individuals and is driven by four major sectors: health and wellness, tourism, study tours, and sports. The project is positioned as "Rainforest Spirit Cave, Health and Wellness Paradise," with plans to create a world-class air purification and detoxification destination, a tropical rainforest canyon wellness haven, the country’s first constant-temperature karst cave health therapy base, and a high-end spiritual retreat destination in China.

Mengyuan Wonderland boasts abundant tropical rainforest resources. The project is located at 21°N latitude, with an average annual temperature of 21°C. The Baojiao Cave maintains a constant temperature of 21°C year-round, with mild summers and winters, making it a natural healing sanctuary. The area’s negative ion concentration peaks at 320,000 per cubic centimeter, offering a natural negative ion bath. The Earth's magnetic field ranges between 4.6 and 5.0 Gauss, making it a natural magnetic healing environment. The small molecular cluster water flowing from the original tropical rainforest is rich in minerals like strontium and metasilicic acid.

The project offers a unique environment for rehabilitation and wellness, supported by a comprehensive ecosystem. It serves as a health and wellness destination that integrates leisure, sightseeing, vacationing, and spiritual retreat.

Mengyuan Wonderland is rich in diverse ecological resources such as karst landscapes, tropical rainforests, and unique cultural elements, including Theravada Buddhism, Baojiao culture, and the ethnic customs of the Dai and Yao people. It is a "wonderful sanctuary" for nurturing the soul and promoting physical and mental wellness.

The abundant tropical rainforest resources and vibrant ethnic culture have attracted excellent domestic and international film, television, and entertainment production teams for location shoots. Mengyuan Wonderland has served as the filming location for the BBC’s "Discovering Chinese Cuisine—Yunnan Xishuangbanna," Baidu and Discovery's "U-Live Survival Challenge," the movie "Princess Peacock" starring Tang Guoqiang, and programs like "Wild Kitchen" and "Small Chase the Ball" on Hunan TV and Mango TV.

Currently, Mengyuan Wonderland has successfully transformed from a traditional sightseeing destination to a deeper experiential tourist attraction. Its main features include experience tours, in-depth tours, thematic tours, and educational tours, making it one of the healthiest and most promising tourist destinations in Xishuangbanna’s business landscape. In addition to traditional sightseeing products such as cave tours and rainforest hiking, the project offers a wide range of popular experiential and deep-dive products, including stargazing campsite tent camping, tropical rainforest zip-lining, rainforest banquets, cave exploration, rainforest crossing, Dai architecture courses, rice field fishing, riverside hotels, farm produce picking, bonfire parties, RV camping, magnetic therapy, natural healing, cave health therapies, yoga, Tai Chi, and calligraphy. In the future, top-tier wellness resorts, health management centers, health check-up centers, air purification and detoxification services, Dai therapies, and traditional Chinese medicine treatments will be introduced as the project develops.

Dushu Chenglin is an ancient banyan tree with a height of more than 50 meters. Local ethnic minorities call it "Meilongka". When translated into Chinese, it is the scenic spot of "Dushu Chenglin", hence its name. A banyan tree in Xishuangbanna is not only a landscape, but also contains profound Dai folk culture, Buddhist culture and the harmonious and natural ecological view of Dai people. 
As the saying goes, "A single tree can't make a forest", but in nature, only banyan trees can "make a forest by a single tree", breaking the saying that "a single filament can't make a thread, and a single tree can't make a forest". According to the calculation of plant experts, this tree is more than 1,000 years old, with a ground area of 2,200 square meters. On the main branches on the left and right sides of the tree, there are 36 aerial roots of different sizes, which are vertically down, intertwined with each other, wrapped in the roots and plunged into the soil to form clustered pillar roots with connected roots. Creating a peculiar scenery with multiple trees, like a fence and a natural screen, is a peculiar landscape in the tropical rain forest and the artistic charm of nature's uncanny workmanship. Become the first typical material for photography hobbies, outdoor curiosity hunting, botany and popular science knowledge disseminators

shortFeatures: Experience the Tropical Rainforest Charm
summary:
· Xishuangbanna Sunac Land is located in the northwest of Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna, about 4.6 kilometers from Jinghong Gasa International Airport and approximately a 30-minute drive from the city center. The park's architectural style blends local Dai culture and is the only tropical rainforest park in Asia. With its rich ethnic cultural heritage, Xishuangbanna Sunac Land attracts numerous visitors.

· Xishuangbanna Sunac Land consists of four major themed areas: Jungle Adventure, Fisherman's Wharf, Tea Horse Road, and Butterfly Kingdom. The park features 15 large entertainment attractions, exquisite Southeast Asian-style architecture, and whimsical mushroom houses, creating a dreamy rainforest paradise that offers visitors a thrilling experience of soaring at high speed, making them scream with excitement.

shortFeatures: The lake is crystal clear and watch the peacocks fly
summary: Peacock Lake is located in the center of Jinghong, covering an area of 18,700 square meters. It was turned into a park in 1977. There are pavilions and waterside pavilions in the garden, and exotic flowers are planted. The lake is clear and the blue waves are rippling. Paddling and playing in the lake is refreshing and refreshing.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Nighttime Scenic Tours; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The city offers both delicious food and beautiful scenery, with the night view especially stunning.
summary:
Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, in the Dai language, means "Nine Towers and Twelve Villages" in Chinese. The central pagoda is quite impressive and definitely worth a visit.

When visiting Gaoshuang Xishuangjing, there's no need to rush. You can rent a bicycle and leisurely explore the area. During the day, visit the Mekong River, then head to the pagoda to experience the Buddhist culture—it's a very relaxing activity. In the evening, you can visit the night market for some "shopping", try some local tropical fruits, buy some handicrafts, or go to a bar to have a drink with friends and chat about life and ideals—it's very laid-back and comfortable.

shortFeatures: King Kong Throne Posture
summary: Manfeilong Pagoda is a famous pagoda group in Xishuangbanna. It is called "Bamboo Shoot Pagoda" because the pagodas rise like spring bamboo shoots. Because of its whiteness, it is called "White Pagoda" and is a symbol of Xishuangbanna. The tower group was built in 1204 AD, with a total of 9 towers, one mother tower and eight sub-towers. The tower base is multi-petaled plum blossom-shaped, and the main tower is surrounded by eight small towers, distributed at eight angles. On the native rock under the niche facing south of the pagoda, there is a human ankle mark, which is said to be the footprint of Sakyamuni, so this pagoda was built. Manfeilong Pagoda has a high reputation in China, Myanmar, Laos and Thailand. Every year, many believers travel thousands of miles to worship and offer gifts devoutly to express their worship and admiration for the Buddha.

The Lancang River flows through Qinghai, Tibet and Yunnan provinces, and exits Mengla County, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province to become the boundary river between Laos and Myanmar, and was later called the Mekong River.

tagNameList: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: Villages with Dai as the main ethnic group
summary: Manzhang Villagers Group belongs to Manjingkan Village Committee of Mengyang Town, and belongs to dam area village. It is a characteristic village with a history of more than 500 years, with Dai people as the main ethnic group, and its traditional ethnic culture is intact.

Songkran Square is located in Xishuangbanna Dai Garden. Songkran Festival is an annual traditional festival of Dai people. You can enjoy this lively festival in the Splashing Square, or you can participate in it yourself and have an exciting splashing battle.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Tea Plantations
shortFeatures: Xishuangbanna's famous origin tea
summary: Nannuoshan is also known as the tea producing area in Xishuangbanna. Here, there is a cultivated tea tree king with a tree age of more than 800 years. It has a strange appearance and a tea content of about 30%, which is higher than that of ordinary cultivated tea trees. Until now, tea trees are still lush all year round, so it is known as the hometown of tea tree king. Around the mountains of Nannuoshan, there are tea gardens all over the slopes and fields. The tea produced has long been famous in history.

poiName: Xishuangbanna Southern Herbal Garden Scenic Area
shortFeatures: Taking traditional medicine culture as the theme
summary: Xishuangbanna South Medicine Garden was founded in 1959, affiliated to Yunnan Branch of Institute of Medicinal Plants, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences. With the theme of carrying forward and inheriting traditional medicine culture, it integrates modern ecology, landscape, plant classification, tourism and other professional elements, carefully planned and cleverly laid out, and is divided into 12 individual parks according to the ecological habits and medicinal effects of southern plants, integrating a pleasing medicinal plant grand view garden. Known as the living picture scroll of Compendium of Materia Medica!

poiName: Xishuangbanna Ancient Tea Horse Road Scenic Area
summary:
Xishuangbanna Tea-Horse Road Scenic Spot is located in Menghai Township, Menghai County, Xishuangbanna Prefecture. The Tea-Horse Road Scenic Spot is jointly developed and constructed by the Tea Research Institute of Yunnan Academy of Agricultural Sciences and the scenic spot. 
The scenic spot has developed into a comprehensive tourism base integrating scientific research, preservation of historical sites and cultural relics, and popular science education. It has become the popular science education base in Yunnan Province with the largest number of tea resources and plants in China, the richest folk cultural relics.
Ai Shanzhai is located in Xishuangbanna Virgin Forest Park, opposite a deep stream. Buildings similar to Dai folk houses are divided into upper and lower floors.

The monument to Premier Zhou Enlai is built on the right side of Jinghong West Tropical Crop Research Institute. This house was built in September 1953. This scientific research base, which covers an area of hundreds of acres, is planted with tropical and subtropical cash crops, which gathers the essence of tropical crops. There is a rubber forest behind the scientific research building, and there stands a monument in the rubber forest, which is an impressionist large-scale sculpture "Monument to Premier Zhou Enlai" designed by a professor at Tongji University in Shanghai.

Jingzhen Bajiao Pavilion is located 14 kilometers west of Jinghong, on Jingzhen Mountain in Menghai County. The pavilion is named after the mountain. It is one of the important cultural relics in Xishuangbanna and was built in 1701 AD. 
 
The octagonal pavilion is a brick and wood structure, with an octagonal shape. The pavilion body has 31 inclined surfaces, inlaid with stained glass, and various flowers are printed with gold and silver powder. The corners of the eight pavilions are sculpted with golden roosters and brightly colored carvings of exotic flowers. At the top of the pavilion is a lotus canopy and a pole of wind. The breeze passes by, and there is a sweet sound. 
 
At the top of the mountain about two miles north of the Octagonal Pavilion, there is a stupa towering, opposite the Octagonal Pavilion. Between the Jingzhen Buddhist Temple and the Octagonal Pavilion, there is a huge ancient tree. The tall and straight trunk can only be hugged by several people, which embellishes the beautiful scenery of the Octagonal Pavilion.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
shortFeatures: Enjoy the rainforest scenery and feel the simple folk customs
summary: Mandan Village, at the southern end of Xishuangbanna, is hidden deep in the tropical rain forest, and the people of the whole village keep a primitive lifestyle. The sky-looking trees and green rice fields towering into the sky surround Mandan Village in the center. Dan Village belongs to Pagong Village Committee, Gelanghe Township, Menghai County, Xishuangbanna, Yunnan Province, and farmers' income is mainly planting.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
summary: Mandiu Village belongs to Manzhangzai Village Committee, Gasa Town, Jinghong City, Yunnan Province. It is a beautiful small village that is free and open, with simple folk customs and open doors at night. The whole stockade is very clean and tidy. The stockade is on the slope and there is a pond in front, which is very beautiful.

shortFeatures: Experience the life of Dai people
summary:
--Manyangguang is a typical Dai village. The houses are "dry fence" bamboo buildings, and the bamboo fences between households are fences, forming their own courtyards. The stockade is not big, so you can visit it soon. 
--Here, you can buy folk handicrafts with ethnic characteristics such as Dai brocade, woodcarving, bamboo weaving, pottery, etc. Dai girls will also take you to their homes to explain the local customs of Dai people.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Water Activities; Markets; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A bustling market with Southeast Asian sentiment
summary: The floating market project shows the unique cultural customs of the six countries in the Mekong River Basin (China, Laos, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia and Vietnam), and creates relevant life scenes in the six countries (mainly Dai and Thai). It is the only floating market with Southeast Asian customs in China. Visitors can also shuttle through the floating market by boat and experience the floating market by boating.

shortFeatures: Filled with rich ethnic customs
summary:
--Riverside Park in Xishuangbanna is located on the south bank of Lancang River in Jinghong City. It is permeated with rich ethnic customs and shows us beautiful pictures of dazzling and uncanny workmanship. 
--The park has the comfort and carefree comfort of "quiet in the middle of the noise, quiet in the middle of the noise, and winding paths leading to seclusion". It is indeed a good place for citizens and foreign tourists to relax, entertain and take a walk.  
--On the floor about 20 meters in front of the main entrance of the park, a map of Xishuangbanna is cast with copper, which is refreshing.

The park has a beautiful natural environment. It is the legendary place where Princess Xiangfa lives, and it is also a typical place where tropical rainforests and monsoon rainforests gather. 
"There is a forest above and a stone forest below" is a wonder in the park. All kinds of plants in various shapes grow on the exposed rocks, and all kinds of vines are intertwined, which is very strange. Among them, Jingdezhen spots such as "Strangling Plants", Tree Waterfall, Big Bangen, Silk Cave, Wangjiang Rock and Wild Elephant Stone are very distinctive and beautiful. Within kilometers, there are many of the world's best water energy resources, the richest biodiversity, and it belongs to the northernmost boundary of the world's tropical rainforest climate distribution; There are hundreds of wild animals such as white monkeys, long-tailed langurs, white-lipped deer, bear monkeys, gibbons and birds inhabit the park. Known as the "natural botanical garden".

Daluo Forest Park is located in Manjing Mountain, Daluo Port on the Sino-Myanmar border in Xishuangbanna, bordering the fourth special zone of Shan State, Myanmar. There are two boundary rivers flowing through the park, and four boundary monuments stand. The park is surrounded by mountains and rivers, dense virgin forests, and the scenery is natural and beautiful.

Nanla River with a beautiful legend is a river that runs through Wangtianshu Tropical Rainforest Theme Park in Xishuangbanna. The rainforest landscape on the shore is beautiful and the birds sound is crisp. There are hundreds of kinds of fish in Nanla River, the most noteworthy of which is the extremely precious rare animal living in the river-"Peach Blossom Jellyfish".

shortFeatures: The magnificent building complex faces Jinghong City
summary: Xishuangbanna Museum of Nationalities is located on the east bank of Lancang River in Jinghong City, which is surrounded by mountains and rivers and has a beautiful environment. The magnificent buildings face Jinghong City and are surrounded by lush natural forests and rubber forests on three sides. The museum covers an area of 150 mu, with a building area of 16,000 square meters, and an estimated total investment of 155 million yuan, which is mainly supported by subsidies from the state and provincial governments, and part of which is raised by the state government. By November 2010, the first phase of the construction project with an investment of more than 90 million yuan has been completed. The long-awaited ethnic museum of people of all ethnic groups in Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture has now changed from a blueprint to a reality. This Xishuangbanna National Museum, which is devoted to the care and love of the leaders of the CPC Central Committee, Yunnan Provincial Party Committee and provincial government, and embodies the wisdom and sweat of commanders and builders, has stood on the half slope of Nanlian Mountain across the river from Jinghong City.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Terraced Fields; Villages
shortFeatures: Understand the culture of the Hani people
summary: Hani Cultural Park is the only Haniaka museum in Southeast Asia. Learn about the cultural highland of Haniaka in China and the world. Forest tea houses with thousands of acres of ancient trees and tea gardens, scoop a pot of mountain spring water and taste the real Pu'er, which is nothing more than the world. Mountains and clouds, quiet valleys, wonderful sounds of nature, Hani Laozhai, Abu Ali, Nannuo ancient tea, the great wisdom of the perfect combination of natural ecology and humanistic ecology is the "harmony between man and nature" that drifts away from us or even abandons us.

--Mange Buddhist Temple is the oldest Buddhist temple building in Jinghong City. The scale of the temple is magnificent. The main temple is supported by 18 red toon wood columns, and 16 Qing elephants stand on the eaves of the temple. 
--The Buddhist temple is surrounded by Dai bamboo buildings and tall broad-leaved trees such as Bodhi, mango and betel nut. It is a typical Southern Theravada Buddhist temple. 
--During the construction process of the whole temple, whether it is beam frame or bucket arch, all of them are connected by mortise, instead of nailing and riveting, and the shape is very elegant and beautiful. 
--Every time the Dai people's "Door Opening Festival" and "Water Splashing Festival", local and even foreign believers come here to worship and redeem Buddha.

Outside the 219 boundary pillar on the China-Myanmar border at Daluo Port in Xishuangbanna is Mengla, the capital of the fourth special zone in eastern Shan State, Myanmar. The 219 boundary pillar is very close to a single tree and a forest. The numbers of the Chinese boundary pillars between China and Myanmar are on the border.

The lake is crystal clear, Lishui lingers, Jiaji River gurgles in front of the lake, trees are lined on both sides, and the scenery is pleasant. The release of animals is originally a Buddhist Chinese language, but the custom of releasing animals in Han China did not begin with Buddhism.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Villages
summary: Manfeilong Village is a famous tourist village in Menglong Town. The village is famous for its traditional residential villages, mellow and simple folk customs, authentic and delicious Dai food and the famous Manfeilong Pagoda. Every year, it attracts a large number of Chinese and foreign tourists to the village to experience Dai culture and folk customs. The Dai-style farmhouse music run by the villagers is even more unique, making Manfeilong Village a characteristic village competition integrating culture, religion and tourism in Menglong Town.
