shortFeatures: There are many ancient tea gardens, rich in Pu'er tea
summary:
Brown Mountain is located in Menghai County, Xishuangbanna, close to the border between China and Myanmar. It is a famous Pu'er tea producing area and one of the areas with the most preserved ancient tea gardens. 
Brown Mountain Township includes Banzhang, Laoman'e, Manxinlong and other villages, among which the oldest Laoman'e stockade has a history of 1,400 years. The Blang people are descendants of Baipu. They have lived in Brown Mountain for generations and are the earliest people in the world to cultivate, make and drink tea.

shortFeatures: Integrate sightseeing, scientific research and entertainment

tagNameList: Treasure spots for kids' outings; City Parks
shortFeatures: Overlooking the scenery of Guiyang City from the mountain
summary:
- Qianling Mountain Park is characterized by its famous mountains, beautiful waters, secluded forests, ancient temples, sacred springs, and spiritual monkeys, and is known as "The First Mountain of Southern Guizhou."
- The Hongfu Temple at the top of the mountain is the largest Buddhist monastery in Guizhou and is the province's most prominent temple. It was founded during the Qing Dynasty, and it is said that prayers here are very effective.
- There are many rhesus monkeys along the Hongfu Temple and the path down the mountain. Many visitors come to Qianling Mountain Park specifically to see these monkeys, which are free-roaming within the park.
- Halfway up the mountain, there is a zoo with a wide variety of animals. The Qilin Cave in the scenic area was the place where General Zhang Xueliang was once imprisoned.

tagNameList: Experience slow living; hidden gem for strolling with kids.; Ancient Towns; Military Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The filming locations of the movie "The Missing Gun"
summary:
- Qingyan Ancient Town was established in the Ming Dynasty and has well-preserved a large number of ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing periods. It is known as one of the four major ancient towns in Guizhou, alongside Zhenyuan, Bian'an, and Longli.
- The ancient town is built along the mountain terrain, with city walls constructed from large stones on the cliffs. It has four city gates: East, West, South, and North. The town’s exquisite stone carvings and wood carvings are major highlights.
- Backstreet is the most distinctive stone alley in Qingyan, with courtyard walls built from layers of stone slabs. The narrow and tranquil road winds with the mountain, making it a perfect spot for photography.
- The town is home to four religions: Buddhism, Taoism, Catholicism, and Christianity. It still preserves both a Christian church and a Catholic church.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Night tour viewing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A wooden attic built in the Ming Dynasty
summary:
Jiaxiu Building is a landmark building in Guiyang. Anyone who goes to Guiyang will board it to observe the scenery. 
The existing building was rebuilt during the Xuantong period of Qing Dynasty. The three-story building stands on Aoji Stone, in front of which is the flowing Nanming River. 
Walking through the floating jade bridge connecting Jiaxiu Building, it is Cuiwei Garden, with pavilions and waterside pavilions in the garden, which is quite south of the Yangtze River. 
The night view of Jiaxiu Building is particularly beautiful. From a distance, it is brightly lit.

tagNameList: Child-friendly Hidden Gems: Autumn Leaf Viewing; City Parks
shortFeatures: Enjoy the authentic rural scenery.
summary: Huaxi Park is a historically significant natural scenic park in Guiyang. The park was completed in 1940 and was officially named Huaxi Park in 1949. The park is primarily known for its real mountains, real waters, and pastoral landscapes, featuring scenic spots such as Furong Island, Baibu Bridge, Bashang Bridge, Golden Avenue, Lin Mountain, Gui Mountain, Pine and Cypress Garden, Peach Garden, Peony Garden, Bamboo Lotus Pond, and Rest Garden.

shortFeatures: Experience Karst Canyon Rafting
summary:
- The South River Grand Canyon is located in Guiyang, integrating natural scenery and cultural facilities, and is known as the "Karst Ecological Museum."
- The scenic area features various landforms, with magnificent Karst canyon landscapes that are the most diverse in type, making it a prime example of canyon scenery.
- It is home to the largest travertine waterfall in Asia, the Jinzhong Waterfall, and is known for its numerous waterfalls in different forms. It also has the longest suspended wooden plank road in the country.
- In addition to the scenery, thrilling activities such as rafting and CS real-life experience games are also must-tries.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
shortFeatures: Collect a large number of local historical folk cultural relics
summary:
Guibo New Museum is located on the north side of the middle section of Lincheng East Road, Guanshanhu District, Guiyang City, across the road from Guiyang International Convention and Exhibition Center and Guiyang Urban and Rural Planning Exhibition Hall. Its skyline and architectural style are coordinated with Guiyang International Convention and Exhibition Center and Guiyang Urban and Rural Planning Exhibition Hall, echoing each other from afar. The total investment of the project is nearly 600 million yuan. 
· The building is roughly divided into three parts: central, eastern and western. The eastern part is basically a public service area, including temporary exhibition, intangible cultural heritage performance, photography and calligraphy exhibition, 4D cinema, youth digital experience hall, teaching, conference and other functions; The central area is the core functional area, the first and second floors are the basic exhibition hall of "National Guizhou", the third floor is the basic exhibition hall of "Historical Guizhou", and others include functional rooms such as lobbies, restaurants and cultural relics warehouses. The west area is the administrative office area of the museum. 
After nearly 60 years of development, the total number of museum collections in Guizhou Province has accumulated to more than 80,000. National cultural relics are the highlights of Guibo's collection and are unique in China. Among them, China Miao costume library and China Miao silver jewelry library rank first in China. In addition, the collection of paleontological fossils in Guizhou, cultural relics unearthed from Paleolithic Age and various cultural relics reflecting local historical, cultural and cultural diversity are also the highlights of Guizhou Provincial Museum.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Enjoy autumn leaves; Wetlands; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Enjoy the park's musical fountain
summary: Huaguoyuan Wetland Park is located in the core area of Greater Guiyang City, surrounded by three mountains such as Yunnan-Guizhou Mountain with lush vegetation. In the park, there are thousand-year-old trees Ginkgo biloba, auspicious Podocarpus pine, beautiful and charming old sunflower, valuable camphor tree, and ten miles of fragrant osmanthus. Together with colorful flowers and plants, fish and birds in the lake, pedestrian promenade and sparkling lake surface, they are combined into a beautiful and charming landscape painting.

shortFeatures: A temple with many ancient ruins
summary:
Hongfu Temple, located on Qianling Mountain in Guiyang, was founded in 1672. It is the most famous Buddhist temple in Guiyang and is known as "the first temple in Guizhou". There are ancient ruins in Hongfu Temple, such as Moyan stone carvings, the ancient Buddha cave visited by Xu Xiake, and the pagoda forest of elders of past dynasties. The temple itself is known for its effectiveness in praying for blessings, so the incense is very strong. 
Hongfu Temple was built in the 11th year of Kangxi's reign in Qing Dynasty, and was founded by monk Chisong. The word "Hongfu" means "promoting Buddha's great wish to save people and the world; The whole temple is located in the center of the peaks of Qianling Mountain. Although Hongfu Temple is not big, the temple has a rigorous layout and majestic architecture, and it is full of ancient style because it is hidden in a green. 
There are many ancient ruins in the temple, including the nine-winding path and Moyan stone carvings opened by monk Chisong, the ancient Buddha cave visited by Xu Xiake, and the pagoda forest of elders of past dynasties. In the bell tower of the temple, there is a bronze bell weighing more than 3,000 kilograms, which was an antiquity cast in the fifth year of Chenghua in Ming Dynasty (1469). It was originally located in Daxing Temple in the city and moved here in 1980. 
There are also many poems, paintings and inscriptions of ancient and modern celebrities in the temple. On the Dashan Gate, there are "Hongfu Temple" inscribed by Zhao Puchu, the former president of the Chinese Buddhist Association, and "Amitabha Buddha in the South" inscribed by Dong Biwu, the late vice president of the state, and "The First Mountain in southern Guizhou". There is also the monument to Chisong Monk and the stele gallery of poems written by Zhu De, Dong Biwu and others in the temple.

shortFeatures: Flower viewing place in the suburbs
summary: This is an original ecological wetland park, which combines streams, valleys and caves. There are also many Dong buildings such as Fengyu Bridge in the park, which have unique ethnic customs. There are mostly plank roads at the foot, and it is very pleasant to walk in the dense forest in spring. The highest point of the park is Aha Reservoir. The water flows down the ladder, like a small waterfall. People who love swimming will be seen in all seasons. There is a shallow beach in the car river, where the sand is flat and the water is quiet. From time to time, people have picnics and barbecues here; After crossing the Prince Bridge westbound, passing through the mountain in the southern suburb park, and crossing a stone bridge, you will arrive at the quiet place of Aha Lake National Wetland Park, which is one of the locations for wedding shooting in Guiyang.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; Treasure place for walking babies; Lakes
shortFeatures: Visit the Maple Grove by boat or landing on the island
summary: Hongfeng Lake is located in the western suburbs of Guiyang, about 28 kilometers away from Guiyang, the provincial capital. It is the first stop of the golden tourism on the west line of Guizhou. The scenic spot covers an area of about 200 square kilometers. It is a national scenic spot that integrates plateau lakes and mountains, karst landforms and ethnic customs. There is a red maple ridge beside the lake, and there are many maple trees on the ridge and around the lake. In late autumn, maple leaves are as red as fire, red leaves and blue waves, and the scenery is beautiful, hence the name "Red Maple Lake".

shortFeatures: Genting Meadow Photographing Beautiful Scenery
summary: The local characteristic folk arts in Gaopo Miao Township include Miao embroidery, lusheng making, birdcage making, etc. The cultural festivals held include the traditional Miao festival "April 8th", the Buyi song festival "June 6th", Miao shooting cards, hole jumping, bullfighting, etc.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Memorial Halls; Historical Architectures
summary:
Xifeng Concentration Camp was the largest and highest-level secret prison among the prisons set up by the Kuomintang Military Bureau during the War of Resistance against Japan period. According to the old military union itself, Zhazidong is a primary school, Baigongguan is a middle school and Xifeng is a university. General Yang Hucheng's family was also imprisoned in Xifeng concentration camp for eight years, where Xiao Luobutou, Huang Xiansheng and Ma Yinchu were also imprisoned. 
In the concentration camp, the old scene of the barracks has been restored, and many chains, bamboo sticks, soldering irons and other instruments of torture can still be seen. Some old cars and motorcycles are also preserved here. Halfway up the mountain, the cat cave is a cave hidden under the ground, and it is also a place where revolutionaries are interrogated, because no matter how torture is used here, the cries can't be spread out. What's even more cruel is that if new instruments of torture were invented at that time, the cat cave would become a place to test the advantages and disadvantages of instruments of torture, which shows the cruelty of Xifeng concentration camp.

shortFeatures: The vast grassland is like being outside the Great Wall
summary: In Gaopo Township, Guiyang, you can also feel the grassland scenery of "the sky is blue, the wild is vast, the wind blows the grass and the cattle and sheep are low". Spring and summer are endless green grasslands, and in autumn there are clumps of reeds floating. In this small Miao township, there are not a few people who come here for barbecue in summer and autumn. If you drive by car, bring camping and photography equipment to photograph sunset, burning clouds and beautiful starry sky.

tagNameList: Enjoy autumn leaves; Night tour viewing; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: A beautiful place for leisure and fitness
summary:
Guanhu Park covers an area of more than 5,500 mu, of which the forest area is about 4,160 mu. There are lush trees in the park, including apple trees, pear trees, cherry trees, peach trees and other fruit trees, as well as Magnolia, Sassafras, Weeping Willow, Du Ying, Liriodendron tulipifera, Erqiao Magnolia, Fatong, Liquidambar formosana, Magnolia grandiflora, Osmanthus, Red Fruit Holly, Magnolia officinalis, Chicken Claw Acer, Lechang Michelia, Luan tree, Metasequoia, Cinnamomum camphora, Ginkgo biloba, Cherry Blossom, Lagerstroemia indica, Pomelo tree and other trees. 
The ecological wetland composed of Guanshan Lake and Jinhua Lake covers an area of about 600 mu, attracting hundreds of egrets, wild ducks and other birds to inhabit here; The water body in the park is formed by seven underground mountain springs, which keep a balanced water level all year round. The clear water ripples and sparkling all year round. It is the "green lung" of the city in Guanshan Lake District.

tagNameList: Experience slow life; Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
shortFeatures: A group of hot springs surrounded by trees
summary:
Xifeng Hot Spring was developed in 1945, with beautiful scenery and natural resources, and is one of the eight famous hot springs in China. 
It is a famous tourist resort in Guizhou and even the whole country, and is known as the "Pearl of Double Victories", which integrates health care, entertainment and vacation. 
The water temperature is about 53 ℃ to 56 ℃. Besides containing a variety of trace elements, radon in spring water has high medical value. It is also one of the few high-quality natural medical drinking mineral waters in the world, and it is known as "the best soup in the world".

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Large downtown leisure plaza
summary: As a city card, Zhucheng Square is located in the center of Guiyang Old Town, with a peninsula nestled on the beautiful Nanming River. Zhucheng Square is positioned as an important place to interpret Guiyang's historical connotation, display Guiyang's urban spirit, enrich citizens' cultural life, highlight the flavor of the times and practice the concept of ecological civilization. Through a variety of landscape elements such as sculptures and clock towers extracted from Guiyang's history and national bamboo culture, combined with modern and fashionable scientific and technological landscaping techniques, the square comprehensively displays Guiyang's urban cultural features. It is an urban space with regional characteristics and historical heritage as well as modernity, science and technology and ecology.

shortFeatures: Zanjiao Chonglou Octagonal Type
summary: Wenchang Pavilion is a traditional sacrificial building in China, which has been built in many places, but the number of gods worshipped in Wenchang Pavilion varies from place to place. Generally speaking, Wenchang Pavilion is quadrangular, hexagonal and octagonal, but Wenchang Pavilion in Guiyang is a ninagonal pavilion with a peculiar architectural style: the ground floor of Wenchang Pavilion is square, and the second and third floors are 9 angles of unequal degrees; Wenchang Pavilion has 81 beams and 54 columns, all of which are multiples of 9; The second and third layers of spinulosa, each with 9 roots. "Nine" in the Book of Changes means supreme and represents lofty status. Wenchang Pavilion is located on the Yuecheng City at the old east gate of Guiyang City, with a high terrain, a panoramic view of the mountains and rivers, and a vast field of vision. It is a good place to enjoy the scenery of Guiyang.

shortFeatures: In memory of Wang Shouren, a philosopher and strategist of the Ming Dynasty
summary: Yangming Temple, located at the foot of Fufeng Mountain in the east of Guiyang, was founded in the 19th year of Jiaqing in Qing Dynasty. Yangming Temple is the general name of three groups of ancient buildings, which includes three parts: Yangming Temple, Yin Daozhen Temple and Fufeng Temple. Three groups of ancient buildings together form Fufeng Mountain Scenic Area with quiet environment and beautiful scenery. Zheng Zhen, a giant scholar in southwest Qing Dynasty, once praised it as "a green hibiscus in the sky". Yangming Temple is not only a place to commemorate Wang Yangming, but also a good place to enjoy tea. Find a quiet afternoon to sit in the teahouse in the temple and enjoy an afternoon of leisure time with a cup of tea.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; City coordinates; Lakes; Water Conservancy Projects; Boat Tours
shortFeatures: The water is clear and the peaks in the lake are towering
summary:
Baihua Lake has the scenery of lakes and mountains, the wild interest of farmhouses and the scenery of castles. In the lake area of Zhuchang Town, there are hundreds of islands in the lake, and the isolated islands look at each other, overlooking the distance, and the green hills are endless. 
The most beautiful season of Baihua Lake is in spring, when the island is full of flowers, and the fragrance of flowers is compelling. Begonia, sweet-scented osmanthus and plum blossoms are competing to bloom, and they are colorful. The Bird Island on Baihua Lake is worth seeing. In spring and autumn, all kinds of birds gather on the island, such as egrets, grey herons, seagulls and geese... which are dazzling. There are several villages in the lake, where local farmers live, and you can taste authentic farm dishes. 
Zhuchang Castle near the lake area was established in the Ming Dynasty and remains to this day. It was a military castle used for troops to be stationed in those days. Not far away, there is a camp slope, which used to be a castle. Although only the ruins remain, you can still see the city walls, crenels and forts.

shortFeatures: Appreciate the rich Karst landscape.
summary: Showcase the rich karst landforms, diverse natural ecological landscapes, and colorful indigenous multi-ethnic cultures of Guizhou's mountainous parks.

shortFeatures: Appreciate all kinds of strange caves
summary:
Lover Valley, located in the eastern suburb of Guiyang, is 7 kilometers away from the center of Guiyang, with an area of 6 square kilometers. The magical and beautiful love legends and wonderful canyon scenery of Lovers Valley are fascinating. 
The whole canyon, the scenery is changeable and magical. Besides the wonderful canyon scenery, there are many caves deep in the dense forest and between cliffs. Such as "Wangtian Hall", "Tongtian Cave", "Immortal Cave", "Rhinoceros Cave" and other karst caves, with all kinds of strange stone bells and milks, each showing its own state and interest, will make you laugh and ponder.

Qilin Cave is a karst cave, formerly known as Tangshan Cave. It is named after a huge stalactite in the cave, which resembles a unicorn. 
Located in Qianling Park in downtown Guiyang. Formerly known as Baiyi Temple. It was originally a place for nuns to practice. 
Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng, the famous anti-Japanese patriotic generals of War of Resistance against Japan, were imprisoned here by Chiang Kai-shek, so they became famous far and near. 
It is a provincial cultural relics protection unit and a patriotic education base in Guiyang. 
Yang Jin, a eunuch who was guarding Guizhou at that time, once wrote the scenery of this cave: "There is a Tangchuan in the depths of the white clouds, and there is a lotus at the entrance of the cave on the pillow of the stone smoke", and "a thousand peaks are green, and a thousand hanging pearls are hanging", which shows that this cave has been valued by tourists in the Ming Dynasty. 
The room displays some historical materials about generals and the "Double Twelve". Between the entrance of the cave and the nunnery gate, there is a small patio, adjacent to the mountain and the cave, and the environment is quiet. At present, there are four bauhinia, osmanthus and pomegranate plants that escape from the side; Chrysanthemums are planted all over the surrounding ridge. In autumn, they are colorful, osmanthus trees are fragrant, pomegranates bear fruit and green leaves are dancing.

poiName: Guizhou Provincial Museum of Ethnic Cultures
shortFeatures: Minority costumes and handicrafts

tagNameList: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
shortFeatures: Photography enthusiasts should not miss it
summary: Huaxi Golden Avenue was founded in 1956, with a total length of 560 meters. There are 115 phoenix trees planted along Huaxi River. Every late autumn, the leaves of phoenix trees gradually turn yellow. Looking from the distant mountains and forests, it looks like a golden avenue, hence the name "Golden Avenue".

shortFeatures: Riding a horse in the wide prairie

tagNameList: Theatre Theatre; Venue exhibition hall; Theater; Taoist Temples
shortFeatures: Admire the exquisite wood carving
summary: Located at No.3 West Street, Qingyan Ancient Town, adjacent to Ciyun Temple. It was built in the Kangxi period of the Qing Dynasty and rebuilt in the third year of Jiaqing (1798). It was not a Taoist temple at the earliest, but a Jiangxi Guild Hall, which was the place of merchants who traveled from south to north, and later transformed into a Taoist temple. The whole palace consists of the main hall, the side hall, the west chamber, the theater and the living area. It sits from east to west and covers a total area of more than 1,000 square meters. However, most of the buildings were destroyed during the Cultural Revolution, and most of them were rebuilt later. The most interesting thing in the palace is the theater, in which the wood carvings are exquisite. On the wooden beam on the right side of the theater, a group of high-relief figures are the most famous, with the contents of "Hongmen Banquet", "House of Flying Ambush" and "Embattled on All Sides", etc., which are very characteristic of military culture.

shortFeatures: Large forest parks around the city
summary: The park is very simple, with no complicated landscape. Except for walking paths, it is a coffee shop, restaurant and karaoke bar on the mountain for people to relax. It's very pleasant to take a walk here in the early morning after the rain. At this time, the park is covered in fog, green bamboo surrounds both sides of the road, and all kinds of trees on the mountain cover the sky and the sun, making it lush. In spring, locust trees and purple trees are full of flowers and give off sweet fragrance. It's a good place to spend time.

shortFeatures: Magnificent style of Han and Tang Dynasties
summary: Guiyang Confucius School is located in the middle section of Guiyang Huaxi National Urban Wetland Park, a famous scenic spot, backed by Dajiang Mountain and overlooking Huaxi River, covering an area of 460 mu. The general layout is divided into the completed "Public Education Zone" and the "Chinese Culture Research Park" under construction. Its main functions are to study, study, educate and spread Chinese excellent traditional culture, gather famous Confucian scholars at home and abroad, exchange academic achievements, open a lecture hall of Chinese studies, read traditional classics, practice civilized etiquette, and have both collection and display.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Hot Springs
shortFeatures: Enjoy the unique hot spring pools and water park.
summary:
- Covering an area of 150 acres, with a building area of nearly 15,000 square meters and an outdoor area of 23,000 square meters, the facility offers services including hot springs, dining, guest rooms, SPA, health care, and chess. The interior design is in Southeast Asian style, and it is built to international standards as a health, leisure, and resort destination.
- Featuring over 40 indoor and outdoor hot spring pools with various special therapeutic effects, the facility also includes a spa, children's water play pool, fish therapy, geothermal zone, dry/wet steam, and an outdoor heated swimming pool, among other amenities.
- The water temperature of the Poly International Hot Spring is 67°C. It is a calcium sulfate spring, rich in various trace elements beneficial to the human body. Due to its significant health and beauty effects, it is known as the "Health Soup."

In 1999, the municipal government increased its investment in park construction and completed the dredging project of Qianling Lake, which increased the capacity of the lake reservoir, made the dam more stable and the water quality clearer. The lakes and mountains are quiet and pleasant. Bridge waterside pavilion, green poplars and green willows, has more scenery of Qianshan Mountain and beautiful waters. 
The Monument to the Liberation of Guizhou Revolutionary Martyrs "stands majestically on the west bank of Qianling Lake. After the renovation, the guardrail of the monument was replaced with white marble, the square with granite ground, and the lakeside guardrail with grass white jade. The green vegetation around the monument was adjusted, and the monument appeared more solemn. 
Qianling Lake has become a place for many Guiyang citizens to cool off in the summer, and it is also the first choice for many swimmers. In the past, whether it was summer or winter, people would see many swimmers in the lake except the rippling cruise ships.

shortFeatures: Combine theater, bookstore and teahouse
summary: The school was originally Nanjiyun Temple built in Yuan Dynasty. It was rebuilt and added many times in Ming and Qing Dynasties, and transformed into Zhonglie Palace. The playground behind Zhonglie Palace is the main part of the former site of Dade School, a typical courtyard house in Ming and Qing styles. The exhibition of Dade School History located in the auditorium shows visitors how this private primary school, which started with just over twenty primary school students, has developed into a complete school with more than 1,600 students.

shortFeatures: Natural oxygen bar with beautiful scenery
summary: Its karst landscape is magnificent, with strange peaks and rocks like gods and Buddhas, flying dragons, girls and strong men. Some river sections are split like huge axes, forming a line of cracks in the ground, and the rushing river water condenses in the slit one meter away, which is a wonder. Among the main scenic spots, the natural landscapes include Qianfoling, Zijiang Tianlong, Zijiang God, Sanquan Yingyue, Wanpu Yuntai, Spring Clouds Rolling, Seven General Mountain, Zijiang Giant Buddha, Zijiang Goddess, Jiutian Milky Way, Phoenix Beach, etc. The cultural landscape includes Lingjiabuyi Village and Green Village, which are surrounded by ancient trees and rare tree species, with rich ethnic customs. Many experts, media and tourists amazed after sightseeing, saying that it is "the diamond on the chest of the earth", "the natural oxygen bar", "the kingdom of animals and plants", "the boutique museum of geology, nature and ecology" and "the first choice for returning to nature".

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Playground; Theme Parks
shortFeatures: A well-equipped amusement park
summary: Guiyang Happy World, which was rebuilt from the original Baiyun Park, is an animation-themed amusement park with the largest investment, the largest scale and the most complete amusement facilities in the whole southwest region. More than 40 animation amusement facilities with domestic leading level, such as hanging roller coaster, Ferris wheel, double-decker luxury carousel, Challenger Tour and 4D cinema, will be settled here.

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
shortFeatures: Enjoy the spectacular animal training performance.
summary:
Guizhou Forest Wild Animal Park is centered around the exhibition and observation of wild animals and forest landscapes. The park features diverse terrain, including gentle slopes, valleys, wide gorges, mountain peaks, stone forests, and karst caves.  
In this paradise suitable for animals to thrive and reproduce, over 5,000 rare and exotic animals from around the world, including the national-level Yangtze alligator, South China tiger, Siberian tiger, African lion, Nubian ibex, giraffe, zebra, chimpanzee, and many others, coexist with performances by animal stars such as those from the Russian circus, lions, tigers, and bears, creating a lively and enchanting ecological space full of wild charm.

shortFeatures: Admire the Calcified Beach Waterfall and the Caves.

tagNameList: Grassland wind collection; Nature and Adventure; Forests

summary: There is a grassland in the park. The well-maintained mixed landscape forest in put in order is tall and beautiful as a silver needle, and the thick grassland under the forest is like a green carpet without dust. In the meantime, listening to the bursts of pine waves rising one after another, a feeling of eternal harmony with nature suddenly comes into mind. There is cherry blossom lake in the garden, which is the essence of Changpo Ridge. Cherry blossoms bloom in spring, red and white, which is extremely romantic. Willows hang low along the lake and are full of vitality. The lake is full of blue waves, and the shadow of the forest is reflected in clouds. The park is distributed into five scenic spots, namely Cherry Blossom Lake, Forest Lawn, Duxi Forest Farm and two minority villages.

shortFeatures: The historical witness of the Thirteen Dynasties' ancient capitals.
summary:
- Also known as the Xi'an Ming City Wall, it is the most well-preserved ancient city wall in China, ranking second in length nationwide.  
- Along with the Pingyao City Wall, Jingzhou City Wall, and Xingcheng City Wall, it is one of the four best-preserved ancient city walls in China.  
- The city wall is surrounded by a moat, and the famous Xi'an Bell Tower and Drum Tower are located at the center of the wall.  
- Visitors can choose to stroll leisurely or cycle around the city gates. The roads on the city gates are uneven, so cyclists should pay attention to safety.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-22:00(Tickets available until 22:00; admission ends at 22:00)

poiName: The Terracotta Army and Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum
shortFeatures: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
summary:
- It is a large funeral pit in the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, based on the Terracotta Army, and is the largest ancient military museum in China built on the original site.
- There are three main pits for the Terracotta Army. Pit No. 1 is the main military formation with a mix of chariots and infantry, containing about 6,000 life-sized terracotta figures. Pit No. 2 consists of chariots, cavalry, and crossbowmen in a mixed formation. Pit No. 3 represents the command system of the army.
- The unearthed terracotta figures include generals, warriors, and charioteers. Each figure has unique facial features and expressions. Originally painted, most of the colors have faded or peeled off due to fire and immersion.
- The bronze chariot and horses on display in the exhibition hall are made with a large amount of gold and silver, and are exquisitely crafted, earning the title "Crown of Bronzes," with significant value for research on the Qin Dynasty.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; a hidden gem for kids.; Museums
shortFeatures: Traveling through time among the vast and precious cultural relics.
summary:
- Located on the northwest side of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, it is China's first large-scale modern national-level museum. Its completion marks a new milestone in the development of China's museum industry.
- The museum houses more than 370,000 cultural relics, ranging from simple stone tools of early humans to various artifacts used in social life before 1840, spanning over one million years of history.
- Among its collection, the Shang and Zhou bronze ware is exquisite, the terracotta figurines from various dynasties are diverse, and the Tang dynasty tomb murals are unparalleled.
- The museum condenses the essence of Chinese history and is known as the "Treasury of China," serving as an artistic hall to showcase ancient Chinese civilization and the history and culture of Shaanxi.

tagNameList: Get Close to Nature; Explore the Exhibition Hall; Springs; Historical Sites
shortFeatures: The place where Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Consort Yang bathed together.
summary:
- Huaqing Palace has been a royal leisure and bathing spot since ancient times, and it is said to have been the bathing place of Yang Guifei. It is also said that King You of Zhou, from the Western Zhou period, built a detached palace here.
- The site preserves relatively complete cultural relics from various dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, Ming, and Qing, such as historical sites, garden landscapes, ancient architecture, and famous old trees.
- It is particularly famous for the romantic love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei, as well as the internationally shocking "Xi'an Incident." Successive dynasties, including the Qin, Han, and Sui, carried out construction here, and during the Tang Dynasty, the palace was expanded several times.
opening_hours: Opens at 07:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:40)

shortFeatures: View the scenery of the palace garden in the prosperous Tang Dynasty
summary:
The largest cultural theme park in Northwest China, with the largest imitation Tang buildings in China. 
There are two "the world's largest" projects in the park, the world's largest outdoor fragrance project and the world's largest water curtain film performance. 
The night scene is bright, and the Tang Culture Corridor, Fanglin Garden, Ziyun Tower and other places in the bright lights are dazzling everywhere. 
The park has praying for heaven and drums, court performances of "Jiaofang Music and Dance" and costume performances of "Yan Ying Clothes", etc. 
· The large-scale dance drama "Dream Back to the Tang Dynasty" staged at Fengming Jiutian Theatre is a music and dance performance that integrates the customs of the prosperous Tang Dynasty and the essence of singing and dancing.

shortFeatures: Tang Dynasty Royal Temple, Magnificent and Magnificent
summary:
Dacien Temple is the most famous and magnificent Buddhist temple in Chang'an City of Tang Dynasty, which was built by the imperial decree of Li and Tang Dynasties. In the 22nd year of Zhenguan of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty (648), Prince Li Zhi founded Ci'en Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Wende, the eldest grandson. 
Xuanzang presided over temple affairs here, took charge of the translation field of Buddhist scriptures, founded the Knowledge-only Sect, one of the eight major sects of Han Buddhism, and became the ancestral court of the Knowledge-only Sect. 
The Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Daci'en Temple, formerly known as the pagoda in the west courtyard of Ci'en Temple (pagoda means pagoda), was supervised by Xuanzang himself, so Daci'en Temple has a very prominent position in the history of Chinese Buddhism and has always been valued by Buddhist circles at home and abroad.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

poiName: Big Wild Goose Pagoda North Square
tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: View the colorful musical fountain
summary:
The most famous square in the city, with the largest musical fountain performance in Asia every night, is a good place for tourists and citizens to take a leisure walk.  
The whole square takes the Big Wild Goose Pagoda as the central axis, the center is the main waterway, and there are many landscapes on the left and right sides and the southern end of the square.  
On the east side is the Opera Grand View Garden with local characteristics in Shaanxi. There are sculpture groups such as opera painted sculptures and local opera cast bronze reliefs in the garden. 
On the west side is the Folk Grand View Garden with the theme of folk culture. Vivid sculptures such as shadow play, eight monsters in Shaanxi, walking on stilts, rural marriage and Bailuyuan series, etc., show the folk customs of all parts of Shaanxi.

It is the earliest museum founded in Shaanxi. It is an art museum that mainly collects, researches and displays steles, epitaphs and stone carvings of past dynasties. 
The museum area consists of three parts: Confucius Temple, Forest of Steles and Stone Carving Art Room, covering an area of more than 31,900 square meters, with more than 11,000 cultural relics and 11 exhibition rooms. 
The most famous ones are the inscriptions of famous calligraphers such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan and Huai Su, as well as two inscriptions of Tang Dynasty, Shitai Filial Piety Book and Kaicheng Shijing. 
There are not only stone tablets, but also stone carvings and some other cultural relics in the museum.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: In the Tang Dynasty, it was the residence of Prime Minister Wei Zheng

tagNameList: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Museums
shortFeatures: Learn about the history of development of the Thirteen Dynasties' Ancient Capitals.
summary:
- It is a comprehensive exhibition area that integrates museums, historical sites, and urban gardens. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located here.  
- It houses nearly 130,000 historical relics, including more than 14,400 precious cultural items of national grade III or above, most of which were unearthed from the Zhou, Qin, Han, Tang, and other dynasties.  
- Through the themed exhibition "Ancient Capital Xi'an," visitors can experience the changes of history through the evolution of the city and the transformation of ancient artifacts.  
- Inside the museum, there is a "model of the city walls" of Xi'an, from the Zhou to the Ming and Qing dynasties, which illustrates the scale, layout, and living conditions of the ancient capitals throughout different periods.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly Hidden Gems; Historical Ruins; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Recreate the Splendid Palaces of the Tang Dynasty
summary:
- It is the most magnificent and grand architectural complex among the "Three Great Palaces" of Tang Chang'an, namely the Taiji Palace, Daming Palace, and Xingqing Palace, which are world-renowned.
- Built in the eighth year of the Zhenguan reign under Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty, the original palace walls had a perimeter of 7.6 kilometers, with a total of 11 gates on all sides. Over 40 archaeological sites, including halls, platforms, and pavilions, have been discovered.
- Here, you can admire a restored miniature model of the Daming Palace, watch the IMAX 3D film *The Legend of Daming Palace*, and experience cultural relic excavation and restoration.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:30)

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Historic site; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The landmark building of the ancient city with shocking night scene
summary:
The Drum Tower and the Bell Tower are 200 meters apart, and the two Ming Dynasty buildings echo each other. It is one of the largest and most well-preserved drum tower relics in China. 
There is no nail in the whole building structure. On the basis of Tang Dynasty style architecture, the architectural techniques of Song Dynasty are used and innovated, which makes the whole building spectacular and magnificent. 
The original giant drum upstairs, which beats the drum every day to tell the time, hence the name "Drum Tower". After years of vicissitudes, the giant drum does not exist, but the drum towers stand tall. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and there is a gilded roof on the top. The building is quaint and vigorous, full of national characteristics.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

summary:
The largest and most well-preserved bell tower left over from ancient China, with six chime performances every day. 
The eaves are covered with dark green glazed tiles, the interior of the building is painted with gold, painted pillars and carved beams, and the top is a gilded treasure top, which is magnificent. 
Standing on the bell tower, you can see the east, south, west and north streets extending from the bell tower, the most prosperous business district in Xi'an around the bell tower, and the Drum Tower not far away. 
When visiting the bell tower, you can also enjoy wonderful performances of visiting ancient times, six performances every day. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the bell and drum tower square, with a musical fountain.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests
shortFeatures: Pine and cypress are evergreen and lush
summary:
Located in the south of Lintong District, Xi'an, it is a branch of Qinling Mountains, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two scenic spots have been merged. 
It is divided into east and west embroidered mountains, and most scenic spots are concentrated in west embroidered mountains, including the "Beacon Tower" of the princes of the beacon drama and the "Bingjian Pavilion" in the Xi'an Incident. 
At the foot of Lishan Mountain is the famous "Huaqing Pool". In the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool in the "Evening Pavilion" is one of the famous scenery, "Lishan Evening Photo".

shortFeatures: A pedestrian street full of books
summary:
Xi'an people usually refer to the Academy Gate, which refers to a pedestrian street from Forest of Steles to the entrance of Guanzhong Academy. 
There is a tall archway with ancient charm at the corner of the street, with three golden characters "Academy Gate" written on it. 
There are blue antique buildings on both sides of the street, the ground is paved with bluestone, and the end of the street is the Forest of Steles.  
During the day, it is a street of calligraphy and painting, with a strong literary flavor; It is a snack street in the evening, and Xi'an is rich in characteristics.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Downtown of Xi'an
summary:
· Also known as Shangshu Provincial Square, it is located in the center of Xi'an, covering an area of 60,000 square meters, second only to Tiananmen Square in Beijing. 
It used to be the seat of Shangshu Province in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, and it was the highest administrative organ to carry out state government affairs at that time. 
The 600-year-old bell tower stands on the east side of the square, and the largest drum tower in China stands on the west side. 
On the north side of the square, there are prestigious time-honored shops such as Tongshengxiang, Defachang and Wang Haitang; Below the square is Century Golden Flower Shopping Center. 
As night falls, the lights of the musical fountain, bell tower and drum tower all light up, which is very spectacular.

shortFeatures: A century-old official compound in Huimin Street
summary:
It is the former residence of Gao Yuesong. Gao Yuesong's ancestral home is Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province. In the ten years of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, his son was happy to be second place, and he was awarded the plaque of "No. 2 and No. 1" by the imperial authority. 
From the 14th year of Chongzhen to the 10th year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty, seven generations of Gao family were officials. The main body of this courtyard was built in Chongzhen period of Ming Dynasty, with a history of more than 400 years. 
There are souvenirs with Shaanxi characteristics, such as architectural art of Ming and Qing Dynasties, couplets of traditional houses, brick carving art, folk paper-cutting, shadow play, porcelain, etc.

tagNameList: Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Autumn Leaf Viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The Relics Repository of Master Xuanzang and Shari's Cranial Top
summary:
- Located at the North Square of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, it is a landmark of Xi'an, glowing with lights at night.
- The fountain is divided into three areas: the 100-meter waterfall pool, the eight-level cascading pool, and the front music fountain pool, each of which can perform independently or in unison.
- The eight-level cascading pool features the world's largest square formation, with nozzles arranged in various patterns to create different water shapes.
- The large laser water curtain fountain can fully ignite and explode in low temperature at a height of 6 meters, providing a sensory experience that visitors should not miss.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:40(Tickets available until 16:40; admission ends at 16:40)

tagNameList: Explorer's Pavilion; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
shortFeatures: Showcase the pottery art from 6,000 years ago.
summary:
- It is the largest and most well-preserved matrilineal clan commune settlement site in the Yellow River Basin, with a history of 6,000 years.  
- It is the first prehistoric settlement site museum in New China, with exhibitions divided into three parts: unearthed artifacts, the site hall, and auxiliary displays.  
- The museum collection includes more than 18,000 artifacts, over 4,000 items of Grade 3 or above cultural relics, more than 300 fossil specimens, and several human skeletal remains from the Neolithic period.  
- The fish-patterned human-faced basin is the most valuable artifact unearthed at the Banpo site, and the design inspiration for the Fuwa (the Olympic mascots) for the 2008 Beijing Olympics came from it.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Night tour viewing; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The main entrance of Xi'an City Wall
summary: Yongning Gate is the south gate of Xi'an City Wall. It was built in the early Sui Dynasty. At that time, it was the east of the three gates in the south of the imperial city. It was originally called Anmen Gate. It was reserved as the south gate when Han Jian shrank to build a new city in the late Tang Dynasty, and changed to Yongning Gate in the Ming Dynasty. Now Yongning Gate is round-the-island traffic, with South Gate Square outside the gate, South Street inside the gate and Nanguanzheng Street outside the gate.

tagNameList: Close to Nature; Hidden Gems for Kids; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Temples
shortFeatures: One of the Five Great Mountains famous for its奇险 (perilous and奇特)景
summary:
- It consists of Bishan Lake Scenic Area, Tianchi Scenic Area, and Shān Bēng Shí Hǎi Scenic Area. The pool cluster at the summit is surrounded by mountains, clear as a mirror, untouched by dust.
- The park features landscapes of cliff remnants, giant stones, strange caves, and landslide-formed lakes, earning the title of "Natural Landslide Museum."
- Cuihua Mountain offers different scenic views throughout the year. The spring and autumn weather is pleasant, summer brings abundant water, and in winter, Tianchi resembles a precious mirror, with waterfalls turning into ice falls, creating a magnificent sight.
- The park has the first natural ski resort on the northern slope of the Qinling Mountains, with excellent snow quality, long and wide ski trails, and slopes perfect for skiing enthusiasts.

tagNameList: Block stroll; Night tour viewing; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Eat Xi'an cuisine all over the ancient neighborhood
summary:
The gathering area of Hui nationality in Xi'an, which is composed of many roads, is also called "Huifang" by locals, and it is a must-see place when you first arrive in Xi'an. 
There are a dazzling array of snack shops on both sides of the street, where you can feel the profound cultural heritage while eating delicious food. 
Nearly 300 kinds of special snacks, such as meat sandwiches, Southeast Asian steamed cakes, steamed buns and cold skin, can be tasted in Huimin Street, which makes people linger. 
The streets are not very clean, there are many pedestrians, and they are congested and noisy every holiday.

summary:
- Based on Mo Yan's Mǎo Dùn Literature Award-winning novel *White Deer Plain*, this is Shaanxi's first large-scale film and television city that integrates film shooting and experiences, cultural leisure, children's entertainment, and spectacular performances.
- By showcasing the architecture, history, and patriarchal culture of the Guanzhong region, visitors can journey through the five major passes—Wuguan, Xiaoguan, Tongguan, Jin Suoguan, and Dasan—experiencing the ancient plains and understanding the ancient history, traversing through the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties.
- There are 13 performance projects, including two large-scale live-action special effect performances, *The Two Tigers Guarding Chang'an* and *The Great Earthquake of Guanzhong*, four children's fun performances, and seven traditional Guanzhong folk performances.
- The site restores the folk customs of Guanzhong, offering an immersive experience of local culture and a true-to-life movie shooting set.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Full of Tang style elements
summary: Datang Never Sleeps City integrates shopping, catering, entertainment, leisure, tourism and business. Relying on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the scenic spot starts from Xuanzang Square in the north, Tang City Wall Ruins Park in the south, Ci'en East Road in the east and Ci'en West Road in the west, and runs through three theme squares: Xuanzang Square, Zhenguan Cultural Square and Kaiyuan Celebration Square, six imitation Tang blocks and four cultural buildings: Xi'an Concert Hall, Xi'an Grand Theatre, Qujiang Film City and Shaanxi Artists Gallery. Zhenguan Cultural Square consists of four groups of cultural and artistic buildings: Xi'an Grand Theatre, Xi'an Concert Hall, Qujiang Art Museum and Qujiang Pacific Studios.

poiName: The Tang Dynasty Western Market Museum
shortFeatures: This is the international commercial center of the Tang Dynasty.
summary: The Great Tang West Market Museum is China’s first privately-owned museum built on the site of the Tang Dynasty Chang'an West Market. The museum houses over 20,000 cultural relics, primarily consisting of artifacts excavated from the West Market site and items collected by the museum's founder over the past twenty years.

tagNameList: Climbing and Hiking; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: The forest in the mountains is dense, and the scenery is beautiful.
summary: The Zhuque National Forest Park is located in the southern part of Huxian County, Xi'an, upstream of the Donglao River, on the northern side of the Qinling Liang. It is 74 li (approximately 37 kilometers) from Xi'an and 75 kilometers from Xianyang. The total area is 2,621 hectares, with five scenic areas and 105 tourist attractions. The park's mountains are part of the northern Qinling fold belt. The front mountain valleys are wide and flat, with dense forests, surrounded by water, and exceptionally picturesque. The back mountains are rugged, with steep peaks, isolated summits reaching into the clouds, and rocks with unique shapes. Waterfalls cascade like a flying dragon stringing pearls, and countless strange cliffs and rocks are hidden among dense forests and giant trees, as well as rare flowers and unique trees, creating a natural landscape painting. The grandeur of Ice River Cui, the wonder of Longtanzi, the peril of Qixiu Peak, the beauty of Luhua River, the tranquility of Qinling Liang—all showcase their own unique characteristics. The waterfall with a drop of over 100 meters hangs like a reversed Milky Way.

The main hall of Daming Palace in Tang Dynasty is surrounded by three levels of "jade steps" about 5 meters wide outside the hall, and there is a Longwei Road to the hall steps more than 70 meters long in front of the hall. 
The front of the temple is divided into two pavilions, Xiangluan and Qifeng, and there are cloisters connected between the pavilions, which form a "concave" shape. It is the development of the "Que" system since the Zhou and Han Dynasties, and has influenced the palaces of past dynasties until the meridian gate of the Forbidden City in the Ming Dynasty. 
· Hanyuan Hall is combined with the high pavilions of the main hall on a "concave" plane, echoing each other, with undulating outline, huge volume, magnificent momentum, cheerful and brilliant, and full of spiritual shock. 
In ancient times, some people described its boldness of vision as "like being born in the sun" and "like being in the sky", and it is worthy of being an outstanding representative of Datang architecture.

shortFeatures: Founded during the Zhenguan period of Tang Dynasty
summary:
Xi'an Nanshan Ancient Guanyin Temple was built in the Zhenguan period of Tang Dynasty (628 AD), with a history of about 1,400 years. It is one of the thousand-year-old temples in Zhongnanshan. 
There is a thousand-year-old ginkgo tree with a history of more than 1,400 years in Guanyin Temple. According to legend, this ginkgo tree was planted here by Li Shimin, Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty.

shortFeatures: Components of Muslim Street
summary:
Xi'an Dapiyuan is full of Muslim customs of the Muslim people, and the food there makes you greedy more, and makes you feast your mouth and eyes. 
The whole street is full of market atmosphere, with food stalls, restaurants and specialty shops all over the streets and lanes on both sides of the street.

tagNameList: Theatre Theatre; Venue exhibition hall; Theater
shortFeatures: View Ming and Qing style architecture
Chinese Buddhist Pure Land Ancestral Court
summary: Xiangji Temple is the first ancestral hall of the Pure Land Sect of Chinese Buddhism. Located in Shenheyuan, about 17 kilometers southwest of Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, it is adjacent to the water in the south. It is one of the national key Buddhist temples in the Han area designated by the State Council. It is also the second year of Yonglong (681) of Emperor Gaozong of the Tang Dynasty. Master Shandao, one of the founders of the Pure Land Sect, passed away. Disciple Huai Yun built Xiangji Temple and Shandao Master's offering tower to commemorate the merits of Shandao, making Xiangji Temple the first dojo after the official establishment of the Pure Land Sect of Chinese Buddhism.

shortFeatures: Love theme cultural park
summary: Hanyao Ruins Park is the first large-scale wedding customs and wedding ceremony experiential theme park in China. Hanyao Ruins Park is divided into three cultural areas as a whole, which focus on the legends of Wang Baochuan and Xue Pinggui's faithful love through thousands of years, namely, wedding area, ruins area and commercial area, which display Chinese traditional love culture and classic love stories in an all-round way through various forms of expression.

tagNameList: Explore the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kids; Museums
shortFeatures: Children's Science Museum
summary: The Shaanxi Natural History Museum is located on a boat-shaped island around the Xi'an Television Tower on Chang'an South Road, Xi'an. It consists of five major exhibition areas: the Natural Exhibition Hall, the Science and Technology Exhibition Hall, the Dome Theater, the Outdoor Exhibition Area, and the Temporary Exhibition Area. The Natural and Science Museums are situated at the north and south ends, respectively, with the Xi'an Television Tower serving as the symmetry point. The Dome Theater in the Science Museum is the first of its kind in Northwest China. The exterior of the Science Exhibition Hall is shaped like a glass sphere, while the Natural Exhibition Hall is crescent-shaped, symbolizing the "Sun" and "Moon," with the meaning of "Sun and Moon Shining Together."

tagNameList: Cute Animals; Treasure Spots for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
shortFeatures: Watch various wild animals in free-range enclosures.
summary: Xi'an Qinling Wild Animal Park is a national 4A-level tourist attraction that integrates wildlife ex situ conservation, popular science education, tourism, sightseeing, and leisure. Covering an area of over 2,600 acres, the park houses rare wildlife species from the Qinling Mountains, including the "Four Treasures of Qinling" – giant pandas, takins, golden snub-nosed monkeys, and crested ibises – as well as more than 200 species of representative wild animals from around the world, totaling over 6,000 animals. The park boasts the largest number and most diverse animal populations in Northwest China, receiving more than 1.8 million visitors annually. Since its opening, it has been awarded titles such as the National Wildlife Protection and Popular Science Education Base, National Youth Civilization Honor, Shaanxi Province’s Middle and Primary School Research and Practice Education Base, and Xi'an Youth Popular Science Education Base, among others. It is also recognized as a leading service brand enterprise in Shaanxi Province and Xi'an.

tagNameList: Night tour viewing; Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
summary:
Daxingshan Temple is located in Xingshan Temple West Street, Xiaozhai, about 2.5 kilometers south of Xi'an. 
· It was founded in the period from Sima Yantai to Taikang (AD 265-AD 289) of Emperor Wu of Jin Dynasty, more than 1600 years ago. It was first called Zunshan Temple. In the second year of Emperor Wendi Yang Jian of the Sui Dynasty (AD 582), Zunshan Temple was expanded on the basis of Zunshan Temple. Because the temple was located in Jingshan Square of Daxingcheng, the capital, it was renamed "Daxingshan Temple". 
During the Kaiyuan period of the Tang Dynasty, Indian monks were stationed in Xiben Temple successively, translating classics, setting up altars to pass on secrets, and then passing on and carrying forward them by one line and Huiguo, forming a profound treasure house of Buddhist culture-Tang Mi. Later, it was spread to Japan and South Korea through Konghai and Zuicheng, and then to Malaysia, Indonesia and other places, which spread widely and had a long influence.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Forests; National Parks; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Where Lao Tzu wrote Tao Te Ching
summary: Louguantai National Forest Park is located 15 kilometers southeast of zhouzhi county, Xi'an, with an altitude of 501-2997 meters, with distinct seasonal climate changes. It is one of the 12 earliest approved forest parks in China and one of the top ten landscapes in Xi'an.

tagNameList: City Parks; Buildings by Famous Architects
summary: Xi'an Tang City Wall Ruins Park is located 500 meters south of Datang City that never sleeps, between two parallel east-west urban roads of Yannan 2nd Road and Yannan 3rd Road. It is the location of the south city wall of Chang'an City in Tang Dynasty.

shortFeatures: 63.3 m giant imitation Han building
summary: Dafeng Pavilion, located in Hancheng Lake Scenic Area, is a landmark building of Hancheng Lake in Xi'an. Its main height is 63.3 meters, which is based on the artistic conception of "Dafeng Song" written by Liu Bang, the emperor of the Han Dynasty, "When the wind blows, the clouds fly, Weijia returns to his hometown, and the warriors are guarding the four directions". It is the commanding height of Hancheng Lake Water Conservancy Scenic Area and one of the landmark buildings in the scenic area. There is a multimedia demonstration project of "Great Han Tiancheng" in the pavilion, as well as pictures and physical displays of Han costumes, military affairs, emperors and allusions of Han Dynasty on the fifth, sixth and seventh floors.

shortFeatures: Built to commemorate Shaanxi National Army
summary: Xi'an Revolutionary Park, located on the north side of the east section of Xiwu Road, Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, is a provincial cultural relics protection unit, a "party history education base" and a "Xi'an youth patriotism education base". The Revolutionary Park was founded in 1929 to commemorate the soldiers and civilians who died in Xi'an by the Shaanxi National Army on the eve of the Northern Expedition.

shortFeatures: Built on the site of Xingqing Palace in Tang Dynasty
summary:
Xi'an Xingqing Palace Park is a cultural heritage park built on the site of Tang Xingqing Palace in 1958. It is located in the north of Xianning West Road outside the east gate of Xi'an, covering an area of 780 mu, including 150 mu of lake surface. It is the largest city park in Xi'an. It has the functions of landscaping, climate regulation, environmental protection and city beautification, and takes into account the functions of flood control and flood discharge in the southeast of the city. 　　 
· The design of the park uses freehand brushwork, splashing ink, taking the trend that the northwest is high and the southeast is low. Three mountains are planted with trees, and there are three islands in the lake, with Longchi as the center. In the lush green and interdependent mountains and rivers, according to the orientation of the original Xingqing Palace, Scenic spots such as Agarwood Pavilion, Calyx Xianghui Building, Nanxun Pavilion, Changqingxuan, the Japanese envoy to the Tang Dynasty "Apei Zhongmalu" monument, Wulongtan Pavilion and Sanba Forest have been set up. 
· Xingqing Lake with clear water and verdant hills are also harmoniously integrated with the buildings in the park. The architecture of the park as a whole has absorbed the construction art of Tang Dynasty in China, and has some creation and development in inheriting the layout and architectural methods of gardens in China.

shortFeatures: There are many delicious foods around the best place to worship Buddha
summary:
Wenshu Academy is a key Buddhist temple in the Han nationality area announced by the State Council. It is known as one of the four Zen forests in the Yangtze River Basin. It is located in the center of Chengdu. It is a Buddhist holy place integrating Zen forest sites, ancient gardens, pilgrimage and sightseeing, and religious study. 
 
The temple was founded in the Daye period of Sui Dynasty (605-617), and was originally named Xinxiangyuan. It was quite influential in the middle and late Tang Dynasty. According to the Records of Famous Scenic Spots, the Inscription of Building Luocheng, written by Hanlin Wang Hui, when Luo Pian, the envoy of Jiedushi in Xichuan, Jiannan, rebuilt the Chengdu city wall, was once engraved in the temple. Huang Quan, a famous court painter in the Five Dynasties, once painted bamboo in the temple, and later Yuan Shuoyou, the magistrate of Chengdu, recorded it with poems. In the Song Dynasty, there were Xin Xiang Zongxian and the abbot of Jiexiu Zen master to spread the Dharma, and scholars and doctors often visited here. Poems such as Song Qi, a writer of the Northern Song Dynasty, Song Qi, a writer of the Northern Song Dynasty, Fan Zhen, a writer of the Northern Song Dynasty, and Feng Shixing, a poet of the Southern Song Dynasty, were handed down from generation to generation. In the late Ming Dynasty, it was destroyed by soldiers. 
 
In the thirty-sixth year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty (1697), the temple was rebuilt by Zen Master Cidu Haiyue. At the beginning, the monk Cidu was repaired in the wasteland. At that time, the world often saw the fire shining in the air at night, and found the place where the monk Cidu practiced according to the trace, saying that Manjushri Bodhisattva should be transformed, so he felt the support of the officials and gentry, rebuilt Brahma, and changed his name to Manjushri Monastery. Emperor Kangxi once gave Mo Bao a book such as "Empty Forest", and Prince Guo once went to the temple to pay homage to Buddha's inscription, and the temple's Dharma feast was very popular. 
 
In the early years of the Republic of China, when the nation was in danger, the temple's Defeng monk and Chan'an monk founded Konglin Charity Pharmacy, Manjushri Purun Higher College and other institutions to serve the society and the people. During the Anti-Japanese War, the monks of the whole temple and the teachers and students of Konglin Buddhist College located in the temple issued the anti-Japanese declaration, held a training class for the Sangha rescue team in the temple, organized the temple monks to recommend the fallen soldiers, and actively participated in the anti-Japanese and national salvation movement. He also covered progressive students to secretly set up the earliest youth organization in Sichuan in the temple. 
 
After the founding of the People's Republic of China, with the attention and care of the party and the government, Monk Kuanlin led the monks on the road of self-reliance and innovation, and the temple was protected and repaired. Party and state leaders Deng Xiaoping, Zhu De, Chen Yi, Luo Ruiqing, Guo Moruo, Liao Chengzhi, Liu Lantao, Ba Jin, Zhao Puchu, Jia Qinglin, Liu Yandong, Xu Qiliang, You Quan, Wang Wenyuan, Wang Zhizhen, Qi Xuchun, etc. visited the temple successively, which greatly encouraged the monks in the temple. He also received Australian Governor Hayden, Dutch King William Alexander, Cambodian King Sihamoni and other foreign dignitaries and heads of state, and played a special role in foreign exchanges. 
 
The current abbot of the temple is Master Zongxing, and there are about 80 permanent monks. In recent years, the monks in the whole temple have carried forward the fine tradition of patriotism and love for religion, supported the leadership of the Communist Party of China (CPC), supported the socialist system, and constantly promoted the sinicization of Buddhism. Adhere to the study and repair system of morning and evening class recitation, fasting in class, half-month Busa, winter participation and summer study all the year round, and fully implement strict education management. Free tickets, free civilized incense throughout the year, organize lectures, meditation experience and other activities to provide religious services for believers. Carry forward the Buddhist spirit of compassion and helping the world, extensively carry out public welfare and charitable undertakings such as helping the needy, disaster relief, respecting the elderly and caring for the young, and actively fulfill social responsibilities. 
 
The temple covers an area of about 90 mu, with a building area of about 20,000 square meters. The ancient buildings of the whole temple are scattered at random, and the six main halls are progressed on the central axis in turn, which is magnificent and majestic. The hollow window grilles of each hall are varied and exquisite, which can be called the crown of Buddhist temples in China. There are tens of thousands of Buddhist statues, magic instruments, ancient books, paintings and calligraphy, etc. in the temple, many of which have been handed down from generation to generation. The iron-cast ring statue in Song Dynasty, the silk Mo Long painted by Han Song, and the thread embroidered Diamond Sutra are exquisite in art; The collection of scriptures written in the Ming Dynasty, Mahayana Sutras and Mantras, the statue of Manjusri, the statue of Guanyin embroidered in the Qing Dynasty, and the blood book Huayan Sutra, etc., are particularly extraordinary; Emperor Kangxi, Prince Guo, Liu Yong, Huang Shen, Guo Moruo, Zhang Daqian, Yu Youren, Xie Wuliang, Feng Zikai, Zhao Puchu, Qi Gong and other famous paintings and calligraphy are precious. In particular, the Buddha's bone relics and Master Xuanzang's parietal bone relics dedicated to the temple are worshipped by the world. 
 
Walking into Wenshu Monastery, a thousand-year-old temple, you will not only be shocked by its rich historical and cultural heritage, but also feel its vitality in the new historical period.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gem for family outings; Mountains; Taoist Temples
shortFeatures: Visit the birthplace of Taoism
summary:
- Located in the western part of Dujiangyan, it is one of the birthplaces of Taoism and is famously known as "Qingcheng, the most serene place under heaven."
- The area is divided into two scenic zones: the front mountain and the back mountain. Most visitors go to the front mountain, while the back mountain is more suited for hiking enthusiasts.
- The front mountain is smaller in area, with a temple or palace visible almost every hundred steps, classical and mysterious under the dense vegetation.
- The back mountain is larger in area and retains a relatively primitive appearance. Although the palaces and incense offerings are not as abundant as on the front mountain, it is quieter and more pristine.

summary:
The street park, where Chengdu people love to drink tea leisurely, is a comprehensive garden integrating cultural relics and leisure and entertainment. 
· The park is composed of natural landscapes such as Jinshui Creek and bonsai garden, and various vegetation and streams planted along the coast complement each other. 
· Goldfish Island and Yongju Tea House are integrated to create a cultural place for fish viewing and tea tasting. At present, there are more than ten kinds of precious goldfish on the island. 
The most famous one in the park is Heming Tea House, whose style has not changed for nearly a hundred years. The standard is bamboo chairs, low tables and covered bowls of tea, and the best tea is "fragrant tablets". 
· Chengdu People's Park is an excellent choice to experience the leisure life and slow time of local people, so as to truly appreciate the lifestyle of "leisure capital".

- The highest peak in the scenic area, Daxuetang, has an elevation of about 5,364 meters, making it the highest peak in Chengdu.
- The famous Tang Dynasty poet Du Fu highly praised the beauty of Xiling, writing "The window holds the snow of Xiling for a thousand autumns," and the Xiling Snow Mountain was thus named.
- In addition to the ski resort, the scenic area offers over ten snow activities, including snowmobiles and dog sledding.
- Xiling Snow Mountain is divided into the front mountain and the back mountain. Xiling Snow Mountain usually refers to the back mountain, which offers superior scenery and recreational opportunities.

shortFeatures: An ancient Taoist temple built in the Zhou Dynasty
summary:
Founded in the Zhou Dynasty, most of the existing buildings were rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. It is one of the famous Taoist temples in China and is known as "the first Taoist temple in western Sichuan". 
The palace preserves the classic edition of Taoist collection, an extremely precious Taoist historical relic engraved in Guangxu period, which is the most complete storage board of Chinese Taoist classics. 
There are two bronze-cast green sheep in the Sanqing Hall of Qingyang Palace. It is said that the sheep on the left was transformed by the attendant boy of Qingdi, which can cure all diseases. Just touch the part of the sheep corresponding to your own pain, and you can relieve the pain. 
The incense here is strong and the Taoist atmosphere is strong. It is a place for locals to relax.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns

summary:
- With a history of over 1,700 years, it is named the Hometown of Chinese Folk Art (Fire Dragon) by the Ministry of Culture and is recognized as a national-level picturesque town.
- The ancient archway, temples, traditional buildings, and ancient banyan trees blend seamlessly, and the cobbled streets showcase a strong sense of ancient charm.
- The old town has many restaurants, with dishes like noodles, fermented soybeans, and sesame cakes being highly recommended, along with the option to taste traditional farm meals.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Landmarks and symbols of the city
summary:
· Tianfu Square is located in the geographical center of Chengdu City, a symbol of Chengdu City, and a famous prosperous landmark in Southwest China. 
· It is the economic, cultural, commercial center and subway transportation hub of Chengdu, and it is also a city card of Chengdu. 
There is a tall statue of Mao Zedong in the center of the square, surrounded by the new Chengdu Museum, Sichuan Science and Technology Museum, Jincheng Art Palace and other buildings. 
With Tianfu Square as the center, there are Chunxi Road and Wangfujing on the east side, Wenshu Monastery on the north side, Kuanzhai Alley and Jinli on the west side.

shortFeatures: Collect Zhang Daqian's rich works
summary:
Sichuan Museum was built in 1941 and is divided into three floors. It is the largest comprehensive museum in Southwest China. 
The first floor is dominated by Sichuan Han Dynasty pottery and stone art exhibition, and most of the exhibits are rough and simple Han Dynasty stone carving art and pottery sculpture art. 
The second floor is mainly composed of Bashu Bronze Hall, Dafengtang (Zhang Daqian Painting and Calligraphy Exhibition Hall), Chinese Painting and Calligraphy Fine Hall and Porcelain Hall. 
The third floor is composed of the Light of Tibetan Buddha, the Stone Carving Museum of Wanfo Temple, the Gufeng Yayun Art and Crafts Museum and other areas, most of which reflect the folk customs of Sichuan. 
When you come out of the museum, you can visit the nearby Du Fu Cottage, Qingyang Palace, Wuhou Temple and Jinli. The distance is very close and you can play together.

summary:
- The Jinsha Site is a relic from the Shang and Zhou Dynasties, with the densest collection of ivory and the richest number of gold and jade artifacts from the same period in the world.
- The most famous item is the "Sun Bird" gold foil in the fourth exhibition hall, which has been designated as the symbol of Chinese cultural heritage and the main logo of Chengdu's city image.
- Here, visitors can pay to enjoy the 4D movie "Dream Back to Jinsha."
