shortFeatures: Angel Grove is a great place for bird watching
summary:
Sichuan University has three campuses: Wangjiang, Huaxi and Jiang'an. Wangjiang Campus is the headquarters of Sichuan University and belongs to the old campus. 
The administrative building of Wangjiang Campus was designed by Mr. Liang Sicheng, an architect, and is listed as a national cultural relic protection building. Now it has become a landmark building of Sichuan University. 
Yuzhang Road on campus, where ginkgo trees are golden in late autumn every year, is a scene in Chengdu. 
There is also an angel forest near the school of physics in the campus, where a large number of rare birds gather. On fine evenings, there are always a group of photographers gathered.

shortFeatures: Feel the unique history and culture
Larger parks in urban areas
summary:
Huanhuaxi Park, located in Huanhuaxi Historical and Cultural Scenic Area, is the largest open urban forest park with the largest investment in Chengdu. 
The park is mainly composed of three major scenic spots: Wanshu Mountain, Canglang Lake and Bailuzhou, and has also been rated as "the only five-star park in Chengdu".  
Here, with the historical and cultural connotation of Du Fu's thatched cottage as the background, the century-old ancient osmanthus, camphor tree and mandarin jacket tree are flourishing and the environment is quiet.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies; Museums
shortFeatures: Collection of more than 200,000 exhibits
summary:
Chengdu Museum is the largest comprehensive museum in Chengdu, with a history of more than 50 years. In 1958, the Preparatory Committee of Chengdu Geographical Museum was established; In 1974, Chengdu Cultural Relics Management Office was established; In 1982, Chengdu integrated relevant cultural relics management institutions to set up Chengdu Museum, located in Daci Temple, Dongfeng Road, Chengdu, and officially opened to the public in 1984; In 2009, the foundation stone of the new Chengdu Museum was laid; In June 2016, the new Chengdu Museum was completed and opened. 
The permanent exhibitions of Chengdu Museum include "Flowers and Brocade Official City-Chengdu Historical and Cultural Exhibition" and "Shadow Dance Vientiane Puppet Show-Chinese Shadow Puppet Exhibition", and high-level temporary exhibitions and special exhibitions will be continuously launched. Chengdu Museum mainly spreads Chengdu's history and culture to the public through the collection, protection, research and display of cultural relics, and strives to provide diversified public cultural services for the city.

tagNameList: Experience slow living; Hidden gems for kids.; Ancient Towns
shortFeatures: A thousand-year-old ancient town with an ancient temple from the Jin Dynasty.
summary:
- Jiezi Ancient Town is located at the foot of Fengqi Mountain in Chongzhou, with a history of over a thousand years. It preserves the rich charm of a Southwestern small town from the Qing Dynasty.
- It mainly consists of three parts: Jiezi Ancient Town, Guangyan Zen Temple, and Fengqi Mountain Forest Park, featuring both picturesque landscapes and ancient charm.
- Notably, the Shuanghe Site in Jiezi Ancient Town dates back over 4,300 years and is an important part of the prehistoric city sites of the Chengdu Plain.
- Additionally, there are more than 20 cultural and historical relics, including a thousand-year-old ginkgo tree, a thousand-year-old ancient camphor tree, Shanggu Temple, a Qing Dynasty pagoda, and a street lined with ancient buildings from the late Qing and early Republican era.
- On both sides of the street, various shops sell local delicacies like soup cakes and sesame cakes. It's a good idea to grab one and enjoy it while walking.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly hidden gems; Playground; Theme Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Experience thrilling and exciting game attractions.
summary:
- Located at No. 16 Xihua Avenue, Jinniu District, Chengdu, next to the Sanshan Road-Jiaotong Interchange, covering an area of approximately 510,000 square meters, about 6.6 kilometers from Tianfu Square, and just 10-20 minutes away from major commercial and entertainment areas in Chengdu.
- Chengdu Happy Valley is the best theme park in the western region, consisting of nine themed areas: Sunshine Harbor, Happy Time, Flying Island, Magic Castle, Silk Road Legend, Happy Lightyear, Bashu Mystique, Mediterranean Adventure, and Caribbean Storm.
- The Magic Castle and Happy Lightyear areas offer family-friendly attractions such as "Crazy Bus," "Bubble Battle," and "Happy Planet," which are highly entertaining for children.
- The park also regularly hosts various events such as the National Style Trendy Play Festival, Music Festivals, Street Art Festivals, Halloween celebrations, and large performances like the Happy Parade, making it a great place for leisure and entertainment.

shortFeatures: Thousand-year-old temple in downtown area
summary:
· Daci Temple, located near Chunxi Road, was built between the 3rd and 4th centuries AD and has a history of more than 1,600 years. 
At the height of the Tang and Song Dynasties, the temple had 96 courtyards, covering an area of more than 1,000 mu, and was known as "the first jungle of Aurora". 
Daci Temple is located in a bustling area, and it still keeps the courtyard quiet, with towering ancient trees. Those who love Buddhism should not miss it. 
In addition, there are vegetarian houses and teahouses in Daci Temple, from which you can walk to Chunxi Road.

shortFeatures: The complete millennium-old Hakka-style ancient town
summary:
- Luodai Ancient Town is the best-preserved Hakka ancient town in the suburbs of Chengdu, and is known as the "First Hakka Town in Western China."
- The town's thousand-year-old street and Hakka dwellings are well-preserved, with the old street following a pattern of "one street and seven alleys," and shops lining both sides of the street.
- Major attractions include the Guangdong Guild Hall, Jiangxi Guild Hall, Huguang Guild Hall, Northern Sichuan Guild Hall, and the Hakka Museum, all of which preserve the past atmosphere of the Hakka people.
- Local Hakka people often hold various Hakka cultural activities here, such as "eating Hakka food, wearing Hakka clothes, and sleeping on wooden platform beds."

tagNameList: Experience Slow Life; Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns
shortFeatures: It has a long history and the Liu family estate.
summary: Anren Ancient Town is not far from Chengdu, only an hour's drive away. The town was originally established during the Tang Dynasty, and most of the existing traditional buildings date back to the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China period. There are buildings from the peak of the Liu family during the Republic of China, with a blend of Chinese and Western architectural styles, featuring solemn, elegant, and grand courtyards that give Anren Town its unique architectural character, earning it the title of "A Fine Example of Western Sichuan Architectural Culture." Notable attractions include the Jianchuan Museum, Anren Old Street, and the Liu Wenchen Mansion, which are all worth visiting. The town offers a wide range of accommodations and restaurants, and the transportation is very convenient, making it highly recommended.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Enjoy autumn leaves; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Built in memory of Xue Tao, a poetess of the Tang Dynasty
summary:
Wangjianglou Park was built in the 15th year of Guangxu in Qing Dynasty to commemorate Xue Tao, a poetess in Tang Dynasty. It is one of the landmark buildings in Chengdu. 
The main buildings in the park include Wangjiang Tower, Zhuojin Tower, Huanjian Pavilion, Wuyunxian Pavilion, etc., and Xue Tao Memorial Hall, where you can get an in-depth understanding of his life and works. 
In memory of Xue Tao, later generations planted all kinds of excellent bamboos in the park, gathering more than 200 kinds of bamboos at home and abroad, which is known as the "park of bamboo".

tagNameList: Exploring the Exhibition Hall; Hidden Gems for Kid-Friendly Fun; Museums
shortFeatures: A large museum complex designed by renowned architects
summary: One of the most unique museums around Chengdu.

shortFeatures: The famous ancient temple in the area
summary: Zhaojue Temple, adjacent to Chengdu Zoo, was founded in Zhenguan period of Tang Dynasty. It was first named "Jianyuan Temple" and was named "Zhaojue" in Emperor Xuanzong of Tang Dynasty. It is known as the "First Zen Forest" in western Sichuan. In Zhaojue Temple, there is a modern wooden statue of "Avalokitesvara with a thousand hands" hidden. The neatly raised hands reach out to the mysterious space like dense shrubs, and the heads of Avalokitesvara are hidden layer upon layer in it. The main buildings in the temple are: Mountain Gate, Octagonal Pavilion, Tianwang Hall, Xianjue Hall, Yuanjue Hall, Imperial Book Building, Guanyin Pavilion, Nirvana Hall, Tibetan Sutra Building and Yuanwu Zen Master Cemetery, etc. It is one of the largest and spectacular temples in southwest China. Zhaojue Temple not only occupies an important position in the history of Chinese Buddhism, but also makes outstanding contributions in the history of cultural exchanges between China and foreign countries. Up to now, many Buddhist temples in Japan and Southeast Asia still regard Zhaojue Temple as their ancestral home. Biyanlu and Yuanwu Heart Essentials written by the eminent monk Zen Master Yuanwu are included in the Taisho Collection of Japan. His book "Tea Zen Blindness" has been introduced into Japan for more than 300 years, and it is still regarded as a treasure by Japanese tea ceremony circles.

tagNameList: Cute animals; Treasure place for walking babies; Zoos
shortFeatures: Look at the baby panda participating in wild training
summary:
Panda Valley is the research base of giant panda breeding, Dujiangyan Breeding and Wild Release Research Center. It is located in Baima Village, Yutang Town, Dujiangyan, about 50 kilometers away from Chengdu.  
In the next two or three years, the wild release center will carry out the second phase of the project, mainly including academic exchange center, breeding animal house, youth ecological education experience village, multi-functional cinema, scientific research room, observation station, etc.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Living; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns
shortFeatures: With a long history, featuring ancient buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties.
summary: Wufengxi Ancient Town, located in Jintang County, Chengdu, Sichuan, lies on the banks of the Tuo River in the middle section of the Longquan Mountains, at the junction of Jintang and Longquan in Sichuan. The ancient town of Wufeng was established during the Kangxi period of the Qing Dynasty. The entire town has only five streets, named Jin Feng Street, Qing Feng Street, Cao Feng Street, Bai Feng Street, and Xiao Feng Street, all named after the phoenix, which gives the town its name. The Wufeng Ancient Town's Wangjiang Wharf historically served as an important water transport hub in Eastern Sichuan. At its peak, more than 100 boats a day carried grain and handicrafts from Western Sichuan to Chongqing, while bringing salt, fruit, and foreign goods from Chongqing, Yibin, and Luzhou, which were then transported overland to Chengdu, 50 kilometers away, for sale. The town features Qing Dynasty residential architecture with Tuo River characteristics, as well as the magnificent Guansheng Temple and Nanhua Palace.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Representative bustling commercial street in Chengdu
summary:
Jinhua Pavilion is located in the hinterland of Chunxi Road, a small street less than 50 meters long. It was newly built after the renovation of Chunxi Road in recent years, connecting Kejia Lane in Chunxi. Because of the architectural style of the Republic of China, this small street presents a different style, quiet and romantic in the downtown area, and then it has become an outdoor shooting place for many photographers, and even a location place for some photo studios to take photos. 
Chengdu Jinhua Pavilion was built in 1914, located between Zhengkejia Lane and Chunxi Road, but people are used to directly calling it Jinhua Pavilion on Chunxi Road, Chengdu. Sichuan has been a place with extremely developed sericulture since ancient times. Shu embroidery and Shu brocade are famous all over the world, and Chengdu is also known as Jinguan City. Jinhua Pavilion is named for it, which means "prosperity and brocade".

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Nature and Adventure; Lakes; Historical Architectures; Flower Fields
shortFeatures: Planting laurel trees around the lake
summary: Xindu Guihu Park is located in the western suburb of Xindu County, about 18 kilometers away from Chengdu, with an area of about 40,000 square meters and a water surface of about 20,000 square meters. It is the former residence of Yang Sheng'an, a famous scholar in Ming Dynasty. It is named after planting laurel trees around the lake. Covering an area of more than 200 mu, it has mixed land and water scenic spots. It not only has pavilions, pavilions and corridors with the charm of ancient gardens, but also is full of modern entertainment facilities. It is a new scene with the blending of Chinese and western styles, lakes and mountains, green shade and fragrant flowers. It is the expansion and extension of Sheng'an Guihu Lake, so it is a self-contained newly-built antique garden. Guihu Lake is small and exquisite, with Yangliu Building, Chengxin Pavilion, Fragrant World, Autumn Resistance, Luyi Pavilion and sweet-scented osmanthus trees in the forest by the lakeside. During the Mid-Autumn Festival, lotus flowers are full of ponds and sweet-scented osmanthus flowers are fragrant. The annual sweet-scented osmanthus fair is held here. There is Sheng'an Temple in the garden, which displays more than 100 kinds of Yang Sheng'an's works and more than 4,000 volumes. There are 105 ink stone tablets of great calligraphers since Tang and Song Dynasties carved in Qing Dynasty in Zhongshan Hall.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Churches and Cathedrals; Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: There are many French buildings and churches
summary:
Bailu Town is located in the northwest of Chengdu Plain, with a long history and rich religious and cultural resources. 
There are many French buildings and churches here, and Bailu Town is not big. You don't have to take a cursory look here. You can go shopping leisurely and record various French buildings with your camera.

shortFeatures: Spring Festival Lantern Festival lasting for half a month
summary:
Tazishan Park is located in the eastern suburb of Chengdu, next to the starting point of Chengdu-Chongqing Expressway, covering an area of about 410 mu. The park has rolling shallow hills, vast terrain, lush forests and quiet environment. There are scenic spots such as Wintersweet Garden, Haitang Garden, Ziwei Garden, Bamboo Forest, Fishing Pond, Quanshi Mountain Forest, Ginkgo Pavilion, Yumingxuan, etc., as well as newly built Bashu Historic Site Miniature Garden and Chengdu's landmark landscape Jiutian Building. 
There are more than 40,000 trees of cedar, ginkgo, camphor, crape myrtle, metasequoia glyptostroboia, peach tree, sweet-scented osmanthus, magnolia and other trees of more than 80 species in Tazishan Park. The bamboo sea covers an area of about 80 mu, with thousands of green bamboos and lush green, with more than 60,000 trees of nearly 100 varieties. The forests in the park are dotted with lawns, lakes, pavilions and trails, which is quite wild in the mountains. There is a vast picnic area dedicated to tourists to light fires in the park, which is a good place for people to play, relax, fish, entertain, climb the tower, have a picnic and drink tea. 
Jiutian Building is located at the top of the shallow hill in Tazishan Garden. Its name is taken from the famous poem "Climbing Jincheng Sanhua Building" by Li Bai, a poet, "It's like a nine-day tour today". The building is about 70 meters high and has 13 floors in total. It has exquisite design and unique structure. It integrates towers and pavilions. It skillfully combines ancient architectural art with modern folk architectural art. The architectural style highlights local characteristics. It looks like a tower in the distance and a building in the near. Its shape is novel and unique, and it is an iconic and magnificent garden landscape in Chengdu. It was completed at the end of 1997. In order to facilitate tourists to board, elevators and corridors are combined to get up and down. 
There is also a bird language forest invested and built by Fuzhou Longchuan Amusement Co., Ltd. in the park, covering an area of 30 mu. It brings together about 5,000 birds of nearly 150 species in eight categories and thirteen subjects, including walking birds, wading birds, waterfowl, songbirds, raptors, climbing birds, flying birds and wandering birds from all over the world, among which there are more than 20 kinds of birds under national first-and second-class protection. Bird Language Forest pays attention to the popularization of bird science, highlights bird art performances, and integrates amusement, fun and popular science knowledge. It is a good place for leisure and play, and the best place for primary and secondary school students to carry out spring and autumn outings. The park is the largest comprehensive garden in Chengdu. It is favored by tourists because of its rich local characteristics and natural wild interest. It has been rated as one of the eight new scenic spots in Chengdu, and its famous scenic spot is Tashan.

shortFeatures: Taoist temple at the foot of Zhangren Peak in Qingcheng Mountain
summary:
Jianfu Palace is located at the foot of Zhangren Peak. It was first built in the Tang Dynasty, and has been restored many times later. Now there are only two halls and three courtyards rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. 
The main hall of Jianfu Palace is magnificent, with Taoist celebrities enshrined in the hall. There are also Weixin Pavilion, the dressing table site of Princess Ming Qingfu, couplets, murals and other cultural relics in the palace. 
This is the quiet first Taoist temple on Qingcheng Mountain. Besides ancient buildings and cultural relics, you can also see towering ancient trees, and the environment is extremely beautiful.  
There is also a famous long couplet of Qingcheng Mountain in Qing Dynasty with a length of 394 characters in the palace, which is praised as "a must in Qingcheng".

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall; Exhibition Halls
shortFeatures: Rooted in Bashu Chuanxiang World
summary:
Chengdu Sichuan Cuisine Museum is the only living theme museum in the world that displays cuisine culture. It is the architectural style of a new classical garden, which is divided into preface hall, collection hall, interactive demonstration hall, tea tasting and leisure hall, Zaowang Temple, Sichuan cuisine raw material processing tools exhibition area, Sichuan cuisine raw material exhibition area, etc. Sichuan Cuisine Museum lasted more than ten years from collecting collections to opening. 　　 
The collection displays the historical Sichuan cuisine culture with cultural relics, classics and pictures. Visitors can learn about the origin, evolution, development and formation of Sichuan cuisine culture. Here, you can see different utensils used in Sichuan cuisine in different periods, and learn about the productivity, people's living habits and aesthetic needs at that time. 　　 
The interactive demonstration hall demonstrates the knife skills, heat and cooking process of Sichuan cuisine on the spot, which is the core content of the intangible culture of Sichuan cuisine. They are dynamic, experiential and artistic, and can only be displayed in the form of demonstration. Visitors can participate in the interaction; Visitors can personally feel the fragrance and flavor of Sichuan cuisine through taste; Visitors can also learn about the dining forms of Sichuan cuisine: snack meals, private rooms and banquets. Different from ordinary restaurants that hide the kitchen, here the kitchen is located in the center, and the intangible culture of Sichuan cuisine skills is displayed through relevant interactive demonstrations and participation. 　　 
Zaowang Temple is another tourist attraction of Sichuan Cuisine Museum. Kitchen King is an integral part of traditional Sichuan cuisine culture and Sichuan folk culture. Among the people, the stove king is responsible for "heaven says good things, and the lower realm keeps peace". Respect the king of the kitchen, eat and drink, and visitors can feel that "one meal is hard-won when thinking", cherish life and live in harmony with nature and society. 　　 
Tea Tasting and Leisure Hall shows the characteristics of Sichuan cuisine culture, which is "tea and rice accompany each other, and food depends on each other". Sichuan cuisine culture is Yanji culture, which integrates banquet, entertainment and leisure. Drinking tea is an integral part of Sichuan cuisine culture. Sichuan people drink tea in an eclectic way: drink Baba tea in the sun in spring and autumn; In midsummer, drink tea in the woods and enjoy the cool air in the shade of trees; Tea in the teahouse is suitable for all seasons. Here, tourists can get the experience. 　　 
Sichuan Cuisine Museum is committed to promoting Sichuan cuisine culture and developing Sichuan cuisine cause, so that guests who are interested in Sichuan cuisine can not only learn about the delicious taste of Sichuan cuisine, but also have a deeper understanding of the history of Sichuan cuisine.

tagNameList: Ancient Town and Village; Night Tour and Scenic View; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Shangwen Temple Worships Confucius
summary: Crossing the South Bridge, you will reach the ancient city of Guanxian, which is also connected to the Dujiangyan scenic area, forming a classic route. Dujiangyan was once known by its ancient name, Guanxian. If you wish to trace the remains of the ancient city, this is a great place to visit. Although the ancient city is now fully commercialized, some areas still retain the flavor of the old city. Especially when standing on the ancient city’s city tower, one side presents the tranquil ancient city, while the other side showcases the bustling modern city. You can also enjoy the covered bridge and the sound of flowing water. Passing through the ancient Xuanhua Gate, you enter the main street of the ancient city—Xingfu Street. Walk along Yangliuhe Street to see the gentle flow of water, explore historical landmarks on West Street and Songmao Ancient Road, and enjoy local snacks as you stroll leisurely. However, the area tends to be crowded on weekends and holidays, so it’s best to avoid visiting if you prefer peace and quiet.

tagNameList: Hi Playland; Kid's Treasure Spot; Water Parks
summary: The Guose Tianxiang Land Amusement Park covers an area of 275 acres and features nearly 30 amusement rides. It is a major new addition to the Guose Tianxiang theme park, following the first phase Fairy Tale Park and the second phase Water Park. This new park combines extreme experiences, recreational leisure, and science education in a comprehensive theme park.

shortFeatures: Stroll through the ancient town with traditional Sichuan-Western style.
summary:
- Ping Le Ancient Town has a history of over two thousand years, renowned for its original western Sichuan architecture and ancient customs.
- The town's main street, Leshan Street, is a famous water-themed scenic street. At the end of the street is Leshan Bridge, which has archways shaped like peaches, a unique feature in western Sichuan.
- The ancient alleys are home to many delicious eateries, with specialties such as milk soup noodles, tangbai meat, bobo chicken, and stone-ground tofu pudding, all worth trying.
- The famous Nine Ancients of the town: ancient streets, ancient temples, ancient bridges, ancient trees, ancient weirs, ancient workshops, ancient roads, ancient customs, and ancient songs, are all sights worth visiting.

shortFeatures: The green lung of the city, a hydrophilic viewing resort
summary:
Qinglong Lake Ecological Wetland Park covers an area of more than 10,000 mu, with forests, lakes, meadows, wetlands, leisure squares and trails. 
Every January, all the cherry blossoms in the park bloom, and cherry blossoms bloom in winter. Many tourists punch in and take photos on the cherry blossom trail. 
The park is divided into wildlife static conservation area and tourist dynamic activity area, which is not only a paradise for wildlife, but also a good place for tourists to travel and relax. 
There are thousands of flowers and trees planted in the park, which bloom all year round, and hundreds of precious wild birds are inhabited.

shortFeatures: Enjoy Sichuan Opera, Sugar Painting and Shadow Play
summary: The classic plays of Sichuan Opera will be staged regularly on the ancient stage. In front of the stage, dam movies will be shown regularly, and performances of folk artists (such as sugar painting, clay figurines, paper-cutting performances, shadow puppet performances, peep shows, etc.) will be held in the form of special stalls. The lively folk snack market allows people to experience the lively scene of "rushing to the market" in the ancient town of western Sichuan. Full of interesting folk wedding display, visitors can participate in it and enjoy it, and couples can even move their wedding ceremony to Jinli to experience a unique and traditional wedding way. Folk music, drama performances and folk costume shows are constant all the year round, full of tricks.

shortFeatures: View the famous Three Monuments
summary: China's only ancestral temple where monarch and minister worship together commemorates Zhuge Liang, the prime minister of Shu. It was merged into Zhaolie Temple of Han Dynasty in the early Ming Dynasty, and it is also the most influential museum of the relics of the Three Kingdoms in China. It consists of three parts: Huiling, Han Zhaolie Temple and Wuhou Temple. Because Zhuge Liang's influence in the eyes of ordinary people exceeds that of Liu Bei, folk custom is called "Wuhou Temple". Wuhou Temple is divided into gate, second gate, Liu Bei Hall, Guo Hall, Zhuge Liang Hall, Sanyi Temple, etc., which are arranged on a central axis from south to north. There are 50 statues of Shu Han heroes such as Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang in the temple. Tips: If you are also a fan of the Three Kingdoms, then this place will definitely satisfy your thirst for history. If you don't want to be disturbed by people's voices, it's best to visit when the door first opens in the morning. Chengdu's famous brocade official deep "Red Wall Bamboo Shadow" is here, don't forget to take photos to commemorate.

poiName: Hongya Cave Folk Custom Scenic Area
tagNameList: Stroll with Kids' Hidden Gems; Neighborhood Walks; Featured Neighborhoods; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: The beautiful stilted buildings built in a staggered manner along the mountainside.
summary:
The Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, as a national AAAA-level tourist destination, along with Chaotianmen Square and Jiefangbei Business District, forms one of the most popular tourist spots in Chongqing for both locals and visitors. "Hongya Cave" innovatively integrates the ancient Bayu stilt house architectural art with new cultural concepts. It perfectly blends with the river view and urban landscape, with an exceptional height difference of 75 meters, built along the cliff with varying heights and terrain.

It encapsulates the 3,000-year history of Chongqing, merging the unique Bayu folk culture, the architecture of mountain dwellings, and dock culture, making it a globally recognized, unique and vibrant city landmark. Today, the Hongya Cave Folk Customs Scenic Area, with its rich cultural essence and brilliant architectural features, has become a must-see destination for both domestic and international tourists, second only to the Forbidden City in terms of foot traffic. Every day, Hongya Cave attracts visitors from around the world with its unique charm and irreplaceable characteristics.

Important Reminder:
To enhance the visitor experience and achieve a smart and safe tourism environment, starting from July 1, 2019, Hongya Cave has implemented an online reservation system for entry. Visitors planning to visit are advised to search for the official WeChat account "Hongya Cave," click "Reservation & Ticket Pickup" in the bottom left corner of the page, and collect a free electronic ticket in advance based on their itinerary. Alternatively, visitors may enter by queuing with their ID cards on-site. This is the only method of entry. Please pay attention to personal belongings and travel safety to avoid scams! We wish you a pleasant day at Hongya Cave.

tagNameList: Experience Slow Life; Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Ancient Towns; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Famous historical and cultural ancient town
summary:
- A historic and cultural street in China, a key protected traditional street in Chongqing, one of the "New Twelve Scenic Spots of Ba-Yu," part of the Ba-Yu folk culture tourism circle.
- Visit Ciqikou Ancient Town, walk on the cobblestone paths, taste local snacks, sit in a tea house, and experience the local customs of Chongqing.
- Enter from the main gate; the stone path is narrow, with vendor shops on both sides.
- There are many snacks and local specialties, especially stores selling Chen Mahua (fried dough twists) and chicken giblets, perfect for leisurely eating and exploring.
- Travelers who prefer peace and quiet can wander into the small alleys to experience the most authentic local life.

· It is a typical karst landform, the uncanny workmanship of nature, which is spectacular and shocking. 
· The three bridges are Tianlong Bridge, Qinglong Bridge and Black Dragon Bridge. From the entrance of the sightseeing elevator to the bottom of the first Tianlong Bridge, you can directly see Tianfu Guanyi. 
The tour route is a one-way track, and there is no exit to go back. There are more hikes in scenic spots, so it's best to wear very comfortable shoes. 
Tickets are cheaper in the off-season. If there is a holiday, it's best to avoid crowds and enjoy the scenery here in the off-season.

tagNameList: City coordinates; Night tour viewing; Squares; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Ancient Wharf in Chongqing
summary:
· One of the "Top Ten Cultural Symbols of Chongqing", it is located at the intersection of Jialing River and Yangtze River in Yuzhong Peninsula, Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is the hub of the two rivers and the largest waterway passenger terminal in Chongqing. 
· Chaotianmen was once one of the seventeen ancient city gates in Chongqing, where the Three Gorges cruise ships, sightseeing cruise ships and ferries to Foreigner Street all departed.  
The night view of Chaotianmen is also very beautiful. The lights are turned on at night, which is particularly beautiful. In front of you is the brightly lit pier, and there are flowery cruise ships shuttling around. 
· And this is also the "zero kilometer" point sign of Chongqing Highway, which will be located in Chaotianmen Square.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly treasure spots; historical ruins; Grottoes; Historical Sites; UNESCO World Heritage - Cultural Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Chongqing World Cultural Heritage
summary:
· The Dazu Rock Carvings refer to a group of rock carvings, which include five sites: Baoding Mountain, Beishan Mountain, Nanshan Mountain, Shizhuan Mountain, and Shimen Mountain. When people generally mention the Dazu Rock Carvings, they are mostly referring to the Baoding Mountain carvings.  
· The Dazu Rock Carvings are Buddhist-themed stone carvings, known for their exquisite beauty and grandeur. Each carving has its own story, and they are colored, making them appear very lifelike, almost vividly animated.  
· The expressions of the Buddha statues in the caves are remarkable, and even the tassels of their clothing seem as though a breeze could blow them away.
opening_hours: Open at 09:00-18:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 17:00)

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Mountains; Forests
shortFeatures: The Southern Pasture with Prairie Scenery
summary:
- Xian Nv Mountain features a rare alpine meadow landscape in southern China and is known as the "Summer Palace of the Mountain City." It is a popular leisure and summer retreat in the Chongqing region.  
- Often referred to as the "Switzerland of the East," Xian Nv Mountain has distinct features in every season. In spring, you can try grass skiing; in summer, it is a cool escape; in autumn, horseback riding; and in winter, skiing.  
- The scenic area provides accommodation and dining services, with a variety of choices including farm stays and star-rated hotels.  
- The top of Xian Nv Mountain is about 1,800 meters above sea level and offers alpine meadows, making it an ideal spot for camping. However, visitors should be prepared for colder temperatures at night.

· Originally a coal cave on the outskirts of Chongqing, a small coal mine opened in 1920, and later set up as a detention center by the Military Bureau of the National Government. 
Zhazidong is surrounded by mountains on three sides and ditches on one side. The terrain is hidden, and it specializes in detaining and persecuting revolutionaries. The more famous one is "Sister Jiang". 
Zhazi Cave was repaired and rebuilt on the original site, which truly reflected the scene at that time. The atmosphere was depressed, and the instruments of torture displayed were shocking.  
The whole scenic spot is not big, so you can visit the Tomb of the Martyrs and the White Mansion together. There are also special buses arranged in the scenic spot, which is very convenient.

tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Enjoy autumn leaves; City Parks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Climb high to see the scenery of the two rivers and the night view is particularly beautiful
summary:
Eling Park is located on Changjiang 1st Road, Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is named after its shape like the neck of a goose. 
The earliest private garden in Chongqing, the villa of Li Yaoting, a wealthy businessman, the first president of Chongqing Chamber of Commerce in the late Qing Dynasty. 
Looking at the Yangtze River in the south, Jialing River in the north, Yuzhong in the east and Futuguan in the west. 
· This is an excellent place overlooking the two rivers and night scenes of Chongqing, with the highest point at Kansheng Building.

shortFeatures: Experience the Fun of Underground Passage
summary:
- Formed by mountain-building movements millions of years ago, the cliffs are steep and the gorge is deep, making it a typical karst geological wonder. Here, visitors can experience the thrill of traversing underground.
- The fissure canyon is 5 kilometers long, with a 2-kilometer section open for tourists, consisting of the entrance fissure, a mid-way cave, and the exit gorge.
- The canyon is 200 to 500 meters deep, with towering cliffs on both sides and sheer rock faces. The gorge is filled with dense primeval forest, endless waterfalls, and rushing streams, creating a majestic scene.
- After passing through a deep cave, take a direct elevator down to 80 meters below the ground. Upon exiting the elevator, the view opens up, and the waterfall is right in front of you.

Zhongshan 4th Road is located in Shangqing Temple, Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is the seat of Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China and Chongqing Municipal Government, and it is a street of anti-Japanese war culture. 
In addition to the special garden of China Democratic Party Museum, the historical sites on this street include Guiyuan, Zhou Mansion and the former site of the Presidential Palace of the National Government. 
In addition to the quaint buildings, the most pleasing thing about Zhongshan 4th Road is two rows of yellow kudzu trees with lush branches and leaves, which are cool and fresh here in summer.

Shancheng Lane starts from Nanjimen and ends at Consul Lane, connecting the upper and lower halves of Yuzhong District. The whole Shancheng Lane covers an area of about 2.4 hectares, with a house area of about 20,000 square meters. Here, you can not only see the geographical characteristics of Chongqing's climbing hills, but also appreciate the original local customs and architectural art of old Chongqing. Therefore, Shancheng Lane is not only a small architectural history museum, but also a natural exhibition area of people's living culture in Chongqing Shancheng. 
The historical evolution of Shancheng Lane can be traced back to the Ming and Qing Dynasties. At that time, it was mostly the house of military generals, and it was one of the high-grade residential areas in the ancient city of Chongqing. In the Qing Dynasty, there was a "Sky Lantern Pole" here, and every festival, the "Sky Lantern" was lit to pray for peace, hence the name "Sky Lantern Lane" and "Sky Lantern Street". In 1900, French missionaries came to this lane and built Renai Hall, Renai Hospital and School. Looking at Shancheng Lane in the distance, the lights winding up the stone ladder, flashing like the stars in the sky. In 1972, Sky Lantern Lane was renamed Shancheng Lane. As the only street named after "Mountain City" in Chongqing, Shancheng Lane is one of the 32 key landscape areas in the city and one of the 12 key landscape areas in Yuzhong District.

- It serves as the center for large gatherings and performances in Chongqing, hosting important events such as the city's Party Congress, People's Congress, Political Consultative Conference, and the unveiling of the municipality's administrative title, as well as international conferences.

There is a stone street about three miles long in the ancient town, which connects the old buildings of the whole ancient town in series, including Ranjia Courtyard, Xiqin Guild Hall, Chuanzhu Temple and Dongjia Ancestral Hall. 
Ranjia Courtyard is an unmissable attraction in the ancient town. It used to be the residence of Ran Shenzhi, the chieftain of the Qing Dynasty, and has the best woodcut window grilles and other cultural relics in the town. 
The commercial atmosphere of the ancient town is not strong, and it retains its simplicity and leisure. There are also cruise ships visiting Wujiang Gallery by the riverside. It is a pleasure to watch the steep walls on both sides of the green river.

shortFeatures: The Ancient Battlefield that Changed the World Order
summary:
Diaoyu City, a millennium-old battlefield known as the "Eastern Mecca" and "The Place Where God Broke His Whip" by Europeans, silently displays the tragic history to the world.

There is a legendary history surrounding Diaoyu City: In July 1259, the Mongol army launched a three-pronged attack on the Song Dynasty. The Great Khan, Mongke, was severely wounded by artillery fire during the fierce resistance of the soldiers and civilians of Diaoyu City, and later died from illness at the Hot Springs Temple in Beiqiao. After Mongke's death, internal power struggles erupted within the Mongol forces, weakening their ability to continue the invasion of Southern Song and expansion into Europe. This prolonged the rule of the Southern Song Dynasty and changed the course of world history, which is why Diaoyu City is praised by historians from both China and abroad as "The Place Where God Broke His Whip."

The ancient battlefield site of Diaoyu City is well-preserved to this day. Major attractions include the city gates, city walls, imperial palace, martial arts office, infantry camp, naval dock, and other relics. There are also famous scenic spots and historical sites such as Diaoyu Terrace, Huguo Temple, Xuanfo Temple, Thousand Buddha Grotto, Huangdong Cave, Tianquan Cave, and Feiyan Cave, as well as a large number of poems, inscriptions, and reliefs from the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. In 1982, Diaoyu City was designated a national scenic area.

poiName: Former Site of the Manchukuo Telecommunications Company
tagNameList: Historic buildings; Memorial Halls; Historical Architectures
summary: Founded on August 31, 1933, it is a special club (company) that controls the telephone, telecommunications and broadcasting networks of the entire puppet Manchukuo and Kanto Prefecture, and operates electrical communication business. The club is located on the west side of Datong Square in Xinjing Special City (now Changchun People's Square west). After the Manchuria Incident ("September 18th Incident"), Japan's colonial propaganda to Northeast China started with ideology, attacked the heart first, forcibly indoctrinated and controlled, and forced the people of Northeast China to identify with Japan's politics, nationality, ideology and culture. Japanese imperialism attempted to fully control the telecommunications and broadcasting networks in Northeast China. In 1932, it put forward the Communication Policy for Manchukuo, claiming that "the highest guiding organ of the empire in Manchukuo should be Japanese, especially the generals of the empire to participate in the establishment and operation of Manchukuo Telecommunications and Telephone Company".

poiName: Puppet Manchukuo Ministry of Foreign Affairs
shortFeatures: Buildings using Western technology and investments
summary: According to historical records, it was designed and constructed by the French company Brossard Moupin, and built with a loan provided by the French Economic Development Association. During the fall of Changchun, this was the only building that used western technology and investment. It was built in 1934. The following year, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the puppet Manchukuo moved here. In 1937, the puppet Manchukuo regime changed the puppet Ministry of Foreign Affairs into the Foreign Affairs Bureau and moved out of this building. In 1942, the Foreign Affairs Bureau of the puppet Manchukuo was changed to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and moved back to this building until Japan surrendered in August 1945. After the liberation of Changchun, the building of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Puppet Manchuria was returned to the people, and it was used by the Party School of Jilin Provincial Party Committee, Northeast Institute of Literature and History, Jilin Military Region and other units. In September 1979, it was transferred to the Provincial Academy of Social Sciences for use as a library. On April 18th, 1984, the Provincial Academy of Social Sciences moved out of this building. Since then, it has been idle.

poiName: Former Site of the Puppet Manchukuo Ministry of Education and Culture
summary:
The former site of the Ministry of Culture and Education of Xinjing Puppet Manchuria is located at No.696 Ziyou Road, Changchun. The original building is a concave two-story building with the main entrance facing north, a reinforced concrete structure and no other ancillary buildings. It covers an area of 10,000 square meters and was completed in 1938. 
When the puppet Manchukuo was founded, the Department of Culture and Education was first set up in the Ministry of Administration. On July 15, 1932, the Ministry of Culture and Education was established on the basis of the Department of Culture and Education. The office address was first in the former Jilin Army Hospital and then moved to the National Capital Construction Bureau (now the former site of the People's Square Municipal Committee). The Ministry of Culture and Education is in charge of education, religion, etiquette and national thought. There are General Affairs Department, Academic Affairs Department and Etiquette Department. In 1937, the Ministry of Culture and Education was abolished, and the Department of Education and the Department of Social Affairs were set up within the Ministry of People's Livelihood. In April, 1943, the Education Department of the Ministry of People's Livelihood was abolished, the Ministry of Culture and Education was restored, and it moved into a newly completed building. The Ministry of Culture and Education consists of the Minister's Office, the Academic Affairs Department, the Teaching Department, and the Education Department. In January 1945, the Student Diligence Service Company was added.

Among them was a small locomotive made in the United States in 1907. The exhibition hall also displays the streamlined SL7751 steam locomotive manufactured in Japan in 1934. A 400-meter track is also laid in the museum, and the locomotive can carry tourists along the track for test run. The steam locomotive exhibition hall is located in Sujiatun Locomotive Depot, Sujiatun District, and has two special railway lines for parking exhibition locomotives. There are 16 steam locomotives manufactured in the United States, Japan, the Czech Republic, Poland, Germany, Romania, Belgium, the Soviet Union and my country from 1907 to 1960. Among them, a small locomotive made in the United States at the beginning of this century. The streamlined SL7751 locomotive manufactured in Japan in 1934 can run on the lines of the exhibition hall for visitors to ride.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs; Pick-Your-Own
shortFeatures: Jiangnan Garden Style Hot Spring Leisure Manor
summary: Huaxidi Hot Spring Ecological Paradise is a comprehensive hot spring leisure manor integrating flower botanical garden, apple orchard, vineyard, agricultural vegetable picking garden, multi-functional children's water park, Doctor Rabbit Kingdom Paradise, standardized hot spring swimming pool, various hot spring soup pools, health and wellness footpath, comfortable and economical rooms, authentic farm food restaurant, agricultural and sideline products supply center and other tourism and vacation picking.

tagNameList: Amusement and entertainment; Treasure place for walking babies; Amusement Parks; Entertainment Centers; Science & Technology Museums

shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful view from the mountain from the hanging terrace
summary: Huishan Mountain is located behind Xiuhu Wharf in Qipanshan Scenic Area, Shenyang. The height of Huishan Mountain is 265 meters, and the stones on the top of the mountain are white. It is called "Huishan Qingxue". Now, due to the dense vegetation on the top of the mountain, it can't be seen in summer. There are stone steps on Huishan Mountain. When you climb to the top of Huishan Mountain, you can see the Qingxue Building, the dangerous pavilion and the suspended terrace on the top of the mountain. Looking down from the suspended terrace makes people feel beautiful and exciting. There is a ropeway built at the foot of Huishan, where tourists can take the ropeway up the mountain. The ropeway is an open seat, and the trees sitting at its feet are clearly visible and very open. When going down the mountain, besides taking stone steps and cableways, there are also slides to choose from. It only takes three to five minutes to slide all the way from the top of the mountain to the bottom of the mountain by taking a slide. The road passes through woods and hillsides, which is thrilling and interesting. At the bottom of Huishan Mountain, there are Huishan Bird Forest and Xiangyang Temple to watch. Among them, Huishan Bird Forest is the largest bird forest in Asia, with more than 80 kinds of cranes and rare birds, which should not be missed.

Shenyang Aisin Gioro Royal Museum is located in Dagujiazi Town, Faku County, Shenyang. Its predecessor was a royal brewing workshop during the Liao Dynasty. In 1635, it was renamed "Zujiafang Distillery," and the "Zujiafang Baijiu" it produced became an imperial liquor for the Qing court. In 2002, it was renamed "Shenyang Aisin Gioro Zujiafang Liquor Industry Co., Ltd." In 2011, the Aisin Gioro Royal Museum was rated as a national AAAA-level tourist attraction. The museum is rooted in traditional liquor culture and showcases four intangible cultural heritages: traditional brewing techniques, the sea mud sealing method, mud-cellar stone pots, and other related craftsmanship. Everywhere in the Shenyang Aisin Gioro Royal Museum displays Manchu history, customs, stories, legends, and traditional Manchu brewing techniques.

tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Climb a mountain; Mountains; Military Sites; Historical Sites
shortFeatures: The mountain shape distribution resembles the shape of the Big Dipper
summary: Shenyang Qixingshan Tourist Scenic Area is located in Shifosi Township. It is backed by Liaohe River and bordered by Shenyang in the south. The scenic spot has beautiful natural scenery and superior environment. Qixing Mountain was formed at the end of Jurassic Period and consists of seven hills such as Nanshan Mountain and Tashan Mountain. The scenic spot is named because its mountain shape distribution resembles the shape of the Big Dipper. There are more than 20 ravines such as Fox Valley in the mountains, with green mountains. There is a spring on the south slope of Tashan Mountain. The spring water is clear and sweet, and the four seasons continue. The scenic spot is rich in cultural landscape and numerous historical sites. There are the ancient pagoda of Liao Dynasty built in 1074, the stone Buddha and temple built by Tuoba in Northern Wei Dynasty, the site of Shuangzhou Ancient City, and the site of Hanjia Garden built in Liao and Jin Dynasties. At the same time, because the scenic spot is backed by the Liaohe River, one of the four major rivers in China, it used to be an important traffic and strategic place in ancient times. The Ming side wall and beacon tower, the Liaohe River Taoti and monument built by Zuo Baogui in Qing Dynasty, and the modern war bunker and other war relics are distributed all over the scenic spot. Since ancient times, the tower shadow is far away, the mountains are fog, and the flute is clear and the water is cool. "

tagNameList: Climbing mountains; admiring the autumn leaves.; Mountains; Mountain Climbing; Rafting
shortFeatures: Visit the historic temples
summary: Tianmenshan National Forest Park is located 60 kilometers north of Zhuanghe City, Dalian. It consists of five scenic areas: Yunqi Mountain, Zhuanxiang Lake, Kuangyu, Tianmenshan, and Daheyuan. The total area of the park is over 150 square kilometers, filled with the beautiful landscapes bestowed by nature. Tianmenshan is very accessible, with an asphalt road directly leading to the mountain, which is now part of the southern Liaoning road network. It is about 350 kilometers from Shenyang, 180 kilometers from Dalian, and 15 kilometers from Bingyu.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Enjoying Autumn Leaves; Forests; National Parks
shortFeatures: Dalian Suburban Forest Oxygen Bar
summary: Dalian Western Suburb National Forest Park is located in the western suburbs of Dalian, within the city's Ganjingzi District, situated on the southwestern tip of the Liaodong Peninsula. It has a warm temperate, semi-humid monsoon climate, with characteristics of a maritime climate. The terrain is classified as low hilly, and it is home to typical brown forest soil. The natural vegetation type is known as deciduous broadleaf forest.

tagNameList: Enjoy autumn leaves; Neighborhood Walk; Featured Neighborhoods
shortFeatures: A poetic open-air museum
summary:
Taiyanggou is located at the southern tip of Liaodong Peninsula, belonging to Lushunkou District, Dalian City, Liaoning Province. It has an elegant environment and is suitable for living. Because Lushun was an important place for the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895 and the Russo-Japanese War, there are a large number of old Japanese and Russian buildings in existence, and the local authorities created a Japanese-Russian style street based on this. 
As the saying goes, half of the modern history of Lushunkou is. Among these honest buildings in Taiyangou, there are many buildings with historical traces, such as Prince Su's Mansion, Yamato Hotel (where the famous Japanese spy Yoshiko Kawashima once lived), Japanese Kwantung Army Command, Sino-Soviet Friendship Tower, Victory Tower, etc. The highest point in Taiyangou is 203 Highland. During the Russo-Japanese War, the Japanese army suffered heavy losses. 
Now Taiyangou is a tourist name. Besides historical sites, there are Cherry Blossom Festival, Modern Museum, Asian Large Snake Museum, Automobile Museum, etc. in May every year. 
The garden green space and traffic green space in the park are intertwined, and the natural landscape is beautiful. Nearly 1,000 century-old trees, such as cypress, ginkgo biloba and cherry blossom, complement each other with Eurasian classical architecture, and thrive in all seasons. Walking slowly in a quiet neighborhood, there is a visual sense of traveling through time and space that is hard to enjoy elsewhere, and the comfort of forgetting time has formed a characteristic tourism brand of "watching cherry blossoms in spring and enjoying colorful leaves in autumn", which has become the desirable back garden of Dalian.

Lingjiao Bay is located at the exit of Laohutan Ocean Park Harbor, where yachts and speedboats can go out to sea. It is a very wide bay near Laohutan. It has also become a winter habitat for some seagulls and mallards. No matter how hurried the pedestrians on the shore are, they are as leisurely as they swim around in the sea water to find food and bask in the sun. Not far away is the 104 warship. Sleeping quietly by the seaside, quietly listening to the sound of the slight waves lapping. Recently, a yacht harbor has been built, and tourists here will provide better sea tour services in the future.

The Golden Beach and Silver Beach Baths on the "Golden Coast" of Dalian are sheltered from the wind and the sun. The beach is evenly distributed with fine sand, gentle and clean. The geographical environment is unique and is a good place for swimming, fishing and catching the sea.

Bada Hutong was once synonymous with Tobacco Leaf Hualiu Lane, north of Xizhushikou Street and south of Tieshu Xiejie Street. 
There are: Baishun Hutong, Rouge Hutong, Hanjiatan, Shaanxi Lane, Shitou Hutong, Wang Guangfu Xiejie, Zhujia Hutong and Lishamao Hutong. 
Nowadays, the "Eight Hutongs" are the residences of ordinary people. From the buildings of some old houses and buildings, we can still vaguely understand the style of those days.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Mountains; Forests
shortFeatures: Enjoy azaleas in spring and red leaves in autumn
summary:
· Labagou Primeval Forest Park is known as the back garden of the capital and has the reputation of "natural oxygen bar". 
The whole scenic spot consists of three main viewing areas: Nanhouling, Baizhangya and Glacier, with a total area of about 45 square kilometers, more than 90% of forest area, about 677 species of plants, about 300 species of animals and about 60 kilometers of green tourist trails. 
There are unique summer glaciers in Beijing, thousands of acres of birch forests that can only be seen in Siberia, hundreds of cliffs with thousands of walls, and eighteen roads that make drivers narrowly missed. 
There are 70,000 mu of primitive secondary forest here, and Nanhou Ridge, which is more than 1,700 meters above sea level, is the highest peak in Huairou District; Bagoumen has the best forest in Beijing, and the plants are extremely abundant.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Night Tour Viewing; Canyons; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Beijing suburbs for summer retreat, water activities, and picturesque mountain views.
summary:
Longqing Gorge combines the charm of southern landscapes and the grandeur of northern landscapes, earning it the title of "Little Li River" of Beijing.  
In the midsummer, Longqing Gorge has fresh air and a cool climate, with an average temperature about 6 degrees lower than that of downtown Beijing, making it an excellent summer vacation destination.  
In winter, the climate is cold, with a long freezing period. The Ice Lantern Festival is held every winter, during which the ice and snow sculptures, in various shapes and glowing with light, are spectacular.  
There are many entertainment activities, including the famous Dragon-shaped elevator, said to be the best in Asia, and thrilling attractions like the winged slide, rock climbing, ice climbing base, bungee jumping, and zip-lining.  
If you get tired, you can visit the local farmhouses in the scenic area to relax and enjoy local specialties like roasted whole lamb and rainbow trout.

tagNameList: Get close to nature; a hidden gem for taking kids.; Lakes; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Admire a full moon amidst the beautiful lake and mountain scenery.
summary:
· Yanqi Lake is about 70 kilometers from downtown Beijing by car. The water is clear and blue, surrounded by small hills, offering beautiful scenery.  
· The lake is named after the large number of rare migratory birds, such as geese and white cranes, that rest here every spring. Nowadays, most visitors come to experience water-based activities.  
· The Yanqi Lake Amusement Park is located on the eastern side, where the entertainment facilities are located. The park is not very large, with a road inside that is about 1-2 kilometers long, and can be explored on foot.  
· The western side of the lake is mainly home to high-end resorts and hotels. The venue for the 2014 APEC summit was located here. This area is part of the hotel zone, where you can enjoy the view if you stay here.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Outdoor Skiing
shortFeatures: Ski resorts where you can appreciate the beauty of the Great Wall
summary:
Huaibei International Ski Resort is located near the Great Wall of Ming Dynasty, with unobstructed beautiful scenery of Mutianyu Great Wall. It is an earlier ski resort in Beijing. 
· The ski resort has 11 snow trails including 2 advanced trails, 7 intermediate trails and 2 primary trails. 
The new Huaibei NITRO Ski Park includes a snowboard park and a cat jumping track, and is also equipped with a children's snow play area, which basically meets the needs of all snowboarders. 
The overall length of the snow trail is long, the slope is moderate, the facilities are well equipped, and the snow quality is good, which is more suitable for junior snow friends, and there is exciting night skiing at night.

tagNameList: Child-friendly hidden gems for walks; Autumn leaf viewing; City Parks
shortFeatures: Dense bamboo forest, with lotus flowers to admire in summer.
summary:
· Beijing Zizhuyuan Park is located outside of Xizhimen in Beijing. Upon arriving at Zizhuyuan, you enter the kingdom of bamboo. The park features bamboo buildings, pavilions, tables, and chairs, and even the various bridges are decorated with bamboo. The magnificent Dong ethnic group’s Wind and Rain Bamboo Bridge allows visitors to experience the fun of resting and sheltering from the rain on the bridge, as done by the people of Guizhou. The Shangchuan Bridge is a large bamboo boat with bamboo awnings and windows. On the street lined with bamboo market stalls by the lake, people are bustling about, drinking tea, tasting bamboo dishes, and buying various bamboo daily goods and crafts, further highlighting the importance of bamboo in everyday life.

· The various bamboo constructions showcase the charm of Chinese bamboo culture. Bamboo waterwheels turn slowly with the sound of rushing water, and the bamboo poles constantly propel bamboo rafts, leaving a trail of water on the lake surface. Visitors can enjoy activities like riding bamboo sedan chairs, playing with diabolo, and blowing bamboo pipes. A large group of people joyously dances the bamboo pole dance to the rhythm of the Miao ethnic group’s lusheng. Performances of songs and dances from the Bai and Dai ethnic groups of Yunnan on a bamboo stage on the lawn also attract many tourists.

· The peak blooming season for hydrangeas is from May to July, and wearing simple and elegant clothes for photography during this time is highly recommended.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Lakes; Wetlands
shortFeatures: A great place for a weekend outing: bring the kids to the reed marsh to feed the wild ducks.
summary:
The Yanqing Wild Duck Lake Wetland Nature Reserve is located in the western part of Yanqing, Beijing. Wild Duck Lake is an artificial wetland formed by the Guanting Reservoir's Yanqing jurisdiction and the tidal flats and submerged areas around the lake below an elevation of 479 meters. It is the only wetland bird nature reserve in Beijing. After more than 50 years of development, the reserve has developed a wetland ecosystem with rich plant and animal resources, high biodiversity, and stability, making it one of the most important bird habitats in Beijing and even in North China.

The Wild Duck Lake Wetland is home to a wide variety of aquatic, wetland, and terrestrial plants. In summer, the lotus flowers stand tall, the reeds are lush and green, while golden wild chrysanthemums, light purple alkali grass, white reed flowers, and brown cattail spikes sway in the breeze, creating a picturesque scene on the lake. Among the plants in Wild Duck Lake are the second-level protected plant "Show Grass" and the only aquatic carnivorous plant in North China, the "Waterwheel Plant." Other common plants include reeds, cattails, and bulrushes.

tagNameList: Discovery Pavilion; Hidden Gem for Kids; Museums
shortFeatures: Visit numerous ancient car prototypes
summary:
After eight years of preparation, the Beijing Automobile Museum finally unveiled its mysterious veil and began trial operations yesterday. This is the world's first government-funded public automobile-themed museum, shaped like a large eye, and located along the southwestern Fourth Ring Road. The building covers an area of 50,000 square meters, with three independent exhibition halls and one thematic exhibition area, capable of accommodating up to 30,000 visitors at the same time. During the trial operation period, more than 70 rare vehicles from China and abroad will be displayed, and more exhibits will be added after the official opening.

The Beijing Automobile Museum is currently the largest, most comprehensive, technologically advanced, and innovative automobile-themed museum in China. After a trial operation period of 2 to 3 months, the museum will officially open. During the trial period, entry is free but only by group reservation, with a daily limit of 1,000 tickets. After the official opening, the ticket prices will be based on those of the China Science and Technology Museum.
opening_hours: Open at  09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:30)

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Museum; Fine Art Galleries; Buildings by Famous Architects
summary:
Tsinghua University Art Museum embodies the wishes of several generations of Tsinghua people. It was completed in 2016 and will be officially opened to the public in September.  
There are more than 13,000 components in the collection, including six categories: calligraphy and painting, weaving and embroidery, ceramics, furniture, bronzes and comprehensive works of art. 
The vast majority of the collection comes from the collections of the Academy of Fine Arts over the years since 1956, as well as donations from alumni and social elites.  
Here, you can feel the collision between culture and soul, and experience an immersive artistic aesthetic journey, which is worth seeing.

tagNameList: Historical buildings; autumn leaf viewing; Temples; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Ancient temple with a history of a thousand years, rare ancient trees.
summary:
· Tanzhe Temple has a history of over 1,700 years and is the oldest ancient temple in Beijing. There is a popular saying, "First there was Tanzhe Temple, then there was Beijing city."
· The tall mountain peaks block the cold currents coming from the northwest, so the climate here is warm and humid.
· The temple is home to towering ancient trees and numerous Buddhist pagodas. The entire temple complex is cleverly designed according to the terrain, with an exceptionally beautiful environment.

shortFeatures: Understanding Chinese Monetary History
summary: Tianjin Financial Museum is located at the former site of the former "French Club" built in 1932. The building is still the old building of that year, a small building with great taste. Just a stone's throw away from Tianjin Railway Station, Jiefang Bridge, a century-old famous bridge, is located in a historical street rich in financial institutions, and is located in the center of Tianjin Financial City under construction. The museum contains currency and financial bills from various periods in China.

tagNameList: The Hidden Gems for Strolling with Kids; Botanical Gardens
shortFeatures: View a variety of rare tropical plants.
summary: Tianjin Tropical Botanical Garden is located within the Caozhuang Flower Market in Xiqing District, Tianjin, and was completed in 2003. It features more than 3,000 varieties of tropical plants from over 30 countries, including Canada, Thailand, Australia, the United States, Malaysia, and various southern provinces of China. It is the largest indoor tropical botanical garden in Asia, consisting of four main halls: the Comprehensive Service Hall, the Premium Flower Hall, the Science Education Hall, and the Tropical Rainforest Hall.

shortFeatures: Witness the history of Tianjin for more than 600 years
summary:
Tianjin Old Town Museum is located in Xu Family Courtyard, which is the only well-preserved traditional residential courtyard in Tianjin. 
The museum is not big, and the walls are covered with old photos. The exhibits mainly include old objects such as daily works, costumes, plaques, cooking utensils, furniture, etc. at that time, which tell the history of Tianjin Old Town. 
It is the small pear garden in the old city at the entrance. There are cross talk performances every afternoon and evening. The group purchase ticket price is not expensive, so it is worth listening to.

shortFeatures: With roller skating rink

Changhong Park is a daily leisure park in Tianjin. There are children's playground, roller skating rink and other amusement facilities in the west of the park, which are amusement areas; South Lake in the south is a boating area; In the northwest corner, there is the Senior Pavilion, which is a place for tourists to gather and recreate activities. Adjacent to it, there is a large underground playground-Fenghua Palace. Many newcomers choose to shoot outside. 
Changhong Park Bitaoyuan is the largest and most varieties of Bitaoyuan in Tianjin. It is famous in Jincheng for its beautiful plant shape and magnificent blooming period. Bitaoyuan Festival is held every April.

shortFeatures: People's livelihood
summary: Binhai Cultural Center is one of the top ten livelihood projects in Binhai New Area. It is located in Tianjian District, the central business district of Binhai New Area, Tianjin, with Central Avenue in the east, Ziyun Park in the south, Xusheng Road in the west and Dalian East Road in the north. It is the core location of Binhai New Area. The main construction contents of Binhai Cultural Center include Binhai Exploration Museum, Binhai Art Museum, Binhai Library, Binhai Performing Arts Center, Binhai Citizen Activity Center, cultural corridor, underground works, outdoor works, etc. Highlighting the functions of cultural entertainment, leisure and recreation, greening landscape, etc., and complement the surrounding areas, are the links connecting various regions. The project covers an area of 120,000 square meters, with a total construction area of 320,000 square meters. Committed to building a large-scale flagship cultural aircraft carrier integrating "education, tourism and health".

Science and Technology Museum; Science & Technology Museums
shortFeatures: View wonderful celestial bodies and astronomical landscapes
summary: Tianjin Science and Technology Museum is a large-scale public welfare science popularization facility in Tianjin. It is located in the cultural center of the city and was officially opened to the public in 1995. The building area of the museum is 18,000 square meters, and the permanent exhibition hall is 10,000 square meters. It is divided into two floors and seven exhibition areas. There are more than 300 pieces (sets) of exhibits, which are scientific, knowledgeable, interesting and participatory, and embody the organic combination of science and technology, humanities and art. It uses a variety of display techniques to combine scientific principles with comprehensive applications to show the audience the harmony and unity between man and nature. The temporary exhibition hall is 1000 square meters, and theme popular science exhibitions are held every year according to social hot topics. The spherical building above the main body of the building is the cosmic theater, which can show all-sky science and education movies and astronomical programs. After the comprehensive renovation in 2010, the exhibition environment, exhibition content and service functions of the Science and Technology Museum have been improved and upgraded.

Baotu Spring Scenic Spot is located in the prosperous area of the center of Jinan, and is known as the three major scenic spots in Jinan together with Qianfo Mountain and Daming Lake in Jinan. 
Baotu Spring is the main scene in the park. The spring water is divided into three streams, which are clear and clear, gushing day and night, and reaching several feet when the water is full. 
Near Baotu Spring, there are more than 30 famous springs scattered, such as Jinxian Spring, Shuyu Spring, Xibo Spring, Liuxu Spring, Huanghua Spring, Dukang Spring and Bailong Spring, which constitute Baotu Spring Group. 
· The south gate of the park is magnificent, graceful and luxurious. The horizontal plaque "Baotu Spring" on the gate is written by Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty and is known as the "first gate" of Chinese gardens. 
Every March, magnolia flowers bloom in the scenic spot, and the petals rain fall with the wind, making the scenery romantic and beautiful; At the same time, plum blossoms and other flowers have also entered the most brilliant moment, full of spring.

tagNameList: Mengmeng Animals; Treasure Spot for Strolling with Kids; Zoos
shortFeatures: The Rich Wildlife World of the Exhibition Area
summary: Jinan Wildlife World is a key tourism project identified by the Jinan municipal government. Most of the animals will be gradually relocated from the Poma Ridge Wildlife World. The Wildlife World is divided into two main sections: the northern part is a walking area, while the southern part is a driving area. The walking area features a "themed" exhibition layout, consisting of seven zones: Birdsong Flower Valley, Elephant Kingdom, Canopy Kingdom, Leopard Trail, Rainforest Exploration, Tiger Roar Valley, and Qinglong Impression. The entire driving area is divided into five zones based on "geographical habitats": African Savannah, Alpine Regions, Australian Forests, Wild Zone, and Asian Grasslands. Jinan Wildlife World offers not only an opportunity to view animals but also boasts beautiful scenery.
The highest point in Jinan City, with a wide view, is the best place to overlook the city of Jinan.

Jiaoji Railway Museum is a special exhibition hall mainly reflecting the birth and development of the Jiaoji Railway. The main building exhibition area is about 2995 square meters, the west auxiliary building exhibition area is 237 square meters, and the outdoor area is 3,170 square meters. meters. The exhibition area is divided into four exhibition areas: the background and process of the construction of the Jiaoji Railway, its impact on Shandong's social and economic development, the vicissitudes of life, and the march towards a new era. The past and present lives of the two old railway stations in Jinan, the Jiaoji Railway and historical culture Celebrities, the Red Jiaoji Railway, and the past century. There are 759 exhibits and 1,314 photos on display, introducing the development process of the Jiaoji Railway and its influence in modern China history.

tagNameList: Monuments and Sites; Memorial Halls; Historical Sites
summary: The General Temple Street Catholic Church was first built in the seventh year of Shunzhi of the Qing Dynasty. Gabole, a priest from the Beijing parish, came to Jinan and purchased more than 13 acres of land on General Temple Street in the west gate, and presided over the construction of a Catholic Church. The church is built in traditional China architectural form and combines the characteristics of Jinan residential buildings. The stone wall reaches the top, the roof is rolled up, and the small green tiles are covered. The form is simple, and only some Baroque characteristics are retained in the doors, windows and other parts.

The spring water is clear and the bamboo forest is dense. The stone road of the bamboo forest is immersed in the spring water. There are not many people. The experience is great and it feels like you are in the south.

shortFeatures: Wine-themed Underground Museum
summary: The Qingdao Wine Museum is a very distinctive museum. The exterior features a European-style castle architecture, and once inside, it offers a different world—spacious and deep. Walking through the long corridors feels like an adventure in a secret chamber. Of course, the theme here is not castle exploration but wine. The walls introduce basic wine knowledge, the history of its development, and the culture of wine. There are many exhibition halls on both sides, such as the wine glass exhibition hall and the international wine exhibition hall, where sculptures and images are displayed. After experiencing the knowledge of wine, visitors can also enjoy a free glass of wine and some snacks provided by the museum.

shortFeatures: A fun museum with the theme of shells

The mountains, sea and clouds in Qingdao constitute the theme of the design of the Grand Theatre. A grand theater with elegant environment and advanced equipment

This is the venue of the annual Qingdao International Beer Festival and the largest international beer city in Asia. Qingdao International Beer City is divided into two functional areas: south and north. The south area is an entertainment area and the north area is a comprehensive area. A large-scale amusement world has been built. The huge "Overflowing the World" sculpture in the city is the iconic subject, with profound meaning; Ten Thousand People Square is the permanent festival venue of the International Beer Festival. 
Qingdao International Beer Festival, founded in 1991, opens every year on the second weekend of August, the golden tourist season in Qingdao, and lasts for 16 days. During the festival, food and entertainment, drinking contests, fashion shows and other activities are colorful and crowded. In the chief restaurant, the brewery also has a special micro-beer production line. When visitors taste the raw beer brewed by the production line, they can also watch the whole process of beer production. Don't miss the opportunity. In addition, there is also a Universal World theme park in the beer city.

The central campus of Qingdao University is located at the intersection of Hong Kong Road and Ningxia Road in the center of Qingdao, backed by Fushan Mountain and facing the sea. The campus has beautiful scenery and is known as the eastern garden of Qingdao. 
· It is close to Qingdao's eastern business district, May 4th Square, Polar Ocean World, Olympic Sailing Base, Fushan Forest Park and other scenic spots.

shortFeatures: The intersection of the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea
summary:
The most meaningful landscape of Linhai Park is the intersection of the Yellow Sea and Bohai Sea-Changshanwei. As the name implies, it is the tail of Long Island and the intersection of the Yellow Sea and Bohai Sea. 
As you can see, a jade-colored stone beach on the coast crosses the Dengzhou Strait, and a vein of snow waves in the sea goes straight to Penglai Pavilion. The shore part is composed of Zhuji pebbles, which are wide and pointed in shape, curved and elegant, and natural. In the sea, snow waves splashed everywhere, dividing a sea of clear water into two worlds, which were distinct. The strangest thing is that the waves here are rapid all the year round, and the waves elsewhere are as flat as mirrors, but here the rapids are like swords. From a distance, they look like a dragon's tail playing in the water and making waves, and they are dancing like sand gulls. Some people say that this is a fight between the Yellow and Bohai Seas, while others say that this is a "close contact" between the Yellow and Bohai Seas. 
In 1999, Zhang Siqing, vice chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, came to Linhai, saw this strange landscape, and happily wrote the words "Flying Snow on Yutan". Stepping into the end of Changshan Mountain, we are "stepping on two seas with one foot and listening to two waves with two ears", which really feels indomitable and self-respecting.

Yandunjiao is a small fishing village with beautiful scenery surrounded by mountains and seas. Every year from November to March of the following year, thousands of wild whooper swans always fly here from distant Siberia to spend the winter. People live in harmony with swans, and the beach has a beautiful landscape, which adds infinite vitality to the beautiful bay... Because people consciously love and protect birds, swans have also established strong feelings with the villagers. The harmonious home where people and birds coexist has attracted professional photographers and amateur photography enthusiasts.

The most famous feature is the jade Buddha statue on the mountainside, which is the heaviest jade Buddha in the world, weighing 300 tons, and is truly spectacular. In addition, the annual Xian Guding Temple Fair has a long history and is usually held on the 15th day of the third lunar month. During the fair, visitors can pray devoutly, sample snacks, and experience a strong sense of local folklore.
