shortFeatures: Historic Post Building
summary:
Shanghai Post Museum was designed by Xiecheng Foreign Company in 1922, formerly known as Shanghai Post Office. Xinfengji Construction Factory was constructed on the original Jimeili plot and completed in November 1924. It was once listed as one of the top ten buildings in Shanghai at that time. 
Shanghai, one of the birthplaces of modern Chinese postal services, has experienced several vicissitudes of customs postal services and Qing postal services. After the birth of New China, the development of people's postal services is changing with each passing day. After the post and telecommunications division in 1999, Shanghai Post, which operates independently, carried forward the past and opened up the future, kept pace with the times, worked hard, and opened up a new world for development. 
Shanghai Post Museum is located in Shanghai Post Building, a national key cultural relics protection unit and an excellent building in Shanghai. It traces the origin and development of postal services with detailed historical materials and objects and modern scientific and technological means. It records the contributions made by the early party organizations of Shanghai Post to the workers' movement and the revolutionary ancestors to the birth of New China; Recorded the achievements of advanced model workers who devoted themselves to the postal service; A variety of postal and postal tools are displayed; This paper introduces the postal service (business) products and their development; Stamps with profound cultural heritage are on display. Shanghai Post Museum, which is ideological, scientific, intellectual, contemporary, interesting and participatory, will become a classroom for revolutionary traditional education, a position for carrying forward advanced ideology and culture, a channel for publicizing postal service concepts and products, an educational base for teenagers to popularize scientific knowledge, a scenic spot for domestic and foreign guests to visit, and a window for displaying Shanghai Post's elegance. Shanghai Post Museum is located on the north bank of Suzhou River, in the building of Shanghai Post Office. In this historic old building, you will see an interesting train car post office and all kinds of interesting old mailboxes and mailboxes, and you can also learn about the development history of postal services, especially for teenagers. 
As soon as you enter the gate, Roman-style columns, spiral stairs and gorgeous chandeliers hanging high on the roof are full of European architectural styles. The whole building is "U"-shaped, and the atrium on the ground floor displays physical models such as the Qing postal carriage, the first postal car purchased in 1917, the first regular air mail aircraft, and the post office of the "mobile mail car" train carriage. You can also see the scene of the Qing post office. 
The second floor is the spacious postal hall, which is divided into four exhibition halls, which tell the history of postal development at all times and at home and abroad. You can see all kinds of old mailboxes and mailboxes with strange appearance. Many rare stamps are also displayed in the treasure hall, such as "Penny Black", "Dalong Stamp" and "Matchmaker in Green". Here, children can simulate writing letters and experience the feeling of delivering express mail in the ancient post office.

Pudong Art Museum (MAP) is invested, constructed and operated by Lujiazui Group and designed by the famous French architect and Pritzker Prize winner Jean Nouvel. Construction started on September 26, 2017 and will be officially opened to the public in July 2021. Open. Pudong Art Museum is located in the core area of Xiaolujiazui Riverside. It is a modern building with 6 floors and 30 meters high. It extends westward to the bank of the Huangpu River and eastward to connect to the Oriental Pearl Tower via the Garden Square, forming a 30,000-square-meter art museum territory.
The main building of Pudong Art Museum covers an area of 13,000 square meters, with a total building space area of nearly 40,000 square meters. It has 13 exhibition halls and an exhibition area of more than 10,000 square meters. The facade and floor of the building are made of Shandong Baima granite, and the interior space and decoration are inspired by Malevich's classic geometric drawings.
As a state-owned public art museum, Pudong Art Museum is an important measure to build the "Shanghai Culture" brand. It shoulders the cultural mission and social responsibilities entrusted by the urban and municipal governments. It focuses on international art exhibitions and exchanges, takes into account domestic art exhibitions, and highlights the four major functions of exhibitions, aesthetic education, cultural creativity, and international exchanges. It is committed to becoming a new landmark of Shanghai's international cultural venues and an important platform for international cultural and artistic exchanges.

tagNameList: Historic sites; Enjoying autumn leaves; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Admire the unique underwater exhibition hall
summary:
The ancient civilization of the Guangfulin Cultural Site has been preliminarily confirmed through scientific archaeology. As early as the late Neolithic period, around four to five thousand years ago, rice cultivation was already widespread in the area, indicating an advanced agricultural production system. Additionally, the textile history here is long-standing, with pottery spindles from the late Neolithic period uncovered at the site.

The development of the Guangfulin Site Park aims to inherit historical culture and preserve the original ecological structure of the ancient town. It will integrate modern urban construction concepts to create an "underwater museum." Stepping into the site, the Guangfulin Cultural Exhibition Hall is particularly captivating. The entire exhibition space is set underwater, with pyramid-like rooftops floating on Fulin Lake, blending with the surrounding environment to create a beautiful scene. The exhibition hall is designed with the concept of a "Journey through Time and Space," combining modern audiovisual technology to present scenes such as the archaeological memories of Guangfulin, the formation of Shanghai's land, the arrival of early settlers, the rise of local cities, the flourishing of Songjiang Prefecture, the emergence of Shanghai as a city, and a vision for the future. Visitors can experience and explore the history of Shanghai's civilization in a time tunnel.

At night, the site hosts an exciting lantern festival. From the lake-bottom garage entrance to near Zhuque Gate, over 40 large lantern sets light up the area, creating a dazzling, beautiful display. Among these, the 3D Mapping show is a major highlight, condensing the thousand-year history of Guangfulin into a stunning three-minute light and shadow performance projected onto Fulin Tower, attracting numerous visitors.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Enjoy autumn leaves; Mountains; Botanical Gardens
summary: Tianma Mountain is located about 10 kilometers southwest of Sheshan Mountain and about 11 kilometers away from Songjiang District Government. Tianma Mountain was called Qianshan Mountain in ancient times. Legend has it that Wu Guogan cast his sword here in the Spring and Autumn Period. Tianma Mountain is steep, and its ridge line is close to the east-west direction. The mountain shape is like a Tianma spreading its wings and ready to fly. It is now called Tianma Mountain. Tianma Mountain is the mountain with the largest forest area and the highest altitude among the nine peaks and twelve mountains of Sheshan Mountain, with a forest area of about 1,433 mu and an altitude of about 99.8 meters. Tianma Mountain has a long history and rich humanities. In the past, it was a Buddhist resort, and there are many monasteries on the mountain. Every March, the first day and the fifteenth day of Yangchun, pilgrims climb the mountain to take incense, and the incense is extremely flourishing, so Tianma Mountain is also called "Burning Incense Mountain".

Shanghai Five-Star Park is a large theme park built based on the artistic concept of *Dream of the Red Chamber*, using traditional Chinese artistic techniques. The entire park is exquisitely designed, combining the grandeur of a royal garden with the graceful style of a Jiangnan garden. The interior furniture, furnishings, plaques, couplets, and even every plant and tree are arranged according to the characters' traits and storylines in *Dream of the Red Chamber*.

Around the Grand View Garden, there are also some scenic spots and entertainment activities for visitors to enjoy. Every spring and autumn, large performance events such as the Red Chamber Art Festival and Red Chamber Tourism Festival are held. It has won several prestigious awards, including the National Architecture Luban Award, Shanghai's Top 10 Buildings for the 40th Anniversary, Top 10 New Leisure Spots, Excellent Architecture of Shanghai for the 50th Anniversary of New China, Shanghai's Top 10 Tourism Gardens, one of Shanghai's Seven Civilized Parks, and honors such as Advanced Group of National Scenic Areas by the Ministry of Construction.

It is named because it was a warehouse jointly funded and built by four banks in old Shanghai: Jincheng, Zhongnan, Daliu and Salt Industry. During the Battle of Songhu, 452 Kuomintang soldiers were stationed here heroically resisting the Japanese attack. The iron doors of the original four-line warehouse are preserved at the entrance of the Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall, which are stained with rust.

shortFeatures: Visit real old locomotives
summary: The Shanghai Railway Museum is located at the intersection of Tianmu East Road and Kangle. Its exhibition hall architecture and outdoor appearance are based on the original site of the Shanghai Station of the Shanghai-Nanjing Railway (Old North Station), which was completed in 1909 and has a British classical architectural style. Here, you can see the real locomotive as well as various train parts, equipment and simulation models. You can also operate the console with your own hands and experience being a driver of an EMU. Walking into the museum area, the first thing you see is two old-fashioned locomotives and a classic green leather carriage. On the side is the railway station platform, which is a good scene for taking photos. The exhibition hall is a retro-style building, with a very contemporary structure and decoration inside, but the exhibition hall is not large, only one floor. The museum contains a wealth of graphic materials, railway publications and badges from various eras, introducing the journey of Shanghai and East China railways over the past 100 years. In the museum, you can see a lot of equipment related to trains and rails, as well as direction signs used on various train carriages and daily objects in carriages of various eras. However, what attracts the children most is probably a variety of simulated miniature locomotive models. In addition, there is also a simulated EMU cab in the museum. You can try to be a driver for a while and drive the train to the distance.

tagNameList: Kid-friendly treasure spots; Autumn leaf viewing; City Parks
summary:
Changfeng Park, located in the western part of the central urban area of Shanghai, at 189 Daduhe Road, Putuo District, is a national AAAA-level tourist scenic area. To the east is the famous East China Normal University, to the south is the Suzhou Creek, to the west is Daduhe Road, and to the north is Nujiang Road. The park has four gates: the south gate, known as Gate 1, is on Daduhe Road; the east gate, known as Gate 2, is at the southern end of Zaoyang Road; the north gate, known as Gate 3, is on Nujiang Road; the west gate, known as Gate 4, is at the intersection of Daduhe Road and Yunling Road. 

Changfeng Park was initially established in April 1957 and was originally called West Shanghai Park. When it partially opened in 1958, it was renamed Biluohu Park after the main scenic feature, Biluohu Lake. It officially opened on National Day in 1959 and was renamed Changfeng Park, inspired by the line “I wish to ride the long wind and break the waves across ten thousand miles” from the "Biography of Zong Qi" in the "Book of Song."

The park covers an area of 364,000 square meters and is a large comprehensive mountain and water park in Shanghai. It features the city's largest artificial lake, Yinchu Lake, covering 146,700 square meters, formerly known as Biluohu Lake. The park also has the highest artificial mountain in the city, Tiewei Mountain, which is 26 meters high and covers an area of 10,000 square meters. The names of the lake and mountain are inspired by the lines “The sky connects with the Wuling Mountains, silver hoes fall, and the earth shakes as the Iron Arms sway” from Mao Zedong's poem "Sending the Plague God Off." In 1998, Changfeng Park was selected as one of China's Top 100 Parks by the Ministry of Construction and the China Parks Association. In 2002, it was designated a "Four-Star Park" in Shanghai.

shortFeatures: Stroll along the Ming and Qing Old Street to admire Huizhou-style architecture.
summary: The street, over 800 meters long, is lined with closely packed houses featuring wooden doors and windows that highlight the characteristics of Huizhou. The wooden plank doors, left unpainted to preserve the natural wood color, are adorned with beams and diagonal wooden supports carved in a bold and fluid style. The street is paved with grayish-blue stone along the sides, while the center is lined with red stones in neat rows, creating a harmonious and aesthetically pleasing color scheme. Particularly distinctive are the drainage covers, carved from grayish-blue stone. The shops along the street mostly sell local specialties from Gaochun, with very few offering tourist souvenirs, avoiding the typical commercialized atmosphere found in other ancient towns.

It was the villa of Xu Da's family, the founding father of Zhongshan King, during the Yongle period of Ming Dynasty, so it was called Xu Taifu Garden or Xu Zhongshan Garden. During the Tianshun period, Jiufeng Temple was built in the garden, and fireworks were at their peak. During the Zhengde period, Xu Tianci, a descendant of Xu Da, expanded the garden into the "largest and magnificent" garden in Nanjing at that time, and named it East Garden. The garden has become an elegant gathering place for the owner of the garden and many famous literati such as Wang Shizhen and Wu Chengen to have poetry and wine parties. During his southern tour, Emperor Wuzong of the Ming Dynasty went to the park to enjoy the scenery and fish.

shortFeatures: Visit the sitting statue of the Buddha of Infinite Life
summary:
It is located on the rock wall from Shamao Peak to Zipen Peak in Qixia Mountain. According to legend, Seng Shao, the founder of Qixia Temple, once dreamed that there was a Buddha light on the west rock wall, so he decided to build a Buddha statue here. After his death, his son began to carve a Buddhist niche on the west wall with Zen Master Zhidu in the second year of Yongming in the Southern Qi Dynasty (484), and engraved three Buddha statues. These three Buddhas are collectively called "Three Saints of the West", and this temple is also called "Three Holy Temples". In the middle, the Infinite Buddha is three feet and three feet high, and it is the largest Buddha in the Thousand Buddha Rocks, so this cave is named "Infinite Buddha", also known as "Big Buddha Pavilion". In the first year of Liang Datong (504), it was reported that Buddha light appeared on the top of the Buddhist shrine. Therefore, feudal nobles of Qi and Liang dynasties, such as Prince Qi Wenhui, King of Yuzhang Literature and subjects, thought that the Buddha had appeared, and competed to donate money to chisel stone statues, which were called Thousand Buddhas and named Thousand Buddhas Rock. Buddha statues are sitting and standing, several feet in size, only inches in size, and exquisite in shape. They are as famous as Datong and Yungang Grottoes in the north and south. Thousand Buddha Rocks were repaired and engraved in Song and Ming Dynasties. On the rock wall, there are seven regular script characters of "Ancient Thousand Buddhas Rock Qixia Temple" written by Song You Jiuyan. 
 
The famous "Dongfeitian is in the Buddhist niche No.102. In 2000," Dongfeitian "was discovered in Qixia Mountain. This niche is very small, with five Buddha statues. Two groups of flying sky on the top of the cave are orange, with clear lines and discernible lines. The flame on the top of the Buddha statue in the middle is faintly visible. 
Although there are only two pairs of flying sky, this is the easternmost "Dunhuang relic" found in China.

tagNameList: Climbing Heights and Mountains; Nature and Adventure; Forests
shortFeatures: The mountains stretch in endless, varied forms.
summary:
Over 2000 years ago, in pursuit of his political ideals and to implement “benevolent governance” for the people, Confucius traveled through various states with his disciples, teaching along the way. In his later years, he passed through Gaochun and ascended Youzi Mountain. The year Confucius ascended the mountain, after the Wu-Chu War, he gazed out from the peak. The lush green hills and waters of Gaochun, where the mountains and lakes merged, were incredibly picturesque. However, the people below were suffering, with barren fields and occasional white bones scattered around, the scars of the Wu-Chu war still evident in the beautiful landscape. Looking back on his life of hardship, Confucius felt that his teachings on “benevolent governance” were still not accepted by the rulers, and he was filled with sorrow and frustration. Though the scenery was beautiful, he was just a foreign traveler, overwhelmed by the longing to return home, feeling like a wanderer with no way to help the people. He thought it was time to return to his homeland and live out his remaining years in peace. Years later, Confucius passed away in despair in Qufu, Shandong. To honor this sage, people named the mountain Youzi Mountain. For centuries, visitors have continuously come to this mountain, and Youzi Mountain has become a sacred place in the hearts of the people of Gaochun.

The main peak of Youzi Mountain, Dayoushan, stands about 188 meters above sea level, with a graceful and towering appearance. The mountain is rich with pine trees and bamboo, offering a captivating view, and is praised as "the most scenic spot of the Sihe River." Not only did Confucius visit this place, but it is also said that when the Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha came to China from the sea to spread Buddhism, he was attracted by the green mountains and clear waters and stopped here to rest and visit. Locals in Gaochun have always believed that Youzi Mountain was the first place where Kṣitigarbha set foot upon arriving in China.

Guangfu Town is a peninsula embedded in Taihu Lake, a famous historical and cultural town in Jiangsu Province, 25 kilometers west of Suzhou, located on the shore of Taihu Lake and at the foot of Dengwei Mountain. The landscape is picturesque, with flowers and fruits everywhere. Ancient poetry praises it as "lakes and mountains, caves and blessed places". During the period of Liang Datong in the Southern Dynasty, the prefect of Jiuzhen's house was a temple, and the word "Guangfu" was taken, hence its name. Guangfu is dotted with scenic spots and historical sites, and its human resources are very rich.

shortFeatures: Climb the mountain and stroll to see the Taihu stones.
summary:
The Three Mountains Island of Taihu, also known as Penglai, was first referred to as Little Penglai during the Ming Dynasty, hence the beautiful nickname "Little Penglai of Taihu." It is also called Bijiashan (Pen-holder Mountain) and Jinguishan (Golden Turtle Mountain), located over fifty kilometers southwest of Suzhou, in the middle of Taihu Lake. It is about seven kilometers across the water from the Dongshan Luhang Pier on the lake's eastern shore. The island is named for its three connected peaks.

Taihu's Three Mountains Island boasts a unique natural geography with a mild climate and distinct seasons. Winters are not too cold, and summers are not too hot. The landscape is picturesque with green mountains and clear waters. The island produces an abundance of flowers and fruits throughout the year. In addition to the "Dongting Red" oranges, there is the famous "Mayan Date," a rare fruit in the country, which grows to about two inches in size and is sweet and refreshing. There are still 692 ancient date trees over 100 years old.

The island once had ten scenic spots. Existing ones include Gu Ting, believed to be a dressing table, Banbi Peak, known as the "Walking Mountain," with steep cliffs that naturally resemble a water and stone bonsai. There are also stacked stones, said to be the residence of the beloved daughter of King Wu; the Twelve Zodiac Stones, which stand by the lake with hollow carvings resembling the shapes of the twelve zodiac animals; and other sites such as Incense Burner Stone and Ox-back Rock. Every household on the island cultivates bonsai, earning it the name "Small Penglai of Blue Waters and Green Mountains." The island is also home to the "Three Mountains Culture," an archaeological site from the Paleolithic era, with mammalian fossils dating back more than 10,000 years.

shortFeatures: Well-preserved typical ancient towns in the Jiangnan region.
summary:
Lili, formerly known as Lihuacun and also called Xihu, was a village during the Tang dynasty. In the Southern Song dynasty, it became a market town, and during the Ming Dynasty, in the Hongzhi era, it was upgraded to a major town in Jiangnan with thousands of households. Lili Town is located in Wujiang District, Suzhou, and is a well-preserved typical ancient town of Jiangnan, with a history that can be traced back about 2,500 years. 

The area is crisscrossed with rivers and lakes, and the fertile soil has earned it the reputation of being a land of fish and rice. The ancient town area currently has over 160,000 square meters of buildings from the Ming, Qing, and Republic of China periods, distributed in a "T"-shaped pattern along the Shishi River. 

Lili Ancient Town is also the hometown of the famous patriotic democrat and poet Liu Yazi. Within the town is the Liu Yazi Memorial Hall, a national-level cultural heritage site, which attracts many visitors from both China and abroad each year. On January 31, 2012, the comprehensive development of Lili Ancient Town officially began.

shortFeatures: Admire the exquisite carvings with a royal grandeur.
summary: The Xishan Carved Flower Mansion is a historical building complex from the Ming and Qing dynasties, covering an area of over 6,000 square meters. It was completed over four reigns of the Qing Dynasty. The entire mansion consists of interconnected buildings: multiple floors, multiple rooms, and all rooms are connected to each other, forming a grand and magnificent structure. It is considered the first ancient famous residence in the Jiangnan region. The mansion contains over 3,000 pieces of brick and wood carvings from the Qing Dynasty, each unique. The carvings, characterized by their diversity, intricacy, craftsmanship, and ingenuity, feature patterns of landscapes, flowers and birds, feathers, and antiques, reflecting daily life and showcasing the classic craftsmanship of the Xiangshan guild from the Ming and Qing dynasties in Jiangnan.

shortFeatures: Zen Temple Built by Xiaozong for Chen Fei
summary: Lianchi Zen Temple, also known as Lianhuachi and Gulian Temple, is located at the mouth of Lingtang Bay on the shores of Wubao Lake. After Chen Fei died of illness, Xiaozong, in memory of her, decided to set up a monk and build a temple here to chant sutras for Chen Fei. Later, he ordered the monks to dig a pool on the east side of the temple to plant lotus flowers, which was called Lotus Temple. After more than 40 years of successive construction, the temple has all kinds of halls, corridors, Baoge Cenlou and Qintang painting boats, making it one of the famous Buddhist resorts in the south of the Yangtze River. In the vicissitudes of eight hundred years, Lianchi Zen Temple has been repeatedly abolished and repaired. After 1996, after continuous renovation, it regained its brilliance, forming a complete ancient lotus scenic spot with Chen Fei Water Tomb, Wenchang Pavilion and Shiyan Long Bridge.

This pavilion is backed by the promenade, facing the wide pool, with sycamore trees and green bamboo trees beside it. The beauty of the pavilion lies in the fact that there are four circular doors on the white wall around it, with holes surrounded by holes and holes covered by holes. From different angles, you can see the peculiar landscape of overlapping and staggered circles, ferrules and continuous circles. The four round cave doors are transparent, lit and elegant, and they also form four beautiful frame pictures with flower windows, small bridges and flowing water, lakes and mountains, and bamboo charm, which are meaningful. The plaque of "Wuzhu Secluded Residence" is inscribed by Wen Zhengming.

shortFeatures: Classical gardens mainly based on rockery
summary: This garden was originally the former site of Qian's Golden Valley Garden in Wuyue in the Five Dynasties, and became a private garden in the Ming and Qing Dynasties. It now covers an area of 2,179 square meters, of which the building area is 754 square meters. The landscape is dominated by mountains, supplemented by pools and water, and there are not many buildings. Although the garden is small, it is very imposing. The lake rockery in this garden is the highest in China, covering an area of only half an acre, while cliffs, peaks, caves, valleys, platforms, Dengdao and other things in the mountains are full of changes. The main mountain in the east of the pool and the secondary mountain in the north of the pool had a continuous momentum, forming a muddy piece, just like a mountain range that runs through and suddenly breaks into a cliff. Where the Dengdao meets the stream, looking up is a line of blue sky, overlooking several clear streams; It's magnificent and beautiful, just like being in the middle of thousands of mountains. The whole mountain is carefully treated, close to nature, every stone is cracked, and it's properly explained. It can be seen from a distance or enjoyed from near. It's no wonder that it has the reputation of "unique and unique in the south of the Yangtze River". Huanxiu Mountain Villa is a cultural relics protection unit in Jiangsu Province. In 1988, this garden was listed as a national key cultural relics protection unit. In 1997, as one of the classical gardens in Suzhou, it was approved by UNESCO to be listed in the World Heritage List. The construction history of Huanxiu Mountain Villa can be traced back to the Jingde Temple built by Wang Xun and Wang Min in the Jin Dynasty, and later became the Golden Valley Garden of Qian Yuanhuang, the son of Qian Liu, the king of Wuyue in the Five Dynasties, and the medicine garden of Zhu Changwen, a writer in the Song Dynasty. Since then, it has risen and fallen repeatedly. During the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty, it was successively changed to Xuedao Academy and Food and Road Administration. During the Wanli period, it was the residence of Shen Shixing, a university student. Sun Shenji, a descendant of the late Ming and early Qing Dynasties, built a garden. During the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty, it was the residence of Jiang Ji, a member of the Ministry of Punishment. Jiang's family built a "Qiuzi Building", and behind the building, stones were stacked into a mountain, and three feet of ground was dug. There was a clear spring overflowing into a pool, and the famous spring was "Feixue", and houses and pavilions were built in between. Later, it became the residence of Shangshu Bi Yuan and the residence of university scholar Sun Shiyi. Sun Jun, a descendant of Sun's family, nicknamed Lin Quan, invited Ge Yuliang, a famous Dieshan artist, to reconstruct this garden in the 12th year of Jiaqing. Ge Yuliang's rockery stacked in half an acre of land has a potential of thousands of miles. Since then, the garden has become famous all over the world for its rockery. In the 29th year of Daoguang (AD 1847), Wang Weiren purchased and built Wang's ancestral hall, set up Gengyin Yizhuang, and rebuilt the northeast garden. This garden became a part of Wang's ancestral hall "Gengyun Mountain Villa" and was renamed "Huanxiu Mountain Villa", also known as "Yiyuan". Many of them were damaged later. In 1949, only one mountain, one pool and one "autumn boat" remained. From June, 1984 to October, 1985, Suzhou Landscape Bureau and Embroidery Research Institute jointly funded a large-scale renovation. It is designed by Suzhou Garden Design Office and constructed by Suzhou Classical Garden Architecture Company. The four-sided halls, Yougu Hall, Wenquan Pavilion, side building, etc. of Huanxiu Mountain Villa have been mainly restored, with a building area of 754 square meters, more than 200 meters of newly built and renovated walls, 246 square meters of auxiliary ground, reinforced rockery, cleaned pool and replanted trees.

In order to inherit and carry forward the long-standing garden art, Taicang Park was comprehensively renovated and expanded with government investment in 2003, and borrowed from the creative conception of Yanshan Garden, a famous historical garden in Taicang, planted big trees, stacked mountains and managed water, restored ancient buildings, and restored more than 20 scenic spots such as Nodding Stone, Fensheng Pavilion, Xiaofei Rainbow, Yanshan Hall, Jiashu Pavilion and Jiuqu Bridge. The area of the park has increased from the original 66 mu to the existing 110 mu, and the old appearance has been changed into a new one. It reproduces the beautiful scenery of small bridges, flowing water, blue waves, pavilions and tree-lined gardens in the south of the Yangtze River, and has become an important tourist attraction to explore the ancient charm of Taicang. summary:
Guide Village is located at the foot of East Tianmu Mountain in Lin'an, on the bank of Nantiaoxi River at the source of Taihu Lake, close to famous tourist attractions such as Shenlongchuan, Taihu Lake Source and Tianhuangping. 
The forest coverage rate of the village is over 93%, and there are more than 200 towering ancient trees behind the village, all of which are rare tree species such as Liquidambar formosana, Ginkgo biloba, Cryptomeria fortunei and Ma Chestnut. The oldest tree age is over 900 years. 
It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with birds singing and flowers fragrant, and the highest temperature in summer and day is below 30 degrees Celsius. It is a good place to escape the summer. Every late autumn, golden ginkgo biloba and fiery maple trees paint this place as a "alpine oil painting with thick ink", which is one of the most beautiful autumn resorts in Jiangsu and Zhejiang provinces. When the red maple trees randomly fall in every corner of the village, the autumn mood of the guide village inadvertently enters a good situation. There are more than 470 acres of terraced fields on the left and right sides of the village, which are magnificent. There is a pond along the winding mountain along the road. The water in the pond is green all year round and there are schools of fish swimming. 
The guide village takes "Que" as its general surname, and there are still well-preserved century-old houses, as well as excavated ancient stone tools and iron coins. Water, house, tree, cultural relics, tomb, surname and village, these "seven ancients" give the guide village its unique charm. 
If you like hiking, you can choose to hike here from Hengdu-this is an excellent leisure hiking route, and it is one of the destinations that outdoor photographers in Hangzhou must visit every year.

summary: Longmen Ancient Town is a national 4A-level tourist attraction, located on the beautiful southern bank of the Fuchun River. The town boasts a picturesque environment. Over 90% of the residents have the surname Sun, making it the largest settlement of descendants of Sun Quan, the Emperor of Eastern Wu during the Three Kingdoms period. The town has a rich historical and cultural heritage, retaining a strong clan atmosphere and unique local customs. The ancient town's layout is complex, with a defensive, fan-shaped network of streets and alleys as its framework. The clan halls and courtyards are connected, and the alleys interlink, creating a maze-like traditional residential settlement. It is the most complete and rare example of ancient Ming and Qing architectural clusters in the rural countryside of southern Jiangnan.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Fuchun River by boat
summary: Tongjun Mountain is located at the intersection of Fuchun River and Fenshui River, just across the water from Tonglu County, and is the nearest scenic spot to the city. The scenery here is quiet, and it is said that it is the place where the old man Tongjun, the originator of traditional Chinese medicine, built his house. Not only is most of the landscape in the mountains related to this, but even the place name of "Tonglu" comes from it. Tongjun Mountain itself is a very small mountain peak with a height of just over 60 meters. It can be visited in less than one hour, which is very suitable for taking the elderly and children to relax together. Standing at the Siwang Pavilion at the top of the mountain, overlooking the clear water and waves of the two rivers, it is somewhat poetic and picturesque. In addition, on the way to climb the mountain, you will pass by Sifang Pharmacy, Tongjun Temple, Tongjun Pavilion and other buildings, and you can simply visit them. Not far from Baicao Garden at the foot of the mountain by boat, it is the cruise terminal of "Qili Yangfan". Compared with Yanziling Diaoyutai and Jiande Qili Yangfan, which both take a boat tour of Fuchun River, there are usually fewer tourists in Tongjun Mountain. The cruise ship runs from Tongjun Mountain to the upper reaches of Fuchun River, crosses the Second Fuchun River Bridge to the First Fuchun River Bridge, and then turns back. The whole journey takes about 40 minutes. The departure time of the cruise ship is adjusted according to the flow of people, and it usually takes 5-10 people to sail. Therefore, in the off-season of tourism, it is best for individual tourists to call the scenic spot the day before to confirm whether there is a group the next day, so as to ensure that there is a boat available.

shortFeatures: The park creates a strong atmosphere of the Three Kingdoms
summary: The entrance scenic spot is designed with squares, ancient city gates, landscape waterscapes, etc. In this block, there is a huge ancient tripod, which symbolizes the confrontation of the Three Kingdoms, and a majestic ancient city gate, which makes visitors feel a strong "Three Kingdoms" atmosphere as soon as they approach the park. After passing through the ancient city gate, you will walk into the leisure and entertainment scenic spot. This scenic spot mainly includes Lushan Academy, tea room, landscape lake, leisure lawn, etc. Lushan Academy is the cultural place of Poetry Printing Society and Chess Painting Academy.

shortFeatures: Take a walk and see the street life in old Hangzhou
summary:
Wuliu Lane in Hangzhou starts from Doufu Third Bridge in the south and ends at Daoyuan Lane in the north. Wuliu Garden was built here in the Southern Song Dynasty, hence its name. In the past, it was a place where dignitaries lived, but later it became a place where ordinary people lived. Most of the residents were small craftsmen and vendors. In the thirty-third year of Guangxu's reign in Qing Dynasty (1907), a railway station was built in Qingtai Gate, and trains passed through the city, which became increasingly lively. 
Wuliu Lane in Hangzhou starts from Doufu Third Bridge in the south and ends at Daoyuan Lane in the north. Wuliu Garden was built here in the Southern Song Dynasty, hence its name. In the past, it was a place where dignitaries lived, but later it became a place where ordinary people lived. Most of the residents were small craftsmen and vendors. In the thirty-third year of Guangxu's reign in Qing Dynasty (1907), a railway station was built in Qingtai Gate, and trains passed through the city, which became increasingly lively. In 1966, it was renamed Xiayiyi Lane, and its old name was restored in 1981. The alleys still retain the lane buildings built in the Republic of China, and Hangzhou Municipal Government has included them in the protection plan of historical and cultural blocks. 
The historical section of Wuliuxiang is located in an important section of the ancient city of Hangzhou, with many relics of past dynasties. In the Song Dynasty, the Donghe River was the city river. At that time, the area belonged to Songzhifang and Xinglifang. In the Yuan Dynasty, the city wall expanded eastward, and the Donghe River became the river channel in the city.

Huang Gongwang Hermitage consists of Huang Gongwang Style Town, Huang Gongwang Memorial Hall, Huang Gongwang Jielu and Subtropical Botanical Garden, etc. The profound cultural history and natural ecology complement each other. Huang Gongwang Hermitage is taking advantage of the natural resources of Huang Gongwang Forest Park, excavating the profound cultural connotation of Huang Gongwang and Fuchun Shan Jutu, and building "Huang Gongwang Hermitage, traditional Chinese painting art garden, cross-strait exchange base and slow life resort". An ecological cultural park integrating modern science and technology, ecological agriculture, leisure tourism services and cultural creativity will be formed here.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the pleasant scenery of Tea Mountain
summary:
Shilangdang is a classic hiking route for Hangzhou donkey friends. Shilangdang is Langdang Ridge, also known as Langdang Ridge, and its ancient name is Menbiling Ridge. Originally refers to the mountains in Tianzhu Shandong, west of Longjing Village and northeast of Meijiawu Village. Nowadays, it is customary to call the hills from Wuyun Mountain in the south to Tianzhu in the north "Langdang Ridge". Because the hills winding for several kilometers, they are also known as "Shili Langdang", that is, "Shili Langdang". 
Shili Langdang was originally a shortcut for peddlers to carry loads from Longjing and Lingyin on the Qiantang River in ancient times. It was named after the sound of bells ringing on the loads. The journey was nearly ten miles, so it was called "Shili Langdang"

poiName: Tomb of Su Xiaoxiao by the Qiantang River
shortFeatures: Couplets written by 12 calligraphers
summary:
Su Xiaoxiao's tomb is located on the bank of Xiling Bridge in West Lake, Hangzhou. Qiantang was the first geek in Southern Qi Dynasty, and the most famous talented woman and beauty in ancient China. 
· After several damages, in 1964, on the eve of the Cultural Revolution, the tomb pavilion was destroyed by the Red Guards. 
In 2004, it was rebuilt and carved with Taishun bluestone, supported by six square columns, which led to today's tomb pavilion. 
Legend has it that Su Xiaoxiao was buried by Xiling Bridge after his death, with a stone tablet in front of it, titled: Su Xiaoxiao's tomb in Qiantang. Su Xiaoxiao's tomb is a household name in Hangzhou.

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Climb a mountain; Mountains; Historical Architectures
shortFeatures: Ring the bronze Brahma bell to pray for blessings and wishes
summary:
· Guide the evening bell of Jingci Temple in Pingshan. "Nanping" refers to Nanping Mountain behind Jingci Temple, and "Evening Bell" refers to the bronze Brahma bell in Jingci Temple. 
The bronze bell is 3 meters high and weighs more than 10 tons. There are more than 68,000 words "Miaofa Lotus Sutra" cast on the bell. 
Every day around 16:00, you can hear the sound of a big mallet hitting the pendulum clock, which is very strong and powerful. 
On New Year's Eve, many citizens and tourists will gather inside and outside the bell tower of Jingci Temple to hold New Year's bell ringing activities.

shortFeatures: A great place to experience the original beauty of nature
summary: Nantian Island, also known as Niutoushan, is located about 3 kilometers south of Shipu Town, Xiangshan County, Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, adjacent to Gaotang Island in the west. The natural harbor composed of the two islands and the mainland coastline is the famous Shipu Fishing Port. The whole island covers an area of about 84.38 square kilometers, with flat land accounting for about 1/3. The highest point, a large mountain, is about 405.4 meters above sea level, making it the largest island in Ningbo. With a population of about 35,000, it is located in Hepu Town. The forest coverage rate of Nantian Island is 40%.

shortFeatures: Show the dowry of rich families in the south of the Yangtze River in Ming and Qing
summary: Shili Hongzhuang is a special museum showing the life of ancient women, and it is also the largest folk museum in the province. Covering an area of more than 3,000 square meters, it displays more than 1,200 pieces of furniture and utensils related to the life and customs of rich ladies in the south of the Yangtze River in Ming and Qing Dynasties, integrating protection, display, research and tourism.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Waterfalls; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Like a white dragon flying into the sky
summary: Baishui Waterfall is located on Baishui Mountain, four kilometers south of Liangnong Town, Yuyao City, Zhejiang Province. Baishui Mountain, also known as Baishan Mountain, is famous because Bai Gong practiced here. There are four peaks on the mountain: Yeshan Mountain, Pingfeng, Shiwu and Yungen. Shiwu Peak is rocky and cliffs. Yungen Peak is green and dazzling, and the flowing spring is shining. Between the two peaks, a curtain of waterfalls plunges down from a height of 53 meters, shaped like a white dragon flying into the sky, and sounding like a sinking thunder, which is spectacular. This is Baishui Waterfall, commonly known as Baishui Chong. Poets of past dynasties have sung many songs about this waterfall, and the descriptions are all very vivid. For example, Zhao Danshan in Yuan Dynasty called it: "The jade dragon roars on the mountains, and the hanging waves burst out and turn over Cui Wei. When you return to the wind, you can make flying rain, and you can listen to the thunder of thousands of valleys." Shen Mingchen in the Ming Dynasty also left the poem "Blowing ancient snow and getting involved in the Milky Way".

tagNameList: Historic buildings; Military Sites; Historical Architectures
summary: Zhenhai is located in the middle section of China's coastline and at the mouth of the Yongjiang River. It goes to Qilu in the north, Fujian and Guangdong in the south, and reaches Suzhou and Hangzhou from the Yongjiang River. Since ancient times, merchants have gathered and sails are like forests. The column couplet engraved in the Banshan Pavilion of Zhaobaoshan Mountain, "A hundred boats compete for a foreign land, and a mountain recruits treasures to shine in Zhongzhou", is a vivid portrayal of the grand occasion of shipping at that time. Zhenhai has always been a battleground for military strategists, and is known as the "mighty town of Haitian" and the "throat of Zhejiang and Zhejiang". According to historical records, there have been 46 wars since the Eastern Jin Dynasty. Since the middle of the Ming Dynasty, Zhenhai has successively experienced wars against Japanese pirates and foreign aggression against Britain, France and Japan, leaving behind many heroic achievements of its ancestors and rich and precious coastal defense sites. There are more than 30 coastal defense sites in various periods within less than 2 square kilometers on the north and south sides of Zhenhaikou.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Nature and Adventure; Waterfalls; Mountains
shortFeatures: Running through a canyon of more than 2,600 meters
summary: Wang'ao Scenic Area is one of the five scenic spots of Jiufeng Mountain Tourist Area, which is run through by a canyon with a length of more than 2,600 meters, including Xiushan Lijing (entrance landscape area), Huaxi Roaming Area, leisure activity area, Longtan Qiyu District, Shimen Feihong District and many other scenic spots. As soon as you enter the scenic spot, there is a wild barbecue field full of smoke, bypassing the barbecue field and crossing Wolong Bridge. There are rain altars and rain hall here, which were built by the people in the past to pray for good weather. They walk slowly along the path, trees lined and spring water gurgling along the way, only to see the Longtan waterfall flowing in front of you like a silver curtain. Finally, when you board Songfeng Tea House, you can not only rest, but also look up at the top of Nine Peaks on the platform.

shortFeatures: Wuguan-style city gate building
summary: Wuling Gate, located in Xikou Town, Fenghua, Zhejiang Province, is away from Wuling Ridge, the gateway of the ancient town. The original site of Wuling Temple is Wuling Temple, with a tea pavilion. In 1929, the antique tower was demolished and built, with three rooms on two floors and cornices. Before 1929, it was a small nunnery. In 1930, Chiang Kai-shek converted it into three two-story Wuguan-style gate buildings. The inscription "Wuling" is engraved on both sides of the door, and the front is written by Yu Youren, a Kuomintang veteran and famous calligrapher. The back is handwritten by Chiang Kai-shek. In April 2007, it was announced by Fenghua Municipal People's Government as the fifth batch of municipal cultural relics protection units.

shortFeatures: Appreciate the white walls and black tiles architecture.
summary:
- Located at the junction of Wuxi, Suzhou, and Changshu, it is a typical water town in southern China, with the majority of the residents being of the Hua family.
- The main attractions are along the north and south banks of the ancient town's river, mostly displaying the life stories and cultural relics of local celebrities.
- The theater to the east of the Hua Hengfang Memorial Hall frequently hosts performances, creative markets, and other activities.
- The ancient town offers many local snacks, with the fried pork being the most famous, along with recommended dishes like Shui Jin tofu, Jin family sesame cakes, and medicinal herb pastries.
- At Qin Yuan, try the authentic Wuxi-style crab roe soup dumplings, and at Hua Fu Ming Zao, find a riverside tea seat to enjoy tea and the view, which is very relaxing.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Hidden gems for kids; Caves
shortFeatures: Take a boat to explore the unique underground caves.
summary:
- Shanjue Cave is located in the southwest of Yixing City. It is a famous limestone karst cave and one of the earliest caves in China to be opened for tourism.  
- It is the top of the "Three Wonders" of Yixing. The cave consists of four sections: Upper, Middle, Lower, and Rear, all of which are interconnected with unique formations. The most extraordinary are the Lower Cave and the Water Cave.  
- Here, you can see delicate and translucent stalactites, as well as magnificent natural boulders. In addition, an underground river flows through the cave.

shortFeatures: Giant bronze sculpture of lotus in bud
summary:
Kowloon Bath, located in the square of Lingshan Giant Buddha, is the largest musical dynamic bronze sculpture group in China, telling the story of Sakyamuni's birth. 
· This is a major landscape of Lingshan Scenic Spot. With the accompaniment of music, the opening and closing of lotus flowers, and the Prince Buddha slowly rises from it, it rotates around in the water curtain formed by the water spray of Jiulong. 
· There are five performances a day. After the performances, the dragon mouth around the square will spray merit water, which visitors can take away; If you want to watch the bathing show in Kowloon, you can choose a location in advance.

shortFeatures: Densely covered with the historical context of Wuxi, a famous capital in the south of the Yangtze River
summary: Go straight along Zhongshan Road to the end is Nanchan Temple, where not only many restaurants gather, but also Wang Xingji is famous, and it is also a place where shopping is concentrated, mostly characteristic markets. If you like shopping, you can try your luck here.

shortFeatures: Representatives of China's New Countryside with Successful Development
summary:
Huaxi Village was built in 1961. Huaxi Village is located in Huashi Town, Jiangyin City, Jiangsu Province. It has a subtropical climate with mild climate and four distinct seasons. 
The richest village in China, I didn't know until I got there. It's no exaggeration. There are whole villas, as well as the "Little Great Wall" and "Little Tiananmen Square". Huaxi Golden Pagoda is a landmark building in Huaxi Village and is known as "the first tower in the world". The tallest building, "New Rural Building in the Sky", can be described as an ultra-luxury building in the village, and there is a golden bull weighing one ton in the building. "Happiness Garden" is a garden that embodies four seasons of "spring, summer, autumn and winter".

Meiyuan is located on the southern slope of Dongshan Mountain and Hushan Mountain in the western suburbs of Wuxi, 7 kilometers away from the urban area and 1.5 kilometers away from Taihu Lake. Plum trees are planted all over the garden, and it is one of the famous plum viewing resorts in the south of the Yangtze River. National AAAA-level tourist attraction, national key cultural relics protection unit, national key park. According to the terrain, combined with the characteristics of plum garden, the garden designer decorates the mountain with plum blossoms, plants plum blossoms against the mountain, plum blossoms are beautiful by the mountain, and the mountain is secluded by plum blossoms, which is unique. There are more than 5,500 plum plants planted in the garden, with a wide variety. There are also Tianxintai, Xixinquan, Qingfenxuan, Zhaohe Pavilion and other scenic spots in the park.

tagNameList: Get closer to nature; A hidden gem for kids; Geological Sites; Caves
shortFeatures: Admire the Stalactites in Various Shapes
summary:
The Tao Zu Sheng Jing is located in Jintang Mountain in the city of Yixing. It was expanded from the original Muli Cave and is adjacent to famous scenic areas such as the Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Xishi Cave, and Panshan Temple.  
The three main attractions within the scenic area are the stalactites of Muli Cave, the bamboo forests covering the mountains, and the pottery-making at Fan Li's pottery workshop. In addition, there are cultural sites related to the love story between Fan Li and Xishi.  
To enter the scenic area, visitors need to travel by waterway. The entire area is not large, and the tour takes about two hours.

Located next to Furong Restaurant, it is called "the most literary tunnel", with a total length of about 1.10 kilometers. It is the longest graffiti tunnel in China. 
· The graffiti in the tunnel is all the youth painted by Xiamen University students, which is inspiring and exquisite. 
The best graffiti are "I love you, goodbye", "Starry Sky", "One Piece-To the Future", etc., which attract many tourists to take photos.

Qinyuan is a piano-themed park, facing Sunlight Rock in the east. 
There are Bird Garden, Audio-visual Museum, Art Gallery and Hero Ode Garden in memory of martyrs in the park. 
Among them, the most attractive one is the Bird Garden, where you can see free-range peacocks and nearly 100 species of birds. 
There are animal performances at designated points every day, so you need to check the time in advance. 
The bird show time begins at 10:30 a.m. daily and is performed for approximately 40 minutes with over 20 shows.

Bishan Cave connects Longtou Road and Neicuo'ao, adjacent to Sanyitang, and not far from the tunnel is Bishan Park. 
The tunnel is short and can be completed in less than five minutes. It is very cool inside the tunnel, and sometimes you can see street performers setting up stalls and singing. 
The deep tunnel was once covered with all kinds of graffiti, most of which were left by passing tourists, and its scale was slightly smaller than the Furong Tunnel.

shortFeatures: White granite masonry
summary: Forty-four Bridges are one of the ten scenic spots of Shuzhuang Garden, located in Shuzhuang Garden, Gulangyu Island, Xiamen. Forty-four bridges made of white granite are winding and undulating like dragons and snakes. It is wonderful to combine artificial and natural. Leaning on the railing of the bridge, outside the Jimu Garden, the autumn water is the same color; Looking back at the garden, red flowers and green leaves support it.

poiName: Pearl on the Sea Observation Tower
tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Observation deck; Observation Decks; Nighttime sightseeing
shortFeatures: Overlooking Kinmen scenery
summary: The Sea Pearl Tower, located at the top of Dongdu Huwei Mountain, integrates the functions of meteorological disaster monitoring, popular science education, tourism and night scene. The tower is equipped with a national intangible cultural heritage hall and a 360-degree panoramic bird's-eye view of the sea garden observation platform. The tower is vase-shaped and has 19 floors in total. It was completed in December 2004, with an altitude of 195 meters at the top. It is the first steel structure building put into use in Xiamen. The podium has astronomy and meteorological science museum and astronomical screening hall. The light green tempered glass exterior wall reflects the tower beautifully, and the modern photoelectric technology makes the tower add a beautiful scenery to the night scene of Xiamen. The radome at the top of the tower looks like a pearl from afar. Today, the tower has become a landmark building in Xiamen.

shortFeatures: Sea-eroded cavern with vast sea views
summary: East China Sea Wonderland is located at the southern foot of Wangye Mountain. Here, there is a natural sea erosion shaft with a diameter of nearly 50 meters and a depth of more than 40 meters called "Immortal Well". The wall of the well is steep and there are three small holes at the bottom of the well connected with the ocean. Next to the "Immortal Well", there is a grand canyon that looks like a crack in the middle of a mountain, which is called Immortal Valley. The East China Sea Wonderland consists of Xianren Well, Xianren Cave, Xianren Valley, Xianren Peak, Xianren Pillar, Xianren Terrace, Xianren Spring, Wangye Zhanggu, Golden Guanyin, Oyster Reef and other landscapes.

shortFeatures: The island is flat and elongated
summary: Tangyu Island is located at the southernmost tip of Pingtan Island and belongs to the jurisdiction of Nanhai Township. The island is flat and long. The southernmost beach of Tangyu Island is a natural crescent-shaped haven beach. The beach shoreline that can be used for swimming and surfing is more than 1,000 meters. The sea water is very clear, the wave height is about 30 ~ 50CM, and the beach flow is gentle. On Tangyu Island, you can see a giant all-male figure-shaped stone figure lying on its back. The giant stone figure, which is four times larger than Leshan Buddha-Haitan Tianshen, has a peculiar shape and vivid image. It is the largest spherical weathered shape of natural granite in the world. The human body is 330 meters long and 150 meters wide, and it is composed of gray-white coarse-grained granite.

shortFeatures: A good place for holiday tourists to play in the water
summary: Dafuwan Resort, close to Jiangjun Mountain Scenic Area in Pingtan. There is a small beach in Dafuwan Resort, which is relatively clean and can be used for holidaymakers to play in the water. Most of the guest rooms face the sea outside the window. You can have a drink by the windowsill and look at the sea, which is very pleasant. Especially at night, there are fishing boats on the sea, which is very beautiful.

poiName: Qingyun Mountain Cloud Sky Stone Gallery
shortFeatures: View the canyon stone corridor, waterfalls and flowing springs
summary: Qingyun Mountain Scenic Area includes five scenic spots: Yuntian Stone Gallery, Jiutian Waterfall, Qinglong Waterfall, Alsophila Valley and Baima Canyon. Yuntian Stone Gallery is located near the top of Qingyun Peak, also known as "Dengtian Gallery". Due to the difference of weathering of soft and hard rock layers, it forms layers of long passages. There are 4 floors in the stone corridor, and people are shocked but not dangerous. There are several hills around Tengshan, with flat slopes, mostly alpine meadows, which are known as "10,000 mu grassland".

shortFeatures: Small old fishing village with many islands
summary: Qida Village, a small fishing village with a history of thousands of years, has a history of more than 300 years. The fishing village was originally surrounded by ancient city walls, but now most of the city walls have been damaged, leaving only four ancient city gates standing tall. The main pattern and roadways of the ancient city are still quite intact. The most beautiful scenery in the village is on the island, from east to west: Dongluo Island, Zhiluo Island and Xiluo Island are juxtaposed. The best viewing place in the village is the sea viewing pavilion on the half slope of Baiyun Mountain, where you can enjoy the mountains and the sea.

Caoyu Island is located in Nanhai Township, Pingtan Comprehensive Experimental Zone, Fujian Province. The island has simple folk customs, beautiful scenery, flourishing vegetation, evergreen all year round and high forest coverage rate. It is also known as the Pearl of Haitan and is an emerald in the Taiwan Province Strait.

summary:
Yongtai Juxi Scenic Area is located in the lower reaches of Dazhangxi River in Yongtai, and the small village in Xikou is named Jukou Village. Take the Yongtai bus from West Railway Station to Jukou. Crossing the river faces the river hill, that is, Longshan Mountain, and the mountain shape is exquisite and delicate. 
The scenic spot is surrounded by mountains and rivers, and the scenery is extremely beautiful. The buildings in the village are built next to Longshan Mountain, mostly made of tiles and wood. The ancient pines on the top of Longshan Mountain are green, and you can see Juxi Creek when you climb to the top. There are eight scenic spots: Longling Pine Wave, Black Dianthus Bamboo Shade, Lutan Dawn Smoke, Wuyan Sunset, Xizhou Clouds, North Shore Sail, Turtle Island Bright Moon, and Niuse Return Tide

shortFeatures: Appreciate the ancient ruins and taste the ancient culture of Fujian and Vietnam
summary: The cultural relics of Tanshishan unearthed by archaeological excavations for more than half a century are exhibited in the museum. It makes full use of sculptures, simulation scenes, multimedia, pictures, written materials, sound, light and other ways to vividly reproduce the production and life scenes of Tanshishan people 5,000 years ago, and also reveals the social consciousness of Tanshishan people, the origin of Tanshishan culture and its close relationship with Neolithic culture on the other side of the Taiwan Strait. The exhibition of the new museum is divided into three parts, including two exhibition halls and the archaeological site hall. The first exhibition hall is the scene hall, which uses sculptures and murals combined with high technology to restore the production and life scenes of Tanshishan people at that time, including several groups of sculptures such as fishing, pottery making, hunting and funerals. The second exhibition hall mainly shows the production, life and social consciousness of Tanshishan people, the origin and flow of Tanshishan culture, and the relationship between Tanshishan culture and Neolithic cultures in neighboring areas, especially with the Neolithic culture of Taiwan Province Island on the other side of the Taiwan Strait. The Hall of Archaeological Sites is a working face of the eighth archaeological excavation and includes a large number of burials, trenches and pottery kiln remains. Three exhibitions, with a total of more than 200 pieces on display. All use some advanced display means, such as computer touch screens, movies, etc., basically effectively use the limited space to transmit the most knowledge.

Baima Canyon Waterfall Scenic Area (the journey takes about 3.5 hours): Walk or take a tour bus (round trip to 20 yuan) to Baima Canyon Waterfall-the largest canyon in southeast China: Guanyin Cave, Cat Playing in the Water, Lion, Baima Waterfall, etc. Baima Canyon Scenic Area is marked by waterfalls, canyons and cliffs. Longguitan Waterfall, Prince Waterfall, Xiayang Waterfall and Baima Waterfall are extremely spectacular with dense fog. Eight canyons, such as Wulong Gorge, Wuming Gorge, Shuangxi Gorge, Wang Zi Gorge, Huiyin Gorge, Baima Gorge, Tianmen Gorge and Pinggu Gorge, have their own characteristics and are wonderful. Liyu Rock, Wang Zifeng, Bajie Rock, Baima Rock and other stone forest rocks are lifelike and lifelike. Yongtai Qingyun Mountain Scenic Spot is located in Linglu Township, Yongtai County, Fujian Province. It is a national key scenic spot with high mountains, lush forests, misty clouds and mist, many strange rocks, secluded valleys and biquan waterfalls.

Jiutouma Residence, located in Qiyang Village, Heshang Town, was built in the Qing Dynasty. It is an ingenious residential building. When you walk into the house, even if you don't know architectural art, you will be deeply attracted by the gorgeous ceiling caisson. The relief is engraved with scenes of folk ancient operas and folk activities, which is very funny. The "Jiutou Horse" building complex faces south, with a basically square plane, 120 meters wide from east to west and 120 meters deep from north to south, and is divided into five columns.

tagNameList: Climb a mountain; Mountains; Mountain Climbing
shortFeatures: Zhu Xi visited here and wrote poems in Song Dynasty
summary: The wall of Wuhu Mountain stands thousands of feet, the valley mouth is deep, and the four gorges are like gates. The situation is dangerous. At the end of the Yuan Dynasty, Chen Youding sent troops to station here, and the Zhaimen site still exists. Within the valley, there are several hectares of flat domains, deep caves, buckling streams, gurgling water, and nearby scenic spots such as Lingbi Rock and Carp Rock. Song Zhu Xi avoided false learning to travel, and built a Yin Cuishan Building in Xiazhuo, leaving the poem "Fangshan": "When you go to the mountain, you don't know the face of the mountain, but you can see the nine-nose Panxi Qu. When I come back, I sit under a small window, leaning on the sky for a hundred feet to pile Han jade." Up to now, the inscription "Yishan Liangshi, where immortals live" still exists on the cliff.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs
shortFeatures: Located on the banks of the beautiful Guihu Creek
summary: "Beauty Valley" is located next to Shanxi Bay in Guihu Lake, with clear and long Shanxi Bay water flowing through the lush mountains. The theme hot spring pool is set on the mountain, with a quiet environment and various choices; The single wooden barrel pool is hidden under the promenade, surrounded by mountains and waters, and has a wide vision; The townhouse single-family leisure soup house is built near the water, with high privacy and unique scenery. In the valley far away from the hustle and bustle of the city, you can be in a hot spring, smell the quiet mountain flowers, listen to the streams, watch the egrets spread their wings, and occasionally the breeze blows your face, which makes you feel comfortable and happy.

tagNameList: Treasure place for walking babies; Hot Springs

shortFeatures: The second hometown of Guanyin Bodhisattva

It is the dojo of Guanyin Bodhisattva. According to the inscription, the temple was founded in the early Northern Wei Dynasty (525), formerly known as Daihai Temple. Legend has it that Guanyin traveled northward and moved to Xingyang. Since then, the moat of Xingyang began to fall with the tide of the sea, so it was named Daihai Temple (meaning instead of the South China Sea), so Daihai Temple became the second hometown of Guanyin Bodhisattva.

Qinglong Mountain, formerly known as Huoshan Mountain and Tianling Mountain, has a thousand-year-old temple Ciyun Temple in the mountain. It was the first Buddhist temple founded by Tianzhu eminent monks Shemo Teng and Zhu Falan after Buddhism was introduced into the Central Plains. It is known as the "source of interpretation" and the "ancestral court" of Buddhism. Baisha Ancient Well, referred to as Baisha Well for short, is called "the first spring in Changsha". Originally, there was only one water in Changsha. By the end of the Ming Dynasty, the water was divided into two eyes, and after many trimming, it was expanded into four eyes. The wellhead was 0.6 meters square, and the spring water poured out from the bottom of the well, which kept going all year round. In the past, there was a Dragon King Temple next to the well. There was a couplet in the temple that wrote: "Changde Deshan Mountain has virtue, but Changsha's sand water has no sand", indicating that the well water is clear and pure.  
The habit of fetching water from Baishajing has lasted for thousands of years, and you can also follow the example of citizens who come to fetch water with all kinds of pots and pots. Tea brewed with Baishajing water is called "Shashui Tea", which is fragrant and sweet. It is said that Changsha's famous wine "Baisha Liquid" is made from the well water of this well.

Changsha Battle Monument, erected by the headquarters of the Ninth Theater of the National Revolutionary Army on July 7, 1941, records the tragic deeds of all the soldiers of the Ninth Theater of the National Revolutionary Army who fought bravely against Japan in September 1939. 
At that time, the Japanese army attacked Changsha in six ways with 180,000 troops. All the soldiers defending the city fought bloody battles, fought loyally and bravely, and the people cooperated to encircle and ambush, and won the victory of annihilating 30,000 enemies. It was called "the first battle of Changsha" in history.

tagNameList: Hi Fun Park; Kid's Treasure Spot; Indoor Skiing; Ice and Snow Parks
shortFeatures: Large indoor ski resort; professional ski instruction services; 17,000 square meters of snow and ice amusement area.
summary:
Guangzhou Snow Miracle covers an area of approximately 75,000 square meters, with temperatures consistently maintained between -6°C and 0°C. It can accommodate around 3,000 visitors at the same time, making it the indoor snow venue with the most diverse snow-related activities and ski slopes.  
The ski area features five slopes of varying difficulty, including practice slopes for beginners on both snowboards and skis, as well as beginner, intermediate, and advanced slopes. Among them, the world's first two 3D-crossing ski slopes offer intermediate and advanced skiers a unique challenge and fun. Additionally, the beginner slope and the ski practice slopes are connected by a buffer zone, forming an ultra-long indoor alpine ski slope of approximately 460 meters.  
The snow play area includes seven attractions, such as Snow Disc, Glacier Leap, Ice Bike, and Ice Bumper Cars, along with two themed areas: Frozen Planet and Polar Bear’s Home. These allow visitors to enjoy the fun of snow and ice under the sunny skies of southern China.  
Whether enjoying family time in the snow or the thrill of skiing, Guangzhou Snow Miracle (Sunac Snow World) offers a 360-degree cool experience, bringing the grand snow carnival to visitors 365 days a year!  
The venue provides free rental of ski suits, ski boots, helmets, and skis, along with disposable socks. Ski enthusiasts may also bring their own equipment.  

**Ski Area**  
The ski area has a total vertical drop of about 66 meters, with five slopes of varying difficulty, ranging from 7.6° to 21° in gradient, and an average width of approximately 35 meters. The snow thickness is maintained at about 50 cm year-round. The uphill facilities include one two-person chairlift and five magic carpets.  

**Snowboard Practice Slope**  
The slope is wide, with a width of about 35 meters and a length of about 70 meters, with a gradient of around 10°. It is slightly steeper than most snowboard practice slopes, so beginners are advised to practice on flat areas first to master basic stances and stopping techniques before boldly attempting new moves from the top.  

**Bear Slope**  
The Bear Slope is wide, measuring about 50 meters in width and 70 meters in length, with a gradient of approximately 8°. It is relatively gentle, making it suitable for beginners. Children can confidently practice here.  

**Snow Rabbit Slope**  
The Snow Rabbit Slope is about 35 meters wide, 300 meters long, and has a gradient of around 10°. It is the most popular slope in the snow park, with the highest skier density. This slope is ideal for those who have mastered basic skiing stances, falling, and stopping. It is also perfect for practicing ground tricks for both snowboard and ski enthusiasts, earning it the nickname “Ground Trick Avenue.”  

**Moose Slope**  
The Moose Slope is about 35 meters wide and 230 meters long, with an average gradient of about 14.8°. It is suitable for intermediate and advanced skiers. The upper section has a gradient of about 18°, testing your stability and skill on steeper slopes, while the lower section, with a gradient of around 10-12°, allows for a full carving experience. Additionally, there are mushroom and wavy paths in the lower section for an extraordinary terrain experience.  

**Tiger Slope**  
The Tiger Slope is about 35 meters wide and 220 meters long, with an average gradient of 16.8°. As the terrain park is located on this slope, it is frequented by the most skilled skiers in the venue. Skiers can often be seen practicing tricks on the props and ramps here.  

**Snow Disc**  
Sit on an inflatable snow disc shaped like a flying saucer and race down from the top of the mountain. The refreshing snow wind hits your face as you speed down to the bottom in the blink of an eye, offering a thrilling and exhilarating snow experience.  
**Requirements**: Passengers must weigh less than 90 kg. Children under 1.2 meters must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Ice Bumper Cars**  
The smooth ice surface reduces friction, adding excitement to the bumper car game, allowing you to experience a popular winter activity even in the south.  
**Requirements**: Children under 1 meter must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Adventure Trail**  
The first indoor adventure trail at a ski resort in China combines fun, entertainment, and challenges of height, speed, strength, and endurance. Feel the thrill and the sense of achievement in overcoming obstacles.  
**Requirements**: Visitors must be over 1.4 meters tall and weigh less than 100 kg. Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Ice Bicycle**  
Ride a bicycle on the smooth ice – a fun and unexpected experience for those in southern China. It is a family-friendly ice activity.  
**Requirements**: Visitors must be over 1 meter tall. Children under 1.2 meters must be accompanied by an adult.  

**Glacier Leap**  
The first indoor ski resort with a dual-direction ski lift.

summary:
Shenzhen Dapeng Peninsula National Geological Natural Park is located in the southeasternmost Dapeng Peninsula of Shenzhen. The geological heritage protection area covers an area of about 46.07 square kilometers. In 2005, it was rated as a national geological park. 
The types of geological relics in the park are mainly ancient volcanic relics formed by five volcanic eruptions about 146 million years ago and coastal landscapes formed in 20,000 to 10,000 years ago. The uncanny workmanship of nature has created the unique landscape here. 
The main peak of Qiniang Mountain formed by volcanic eruption is about 869.7 meters above sea level, making it the second highest peak in Shenzhen. The stretching coastline was rated as one of the "eight most beautiful coasts in China" by China National Geographic. 
The park is divided into four scenic spots: Qiongqiu Travel Scenic Spot, Haishi Wonder Scenic Spot, Luzui Tide Watching Scenic Spot and Buxi Yangmei Scenic Spot. Based on the needs of geological relics and natural environment protection, the areas officially open to the public in the park are "Qiongqiu Tour" and "Luzui Tide Watching", with museum scenic spots, main peak scientific research line and Luyan scientific research line.

shortFeatures: Experience the joys of hiking
summary: Meilin Reservoir is located north of Meilin Village, a large residential area in Futian District, Shenzhen, and east of Tanglang Mountain. The normal water storage level is 58.60 meters, and the protected area is 4.34 square kilometers. This is a hiking route that outdoor enthusiasts like. The air is very good and there are not many people. Walk along the reservoir all the way. After staying in the city for a long time, you will feel far away from the downtown area and close to nature.

Later, with the development of the city and the transfer of industries, the float glass factory moved out in 2009. Until the 2013 Biennale, this old factory took on a new look. At the same time, in the movie Mermaid directed by Stephen Chow, the mermaid research laboratory, sonar laboratory and panoramic glass conference room, which appeared many times, were shot here.
