shortFeatures: Remember the martyrs and remember history
summary: Dongjiang Column Memorial Hall In the history of China's Anti-Japanese War, a special unit has made a brilliant record. This anti-Japanese armed force isolated behind enemy lines in South China-during the eight-year war of resistance, it didn't get direct support from the CPC Central Committee. In difficult times, it didn't even have a radio station, and only relied on the radio to listen to the news of Yan'an Xinhua Radio Station. This is the heroic Dongjiang column. The memorial hall covers an area of 5,000 square meters and has a building area of 1,500 square meters. It consists of a hall, an exhibition hall, a cultural relics hall and a martyr's name monument. According to the development process of Dongjiang Column, the exhibition hall is divided into parts: the giant relief in the preface hall shows the elegant demeanor of anti-Japanese soldiers and civilians. As soon as you enter the gate, it is the preface hall, and on the oncoming wall is a V-shaped giant relief, symbolizing the victory of the Chinese people's War of Resistance against Japan. The fists and weapons above show the strong fighting spirit of Dongjiang anti-Japanese soldiers and civilians to resist foreign aggression. The undulating reliefs on both sides symbolize the winding Dongjiang water. The left side shows the scene of Dongjiang people rising up to fight against the Japanese aggressors, and the right side shows the scene of Dongjiang column bravely killing the enemy. The relief is made of red sandstone with Dongguan regional characteristics, and the song score of "Song of Dongjiang Column" is engraved on the gray cement wall above the relief. There is also an electronic sand table in the preface hall, which can intuitively understand the scope of activities of Dongjiang column. The first exhibition hall: a comprehensive introduction to the development process of Dongjiang Column. From the preface hall to visit each exhibition hall, you can fully understand the development process of Dongjiang Column. The theme of the first exhibition hall is "The Outbreak of War of Resistance against Japan, China". The display shape of the exhibition hall imitates the blue brick wall of the former anti-Japanese site in Dawangling Village, with pieces of ruins and numerous bullet marks, creating a historical atmosphere filled with smoke and broken mountains and rivers in the war years. It shows photos of leaders of party organizations in Dongjiang area, as well as some anti-Japanese propaganda photos, materials and party documents in Dongguan at that time. The second exhibition hall: Phantom imaging reproduces the Battle of Baihuadong. The second exhibition hall introduces the establishment of Dongjiang Anti-Japanese Base Area. It uses the typical blue brick wall and mud brick wall of Dawangling Village, an old revolutionary base area of Dongjiang Column, as the layout shape, which sets off the historical atmosphere of uniting the military and civilians in the base area to resist Japan. The most special thing about this exhibition hall is that it is equipped with a set of phantom imaging equipment with the largest imaging scale in China at present. It adopts one-to-one imaging technology, coupled with advanced sound, photoelectric and scene restoration technology, and a short film of about 4 minutes vividly reproduces the scene of the most famous battle of Dalingshan soldiers and civilians beating the Japanese aggressors-the Battle of Baihuadong. The third exhibition hall: Overseas Chinese compatriots from Hong Kong and Macao support the Anti-Japanese War After watching the high-tech reproduction of real scenes, we stepped into the third exhibition hall, where we introduce the support of overseas Chinese compatriots from Hong Kong and Macao to the Dongjiang Anti-Japanese War, as well as the Hong Kong and Kowloon Anti-Japanese War and rescue operations. Part of this exhibition hall adopts a curved streamlined layout, which symbolizes the attachment and support of overseas Chinese and Hong Kong and Macao compatriots to the motherland, as well as the anti-Japanese spirit of unity. The fourth exhibition hall: The wax figure highlights the deep affection between military and civilians in the base area. The largest exhibition hall is the fourth exhibition hall, which introduces the development of guerrilla warfare behind enemy lines in Dongjiang. The exhibition hall is octagonal, and the development stages before and after the establishment of Dongjiang Column are set off by adopting exhibition plates with different colors. Here, the objects used by leaders of the Dongjiang Column, such as Lin Ping, Wang Zuoyao and Yang Kanghua, are displayed, and the scene paintings of the inaugural meeting of the Dongjiang Column are also displayed through semi-scene artistic techniques. The memorial hall also uses wax figures to show the scene of Dalingshan people supporting the guerrillas. The masses send food, eggs and other items to the guerrillas, and the villagers actively send their children to join the army. The scene skillfully combines wax figures, scenery and background painting, which intuitively and vividly reproduces the scene of the people in the base areas supporting the Anti-Japanese War. There are four exhibition halls downstairs in the fifth exhibition hall. Next, we went upstairs to visit the fifth exhibition hall. The content of this exhibition hall is to introduce the Dongjiang Column to cooperate with the Allied Forces to win the Anti-Japanese War. Part of the exhibition hall adopts the way of hanging layout, breaking the limitation of flat exhibition layout, so as to set off the historical atmosphere of winning the victory of the Anti-Japanese War. The exhibits reflect events such as the troops rescuing American pilots, cooperating with the allied forces to carry out intelligence work, carrying out the surrender struggle, and swept the Dongguan-Taiyuan line to win the Anti-Japanese War. The sixth exhibition hall withdraws from Shandong to the north and south. The sixth exhibition hall introduces withdrawing from Shandong to the north and south. The main force of the Dongjiang Column was ordered to withdraw northward from the Shandong Liberated Area in June 1946. In March 1947, the Guangdong and Guangxi Columns of the Chinese People's Liberation Army were established and moved to East China. The commanders and fighters who stayed in the Sadongjiang column in Guangdong developed into the Guangdong-Jiangxi-Hunan border column of the Chinese People's Liberation Army. In September, 1949, the Guangdong and Guangxi columns were ordered to go south and fight together with the Guangdong, Jiangxi and Hunan border columns, liberating Guangzhou, Huizhou and Dongguan successively. The exhibition hall displays photos of Guangzhou soldiers and civilians celebrating liberation, Guangdong, Jiangxi and Hunan border columns entering Dongguan County and Dongguan people's gathering to celebrate. The Seventh Exhibition Hall entrusts people's deep memory of the predecessors of the East Vertical Revolution. The spatial shape of the Seventh Exhibition Hall is like a group of cheerful peace doves flying freely in a blue sky, which entrusts people's deep memory of the predecessors of the East Vertical Revolution. The four statues in the exhibition hall with the theme of "Praise of Heroes" are Zeng Sheng, commander of Dongjiang Column, Lin Ping, political commissar, Wang Zuoyao, deputy commander and chief of staff, and Yang Kanghua, director of the political department. An electronic screen scrolls to display the list of martyrs of Dongjiang Column, as well as a group of photos of central leaders cordially receiving the main leaders of Dongjiang Column.

Shenzhen Wangye Museum was approved by the Department of Culture in February 2009 and reported to the State Administration of Cultural Heritage for the record. It officially opened on October 21st, 2012, and the logo of Wangye Museum was inscribed by Mr. Su Bai, a professor from Peking University. The site is located on the third floor of Longhua Cultural Center, Longhua District, Shenzhen. It is a non-state-owned museum that mainly collects, displays, researches and exhibits ancient cultural relics. It covers an area of 2120 ㎡. There are nearly 10,000 pieces of cultural relics and more than 40,000 pieces of specimens in the collection, including rare relics and unique collections in the world. After two grading appraisals, there are 55 national first-class cultural relics, 81 second-class cultural relics and 68 third-class cultural relics in the collection. At present, it is the unit with the largest collection of national first-class cultural relics among all state-owned and non-state-owned cultural relics collection institutions under the jurisdiction of Shenzhen.

Houhai Tianhou Temple was built in the Ming Dynasty. The temple was destroyed many times and rebuilt many times. Houtianhou Temple has a five-bay and two-entrance layout, including a mountain gate, a sacrificial pavilion, two corridors, two wing rooms, two halls on both sides and the main hall. Under the eaves and beams of the temple, there are painted flowers, birds, fish and insects, which are vivid.

shortFeatures: Chinese-style golden roof building
summary: The Hong Kong Railway Museum is a branch of the Hong Kong Heritage Museum. It is a museum dedicated to the history of the Kowloon-Canton Railway. It is a unique traditional Chinese building with a golden top. The museum is located at 13 Shung Tak Street, Tai Po Market. Although this museum is small in scale, it is unique. This is a unique Chinese-style golden-roofed building, which was built at the old Tai Po Market Railway Station in 1913. In 1984, the railway station was listed as a statutory monument and is free and open to the public. The museum displays pictures and materials about railway historical materials, railway equipment and train models, etc. Outside the museum, there are also a section of old railway and turnouts, ancient arm signal machines, ancient locomotives and vehicles, etc.

summary:
The Hong Kong Film Archive is located at 50 Lei King Road, Sai Wan Ho, Hong Kong Island. It is a 4-story building and a main building.
The area is 7200 square meters. The building is divided into two parts, with half of each floor serving as a collection room. The other half is an exhibition hall, a movie theater, and a resource center for reference purposes.
The museum promotes Hong Kong film art for Hong Kong citizens and provides a large amount of information for film workers and researchers. The museum currently collects more than 5600 film copies, the earliest of which is a short scenery documentary filmed by the American Edison Company in Hong Kong in 1898. The museum also collects film-related materials, including: stills, scripts, movie posters, movie soundtracks, film special issues and contract documents, film awards, props, etc.

shortFeatures: Hiking trails running through the New Territories
summary:
· MacLehose Trail is a famous hiking route and the longest hiking trail in Hong Kong. 
· The MacLehose Trail is divided into 10 sections, each with a length of 5 to 16 kilometres. It runs from Sai Kung in the west to Tuen Mun in the east, and runs through the east and west of the New Territories of Hong Kong. 
The trail spans 8 of Hong Kong's 23 country parks, and it has to climb over more than 20 hills along the way, including Niuer Stone Mountain, Ma On Shan, Cao Shan and Tai Mo Shan.

Fei'e Mountain is located in the Baihua Forest of Fei'e Mountain, where the tomb of Dr. Sun Yat-sen's mother is located. The Hong Kong Scout Association has Keevel Camp at Fei Ngo Shan. 
Fei Ngo Shan is located at the junction of Wong Tai Sin, Kwun Tong, Sai Kung and Sha Tin districts in Hong Kong, also known as Kowloon Peak. With a height of 602 meters, it is the highest mountain in Kowloon. Visitors can enjoy the scenery of the whole Kowloon Peninsula, the north coast of Hong Kong Island, Sha Tin and Ho Chung offshore. It is now zoned as part of Ma On Shan Country Park. In Fei Ng Shan, you can enjoy the vast sea and dozens of islands in Sai Kung, as well as the panoramic view of Kowloon and Hong Kong Island. It is also one of the good places for many people to drive for outings on Sundays. It is also a good place for people to fly kites and model airplanes. Therefore, there are many bright kites and model airplanes flying in the sky on Sunday. The Hong Kong Scout Association has Keevel Camp at Fei Ngo Shan. There is no bus arrival in Fei'e Mountain, and tourists mainly arrive by car or taxi. Because of this, Fei'e Mountain has become a place for many couples to talk about love; Many TV programs are also shot here.

The Hong Kong Maritime Museum is located on the ground floor of Murray House, Stanley Plaza, Stanley, Hong Kong. The construction of the Hong Kong shipping industry enthusiasts started in late 2003 and officially opened on September 8, 2005. It aims to showcase the history of shipping along the south China coast and the role played by Hong Kong. It is run by Hong Kong International Shipping Group. Tung Chee-hwa, vice chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, is the honorary patron of the museum. 
The whole museum is divided into two parts: ancient museum and modern museum.

summary: Big Wave Bay is a large bay in Hong Kong. It is located in the eastern part of Sai Kung Peninsula in the New Territories, facing the South China Sea. It is mainly composed of four bays: West Wan, Ham Tin Wan, Great Wan and East Wan. Together with the Anaconda Tip, the peak in the north of Big Wave Bay, it is collectively called "One Tip and Four Bays" and is also known as one of the "Four Wonders of Hong Kong".

shortFeatures: Starting point of visiting Lantau Island
summary: Mui Wo is located in the southeast of Lantau Island, Hong Kong, and the district is administratively an Islands District. Mui Wo, also known as Silver Mine Bay, is named after two silver mines in the former valley. Song Emperor Min and his attendants once took refuge here, and Mui Wo was stained with glory. Now, the old market is surrounded by new buildings. There are shops selling snacks near the ferry terminal. Across the river is the old market, which is also the hub of land and water transportation on Lantau Island. Outside the ferry terminal is the bus terminal, and there are shops, restaurants and markets nearby. Walking along the coast is where Silver Mine Bay Beach is located.

shortFeatures: Appreciate the essence of Hong Kong culture
summary:
The Hong Kong Heritage Museum, located at No.1 Man Lam Road, Sha Tin, is a comprehensive museum in Hong Kong, covering various fields of history, art and culture. The design of the museum adopts the traditional Chinese courtyard layout and combines modern architectural techniques, which is very distinctive. 
With the theme of caring for Hong Kong's nature and understanding Hong Kong's history, the "Children's Discovery Hall" in the Hong Kong Heritage Museum leads children to discover the mysteries of archaeology. The exhibition "Hong Kong Children's Play" is set up to attract the active participation of visitors through games and interactions. "Zhao Shaoang Art Museum" is named after Professor Zhao Shaoang, a master of Chinese painting in Lingnan School. It mainly displays Professor Zhao's masterpieces, manuscripts and sketches. The "New Territories Heritage Museum" is a long-term exhibition hall dedicated to the history of the New Territories. Visitors can shuttle through eight time tunnels, namely, Natural Environment, Prehistoric Life, Trade and Coastal Defense, Fishermen's Glimpses, Countryside Landscape, British Governance, New Town Development and Future Construction, and learn about the historical and social changes in the New Territories over the years. "Cantonese Opera Heritage Museum" allows visitors to experience the feeling of being in the theater and backstage. Unique Cantonese opera costumes, cosmetics and documents are displayed in the showcase, and the eucalyptus stalls in the museum give visitors the opportunity to relive the past performances and feel the unique opera art of Guangdong Province. The Hong Kong Heritage Museum is a leisure and cultural service.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the sunset
summary: Tai Tung Shan is the third highest mountain in Hong Kong, with an altitude of 869 meters, second only to Tai Mo Shan (958 meters) and Phoenix Mountain (934 meters). Tai Dongshan is located in the east of Lantau Island in the New Territories, and its vicinity is included in South Lantau Country Park.

shortFeatures: The king of movie comedy is shot here
summary: Shek O Beach is located in the southern district of Hong Kong Island, where many Hong Kong dramas are filmed. Anyone who has seen "The King of Comedy" should be familiar with it. This small beach is also the place where Liu Piaopiao "wiped lipstick" on Yin Tianchou. This place is particularly beautiful because of the story of Master Xing. Looking at the small broken boat and the small beach, we sit together and wait for dawn.

Qi'ao Island is the only way to Lingdingyang and the cross-sea bridge. It has a long history. There are 17 temples built in Song and Qing Dynasties on the island. 
The island has historic sites such as Su Zhaozheng's former residence, Shawan Ancient Site and Baishi Street, as well as natural scenic spots such as Mangrove Wetland Reserve and Qi'ao Bay. 
· The main attraction on the island is the mangrove wetland reserve, where more than 100,000 migratory birds come to spend the winter every winter, making it the best choice for bird watching enthusiasts.

· Hebao Island has a good ecological environment, clear and transparent sea water and fine sea sand, and is known as "Ten Miles of Silver Beach". 
· There are eight bay streams on the island, including Danan Bay, Zangbao Bay (Gem Beach), and Gongtong Bay, forming a picture of the sea and sky Buddhism. 
· In addition to natural landscapes such as beaches, forests and butterfly valleys, there are also trenches, tunnels and fishing villages for tourists to visit. 
In addition to the natural scenery of tropical virgin forests, there are also amusement projects such as sightseeing around the island, tent camping and bonfire parties. 
· The development is limited and the facilities are primitive. It is recommended to bring more snacks before going to the island. You can rent tents and cabins by the sea for camping on the island.

summary: Huitong Village was founded in Huitong Ancient Village, which has a history of more than 280 years in the tenth year of Yongzheng in Qing Dynasty (1732). It is the best preserved modern village in Zhuhai. The well-known grandparents and grandchildren of Mo Shiyang, Mo Zaoquan and Mo Gansheng have operated Swire Foreign Company in Hong Kong for more than 60 years and made important contributions to the early development and construction of Hong Kong. The Mo family quoted nearly 1,000 villagers to go out to start businesses and make a living, and introduced the achievements of western material civilization to China to promote the economic development of the mainland. At the same time, they built bridges, paved roads, built ancestral halls and run righteous schools for their hometown, so that villagers used electric lights and watched movies in the 1920s, and were known as a model township. In recent years, governments at all levels in Zhuhai have attached great importance to the protection and development of Huitong ancient villages, scientifically planned rural revitalization, coordinated rural revitalization and urban development, optimized public cultural services, made ancient villages glow with new opportunities, and attracted tourists from all over the world with their unique artistic atmosphere.

shortFeatures: Beautiful scenery of trees and rocks on the climbing road
summary:
Lingding Peak is the main peak on Wailingding Island, with a height of 311.8 meters. Because of the many slopes, it usually takes about 1 hour to climb to the top of the mountain. 
All the way through Acacia Forest, Observation Deck, Beidi Morning Bell, Wishing Well and other landscapes. The trees on the road are lush and the environment is fresh. 
The top of the mountain can also overlook the whole island, and the scenery is very open. You can also see the beautiful scenery composed of rugged rocks and ethereal clouds on the mountain.

shortFeatures: Chinese and Western Garden Building Complex
summary: Xiaxian Pavilion is one of the three ancient gardens in Zhuhai, located in the southwest of Huitong Village on the bank of Tangjiawan in Xiangshan, Zhuhai. Its owner is the grandson of Mo Shiyang, a comprador Chinese of Swire Foreign Company in Hong Kong (ancestral home of Huitong Village). In memory of his original wife Zheng Yuxia, it was built in the second year of Xuantong in Qing Dynasty (AD 1910). It covers an area of 15 mu (10,000 square meters) Chinese and Western garden buildings. It is planted with precious flowers and fruits, green shade, birds and flowers, pleasant environment and beautiful scenery.

shortFeatures: A half-moon bay
summary:
Xianglu Bay is a half-moon-shaped bay, named after fishermen who landed here in the past and worshipped Xianglu Cave in Shijingshan.  
There is a mountain at the bottom of a boat that extends into the sea, dividing Xianglu Bay into two beautiful bay rings, like water chestnuts in the water, so these two bay rings are also called "water chestnut mouths". 
Here, the blue sea and silver beach, the green forest is like a belt, the seagulls are chasing the waves, and the sails are passing through, making the scenery picturesque.  
· Located on Lovers Road, it adds a modern and romantic atmosphere to Zhuhai. Whenever night falls, the lights are on, the sea is dotted with fishing fires, and the night is charming.

summary: Gaolan Island was called "Gaolan" in ancient times, which means that "five peaks are like fingers, and there are many orchids in the valley". Its "flying sand wonder" since ancient times is a rare wonder in southern China, and it is the natural coastal navigation mark of the ancient Maritime Silk Road. The mountains on the island are undulating, the vegetation is dense, and there are many ornamental plants such as cactus, eucalyptus tenufolia and casuarina equisetifolia. The natural stone scenery is strange, the cliffs are steep and steep, and the coast is tortuous. What is particularly fascinating is the desert on the island. Dafei Beach is embraced by stone mountains on both sides, and the beach has wide windbreaks, so the natural conditions are quite superior. In addition, seven beaches, such as Baisha Bay, Xisha Bay and Crab Claw Bay, are continuous, with different scenery, quiet and dusty.

summary: Jiuzhou Island is located on the Jiuzhou Ocean on the west side of the Pearl River Estuary, two kilometers away from Jiuzhou Port in Zhuhai City. The main island covers an area of only about 0.2 square kilometers. It is a provincial tourist resort in Guangdong Province. The island has lush trees, verdant full moon, beautiful green trees, secluded valleys and beautiful forests, including Casuarina equisetifolia, banyan trees, eucalyptus tenufolia, fir trees, longan trees, guava trees, etc.

shortFeatures: Named for its shape like a pole
summary: The geology of Dangan Island is granite structure. There are 9 large and small stone caves in the island. The surface is yellow sand clay, with many exposed rocks. Low thatch and shrubs grow mixed, and there are a few pines and acacia trees between them. From northeast to southwest, the terrain is high in the middle and low at both ends. There are harbor docks on the island, water supply, oil supply and other facilities, and roads leading to major harbors, with a total length of 11.5 kilometers. There are regular boats going to and from Xiangzhu and Tang's family every week. Dangan Waterway is the only channel for large ships to lead to Hong Kong, Guangzhou and Shantou.

shortFeatures: Exploring underground river caves
summary: Jinshuiyan is the largest, most distinctive, most exciting and world-famous underground river crystal cave in Yangshuo. It crosses three mountains and is about five kilometers long. The upper and lower floors of the cave are divided into three areas, namely, dry cave paradise area, mud bath area and underground river hot spring area. The stalactites in the cave are majestic and abrupt, criss-crossing, just like the "Dragon Palace". There is a 200-meter flyover scenic road outside the cave carefully designed for tourists, where you can enjoy the scenery of Shili Gallery and start to enter the dry cave paradise area, which lasts about 50 minutes. In the cave, you can see the natural image of "God Bodhisattva", which is the treasure of the town cave, as well as the Undersea Dragon Palace, the Throne of Monkey King and the Imperial Umbrella of the Palace. There is no artificial modification in the cave, and the most primitive karst features are maintained. The imperial palace umbrella made of strange stones, with the projection of lights, looks solemn and majestic, just like the imperial umbrella of Cheluo when the emperor traveled in ancient times. The top skylight is naturally formed, and the spiral escalator design adds European style. It is really unique to marvel at the uncanny workmanship of nature. The natural skylight adds the mysterious characteristics of Bodhisattva Water Rock.

summary: Lingchuan Qingshitan Scenic Spot is located in the upper reaches of Lijiang River, 28 kilometers away from Guilin City and 19 kilometers away from Lingchuan County. The scenic spot consists of East Lake, West Lake and Fair Lake, with a total area of 170 square kilometers, a lake area of about 30 square kilometers, a land area of 141.7 square kilometers and a lake water capacity of 600 million cubic meters. It is known as "the first lake in South China". It is the closest and largest primitive ecological nature reserve to Guilin.

Huangluo Yaozhai is known as the first long-haired village in the world. Because there are more than 60 women in the village, all of whom have black hair more than one meter long, and the longest one is 2.1 meters. In 2002, this village also won the Guinness Book of World Records certificate for group long hair. 
After staggering across a long chain bridge, we really entered the village. Customs and folk feelings are rich in the stockade, and most photographic works with the theme of long hair need to be paid at their own expense. You can also enjoy Yaozhai style performances in the stockade. 
One difference can be paid attention to during the tour, the difference between unmarried and married Hongyao girls: the former needs to be wrapped in cloth and can't be exposed, and only her future husband can get a glimpse of her hair; The latter can be exposed in the bun.

shortFeatures: Admire ancient architecture and century-old persimmon trees.
Caves in the Mountains and Beautiful Cherry Blossoms
summary: The Nanshi Mountain is only one kilometer away from Guilin Railway Station. It was first discovered by Li Bo, the Guilin Inspector, during the Tang Dynasty. To this day, there are still stone inscriptions of his poem "Liu Bie Nanxi" in the cave. Since Nanshi Mountain was developed early, nearly 200 stone carvings from the Tang Dynasty to the present can be found on the cliffs. The highest cave in Nanshi Mountain is the White Dragon Cave, which is 20 meters high. The outer cave is bright, spacious, and flat, so visitors don’t have to worry about camera exposure. At the entrance of Nanshi Mountain Park, there is a stone tablet inscribed with the words "Guilin's mountains and waters are the best under heaven" by Wang Zhenggong from the Song Dynasty. Every March, visitors can also enjoy the cherry blossoms in the park.

summary:
It is said that the ancestors of Ancient Stone City ran to the mountains to escape the war and gradually became a village. Therefore, the whole village was the descendant of one ancestor, and now there are hundreds of people. Houses are built with local materials, so almost all of them are stone houses, stone roads, stone wells and stone flat. Stone City has a long history, and its construction date is still a mystery. It is one of the best preserved ancient cities in Guangxi. 
Along the mountain road, you can enjoy the karst landform from a commanding position. You can find villagers' homes cooking farm dishes in Shitouzhai or Dayantou Village. After eating, continue to walk east, pass through Daping Village and Shuiyanmen Mountain to Xianggong Mountain, which is one of the best shooting spots of Lijiang River. There is a platform on the top of the mountain, which is a relatively easy mountain to climb. The best shooting time is 6:00, and it is a good place to watch the sunrise of the mountains of Lijiang River and the first bay of Lijiang River.

shortFeatures: Reproducing the lifestyle of the ancient inhabitants of Guilin
summary:
- Located near the famous "Ten-Mile Gallery," it encapsulates the wisdom of the ancestors of the Nanyue culture and is one of the origins of Lingnan culture.
- Exhibits include stone tools, pottery, natural totem poles, and ancient bows and crossbows, representing scenes of primitive life.
- It recreates the historical lifestyle, religion, hunting practices, and Zengpi culture of the ancestors of Guilin from ten thousand years ago.

summary:
Longtan Village, located 1km west of Moon Mountain, has a history of more than 500 years. summary: Yunnan Art Museum is a non-profit public welfare art museum with legal personality under the leadership of Yunnan Provincial Department of Culture and open to the public. Its purpose is to adhere to the party's literary and artistic principles and policies and carry forward national culture. Support art creation activities, activate academic exchanges, and make due contributions to the development of Yunnan art and the construction of socialist spiritual civilization. The main business is to collect, study, exhibit and popularize art education of various forms of outstanding art works in modern Yunnan, so as to improve national cultural and artistic accomplishment and spiritual sentiment. Yunnan Art Museum has been established for 24 years. Yunnan Painting Academy (including the former Fine Arts Photography Office of the Provincial Department of Culture) has successfully hosted more than 20 national medium-sized art exhibitions since its establishment 32 years ago, and conducted art exchange activities with some provinces, cities, Hong Kong and Macao regions in China. By visiting and receiving artists and art professional institutions in the United States, Italy, Japan, Australia, Germany and other countries, Yunnan Painting School has promoted Yunnan's international and regional exchanges. Over the years, he has won more than 30 national art exhibitions, national print exhibitions, national individual art exhibitions and overseas art awards. Yunnan Art Museum has a collection of more than 100 outstanding works by modern and contemporary domestic and local painters, more than 100 ancient murals (copies) of Yunnan ethnic minorities, more than 300 silver ornaments of Yunnan ethnic minorities and more than 100 handicrafts of Yunnan ethnic minorities. 120 pieces of excellent out-of-print woodcuts in Yunnan.

Under the blue sky, the snow-capped mountains are like crystal clear jade dragons, looking at Haba Snow-capped Mountains in the distance. The songs of Tibetan girls in the distance line the quaint wooden houses and Mani piles, which are mysterious and romantic.

tagNameList: Ancient towns and villages; Nature and Adventure; Ancient Towns; Terraced Fields
shortFeatures: A mountain town made of rock
summary:
Baoshan Stone City is located in Baoshan Township, Yulong Naxi Autonomous County, Lijiang City, Yunnan Province. It is located in the Jinsha River Canyon northeast of Yulong Snow Mountain. It covers an area of about 0.5 square kilometers. It is built on a raised natural mushroom-shaped rock and relies on the characteristics of the landform to build a complete defense system, hence the name Stone City. Naxi language is called "Laberu Panwu", which means "Baoshan Baishi Village". 
Baoshan Stone City is surrounded by Jinsha River in the east, Yak Ridge in the west, Taiziguan in the north, Yankedu in the south, and overlapping terraced fields around it, forming a dangerous terrain of "three mountains as screens and one facing the river". Stone City is surrounded by cliffs on three sides, south and northwest, and the steep slope in the east plunges directly into Jinsha River. Only two stone gates in the north and south can be accessed. 
Shitoucheng is divided into inner city and outer city. The dwellings in the city are typical Naxi wooden houses and wooden tile houses, which are typical examples of studying the formation and development of traditional Naxi villages. It was built from Yuan to Yuan Dynasty (1264-1294), and it was the place where ancient Qiang descendants migrated southward across Sichuan and Yunnan, and it was also the first settlement of Shuyou clan in Yunnan.

Qinling Zhongnanshan Global Geopark is located in the main part of the collision and fusion of the north and south continental plates of China. It is the dividing line between the north and south of China's natural geology, geography, ecology, climate, environment and even humanities. It is known as "China Natural Zoo" and "Asia Natural Botanical Garden". 
The park consists of Cuihuashan Landslide Landform Park, Lishan Rift Barrier Structural Park, Ice Crystal Top Ductile Shear Zone and Tectonic Mixed Lithization Park, Yushan Island Arc Granite Peak Ridge Landform Park, South Taibai Plate Collision Suture Zone and Quaternary Glacier Park and other five parks with unique themes and interconnections.

shortFeatures: Display historical materials of the Xi'an Incident
summary: Zhang Xueliang Mansion is located in Jinjia Lane, Jianguo Road (now No. 69 Jianguo Road), the mansion of General Zhang Xueliang, the former general of the Northeast Army. After the "Xi'an Incident" on December 12, 1936, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China received telegrams from Zhang Xueliang and General Yang Hucheng, and sent a delegation from Zhou Enlai, Ye Jianying, Qin Bangxian and others to Xi'an, where they stayed. Here, he established the strategy of peacefully resolving the "Xi'an Incident" with Generals Zhang and Yang Er. After liberation, it was built as a memorial hall for people to visit.

poiName: Xi'an Tang Imperial City Wall Hanguang Gate Site Museum
summary: Xi'an Tang Emperor City Wall Hanguangmen Ruins Museum is located at No.136, west section of Huancheng South Road, Lianhu District, Xi'an. The Hanguangmen section of Ming City Wall contains the ruins of Chang'an City Wall in Tang Dynasty. It is also an entrance to the city wall of Dengxi. Honglu Temple, which received foreign guests in the Tang Dynasty, was also located in Hanguang Gate. At that time, it was the "customs" for businessmen from the Western Regions to enter Chang'an City. The museum is divided into two halls: east and west. The layout of the whole Hanguangmen Site Museum is divided into east hall, middle hall and west hall.

The temple was built in the ninth year of Yongle in Ming Dynasty (1411), and was purchased by Mr. Ma Daozhen. In 1959, it was occupied for other purposes, resulting in disrepair and the collapse of the main hall and the north and south pavilions. In 1985, the party's ethnic and religious policy was further implemented, with donations from local paradigms. Under the leadership of Xuedong Bai Zhiqing, after five years' efforts, not only the original appearance of the mosque was restored, but also new facilities such as stone carving fence, Paihang, Manla Building and Tiger State Worship Building were built.

shortFeatures: Zhengxi Gate of Xi'an Ancient City Wall
summary: Anding Gate is the main west gate of Xi'an City Wall, commonly known as the West Gate. It was the middle gate in the west of Tang Imperial City, and it was preserved when Han Jian shrank and built a new city in the late Tang Dynasty. In the seventh to eleventh years of Hongwu in the Ming Dynasty (1374-1378), when the city wall was expanded, the location moved slightly southward and it was named Andingmen. "Stability" means Antai Kangding in the western frontier. Inside the city gate is West Street, and outside the gate is Xiguan Main Street. There are three gate towers in the west gate. The tower, arrow tower and gate tower are on the three walls from the inside to the outside. There are arched door openings downstairs. There is a square urn between the tower and the arrow tower, which is an entrance and exit passage in peacetime and an important defensive place in wartime. Its arrow tower is the most complete ancient castle in China so far. On the north side of the tower is an observation platform built by the Japanese emperor when he visited Xi'an.

summary:

The upgraded and expanded new museum is a comprehensive venue integrating classic car exhibition hall, retro culture street, amusement experience area, Sanhe art space, multimedia film and television center, cafe and souvenir shop. It is currently the largest and most influential private classic car museum in China. 
 
Sanhe classic car collection began in the 1990s, with more than 100 collections bringing together more than 30 well-known automobile brands at home and abroad. For more than 20 years, Sanhe has been committed to promoting automobile culture with classic cars as the carrier, and has extensively participated in major auto shows, classic car festivals and events at home and abroad, expositions, music festivals, film and television drama shooting, etc., so that people can explore history and recall classics while enjoying the relics of the development of human automobile industry at close range.

poiName: Baoguang Guihu Cultural and Tourism Area
shortFeatures: Pray for Blessings and Appreciate the Imperial Gardens
summary: Located in the outskirts of Xindu County, 18 kilometers from Chengdu, covering an area of 90,000 square meters. It is said to have been established during the Eastern Han Dynasty and was known as Dashi Temple in the Sui Dynasty. In 881 AD, Huang Chao broke into Chang'an, and Emperor Xizong of the Tang Dynasty fled to Shu. He built a palace behind the temple and ordered the reconstruction of the temple and pagoda, renaming it Baoguang Temple. During the Song Dynasty, the temple had 3,000 monks and reached its peak. It was destroyed in the Ming Dynasty due to war. In the Qing Dynasty, it was repaired and expanded, forming its current scale. Baoguang Temple faces south with a symmetrical central axis. The screen wall faces the main gate, followed by the Hall of Heavenly Kings, the Relic Pagoda, the Hall of Seven Buddhas, the Great Hall of the Buddha, the Sutra Repository, and Zixia Mountain. On both sides are the Zen Hall, Dharma Hall, Precepts Hall, and Dining Hall, with all ritual halls in place. The halls are grand and magnificent, with intricate carvings on doors, windows, eaves, and arches. There are over 400 stone pillars, showcasing the superb artistry of ancient architecture. On the eastern side of the temple is the Arhat Hall, which houses statues of three Buddhas, six Bodhisattvas, fifty ancestors, and five hundred Arhats. Each statue is 2 meters tall, with gold-painted figures and exquisite craftsmanship, each with its unique expression. The temple's Relic Pagoda, built during the Tang Dynasty, is a four-sided brick pagoda with a concealed eaves design. It stands 30 meters tall and has 13 stories, with Buddha images carved on all four sides of each level, and copper bells hanging at each corner. The temple also preserves a stone tablet of 1,000 Buddha carvings from the second year of the Liang Dynasty in the Northern and Southern Dynasties, a relic pagoda engraved during the Guangxu period of the Qing Dynasty, and the "Three Treasures" praised by the temple's monks: a relic, Udumbara flowers, and palm-leaf manuscripts.

shortFeatures: Quiet Jiangnan-style water town style
summary: Longtan Water Town is located in the core area of Longtan Headquarters Economic City, chenghua district, Chengdu, covering an area of 220 mu, with a total investment of about 2 billion yuan. It took four years to build, and its scale is equivalent to Zhouzhuang Ancient Town. It is the largest supporting project of Chengdu Longtan Headquarters Economic City, and the only characteristic block in the central city of Chengdu built by using living water resources. This is another cultural tourism business card created by Chengdu after the memory of Jinli, Kuanzhai Lane and eastern suburbs. It is known as Chengdu's "Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival". In terms of cultural inheritance, Longtan Water Town adheres to the "original ecology" and pays attention to the organic integration of Chinese classical culture and architectural forms. Twelve main streets and lanes are named after Jinling 12 hairpins in A Dream of Red Mansions, corresponding to each hairpin's zodiac, and 12 zodiac stone carvings collected from Suzhou folks are set up at the street corner. Iconic hotels and clubhouses are named after the traditional "homes". The bluestone slabs on the main street, doors and windows of classic buildings and other building materials are mostly taken from East China folks and transplanted from the original flavor. When you walk into the water town, you will feel as if you were in a water town in the south of the Yangtze River: antique buildings, small bridges and flowing water, the gurgling sound of the river, and awning boats waiting to set sail. The overall style of the water town is based on the unique cultural elements of Chengdu, transplanting the charm of the water town in the south of the Yangtze River. Strolling in Longtan Water Town, the rich Jiangnan customs pervade, and tourists can also take a covered boat to cruise the river, which makes people feel as comfortable as a paradise.

Quanzhen Temple is located halfway up the mountain in Longjugang, Qingcheng, and its ancient name was Longju Temple. Quanzhenguan Hall is facing the mountain pass of Zhangrenfeng. From Tianhe Temple, it goes up along the hill, and the peaks and turns around, showing layers of tea gardens and kiwifruit forests. The stream flows down the path, and the towering palace stands among the lush trees, which is really a place for self-cultivation. On the left is the sharp and stretching Zhangren Peak, and on the right is the winding and beautiful Feixian Hill. There are Cihang Hall, Qizhen Hall and Wuzu Building here. Cihang Hall is dedicated to Cihang Zhenren of Taoism, and Qizhen Hall is dedicated to Qiu Chuji, Tan Chuduan, Ma Danyang, Liu Chuxuan, Wang Chuyi, Hao Datong and Sun Buer, who founded Quanzhen Taoism. Seven founders, collectively referred to as "Quanzhen Qizhen". Above the Seven True Hall is the Wuzu Building, which enshrines five Taoist emperors such as Wuchongyang, collectively referred to as the "Wuzu". The scenery of Quanzhen Temple is quite artistic, and the towering hall stands among the green surroundings. It is very comfortable to sit here for a while. Every spring, "thousands of pear trees bloom", and thousands of pear trees in Lihuaxi turn into a world like ice carvings and jade chisels overnight. On the hillside, in the fields, among the streets, beside the thatched bamboo forest, and around the green house, pears with buds and stamens are like snow and clouds, and the spring breeze blows and makes tidbits fly all over the sky.  
In fact, Lihuaxi is an original ecological pear blossom forest, which has not been specially planned. They are all planted by the older generation in order to eat pears for their own families. After a long time, it slowly turned into pear trees all over the mountains and plains. Now you can not only enjoy flowers here, but also many farmhouses where you can eat and rest.

Longmenhao Old Street has a history of one hundred years, where the port opening culture, anti-Japanese war site culture, Buddhist culture, Bayu culture and dock culture are colorful. The restoration of the old street employs first-class cultural relics restoration craftsmen, and uses 1.6 million old bricks, 400,000 old tiles and 30,000 tons of old stones collected from various places. Based on the principle of repairing the old as before, the building technology of a hundred years ago is adopted to restore the former style of Longmen Hao Old Street.

tagNameList: Ancient town and village; Ancient Towns
shortFeatures: Cascading wooden houses built on the mountain are very charming
summary:
Pianyan Ancient Town is located between two remaining veins in the southwest of Huaying Mountains. It is located in the hills, showing the trend of high in the northeast and low in the southwest. The average altitude is about 520 m and the maximum is about 942.9 m. In the Qing Dynasty, it belonged to Liujia, Lili, Jiangbei Hall, and it was built here as a town in the 24th year of Qianlong. Because there is a towering rock wall in the north of the town, it is named Pianyan Town. 
Pianyan is an ancient industrial and commercial town on the old road from old Chongqing to Huaying. In the past, businessmen gathered, commerce and trade were prosperous, and it was famous in Sichuan, Shaanxi, Huguang and Guangzhou. Although the times have changed for hundreds of years, its streets, buildings, folk customs and market conditions still retain the simple and elegant style of the past. The ancient town is built by the mountains and rivers, standing outside the town, and looking from a distance, it can be seen that wooden houses and brick houses are distributed by the mountains, overlapping and strewn at random. 
At the entrance of the ancient town, there is a long bluestone bridge across the water, and the street is also paved with bluestone. It is about 400 meters long along the Heishuitan River. The shops on both sides of the street are larger than Lin Lin, and the shop buildings are mostly made of wood and bamboo structures, or long wooden boards are assembled as walls, or bamboo fences are pasted with paste powder as walls. In some small buildings facing the street, the ground floor space is mostly set up as shops. The upper building is a hanging-foot building, which is suspended and built by columns, which not only saves the street surface, but also achieves the design effect of "giving up three feet of land and occupying an extra space".

· Laitan Ancient Town is located about 32 kilometers east of Hechuan City, Chongqing, on Jiefeng Mountain. The town was established during the Song Dynasty and is one of China’s first historical and cultural towns, one of the top ten ancient towns in China, and one of the first “Most Beautiful Villages and Towns in China.”  
· The ancient town is surrounded by the Qujiang River and integrates ancient temples, cities, and Buddhas, offering beautiful scenic views. The area is surrounded by cliffs on three sides, presenting a formidable defense reminiscent of the saying “One man at the pass can hold off ten thousand.”  
· Laitan Ancient Town is divided into Upper and Lower Towns, separated by a very short distance, resembling siblings—one high, one low, one firm, one gentle, complementing each other. The Upper Town is located on Jiefeng Mountain, overlooking the Qujiang River. Its imposing presence exudes masculinity and grandeur, with the town walls towering like a dragon coiled among the mountains.  
· Laitan Town covers an area of approximately 0.25 square kilometers. Its four city gates are symmetrically arranged in a cross pattern. The town walls are built with stone slabs over half a meter long, standing about 7 meters high and 2.5 meters wide, providing a sharp contrast to modern construction with a distinct ancient charm.  
· Within the ancient town, the old castle-like features are preserved, including narrow and winding stone streets and alleys, and more than 400 Qing Dynasty residences. The layout of the small wooden and tiled buildings is harmonious, maintaining the original appearance of the Ming and Qing dynasties. The town is quaint and elegant, offering a sense of tranquility and a return to a simple, rural life.

shortFeatures: Walk through the once bustling Financial Street
summary:
Baixiang Street is located in the southeast of Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It is about 425 meters long and less than 10 meters wide. It is connected to Wanglongmen in the northeast, Taipingmen in the southwest, and close to the government yamen. With the development of water transportation in Chongqing, merchants and boatmen have to deal with the government when they come to Chongqing. Therefore, many warehouses and commercial firms have been built in that area, and Baixiang Street has become increasingly prosperous. 
· In 1886, Chongqing's earliest cable and telegraph bureau was established here. After Chongqing opened its port in 1891, British, American, Japanese and other companies opened foreign firms here, forming a "financial street". With the development of Chongqing's water transportation, merchants and shipmen When shipping goods came to Chongqing, they had to deal with the government, so many warehouses and commercial firms were built in that area. Because foreign businessmen are confined to the south bank, they can't come to the city without permission, but foreign businessmen have to do things, so there are compradors. Baixiang Street is in Taipingmen, close to the government, so it is used as an office residence by various compradors and firms. Therefore, Baixiang Street has the earliest foreign houses in Chongqing, which have absorbed some advantages of traditional Chinese architecture. For example, most of them are latticed doors and windows, carved hollowed out, and quite exquisite.

tagNameList: Stroll through the neighborhood; Nighttime sightseeing; Featured Neighborhoods
summary:
Changjiahui Danzishi Old Street is the first national AAAA tourist attraction in China themed around "open port culture and the city’s nine-level hillside terrain." It is located on Nanbin Road, which is known as the "Chongqing Bund." The old street stretches one kilometer from end to end, with an elevation difference of about 80 meters across nine levels of slopes. Visitors walk uphill through streets and alleys with Eastern Sichuan-style courtyards, passing by scattered stilted buildings and businesses.

The scenic area is set against the mountains and water, offering a combination of rich historical heritage, sightseeing, leisure, entertainment, and shopping. Key attractions include the French Naval Barracks (a national heritage site), the Madame Tussauds Chongqing (the first in Southwest China), Changjiahui Ocean Park, Yide Hall, Wang’s Mansion, and others.

This is the only place in Chongqing where visitors can simultaneously "view two rivers," "see three bridges," and "admire three landmarks." At night, the 270-degree panoramic view from the "Two Rivers Viewing Platform" offers a sweeping view of the Yuzhong Peninsula and Jiangbei District, presenting the essence of Chongqing’s nightscape. It truly offers "a complete view of Chongqing at a glance." In addition to its unique landscape features, the area is also a food haven. Along the one-kilometer old street, every few steps you’ll find "Chongqing famous snacks" and "China’s renowned shops," as well as restaurants and bars with prime riverfront views. Today, Danzishi Old Street has become the first choice for locals to relax and entertain, as well as the must-visit destination for showing out-of-town guests the charm of Chongqing.

Hongyan Revolutionary Memorial Hall was the location of the Southern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and the Chongqing office of the Eighth Route Army during the War of Resistance against Japan period. A memorial hall was built here in 1955 and opened to the public on May 1, 1958. In 1959, Dong Biwu inscribed the name of the museum. In 1961, the State Council announced it as the first batch of national key cultural relics protection units. 
During the War of Resistance against Japan period, Zhou Enlai, Dong Biwu, Ye Jianying, Wang Ruofei, Qin Bangxian, Deng Yingchao and other older revolutionaries lived and fought here for a long time. During the Chongqing negotiations in 1945, Mao Zedong also stopped in Hongyan. The great achievements made by the older generation of revolutionaries such as Zhou Enlai and Dong Biwu and the Hongyan spirit cultivated here have made this red land famous at home and abroad, and become a famous revolutionary holy land and a national patriotic education base.

Qixinggang, located outside Tongyuan Gate, the main urban area of Chongqing, is a small hill. However, on the map of Chongqing in the late Qing Dynasty, Qixinggang was also marked as "Qixinggang". In the old days, what Chongqing was most afraid of was fire, so pools, tanks and other facilities were used everywhere to store water, just in case of a fire. As Qixinggang is outside the old city, it turned out to be quite desolate. With the expansion of Chongqing's urban area, Qixinggang has gradually become prosperous, and the housing around it is particularly dense. In recent years, the area around Qixinggang is the focus of real estate development. The broken sheds and rotten houses in the past have basically been demolished, and the tall buildings are like forests, which make the back streets and alleys in the past become narrower and narrower. If we want to talk about the density and population density of commercial housing, Qixinggang may be one of the highest places in Yuzhong District at present.

The Criminal Evidence Site of Unit 731, located in the southern suburbs of Harbin, displays a large amount of evidence of Japanese aggressors conducting experiments on living people. Various experimental equipment, character scenes, sculptures, pictures, and testimony materials, as well as sites such as microbiology laboratories, frostbite laboratories, and crematoriums, are all iron evidence like mountains. Unit 731 was founded in 1933 and has been conducting human experiments on captured Chinese soldiers and a large number of innocent Chinese civilians for more than 20 years, including frostbite experiments, dissection of living people, gas experiments, microbiological experiments, pressure experiments, and so on.. And now there are still many radioactive devices buried on the land of the three northeastern provinces of China. summary: The Flood Control Memorial Tower is located on the square at the northern end of Central Street and is one of the landmark buildings in Harbin. This memorial tower has a magnificent appearance, and its architectural design is full of strong Russian style. In addition, its location is relatively wide, making it a popular spot for tourists to take photos. The full name of the Flood Control Memorial Tower is Harbin People's Flood Control Victory Memorial Tower, and behind it is the Songhua River. In 1957, Harbin suffered a major flood, and the people of the city and the stationed officers and soldiers worked together to overcome the flood. The following year, this tower was built as a commemoration. The memorial tower is a cylindrical structure with a height of 22.5 meters. The tower body depicts the vivid scene of defeating the flood in relief. The top of the tower is a round sculpture depicting the image of workers, peasants, soldiers, and intellectuals, showcasing the heroic figure who defeated the flood. At the bottom of the tower, there are 11 semi-circular water tanks, whose water level is the high water level mark of 1957. Behind the tower is an ancient Roman style corridor, surrounded by 20 columns that blend seamlessly with the memorial tower, creating a magnificent and harmonious atmosphere.

The Songhua River Railway Bridge, also known as the Songhua River Binzhou Railway Bridge, is a cross river bridge of the Middle East Railway that crosses the Eurasian continent over the Songhua River. The bridge was designed and supervised by Russian bridge experts. The Songhua River Railway Bridge was first built in May 1900 and put into use in October 1901. The bridge has 19 spans, is 7.2 meters wide, and has a total length of approximately 1015 meters. The overall construction is built according to high standards and specifications, with over a hundred experiential projects, fully utilizing viewing, entertainment, education, and interaction. It is an indoor comprehensive theme park that integrates tourism, entertainment, leisure, study, and culture. Ocean Kingdom - a "park" developed with the theme of ocean culture and marine animals, featuring a 360 degree circular underwater tunnel, an Atlantis themed restaurant, a marine life viewing corridor, and other parts. There are also 3D multifunctional theaters - Naughty Sea Lion Theater, Romantic Mermaid Theater, and Dynamic Water Curtain Animation staged in rotation! A series of exciting and unparalleled ocean shows immerse tourists in the world of the ocean. Creative Tribe - a creative camp for children's imagination. As a creative education center, the tribe uses ocean themed imaginative picture books to learn while walking, popularize interesting science, understand and appreciate the ocean, explore science, and create environmental protection together. The tribe is divided into six categories based on their play characteristics: amusement experience, DIY creation, food classroom, handicraft classroom, archaeological exploration, and traditional Chinese culture and literature, with a total of 20 characteristic classrooms. Integrating diverse knowledge and information such as interactive entertainment, traditional culture, and modern technology, continuously cultivating children's hands-on and innovative abilities during the process of playing. At the same time, it can better enhance parent-child emotional communication, promote parent-child relationships, allow adults and children to experience the fun of entertainment classes, and strive to achieve "playing in the ocean and creatively learning". Cute Pet Mobilization - This includes over a hundred species of land animals, marine animals, and aerial animals. Land animals are represented by the old internet celebrity "alpaca" in the animal world, as well as the swimming champion "raccoon", the cute "Angora long haired rabbit", and the petite and delicate little pig; Aerial animals have the appearance to act as "golden parrots"; Marine animals are all encompassing, including playful sea lions that can interact with each other, otters that sleep hand in hand in the water, and colorful jellyfish Waiting for rare small animals in daily life. This is a gathering place for many cute pets and a large parent-child interaction center. Cute Pet Park uses ecological design techniques to create a green jungle, allowing children to have intimate contact with animals in nature and experience the charm of nature and the ocean! Joyful Kingdom - The project covers an area of 2300 square meters and features a super large ocean themed playful castle with a 10.5-meter overhang and natural lighting. A new generation of children's activity center that integrates play, exercise, intelligence, fitness, and other functions is formed by scientifically combining children's natural preferences such as drilling, crawling, rolling, shaking, swinging, jumping, and shaking. Here, children can cultivate their independent personalities, exercise their bodies, and develop their brains and intelligence. There are also rock climbing expansions, car towns Let the children have fun here! Science popularization agriculture, also known as "smart farms", uses technological lighting to replace sunlight to illuminate plants, and irrigation water is 90% less than traditional outdoor farms. The farm controls the growth of each plant through remotely uploaded formulas, precisely controlling the surrounding environmental conditions such as temperature, humidity, irrigation, etc., to ensure a continuous and reliable planting process. Here, children can see giant tomato trees, fishing root plants, technological drip irrigation, and fish vegetable symbiotic systems. The venue combines "new, unique, and special" popular science viewing with physical games, handmade crafts, and various colorful experiential projects, creating a paradise for children to play and run, and opening up future technological ecological experiences through education and entertainment. Featured Performance - The project features an 8.1-meter elevated sea lion theater, a mermaid theater similar to the underwater tunnel, and a dream theater for experiencing joyful interaction. The three major performance venues can accommodate 1500 people for interactive viewing at the same time. The project enhances children's emotional interaction through marine themed scenario interpretation. Naughty Mr. Sea Lion waves and interacts with children, beautiful Miss Mermaid interprets ocean stories for you, Mr. Joker interacts with children with magic, and cute sea dogs also join the performance team. Here, the scenario based characteristic performance brings children a joyful stage. As a large-scale indoor theme park in Northeast China, Hailanxing Dream City will rely on its perfect location advantages to radiate to a 300 kilometer radius around the project. By leveraging the advantageous resources of the project, centered around Shenyang and radiating to 8 satellite cities in the surrounding area, and leveraging the coordinated development of the location, the location advantage can be transformed into a regional coordinated development advantage. With the support of the Shenyang Economic Circle, the integration of tourism project resources can be promoted, forming a centralized advantage and attracting the injection of tourism market resources. In the coming years, Hailanxing Tourism Culture Development Co., Ltd. will build "multi-level" brand ocean cities in multiple cities in China, allowing more people to experience the fun of ocean tourism and feel the profoundness of ocean culture. Enable people to experience more advanced tourism and leisure products. Enhance people's quality of life and improve urban development. Committed to building a comprehensive service provider for themed tourism. Full text 

The September 18th History Museum, located in the northeast corner of Shenyang City, was built to commemorate the victims of the September 18th Incident and warn countrymen not to forget the national humiliation. The museum displays a large number of historical photos and archives, as well as various cultural relics such as evidence of the invasion of China and relics of anti Japanese martyrs. It showcases the historical evidence of the Japanese invasion of China from various aspects, as well as the suffering and indomitable struggle of the people in the occupied areas. This is a very meaningful educational venue, perfect for taking children to learn history and receive the baptism of patriotism. The main building of the museum is very distinctive. It is a huge stone carving in the shape of a reliquary, which is a table calendar flipped to the date of the incident. It is covered with bullet marks and skeletons, symbolizing the millions of wronged souls who fell under the gun, calling out. The reliquary is engraved with the date and time of the September 18th Incident, as well as a brief introduction to the incident. Entering the main hall through the arched door on the front of the Remnants Monument, one is greeted by the four large characters "Never Forget the National Humiliation" carved on black marble. Above the characters, the hour hand of the crescent shaped clock points to 10:20, which is the moment when the invading Japanese army attacked Beidaying. Suggest following the guide to listen to detailed explanations. You can also rent a voice guide machine at the entrance. Please note that photography is not allowed inside the museum. The museum is roughly divided into four parts: the first part introduces the premeditation process of the "September 18 Incident" and the deployment of the Northeast Army at that time. It also demonstrates through light and shadow the process of the Japanese army assassinating Zhang Zuolin and destroying trains, and then falsely accusing the Chinese army of destroying railways and attacking the Japanese garrison; The second part shows the bloody scenes of the Japanese army's occupation of Northeast China and the brutal killing of Chinese civilians; The third part introduces the struggles of the Chinese people against the Japanese invaders; The fourth part introduces the recent Sino Japanese relations, while reminding the world to be vigilant about the resurgence of Japanese militarism and to always learn from history. In the museum, you can see many realistic wax figures, showcasing scenes such as the brutal and bloody human experiments of the Japanese "731 Unit" and the lives and battles of Eighth Route Army soldiers. You can see evidence of Japanese corpse transport vehicles, ammunition, and other crimes, as well as watches, cigarette butts, bullets, and other items on the bodies of slaughtered compatriots. You can also see many captured Japanese military flags, weapons, knives, and other items, as well as war knives and other items used by the Eighth Route Army. Full text 

summary: The Nanguan Catholic Church is located on Lejiao Road in Shenhe District, Shenyang City. It was first built in the fourth year of the Guangxu reign of the Qing Dynasty (1873) and was burned down by the Boxers in the twenty sixth year (1900). In 1912, it was rebuilt with compensation from the Qing court and is now a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit in Liaoning Province. The entire building of Nanguan Catholic Church is divided into two courtyards, east and west. The church is located at the northern end of the east courtyard, with a length of 66 meters from north to south, a width of 17 meters from east to west, and a height of 40 meters. The building area is 1100 square meters and can accommodate 1500 people at the same time. The church belongs to typical Gothic architecture, with two conical spires at the top decorated with crosses. In front of the church are three arches, with rows of small windows on both sides, supported by twenty-four stone pillars, and a dome adorned with huge patterns. The west courtyard of the church has a four story building, which is the bishop's residence built in 1926.

It is also known as the two world-wide murderous caves in the world together with Auschwitz concentration camp of German Nazis. It is a block with dense historical and cultural resources in Shenyang City and a concentrated area of historical and cultural relics in Northeast China. There are seven provincial-level cultural relics protection units, including the Shenyang Forbidden City, a world cultural heritage site, and the former residence of Zhang Xueliang, a national key cultural relic protection unit. There are nine city level cultural relics protection units, including the Shengjing City Site (Northwest Corner Tower), and 42 historical buildings, including the former site of the Governor General's Office in the three eastern provinces. There are also 11 traditional stores, such as Majia Shaomai and Laobian Dumplings. There are four provincial-level intangible cultural heritages, including Shenyang folk traditional lantern riddles, Shenyang Hu Kuizhang pen making techniques, Majia Shaomai making techniques, and Liaocai traditional making techniques. poiName: The Governor's House of Northeast China
summary: The Governor General's Office of the Three Eastern Provinces was the location of an important military and political institution in Northeast China during the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China. It was also a well-known large-scale government office complex in Shenyang, Shengjing, following the imperial palace of the Qing Dynasty. The Governor General's Office of the Three Eastern Provinces has gone through a century of ups and downs, witnessed and carried the historical process of Shenyang and even the entire Northeast region in the turbulent years of modern China, and has important historical and architectural cultural value. The former site of the Governor General's Office in the three eastern provinces has been designated as a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit and is open to the public as a museum.

The daytime temperature in winter is between -5 ℃ and 15 ℃ all year round, making it a winter tourism destination that integrates tourism, sightseeing, sports, entertainment, leisure, and vacation. The alpine skiing area is equipped with 1000 meter, 800 meter, and 600 meter long ski resorts, 500 meter long ski practice areas, and 200 meter long children's ski practice areas. The Beiling Park - Qingzhao Mausoleum in Shenyang is the tomb of Emperor Taizong of the Qing Dynasty, Huang Taiji, and his empress. It is located in Huanggu District of Shenyang City and covers a vast area. Its highlight lies in the fusion of Manchu and Han architectural styles in the royal mausoleum, which is magnificent and towering with ancient pine trees. It is an important window for understanding the history and culture of the Qing Dynasty. Tourists can experience the solemnity of the imperial tomb and the weight of history here, while enjoying the natural beauty of the park.

Bird Island is currently a natural ecological bird viewing center in Shenyang. Bird Island, also known as Ganhezi Island, is located in the Qipanshan Development Zone, east of Dongling Park and south of World Expo Park. It is an island in the Hun River system, covering an area of 49.26 hectares. The Bird Island in history was named "Longtan Fishing" because its shape resembles a giant dragon lying in the Hun River water, and has become one of the "Eight Scenic Spots of Huishan". In different seasons of the year and at different times of the day, the forests, shrubs, wetlands, and ponds on Shenyang Bird Island will bring people different landscapes: in spring, all things revive, flowers bloom, and the birds on Bird Island begin to give birth to life; In summer, the vegetation is lush and green, and in autumn, the layers of forest are dyed. The newly grown geese follow their mother and sway unsteadily on the ground covered with golden leaves; In winter, the snow is white and the earth is desolate, with only geese and ducks playing on the unfrozen water surface of the Hun River. The wetland covers an area of about 100000 square meters and is the main habitat for wildlife, especially waterfowl, wading birds, shore birds, and Passeriformes. Creating wetland landscapes can not only enrich the habitat types of Bird Island, allowing more birds to settle here, but also enrich the viewing content of the island, making it truly a "Bird Island". Tall trees such as Pinus tabulaeformis, larch, Liaodong birch, Mongolian birch, white wax, and white birch, shrubs such as honeysuckle, yellow thorn, red rosewood, willow leaf embroidery chrysanthemum, mountain plum blossom, as well as aquatic plants such as water chestnuts, grasses, lotus flowers, and calamus, have been planted to form ecological landscapes of forests, vegetable forests, grasslands, and wetlands. Northeast Martyrs Memorial Hall is the Chinese Revolutionary Memorial Hall. In Yiman Street, nangang district, Harbin, Heilongjiang Province. Opened on October 10, 1948. The building of the museum is a three-story building in Western European classical architectural style built in 1931. In September, 1933, the puppet Harbin Police Department occupied this building, which became a criminal place for Japanese invaders to suppress the Chinese people. Zhao Yiman, an anti-Japanese national heroine, was tortured here and went to punishment. The museum has more than 7,000 pieces of collection and more than 5,000 historical materials. Important collections include the mattress used by General Yang Jingyu, the anti-Japanese national hero, the old woolen pants worn by General Li Zhaolin when he was assassinated by Kuomintang agents, and the Mao Zedong Medal, a special military medal won by Dong Cunrui, a famous national fighting hero, after sacrificing his life to bomb the enemy's fort. The total construction area of the memorial hall is 4,283 square meters, and the display area is 1,200 square meters. The basic display is to display the influential and representative deeds of martyrs in Northeast China. More than 1,000 pieces of cultural relics, pictures and materials were exhibited. At present, there are more than 5,000 cultural relics and more than 30,000 books, archives, documents and photos in the collection, which initially constitute an epic northeast revolutionary library. The memorial hall also uses modern means such as landscape restoration and large-screen display to reproduce the tragic scenes of the past, which makes people unforgettable after watching them. Since its establishment, the museum has received 7.28 million visitors. In addition to frequently reporting the deeds of martyrs, the museum set up a mobile exhibition team of martyrs' deeds in 1977, which insisted on going deep into the grass-roots level and carrying out education on patriotism, revolutionary traditions and ideals. It has traveled all over the prefectures, cities and counties in Heilongjiang Province, including 16 provinces and cities across the country, preaching more than 2,700 martyrs' deeds, with more than 1.6 million educated people, and being commended by the Ministry of Culture and the Heilongjiang Provincial Government. Won the title of "Advanced Collective of Socialist Spiritual Civilization". Due to its outstanding contributions to the reform and development of cultural heritage protection, on May 24th, 2007, the Northeast Martyrs Memorial Hall was awarded the glorious title of Advanced Collective of National Cultural Relics System by the Ministry of Personnel and the State Administration of Cultural Heritage. The museum publishes a series of deeds of Northeast Anti-Japanese Martyrs and Biography of Northeast Liberation War Martyrs. In cooperation with the Institute of Party History of Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, the Biography of Northeast Anti-Japanese Martyrs was compiled and published. Premier Zhou Enlai specifically instructed that "the Martyrs Memorial Hall should be run well, and the history of the revolution and the heroic deeds of the martyrs should be widely publicized to educate the people", and wrote the inscription "Revolutionary martyrs will live forever".
