The Stele Forest in the central region is a gathering place for calligraphy by emperors Kangxi and Qianlong, as well as famous figures, literati, and ink artists; The mascot carved by 12 elder brothers in the Zodiac Garden in White Marble is simple and lovely, full of childlike charm. The tears shed by the divine turtle in the west originated from a folk legend during Emperor Kangxi's eastern tour to worship his ancestors. The park boasts beautiful mountains, rivers, and ancient scenery, with layers of red walls and towering ancient trees. It integrates tourism, leisure, entertainment, and romantic vacations, making it a shining pearl of the ancient city of Shenyang. It is also a great place for Chinese and foreign tourists to appreciate the essence of world heritage culture, appreciate the charm of historical architecture and ancient style, return to nature, add blessings to happiness, and enjoy themselves

poiName: Harbin Daoli Vegetable Market (Dashangxin 100 Shopping Plaza Store)
summary: Harbin Deli Cai Market is located within the Da Shang Xin 100 Shopping Plaza and is a comprehensive market that integrates shopping, dining, and entertainment. This place not only has rich local specialty ingredients, but also various snacks and handicrafts, making it a great place to experience local life in Harbin.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 21:00 throughout the year

summary: The Jin Taizu Mausoleum Site Park is located two kilometers south of Acheng District. It is the tomb of Jin Taizu, the founding emperor of the Great Jin Dynasty, and one of the well preserved imperial tombs in Northeast China. Locally known as' Zhanjiangtai '. The tomb site is a turtle shaped mound about 10 meters high, with a circumference of over 100 meters at the bottom of the mound, covering an area of nearly a thousand square meters. The tomb site is known as the "First Mausoleum of the Golden Source Ancient Land", because in the early Jin Dynasty, the Ning Temple was built on the tomb site, also known as the "Taizu Temple" or "Aguda Temple". The Mausoleum Site Park is divided into five parts: the Leading Space, the Shinto Space, the Baoding, the Ning Temple, and the Underground Palace. The cemetery is grand and majestic, mysterious and spectacular, showcasing the magic of Jinyuan culture, and is one of the boutique tourist attractions of Jinyuan culture.

poiName: The Fourth Field Army Memorial Hall Of Chinese People's Liberation Army
summary: The Fourth Field Army Memorial Hall is a specialized museum of revolutionary history in social sciences, located in Shuangcheng District, Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province, with a total area of 20000 square meters. The entire museum is divided into two halves, north and south. The south half is the Siye Theme Square, the west half is the weapons exhibition area, and the east half is the main museum area. The main building covers an area of 6000 square meters, including two courtyards on the east and west sides. The courtyard is located in the east and the west side is a quadrangle courtyard, both of which were completed in the early years of the Republic of China (1917).

A great place to appreciate the scenery of Dalian, overlooking the southwest with a panoramic view of Xinghai Bay, and looking southeast with a vivid memory of the Fujiazhuang seaside and cross sea bridge. The observation deck provides a great angle and height for a bird's-eye view of the panoramic view of Dalian.

shortFeatures: Offshore ground-anchored suspension cable cross-sea bridge
summary: Dalian Changshan Island Cross-sea Bridge is located between Dachangshan Island and Xiaochangshan Island in Changhai County, Dalian. It is the largest span prestressed concrete low-tower cable-stayed bridge in China at present. The total investment of Changshan Bridge is 579 million yuan. As a major functional infrastructure project in the construction of Changshan Islands Tourist Summer Resort, Dalian Changshan Bridge spans the Lichangshan Strait and connects the big and small Changshan islands, with a total length of 3.38 kilometers and a main bridge length of 1.79 kilometers. It adopts the two-way four-lane first-class highway standard, with a design speed of 60 kilometers per hour.

The Dalian Port 15 Warehouse Sea Dream Sailing Club includes water passenger transportation, sea sightseeing, and more. The sightseeing route departs from the old wharf of Dalian Port to along the line of Bangcui Island. Along the way, you can enjoy the scenery of Dalian Old Port Area, Centennial Fifteen Treasures, Centennial Signal Tower, Centennial Lighthouse, Donggang Venice Water City, Haiyun, Sanshan Island Scenic Area, Bangcui Island Scenic Area, as well as Centennial Shipyard, Dalian Bay Port Area, and the northern coast of the city (this information is for reference only, subject to the actual route).

Haichang Oriental Water City is based on the city of Venice and runs through over 200 European style castles. The "Gondola" wanders among the European style castles, immersing itself in them as if arriving in a foreign land. Here, you can experience exotic charm while writing your own water city story. As night falls and the lights come on, the hazy architectural lights of Venice's water city seem to have arrived at the Pujiang River in Shanghai. One can only see the unique style of Bruges walls, and multiple European style castle buildings scattered on both sides of the canal, each with its own charm reflected on the river surface of the water city. The gentle breeze, swaying tree shadows, winding water lanes, flowing clear waves, immerse oneself in the dream of rippling blue waves, the poetic and picturesque scenery of the coastal city, and the romance of Dalian are rendered here. The charm of the blue sky, the starry sky at night, and the shimmering water complement each other, sweeping away your summer heat as if entering a beautiful dream.

poiName: Jinshi Beach Sea Gull Feeding And Sea Fishing
summary: The Jinshitang Seagull Fishing Site is located at Jinshitan Port in the beautiful back garden Jinshitan Tourist Resort in Dalian. Here, away from the hustle and bustle, we worship nature, play with seagulls on the waves, ride boats and tide, and when enjoying the sea becomes fashionable, we offer a beautiful waterfront terrace. The port of Jinshitan is docked with over a thousand boats operated by fishermen, carrying hope and harvest. Standing by the shore, breathing in the simple taste of fishermen and feeling the rich culture of fishermen. This is a place to relax both body and mind, a mysterious paradise to soothe emotions and release wishes. Seagulls are praised by fishermen as divine birds in the sky. They coexist with schools of fish in the sea. When thousands of seagulls soar over the sea and sky. It heralds the arrival of fishing news. Experienced fishermen will seize the opportunity to cast their nets. The seagull shadows sway gracefully, and the fishing boat sings in the evening. Sprinkle fresh fish and shrimp into the air and see flocks of seagulls hovering and flying around you. I heard the sounds of excitement and blessings coming one after another. There is a local saying in Jinshitan called 'Fishing is better than eating', which means that the feeling of eating fish is far less pleasant and satisfying than fishing. Ten zhang line, three xi hooks, no worries about laying water and covering the waves for food "Whether it's hand line or rod fishing, it can bring an unprecedented sense of fun. Truly experiencing the hardship of labor and the joy of harvest, feeding seagulls for fishing projects, and personally experiencing the joy of swimming and playing in the sea!

The Binhai National Geopark is located on the coast of Jinshitan in the outskirts of Dalian. The reefs here have been carved into various natural artworks by nature. Some of these giant stones resemble stone monkeys watching the sea, some resemble a roc spreading its wings, and some resemble the portrait of Beethoven. Most of them stand on the coast and are also filming locations. The formation of these peculiar rocks along the coast originates from rock deposits and a large number of ancient fossils dating back 600-900 million years. The core scenic areas developed by the geological park mainly include three major scenic groups: Dinosaur Park, Nanxiu Park, and Aotan Park. Most tourists will visit these three scenic groups, and the entire hiking tour takes more than three hours. If you have enough time and physical strength, you can also visit the Rose Garden Scenic Area, the Stone and Stone Garden Scenic Area, and the Geological Museum. In the rose garden scenery, one can see rocks with unique textures that resemble clusters of blooming roses; In the dinosaur garden scenery group, there is a "Beethoven portrait" stone, and you can also walk on the shoulder of the "Dinosaur Exploration Sea" giant stone and look out at the sea; In the Nanxiu Garden landscape group, one can see giant stones with images such as "Big Peng spreading its wings" and "Hedgehog foraging"; In the Aotan Garden Scenic Group, there is a treasure of the town beach - Turtle Back Stone. The Jinshi Garden scenic group is slightly different from the coastal boulders. It is all a stone forest landscape, with unique island shaped residual hills, karst caves, natural bridges and other karst landforms. In addition, you can also see various small stone exhibitions in the Geological Museum. Full text 

The Lushunkou Scenic Area is located on Huanghe Road, Lushunkou District, Dalian City, at the southern foot of Baiyushan and on the north bank of Lushunkou Military Port. The main waterway facing Lushunkou Gate to the south and connected to Lushunkou West Port to the west, was built in 1985 and covers an area of over 5000 square meters. The renovated scenic area in 2020 is designed with a military theme, resembling China's first aircraft carrier, the Liaoning. Large military models such as powerful warships, carrier islands, and carrier based aircraft can be seen everywhere, and walking inside feels like being on the deck of an aircraft carrier. The Lushun Centennial Military Port, which can be seen in the Lushunkou Scenic Area, is one of the five natural ice free ports in the world. It was once an important base for the Beiyang Navy of the Qing Dynasty. The port faces two mountains east and west, with a natural gateway and good concealment and wind resistance. Strategically, it is easy to defend but difficult to attack, and is known as the "number one military port of Beiyang". Standing on the shore guarding the military port, the mountains and seas are calm, the waves are calm, it's really hard to imagine the war and smoke that this place has experienced.

Baiyushan is located in the center of the urban area of Lushun, on the north bank of Lushun Port, and is a famous scenic spot in Lushun. Climbing to the top of the mountain, you can overlook the entire Port of Lushun and also see the natural sand mouth "Tiger Tail" extending from the opposite mountain, which is a great viewing spot in Lushun District. There are also two scenic spots on the top of the mountain, the Baiyushan Pagoda and the Navy Weapon Museum. Baiyu Mountain is not high, with a peak elevation of only over 130 meters. There are not many scenic spots in the scenic area, and it can be visited in less than half a day. There are mountain roads leading to the top from both the northeast and south of the scenic area, and the scenic area is close to Lushun Railway Station and Bus Station, where you can take a taxi up the mountain after exiting. There is a cableway to the mountaintop in the southern part of the scenic area, with a one-way fare of 15 yuan. There is a ticket office in the eastern part of the scenic area (at the intersection of Huanghe Road and Changjiang Road, on the right side of the Baiyushan Tunnel entrance), and the cement steps next to it can be walked up the mountain, which takes about 20 minutes to climb. The Baiyushan Pagoda, formerly known as the "Biaozhong Pagoda", was built by the Japanese army in the early 20th century to honor officers and soldiers who pledged loyalty to the emperor during the Russo Japanese War. However, it has now become evidence of aggression in history. Climbing up the tower provides a broader view of Port Arthur, but an additional fee will be charged. The Naval Weapons Museum is included in the entrance ticket of the scenic area. It displays some of China's self-designed and constructed naval weapons and equipment, including torpedo boats, tanks, shore to ship missiles, helicopters, radars, naval guns, and other exhibits. Military enthusiasts should not miss it. There is a Lushun Hundred Birds Garden in the southwest corner of Baiyushan Scenic Area, which is also included in the entrance ticket of the scenic area. When you go down the road from Baiyushan Pagoda, you will pass by halfway up the mountain. Within the Hundred Birds Park, you can admire peacocks, brown pheasants, blue pheasants, as well as various bird species such as parrots, cranes, and mandarin ducks. There are also performances such as cockfighting and parrot tongue learning. Why not take a stroll. You can still see ancient cannon ruins halfway up the mountain. There are several small shops on the mountaintop that sell beverages, cold drinks, grilled sausages, and other food, but the prices are higher than outside the scenic area. It is recommended to bring some dry food and water, and you can go to the urban area at the foot of the mountain to eat. Full text 

shortFeatures: A Great Place to Enjoy Flowers
summary: Dalian Yinggeshi Botanical Garden is located in Yinggeshi Village, Longwangtang Street, Lüshun, Dalian, with geographical coordinates of 121°21'30" E, 38°53'50" N. It is the first comprehensive botanical garden in China funded by a private enterprise. The garden was first established in 2003 and officially opened in April 2014. The total area of the garden is 95.57 hectares.

shortFeatures: The reefs are as patchwork as artificially arranged

summary: The Russian Style Street, also known as Unity Street northwest of Shengli Bridge, is not far from Dalian Railway Station. The Russian style old buildings on both sides of this street were built over 100 years ago and are still well preserved today. Walking all the way from the street corner, it feels like being on a European city street, and tourists who love to photograph old buildings should not miss it. The Russian Style Street is less than 500 meters long, with densely packed Russian style buildings on both sides. Nowadays, these buildings are mostly occupied by chain hotels and small shops such as Russian nesting dolls, telescopes, and Russian cigarettes. However, due to the unified renovation by the municipal party committee, visitors can still feel a bit of exotic charm when walking here. When it comes to the origin of the Russian style street, it can be traced back to the late 19th century when Dalian was forcibly leased by the Russian Empire and the city of Daruni was established in the current area of Tuanjie Street. Therefore, this has become a long-standing Russian style street in Dalian and even throughout the country. The larger Russian style old building at the end of Fengqing Street today is the former site of the Daruni City Hall. In addition, the beautiful European style building at the entrance of Fengqing Street was once the former site of the Dongqing Steamship Company and is also a famous classic building.

poiName: Haida Cableway Of Dalian Forest Zoo
summary: The Haida Cableway is located between the beautiful Baiyun Yanshui Scenic Area at the southern end of Dalian city and the second phase of Dalian Senli Zoo. The cableway is connected by 166 suspension boxes and has a total length of 1200 meters. The one-way journey takes about 20 minutes, and the round trip takes about 40 minutes. Here, nestled by mountains and the sea, the scenery is pleasant and it is the longest aerial cableway in Dalian city. When taking the cableway, please take care of the elderly and children around you. It is strictly prohibited to play, sway, or smoke in the hanging box to ensure safe travel. As the cable car slowly rises, we can see that to the west of the cable car are Asia's largest Star Bay Square, a long sightseeing corridor along the coastal road, a high star One Square Castle Hotel, and the Star Bay Cross Sea Bridge connecting Dalian city and the High tech Zone, as well as the Shanhai Reef Island, shining together. The middle station passed by the cable car is a high point in Dalian - Lianhua Mountain, with an altitude of about 260 meters. From here, overlooking the east, it is the bustling world of the four districts and development zones in Dalian. European style houses are like huge pearls embedded in this beautiful coastal city. It's refreshing to enjoy the citywide scenery in the slowly rising cable car, which is a kind of comfort and refreshment you can't feel in Mount Taishan, Zhangjiajie and other cable car cableways! This is the unique Oriental Pearl TV Tower - Dalian.

shortFeatures: Seaside landscape wooden plank road
summary: Binhai wooden plank road is built with special anti-corrosion treatment of Eucalyptus grandis from South America and Pinus sylvestris var. Mongolica from Russia, with a total length of 20.99 kilometers. It starts from Xinghai Bay Bridge and ends at Donghai Park, with the widest point of 17.18 meters and the narrowest point of 0.85 meters. There are 11 observation decks along the way, with a construction drop of 68 meters. It runs through 48 scenic spots in eight scenic spots. As the longest pedestrian landscape road in China with the most connecting scenic spots and running through the whole line, it was recently recognized as "the longest in China" by Shanghai World Guinness Headquarters.

shortFeatures: A suitable place for wedding photos
summary: Yingbin Road, located in Zhongshan District, is an avenue from Pingshan Street in Zhongshan District, Dalian to Bangchui Island State Guesthouse. The total length is 3.6 kilometers, passing through Yingbin Garden and reporter Lin scenic spot. The scenery along the way is beautiful, and there are wooden plank roads for tourists to walk.

Dalian is a beautiful coastal city and also a romantic capital. Its appeal comes more from the characteristics of the sea and the connotation of the city. The old dock scenic area, a new landmark in Dalian, embodies the combination of visiting the century old history and culture of Dalian Port with the sightseeing tourism of "seeing Dalian on the sea" by sailing. It is also the combination of sailing sports competition experience and sea leisure tourism experience, interpreting the concept of "seeing the sea, eating the sea, and playing in the sea" here! The tourism project of Lao Matou Scenic Area is divided into two parts: one is the century old historical area, where visitors can visit the historical and cultural heritage of Dalian Port. You can see the century old lighthouse sculpture, century old 15 library, and century old signal station at the entrance, all of which are popular online celebrity check-in sites today; In the scenic area, you can also see the display area of Dalian Port's old dock objects, such as Hall anchors, grab buckets, forklift attachments, electric locomotives, transport vehicles, etc., as well as the photo exhibition area celebrating the 120th anniversary of Dalian Port's founding. They are all telling the historical story of Dalian Port for 120 years; There is also the newly opened "Old Wharf Historical Museum", where you will hear the voice of Dalian, a city with a hundred years of history. The second is the sailing experience area, which provides a leisure experience of "watching Dalian on the sea" by sailing. First of all, looking at the sea, and then looking at Dalian from the sea, is a completely different feeling. Riding the Dream of the Sea sailboat, looking west is the hundred year history and culture of Dalian city yesterday, and looking east is the development prospects of Dalian city today and tomorrow. It can be said that Dalian Port is the intersection of history and the future, the critical point of time and space travel. Next is eating the sea. At the Fifteen Treasures, everyone can taste a rich variety of seafood delicacies. While leisurely sightseeing on the sea, they can also enjoy delicious seafood, which is truly enjoyable. The third is playing in the sea, sailing experience, feeding seagulls by boat, calling for white clouds in the sky, breathing the breath of the sea, and taking wedding and travel photos on the sea, fully immersing oneself in nature. If you are interested in experiencing it, you can personally pull the cable and truly experience setting sail; You can also personally turn the wheel and experience the feeling of sailing. All of these will make out of town tourists linger and enjoy themselves endlessly. The transportation vehicle for "Watching Dalian from the Sea": 6 new catamaran sail passenger ships, which have many advantages such as stable and safe catamaran operation, good maneuverability, and strong ornamental value. In addition, the sailboat is 9.95 meters long and 5.5 meters wide, capable of carrying 38 passengers. Its 360 degree visual space allows you to take photos as you want and be as beautiful as you want. Full text 

Jinshitan Resort is located in the northeast of Dalian city, surrounded by the sea on three sides and beautiful scenery. The period from May to October is a suitable tourist season. There are many attractions here, you can come and explore the Kingdom Theme Park for a day, or go to the Coastal National Geopark to admire the wonders of the rocks, or take your children for a walk on the beaches of the Gold Coast. It takes about 50 minutes to get to this backyard of Dalian by taking the high-speed rail Line 3 from the North Square of Dalian Railway Station. From the high-speed rail station, you can purchase tickets at the nearby tourist service center. Each attraction in the resort can be sold separately. If you want to visit multiple attractions, you can also purchase a package ticket, which is much cheaper than buying separately. Next to the light rail station, you can take the sightseeing circular bus to various scenic spots, and you can take it unlimited times with a ticket. The Kingdom Theme Park is not far from the light rail station, and you can take a dedicated bus directly from the tourist service center to the main entrance of the park. Discovery Kingdom is a famous theme park in Northeast China, with many large amusement facilities, among which the "Crazy Cobra Roller Coaster" and "Heaven Earth Rotating Roller Coaster" are very thrilling and worth experiencing. It usually takes a day to explore the kingdom. To the south of the Kingdom Theme Park is the Gold Coast, a 5-kilometer stretch of sandy beach with a wide view. The clarity of the seawater and sand here are even better than the beaches in the city. You can take a sightseeing train from the tourist service center to the east coast of the Gold Coast. The Binhai National Geopark is located at the southeast end of Jinshitan Resort and is a photography destination. Here, you can enjoy various peculiar boulders formed by rock deposits from hundreds of millions of years ago and a large number of ancient fossils. They stand by the seaside, some resembling stone monkeys to watch the sea, and some resembling giant pandas spreading their wings. You can take a sightseeing circular bus to the park. There are many hiking trails in the park, so pay attention to steps and steep slopes. The above are some scenic spots worth visiting in the resort area. In addition, the Jinshitan Resort also has attractions such as the Jinshitan World Celebrity Wax Museum, Jinshitan Geological Museum, Life Mystery Museum, and Film and Television Art Center (Xu Beihong Art Museum), most of which are concentrated near the light rail station. If you have purchased a package ticket and have plenty of time, you can go for a stroll. There are many hotels, inns, and various restaurants in the streets and urban areas around the light rail station and one kilometer east of the light rail station. The consumption here is not much different from the urban area, and there are short distance buses available locally, making travel relatively convenient. The Jinshitan Resort also has various leisure facilities such as Tangfeng Hot Springs, Flight Experience Center, Jinwan Golf Course, Jinshitan Golf Course, Jinshitan Hunting Club, etc. If the vacation is abundant, it is very suitable to stay in the resort for a few days. Full text 

There is a huge sailboat building on the square, named Jinshi Hao. It is 41.8 meters high, 9.8 meters wide, 56.8 meters long, and weighs 5.8 tons. It is a large antique style sailboat building, with a lion at the bow of the ship roaring high into the sky, creating a magnificent atmosphere. The "Jinshi Hao" is the iconic building of Pingshun Square and also the facade of Jinshitan. Pingshun Square only has one sailboat building, with lanes on both sides, and cannot walk in front of large ships. It symbolizes that tourists who come to Jinshitan for tourism and people who work and live in Jinshitan can have smooth sailing, and the square is named after it. poiName: The Huang-Bohai Seas Demarcation Line in Laotie Mountain
summary: This is a place to observe the sea. Standing here and looking into the distance, you can see the boundary between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, which can be described as "clear and distinct". Some of the water in the eastern Yellow Sea is dark blue, while the water in the western Bohai Sea appears turbid, slightly yellow. "Laotie Mountain heads deep into the sea, and the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea divide from here; the torrent flows like a sea of clouds to the west, and the mist flows like wind to the south." This poem vividly depicts its spectacular scene. Dalian writer Deng Gang vividly depicted the waterline that separates the two seas in his novel "Dragon Soldiers Crossing".
This is a venue mainly showcasing polar marine animals such as beluga whales, polar bears, dolphins, Antarctic penguins, and whale sharks.

Heishijiao Park covers a wide area and features various forms of black reefs, including reef gardens, artificial beaches, sightseeing wooden walkways, and amusement parks. It is a park that combines science popularization and environmental protection. Full text 

The Eighteen Peculiar Slopes are located within the Sea Charm Park, presenting an overall slope that is high in the east and low in the west. Due to the strange phenomenon of easy uphill and difficult downhill, it has become a fun and mysterious place for people to explore.

shortFeatures: Submarine Culture Museum
summary: The Lushun Submarine Museum covers an area of 16,000 square meters, with a total estimated investment of 87 million yuan. It consists of a submarine exhibit hall, a world submarine culture hall, a submarine life experience hall, and a 3D dynamic submarine simulation hall. The construction of the submarine display base has been completed.

Sino-Soviet Friendship Tower is located in Taiyanggou Scenic Area, Lushunkou District, Dalian, on the square north of Lushun Museum. It is a national key cultural relics protection unit. The Sino-Soviet Friendship Tower was built in 1955, and Premier Zhou Enlai personally laid the foundation stone of the tower with the inscription "Laying the Foundation Stone of Sino-Soviet Friendship", which was a symbol of Sino-Soviet friendship in 1950s. The tower is 22.2 meters high, and its body is a regular dodecagon. At the lower part of the tower, there are 20 vivid portraits of the Chinese and Soviet people with a height of 1.2 meters.

poiName: xi hai yu gang ( wang hong gan hai di )
summary: Xihai Fishing Port, located on Wuyi Road in Jinshitan, Jinzhou District, Dalian City, Liaoning Province, is a popular fishing destination that is open all day, providing tourists with the opportunity to catch seafood and experience the fun of fishing. Xihai Fishing Port has abundant marine resources and a wide variety of seafood, making it a great place to get close to nature. In addition, there are various barbecues and snacks here to satisfy your taste buds. In terms of transportation, although Xihai Fishing Port is located in a remote area, self driving tours are more relaxed and enjoyable. Summer is the best time to visit because the temperature is moderate, the sunshine is bright, and the seafood is also the most delicious. While enjoying nature here, you can also rest under the shade of trees and feel the coolness of nature. In short, whether it's the pleasure of finding seafood or enjoying the beauty of nature, Xihai Fishing Port is a place not to be missed.

The EX Future Science and Technology Museum is located within the Jinshitan Jinshi Culture Expo Square in Dalian. It is divided into two main venues, the Jinshi Wax Museum and the EX Future Science and Technology Museum, with multiple themed areas and an exhibition area of nearly 20000 square meters. The Golden and Stone Wax Museum has upgraded traditional wax figures in all aspects. Based on innovative simulation technology, more than 30 wax figures of Lu Xun, Einstein, Steve Jobs, and others have been reproduced in the exhibition hall in the form of bionic robots. The figures cover multiple fields such as history, literature, technology, and film, providing visitors with an opportunity to cross time and space and "face" historical and cultural celebrities, listening to their "stories" about historical events. The EX Future Science and Technology Museum adopts a one-stop service for robots, including a biomimetic experimental cabin, an artificial intelligence robot research center, a biomimetic robot manufacturing center, and other technological scenes. It integrates high-tech achievements such as biomimetic humanoid robots, 5G cloud robots, and interactive technology products, simulating many application scenarios of artificial intelligence in future life. Being in it, you can experience an unprecedented human-machine symbiotic future life.
opening_hours: Opens at Peak season 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30),Opens at Off season 08:30-16:30(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

shortFeatures: Wax figures are numerous and vivid
summary:
Jinshi Wax Museum is located in Jinzhou District, Dalian, on the east side of Jinshitan Station of Express Rail Line 3. It is the main indoor attraction of Jinshitan Resort, and it is also the largest wax museum with the largest number of exhibits in China at present. Here, you can be in the same room with political figures such as national leader Chairman Mao, former US President Roosevelt and former British Prime Minister Churchill, or you can gather with celebrities such as Princess Diana, Bill Gates, Jackie Chan and Yao Ming. 
There are three floors in the wax museum, and each floor has wax figures of people with different themes. The first floor is mainly composed of Chinese political greats and some world stars, including Andy Lau, Maggie Cheung, Jiang Wen, Zhang Yimou and Bi Fujian, as well as foreign Will Smith, Halle Berry and Marilyn Monroe. 
On the second floor, wax figures of foreign politicians, world sports stars and scientists are displayed. You can see wax figures of Obama, Nixon, Margaret Thatcher, Edison, Marie Curie, Qian Xuesen, Yuan Longping, Jordan, David Beckham, Li Ning, Lang Ping and others. You can also see characters from many classic love stories such as The Legend of the White Snake, A Dream of Red Mansions, Butterfly Lovers, Titanic, Romeo and Juliet, Jane Eyre, etc. 
On the third floor, you can see wax figures of Chinese and foreign action movie stars and music superstars, such as Jackie Chan, Jet Li, Bruce Lee, Schwarzenegger, Stallone, Michael Jackson, Liu Huan and Han Hong. The "fairy tale kingdom" here is also quite distinctive. You can see the images in fairy tales such as The Little Match Girl, Cinderella, The Emperor's New Clothes, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, and The Frog Prince.

The Dalian Fantasy Art Experience Hall has a building area of over 2600 square meters and features more than 150 fantasy art oil paintings, covering all forms of fantasy art expression. It consists of seven major fantasy venues, including the Famous Painting Hall, Life Illusion Hall, Greek Roman Egyptian Hall, Dinosaur and Animal Aquarium, China Hall, World Hall, and Korea Hall. There are world-renowned paintings here, where you can interact with dozens of characters from world-renowned paintings at the art gallery, create portraits of Mona Lisa, and serve as a guide for Napoleon; If you are passionate about experiencing the peculiar and interesting world of illusions, you can become a superhero at the Life Illusion Hall, where you can easily achieve abilities such as flying, gigantism, clones, and controlling tsunamis; If you enjoy the mythological world of ancient Greece, Rome, and Egypt, you can go on an adventure to the Greek Roman Egyptian Pavilion, explore Egyptian tombs, break into Greek temples, experience the collapse of the earth at Medusa's lair, and more.

poiName: Golden Pebble Beach Life Mystery Museum
shortFeatures: Revealing the evolutionary course of vertebrates
summary: The predecessor of Dalian Jinshitan Life Mystery Museum was Lushun Life Mystery Museum. In 2012, after more than two years of precipitation, it finally made a perfect transition and upgraded gorgeously. It moved from Lushun to Jinshitan Cultural Expo Plaza, and officially changed its name to Dalian Jinshitan Life Mystery Museum. It will provide the public with high-grade and high-quality natural science exhibitions and other cultural and leisure services.

The music fountain in Xinghai Square sprays beautiful water splashes out, constantly adjusting its posture and formation with the changing music, dancing gracefully in various colors, like a little girl who loves to wear beautiful clothes swaying in her posture, making people unable to cope and never getting tired of it!

shortFeatures: Dalian's landmark and ecological scenic spot; The main peak Jingshi Peak is 173 meters above sea level
summary:
Dalian Tongniuling is located on the south side of the development zone, with mountains and seas interdependent on each other, and the blue sea is close to the lush Dongshan Mountain. It reserves a natural ecological environment for the new district with the theme of industrial development, and provides a quiet rest place for people in the development zone who work hard on weekdays. The UFO-shaped viewing tower climbs to the highest point in Tongniuling, overlooking the city with high-rise buildings and infinite vitality in the north, and the vast sea in the south is close at hand, right here. Since 2002, a UFO-shaped building has been built for 18 years. The owner hopes to use this to symbolize the second venture of this new city, and at the same time, it will be turned into a natural ecological park-a large area of Luan trees, Cotinus coggygria, green grass and dense pear orchards on the mountain. 
In 2002, a flying saucer-shaped observation tower was built on the main peak. The main body is divided into upper and lower floors, with a building area of about 600 square meters and an absolute height of 28.73 meters. It is the commanding height of Dalian Development Zone. Boarding the viewing tower, you can overlook the whole development zone, and observe the night sky star phase through astronomical telescope. When night falls, the magnificent landscape of "visitors from outside the sky" presented by the viewing tower is vivid and dreamlike, which has become the biggest highlight of the development zone. 
The scenic spots in the scenic spot are connected by two winding mountain roads in the north and south, and a 2-kilometer wooden plank road bridge is laid. There are 2 parking lots in the scenic spot. The 1km-long large-scale relief "Memories of the Sea" is processed with the help of rocks left over from the seashore, which is ingenious. The large sculpture of "Nine Dragon Wall" is skillfully carved from coastal cliffs. Shiwan Bathing Beach, antique bell tower, Sea Love Square and sketches constitute a landscape where humanities and ecology "combine", and become a good place for people to relax, keep fit, get close to nature and cultivate their interest.

summary: The hot spring water of Dalian Luneng Ocean Hot Spring Hotel is pumped from more than 2,400 meters underground. The hot spring center includes dining area, SPA area, leisure and entertainment area, SPA area, etc. The leisure and entertainment area includes KTV private room, energy room, children's game area, pedicure area and big gathering point. There are indoor and outdoor pools in the spa area, including 67 pools with various functions such as swimming pool, children's paddling pool, fish therapy, traditional Chinese medicine pools, strange stone theme area, fragrant body nourishing area, beauty and beauty area, warm-up spring and dynamic area.

The Lushun Railway Station is located on the southwest side of the Lushun Baiyushan Scenic Area and is a uniquely shaped wooden building. This train station with a history of over a hundred years has a well preserved European style platform in China, with a straw hat shaped elliptical pointed tip covered in feather shaped small tiles and exquisitely carved details. The Lushun Railway Station was built in 1898 and put into operation in 1903. Today, it is a relatively well preserved European style building along the Northeast Railway. This railway station used to have trains to Dalian for a long time, and many travelers took the green train from Dalian to Lushun just to experience that leisurely feeling. Unfortunately, due to various reasons, starting from April 20, 2014, with the suspension of trains 6331 and 6332, taking the green train to Lushun has become an eternal memory. Fortunately, the Lushun Railway Station can still be visited today, but usually only the ticket hall can be visited. For tourists who love historical buildings, it is still worth a visit.

Kaide Heping Square is located in Dalian City and is a comprehensive commercial square that integrates shopping, dining, and entertainment. The square has numerous internationally renowned brand stores, as well as various restaurants and entertainment facilities, making it a great place for citizens and tourists to relax and shop.

Qingniwa Commercial District is located south of Dalian Railway Station and is a bustling commercial area in Dalian. Fashion department stores are the highlight here, including many large shopping malls and century old shops. In ancient times, this was just a fishing village called Qingniwa, named after the local geographical characteristics. The main shopping malls in Qingniwa include Dalian Shopping Mall, McLaren Dalian Shopping Mall, Dashang New Mart, Shengli Underground Commercial Street, and so on.

Lushun Port is a natural barrier with strategic terrain, and has always been a battleground for military strategists. Lushun Port is surrounded by mountains and is also a natural northern ice free harbor.

The Dongjiguan Mountain Site of the Russo Japanese War is located in the northeast of the urban area of Lushunkou District, Dalian City. It was an important battlefield for the eastern defense line of the 1904 Russo Japanese War in Lushunkou. At present, there are relatively complete relics of the Russo Japanese War preserved here, mainly including the Russo Japanese War Exhibition Hall, the North Fortress of Dongjiguan Mountain, the Erlongshan Fortress, and the Wangtai Battery. The Russo Japanese War Exhibition Hall uses various forms such as lectures and physical displays to provide rich and detailed information, profoundly exposing the crimes of imperialism's invasion of China. Here are more than 300 important historical materials such as photos, physical objects, charts, etc. from the Sino Japanese War and the Russo Japanese War, as well as a large-scale electronic control war sand table and film and television documentary produced by Changchun Film Studio for the Battle of Port Arthur during the Russo Japanese War. The North Fortress of Dongjiguan Mountain is mainly composed of fortress gates, officer rooms, barracks, ammunition depots, telephone rooms, side defense bunkers, outer edge tunnels, protective trenches, trapezoidal wells, underground passages, artillery positions, machine gun positions, kitchens and dressing stations, bunkers, fortress backyards, wooden suspension bridges, and scattered soldier trenches. The northwest to southwest and south are logistics and living facilities, while the northeast to southeast are military and political defense facilities.

Jinshiyuan Park is named after the golden color of rocks after weathering. It is one of the famous natural geological landscapes of strange stones in Jinshitan Resort and the only coastal natural garden landscape in northern China. 
Sinian layered limestone and gravel limestone, whose main body is about 650 million years ago, were formed by ancient storms. It is scientific, popular science and aesthetic appreciation. 
The unique landscape of the park, such as island-shaped residual hills with peculiar shapes, caves with changeable shapes, natural bridges, erosion windows, etc., and steep cliffs, are all amazing.

Dalian Shibei Bay Dream Water Park is a seaside indoor water park complex with the theme of "Dreamy Shibei World". It is located at the intersection of Binhai Road and Chifeng Street in Jinpu New District, Dalian, facing the sea with beautiful scenery. The project was built by Dalian Ruibai Group with an investment of 1.5 billion yuan, with a construction area of 100000 square meters. The park has nearly 100 amusement and leisure projects, with a designed daily reception of 10000 people. It has won the title of "Anticipated Theme Park" at the 6th Longque Award and is a seaside indoor hot spring water play theme park. Among them, projects such as the floating river in the air and the boundless sea view swimming pool are among the best in China. The overall use of shell and wave elements in Shibei Bay Dream Water Park integrates coastal style and children's theme, integrating various high-end amusement equipment such as amusement park, hot spring health preservation, catering and leisure, theme infinity pool, children's play, and floating river in the air. Paired with family themed resort hotels, luxury apartment hotels, and popular commercial streets, it creates a new landmark for family leisure and vacation in Dalian!

summary: The Lushun Russo Japanese War Battery is located in the southwest of Lushun and has a history of over a hundred years. It was once home to cannons, rapid fire guns, water wells, and fortifications. Through the remains of the battery, people can better understand that period of history.

Wangyu Mountain is located in Ganjingzi District, Dalian City. It has cliffs and sea views, and can be used for camping and fishing. There are two observation decks, and photos are taken specifically. In the evening, people sit on the edge of cliffs watching the sunset over the sea. In addition, many stone axes and knives from the Bronze Age have been unearthed at the Wangyushan site at the foot of the mountain.

The environment of Bihai Mountain Villa Park is clean and the scenery is beautiful. There are scenes such as hobbit houses, Santorini blue and white houses, European style churches, and seaside pianos in the park. Many people choose to come here to take photos and check-in, and it is also a well-known wedding photography base in the local area.

Xinghai Bay Bathing Beach is located on the southern coast of Xinghai Bay International Business Center, adjacent to Xinghai Square and Xinghai Park. It is the largest artificial bathing beach in China. Xinghai Bay Bathing Beach is about 2000 meters long and consists of 3 small bathing beaches. The whole beach is paved with high-quality sand transported from Beidaihe, with a thickness of 3 meters. Breakwaters at both ends of the curved shore calm the bay. There are three tourist boat docks in Xinghai Bay, from which you can directly reach Tiger Beach and Bangchui Island by boat. Two cruise ships are bottom-looking, and the magical and changing underwater world can be observed through the transparent bottom.

Fairy Lake is located at the entrance of Laotie Mountain in Guanglu Island. The lake and the sea are in harmony. The scenery is beautiful. The lake against the sea looks gentle and beautiful. The sea against the lake is wider and wider. Xiannv Lake is over 800 meters long, 200 meters wide, and 30 meters deep, with a large capacity of 1.2 million cubic meters. It was formed in the 1970s when local villagers built dams to block water from flowing into the Yellow Sea from the mountains.

The Mazu Temple was built during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. After reconstruction, the Mazu Temple has a building area of 204 square meters and houses Mazu statues, as well as the three officials of heaven, earth, and water. Every time there is a Mazu temple fair, people from southern Liaoning flock to the island to worship. The Mazu temple is constantly filled with incense, and more than ten thousand visitors come to pay their respects every year. Every year on the 16th day of the sixth lunar month, believers come to the temple on the island to burn incense and pray for good weather, abundant crops, fish and shrimp, and a prosperous population.

The Prince Qing's Mansion is a historical building located in both Beijing and Tianjin. The Qingwang Mansion Boutique Cultural Hotel Area consists of an "Urban Cultural Heritage Club" and a "Villa style Historical and Cultural Theme Hotel", and is a comprehensive cultural tourism, business conference, and leisure vacation community. Qingwangfu Mansion is a villa style historical and cultural themed hotel in Tianjin. Its predecessor was the "Shanyili" English style alleyway residential complex built in 1937. It has 16 sets of townhouse style hotel suites and 17 sets of hotel style apartments. After two years of careful renovation, it fully preserves the architectural style of sloping red tiles and sulfur tank brick walls, as well as the dense and orderly block texture. Each villa room comes with its own courtyard, providing guests with a private and peaceful living experience away from the world. The main building of Qingwang Mansion features elegant and distinctive Chinese and Western style private rooms, offering a feast of Chinese, Western, and Asian cuisine. The atrium of the main building is a sky covered shared hall, where guests can relax and enjoy a cup of afternoon tea. Standing on the rooftop terrace of the third floor, you can have a bird's-eye view of the rows of modern Western style buildings on the Five Avenues, experiencing the tranquility and elegance that once belonged to the early 20th century. Experience the unique historical charm and cultural atmosphere of the Qingwang Mansion in Tianjin, and enjoy a special cocktail in the evening, allowing guests to enjoy a romantic and comfortable slow paced life after busy work. At the caf é located in the courtyard, you can enjoy a leisurely afternoon tea, coffee, pastries, and French light meals while admiring the beautiful scenery of the small bridge, flowing water, and lush greenery. The red bar and cigar shop specially set up in the annex have a leisurely feeling of being away from the hustle and bustle. Full text 

Tianjin Eye is a Ferris wheel that spans across the Haihe River, like an eye on a bridge. It is also one of the famous landmarks of Tianjin. Every night when the lights start, the colorful lights of Tianjin Eye are soft and beautiful. Countless tourists come here to take panoramic photos or take sightseeing, enjoying a different kind of romance. There are generally two ways to visit Tianjin Eye: by car or by taking photos from afar. The ride on the Ferris wheel is 80 yuan per person for the day session and 100 yuan per person for the night session. The operation of the Ferris wheel takes about 30 minutes, and there is air conditioning in the cabin, allowing you to slowly enjoy the surrounding open scenery, especially at night when the lights come on after dark, which is very beautiful. If you want to take a picture of the Ferris wheel, you can stand on the Diamond Bridge on the south side of the Ferris wheel. Standing on the bridge, the Sancha River mouth (the intersection of the Haihe River, the South Canal, and the North Canal) is right in front of you, and the gentle Tianjin Eye unfolds in front of you. Surrounded by beautiful buildings on both sides of the Haihe River, just press it and you will see sparkling landmark photos.

The Xikai Church is located at the southern end of the bustling Binjiang Road commercial street. It was founded in 1917 and is the main church of the Catholic Diocese of Tianjin. The architectural style of the church is solemn and grand, and the sculptures inside the church are also complex and exquisite. In addition, Mass and Catholic holiday activities are open to the public, allowing participants to experience the strong religious atmosphere. The exterior of the church is made of red and yellow flower bricks, with three towers arranged in a cross shape and towering into the clouds covered with green copper sheets. After years of erosion, the mottled green shines with a sense of history under the sunshine, and each tower has a bronze cross on its top. Entering the church, the first thing that catches the eye is the main color scheme composed of lake blue, white, and light yellow, giving a fresh feeling. Various patterns are carved in just the right positions, and 14 columns are arranged from the doorway to the altar, exuding an extraordinary aura. There are exquisite copper statues of believers around the church, and oil paintings depicting the story of Jesus' suffering are hung on the walls. Inside the church, there are also colorful statues of the Virgin Mary, Jesus, angels, and others. In addition, the stained glass windows are also very charming. On one side of the church, you will find a small wooden room with a small cross on top, which is a "confession pavilion" used by priests to receive believers for confession and confession. The mass event of Xikai Church is open to the public, and non believers can also participate. However, during the mass time, visitors cannot wander around the church. They should sit quietly in the back row, not make loud noises or take photos, and feel the inner peace in the bustling city. In addition, there are also many Catholic holiday activities that are open to the public, just like Mass. The specific times for Mass and Catholic holiday events can be found on the official website. summary: Century Bell Square Century Bell is a large-scale iconic city sculpture building built in the square in front of tianjin railway station in Tianjin to welcome the new century. At 0: 00 on January 1, 2001, a sweet bell rang in front of Jiefang Bridge in the square in front of tianjin railway station, ringing the bell to welcome the new century. From that moment on, the century clock has become one of the most attractive landmark buildings in Tianjin, which accompanies the new century.

Jintang Bridge is located on the Haihe River between the western end of Jianguo Road and Shuige Street, and is one of the earliest large iron bridges built in Tianjin. The name of the bridge, Jintang, means "as solid as Jintang". The bridge is 76.4 meters long, 10.5 meters wide, and covers an area of 8022 square meters. Jintang Bridge was first built in 1906 and is one of the earliest steel structure bridges in Tianjin and one of the few in China to have a three span swing type opening.

Haihe Park is one of the places where people in Tianjin enjoy walking, playing, and resting. On the water surface adjacent to the Lion Forest Bridge at Sanchakou, there are two sets of copper statues, which are the starting point of Haihe Park.

shortFeatures: Relatively well-preserved foreign military barracks in Tianjin
summary:
· The barracks, built in 1925, have a wide playground and two tall three-story sloping-roofed buildings at right angles, with corridors more than ten feet wide in front of each floor. The building is magnificent and unique in style. It is well preserved so far, but it also reveals a magnificent and twisting. When tourists stop here, their feelings must be complicated. 
This ancient Romanesque building is located in a very inconspicuous alley. It is one of the largest buildings in the original concession. It is also the only preserved foreign barracks in the Nine-Kingdom Garrison Barracks in Tianjin, and the only completely preserved building of its kind in the country. 
It is said that when Pu Yi was in Tianjin, he visited the barracks to "inspect" and left a photo that can be seen in the exhibition room in Jingyuan.

The Italian style district is located in the center of Tianjin, with over 200 elegant Mediterranean style buildings. Strolling through it is like walking in a romantic European town, with numerous celebrity residences and filming locations adding a lot of color to visitors' journey. The Italian style area is located next to the Haihe River. Walking from the Haihe River (Bei'an Bridge), the first thing you see is a tall bell tower with a pointed tip. Further ahead, you can see exquisite hollowed out copper carriages, marking the arrival of the Italian style tourist area. Strolling along the street, admiring the red roofed Italian architectural complex, European sculptures, and strolling to Marco Polo Square. Marco Polo Square is one of the iconic buildings in the scenic area, with a central Collins style stone pillar standing the goddess of peace holding an olive branch. To the west is the "Flying Lion Wishing Pool" in Venice Square, which is far from the grandeur and popularity of the real Roman Wishing Pool in the movie "Roman Holiday". However, it blends with the atmosphere created by the entire Italian style district and has a faint cinematic feel. There are indeed many film and television dramas that come here for filming, such as "The Founding of a Nation" and "The Golden Powder Family". Visitors can find familiar scenes from the dramas here, and it also attracts many couples who take wedding photos. In addition, the scenic area has numerous celebrity residences. Liang Qichao's former residence, the famous "Ice Drinking Room" is located here; The former residence of warlord Cao Kun is now the Bohai Commodity Exchange; The former residences of Yuan Shikai and Feng Guozhang have now been converted into restaurants; There are also the former residences of Cao Yu and Zhang Tinghe. It's also good to visit the Tianjin Planning Exhibition Hall, which introduces the history and future urban planning of Tianjin. At night, Italian architecture lights up, candlelight and flickering lights in Western restaurants and cafes, bars become lively, and the scenery and atmosphere of Italian style areas become even more charming. Preserving the historical relics of the teahouse and presenting them in front of the audience in conjunction with the transition to the new era. Baohe Xuan Tea House gathers renowned cross-talk performers from three age groups: old, middle-aged, and young. The performers combine traditional culture with new era content to perform. Speaking, learning, teasing, singing, and performing all kinds of things in the world, laughing, cursing, and joking are just for the sake of everyone's laughter. Baohexuan Tea House is located in a cultural town 50 meters away from the theater building on Jinmen Ancient Culture Street across the Haihe River. Located in Tianjin Ancient Culture Street, the memorial archway of the hometown of memorial archway is painted in the form of "smoke carving ink stone chasing jade". The words on the heart of the memorial archway are "the hometown of Tianjin" (facing south) and "sunny snow" (facing north). Jinmen "is another name for Tianjin," Hometown "means old place, and" Jinmen Hometown "is the old place of Tianjin Wei, which means the birthplace of Tianjin Wei. 'Qing' means good weather, while 'Xue' means' wash '; Qingxue "is the scenery just after snowfall, with a clear sky stretching thousands of miles and streets crowded with tourists. It metaphorically refers to a person's pure and innocent mood, as if washed away. Here, we offer incense to the Queen of Heaven and wish for a better future.

Haihe Sightseeing Boat gathers the essence of Tianjin tourism. Along the way, you can not only feel the changes of Tianjin era, but also appreciate the modern buildings of modern cities. A Haihe River has summarized the history of Tianjin. As the saying goes, only with the Haihe River can there be the history and prosperity of Tianjin, and the prosperity of Haihe River leads to the prosperity of Tianjin. In the Haihe River sightseeing cruise route, what attracts people's attention are the distinctive bridges, which are the pride of Tianjin's urban style. The Yongle Bridge, which integrates with the huge Ferris wheel "Tianjin Eye", the Jiefang Bridge, one of Tianjin's iconic buildings, and the Lion Grove, which has a variety of stone lions. While getting close to these bridges by boat, taking the Haihe River cruise can also enjoy the "Nine Bridges and Thirteen Scenic Spots" along the Haihe River, such as the Dabeiyuan commercial area, the historic Tianjin Station, and the Italian style street that combines Chinese and Western styles.

shortFeatures: The former residence of He Shen, a minister of the Qing Dynasty.
summary:
- The Prince Gong's Mansion is the most well-preserved royal residence complex in China, with more than 30 distinct architectural groups. The layout is meticulous, and the grandeur is extraordinary.  
- Originally the residence of Heshen, it witnessed the entire history of the Qing Dynasty, from its peak to its decline, which is why it is said that "One Prince Gong's Mansion represents half the history of the Qing Dynasty."  
- The complex is divided into two main sections: the mansion and the garden. The Western-style Gate, the Grand Theater, and the Rear Pavilion are the "three wonders" of Prince Gong's Mansion and should not be missed.  
- The Mysterious Cloud Cave is also worth a visit, where a stele inscribed with the character "Fu" (blessing), stolen by Heshen from the imperial palace, is displayed.

shortFeatures: Historic districts and vibrant nightlife.
summary:
- Shichahai, also known as "Shichahai" (Ten Temple Lakes), is named after the ten Buddhist temples that once surrounded it. It is home to tranquil lake views, former residences of famous people, royal mansions, and other historical sites.
- A scenic area in old Beijing where classical and modern elements coexist, and traditional and avant-garde styles blend, with natural landscapes and cultural landmarks complementing each other.
- The most famous of these is Prince Gong's Mansion, which was once the residence of the corrupt Qing Dynasty official He Shen. The "treasure of the mansion" is a stele inscribed with the character "fu" (happiness) written by Emperor Kangxi.
- Shichahai Bar Street is quite lively, with many stars having performed here before they became famous. Notable bars include Hutong Xieyi and Jiadingfang.
- If interested, visitors can turn onto Yandai Xiejie (Smoke Bag Alley) to visit the Qing Dynasty Post Office and stamp a few beautiful postmarks as souvenirs.

shortFeatures: Feel the breath of old Beijing in the old hutong
summary:
Yandai Xiejie, with a total length of 232 meters, is the oldest commercial street in Beijing. During the Qing Dynasty, it mainly dealt in smoking sets, mounting calligraphy and painting, selling antiques and jade articles, etc. 
Yandai Xiejie itself is like a tobacco bag, the slender street is like a tobacco bag pole, and the east entrance is like a tobacco bag mouth, so it is named Xiejie after "Yandai". 
There are Beijing paper-cutting, sugar-blowing people and Beijing specialty snacks here, which are full of ancient and unique city customs and full of charm. 
There are also famous scenic spots such as Yinding Bridge, Lotus Market and Prince Gong's Mansion around, as well as special delicacies such as Yaoji Fried Liver and Nanmen Hotpot, which can be visited together.

shortFeatures: Ski resort very close to Beijing
summary:
· Jundu Mountain Ski Resort is located in Zhenshun Village, Cuicun Town, at the foot of Jundu Mountain, Changping District, Beijing. It has a superior transportation location, about 30 kilometers away from the city center. It is an old ski resort in Beijing. 
There are 5 ski trails in the ski resort (1 advanced trail, 2 intermediate trails and 2 primary trails), and it has always been a legend in the industry that there is No.7, the advanced ski trail with the highest difficulty coefficient in China. There are also snowboard parks (mini oh) and double board parks, as well as children's areas and learning areas in ski resorts. 
· Jundushan Ski Resort has complete facilities, soft snow, spacious ski equipment hall, professional ski instructors, and you can also experience the excitement of night skiing.

shortFeatures: The Plaque of the First Magnificent Pass Under the Sky
summary:
- Juyong Pass is a famous pass along the Great Wall, known as one of the three major passes of the Great Wall. It is built along the mountain, and a plaque reading "The First Strong Pass Under Heaven" hangs above the city gate.
- At the foot of the scenic area lies the Juyong Pass Scenic Area Square, where there is a stone gate called Yuntai. It is a Tibetan Buddhist architectural treasure made of white stone, housing a statue of a Bodhisattva, both beautiful and unique.
- After purchasing a ticket at the pass gate, visitors can enter the scenic area, which includes several cultural attractions such as the Temple of Guan Di, Diecui Academy, the Loyalty Temple, and the Fengyu Granary. These sites honor ancient celebrities and record the history of Juyong Pass. There is also a small lake nearby that visitors can explore.
- Climbing the Great Wall to the top watchtower generally takes two to three hours. Once at the top, visitors can see one of the famous "Eight Views of the Capital," known as "Juyong Diecui." In the distance, the green mountains stretch on, with layers of peaks, creating a breathtaking view.

summary: Qingliang Valley is located on the north side of Miyun County, Beijing, and is a scenic area mainly featuring mountain and water scenery and water entertainment. The suitable time for tourists to come here is summer, where they can enjoy many water sports and experience the coolness of playing in the water in summer. You can also take a leisurely hike and watch the clear springs and waterfalls in the mountains, with a fresh and beautiful scenery. The Qingliang Valley Scenic Area is not large. When visiting the scenic area, the main activities are entertainment and mountain climbing. Entertainment activities are distributed in the lake at the foot of the mountain and the water pools on the mountainside. In addition, there are also some recreational activities such as drifting and slides. The mountains in the scenic area are not particularly high, and it takes about 2 hours to stroll and enjoy the scenery to reach the top of the mountain. The entertainment projects in Qingliang Valley are mainly focused on water. As soon as you enter the gate, you can see a lake. This is the "Happy Charge Forward" game in the scenic area, which is similar to the water challenge activity on TV and is a paid experience. There are also exciting entertainment projects such as water suspension bridges and water slides nearby, which are very suitable for bringing children to play. However, most of the entertainment here is privately operated and paid experience. After passing through the lake area, you can start climbing up the mountain along the boardwalk. The mountains in Qingliang Valley are handsome, with many rock walls and strange stones of various shapes. There are also many trees in the mountains, which can provide a fresh and peaceful feeling. Climbing the mountain road, you will pass through many green pools and waterfalls with various shapes and beautiful landscapes, which are suitable for taking photos. You can also go boating and experience drifting in the relatively large lake on the mountainside. Climbing all the way to the top of the mountain, one can overlook the surrounding mountains and the scenic lake at the foot of the mountain, with a broad view and a lush green scenery that is also refreshing. When descending the mountain, you can walk back along the original path or experience the slide in the scenic area. The slide is in the shape of a marble groove slide, and the descent is not particularly fast, which is very suitable for bringing children to experience. Full text 

shortFeatures: The meeting place of the people's congress
summary:
· Located on the west side of Tiananmen Square in the center of Beijing, it is an important part of Tiananmen Square. 
The Great Hall of the People faces east from west, 336 meters long from north to south, 206 meters wide from east to west, and 46.5 meters high. It covers an area of 150,000 square meters, which is larger than the total building area of the Forbidden City. 
It is an important place for the party, the state and various people's organizations to hold political activities, and it is also a place for Chinese state leaders and people to hold political, diplomatic and cultural activities. 
Usually, there will be some performances in the Great Hall of the People, such as concerts and some Peking Opera performances.

· Chairman Mao Memorial Hall was built to commemorate leader Mao Zedong. It is located in Tiananmen Square, south of the Monument to the People's Heroes. 
· Completed on May 24, 1977, it covers an area of more than 57,000 square meters, with a total construction area of approximately 28,000 square meters. It is located at the former site of Zhonghua Gate. 
The roof has two layers of glass cornices, and sunflower reliefs are inlaid between the cornices. The base has two platforms, all of which are made of jujube granite beside the Dadu River in Sichuan, surrounded by Fangshan white marble and dieffenbachia railings.  
· Every year, thousands of tourists come here to commemorate Chairman Mao, including viewing halls, memorial rooms, cinema halls, etc.

shortFeatures: The main entrance of the Forbidden City
summary:
The main entrance of the Forbidden City, the largest of the four gates, has a history of nearly 600 years and is now an important exhibition hall of the Palace Museum. 
There are three doors in the middle of the tower, and a tuck door on each side. The middle door can only be walked once when the emperor, the queen enters the palace on the wedding day, and when the top scholar, the second place and the flowers leave the palace in the final imperial examination. 
This is also the place where the emperor holds important ceremonies. In case of a large-scale triumphant prisoner sacrifice ceremony, the emperor will climb to the Meridian Gate Tower to accept worship.

shortFeatures: The "Golden Temple" in the Forbidden City
summary:
The Hall of Supreme Harmony, commonly known as the Jinluan Hall, is the highest existing palace in China and is known as the first of the "Three Great Halls of the East". 
The interior decoration of the hall is very luxurious, with gold bricks paving the floor, and a throne with golden lacquer cloud dragon patterns, inlaid with thousands of golden dragon patterns, which is exquisite and unusually. 
There are also sundials, bronze turtles, bronze cranes, etc. in front of the temple, and a stone faucet for drainage is installed. During the rainy season, it can present the spectacle of thousands of dragons spitting water. 
At the same time, it is also the center of gravity of the Forbidden City, where it is used to hold various grand ceremonies, such as the emperor's accession to the throne, the emperor's wedding, and the establishment of the queen.

shortFeatures: Roof covered with yellow glazed tiles
summary:
The Hall of Preservation of Harmony was built in 1420, behind the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and it is one of the three halls outside the Forbidden City. 
The floor in the hall is paved with gold bricks, and there is a carved gold lacquer throne from north to south. The inner and outer eaves are painted with golden dragons and seals, and the ceiling is a front dragon with powder and gold, which is luxurious and rich when matched with the decoration and furnishings that emphasize Dan red. 
The temple had different uses in the Ming and Qing dynasties. Before the ceremony of the Ming Dynasty, the emperor often changed clothes here. In the Qing Dynasty, every New Year's Eve and the 15th day of the first month, the emperor's family banquet and palace examination were held in Baohe Hall.

The Fengxian Hall is located on the east side of the Three Palaces in the Forbidden City and was first built during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. 'Fengxian' means to worship ancestors. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, this was a family temple where emperors worshipped their ancestors. The hall is divided into two parts, front and back, connected by a passage in the middle, forming a "gong" shaped hall structure. The rear hall is adorned with divine plaques of emperors and empresses from various dynasties. Every year during major national celebrations such as Lunar New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and birthdays, the emperor would move the ancestral tablet to the front hall for worship. On the birthdays and deathdays of the deceased emperor and empress, as well as the festivals such as Yuanxiao (Filled round balls made of glutinous rice-flour for Lantern Festival) and Tomb Sweeping Day, the emperor would go to the back hall to offer incense and salute. Now Fengxian Hall has been transformed into a clock exhibition hall, showcasing over 200 various watches made in the 18th century both domestically and internationally. In ancient China, the use of gnomon, sundials, and leaking pots for timekeeping was common. However, during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, European mechanical clocks began to be introduced to China, gradually replacing traditional timers. In the 18th century, the Qing court extensively used mechanical clocks and watches. These clocks are accurate in timing, exquisitely designed, colorful, and have beautiful music, humorous acting skills, and various auspicious meanings. They are deeply loved by the emperor's backdoor and have become precious furnishings and decorations in the palace. Most of the clocks and watches in the Qing Dynasty's old collection have been preserved to this day and are an important category in the cultural relics collection of the Palace Museum. The clock museum displays exquisite pieces of these watches, including copper teapot drip, rosewood tower style large clock, hardwood carved tower style self ringing clock, copper gold-plated office clock, copper inlaid gold rooster animal seat tower style watch, etc. In addition, there are various boutique clocks and watches on display in the exhibition halls such as Qinggong Manufacturing Office, essence of Guangzhou, Charm of Suzhou, and French Elixir.

The Hall of Nourishing Nature, the Hall of Music and Longevity, and the Yihe Pavilion are arranged in sequence north of the Ningshou Palace. After Emperor Qianlong became the Grand Emperor, he mainly lived here, and Empress Dowager Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday. Among the three halls, the Le Shou Hall is more magnificent. The interior decoration of the hall is often wrapped in precious woods such as rosewood and rosewood, and decorated with jade and enamel, appearing elegant and luxurious. In the center of the north hall of the indoor space, there is a huge jade sculpture of Yu the Great's flood control painting, Yushan, which is housed in the Forbidden City. The walls of the corridor outside the hall are embedded with carved stones of the "Jingshengzhai Dharma Script", all of which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's famous calligraphy and classic quotes. At present, these three palaces have been converted into the Palace Museum Treasures, with a particularly rich collection of treasures, including Buddhist supplies, jewelry, daily utensils, and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, emerald, pearls, and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by renowned craftsmen from all over the country. Exhausting all ingenuity and spare no expense, its craftsmanship represents the high level of the time. Among them, the red coral lion, which is 14 centimeters high, and the golden "Fengtian Treasure" seal, which is 17.5 centimeters high, are rare treasures.

shortFeatures: According to legend, the place where the emperor climbed to enjoy the moon
summary:
Located at the northern end of the central axis of the Forbidden City, it covers an area of more than 12,000 square meters. It was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty and named "Palace Houyuan". It was renamed "Imperial Garden" in the Yongzheng Dynasty of the Qing Dynasty. 
The buildings in the park adopt the symmetrical layout of the central axis, and the buildings are mostly leaning against walls. Only a few beautifully shaped pavilions stand in the park, and the space is wide. 
Cypress and locust trees are planted in the garden, with potted plants and bronze statues to add vitality, forming an evergreen scenery all year round, highlighting the Han culture of harmony between man and nature. 
In early spring, the apricot trees next to Chengrui Pavilion in the Royal Garden gradually enter the full bloom period.

poiName: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests
shortFeatures: The landmark building of the Temple of Heaven
summary:
The Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, also known as the Valley Prayer Altar, is the place where Meng Chun's Valley Prayer Ceremony is held. It was built in 1420 and is also the earliest building of the Temple of Heaven. 
The Hall of Prayer for Good Years is the landmark building of the Temple of Heaven. The altar is a circular building combining the altar and the temple, which is built according to the ancient saying of "offering sacrifices to the emperor under the house". 
There are 28 golden nanmu pillars in the hall, which are arranged in a circle. The beams in the hall are painted with dragons, phoenix and seals, and the whole building is magnificent. 
· In addition to the main building, the altar of the Hall of Prayer for Good Goods, there are also the Huanggan Hall, the east and west side halls, the Gate of Prayer for Good Goods, etc. beside the altar.

shortFeatures: The walls are extremely smooth and tidy
summary:
The echo wall, located in the Temple of Heaven Park, is the circular wall of the imperial dome. The wall is made of Shandong Linqing bricks and ground bricks, and is covered with blue glazed tube tile roof. 
Because the curvature of the wall is very regular, it becomes a good reflector of sound waves. Two people can stand at both ends of the wall and hear the sound. 
The two of them answered, asked questions and answered, and their voices were long and interesting. Feel the wisdom and magic of the ancients.

The Summer Palace Corridor is located on the north bank of Kunming Lake, south of Wanshou Mountain, and was built during the Qianlong period. The long corridor was damaged during the invasion of Beijing by the British and French armies, and was rebuilt in 1888. Currently, it is one of the scenic spots worth visiting in the Summer Palace. There are a large number of murals painted on both sides of the corridor, and the richness of the paintings has once been recorded in the Guinness World Records.

shortFeatures: One of the symbol buildings of the motherland
summary:
· The Monument to the People's Heroes is located in the center of Tiananmen Square in Beijing, the capital, and was built to commemorate the revolutionary martyrs in modern Chinese history.  
The whole Hero Monument is carved with more than 170 figures, which summarizes and vividly shows the great historical facts of the people's revolution in China in the past hundred years. 
On the front of the tablet, there are eight characters "People's Heroes Live Forever" inscribed by Chairman Mao himself, and on the back there is an inscription drafted by Chairman Mao and written by Premier Zhou Enlai. 
· This is the memory of the older generation and the study place of the younger generation. When you come to Tiananmen Square, you will definitely come here to commemorate it.

shortFeatures: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of miles, with magnificent mountains and rivers; from the Great Wall, one can enjoy the enchanting autumn scenery.
summary:
- Located in Huairou District, it is one of the new sixteen scenic spots of Beijing, connecting to the Juyongguan Great Wall to the west and Gubeikou to the east.  
- With a total length of approximately 5400 meters, it is currently the longest section of the Great Wall in China. The open section is about 2250 meters long, with three enemy towers standing on the main pass, a rare sight.  
- Famous Great Wall scenic spots such as Jiankou, Niujiaobian, and Yingfeidaoyang are located at the western end of the Mutianyu Great Wall, representing the essence of the Great Wall.  
- Former British Prime Minister John Major, former U.S. President Bill Clinton, and several other foreign leaders have visited the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall.
