summary: The Bird's Nest (National Stadium) is located at the northern end of Beijing's central axis and was the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. With its high-end and atmospheric appearance and hosting of numerous international competitions, it has become one of Beijing's new landmarks in recent years. The unique appearance of the sports stadium is woven into the shape of a "bird's nest" with steel interwoven like tree branches. The undulating curved lines make it look like a rhythmic life form, and the shape is highly visually impactful. The Xiangyun Torch Tower, which was originally placed on top of the Bird's Nest, has now been moved to the Torch Square on the northeast side of the Bird's Nest, and can be seen outside the stadium. The interior of the Bird's Nest is densely packed with nearly 100000 red audience seats, which is quite spectacular. At the same time, some exhibitions related to the Bird's Nest construction project and Olympic themes are displayed, which can be visited inside the Bird's Nest with a 50 yuan ticket. If you buy an 80 yuan ticket for the Bird's Nest Sky Corridor (referred to as "Top Beauty"), in addition to visiting the above content, you can also take the elevator to the top on the north side of the fifth floor of the Bird's Nest - the original location of the Xiangyun Torch Tower. Through the steel mesh under your feet, you can enjoy a panoramic view of the longitudinal and transverse steel structures and the scenery inside the Bird's Nest; The surrounding Linglong Tower and the Olympic Park Scenic Avenue are all within sight; Looking far into Beijing, if the weather is good, you can even see the outline of Jingshan Park to the south. If you buy a VIP ticket for 110 yuan, in addition to the 50 yuan tour ticket and the Bird's Nest aerial corridor, you will also add a VIP area, a golden hall, a golden passage, and a magnificent yet dignified lounge, which can be described as a combination of "high-end" and "high-end". The appearance of the Bird's Nest is already unique enough for tourists to take photos outside without visiting the interior. There are many landscape lights around the Bird's Nest square, all designed in the shape of a bird's nest. The photos taken with the "Little Bird's Nest" landscape lights as the foreground and the "Big Bird's Nest" National Stadium as the background are quite interesting. At night, the bird's nest lights up with red lights, while the blue lights of the nearby water cube (which may change to other colors) complement each other. The night view is beautiful, but don't be too late, otherwise turn off the lights. There is an artificial river to the east of the Bird's Nest. Find your favorite spot by the artificial river and take a photo of the illuminated Bird's Nest and its reflection on the water surface, which is the "standard photo" of the Bird's Nest. In addition to hosting sports events, the Bird's Nest also hosts cultural and artistic events such as concerts. Inside the Bird's Nest, there are souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Bird's Nest itself for sale. The square between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube sells long strings of kites (many small kites are connected into a string), which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. In addition, the water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

tagNameList: Swimming Pools; Modern Architecture; Nighttime sightseeing
summary: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing's urban area, with a very unique building. The exterior walls are composed of more than 3000 irregular air cushion bubbles, which look like water molecules in the blue sea from a distance. The colorful lights at night are dazzling, making it a great place to capture night scenes. Upon entering the interior of the Water Cube, the sunlight seeped in and revealed that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the exterior walls, but several layers. It was as if one had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess within the stacked bubbles. Many people have the idea of poking when they see bubbles. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is composed of so many inflatable bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, which is the "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor, covering an area of 170 square meters. Other places cannot touch the special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles. Please gently touch them in the 'Bubble Bar' and take care of the Water Cube. If you want to have an intimate encounter with cool water while swimming, you can satisfy yourself at the swimming pool on the first floor and the Water Cube amusement park. Swimming in the swimming pool used by Olympic athletes also gives you the feeling of being a sports star. The deep water area of the swimming pool cannot be accessed casually. The staff on the side have strict supervision and must have a deep water permit. When entering the water cube, you can request the staff to apply for a deep water permit on the spot. After swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, an additional fee of 20 yuan is required for the deep water permit, and remember to bring a 1-inch photo. The swimming pool locker is free. The Water Cube of the Water Playground is equipped with amusement facilities such as deep-sea tornadoes (loudspeakers), high-speed tube slides, and crazy tsunamis (artificial waves), making it an exciting indoor water amusement park. The locker at the Water Cube Playground requires an additional rental fee and a deposit for the key card. No cash is required for using the key card in the park. If needed, you can recharge at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when returning the key card. Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube amusement park have air conditioning, with constant temperature throughout the year, and can also be played in winter. It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Playground, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session lasts for 2 hours and includes bathing and changing clothes (an additional 30 minutes for the Deepwater Water Certificate exam). Overtime will be charged, with a fee of 20 yuan for the first 30 minutes, 30 yuan for the first 30 to 60 minutes, and 40 yuan for the first 60 minutes or more. At night, when shooting night scenes, the Water Cube will light up with blue as the main color, occasionally changing colors to complement the red lights of the nearby Bird's Nest (National Stadium), like a "double sky of ice and fire". You can come and shoot night scenes. The Water Cube will turn off the lights around 21:30-10:00 at night, so don't be too late if you only want to see the night scene and don't visit the interior. In addition to hosting water sports events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the popular 2013 TV show "Star Diving Cube". The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the open space between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, there are long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) sold in the sea, which are very unique and can be played with by flying kites. The water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive. Full text 

summary: The Olympic Park is located at the northern end of the Beijing Central Axis Extension Line. It embodies the three major concepts of "technology, green, and humanities", and is a new urban area that integrates multiple functions such as office, commercial, hotel, cultural, sports, conference, and residential.

Peking University, abbreviated as "Peking University", is located in Haidian District, Beijing. It is one of the earliest established national universities in China and also one of the most famous higher education institutions in China. Peking University is renowned for its long history, profound cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Weiming Lake and Boya Tower, which are great places for tourists to learn about the history and culture of Chinese higher education.

summary: Tsinghua University is a renowned higher education institution in China, located in Haidian District, Beijing. There are many historical buildings and beautiful natural landscapes on campus, such as Tsinghua Garden and the moonlit lotus pond, making it a great place to learn about the history of modern education and architectural art in China.

shortFeatures: State education departments in Ming and Qing Dynasties
summary:
Located in Guozijian Street, Andingmen, Beijing, adjacent to Confucius Temple and Lama Temple, it is the highest administrative institution of state management education in Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties in China and the highest institution of learning established by the state. 
Confucius Temple is a part of imperial academy, formerly known as imperial academy Confucius Temple or Capital Confucius Temple. It is the place where the emperor held the national ceremony of offering sacrifices to Confucius. It and imperial academy form the system of "left temple and right study". 
October-April is the best tourist season every year, with warm spring flowers and pleasant climate. You can also stroll around Huangchenggen Park and enjoy flowers and birds, which is very pleasant. 
Wisteria flower is one of the characteristics of the scenic spot, and many tourists come here every spring.

shortFeatures: A well-known old shopping district in Beijing
summary:
The church was founded in 1655, and it is the second Catholic church in Beijing after "Nantang". 
The whole building is made of brick and wood structure, with grey brick and clear water walls, and the western classical style incorporates the characteristics of traditional Chinese architecture. 
· It is a Roman architectural church, which is a model of the blending of Chinese and Western architectural styles. 
During the festival, I sometimes walk by the hall, and the vigorous sound of electric organ and choir songs will come from inside.

shortFeatures: The landmark of Beijing's fashionable life

summary:
· Dashilan, pronounced "dàshílànr", is a famous commercial street outside Qianmen in Beijing. 
· Located in the center of old Beijing, it is an important part of the south central axis. It is located south of Tiananmen Square and west of Qianmen Street, with a total length of 275 meters from the east exit to the west exit. 
There are rows of shopping, dining, entertainment and other shops in the block, and all the time-honored brands are arranged among them, which is a must-choice place to experience Beijing culture. 
It was once the entertainment center of Beijing. Many famous theaters, teahouses, bookstores and the earliest cinemas in Beijing history have settled here. It is worth visiting.

· Dashuifa Site is a part of the Chinese and Western Building Scenic Spot in Yuanmingyuan, Beijing. 
The main scene of Xiyang Building Scenic Area is the artificial fountain, which is called "Water Law" at the time. It is characterized by a large number, great momentum and peculiar conception. 
· It mainly forms three large fountain groups: Harmony, Haiyantang and Dashuifa, which are quite interesting and are the essence of Chinese and Western cultures.

shortFeatures: A collection of over a hundred aircraft
summary:
The China Aviation Museum is the first large-scale aviation museum in China open to the public. Located at the foot of Da Tang Mountain in Changping, Beijing, it houses 91 types of aircraft, with a total of 163 aircraft, as well as over 600 pieces of missile, radar, anti-aircraft artillery, and other military equipment. On August 20, 2007, the museum was rated as a National 4A Tourist Attraction by the National Tourism Quality Rating Committee.

As a window for the development of Air Force culture, the museum thoroughly documents the history of the birth, growth, and strengthening of the Air Force of New China, and showcases the history, reality, and future of national defense technology. Over the past 20 years, the China Aviation Museum has played a unique and positive role in strengthening patriotic education, promoting fine traditions, raising awareness of national defense, popularizing scientific knowledge, facilitating international exchanges, and promoting tourism.

Covering an area of over 50 hectares, the museum has two large exhibition halls—the Cave Hall and the Outdoor Aircraft Display Area. The Cave Hall, converted from an aircraft storage facility built in the 1970s, is grand and spacious, with a total area of 20,000 square meters. It mainly displays representative and precious aircraft from various periods of China’s aviation history, including the Initial Training Aircraft–5, which ended China’s history of being unable to build aircraft; the J-12, China’s newly designed fighter jet (aerial version of Li Xiangyang); and the Y-5, which once carried the ashes of the Premier back to the motherland.

The outdoor exhibition area mainly displays aircraft from around the world, such as the British-made “Viscount” transport aircraft, the world’s first to use a turboprop engine, along with other fine aircraft models. In addition, the museum hosts exhibitions such as the "Engine Series," "Treasures Exhibition," "Aviation Photography Equipment Exhibition," "Rescue and Protective Equipment Exhibition," and "Chairman Mao's Airplane Exhibition." The museum houses over 100 types of aircraft, more than 200 aircraft in total, and over 600 aviation exhibits, including surface-to-air missiles, radar, and more, with many exquisite items on display. With such a large scale, the China Aviation Museum is one of the few aviation-themed museums in the world, representing a miniature of China’s aviation history and a grand exhibition of aircraft.

Beijing Fengshan Hot Spring Resort is backed by Fengshan and Mangshan National Forest Parks, and faces the Thirteen Tombs Reservoir to the west. It is a secluded paradise away from the hustle and bustle. Here, we gather services such as conferences, hot spring therapy, entertainment, catering, accommodation, etc., providing guests with meticulous and thoughtful integrated family services, allowing you to enjoy the joy of bathing as you please. There are 68 kinds of unique hot spring baths in the Hot Spring Paradise, which add more private space for enjoyment in the distinctive hot spring bathing pool. Amidst the misty spring water, one can witness the splashing of pearls and jade, appreciate the verdant peaks, and experience a pleasant surprise.

summary: Beijing Deyun Society is a cross talk performance group founded by Mr. Degang Guo. It has many branches in Beijing, among which Tianqiao is popular and has cross talk performances every night. This is also the place where Degang Guo made his fortune. "How many tourists don't remember their homes in Tianqiao City with wine flags and drums" is a true portrayal of Beijing's old flyover. Today's Deyun Society Theater integrates folk culture, food culture and tea culture. It is also a must-experience for many people to come to Beijing to watch a cross talk in Deyun Society.

summary: When traveling in old Beijing, the first place to visit is the several hutongs near Houhai and Shichahai in Beijing, such as Zhanzi Hutong, Dongguan Fang Hutong, Dongmei Factory Hutong, Changqiao Hutong, Ximei Factory Hutong, Liuyin Street, Dingfu Street, and Longtoujing Hutong, which belong to the old hutongs on the southwest side of Houhai and Shichahai. Next are the cigarette bag sloping street on the north side of Houhai and the northern edge of Houhai. There are many uniform dressed tricycle drivers in this area who use human powered tricycles to pull up tourists. While pedaling the tricycles vigorously, they introduce the historical stories of the hutongs or official mansions they pass through, or tell you some wild historical rumors. You can also read some books on the historical changes of Beijing's hutongs first, and then freely walk through the streets and alleys to the area around Qianmen West River and Dashilan West Street to learn about the old events in the south of Beijing. You can also visit the Dong Si and Xi Si Hutong Protected Areas, which will be quite interesting during your travels. Full text 

shortFeatures: One of the three outer halls of the Forbidden City
summary:
Zhonghe Hall is one of the three halls outside the Forbidden City. It is located between the Hall of Supreme Harmony and the Hall of Preservation of Harmony, which means adhering to the golden mean and seeking harmony in the world. 
There is the throne of the emperor in the middle of the main hall, and two shoulders are displayed on both sides. The shoulders are one of the sedan chairs on which the emperor rides, mainly used by the emperor for his activities in the Forbidden City. 
· The emperor would rest in the Hall of Zhonghe before going to the Hall of Supreme Harmony for a grand ceremony, and receive worship from deacons.

shortFeatures: The main halls of the three palaces of the Forbidden City
summary:
· Qianqing Palace is the first of the three palaces in the Forbidden City. It is located in Qianqing Gate and is the essence of Han palace architecture. 
On the spacious platform in front of the hall, there are bronze turtles, bronze cranes, sundials and Jialiang on the left and right respectively. There are four gilded incense burners in front, and the hall is covered with gold bricks. 
It used to be the bedroom of the emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and it was also the place where the emperors of the Ming and Qing Dynasties handled daily political affairs. Now it is the original display of court life.

Located in the southern half of the Temple of Heaven, Qiu Qiu was founded in 1530. Qiu Qiu was the place where the emperor held the ceremony of worshipping heaven in the winter solstice, also known as the Temple of Heaven. 
The hill faces south, surrounded by red palace walls and decorated with green glazed tiles, commonly known as "sub-walls". 
The number of stones used in the altar is all related to "nine". The sum of the three floors is 45 feet, which is not only a multiple of nine, but also means "the respect of the ninth five years".

There is a European style garden in the northern part of Changchun Garden in the Yuanming Three Gardens, commonly known as the "Western style Building". Founded in the 12th year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1747), it was basically completed around the 24th year of the Qianlong reign. Including Western style architecture, large fountains, several small fountains, and garden ornaments, they are distributed in a strip along the north wall. It consists of more than 10 landscapes, including Xieqiqu, Huanghua Formation, Bird Cage, Fangwai, Wuzhu Pavilion, Haiyan Hall, Yuanying Temple, Dashui, Guanshui, Xianfa Mountain, Fanghe, and Xianfa Painting, with a total area of about 8 hectares.

The Binhai Science and Technology Museum has a building area of approximately 26000 square meters and an exhibition area of approximately 17000 square meters. The main body of Binhai Science and Technology Museum consists of four floors. On the first to fourth floors of the venue, there are four main themes: "Technology Illuminates the Binhai", "Science Changes Cognition", "Technology Expands Perspectives", and "Smart Creating the World". There are 16 permanent exhibition areas and over 350 exhibits of various types. In addition, there are cinemas, science classrooms, and science laboratories.

summary: The Yanle Shengping Crosstalk Teahouse is located on the second floor of the Food Street in Tianjin's Ancient Culture Street. Nowadays, "tasting the 'Three Wonders of Tianjin' and listening to teahouse cross-talk" has become a nationwide sensation. On stage, there was a piece of sobering wood, a folding fan, and a handkerchief. The actors were dressed in long robes and jackets, with their mouths flowing and their witty words echoing. Dozens or even hundreds of audience members were sipping tea and cracking melon seeds, laughing and applauding incessantly.

Feng Guozhang, also known as Huafu, was born in Hejian, Hebei in the seventh year of the Xianfeng reign (1857). The Feng family owned multiple properties in Tianjin, two of which were his residences. The more famous ones are located at No. 50-54 Minzhu Road and Huayuan Lane on Haihe East Road in present-day Hebei District. Feng purchased three buildings from Austrian engineer Bruner in 1913, covering an area of 6.376 acres. In 1915, a German architect was commissioned to design an expansion and extension based on the original architectural style, and a garden style garden was built, known as the "Feng Family Garden" or "Feng Family Courtyard". There are a total of 110 buildings and 54 bungalows with a construction area of 4661 square meters. Another building is located at the corner of Fourth Road and Yuwei Road in Hebei Province (now No. 6 Yuwei Road, Hebei District), with a total of 24 buildings and 47 bungalows, with a construction area of 1425 square meters. The main building in the courtyard is a two-story Western style small western-style building with a unique design and strong overall integrity.

tagNameList: Explore the exhibition hall; Treasure place for walking babies
shortFeatures: View the fossils of extinct animals and plants
summary:
· Located in the Tianqiao area on the central axis of the south city of the capital, it is backed by the World Cultural Heritage Temple of Heaven Park and faces the modern Tianqiao Theater. 
There are four basic exhibitions and a Dinosaur World Expo. The number of large-scale ancient mammal fossils in the exhibition museum ranks second in the world, and the ancient elephant fossils and dinosaur fossils of the Yellow River are famous at home and abroad. 
If you are bringing children, you must go to the "Discovery Corner" in the museum, so that you can give full play to your imagination.

shortFeatures: A famous hutong in Beijing
summary:
Located in the southeast of Dongcheng District, it starts from Chaoyangmen South Street in the east, ends at Dongsi South Street in the west, connects with East and West Luoquan Hutongs in the south, and is adjacent to Ministry of Internal Affairs Street in the north. 
It is a very famous hutong, and it is also one of the more than 40 hutongs in Beijing that have retained their old names since the Yuan and Ming Dynasties. 
It is also close to Dongyue Temple, Longfu Temple, Zhihua Temple, Mosque, Daci Yanfu Palace and other temples. The former residents include Zhang Shizhao and Zhang Hanzhi. 
Hutongs have neat buildings and good houses, mostly large houses. Many historical celebrities and upper-class nobles once lived here.

Jinyu Hutong is located in Dongcheng District, Beijing, starting from Dongdan North Street in the east and ending at Wangfujing Street in the west. The total length of the alley is 567 meters, wider than the average hutong, and can be considered a road. Since 1988, there have been more restaurants and hotels in Jinyu Hutong, including the famous Donglaishun Restaurant, Guolv Building, Wangfu Peninsula Hotel, Heping Hotel, and Taiwan Hotel. Therefore, it is called "Hotel Hutong". There was originally the mansion of the late Qing Dynasty scholar Natong in the alley, commonly known as that garden. Later, the Peace Hotel (Novotel Peace Hotel) and the Wangfu Hotel (now Wangfu Peninsula Hotel) were expanded, and half of the Jinyu Hutong was demolished, and the garden was also demolished. Nowadays, the road of Jinyu Hutong is spacious, with high-rise buildings on both sides of the street. The west entrance connects to Wangfujing Street, which is lively and bustling. The scene of the Hutong in the past is no longer there.

Lanman Hutong is located in the south of Beijing city, starting from Nanheng West Street in the south and ending at Guangnei Street in the north. It can be considered a major alley in the southern part of the city. Lanman Hutong, formerly known as "Lanmian Hutong", was mentioned by Zhao Jishi, a Qing Dynasty scholar, in his book "Ji Yuan Ji Suo Ji": "In February of the capital, Taogou was a foul smelling place, and Lanmian Hutong was particularly deep and wide, each two zhang, with no traffic or horses when driving..." According to research, this alley was a moat from the Five Dynasties to the Liao Dynasty. In the late Qing Dynasty, it changed its elegant name to "Lanman Hutong". From north to south in the alley, there used to be Hunan Guild Hall, Hanzhong Guild Hall, Xiangjiang Guild Hall, Dongguan Guild Hall, and Changshu Guild Hall, but now only Hunan Guild Hall is still preserved. There is a Lotus Temple built in the Ming Dynasty in the alley, and only one courtyard remains. During the Qing Dynasty, Han scholar Hong Liangji was convicted of guarding the border and resided here; At the beginning of the 20th century, scholar painter Yao Mang's father lived here for a long time. The alley almost separated from the Hunan Guild Hall is the South Half Hutong, where Mr. Lu Xun lived for seven years and the famous "Diary of a Madman" was born.

- It is the second largest altar among the Five Altars of Beijing, a place where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties worshiped the "Emperor of the Earth," and it is also the largest remaining altar of sacrifice in China.  
- Autumn is the most beautiful season at the Temple of Earth, with the ginkgo trees in full golden splendor. Compared to the crowded Ginkgo Avenue at the Diaoyutai, the Temple of Earth is much less crowded.  
- The Temple of Earth Book Fair is an annual literary event in Beijing, with a significant influence among readers. It has become a beloved cultural event for the people of the capital.  
- Every year during the Spring Festival, the Temple of Earth holds a lively temple fair, where there are performances of simulated Qing dynasty sacrificial ceremonies, showcasing the grand scale of the emperor's sacrificial rites.

The History Museum of Peking University was founded during the centennial celebration of Peking University in May 1998 and completed in September 2001. The building is divided into three floors with a construction area of 3100 square meters. The first floor is the "Exhibition of Outstanding Figures at Peking University", showcasing the biographies and photos of 217 outstanding revolutionaries, thinkers, theorists, scientists, and educators in the history of Peking University. There is a gift department on the west side of the school history museum where you can purchase relevant reading materials and souvenirs.

If you could only choose one place to appreciate Dalian, where would you choose? The "Romantic Star" Ferris wheel of Dalian Forest Zoo is located at the entrance of the free range area of Dalian Forest Zoo, adjacent to the forest sea and three thousand cute animals. With an altitude of nearly 100 meters, it offers a panoramic view of the beauty of the romantic capital. The "Romantic Star" Ferris wheel has a diameter of about 70 meters and offers a 360 ° unobstructed view, overlooking the southern coastal scenery of Dalian from start to finish. Nearby, there is the Cute Beast Star Bay Cross Sea Bridge and the Coastal City Cluster, while in the distance, there is Yanwo Ridge and Huangni River, providing a high-altitude sightseeing experience.

tagNameList: Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
summary: The Shuanglei Battery is located in Beitang Ancient Town and is a magnificent building. Standing on the battery, you can overlook the entire ancient town and also see the Rainbow Bridge. The night view is very beautiful.

· Tiananmen Gate Tower is located at the northern end of Tiananmen Square, on the central axis of Beijing. It is one of the most magnificent towers in ancient China and a place that every tourist who comes to Beijing must not miss. 
· On Tiananmen Square, you can see the standing Tiananmen Gate Tower from a distance. When you walk to the foot of the tower, the red tower seen countless times in textbooks and TV is close at hand. 
· The interior of the tower is antique. You can visit the living room of that year, as well as graphic and text exhibitions, and you can learn about the evolution of Tiananmen Square in various periods and the important activities held here. 
Many tourists imitate Chairman Mao's classic waving gesture at the founding ceremony and take photos here, which gives them a very wonderful sense of crossing and national pride. 
· It is also worth mentioning that the night view of the Tiananmen Gate Tower is also very beautiful. When the lanterns are first turned on, the landscape lights on the tower, which complement other buildings in Tiananmen Square, making it particularly magnificent.

shortFeatures: Named after the Confucius Temple and Imperial Academy
summary: Guozijian Street is located between Yonghegong Street and Andingmennei Street in Dongcheng District, and is an east-west hutong in Andingmen, Dongcheng District, Beijing. It starts from Lama Temple Street in the east and ends at Andingmennei Street in the west. One of the first "Chinese Historical and Cultural Streets". It is named after the Confucius Temple and imperial academy here, also known as imperial academy Hutong. On June 14th, 2008, the ancient street of imperial academy, which has a history of more than 700 years, showed its "old face" again. The renovated Confucius Temple and imperial academy have restored their historical pattern and regulation, and Beijing Confucius Temple and imperial academy Museum officially opened.

shortFeatures: A famous commercial district in Beijing

summary: Located in B2 of Wangfujing Department Store in Caichang Hutong, Dongcheng District, Beijing, Peace Fruit Bureau authentically restores the life scene of that era, taking you back to the era of "longing".

The Cining Palace is the essence of ancient Chinese palace architecture. Founded in the 15th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty, the Cining Palace was the residence of the previous imperial concubines.

The Imperial Vault of Heaven is located north of the Round Hill Altar of the Temple of Heaven, and is a place where the altar of the Round Hill Altar worships the divine position and stores sacrificial plaques. The Imperial Dome is a brick and wood structure. There is no cross beam in the hall. The roof is supported by 8 eaves columns, 8 gold columns and many arch of wooden architecture. Three layers of ceiling and coffered ceiling, with each layer folded in, are extremely distinctive and rare in ancient architecture. The eaves of the hall are covered with blue glazed tiles, and there is a gilded crown on the eaves. The walls of the hall are brick walls made of perfectly round polished bricks, which look like a sapphire umbrella with a golden crown when viewed from afar. There are two side halls on either side of the Imperial Vault, each with a width of five rooms. The structure is a single eaved gable roof, and outside the main hall are the famous Echo Wall, Three Tones Stone, and Dialogue Stone. The imperial dome enclosure has the function of transmitting sound, commonly known as the echo wall. The San Yin Stone is located on the corridor in front of the Imperial Palace. Standing at the Three Tones Stone and clapping, you can hear three echoes, a phenomenon known as human whispers and heavenly thunder.

poiName: National Centre for the Performing Arts
shortFeatures: Visit the beautiful water drop architecture
summary: The National Centre for the Performing Arts is the highest performance venue in Beijing and the highest hall of Chinese performing arts. The theater is located on Chang'an Street in the west of Beijing, adjacent to the Great Hall of the People and Tiananmen Square. The north entrance is connected to Tiananmen West Station of the subway, and there is a ticket office at the entrance. Its architectural appearance is unique, which is a steel structure shell with a semi-ellipsoidal shape, novel shape and unique conception; The underwater promenade inside is 80m long and sparkling. The National Centre for the Performing Arts has three professional theaters: the concert hall on the east side, the opera house in the middle and the theater on the west side. In addition, there is an experimental small theater to meet the entertainment and cultural needs of people of all ages.

Cining Garden is located southwest of Cining Palace on Outer West Road of the Inner Court. The garden is approximately 130 meters long from north to south and 50 meters wide from east to west, covering a total area of 6800 square meters.

Shoukang Palace was the residence of Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager of the Qing Dynasty, where the imperial concubines and concubines resided. After the death of Empress Dowager Xiaosheng Xian, Emperor Qianlong still visited Shoukang Palace every year on Christmas Day and the day before Shangyuan Festival, offering incense and worshiping the throne to express his grief and admiration.

· Located outside Huangji Gate, Ningshou Palace District, Forbidden City, it is a single-sided glazed shadow wall built against the palace wall, which was fired during the Qianlong period. 
The upper part is a yellow glazed roof, and the eaves are an imitation wood structure. The wall is shaded with clouds and water, with blue and green colors, which sets off the momentum of water and sky connection. The lower part is a white marble stone base, which is dignified and dignified. 
· Kowloon is made of high relief technique, which has a strong three-dimensional sense. The strange cliff stones running through the center of the wall separate nine panlong dragons into five spaces, and the production process fully shows the wisdom and artistic talent of the ancient Han working people.

Shichahai Bar Street is a gathering place for bars with a more artistic atmosphere in Beijing. The bars are either located on the picturesque Shichahai beach or in the old Beijing style hutongs and courtyards. Compared to places like Gongti and Sanlitun Bar Street, the bars here are quieter, and many bars and music bars often have resident singers who sing very well. The bars along the lake near Shichahai are mainly distributed in three parts, namely the Lotus Market and Qianhai section, near Yindian Bridge, and the Houhai section. Most bars are ancient style buildings, and the lakeside environment is very elegant. Some bars even set up tables and chairs along the road by the lake, and it's very pleasant to drink and chat outside on summer nights. However, due to the popularity in recent years and the proliferation of bars, the quality and variety of services have also begun to vary. Dishonest situations such as desperately soliciting customers and vulgar performances on the street often occur, and it is necessary to choose a bar that suits oneself. Among them, bars such as Huomu Bar, Jiadingfang, and Tianyudi are popular for their band performances and you can try them out. Compared to the proliferation and noise of bars along the lake, the bars in the hutongs near Shichahai appear to be of higher quality. In several alleys on the west side of Shichahai, there are very good specialty bars. Most bars are located in traditional quadrangle courtyards. Although they do not have a view along the lake, the environment is quiet and elegant, with their own themes and characteristics. Some environments are very comfortable, some are very petty bourgeois, and some have great resident bands and singers. Many of the folk musicians who have become popular in recent years have sung here. If you don't go to the bar, it's also a good choice to just come and stroll around at night. Standing on the Yindian Bridge at night, the trees on both sides of the lake sway, and the lights on the shore are red and green, creating a beautiful urban night scene that is suitable for photography. The quadrangle courtyard is a traditional building in Beijing, and today's quadrangle courtyards are all newly renovated. Here, birds sing and flowers bloom, ancient and modern.

Located in Chaoyang District, Beijing, it is a newly built ice competition venue for the Beijing Winter Olympics. The "ribbon dancing" on its exterior symbolizes speed skating on the main road, and the "ice ribbon" glass curtain wall shines brightly. Inside the venue, the ice surface is white and transparent. The venue will become a multifunctional venue capable of hosting events such as short track, figure skating, ice hockey, and curling, as well as mass ice sports.

summary: Kunming Lake occupies three-quarters of the area of the Summer Palace, with beautiful scenery and is the soul of the entire garden. Every summer and autumn, a large number of tourists come to enjoy boating on the lake, admiring the pavilions and towers by the lake, and admiring the beautiful scenery of the entire park. In addition to the beautiful scenery of the lake, attractions such as the Seventeen Arch Bridge and the West Embankment in the lake are also worth savoring. Overview of Travel: Kunming Lake can be divided into three parts based on the division of water bodies: Great Lake, West Lake, and Back Lake. It takes about 2 hours to walk around the lake for a week. In summer and autumn, you can take a boat tour of the lake, which is both relaxing and enjoyable, without missing out on sightseeing and sightseeing. There are 8 boat docks and 5 different types of boats in the park. The prices and routes of cruise ships vary, please consult the scenic area for details. The main attraction to the east of Kunming Lake is Zhichun Pavilion, which is said to be where the thawing of Kunming Lake begins every spring. Not only can you capture the beautiful scenery of the entire park here, but the vast water color will also give you a very artistic silhouette effect. The seventeen span bridge spans between Nanhu Island and the east bank, with a length of 150 meters, like a long rainbow perched on the sparkling blue waves. It is a replica of Lugou Bridge, with stone lions of various shapes carved on the top of each stone barrier on the bridge, appearing exquisite, majestic, and beautiful. On the east bank of the Seventeen Arch Bridge, there stands a national octagonal pavilion. Nearby, there is a beautifully crafted bronze bull, the size of a real cow, squatting with its head held high and ears raised. If one hears something and looks back in surprise, it is very beautiful and vivid. Originally taken from the meaning of a divine cow guarding the water, it is now a precious cultural relic. To the south of the Seventeen Arch Bridge, there is a west embankment modeled after the West Lake Su Causeway, with six exquisitely constructed bridge pavilions that are worth a visit.

Today, no one in countrymen knows about Guo Degang, and no one knows about Deyun Society. It's a pity to come to Beijing and not listen to Duan Guo style crosstalk. Deyun Society was founded by cross-talk performer Mr. Guo Degang in 1995 with the aim of "bringing cross-talk back to the theater" and creating "true cross-talk". On July 3, 2011, Deyun Society opened up a new form of cross-talk at the Beizhan Theater, using a mix of drama and cross-talk to perform various styles of cross-talk from the Qing Dynasty to the establishment of New China for the audience. Guo Degang was born in Tianjin in 1973 and has had a passion for folk art since childhood. At the age of 8, he entered the art world and first studied storytelling under the guidance of his predecessor Gao Qinghai. Later, he studied xiangsheng under the master of xiangsheng, Chang Baofeng, and received guidance and instruction from many xiangsheng masters. During this time, he also devoted himself to studying various opera genres such as Peking Opera, Pingju, and Hebei Bangzi, and traveled to the pear orchard, where he worked on the art of literature, ugliness, and bronze hammers, playing a very important role in enriching his cross-talk performances. By drawing inspiration from various art forms, one has developed their own style. The phrase 'Jiuqi Xigu Tianqiao City, how many tourists don't remember their homes' is a true portrayal of the old Tianqiao in Beijing. The current' Beijing Deyun She Theater 'can also allow you to rediscover the common culture of the ancient capital and enjoy traditional folk art.

shortFeatures: Higher specification doors in ancient China
summary:
Taihe Gate is the main entrance of the outer palace of the Forbidden City. It was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. It can be called the highest-standard gate in ancient China and belongs to one of the five gates of the emperor. 
· Sitting on a white marble pedestal, a pair of bronze lions on the left and right side of the door were cast in the Ming Dynasty, which is also the largest pair of bronze lions in the Forbidden City. 
Inside the gate is the Hall of Supreme Harmony. Both the Ming and Qing Dynasties had a system of "listening to politics at the imperial gate". The emperor had to accept ministers' worship and handle political affairs in front of Taihe Gate. 
Between Taihe Gate and Wumen Gate is Taihe Gate Square, and the inner Jinshui River flows from west to east, echoing the Jingshan Mountain behind it, which makes the royal family have excellent feng shui with the mountain behind and the water facing.

shortFeatures: Higher architectural skills in ancient China
summary:
The turret is a building in the southeast, northwest and northwest corners of the Forbidden City, consisting of nine beams, eighteen columns and seventy-two ridges. 
It carries the highest architectural skills in ancient China and is one of the most representative buildings of the Forbidden City. 
The turret is strange and colorful in shape, and the best place to photograph the turret is the northwest corner outside the moat. 
The renovated turret has taken on a new look, and the yellow glazed tile roof and gilded treasure roof shine brightly in the sun.

poiName: Confucian Temple And Imperial College Museum
summary: The Confucius Temple and the Guozijian Museum are composed of ancient buildings in Beijing, which are closely adjacent and have similar themes. They are now open to the public as the same scenic area. The ticket office is located next to the entrance of the Confucius Temple. After purchasing tickets, enter the Confucius Temple and enter the Guozijian for sightseeing at the "Chijing Gate" next to the Stele Pavilion. The Confucius Temple was first built in the Yuan Dynasty and was a place where Confucius was worshipped during the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. The building has a large scale, and it takes about 1-2 hours to visit and tour inside the Confucian Temple. There are three main points to pay attention to when visiting Confucian temples. The first is that there are rare Yuan Dynasty style ancient buildings in the temple, which are very unique in Beijing. The second is the numerous stone tablets in the courtyard, including inscriptions by Yuan Chonghuan, Lin Zexu, Li Hongzhang and others, name tablets for over 50000 successful candidates from the Yuan Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, and a forest of steles engraved with the Thirteen Classics of Confucianism, which are rich in content and very precious. The third is the traditional ritual dance "Dacheng Ritual Music" performed several times a day in the Chongsheng Temple, which showcases ancient traditional culture and art, and is very exciting. In addition, the courtyard is antique with many towering ancient trees, as well as memorial tablets and cultural relics exhibitions dedicated to Confucius, all of which can be visited one by one. Guozijian was a national institution of learning during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and also the place where emperors personally gave lectures in the past. Like inside the Confucian Temple, the buildings here are also ancient and charming, with towering ancient trees in the courtyard that look quaint and beautiful. It is suitable for visiting and taking photos, and usually takes about an hour for sightseeing. When visiting the Imperial Academy, you can pay attention to the buildings inside. Jixian Gate, Taixue Gate, glazed memorial archway and other buildings are very distinctive, especially the glazed memorial archway, which is a landmark of the Imperial College. The Biyong Hall is the main body of the Imperial Academy, surrounded by a circular pool on the outside and a square shaped central hall, which is very unique. The Yilun Hall next to it is the place where ancient emperors gave lectures, and you can also visit it well. There are also perennial exhibitions such as the "Ancient Chinese Imperial Examination Exhibition" and the "Exhibition of the Original State of the Imperial Academy" inside the Imperial Academy, which visitors interested in the imperial examination system can visit. Badaling Wildlife World is located adjacent to Badaling Great Wall Scenic Area and is one of the famous zoos in Beijing. There are hundreds of species and tens of thousands of animals in the park, making it a great place to take children to see animals. The entire zoo can be visited by car, making it convenient to observe and feed animals up close. Overview of the Park: The main entrance of Badaling Wildlife World is located on the north side, and at the end of the south side is an Ark Square. The square area has animal performance areas, viewing areas, and a temple. There are two roads leading from the main entrance on the north side to the square on the south side. One passes through the area of fierce animals (mainly carnivores), and the other is the area of gentle animals (mainly herbivores). The animals in both areas are free range, and tourists can observe them up close. In the gentle animal area, they can also open the car window to feed. The tour route in the park is to first observe the fierce beast area, then reach the square and play in the animal performance area and viewing area near the square, and then return from the gentle animal area to visit and feed gentle animals along the way. The zoo can be accessed by car, which is very convenient, but there is a certain fee for self driving. If it is a non self driving tourist, they need to take public transportation within the park. There are buses for sightseeing in the fierce beast area, as well as more open iron cage feeding vehicles. After arriving at the square for sightseeing, you can walk back from the gentle animal area or take an electric scooter to return. The Beast Zone is the area where tourists first visit the zoo. There are parks such as the White Tiger Park, Wild Wolf Valley, Wild Boar Forest, Lion Tiger Park, and Malay Bear Park. Each park is separated by iron gates to prevent animals from getting mixed up. When vehicles arrive at the gate, the iron gates will automatically open. When driving or taking park transportation through here, you can watch these animals along the way. If you take the zoo's iron cage feeding cart, you can also feed the animals. It should be noted that if driving through this area, the windows must be closed and the doors locked (some animals may open the doors themselves) to prevent accidents. Ark Square is mainly focused on performing arts and entertainment. There is an animal performance venue on the square, where there are animal performances every weekend and holidays. You can see bears riding bicycles, elephants dancing, etc., which is very suitable for bringing children to watch. There are several animal viewing areas on the east side of the square, where animals are kept in cages and can be fed. In some parks, you can hug animal babies and take photos with small animals. On the mountain behind the square, there is also a small Buddhist temple where those interested can visit and worship. On the way back to the gentle animal area, you will pass through the gentle animal area, which is mainly inhabited by herbivores such as spotted deer, zebras, alpacas, camels, etc. You can get off the car to feed them, and many animals will come to eat, which is very interesting. On the way, you will pass by a lake where you can admire animals such as egrets and swans. In addition, there are attractions such as Peacock Garden, Monkey Mountain, Panda House, etc. that can be visited, and some viewing and feeding gardens may charge additional fees. Full text 

shortFeatures: One of the landmarks in Beijing
summary:
· It is located on the central axis of Beijing, the capital, on the shore of Olympic Lake in the northeast of the central area of the Olympic Park, and hangs the permanent Olympic rings symbol. 
· The highest point of the tower is 246.8 meters, which is the sixth tallest in China and the 22nd in the world. 
· With the design concept of "Tree of Life", it means that the Tree of Life breaks out of the earth's crust and grows naturally. 
· It is the only tower in the world composed of five independent towers. The tower itself consists of three parts: a tower base, a tower body and a tower crown.

· Located in the Summer Palace in the western suburbs of Beijing, it is a long bridge connecting the east bank of Kunming Lake and Nanhu Island. 
· Built during the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty, it is the largest stone bridge in the park. The bridge consists of 17 bridge openings, 150 meters long, flying across the East Embankment and Nanhu Island, and looks like a long rainbow lying on waves. 
· Its shape has the characteristics of Beijing Lugou Bridge and Suzhou Baodai Bridge. The stone carvings on the bridge are exquisite, and the watchpillars of each bridge railing are carved with lions with different expressions, with a total of 544 sizes. 
There are also stone carvings of exotic animals at the two bridges, which are very vivid. The north side of the bridge is written "Spirit Beast Yanyue" and the south side is written "Cultivating Lingbo", which contains profound cultural heritage.

shortFeatures: One of the famous buildings of the Summer Palace
summary:
· Buddha Fragrance Pavilion is the main building of the Summer Palace, which is built on a 20-meter-high square platform of Wanshou Mountain. 
· Facing Kunming Lake in the south, backed by the Sea of Wisdom, the buildings centered on it spread out to the two wings in a neat and symmetrical manner, forming a magnificent trend of stars holding the moon. 
Foxiang Pavilion is 41 meters high, with 8 sides, 3 floors and 4 eaves. There are 8 huge iron pear wood Optimus Prime in the pavilion, which is quite complicated in structure and is a masterpiece of classical architecture.

shortFeatures: Granite Tiger Carving Designed by Han Meilin
summary: The largest group animal sculpture in Asia, one of the landmark sculptures in Dalian, and a must-visit place for Dalian tourism. Six tigers of different shapes, with their heads facing the east, howling in the wind, were designed by Han Meilin, a famous painter and sculptor in China. Tiger Carving Square is built on the basis of Qunhu Sculpture, the largest granite stone carving in China. It is the first time that foreign gardening art is adopted, and strange rocks and stones stand among the planted flowers and trees, giving people a novel and peculiar vision. At night, the lights are turned on, which makes Tiger Carving Square more beautiful. Tiger Carving Square is the most gorgeous among many squares in Dalian.

Panshan is located on the west side of Jixian County and is a famous mountain in the Beijing Tianjin area. There are many strange pine trees, rocks, and flowing water on the mountain, and with different heights, three layers of scenery appear in sequence, becoming the famous "Three Pans" scenery. Due to its beautiful scenery, Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty visited Panshan 32 times and even exclaimed, "If I had known there were Panshan, why go down to Jiangnan. Although Panshan belongs to Tianjin city, it is actually closer to Beijing city center than to Tianjin city center. During holidays, tourists from the vicinity of Beijing and Tianjin rush to visit, and there are more people there. There are two cable cars in front of the mountain: the Jinsheng Cable Car (Shanmen Wansong Temple), which costs 60 yuan one-way and can reach halfway up the mountain; Yunsong Cableway (Wansong Temple Yunmao Temple), one-way 60 yuan, from halfway up the mountain to Yunmao Temple under the hanging moon peak, very close to the mountaintop. There is a mountain sightseeing bus and a hanging moon cableway in the back mountain, which are sold together for 100 yuan per trip. After taking the sightseeing bus and cableway in sequence, climb a short distance to reach the top of the mountain. The highest peak on the mountain is only 864.4 meters above sea level, but if you hike the entire distance, you will have to walk about 30 kilometers. Although the mountain is not high, you have to climb several hills, which is very tiring. A more reasonable arrangement is to take a sightseeing car and a hanging moon cableway from the back mountain directly to the top of the mountain, then walk down from the front mountain and walk along the front mountain from the hanging moon peak to the mountain gate, which is about 12 kilometers. Hanging Moon Peak: After climbing to the top of the mountain by sightseeing car and cable car, you can see the Pagoda of Dingguang Buddha Relic, which is a stone pagoda and a symbol of the mountain top. Start descending the mountain. If you have good physical strength, you can choose to climb the second highest peak of the mountain, Zilai Peak, at the fork in the road; If you want to save energy or time, just go all the way down the mountain. Top of the Mountain - Wansong Temple: After passing through the high temples such as Yunmao Temple, Nantian Gate, and Jiangjun Stone on Panshan Mountain, you can descend to the large temple Wansong Temple (formerly known as Li Jing'an, where the famous Tang Dynasty general Li Jing once lived). This is the road that the Yunsong Cableway passes through. If you hike, there are many dirt roads that are difficult to walk on and have few scenic spots. However, you can see the magnificent natural scenery, with rolling mountains, white clouds dotted in the blue sky, and the strange pine trees on the upper plate and the strange rocks in the middle plate all in one's sight. Wansong Temple Shanmen: This section is the route that the Jinsheng Cableway passes through. The road is relatively easy to walk, with a concentration of scenic spots and many cultural attractions. You can also see the scenery of Shuisheng in the lower part. Hiking down the mountain, one passes through the Tallinn, which is composed of 99 tombs and pagodas of eminent monks from various dynasties with different shapes; The place where Qianlong's substitute monk became a monk - Tiancheng Temple. To the east of the temple gate is the Woyun Tower, and at the foot of the mountain opposite the tower is the old site of a small stage. Qianlong once watched a play here. Further ahead, you can see Shuxia, one of the representative attractions of the Lower Water Festival. A waterfall like structure resembling strands of silk floats into the pool, bringing a refreshing feeling. Continuing on, I encountered a stone that looked like a gold ingot - Yuanbaoshi. It is said that touching it can bring wealth. When you see the stone with the words "entering victory" handwritten by Rong Lu, the Minister of War and Governor General of Zhili in the late Qing Dynasty, it indicates that the mountain gate is not far away. Every March and April, a temple fair is held in Panshan, where the scene of "Qianlong's Tour of Panshan" can be seen, recreating the grand scene of Qianlong's parade in the past. Full text 

shortFeatures: Visit the ancient props of the movie
summary:
China Film Museum is currently the largest national film professional museum in the world. It is a landmark building to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the birth of Chinese films. It shows the century-old development of Chinese films and exhibits film technology. 
There are 20 exhibition halls in China Film Museum, among which the preface hall and exhibition halls 1 to 10 are film art exhibition halls. On the second and third floors, they mainly display the century-old history of Chinese films and the artistic achievements of film artists. 
In addition to watching exhibitions, the museum is also a cinema, with the largest film screen in the world. The latest online movies will be shown here, and the general ticket price will be cheaper than that of regular cinemas outside.

The appearance of Tianjin Binhai Library is very interesting. Standing not far away, you can see that the entrance looks like an oval opening, like a huge eye, so some people call this library "Binhai Eye". The reason why Tianjin Binhai Library is called "Binhai Eye" is that it is a spherical multifunctional hall inside. This spherical multifunctional hall has a dome shaped cinema built on the outside, and the center of the "eye" is a mirrored lecture hall, which provides a 360 ° panoramic view of the interior of the library. The interior design centered around the "eyeball" is extremely attractive, with bookshelves arranged like terraced fields, serving as both bookshelves and stairs, as well as seats.

Zhang Xueming's former residence is located at 50 Munan Road, Heping District, Tianjin. It was built in 1925 and is a courtyard style two-story residential building. The front building is the main building, where the owner's food and living are all located. The back building is a servant's house and a family classroom. Zhang Xueming was the younger brother of Zhang Xueliang and served as the mayor of Tianjin before the liberation; And he is widely recognized as a gourmet with a deep understanding of various cuisines. Zhang Xueming's residence is very particular. The main building is a Western style building with a sloping roof, with purple red machine bricks used for the exterior walls and luxurious interior decoration. The first floor has a lobby with a heated corridor and flower room, which is connected to guest bedrooms, dining room, kitchen, bathroom, and stairwell. The second floor has a bedroom, reception room, and two bathrooms. The lobby is decorated with colored glass windows for easy lighting. In front of the building is a garden filled with lilacs and wisteria throughout the year.

The former residence of Gu Weijun is located at 267 Hebei Road, Heping District, Tianjin. His residence was built in 1921, and Gu Weijun lived here briefly in 1924. The main building has three floors and is constructed with brick and wood. On the ground floor, there are 6 rooms and 2 living rooms. You enter the hall from the entrance hall and there is a large fireplace inside. There are fixed chairs by the window, and there are study rooms, dining rooms, flower halls, etc. nearby. There is a large platform outside the hall. 2、 The third floor consists of bedrooms and bathrooms. The building facade is made of red brick walls. The window is combined with the arch, and a pair of baroque Fried Dough Twists shaped columns in front of the door are dignified and elegant. Gu Weijun, born in Jiading, Shanghai, was a modern Chinese diplomat. In 1912, Gu Weijun joined the Beijing government and participated in the Paris Peace Conference as a member of the Chinese delegation in 1918. He resolutely took on the responsibility of peace talks and, after all his arduous efforts failed, he resolutely refused to sign the unequal treaty, upholding the dignity of the country. In his more than 50 year diplomatic career, he has served as the Chinese ambassador to the United States, Britain, and France, as well as the representative to the League of Nations and the United Nations. He has also served as the Foreign Minister of the Beijing government, Premier of the State Council, and Foreign Minister of the Nanjing government. He has attended the Paris Peace Conference and the San Francisco Conference, and participated in the establishment of the League of Nations and the United Nations. In 1967, Gu Weijun retired from his position as Vice President of the International Court of Justice in The Hague.

Tianjin Polar Ocean Park is a national 4A level scenic spot and popular science education base. With its rich and unique polar ocean resources, exquisite animal celebrity performances, and diverse interactive projects, it is known as one of the "Top Ten Popular Ocean Theme Parks Popular by Consumers" and a "Destination for Parent Child Tourism Projects". Tianjin Polar Ocean Park is an open scenic area covering an area of 49000 square meters, with a whale shaped composite structure. Featuring fifteen major exhibitions (Antarctic Penguin Island, Mysterious Arctic Village, Underwater Tunnel, Ancient Ocean, Shark Harbor, Coral Sea, White Whale Bay, Liuchuanyu Lane, Sea Grass Hall, Exploring Fish Universe, Future Jellyfish Pavilion, Cute Beast Bay, Magic Ocean Technology Experience Hall, Cute Pet Paradise, Wonderful Rainforest), four major performances (Happy Moon Island, Whale Moon Legend, Mermaid Fairy Tale, Aoaoxing Adventure), five major animal science popularization shows and high-end themed products such as overnight stays and banquets, it is deeply loved by tourists. Among them, the Future Jellyfish Pavilion is a characteristic themed exhibition hall with an open back area, with a total of more than 80 exhibition tanks, showcasing up to 20 types of jellyfish and more than 10000 individuals. Through various forms such as digital interaction, sound and light projection, we showcase the colorful and magical world of jellyfish to tourists. The "Four Great Performances" were carefully crafted over three years and made their debut in 2014. With four unique and exciting performances, "Happy Moon Island", "Whale Moon Legend", "Mermaid Fairy Tale", and "The Adventures of the Roaring Star", they jointly created four unique and exciting performances. The five popular animal stars - beluga whales, dolphins, fake killer whales, walruses, and sea lions - each have their own unique skills and work together with mermaid princesses to perform a lively and exciting "Ocean Circus". Whether in plot, performance, or atmosphere, it is of high domestic standard, which has opened the eyes and made many tourists enjoy it. The museum is divided into 15 exhibition areas, including Antarctic Penguin Island, Mysterious Arctic Village, Underwater Tunnel, Ancient Ocean, Shark Harbor, Coral Sea, Beluga Bay, Liuchuan Fish Lane, Seaweed Hall, Exploring Fish Universe, Future Jellyfish Pavilion, Cute Beast Bay, Magic Ocean Technology Experience Pavilion, Cute Pet Paradise, and Wonderful Rainforest. The 15 major exhibition areas complement each other and have their own unique features, allowing tourists to feel the magic of the ocean as if they are traveling through a mysterious underwater world. The Future Jellyfish Pavilion is divided into six themed exhibition areas: the Featured Light and Shadow Area, Jellyfish Kaleidoscope, Jellyfish Secret Realm, Jellyfish Music Hall, Jellyfish Fairy Tale Area, and Jellyfish Interactive Area, as well as two functional exhibition areas: Jellyfish Laboratory and Jellyfish Classroom. Jellyfish Kaleidoscope ": It gathers nearly one tenth of the world's jellyfish species. In the exhibition area, in addition to showcasing familiar species such as the Sea Moon Jellyfish, the Andromeda Jellyfish, and the Australian Spotted Jellyfish, it will also introduce interesting and ornamental species such as the Peace Jellyfish, Inverted Jellyfish, Egg Jellyfish, and Cloud Jellyfish, as well as difficult to raise species such as the Black Sea Jellyfish, Pacific Sea Jellyfish, and Purple Sea Jellyfish; Jellyfish Secret Area ": Using technological elements such as imagery, sound, light, and shadow, allowing visitors to experience the vast and romantic jellyfish planet intertwined with light and shadow; Jellyfish Interactive Zone ": Tourists can interact with virtual jellyfish through the interactive biomimetic wall, learn about the structure of jellyfish, their natural enemies, etc., allowing tourists to not only understand the interesting science of jellyfish, but also experience the feeling of touching jellyfish, and comprehensively understand the wonderful and beautiful jellyfish; Jellyfish Concert Hall ": The perfect combination of music rhythm and jellyfish swimming frequency, immersing oneself in it is like lying in the depths of the sea, imagining jellyfish drifting by, changing different colors. Cooperate with the frequency of jellyfish oscillation to improve one's breathing rate, achieving physical and mental relaxation and balance unconsciously. Jellyfish Fairy Tale Area ": It is a place that children love, where various types of jellyfish are transformed into cartoon characters, introducing their characteristics to tourists. The complete knowledge of jellyfish can be seen at a glance; Various jellyfish themed amusement facilities such as jellyfish swings and jellyfish swings attract children's attention. Jellyfish Laboratory ": The exhibition area will open its backstage, and lucky visitors can book and participate in the" Jellyfish Exploration Tour "to observe the feeding, reproduction, and other processes of jellyfish up close, learn about interesting science popularization stories about jellyfish, and have face-to-face academic exchanges with professional jellyfish breeders. Jellyfish Classroom ": It is a jellyfish classroom designed for jellyfish enthusiasts and children. If you want to have a deeper understanding of popular science knowledge and interesting stories about jellyfish, you can sit quietly and enjoy a vivid science class in the world of jellyfish. In 2018, a new exhibition area for ancient ocean science popularization was opened, with a total area of over 700 square meters and a tour route of over 100 meters. It is located in the back of the third and a half floors. Mainly based on biological evolution as the clue, with five major species extinctions as the main nodes, showcasing content including fish, invertebrate arthropods, insects, amphibians, reptiles, birds, mammals, etc., a total of more than 40 sets of exhibition tanks, 77 species of organisms, and more than 350 animals. In chronological order, from the Cambrian to the Cenozoic era, select several periods with typical events, and design the exhibition area with the evolutionary history of five major species extinctions as the dividing point. Select current and historically close species for display. Raccoons, squirrel monkeys, Dutch pigs, Totoro, Eurasian red squirrels, groundhogs, plush cats, and many other adorable pets will accompany you through 500 million years of the Earth in a brand new way! Mengshou Bay is an outdoor venue that showcases a variety of marine animals to visitors. People can get up close to marine animals in the sunlight and appreciate their diverse lifestyles from different perspectives. Learning popular science knowledge while having intimate contact with "cute beasts" is the best choice for families to travel, play and check-in. At Moe Beast Bay, you can meet a group of cute spotted seals and enjoy the relaxed sunshine with lazy seals. Ocean Happy Planet is an outdoor ocean theater that can accommodate thousands of people watching simultaneously. Here, performers combine the ups and downs of the story with stunning performances of marine animals, allowing visitors to experience a brand new ocean themed drama and creating a harmonious coexistence between humans and nature in a fairy tale world of the ocean. Cute Pet Paradise is an open outdoor tourist venue that combines sightseeing, entertainment, and education. The amusement park mainly features eight popular creatures such as spotted deer, grey goats, alpacas, squirrels, peacocks, and various parrots, gathering nearly a thousand cute pets from land and air. It integrates three core elements of immersive experience, zero distance interaction, and knowledge popularization, which can expand children's understanding of natural animals. Here, you can step into a simulated natural environment and learn about the little secrets of cute pets: sika deer like to live alone as adults, and alpaca spitting is a self-defense method. You can also have close contact with various cute pets and experience diverse interactive scenes, making it a place for parent-child outings and pure natural experiences. 【 Featured Projects 】 For families with children, Tianjin Polar Ocean Park also offers overnight stays and banquets to explore the characteristics of the polar regions in the deep ocean at night, taste polar cuisine in the blue underwater tunnel, sleep with fish at night, and experience the magical polar regions at night. This project has become one of the popular parent-child experience projects in the Beijing Tianjin Hebei region. Tianjin Polar Ocean Park has launched a variety of characteristic projects according to the needs of different age groups. For family tourists, it has launched the "5D Dynamic Experience" and "Ice Age Pavilion". In the 5D dynamic experience, visitors can once again experience the stunning visual impact, allowing you to enjoy an exciting dynamic experience. In the Ice Age Pavilion at minus ten degrees Celsius, visitors can enjoy rich and interesting animal ice sculptures, explore the mysterious life of Inuit people up close, and enjoy a romantic snow area, allowing you to cross the polar regions in one second and enjoy the coolness. For children, "Penguin Fun Park" and "Interactive Beach" have become popular featured projects. Penguin Paradise is a polar ocean themed children's soft pack adventure experience amusement project. Children can find their favorite polar dolls, communicate and explore with them, play together, and exercise social skills, physical fitness, and coordinated movements while playing. The "Interactive Beach" project allows children to play freely on the artificial beach, experience the ocean scenery, and get up close with animals. Tianjin Polar Ocean Park concentrates the polar essence and exhibits the wonders of the sea. Come to Tianjin Polar Ocean Park and experience the soul ringing "Blue and White Symphony", and reap pure joy and emotion! Full text 

The Li Shutong (Former Residence) Memorial Hall is a specialized memorial hall built to commemorate Li Shutong (Master Hongyi), a pioneer of modern Chinese culture and a generation of Buddhist masters. It is located at the intersection of Haihe East Road and Binhai Road in Hebei District, Tianjin, and is a cultural relic protection unit and 3A level scenic area in Tianjin. It covers a total area of 4000 square meters and is divided into two parts: garden and former residence. It is a unique cultural and museum venue in our city. The garden covers an area of 2600 square meters and is composed of the Taihu Lake rockery, artificial lake, memorial pavilion and pavilion. In the center of the memorial pavilion, there sits a 2.7-meter-high bronze statue of Li Shutong (Master Hongyi). On the shadow wall behind it, there is an inscription of Li Shutong's (Master Hongyi's) last words: "The friendship between gentlemen is as light as water, holding onto an elephant and seeking, approaching at a distance of thousands of miles, asking for more comfort, leaving behind words, blooming branches in spring, and the heart of heaven and moon full. There are plaques and couplets in the park praising Li Shutong (Master Hongyi) by Zhao Puchu, former president of the Buddhist Association of China, and Mr. Zhang Hai, Chinese Calligraphers Association. The former residence covers an area of 1400 square meters and consists of four courtyards and 48 houses. It is a traditional brick and wood structure with a "field" shaped layout. The green gray brick walls and vermilion doors and windows are solemn and dignified. The "Jinshi Di" plaque on the gatehouse highlights the prominent status and identity of the Li family. The basic exhibition of the memorial hall, "Li Shutong, Son of Haihe River," consists of three parts: "patriotism," "brilliant talent," and "moral cultivation." It consists of three parts: "patriotism," "brilliant talent," and "moral cultivation." There are a total of eight exhibition halls, as well as three restoration exhibition rooms and one screening hall. The first part of the exhibition, "Family and Country Sentiments," mainly introduces Li Shutong's family background, early growth experience, learning and practice, teaching career, pioneering art education, respecting teachers and valuing the Way, patriotic feelings, and other contents. It focuses on Li Shutong's living environment and growth process during his time in Tianjin, showcasing the origin of Li Shutong and Tianjin, especially the nourishing, influencing, and foundational role of Tianjin's regional culture in Li Shutong's growth, and strengthening the cradle significance of Tianjin for Li Shutong's growth; The second part "Brilliant Talent" comprehensively introduces Li Shutong's great achievements and cultural contributions in calligraphy, seal carving, music, art, drama, poetry, and other fields; The third part "Moral Cultivation" explores the ideological foundation of Li Shutong (Master Hongyi)'s lifelong moral cultivation from the perspectives of revitalizing legal studies, self-discipline and frugality, patriotism and humility, and seriousness in everything. It praises his spirit of integrating knowledge and action, and strives to find the motivation for his ordination from traditional Chinese culture, with profound and innovative ideas. The entire exhibition provides a detailed review of the life of Li Shutong (Master Hongyi) through more than 250 photos, newspaper photos, and images, as well as 97 sets of historical documents. Especially, the high-definition versions of his hometown research, Li's father's archives, and other materials were publicly exhibited for the first time, making the exhibition more substantial and rich in content. "Li Shutong's Origin with Tianjin" is even more eloquent in the face of historical materials. In order to enhance the authenticity of history, the memorial hall restored the living and living scenes of the Li family at that time, such as the living room, foreign study room, and central library, and selected furniture, ornaments, bedding, supplies, and other aspects to make it more dated and historical, and to add the unique temperament and characteristics of the Li family. In order to bring dormant cultural relics out of the warehouse, the exhibition showcases old objects such as door frames and window frames that have been preserved from the original residence, becoming a highlight that surpasses other similar museums. In addition, there are three "scene reproductions" on the exhibition line, namely "Tongda Silver Hao", "Li Shutong's Teaching", and "Chunliu Society Drama Performance", making the exhibition more three-dimensional and vivid. In order to demonstrate the Li family's emphasis on education and showcase Li Shutong's artistic achievements in calligraphy, seal carving, and other fields, a certain number of plaques, couplets, calligraphy, seal carving works, etc. are displayed in the outdoor art exhibition area; In order to break through the limitations of the exhibition line, enhance the dynamic display effect and interaction with the audience, and bring cultural relics to life, there are a total of 13 multimedia displays used to showcase the activity trajectories of Li Shutong in different periods, allowing the audience to copy Li Shutong's paintings, calligraphy, seal carving, listen to Li Shutong's songs, reproduce Li Shutong's debut drama style, appreciate his artistic works, understand his teacher-student friendship and teacher-student friendship, etc., allowing the audience to freely read the content of interest through the touch screen, deeply understand the owner of the former residence, leave their visit comments, and pay tribute to the master. The west gate of the former residence on one side of the coastal river is composed of famous stones, ecological ramps, and year-round green plants, highlighting its landmark significance and becoming an important part of the Haihe River sightseeing belt. Tianjin is the birthplace of Li Shutong (Master Hongyi), recording his wonderful youth. His brilliant achievements throughout his life were nourished by the profound cultural heritage of the land of Jingu. His high integrity and outstanding contributions are an important part of Tianjin's urban cultural characteristics and a historical embodiment of its urban spirit. I believe that through the visit, you will have a profound understanding of Li Shutong (Master Hongyi)'s extraordinary life, outstanding cultural contributions, and noble character cultivation, and your heart will be filled with a sense of awe. The Li Shutong Former Residence Memorial Hall awaits your visit with beautiful environment and high-quality service! Full text 

summary: Tangze Japanese-style hot spring is located in Jinzhou District, Dalian. The hot spring is divided into public bathing area and men's and women's bathing area. Zhangyu Aifeibao International Winery is a winery created by Yantai Zhangyu Group, integrating capital from multiple countries such as France and Portugal. On the basis of the original grape cultivation and wine making, Aifebao is also equipped with three innovative functions: wine themed tourism, professional tasting training, and leisure vacation, opening a new era for the winery. Changyu Aifeibao International Winery is designed in a European style, featuring the French Avenue, fresh grape picking garden, Gothic castle, underground wine cellar, European town, Changyu Centennial History Museum, and landscape leisure area. You can fully experience the fun brought by wine culture, have intimate contact with nature, and completely relax your body and mind. Changyu Eifferberg International Winery Appreciation Center cooperates with OIV and other international well-known wine organizations, and has designed a number of courses for countrymen people, focusing on introducing the internationally popular knowledge system of wine culture and wine etiquette. The Wine Club is a spiritual home for wine enthusiasts around the world. Here, you can taste Chinese and Western cuisine with rich wine culture characteristics in elegant and diverse wine themed restaurants. Jinmen Longying is a famous scenic spot in Tianjin, attracting numerous tourists with its unique dragon shaped architecture and rich cultural connotations. This is not only a great place to appreciate architectural art, but also an important window to learn about Tianjin's history and culture.
