tagNameList: Famous Residences; Buildings by Famous Architects
summary: The former residence of Liang Qichao is located at 44 Minzu Road, Hebei District, Tianjin, and the ice drinking room is located at 46 Hebei Road. The front building is the main building with a basement. 1、 There are 9 bedrooms on each of the second floors. The overall building is divided into two parts, with the eastern half dedicated to the Liang family, including a small study, living room, living room, etc; The western half is for family housing. The rear building is an ancillary building with a kitchen, boiler room, storage room, servant's quarters, etc. The front and back buildings are connected by corridors and overpasses. The entire building covers an area of over 1100 square meters. The main building is made of brick and wood, with a cement cover and patterned plastic. It has a unique red tile roof, high stone steps, and double groove doors and windows. The entire building is quite exquisite, with a garden, a garage, and a reception room. The Yinbing Room is located at 46 Minzu Road, Hebei District, connected to a residential building (44 Minzu Road). It was built in 1924 and is a light gray two-story small Western style building. There are three small arched halls on the front of the building, with stone steps on both sides in front of the door. There is a reservoir in the middle, in which a stone beast is carved, and water sprays continuously from its mouth all year round. In the center of the first floor is the hall, surrounded by 5 rooms, except for 1 miscellaneous room, the rest are study rooms and library rooms. There is also one hall on the northwest corner of the second floor, and several main bedrooms or library rooms on the southeast corner. Liang lived here in the later period to engage in writing. Liang's ice drinking room was designed by Italian architect Baronio and features a courtyard style porch with a closed canopy. The architectural design is unique, and the central hall is actually a canopy of a courtyard courtyard. The canopy rises above the roof and is inlaid with stained glass. The building has a total of 34 rooms and a construction area of 949.5 square meters. Full text 

This is a bustling street filled with various small shops and stalls. There are many lanterns during festivals, which are suitable for taking children to explore. There are also many jewelry, gourds, ornaments, walnuts, handicrafts, etc. here. There is also a cultural center and the Shijia Courtyard nearby.

The Shijia Courtyard is located in the center of Yangliuqing Town, a millennium old ancient town. It was originally the residence of Shi Yuanshi, one of the Eight Great Masters of Jinmen in the late Qing Dynasty. The house was named "Zunmei Hall" and is commonly known as the "Shijia Courtyard" by the public. The Shijia Mansion was first built in the early years of the Guangxu reign (1875). It is a large Qing Dynasty residential building with a history of over 140 years, covering an area of 7500 square meters and a building area of 3552 square meters. The entire building complex consists of 18 courtyards, with a typical four in one layout, courtyards within courtyards, clear axis lines, and grand and imposing style. Its brick, wood, and stone carvings are exquisitely lifelike and symbolize good luck, while the theater in the courtyard is a well preserved and large-scale enclosed residential theater in China. The Shijia Mansion was once known as the "First Residence in North China" and the "First Residence in Tianjin".

It has bred Yangliuqing Youth Painting, the first of China's four major woodcut New Year pictures, Yangliuqing kites and Paper Cuttings, which are famous in Tianjin and Beijing. Yangliuqing Manor in Yangliuqing Town is a local ecological leisure tourism scenic spot. The estate is particularly suitable for parents to come with their children. summary:
The Jizhou Karst Cave Scenic Area is located at the foot of Lingqi Mountain, north of Hongshuizhuang Village, Luozhuangzi Town, Jixian County, Tianjin, 12 kilometers from the county seat of Jixian. It borders the Jinhai Lake in Pinggu, Beijing to the north, overlooks the famous Pan Mountain Scenic Area to the west, and is connected to the Huangyaguan Great Wall in the east. The Jinwei Highway runs through the area. It is named Jizhou Karst Cave because Jixian County was once known as Jizhou. 

The first phase of the Jizhou Karst Cave development covers about 30,000 square meters, with a total length of 1,200 meters. The cave features a connected three-level horizontal cave system, with 28 prominent scenic spots. The cave's landscapes are crystal clear, diverse in shape, and brilliantly colorful, leaving visitors enchanted. 

The cave’s formations include stalactites, flowstone, stalagmites, curtains, columns, shields, and stone flowers. Iconic formations in the cave include a stone dragon, stone monkey, stone seal, stone flag, and stone Guanyin. The distinctive features of Jizhou Karst Cave can be summed up in four words: new, unique, strange, and special.

Jim's Adventure World is a North American style, large-scale, unpowered outdoor exploration themed family and child park. The first phase of the park project consists of six popular projects specifically designed for families, children, and teenagers: 1. Beijing Botanical Garden is located in the northwest of Beijing city, about 5 kilometers east of Xiangshan Park. Tourists can enjoy various flowers and plants while playing in the park; You can also visit the Cao Xueqin Memorial Hall and the Tang Dynasty Ancient Temple; You can also go hiking and enjoy the wild scenery in the cherry valley in the north of the park, and the experience is very rich. There are many gates in the botanical garden. Generally, tourists enter the garden through the south or southeast gate and travel north along the central axis road. The park is divided into three main parts: a plant exhibition area, a scenic spot area, and a nature reserve. Each section has its own unique scenery. The plant exhibition is divided into an ornamental plant area, a tree garden, and a greenhouse area. The ornamental plant area consists of various specialized gardens, mainly including rose garden, peach blossom garden, peony garden, peony garden, plum garden and other professional gardens. The rose garden is currently one of the largest rose specialized gardens in China, with nearly a thousand rose varieties available for viewing; Peach Garden is the specialized garden with the largest collection of peach blossom varieties in the world. The "Beijing Peach Blossom Festival" in March every year attracts many tourists to come and enjoy it. In addition, every autumn, the large ginkgo trees in the orchard turn golden, attracting many tourists. In the tropical plant exhibition greenhouse, typical plant landscapes from different climatic zones are displayed. In the Ginkgo Pine and Cypress District, there is also the tomb of the famous reformist Liang Qichao. The scenic spots and historical sites in the scenic area mainly include the Cao Xueqin Memorial Hall located in the central southern part of the park and the Wofo Temple located in the northern part of the botanical garden. After entering the park from the south gate, follow the central axis road all the way north to reach these two scenic spots. The main attraction of the nature reserve is Cherry Valley in the northwest of the park, which is known for its wild charm. The small stream in the valley is clear, and the water fir, known as the "living fossil", is thriving here. There is a peaceful atmosphere of the valley here, making it a great place for mountain hiking. Due to the lush trees and blooming flowers in the botanical garden, it has become a great place for Beijing citizens to take wedding photos in recent years. The flowering period of various flowers in the park varies, and there is a snack bar in the scenic area. Tourists can also bring their own dry food. Full text 

The Pacific Underwater World Exhibition Hall is located under the Beijing Central Radio and Television Tower, mainly showcasing marine life. Here, you will appreciate various beautiful marine creatures and appreciate the breathtaking scenery of the underwater world. There are hundreds of marine creatures in the museum, ranging from fierce sharks to colorful coral fish. The Underwater World consists of venues such as Penguin Pavilion, Underwater Tunnel, Jellyfish Area, and Gift Shop. At the Penguin Pavilion, you can fully learn about the world's endangered protected animal - the rainbow penguin; In the underwater tunnel, you can swim underwater and observe hundreds of marine creatures from the perspective of a diver; In the computer classroom, visitors can operate the computer themselves and master knowledge of marine life; There are also thrilling shark dance performances, sea lion performances, and more. Full text 

The foundation stone was laid on November 29, 1995, and the museum was completed and opened on July 23, 1997.

The main exhibition hall is a majestic three-story building, 22 meters high, with a simple and ancient style, featuring warm gray granite cladding. It combines traditional Chinese elements with modern aesthetic styles. On the large archway above the exhibition hall is a golden inscription of "Pingjin Campaign Memorial Museum" in seven characters written by Marshal Nie Rongzhen, with his signature on the lower right. A 40-meter-wide granite staircase guides visitors into the exhibition hall. The total length of the exhibition line in the main hall is 740 meters, divided into six sections: Preliminaries, Campaign Decisions, Campaign Implementation, People's Support, Great Victory, and Heroes' Achievements. The exhibition displays over 400 historical photos, more than 2,000 cultural relics, as well as multimedia, electric sand tables, restored sites, landscapes, sculptures, and paintings as auxiliary exhibits.

The Jiaotai Hall is located between the Qianqing Palace and the Kunning Palace, with a shape slightly similar to the Zhonghe Hall. 'Jiaotai' comes from the phrase 'Heaven and Earth Jiaotai' in the Book of Changes, meaning that the universe, yin and yang, and the upper and lower intersect, allowing all things to flow smoothly and be nurtured. Above the throne in the center of the hall hangs the "Wuwei" plaque written by Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, and on the screen behind the throne is the "Jiaotai Palace Inscription" written by Emperor Qianlong. There is a copper pot with a ticking timer in the East, which was no longer used after the Qianlong reign. There is also a self ringing clock in the Western Palace used for timing, and the entire Forbidden City is based on the "Jiaotai Hall Time". The self ringing bell is about 6 meters high and was manufactured in the third year of the Jiaqing reign of the Ming Dynasty. It is the largest existing ancient clock in China. Emperor Shunzhi of the Qing Dynasty also established an iron plaque here stating that 'no interference in political affairs is allowed in the inner palace'. The Jiaotai Hall was originally the place where the Empress Dowager received congratulations during major festivals. Since the Qing Dynasty's Qianlong period, the Jiaotai Hall has been used to place the 25 imperial seals symbolizing imperial power. Each of the 25 imperial seals has a different purpose. They are all seals used by the emperor to exercise his power. Usually, the seals are placed in boxes covered with yellow silk. Now, the treasure box is still displayed in its original position in the Jiaotai Hall.

shortFeatures: Ancient multifunctional palace architecture
summary:
Kunning Palace is the last of the three palaces in the inner court. Its name is taken from the sentence in Tao Te Ching. Kun De Yi Yining, hence the name Kunning Palace. In ancient times, the status of the queen is opposite to that of the emperor, and she is the most noble woman in the world. Kunning Palace echoes the Qianqing Palace where the emperor lives. In the Ming Dynasty, it has always been the bedroom of the queen, the empress of the main palace. In the Qing Dynasty, Kunning Palace was rebuilt according to Manchu customs. The rebuilt Kunning Palace style was full of Manchu cultural characteristics, and its main function was changed from the queen's bedroom to a place of sacrifice. On all the days of great sacrifices and on the first and fifteenth days of each month, the emperor and queen would personally come here to worship the gods. Every major celebration and New Year's Day, the queen also holds a celebration ceremony here. In addition, it has an important function, that is, as a new house for the emperor's wedding. Kangxi, Tongzhi, Guangxu and Xundi Puyi, who were young to the throne, all lived in Dongnuan Pavilion of Kunning Palace for two days when they got married, and then returned to Qianqing Palace or Yangxin Hall. At present, the Dongnuan Pavilion of Kunning Palace is still furnished according to the wedding room of the emperor of the Qing Dynasty. 
Every year at the beginning of April, apricot blossoms in Kunning Palace begin to bloom, and pink and white apricot blossoms bloom all over the branches.

The Chu Xiu Palace is one of the six western palaces in the Forbidden City in Beijing. It was built in the Ming Dynasty as a palace building and served as the residence of imperial concubines during the Ming and Qing dynasties. The Chu Xiu Palace is a single eaved gable mountain with a width of five rooms and a front porch.

Jingren Palace is one of the six eastern palaces of the Inner Court. The palace has two courtyards, with the main entrance facing south and named Jingren Gate. There is a stone shadow wall inside the gate, which is said to be a relic of the Yuan Dynasty. The main hall of the front courtyard is Jingren Palace, with a width of 5 rooms and a yellow glazed tile roof. Five beasts are placed at the corners of the eaves, and single upturned, single uplifted, five stepped brackets are used under the eaves, decorated with dragon and phoenix and painted seals.

shortFeatures: One of the east six palaces of the inner court of the Forbidden City

The most eye-catching thing in the palace is the three-story western-style palace-Lingzhuoxuan, which is a fish pond built to prevent fires. Later, it was shut down due to the change of the situation, and it has since become the oldest unfinished building in Beijing. 
With the popularity of the TV series Story of Yanxi Palace, Yanxi Palace, where the heroine Wei Yiluo lives, has become a must-punch scenic spot in online celebrity in the Forbidden City. Do you want to see how "Sister Wei" trapped the big pig's trotters step by step? Then go to Yanxi Palace to find out.

shortFeatures: The North Gate of the Forbidden City
summary: Shenwumen is the north gate of the Forbidden City. It was built in 1420 and is known as Xuanwu Gate. When it was rebuilt in the year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, it was renamed Shenwumen to avoid the name of Emperor Kangxi Xuanye. Shenwumen used to set up bells and drums, which were managed by Luan Yiwei. Qin Tianjian instructed to change the point, and one doctor took turns every day. The bell rings 108 times after dusk every day, and the drum rings after the bell. After that, the bell and drum were rung every time, and the bell was rung again when the dawn was enlightened. When the emperor lives in the palace, he doesn't ring the bell. As the back door of the palace, Shenwumen is an important entrance guard for daily access to the palace. The queens of the Ming and Qing Dynasties entered and exited from this door when they performed their silkworm kiss ceremony. In the Qing Dynasty, female draft was selected every three years, and the candidates entered the palace through this partial door. In 1924, Xun Di Pu Yi was expelled from the palace, and he left through this door when he left the palace.

The Bell and Drum Tower is located at the northern end of the north-south axis of Beijing. As the timekeeping center of the capital cities of the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, it is one of the iconic buildings of the ancient capital Beijing and has a long history to this day. The Bell and Drum Tower consists of two buildings: the Bell Tower and the Drum Tower. The two buildings are vertically arranged in front and behind, creating a magnificent and majestic atmosphere. The ancient Chinese bell and drum tower originated in the Han Dynasty. According to historical records, there was already a system of morning drums and evening bells in the Han Dynasty, which called for "beating drums at dawn to urge people to rise, and ringing bells at night to urge people to rest". The Beijing Bell and Drum Tower was first built in the Yuan Dynasty, during the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. As the center of timekeeping at that time, the drum tower housed drums, and the bell tower hung bells. The "morning bell and evening drum" followed the rhythm and rhyme. Until now, there are still drumming performances available here every day, with 3-4 performances every hour in the morning and afternoon. The drums are deafening and majestic. At night, the bell and drum tower lights up in the darkness, appearing even more antique and beautiful.

shortFeatures: Observatory in Ming and Qing Dynasties

It is famous for its complete architecture, complete instruments and long history. It is the longest existing ancient observatory that has maintained continuous observation. It is also an important place for cultural exchanges between China and the West, and enjoys a high reputation at home and abroad. The observatory has complete architecture and complete instruments. Its giant astronomical bronze ancient instruments are unique in the world and have a long reputation in the world. They represent the highest level of metallurgical casting and mechanical technology in ancient China. Besides the Chinese tradition, it also reflects the progress and achievements of large-scale astronomical instruments after the Renaissance in Western Europe in terms of scale, travel watch and structure.

The Japanese military turned this building into Prince Su's Mansion.

The Wanghailou Church, formerly known as the Church of Our Lady of Victory, is located on the north side of the west end of Shizilin Street in Hebei District, Tianjin, diagonally facing Shizilin Bridge. It is named after its former site, Wanghailou. This church was built at the end of 1859 and features the European Gothic architectural style. The plan of Wanghai Tower Catholic Church is rectangular, with the church body facing north and south, 10 meters high. It is a stone based brick and wood structure building with blue brick walls facing southwest. The front of the building has three flat topped towers in the shape of mountains, and the middle tower is 12 meters high and has a pen frame structure. Except for the middle tower, most of the buildings are two-story. There are also 8 animal heads embedded at the top of each tower on both sides, specially designed for drainage during rain, and rainwater can flow out from the mouths of the animal heads. The church has two rows of parallel columns inside, without partitions or compartments. There are buttresses on both sides of the entrance, and there are three corridors inside. The central corridor is slightly higher, followed by the side corridors, belonging to the basilica type. There are eight columns on each side of the main hall of the central tower, supporting the arched roof. The northern end is the main altar of the Virgin Mary, and on the left and right are the statues of Jesus and the Eucharist. In addition, there are pictures of the Passion of Jesus hanging on the walls around the church, and the top and walls of the entire building are painted. The doors and windows, as well as the top of the hall, are designed with pointed arches. The windows in the church are pointed arches, with geometric patterns made of colorful glass on the window surface, embedded with the story of Jesus' death. The interior floor is paved with porcelain black and white flower tiles. The church also has a flat topped tower, and later small corner towers were set up at the four corners of the chapel. There is a choir behind the church. Full text 

shortFeatures: The Three Mountains, Eight Temples, and Twelve Scenic Spots; A Premier Destination for Praying for Blessings and Enjoying Autumn in the Outskirts of Beijing.
summary:
The Eight Great Places refer to Chang'an Temple, Lingguang Temple, Sanshan An, Dabeisi Temple, Longquan An, Xiangjie Temple, Baozhu Cave, and Zhengguo Temple.  
Located in the western suburbs of Beijing, outside the Fifth Ring Road, these eight temples have a long history and are popular pilgrimage sites. Chang'an Temple is temporarily closed, but the other seven are open to visitors.  
Lingguang Temple houses a relic of the Buddha's tooth, one of only two in the world, making it highly renowned in Buddhist temples, with legends about its miraculous powers.  
In addition to the Eight Great Places, a recently discovered cliffside valley is called the "Ninth Place." The cliffs feature several Buddhist and Bodhisattva statues carved during the Ming Dynasty.  
The ancient and solemn temples and gardens are serene and beautiful, with many ginkgo and maple trees. It is a great place for walks, sightseeing, and mountain climbing, especially in the autumn.

Lingguang Temple is the second temple in the Eight Great Places. Established during the Dali period of the Tang Dynasty, it has been over 1300 years since then. Today's Lingguang Temple Buddha Tooth Relic Pagoda is magnificent and straight, up to 51 meters high, octagonal, in the form of a thirteen story pagoda with dense eaves, and the White Marble worship platform is 2.7 meters above the ground. The interior of the tower is a seven story hall. The golden pagoda in the hall enshrines the relics of Buddha's teeth. There is a stone staircase outside to reach the Buddha Tooth Relic Hall. Jinta is made of pure gold, about 1 meter high, and weighs 135 kilograms. The Heart Sutra Wall is located on the north side of the Buddha Tooth Relic Pagoda, built according to the mountain terrain, and requires climbing up a stone ladder. This wall was built in 2001 and is completely new. The abbot of Lingguang Temple engraved this core Buddhist scripture on a huge stone wall for believers and tourists to observe and study. The wall is 30 meters wide and 7 meters high, with a granite base and blue and white stone walls. The top is covered with green glazed tiles, which is solemn, elegant, and simple. Lingguang Temple didn't worship 500 Arhat until the Arhat wall was built in early 2004, and the image of Arhat appeared. The Arhat wall is 25 meters wide and 8.35 meters high. The whole structure is granite. The image of 500 Arhat is carved with relief. The image of Arhat on the wall is very lively, full of artistic imagination and romantic spirit. The expressions and movements of the characters are different, each free and lively, lifelike, and ready to come out.

shortFeatures: The life of Samaranch is presented.

The museum houses more than 16,000 items from Mr. Samaranch's personal collection and private belongings, documenting his life journey, Olympic history, and his deep connection with China. On April 21, 2013, the museum officially opened on the third anniversary of the passing of Juan Antonio Samaranch, the former Honorary President of the International Olympic Committee.

summary: Beijing Shengquan Mountain Tourist Scenic Area is a natural Buddhist holy land and also a Buddhist cultural site in Huairou. It has places for meditation such as Guanyin Temple Buddhist Culture Garden, Bell and Drum Tower, and Spirit Bone Pagoda. The core landscape is Shengquan Mountain Guanyin Temple, surrounded by numerous cultural and natural landscapes. Among numerous cultural relics, there are still many mysterious mysteries that cannot be solved. In the northeast of Beijing, at the foot of the Yanshan Mountains, there is a blessed land on earth and a Buddhist scenic spot. Here, the mountains are majestic, the peaks are towering, the trees are dripping green, the water is lingering, the temples are weathered, and the scenery is leisurely. This is the Shengquan Mountain Tourist Scenic Area - a brilliant and splendid flower blooming on the outskirts of Beijing! Beijing Shengquan Mountain Tourist Scenic Area is located 6 kilometers from Huairou City, adjacent to the millennium old Hongluo Temple to the east and Mutianyu to the west. It covers a total area of 15 square kilometers and is backed by the Yanshan Mountains. It is magnificent and grand, with the Huai Sha River in front of it and beautiful scenery. Shengquan Mountain combines natural and cultural landscapes with Buddhism and historical culture, making it a pure land of Buddhism and a Zen paradise. Since ancient times, countless visitors have speculated and speculated, with different opinions brewing into numerous magical legends and stories among the people. These stories have been passed down from mouth to mouth, spreading the reputation of Guanyin Temple on Shengquan Mountain far and wide. Believers, curiosity seekers, and visiting saints come in an endless stream, each with their own experiences, making the Guanyin Temple on Shengquan Mountain not desolate in the deep mountains, far away from the human realm but thriving in incense. According to the inscription on Guanyin Temple, the temple was first built in the Tang Dynasty and was renovated during the Chenghua period of the Ming Dynasty. It has a history of more than 1700 years. In addition to the the Shakya ManiHall, Great Compassion Hall, Yuantong Hall and other cultural landscapes, the natural landscape around the temple is very rich, including Shengui Stone, Sanxing Cave, Incense Burner Stone, Lingzhao Pine, etc. According to folklore, Fan Lihua, a famous female general of the Tang Dynasty, guarded the northern border of Youzhou. During a battle with the northern country, she was trapped at the foot of Jiulong Mountain (now known as Shengquan Mountain), where the enemy was strong and we were weak, and her life was hanging by a thread. In a moment of desperation, Fan Lihua clasped her hands and shouted urgently, "Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva has shown his power! Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, save me!" Upon hearing the call for help, Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva immediately turned on the nine lying green dragons of Jiulong Mountain, asking them to come to their rescue and achieve extraordinary karma. Nine green dragons gladly accepted the command and immediately set up winds and rain, pouring down heavily over the military formation. Both sides of the conflict were drenched in heavy rain, unable to open their eyes or lift their arms, and unable to focus on themselves. In the chaotic army, Fan Lihua led her own troops to rush with their heads covered and broke through. Afterwards, Fan Lihua felt grateful for the life-saving grace of Guanyin Bodhisattva and built a temple statue of Guanyin Bodhisattva at Yunxing on Jiulong Mountain as a tribute. Over time, with the passage of time and the ravages of wind and rain, Tang Dynasty architecture has disappeared without a trace. However, on the west side of the main hall of Guanyin Temple and the southeast corner of Weituo Hall, two remaining ancient locust tree roots with a diameter of over 1.5 meters can still be seen today. During the Liao, Jin, and Yuan dynasties after the Tang Dynasty, there was social unrest and unstable population migration in the area around Shengquan Mountain. The story of Guanyin Temple on Shengquan Mountain has been largely lost to history. The long-standing Buddhist culture and formal Buddhist worship tradition have been the tourism highlights of Shengquan Mountain Scenic Area since its reconstruction and opening in 2006. Together with the subsequent folk tourism, they form the main tourism body of Shengquan Mountain. Shengquan Mountain does not have the name of the Five Sacred Mountains, but it has the power of the Five Sacred Mountains. Looking around, one can see towering mountains and towering peaks, with valleys scattered between them, far away from the hustle and bustle of the world and enjoying the natural energy. The section from the foothills of the scenic area to "Chanlin Chunxiao" has an altitude drop of 288 meters and an average slope of 25 degrees on the hiking trail, making it suitable for mountain climbing and fitness; The section from "Chanlin Chunxiao" to Guanyin Temple is lush with pine and cypress trees, lined with trees and birds singing, and the air is fresh, suitable for strolling and sightseeing. Surrounded by green mountains and clear waters, Qinglong Gorge boasts fresh air. While hiking and exploring the mountains, you can also see the ancient Great Wall of the Ming Dynasty along the way, making it a great destination for Beijing residents to relax and vacation. In addition to natural scenery, you can also participate in water games such as boat tours, collision boats, speedboats, and even try bungee jumping and rock climbing for excitement. There is a reservoir dam built in Qinglong Gorge, which divides the entire scenic area into two parts: the Gaoxia Pinghu area in the south and the extreme sports venue on the east bank. In the southern lake area, the scenic spot offers many water sports activities. Tourists can take boats or speedboats to swim on the water surface and enjoy the scenery on both sides. They can also choose bamboo felling or hand rowing in the shallow water area, or play water games such as collision boats and water walking balls. In summer, there is also a swimming pool open to the public in the lake area. If you enjoy exciting entertainment activities, then go to the east coast of the scenic area. On the east bank of Qinglongxia Scenic Area, there are extreme entertainment projects such as bungee jumping, rock climbing, and downhill. The bungee jumping platform is about 60 meters away from the water surface; The total length of the rapid descent is about 300 meters, with a drop of about 30 meters; Climbing up to 25 meters is very challenging and exciting. Water sports and extreme entertainment activities within the scenic area require additional payment, and specific prices can be found on the official website. In addition, you can also walk along the hiking trail in Qinglongxia Scenic Area (or take a sightseeing cable car, 10 minutes one way) to reach Yuhuangtai. Along the way, you can enjoy the winding and twisting Ming Dynasty Great Wall among the mountains. On clear days, you can also have a distant view of Huairou City and Miyun Reservoir from the mountaintop. There are accommodation and catering services within the scenic area, but most tourists return to Beijing on the same day and do not stay in the scenic area. Full text 

summary: Jizhou Confucian Temple was first built in the Tang Dynasty and is a county-level cultural relic protection unit. It is located on the west side of Gulou North Street in the county town, with Dule Temple as the center and Wuding Street as the central axis. It is an ancient architectural complex adjacent to Luban Temple from east to west, covering an area of more than 2000 square meters. Its specifications belong to the state level. The entire building consists of two courtyards, one at the front and one at the back, each with the Lingxing Gate, Dengqiao Bridge, Panchi, Dacheng Gate (or Chengji Gate), East West Annex Hall, East Pavilion, West Pavilion, Dacheng Hall, etc. It has undergone many renovations throughout history. From the Kangxi Emperor of the Qing Dynasty to the Daoguang Emperor, five emperors wrote plaques with titles such as "Eternal Master's Table", "Unprecedented by the Living People", "Together with Heaven and Earth", "Great Accomplishment of the Holy Assembly", and "Holy Harmony in the Times", respectively, and achieved great prosperity.

Luban is the representative of many skilled craftsmen and the embodiment of the intelligence of ancient working people. It consists of the mountain gate, the main hall and the east and west side halls.

The hot springs in Gubei Shuizhen originate from the foot of the Great Wall. According to the inspection report of the Beijing Geological Engineering Survey Institute, the temperature of the hot springs is 60 ℃, and the total content of dissolved substances is below 1000mg/kg. According to the Japanese Hot Springs Law, it belongs to the category of iron springs and also belongs to the category of healing springs. The hot spring water source is located at a depth of 3800 meters at the foot of the Great Wall. The water is rich in various beneficial trace elements such as iron, sulfur, and magnesium, and has excellent water quality. It is an authentic natural hot spring water. In the open-air hot springs, close your eyes and meditate, whispering with heaven and earth. The warm bathing pool in the warm room, the warm atmosphere in the room, the gurgling water sound, such as smart music, can really be called the soup of the soul. The elegant architecture and exquisite facility style of the bathing area, whether it is an indoor hot spring bathing pool or an outdoor Fenglu District, can meet your different needs and let you enjoy the unique hot spring experience. Full text 

Zhonghua Quyuan is the performance venue of Tianjin Quyi Troupe, with over 400 performances of drum music, cross-talk, and more every year, attracting more than 15000 Quyi enthusiasts. Founded in the first half of the 20th century, Zhonghua Opera Garden, called "Zhonghua Tea Garden", has performed Quyi, Hebei Bangzi, Qin Opera Opera, etc. Famous actors such as Yin Dazi and Han Junqing have performed here. Tea gardens were already very famous theaters at that time, and since the liberation, they have been used as a small performance venue, active among actors in the local and foreign performing arts circles. After 1980, Zhonghua Quyuan became the performance venue for Tianjin Quyi Troupe. The performances of Tianjin Quyi Troupe and the performance practice base of Northern Song School are both located in the "Zhonghua Quyuan".

summary: As a key construction project of Binhai New Area, Binhai Art Museum Tianjin Binhai New Area Cultural Center Project is one of the top ten livelihood projects in the new area, with a total building area of 312,000 square meters, mainly including Binhai Art Museum, Binhai Modern City and Industrial Exploration Museum, Binhai Library, Binhai Performing Arts Center, Binhai Citizen Activity Center, Cultural Corridor, etc.

The world-famous Ming Thirteen Tombs are located at the southern foot of Tianshou Mountain in Changping District, Beijing. They were first built as long tombs in May of the seventh year of the Yongle reign (1409 AD), and lasted for more than 230 years until the last emperor of the Ming Dynasty, Chongzhen, entered the Siling Mausoleum. During this period, 13 magnificent imperial tombs with golden walls, 7 imperial consort tombs, and 1 eunuch tomb were built here. A total of 13 emperors, 23 empresses, 2 crown princes, over 30 concubines, and 2 eunuchs were buried, making it the most well preserved and buried imperial tomb complex in the world today. The Ming Thirteen Tombs have magnificent architecture, complete system, long history, and high historical and cultural value. The Ming Dingling Mausoleum is the tomb of Emperor Wanli, and the overall layout of the ground buildings is in a front to back circular shape, symbolizing the ancient Chinese philosophical concept of "the sky is round and the earth is round". The construction of Dingling began as early as the lifetime of Emperor Wanli. It started in the twelfth year of Wanli (1584 AD) and took six years to complete, consuming eight million taels of silver. The emperor was only 28 years old when the tomb was built, and it was not officially put into use until 1620. The tomb remained unused for 30 years. Dingling has become one of the three cemeteries among the Thirteen Tombs.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

summary: The Beijing Confucian Temple is located on Guozijian Street, adjacent to Guozijian. It was first built in the Yuan Dynasty and was a place for worshipping Confucius during the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. The Beijing Confucian Temple, revered by royal emperors throughout history, holds a high status and has undergone multiple renovations. In terms of specifications and status, it is the second largest Confucian temple in the country, second only to the Qufu Confucian Temple. At present, the Confucius Temple and the nearby Guozijian are open for visitors as the Confucius Temple and Guozijian Museum, with unified ticket sales. The ticket office is located next to the gate of the Confucius Temple. After purchasing tickets, you can first enter the Confucius Temple for sightseeing. After sightseeing, you can enter the Guozijian for sightseeing at the "Chijing Gate" next to the Confucius Temple Stele Pavilion. The total travel time for the two places is about 3-4 hours, with the Confucian Temple section taking about 2 hours. When visiting numerous Yuan Dynasty buildings and visiting Confucian temples, the first thing to pay attention to is the architecture inside the courtyard. Some of the buildings inside the Confucian Temple have undergone generations of repairs, but still maintain the style of the Yuan Dynasty. For example, the first master's gate at the gate is the Xieshan roof of the Dadu Arch. This kind of building is rare in Beijing, and you can have a good visit. The entire courtyard is antique and has many famous ancient trees. The environment is quaint and elegant, and you can take photos here. The numerous stone tablets and pavilions that can be seen everywhere are another highlight of the Confucius Temple. There are numerous stone tablets and pavilions in various courtyards of the Confucius Temple. There are inscriptions on famous scholars such as Yuan Chonghuan, Lin Zexu, and Li Hongzhang, as well as a register of over 50000 scholars from the Yuan Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty. There is also a forest of steles engraved with all thirteen Confucian classics. These numerous ancient steles are very precious, and their contents are also worth visiting. Another well-known activity of watching traditional ritual and music performances and visiting Confucian temples is watching traditional ritual and music performances. In the Chongsheng Temple located deep inside the Confucian Temple, there are several performances of the traditional ritual and music dance "Dacheng Ritual and Music" every day. The performances are held at 10:00, 11:00, 14:00, 15:00, and 16:00 (the number of performances may sometimes decrease depending on the season and the number of tourists), with each performance lasting half an hour. There are chapters such as "Xue Er", "Fu Xi", "Guan Ju", "Da Tong", etc. The atmosphere of traditional Chinese culture is strong and very exciting. You can pay attention to the time to visit. In addition, there are also the Dacheng Hall, a temple dedicated to Confucius, the Chongsheng Temple, an exhibition hall showcasing the historical evolution of the Confucius Temple, and the National Studies Museum, among others, all located within the temple. Here, you can see the ritual vessels, tablets, and historical evolution of Confucian temples dedicated to Confucius, and learn about and visit them one by one. Full text 

shortFeatures: One of the municipal administrative and cultural centers in Tianjin
summary: Tianjin Cultural Center is a municipal administrative cultural center located in Hexi District, Tianjin, China. Tianjin Cultural Center covers the whole area east of Youyi Road, west of Longchang Road, south of Leyuan Road and north of Pingjiang Road, with a total area of about 900,000 square meters. The projects of Tianjin Cultural Center include Tianjin Natural History Museum, Tianjin Library, Tianjin Museum, Tianjin Art Museum, Tianjin Grand Theatre, Tianjin Youth Activity Center, Tianjin Galaxy Shopping Center, Ecological Island, etc.

Zhang Ailing's former residence is located in Heping District, Tianjin. It is a remarkable historical building with the prominent words "Zhang Ailing's Former Residence", which makes people want to explore the place where this talented woman lived. Nowadays, Zhang Ailing's former residence is not only a historical building, but also a coffee shop with a comfortable life.

Quanye Chang was completed and opened in 1928. In 1931, the sixth and seventh floors were added as entertainment facilities such as theaters, making it a traditional shopping mall in Tianjin. Quanyechang was once a large shopping mall in Tianjin, as well as a large commercial and entertainment district, which is a symbol of Tianjin's commerce. It is now one of the three major retail department stores in Tianjin and one of the top ten shopping malls in the country. Quanye Market operates a variety of 30000 products, with channels covering the whole country, and is known for its complete range of small commodities. The Quanyechang was designed by architect Mu Le from the French firm Yonghe Engineering Company. The architectural form is a classical compromise style, and the old building has a magnificent and towering momentum, and has been listed as an excellent modern building by the country.

summary: Clay Figurine Zhang Art Museum was built with funds raised by descendants of clay figurine Zhang's family. It collects more than a thousand works of clay figurine Zhang's family in past dynasties, and exhibits more than 100 pieces all year round.

Dante Square is located in the Italian style district of Hebei District, Tianjin, at the intersection of Freedom Road and Minsheng Road. In the center of the square, there is a statue of Italian Renaissance poet Alighi Dante. The theme style of the square is Italian style, which is coordinated with the style of the surrounding cultural area. To the west of the square is Marco Polo Square, surrounded by numerous historical buildings such as the Yuan Yi Guo Garden, Zhang Mingqi's former residence, and Wang Yimin's former residence, making it a must visit place for tourists visiting the scenic area. There is a special floor tile on Dante's Square, located in the center of the square and carved with Dante's portrait, which is one of the characteristics of Dante's Square.

The ice drinking room refers to the study of Liang Qichao's former residence. The study "Ice Drinking Room" is a light gray two-story building built in 1924. The first floor is its study, and the second floor is used for bedrooms and reception. Liang Qichao's later works were all completed here. 
The "Ice Drinking Room" is specially designed by Italian architect Bailonio, with a unique and elegant shape.

Jin Street is one of the top ten famous commercial streets in China. It was founded in 1902 and was originally named Du Consul Road and Roosevelt Road. In 1953, it was renamed "Peace Road" with the meaning of "loving peace". It is the cradle of modern Tianjin commerce, a symbol of Tianjin's prosperity, and a source of pride for Tianjin people. Jinjie is a tourist and leisure shopping street that integrates sightseeing, shopping, dining, entertainment, and leisure. The pedestrian street, which is 1.3 kilometers long, features European style street lights and buildings. Representative buildings such as department stores and four sided clocks have been restored to their original appearance. There are not only large department stores with a long history such as Quanyechang, Zhongyuan Company and Department Store, but also traditional stores such as Tianjin Shoes Store, Hendry Watch Store, Guanshengyuan Food Store, Guishunzhai Pastry Store, Zhengxingde Tea House, Shengxifu Hat Store, as well as large shopping centers such as Binjiang Shopping Mall, Friendship Xintiandi, Milaiou, and new joint-venture shopping centers and specialty stores such as Geely Building, International Shopping Mall, Idujin, and Maigou. The small commodity market on the section of Shandong Road to Nanjing Road in Binjiang Road Commercial Street gathers various stalls, attracting a continuous stream of tourists. At night, colorful lights flicker, and some Tianjin style snack stalls also take to the streets, forming the landscape of Jinmen Night Market. Liaoning Road is one of the birthplaces of Tianjin's snack culture, with over 50 shops offering more than 50 varieties of snacks, injecting fresh blood into this century old snack street. While shopping on Jinjie, citizens can also taste authentic local snacks here.

Xiannong Courtyard is a place that integrates catering, fashion, art, and leisure. There is an exotic villa with a variety of delicious food gathered here. During the day, you can sit in the yard and have lunch and afternoon tea. The night view is illuminated, making it very comfortable and suitable for bringing children to play and have meals here.

Jiefang Pavilion is located at the southeast corner of the old city wall of Jinan, east of Heihu Spring, facing Heihu Spring across the moat. The pavilion is located at the breakthrough point of the siege of Jinan by the People's Liberation Army during the 1948 Battle of Jinan (specifically on September 24, 1948). When the old city wall was demolished due to urban construction, the people of Jinan specially built a magnificent Jiefang Pavilion on the old city site here to commemorate the liberation of Jinan. A 10 meter high stone platform was built in 1965, but construction was halted due to the Cultural Revolution. The pavilion was built on stage in 1985 and completed on September 24, 1986. Jiefang Pavilion is a provincial-level key cultural relic protection unit in Shandong Province and also one of the patriotic education bases in Jinan. Standing on the Jiefang Pavilion, people can pay their respects to the martyrs and heroes.

The Jinan Old Commercial Port Night Market mainly has a bar area, a coffee area, and a barbecue area, upgrading the century old style of the commercial port into a cultural IP, focusing on young customers, and holding the first Shitaiyan Retro Market, which integrates food, antiques, and cultural creativity.

The full name of Hongjialou Catholic Church is Hongjialou Cathedral of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, commonly referred to as Honglou Church. It is one of the iconic buildings in Jinan and an important symbol of Jinan's cultural belt. The church is located in the eastern part of Jinan City, Shandong Province, on the north side of Honglou Square in Licheng District, adjacent to the old campus of Shandong University to the east. It is named after Hongjialou Village and is one of the largest Catholic churches in Jinan City and North China. It is also one of the three famous Catholic churches in China and plays an important role in modern religious architecture.

The former Zhejiang Industrial Bank Building is located in Heping District, Tianjin and is a historically significant building. This building was built in the early 20th century, showcasing the typical style of banking architecture at that time, integrating elements of Chinese and Western architecture, and possessing high historical and artistic value.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

summary: The Tianhou Temple, commonly known as the "Goddess Temple", is located in the ancient cultural street. It enshrines the "Sea God" Mazu and was first built in the Yuan Dynasty. It has a long history and is one of several Tianhou Temples around the world. Ancient buildings, rich folk exhibitions, and lively temple fairs are all attractions that attract tourists. The Tianhou Temple sits in the west and faces east. From east to west, it is composed of the theater, the streamer pole, the mountain gate, the memorial archway, the front hall, the main hall, the phoenix tail hall, the Sutra Pavilion, the Qisheng Temple, the Bell and Drum Tower, the Zhangxian Pavilion and four side halls. It is an existing ancient architectural complex in Tianjin. Nowadays, Tianhou Palace has become the location of Tianjin Folk Museum. In addition to preserving the restored display of the Tianhou Palace, the museum has also opened exhibitions based on showcasing Tianjin's folk customs, systematically introducing customs such as water transportation, marriage and childbearing, commerce, folk life, folk art, and folk beliefs. Every year on the 23rd day of the third lunar month, it is the birthday of Empress Dowager Tianhou. At that time, the entire ancient cultural street will hold an imperial fair (originally called the "Empress's Fair", named after Emperor Qianlong's visit to Jiangnan). Performances can be seen in the square in front of the Tianhou Palace, the south and north of the palace, including dragon lantern dance, lion dance, Shaolin Festival, stilts, drums, dry boats, yangko dance, martial arts, as well as Beijing Opera, Pingju, Bangzi, etc. It is one of the lively temple fairs in Tianjin.

Nanshi Food Street gathers various well-known snacks from Tianjin and is a specialty shopping center mainly focused on food. Not only can you taste a variety of traditional cuisine here, but you can also appreciate traditional tea garden arts such as cross-talk and opera. In addition, the architecture here combines Chinese and Western styles, and the photos are also very beautiful. Nanshi Food Street is a corridor style three story building with entrances in all four directions. The third floor is the inner hall of a restaurant, while the first and second floors offer shopping opportunities. The first floor here is relatively open, which is a fake arcade style building. The main shops are various snacks, such as Fried Dough Twists in Tianjin Gui Faxiang, Fried Dough Twists in 18th Street, Ear Eye, Bean Collapse, etc. In addition to delicious food, you can also find interesting traditional stalls such as candy figurines on this floor. You can go and take a look. The second and third floors of Nanshi Food Street are semi open corridor style buildings, with each floor connected and passing through shops like shopping. These two floors are mainly served by various restaurants, including Sichuan cuisine, Shandong cuisine, and other cuisines. Famous restaurants include Tianjin Restaurant and Yaxi Restaurant. In addition, the Kong Family Restaurant on the second floor often has cross-talk performances in the afternoon and evening. If you are interested, you can go and listen to them.

Dingling is the mausoleum of Wanli Emperor Zhu Yijun and his two queens. It has the only underground palace excavated in the Ming Tombs and is one of the three largest mausoleums in the Ming Tombs. 
Dingling Underground Palace is the only underground palace developed in the Ming Tombs at present, and it is the first planned imperial tomb to be excavated after the founding of the People's Republic of China. More than 3,000 pieces of cultural relics were unearthed from the underground palace, including four national treasures: Golden Crown, Phoenix Crown, Night Pearl and Ming Sancai. 
The underground palace is divided into the main hall, the side hall and the front hall, which are exactly the same as the above-ground buildings. There is no beam frame inside, but it is a stone arch coupon, which is quite tall. There are seven 4-ton white marble doors inside, which are clever in design and flexible in opening and closing. The coffins of Zhu Xujun and two queens are parked on the coffin bed in the apse, and 26 red lacquered wooden boxes filled with funerary objects are placed beside the coffin.

Beijing Square is a new landmark of Beijing culture. Hutong is the most familiar expression of Beijingers. Beijing Square retains and continues the important geographical textures such as the headline of corridors, the two corridors, the doorframe hutong and Sanfu hutong, protecting and reshaping the original historical appearance of this plot to the maximum extent, and showing the collision between the ancient charm and fashion of Beijing. 
In the open block of Beijing Square, there are many landscape and cultural places designed. The central building-Beijing Quanyechang Building has three floors above ground and one floor underground, with three atriums in the depth direction and three cloisters around it. The facade facing the street is Baroque, and the entrance of the gate is a western-style door cover. The second and third floors are decorated with pilasters, window covers and balconies, and the eaves are parapets. With exquisite interior decoration, it is the first building with van elevator and amusement park in Beijing. It was once known as "the first commercial floor of Beijing".

Wangfujing Catholic Church is one of the four major Catholic churches in Beijing. Wangfujing Cathedral is a Roman style church that is a model of the fusion of Chinese and Western architectural styles. Although located in the bustling city, it has not diminished its sacred temperament at all. During the holiday season, sometimes I accidentally pass by the Wangfujing Catholic Church, and the rich sound of electric wind instruments and the sunny singing of the choir can be heard from inside, rippling in the winter air. After the renovation of the northern section of Wangfujing Street in Beijing, the wall surrounding the mysterious church was removed, attracting the attention of many people. The gray European style pointed buildings exude a sense of mystery due to their antiquity, while the newly paved square in front of the door is surrounded by green trees and has a stronger humanistic color. Against the backdrop of modern buildings, Wangfujing Catholic Church has become a new attraction on this street. The square in front of the church has been paved, and there are seats on both sides of the square for pedestrians to rest.

Baotu Spring Park is located in the bustling area of Jinan city center, with Qianfo Mountain to the south, Daming Lake scenic area to the north, and Quancheng Square to the east. It is a characteristic garden with spring water as its theme. Baotu Spring, known as the "number one spring in the world", is located at the top of Jinan's "72 famous springs" and has a history of more than 2000 years. It has also appeared multiple times in literary works, with the representative being "Baotu Spring" by Lao She. And tourists come here to witness the magnificent scene of the three springs of Baotu Spring erupting. Baotu Spring is the main attraction in the park, with three streams of clear and pure water that gushes day and night, reaching several feet in height during peak hours. There are large stone blocks around the spring, surrounded by railings, which allow you to overlook the spectacular scene of the three springs gushing in the pool from the edge of the railing. There is a stone tablet standing next to the spring, inscribed with the words "First Spring". Its color is dark green and it was inscribed by Prince Zhonglin of Licheng during the reign of Emperor Tongzhi of the Qing Dynasty. In addition, there are more than 30 famous springs scattered near Baotu Spring, including Jinxian Spring, Shuyu Spring, Xibo Spring, Liuxu Spring, Huanghua Spring, Dukang Spring, and Bailongquan, forming the Baotu Spring group. Due to the heavy rainfall in July and August, it is a good season to come and enjoy the spring water. During the summer season, tourists can have intimate contact with spring water in the park. Some springs do not have railings around them, and there are stone paths in the pool where the spring water flows. Visitors can go down to the pool and enjoy the water. Walking on the stone paths, their feet will be wet by the spring water, creating a cool feeling. In addition to being hydrophilic, there is also free spring water available for tourists to drink directly by the Baotu Spring pool. On the east side of the spring, there is the Hope Heting Tea Society, which provides visitors with fragrant tea brewed with Baotu spring water at a moderate price. In addition to the spring water, there is also a scenic spot worth watching in the park, which is the south gate of the park. It is decorated in a magnificent and elegant manner, and the horizontal plaque on the gate reads "Baotu Spring" with a blue background and gold letters. It was written by Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty and is known as the "first gate" of Chinese gardens. In the past few years, Baotu Spring often experienced seasonal water stoppage, but after years of protection, its normal water level has been basically restored. In addition, Baotu Spring Park often holds various cultural activities. On the first day of the first lunar month every year, a lantern festival will be held in the park, lasting for 20 days. In late September every year, there is also the Baotu Spring Water Culture Festival, which lasts for about 10 days. At that time, there will be various folk activities, calligraphy and painting exhibitions, opera performances and other performances in the park for tourists to enjoy. Every year from the end of October to the end of November, there is also a chrysanthemum exhibition held in the park. In the golden autumn season, the springs flow together and chrysanthemums and springs complement each other, making it very worth a visit. In addition, the Baotu Spring Scenic Area has also launched a boat tour route. After visiting the Baotu Spring Scenic Area, tourists can board the boat at the Baotu Spring Boat Show if they are interested. The boat passes through the Ximen Bridge in the old city area of Jinan, passes through the east gate of Wulongtan Park, and enters the first passenger ship lock in Jinan's history - Wulongtan Ship Lock, where they can experience a drop of more than 2 meters. Sitting on the east side of the ship, you can still see the relief of the "Eight Scenic Spots of Jinan". There are many aquatic plants along the shore, and the river water is clear to the bottom. The cruise ship finally crossed the Yanbo Bridge and entered the Daming Lake Scenic Area. Full text 

The Chaoran Building is the carrier of the Chaoran Zhiyuan landscape in the Daming Lake Scenic Area. The building was first built in the Yuan Dynasty. According to the "Licheng County Annals", after the Daming Lake Water Pavilion, Li Cong, a scholar from the Yuan Dynasty, built the Chaoran Building. The poet Yang Yansi of the Ming Dynasty wrote the poem "Chaoran Tower": "The pavilions and terraces near the water are lush with vegetation, and the Zhu Tower echoes a hundred feet away. The windows contain the East China Sea rain, and the threshold overlooks the southern mountains with Daidai clouds. The willow colored lotus fragrance is revered outside, and the sound of Lingge and fishing is heard in the seats. Who can collect the smoke and moon on the seven bridges? It has already scattered into the Minghu Lake." The Chaoran Tower has an area of 5673 square meters, a height of 51.7 meters, and is divided into seven floors. The upper floor is for sightseeing, and the lower floors are decorated with wood carvings, murals, pictures, texts, and other forms, reflecting Jinan's spring culture, urban garden culture, and folk culture of old Jinan.

Furong Street is an old street with a Jinan style and is an old commercial street in Jinan city, known as the "number one snack street in Qilu". Furong Street is named after the Furong Spring in the street, and is adjacent to the two major government offices and the Gongyuan, the Fu Confucian Temple, and the main road of the ancient city throughout history. During the Jin, Ming, and Qing dynasties, it was a place where literati and poets drank and wrote poetry. Among the old streets in Jinan now, Furong Street is particularly lively. Countless small vendors and vendors set up stalls or shops on both sides of the road, offering a wide variety of snacks from all over China, Europe, America, Japan, and Korea. Furong Street is bustling with people every day, and compared to most quiet old streets, Furong Old Street is full of commercial vitality. Here is the travel guide. In addition to exploring the unique neighborhoods and experiencing the historical and cultural heritage of Qilu, there is also the opportunity to enjoy delicious food. Guozu Stinky tofu is different from Changsha stinky tofu. Its skin is burnt, its inside is tender, and its fragrance is full. There is a Lingji Duck Blood Vermicelli that tastes great, with delicious soup and Tea egg. There are vendors selling roasted pig trotters on the roadside. When passing by, they smell super fragrant and drool. There are also a variety of kebabs, Bingtanghulu, etc. Come here and look for your favorite food. The crowd here is quite crowded, please take care to protect your belongings. Full text 

shortFeatures: Understand the history and culture of old Jinan
summary: As a complex of Jinan's unique commercial port culture, Ronghui Old Commercial Port is the place that can best reflect the history and culture of old Jinan besides the ancient city area with spring water and old streets. The buildings here are scattered at random, with different styles. There are century-old buildings Zhang Caicheng's former residence and Baolong Foreign Company, as well as rebuilt buildings that reflect modern styles. Each building is named after the buildings that actually existed in the old commercial port period, and the charm of that era can be vaguely seen, so that the culture of the century-old commercial port area can be admired, experienced and passed down.

The Huo Yuanjia Memorial Hall consists of two parts: the former residence of Huo Yuanjia and the Huo Yuanjia Cemetery. The cemetery covers an area of nearly one hectare, and the overall building adopts an axis symmetric layout. It is composed of Shinto, Stone Lion, Hall of Enjoyment, Stone memorial archway and Bedding Garden. There is an exhibition hall showcasing the life and deeds of Huo Yuanjia; Since its completion, tens of thousands of people have come to visit and admire the legendary deeds and touching spirit of the hero Huo Yuanjia.

Jingwumen Zhonghua Wulin Park is located next to Tuanbo Avenue in Jingwu Town, south of Tianjin City. It is a park with the theme of commemorating patriotic martial artist Mr. Huo Yuanjia. This used to be the former residence and cemetery of Huo Yuanjia, but now a cemetery and memorial hall have been built in the scenic area. You can come here to visit and pay tribute to this legendary figure and learn about his life story. The area inside the scenic spot is very large, with a length and width of about four to five hundred meters. There are not many tourists usually, making it spacious and peaceful. You can take a stroll and play inside. There are ancient buildings with a strong charm in the scenic area, as well as trees and green plants. The environment is very good, and it is generally recommended to visit here for 2-3 hours. On the east side of the scenic area is the cemetery of Huo Yuanjia, which includes a memorial hall, martial arts Shintoism, and the tomb of Huo Yuanjia, where one can pay tribute to their predecessors. To the west is Huo Yuanjia Square, where there is a statue of him. To stand out is the Huo Yuanjia Memorial Hall in the center of the square, which displays the life and cultural relics of Huo Yuanjia, as well as videos about his deeds. You can visit it carefully and learn about the life of this patriotic martial artist.
opening_hours: Open at 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

summary: Yudu Gate is located in Beijing and is a historic architectural relic that attracts many tourists with its unique architectural style and rich historical and cultural background.

Gu Ya Ju is a mysterious place located in the valleys of the outskirts of Beijing. On both sides of a ravine less than 10 meters wide in the canyon, steep granite walls covering an area of nearly 100000 square meters from the valley floor are filled with artificially carved chambers of different sizes. There are a total of 117 stone chambers, arranged in a staggered and orderly manner, resembling a natural village. The stone chamber is generally 1.8 meters high and rectangular or square in shape, with three suites consisting of one bright and two dark rooms being the most common. All the stone chambers are distributed in a layered structure, with stone steps, stone staircases, and piers connecting each layer. There are many traces of human survival left in the stone chamber, such as doors, windows, wardrobes, lamp stands, stone kang, smoke exhaust ducts, stone stoves, and horse troughs. A stone room with a kang is a living room, and the kang is wide enough to accommodate two people; A stable with a stable can usually accommodate four or five horses. Shiyaju is a large-scale cliff dwelling site in North China. Researchers believe that its excavation age, purpose, and historical background were ancient military camps, border soldiers' barracks, or a hiding place for the outlaws in the rivers and lakes. However, there is still no consensus on this. Tourists may visit the site in person, make their own judgments based on what they see and gain.

The West Coast Cross Talk Theater, which opened in August 2011, is a high-end theater of traditional folk art in Tianjin, located in the well-known century old park - People's Park. The theater is divided into two floors. The first floor is the performance hall, which can accommodate more than 200 people, and the second floor is the VIP area, with a total of 7 VIP single rooms, which can accommodate more than 70 people. The decoration of the theater is also worthy of praise, luxurious and elegant, combining ethnic style and modern fashion. From lighting and scenery to stage sound and viewing hall, it is rich in traditional Quyi characteristics and meets the needs of modern audiences. Most of the cross-talk performers in the theater are young people born in the 1980s.

Binjiang Road Commercial Street is one of the bustling commercial streets in Tianjin. It starts from the seaside and extends southwest to Nanjing Road, with a total length of 2094 meters. This street not only has shops such as Quanye Chang, Zhongyuan Company, Daoxiangcun Food Store, Hengdeli Watch Store, Guangming Cinema, Dengyinglou Restaurant, but also newly built shopping malls (Binjiang Shopping Mall, Geely Building, International Shopping Mall, etc.) and shops. In April 1987, after the section from Shandong Road to Nanjing Road was converted into a small commodity market, individual stalls sprung up like mushrooms on the western section of Binjiang Road. Tourists flowed in all day long, and at night, colorful lights shone, becoming a new scenery of Jinmen Night Market.

The Badaling Ancient Great Wall is located 10 kilometers southwest of the Badaling Great Wall Scenic Area and serves as the western gateway for the defense of the Badaling Great Wall. Here, there are towering mountains, deep ravines, and perilous valleys, connected by the Great Wall gates and facing each other across the fortresses. Due to the preservation of its original form, although it is incomplete, the majestic peak still exists. Among the broken walls and ruins, the historical vicissitudes and weight of the Great Wall can be seen even more. The remaining Great Wall at Badaling is a witness to history. According to expert research, two archaeological sites with significant archaeological value have been discovered at the remains of the Great Wall in Badaling. One is the quarry where the Great Wall was built back then, where the split rocks are clearly visible, and the chiseled marks of unfinished stone materials are still visible. Another place is the brick kiln group where bricks were fired back then, from which you can learn about the sources of some of the raw materials used during the construction of the Great Wall.

Beijing Nanshan Resort is located in Miyun County, 62 kilometers away from Heqiao, with direct access to the Beijing Chengde Expressway. It is a rare winter resort in Beijing and North China that integrates dynamic leisure and entertainment projects such as skiing and slides. With a daily reception capacity of 5000 people and more than 2000 parking spaces, it is located on the north slope of Nanshan in Miyun County, with excellent snow quality, magnificent scenery, and pleasant climate. Nanshan Ski Resort is a relatively large ski resort in North China. It has built high, medium, and junior ski slopes, 21 teaching and recreational ski slopes, including the Mogul advanced ski slope, Waves Slope, and children's snowmobile dedicated ski slope. It also has a snowboard park - NANSHAN MELLOW PARK, as well as the first six person snow soccer field in China. The famous "Wild Snow Park" is a beautiful forest skiing area that has become a special training ground for non mainstream skiing experts in Beijing to train in the forest. In terms of snow entertainment, we have introduced and constructed the German Weigang dry land sled (with a slide of 1318 meters), which crosses 9 elevated bridges and 1 100 meter tunnel along the way. The entire journey is long, including Canadian snow flying saucers, Korean plows, American cableway snow mountain gliders, and children's gliders.

Yangkou Beach is located within the Yangkou Scenic Area. This beach is wide, flat, and has excellent sand quality, making it a relatively high-quality beach in the suburbs of Qingdao. The location of Yangkou Beach is a crescent shaped bay - Yangkou Bay, about 22 kilometers long, with distant islands called Daguan Island, Xiaoguan Island, and Rabbit Island. However, Yangkou Beach is currently not a formal beach and there are no safety personnel here. For safety reasons, it is not recommended to swim here.

Maimai Island Park is located 50 meters west of Maidao Road in Laoshan District. Maimai Island is a circular island with large flat and wide green grasslands. In the distance, there is a deep blue sea water, and you can overlook the distant coastline from here. It is a beautiful seaside scenery that is very suitable for photography.

The Shilaoren Beach is located in the eastern part of Qingdao city and is one of the larger beaches in Qingdao. This place is adjacent to the Ocean World to the south, and to the east, you can see the giant stone "Stone Old Man" standing in the sea. This strange stone looks like an old man sitting in the sea, and it is a sea eroded pillar landscape formed by millions of years of wind and wave erosion and impact. The Shilaoren Beach has a flat slope and many people believe that the seawater is clearer than several beaches in the city, so many local residents love to come here for swimming. Moreover, there are fewer people here, the air is fresher, and the sand is finer. It's very enjoyable to take a walk and bask in the sun here. However, during summer, there are often seaweed floating on the water surface, which can slightly affect swimming. Not far from the bathhouse, there is also the famous International Beer City on Hong Kong East Road. During the summer beer festival, there are crowds of people here, and you can also come here to join the fun, enjoy beer, barbecue, and seafood, and play a roller coaster in the amusement park.

The Jiaozhou Bay Subsea Tunnel, also known as the "Qingdao Jiaozhou Bay Tunnel". To the south is the Xuejiadao Street Office in Huangdao District of Qingdao City, and to the north is Tuandao in the main urban area of Qingdao City, passing through the mouth of Jiaozhou Bay. The tunnel has a total length of 7800 meters and is divided into two parts: land and seabed. The seabed part is 3950 meters long. The tunnel is located at the mouth of Jiaozhou Bay, connecting Qingdao and Huangdao, with six lanes in both directions. The Jiaozhou Bay Tunnel is located in a volcanic rock and subvolcanic zone, with a thin covering layer and dense fault zones. It crosses a total of 18 fault fracture zones, with a cross-sectional span of 28.20 meters and a depth of 82.81 meters below sea level.

China Photography Island is located in Ganshuiwan Village, Huangdao District, Qingdao City. It is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on one side. It has beautiful scenery and beautiful environment, with both rural atmosphere and coastal scenery. It is a fishing village full of original flavors.

Huangdao Jinshatan is located on the southeast coast of Huangdao Development Zone. The sand in Jinshatan is finer than the several major beaches in the city, and it has a vast coastline. This place is far away from the hustle and bustle, with fewer tourists. Every summer, the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival is also held. Here, you can stroll or run barefoot, enjoying the soft sandy beach to your heart's content. You can also bring your children here to do sand sculpture, fly kites, or go surfing or swimming in the water. You can also take a speedboat, ride a water bike, or play beach volleyball. There are also children's amusement projects such as carousel, pirate ship, and air cushion children's playground in the scenic area. Jinshatan holds the Jinshatan Cultural Tourism Festival every summer (usually from mid to late July to mid August). Each opening ceremony invites many well-known singers and dance troupes from home and abroad to participate, and there are also exciting performances and singing competitions. Therefore, there are still many tourists during the summer and Golden Week. If you don't like to gather in crowds, you can also choose to come here in June or September to see the more pristine scenery. Attention should be paid to protective measures when coming here in summer. During the peak tourist season, there are many vendors on the beach who provide services such as renting umbrellas, storing items, and foot watering. There are also water sports such as motorboats and aerial parachutes that are worth experiencing. Full text 

Jinshatan Beer City is located on the northwest side of the West Coast International Beer Square, consisting of 7 buildings. It is designed in a unique small town style in southern Bavaria, Germany and is one of the important iconic buildings of the West Coast Beer Square. It includes six functional areas: beer culture exhibition hall, brand beer exhibition hall, craft beer house, gravity beer bar, beer culture experience entertainment hall, and beer derivative exhibition hall. The Brand Beer Exhibition Hall selects international level beer brands for display and experience; Craft beer houses aim to experience the lifestyle carried by modern beer culture and create one of the earliest gathering experience areas for craft beer in China; The Beer Culture Experience and Entertainment Center combines beer culture with entertainment facilities, with two 5D dynamic entertainment experience halls, the Flying Cinema and Qiqu Maileburg, opening up tourists' interesting interpretation and intelligent exploration of beer culture through a deep interactive entertainment method; The Beer Derivatives Exhibition Hall focuses on beer and develops a series of artistic and innovative derivatives.

Qingdao Polar Ocean Park is a national AAAA level scenic spot located at No. 60 Donghai East Road, Laoshan District, Qingdao City. It is situated in the core coastal tourism belt of Laoshan, facing the Yellow Sea, backed by Fushan Mountain, adjacent to Sculpture Garden, Shilaoren Beach, and Wheat Island Park, facing the sea on three sides. With beautiful scenery and convenient transportation, it is a polar ocean themed park that integrates ocean display, cultural tourism experience, science education, and animal conservation. The Qingdao Polar Ocean Park consists of five major venues: the Polar Ocean Pavilion, the Horizon Theater, the Deep Sea Fantasy Jellyfish Secret Realm, the Polar Legend Ice and Snow Experience Pavilion, and the 360 ° Ball Screen Cinema. Combined with the Whale Joy Square in the center of the park, it creates a unique and joyful ocean cube in Shandong Province. Immersed in it, you can observe polar animals such as beluga whales, dolphins, walruses, polar bears up close, as well as over 50000 marine creatures such as hawksbill turtles, sand tiger sharks, golden scads, swallow rays, jellyfish, and seahorses. Not only that, there are six major performances including "Whale and Dolphin Show", "White Whale Love", "Deep Sea Mermaid Show", "Sea Lion Legend - Pava", "Scientific Magic Show", and "Magic Ocean"; The seven internet famous check-in areas of 360 ° fully transparent dreamy jellyfish tunnel, underwater tunnel, beluga whale exhibition tank, deep-sea migration pool, ocean cute main gallery, flowing light goldfish bay, and whale joy square combine real ocean scenes with artificial scenery, allowing you to "come to the polar regions and leave memories", feel the fantasy and charm of the ocean, and harvest the wonderful experience of "crossing the North and South Poles in a day and receiving countless surprises". 1、 Five Theme Pavilions 1. Tourists depart from the century old Xiaogang Pier and take professional boats or yachts of different specifications. Along the way, they can visit century old lighthouses, cruise homeports, cross sea bridges and other places, ride the wind and waves, swim in the sea, take photos in the sea breeze, swing poles in the deep sea, and experience the joy of fishing.
