summary: Xiaoyushan Park is one of the best scenic spots in Qingdao, firstly because it is located in the city center and is a mountain close to the sea, with a geographical location; Secondly, due to its altitude of only 60 meters, climbing the mountain is not tiring. When you reach the top, you can see the representative scenery of Qingdao, which is "red tiles, green trees, blue sea and blue sky". At the top of Xiaoyushan Mountain, there is a three story octagonal pavilion called the Tide Viewing Pavilion, which is 18 meters high and covered with green glazed tiles. Climbing up the spiral staircase to enjoy the view, nearby are German style buildings with red tiles and yellow walls hidden among green trees. To the southeast, you can see the golden sand of the first beach connected to the blue sea. To the northeast, you can see the Qingdao TV Tower on Taiping Mountain. When the weather is good to the west, you can distinguish the small Qingdao and the wharf in the distance. To the north, you can take a panoramic view of Signal Mountain Park. The guesthouse on the mountainside of Signal Mountain and the three red topped mushroom buildings on the mountaintop are clearly visible. At night, you can take photos of the night view of Qingdao city on the mountain. To the west of the Lianchao Pavilion is the Hexagonal Pavilion with Bibo Pavilion, and to the east is the Four Corner Pavilion with Cuicui Pavilion. Both pavilions are covered with green glazed tiles, providing scenic views. The front of the curved corridor connecting the Lianchao Pavilion and Yongcui Pavilion features white reliefs, with modern characters "small" and "mountain" and ancient pictographic characters "fish" forming the mountain emblem of Xiaoyushan. You can take a photo with it, and there are also beautiful murals next to the emblem. In addition, on the southern slope of Xiaoyushan, there are miniature models that gather Qingdao architecture. If you are interested, you can also take a look. There are many scenic spots near Xiaoyushan Park, mostly along the coastline. To the west, you can follow the route of Zhanqiao - Navy Museum - Little Qingdao - Lu Xun Park - Xiaoyushan Park. To the east, you can see Kang Youwei's former residence, the first beach, Badaguan, and then go to Taipingjiao to see the sunset. Full text 

Shangjie Lane · Yinyu Lane is a century old block formed by the intersection of Ningyang Road and Shoukang Road in the southern district of Qingdao. It preserves the traditional courtyard architecture of Qingdao and is also a cultural gathering place, with a strong atmosphere. There are also many trendy shops, jewelry and souvenir shops, coffee shops, restaurants, and more inside.

Lingshan Island is located in Lingshan Bay, southeast of Huangdao District, Qingdao City. It is isolated from the world and has a primitive way of life and natural island scenery. You can also experience the fisherman's style here through various ways of play. To enter and exit Lingshan Island, one needs to take a boat. After arriving on the island, one can rent a boat for sea fishing, usually heading to the northeast coast of the island. It is said that someone caught over a hundred mackerel there in a day, and some people caught about thirty pounds of large sea bass. The variety of seafood on the island is very rich. When the tide falls at night, you can find many spicy snails, eccentric snails, etc. at the Stone Beach in the north of the island. The mountain treasures here are even more delicious, and CCTV's "Beautiful Chinese Countryside Tour" was filmed because of this. Lingshan Island is located in the open sea with minimal pollution, and most local residents still maintain their traditional way of life. The visibility here is high, and the starry sky at night is particularly beautiful, attracting countless astronomy enthusiasts to come here. In addition, there are also attractions such as Beilai Stone and Tiger Mouth on the island that can be enjoyed together.

The First Beach was built in 1901 and is a relatively old urban beach in Qingdao. It is located in the southern part of Qingdao city. From July to September every year, the First Beach is crowded with visitors. People swim in the sea here, or lie on the beach to enjoy the sea breeze. They can also ride water motorcycles or speedboats to ride on the waves and enjoy the summer excitement. The first beach in spring and autumn may not be suitable for diving, but it has become a great place for strolling and enjoying the scenery along the seaside. You can stroll shoulder to shoulder with your loved one on this 500 meter long beach, breathing in the pleasant air of the seaside, and also take photos of the beautiful seaside scenery and sunset glow connected by mountains and seas. If you climb up to the nearby Xiaoyushan, you can also overlook the beautiful coastal arc of the entire bathhouse. Winter swimming enthusiasts can often be seen in the bathhouses during winter.

You can dig up various shellfish on the beach, and the secret is that by seeing the small holes on the beach, you will know that there must be small creatures below. Remember to bring rain boots when you come here. Not only can you play on the beach, take beautiful photos, but you can also enjoy the beautiful sunset scenery.

shortFeatures: Featuring fisherman culture
summary: Qingshan Fishing Village is located in Laoshan Scenic Area, Laoshan District, Qingdao. Halfway up the mountainside of Laoshan Mountain, it still retains the original style of the fishing village. It has the reputation of Laoshan Fishing Village Folk Customs Museum

The Li Qingzhao Memorial Hall is located in the north of Baotu Spring Park. Built in 1959 at the original Ding Baozhen Temple and renovated in 1980. Li Qingzhao (1084-1155), also known as Yi'an Jushi, was an outstanding female poet of the Song Dynasty from Jinan. She was a representative of the "Wanyue School" in the field of poetry and her works were called "Yi'an Style", which had a great influence on later generations. Niantang is a traditional courtyard residential form. The composition is symmetrical, surrounded by winding corridors and staggered loops, with orderly changes. The entire building adopts the Song Dynasty style, taking its meaning rather than imitating its shape, reflecting the atmosphere of the era in which the female poet lived. The courtyard gate faces south, with front and rear pillars, double ridges and wings, and upturned eaves. A wooden plaque hanging from the forehead reads' Li Qingzhao Memorial Hall '. The main hall faces north and south, with a gable roof and overhanging eaves. In front of it is a pavilion, with ear rooms on the side. Couplets are hung on the pillars: "By the Daming Lake, by the Baotu Spring, the former residence is deep in the weeping poplar trees; the jade is concentrated, and the inscriptions on stone and stone have a literary charm reminiscent of the late master." Inside the hall, there is a statue of Li Qingzhao, holding a scroll, with deep furrowed brows, lost in thought. On the walls of the hall, paintings and calligraphy by famous figures such as Mao Dun, Ye Shengtao, Feng Yuanjun, Shu Tong, Zang Kejia, and Li Kuchan are displayed. There are various versions of Li Qingzhao's poetry displayed in the shop window, as well as research monographs by scholars at home and abroad.

shortFeatures: Large-scale Temple of Sacrifice to Emperor Guandi
summary: The temple was built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The current building consists of one residential temple gate, three main halls and newly-built north and south wings. The temple gate is a hard mountain top and the main hall is a rolling shed roof. It was renovated from March to December 2009 and opened to the public. There are also inscriptions in the temple, such as the Inscription on Rebuilding the Kaopeng in the 59th year of Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty (1720) and the Inscription on Rebuilding the Shengjun Temple in Dongguandi, Dongkou Road, Chief Secretary Street, North Head of Furong Street in the 25th year of Guangxu (1899).

shortFeatures: In memory of Tie Xuan, Minister of War of the Ming Dynasty
summary: Tiegong Temple, located at the west end of the north bank of Daming Lake, was built to commemorate Tiexuan, the minister of the Ministry of War in Ming Dynasty. It is a comprehensive garden courtyard, which consists of ancestral hall, Xiaocanglang Pavilion, Deyue Pavilion, lakeside promenade, lotus pool and other scenic spots. There is a built-in bronze statue of Tie Xuan in the ancestral hall, which is 2.3 meters high and weighs 1.8 tons. It is antique bronze. Tie Gong is wearing Ming Dynasty civil servant costumes, with a crown and a robe, slightly frowned eyebrows and a sad face. The characters are vivid and lifelike. The combination of traditional sculpture and modern sculpture can better depict the character characteristics and inner world of characters. On the inner wall of the hall, ancient and modern calligraphers' handwritten stone carvings are embedded in all directions. True, line, cursive, seal script and Wei tablet are all equipped with profound skills and their own merits. There are many literati inscriptions in the courtyard, including travel notes, redacted records, poems, inscriptions, birthday words and commemorative articles.

shortFeatures: One of the important monuments by Daming Lake
summary: Arctic Pavilion is located on the north bank of Daming Lake, also known as Arctic Temple and Zhenwu Temple. It is a Taoist temple. The Arctic Pavilion was built from the Yuan Dynasty to the 17th year of the Yuan Dynasty (AD 1280), and was rebuilt during the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty. The temple is built on a stone platform more than 7 meters high, and consists of front and back halls, bell and drum towers, and east-west rooms. In the main hall, the statue of Emperor Zhenwu, the northern water god, is enshrined. Next to the statue, there are statues of two turtles and snakes and four heavenly monarches, all of which are vivid and vivid. The walls on both sides of the main hall are painted with murals about the cultivation of Zhenwu into immortality, which have extremely high artistic value. The back hall, named Qi Sheng Temple, is dedicated to the statues of Zhenwu's parents.

Xigengdao Street is located in Lixia District, Jinan City and is an ancient street with a long history. This place preserves many traditional quadrangle courtyards and ancient buildings, making it a great place to learn about the history and culture of Jinan. There are many specialty snacks and handicraft shops on both sides of the street, where tourists can experience the authentic Jinan style.

summary: The Sky Tower was built in 1991 and is a "water tower". It is a member of the World High Tower Association. The Sky Tower, with its power like a sword leaning against the sky, is known as the "Sky Tower Spinning Clouds". It is 415.2 meters high and currently ranks sixth in the world and fourth in Asia. The Sky Tower mainly includes two functions: broadcasting and television signal transmission and tourism sightseeing. The Tian Tower is located at the intersection of Niegong Bridge South, Zijinshan Road, and Weijin South Road in Hexi District, Tianjin, opposite the Water Park, and is a 4A level scenic spot. The observation hall of the Tian Tower is located at an altitude of 253 meters, where visitors can experience a 360 degree panoramic view of the entire Tianjin city; There is also a starry sky hall and a high-power telescope indoors to provide visitors with a more intuitive physical and mental experience. As a landmark scenic spot in Tianjin, in order to promote Tianjin's history and culture, and convey the spirit of urban construction, a 360 degree "Dare to be the First in the World" themed exhibition has been set up around the tower, with the theme of "Looking at Tianjin with a Century of History" as the main line. The West Bank Bookstore of the Tian Ta is a relatively high rotating bookstore in China, located 257 meters above the Tian Ta. The bookstore features a boutique coffee bar and four experiential projects. Cloud Rain Art Installation, 160 Billion Pixel VR Panoramic View of Tianjin, Tower Top Selfie Check in, "Along the Light" Glass Art Exhibition. The study has nearly 10000 books, with a wide variety covering 22 categories such as philosophy, culture, literature, art, history, geography, astronomy, etc., which can be borrowed for free by tourists. At the same time, on the occasion of New Year's Eve in 2020, Tianta collaborated with major enterprises to create a national high naked eye 3D advertising light show on the Tianta Tower. Ascending the Heavenly Tower, overlooking Tianjin, and admiring the beautiful scenery of the city! Full text 

The Qingdao Seaside Sculpture Park is located on the banks of Huanghai Beach in the eastern new district of Qingdao. It consists of an indoor sculpture art museum and an outdoor sculpture park, with a total planned area of 8 hectares and a total investment of over 40 million yuan. Among them, there are more than 3800 square meters of indoor space, mainly for collecting exquisite sculptures from both modern and contemporary China and abroad; The park displays excellent outdoor sculptures and artworks from both domestic and foreign sources, with the main function of showcasing representative and famous works of Chinese modern sculptors in the 20th century.

The sixth beach located west of Qianhai Pier, adjacent to the train station, is also known as the "Pier Beach". Many out of town tourists who have never seen the sea have first encountered it here. The coastline entwined in six baths is one of the more beautiful places in Qingdao, with famous attractions such as the wharf and modern style high-rise buildings. The bathing area is relatively small, and most of the sand on the beach is newly replaced. The sand is fine and soft, especially suitable for playing on the beach. The sixth beach is not far from Little Qingdao, and every night the navigation lights and waves on Qindao Island complement each other, creating a mesmerizing night scene. Full text 

Yangkou Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Laoshan Mountain and is a classic tourist area for the natural landscape of the entire Laoshan Mountain. There are many unique peaks and rocks in Yangkou Scenic Area, including Lion Peak, Xiantao Stone, Shouzi Peak and other famous landscapes, as well as the winding and twisting Seeking Heaven Cave. This is also a great place to overlook the beautiful scenery of the Yellow Sea coast and watch the sunrise. The peaks in Yangkou Scenic Area are steep and the scenery is beautiful. There are mainly strange peaks and rocks in the scenic area, such as Lion Peak resembling a male lion, Sheep Stone resembling a sheep, Xiantao Stone resembling a fairy peach, and Shouzi Peak engraved with the characters "Shou" big and small. There are also stone caves such as Bailong Cave, Yulong Cave, and Mixian Cave. There is a simple and elegant Taoist palace on the mountain - Taiping Palace, which was first built in the Song Dynasty as a Taoist holy land. There is a cable car in the scenic area, and many tourists choose to take the cable car up and down the mountain, or walk up and down the mountain. The cable car can take tourists to the vicinity of Mitian Cave. Mitian Cave is a fun attraction in the scenic area, consisting of many giant stones stacked between two large cliffs. It is divided into five layers from bottom to top, with twists and turns inside the cave, strange and mysterious. After entering the cave, one must perform eighteen martial arts such as drilling, climbing, moving, and crossing to get out. After passing through the Mitian Cave and continuing to climb upwards, we finally arrived at the summit - Tianyuan. Standing here, we can overlook the Yangkou Beach at the foot of the mountain and the Yellow Sea in the distance. Yangkou Beach is wide and flat, with excellent sand quality, making it an ideal beach. In addition, the cliff carvings scattered throughout the Yangkou Scenic Area are also a major attraction, and one can also see the handwritten poems of the Yuan Dynasty Taoist Qiu Chuji.
Qinyu Road, located between Luxun Park and Little Qingdao in Shinan District, Qingdao, is a very artistic path with distinctive Qingdao characteristics. You can come here to relax.

If you go south along Ningwu Pass Road to explore Badaguan, you will come to the second beach next to Huashi Tower. The bathhouse and Badaguan complement each other, forming a typical beautiful landscape of "red tiles, green trees, blue sea and blue sky" in Qingdao. Therefore, couples often take wedding photos here, making it a popular location for outdoor filming. The beach of the second bath is slightly smaller than the first beach, but there are fewer tourists here and the environment is better. The beach shore here is made of reddish brown rocks, with cliffs as steep as knives, and black pine trees planted all over the shore, creating a pleasant environment. Even if you come here to take a stroll and bask in the sun, it is still quite comfortable. And the seawater in the second bath is relatively clean, with small waves and gentle slopes, making it a summer swimming destination. There are many pebbles on the western beach of the bathhouse, and visitors often come to pick them up. Due to the abundance of reefs in this area, it is suitable for picking up shells, and even living creatures such as hermit crabs and starfish can be seen. The sandy beach here is relatively fine, so it is suitable for walking barefoot here, and children can also play digging sand. There is also a stone embankment bridge that extends into the sea, where you can walk and feel closer to the ocean.

Yushan Road is located in Shinan District, Qingdao. It has a strong German style path and German-style buildings throughout the road. Yushan Road has now become online celebrity Road, which is the punch-in place for many people to visit Qingdao.

shortFeatures: Visit the unique ape museum
summary: Qingdao Zoo founded an animal cage in 1915, and formed a small zoo in 1930s. Since then, it has continued to develop, and by the early 1960s, it has reached considerable scale. In 1977, Qingdao Zoo was built on the southwest side of Taiping Mountain. After 10 years, 18 unique animal houses, such as Ape Pavilion, Orangutan Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Bird Cage, Songbird Pavilion, Liger Mountain and Children's Pet Garden, were gradually built, with hundreds of species of animals on display.

Qingdao Taipingshan Central Park is located within the Qingdao Scenic Area, abbreviated as Taipingshan Central Park. Taiping Mountain Central Park has included seven parks including Zhongshan Park, Botanical Garden, Zoo, Julin Park, Qingdao Mountain Park, Baihua Garden, and Huiquan Square. The scenic area is mainly characterized by "Taoist Holy Land", "Small Jiangnan Botanical Area" and natural sea and stone wonders. Taiqing Palace is a Taoist temple with a long history and a large scale on Mount Laoshan. It is said to have been built in the first year of Jianyuan in the Western Han Dynasty (140 BC) and has a history of more than 2100 years. The Taiqing Palace is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on one side. Due to being surrounded by distant peaks and nearby seven peaks, it blocks the cold air flow from the north in winter, forming a unique subtropical microclimate and small environment. Therefore, it has neither cold winter nor hot summer, mild and humid, lush plants, and a wide variety of species, earning it the nickname "Little Jiangnan".

The PLA Naval Museum is a military museum reflecting the development of the Chinese navy in China. It is the historical, spiritual and cultural highland of the People's Navy. The Navy Museum is located at No. 8 Laiyang Road, Shinan District, Qingdao, adjacent to Lu Xun Park to the east and Little Qingdao Park to the west, echoing the wharf from afar. The Naval Museum has a land area of approximately 141 acres and a sea area of approximately 214 acres. It was officially opened to the public in October 1989. In 2001, it was rated as a national defense education demonstration base by the Central Propaganda Department. In June 2021, at the important historical moment of celebrating the 100th anniversary of the founding of the CPC and achieving the goal of "the first 100 years", the Naval Museum completed its reconstruction and expansion, opened to the outside world with a new look, and presented the glorious history of the People's Navy for more than 70 years under the strong leadership of the CPC in a panoramic manner. On May 18, 2022, the Naval Museum's "Strong Towards the Sea - Basic Exhibition of the History of the People's Navy" was awarded the 19th (2021) "National Museum Top Ten Exhibition Excellence Award". The Naval Museum is divided into three exhibition areas: indoor, sea, and land. The indoor main exhibition hall is the basic display of the history of the People's Navy, with four exhibition halls covering an area of over 7000 square meters. It is divided into three parts: "Socialist Revolution and Construction Period", "New Era of Reform and Opening up and Socialist Modernization Construction", and "New Era of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics". There are over 18000 cultural relics in the collection, mainly displayed under the strong leadership of the Party, where the People's Navy was born, grew, and developed through artillery fire; Along the way, cutting through waves and traversing thousands of miles of maritime territory, galloping across the vast oceans, we are striding towards the goal of building a world-class navy. The exhibition area for naval vessels covers an area of over 40000 square meters, with 3 docks and 6 berths. It mainly showcases China's first destroyer Anshan (hull number 101), the first domestically produced destroyer Jinan (hull number 105), the first domestically produced air defense frigate Yingtan (hull number 531), the first nuclear submarine Long March 1 (hull number 401), the first experimental submarine Great Wall 200 (hull number 200) and other iconic vessels. The land equipment exhibition area covers an area of over 13000 square meters. The main exhibition showcases the small surface vessels, naval aviation equipment, marine equipment, and naval coastal defense equipment that have served in the People's Navy since its establishment. The main exhibits include: the Liberation class meritorious boats and gunboats that made great collective contributions in the Battle of Wanshan; The honor boat - No. 245 wooden shell torpedo boat showcased during the first naval parade of the People's Navy; The Il-14 aircraft, which once ensured the participation of Navy Commander Xiao Jingguang in various activities and carried out important tasks such as transporting rescue personnel, supplies, and international friends; Meritorious artillery that participated in the aid to Vietnam and anti US air defense operations; The T-34 tank, which has been widely equipped with the Marine Corps and island guarding forces such as the Xisha Islands; The YJ-62A shore to ship missile launcher, which is used to block ports and sea routes, and maneuver to strike large and medium-sized surface targets, is a significant naval weapon and equipment. These weapons and equipment have played a significant role in tasks such as liberating coastal islands, safeguarding maritime security, and protecting people's lives and property. The Naval Museum will focus on inheriting the red genes, keeping in mind the original mission, strengthening historical memory, and exerting educational functions, striving to build a leading domestic and world leading naval museum. The Japanese army demolished Pingyuan Building, the original building of Zhangyuan, and rebuilt a two-story building with brick and wood structure at the original site. summary: Shuyu Spring is recorded in the Jin Dynasty's "Famous Spring Stele", Ming Dynasty's "Seventy Two Springs Poetry", and Qing Dynasty's "Seventy Two Springs Record". On the east side of Liuxu Spring, there is a rectangular stone built water pool surrounded by stone carved railings. The north wall of the pond is inlaid with carved stones of "Shuyuquan", which was written by contemporary calligrapher and painter Guan Yousheng in Jinan in 1956. The name 'Shuyu' evolved from the term 'Shushi Pillow Flow'. According to legend, Li Qingzhao, an outstanding poet of the Song Dynasty, once gathered here to dress up, write poems, and recite poetry. Her work "Shuyu Ci" was named after this spring. On the south side of the spring is an overflow outlet, built with natural stones. Spring water emerges from the bottom of the pool, forming clusters of water bubbles that rupture on the surface, sizzle and sizzle. Then, it flows through the crevices of the rocks and falls into a natural shaped pool, resembling a jade bath. The water surface of this pool is relatively large, with rocky embankments arranged in a staggered manner. There is another spring in the pool, clusters of water bubbles, rotating and slowly rising, like a spiral, also known as a screw spring. The spring water is clear to the bottom and contains goldfish. The green pine trees on the shore are tall and graceful, while the green bamboo is graceful and varied.

shortFeatures: Named after the ripples of golden thread fluttering on the water
summary:
Jinxian Spring is located on the northeast side of Baotu Spring, between Shangzhitang and Huanghuaxuan. The spring pool is rectangular, originally 4 feet long and 2 feet wide. Because there is a fluttering waterline ripple on the water surface, it is like a glittering golden line floating on the water surface, hence its name. Zeng Gong's poem "Golden Thread Spring" goes: "The jade is always floating and fresh, and the golden silk is uncertain to the south spring. The clouds compete into wisps by the beautiful algae, and the moon shines on the spirit and winds it skillfully." 
During the Ming and Qing Dynasties, the golden thread could still be clearly seen. Later, due to the reconstruction of the spring pool, the base was destroyed, the water surface also shrank, the water potential weakened, and the golden thread disappeared from then on. In 1956, when Baotu Spring Park was expanded, golden thread also appeared in a small stone carved pool about 20 meters east of the original golden thread spring. So people called this spring "Golden Thread Spring", and the three-character stone carving "Golden Thread Spring" inscribed by Ding Yanchen in Xing Wu, Jiangsu Province in the ninth year of Tongzhi in Qing Dynasty was embedded on the east wall of this spring. The original Golden Thread Spring was renamed "Old Golden Thread Spring", and the new inscription "Old Golden Thread Spring" by Jinan calligrapher Li Zhongyu was embedded on the pool wall.

Dukang Spring, also known as Beiboiled Kang Spring, is located on the northwest side of Baotu Spring. It was buried in 1994 and restored in 1999. The current spring pool is built with stone blocks, rectangular in shape, 2.4 meters long and 2 meters wide, surrounded by railings, and connected to Dengzhou Spring to the south.

The huge stone wall of "Shou Zi Peak" is engraved with the words "Shou" of all sizes. 
Chinese people's pursuit of longevity has a long history. Throughout the ages, from Qin Shihuang sending Xu Fu to the east to look for the elixir of immortality, to Tang Xuanzong sending Sun Tan to Laoshan Mountain to collect medicine and alchemy, and then to generations of Taoists in Laoshan Mountain to cultivate Taoism and keep in good health, until today, people wish their elders health and longevity, which shows the position of the word "longevity" in people's minds. 
The word "Shou" written by ancient and modern Chinese calligraphers in different fonts is engraved on the peak of Shou, including Li, Seal, Xing, Cao, Kai and other fonts. It forms a spectacular picture of a hundred longevity on the huge rock wall, and it is also a calligraphy exhibition of the word "Shou". We can enjoy the art of calligraphy while enjoying the strange peaks and valleys. Among them, the very eye-catching, vigorous and dignified word "Shou" is 20 meters high and 16 meters wide. Shen Peng, president of the Chinese Calligraphers Association, is happy to write "the longest life in the world", which can be called "the longest life in China", which means "long life, long life, long life and long life". Many tourists come here, and they like to take photos with the word "longevity" as the background. First, they keep it as a souvenir of the tour, and second, they pray that they will be accompanied by "longevity".

Lion Peak is like a strong and mighty male lion towering over the vast sea, hence it is called "Lion Peak". Lion Peak is backed by mountains and facing the sea, with majestic clouds. The huge mouth opened by the "Lion" can accommodate more than ten people at the same time. Between the upper and lower jaws of the lion's mouth, due to the erosion of wind and rain, the rock particles are uneven, forming countless "teeth" that are very realistic. By passing through the cave under the lion's rib, one can climb onto the lion's back. This is an ideal place to watch the sunrise over the sea, and has always been a place for literati to express their thoughts. If in the early morning, the clouds and mist have not yet opened and the white clouds are lingering, standing in the distance to see Lion Peak, it is another wonderful sight: cloud blocks float around the waist of Lion Peak Mountain, waves of sea breeze blow, cloud blocks flow like flowing water and clouds, like rough waves. Looking at that lion again, in the rolling sea of clouds, it seemed like it was about to leap with its claws, its huge mouth opening wide, swallowing clouds and exhaling mist, and howling long into the sky. This landscape is called "Shiling Hengyun" and is one of the "Famous Twelve Scenic Spots of Laoshan Mountain". There are many ancient poems from the Ming and Qing dynasties carved on the top and surrounding stone walls of Lion Peak, which are also of great ornamental value.

Sanxian Mountain Scenic Area is located on the coast of the Yellow Sea in the northern part of Penglai City, adjacent to the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea Scenic Area. It is a themed scenic area with Taoist culture as its core. There are magnificent pavilions and towers, as well as magnificent flying eaves and upturned corners in the scenic area, which recreate the imagery of the "Three Immortal Mountains" in mythology. You can also enjoy the art treasures such as wood and jade carvings collected in the park, among which a rare statue of Shakyamuni Buddha lying in the water, white jade, and ice from Myanmar is particularly precious. The Three Immortal Mountains refer to the three legendary mountains of Penglai, Fangzhang, and Yingzhou in ancient mythology. The various magnificent and splendid "Immortal Palace Pavilions" in the scenic area are also modeled after the legendary fairyland, making it a very suitable place for photography. Tourist Guide: There are tour guides in the scenic area who will provide free explanations, allowing you to learn about many historical stories. The entire tour takes about two hours. Upon entering the scenic area, you will first arrive at the Hall of Harmony, where statues of Confucius, Laozi, and Shakyamuni are enshrined. Among them, the statue of Shakyamuni is finely carved from Burmese white jade, while the statues of Confucius and Laozi are painted with purple copper and gold plating, each with a solemn expression. Next, we will visit the main buildings in the park, Penglai Fairy Island, Fanghu Scenic Area, and Yingzhou Wonderland, all of which are towering structures built in artificial lakes. Climbing up to the high pavilion, we can overlook the panoramic view of the park. The Jade Buddha Temple is a place of prayer within the garden, where the "Treasure of Zhenyuan" is enshrined: a reclining Buddha statue of Shakyamuni Buddha, a Burmese white jade ice seed from around the world. This 108 ton Buddha statue is finely carved from a single piece of jade, with a body embedded in 24K gold and decorated with over 3000 red, blue, and jade stones, making it a rare treasure. The Guanyin Pavilion next to the temple houses a 9.9-meter-high statue of eleven jade Guanyin statues, adorned with over 10000 precious stones, jadeite, and agate, exuding a dignified and luxurious appearance. The Treasure Hall in the park displays numerous precious art collections: the first floor hall displays numerous tree shaped jade with a history of 200 million years, the second floor offers the opportunity to appreciate the ink treasures of famous figures throughout history, and the third floor displays exquisite Yangzhou lacquerware, jade carvings, wood carvings, and other art treasures. In addition, there are also wooden carving halls and nanmu halls in the park, both of which collect precious wooden crafts and are worth a visit. Full text 

It gathers nearly a hundred species of marine creatures from around the world, including polar bears, beluga whales, penguins, walruses, sea lions, dolphins, etc. It integrates viewing, entertainment, fun, marine culture, and marine technology. Through a combination of dynamic and static methods, it allows people to learn more about marine knowledge and improve ecological protection awareness. It has been awarded the "Provincial Science Popularization Education Base" by the Shandong Provincial Association for Science and Technology and the "National Science Popularization Education Base" by the China Ocean Society. The scenic area has twelve themed pavilions: Tropical Rainforest Pavilion, Polar Pavilion, Whale Bay, Underwater Tunnel, Underwater Theater, Marine Boutique Pavilion, Turtle Pavilion, Shark Pavilion, Seal Island, Jellyfish Pavilion, Science Popularization Pavilion, and Ocean Theater. Two major performances: Underwater Theater: Mermaid Performance, Ocean Theater: Dolphin and Sea Lion Performance. In the Tropical Rainforest Pavilion, cascading waterfalls, tall and dense forests, and fierce crocodiles will take you into a mysterious and thrilling world. Through the time tunnel, you will arrive at the Polar Pavilion, where numerous polar marine creatures such as polar bears, beluga whales, penguins, walruses, and sea lions live freely in the white ice and snow world. The mermaid shuttling through the colorful ocean kingdom in the underwater theater is breathtaking. In the cylindrical cylinder, the multi shaped underwater tunnel seems to immerse visitors in the azure sea, and the nearby marine creatures seem within reach, offering a panoramic view of the beautiful underwater world. Shark Aquarium, Seal Island, Turtle Aquarium, and mysterious and magnificent underwater corals allow you to experience a unique marine atmosphere! In the dolphin and sea lion performance hall, comical sea lions and intelligent dolphins give exciting performances, with explosive scenes that allow you to experience the wisdom of marine animals! In this small block, there are all kinds of big stalls of restaurants, where you can taste authentic Qingdao food, including bean curd jelly served with sauce, Guozu Stinky tofu, Qingdao old yogurt, Potsticker, grilled squid, etc. At first, this place was filled with randomly built dilapidated houses called "chopping wood houses". In 1902, after the German occupation of Qingdao, Jiangning Road was built in the chopping wood yard, and several large courtyards were built. Later, it became an entertainment center and food street in Qingdao, with all kinds of food, drink, and entertainment options. The street of Bichaiyuan is in the shape of a "person", with the main street running from Zhongshan Road to Hebei Road, and old houses along the roadside, forming a sharp contrast with the surrounding high-rise buildings. Entering the chopping wood yard from Zhongshan Road, you can see a beautiful gatehouse, which looks a bit like the gatehouse of Shanghai Shikumen Lane. The words "chopping wood yard" and "1902" are written on it, and the back of the gatehouse is painted with colorful figures. Walking through a small doorway into a narrow street, various large row style restaurants lined up on both sides, mainly featuring seafood and barbecue. There is a Jiangning Guild Hall at No. 10 Jiangning Road, which is said to have been referred to as the "Chai Chai Yuan" in the early days, hence it is also known as the "Chai Chai Lao Yuan". There is a stage in the museum where traditional Chinese operas such as Peking Opera and Lv Opera are performed almost every day at noon and evening. When there is no performance, the large screen on the stage also plays cross-talk. You can eat and watch the show here. Chinese crosstalk master Ma Sanli once practiced stall here, and now a statue of Ma Sanli can still be seen in the hall. There are actually many artists who have come out of here, including Xihe drum performer Liu Taiqing and storytelling artist Ge Zhaohong. In addition, there are many craftsmen busy making various items in the chopping wood yard, such as maltose in different shapes, carved gourds, noodle figurines, etc., all of which are worth appreciating. Strolling leisurely along the seaside pedestrian street, listening to the waves while enjoying a leisurely stroll, the sculptures along the way are naturally harmonious. If you head south into the historic old street and stroll along it, you will inadvertently feel the opening scene of modern coastal ports. Many modern buildings from the 19th century combine Chinese and Western styles, which feels very beautiful. The old street is quiet and scattered, and when you turn into a courtyard, there is a feeling of returning to the past.

summary: Huibo Building is located in the northeast corner of Daming Lake Park. Built in the early Yuan Dynasty, it was named after the building was built on Huibo Bridge (also known as Beishuimen). On the eve of the founding of the People's Republic of China, the building was destroyed and rebuilt in 1981. It is a concrete structure with a width of seven rooms and two floors, wing corners hanging from mountains, Dan pillars and green tiles, lifelike kissing beasts, and sonorous wind chimes. Surrounded by poplars, like stars holding the moon. Li Xiongcai, a contemporary painter and calligrapher, inscribed Huibo Building on it. When you climb the building, you can look at famous mountains such as Lishan and Yuhan in the south, Huashan Mountain, Queshan Mountain and Yaoshan Mountain in the north, look up at the blue sky and clear clouds, and look down at the clear waves of Minghu Lake. In the green lotus bush, boats are competing for the crossing, and the reflection of Hanguang is unobstructed. If you climb the stairs on sunny days or in the evening, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery. The sunset lake reflects each other, the sunset is spread, the soft waves are fascinating, and the upper and lower sky lights are integrated. This wonderful place makes people worry and annoy. The evening photo of Huibo, one of the eight scenic spots in Jinan in ancient times, is called this scene. Liu Haisu, a master of contemporary painting and calligraphy, inscribed a plaque upstairs on Huibo Late Photo.

Lotus Shen Temple, located on the northeast bank of Daming Lake and the south side of Huibo Building, was built in 1998. It has three rooms wide, a mansion in front, and a flower partition. The shrine is dedicated to the colored sculpture of lotus root god dressed in women's costumes of Song Dynasty, which is 2.8 meters high; There are murals painted on the east, north and west walls. The main content of the painting is the legendary story of Li Qingzhao, and the background is the beautiful scenery of Daming Lake. The museum has two floors, with letters as the main collection, divided into four parts: the cultural history of letters, the collection of ancient letters, the collection of modern and contemporary letters, and the collection of letters from famous people in Shandong. It exhibits nearly 300 pictures and more than 100 authentic works, as well as nearly 100 replicas of representative ancient exhibits.

Jianghu Art Society is a cultural venue in Jinan City that integrates traditional folk art performances, cultural exchanges, and art exhibitions. Wangfu Reef Park is one of the tourist attractions on Long Island. The main attractions include the "Fu" character on the slope of Wangfu Reef, which is 21.9 meters high and 16.3 meters wide, as well as the Guanyin Pavilion, Olympic Monument, Geological Museum, etc. This large "Fu" character immediately highlights the atmosphere of the "source of Fu".

Crescent Bay, also known as Half Moon Bay, is located at the northern end of Beichangshan Island. Crescent Bay is a beach with mountains and water on its back. As the name suggests, its shape resembles a crescent moon in the night sky, embedded between green mountains and clear waters. However, what is particularly unique is the ball stones scattered on the beach, as white as jade, colorful and extremely beautiful. The main buildings in the park are a 20 meter high "Crescent Pavilion" that combines Chinese and Western styles, a "Guanlan Pavilion" standing on a cliff, and a long corridor about a kilometer long. In front of the long corridor, there is a 100 meter "stone carpet" decorated with stone balls, giving a feeling of "stepping on pearls" when walking on it. What is particularly charming is the ballstone of Crescent Bay, which can be said to be a world of glittering and precious ballstones. It is as white as jade and crystal clear as amber, and no matter where you pick it up, you will not be able to let go of a single one.

Baota Reef is named after its shape resembling a pagoda. The reef is about 21 meters high and has a diameter of about 5 meters. Its shape resembles a towering giant tower, and no matter from which angle you look, you will always appreciate different natural charm, which makes people admire the greatness of natural power. Baota Reef is composed of alternating layers of quartzite, with horizontal stone patterns dividing the tower into several straight layers. The vertical rock lines also divide each layer into multiple sections. Under this criss crossing, it seems that the tower is not a tight whole, but a loose building made up of stones of different sizes and shapes. Now a pristine navigation lighthouse has been built on the adjacent small island on the south side of the reef. The white tower on the island stands side by side with the pagoda in the sea, making it a beautiful scenery on the sea.

poiName: Qingdao Tangdao Bay National Wetland Park
summary: Qingdao Tangdao Bay National Wetland Park is located in the west circular area of Qingdao Phoenix International Tourism Island, between Yinsha Beach Road and Tangdao Bay. The park started construction in July 2010 and was completed and opened on April 27, 2012. The whole park highlights the theme of "golden bay shore" in planning and design. Relying on the advantages of "natural mudflat" and "wetland landscape" on the south bank of Tangdao Bay, and ingeniously drawing on the experience of Shanghai World Expo Park, Cairns Park in Australia, Sydney Lover's Harbor and other well-known landscape parks at home and abroad, it has built a coastal landscape park that meets the needs of high-end tourism, reflects island customs and bay culture, and focuses on static leisure.

Shique Beach is located near the Yellow Sea and is shaped like a crescent, spreading out from east to west, hence the name Shique Mouth. The Shique Beach is naturally unique, with beaches, rocks, water, and pine trees connected into a single piece. The Shique Mouth in the east is a cape that extends about 0.5 kilometers towards the Yellow Sea, commonly known as the "Phoenix Head". There is a strange stone on it that looks like a bird and is called the Shique. Here, the beaches and reefs blend together, and strange rocks stand tall during low tide, making it a great place to watch the sea and listen to the tide.

summary: Yantai Changyu International Wine City has a total investment of 5 billion yuan and covers an area of 5500 acres. It is a comprehensive park integrating wine grape cultivation, technology research and development, wine and brandy production, and themed tourism. The wine city includes: Grape and Wine Research Institute, Winery Grape Planting Demonstration Garden, Fresh Grape Picking Garden, Gold Award Grand Wine Cellar, Wine Production Center, Dinglote Wine Winery, and Kaya Brandy Winery. The park has 2500 acres of vineyards, including 1000 acres of hillside vineyards, mainly planted with five types of wine grape varieties. It is a great place for guests from all over the world to experience wine estates, and also a gathering place for photography enthusiasts and wine enthusiasts.

The Linhaifeng Mountain Scenic Area is located at the southern end of Changdao City and is named after its vast sea and dense forests. The environment here is elegant and peaceful, with thick shade blocking the sun and cool and pleasant. The air has a high content of negative oxygen ions and is known as a natural "oxygen bar" area. The Linhai Fengshan Scenic Area includes two parks, Linhai and Fengshan. To the south of Linhai Park is the boundary between the Yellow Sea and Bohai Sea - Changshanwei. Changshanwei is formed by the accumulation of Zhuji pebbles, which are wide and pointed, curved and elegant, resembling a "ponytail". Changshanwei divides a blue sea into two worlds, with a clear distinction between Wei and Wei, which makes people marvel at the incredible craftsmanship of nature. Fengshan is the highest point of Changdao. In the Ming Dynasty, the famous anti Japanese general Qi Jiguang built the Fenghuotai in Shandong to prevent the invasion of Japanese pirates at sea, hence the name. Fengshan Park is a natural "tourist station" for the north-south migration of Houdao Island in China, with over 40 species of birds under national first and second level protection. People are also accustomed to calling it Eagle Mountain, because there is a sculpture of an eagle on the top of the mountain. Looking from afar, it spreads its wings and wants to fly, symbolizing the soaring Long Island of the reform era.

Long Island is located between the Liaodong Peninsula and the Shandong Peninsula, north of Penglai City, and is known as the "Wonderland on the Sea". It is composed of 32 islands, but the main attractions on the islands are mainly concentrated on North Changshan Island (North Line) and South Changshan Island (South Line). Long Island is neither beautiful nor unusual without islands, it is a natural sea garden. There are reefs, cliffs, beaches, and forests distributed here, and famous attractions include Crescent Bay Park, Jiuzhang Cliff, Temple Island Tianhou Temple, Dragon Claw Mountain, Baota Reef, Wanniao Island, Yellow Sea Bohai Boundary Line, Linhai Park, Wangfu Reef, etc. Climbing up Mount Feng, watching the sunrise over the Yellow Sea to the east, and witnessing the spectacular scene of the sun jumping out of the sea level, is a breathtaking sight that cannot be missed on Long Island.

[Route Features] During the sea voyage, you can enjoy the unique reefs and rocks of Long Island, appreciate different natural wonders from multiple angles, and feed seagulls on Wanniao Island. You can also play with seabirds up close and experience the joy of birds soaring and raising your hand to caress them. Seagulls are a symbol of tourism on Long Island. Every spring, beautiful seagulls fly from all over the world to Long Island to inhabit and reproduce. These beautiful seagulls gather on the high mountain island of Long Island, where thousands of birds fly together, singing and parroting. It is also a beautiful destination that attracts tourists from all over the world to Long Island. Therefore, the high mountain island is also known as the Island of Ten Thousand Birds and is well-known as a famous tourist destination. Cruise by boat between mountains and seas, enjoy the natural beauty of the fairy mountains on the sea, and fall in love with tens of thousands of bird islands with seagulls. Flight route: Long Island Port - Jiuzhang Cliff (view) - Seal Reef (view) - Baota Reef (view) - Monkey Island (view) - Gaoshan Island - Temple Island - Long Island (flight time of about 3.5-4 hours) Jiuzhang Cliff (view). Currently, Jiuzhang Cliff is a comprehensive tourist scenic area that integrates mountains, seas, bays, reefs, cliffs, and caves, integrating uniqueness, magnificence, beauty, and danger. Its majestic "body" is at the forefront of marine erosion geology in the country. Seal Reef (Observation): Every year in early March, large groups of spotted seals flock to the waters of the Diaoyu Islands in the northern part of Beichangshan Island, taking advantage of the high tide of the sea to climb onto the reef and enjoy a comfortable "sunbathing" experience. Baota Reef (Observation) The Baota Reef system is formed by alternating layers of rocks that have been eroded by the sea over time. With the transformation of the waves, the water color, sky light, and strange stone tower shadows suddenly give rise to spirituality in the natural light and shadow. Gaoshan Island (feeding seagulls) is an isolated island full of primitive and mysterious atmosphere, with particularly prominent natural landscapes. The cliffs are high and steep, with numerous stone caves, making them very suitable for the habitat and reproduction of gulls. Due to the large number of gulls, this island is also known as the Island of Ten Thousand Birds. Up close, seagulls shuttle and accompany tourists, just like the spirit birds of the immortal world, accompanying them to play. Sometimes curious to observe in the air, sometimes pecking at the gull food in your hand, sometimes lightly stepping on your shoulder, in the magnificent scene of thousands of birds soaring, there are various rare migratory birds hidden, such as black tailed gulls, yellow billed egrets, oyster sandpipers... Legend has it that the black tailed gull was burned black by the boiling sea fire in the iron gourd

Seal Island is located on both sides of the gourd water feature in front of the Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea Scenic Area. The dozens of spotted seals released on the island are unique marine creatures of the Bohai Sea, belonging to mammals that breathe with their lungs and feed on fish meat. They move quickly in the water and have intelligent minds. Tourists can hold food, feed it themselves, take photos with seals, and have close contact with marine animals.

The Qi Jiguang Memorial Hall is located on the north side of Zhenyangmen and is a symmetrical two entry antique style building facing north and south. The gate faces south, facing the Zhenyang Gate. There are four columns of arch of wooden architecture cornice stele pavilions on the east and west sides respectively. In the pavilions, there are two steles with the word "Zhong" facing each other. The stele is 3 meters high and 1 meter wide. The life of Qi Jiguang and Qi Jingtong (Jiguang's father) are engraved on the back of the stele. The entire exhibition hall of the memorial hall focuses on showcasing the national hero Qi Jiguang's defense of the country and the people, as well as his lifelong military service. At the same time, more than 20 cultural relics such as war swords and war robes were exhibited, and it was designated as a patriotic education base in Shandong Province by the cultural relics management department. Qi Jiguang (1528-1587), also known as Jing and Nantang, was a native of Penglai, Shandong. He came from a prominent family and was a hereditary commander of the Dengzhou Guard (now Penglai). His father Qi Jingtong was upright and straightforward, with a clear understanding of border affairs and strict military governance. He held important positions in preparing for the Japanese invasion and guarding the border. Qi Jiguang inherited his father's business and spent his whole life preparing for the Japanese invasion of Zhejiang and Fujian provinces, guarding Jimen (now Jinji County, Tianjin), and achieving outstanding honors and achievements. Once said in a poem, "Driving north and south to express one's feelings, the moon on the edge of the river smiles throughout one's life. Three hundred and sixty days a year, most of them are on horseback

Tianheng Mountain is located on the west side of Penglai Pavilion on Danya Mountain. There is a lighthouse built on the mountain. The line between Tianheng Mountain and Laotie Mountain lighthouse in Lushun is the boundary between the Yellow Sea and the Bohai Sea, so it has a unique geographical position of "one mountain divides two seas". In 202 BC, King Tian Heng of Qi committed suicide by cutting himself due to his unwillingness to serve his vassal Liu Bang. Upon hearing the news of Tian Heng's death, the five hundred strong men stationed on Tian Heng Mountain sang funeral songs, and after the songs ended, they committed suicide one after another. The indomitable spirit of Tian Heng and five hundred brave warriors deeply influenced future generations, hence the name Tian Heng Mountain. Tianheng Mountain has an altitude of only 72 meters, but the rocks are reddish brown. From a distance and up close, it has the characteristic of a "water blue mountain red" cliff scenery. The cliffs on the east, north, and west sides are steep, with strange rocks and scales. Standing on the railing, watching the sea and listening to the waves, thinking about the past and cherishing the present, has a unique charm. There are inscriptions on the tomb of Ji Tianheng, Qi Wang Ding, Xiaoyaolu, Bagua Pile, and Sun Tzu Han Bamboo Slips sculpture inside.

The Dragon King Palace is located on the west side of the half waist of Danya Mountain in Penglai Pavilion Scenic Area, northwest of Danya Wonderland Square. It is arranged from south to north and has a main entrance, front hall, two wings, main hall, and rear hall, with three courtyards. It is a temple style building. In the front hall, there is a statue of a sea protector on both sides, with the sea god of stability on the east and the sea god of peace on the west, each holding a magic weapon and exuding a majestic aura. The main hall is 12.69 meters long from east to west and 10.08 meters deep from north to south. It has a front porch and two Ming pillars inscribed with couplets: "Long pays tribute to Dan Cliff, hoping for a peaceful breeze and sweet rain, and Wang Ying Dongpo prays to Cuifu Heavy Tower." The hall is decorated with the words "Lin Yu Cang Sheng." On the west side of the Ming porch, there is a "Introduction to the Dragon King Palace. There is a high platform divine constitution in the hall, with a golden statue of the East Sea Dragon King Ao Guang sitting inside. There are 8 standing officials on both sides, from south to north. To the east are the Sea Patrol Night Fork, Thousand Mile Eye, Electric Mother, and Thunder God, and to the west are the Fish Chaser, Wind Wind Ear, Wind Po, and Rain God. The rear hall is the sleeping palace of the Dragon King and also has a clear corridor. There is also a high platform shrine in the hall, with golden statues of the Dragon King and his concubines sitting inside; Four maids are sculpted on each side of the hall. The old wooden statues of the Dragon King and the walking chariots and ceremonial guards used by the Dragon King for travel no longer exist today.

The Qingdao Art Museum is a modern and contemporary art museum that focuses on collecting, researching, and displaying works of artists, while promoting the comprehensive and coordinated operation of other functions. The exhibition mainly showcases art works such as Chinese painting, calligraphy, seal carving, oil painting, watercolor, watercolor, photography, etc. Located at No. 7 Daxue Road, Qingdao, surrounded by the unique yellow tiles and red walls of traditional Chinese architecture, a series of architectural complexes are excellent historical buildings in Qingdao. It is also a building that combines three houses, two courtyards, and five religions. It was built from 1934 to 1940 and was originally the site of the "Wanzihui". Now it is the Qingdao Art Museum. With a three house layout, it concentrates three different styles of buildings: Roman colonnade style, Chinese palace style, and Arabic style. It not only has historical sedimentation and cultural thickness, but also is a highly valuable tourist destination. The building covers an area of 14183 square meters, with a total construction area of 4108 square meters. In 2006, it was officially approved by the State Council as the sixth batch of national key cultural relics protection units.

The main peak of Laoshan is called "Jufeng" or "Laoding". The Jufeng Scenic Area is a scenic tourist area mainly formed by the peaks of Laoshan Mountain. Here, there are scattered rocks and towering peaks, with a magnificent atmosphere. Standing on the top of Laoshan Mountain, you can see the vast expanse of the Yellow Sea with blue waves, the islands like pearls and jade, and the mountain scenery with layers of mountains competing for dominance and thousands of peaks competing for beauty; During the summer season, you can often see the 'Wonders of the Sea of Clouds' here; And in winter, you can also enjoy the fairy tale like scene of "Silver Peak Crystal Hanging"; As for watching the sunrise at the top of Laoshan Mountain, it is also a beautiful and charming scene, hence the "Rising Sun of the Giant Peak". The main way to visit the Jufeng Scenic Area is to climb mountains, and the core scenic area of Jufeng is circular, which means you can go around without turning back. It is recommended to walk counterclockwise, that is, to the right side first, because the scenery is relatively beautiful, and the Lingqi Peak, which can be called the crown of giant peaks, is at the beginning of this road. If you are not strong enough or do not have enough time to return the same way, there will not be too many regrets. You can stop and go, eat and pat, and walk around in about 5 hours. After purchasing tickets from the foot of the mountain, you need to take a shuttle bus and walk eight kilometers on the mountain road before entering the mountain gate. If you need to walk a distance from here to the core area of the scenic spot, you will see a huge sculpture of "a divine turtle carrying a river map and a book of Luo". This is a myth of ancient Chinese humans, telling the story that the origin of Chinese ancient culture all originated from the river map and the book of Luo. Then you can see the old site of the Iron Tile Hall along the way, with granite walls that are up to 100 meters high and engraved with stone carvings from the second year of Kangxi's reign. You can see stone carvings along the way. After passing this scenic spot, the Giant Peak Loop begins. There are two roads on Shanglingqi Peak, one is a one-way dangerous road with guardrails for protection, which is still very safe. This road is steep, and adventurers can choose it. Next is to turn right and head up from Xunmen, which is the road chosen by ordinary tourists. In addition to climbing high to see the sea, another major feature of Mount Everest is its unique rocks. Here, you can see various strange stones with different shapes, such as natural steles in the shape of "dog heads". If you walk counterclockwise, one of the attractions in the Jufeng Ring Road is Lingqi Peak. To the south of here is the sea, with blue sky and white clouds, where you can feel the famous mountains on the sea. Then came the line of heaven, with a huge circular boulder sandwiched between the two walls. After just a few days, you can see the peak of Mount Laoshan, the towering peak of Mount Laoshan. It is like a sharp sword piercing straight into the blue sky, and can climb up the watchtower along the artificially excavated stone steps. Looking up from the summit, one can see the sea and mountains in full view. The Mudan Slope, which is just ahead from the observation deck, blooms with azaleas and red flowers every April and May, as beautiful as fire. Then there is Danlu Peak, which is the second highest peak in Laoshan Mountain after Jufeng. The peak here is relatively flat and can accommodate hundreds of people, making it a great place to watch the sun. On the north side of the top of the mountain peak, there is a group of bare rocks resembling a "curling furnace". On the mountain peak, there are also pictographic mountain stones such as "sister stones" and "uneven dangerous rocks". After passing the Danlu Peak and moving forward, two huge Double Blessings characters are carved on the opposite rock wall, imitating the technique of calligrapher Wang Xizhi. The characters are strong and eye-catching. For the convenience of tourists, three viewing platforms have also been built along the way, namely "Wangfu Platform", "Jufu Platform", and "Defu Platform". Afterwards, we arrived at the Qiannu Peak, which sits facing north. The contours of the eyes, nose, and mouth at the top of the mountain are very clear, like a young girl from a mountain village wearing a scarf, with her hands clasped together and facing north devoutly. Her posture is so dignified, simple, and elegant, giving people a feeling of holiness and piety. Next is Wuzhi Peak, as the name suggests, these five peaks are like a hand stretching out its five fingers, piercing straight into the blue sky. The main features of the scenery here are high mountains and peculiar peaks, with a graceful and majestic posture. Here, you can also enjoy up close stone landscapes such as "Bajie Gu", "Turtle Stone", "Ziya Chushan", "Master Apprentice Teaching", "Taigong Gu", and more. A little further away, there are also landscapes such as "Qiannv Peak", "Heifengfeng", and "Huanghuading". Leaving Wuzhifeng and walking for a while, we arrived at a suspension bridge called "Fengqiao Dangerous Crossing". The bridge is over a hundred meters long and hangs high in a deep valley. The strong wind blows under the bridge, with no danger and it is very safe. After crossing the dangerous crossing of Fengqiao, we arrived at a scenic spot called Baguamen on the Jufeng Ring Road. The construction of the Jufeng Scenic Area combines the ideas of the Book of Changes with the magic of Jufeng, and Baguamen are set up along the route according to the Baguamen direction. Just a reminder, passing through the Wufeng Immortal Pavilion after reaching it is the normal circular tourist road, not the cement road (which leads to Beijiushui). Remember not to take the wrong direction and go to other scenic spots. It is recommended to pay attention to the signs. Due to its relatively small reputation and low number of tourists, the Jufeng Scenic Area is not disturbed by tour group loudspeakers, allowing visitors to enjoy the tranquility and leisure of the mountains and waters. Liugong Island, located at the mouth of Weihai Bay, faces the Yellow Sea and is backed by Weihai Bay. It is known as the "Peach Blossom Spring on the Sea". The main attractions on the island include Liugong Island National Forest Park, Liugong Island Expo Park, Liugong Island Whale Museum, Qidingshan Battery, and more. There is also a Sino Japanese War of 1894-1895 Museum, making it a memorial site for the war and a patriotic education base. To visit Liugong Island, you need to take a passenger ship from Weihai, which takes about 20 minutes. It is recommended to head west to the nearby Sino Japanese War of 1894-1895 Museum after landing on the island. This is a museum of archaeological sites, mainly featuring Qing Dynasty buildings such as the Beiyang Navy Admiral's Office and the Naval Academy, which truly reproduces the historical appearance of the Beiyang Navy and the War of 1894-1895. After visiting, head north through the exit and enter Liugong Island National Forest Park, which is also one of the few marine parks in China. The park is covered with green pine and cypress trees, with blooming mountain flowers and a very high plant coverage. There is a small zoo in the park, and visitors can see many sika deer in the sika deer house. Afterwards, you can go to the mountain to see the Qidingshan Battery. After visiting, you can take the cable car here and enjoy the Liugong Island Expo Park. From the cable car, you can also overlook the entire Expo Park. In the Expo Park, you can truly understand the history of Liugong Island, and it takes about 2 hours to play the entire park. The "Liu Gong Virtue" area mainly uses huge wall carvings and wood carvings to tell the culture of Liu Gong Island. In the Memorial Hall of the Battle of Jiawu, one can also see the process of the Beiyang Fleet from its formation to its downfall, vividly reproducing the heroic scenes of the war. Outside the memorial hall is the Deng Shichang stone carving that came into view when landing on the island. The buildings outside the exhibition hall are mostly characterized by sloping roofs and a square chimney, which is very distinctive. In addition, tourists can also choose to take a sightseeing bus through the forest and pine forests, and the 20 minute journey can take in a panoramic view of all major attractions. Alternatively, you can choose to take a cruise around the island to experience the full view of Liugong Island. Among them, Courtyard 4 and Courtyard 5 have more than 60 island folk countryside houses, peaceful courtyards, fresh air, counting stars and listening to frogs here, as if returning to childhood. The rich historical and cultural atmosphere, tranquil island nights, bathing in the sea breeze, enjoying the sea view, have a unique flavor in your heart. Liugong Island attracts tourists from home and abroad with its unique natural scenery and rich historical and cultural atmosphere. Chengshantou is located in Longxu Island Town, Rongcheng, Weihai, and is named after its location in the eastern section of the Chengshan Mountains. It is surrounded by the sea on three sides and land on one side, facing South Korea across the sea. It is the eastern end of the Chinese coast and also the place where the sunrise over the sea can be seen on the Jiaodong Peninsula. The mountains here are very steep, with peaks and green trees covering the entire mountain. The sea waves churn under the cliffs, and the water flow is very fast and the waves are strong, which is very imposing. This has been an ideal summer resort since ancient times. One of the attractions worth visiting in the tourist guide scenic area is undoubtedly the "Endless Sky" stone tablet by the seaside. In earlier years, this stone tablet had the words "Endless Sky" written on it, but it was renamed due to its poor meaning. As soon as you enter Chengshantou Park, there is a small temple on the nearby hillside, which is the Temple of the First Emperor. It is said that Emperor Qin Shi Huang visited this place twice because it was the place where he saw the sunrise on the sea, and it is also a "Temple of the First Emperor" in the country. The temple includes the front hall of the Sun God Temple, the main hall of the First Emperor Temple, the east hall of the east palace, the Deng Gong Temple, the bell tower, and the stage. Among them, the Deng Gong Temple was dedicated to commemorating the sacrifice in the Battle of Jiawu. Built by the famous general Deng Shichang. After visiting the Temple of the First Emperor, walk along the trees in the garden for about 10 minutes and you will arrive at the inscription "Heaven Has No End". The first thing that catches the eye are several tall stone pillars, with a long sea viewing corridor beside them. Standing on the long sea corridor, looking up, there is an endless and magnificent sea in front of me. The sea breeze is gentle, the waves are splashing, and the vast sea is like a dynamic painting. There are also general stones, small stone forests, and various reefs standing on the sea, and the scenery can be seen at a glance. In addition, beside the long sea corridor, there are bronze statues of Qin Shihuang, Li Si, and Xu Fu. The stone tablet engraved with the four characters "Endless Sky" stands at the end of the ridge of stone extending into the sea, on a large stone nearly three zhang high. The characters are gilded, and together with the direct sunlight, they appear to be flowing gold, floating colors, and shining brightly. There are railings on both sides of the ridge leading to the stone tablet and the platform of the stone tablet, where tourists can take photos and overlook the East China Sea to their heart's content. In addition, there are also Qin Dynasty standing stones, Qin Bridge ruins, Wanghai Pavilion, Guantao Pavilion, and some man-made attractions that can be visited together in the park. Full text 

The Shuangta Temple in the southern suburbs of Taiyuan is a landmark building of Taiyuan city and the theme pattern on the city emblem. Shuangta Temple, formerly known as Yongzuo Temple, was built around the middle of the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period (1597-1602). Due to the presence of two high towers inside the temple, it is commonly referred to as Shuangta Temple. Nowadays, locals are accustomed to calling this place Shuangta Temple, but they are relatively unfamiliar with its original name. The architectural layout of Shuangta Temple is not complicated, consisting of three parts: the front courtyard, the back courtyard, and the tower courtyard. The famous "Twin Towers" are located in the tower courtyard. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple is opposite to that of most temples. The gate of the Twin Pagoda Temple faces north. After entering the gate, tourists can walk from north to south. During the tour, they can see the the Shakya ManiHall, the stele gallery and the Twin Pagodas in turn. These three places are worth seeing. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a brick imitation wood building. The entire building has no beams or a single piece of wood, and is entirely made of bricks with intricate and elegant carvings. When you enter the the Shakya ManiHall, you can see the three Buddha statues enshrined in the hall: Amitabha Buddha, Sakyamuni and Herbalist Buddha. Among them, Amitabha Buddha is a bronze statue, while the other two are iron seated statues. It can be seen that these three Buddha statues are not original in the temple, but were moved from different places. The the Shakya ManiHall of the Twin Towers Temple is a two-story structure. From the east side of the hall, there are steps to the second floor. There is a "Three Saints Pavilion" on the second floor, which houses three great masters: Guanyin, Manjusri, and Samantabhadra. These Bodhisattva statues were also moved from other temples. If you come to the the Shakya ManiHall in May, you can also enjoy the hundred year old peony planted in the Ming Dynasty, called "Zixia Immortal", which is rooted in the square flower bed in front of the Mahavira Hall and has been blooming here for more than 300 years. Visiting Shuangta Temple to see peonies is also a great pleasure for the citizens of Taiyuan. On the way from the the Shakya ManiHall to the tower yard, there is a corridor, including a "stele corridor". If you are a calligraphy lover, you must come here to have a look. You can admire the inscriptions on the walls of the stele gallery, which are adorned with the Ming Dynasty's "Baoxian Hall Collection Ancient Calligraphy", the Qing Dynasty's "Ancient Baoxian Hall Calligraphy", and the Qing Dynasty's Su Dongpo Drunken Script Stone Carving "Red Cliff Nostalgia". Among them, Su Dongpo's handwritten "Red Cliff Nostalgia" was made in 1762 during the reign of Emperor Qianlong, based on the inscription on the stone. It is said that there are only two preserved sites in the country at this moment, the other being the Dongpo Red Cliff in Huangzhou, Hubei. When you arrive at the southern tower courtyard of the temple, two ancient pagodas come into view completely. Both towers are made of bricks and stones, with a distance of 60 meters. The carvings on the towers are beautiful and have distinct contours. The East Pagoda, also known as Wenfeng Pagoda, was first built in the southeast, but it is not a Buddhist pagoda. It was built to make up for the unfavorable cultural development of Taiyuan City's "high northwest and low southeast". Since its construction, it has tilted slightly towards the northwest. It is said that the designer considered that this tower is located at the forefront of Dongshan Mountain, facing the impact of northwest winds, and deliberately tilted it towards the northwest to ensure the stability of the tower body. The northwest tower is a later built Buddhist pagoda (Xuanwen Pagoda), also known as the "West Pagoda" or "North Pagoda" because it is located in the northwest direction. It was supervised by the eminent monk Miaofeng (also known as Fudeng Monk) during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. Because there were Buddhist relics hidden inside the pagoda at that time, it was also called Xuanwen Pagoda or Relic Pagoda. The Xita (Xuanwen Pagoda) was mostly destroyed in the war during the Liberation War, and what we see now is the one that was restored in the 1980s. If you are interested, you can climb the tower. However, it is recommended not to climb the tower, as due to the local air conditions, climbing the tower would result in a misty view from all around. Full text 

The Liu Gong Temple is a temple built in memory of Liu Min, the son of Emperor Liu Bian of the Eastern Han Dynasty, and his wife for accumulating virtue, doing good deeds, and helping the needy. In history, due to natural disasters, wars, and other reasons, the temple has been relocated several times and repaired several times, but the incense has been continuous. According to historical records, Liu Gong Temple was first built in the Ming Dynasty. In the 14th year of the Guangxu reign of the Qing Dynasty (1888 AD), the Beiyang Navy formed an army on Liugong Island, and Zhang Wenxuan, the commander of the garrison, invested in the reconstruction of the Liugong Temple to ensure that the military and civilians received the protection of Liu Gong and Liu Mu. Prince Yihuan and Li Hongzhang, the naval ministers of the Qing government, entered the temple to pay their respects during the inspection ceremony of the Beiyang Navy. Every time the Beiyang Navy soldiers went out to sea or fought, they would go to the temple to offer incense and pay their respects. In 1898, Britain forcibly leased Weihaiwei, and all the land and houses on Liu Gong Island were purchased by Britain, forcing residents to move out of the island. The Liu Gong Temple followed suit and moved out of the island. The temple no longer exists, but there is a monument that reads "God is based on people, temple moved out of the island". The original Liu Gong Temple site on Liu Gong Island still exists. In order to enrich the cultural landscape of Liugong Island, the Liugong Temple was rebuilt in 1994, covering an area of 800 square meters. It has a front entrance gate, left and right bell and drum towers, and a front courtyard with a step leading to the middle courtyard. The plaque on the east side of the hall reads "Qiong Island Cangsang", and the plaque on the west side reads "Eternal Fragrance". Each hall has five sets of colorful clay sculptures, telling the miracles of Liu Gong and Liu Mu and the historical changes of Liugong Island over the past two thousand years. The main hall hangs a plaque with the words' Sea Light ', with statues of Liu Gong and Liu Mu. On both sides, there are eight statues of wind, rain, thunder, lightning, thousand mile eyes, wind ear, righteousness, and evil that are two meters high. The content setting fully embodies the spirit of islands and folk customs. Liugong Temple is a tourist attraction for learning about the origin and history of Liugong Island. Since the reconstruction of Liugong Temple, visitors have come in droves to admire its name. Full text 

summary: Taiyuan Ancient County City is located in Jinyuan District, covering an area of approximately 0.8 square kilometers. It follows the ancient architectural pattern of the "Phoenix Soaring in the City" of Jinyang Ancient City, resembling a phoenix with a head to the north and a tail to the south. It has been known as the "Phoenix City" since ancient times and is an extension of the 2500 year cultural heritage of Jinyang Ancient City. There are 79 existing cultural relics buildings in the city, and 49 historical buildings listed for protection by the Taiyuan Municipal Government. summary: The Tianlong Mountain Grottoes are located on the mountainside of Tianlong Mountain, 40 kilometers southwest of Taiyuan City. Tianlong Mountain was originally named Fangshan. In the Northern Qi Dynasty, after the construction of Tianlong Temple at the foot of the mountain, this mountain was called Tianlong Mountain. This was once the summer palace of Gao Huan, the father of the Northern Qi Emperor Gao Yang. Tianlong Mountain has beautiful scenery, surrounded by undulating mountains and lush pine and cypress forests. The Dragon King Stone Cave on the top of the mountain has rippling springs, and the streams in front of the mountain are clear and gurgling. The Tianlongshan Grottoes are located at the waist of the cliffs on the east and west peaks of Tianlongshan Mountain. There are 24 caves excavated by the Eastern Wei, Northern Qi, Sui, and Tang dynasties, including eight caves on the east peak, thirteen caves on the west peak, and three caves on the north side of the mountain. There are over 1500 statues and 1144 reliefs, cofferdams, and portraits in the Coexistence Grottoes. The Tianlongshan Grottoes are known for their mature, full, refined techniques, and meticulous expression of emotions, which are close to the life atmosphere of laborers. They are characterized by strong ethnic and local characteristics, and are known for their "small but refined" nature.

Chenghuang Temple is located in the Chenghuang Temple tourist area in the center of Shanghai, also known as the Old City God Temple. It is a famous Taoist temple in Shanghai.
