However, they do not know that there is a Taoist temple in the south of Yu Garden, which is quiet in the midst of noise, and it is a time-honored holy place for praying. Here you can feel the local religious culture. The Chenghuang Temple in Shanghai was built in the Yongle period of the Ming Dynasty (1403-1424), a little earlier than Yu Garden, but it was severely damaged during the "Cultural Revolution", and then restored to its full appearance after restoration. There are currently nine halls within the temple, including the Grand Hall, Jiazi Hall, Caishen Hall, Cihang Hall, and Chenghuang Hall. The plaque "Chenghuang Temple" is hung on the main entrance of the hall, which is dedicated to the sitting statue of the great general Huo Guang, the Marquis of Bolu in the Han Dynasty, who is the god of Jinshan. On the left is the judge of literature, on the right is the judge of martial arts, and on the second is the daily inspection and night inspection. Below the daily inspection and night inspection are the Eight Sapphires. The Yuanchen Hall, also known as the Sixty Jiazi Hall, enshrines the Tai Sui God corresponding to the sixty Yuanchen. Believers worship their own Tai Sui in this hall, praying for peace and good luck every year. The Cihang Hall enshrines the Goddess of the Eye, the Great Master Cihang, and the Goddess of the Heavenly Queen; The God of Wealth Hall enshrines the God of Wealth, the Immortal Officials of Treasures, the Immortal Officials of Prosperity, and the Immortal Officials of Treasures; The Wenchang Hall enshrines the Wenchang Emperor, and the two children on the left and right are referred to as Tian deaf and Di mute. At the back of the Chenghuang Temple is the City God Hall. In the center of the City God Hall is a red faced wooden statue of the City God of Shanghai County. The decoration inside the hall is modeled after the county government hall of the Ming Dynasty, with strict ceremonial measures. The east end of the City God Hall is the Parents Hall, where the parents of the Shanghai County City God God are enshrined; To the west of the City God Hall is the Niangniang Hall, dedicated to Lady Chu, the wife of the City God of Shanghai County. Jing'an Temple is full of incense. Every birthday and anniversary of Bodhisattva, the temple will hold a Dharma fair. Every year, on the eighth day of April in the lunar calendar, a three-day temple fair will be held.

poiName: The site of the first CPC National Congress
summary: Shanghai is the birthplace of the CPC, the birthplace of its original aspiration, and the birthplace of its great founding spirit. The site of the First Congress of the Communist Party of China is the place where the CPC dreams to set sail and the spiritual home of CPC people. On July 23, 1921, the first National Congress of the CPC was held at No. 106 Wangzhi Road (now No. 76 Xingye Road) in Shanghai, announcing the official establishment of the CPC. In September 1952, the site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was restored, a memorial hall was established, and it was opened to the public. In March 1961, the site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was designated as a national key cultural relic protection unit. The Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China is directly under the Propaganda Department of the Shanghai Municipal Committee. On June 3, 2021, the brand new Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China was officially completed. The upgraded Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China has formed the characteristic pattern of "one hall and three sites". With the newly completed exhibition hall as the main core, it manages the site of the first National Congress of the CPC, the former site of the dormitory of the first National Congress of the CPC (Bowen Women's School), and the former site of the CPC delegation office in Shanghai (Zhou Mansion) as three key cultural relics under national protection. It is a red hall that tells the story of the founding of the party, demonstrates the founding of the party, and interprets the great spirit of the founding of the party. There are over 128000 collections of various levels from the Opium War to the new era of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The new basic display, The Great Beginning - The Exhibition of the Creation History of the CPC, tells the history of the founding of the Party in a panoramic way, leading the audience to deeply understand the rich connotation of the great spirit of party building.

poiName: The Memorial Hall of the Site of the Second National Congress of the Communist Party of China
summary: The Memorial Hall of the Site of the Second National Congress of the Communist Party of China, also known as the Site of the Second National Congress, is located in a Shikumen building built in 1915. It was the residence of Li Da, the propaganda director of the Central Bureau at the time. In 1959, it was designated as a "Shanghai Municipal Cultural Relic Protection Unit" by the Shanghai People's Committee. In 2001, to mark the 80th anniversary of the founding of the Party, the site was restored, a memorial hall was established, and it opened to the public the following year. In 2003, the Shanghai Municipal People's Government named it a "Patriotism Education Base in Shanghai." The Second National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held here from July 16 to 23, 1922. Attendees included members of the Central Bureau, representatives from local Party organizations, and some delegates who returned to China after attending the First Congress of Communist Parties and National Revolutionary Groups of the Far East.

Taishan Temple, also known as Taishan Longquan Temple, is said to have been inhabited by a mountain resident named Shi Gandang during the Northern Han Dynasty, who was renowned for his bravery. The mountain where he lived was also famous for this. The name of the temple is taken from the homonym of "Mount Taishan Shigandang". According to records, Longquan Temple was originally a Taoist Haotian Temple, built in the first year of the Jingyun reign of the Tang Dynasty (710 AD) and destroyed in the Jin and Yuan wars. In the 24th year of the Hongwu reign of the Ming Dynasty (1391 AD), it was rebuilt as a Buddhist temple and five nearby temples, including Guanyin and Tongzi, were incorporated. Taishan Longquan Temple faces north and south, with halls, pavilions, and terraces built along the mountain terrain, varying in height and spread out layer by layer. Outside the mountain gate is a large flat land, and the cave style music tower foundation still exists today. The mountain gate is a suspended mountain top, with the name "Mountain Forest Ancient Temple" on its forehead. The rafters and columns under the eaves still retain traces of the Taoist "Eight Trigrams". The left and right wings of the temple, as well as the drum tower, are made of brick and wood structures. The iron bells on the bell tower were re cast in the tenth year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1745) and remain intact to this day. The the Shakya ManiHall is five rooms wide and two rooms deep, with two floors in total. The brick cave at the bottom is dedicated to Guanyin Bodhisattva; The upper brick and wood structure hall was originally dedicated to the Buddha Shakyamuni. In the back yard of Longquan Temple, there are three octagonal buildings, namely Guanyin, Wenshu and Puxian.

Taiyuan Food Street is located in Yingze District, Taiyuan City. Passing through the bustling commercial area of Gulou Street, you can see the ancient archway of Food Street and the spacious and tidy large parking lot of Gulou Street. The newly renovated food street, with its smooth marble pavement, features the five flavors of "sour, sweet, bitter, spicy, and salty" in ancient Chinese characters, indicating the uniqueness of this street. Standing at the south entrance of Food Street, looking north, there are two rows of two-story buildings modeled after the Ming and Qing dynasties, pavilions, memorial archway, cornices, and arch of wooden architecture. The traditional cultural symbols of Shanxi, such as painted buildings and red lanterns, are presented one by one in the block. Anti corrosion long flower pots, sculptures that reflect the characteristics of Shanxi noodles, and antique leisure chairs are neatly arranged on the road paved with bluestone strips. Taiyuan Food Street gathers numerous delicious foods, not only old shops such as Quanwazi snacks and Xueshan cold drinks, but also new ones such as Yantonglou, Jinyunlou, and Old Beijing braised and burned food are crowded with diners who come to try them out. The "guards" dressed in the costumes of Song Dynasty warriors guard the street corner, adding a cultural atmosphere to the food street. In the center of the street, there are antique vending cars that not only complement the surrounding buildings, but also showcase the rich Jin merchant culture.

tagNameList: Treasure spots for kids; Featured Exhibition Hall
shortFeatures: Admire the lifelike wax figures of numerous world celebrities.
summary:
The Madame Tussauds Shanghai, which opened on May 1, 2006, is the sixth Madame Tussauds museum in the world and the first in mainland China. As the flagship museum in Asia, Madame Tussauds Shanghai inherits the legendary brand history and craftsmanship of Madame Tussauds while embracing current trends in popular culture. It draws inspiration from celebrities to offer a fun and immersive experience.

Exquisite Wax Figures Capture the Shine of Stars  
With a history spanning nearly two centuries, Madame Tussauds originated in London, surviving the French Revolution and World War II, and has grown larger in scale with more refined techniques, becoming the hall of fame for global celebrities. Madame Tussauds Shanghai continues the brand's legacy with superb waxwork craftsmanship, blending vibrant history and capturing the brilliance of 21st-century superstars.

A Close-Up Entertainment Feast of Chinese and International Stars  
Madame Tussauds Shanghai features cutting-edge high-tech elements, making it the venue with the richest interactive experiences globally. The museum houses twelve themed exhibition areas, including the first-ever heart-pulse technology wax figure of Zhu Yilong in China, the world's first robotic wax figure of Jing Boran and Hu Ba from *Monster Hunt*; a dazzling AR interactive experience at the Music Dream Factory where you can sing with TFBOYS and Lady Gaga; the FASHION section’s trendy fashion show, where you can strut on the runway with supermodel Alessandra Ambrosio; and the A-LIST VIP party area with its glittering star-studded gala, where you can meet Nicole Kidman, Tom Cruise, Tang Yan, Michelle Yeoh, Zhu Yilong, and Zheng Kai on the red carpet, experiencing the excitement and dreamlike atmosphere of being chased by the flashbulbs; the British Royal Party area where you can enjoy an afternoon tea with Queen Elizabeth II, Prince William, and Kate Middleton; and the immersive film and entertainment section where you can co-host *Happy Camp* with He Jiong, revisit the touching moments of *Kangxi Coming*, and chat with Xiao S and Cai Kangyong about the fun of the entertainment industry. The *Tomb Raider Notes* IP experience zone restores classic scenes such as the Nine-Headed Snake’s Base, the underwater world of Xisha, the Cloud-Topping Heavenly Palace, and the Bronze Gate, offering an exciting challenge for visitors. The incredible audiovisual effects and thrilling interactive experiences make visitors feel as though they are stepping into famous eras or scenes, getting up close with their beloved idols, and experiencing the charm of celebrities.

summary: The Xisha Mingzhu Lake Scenic Area is located at the southwestern tip of Chongming Island, the third largest island in China and the world's largest river deltaic sand island. The area consists of Mingzhu Lake and Xisha Wetland, covering a total area of 7.8 square kilometers (11,900 acres). The region was once a main navigation channel of the southern branch of the Yangtze River and was also part of the route taken by the Ming Dynasty navigator Zheng He during his voyages to the West. As a station on the International Migratory Bird Route No. 5, the scenic area offers unique and beautiful natural landscapes including wetlands, lakes, and forests, as well as distinctive water and land sports, competitive, leisure, and tourism activities, making it a well-known National Ecotourism Demonstration Zone. The area boasts beautiful natural scenery, high environmental quality, with air quality at the national first level and water quality classified as national surface water Category II. Activities such as releasing wild geese, an 8-kilometer lakeside running track, water lure fishing, amphibious vehicles, cruises, fish specimens, children's playgrounds, wetland water forests, mudskippers, and Xisha sunsets are all attractions that invite visitors to immerse themselves, making it an unforgettable experience and truly capturing the charm of Mingzhu Lake and the breathtaking beauty of Xisha.

The insecure Hug Dragon is Andy's toy T-Rex. He likes not only playing video games, but also playing remote control cars. Shanghai Disneyland is the first Disneyland in the world to have a "historic discovery camp". Explorers, regardless of their age and skill, can set out together to search for traces of ancient tribes in waterfalls, ruins and archaeological sites on the island, or explore natural landscapes and ancient legends, trek through waterfalls and follow the island's special climbing ropeway to find tribal ruins. Visitors to the "Monument Discovery Camp" can choose their own route. Visitors who prefer thrills can choose to explore the natural landscape of Leiming Mountain, while others can choose to enjoy the steep beauty of Leiming Mountain or revel in the science, nature and history of the island.

Bicester Shanghai Shopping Village is located in the Shanghai International Tourism Resort, adjacent to the Shanghai Disney Resort. As a member of the "Bicester Series", its main feature is the combination of tourism and shopping experience, with a beautiful European shopping environment and VIP concierge service, allowing guests to enjoy unparalleled exquisite experiential shopping. At present, more than 200 brand boutique stores have settled in Bicester Shanghai, bringing together international boutique brands and local designer brands, with some products starting at 20% off throughout the year. This place boasts European style scenery, delicious lakeside cuisine, an art lounge known as the "tourist toilet", a space themed children's playground, as well as attentive services such as chauffeur parking, free strollers, and umbrellas, providing domestic and foreign tourists with a comfortable and refreshing shopping experience. It is a suitable tourist shopping destination for all ages.

The Red Queen's Royal Garden is a famous attraction in Disneyland, located within the Alice's Adventures in Wonderland Maze. This garden features a red peach heart design, with flower beds and porches filled with red peach heart patterns. There are also many brightly colored and beautifully shaped tables and chairs, cakes and desserts, as well as European classical tableware and tea sets. You can enjoy playing here without feeling tired at all.

Diantou Ancient Village is located in the branch of Lvliang Mountain, within the mouth of Fengyugou, with Mengshan Mountain to its back and Longshan Mountain to its south, stretching for 1km from east to west. Diantou Village is one of the eight villages in Fengyu. In history, it was a must pass place from Yangcheng in ancient Jin to Shaanxi Gansu Ningxia, and also an ancient military castle that was easy to defend but difficult to attack. There are currently over 360 relatively complete houses remaining. Diantou Ancient Village has a rich historical and cultural heritage, which is not only a corner of Jin culture, but also a carrier of ancient villages in Jin state. The team behind the movie 'Blood Drops' once filmed in the ancient village of Diantou.

summary: The Tianlong Mountain Scenic Area includes three natural villages in Jinci Town: Wupo, Nanping, and Yaotou, as well as Nanshan and Beishan (i.e. Tianlong Mountain) at the source of Liuzigou. Tianlong Mountain is named after the Tianlong Temple built in the northern Qi Dynasty, and also because of the grottoes on the mountain. The grottoes are the essence of the whole Tianlong Mountain scenic spot, which is worth seeing. The Tianlongshan Grottoes have 24 caves excavated during the Eastern Wei, Northern Qi, Sui, and Tang dynasties, with the Tang dynasty being the most numerous. The seated statue of Maitreya Buddha in the ninth cave "Manshan Pavilion" is about 8 meters high, with harmonious proportions and a dignified and solemn appearance, making it a cave worth appreciating.

summary: Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is located in the north of Nanjing city, overlooking Purple Mountain to the east and Xuanwu Lake to the south. It has unique forest landscapes and animal resources, and is an important ecological landmark in Jiangsu Province. Here, more than 260 species and over 3000 rare wild animals from around the world gather. The park covers an area of over 68 hectares and currently has more than 20 animal exhibition areas. It is divided into three major areas based on the mountains. The Dahongshan area mainly includes the Tiger Area, Bear Area, Chinese Feline Pavilion, Feline Planet, Wolf Area, Native Species Conservation Area, Small tailed Mongoose Pavilion, Monkey Mountain, Giraffe Pavilion, etc; The Fangniushan area mainly includes Koala Pavilion, Gaoligong, Gondwana, Asian Primate Zone, Chimpanzee Pavilion, Hippopotamus Pavilion, etc; The Xiaohongshan area mainly includes tropical bird halls, hornbill halls, Zhangjipo, parrot halls, pheasant gardens, rare bird gardens, etc. It is worth mentioning that the China Feline Pavilion is a designated exhibition area for Zoolex in mainland China, indicating that the design level of the China Feline Pavilion has reached the international advanced level, and it is very worth visiting. Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo is currently a national 4A level tourist attraction, a national science popularization education base, and a wildlife rescue center in Jiangsu Province and Nanjing City. Taking conservation education as the core mission, scientific research as the technical support, and comprehensive protection as the goal, Nanjing Hongshan Forest Zoo adheres to the international development concept, promotes comprehensive development through venue ecological transformation, wildlife welfare improvement, population development, conservation research, public science popularization education, etc., realizes the core value of modern zoo "science popularization education", conveys important information on ecological protection, and advocates harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Full text 

Zhongshan Mausoleum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, adjacent to Linggu Temple to the east and Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum to the west. The entire building complex is built according to the mountain terrain, arranged on a central axis from south to north, and the cemetery is designed in a "alarm bell" shape. The overall distribution of Zhongshan Mausoleum includes buildings such as Boai Fang, tomb passage, tomb gate, stele pavilion, sacrificial hall, and tomb chamber. There is a tall granite memorial archway at the entrance square of the mausoleum, on which are two gold characters of "fraternity". Walking north through Boai Fang, you will arrive at a nearly 400 meter long tomb passage with 392 stone steps and a drop of 73 meters. Walk along the tomb passage to reach the tomb gate, which is topped with blue glazed tiles and inscribed with the four characters' The world is for the public 'on the forehead. Enter the Stele Pavilion again and continue forward until you reach the Sacrificial Hall. To reach the top of Zhongshan Mausoleum, one needs to climb long steps, and each step will have a platform for resting. Here is a visual design technique that allows you to see the steps but not the platform when looking from bottom to top, and the platform but not the steps when looking from top to bottom. You may want to take a closer look. On the fifth platform, there are two large cauldrons, one of which still has shell holes left on its wall caused by the Japanese invasion of China. The main building of the Sun Yat sen Mausoleum is located on the peak of the Jitang Mountain, which is a palace style building. There is a vertical forehead embedded on the top of the middle door with the words' Heaven and Earth's Righteousness'. In the center of the sacrificial hall is a seated statue carved from white marble, with six reliefs engraved on the base. There are two copper tomb doors in the tomb chamber and sacrificial hall, with a circular tomb chamber inside and a long tomb in the center. The tomb chamber is not open to the public. Surrounding the tomb complex are commemorative buildings such as the Music Stage, Guanghua Pavilion, Liuhui Pavilion, Yangzhi Pavilion, Zhongshan Academy, Sutra Building, and Xingjian Pavilion

Changsheng Deer Garden "is located on the east side of" Tai Xiang Zhao Ming "in Meihua Valley of Ming Xiaoling, on the north bank of Yanque Lake, and currently has 16 spotted deer. The south side of Luyuan is separated from Mingling Road by only a few meters of lake water, which will recreate the historical landscape of "silver deer wandering in the forest". When Ming Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang built the Xiaoling Mausoleum, he raised a thousand deer in the Xiaoling Mausoleum area. The deer had a silver medal hanging on their neck with the words "Changsheng" on it, so later people called Xiaoling deer "Changsheng Deer" or "Silver Medal Deer". Tourists entering the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum can have an intimate encounter with the little deer at the "Changsheng Deer Garden".

There is an old residential building on Yihe Road and Ninghai Road in Gulou District. It is the garden villa of many embassies, party, government and military officials, rich people and foreigners. There are still more than 200 well preserved buildings, including the famous former site of the American Embassy. This area was once known as the "embassy district" and the "model area of modern and contemporary architecture". Wandering among these century old buildings that blend Chinese and Western styles, it feels like returning to the era of old and new alternation, with a dreamy and secluded atmosphere.

Xuanwu Lake, formerly known as Sangbo and Houhu, is located at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. It is a large-scale royal garden lake in China and is known as one of the "Three Famous Lakes in Jiangnan" along with Jiaxing Nanhu and Hangzhou West Lake. Xuanwu Lake is divided into five oases, gathering many famous scenic spots and historical sites. It is now a famous cultural and leisure park in Nanjing. From Nanjing Railway Station on the south bank, you can take a stroll around the lake and enjoy the scenery of Xuanwu Lake. To the south is Huanhu Road. If you come here in summer, you can see large areas of lotus flowers in full bloom, and the water surface is lush green, which is particularly charming. On the south bank of the lake, there is a section of the Ming City Wall (the city wall where the Ming City Wall History Museum is located), and viewing the lake from here also has a unique flavor. You can take a pedal boat or an electric boat to visit the lake and enjoy the scenery of Wuzhou and its surrounding cities on the lake, which is very pleasant. Of course, to appreciate the beauty of Xuanwu Lake, one needs to walk up to Wuzhou and explore slowly. There are bridges and embankments connecting the five continents, allowing for free passage. Visiting Sakura Island in spring, you can see cherry blossoms adorned with branches; There is also a lotus garden here, which is a great place to see lotus flowers and take photos. When Huanzhou comes to Huanzhou, you can enjoy the rockery waterfalls here. Many the Taihu Lake rockery stones have different shapes. The child worships Guanyin stone looks like a child worshipping Guanyin. You can study it. There is Guopudun on a small hill in the northwest of Huanzhou, which is a high point in the lake area. Lingzhou, Liangzhou, and Cuizhou can overlook the scenery of Zhongshan and Xiaojiuhua Mountain from the Tai Ling Flower Frame in Lingzhou. There are landscapes such as bonsai garden, azalea garden, and scenic tower in Liangzhou. In Cuizhou, there are plants such as pine, cypress, bamboo, and willow everywhere, which are lush with greenery and very suitable for relaxing. In addition, there is a couple's garden on the east side of Xuanwu Lake, where there are various plants such as tulips and peach blossoms. The scenery is pleasant and couples often come here to take wedding photos. Full text 

poiName: Shanghai Chongming Dongtan National Nature Reserve for Birds
shortFeatures: Lush vegetation, wild waterfowl habitat
summary: Chongming Dongtan is located at the easternmost point of Chongming Island in Shanghai, bordering the estuary of the Yangtze River in the north and south, slowly extending to the vast East China Sea in the east, and opposite the north and south continents. Chongming Dongtan Reserve starts from Xijiagang in the south, ends at Beibali Port in the north, is bounded by the embankment built in 1968 in the west, and ends at the 3000m waterline outside the zero-meter line of Wusong elevation in the east. It imitates the water, land and tidal flats of Chongming Island within the semicircular channel line. Chongming Dongtan Nature Reserve covers an area of 326 square kilometers and is a typical estuarine wetland in the Yangtze River Estuary. Among them, the nature reserve covers a total area of 265 square kilometers of tidal flats outside the embankment, including 120 square kilometers of tidal flats above the zero-meter line of Wusong elevation and 145 square kilometers of waters within 3,000 meters beyond the zero-meter line of Wusong elevation. The area in the embankment, mainly constructed wetlands, is 61 square kilometers.

Sunset Bay is located in the eastern part of Huancui District, Weihai City, with a superior geographical location and convenient transportation. This is an artificially excavated bay with a spacious beach and clear seawater. Especially at dusk, the afterglow of the setting sun falls on the bay entrance, casting a golden glow over the entire bay, which is breathtakingly beautiful.

shortFeatures: Named for the rocky nature of the island
summary: Xiaoshidao is located in the north-west of Weihai City, between Shidao Port and Shidao Beach. It is named after the rocky island. Including two islands, big and small: Big Island in the west and Mingshi Island; The small island is between the big island and the land, Mingli Island, and there are reefs connecting the two islands. It runs east-west, approximately oval. The coastline of the island is 1.25 kilometers long, with a bedrock coast that is rugged and steep, and there are reefs offshore. It belongs to the continental island and is composed of biotite schist of the Jiaodong rock group of the lower Proterozoic. There are pines and weeds on it, and there is no water source. The north shore is steep, with sea erosion caves, named Shuilongwo. The top is equipped with a triangular surveying and mapping sign.

poiName: Tangshan Ziqing Lake Tourist Area Forest Hot Spring

Not only does this place have a superior geographical location, but it has also become an ideal place for urbanites to escape the hustle and bustle and seek physical and mental peace with its attentive service that is open 24/7. shortFeatures: The famous popular hot spring in Tangshan
summary:
Located in Tangshan Town, Nanjing, which is famous for its hot springs, it is one of the most famous hot springs in this area. The clear water in front of the door is a mirror and the green hills behind it are a screen. 
Yishang Hot Spring has two spring resources, and the water is pure natural and does not need to be heated. There are not only Chinese hot springs, but also hot springs arranged in Roman and Turkish western styles. While soaking in hot springs, you can enjoy the stars in the sky. Linggu Scenic Area is located on the southeast slope of Zhongshan (Zijin Mountain), about 1.5 kilometers east of Zhongshan Mausoleum. It is one of the three major scenic spots in Zhongshan Scenic Area, with fewer tourists than the other two scenic spots, Zhongshan Mausoleum and Ming Xiaoling. In addition, the ancient trees in the scenic area are towering, earning it the reputation of "Linggu Deep Pine", which gives people a feeling of tranquility. The history of the scenic area: During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang relocated the original Southern Dynasty famous temple to its current location for the construction of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. However, it was later destroyed in the war and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period. It was located on one side and no longer had its original size. Later, a National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery was built here. So the Linggu Temple Scenic Area is composed of an ancient temple and a cemetery that blend together. The central axis runs north-south for 1 kilometer and is the site of the former Linggu Temple. The main structure on the central axis now consists of a series of buildings from the National Revolutionary Army Martyrs Cemetery. The main gate of the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army, the Hongshan Gate, is open at the south end. Outside the gate is a large release pool, where you can enjoy the lotus flowers in summer. Entering the gate and heading north, I first saw the memorial archway of the fallen soldiers of the National Revolutionary Army. It had five gates and six columns, covered with green glazed tiles, and had a pair of stone beasts in front of it. Further ahead, there is the unique architecture of the scenic area, the Wuliangdian. The Wuliang Hall is the only building in Linggu Temple during the Ming Dynasty, built in the 14th year of the Hongwu reign (1381 AD). Such a large hall does not require a single beam or column, but is entirely made of bricks and stones. Inside the hall is the memorial hall of the cemetery, with the words "Memorial of National Revolutionary Martyrs" written on the central wall and "List of National Revolutionary Martyrs Who Died" embedded on the surrounding walls. Now the wax museum of the famous figures of the Xinhai Revolution is also located in the Wuliang Hall. There is a huge Ming Dynasty stone turtle on the southwest side of the hall, and the stone tablet on its back is nowhere to be found. The first cemetery for fallen soldiers is located on the north side of the Wuliang Hall, with a memorial monument for the fallen soldiers of the Songhu Anti Japanese War erected. The second and third cemeteries are located 300 meters east and west respectively, where soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Northern Expedition and the Anti Japanese War are buried. The second cemetery on the east side was later converted into the tomb of Deng Yanda, the founder of the Agricultural and Workers' Democratic Party. Behind the curved tomb wall of the First Cemetery is the Songfeng Pavilion, which used to be the memorial hall of the cemetery. Now, the pavilion sells specialty snacks and small souvenirs. To the east of Songfeng Pavilion, there is Shensongju vegetarian restaurant where you can eat vegetarian food. The Three Treasures Stele Linggu Temple was originally built by Emperor Wu of the Southern Liang Dynasty to commemorate Monk Baozhi (the prototype of Jigong). The Baogong Pagoda and Three Treasures Stele on the west side of Songfeng Pavilion originated from this temple. The stele was named "Three Treasures" because its descendants had paintings by Wu Daozi, poems by Li Bai, and inscriptions by Yan Zhenqing. Unfortunately, both the tower and the stele were destroyed later and rebuilt during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign. The Three Treasures Stele is now embedded in the tower, with blurred calligraphy and paintings. There is also a clear new Three Treasures Stele behind the nearby Zhigong Hall. The Linggu Tower, also known as the Memorial Tower for the National Revolutionary Army's fallen soldiers, is located at the northernmost end of the central axis, with a height of 9 floors. It is a landmark of the scenic area and can be climbed to enjoy the view. To the east of the Wuliang Hall of Linggu Temple is the current Linggu Temple, with a pond and eight streams of water in front of the temple. There are the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Sutra Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, Ancestor Hall and other buildings in the temple. The east courtyard of the the Shakya ManiHall is Xuanzang Hall. In the mini golden pagoda enshrined in the Main Hall Daaojue Hall (Xuanzang Memorial Hall), there is Xuanzang's parietal bone relic, which is very precious. It is not usually seen. Only when Linggu Temple holds an exhibition can we have a chance to see it. In the Linggu Temple scenic area, there are several more remote attractions, but they are also worth a visit. From the "Linggu Songshen" stone tablet on the east side of Linggu Temple to the north, or from Linggu Tower to the east, you can see the tomb of Tan Yankai, who was once the leader of the government of the Republic of China. The White Marble peony flower bed and altar there are said to be the original objects of the Old Summer Palace. Traveling west from Linggu Pagoda and passing through Wanzhu Guiyuan, one can see Guilin stone houses. The ruins of the stone houses are adorned with various Ming and Qing stone carvings, giving them a sense of dilapidated beauty. Full text 

The Nanjing Ancient Qinhuai Confucius Temple Pedestrian Street is located at No. 53 West Gongyuan Street, Confucius Temple, Nanjing, China. This street is a very lively commercial street in Nanjing, with visitors flocking to it every night. It sells various Nanjing specialty snacks and craft souvenirs. There is also a Confucius Temple on the street to commemorate Confucius.

The Nanjing Presidential Palace is a large-scale and well preserved architectural complex among the remains of modern Chinese architecture, and is also one of the main representatives of Nanjing architecture. It is an important site of modern Chinese history and has now been designated as the Museum of Modern Chinese History Sites. The Nanjing Presidential Palace has a history of over 600 years, including both the traditional Jiangnan gardens of ancient China and the architectural remains of the modern period when the Western wind spread eastward. Its history can be traced back to the Guide Marquis's Mansion and the Han Palace in the early Ming Dynasty. In the Qing Dynasty, it was designated as the Jiangning Weaving Office, the Liangjiang Governor General's Office, etc., and was used as a palace for southern tours. After the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom established its capital in Tianjing (now Nanjing), it expanded on this basis. On January 1, 1912, he was sworn in as the interim President and established as the Presidential Palace, which later became the Nanjing Presidential Palace. Inside the Presidential Palace, there is a courtyard that combines Chinese and Western elements. It features finely designed Western style office buildings, towering columns, and deep corridors, as well as serene and elegant Chinese gardens. At present, the Presidential Palace is divided into three visiting areas: central, western, and eastern, with a series of historical material exhibition halls and restoration displays, as well as some wax figures depicting historical scenes. You can first tour the central area along the central axis, and then enter the western or eastern area from the end. The gate tower and the north gate tower of the gate tower are the iconic buildings of the Presidential Palace, with a majestic atmosphere. It is a place where many tourists will definitely take photos, and entering from here is the Central District. The lobby is a Chinese style building with a horizontal beam inscribed with the words' The world is for all '. Going straight ahead, there is the Presidential Palace Cultural Relics and Historical Materials Exhibition Hall. To the west of the gatehouse, if you enter and walk west from the gatehouse, the first thing you will see is Xuyuan (also known as West Garden), with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. It is a typical Jiangnan garden that preserves relics and scenic spots such as the Stone Boat, Xijia Tower, Forgotten Flying Pavilion, Yinxin Stone House, and Yilan Pavilion. To the east of the gatehouse is Dongyuan (also known as Dongyuan Garden), which houses buildings from various periods such as the Executive Yuan, Taolin Second Temple, and stables. There is also the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall here, which simulates landscapes such as study rooms, harem, and secret rooms, reproducing the former glory of the palace. Full text 

poiName: The Historical Museum of The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
tagNameList: Gardens; Museums; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
summary: Zhanyuan, also known as the Great Ming Palace or the First Garden of Jinling, was first built during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty. It was originally the palace of Xu Da, a founding hero of the Ming Dynasty. It is a long-standing garden in Nanjing and is known as one of the "Four Famous Gardens of Jiangnan" along with Wuxi Jichang Garden, Suzhou Humble Administrator's Garden, and Liuyuan. Historical background: Zhanyuan has a history of over 600 years. The layout of the whole garden is elegant and exquisite, including ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, the Taihu Lake Lake stones of the Northern Song Dynasty, quiet buildings, pavilions, rockeries, etc. During Emperor Qianlong's southern tour, he visited here twice and borrowed the imperial name of the garden from Ouyang Xiu's poem "Looking at the Jade Hall, as if it were in the sky". He personally inscribed the plaque "Viewing the Garden". During the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, it was still the residence of the Eastern King Yang Xiuqing and the Young Western King Xiao Youhe. Dongzhan Garden is divided into two parts, east and west. The main gate (south gate) is located in the east half, with a large plaque hanging on the gate reading "Jinling First Garden". In the center of the entrance is a half body bronze statue of Hong Xiuquan. The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom History Museum is the main visiting point of Dongzhan Garden, displaying cultural relics such as the Jade Seal of the Heavenly Father, the Golden Crown of the Loyal King, the Great Flag, the Sword, and the Stone Trough. Xizhan Garden can be reached through Shuiyuan, which is a typical Jiangnan garden. The ancient buildings in the park include the Viewing Pavilion, Flower Basket Hall, Zhishuang Pavilion, Yingcui Pavilion, and winding corridors. These buildings and corridors divide the Xizhan Garden into five small courtyards and a main garden, with rockeries being the main scenery and backbone of the entire garden. There are rockeries in the south, north, and west, each exquisitely crafted. The central part of the main garden is Jingmiao Hall, surrounded by water on three sides and by land on one side. The "Tiger" stone tablet on the right wall at the entrance of the Guanyu Pavilion is said to have been bestowed upon the tiger general Xu Da by Zhu Yuanzhang. It stands upright like a tiger, howling loudly in the sky. Upon closer examination, one can discern the four characters "the richest in the world", making it the "number one tiger in the world". The copper pavilion and the other miracle in the the Taihu Lake Shizhan Garden, the copper pavilion (namely the fan pavilion), are the world's earlier heating equipment (equivalent to air conditioning buildings). In addition, there are also two the Taihu Lake Lake stones in the garden. The Immortal Peak is in the garden behind the south gate, and it stands in a beautiful place; Leaning against the cloud peak in the southeast corner of the flower basket hall, amidst the osmanthus bushes, it stands out with a sudden and graceful charm. Full text 

Riding on the Qinhuai River painting boat, ancient buildings with white walls and black tiles on both sides constantly come into view. The lights on the buildings and strings of red lanterns under the eaves are reflected in the Qinhuai River water, and the boat seems to have taken you into Zhu Ziqing's "Qinhuai River in the Sound of Paddles and the Shadow of Lights". By boating on Qinhuai River, not only can you get a full tour guide's explanation, but you can also enjoy more than 40 scenic spots and landscapes along the coast, such as celebrity residences, historical relics, bridges, Jiangnan famous gardens, Qinhuai lanterns, etc., and listen to the historical allusions and anecdotes brought by the tour guide. Nowadays, 'riding a painted boat and exploring Qinhuai' has become a necessary activity for tourists coming to Nanjing.

The world-famous hot spring sanatorium, the only hot spring in China that has obtained the international double certification of hot spring water quality in Europe and Japan, is known as "a thousand-year holy soup, a healthy paradise".

The Purple Mountain Observatory was built in 1934 and is located on the third peak of Purple Mountain in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. It is the site of the former site of the "National Purple Mountain Observatory" and is known as the cradle of modern astronomy in China. It is the main place for scientific research, observation, science popularization and other work in the history of Purple Mountain Observatory, and has left many important astronomical heritages. Some areas have been opened up as public science popularization service areas. This place records the history of the development of modern astronomy in China, inheriting the spirit of scientific exploration, and is also a famous scenic tourist destination in Nanjing. The Purple Mountain Observatory is a national science popularization education base, a national key cultural relic protection unit, and one of the first ten science and technology tourism bases in China. Entering the entrance of the scenic area and climbing up the stairs is the Meteorite Exhibition Hall, which has an exhibition area of about 200 square meters and displays more than 20 precious meteorites of various types. Tourists can have close contact with extraterrestrial visitors - meteorites, learn and understand meteorite knowledge. The former site of the observatory is the headquarters of the observatory, also known as the Great Observatory and the Great Equatorial Instrument Room. It is a combination of Chinese and Western architecture designed at the beginning of the construction of the observatory. The dome has distinctive Western characteristics. The gate is a memorial archway style, covered with glazed tiles. The central plaque has the word "observatory", which is based on the winter solstice on December 22, 1933. The 600mm reflecting Great Equatorial Instrument was placed, which was the largest telescope in the Far East at that time. Ancient Astronomical Instrument Exhibition Area Ancient Astronomical Instrument Exhibition Area is part of the essence of the Observatory. There is a celestial globe with a shape similar to a globe, also known as a celestial globe, embedded with stars. It was replicated by the Qing government in 1903; The armillary sphere and simple instrument, which have circular trajectories resembling the movements of several planets nested with each other, were both cast during the Ming Dynasty's Zhengtong period; There is a gnomon that uses the shadow of the sun to measure time; There is also the horizontal theodolite replicated by the Qing government in the early 20th century for measuring coordinates. The Meridian Room is the first building to be completed at the Purple Mountain Observatory, covered with square glass roofs and windows. It was built on the summer solstice of June 21, 1932, and the foundation stone was inscribed by Cai Yuanpei. The built-in meridian instrument is a celestial measurement instrument used to observe the moment when a star passes through its zenith. There are still some exhibits related to timekeeping displayed in the Meridian Room, such as copper pot droppers, scale droppers, modern navigation clocks, etc. The Ruins of Tianbao City Tianbao City was a fortress built by the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, and its former glory is no longer seen. There is a dome shaped observation room on the mountaintop. Climbing to the platform on the roof, you can overlook Nanjing City, and looking west is Xuanwu Lake; The perspective of the observatory is also very good, suitable for taking photos, and can capture a lot of observatory buildings. In addition, the scenic area also has graphic and textual exhibitions as well as special exhibitions. The graphic and textual exhibitions showcase the forefront and major achievements of scientific research at the Purple Mountain Observatory, as well as important history. They use astronomical photography images and physical objects and models to display basic knowledge of astronomy. The special exhibition is currently an original astronomical oil painting exhibition. summary: The Jiangnan Gongyuan is located in the southeast corner of Nanjing city, and was a large-scale imperial examination center in ancient China. It was also a place for scholars in southern China and one of the three major ancient architectural complexes in the Confucius Temple area. It is an important part of the Confucius Temple Qinhuai Scenic Belt. According to the "Nan Chuang Ji Tan", Jiankang (Nanjing) Gongyuan was first built in the fourth year of the Qiandao reign of Emperor Xiaozong of the Southern Song Dynasty (1168), by the prefect Shi Zhengzhi. Initially, it was used as an examination venue for county schools. The area is not large, and there are not many people taking the exam. If there is an increase in the number of candidates, the temple will be used to hold the exam. After continuous expansion during the Ming and Qing dynasties, by the reign of Emperor Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty, the Jiangnan Gongyuan had formed an examination hall with 20644 rooms, as well as more than a thousand official rooms for chief examiners, supervisors, inspectors, and officials such as co examiners and appointed guards. In addition, there were rooms for meals, warehouses, miscellaneous workers, and guards, as well as land for ponds, gardens, bridges, passages, and watchtowers. The scale and land area were vast, and the number of buildings was the highest in the country's examination halls.

The planned total area of Jinling Small Town is 3000 acres, with a land area of 780 acres. It is located in the western part of Niushou Mountain Cultural Tourism Zone, east of Niushou Avenue and north of Mozhou Road. The scenic area is characterized by "one street, one water, one Zen, one hall, one museum, and two lakes", and through the scene changes of changing scenery and recalling the prosperous scenery of Jinling, it vividly reproduces the millennium Jinling style of elegant banquets and literati. Yanjili is one of the "Eight Miles" of Jinling Small Town and a model for the entire project. As a leading demonstration area of Jinling Small Town, it provides tourists with five major experience modes: tourism, residence, commerce, participation, and music. It presents the unique temperament of Jinling Small Town, including the royal atmosphere, elegant soul, artistic beauty, secluded mountains and forests, and the charm of vicissitudes.

summary: Shikumen is a residential building with Shanghai characteristics. The old alleyways in Shanghai are usually built with Shikumen architecture, which incorporates a large number of styles from Jiangnan residential buildings. The door frames are made of stone and the door leaves are made of solid black lacquer wood, hence the name "Shikumen". Shikumen in Shanghai is mainly concentrated in Huangpu District and Jing'an District. The Shikumen in Lane 96 of Shaoxing Road is one of the relatively well preserved Shikumen in Shanghai. Many movies and TV dramas depicting old Shanghai themes like to come here for outdoor scenes. The residents here have seen the world before and are not surprised to see someone carrying a camera running around the alley. They look calm and composed, as if the cultural atmosphere of Shaoxing Road has infiltrated their bones.

tagNameList: Buildings by Famous Architects; Featured Neighborhoods
summary: Wukang Road is located in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its original name was Fu Kaisen Road, named after American missionary John Fu Kaisen. Wukang Road connects the busy Huaihai Middle Road and the quiet Huashan Road from north to south, and is a "Chinese Historical and Cultural Famous Street" with 37 historical buildings. Among them, there are 14 good historical buildings, which are truly the "Celebrity Road". Strolling along this century old road, the ancient trees on both sides are lush and green, and European style buildings scattered along the roadside can be seen from time to time. The Wukang Building is a landmark building on Wukang Road, designed by the renowned Hungarian architect Hudec. The red brick walls, corner balconies, and triangular classical mountain flower window lintels throughout the building exude a French Renaissance charm. The Wukang Building is shaped like a giant ship waiting to set sail, so it is not difficult to understand the origin of its old name "Normandy Apartments". Film artists such as Wu Yin, Zheng Junli, and Zhao Dan once lived here, and Miss Kong Er, daughter of Kong Xiangxi, is now the larger owner here. One major feature of Wukang Road is the succession of celebrity residences. No. 113 is the former residence of Ba Jin, a literary giant of his generation. The peaceful and warm old residence was Ba Jin's last and longest residence in Shanghai; 393 British country style garden villa is Huang Xing's former residence; No. 1, Lane 40 is Tang Shaoyi's old residence, a Spanish style detached garden house with a retro atmosphere In addition to celebrity residences, there are other distinctive old western-style houses here. The office building of SAIC Motor Corporation at No. 390 features a Mediterranean style small house with a red roof and white walls, which sets it apart from other old western-style houses; No. 99 is the Zhengguanghe Old House, an independent western-style house with a towering spire that appears precious and mysterious under the white walls and green branches. The movie "Lust, Caution" was filmed here. If you want to savor the past and present of Wukang Road carefully, it may take a day, and there are also many coffee shops and restaurants here to rest. There are three old western-style houses located outside Wukangting at No. 376. Among the flowers, there is a popular restaurant called Coffee Tree. Ordering a vegetable Panini and a cup of rich coffee is very satisfying. The Farine caf é at No. 378 is filled with a rustic French countryside flavor, and the lamb horns here are known as' Shanghai's delicious croissants'. Full text 

The Shanghai Greenhouse Garden is located in the center of the Shanghai World Expo Cultural Park, adjacent to the central lake and backed by the Twin Mountains. It covers an area of about 22000 square meters and has a total construction area of about 40000 square meters above and below ground. It is a multifunctional ecological complex that integrates sightseeing, leisure and entertainment. The exterior design combines historical memory and modern elements through the renovation and utilization of the old factory building of Shanggang No.3, forming a natural and elegant cloud like curve. The Shanghai Greenhouse Garden consists of four venues, including one tourist service center and three themed venues (namely Hall 1 Haishi Shazhou, Hall 2 Yunshang Forest, and Hall 3 Yunwu Canyon). The three main theme venues are classified and set up according to the habitat of plants, combined with the spatial structure of buildings, selecting typical ecological fragments from the world's ecosystem, and creating three environmental types: tropical drought, tropical wetland shade tolerance, and tropical wetland sun preference. They respectively display tropical drought plants, tropical rainforest plants, and tropical floral plants. In terms of display format, we strive to showcase the extension of plants to museums and culture, in order to create a beautiful and fun immersive exhibition greenhouse. In the future, high-tech means such as multimedia imaging, artistic lighting, and mobile interaction will be introduced to create a unique sci-fi and wonderful night tour experience. Stay tuned.

It is currently the longest single cycle hanging chair mountain climbing cableway in China. It starts from the underground fortress city on the western foot of Zhongshan Mountain, passes through vast forests, penetrates through flowing clouds and mist, and passengers only need to spend half an hour to reach the top of the mountain, Toutuoling Scenic Area, at an altitude of 425 meters. Tourists can take the tourist shuttle bus in Zhongshan Cemetery Scenic Area to the starting station of the cableway, get off and climb the steps along the "Zijin Mountain Cableway" memorial archway, and then with the help of the staff, they can take the double seat chair, just like flying people.

Nanjing Happy Valley is the 8th stop in the nationwide chain of Happy Valley, located on the east side of Qixia Mountain, adjacent to the Yangtze River, surrounded by mountains and waters, with a unique geographical environment. Nanjing Happy Valley has six major parks: Happy Time, Lost Fortress, Dessert Kingdom, Black Iron City, Fantasia Ocean, and Magic Eye Forest. The completion of Nanjing Happy Valley not only promotes the rapid formation of a new landmark for entertainment in the "Great Southern Capital", but also further enhances the radiation ability of Zidong tourism resources. Through stable customer flow, it injects a shot in the arm into Nanjing's development plan and interprets the true essence of "a prosperous and happy city" in Nanjing.

Jiang Jiegui's office is located in Nanjing and is an important historical site during the Republic of China period. This was once the place where Chiang Kai shek handled government affairs and received foreign guests, preserving many precious historical relics and photos, showcasing the style of that era.

Duan Fang, the governor of Liangjiang in the Qing Dynasty, visited Europe and was influenced by western thoughts to build this building imitating the French Renaissance style. 
· Because it is located in the West Garden on the west side of the Governor's Office, it is also called "West Flower Hall". 
On January 1, 1912, Sun Yat-sen became the interim president of the Republic of China, which became the office of the president.

Lianhua Island is located in the northeast of the ancient city of Suzhou, surrounded by water on three sides. It is named after its lotus like shape, which is embedded in the lake. The total area of the island is 3.2 square kilometers, with over 300 households living on the lake and making a living from crabs. The water here is vast and the water quality is particularly good. It is the birthplace of authentic Yangcheng Lake hairy crabs and is known as the "hometown of hairy crabs". The attractions on the island, such as Yiyuan Garden, Yaoshi Temple, Sanyuan Mansion, Xizui Wetland, Dadi Painting, Windmill Array, Cow Water Performance, and Water Treading, are both ornamental and experiential. With the rise of rural tourism, more and more tourists have come to visit, forming an industrial service chain integrating food, housing, tourism, entertainment and shopping. Lotus Island is developing into a resort for vacation and leisure. The Yiyuan Yiyuan Museum covers an area of over 5000 square meters and showcases the fully ecological, productive, and lifestyle of Yangcheng Lake. It not only restores the original ecological lifestyle of Lianhua Island, but also uses artistic techniques to spread the folk customs of the entire Jiangnan water town. The entire building includes: the foyer, atrium, fishery hall, water town wedding hall, water town costume hall, historical and cultural hall, and folk customs hall. The waterwheel was an irrigation tool used in ancient times and was popular in most parts of China. When used, stepping on the crutch to rotate the large wheel axle drives the blade in the groove to scrape water upwards and pour it into the field. This type of water lifting facility has a long history because its shape resembles a dragon bone, also known as a "dragon bone water wheel". Fengqing Fishing Port Fengqing Fishing Port is home to the original residents of Lianhua Island who live by the water on both sides. The pink walls and black tiles are connected together, and there is a row of boats and boats in front of the houses, maintaining the original ecological style of the Jiangnan water town. There are aquatic products all year round, and in the golden autumn season, crabs are harvested with joy. Every household welcomes guests with a smiling face. The charming water alleys of Lianhua Island make tourists come and go frequently. Xizui Wetland Park covers an area of over 300 acres, with diverse vegetation types and a good ecological environment. Along the lakeside boardwalk, visitors can enjoy the lake scenery and lotus flowers. In the flower planting area, rapeseed flowers can be seen in spring and sunflowers can be seen in autumn, creating a beautiful scenery. Cattle fetching water used to be a common scene in agriculture in Jiangnan. In a pavilion that was over a person tall, an old cow with its eyes covered was placed by a large wooden plate, circling in circles. The rotation of the large wheel axle drove the blades in the trough to scrape the water upwards, and the river water was irrigated by the "bucket board" into the fields by the river. The former residence of Qian Qi in the San Yuan Mansion, where "San Yuan" refers to Lianzhong Huiyuan, Jieyuan, and Zhuangyuan. Only 15 people in Chinese history have received this honor. In October 2010, construction was carried out on Qian Qi's old house, which consists of three entrances in front and back, with a total area of 300 square meters. The first two entrances are Ming style buildings with an area of 160 square meters, while the last entrance is an early Qing Dynasty building with an area of 140 square meters. The Suzhou Yangcheng Lake Tourism Distribution Center is located in the middle of the "Beauty Leg" Peninsula in Yangcheng Lake Resort. It is a comprehensive service center that integrates tourism distribution, tourist services, cultural exhibitions, and product sales. It is also a transportation hub that combines road and water transportation, and is a benchmark for smart tourism distribution centers in China. It covers an area of 36.5 acres and has a building area of 6848 square meters. It consists of three main parts: an ecological parking lot, a distribution building, and a boat dock. Designed by the architectural master Kengo Kuma, the building resembles a layered structure of thatch, which is a concrete expression of the rural areas of Jiangnan; The massive triangular roof is like a mountain range connected along the lake, perfectly blending with nature. This is a new cultural landmark, as well as a brand new cultural window and innovation and entrepreneurship base by Yangcheng Lake. It has become a well-known check-in spot for internet celebrities. Yiyuan is a museum located at the northeast corner of Lianhua Island in Yangcheng Lake, Suzhou. It has carefully set up a fishery museum, a folk customs museum, a water town wedding museum, a Yangcheng clothing museum, a historical and cultural museum, etc. Through artistic techniques, it spreads the folk customs of the entire Jiangnan water town from point to surface, comprehensively showcasing the fully ecological, productive, and lifestyle of Yangcheng Lake, and restoring the original ecological way of life of Lianhua Island.

The Pingjiang Road Historical District is located south of the Humble Administrator's Garden and has a history of over 2500 years. It is a relatively well preserved ancient street area. It is only one lane away from Guanqian Street in the west, but it has a completely different quiet and quaint atmosphere. Strolling around here, admiring the architecture while enjoying snacks, is very relaxing. The entire block is centered around Pingjiang Road, with small alleys such as Xuanqiao Lane, Daru Lane, Weidao Guanqian, Zhongzhangjia Lane, and Daxinqiao Lane on both sides. In particular, multiple water lanes are preserved on the east side. The block features parallel water and land transportation, with adjacent river streets, giving it the distinctive characteristics of a Jiangnan water city. The block retains the old appearance of the streets and alleys, even the transformed bars, souvenir shops, and cafes are not ostentatious, looking like residential buildings. You can carefully observe the old houses here, with white walls, gray tiles, wooden doors and windows, elegant and charming. The bridges here also have their own characteristics. The drum hugging stones and cloud patterned stone pillars at both ends of the bridge railings, as well as the railings carved with patterns such as double dragons playing with pearls, emerald bamboo, and flowers, are all very exquisite. There are also Kunqu Opera Museum and Pingtan Museum in the block, where you can enjoy exciting performances. There is a bridal garden on the east side of the block and a lion forest on the west side, both of which can be visited well. In addition, you can take a small boat tour of the Pingjiang River at the pier upstream of the river. In the evening, there are lights shining on the small bridges, flowing water, and ancient residential streets, which are particularly intoxicating. There are many interesting shops in the ancient street area that literary and artistic youth love to visit, such as the Sky City of Cats. This bookstore full of petty bourgeois atmosphere is very lively, and many people mail "postcards for the future" here. There are also small flower shops, Su style clothing stores, etc. that have their own characteristics. Of course, there are also many delicious foods worth tasting in this neighborhood

The Huangpu River is a symbol of Shanghai and a famous tourist port in China. Pujiang Tour has always been a traditional tourism program in Shanghai. Starting from the riverside dock, taking a cruise ship on the river, crossing the Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge, the beautiful Pudong Binjiang Avenue, the uniquely shaped Shanghai International Convention Center, and more, it takes you from the bustling city of Shanghai to the "Sanjia River" outside Wusong Mouth, where the Huangpu River and the world's third largest river, the Yangtze River, converge into the sea. Driving in the heart of the river, gazing at the architectural complex spanning a century of vicissitudes across the river, one cannot help but feel emotional. The Huangpu River mainly has the 16 Pu, Jinling East Road Wharf, etc. Different wharfs can take cruise ships of different styles. The the 16 Pu can take the essence Tour, "Happy Captain", "Dragon Boat", "Crystal Princess" and other cruise ships. The Jinling East Road Pier is the boarding point for the express tour.

Suzhou Museum was established in 1960 and is a comprehensive local museum. It is also the center for the collection, protection, research, exhibition, and education of cultural relics in Suzhou. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum is located at No. 399 Changjiang Road, High tech Zone, with a building area of 48365 square meters and an exhibition area of 13391 square meters. It displays more than 2100 cultural relics, including the Wu Wang Yu Yi Sword, the Bi paper and gold book "The Lotus Sutra of Miao Fa", and precious cultural relics such as the Jun kiln drum nail three foot washing. It was put into trial operation on September 25, 2021. The West Hall of Suzhou Museum has multiple exhibition areas such as the General History Exhibition Hall, Suzhou Craftsmanship Exhibition Hall, and Multimedia Exhibition Hall, which comprehensively showcase the long history and characteristic crafts of Wu from various aspects such as culture and art, Suzhou craftsmanship, and Suzhou style life. On the basis of focusing on Jiangnan culture, the West Branch of Suzhou Museum also has a dedicated International Cooperation Hall, which collaborates with world-renowned museums to actively explore the connection and integration of diverse cultures around the world. The West Branch of Suzhou Museum pays more attention to and highlights the educational function of museums. For the first time, it has attempted to set up an exploration experience hall in local comprehensive museums in China, creating a museum school for young audiences in China, allowing them to understand Suzhou City and see the world in an open, interactive, and exploratory experience. The General History Exhibition Hall is located on the first floor of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters and a total exhibition line of 360 meters. It displays more than 1200 cultural relics/sets, including more than 150 key cultural relics/sets. The exhibition starts from three dimensions: city, history, and people. Using space, historical facts, and characters as clues, and chronological order, it showcases the history of Suzhou from the Paleolithic era on Sanshan Island to the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, spanning ten thousand years. The Suzhou Craftsmanship Museum is located on the second floor above ground in the west hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 2280 square meters, showcasing exquisite Suzhou crafts from the Song and Yuan dynasties to the present and contemporary times over a thousand years. The exhibition displays a total of 900 cultural relics per set, with 150 key cultural relics per set, including traditional crafts such as jade carving, bamboo carving, Su embroidery, and Taohuawu woodblock New Year paintings. The exhibition aims to reveal the brilliant achievements of Su made craftsmanship and the key role of Su made craftsmanship and Su style culture in the development of traditional Chinese culture and art. The International Cooperation Hall is located on the second floor above ground in the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 1037 square meters. It focuses on the history of world civilization and is committed to enhancing the international perspective of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum. By collaborating with world-renowned museums to hold exhibitions, we provide visitors with a viewing experience that allows them to see the world without leaving Suzhou. The Multimedia Exhibition Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of approximately 540 square meters. It includes three areas: Suzhou Life Digital Hall, Audio and Video Room, and Derivative Space. The Su Se Life Digital Hall takes "Su Se Life" as its theme, focuses on the aesthetics of Suzhou life under the 24 solar terms, and uses the traditional cultural aesthetics of Suzhou as the basis for color extraction. Through the display of digital media screens, it creates an immersive digital color sensory space scene, presenting the Suzhou life under one solar term, one season, and one day and night to the audience. The Exploration Experience Hall is located on the basement level of the West Hall of Suzhou Museum, with an exhibition area of 4501 square meters. It focuses on the comprehensive development of children aged 3-12 through a "theme based" combination of exhibition and education, integrating the exhibition hall with the educational space. Through interactive experiences of exhibition and education, it inspires children's imagination and creativity, providing them with an exclusive space to explore, learn, and unleash their imagination. Eslite Bookstore is not so much a bookstore as a comprehensive building with bookstores as its main body. The entire building is built with a strong sense of design, and from the east gate, you can see the iconic 72 step staircase that is 18 meters high and 6 meters wide, which is very magnificent. The bookstore sells a large number of books and thoughtfully sets aside areas for customers to sit down and read. In addition, exquisite stationery stores, dessert shops, coffee shops, restaurants, and clothing stores are distributed on various floors, where literary and artistic youth can stroll around for a whole day. The rich collection of books includes 150000 varieties and 500000 volumes of Chinese and foreign books from 2000 publishing institutions around the world, covering five major book areas: Chinese and foreign literature, humanities and social sciences, art and design, lifestyle, and trend learning. You can see a large number of traditional Chinese books by Taiwanese writers, but the book prices are slightly higher. At the entrance of the book sales area is the "Eslite Selected Books" bookshelf, which lists Eslite's recommended books. It is said that the quality is good and worth a look. An interesting store located in B1 collects and sells small items and handicrafts, such as Suzhou embroidery, Suzhou fans, nuclear carving, woodcut New Year paintings, etc., all of which have local characteristics of Suzhou. The visual laboratory is located in the attic above the art book area, exhibiting art works and decorated in a small and fresh manner. The Eslite Children's Center on the second floor sells children's books and small toys, and customers with children can come here to take a stroll. Full text 

Although Huqiu is just a small hill, it has natural landscapes such as cliffs and ravines. Due to the construction of various dynasties, it has formed numerous cultural attractions. The buildings and plants in the park complement each other, giving it a delicate Jiangnan garden style. You can learn about the stories of the Spring and Autumn Period and the tilted Yunyan Temple Pagoda, a landmark on the exterior. The entire Huqiu Scenic Area is similar to a square, with a small area of about 500 meters both horizontally and vertically. The mountain height is only about 30 meters, and visitors can walk into the scenic area for sightseeing. The scenic area is mainly divided into three parts: Qianshan, Qianrenshi, and the mountaintop. Each section has many scenic and cultural attractions worth watching. In addition to the Yunyan Temple Pagoda, there are also Sword Pool and Thousand Person Stone that require special attention. Huqiu is also an important gathering place for Suzhou folk culture. Based on the history of the "Three Cities and Three Festivals", the scenic area has innovatively launched the Spring Art Flower Festival (from the end of March to May), showcasing the charming charm of a large number of precious flowers such as peonies, tulips, Belgian azaleas, lilies, etc., with high artistic taste; Accompanying the flower fair is the rich folk customs of the Golden Autumn Temple Fair (in September), which reproduces the grand scene of the mountain pond fair and showcases folk art programs that blend the north and south, deeply loved by tourists. Entering the Huqiu Scenic Area from the south gate (i.e. the main entrance of Huqiu Road), the first thing you come to is Qianshan. The stone arch bridge that catches the eye is the first scenic spot on the front mountain, called Haiyong Bridge. Looking ahead from Haiyong Bridge, the shape of the mountain resembles that of a tiger perched on top, which is said to be the true reason for the name Tiger Hill. It can also be seen that the mountain is hidden in a temple, and the temple is surrounded by the characteristics of a small mountain. Further ahead, you can see the Trial Sword Stone, which is said to be the place where King Helu of Wu tried the Mo Xie Sword. Now, when you go to the Trial Sword Stone to observe, you can see a crack passing through the large stone, resembling a knife cutting a sword. There are also attractions such as the Broken Beam Hall, Xiangbei, Hanhan Spring, and Pillow Stone in the front mountain, each of which has a fantastic and ancient legend. You can learn about their stories through the tour guide's explanation. Further ahead, you will arrive at the Thousand Person Stone area, where the main attractions include the Thousand Person Stone, Nodding Stone, Erxian Pavilion, and Sword Pool. Jianchi is a key attraction for visiting Huqiu, where the natural scenery is very unique. On the small hills of Jiangnan, there is a rare rock wall and steep valley behind Jianchi, and beneath the rock wall is a small pool of water. There are four big characters on the rock wall, "Tiger Hill Sword Pool," written by the famous scholar Yan Zhenqing. Legend has it that there is a large amount of treasure in the Sword Pool, and many kings in history have searched for it here, but it is still a mystery for thousands of years. Climbing up the gentle steps, one will reach the mountaintop where there are attractions such as the Yunyan Temple Pagoda and the Yunyan Zen Temple Ruins. Yunyan Temple Pagoda is the most important attraction in Huqiu Scenic Area. What attracts people to it is that it is a leaning tower with a tip that slopes more than two meters northwest. It is known as China's "Leaning Tower of Pisa" and "the second leaning tower in the world", which is very special and attracts many tourists to take photos here. The Yunyan Temple Pagoda is currently not allowed to enter the interior, only the exterior can be appreciated. There is a scenic spot called "Cold Fragrance Pavilion" on Huqiu Mountain, which was built in the sixth year of the Republic of China. Merlin trees are planted around the pavilion, and from February to March every year, the shadows are scattered and the fragrance is hidden. Tourists who come to Huqiu to appreciate the plum blossoms can go to the Cold Fragrance Pavilion to soak in a pot of fragrant tea, sit alone, and enjoy the tea and plum blossoms, adding more elegance and charm. The Yulan Mountain House is located on the north side of Huqiu Mountain, above the Tongyou Pavilion. There is an old Yulan tree, which is very ancient and named Guanwuzhong. It is said to have been transplanted from Fujian by Song Zhuzhen. Every early spring, the magnolia blossoms are about to bloom. This area is elegant and beautiful, peaceful and comfortable. Tourists come here, reluctant to leave and reluctant to return. Full text 
