summary: Huqiu Pagoda is located on Huqiu Mountain in the northwest suburbs of Suzhou, 5 kilometers away from the city center. According to legend, during the Spring and Autumn Period, King Fuchai of Wu buried his father (Helu) here. Three days after the burial, a white tiger perched on it, hence the name Huqiu Mountain, abbreviated as Huqiu. Huqiu Pagoda is a famous ancient pagoda from the Song Dynasty, both domestically and internationally. Founded in the sixth year of Xiande in the Later Zhou Dynasty (959 AD) and completed in the second year of Jianlong in the Northern Song Dynasty (961 AD). The tower has seven levels and eight sides, with two layers of internal and external columns and half arches, brick body and wooden eaves. It is a representative work of brick towers in the Yangtze River Basin in the 10th century. Due to multiple fires from the Song Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, the wooden eaves at the top were all damaged, and the current height of the tower is 47.5 meters. In 1956, a large number of cultural relics were discovered inside the tower, including rare art treasures such as Yue kiln and lotus stone turtle. The Tiger Hill Tower is a leaning tower.

The northwest end of Shantang Street extends to Huqiu, and the southeast end is at Changmen. The street runs parallel to Shantang River, with ancient bridges spanning the river. On both sides of Shiban Street are old houses with pink walls and black tiles, as well as numerous shops. At night, the lit red lantern reflects in the river, making it suitable for taking photos. You can also take a boat ride or find a tea house to have tea or listen to Pingtan. Shantang Street runs southeast to northwest, with a total length of about seven miles, hence it is known as the "Seven Mile Shantang". Shantang Street has a history of thousands of years and was built by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi during his tenure as an official in Suzhou. Nowadays, at the southern end of the street, one can see the Bai Gong Temple built by the people in memory of Bai Juyi. Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty had a special fondness for the Qili Mountain Pond, and his imperial inscription "Seeking Victory in the Mountain Pond" has been well preserved to this day. There are also memorial archway, ancestral temples, guild halls and other historic sites. There are more than a dozen guild halls alone. They used to be offices of foreign chambers of commerce in the Soviet Union, most of which were built in the middle of the Qing Dynasty. The southeast of Shantang Street, which is a small section near Changmen, is called "Shantang Old Street" and is about 360 meters long. This section of the street is densely populated with various handicraft shops and snack shops, as well as major attractions such as Yuhan Hall, Antai Firefighting Association, Tonggui Bridge, Suzhou Chamber of Commerce Museum, and ancient stage. It is a place with a commercial atmosphere and a large number of tourists throughout the street. Yuhan Hall is the former residence of Wu Yipeng, the Minister of Personnel of the Ming Dynasty, and is an ancient architectural complex outside Suzhou City. This building gathers various forms of Chinese rooms, such as halls, halls, towers, pavilions, and rooms. Through the carved beams and painted rafters, you can feel the rich cultural and artistic characteristics of the Ming Dynasty. Tonggui Bridge is an arched stone bridge spanning the Shantang River, which is a great place to appreciate the scenery of Suzhou's water town. It is also a classic filming location for oil paintings and watercolor paintings. Careful painters can often be seen on the bridge, and award-winning films such as "Plum Blossom Turban" and "Red Powder" have also been filmed here in the past. There are many traditional food stores on Shantang Street, such as Songhe Restaurant, Rongyang Restaurant, New Year's Dim sum Restaurant, and Dim sum stores such as Huangtianyuan Caoyuan and Caizhizhai Candy. You can taste traditional snacks such as plum cake, crabapple cake, red bean paste sugar Congee, etc. There are also many folk craft shops selling antiques, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, Paper Cuttings, etc. Full text 

The original name of Shen Hall was Jingye Hall, which was renamed Songmao Hall in the late Qing Dynasty. It was built by Shen Benren, a descendant of Shen Wansan, in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1742 AD). It is divided into seven entrances and five gates, and the architectural layout has the style of a wealthy family. Shen Hall is a must visit attraction in Zhouzhuang, and tourists come here mainly to explore the past of the wealthy Shen Wansan. Layout structure: The first entrance of the Shen Hall is the Water Wall Gate, which is equivalent to the private dock of the Shen family for docking their boats; The second entrance is the foyer; The third entrance is the tea pavilion, used to entertain guests with average status; The fourth entrance is the main hall, Songmao Hall, used to entertain distinguished guests; The fifth entrance is the lobby building where women reside; The sixth entrance is the small hall building; The seventh entrance is the restaurant, with a kitchen next to it. Highlights of Shen Hall: Brick carved gatehouse, main hall, treasure trove, and copper murals are several highlights of Shen Hall. The gatehouse between the third and fourth entrances is one of the five exquisite gatehouses in Shenting. There are beautiful brick carvings on the gatehouse, with the words "Accumulated Thick and Flowing Light" carved in the middle. The main hall, Songmao Hall, is spacious and grand, with old dark windows visible when looking up. In the sixth entrance of the small hall building, there is a statue of Shen Wansan, and in front of him is a glittering treasure trove, which is said to bring wealth to people. There are copper murals on both sides of the lane in Shen Hall, introducing the legendary life of Shen Wansan. Visiting the second floor of the Shen Hall's Ma Tower requires an additional fee. On the second floor, you can look at the various courtyards of the Shen Hall from a different angle, and also see the ladies' boudoirs. It is quite interesting to peek into the main hall's Song Mao Hall from the dark window.

summary: Suzhou Tianyi Hot Spring Resort has 39 indoor and outdoor hot spring pools scattered among them, which are functionally divided into six bathing areas: herbal medicine, aromatherapy, supreme, physiotherapy, original flavor and leisure. Rockery, waterfall, small bridge and flowing water are interspersed among them, filled with colorful fish. The fish therapy pool, the central waterscape stage and the waterfall allow customers to enjoy the amusement experience after soaking in the spring. At the same time, the hot spring is equipped with KTV boxes, chess and card rooms, a la carte restaurants, gyms and other supporting facilities that can accommodate 20-60 people. Space capsule physiotherapy machine, fresh petal bath, magnet SPA and other projects can make modern fashionable women beautify their body and soothe their body and mind.

Fengqiao Scenic Area is located by the canal west of the ancient city of Suzhou, with Fengqiao, Tielingguan, Fengqiao Ancient Town, and the ancient canal (a section of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal) as the main tourist attractions. Zhang Ji's poem "Night Mooring at Maple Bridge" from the Tang Dynasty has attracted countless tourists from ancient times to the present day to reminisce and experience the ethereal atmosphere of listening to the bell ringing from Hanshan Temple under Maple Bridge. It should be emphasized that although countless introductions claim that Fengqiao Scenic Area includes Hanshan Temple, these two are not really the same scenic spot and are sold separately without being accessible to the public. The affiliated attractions of Fengqiao Scenic Area account for the vast majority of the scenic area, mostly located on the slender north-south oriented Jiangfengzhou, which is connected to the land by a bridge. To the east is Hanshan Temple, separated by a narrow river channel. Tieling Pass is located on the same bank as Hanshan Temple, along with Fengqiao, which is adjacent to Tieling Pass, in the northwest corner outside Hanshan Temple. The scenic area has three entrances: the Heshan entrance, which is closer to Heshan Road and Jinmen Road to the south, the Jiangcun Bridge entrance near the Hanshan Temple Mountain Gate in the middle, and the Tieling Pass entrance to the north, which leads to the main attractions of Tieling Pass and Fengqiao. The bus stop is on Jinmen Road, so tourists taking the bus are advised to approach from the He Shan entrance. Otherwise, they need to follow the outer fence to reach the other two entrances. Tourists who drive or take a taxi can park their cars at the East Square of Hanshan Temple Scenic Area, and then enter directly from the entrance of Tieling Pass to the key points. To the south of Jiangfengzhou is a green belt with sparse gardens and halls, while to the north is Fengqiao Ancient Town, all of which are newly built in an antique style. There used to be an ancient town here because it was the intersection of a canal and an ancient post road, where merchants gathered. It flourished during the Ming and Qing dynasties, but was later destroyed by war. You can take a look at several exhibition halls in the town. You can see ship models in the Canal Transport Exhibition Hall, art exhibitions in Jiangfeng Academy, and the miniature model "Fengqiao Scenic Spots" in Fengqiao Garden, which reproduces the prosperous scene of the Fengqiao area during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Several bridges are also worth paying attention to. The Jiangcun Bridge near the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple is an ancient bridge rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty. It is said that the "Jiangfeng Fishing Fire on Sorrowful Sleep" refers to the maple trees by the river, and the Jiangcun Bridge and Maple Bridge. The wooden covered bridge and the bell bridge provide a great angle for capturing the maple bridge and the Tieling Pass. The memorial archway at the north end of Jiangfeng Island, Jinghong Ferry, can see the busy scene of ships on the ancient canal, and there is a cargo ship wharf on the opposite bank. Not far east from Tingzhong Bridge is Fengqiao, with several steps in front of the river. It is said to be Zhang Ji's night berth. The exact year when Fengqiao was first built is unknown, but what we see now is its reconstruction in the sixth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1867 AD). Walking along this single arch stone bridge, the steps of the bridge extend all the way into the doorway of Tieling Pass. The stone platform steps are stepped on smoothly, with uneven edges. You can clearly feel the passage of time, even leaving marks on the stones for the woven visitors. Tieling Pass was first built in the 36th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1557 AD) and is an existing anti Japanese building in Suzhou. The stone pedestal at the lower part of Tieling Pass is still an ancient relic from the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the ivy covering the pedestal seems to be telling the story of the mottled years. The closed tower is a modern reconstruction. Tourists can climb up the Guanlou through a one person wide staircase and overlook Fengqiao Ancient Town and the Puming Pagoda of Hanshan Temple from above. If you purchase a ticket and a combined ticket for the Pingtan cruise ship, you can take a cruise ship at the dock under Tieling Pass, and the boat will leisurely pass through the bridge tunnel, giving people a feeling of "being on a passenger ship". In addition, there are also Pingtan performances to watch on the cruise ship. If you want to go to Hanshan Temple, go south through the ancient street of Hanshan Temple Lane that sells handicrafts at Tieling Pass, and walk less than 100 meters to reach the mountain gate of Hanshan Temple. Alternatively, if you cross Jiangcun Bridge over Jiangfengzhou, you can see Hanshan Temple on the bridge, which is only a few steps away. Full text 

Located on the bank of Zhenfeng Bridge, the Lazy Building was formerly known as Deji Hotel. The whole structure is made of wood, and the previous style is restored and retained. 
This wine shop, which lives near the water, became famous because scholars and writers tasted tea and wrote poems, "If wine is not drunk, everyone is drunk, and the scenery is pleasant and charming".

shortFeatures: Show the characteristic folk customs of water towns
summary:
Zhouzhuang Museum is located in a simple and elegant house, which was originally the residence of a family named Zhu in the early years of the Republic of China. 
The whole pattern here is the front hall and the back hall, which is in the form of a ladder from east to west, mainly displaying folk living utensils and farm tools. 
There are also paintings, photographs, arts and crafts works by famous modern artists in the museum, showing the strong nostalgia of Zhouzhuang, the first water town in China. 
The museum is full of the history of Zhouzhuang, and it is a good place to learn about Zhouzhuang.

Kunshan, where Zhouzhuang is located, is the birthplace of Kunqu Opera. In order to promote traditional culture, Zhouzhuang has restored and rebuilt the ancient stage. The ancient stage, the walking horse tower style performance building, the exhibition hall, and other buildings surround the central square. The entire building complex is like a courtyard in Beijing. After purchasing tickets to enter Zhouzhuang, tourists can enjoy free performances of Kunqu Opera here. The numerous wooden carved phoenixes in the center of the ancient stage form a phoenix coffered ceiling, which is a "high-end sound system" built using the principle of resonance, making the performances here more graceful and pleasant. For specific performance times and repertoire, you can pay attention to the sign at the entrance of the ancient stage. Generally speaking, on Thursdays, there will be performances of Xiju opera, such as "Pearl Tower", and on weekdays other than Thursdays, there will be performances of Kunqu opera, such as "Peony Pavilion". You can sit on chairs in the open-air square to watch the play, or go to the tea room across from the stage to buy tea and snacks, and watch while eating. When there is no performance, the ancient stage is also open. You can take a look at the introduction of traditional Chinese opera and the displayed costumes.

The oldest bridge in Zhouzhuang was built in the Yuan Dynasty, and was later rebuilt by Shen Wansan's younger brother Shen Wansan, and renamed Fu'an Bridge. 
· The only remaining three-dimensional bridge building in the water town of the south of the Yangtze River, the bridge building is rising from the waves, facing each other from a distance, and its momentum is extraordinary. 
There is a local saying that walking the Fu'an Bridge three times will lead to a successful career. It is said that Premier Zhu Rongji walked the Fu'an Bridge three times before taking office. 
Because Fu'an Bridge is quite distinctive, there are a lot of people coming here. Friends who want to go choose a good time, otherwise it will be difficult to take a single photo.
Zhenfeng Bridge is located in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China. It is a historic ancient bridge known for its unique architectural style and rich historical and cultural background.

summary: Quanfu Lecture Temple was first built in the first year of the Song and Yuan dynasties (1086 AD), and the temple we see today was rebuilt in 1995. This temple, which is located by the South Lake, is a typical garden temple with a large lake and pavilions. Most of the temple buildings are floating on the water. The word "Buddha Kingdom in the Water" on the memorial archway at the gate of the temple is its portrayal. Quanfu Lecture Temple runs north-south, with the main building on the central axis and two gardens on the east and west sides, respectively built to commemorate the famous Tang Dynasty poets Liu Yuxi, Lu Guimeng, and Western Jin Dynasty literary figure Zhang Jiying. The mountain gate of the temple faces the South Lake, where Maitreya Buddha, Wei Tuo, and Heng Ha are enshrined. The five hole stone bridge connecting the mountain gate and the Zhigui Pavilion spans over a large release pond, and there is a curved bridge to the west with pavilions on the bridge, rockeries on the shore, and groups of carp swimming in the pond. If it were not for the yellow walled and gray tiled temple buildings, tourists would probably suspect that they are in the park. The Three Saints of the West are worshipped in the Zhigui Pavilion. Passing the Zhigui Pavilion and passing the Bell Tower and Drum Tower to the north, the the Shakya ManiHall is located. The Sakyamuni bronze statue in the hall is as high as 5 meters, which is majestic and magnificent. To the north of the the Shakya ManiHall is the Sutra Pavilion. Visitors are not allowed to enter.

Located in the south of Zhouzhuang Town, commonly known as Nanbaidang, this big lake with nearly 1,000 mu of water surface brings abundant water sources to Zhouzhuang. 
It is not only a natural reservoir and fish farm, but also a rare scenic spot, with bamboo forests and quiet environment.

Yangcheng Lake overlooks Chongyuan Temple, the magnificent Daxiong Hall is magnificent, and the Guanyin Pavilion with cornices and corners is magnificent. In addition, the main building of the temple is advanced layer by layer, the Guanyin statue, the leather drum with copper cavity, the Guanyin wall on the island and the bronze bell, etc., which can be called a giant masterpiece in China, reproduce the elegance of Chongyuan Temple in those days.

summary: Dragon Claw Mountain is located at the northern end of Daheshan Island, a 5-minute drive from the dock. It is composed of five coastal cliffs and ravines crisscrossing the sea, with cliffs and broken arms extending across the sea. On the cliffs of Dragon Claw Mountain, there is an inexplicable "immortal path" that is about 1500 meters long and only over 1 meter wide, embedded in quartzite cliffs. Legend has it that the Eight Immortals left their traces here. There is a sea eroded cave on the west side, with a depth of no light, a width of only two people standing side by side, and a height that is difficult to reach the top. It is said to be the resting place of the Eight Immortals when crossing the sea, named "Juxian Cave", which is an existing sea eroded cave in China. At the westernmost end of the mountain, there is a rare "stone tower", with its walls and sea surface at a 90 degree angle. Above it, there is a natural window, and the sunrise, dusk, and stone tower present an instantaneous and ever-changing rosy glow. Through the stone tower, one can see a unique and ever-changing landscape, hence it is known as the "Eye of Long Island".
The main peak of Daheshan Island is called Laoheishan due to the blackened rocks, and there are vipers on the mountain.

It has a milestone significance in the history of Chinese warship construction. The ship began laying its keel at Zhonghua Shipyard in June 1979, was launched in September 1981, and officially completed and commissioned into the North Sea Fleet on December 26, 1984, with hull number 110. Captain 132 meters, width 12.8 meters, draft 4.6 meters, speed 36 knots, endurance 2970 nautical miles, full load displacement 3670 tons. During 36 years of service, the destroyer has won many honors in various exercises and escorts. It has been repeatedly rated as a exemplary organization in grass-roots construction by the higher authorities, and won a collective second class merit. In 1986, as the flagship of the North Sea Fleet, he received a delegation from the United States Navy to visit China. In 1988, he participated in military operations in the South China Sea and took part in the 60th anniversary naval parade of the People's Navy. He wrote a brilliant chapter in the development and growth of the People's Navy. In May 2019, the destroyer was retired with honor and lowered its military flag. In September 2020, it docked on the west side of the Liugong Island Passenger Transport Center in Weihai and continued to dock. Starting from April 23, 2021.

As the first national art museum in China, it represents the official beginning of the career of China Art Museum. In 1960, it was renamed Jiangsu Art Museum and is still in use today. 
The National Fine Arts Exhibition Hall has held many influential exhibitions, including several national art exhibitions and various exhibitions of traditional Chinese paintings, oil paintings and prints. The "Second National Art Exhibition of the Ministry of Education" held in 1937, from the "Special Collection of the Second National Art Exhibition" preserved by Nanjing Library so far, shows that the artistic status of the preparatory committee members and examination committee of the exhibition is prominent, the works of the participating artists are heavy, and the scale of the exhibition is large. In the whole 20th century, no art exhibition can surpass it. 
On November 24th, 2018, the former site of the National Fine Arts Exhibition Museum was selected as the "Third Batch of Chinese 20th Century Architectural Heritage Projects". In October 2019, it was included in the list of the eighth batch of national key cultural relics protection units.

Introduction to Shidao Chishan Scenic Area: "There are wonders in the mountains and seas, and you can see Chishan from Weihai." Chishan Scenic Area is located on the shore of Shidao Bay in Weihai. It is named "Chishan" because the main peak of Chishan, which is 369 meters above sea level, turns red under the sun. The scenic area covers an area of 12.8 square kilometers and is a national AAAA level tourist attraction and provincial-level scenic spot. The forest vegetation coverage rate is over 95%, and the negative oxygen ion content is over 60000 per cubic centimeter. It is a natural forest oxygen bar and a national key construction base for forest health preservation. Here, shrouded in clouds and mist, the scenery is beautiful. In ancient times, there was a saying that 'gods return to Chishan', adding a magical touch to the Oriental Divine Mountain by the seaside. The main deity worshipped in Chishan is Chishan Mingshen. Chishan Mingshen originally appeared in the Hongmen Cave of Chishan. According to legend, Chishan Mingshen is the incarnation of the Sun God, who was worshipped by the ancestors in ancient times. He guards the mountains and the sea, with boundless power, protecting coastal fishermen with fish and shrimp in their warehouses and returning safely. For thousands of years, it is precisely because of the protection of the Chishan Ming God that the people here live and work in peace and prosperity. Therefore, their divine powers and merits are highly believed and worshipped by people. Therefore, people worship the sea guardian deity Chishan Ming God as the God of Peace. Zhang Baogao, a native of Silla, built the Chishan Fahua Temple here in 824 AD. Later, Japanese monk Yuanren visited Chishan three times and stayed at the Fahua Temple for two years and nine months. Chishan became famous throughout the Tang Dynasty, thanks to Master Yuanren's book "Journey to the Tang Dynasty to Seek the Dharma", which tells the story of Chishan Mingshen's blessing on his successful return from Chishan Pu (now Shidao Bay). Yuanren's disciples followed his wishes and built Chishan Zen Temple to worship Chishan Mingshen. Zhang Baogao also built two Chishan Temples in Silla to worship Mingshen, thanking him for his reputation as a maritime trade king and national hero under the protection of Mingshen. From then on, Chishan Mingshen gradually became worshipped by the Tang Dynasty, as well as countries such as Japan, Silla, Persia, and Dashi. The existence of the Fahua Temple also led to a fate of "one temple connecting the three kingdoms for a thousand years". Chishan is known for its "Eastern Divine Mountain", "Buddhist Resort", "Island Folk Customs", "Forest Park" and other attractions. The main attractions include the Chishan Fahua Temple, a thousand year old ancient temple that connects the Three Kingdoms and the love story between China, South Korea and Japan, the Jixiang Ping'an Valley, a large dynamic music fountain square with auspicious peace as its theme, the 58.8-meter-high Ping An God Chishan Mingshen, the Zhang Baogao Biography Museum, which tells the legendary life of the Korean sea king Zhang Baogao, the Chishan Zen Temple, which records the experience of Japanese monk Yuanren seeking Dharma in the Tang Dynasty, the Rongcheng Folk Culture Museum in northern China, the Chishan Intangible Cultural Heritage Maker Center, a famous water and stone culture museum, and the Shilian Cultural Museum. Yashi Hall, the Pure Land of Guanyin Bodhisattva - Guanyin Altar, and the Jade Carving Hall of "Dragon and Phoenix Jue Yuan" that interprets the poignant love story between Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Yang Guifei, As well as many scenic spots such as Fahua Tower, Longfeng Lake, Baihua Garden, and Daming Holy Land, it is a paradise for coastal tourism, mountain and sea landscape tourism, fishing folk tourism, and religious pilgrimage tourism. The Zhujiajiao Great Qing Post Office was established in 1903 and is the former site of the Great Qing Post Office preserved in East China. It is also the earliest postal institution in the region. It is said that there were a total of thirteen postal stations in Shanghai at that time, and Zhujiajiao Post Office was one of them. After the Xinhai Revolution overthrew the Qing Dynasty, the Qing Post Office continued to operate as China Post. In 1953, it was relocated to the vicinity of Fangsheng Bridge on North Street, and in 2001, it was listed as a cultural relic protection unit in Qingpu District. The antique bronze cast dragon mailbox standing outside the old post office site is a unique business card of Zhu Jiajiao, showcasing the retro romance of "slow carriages and horses, long letters and letters". In 2022, the overall building of Zhujiajiao Daqing Post Office will undergo a comprehensive spatial upgrade, revitalizing through the renovation of the old style. While preserving the original Ming and Qing architectural styles and cultural heritage, it will integrate new Chinese aesthetics, combining cultural exchange, cultural and creative experiences, art exhibitions, study salons, boat tours, and other diverse cultural experiences. This will recreate the century old vicissitudes of the ancient town post office and showcase the long history of China Post. In addition to the historical attributes of ancient architectural sites, more cultural exchange spaces such as theme coffee, cultural exhibitions, characteristic cultural creation, creative workshops, art summer camps, etc. have also been opened up. shortFeatures: Appreciate the unique beauty of Baroque architecture
summary: Sheshan Catholic Church, also known as the Church of Our Lady of Sheshan, is located on the top of Xishe Mountain in Sheshan National Forest Park. From a distance, the church on the top of the mountain is connected with the mountain as a whole. The red brick wall is in obvious contrast with the green mountain forest, which is dignified and majestic. The whole church is long in the south and short in the north, wide in the east and narrow in the west. It is a classic asymmetric building. Sheshan Catholic Church often has many newcomers here to hold weddings. Even if you are not a believer, you can enter and experience the sacred and solemn religious atmosphere. But please respect religious beliefs and do not take pictures in the church. This church is a European Baroque style building, but also combines various other architectural techniques, such as Romanesque vaults and corridors, Greek style colonnades, Gothic style spires, Israeli style olive-shaped bell towers, Spanish style The small dome at the east end has Chinese-style clear water walls, bucket corner floor tiles, and glazed tiles. At the same time, the building also adopts a structure without wood, nails, steel and beams, which can be called an architectural classic. Stepping into the church, you can see that two rows of tall and straight columns support the olive-shaped dome, neat benches are placed in the venue, the windows of the hall are inlaid with colorful glass, and the front of the hall is a large altar made of marble inlaid with gold and jade. The altar and the hall are separated by low white marble railings, and the floor is covered with flower tiles. Eight bells are arranged on the bell tower according to certain notes. The spire is 38 meters high. There is also a statue of the Virgin made of copper on the bell tower. The church was founded by French missionaries in 1871 and completed in 1935. The Pope of Rome designated the church as a basilica in 1942. Tens of thousands of people from all over come here for pilgrimage every year on the "Mother Month" in May and the "Christmas" in December. From the foot of the mountain to the top of the mountain, there are 14 pavilions of the Crucible, each pavilion has a crucifixion relief, 3 holy pavilions and the Church of Our Lady of Zhongshan halfway up the mountain. When the faithful go to Sheshan for pilgrimage, they must follow the twists and turns. The road of suffering goes up step by step.

shortFeatures: Offer to the Great Sage Kinnara King Bodhisattva
summary:
Xiangji Temple was formerly named Xingfu Temple, and was later named "Xiangji Temple" by Song Zhenzong. It used to be a famous temple in the Hushu area of the Grand Canal-it was the first temple to enter Hangzhou through the canal and the last temple to leave Hangzhou, and it was also the only place for Buddhist believers in Hangjiahu area to go from the canal to Lingyin and Tianzhu to go to the mountains. Therefore, she has a high status in the canal and the Buddhist circles in Hangzhou. 
Xiangji Temple was destroyed by war at the end of Yuan Dynasty and rebuilt in 2009. There were two original east and west towers, but now only the west tower remains. It is made of stone with eight sides and nine floors of imitation wooden pavilions. The tower body is divided layer by layer. Except for the railings above the second floor, which are made of bluestone, the rest are made of lake stone, and the tower foundation is Xumi-style. Each floor on it is composed of flat seats, tower bodies and tower eaves in turn, ending with tower brakes, and the top of the brakes is made of treasure gourds, Buddha statues or scriptures. Under the eaves, the flat body section is five steps and double warps, and the angle section is seven steps and three warps. The center of each side of the tower is carved with a door, and both sides are relief. 
The temple doesn't look big outside, but when you go in, you find that it's not small. There are many lay people chanting scriptures, and there are free incense for everyone to enter. It is worth mentioning that his plain noodles are famous in Hangzhou. As soon as they come up, they smell fragrant, and they eat them all as soon as they move chopsticks.

summary: China Grand Canal Museum is adjacent to Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal in the west, and there is the ancient Gongchen Bridge next to it. The cultural square around the canal is arranged in the shape of a fan, with a combination of flat and slope shapes. Ancient Chinese traditional architectural symbols are extracted from the facade details. After refinement and simplification, the indoor and outdoor are integrated through a unique open pattern, and canals, bridges, boats and ports are skillfully borrowed as living exhibitions. The museum introduces the historical changes and culture of the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal through five exhibition halls. Interested friends may wish to visit here.

The Lingyin (Feilaifeng) Scenic Area is located to the west of West Lake and includes two main attractions: Lingyin Temple and Feilaifeng. Feilai Peak is neither large nor high, but it gathers hundreds of statues of bodhisattvas and high monks from different dynasties, with a kind of fusion beauty. The Lingyin Temple in the mountains is a famous ancient temple in Hangzhou, with strong incense. You can buy incense coupons to enter the temple and pray. The scenic area itself is not large, it can be enjoyed on foot. After entering the gate and turning left, you can see Feilai Peak in no time. Following the forest path for less than 5 minutes, you can see the entrance of Qinglin Cave. It is said that the stone slab in front of the cave was once Ji Gong's bed, and sleeping there will no longer be disturbed by the world, attracting many tourists to lie down here. To the north, there are 18 Arhat of the Northern Song Dynasty in the Yuru Cave, and on both sides of the eastern end of the cave, there are six ancestors of Zen, which are very exquisite. Continuing forward, Longhong Cave, commonly known as Guanyin Cave, has a stone crevice called "One Line of Sky" inside. Not everyone can see the light passing through the crevice, so it is common to see people stretching their necks to look up. The cliffs outside the cave are covered with stone carvings of Buddha statues, and at lower levels, one can see the Song Dynasty stone carvings of "White Horse Carrying Sutra". The Ligong Pagoda at the entrance of Longhung Cave is the only surviving Ming Dynasty pagoda in Hangzhou. Walking along the Cold Spring Creek, you can also see the Big Belly Maitreya. Across from the stone carvings is the famous Lingyin Temple. To enter Lingyin Temple, you need to purchase an additional incense and flower voucher for 30 yuan, but it is still worth a visit. The Wei Tuo statue in the Heavenly King Hall is like a relic from the Southern Song Dynasty, carved from a whole piece of camphor wood and very precious. The newly built Yongfu Temple is located next to Lingyin Temple. Follow the signs to get there. In addition to the serene ancient buildings, there is also a tea garden and many ancient trees in the temple, making the scenery quite beautiful. When you arrive at Yongfu Temple, you must return the same way. If you want to climb the mountain, there is a fork in the road on the way back to Lingyin Temple. You can take the exit from Taoguang Temple to reach the North Peak. This section is quiet and quiet, and it feels great to walk around. shortFeatures: There are five-colored clouds hovering over the top of the mountain
summary:
Wuyun Mountain is the third mountain among the mountains of the West Lake, with an altitude of more than 300 meters. It is said that there are five-colored clouds hovering on the top of the mountain, and it is named after time. Others say that there are five wells in Zhenji Temple on the top of the mountain (only three are left today). In the wells, you can see the reflection of clouds in the sky, and their shapes are different, hence their names. 
In fact, the mountain is located between the Qiantang River and the West Lake, with abundant water vapor; The temperature difference between the mountain and the foot of the mountain is obvious, forming mountain clouds, which are exposed to strong sunlight and show colorful clouds. There is a pavilion on the mountainside, with a couplet "The long embankment cuts through the whole lake, and the word divides two Zhejiang mountains equally". 
In addition to three ancient wells, there is also a ginkgo tree embraced by five people, with a tree age of 1,400 years and a height of 21 meters, which is known as "the No.1 ancient tree in Hangzhou". From the top of Wuyun Mountain, you can climb over Shili Langdang Ridge, cross Longjing Lion Peak, and go to Tianzhu and Lingyin. Yunqi is located at the foot of Wuyun Mountain in the southwest of the West Lake. According to legend, the colorful clouds floating from Wuyun Mountain often live here, hence the name Yunqi. 
Yunqi Zen Temple was built in the Five Dynasties. Among them, there are six scenic spots in Yunqi, such as Riyaofeng, Baodaolong, Qinglong Spring, Shengyi Spring, Jinye Spring and Biguan Peak.

shortFeatures: "The First Village of Tea Township"
summary:
Longjing Village is located in the southwest of West Lake Scenic Area, surrounded by mountains on all sides, showing a trend of high in the north and low in the south. It has nearly 800 mu of alpine tea gardens. 
The northwest peak, Lion Peak and Tianzhu Peak in the northwest of the village form a natural barrier to block the cold wind from the northwest. There is Jiuxi in the south, and the valley is deep and wide, which leads directly to Qiantang River. The southeast wind in spring and summer is easy to enter the valley. The geographical conditions of ventilation and ventilation provide unique advantages for the growth of Longjing tea. Longjing tea produced here ranks first among "lion, dragon, cloud and tiger". 
· According to legend, when Emperor Qianlong went to the south of the Yangtze River, he went to Hugong Temple at the foot of Shifeng Mountain in Longjing Village to taste West Lake Longjing tea. After drinking, he was full of praise, and named the eighteen tea trees in front of the temple "Imperial Tea". Longjing Village, the "first village in tea township", is famous for its abundance of top-class West Lake Longjing tea. 
It is bordered by Xizi Lake in the east, Wuyun Mountain in the west, Qiantang River in the south, and the north and south peaks inserted into the clouds in the north. It is surrounded by green mountains and clouds, just like an emerald gemstone inlaid on the shores of Xizi Lake.

Located at the western foothills of Wengjia Mountain, west of West Lake. Longjing was originally named Longhong, and during the Jin Dynasty, Ge Hong practiced alchemy here. Longjing is a circular spring pool that never dries up in severe drought. Ancient people believed that this spring was connected to the sea and contained dragons, hence the name Longjing. About 500 meters away from Longjing, there is Longjing Temple in Luohuiwu, commonly known as Old Longjing. It was founded in the Later Han Dynasty of the Five Dynasties and was originally named Baoguo Kanjingyuan. During the Northern Song Dynasty, it was renamed Shoushengyuan. During the Southern Song Dynasty, it was renamed Guangfuyuan and Yan'en Yanqing Temple. In the third year of the Ming Dynasty's Zhengtong reign (1438), it was relocated to Jingpan, and now the temple has been abandoned and is secluded as a tea room. The water of Longjing Spring is composed of two parts: groundwater and surface water. The proportion of groundwater is relatively high, so groundwater is below and surface water is above. If a rod is used to stir the spring water in the well, the spring water below will flip to the surface. Forming a circle of dividing water lines, when the underground spring water sinks again, the dividing water lines gradually shrink until they disappear, which is very interesting.

It follows the waves for thousands of miles, where is the spring river without moonlight... The river and sky are one color without dust, and the moon shines alone in the sky. Who first sees the moon on the riverbank, and when does the river moon shine on people..." Without noisy tourists or various different observers, under the reflection of the lights on both sides, a cruise ship can also carry a quiet and high-end atmosphere. Full text 

shortFeatures: Historical town, base area during the Anti-Japanese War
summary: Liangnong is a famous historical and cultural town in Zhejiang Province. During the Anti-Japanese War, it was the heart of Siming Mountain revolutionary base area. Historically, it was also an important post station of Tang poetry road in eastern Zhejiang, where many poets such as Li Bai and Pi Rixiu stopped. There are historical sites such as Wuguilou, Song Tomb Stone Carving, Horseshoe Street, and revolutionary sites such as the Memorial Hall of East Zhejiang Base Area, the former site of the New Fourth Army East Zhejiang Column Headquarters, and Simingshan Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery in the town. Nature and humanities complement each other. Liangnong Town, it is said that two ancestors surnamed Liang and Feng first settled here. Originally known as Liang Feng, it somehow became Liangnong. It is an ancient town with a history of more than 1,000 years. Liang Nong, with winding alleys, gurgling water, green tiles and brown eaves, and ninety-nine alleys are all open. She is like aged wine, and you must taste it carefully before you can know its mellow fragrance. Enter the ancient town and go eastbound along "Zhengmeng Street". Although it is a new street, you only feel the ancient wind blowing on your face. This street is built in the style of Ming and Qing Dynasties, and intersects with the old streets in the town. There are mostly two-or three-story houses along the street, with scattered eaves and gables, echoing the second library in eastern Zhejiang. And the century-old town central primary school is nearby, as if deliberately showing off its quaint style and long history to people. After walking dozens of meters, turn right, and it is an old street before liberation. In this ancient street, you can see the complete living customs of the mountain township in the south of the Yangtze River, and at the same time, you can appreciate the elegant style of the mountain township figures. On a street, there are many sheep-killing workshops "Yangtao", noodle-making workshops, soju workshops, etc. There are also old shop counters that are still open to welcome guests, etc., all of which condense the social culture of Jiangnan Mountain Township. Walking into the old houses in the old street, you can still see people sleeping in ancient beds, hanging century-old banners, and even eating bowls are not short. They seem to live in the past history. Nowadays, most of the people living in the old streets in the town are elderly people, and letting them still live here seems to be a measure taken to protect the old houses in the old streets. Go to the end of the old street and turn left to the former site of the guerrilla column headquarters in eastern Zhejiang of the New Fourth Army. The former headquarters site is located in "Xiaoyuanhe" in Liangnong, and it is a key cultural relics protection unit in Yuyao City. The former headquarters site was renovated to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the founding of the base area. In March, 1993, the historical materials exhibition room of the East Zhejiang Column of the New Fourth Army was established, displaying more than 30 revolutionary historical relics, more than 160 historical photos and more than 10 charts.

tagNameList: Ancient Towns; Memorial Temples; Nighttime sightseeing
summary: Cicheng Ancient County is located in the northern suburbs of Ningbo. The city retains the layout of the county town and a large number of Ming and Qing Dynasty ancient buildings. Walking around the city, you can see quaint courtyards everywhere, and occasionally large mansions and deep courtyards. It is a comfortable and quiet ancient city. Don't miss out on the high-quality and affordable specialty snacks here, among which Cicheng Nian Gao, which has been featured on CCTV, is more famous. Entering Guxian City from the tourist center on the east side, you will first pass by Feng Yu's residence. The poem "The Wanderer's Song" displayed outside the ancient residence straightforwardly reveals that Cicheng is the hometown of filial piety. The Feng Yu Mansion is also one of the large-scale and well preserved ancient architectural complexes in Ningbo, with exhibitions such as the Seat Culture Exhibition, Huishan Clay Figure Exhibition, Jingdezhen Blue and White Porcelain Exhibition, etc. It is worth visiting the buildings of the Feng Yu Mansion alone. The Jinjiajing Lane on the west side of Feng Yu's residence, from east to west, is home to the Buzhengfang, Fuzi Mentou, and Jiadi Shijia, all of which are typical Ming and Qing architecture. Turning south to Zhuxiang East Road, you can see the Lingxing Gate of the Confucian Temple. It is the only well preserved Confucian temple in eastern Zhejiang, with some ancestral halls and inscriptions, where you can experience the Confucian atmosphere. Going north along Jiefang Road, at the end is the Cicheng Ancient County Government Office. The ancient county government office is very large and has now been integrated into the Qingfeng Garden Scenic Area. Inside, wax figures have been used to restore the original scene of the county government office. What leaves a deep impression on people is a copper coin shaped gate, which gives them a feeling of "entering the eyes of money" when entering. Inside are statues of corrupt officials from various dynasties and three guillotine knives of dragons, tigers, and dogs, which are gloomy and intimidating. The Chenghuang Temple on the west side of the county government is an interesting place in the whole ancient county. There is a Cicheng Rice Cake Shop inside, which not only displays the production process of rice cakes with physical objects and pictures, but also offers a taste of Cicheng Rice Cake that has been featured on CCTV programs if you are hungry. Walking to the north of Guxian City is Cihu Lake, with water tombs, Dong Xiaozi Well, Shigu Pavilion and other landscapes along the lake. To the east of the lake, there is an exhibition about the imperial examination system at the School Scholar Hall. The scenery along the lake is great, you can take a nap here for a while. The Zoumalou Restaurant and Baoshantang Bar by the lake have antique architecture, where you can go eat something and also visit the buildings. There are also many snacks and noodle shops on the street for dining. On your return journey, you will go south along the Taihu Lake Road and pass by the gate of Feng Yue's painting platform. The mother's art exhibition here can visit and experience needlework art such as Chinese knots and Paper Cuttings. Going south along the moat outside the city, you can reach the Qingdao Temple. This scenic spot is slightly further away, on a small hill where you can climb up and enjoy the scenery. Those interested in Taoism can come and take a look. Full text 

tagNameList: Experience slow living; a hidden gem for kids.
shortFeatures: Famous Forest Hot Springs in East China
summary:
The commonly known "Tianming Mountain Nanxi Hot Spring" is a natural "Oxygen Valley" in Ningbo, and one of China's three major famous hot springs.  
With a water temperature of around 49.5°C, it is rich in various beneficial minerals and trace elements, making it a rare mid-temperature hot spring with a sodium bicarbonate water quality in China, regarded as a "unique gem in the Yangtze River Delta."  
Surrounded by peaks, the scenic area boasts a beautiful natural environment and is a comprehensive resort that integrates natural attractions, hot spring spas, outdoor activities, and gourmet food.  
The average temperature in summer is 3-5°C lower than in the city, making it an ideal place for leisure, cooling off, and escaping the heat.

Maojiabu is a scenic spot developed in recent years, located near Yanggongdi. Except for holidays, there are not many tourists on weekdays. Named after the thatched roofs covering the village entrance and the wild charm during the Ming and Qing dynasties, this place is also the starting point of the famous "Shangxiang Ancient Road" and a necessary route for Hangzhou pilgrims to travel from the city to India to offer incense. Rural tourism and wetlands are the key words of Maojiabu. The century old Shangxiang Ancient Road connects West Lake with the villages in this area, making it an ideal destination for tourists to explore the ancient world. Maojiabu is divided into upper and lower parts, separated by Longjing Road in the middle. On the west side of Longjing Road is Shangmaojiabu, where there are more concentrated places for eating and drinking tea; The former residence of Du Jinsheng located in Xiamaojiabu is also worth a visit. The closer way to nature here is to watch birds on the waterfront. There are few tourists on the south bank of Maojiabu, and the reed marshes are dense. Birds that come to winter here like to build nests here. High magnification telescopes and telephoto lenses are excellent tools for bird watching. Full text 

shortFeatures: Climb Mount Wu and look up at the bright moon
summary: Chenghuang Pavilion (Hangzhou New West Lake Ten Scenic Spots Wu Shantian Scenic Area) is located at the top of Wu Shan, which is the general name of several hills such as Qibao Mountain, Ziyang Mountain and Yunju Mountain. Chenghuang Pavilion, an antique pavilion-style building with seven floors underground, is 41.6 meters high, dazzling and rich. It integrates the architectural styles of Yuan and Ming temples, focuses on the big picture and outlines the details, and wins the rivers, mountains, lakes and cities of Hangzhou.

Nafu Yuntai is located in Hangzhou and is a tourist attraction that combines natural scenery and cultural experience. This place attracts numerous tourists with its unique cloud sea landscape and rich cultural activities.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

summary: The Grand Canal (Hangzhou section) is the southernmost end of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal. Over thousands of years of history, it has integrated the unique products, cuisine, clothing, customs, and etiquette of various regions in northern and southern China, forming the canal cultural landscape represented by the "Ten Scenic Spots of the Canal". Caofang boats are the "tide" boats of the Hangzhou Grand Canal. Today's Caozao boats integrate historical ship elements of the canal with modern science and technology, and are an important carrier of modern canal tourism. Starting from Wulinmen Pier, taking Caofang boats all the way north can appreciate the unique scenery along the Grand Canal heritage line, such as Jiangqiao Muyu, Xiangji Fanyin, Fuyi Liuyu, Gongchen Yaoyue, and Qiaoxi Renjia. You can experience the slow life of Hangzhou by taking a boat ride. Canal water tourism represented by boats and boats, including canal tours, night tours, ancient town tours, and red transportation tours, is favored by citizens and tourists.

shortFeatures: Visit the Canal Museum
summary:
Gongchen Bridge, which is connected to Lishui Road and Taizhou Road in the east, Qiaonong Street and Xiaohe Road in the west, is the tallest and longest stone arch bridge among ancient bridges in Hang Cheng. The bridge is 98 meters long and 16 meters high. The middle section of the bridge deck is slightly narrower and 5.9 meters wide, while the bridge ends at both ends are 12.2 meters wide. The three-hole thin-pier coupled arch hump bridge has a clear span of 11.9 meters on the side hole, 15.8 meters on the middle hole, and a stone thickness of 30 cm on the arch coupon. It adopts a wooden pile foundation structure, and the arch coupon is built in longitudinal sections and side by side. 
This is a very rich bridge. Standing on the bridge seems to feel history rolling in like a river. At the same time, it is also the starting point of the southern section of the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal.

The Zhejiang Provincial Museum is located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. It is the largest comprehensive humanities museum in Zhejiang Province, with a rich collection of historical relics, artworks, natural specimens, etc., showcasing the historical culture and social development of the Zhejiang region.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year (closed at 16:30 and closed on Mondays)

summary: The Yuewang Temple is located at the northwest corner of West Lake, opposite Quyuan Fenghe, and is a place to commemorate the national hero Yue Fei. The tomb of Yue Fei and his son, as well as the kneeling statue of Qin Hui, who has been kneeling in front of the tomb for thousands of years, and four other treacherous officials, make people's hearts surge. In addition, the exhibition hall also displays historical materials about the life of General Yue Fei, which can reveal his life of being "loyal and devoted to the country". Entering the main entrance of the Yuewang Temple scenic area, there is a square courtyard, with the main building of the Yuewang Temple, the Martyrs' Shrine, directly in front of it. The main hall is dedicated to Yue Fei, and there is a plaque with the four characters "Heart Shines on the Heavenly Sun" hanging on the door, which is very solemn. Entering the main hall, one is greeted by a full body portrait of Yue Fei dressed in military attire, with his oath hanging high above his head, 'Return my country'. The murals on the walls around the main hall record the life of Yue Fei, among which the classic "Mother in law tattooed" is widely circulated. On both sides of the main hall, there are two generals of Yue Fei, Niu Gao and Zhang Xian, enshrined. After visiting the main hall, return to the courtyard, walk west through the stele corridor, cross the Jingzhong Bridge, and arrive at the tomb area. Here, one large and one small are the tombs of Yue Fei and his son Yue Yun. Facing the tomb of Yue is an archway, with a pair of iron statues of treacherous officials kneeling on either side of the door. They face the tomb of Yue Fei, kneeling to plead guilty to him. On the left are Qin Xian and his wife Wang. In the past, people came here not only to admire national heroes, but also to spit in front of these two kneeling statues. Nowadays, spitting is no longer allowed, and there are signs hanging on the wall next to it that read 'Civilized tourism, no spitting'. The entire Yuewang Temple is not large, but the ancient trees are towering. It is not far from the cemetery to return to the main entrance of the Yuewang Temple, and the entire tour time is about one hour. Full text 

Drum Tower, also known as Haishu Tower, is the only remaining ancient city tower site in Ningbo city. Its lower part is in the traditional Chinese style of a city tower, while above it is a Roman style bell tower, with a unique blend of Chinese and Western styles. Nowadays, the area around Gulou is an antique pedestrian shopping district, and Ningbo specialty snacks such as Youzan Zi are worth trying. Nowadays, the Drum Tower and the surrounding Park Road area have become the gathering places for major cultural activities in Ningbo. Art exhibitions, calligraphy exhibitions, and photo exhibitions are often held inside the tower. On both sides of the road are shops imitating the traditional architectural style of Ningbo, with small blue tile double slope roofs, wind and fire horse head walls, and various exquisite exterior wood decorations, which not only have the style of Ningbo's traditional commercial street, but also have a strong historical and cultural texture. The two ancient stone memorial archway at the entrance of the east and west ends, the ruins of the city wall, the stone monument of Zicheng's historical changes, and the Yongfengku Site Park near the Drum Tower can provide you with a detailed reading of Ningbo's history. At night, the Drum Tower area is very popular, and when the landscape lights are on, it is particularly suitable for taking night shots.

shortFeatures: Visiting the footprints of Jiang Gong and his family
summary:
The former residences of Chiang Kai-shek and Jiang Jingguo, the fourth batch of national key cultural relics protection units, important historical sites and representative buildings in modern times. 
The former residence is a group building, which includes Fenggao House, Small House, Yutai Salt Shop, etc. The bureau is a traditional front hall and back hall, with two hatchbacks and four halls. 
The building is connected with the building, with ink pillars and ochre walls, which is magnificent. There are three gardens in the front hall and left and right, and there are also Jiang's ancestral hall and Jiang's mother's cemetery in the garden. 
The corridor of the hall is covered with carved colorful paintings, and there are plaques written by Chiang Kai-shek in the newspaper hall, "Newspaper respects relatives is the moral important way" and "Being reasonable and handsome".
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

shortFeatures: Also known as "Xixi Xiaozhu"
summary: This three-room two-story small villa was built in 1930. Because of its small structure, the building material cement used is also called "foreign ash", so it is named "small villa", also known as "Shanxi Xiaozhu" and "Hanzhai". It is located on the east side of Wenchang Pavilion, and there is an open-air corridor connecting Wenchang Pavilion. It is mainly built for Chiang Kai-shek to call his close aides when he lives in Wenchang Pavilion. In April, 1937, Jiang Jingguo returned from studying in the Soviet Union, and Chiang Kai-shek arranged for him to live and study here. While tutoring Chinese, studying Zeng Guofan's letters from home, Wang Yangming's complete works and "Chinese Language Legacy" and other works, he asked him to write the Report on Russia, reflect on the red brand he made when studying in the Soviet Union, and "brainwash" his son. Jiang Jingguo described it as "Hanzhai" in his diary, and slightly ridiculously compared it to "a study to cultivate body and mind and increase self-cultivation". When Jiang Jingguo lived and studied, upstairs was the bedroom in the east, the study in the west and the living room in the middle. The small villa also lived in Duan Na, Chiang Kai-shek's foreign military adviser, and Chen Bulei, director of the attendant's office. On the first floor of the small villa, there is a stone tablet "washing blood with blood", which tells the history of the death of Jiang Jingguo's mother Mao Fumei. On December 12th, 1939, Japanese invaders' planes bombed Xikou, and Mao Fumei was unfortunately crushed to death by the collapsed back wall at the back door of Fenggao House. After hearing the news, Jiang Jingguo hurried from Jiangxi to attend the funeral, and wrote the four characters "Wash blood with blood" in tears in grief and anger, expressing his firm determination to avenge his mother's killing.

Due to its geographical advantage, Wenchang Pavilion has become a scenic spot in Xikou Town. It is located at the southern end of Wushan, on the bank of Shanxi River, overlooking the southern mountains of the river, overlooking a three mile long street, and facing the wind on all sides, creating a beautiful scenery. The Wenchang Pavilion was first built in the ninth year of the Yongzheng reign of the Qing Dynasty (1731). Due to the worship of the first Kui star inside the pavilion, it is also known as the "Kui Pavilion" and is known as the "Kui Pavilion Lingxiao". It is one of the ten scenic spots in Xikou during the Qing Dynasty.

Yutai Salt Shop was established by Jiang Siqian in 1871 and later inherited by Jiang Zhaocong. After Jiang Zhaocong's death, his brothers separated and the salt shop was managed by Jiang Jieqing. In 1919, Jiang Jieqing went out to seek trouble and the salt shop was closed. There are currently three buildings, three bungalows, and ancillary buildings such as kitchens and toilets.

The Xuedou Mountain Giant Buddha Scenic Area, also known as Xuedou Temple, is the Maitreya Dojo at the foot of Xuedou Mountain. The temple is relatively new and has a large scale. The huge open-air Maitreya Buddha statue in the temple can be regarded as a prominent landmark in the Xikou Scenic Area, and many places can be seen from afar. Walking in front of the Buddha and embracing his feet to experience good fortune is also a favored experience for tourists and pilgrims. Apart from the open-air Maitreya Temple, there are no special landscapes that cannot be missed in Xuedou Temple. You just need to relax and take a stroll in it, and you will enjoy it very much. You can buy tickets to visit Xuedou Temple alone, but most tourists will directly purchase a package ticket for Xuedou Mountain Scenic Area, along with the scenic spots such as Miaogao Platform and Qianzhang Rock on Xuedou Mountain. This not only provides a richer experience, but also a more reasonable route and more cost-effective price. Miaoxiangzhai is the vegetarian restaurant of Xuedou Temple, and tourists can also come here for meals. We had a buffet, and you can add your own after finishing.
opening_hours: Open at 08:30-16:30(Tickets available until 15:00; admission ends at 15:00)

shortFeatures: The old street maintains the style of hundreds of years ago
summary:
Hanling Old Street is known as "the first ancient street in eastern Zhejiang". Hanling Village has a long history. It is said that it was named after the Han surname lived here in its early years. 
There are two old streets in Hanling, namely the front street and the back street, which run through the whole village. Commerce and trade are concentrated in Qianjie, with a total length of more than 500 meters, which is divided into Xiajie, Middle Street and Shangjie. More than 30 shops in the village are mostly concentrated in the lower street, and there is a street stream flowing slowly in the middle of the lower street. The whole street used to be paved with blue-black cobblestones, but now it is a cement road. 
The old street still maintains the style of hundreds of years ago: there are all two-story buildings on both sides, gray tiles and white walls, and red paint facades, one room after another, stretching forward, using the place names left by the market of that year, such as bamboo shed roots, firewood fields, etc. There is also a small manhole in the village. The well water is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a hint of sweetness. Although there is tap water in the village, the villagers still like to eat the water from the small manhole.

shortFeatures: Combine nostalgia, leisure and entertainment
summary:
Taogong Island Scenic Spot is the seclusion place of Fan Li and Xi Shi, and Taogong Island is the most auspicious and romantic place in Ningbo.  
Taogong Island Scenic Spot integrates nostalgia, leisure and entertainment, among which the ancestral court of the God of Wealth is the only in the world, the dragon boat entertainment is the only in Ningbo, the picnic barbecue is the first in Ningbo, and the delicious taste of Taogong is the best in Ningbo. 
The main landscapes of Taogong Island Scenic Area are: Ruyi Gate, Caishen Ancestral Court, Wulu Caishen Temple, Jiutai Da Yuanbao, etc. It is the most popular place for tourism and leisure in Ningbo and Dongqian Lake Tourist Resort.

shortFeatures: Explore Jiang's former residence and enjoy wood carvings and colorful paintings
summary: Fenggaofang, the former residence of Jiang's family, is the most important cultural landscape in Xikou Town. Fenggaofang, also known as Suju, is named because the Jiang family believed in Buddhism and ate vegetarianism for generations. Fenghao House covers an area of 4,800 square meters, with a building area of 1,850 square meters. The architectural pattern is the front hall and the back hall, two hatchbacks and four corridors, which is a traditional family mansion pattern. There are also three gardens in the front hall and left and right, which are connected by the moon cave gate. There is a small patio in the middle, with a gold and silver osmanthus on both sides, which was planted by Song Meiling himself. There are also three highlights in Fenggao House, namely carving, colorful painting and stacking sculptures. Entering the front hall, you can see the pile of plastics in the middle of the roof, with "Fu Lu Shou Samsung Gao Zhao" in the middle and "Double Dragons Playing Pearls" on both sides. The Baobentang, where Chiang Kai-shek worships ancestors and worships heaven, is the core of the whole building of Fenggaofang.

Dujuan Valley Parent Child Park is positioned as a "fun forest, wilderness study tour" with the design principles of "ecology, love, interaction, and enjoyment of learning". It takes common ecological elements in nature - mountains, forests, water, and valleys - as the landscape and interactive experience basis, creating a mountain ecological characteristic micro vacation destination that integrates "forest exploration experience+ecological nature protection"
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

summary: Lomeng Universal Park, located in the southern new city of Ningbo, is one of the largest urban indoor theme parks in the world. Luomeng Universal Park consists of a dome-shaped indoor park with a height of about 57.4 meters and an outdoor legendary island. The park is planned to have six theme areas: Romantic Avenue, Dream World, Mysterious Continent, Adventure Tour, Happy Square and Legendary Island, with more than 30 amusement facilities, nearly 30 specialty restaurants and more than 20 theme shops.

The Feilaifeng Statue is located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, with over 380 statues. In 1982, the Feilaifeng Statue was announced as the second batch of national key cultural relics protection units. In 2006, the sixth batch of national key cultural relics protection units was announced, and the statues of West Lake Nanshan (including the statues of Ciyunling, Yanxia Cave, and Tianlong Temple) were included in the statues of Feilai Peak.

The Maitreya Buddha statue is located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. It is a huge statue of Maitreya Buddha, symbolizing compassion and tolerance. This Buddha statue is not only a symbol of religious belief, but also an important cultural landmark in the Hangzhou area.
opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

summary: The Songcheng Qing Bridge is located within the Songcheng Scenic Area in Hangzhou and is a bridge full of romantic atmosphere. The design of the bridge incorporates the architectural style of the Song Dynasty, and is decorated with various sculptures and decorations with love themes, making it a popular spot for couples to take photos and take pictures.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 21:00 throughout the year

shortFeatures: The mountain peaks are surrounded by clouds and mist, and the scenery at the foot of the
summary: Twin peaks insert clouds, one of the ten scenic spots of West Lake. The so-called double peaks refer to the south peak and the north peak, which are a branch of the remaining veins of Tianmu Mountain. When they meet the West Lake, they are divided into Nanshan and Beishan. On a beautiful day in spring and autumn, the mist is white, and the spire of the tower enters the clouds, sometimes hiding and sometimes showing, and it looks like a fairyland in the distance.

The ancient city wall of Suzhou is an important component of Suzhou's ancient city, with a long history and witnessing the changes and development of Suzhou. The city wall was first built in the Spring and Autumn period and has undergone multiple repairs, still retaining some of its original appearance to this day. The ancient city wall is not only a symbol of Suzhou, but also an important physical material for studying the defense system of ancient Chinese cities.
opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 17:00 throughout the year
