shortFeatures: Rich and diverse brick and wood carvings
summary:
Chongtang is located in the north of Changqing Bridge in Fuguan Street. It faces south and is built facing the water. It faces Jiayin Hall across the river in the east and is connected with Changqing Bridge and other three bridges in the west. Neat stone revetment guards this quaint mansion. If Tongli is compared to a museum of ancient buildings, then Chongbentang is an exquisitely carved work of art in this museum. Its exquisite skills and profound connotation make every visitor amazed. The most attractive thing about Chongbentang is, of course, its various carvings.  
Above the gatehouse, there are wood-like flying rafters, bucket arches, stone thresholds, doors and windows, all of which show the carving skills. The contents of woodcarvings in Chongbentang are different, the pictures are simple and lively, the composition is lively, and the knife skills are round and skillful. From "The Story of the West Chamber" to "A Dream of Red Mansions", then to "Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea", or from "Flowers Bogu" to "Carp Jumping into the Dragon Gate", Chongbentang has brought carving to the extreme, even the details of every threshold and door latch Not let go, every inch is a story. Each side reveals the beautiful meaning of peace, wealth, and good fortune.

The main building of Jiayin Hall imitates the structure of Ming Dynasty, commonly known as "Shamao Hall". It is named because the wood at the head of the beam resembles the wings of the official hat of the Ming Dynasty. The courtyard is tall, spacious, solemn and solemn. The center of both sides of the five beams is engraved with "Eight Horses", and the two ends of the beams are engraved with "Phoenix Wearing Peony". The bottom of the beam is engraved with patterns such as "satisfaction" and "must be a high school". What's even more rare is that eight plays in Romance of the Three Kingdoms, such as "Ancient City Club, Three British Battles against Lu Bu", are engraved on the "Shamaowing" (that is, Liangtou Zhaomu), which are vivid and ready to come out.

Chen Qubing's former residence is a simple and ordinary residence in the Qing Dynasty, covering an area of 1,364 square meters. Above the lintel, there is an original plaque of "Filial Piety and Old Business". When you enter the door, you can see buildings such as half a pavilion, old ancestral hall, 100-foot building and Haoge Hall. After the vicissitudes of wind and rain, the wall is almost dilapidated. There is a one-month cave door facing east, and the words "Green Jade Qingyao Pavilion" on the frieze are already mossy and slightly green. According to the records, the Green Jade Qingyao Pavilion was first built in 1932, more than 60 years ago. 
Chen Qubing (1874-1933) was a modern poet and one of the founders of Nanshe. Formerly known as Qinglin, the courtesy name is Peiren, and the name is Chuihong Pavilion Chief. Native of Tongli, Wujiang, Jiangsu. My ancestors got rich by running oil pressing industry. Because of reading "The Xiongnu is not destroyed, why do you want to be at home?", I resolutely changed my name to "Go sick". In his early years, he participated in the League, followed Dr. Sun Yat-sen, and spared no effort to publicize the revolution. He made important contributions in the Revolution of 1911 that overthrew the Manchu monarchy and the crusade against Yuan Shikai. His poems mostly express patriotic passion, and their style is vigorous and tragic. In 1923, he served as a professor in the Chinese Department of National Southeast University (changed to Central University in 1928 and Nanjing University in 1949). After 1928, he served as the curator of Jiangsu Revolutionary Museum and the chairman of Jiangsu Branch of Antiquities Custody Committee of University College. In 1933, he died of illness in his hometown Tongli Town.

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Enjoy autumn leaves
shortFeatures: Mysterious caves and canyons
summary: Tiantong Forest Park is based on the scenic spots of Taibai Mountain, such as Linglong Tiancou, Donggu Qiuhong, Nanshan Wancui and Taibai Yunsheng. In 1981, the Ministry of Forestry and the County Forestry Bureau jointly established a forest park, covering an area of 333 hectares, and it is one of the three forest parks in China. There are lush trees in the garden and many original ecological vegetation. There are many trees embracing each other, and the pavilions are all quaint, combining primitive wild interest with exquisite gardens. The stone paths in the garden are horizontal and inclined, and there are more than ten landscapes along the way, such as Tingtao Pavilion, Guanyin Cave and Shuiyue Pavilion, each with its own legendary background. There are newly built Taibailou Restaurant and Linglong Pavilion Guest House.

Tiantong Temple is located at the foot of Taibai Mountain, 26 kilometers away from Ningbo. Its history can be traced back to the Jin Dynasty and it is one of the famous thousand year old temples in Ningbo. There are not many tourists and pilgrims coming here, and monks can often be seen walking or meditating in the temple. Even if you don't have a Buddhist faith, experiencing the religious atmosphere and breathing fresh air is still a great experience. Unlike other temples, Tiantong Temple has three mountain gates. Walking up the tree lined path, you will pass through Fuhu Pavilion, Gushan Gate, and Jingqian Pavilion in sequence. From a distance, you can see the Ten Thousand Buddha Pagoda on the mountain. Because the temple is located next to Tiantong National Forest Park, the scenery along the way is very beautiful, with green everywhere. Further ahead, walking past the seven stone towers of Seven Pagodas Garden, you will arrive at Wangong Pool. The two pools here used to be release ponds, but now there are still many released turtles in one pond. The four characters "Southeast Buddhist Kingdom" are written on the screen wall opposite the Wangong Pool, and the surrounding trees and temple buildings reflect beautifully in the pool water, attracting many tourists to take photos here. There are many pigeons on the nearby square, scrambling for the food thrown by tourists. Enter the temple and walk up the mountain. The main buildings on the central axis are Buddha Hall, Dharma Hall (Sutra Pavilion), and Arhat Hall. The grand buildings are connected by long corridors. Therefore, entering the temple can "keep the sun off in sunny days, and keep the road wet in rainy days". The oldest buildings in the temple today are the Buddhist Hall and the Abbot's Hall, which were renovated during the Ming Dynasty and are quaint and solemn. On the west side of the Dharma Hall, there is a gilded bronze statue of a pharmacist bestowed by Emperor Shunzhi. The East Zen Hall is now a collection exhibition room, displaying some Buddhist relics. One must not miss is the Arhat Hall on the north side, where the stone carvings of Luohan are very exquisite, and the figures are naturally mature and full of charm. Climbing to a higher place, Yingzhen Pavilion offers a panoramic view of the temple and the surrounding mountain scenery, with a very open field of vision. There are many monuments around the pavilion, mostly erected by Japanese Buddhist groups and figures. Many pilgrims and tourists rest, enjoy the scenery, and take photos here. Go down the mountain and return to the "Southeast Buddhist Kingdom" Zhaobi. Take the small path next to the Zhaobi and turn left. Not far away is the Thousand Buddha Pagoda. There is a sign near the pagoda that reads "Ancient Heavenly Child". After walking along a relatively quiet path, you can reach the ancient Tiantong deep in the bamboo forest. A more regular itinerary is to visit Tiantong Temple in the morning, take a break at noon, continue hiking at Tiantong National Forest Park in the afternoon, and then take a car back to the city of Ningbo. Full text 

shortFeatures: High quality indoor and outdoor hot springs at the same time
summary:
Located on the bank of Dongqian Lake, at the foot of Erling Mountain, it has a beautiful scenery with the same color of lakes and mountains, beautiful mountains and beautiful waters, and clean wind and smoke, which makes it feel like a paradise. 
It has the largest indoor and outdoor open-air hot springs in eastern Zhejiang. The hot spring water is introduced from the natural geothermal spring of Erling Mountain, which is weakly alkaline and belongs to sodium bicarbonate spring, commonly known as "baking soda spring". This spring quality is known as "Beauty Soup" in Japan and Taiwan Province, and it is the best among hot springs.

Xikou, along the wide Shanxi River, is nestled against the picturesque Xuedou Mountain with waterfalls and streams, making it a popular tourist destination. Nowadays, the Xikou Scenic Area includes two main scenic spots, the former residence of the Jiang family and Xuedou Mountain, which are worth spending 1-2 days exploring. The two ticket offices in the scenic area are located at Wulingmen (the entrance of Jiang's hometown) in Xikou Town, and at the tourist distribution center at the junction of the two scenic areas on the west side. The tourism supporting facilities in Xikou Scenic Area are very complete, with green tourism buses running back and forth between Xikou Bus Station, Wulingmen, and Tourist Distribution Center. You can take a bus to the tourist distribution center to go to the Xuedou Mountain scenic area, where you can transfer to the green sightseeing bus (included in the Xuedou Mountain scenic area and unified ticket, unlimited rides) to San Yin Tan, and then start your tour of Xuedou Mountain. Schedule: If this is your first time visiting Xikou, it is recommended to schedule 2 days. The recommended itinerary is to arrive at Xikou at noon on the first day and visit Xuedou Mountain and Xuedou Temple in the mountains after lunch. Stay overnight in Xikou Town at night, go to Jiang's hometown the next morning, and go to Jiang's mother cemetery in the afternoon. Guide to Xuedou Mountain: It takes about half a day to visit Xuedou Mountain. The most eye-catching natural landscapes on the mountain are the streams and waters of Sanyin Lake, as well as the waterfall of Qianzhang Rock. Starting from San Yin Tan, visit the upper, middle, and lower pools in sequence (about 2 hours), then return to the original route and take a sightseeing bus to the transfer station in Xuedou Mountain to visit the attractions of Qianzhang Rock and Miaogao Terrace. After Miaogaotai, there is a regular sightseeing trail that goes downhill and is easy to walk. Not long after, you can walk to the Snow Dou Temple at the foot of the mountain. The temple is relatively new, but you can take a rough look. There is a very eye-catching open-air Buddha here, and many tourists are "embracing the Buddha's feet" here seeking peace. There is also a green sightseeing bus stop at the entrance of Xuedou Temple, where you can take a bus back to the town. This arrangement is a reasonable gameplay for Xuedou Mountain, which not only allows you to enjoy the highlights of the mountain, but also the entire downhill journey without turning back. Jiang's Former Residence Guide: The next morning, start visiting the Jiang's Former Residence scenic area from Wulingmen. The main attractions here are arranged along the Wuling Road pedestrian street by the Shanxi River, and you can walk around. Worth seeing are Wuling School, Xiaoyangfang, and Wenchang Pavilion near the entrance. Among them, Wenchang Pavilion is located on Wushan Mountain, which was once the villa of Jiang Song and now hangs paintings by Soong Mei ling. In addition, Fenghao House near Jingtang Road is the place where Mr. Jiang married Mao Fumei. The plaques, couplets, carvings, and sculptures inside are also worth paying attention to. The Yutai Salt Shop to the west is the place where Mr. Jiang was born, with the words "Qinglu" engraved on the door. It should be noted that some small paths in the scenic area lead to the streets outside, so be careful not to leave the scenic area when visiting. Tickets are only valid once. The tomb of Jiang's mother is located at the junction of two scenic spots and is included in the entrance ticket for the Jiang's former residence scenic area. The cemetery consists of the Jiang Mu tomb passage and the Dujuan Valley, with beautiful scenery. There is a tomb hut at the entrance, which used to be Mr. Jiang's residence and had his handwritten couplets. Now it is a small exhibition room. The carvings on the tomb passage of Jiang Mu are exquisite, and the view of Dujuan Valley is wide. The lush forests and lawns make people feel relaxed and happy. Full text 

shortFeatures: A place where local people conduct clan activities
summary: Jiang's Ancestral Hall is a traditional place for Jiang's clan activities in Xikou, where ancestor worship, celebration, wedding and funeral are all held. Here, it enshrines the ancestors of the Jiang family since the ancestor of Jiang Shijie moved to Xikou at the end of the Yuan Dynasty. The family history of more than 600 years is condensed here. The words "Loyalty and Filial Piety" on the horizontal plaque on the archway at the entrance of the ancestral temple are written by Chiang Kai-shek, which entrusts Chiang Kai-shek's expectation for Jiang's younger generation and shows his own admiration for the Confucian tradition. The ancestral hall is composed of two new and old ancestral halls, with a total area of 3,000 square meters and a building area of 1,800 square meters. Qianjin is a new ancestral hall, which was funded and built by Chiang Kai-shek in 1930. The east wing of the new ancestral hall displays historical materials about Chiang's ancestral hall, as well as pictures of Taiwan Province knowledge jointly produced by the Taiwan Affairs Office and the Information Office of the State Council, which systematically introduces the history of Taiwan Province, cross-strait relations, the Communist Party of China (CPC) 's principles and policies towards Taiwan, etc. It is an old ancestral hall in the back, which was rebuilt in the 55th year of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty. The stage is connected to the middle gate, with double eaves at the top of the mountain and spirulina well. Chiang Kai-shek once worshipped ancestors here, entertained his clansmen, read genealogy and watched performances. The funerals of Chiang Kai-shek's brothers Jiang Jieqing and Yuan Pei Mao Fumei were also held here.

Pingyao Old Street has a history of more than 20 years. After renovation, Pingyao Old Street still retains the style of the 1970s and 1980s. shortFeatures: It was Xu Shiyuan's private garden in the early Qing Dynasty
summary: Hongyinshan House, located 200 meters east of Yanjia Garden, is a famous garden in the suburbs of Suzhou during the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty. Because the door faces Xiangxi and is backed by Lingyan, "the beauty of the wind and moon in the mountains and the victory of flowers and trees in the pond pavilion" is far superior to other gardens. Therefore, every time Emperor Qianlong went to the south of the Yangtze River to visit Mudu, he would go to Hongyinshan House, where he visited the garden, watched the theatre, tasted tea and recited poems. Therefore, Hongyinshan House is also known as the "folk palace" of Emperor Qianlong in the local area. It is a municipal cultural relics protection unit.

shortFeatures: Take a cup of tea, look at the sea and listen to the waves
summary: Huangcheng Beach is located in the northeast of Shipu City, Xiangshan Mountain, facing the sea in the east, Tianchou in the west, and connected with mountains at both ends of the northeast. The beach head is gentle, and the sand is moderately soft and hard. The beach is more than 1,800 meters long and 300 meters wide, and it is like a crescent moon. When it starts, the waves are overwhelming, as cool as a city wall surging rapidly on the sea, and its momentum is as huge as the beach on the east coastline of Zhejiang; When the air is flat, the ripples meet the sky, and the flexibility is infinite, which can be used by Xi Shi to wash yarn. There are the main venue of China Fishing Festival with more than 10,000 fixed seats, ornamental standard berms costing 10 million yuan, and leisure and entertainment facilities. You can jump on the mount and ride your horse to gallop; You can also drink a cup of tea, look at the sea and listen to the waves; You can pounce into the sea and show your skills. The "March 3rd, Stepping on the Beach" activity with profound cultural heritage, the annual China Fishing Festival sea sacrifice ceremony, maritime stunt performances and other activities make the Huangcheng Beach crowded and lively, attracting thousands of Chinese and foreign tourists to visit. In 1998, it was rated as one of the new ten scenic spots in Ningbo.

Yushan has beautiful scenery, with its southeast foothills extending into Changshu City, earning it the reputation of "ten miles of green mountains half entering the city". Climbing is free, and only a few scenic spots on the mountain require tickets, so you can see many locals relaxing, entertaining or exercising on the mountain. Yushan runs northwest southeast, with a length of 6.5 kilometers, a width of 3 kilometers, and an altitude of 263 meters. It is named after Zhongyong (Yuzhong), the son of the Zhou ethnic group at the end of the Shang Dynasty, who gave way to his younger brother and became the ancestor of Jiangnan in the south. After his death, he was buried here. To the west of Yushan is Shidong Scenic Area, to the southwest is Baoyan Scenic Area, to the middle is Jianmen Scenic Area, to the north is Xingfu Scenic Area where Xingfu Temple is located, to the east is Yushan City Wall, and to the northeast is Yushan Park. There is a road leading to the mountaintop, which can be driven by car, and buses also run on the mountain. There are multiple entrances to the mountain. If you want to walk up the mountain, we recommend starting from Xingfu Temple, which is close to the top of the mountain. Two minutes to the right of the temple gate is the Yushan Cableway, which leads directly to the Jianmen Scenic Area. The one-way fare is 40 yuan, and the round-trip fare is 60 yuan. Xingfu Temple, also known as Po Shan Temple, was first built in the Southern Qi Dynasty. A stone tablet in the temple bears the inscription "Inscription on the Zen Temple Behind Po Shan Temple", which was frequently built in the Tang Dynasty. It was handwritten by the great calligrapher Mi Fu of the Song Dynasty. The famous line in the poem "The winding path leads to a secluded place, and the deep flowers and trees in the Zen room" describes Xingfu Temple. Temples have been repeatedly rebuilt in the 1980s, and are currently one of the larger and more famous temples in Changshu, with strong incense and praying for blessings. Don't forget to go to Xingfu Temple Noodle Shop next to you to have a bowl of plain noodles and mushroom oil noodles. There is Xingfu Temple Tea Room on the east side of the temple, and a pot of Yushan green tea is also very good. Climbing from Xingfu Temple to the Jianmen Scenic Area at the top of the mountain, you will first see the Jian Ge standing at the top of the mountain. There is a model sand table of Changshu City on the first floor, and the second floor is not open to the public. The cliff in front of the Jian Ge offers a panoramic view of another famous scenic spot in Changshu, Shanghu Lake. Further ahead, you can climb the Sword Gate, which seems to be avoided by a sword, see the cliff carvings, and visit attractions such as Zanghai Temple, Baoguo Temple, and Fushui Qingyan. The road leads all the way to the foot of the western end of Yushan Mountain. If you have had enough fun, just go back the same way. Don't go down the mountain to the west, as the scenic spots in the east are more important than those in the west. To the east, you can walk or take a bus to Guixiangyuan, which is not far from the main entrance of Jianmen Scenic Area. Along the way, passing by Weimo Mountain Villa, you can see a large tea garden. Vimo Mountain Villa was rebuilt in modern times on the site of Vimo Temple in the Song Dynasty. There is a stone well in the backyard, which is a relic of the Song Dynasty. The Wanghai Tower in the villa is a great place to watch the sunrise. Continuing on to the Yushan City Wall in the east, it is also one of the important attractions on Yushan. The city wall is a section of the ancient city wall of Changshu that enters the eastern foothills of Yushan Mountain. It was first built during the Wude period of the Tang Dynasty, and what we see now is a modern restoration based on the Ming city wall. In the middle of the city wall is the city tower Yushan Gate, which extends southwest to Xicheng Pavilion and Fucheng Gate, and northeast to Zhenhai Terrace, with a total length of 1400 meters. Walking on the city wall, one can overlook the scenery of Changshu city. Then heading northeast, you can go to Yushan Park, which is built to resemble a Jiangnan garden. Inside, there is the Yushan Park Zoo in Changshu. The zoo is not large and there are not many animal species. Yushan Park is free, but visiting the zoo requires an additional fee, with a reference price of 20 yuan. If you choose to go east from the Yushan Gate of the Yushan City Wall to the foot of the mountain, you can see the tomb of King Zhou Zhang of Wu on the way. At the eastern foot of the mountain, there is the tomb of Yanzi, a southerner disciple of Confucius. At the entrance of Yanzi's tomb, you can see several stone archways on the south side. Entering is the ancient tomb of Zhongyong, which has a history of more than 3000 years and is one of the earliest known tombs in Changshu. The abundance of tombs is also a characteristic of Yushan, representing thousands of years of history and culture in Changshu. However, these tombs are scattered throughout Yushan and require time to search for them. For example, near the Shidong Scenic Area in the west of Yushan, there is the tomb of Huang Gongwang, the tomb of Weng Tonghe (Weng Tonghe), the imperial teacher of the Qing Tongzhi and Guangxu dynasties, the tomb of Qian Qianyi at the foot of Yushan in the south, and the tomb of his lover Liu Rushi, one of the famous courtesans of Qinhuai in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties. The Shidong Scenic Area and Baoyan Scenic Area in the western part of Yushan have relatively few visitors. There are small stone caves covered with ancient vines in the Shidong Scenic Area, as well as the newly built Xiaoyunqi Temple, which was first built in the Ming and Qing dynasties. The main purpose of Baoyan Scenic Area is to experience rural tourism. In early summer, you can pick bayberries in Baoyan Ecological Sightseeing Park. The Baoyan Zen Temple in the scenic area was first built during the Tianjian period of the Southern Liang Dynasty, and what you see now is also newly built. Playing Yushan requires taking it slow. Going straight to the top and then down the mountain will make you feel like it's just a small hill, like the locals. You can see people drinking tea and calling out three to five friends to score 80 points everywhere in Yushan. You can also sit there staring at the blue sky, or buy some dried tofu with 7 or 8 flavors. While eating, you can leisurely explore the hidden small streams on the north slope of Yushan, such as Qinpo Stream, Taoyuan Stream, etc. After the rain, the spring water is gurgling, and the small waterfall surprises people. In autumn, when you meet a chestnut seller, you can buy some and share it with your friends and family. In addition, Wangsi Restaurant at the foot of the north side of Yushan Mountain can eat authentic Beggar's Chicken, and osmanthus wine is also its feature. To the south of Yushan is Shanghu Scenic Area, a classic tourist attraction in Changshu city with one mountain and one lake, which can be visited together. Full text 

The water in the pond is clear, surrounded by lush trees. When the wind blows, the scenery of rippling blue waves is beautiful, and each season has its own unique charm.

summary: Guli Ancient Town is located in the eastern suburbs of Changshu City, with white walls, black tiles, small bridges, and flowing water, exuding the charm of a Jiangnan water town. shortFeatures: Private library in the Qing Dynasty, with a rich collection of books
summary: The Tieqin Bronze Sword Building has been well-known at home and abroad for a long time. It has more than 100,000 rare manuscripts in its collection. Lou" is equally famous, and is also known as the Four Great Book Collectors of the Qing Dynasty. The library was built in the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty and has a history of more than 200 years. From the founder Qu Shaoji onwards, the five generations of Qu's book collectors are all indifferent to fame and fortune, and enjoy collecting and reading books. Qu Yong, the second generation of the Qu family and the son of Shaoji, has an eclectic mix of Ding Yi ancient seals, and especially cherishes an iron qin and a bronze sword, hence the name. This building has two floors and two floors, and the third and fourth floors are the only remaining buildings today, where the "Tieqin Bronze Sword Building" is located. The ancient building is facing south, with three syllables, separated by small patios. Every two floors, the lower eaves are supported by arches, and the exquisite Kuilong pattern is carved. The decoration shows the architectural style of southern Jiangsu. In this building at that time, the third and fourth ones were upstairs for the collection of books, the third one was downstairs for reading, and the fourth one was downstairs for the family ancestral hall, which also collected antiquities and stone carvings. Except for some of the books that were robbed, most of the books were donated by the descendants of the Qu family at the beginning of the People's Republic of China, such as Beijing Library, Shanghai Library, and Changshu Library.

shortFeatures: A classical garden with numerous historical relics.
summary:
Fangta Park, located in the eastern part of the ancient city of Changshu, has its main attraction as the Chongjiao Xingfu Temple Pagoda, originally named Chongjiao Baota and commonly known as Fangta. It was first built in the fourth year of Jianyan during the Southern Song Dynasty (1130). At that time, the monk Wen Yong proposed: "The layout of this town, with the high right and lower left, disrupts the distinction between guest and host. It should be built at the left corner of the Canglong to overcome this." The county magistrate, Li Zhishan, approved this suggestion and ordered the construction of the pagoda. By the third year of Shaoxing (1133), 150,000 cash had been spent, but the work was not completed before Wen Yong passed away. During the Xianchun period (1172), the monk Farun (or Fazhou) rebuilt the pagoda. It was renovated several times during the Yuan, Ming, and Qing Dynasties. During the Xianfeng period of the Qing Dynasty, the temple was destroyed, but the pagoda survived. A major restoration took place in September 1963.

Fantongshan is nestled against the mountains on one side and faces the sea on the other. The sky is blue and the grass is green, with a faint salty taste of seawater in the wind. There are dams, greenways, sheep herds, the sea, and the sunset glow here... It is a beautiful and niche camping site.

The Ningbo Songlan Mountain Tourist Resort is located on the east coast of Xiangshan County, Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, with a total area of approximately 31 22 square kilometers (including a land area of approximately 9.77 square kilometers and a sea area of approximately 21.45 square kilometers). The resort boasts a blend of mountains and seas, numerous cape bays, continuous beaches, and unique reefs. It is located along the 30 ° N golden line with the three major world health resorts of Florida, the Gulf of Mexico, and Hawaii, and has a large group of onshore beaches. It is one of the top coastal vacation destinations in East China for a wonderful life. The resort has a profound marine cultural heritage and a long history. It is a national provincial-level tourist resort, the venue for the 19th Asian Games sailing and windsurfing competition in Hangzhou, and the location of the Zhejiang Ocean Sports Center. There is one national 4A level scenic spot, eight resort hotels such as Sheraton and Redison, and two homestay clusters such as Baishawan and Meiao in the area. The resort has cultivated and created a unique vacation product system, including seafood cuisine, coastal tourism, beach amusement, ocean sports, sightseeing and photography, intangible cultural heritage research and learning, festival events, Japanese cafes and night drinks, RV camping, etc. It has formed a four season activity system of spring sand riding, summer sea play, autumn fresh food, and winter recuperation. It is a comprehensive coastal tourism resort integrating travel, leisure, entertainment, sports, health preservation, conferences, etc. It is a shining pearl on the "30 ° North Latitude coastline".

Half of the East China Sea is located on the coast of Shipu Town, Xiangshan County. It is surrounded by the sea on three sides, resembling a qilin, with two islands accompanying each other. Relying on natural and cultural resources such as mountains, oceans, beaches, and fishing villages in the area, it has been developed into a seaside resort and leisure destination that integrates mass tourism, business leisure, coastal vacation, and health preservation. Time has left the 'magic' on this East China Sea Peninsula, which is shaped like a mythical beast Qilin. Legendary stories such as Zhu Bajie's mountain splitting, the Dragon King's offering of treasures, Xu Fu's eastward crossing, and Qi Jiguang's resistance against the Japanese are sung here.

There is Dongmen Fishing Village on the island, with a developed fishing economy, including 274 acres of orchards, 1799 acres of forests, and 200 acres of marine aquaculture. Most of the young and middle-aged people in the village are engaged in marine fishing. Dongmen Fishing Village boasts both mountains and seas, with picturesque scenery and a long history of coastal defense. The island is home to numerous historical sites, ancient landscapes, and cultural landmarks, as well as rich marine cultural relics and a strong fishing culture.

Simingshan Geological Park is a provincial-level geological park in Ningbo City, which has a relatively large and well preserved ancient planation surface in East China, with a total area of 61.7 square kilometers. It is divided into three major blocks, namely the Hemudu Ancient Human Culture Park, the Sichuangyan Danshan Chishui Geological Park, and the Luochengshan Yangtian Lake Geological Park, which were previously opened. The core scenic area of the geological park, Luochengshan Scenic Area, is located in Dashan Village, Simingshan Town. The Simingshan Geological Park Scenic Area preserves a large number of intact ancient flat surfaces and is also a good place to appreciate the geological landscapes of Zhejiang's high-altitude plateaus and wetlands, cliffs and stone eggs, waterfalls, springs, etc. The scenic area has eight major landscapes, including Siming Huai Gu, Great Wall Xiong Feng, Bogu Fei Tian, Divine Eagle Breaking the Wall, Pine Forest Seeking Fragrance, Blue Lake Flowing Clouds, Pinggang Dining Show, and Green Fairy Trail. The total area is about 300 acres, and tourists can walk about 2 kilometers on the park trail to intuitively experience various geological landscapes in the Siming Mountain geological area. Among them, "Siming Huai Gu" restores the surface landscape of the ancient flat surface of Siming Mountain.

The Wang Shaoao Memorial Hall is located in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, and was established to commemorate Mr. Wang Shaoao, a famous educator and social activist in modern China. summary:
One of the eight scenic spots in Tongli was built by Zhu Xiang, a scholar in the Ming Dynasty. The architectural layout is the front house and the back garden, which is a typical mansion style of Ming and Qing Dynasties. 
There are still three entrances and 41 rooms, with gardens, pavilions and pavilions; There are landscape buildings such as Lotus Pond, Yuanyang Hall and Huanxiu Pavilion in the garden. 
Root carving is the main focus, supplemented by stone carving. When you step into the foyer, you feel solemn and simple, tall and spacious, and antique.

Hupao Park is located in the southwestern mountainous area of West Lake, and is home to the famous "third spring in the world" - Hupao Dream Spring. Hupao Spring Water is known for its sweet and mellow taste, and drinking it regularly has certain health benefits. summary: The park covers an area of 6.7 hectares, with a total investment of more than 30 million yuan. The stone carvings in the park are mainly from the Southern Song Dynasty, and there are also works from the Ming and Qing Dynasties, totaling more than 200 statues. There are many stone carvings in China, but they are basically Buddhist grottoes and royal cemeteries, except the Southern Song Dynasty. Among the grand royal cemetery stone carvings in the Southern Song Dynasty, there is no representative stone carving. Instead, many tomb stone carvings were found in the cemeteries of the four most important prime ministers in the Southern Song Dynasty. These stone carvings not only fill the gap in the history of carving art in the Southern Song Dynasty, but also are unique in China. When you step into the garden, the first thing you see is the five stone carvings of civil ministers, military commanders, squatting tigers, immediately horses and kneeling sheep. These five stone carvings represent "loyalty, courage, integrity, righteousness and filial piety" respectively, reproducing the historical and cultural landscape of the Southern Song Dynasty.

summary: Gaozhuang, formerly known as Xixi Mountain Villa, was the residence of Gao Shiqi, a prominent official in the early Qing Dynasty, a favored minister of Kangxi, and a talented scholar from Hangzhou. This grand and imposing large-scale estate has the characteristics of official residences in the late Ming and mid Qing dynasties, as well as elements of literati gardens in the Qing dynasty. The spatial layout forms a distinct pattern of "front mansion and back garden", demonstrating the grandeur and majesty of official residences. The landscape in the park is ancient, clean and secluded, known as a model of Jiangnan gardens and one of the famous works of Hangzhou gardens. The main attractions in the village include "Bamboo Window", "Zhuxi Thatched Cottage", and "Jiaoyuan Poetry Society", reflecting the unique official deeds, reclusive culture, and women's artistic and cultural activities during the Ming and Qing dynasties in the history of Xixi. summary: One of the 12 islands in the Qiangjiao Archipelago, it is an important component of the developing Ninghai Bay Tourist Resort. The island runs north-south, with a length of 0.76 kilometers, a width of 0.23 kilometers, and a high point of 51 meters above sea level. No matter from which perspective the island is viewed, it forms a horizontal shape resembling the character "mountain", hence its name. There is a Zhenfu Temple on the island, which was originally divided into two halls, front and back. It was built during the Ming Dynasty, and the beams and columns were shaped in the Qing Dynasty. It is called "Xiaoputuo" and attracts a continuous stream of devout men and women from Fenghua, Ningbo, and Ninghai. On the island, lush forests and bamboo cultivation create a serene and elegant atmosphere. The rocks around the island have been battered by the waves for years, forming cliffs and caves with various shapes and shapes, and the scenery is tempting. If you are fortunate enough to visit, become a "Penglai Fairy"! Other attractions include the Punan Zen Monastery and the former site of the Provincial Fisheries School. This is an ancient and mysterious island. As early as the Han Dynasty, Emperor Wu set up a pavilion called "Tu Qi" because this place was a key point on the sea route. In the Northern Song Dynasty, Lin Bu, who was accompanied by his wife and children, became interested in this place and built the Taiji Palace with the Eight Trigrams image in Siguping. In the Ming Dynasty, this place was also called the Mirage Gate due to the appearance of mirages, and the entire sea corner was named Mirage Sea because of this. At this time, a story of Guanyin solving difficulties was spreading among the people, so a Zhenfu Temple dedicated to Guanyin was erected on Hengshan Island, and the name "Little Putuo" was rumored to be well-known. Since the Ming Dynasty, deforestation has been banned, and to this day, the entire island is covered in towering ancient trees, including mulberry and hibiscus trees that have been in existence for over 700 years. Nowadays, Qiangjiao has built a 3000 ton dock, which is a natural harbor and seafood base in Ningbo City. However, the Tingzhai ruins, Ming and Qing ancient buildings, as well as the Siguping Road Courtyard, Xiaoputuo Hall and other historical sites are still intact. Visiting here, you can experience the charm of ancient times, appreciate the wonders of the sea and sky, and taste the new flavors of seafood. Full text 

In 1963, it was listed as a cultural relics protection unit in Suzhou. The existing area of the garden is 5,000 square meters, with a pool in the middle, sparse buildings, curved corridors, bright water and woods, and clear courtyards. It has been repaired several times over the decades.

The Liangzhu Museum is located in Liangzhu Town, Yuhang District. The Liangzhu site and surrounding areas have yielded a large number of exquisite jade artifacts dating back 4,000 to 5,000 years. At the museum, visitors can not only view these artifacts up close but also engage in various interactive experiences to learn about the past and present of the Liangzhu culture. It's also a great place to bring children for an educational and fun experience.

The museum's architecture is an artwork in itself, designed by British architect David Chipperfield. The building is inspired by the image of a "jade cone scattered on the ground" and represents contemporary architectural design. Inside the museum, there are three main exhibition halls: Seeking Truth, the Liangzhu Kingdom, and Liangzhu Civilization. These are interspersed with three open-air courtyards in a skylight style, decorated with representative elements of Liangzhu culture. Moving through this architectural space is truly an enjoyment in itself.

summary:
Daci Rock is located about 24 kilometers south of Jiande City. On the mountain, there is a golden, sparkling double-faced Buddha statue. Half of the temple at the mountainside is embedded into the rock, while the other half is suspended in mid-air, similar to the Hanging Temple of Heng Mountain, which is why it is also known as the "Hanging Temple of the South of the Yangtze River." The entire scenic area emphasizes the concept of "suspension," with walkways, temples, and the large Buddha all built along steep cliff walls. Although most of these structures are rebuilt, they still evoke admiration for the ingenuity of the ancients.

A major feature of Daci Rock is the cliffside cave architecture. The main temple, the Kṣitigarbha Hall, is built into the mountain, half embedded in the rock and half suspended in mid-air, creating a stunning and perilous sight. It is quite similar to the Hanging Temple of Heng Mountain in Shanxi. Another newly constructed temple, the Qingfeng Pavilion, is built on the cliff, giving the impression of soaring to the skies from a distance. From the temple, one can overlook the mountains and rivers in all directions, achieving the ultimate in suspension.

summary: Dan Mountain and Chishui are located in Siming Mountain. From a high vantage point, one can enjoy a panoramic view of Siming Mountain. Not only can you breathe in the fresh air, but you can also experience life in the mountains and the charm of rural homesteads. The cliffs, strange rocks, ancient bridges, flowing streams, and waterfalls are the main attractions here. With the blend of Taoist culture and the well-preserved ancient mountain village style of Eastern Zhejiang, the scenery is breathtaking.

The replica of Hemudu Ancient Village is located in Hemudu Village, about 25 kilometers away from Yuyao. Showcasing the unique charm of the organic coordination between modern expression methods and primitive antique style; Realistic reproduction of the life and production conditions of the ancient Hemudu people, natural ecological environment, and local features of primitive tribes; Intuitively creating an atmosphere of ancient agricultural civilization; The image reflects the development of productivity 7000 years ago and the rich cultural connotations of our ancestors' conquest of nature and reproduction of life. The chaotic thatched buildings in the ancient village, with rough and primitive lines and charming ancient music, are full of mysterious atmosphere. It makes people feel dizzy and decadent, and suddenly feel like they have become the ancient and simple Hemu people of 7000 years ago: fierce and powerful, full of vitality.

The Hemudu Site Museum is located in Hemudu Town. For many people, "Hemudu Culture" is just a term in history textbooks, but when you come to Yuyao, one of the birthplaces of Hemudu Culture, there is no reason not to come to the museum to witness its past and present. If you take children on a trip together, it is a great opportunity to gain knowledge. The museum consists of two parts: the exhibition hall and the on-site display of the site. The arch composed of three giant stones in front of the museum is the symbol of this place. On the crossbeam is a painting on an ivory piece unearthed from the site: two flapping giant birds, arching and protecting the rising sun, with tension. Almost all tourists who come here will take photos here. The architectural design of the museum is also based on the architectural style of Hemudu, with a herringbone appearance and several interlocking components symbolizing Hemudu's mortise and tenon technology. Firstly, visit the exhibition hall, which consists of three exhibition halls. The first exhibition hall is the prologue, showcasing the overview of Hemudu culture through graphics, models, and cultural relics. Especially the two skull fossils and reconstructed head portraits allow the audience to see the appearance of distant ancestors after 7000 years. The second exhibition hall mainly introduces rice agriculture and fishing and hunting activities. The exhibited objects include stone tools, pottery, bone needles, bone whistles and other tools with typical Neolithic characteristics, as well as remains of crop fruits such as rice and jujube, allowing you to understand how our ancestors produced and lived back then. The third exhibition hall focuses on life and art, showcasing architectural wooden components and various textile tools. In addition, there are many decorative items made of ivory, bone, jade, pottery, etc., and the craftsmanship and conceptual design level of their creation are very impressive. Tourists can perceive the daily and artistic life of the Hemudu people from this. Leaving the exhibition hall, walking southeast is not far from the on-site exhibition area of the site. The first thing that catches the eye is the restored archaeological site, with large and dense wooden building components in the ground fence, which shows the prosperity of the Hemudu tribe. In addition, there is a reconstructed Hemudu house nearby. These "dry railing style" buildings not only have artistic shapes, but also feature mortise and tenon techniques, as well as designs that allow people to live on top and livestock to be raised on the bottom, which are groundbreaking innovations in Hemudu culture. The sculpture group here creates the living atmosphere of that time, which is the most interesting and intuitive part of the entire museum. You can stroll on the streets like residents of a tribe, or walk into houses and watch women spin yarn and weave cloth, while men chop wood to build houses. Some people grind bone tools, some mash grain to remove shells, some make pottery with mud, and some carve with concentration, making people feel as if they have returned to ancient times and have a sense of time travel. After the visit, why not take a walk by the nearby Yaojiang River? The scenery is beautiful. If you are interested in archaeology, the Tianluo Mountain Site Museum, which is also managed by a museum, is worth visiting about 7 kilometers north. You can see the archaeological site up close. However, due to the lack of reliable public transportation, you may need to find a tricycle or motorcycle to get there. Full text 

summary: The Hangzhou Oriental Cultural Park is located in Yiqiao, Xiaoshan, 15 kilometers from both the downtown area of Lihang City and Xiaoshan District. It is a cultural tourism area based on traditional culture. The park is divided into several sections, including Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism. Although all the attractions are man-made, it is still pleasant to walk around. At the entrance of the park, there is a large sculpture of the Double Stars of Blessings and Longevity. Upon entering, visitors will encounter the Buddhist section featuring the manifestation of Guanyin, surrounded by many statues of Bodhisattvas and Immortals in the artificial rockeries. "The Manifestation of Guanyin" is a scheduled performance that takes place at 9:00, 10:30, 13:00, and 14:30 (subject to the park's announcements). The statue of Guanyin rises to the top of the mountain, the music fountain begins to perform, and holy water is poured from the purification vase held by the Bodhisattva. Devotees eagerly gather below to receive the water, creating a spectacular scene. Further inside is the Yangqi Zen Temple, and in the underground palace square behind the temple, there is a statue of Buddha Shakyamuni, a gift from the Thai Buddhist community, inlaid with jewels, which is the largest jade reclining Buddha statue in the country. After visiting the Golden Underground Palace of the Ten Thousand Buddha Tower, you can continue to the Sanjiang Pagoda, where you can enjoy a panoramic view of the cultural park and the surrounding cityscape. Beyond the Sanjiang Pagoda, you will find the Taoist and Confucianism sections by the Tai Xu Lake, featuring ancient-style buildings, statues, and stone carvings related to Confucianism and Taoism. There is also a water-based art corridor offering lake views. After a quick visit, you can return to the entrance area via Tai Xu Bridge. If time permits, you can also visit the nearby Oriental Water World.

The Wanfo Golden Pagoda Underground Palace is located in Hangzhou, China, and is a tourist attraction that integrates Buddhist culture, art, and architecture. There are tens of thousands of Buddha statues enshrined in the underground palace, each exquisitely carved, showcasing profound Buddhist art and culture. The architectural style of the underground palace is unique, blending traditional and modern elements, providing visitors with a peaceful and solemn visiting environment.

Tianmu Mountain Scenic Area is located in Lin'an City, passing through Tianmu Village and ending at the South Gate Tourist Center of West Tianmu Mountain. From here, you can walk through Zenyuan Temple to the Big Tree King Scenic Area on the mountain, or take the scenic area transportation bus from the direction of Glacier Grand Canyon to the Longfengjian Parking Lot, and then walk to visit the Big Tree King Scenic Area. Take the scenic bus up the mountain along the tour route. The vegetation on the roadside is very dense. If you go early, sometimes you can also see the misty scenery of Tianmu Mountain. Starting from the Longfengjian parking lot, the roads in the scenic area are basically a circular road. Clockwise, there are several main attractions, including Four Sided Peaks, Inverted Lotus, Five Generations of the Same Hall, Big Tree King, and Kaishan Old Hall. Among them, the Four Sided Peaks have a better view. Standing at the top of the mountain, the Yuli Pavilion offers a panoramic view of the undulating mountains around, especially during cloudy and foggy weather, where the magnificent scenery of misty waves can be seen everywhere. In addition, the highlight of the Big Tree King scenic area is naturally the "Big Tree". Here, you can see many rare giant trees, some of which can reach a diameter of over 1 meter and require several people to hug. Tourists who come here together always hug the big tree and take a photo as a souvenir. The trees here are not only huge in shape, but also have a gradient effect of red, yellow, and green on their outer skin. There are also some intertwined and coiled tree roots exposed on the surface, covered in green clothes, giving people a deep feeling. After completing the circular route, if you have the energy, you can continue up the mountain to Xianrending. The altitude here is about 1500 meters, and you can see a more open scenery. However, the hiking trail here is not yet complete and not very easy to walk. If the weather is bad or it is late in the afternoon, it is not recommended to go there. If you hike down the mountain, you can go down to the Great Tree King scenic spot. Along the way, besides the nearby streams, you can also see the relics of ancient masters practicing here. Although the Shanyuan Temple on the mountainside was later rebuilt, it still has a bit of tranquility and can be visited for a walk. If you want to take a car down the mountain, you need to take the circular road back to the Longfengjian parking lot. On the way back, you can go halfway to the Glacier Grand Canyon to see waterfalls and streams. Many tourists also choose to charter a car to Tianmu Grand Canyon after returning to the foot of the mountain to enjoy the more spectacular canyon scenery, which takes about 30-40 minutes by car. Tianmu Village, located around the scenic area, is already a very mature rural tourism base with a wide range of food and accommodation options. Full text 

summary: There are nine rivers in Tianmu Mountain, and Shenlong River has two. It is one of the main water sources of the Taihu Lake Lake. There are five major scenic spots in the Shenlongchuan Scenic Area, including Yileyuan, Wolongxi, Qingliangjie, Shennongtai, Xiaohuashan, and Shennong Resort. Shenlongchuan is a great oxygen bar with abundant rainfall and humid climate. Entering the scenic area, you can see lush greenery and fragrant flowers all over the river. Even on scorching hot days, it is still incredibly cool. There are more than 30 scenic spots in the five major scenic areas of Shenlong Mountain, mainly including Longfeng Tower, Leisure Jungle, Hanxiao Pavilion, Lingshan Stone, Shennong Temple, Resort Villa, Amusement Park, Baicao Garden, Yizhi Pool, etc. It is a convergence of local celebrity culture and folk culture. For example, "Lingshan Stone" weighs over 100000 pounds and has the four characters "Lingshan Shenxiu" on it. It is a collection of characters from Wang Xizhi, the literary saint of the Jin Dynasty. Shenlongchuan is still a treasure trove of Chinese herbal medicine. It is said that Shen Nong and Li Shizhen once went to Shenlong River to collect medicine and treat the people, and their reputation spread far and wide. There are over a thousand types of plant materials such as Astragalus membranaceus, Panax notoginseng, Lily, Dendrobium officinale, and Polygonatum sibiricum on the mountains of Sichuan. Those who do not recognize them as plants are treasures.

Qingshan Lake is an artificial lake located four to five kilometers east of Lin'an City, with clear scenery and a wide surface without much decoration. What's worth seeing on the lake is the water forest, where these peculiar fir trees grow in the water with lush branches and leaves. In addition, there are barbecue gardens and small amusement parks in the scenic area where you can play activities such as water parachutes. The main way to play and explore Qingshan Lake is by taking a boat. The Qinshan Pier and Shenghe Pier to the south of Qingshan Lake can both be purchased for tickets and taken by boat, with the same pier for boarding and disembarking. Taking a cruise not only allows you to enjoy the scenery of the lake, but also to visit major attractions such as water forests and water platforms that stop along the way. There is no limit to the time of shore visit, and after the tour, you can continue to take the boat with your ticket. There are two types of ship types, one is a classical painted boat, and the other is a yacht. For individual travelers, the wise choice is to wait for the arrival of the team and then ship together. 9: 00 is the peak reached by the Qinshan Port team, and it is the time when the success rate of ship sharing is high. The probability of finding a boat during other time periods is also not low, usually within about 20 minutes. The scenic spot is worth taking a boat ride to the Water Forest, which takes about 40 minutes. The tall and straight tree trunks of the water fir trees in the lake water are eye-catching scenery of Qingshan Lake, and almost every tourist who comes here will take photos. There is an amusement park called "Water Forest Challenge" near the Water Forest, where players can play various challenge games such as water climbing, battlefield roller skating, and water soft bridges. In addition, some water projects on the water platform in the middle of the lake are worth participating in, such as motorboats, water parachutes, etc., which can be participated according to personal preferences. There is a lawn near Shenghe Wharf, which is a lively barbecue garden. Tourists from nearby cities like to barbecue and gather here. There are stalls here for renting barbecue cooking utensils and tents, and ingredients can also be purchased here for an additional fee. In addition, there is a water stage on the lake near Qinshan Wharf, where there will be performances such as clowns and Thai human demons (about 50 yuan). You can go and watch them. Full text 

shortFeatures: Pin Longjing Tour West Lake
summary:
If you are just a passer-by in Hang Cheng in a hurry and want to witness the essence of this city in the shortest possible time, then I will probably show you around Nanshan Road. Because here, even if you just stand at the crossroads of a street corner, you will feel a completely different urban temperament gathering here: the bustling traffic of modern cities, the bustling scenery of eating, drinking and having fun, the beautiful and graceful scenery of the West Lake, and the thick but vivid historical and cultural imprints of thousands of years... History and modernity, the past and the future are integrated here and complement each other. 
High-grade leisure and entertainment places such as West Lake Xintiandi gather here, and it is a famous bar, gallery and entertainment street in Hangzhou.

The West Lake Music Fountain is located on the lake surface near the Lakefront Three Parks, and is a must visit attraction for night tours of West Lake. This is adjacent to the bustling commercial district, with attractions such as Hubin Yintai, Huansha Road, and Pinghai Road not far away, offering a wide range of food, drink, and entertainment options. Going shopping and having dinner here at night, while enjoying the music fountain and the night view of West Lake, is very relaxing. The fountain at night looks more spectacular than during the day due to its colorful lighting effects. Countless water columns danced in the night with the rhythm of lights and music, creating a magnificent sight. If you are specifically going to see the fountain, it is recommended to depart as early as possible and choose a location with a broadcast in the middle. Especially during holidays when there are a lot of people, if you arrive late, you may only be able to catch a glimpse from afar. In addition, there are many cruise ships on West Lake, and some boats will travel nearby during fountain performances, which can also be viewed from the boats.

Limin Village is located to the east and north of Taogong Mountain, to the west of Dongqian Lake Xiaoputuo Scenic Area, and is connected to Taogong Village. Without doorplate instructions, it is almost impossible to distinguish them. The residential houses in the village are distributed along the lake, facing the water on both sides, and there are several large trees by the lake. There is a long village road along the lake, and standing on the roadside, you can enjoy the scenery of the lake and mountains. Occasionally, speedboats or small boats gallop by on the lake, full of poetic and picturesque charm. If you go boating on the lake, the entire Limin Village will be reflected in the lake, like a mirage, becoming a beautiful landscape painting.
There are many tall cedar trees in the Qingshan Lake Forest Country Park. People can have picnics, fly kites, and even slide grass on the large lawn, which is very interesting.

Wansong Academy is located on Wansong Ridge in the north of Phoenix Mountain, surrounded by mountains on three sides and water on one side-the West Lake. When Emperors Kangxi and Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty visited the south, they gave them "Zhejiang Water Fu Wen" and "Hushan Cuixiu" respectively. 
The academy was founded in the first period of Tang Zhenyuan (785-804), formerly known as Baoen Temple; In the eleventh year of Hongzhi in the Ming Dynasty (1498), it was changed into Wansong Academy by Zhou Mu, a right political party in Zhejiang Province. It was the largest, longest-lasting and most influential gathering place of literati in Hang Cheng during the Ming and Qing Dynasties, and Wang Yangming, an acting scholar in the Ming Dynasty, once gave lectures here. 
But what makes this place even more famous is the well-known folk story-butterfly lovers and Zhu Yingtai. According to legend, this is the place where butterfly lovers and Zhu Yingtai are classmates. The poignant love of Butterfly Lovers makes Wansong Academy a place where men and women are married, and its reputation spreads all over the province. Therefore, it is named "Wansong Shuyuan", which is also the sixth of "Three Comments on Ten Scenes of the West Lake".

Jichang Garden is a classical garden located at the eastern foot of Huishan Mountain and within Xihui Park in Wuxi. Jichang Garden incorporates the water from Huishan Spring into its water scenery, cleverly utilizing the technique of borrowing scenery. Within the garden, one can see the reflection of the Dragon Light Tower on Xishan in the pond, which is quite unique in its arrangement. Jichang Garden was once a private garden for returning officials in the Ming Dynasty, and is known as one of the "Four Famous Gardens of Jiangnan" along with Nanjing Zhan Garden, Suzhou Humble Administrator's Garden, and Liuyuan. The park is centered around a rockery pond, surrounded by buildings such as Yupan Pavilion Corridor, Zhiyu Barrier, Seven Star Bridge, Hanbi Pavilion, and Qingyu Corridor. It also introduces water from the "Erquan" (Huishan Spring) into the ravine, known as the "Bayin Stream" due to its murmuring sound. There are also buildings in the park, such as the "Bingtang Hall" within the park and the former study of the park owner, the "Hanzhen Study". Jichang Garden was deeply loved by the two emperors of the Qing Dynasty, Kangxi and Qianlong. They visited this garden several times during their southern tours, and now they can still see the imperial stone plaques of Kangxi's "Mountain Scenery and Stream Light" and Qianlong's "Jade and Golden Fir". Even the Xiqu Garden in Beijing's Summer Palace and the Grand Duke of Kuoran (destroyed in the war) in the Summer Palace were built in imitation of Jichang Garden. In addition, the towering trees in the park are also a great place to relax in summer, and in autumn, you can see colorful red maple and ginkgo trees.

shortFeatures: Visit historic sites, worship Buddha and pray for blessings
summary: Huishan Temple was founded in the Southern and Northern Dynasties, and it has been more than 1,500 years ago. Huishan Temple has preserved precious cultural relics such as the stone bed of listening to pine in Tang Dynasty, the scriptures of Tang and Song Dynasties, the Xianghua Bridge, the Jinlian Bridge in Song Dynasty, the ancient ginkgo in Ming Dynasty, the imperial monument in Qing Dynasty, as well as the Daxiong Hall and Huishan Temple bell restored in recent years, which show the unique charm of Buddhist culture. Huishan Temple ranks first among the top ten jungles in Wuxi because of its long history and profound culture.

Nianhua Bay is adjacent to Lingshan Scenic Area, located to the west of Lingshan Scenic Area. The town has an antique style and is themed around Zen. A series of beige and white characteristic buildings cover the blue sloping roof, with doors, windows, and pillars mostly made of wood. The town is dotted with small bridges, flowing water, and garden scenery, making it a particularly suitable homestay town for vacation, relaxation, and self-cultivation. During the day, you can visit buildings such as Zen Music Hall, Baihua Hall, Miaoyin Terrace, Nianhua Hall, Nianhua Pagoda, and stroll through handicraft shops. If you feel tired from shopping, you can sit down and eat and drink. At night, you can shoot the quiet night scene of Nianhua Bay and watch the unique 3D water screen movie on Nianhua Lake. Entering Nianhua Bay, it feels like entering a paradise on earth, where everything is both a dream and a reality. There are also eight scenic spots to visit in Nianhua Bay, including Xushan Dachan Hall, Luming Valley, Chanxin Valley, Ginkgo Valley, Zhuxi Valley, Yunmen Valley, Xiangyue Flower Street, and Youyou Fishing Port. Everyone can find their own Zen lifestyle and cultivate their body and mind here. Attend a "Thousand People Morning Zen Meeting" in a large Zen hall to gain spiritual and spiritual rewards; On the Fragrant Moon Flower Street, known as "One Flower, One World," there are hundreds of Zen themed small shops that leave you dazzled and reluctant to leave; Have a delicious meal at the Youyou Fishing Port and experience the Zen philosophy of "the leisurely swimming of fish, only the fish know it; the joy of migratory birds, only the birds themselves understand". When it comes to tracing the river to escape the heat, Lu Ming Valley in Nianhua Bay is the perfect place. Luming Valley is a narrow valley northeast of Nianhua Bay, with towering trees and murmuring streams. The Luminggu Creek Water Park is nestled amidst this lush greenery. The water level here is still shallow and the water flow is gentle, which is very suitable for parents to bring their children to play and have intimate contact with nature. It takes only ten minutes to walk from the foot of the mountain, and the secret stream is hidden among lush trees, winding down and making a cool sound. Stepping barefoot in the water, the ice is cold, the heat and troubles are instantly evaporated. Throwing all the fruits into the stream, the chilled fruits taste cool and sweet. Move the small table and chairs to the middle of the stream, unlock the "natural refrigerator" to chill the fruit soda, and "click click click" the whole summer in one bite. Playing in water, treading water, and playing with water guns. The children were playing in the water, with constant laughter and joy. The innocence and happiness infected everyone present. Looking up at the valley covered in lush greenery, feeling the cool stream water sliding over your skin, this is a more effective way to cool down than air conditioning. Riding on a children's hand cranked cart, drifting freely on the stream, accompanied by lush greenery and gentle breeze, it feels refreshing and cool. Unplugged parent-child time, the wind in the mountains, the water at your feet, and the chirping of birds will all give children a sweet childhood. Relaxation brings children, liberates hands, and gives parents a chance to lie flat. Drinking tea, eating melons, taking photos, chatting... also give yourself a day of summer vacation. Life is unsolvable, happiness is wild. The summer soaked in water has become less hot, and the seemingly complicated problems in life have become clearer. I am looking forward to every summer. In this place without a ceiling, feel the healing power of nature and recharge your tired body. This is not just a place to play in water, but also a bridge connecting nature and life. One table, one chair, one summer, one person, one tea, one state of mind, I have come to understand the principle of 'a calm heart naturally cools down'. Full text 
