shortFeatures: A giant lotus in the center of the lake
summary: Wudeng Lake, located in the core area of Nianhua Bay, is the gathering place of various water lanes and streams in the town. It is also the main performance area of the large-scale performance "Zen Walking". Every night, the graceful lotus fairies dance on the lotus leaves, step on dreamy lanterns, accompanied by Zen music, insects and music, moonlight and shadow, and flow between the breeze and flowing water, just like gradually entering the world, and dreams are true.

Lishui Chanyin is located in Wuxi City and is a tourist attraction that combines natural scenery with Zen culture. Here, mountains and waters are interdependent, and the environment is peaceful, making it an ideal place for tourists to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and seek spiritual peace.

shortFeatures: The architecture is mainly Tang style and Song rhyme
summary: Xiangyuehua Street is the Zen theme street of Nianhuawan. It is the core area of leisure and holiday life in Nianhuawan, and it is also the most humanistic block at present. The architecture here is dominated by Tang style and Song rhyme, which is simple and elegant. There are also a dazzling array of cultural and creative product shops and special experience workshops, as well as shops with various themed restaurants, creative food and local snacks, and Zen-themed inns with different styles and themes. Here, you can find the most comfortable and pleasant Zen life experience to meet your needs of physical and mental vacation relaxation.

shortFeatures: There is a retreat meditation temple
summary: Luming Valley is a narrow valley in the northeasternmost part of Nianhua Bay, a Zen town. It is the first petal of the "five petals" in the "Eight Views of Lotus". The trees here are towering, quiet and quiet, and it is a natural landscape with deep flowers and trees in Zen rooms. The name of Luming Valley is due to a thousand-year-old story. It is said that when the Tang monk came back from the Buddha's scriptures, he passed by here, and released two sacred deer brought back from the Luyeyuan of Buddha in Tianzhu Kingdom into the mountain forest. Up to now, there is a clear pool called "Lumian Pond" deep in the mountain bay. The Zen life here is therefore vividly called "Ming Sleeping Zen". There is Luming Tea House in Luming Valley, which is used to receive high-end tea parties or customized meditation activities of private and enterprises.

The large-scale bronze art treasure "Bai Zi Xi Maitreya" is located on the right side of the Ashoka Pillar Square under the Lingshan Giant Buddha in Wuxi. Maitreya Buddha is 3 meters high, 7.8 meters wide, and weighs 9 tons. Joyful and auspicious, deeply loved by tourists. The reclining Maitreya had a kind expression and a charming smile. On Maitreya's huge body, there are a whole hundred playful and playful little children, each with different shapes and spirits, vividly portrayed. Some of them are overlapping, juggling, tug of war, ear digging, rolling, stabbing Maitreya's navel with a twig, and even more mischievous, urinating on Maitreya. Bai Tong scattered Maitreya all over, making people laugh uncontrollably. A hundred playful children climbed on the smiling back of Maitreya, adding a touch of liveliness to the solemn Spirit Mountain.

shortFeatures: A magnificent Buddhist palace
summary:
After visiting the main hall of the Brahma Palace, go directly to the second floor, and walk straight to the entrance of the Treasure Hall. 
The four beauties in ancient China, adult fish, falling geese, closed moon and ashamed flowers, were very exquisite. Their clothes were very realistic, and the shape of their cuffs was very thin. This kind of art was perfect. 
There are many works of Patriarch Bodhidharma. There is a large statue of Patriarch Bodhidharma erected in the center, with a red gourd on the back, a pool around it, and many works around it are exquisite treasures ~

shortFeatures: There are many ancient and famous trees
summary: The mountain is hidden and beautiful, located at the southeast foothills of Luding Mountain, where the former Chen Family Garden was located. Chen Family Garden, also known as Ruopu, was built in 1928 by Chen Zhongyan, a national industrial and commercial businessman in Wuxi, and set up a nursery after the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is the main location of Taihu Ornamental Botanical Garden, which wins by trees and flowers, natural wild scenery, many ancient and famous trees, and birds and flowers everywhere.

shortFeatures: A sea of cherry blossoms all over the mountains and plains
summary:
There are many great cherry blossom viewing places in China, and Yuantouzhu in Wuxi is the best cherry blossom viewing. Wuxi Yuantouzhu Scenic Area, together with Hirosaki Cherry Blossom Garden in Japan and Washington Cherry Blossom Garden in the United States, is known as the three largest cherry blossom viewing resorts in the world. 
This year's Yuantouzhu Cherry Blossom Festival lasts from 3.1 to 4.20, and early March is the early cherry blossom period. The early cherry blossoms that open include Chunhan cherry blossom, Hejin cherry blossom, Han cherry blossom and Alishan cherry blossom. From late March to mid-to-early April is the peak period of cherry blossoms, and more than 20 kinds of cherry blossoms bloom together in the park. 
When in full bloom, here is an interpretation of what a sea of pink flowers is.

Wuxi Renjie Garden, located in the Cherry Blossom Forest at the foot of Luding Mountain in Yuantouzhu Scenic Area of the Taihu Lake Lake, covers an area of 20000 square meters and a building area of 1700 square meters. It is a special memorial hall invested and built by Wuxi Municipal Party Committee and Government in 2007. At the same time, the construction of Wuxi Renjie Garden highlights the garden style leisure tourism characteristics of the organic combination of natural landscapes and cultural history. Wuxi Renjie Garden consists of four parts: sculpture group, Renjie Exhibition Hall, demonstration hall, and Wu Weishan Studio. Showcasing the life achievements of over 60 Wuxi sages, it is an educational and entertaining "Liangxi Landscape Living Room" and "Wuxi Cultural Business Card".

shortFeatures: Arch of wooden architecture cornice; Quaint and elegant
summary: Guqu Shengjing is located in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, China, and is a tourist destination that combines natural scenery and cultural landscapes. This place attracts numerous tourists with its beautiful lake and mountain scenery and rich cultural heritage.

The Ningbo Drum Tower is one of the landmark buildings in Ningbo City, located in the center of the city and part of the ancient city wall of Ningbo. The Drum Tower was first built in the Tang Dynasty and has undergone multiple reconstructions. The existing architecture is in the style of the Qing Dynasty. The Drum Tower is not only an important symbol of Ningbo's history and culture, but also a window for tourists to learn about Ningbo's history and culture.

shortFeatures: Zheyang Middle Road Important Town
summary:
Shipu Town, located at the southern end of Xiangshan Peninsula in Zhejiang Province, is known as the "important town of Zheyang Middle Road". Shipu Town is named after the unique scenery of Shipu Port. 
In the fifth episode of Meeting on the Tip of China 2, the story of Zhang Shizhong's return to Taiwan and his family reunion took place in Shipu, Xiangshan. The film also focused on Xiangshan seafood-mussel. Shipu Town is an ancient town on one side and the sea on the other. Walking in the town, you can appreciate the rich seaside town customs.

Hangzhou West Station East Square is an important component of Hangzhou West Station, located in Xihu District, Hangzhou. It is a modern square that integrates transportation, commerce, and leisure. The square is designed modern and has a beautiful environment. It is one of the main passages for passengers to enter and exit Hangzhou West Station, and also a good place for citizens to relax and entertain.
opening_hours: Open from 00:00 to 24:00 throughout the year

summary: Yongfu Temple in Hangzhou is located at the foot of Shisun Peak, about one mile west of Lingyin. It has a history of more than 1600 years since its founding by Master Huili of the Eastern Jin Dynasty. The architectural complex of the temple rises from the mountain and is divided into five open courtyards: Puyuan Jingyuan, Jialing Lecture Hall, Ziyan Huiyuan, Guxiang Zen Temple, and Fuquan Tea Temple. It has seven entrances, five halls, three halls, two pavilions, two floors, five pavilions, and more than a thousand ancient and famous trees. It is one of the largest temple courtyards in Hangzhou.

shortFeatures: Temple Gate with Architectural Charm in Jiangnan
summary:
Taoguang Temple is an influential ancient temple in the Tang Dynasty in Lingyin Scenic Area. It is located next to Yongfu Temple. It was built by Taoguang Zen Master, a famous poet monk in Sichuan during the Tang Dynasty, hence its name. The temple has always been famous for paying homage to Buddha, watching mountains and watching the sea. Historically, when Bai Juyi was the secretariat of Hangzhou, he often came to the temple to make tea and recite poems. 
The gate of the temple is very special, with white walls and gray arches, which has the charm of Jiangnan architecture. After entering the gate, there are Daxiong Hall, Mani Hall, Golden Lotus Pond, Yitan Mountain Spring, Guanhai Building, Taoguang Patriarch Hall, etc. Behind the building, there is a statue of Lu Dongbin, etc., which is very special. Occasionally, people come to burn incense in the temple, and the ancient Zen sound is very quiet and peaceful.
The East Square of Hangzhou East Railway Station covers a vast area and has a reasonable green layout, making it one of the main passages for passengers to enter and exit the station.

poiName: Qingming Bridge Ancient Grand Canal Scenic Area
summary: The Qingmingqiao Ancient Canal Scenic Area is located in the center of Wuxi city, with antique water town buildings and real old houses forming a block. There are attractions to visit, as well as bars and restaurants. The night view here is even more beautiful than the day view. The houses with pink walls and black tiles are lit up, and strings of red lanterns are reflected in the canal, attracting countless photography enthusiasts. Sitting on a cruise ship, from the Nanchan Temple Pier to the Kuatang Bridge, one can see the antique style architecture of Yangchun Lane Commercial District. From the Tangqiao Bridge to the Qingming Bridge is the essence part, which is called "Jiangnan Water Alley, the canal out of print". Seeing the memorial archway of "Canal Ancient Town" on the right bank means entering the real historical block transformed from old houses. Along the way, many beautiful people and small terraces can be found near the water. After passing Dagong Bridge, there is the China Silk Industry Museum on the right bank, and after passing Qingming Bridge, there is the Wuxi Kiln Site Museum on the left bank. Then go ahead to the Narcissus Taoist Temple, and see the memorial archway of "Tang Tree Leaves Shadows", which means the end of the block. It is recommended to take a cruise to the foot of Shuixian Road Courtyard and then walk back to Nanchan Temple Pier. Along the way, you can visit attractions such as Shuixian Road Courtyard, Canal Culture and Art Museum, Kanggong Salvation Society, and China Silk Industry Museum. If interested, you can also turn to Yangchun Lane for a stroll.

Chenghuang Temple, also known as Ningbo County Temple, is an old business center in the center of Ningbo. There are always bustling tourists here. Whether it's Ningbo Duck and Dog rice dumpling or local snacks, it's not difficult to find it here. It's a good place for tourists to experience the folk customs of Ningbo. The scale of Chenghuang Temple in Ningbo is one of the best in China. Thousands of shops gather here. You can always find your favorite gadget while eating. The Tianfeng Pagoda in the south of Chenghuang Temple is the symbol of this area. You can climb the pagoda to look far and overlook the busy city scenery of Ningbo. Not far to the north of Chenghuang Temple is Tianyi Square, which is a new business district in Ningbo, with a more modern shopping environment. The Moon Lake Park to the west is a peaceful scenic area in the city center, where you can stroll along the lake and enjoy the pavilions and gardens, which is very pleasant. Full text 

shortFeatures: Literary and elegant villa
summary: Meizhu Mountain Villa was built by Zhang Cibai, a scholar in Qing Dynasty. Now it mainly has three main buildings: Meizhu Wulu, Xuanhui Hall and Xu Pavilion. Enter the courtyard gate to Meizhu Hall first, and then go to Sixuzhai and Xu Pavilion through the small bridge behind the hall. From the south, along the 100-meter path to the floating pavilion, there is a persimmon tree on the west side of the pavilion, and a pine tree on the east of the pavilion. The shade is like an umbrella, and the pavilion is like a cover. Visitors stand under the pavilion and look up at the villa, but they see that the ferry pond embankment lies in front, the plum and bamboo house is faintly behind the green shade, and Xuanhui Hall is faintly exposed in the depths of plum and bamboo.

shortFeatures: Participate in the dragon boat race during the Dragon Boat Festival

summary: The Qiantang First Well is located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China and is one of the famous historical sites in Hangzhou. This well has a long history and is said to have been built during the Southern Song Dynasty. It was one of the important water sources in Hangzhou at that time. The well water is clear, the well wall is made of bluestone, the wellhead is circular, and there are stone railings around for protection. The Qiantang First Well is not only a representative of ancient water conservancy projects in Hangzhou, but also an important material for studying the history and culture of Hangzhou.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

tagNameList: Nature and Adventure; Night tour viewing
shortFeatures: Watch Qiantang Tide
summary:
Qiantang River, known as Zhejiang in ancient times, whose full name is "Zhejiang", also known as "Zhejiang River", "Zhijiang River" and "Luosha River". Generally, the Fuyang section of Zhejiang Province is called Fuchun River, and the Hangzhou section of the lower reaches of Zhejiang Province is called Qiantang River. 
Qiantang River was first named in Shan Hai Jing, named after flowing through ancient Qiantang County (now Hangzhou), and is one of the main birthplaces of Wuyue culture. Qiantang River is the largest river in Zhejiang Province, the name source of Liangzhe Road in Song Dynasty, and the name source of Zhejiang Province when it was founded in the early Ming Dynasty. Starting from the Xin'an River in the north source, the river length is about 588.73 kilometers; Starting from Majin Creek in the upper reaches of Qujiang River in Nanyuan, the river length is about 522.22 kilometers. From the source, it flows through today's southern Anhui Province and Zhejiang Province, with a drainage area of about 55,058 square kilometers, and flows into the East China Sea through Hangzhou Bay.

shortFeatures: Experience the peaceful scent of books
summary: Donglin Academy was established in the first year of the Zhenghe era of the Northern Song Dynasty, in 1111 AD. It was a place where the famous Neo-Confucian scholar Yang Shi, a direct disciple of Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi, lectured for a long time. The academy was later abolished. In the 32nd year of the Wanli reign of the Ming Dynasty, in 1604 AD, it was revived and renovated by Donglin scholars such as Gu Xiancheng. They gathered people here for lectures, advocating the spirit of "reading, lecturing, and loving the country," which received widespread response from scholars across the country and gained great fame. Donglin Academy became a cultural hub in the Jiangnan region and a major center for public discourse on national affairs.

poiName: CCTV Wuxi Movie & TV Production Base
summary: Wuxi Film and Television Base is a direct subsidiary of Zhongshi Media Co., Ltd. (stock code: Zhongshi Media 600088). The Wuxi Film and Television Base was founded in 1987, covering an area of approximately 1200 acres, with a usable water area of about 3000 acres. The Three Kingdoms Water Margin Scenic Area, to which it belongs, is a large-scale film and television filming base built for the historical masterpieces "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" and "Water Margin". It is the earliest theme scenic area in China that perfectly combines historical culture, film and television culture, and tourism culture, and is also one of the first national AAAAA level tourist attractions. The Three Kingdoms City and the Water Margin City are in a superior geographical position. With a panoramic view of the vastness of the Taihu Lake Lake and the verdant Junzhang Mountain on their backs, they enjoy the charm of the Taihu Lake Lake. The buildings in the scenic area are magnificent, ancient and dignified, and staggered. The main attractions include the Wu Palace, Taoyuan, Ganlu Temple, Caoying Water Village, Zishi Street, Qingming Shanghe Street, Song Palace, Liangshan Juyi Hall, etc. The spectacular performance program is a highlight of the scenic area. The large-scale horse battle performance "Three Heroes Fighting against Lu Bu" reproduces the war scenes of the Three Kingdoms period with golden spears, iron horses, and fierce competition. Its grand performance scene and stunning horse fighting performance have won the hearts of countless audiences. The film and television special effects performance "Fighting and Killing Ximen Qing" reproduces the wonderful story of Wu Song avenging his brother and fighting and killing Ximen Qing. The performance reveals to visitors the secrets of special effects commonly used in film and television filming, such as flying figures, aerial fights, burning people, and fireworks explosions, which are displayed one by one in the program; The dazzling stage play "Ode to the Goddess of Luo" focuses on classic poetry, famous essays, and timeless paintings. It uses artistic forms such as dance, instrumental music, and recitation to integrate stage design, visual effects, lighting, and sound effects, providing visitors with a legendary journey through time and space, leading the public to enjoy the masterpiece together... These wonderful performances that have been performed for many years in the Three Kingdoms Water Margin Scenic Area showcase well-known and popular classic stories from historical classics. The participating projects in the scenic area are diverse and colorful. Touring the Taihu Lake Lake by ancient boat, Zhuge Liannu, Bagua Formation, Water Army Training Camp and other activities are full of fun and make people linger. As a famous film and television production base in China, this place has hosted the filming of thousands of domestic and foreign films and TV dramas, such as "Romance of the Three Kingdoms", "Water Margin", "Emperor Tang Ming", "Great Ming Palace Poetry". Wuxi Film and Television Base warmly welcomes domestic and foreign tourists and film and television production teams with scientific management, high-quality services, innovative products, and complete film and television shooting facilities! Full text 

shortFeatures: Adjacent to the lake, you can overlook the landscape
summary:
The second largest water ferris wheel in the world stood on the north bank of Li Lake in Wuxi in 2008 (the largest water ferris wheel in the world at present is the water ferris wheel on Jinji Lake in Suzhou, which is 120 meters high, equivalent to the height of a 60-story building). 
The official opening of this 115-meter-high large-scale amusement facility means that the construction of Lihu scenic spot, which is dominated by ecological restoration and sightseeing along the lake, has entered a new era. 
This water skyscraper named "Taihu Star" will form a landmark structure of Wuxi lakeside city together with Lihu Bridge, and become a spectacular gateway into the CBD of Taihu New Town.

Wuxi Rongchuang Sea World covers a total area of 44000 square meters and is home to over 10000 marine, land, and air creatures such as dolphins, seals, and sharks. Featuring a 35 meter ultra long underwater landscape tunnel and a 180 ° display tank, allowing you to swim underwater from all directions and angles. An interactive ocean park that integrates exhibition, science popularization, performance, and amusement; The five major amusement projects combine ocean elements with amusement equipment, such as skydiving cavalry, ocean knights, ocean carnival, rainforest cinema, and dazzling jellyfish (for an additional fee); The performing arts projects include the legend of mermaids, the dream of Blue Island, and showcasing the wonders of marine life! Tourists can not only enjoy the joy of entertainment and play, but also have an educational and entertaining experience of acquiring knowledge. It will also allow adults and children to wander together in laughter and joy, leaving unforgettable memories of parent-child interaction. Welcome to Wuxi Rongchuang Sea World, embark on a wonderful journey of colorful ocean! Full text 

shortFeatures: Visit famous monuments such as Jichang Garden

summary: Hepu Town is a town under the jurisdiction of Xiangshan County, Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province. Hepu Town is located on Nantian Island, the largest island in Ningbo City, with a land area of 102 square kilometers. It has 34 administrative villages and 4 neighborhood committees under its jurisdiction. According to the sixth national census data, there are a total population of 32030 people. The island is rich in resources, with 195000 mu of shallow sea, 20000 mu of mudflat, 22000 mu of cultivated land, and 85000 mu of mountain forest. Hepu Town has a long history. According to the Records of Xiangshan County in the Republic of China, it belonged to Taizhou Prefecture in the third year of the Kaiyuan Period of the Sui Dynasty, and Mingzhou Prefecture in the Shenlong Period of the Tang Dynasty. In the seventh year of the Hongwu Period of the Ming Dynasty, it was banned to prevent Japanese riots. Until the fifth year of the Guangxu Period, it was granted reclamation, and gradually developed into a hub of the north-south sea route.

shortFeatures: The Origin of the Creation of Two Springs Reflecting the Moon
summary: The Second Spring in the World is located in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. A melodious music of "Two Springs Reflecting the Moon" will take you to the famous second spring in the world, make a cup of Two Springs tea, and drink it in your mouth. It is sweet and mellow. When you pour tea carefully, you can also find that the tea is several millimeters above the mouth of the cup without overflowing. This is because it contains a lot of minerals. Experts believe that the second spring water has the effect of relieving annoyance, quenching thirst and prolonging life. There are many clear springs in Huishan, and there is a saying of "Thirteen Springs of Nine Dragons" in history. Huishan Spring, located near Huishan Temple, was originally known as Yilan Spring. According to legend, it was excavated by Jingcheng, the magistrate of Wuxi County, in the wei year of Dali in the Tang Dynasty (AD 779). There are two pools in total, the upper pool is round, the water is clear and blue, and all drinks are drawn here; Lu Yu in the Tang Dynasty arranged 20 famous springs in his "Tea Classic", and Huishan Spring in Wuxi ranked second. Liu Bochu, another water critic, thought: "The spring water suitable for making tea has seven eyes, and Huishan Spring is the second." Since then, the name of "the second spring in the world" has been recognized by literati and celebrities in the past dynasties. Boil tea with two springs to entertain guests. Wang Ji, a famous painter, painted for a bamboo stove in the eighth year of Hongwugan (AD 1395), and wrote a poem: "I don't sleep at night in a cold fasting, and I sit by the fireside with tea; The fire simmers mountain chestnuts, knocks on ice to draw streams and springs, tiles turn white clouds, and bamboos emit green smoke; A sip of a phoenix gives birth to the armpit, and the Russian police bones are immortal! "It shows his falling feelings. The famous painter Wen Zhengming had a tea party with his friends in Huishan on February 19th, the 13th year of Zhengde in the Ming Dynasty (AD 1518). The party caused by the party to make a" Huishan Tea Party Picture ", which was colored on paper, reproducing the scene of poets and painters cooking tea in bamboo stoves and thinking in Maoting. This precious picture scroll is treasured in the Palace Museum. Pi Rixiu, a poet in the late Tang Dynasty, compared Li Deyu's addiction to drinking second spring water with Yang Guifei's love for lychees, and wrote a satirical poem: When the prime minister often thinks about cooking tea, it is only too late for the county marquis to urge him; Wu Guan went to the country for three thousand miles, and Mo Xiao Yang Fei loves lychees. In the later Song Dynasty, Hui Song Dynasty included the second spring water as a tribute, and it entered a hundred altars every month. Su Dongpo, a famous poet, sang the famous sentence "Take a small moon in the sky alone and try the second spring in the world". Both Kangxi and Qianlong went to Huishan to taste springs to inscribe chants. A Bing, a blind folk musician in modern times, once wandered around Huishan, and composed a song "Two Springs Reflect the Moon", which was widely circulated at home and abroad. For 3,000 years, the stone threshold has been trampled by water drawers for more than ten centimeters. The center is the spring pavilion, with the upper pool and the middle pool in the pavilion; Above the spring pavilion is the "Jinghui Hall": under the spring pavilion is the "Yilan Hall", and in front of the hall is the lower pool. The upper pool, middle pool and lower pool form a complete water system of "the second spring in the world". The three pools have different shapes, all built with exquisite bluestone railings. The middle pool is square, close to the upper pool, only three feet apart, and the stone bottom is "a trickle of running water. Clear and lovely, but the water quality is poor. " Above the upper pool and the lower pool, there is a "Two Springs Pavilion".

With a panoramic view of the vastness of the Taihu Lake Lake and the verdant Junzhang Mountain on their backs, they enjoy the charm of the Taihu Lake Lake. The large-scale horse battle performance "Three Heroes Fighting against Lu Bu" reproduces the war scenes of the Three Kingdoms period with golden spears, iron horses, and fierce competition. Its grand performance scene and stunning horse fighting performance have won the hearts of countless audiences. The film and television special effects performance "Fighting and Killing Ximen Qing" reproduces the wonderful story of Wu Song avenging his brother and fighting and killing Ximen Qing. The performance reveals to visitors the secrets of special effects commonly used in film and television filming, such as flying figures, aerial fights, burning people, and fireworks explosions, which are displayed one by one in the program; The dazzling stage play "Ode to the Goddess of Luo" focuses on classic poetry, famous essays, and timeless paintings. The International Architecture Exhibition is not just the name of a building, but a combination of various Chinese and Western architecture on Gulangyu Island. These architectural complexes are collectively referred to as the International Architecture Exhibition, which is the essence of the cultural exchange between China and the West on Gulangyu Island. These buildings include traditional Chinese temples with upturned eaves and corners, Minnan style courtyard bungalows, Bagua buildings with a combination of Chinese and Western walls, small and exquisite Japanese houses, former national consulates in 19th century European style, and Shuzhuang Garden, which can be regarded as a masterpiece of classical gardens in Jiangnan.

Chuncao Cottage, built in 1933, is the residence of Xu Chuncao, the president of Xiamen's first construction trade union. It was designed by Xu Chuncao himself and built on the cliff. It looks like a western-style building, but it is actually a modern Chinese residence. His sons and daughters named the building after his father in memory.  
The difference between Spring Cottage and other villas in Gulangyu lies in the fact that the unique granite of southern Fujian is selected as the wall foundation, wall columns and columns. In particular, the wasteland surface of granite is deliberately preserved, and it is jointed with clear water and red bricks. At first glance, it not only has the natural rough and thick feeling, but also has the natural color beauty of southern Fujian architecture. The site selection of this building is unique, with a wide viewing angle, and you can push the window to see the sea and clouds.

When it comes to overlooking Gulangyu Island, most people think of Sunshine Rock, but in fact, there is also Moonlight Rock on Gulangyu Island, which is not only a place to enjoy the sunset, but also offers a distant view of Haicang Port. Moonlight Rock is the second highest point on Gulangyu Island, located on Bishan Road. It is sparsely populated, quiet, and offers a 360 degree panoramic view of the sea from afar. Climbing up Moonlight Rock, you can almost see half of Xiamen.

The cave adopts the combination of multimedia, sound, light and electricity, combining virtual and real. 
 
The Shell Museum, located in Gulangyu Island, is located in the dream world of shells. It has a collection of more than 6,800 kinds of shells, mainly representative snails such as Martin proboscis snail, Tianwang snail, Venus snail and Brandy snail. It has a deep understanding of the basic shape, typical characteristics and basic classification of shells, and displays anecdotes about shell collection by shell collectors all over the world. Some precious collections in the museum are only for annual academic exchanges of shells.

After the looming mysterious shell phantom appeared, the life of seaside fishermen began at sunrise and sunset. A beautiful wave of Gulangyu attracted us to the shell theater driven by shell elves. The mysterious power between light and shadow introduced us into the ancient submarine hut and entered the deepest part of the ocean. The mermaid swayed its beautiful posture to tell us the mysterious passage ahead. The legendary and thrilling journey has made Shell Dream World form a unique advantage and become the representative business card of Gulangyu Island.

The Ten Mile Embankment was started by the people of Xiamen in October 1955. The "Ten Mile Embankment" is the elegant name for the Jimei and Xinglin seawalls, also known as the "Xiamen seawall", with a total length of 2820 meters. In that year, the people of Xiamen also turned Xinglin Bay, with an area of 5.2 square kilometers, into an artificial lake. This is a great place for a walk, with many trees planted along the long embankment. The sea breeze is gentle and the leaves are rustling, allowing tourists to fully enjoy the tranquility and comfort provided by nature. The dusk and night scenery here are also very beautiful, which is a blessing for tourists who love photography.

It is known as "Science Disney". The Science and Technology Museum has five theme exhibition halls, about 400 interactive experience projects and three dynamic cinemas, attracting more than one million audiences every year.  
As soon as you walk into the preface hall, you can see the treasure of the Science and Technology Museum-the water clock, which is a water-powered timing device. Its design combines the pivot escapement mechanism invented by Su Song, a Xiamen scientist in the Northern Song Dynasty.  
A new adventure into the Discovery Hall is about to begin: indulge in the ever-changing cosmic galaxy in the time and space tunnel, an exhibit in online celebrity; Really experience a "angry crown" on the open magneto-electrical stage; Disoriented in an oversized maze of mirrors …. 
The moment you step into the Creation Museum, you feel like you have come to the future world-watching robots dance, playing chess with robots, and letting robots draw portraits of you... There is also a very popular world of light and shadow: a wonderful sea of colorful flowers, created with gestures. A different kind of fireworks fountain, discover a shadow world given "life"... 
From the beginning of entering the Harmony Pavilion, an experience space full of science and technology and futuristic sense will immediately appear in front of you. Through immersive human adventures, vivid and rich 3D animations to interesting and fun physical fitness tests, you can explore the secrets of the human body from cells.  
Come to the domestic "Intelligent Mecha" immersive experience space, and many domestic mecha interactive devices are exhibited for the first time. The secret world of the future time and space exceeds 1,000 square meters, and the future world is unfolded from this. Let's travel through time and space together and explore the unknown! In the quiet future forest, there are mecha jellyfish dancing their tentacles in the air, and flying wings with vast birds singing in the sky; The ugly "mecha dog", who has no head and slender limbs, is greeting you and performing a heel flip. 
When you come to the aquarium, you must prepare a curious heart and active brain, because there is not only an underwater world where you can use your imagination, but also a magical and interesting VR underwater adventure and AR surfing experience.  
Walking to the children's pavilion on the second floor is like opening a Pandora's treasure box, with endless fun inside: witness with your own eyes how the magic rain overcomes gravity and flows backwards from bottom to top, experience the pleasure of sliding from the big slide to the ocean ball pool, and watch the small ball kingdom. The ball climbs gears, suspends... each shows its unique stunts.  
In addition to five theme exhibition halls, there are three cinemas in the Science and Technology Museum. The dream theater that combines reality and reality, the 4D flying theater with a strong sense of story, and the 720Rider theater with a full sense of experience, you can not only see the beautiful special effects but also not miss the exciting experience during the movie watching process.

The former British Consulate General's residence in Xiamen, located at No. 5 Zhangzhou Road, Gulangyu Island, is a beautiful mansion nestled among green trees. Today, it has become an exhibition hall of the Xiamen Jinquan Coin Museum. The original British Consulate building on Gulangyu Island was a three story red brick building with bricks and stones at the four corners. The structure was square and rigorous, with floor to ceiling doors and windows, all equipped with louvers to adjust sunlight and block wind and sand, and also decorated with fireplaces. According to research, this mansion represents the early colonial architectural style of Gulangyu Island.

tagNameList: Churches and Cathedrals; Buildings by Famous Architects
summary: The Concordia Chapel is the earliest church on Gulangyu Island. In the mid-19th century, many devout Christians came to Gulangyu Island. In order to have a place of worship, they decided to build a church on Gulangyu Island. As a result, believers from various churches donated money and built a church on the top of Lujiao on Gulangyu Island. In 1863, this neoclassical style church was completed and was originally called the "International Chapel". In 1911, the church underwent renovation and was renamed the "Concordia Chapel". After 1949, the Concordia Church was handed over to the management of the Chinese Church. At the end of March 1951, the Concordia Church was taken over by the Presbyterian Church of Trinity Church and Gospel Church. After 1952, Xiehe Church was handed over to the Second Hospital of Xiamen for use. In 1974, due to the development needs of the Second Hospital, the church was almost demolished to build a pharmacy for the hospital. However, under the efforts of architect Mr. Bai Jiaxin, some buildings were added around the church using seemingly destructive but actually protective methods. Although the church was covered by the buildings, it was able to be preserved. The Concordia Chapel has been renovated and presented to visitors in its old and restored appearance.
Gangzaihou Beach is located in Xiamen City and is one of the beaches on Gulangyu Island. The coastline of the beach is not very long, the sand is clean and fine, and the sea water is clear in color.

Wuyuan Bay Wetland Park covers an area of 85 hectares, equivalent to half of Gulangyu Island. It is a large park and wetland ecological park in Xiamen, known as the city's green lung. Every March, a large number of egrets build nests and breed here, and it is also an important stop for migratory birds to migrate north and south. On the current plot of the park, there are aquatic and wetland plant zones, aquatic plant communities, reed and wetland plant communities. Currently, 25 species of wetland waterbirds from 9 families and 29 species of forest and farmland birds from 17 families that inhabit wetlands will continue to live and sing here. Tourists can sit on the observation balcony of the Water Pavilion and watch the five bridges complement each other from afar. They can stroll on the wooden boardwalk to see the reeds swaying and water lilies blooming on the lake. On the bird island in the center of the lake, they can watch water birds rise and fall in the misty air, or enjoy the fun of fishing on the wooden platform. Across from the thousand foot wooden boardwalk is a gathering place for yachts, where sailboats or sea swimming training can be seen from time to time. Because Wuyuan Bay is the main venue for many international sailing competitions and the starting point for many sailboats going out to sea, if you have enough time, you can also schedule a sailing activity to experience the excitement of sea breeze and seawater rushing towards you.

Longtou Road is located on Gulangyu Island, not far from the pier, and it is also a necessary route to reach the pier. This road is a bustling commercial street on Gulangyu Island. The not wide streets are lined with various cultural shops, delicious snacks, and more. Each shop has its own style and characteristics in terms of window display and decoration. Even if you don't go into the shop, it's still great to just stroll outside and take a look.

The Organ Museum is located at 43 Guxin Road, Gulangyu Island. The venue is not very large and displays more than 5000 organs of various ages and styles. Those interested in music can come and visit, otherwise they may find it boring. It is said to be the only organ museum in China and the largest in the world at present. The first floor of the venue displays many historical organs from around the world, most of which are produced in France and Spain. The treasure of the town hall here is the world's largest organ. The backyard of the museum houses some smuggled cultural relics seized from customs, all of which are stone carvings.

Lihu Park is located on the north side of Lihu Bridge, leaning against the bridge and facing the lake, with scenic views. It covers an area of 15.8 hectares and is an important node in the Lihu Scenic Belt. Construction began in March 2004 and was completed and opened to the public on the eve of National Day that year. The park combines the strengths of traditional gardens and European style parks in its design and construction, creating high-quality green spaces and integrating leisure and recreation, gathering activities, and commercial functions into a tourism and leisure center. The four major landscapes in the garden, namely the beauty of spring, the beauty of summer, the charm of autumn, and the condensation of winter, are ingeniously arranged, showcasing the beauty of Jiangnan with flowers and trees throughout the four seasons. Surrounding the garden with water, creating scenery along with the water, twelve small bridges point out the charm of the water town. Garden in Garden - Shiyuan, named after the historical legend of Fan Lishi's boat ride on Lihu Lake. The lush forests and bamboo groves embrace the garden, winding paths and secluded streams surround it, and the blue water in the garden pool is like a moon mirror, with a heavenly realm. The four pavilions of Liuyun, Tianyuan, Yuehong, and Qinghui look at each other from the corners, looking at each other with a beautiful expression. The water mirror corridor, which is built around the water, is a circular arc, 286.7 meters long. It is a combination of Chinese and Western styles, and has a unique shape. The corridor is engraved with masterpieces of poetry, painting, and photography of celebrities who praise the Taihu Lake Lake from ancient and modern times, highlighting the beauty of the Taihu Lake Lake culture, and feeling the long civilization of the five lakes. There is a clear stream of water in front of the corridor, with lotus flowers filling the pond. It stands tall and elegant, with a fragrance that is far away and clear. The ferris wheel on the water, the "Star of the Taihu Lake Lake", is 115 meters high, standing by the side of the park lake. Sitting on the ferris wheel of Lihu Lake in the Taihu Lake, you can not only see the beautiful scenery of the Taihu Lake Lake, such as the fairyland of the Taihu Lake Lake and Luding Mountain, but also overlook the urban area of Wuxi. After nightfall, the electronic decoration of the ferris wheel will change into beautiful scenes. This water ferris and Lihu Bridge together form the landmark building of Wuxi lakeside city, and become the spectacular gateway of the Taihu Lake New Town CBD. Full text 

Wuxi Sunac Resort City is located in Binhu District, Wuxi City, adjacent to Yuantouzhu Scenic Area and Xuelang Mountain Scenic Area. It covers a total area of 240 hectares and has Sunac Land, Water Park, Snow Park, Sea Park, runway, Sunac Mall, high star lake hotels, bar streets, high-quality residential areas, etc. It is a large-scale comprehensive project integrating cultural tourism, leisure and entertainment, hotels, commerce, and housing. summary: Lutingzhong Village is a millennium old Peach Blossom Spring village hidden in Ningbo, located at the northern foot of the Siming Mountains. The terrain is high in the south and low in the north, with Xiaolu Daxi passing through the village. This place has a long and profound history, with green mountains, beautiful waters, ancient temples, ancient bridges, and ancient dwellings, showcasing the unique style of the local ancient villages in eastern Zhejiang. Approaching Zhongcun, one is greeted by layers of lush green mountains. In the center of the village, a clear and bottomless Xiaolu River winds through, dividing the entire village into two parts and forming a situation of facing each other across the bank. The existing residential buildings in the village are mostly traditional rural buildings built with stone blocks and decorated simply. The interior of the village maintains the traditional street and alley texture, and the overall layout is complete. The Baiyun Bridge in the village was first built during the Tang Dynasty's Zhenguan period and has been repeatedly destroyed and rebuilt. The existing bridge was built in the 16th year of the Qing Dynasty's Guangxu reign and has a history of a hundred years to this day. From a distance, this towering steep arched single hole stone bridge spans across the banks of Xiaolu River like a rainbow. The bridge is tall and narrow, with towering mountains on both sides. Accompanying this Baiyun Bridge are 20 stepping stones connected to the arch bridge in the south. This type of water stepping stone is unique to mountain streams and does not have bridge slabs. Floods can flow through the stone steps, and pedestrians can also cross the water by stepping on the stones. Its principle is equivalent to the spillway of a modern reservoir dam, which plays a role in overflowing floods and protecting the bridge body. Nowadays, villagers have started their own farmhouse restaurants, producing dishes such as gray sauce balls, bamboo shoots grilled meat, creek pit fish, and bamboo shoots dried vegetables that have a strong rural flavor. If you feel unsatisfied, you can also buy some sweet potatoes, dates, bamboo shoots dried vegetables, vermicelli, etc. to take home and savor. Full text 

poiName: Former Site of the Japanese Consulate
summary:
In 1896, the Japanese government forced the Qing government to allow it to set up a consulate in Xiamen, which was located at No.26 Lujiao Road, close to the British consulate. The building was designed by a Chinese designer, but the building was in English style and the roof was in Chinese style. It was built in 1897. 
In 1928, Japan built two red buildings on the side of the consulate as its police headquarters. During the Anti-Japanese War, many anti-Japanese soldiers were detained in the basement prison here. Up to now, the anti-Japanese slogans and blood stains left by the anti-Japanese soldiers who were detained at that time can still be seen on the walls. After the victory of the Anti-Japanese War in 1945, the National Government nationalized it, and later it was owned by Xiamen University. It is now the dormitory of faculty and staff of Xiamen University, but it has been seriously dilapidated.

The Zhejiang Museum has two venues, Gushan Hall and Wulin Hall. The old museum, Gushan Hall, is located at the southern foot of Gushan and consists of the main building, Zhejiang West Lake Art Museum, and the Royal Library Wenlan Pavilion. The main exhibition features pottery and lacquerware from the Hemudu culture, as well as jade and silk fabrics from the Liangzhu culture; Bronze artifacts from the state of Yue; Works of Zhejiang calligraphers and painters from the Ming and Qing dynasties. The main building has three floors, with exhibition halls such as Ceramic Hall, Celadon Hall, Lacquerware Hall, etc. The first floor mainly displays some pottery, the second and third floors mainly display porcelain, the second floor mainly displays some Yue kiln porcelain, Longquan porcelain, etc., and the third floor displays porcelain from the Ming and Qing dynasties or later periods. The Zhejiang West Lake Art Museum on the east side of Gushan Museum mainly displays some calligraphy and painting works. In addition, there are two special exhibition halls available for visitors: Huang Binhong Calligraphy and Painting Museum and Lv Xiaguang Art Museum. In addition, the main building of the museum and the West Lake Art Museum hold different temporary exhibitions from time to time every year. The Wenlan Pavilion on the west side is one of the seven pavilions in the Qing Dynasty that collected the Complete Library of Four Treasures. However, it no longer houses the Complete Library of Four Treasures, only the bookshelf where the books were stored at that time. There are sample introductions to the Complete Library of Four Treasures and introductions to the process of collecting them after being destroyed in war. However, the Wenlan Pavilion has a beautiful scenery and is a typical Jiangnan courtyard building, worth a visit. Xiling Seal Engravers Society is located not far from Gushan Pavilion. shortFeatures: The landmark landscape of Baoshi Mountain
summary:
Baochu Pagoda is an ancient Han building built in the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. It is located on Baoshi Mountain in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It is also known as Baoshu Pagoda, Baoshi Pagoda, Baosuo Pagoda and Baosuo Pagoda. According to the records, it was built in the anniversary of the Five Dynasties. It was originally Grade 9, but it was changed to Grade 7 when it was rebuilt during the Xianping period of the Northern Song Dynasty. It has been built many times in the past dynasties, and the present solid tower was repaired according to the original state of the ancient tower in the 22nd year of the Republic of China (1933). In 1997, the decayed pagoda brake was replaced and repaired. Since then, Baochu Pagoda has remained intact to this day.  
Baochu Pagoda, located on Baoshi Mountain on the north line of West Lake in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, was built in the Northern Song Dynasty, and was repeatedly destroyed and built. It was rebuilt in 1933 according to the original style after the late Ming Dynasty. The tower body of Baochu Pagoda is an octagonal brick structure, which is divided into seven floors, and there is an iron-cast tower top supported by a wooden base. There is a wooden ceiling at the top of the seventh floor of the pagoda, and there are coarse logs penetrating from the top to support the top of the pagoda. The hole reserved for these logs is still clearly visible at the top of the tapered tower. Above it is a cast iron spire with five iron rings. The tower is huge, and it is impossible to climb to the top from the inside. If the spire is not counted, the height of the tower is also estimated to reach 40 meters. The width of each side of the bottom floor of the tower is 2.65 meters. Except for the second to fifth floors, the outer walls of each floor are slightly smaller than those of the bottom floor.

The Grand Canal (Hangzhou section) is the southernmost end of the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal. Over thousands of years of history, it has integrated the unique products, cuisine, clothing, customs, and etiquette of various regions in northern and southern China, forming the canal cultural landscape represented by the "Ten Scenic Spots of the Canal". Caofang boats are the "tide" boats of the Hangzhou Grand Canal. Today's Caozao boats integrate historical ship elements of the canal with modern science and technology, and are an important carrier of modern canal tourism. Starting from Wulinmen Pier, taking Caofang boats all the way north can appreciate the unique scenery along the Grand Canal heritage line, such as Jiangqiao Muyu, Xiangji Fanyin, Fuyi Liuyu, Gongchen Yaoyue, and Qiaoxi Renjia. You can experience the slow life of Hangzhou by taking a boat ride. Canal water tourism represented by boats and boats, including canal tours, night tours, ancient town tours, and red transportation tours, is favored by citizens and tourists.

shortFeatures: One of the landmark buildings in Hangzhou
summary: Drum Tower is located in the east face of Wushan Mountain in Hangzhou, bordering Shiwukui Lane in the south, Dajing Lane in the north, Zhonghe Road in the east and Wugong Mountain in the west. It is the starting point of the southeast face of Qinghefang Historic District. Founded in the Southern Dynasty during the Five Dynasties, about 1400 years ago, it used to be a palace of the emperor of the Southern Song Dynasty "Fulin Hall", commonly known as the Drum Tower among the folks. It was demolished in the 1960s and rebuilt in 2003. Huge Dongyang woodcarvings, Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival and Drum Tower Scene Scene, were installed above the exhibition hall. The big drum on the tower on the second floor is two meters in diameter, and the Century Peace Bell is protected by rice on the observation platform, which can be used for tourists to beat drums and bells to help them enjoy themselves and arouse the feeling of nostalgia for the past.

shortFeatures: Understand the history of tea, tea extraction, tea set and tea culture

summary: Huishan Ancient Town is located in Wuxi City and is a cultural ancient town with a long history. The Xu Xiake Temple is built to commemorate the famous Ming Dynasty traveler Xu Xiake. On the upper floor of the city gate, flags and banners are fluttering, and two Han Dynasty divine beasts, Tianlu and Bixie, stand tall in the square. Tianlu and Bixie are legendary ancient divine beasts with auspicious and festive meanings.

In the old days, there were Zen temples in the southeast, northwest, and northwest suburbs of Fuzhou. This temple was located at the foot of Yishan Mountain in the western suburbs of Fuzhou, so it was called Xichan Temple. In history, Xichan Temple has been destroyed several times, so although it is an ancient temple, most of the Xichan Temples you see now are newly built. Overall, the repairs are very good, and the main hall of the temple is very tall and magnificent. In the temple, there are the Shakya ManiHall, Dharma Hall, Sutra Pavilion, Jade Buddha Tower, Guanyin Pavilion, guest hall, Zen Hall, Abbot Room and other buildings. The most precious cultural relic is the Kangxi imperial calligraphy of the "Medicine Buddha Sutra" hidden in the Sutra Pavilion, but tourists cannot see it. The environment of Xichan Temple is beautiful and the greenery is well done, and there is also a famous feature - lychee trees. On the pillars of the ancient temple gate, there is a couplet engraved: "The four dynasties of the Li tree are passed down to the Song Dynasty, and the sound of the bell echoes through the ages." This is a couplet written by Zhou Lian in the Qing Dynasty. This not only indicates that there are many lychee trees in Xichan Temple, but also shows that Xichan Temple has existed since the Tang Dynasty. The lychee tree in the front courtyard of the Dharma Hall is an ancient tree that dates back to the Song Dynasty and is still blooming and bearing fruit today. Like other temples, Xichan Temple also has a release pool with a lot of fish and turtles inside. Children will be very happy to see it. In addition, overseas temples such as Shuanglin Temple in Singapore, Shuangqing Temple in Penang, Malaysia, and Nanputuo Temple in Vietnam are all under the jurisdiction of the Western Zen Lower House and are still managed by the monks of the Western Zen Temple. Therefore, this is a window for cultural exchange between Fuzhou and Southeast Asia. Every year, many foreign monks and believers visit and participate, making it a unique landscape of ancient temples. Overall, for a city like Fuzhou where almost every park is free, seeing paid temples is somewhat uncomfortable, and it feels like worshiping Buddha has a more secular flavor. If you have plenty of time and there are not many scenic spots in Fuzhou, and this is still considered a good attraction, then you can come. Full text 

poiName: Former Residence of Lin Juemin and Bingxin
summary: The former residence is located at the intersection of Yangqiao Lane and the west side of Nanhou Street North Exit, at No. 17 Yangqiao Road. It was announced as a national key cultural relic protection unit in 2006 and now has exhibitions of "Lin Juemin's Life and Historical Sites" and "Ice Heart and Fuzhou". The former residence was originally inhabited by the seven bedroom family of Lin Juemin's ancestors (including Lin Changmin). After Lin Juemin died in the Guangzhou Uprising, the Lin family fled to avoid danger and sold their house to Xie Luan'en, the grandfather of Bing Xin. The Xie family lived there until the 1950s. Bing Xin lived here when she was eleven or twelve years old. The former residence was built in the Qing Dynasty, facing east and surrounded by wind and fire walls on all sides. The front door faces the back street, and the gatehouse used to be a "10000 liter bucket stone shop". The main building has three entrances, covering an area of 694 square meters, and the entrance has been relocated to Yangqiao Road. Yuan Bingxin lives with her parents in the left wing of the second courtyard, while her grandfather lives in the right wing, with a study in the front and a bedroom in the back. On the south side of the main building, outside the partition wall, from the east is the Wisteria Bookstore, which is connected to the front porch of the main hall. There is another small courtyard in the southwest corner outside the wall. The small house in the courtyard has two rooms, one living room and one bedroom. It was the residence of Lin Juemin and his wife at that time. There is a small courtyard to the south, and there are plum trees planted on the flower bed. This is exactly the scene described in Lin Juemin's "Letter to My Wife": "Recalling the house on the back street, the entrance passes through the corridor, and after passing through the front hall, there are three or four turns. There is a small hall and one room next to the hall, which is a place for me and you to live together. Three or four months after our first marriage, looking out at the winter, the sparse plum blossoms outside the window screen the moon's shadow, faintly hidden. I stand shoulder to shoulder with you, low and straight. Why don't you speak, why don't you express your feelings?" Regarding the courtyard, Bing Xin also had a vivid description in his later years in "My Hometown": "Our house has several courtyards, but it's not like the courtyard of the 'quadrangle' in Beijing; it's just in one row or one room. In front of it, there is a rectangular 'courtyard' with a well inside each 'courtyard', which is almost a characteristic of houses in Fuzhou. In this large room, besides the residents, there are the guest room and study. Almost all halls, guest rooms, and study rooms have calligraphy and painting pasted or hung on their columns and walls Full text 

summary:
The China Shipbuilding Culture Scenic Area is located near Mawei Port and is a theme park focused on shipbuilding culture. The Mawei Shipyard was China’s first modern shipyard and the largest dry dock in the Far East at that time. From its establishment in 1866 until shipbuilding ceased in 1907, it constructed 40 ships of various sizes. Fuzhou Shipbuilding thus gained worldwide fame, becoming a significant chapter in modern Chinese history.

The scenic area’s attractions are distributed along the banks of the Min River, within a 1-kilometer radius of Mawei Port. These include Luoxing Tower Park, Ma Xian Mountain Park, and the Majiang Sea Battle Memorial Museum. Visitors can walk around the sites, which are all free to enter. The surroundings are pleasant, making it a good spot for both leisure walks and learning about the history of Fuzhou Shipbuilding.

When visiting, the focus is typically on the China Shipbuilding Culture Museum and the Zhao Zhong Temple on the western side of Mawei Port. In the Shipbuilding Culture Museum, visitors can see various models of ships from the time, showcasing their exterior designs and internal structures. There are also sculptural reenactments of historical events to help tourists understand significant moments in history. Nearby is the Zhao Zhong Temple, built in memory of the soldiers of the Fujian Navy who died in the Sino-French Mawei Sea Battle, now serving as the Majiang Sea Battle Memorial Museum.

Behind the two venues, Ma Xian Mountain is also worth exploring. The numerous fortifications, the Shengjiao Hospital, Meiyuan Prison, and the British Consulate branch at the top of the mountain are all historically significant sites. To the east of Mawei Port, Luoxing Tower in Luoxing Tower Park is a landmark of Fuzhou, but it can only be viewed from the outside. The small hills in the park offer a good walk for exercise, and from the top, visitors can enjoy views of the Min River flowing below.

The Chinese Shipbuilding Culture Museum is a museum with shipbuilding as its main theme. Our exhibition showcases the fruitful achievements of China's shipbuilding industry in modern China's advanced technology, modern education, industrial manufacturing, and the translation and dissemination of Western classic culture through a large number of precious cultural relics, pictures, models, and various simulation scenes, using modern means such as sound, light, and electricity. It reflects the spirit of many benevolent individuals and their advanced ideas, and reflects the traditional cultural charm of the Chinese nation's unique perseverance, eagerness to learn, willingness to learn from others, courage to innovate, and loyalty to the country. The Shipbuilding Culture Museum (formerly known as the Modern Chinese Navy Museum) is located at the foot of Majian Mountain. It is a five story building with a construction area of 4100 square meters, including an exhibition hall area of about 3500 square meters. It was first built in 1997 and renamed in 2005. Since 2004, the government of the Development Zone has invested over 6 million yuan to comprehensively revamp the China Modern Navy Museum and rename it as the China Shipbuilding Culture Museum, in accordance with the strategic deployment of the Fuzhou Municipal Committee to "explore shipbuilding culture and break through Fuzhou tourism", in order to promote shipbuilding culture. The museum is a five story building, divided into five sections to showcase the essence of shipbuilding administration. The preface on the first floor mainly uses a large relief sculpture to reflect the connotation of shipbuilding administration; Overview of Ship Administration on the Second Floor, summarizing the development and achievements of ship administration through systems such as Qin Zhe, Submarine Electricity Charges, and Ship Administration Achievements; The theme of the third floor exhibition hall is the revival of science and education, mainly elaborating on the important position of the Shipbuilding School education in modern Chinese industry, reflecting that "Min Tang is the ancestor of the founding"; The pioneer of the fourth floor industry mainly reflects that Fujian Shipbuilding is an important birthplace of Chinese industrial workers; The fifth floor is the foundation of the navy, and Ma Wei is the cradle of modern Chinese navy. Sun Yat sen praised shipbuilding as "the foundation of the navy". In April 2006, Lien Chan and his delegation, who were visiting Fujian Province to pay tribute to their ancestors, visited this museum. During the visit, he told reporters, "The Shipbuilding Museum narrates the modernization process of the entire shipbuilding construction and development, which was very difficult and encountered many difficulties and setbacks. Therefore, the efforts of our predecessors have given great inspiration to future generations: how to jointly enrich the country and the people is the responsibility of our generation." Before leaving, Lien Chan also wrote an inscription for the museum: "Eastern learning is for physical and Western learning, and the Majiang giant ship controls the raging waves. Full text 

Within the scenic area, Shizhu Temple is an ancient temple where both Buddhism and Taoism coexist. The main deities enshrined here are not the Jade Emperor or the Three Pure Ones, but the renowned He family's Nine Immortals in Taoism. It is said that praying here is effective, and the temple is very popular. It is worth noting that incense and candles at the base of the mountain are usually much cheaper than those at the summit.  
If time is limited, visitors can return from Shizhu Temple. For those wanting to enjoy more natural scenery, they can continue up the stone steps to the top of Zhuangyuan Peak. Two hiking paths from the halfway point meet at Fuqiang Pavilion and merge into one road leading straight to the summit. Completing the entire hike requires some physical effort. Additionally, the Lion Rock Hall in the mountain is also one of the more famous prayer sites.

Entering the flower exhibition room, the dazzling floral bonsai is constantly praised. In the tropical botanical specimen garden, there are world-renowned trees such as peach blossom heartwood, ironwood, and teak, oil pears with an oil content of up to 20%, and parasitic trees such as Sumatran acacia, which is a valuable industrial raw material for purple gum. On Mount Fulu, about five miles southwest of Longtian Town. During the Northern Song Dynasty, there were temples on Mount Fulu, which experienced several ups and downs. During the Ming Wanli era, there were still old temples on the mountain, and the remaining Fulu Temple was founded by scholar Ye Xianggao in the 42nd year of the Ming Wanli era (1614). Fulu Temple began to decline since the late Qing Dynasty. And due to the warlord chaos and inadequate protection of historical sites, remote scenery has gradually been destroyed, and temples are often stolen. With the sponsorship of Longtian Town and the believers in Jincun, Monk Shisheng raised funds to rebuild the temple and erected a monument to commend the donors. The monument still exists today. During the Cultural Revolution, the doors, windows, rafters, columns, bricks, and tiles of Buddhist temples were stolen, and bronze Buddha statues, steel immortals, and bronze bells were smashed and sold. All remaining trees were cut down. The current Fulu Temple was rebuilt in 2004, basically in its original appearance.

Here, one can appreciate the unique features of the Yellow River, such as its suspended, dangerous, turbulent, wide, and turbid nature. summary: Fuzhou Zhenhai Tower is located at the top of Pingshan Mountain and is one of the nine famous towers in China. Built in the fourth year of the Hongwu reign of the Ming Dynasty (1371), it was originally a sample tower for various city gates, later renamed Zhenhai Tower. It is a high-rise building in the ancient city of Fuzhou, a symbol of the north side of the city, and a sign of ships entering the city at night. "Viewing the Sea from the Sample Tower" was once one of the eight scenic spots outside West Lake in Fuzhou. Zhenhai Tower has gone through more than 600 years of vicissitudes and has been repeatedly built and destroyed. The existing Zhenhai Building began reconstruction in November 2006. The rebuilt Zhenhai Tower consists of a base layer, a pedestal layer, and a two-story tower, with a total height of 31.3 meters; The basement level houses an underground palace, while the base level and the first floor of the tower serve as exhibition halls, and the second floor serves as a viewing and leisure hall.

Hualin Temple is at the foot of Pingshan Mountain. It was built by Fuzhou County Governor to pray for border peace during the separatist regime of King Qian of Wuyue. However, after several spring and autumn periods, only the main hall remains. It was rebuilt many times in the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the mountain gate, left and right side halls and corridors were added. However, its main components are still thousands of years old, and it is the oldest wooden structure in the south of the Yangtze River in China. 
The construction technique of Hualin Temple is unique in the wooden architecture of Tang and Song Dynasties in China. According to the textual research of experts and scholars from China and Japan, the main hall of Hualin Temple has a great influence on the architectural style of Kamakura period in Japan, such as Buddha-like and Tencel-like.

The Erqi Memorial Tower is located in the center of Erqi Square and was built to commemorate the general strike of Beijing-Hankow railway workers on February 7, 1923. It is a reinforced concrete structure with a height of 63 meters and a total of 14 floors, of which the tower base is 3 floors and the tower body is 11 floors. The top corner of each floor is an antique corner cornice and covered with green glazed tiles. There is a bell tower at the top of the tower, with six large clocks with a diameter of 2.7 meters. The music "The East is Red" is played on the hour, and the bells are melodious and stretch for several kilometers. The plane of the tower is two pentagons connected from east to west. When viewed from east to west, it is a single tower and when viewed from north to south, it is a twin tower. One side of the tower is a spiral ladder and the other is an exhibition room. Visitors can climb to the top of the tower and overlook the city. After night, a variety of colorful lights illuminate inside and outside, making the twin towers more colorful.

shortFeatures: Exquisite ancient architecture of the Henan merchants
summary: Kang Baili Manor, also known as Heluo Kang Family Manor, was built by the ancestor of the Kang family, Kang Shaojing. It was established during the Ming Dynasty, flourished in the early Qing Dynasty, reached its peak during the Qianlong era, gradually declined after the Xianfeng period, and fell into ruin in the mid-Republic of China. It is one of the three major manors in the country (the other two being Liu Wencai Manor and Mou Erhei Manor). Spanning three historical periods—Ming, Qing, and the Republic of China—the manor remained prosperous for twelve generations over more than four hundred years, dominating the Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi provinces, with ships navigating the Luo, Huang, Yun, Yi, Jing, and Wei rivers. It boasted fertile fields covering over two thousand acres, and its wealth was beyond measure. "Head resting in Jingyang and Xi'an, feet on Linyi and Jinan; horses travel a thousand miles without eating other grass, people walk a thousand miles through Kang family fields" is a true depiction of its grandeur. The manor consists of 33 courtyards, 53 buildings, over 1,300 rooms, and 73 cave dwellings. It is divided into several sections, including the Upper Village main residence area, Lower Village residential area, South Courtyard, ancestral hall area, workshop area, vegetable garden area, Longwo Gorge, Jingu Village, garden, and warehouse area, among others.

summary: Gongyi Grotto Temple was founded in the period of Emperor Xiaowen of the Northern Wei Dynasty, and it is one of the large grottoes excavated by the royal family of the Northern Wei Dynasty. The Eastern Wei, Western Wei, Northern Qi, Sui, Tang and Song Dynasties successively cut niches and statues here, leaving behind a large number of precious statues and inscriptions. After more than 1500 years of wind and rain, there are 5 existing caves, 1 thousand Buddha niches, 3 cliff Buddhas, 7,743 Buddha statues, and 186 statue inscriptions and other inscriptions. Grotto statues are meticulously carved, rich in connotation, naturally vivid and extraordinary; The emperor's worship of Buddha is perfect in composition and well preserved, which fully shows the grand scene of the royal family of the Northern Wei Dynasty going to worship Buddha. Beihu Emperor Cave integrates cultural and natural landscapes, She ethnic culture, natural forests, Grand Canyon, lakes and other mountain and water landscapes. It has 23 waterfalls, over 80 cultural and water landscapes, strange rocks and trees, and is dotted with stars. It has a typical natural waterfall group of Danxia landform in Fujian Province. It is a Grand Canyon lake scenic area with a large number of waterfalls, good ecological protection, and extremely rich cultural landscapes discovered in Fuzhou so far. Although Emperor's Cave is called a cave, it is actually a canyon and wins with waterfalls. A deep canyon formed by the erosion and cutting of Cretaceous volcanic rocks (rhyolite crystal tuff) along faults and joints by flowing water. The canyon is V-shaped, about 5 kilometers long, with a height difference of over 400 meters. The mountains on both sides of the canyon are steep and steep, with steep cliffs and a valley bottom width of 10-30 meters. The valley has a steep slope, and the perennial Feishui River winds through the Grand Canyon, with shallow shoals, deep pools, waterfalls, and flying springs visible. There are more than 20 waterfalls of various sizes in the canyon, with a large drop of 76 meters, resembling flying water in the sky and the Milky Way rushing wildly. The waterfall and pond meet each other, creating a majestic and majestic atmosphere. The stream is full of strange and rugged rocks, with interesting stones piled up. The stream is clear to the bottom, sometimes rushing and roaring, and sometimes gently flowing with microwaves. The green trees on both sides of the strait cover the sky, and the subtropical rainforest in the stream provides shade. Vines climb and attach to the trees, while strange flowers and grasses sway in the wind. Bees fly and butterflies dance, birds chirp, and the landscape is beautiful, exuding a strong mountain charm everywhere. The Beihu Reservoir in Emperor Cave is the second largest drinking water source and the largest artificial lake in Fuzhou City. It is located between Rixi Township in Jin'an District, Xiaocang Township in Lianjiang County, and Huokou Township in Luoyuan County, with a water area of 6.8 square kilometers. Originally named Shanzi Reservoir, it is named Beihu due to its location on the north peak and also known as Sheshan Lake due to its flow through Shejia Village. Located at No. 4, north of the east entrance of Yijinfang, it was founded during the Ming Wanli period (1573-1620) and was originally a residence of the Zheng surname; During the reign of Emperor Daoguang of the Qing Dynasty (1821-1851), it was owned by the Sun Yimou family and has been inhabited by descendants of the Sun family for a long time. After multiple renovations, it has become three adjacent and larger residential buildings throughout the entire area. The major feature of the Flower Hall is the construction of a water pavilion stage, which is the only water pavilion stage in Fuzhou city. It is an important venue for festive banquets in the mansion. The pool covers an area of 60 square meters, with a gushing spring at the bottom that never dries up all year round. The pool is home to various aquatic species such as goldfish, crucian carp, turtles, and turtles. The water pavilion stage built on the pond, facing south and north, is a single story platform; On the inner ceiling, there is a square coffered ceiling with a carved crane in the center and bats surrounding it, symbolizing both good fortune and longevity. The stage faces the water on three sides, with a courtyard in the middle, facing the pavilion, and has good sound pickup. The stage is square with an area of 30 square meters. Stone railings by the pool, with embossed flowers; On both sides of the pond are rockeries and snow caves. A double layered pavilion is built directly across from the stage, which can be used for gatherings, watching plays, or looking up from high. The gray plastic lace patterns on the walls, eaves, and ridges are all meticulously crafted, with unique and distinctive shapes, and have been well protected to this day.

shortFeatures: Visit the former residence to learn about Yan Fu's life
summary: Yan Fu is a famous educator, translator and thinker. The hall of the former residence is three rooms wide, the main room is divided into front and rear halls, and the left and right sides are front and rear wings. There is a small door to the west of the front porch of the main seat leading to the flower hall. The corridors and railings in front and back of the flower hall imitate western architectural decorations. At that time, Li Houji, the governor and governor of Fujian Province, purchased it for Yan Fu. Yan Fu returned to Fuzhou at the end of 1920 and lived here until his death in 1921. Although Yan Fu didn't live here for a long time, it was still the place where his fallen leaves returned to his roots.

shortFeatures: Understanding Huang Pu's Life
summary: Xiaohuang Building, No.36 Huangxiang, covers an area of more than 1,000 square meters. Huang Pu, a poet and Jinshi in the second year of Emperor Zhaozong Dashun of Tang Dynasty, settled here after retiring. Once a landmark building in Huangxiang, it was destroyed by a fire in the early Qing Dynasty. The Xiaohuanglou building that tourists can see now was repaired by Liang Zhangju during the Daoguang period of Qing Dynasty. The buildings of Xiaohuanglou are compact, and there are typical representative pavilions, terraces, buildings and pavilions in Fuzhou landscape landscape in the garden. Its rockeries, fish ponds, flowers and trees, and pavilions are all small and exquisite, and the legacy of the Tang Dynasty can still be seen after thousands of years.

The Silver Ferris Wheel will be located in the Silver International Tourism Resort in 2022. When the No.1 scholar in Song Zheng Xing returned to his hometown in good clothes, the people who had humiliated him because he was down and out before felt bad and rushed to avoid it, so they called it "hurry to avoid the lane". In the Ming Dynasty, the name of the lane was changed to "Jipi Lane" by homophony, which means good luck and peace. Dong Ziliang, a professor at Fujian School of Law and Politics, also lives here. Fuzhou's famous "Antai Building" restaurant is also located at the entrance of Jipi Lane.

The Fuzhou Majiang Naval Battle Memorial Hall is located at the eastern foot of Majian Mountain in Mawei District, Fuzhou City, Fujian Province. It was established in August 1984 and includes seven scenic spots, including Zhaozhong Temple, Martyrs' Tomb, Zhongpo Battery (also known as Majiang Naval Battle Battery), the British Vice Consulate and its affiliated buildings, the Dean's Apartment of the Holy Education Hospital, and the Tianhou Palace of the Shipbuilding Administration. It covers an area of 31000 square meters and is a national demonstration base for patriotic education and national defense education. The Zhengzhou Museum was founded in 1957 with a building area of 14200 square meters. It is based on the Shang Dynasty bronze square tripod unearthed in Zhengzhou, with the meaning of "the tripod stands in the Central Plains". It is accompanied by a circular disc-shaped roof, with far-reaching eaves and loose lines, symbolizing the philosophical concept of "heaven is round and earth is square". The museum has a collection of over 50000 cultural relics of various types, with the main exhibition theme being "The Ancient Capital of Zhengzhou". The exhibition focuses on the splendid bronze civilization of the Xia, Shang, and Zhou dynasties in Zhengzhou, and is divided into three parts: "Ode to Mountains and Rivers - Abundant Land of Civilization" and "Zheng Han Style - Ancient Capital Spring and Autumn Period". The collection includes exquisite animal fossils such as ancient elephants dating back four to five hundred thousand years, exquisite and antique bronze, jade, and primitive porcelain unearthed from the Zhengzhou Shangcheng site, Han Dynasty portrait bricks with various patterns unearthed from the Zhengzhou area, and stone carvings of Su Shi's cursive script "Zuiweng Pavilion Record"; Colorful porcelain, precious cultural relics such as Ming, Qing, and modern celebrity paintings and calligraphy. Representative examples include the Taotie patterned bronze square tripod, the ox headed bronze statue, the Jufu Ding bronze tripod, and the Yao Jinzao Guanyin bronze statue.
