summary: Without arriving at Lijingmen, one would be wasting their time in Luoyang City. Lijingmen was first built in the Sui Dynasty and is the western gate of the ancient city of Luoyang, known as the "first gate of the ancient capital". The current Lijingmen Scenic Area was rebuilt on the original site of the Luoyang Municipal Government, consisting of parts such as the City Gate Tower, Wengcheng, Arrow Tower, City Wall, Lijingqiao, and moat. It is also the location of Luoyang Old Street. Tourists can come here to climb up and enjoy the scenery, taste local snacks, and learn about the ancient Heluo culture. New Year Bell ringing Activity: Every year on the occasion of bidding farewell to the old and welcoming the new, the Lijingmen City Tower holds the "Welcoming the New Year at midnight Bell" activity. Tourists can personally climb up to the city and ring the 108 bells symbolizing the prosperity, auspiciousness, peace, and happiness of the new year, echoing the sound of the Ma Temple bell from afar.

The Sui and Tang Luoyang City National Heritage Park was once the core area of the palace ruins of the Sui, Tang, Five Dynasties, and Song dynasties, among which the famous ones were the Mingtang and Tiantang during the reign of Empress Wu Zetian. Mingtang is located on the axis of Luoyang city during the Sui and Tang dynasties. It is the main hall of the palace city and an important place for Emperor Gaozong and Empress Wu Zetian to unify the world and govern the country. The prototype of the Tianfu Tu in the 2013 film "Detective Dee: The Empire of Heaven" directed by Tsui Hark is here. Heaven is the place where Empress Wu Zetian worshipped Buddhism. The building has five floors on the exterior and nine floors on the interior, symbolizing the supreme status of the emperor as the ruler of China. Tourists can take the elevator directly to the ninth floor, overlooking the panoramic view of Luoyang, and the night view is not to be missed. There are also large and small Buddha statues and murals on other floors, which can reveal the profound Buddhist culture. Full text 

tagNameList: English: Kid-friendly treasure spots; Historical ruins
shortFeatures: Appreciate the Sui and Tang ruins, savor the culture of the ancient capital.
summary: Ying Tian Gate was the main southern gate of Ziwei City, originally constructed in the first year of the Sui Dynasty's Daye era (605 AD). It was initially named Ze Tian Gate, but in the first year of the Shenlong era (705 AD), it was renamed Ying Tian Gate to avoid using Empress Wu Zetian's name. Later, it became known as the Five Phoenix Tower and endured through the Five Dynasties and the Northern Song Dynasty. Ying Tian Gate was an important venue for the imperial court to hold major state ceremonies and diplomatic events. These included significant occasions such as the Yuan Zheng (New Year's Day), the Winter Solstice, ceremonial music performances, banquets, amnesties, and the transition to a new year. During such events, including tributes from foreign envoys and dignitaries, the emperor would ascend the gate to listen to state affairs. Historical ceremonies such as Emperor Gaozong's capture of the Baekje king, Empress Wu Zetian's ascension to the throne, and Emperor Xuanzong's reception of Japan's eighth envoy to Tang China were all held on the Ying Tian Gate tower. Its function was similar to that of the Meridian Gate in modern Beijing. Ying Tian Gate was a massive architectural complex shaped like a "concave" character, consisting of a main gate tower, parapet walls, east and west watchtowers, and connecting corridors.

summary: Today's Jiuzhouchi Site Park covers an area of 288 acres, including the Great Inner Dormitory area in the northwest of the palace city, a part of the Taoguang Garden in the north of the palace city, and the Jiuzhouchi Royal Garden in the north of the city west of the palace city. There are a total of 12 sites, which are protected and displayed through various scientific methods. We hope to use methods and forms such as displaying the original site of ancient ruins and simulating the ground to allow more people to understand the royal garden style during the prosperous period of the Sui and Tang dynasties. Jiuzhou Pool, as the imperial garden of Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang dynasties, was a real existence in history. According to the "Fangkao of the Two Capital Cities of Tang Dynasty", "Jiuzhou Pool has a curved pool with several islands in it, like Jiuzhou in the East China Sea. It covers an area of ten hectares, with a water depth of more than ten zhang, and is home to birds, fish, and flowers." In 1960, archaeologists discovered it while excavating Luoyang City during the Sui and Tang Dynasties. The palace city area of Luoyang during the Sui and Tang dynasties was composed of a central core area and many surrounding small towns. Jiuzhou Pool is located in the northern part of Xige City on the west side of the Imperial Palace, accounting for about two fifths of Xige City. The scope of "ten hectares of residential land" recorded in the records is based on the Tang Dynasty's system of land cultivation. In the Tang Dynasty, one foot was about 29.5 centimeters and ten hectares were about 520000 square meters, which was larger than the entire western city. However, the actual archaeological measurement of the water area of Jiuzhou Lake is about 139250 square meters. Chinese classical garden art holds a pivotal position in traditional Chinese architecture. The forms of Chinese landscape gardens, represented by literati gardens and royal gardens, are aimed at pursuing the spiritual realm of nature, thus achieving the aesthetic pursuit of "although created by humans, as if opened by heaven", reflecting the cultural concept of "harmony between man and nature", which is completely consistent with the overall architectural concept of Luoyang City in the Sui and Tang dynasties. As a royal garden, Jiuzhou Pool not only embodies the combination of nature and culture, expressing the concept of harmonious unity between humans and nature, but also highlights the "ritual system" in traditional Chinese culture. Xiangshan is named after its abundant production of fragrant kudzu. Xiangshan Temple was first built in the first year of Xiping in Northern Wei (516 AD) and in the sixth year of Dahe in Tang Dynasty (832 AD). Henan Yin Bai Juyi donated six to seven hundred thousand guan to rebuild Xiangshan Temple and lived here in seclusion in his later years. It is separated from the world cultural heritage site of the Longmen Grottoes Xishan Grottoes by a narrow strip of water, facing each other across the river, and connected to the Longmen Grottoes Dongshan Grottoes and Baiyuan, standing side by side.

According to legend, Laojun Mountain Scenic Area is the place where the founder of Taoism, Li Er (Laozi), retired and practiced. During the Northern Wei Dynasty, a temple was built in the mountain to commemorate him, and later it was honored as a "famous mountain in the world". It has always been a place of strong incense. The trees in the mountains are lush, the scenery is picturesque, and mountain springs can be seen everywhere. In the golden autumn, this is the best choice for surrounding areas to enjoy the red leaves. After the rain, Laojun Mountain is surrounded by clouds and mist, like a fairyland in the sky. The scenic area is vast, mainly divided into the central Laojun Mountain main scenic area, the Dream Chasing Valley scenic area in the west, and the Zhaigou scenic area in the east. Generally, tourists spend a day exploring the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, which is also a well-developed region of the entire scenic area. If you go to the mountaintop, there is still a chance to enjoy the beautiful sea of clouds, sunrise, and sunset. The main scenic area of Laojun Mountain includes major attractions such as Zhongtianmen, Jinding, Laojun Temple, Nantianmen, Yuhuangding, and Mazongling. Since its establishment in the Northern Wei Dynasty, Laojun Temple has been the center of worship for pilgrims from the Central Plains; The Taoist temple at the Jade Emperor's Peak enshrines the Jade Emperor, which is also a great place for mountain viewing; Jinding and Mazongling are great places to watch the sunrise and the sea of clouds. Recommended itinerary: A one-day tour to explore the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain is the choice of most tourists. Roughly speaking, the route is as follows: Lingguan Hall - Laojun Statue at the foot of the mountain - Linqi Hall - Zhongtian Gate - Linyin Trail - Woyun Pine - Bodhisattva Hall - Laojun Temple, Jinding - Yuhuangding, and then return to the original route. Tourists can choose to visit Laojun Mountain on foot or by "walking+cableway" depending on their own situation. Between the Lingguan Hall at the foot of the mountain and the Zhongtian Gate on the mountainside, there is the Zhongling Cableway in the scenic area. Take the Zhongling Cableway and then walk from Zhongtianmen to the Jade Emperor Peak at the top of the mountain. The road from Zhongtianmen to the top is not very steep and usually takes about an hour to complete. If you have plenty of time, you can spend two days exploring Laojun Mountain. The approximate itinerary is as follows: D1： Visit the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain and stay overnight in the mountains. D2： From the top of Laojun Mountain, choose to descend from the Dream Chasing Valley in the west or the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, and reach the west and east gates of the scenic area respectively. In the main scenic area of Laojun Mountain, accommodation is available near Zhongtianmen on the mountainside and Laojun Temple on the mountaintop. There are hotels near Zhongtianmen with good accommodation conditions, while the accommodation conditions around Laojun Temple are relatively poor. If you are planning to go to the mountaintop the next morning to watch the sunrise, then you can stay around the Laojun Temple. Compared to the Zhaigou Scenic Area in the east, the mountain roads in Chasing Dreams Valley are smoother, and tourists can choose one of them to descend according to their preferences. There are multiple places in the entire scenic area that can provide catering services for tourists, but some road signs in the scenic area are not yet very complete, so tourists need to pay more attention when playing. poiName: White Horse Temple International Buddha Hall Garden
summary: The Bai Ma Temple International Buddhist Hall Garden is located inside the Bai Ma Temple in Luoyang City. Walking into the garden, you will see a Buddhist hall full of exotic elements. This garden was built in the early 1990s and incorporates the architectural style of Thai temples, making it very exotic.

The Historical and Cultural Ancient Street of Luoyang Old Town is located in the Xiguan Old Town area of Luoyang City. It was a gathering place for merchants in ancient times and later became one of the important commercial districts in Luoyang City and a gathering place for Luoyang snacks. In 2015, it was selected as one of the top ten food streets in China.

The Binyang Cave is located within the Xishan Grottoes and consists of three caves: Binyang South Cave, Binyang Middle Cave, and Binyang North Cave. Binyang "means welcoming the sun of birth and is one of the caves created by Emperor Xuanwu of Northern Wei to honor his parents, Empress Dowager Xiaowen and Empress Dowager Wenzhao. Binyang Middle Cave is a representative cave of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which started construction in 500 AD and took 24 years to complete. Due to the death of host Liu Teng and other reasons, only one of the three planned caves, Binyang Middle Cave, was completed. The main statues of the South Cave and North Cave were not completed until the early Tang Dynasty. The cave in Binyang has a horseshoe shaped flat surface, a dome shaped roof, and a lotus treasure cover carved with double petals of large lotus flowers in the center. Around the lotus flowers are eight auspicious gods and two offerings to heaven and man. The cave is themed around the Three Buddhas of the past, present, and future, with Shakyamuni as the main Buddha. Due to the Northern Wei Dynasty's emphasis on thinness as beauty, the main Buddha Shakyamuni had thin cheeks, a slender neck, and a slender body. On the north and south sides of the front wall of the cave, there are four layers of exquisite reliefs from top to bottom. The first layer is a relief sculpture based on the story of the Vimalakirti Sutra, called "Vimalakirti". The second layer consists of two stories about the life of Buddha. The third layer is the famous painting of emperors and empresses worshiping Buddha. The fourth layer is a relief statue of the "Ten Divine Kings". The main Buddha statues in Binyang South Cave were all completed in the early Tang Dynasty. The main Buddha in the cave is Amitabha Buddha, with a full face, broad shoulders, and a plump body, reflecting the Tang Dynasty's style of beauty based on obesity. Full text 

Luoshui Tang Tang, a river of history and culture. "Black Bow BLACKBOW draws inspiration from the spirit of" Luoyang charm "and uses the Heluo culture as a creative blueprint to tell the story of Luoyang through technology and art, constructing China's first digital immersive performance" Luoshen Fu ". The opening ceremony visual effects director of the Beijing Winter Olympics, Wang Zhiou, served as the chief director, and the opening ceremony visual effects production team, Black Bow BLACKBOW, served as the chief creator. The venue combines digital imaging, mechanical devices, and live performances to showcase the reincarnation story of the ancient capital Luoyang City; Integrating digital immersive performances, immersive museums, and multi-dimensional digital performances, it comprehensively and comprehensively showcases the cultural history of Luoyang. The expert team BLACKBOW specially invited Pan Lusheng of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles, Guan Jun, president of the Calligraphy Institute of the Chinese Academy of Arts, Sun Xiaochun, president of the School of Humanities of the University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Geng Shuo, associate professor of the School of Humanities of the Central Academy of Fine Arts, to serve as the expert of "Tracing Luoshen Fu". Based on the Heluo culture, with a historical perspective of "ancient, modern, and new", we will deeply explore the historical culture and humanistic arts of Luoyang "in the world", as well as the "radiation" and dissemination of Luoyang culture to the world. The digital immersive performance black bow highly extracts the core cultural symbols of Luoyang, breaks the traditional theater viewing mode, and uses a combination of non-linear narrative and three-dimensional performance areas to break through the limitations of time and space, bringing multi-dimensional sensory stimulation and emotional resonance to the audience. Experience a fully immersive walking and performance mode, walking in different time and space. Exploring the long forgotten story of Luoyang from a new perspective, and glimpsing the origins and traces of the Hetu Luoshu. Witnessing the encounter between Cao Zhi and Luo Shen, experiencing the sorrow of wandering for roots, and exploring the state of mind of literati and ink masters Saints, grandmasters, and famous poets have gathered in Luoyang for thousands of years. The story of Chinese civilization begins here - the Xia and Shang dynasties began, casting tripods and shaping inscriptions; Duke Zhou established the capital and established rituals and music; The Three Kingdoms and Two Jin Dynasties were both literary and martial; The Buddhist capital of Northern Wei, the wonder of Galan; During the prosperous period of the Sui and Tang dynasties, various countries came to court; In the Western Capital of the Northern Song Dynasty, famous scholars gathered. Immersive museums rely on the form of "digital" cultural and museum exhibitions to comprehensively and stereoscopically reproduce the glorious era of the ancient capital Luoyang. By combining digital art, real-time interactive exhibitions, and live performances, we will experience a journey through time and space. Pursuing the source of civilization, entering the temporal and spatial dimensions of history, exploring and practicing cross-border innovation of "cultural relics+technology", and unfolding the "picture scroll" drawn by the unique cultural symbols of Luoyang one by one. The book of rivers, maps, and Luo in the world is here; Chinese civilization originated here; Duke Zhou measured the shadows and established his capital here. The wheels of history slowly pass by, and civilization flows endlessly for thousands of years. We will return to the "world" in the hearts of ancient people, awaken the dormant Chinese civilization under this land, trace the source of civilization and explore the center of the world through the changes of the world. Wulu Tongluo Luoyang is also a crossroads of ancient Chinese transportation, where waterways and land routes intersect. The Sui and Tang Grand Canal, the Ten Thousand Mile Tea Road, the Grassland Silk Road, the Desert Silk Road, and the Maritime Silk Road, transportation arteries from different periods converge in Luoyang, forming a major transportation pattern of "five roads connecting Luoyang". They are not only economic and trade routes, but also cultural exchange routes, injecting a continuous stream of vitality into the historical process of Luoyang's prosperity for thousands of years. Culture collides and blends in exchanges, and we will become ancient people, listening to camel bells in the desert, traveling through ancient sandy roads, encountering boats, carts, and merchants, and retrieving the "treasures" left behind by our predecessors on the way, returning to the magnificent era of "Five Roads Connecting to Luo". If you ask about the rise and fall of ancient and modern times, please only look at Luoyang City. Looking back at Luoyang for a thousand years, it seems like a dream. Today, we will pick up the fleeting shadows scattered in the long river of history one by one, immerse ourselves in this shining historical memory, return to the prosperous era of the ancient capital, and search for the dream of the divine city together. The national beauty of peonies has accompanied Luoyang for thousands of years. What would the world look like in her eyes? From the perspective of peonies, in the cycle of four seasons and the flow of time and space, we explore the beauty of national colors and feel the growth and decline of all things. We can see the scene of peonies blooming in the capital during the blooming season, and experience the step by step blooming like a startled swan, waving our sleeves into poetry. The 24 solar terms of Heluo Palm Lantern Festival are an important part of traditional culture, reflecting the wisdom and romantic feelings of ancient Chinese people, and embodying the long history and profoundness of Chinese culture. In the "Heluo Palm Lantern" segment, Black Bow incorporates iconic Chinese culture such as the Luoshen Fu and the 24 solar terms. It blends multiple levels of performance forms in outdoor spaces, using technological aesthetics to subvert tradition and make you feel like you are in a fantasy dream, encountering the goddess of Luoshui. The "24 solar terms" unfold slowly like a historical scroll, carrying the longing for the charm of Luoyang and entering the wonderful night of Luoyang together. In the long scroll of time, Luoyang has painted scenes of history, and now it will also paint scenes of the future... The journey of "tracing" has never ended. Let us step onto this land to explore, see, and experience! Full text 

poiName: The Erlitou Xia Capital Site Museum
shortFeatures: The collection is rich, showcasing the history of the Xia Dynasty.
summary: The museum is located at the site of the capital of the Xia Dynasty, where a large number of stone tools, pottery, jade artifacts, and other items have been unearthed. Among them, small bronze objects such as knives, jue (wine vessels), bells, and others are the earliest bronze artifacts discovered in China to date. A large-scale casting copper and pottery workshop site was also found in the southeastern part of the site. The area has now been designated as a national key cultural heritage protection unit. The Erlitou site includes three natural villages: Yanshi Erlitou, Gedangtang, and Sijiaolou, with four cultural strata found in the deposits. The Erlitou cultural site is large in scale, well-equipped, and rich in content. Discoveries include palaces, tombs, houses, roads, and wells, along with a bronze casting site and early bronze tools, including weapons and ritual vessels. In the late Erlitou cultural layer, a large number of jade artifacts were unearthed, such as cong, gui, and zhang ritual objects, as well as ceramic sculptures of turtles, pigs, and sheep heads, and pottery engraved with dragon-snake patterns, turtle motifs, and human figures.

It is a thematic museum with Tang Sancai as its theme. The museum mainly displays ceramic treasures from the Han Dynasty to the Song and Yuan Dynasties, vividly depicting the development process of Tang Dynasty tri colored glazed pottery from its origin, prosperity to decline.

Tang Sancai is a magnificent flower in the treasure trove of ancient Chinese ceramic art. There is a village called Nanshishan Village in Chaoyang Town, Mengjin County. Due to its exquisite antique imitation skills, it is known as the "Sancai Town", "Henan Province Characteristic Cultural Village", and "China's First Tang Sancai Culture Village".

This is a paradise for foodies and a popular gathering place for snacks among Kaifeng residents on a daily basis. There are various types of snacks with different flavors, such as lamb kang bread with a crispy exterior and a fragrant interior, almond tea with a sweet and fragrant aroma, soup dumplings with rich juice, and even a barbecue to eat. It is a great place for three to five friends to enjoy delicious food, drink spicy food, and chat. Full text 

Wansui Mountain Wuxia City is located in the Wansui Mountain Tourist Area in the northwest of Kaifeng City. It is a large-scale tourist area built against the backdrop of Song Dynasty culture and martial arts culture. There are ancient and charming Song Dynasty garden streets and alleys built in the scenic area, with exciting martial arts and ancient costume performances all year round, as well as rich entertainment facilities. It is a good place for relaxation and entertainment in the surrounding areas of Kaifeng and Zhengzhou. When visiting Wansui Mountain Wuxia City, the first thing to experience is the beautiful scenery of the scenic area. The overall atmosphere of Wuxia City is shaped by the Song Dynasty, with many eye-catching landscapes such as Wansui Temple, which reproduces the glory of the thousand year old temple of the Song Dynasty, Dragon Altar, which embodies the spirit of Buddhism, Confucianism, and Taoism, the well preserved ruins of the ancient city walls of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, and one of the large-scale artificial streams and waterfalls in China, the "Nine Dragon Waterfall". What's rare is that there are also very large forest green spaces in the scenic area, with a peaceful environment and flowers blooming in the appropriate season, which is very suitable for photography. Afterwards, tourists will notice the unique martial arts characteristics in the scenic area. There are 36 martial arts themed performances released here year-round (about 60 performances per day), including "Cross Slope", "Wu Song Drunken Beats Jiang Men Shen", "Wild Boar Forest" and several other exciting themed performances. Don't miss it here; Interactive performances such as "Wuxia Film and Television Experience Hall", "Wuzhuangyuan", and "Li Kui's Case" can also allow tourists to participate in Wuxia stories, which are full of fun. In the architectural design of the scenic area, there are also many elements of martial arts, such as the martial arts road with large weapons such as the "Heaven Reliant Sword" and "Overlord Sword", the "Swordsman Map" of the Song Dynasty Martial Arts Academy, the "Sword Altar" of the Cross Slope, the Juxian Village, and the martial arts venue, all of which are unique. In addition, during the Spring Festival every year, Wansui Mountain holds large-scale temple fairs with grand performances, rich specialty snacks, dazzling handicrafts, and unique entertainment activities, creating a lively atmosphere. shortFeatures: Xishan Grottoes with quiet and kind Buddha statues
summary: Qianxi Temple is the first big cave at the northern end of Longmen West Mountain. It is more than nine meters high, nine meters wide and nearly seven meters deep. It was built in the early Tang Dynasty more than 1,300 years ago. The caisson on the top of the cave is a shallow carved big lotus flower. Amitabha, the main Buddha, sits upright on the Sumeru platform, with a plump face, raised chest, and oblique clothes hanging in front of the seat. His body is well proportioned and his expression is wise. His whole posture gives people a sense of quietness and kindness. On the left side of the Buddha is the big disciple Kasyapa, and on the right side is the younger disciple Ananda. Next to the two disciples are Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva and Mahashizhi Bodhisattva. In particular, the Bodhisattva on the south wall is full and honest in shape and quiet in manner. There are 1: 1 replicas displayed in the Palace Museum. Amitabha and the two Bodhisattvas on both sides are called the Three Saints of the West, that is, the three saints in charge of the western paradise, and are the objects of Buddhist Pure Land belief.

Copper Camel Evening Rain "refers to the smoke from cooking in the twilight of Zhongtong Lane outside the east gate of the city, and is one of the eight major scenic spots in Luoyang. During the Sui and Tang dynasties, this place was densely populated. Whenever dusk fell, the smoke from every household's kitchen rose like a misty rain, rising in a flurry. Therefore, it was named "Bronze Camel Evening Rain".

The Luanchuan Bamboo Sea Wildlife Park is located in Cangfang Village, 2 kilometers south of the Chongdugou Scenic Area in Luanchuan County, and 7 kilometers away from the Chongdugou Toll Station on the Luoluan Expressway. The total planned control area of the park is 10.3 square kilometers. The park has four main themes: a wild beast release area, a small animal park, a 10000 acre bamboo sea leisure area, and a primitive forest resort. It currently has nearly 3000 animals such as Northeast tigers, lions, black bears, red pandas, macaques, alpacas, sika deer, deer, peacocks, ostriches, and emus, and introduced the national treasure giant panda in September 2020. The six essential elements of food, accommodation, transportation, sightseeing, shopping, and entertainment are fully supported. The integration of wildlife viewing and bamboo sea vacation, convenient tourism transportation, comfortable and hygienic leisure accommodation, and smart tourism clothing standards make it a wildlife park in the Central Plains region with the main feature of releasing wild beasts and interacting with animals. It is also a destination for weekend tours, parent-child tours, science education tours, and summer leisure tours. Developing a 10000 acre bamboo sea, exploring night travel modes, and introducing a new trend of leisure vacation; Build a Thousand Tiger Base, jointly build a national treasure homeland, and create a new highlight of tourism in Luanchuan. The Bamboo Sea Wildlife World, with its unique features, is home to a variety of precious animals represented by the "Top Ten World Precious Animal Treasures", including giant pandas, Northeast tigers, red pandas, alpacas, macaques, Asian black bears, lions, spotted deer, and more... These rare animals live and spread their branches and leaves in this animal paradise, making the Bamboo Sea Wildlife Park one of China's important wildlife breeding and protection bases. Most of the animals in Zhuhai Wildlife Park have formed large populations, such as spotted deer and Northeast tigers, which have formed large populations of dozens or even hundreds of individuals and are still growing and expanding, making them rare in zoos around the world. The Bamboo Sea Wildlife Park showcases animals in their natural habitats through a new type of animal display that combines science education, animal protection, and entertainment. The grand and thrilling scene of walking with tigers and sleeping with lions As the largest wildlife park in the north, Zhuhai Wildlife Park has always emphasized its educational function in science popularization. Turning the Wildlife World into a science popularization and environmental education base is not only a business necessity, but also a public welfare action that benefits future generations. As a popular science education base in Luoyang City, Zhuhai Wildlife Park regards it as a very important function of its own. At the Zhuhai Wildlife Park, the concept of protecting animals can be seen everywhere. The animal science popularization station that combines explanation and action, animal instruction signs with pictures and text, rich science popularization corridors, vivid and interesting animal schools, and a warm animal kingdom make visitors feel the importance of protecting animals and the ecological environment firsthand. While playing, it allows children to understand the concept of "caring for animals and protecting the environment". The Giant Panda Pavilion of Luanchuan Bamboo Sea Wildlife Park covers an area of 2464 square meters, equivalent to the size of six standard basketball courts. The newly built 2400 square meter giant panda enclosure in the park has a well planned indoor and outdoor area. The indoor area not only has sufficient air conditioning and a clean and tidy resting and playing area, but also the outdoor area is covered with lawns. Facilities such as swings, slides, and shade have been set up, and more than 20000 bamboo trees have been transplanted. The giant pandas' new home in Luanchuan is comfortable and beautiful. The value significance of a wildlife park is to protect, breed, and preserve precious and endangered animals; Popularize animal knowledge to the public; Awareness of raising and protecting animals; The purpose of the park is to combine science popularization with tourism. Wildlife parks should implement a comprehensive development policy, fully considering the organic combination of environmental benefits, social benefits, and economic benefits. Through the comprehensive development of land around the base, the construction of wildlife parks can be driven. At the same time, it also promotes the economic development of the surrounding areas by establishing wildlife parks. The establishment of a wildlife park also adds new charm to the green landscape of the entire city. Full text 

poiName: Luoyang Sui-Tang Grand Canal Cultural Museum
shortFeatures: Built based on Luoyang Shanshan Guild Hall
summary: Luoyang Sui and Tang Grand Canal Museum, located in Luoyang City, Henan Province, was built on the basis of the national key cultural relics protection unit on the north bank of Luohe River-the ancient building Qunshan Shaanxi Guild Hall. In the exhibition hall, the relationship between Luoyang and the Grand Canal will be comprehensively described through various display methods such as physical objects, pictures and multimedia. Among them, the photo exhibition mainly includes four parts: the excavation of the Sui and Tang Grand Canal, the prosperity and function of the Sui and Tang Grand Canal, the relics of the canal, the protection and application of Luoyang section of the Sui and Tang Grand Canal. The physical exhibition mainly focuses on the cultural relics related to the Grand Canal excavated or collected in Luoyang area, such as the stone components of the riverbank of the Grand Canal, grain specimens containing Jiacang, and cellar models. The museum also plans to use high-tech means to display some typical canal cultural relics in front of the audience through holographic projection, so as to enhance visitors' intuitive feelings. The cultural relics displayed in this way mainly include celadon pots with deer patterns in Changsha Kiln, double-series porcelain notes in Yue Kiln and pots with lids with three-color pearl patterns.

Yunshang Ranch is located on a mountaintop at an altitude of nearly a kilometer, and is one of the earliest ranches in the Central Plains to be located on a mountaintop. With an area of over a hundred acres, tourists can get close to nature in the original ecological environment. There are dozens of animals here that can be fed without having to go to Nara, including the screaming groundhog, Boer goat, Dutch pig, Angora long haired rabbit, black swan, and more. These cute animals are distributed in different parks such as Deer Forest, Mysterious Zone, Elf Mouse Rabbit, Grassland Tribe, Swan Lake, etc. Tourists can get up close to animals and experience the wonderful time of harmonious coexistence with them and the joy of getting close to nature.

summary: The Grand Song Dynasty Tokyo Dream "is a large-scale live water performance created by live action planner Mei Shuaiyuan, directed by renowned live action director Zhang Rensheng, and produced by Kaifeng Qingming Shanghe Garden. The performance of 'Dream of the Song Dynasty in Tokyo' lasts for 70 minutes and is performed by over 700 actors, making it another masterpiece of live action performances in China. The Dream of Splendor in the Eastern Capital of the Great Song Dynasty "is an impressionistic painting about the heyday of the Northern Song Dynasty, and a historical representation of" Along the River during the Qingming Festival "and" Dreams of Splendor in the Eastern Capital ". It uses eight well-known classical Song Ci and its artistic conception, such as "Yu Meiren", "Zui Dongfeng", "Butterflies in Love with Flowers", "Man Jianghong", to outline the historical picture of Tokyo, the capital city of the Northern Song Dynasty. The whole performance was divided into six acts and four scenes, including Preface - Yu Meiren, Drunk by the East Wind, Butterflies in Love with Flowers, Qitian Music, Man Jianghong, and Ending the Water Melody. The gorgeous scenes, classic Song lyrics, and high-tech dance beauty brought strong audio-visual shock to the tourists, vividly and truly representing the prosperity of Bianliang, the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty.

The Yuhuangding of Baiyun Mountain is located in the hinterland of Funiu Mountain in the south of Songxian County, Luoyang City, Henan Province. Its peak is 2,211.6 meters above sea level, which is the third peak in the Central Plains and the best place to watch the sunrise and the sea of clouds in the whole Central Plains. Watching the sunrise at the summit, every detail of a red sun slowly jumping out can be seen. Overlooking the sea of clouds at the top of the peak, the evaporating clouds and mist are like clouds by the sea, washed by water vapor, and like clouds outside the sky. There is no dust pollution, just like being in a fairyland on earth.

It is a cultural tourism project that integrates culture, tourism, and ecological agriculture sightseeing. It is divided into 8 functional areas, including ancient town style area, lake scenic tourist area, leisure resort area, ancient battlefield culture experience area, ecological farmhouse experience area, cultural and creative health preservation area, ecological wetland experience area, and ecological forest sightseeing area. summary: Zhouqiao was a famous bridge at the intersection of Yujie and Bian River during the Northern Song Dynasty. Zhouqiao was first built in the Tang Dynasty and was named Bianzhou Bridge. During the Five Dynasties, it was called Bianqiao. During the Northern Song Dynasty, the Bian River was called Tianhe, and the bridge was renamed Tianhan Bridge, commonly known as Zhouqiao. The Zhou Bridge has a wide bridge deck and a grand atmosphere. The story of Yang Zhi angrily killing the second Bopi Niu in the Water Margin happened here. During the Northern Song Dynasty, there were many night markets on both sides of Zhouqiao. At present, the state bridge is buried on the south side of the intersection of Zhongshan Road and Dazhifang Street in the bustling city center of Kaifeng. In 1984, archaeological excavations revealed a complete ancient bridge beam as wide as 30 meters.

The Lankao People's Memorial Hall is located in Lankao County, Kaifeng City, Henan Province, and was established to commemorate Comrade Jiao Yulu. Jiao Yulu was the former county party secretary of Lankao County. During his work here, he led the people to control the three major disasters of sandstorms, salt alkali, and waterlogging, improving the local production and living conditions, and was deeply loved by the people. The memorial hall displays Comrade Jiao Yulu's life stories, work achievements, and his profound feelings towards the people of Lankao. It is an important place to learn and promote the spirit of Jiao Yulu.

summary: Yuefei Temple in Zhuxian Town, commonly known as Yuewang Temple, is located 22 kilometers south of Kaifeng City. The Yuefei Temple was first built in the 16th year of the Ming Dynasty's Chenghua reign. It is collectively known as one of the four major Yuefei temples in China, along with the Yuefei Temples in Tangyin, Wuchang, and Hangzhou, and is renowned both domestically and internationally. According to legend, Zhuxian Town was the hometown of Zhu Hai, a righteous hero of the Wei state during the Warring States period, and became one of the four famous towns in the country during the Ming and Qing dynasties. In the early years of the Southern Song Dynasty, the anti Jin hero Yue Fei led his troops to a great victory over Jin Wuzhu here. The Yuefei Temple faces north and south, forming a three courtyard structure with a rectangular outer corridor. The entire hall is grand and majestic, with numerous stone tablets and pavilions, as well as colorful carvings and sculptures. It once attracted historical figures such as Yu Qian, Emperor Qianlong, Yang Chengwu, and Zhu Muzhi to come here to pay tribute and stay in ink. The mountain gate, the front screen wall, and the statue of "Five Traitors Kneeling Loyal" have been repaired. The steles in the temple are very famous, including "Mr. Zhang's Northern Expedition at Daoziya", "Man Jianghong" and other steles, with vigorous and unrestrained characters, which are the top grade among the steles.

shortFeatures: Feel the wonder that the bottom of the slope is higher than the top
summary: Xiamen Strange Slope is a section of Wenping Road to Banling Palace, which is about 50 meters long. This strange slope is strange because things will roll from the bottom of the slope to the top of the slope. No matter how you try it, it is always like this. When you ride by, you will find that it is easy to go uphill and laborious to go downhill. Later, the surveyors of the Municipal Highway Bureau came to the conclusion through verification that "strange slope" is actually a visual error caused by people due to the surrounding reference objects.

poiName: Grand Hall of the Great Hero
summary: In Buddhist monasteries, the Daxiong Hall is the main hall, which is also called the main hall. The Daxiong Hall is the core building of the whole temple, and it is also the place where monks concentrate on practicing morning and evening. The Buddha statue of our teacher Sakyamuni Buddha is enshrined in the Daxiong Hall. Nobita is the virtuous name of Buddha. Big means that it contains everything; The male means to subdue the demons. Because Sakyamuni Buddha is full of wisdom and can dominate the world, Buddhist disciples respect him as Daxiong. The treasure of the temple refers to the three treasures of Buddhism, Dharma and Monk.

Kaifeng Iron Tower, located in Iron Tower Park, was originally named Kaibao Temple Tower, also known as Inspiration Tower or Shangwen Temple Tower. Due to the brown glazed bricks embedded on the outer wall, it appears to be iron from afar and is commonly known as the "Iron Tower". The iron tower has been built for over 900 years and has withstood disasters such as wars, floods, and earthquakes, still standing tall today. The design of the iron tower is exquisite and the structure is sturdy. The tower body is octagonal, with a total of 13 floors and a height of about 55 meters, gradually decreasing from the bottom to the top. The brick carvings here are very famous, with over 50 patterns of flying sky, qilin, bodhisattva, geisha, lion and other motifs carved on the bricks. The shapes are beautiful and the expressions are vivid, making it a masterpiece of brick carving art in the Song Dynasty. There are stairs inside the tower that lead directly to the top of the tower, offering a panoramic view of the city and its surroundings. On the top of the iron tower is a gourd shaped copper bead, which looks like a monk wearing a solemn monk's hat from afar. The window design of the tower is also very unique, with two types: bright windows and blind windows. There is one bright window on each floor, with the first floor in the north, the second floor in the south, the third floor in the west, the fourth floor in the east, and so on, until the upper floors. The so-called blind window is actually a window model that cannot be opened. Back then, this tower was an important attraction in Bianjing, named "Iron Tower Clouds". Climbing the tower and looking into the distance, the Yellow River is like a belt, and the earth is like a brocade. To the west of the iron tower, there is a temple dedicated to the introduction of a bronze Buddha from the Song and Jin dynasties, which is about 5 meters high and weighs about 12 tons. It is also a precious treasure. The other buildings of the temple were abandoned during the Qing Dynasty's Daoguang period. Full text 

tagNameList: A treasure trove for strolling children; Featured exhibition hall; Experiences
shortFeatures: A photography paradise with inverted decoration style
summary: The Inverted Museum is a unique interactive experience hall in Xiamen, known for its unconventional interior design and layout. Tourists can experience various upside down scenes here, such as upside down living rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, etc., which are perfect for taking photos and checking in, enjoying a wonderful visual and spatial experience.

Hubei Museum of Art, formerly known as Hubei Provincial Art Museum, is located on the shore of Donghu Lake in Wuchang District, Wuhan City, opposite the Hubei Provincial Museum. The main building of the art museum has 4 floors above ground and 1 floor underground. There are ten exhibition halls in the museum, making it a holy land for art enthusiasts and cultural youth. The exhibitions in the museum are updated frequently. If you want to know the exhibition plan, there are previews on the official website. You can check them before going. In addition to the exhibition hall, the art museum also has modern collection art libraries, multifunctional academic lecture halls, VIP halls, artist studios, art training centers, movie theaters, Chinese and Western restaurants, cafes and other advanced supporting service facilities. After visiting the Hubei Provincial Museum, why not come here and have a look? If you're lucky, you can also see everyone's exhibition. Alternatively, you can sit in the coffee shop here and savor art and life.

shortFeatures: An exotic temple modeled after Burmese style
summary:
Taking the meaning of "good mind and ancient nature, and popularizing virtue", the Buddhist temple is modeled after Ananda Temple in Myanmar, which is a temple with a strong exotic architectural style. 
· It is one of only two remaining Buddhist buildings of this style in the world, and has important religious, architectural and cultural historical value. 
Hidden in the tall buildings of the city, it was once a place that many Wuhan people didn't know.

The predecessor of the Wuchang Uprising Memorial Hall was the Hubei Consultative Bureau in the late Qing Dynasty. In October 1911, the first shot of the Xinhai Revolution was fired in Wuchang. After the successful uprising, the revolutionary party established a military government here. The main body of the memorial hall is a small building with red walls and tiles, commonly known as the "Red Chamber" by locals. The memorial hall, founded in 1909, is a two-story brick and wood Western style building. There are currently two themed displays in the museum. One is the "Restoration Exhibition of the Former Site of the Governor General's Office of the Hubei Army", which reproduces the scene of the early establishment of the Governor's Office. From the display, we can learn about the organizational structure of the military government in its early days. There is also a flag on display, called the Eighteen Star Flag, which is the military flag of the Wuchang Uprising. The eighteen yellow stars represent the descendants of Yan and Huang from the eighteen provinces within Shanhaiguan. The other main exhibition is the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution", which showcases the historical scene of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution through cultural relics, pictures, and models. Here, you can also see portraits of figures related to the Wuchang Uprising. There is also a photo of a woman in the "Exhibition of Historical Sites of the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution". The person in the photo is Zhang Zhujun, the president of the Shanghai Red Cross Society. During the Wuchang Uprising, she organized a civilian medical team and disguised revolutionary party member Huang Xing as a doctor of the Red Cross Society, taking her on a ship to Wuhan. Full text 

poiName: Wuhan Liangjiang Cruise (Night Cruise on Yangtze River)
summary: Wuhan Liangjiang Tour (Night Tour of the Yangtze River) is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Wuhan. Riding a cruise ship on the river, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River, such as the Yangtze River Bridge, the riverbank, and the Yellow Crane Tower. Night tours offer even better views. There are ships departing from Hankou Yuehan Port and Wuchang Hongxiang Port. Some ships also offer Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way while enjoying delicious food. Full text 

Chuhe Han Street is located on Gongzheng Road in Wuchang, between Donghu Lake and Shahu Lake. This is a commercial pedestrian street full of retro style, with red and gray plain brick walls, exquisite brick line feet, black lacquer doors, copper door rings, stone warehouse entrances, blue brick paths, and old wooden lacquer windows. Being in it, it feels like time has been turned back. As a waterfront pedestrian street, the Chu River runs through it. You can take a boat tour at the pier in the middle of Han Street to enjoy the scenery of the river city on both sides, and the night tour is even better. Walking to the middle of Han Street, you can also see a particularly representative large stage. The antique style stage is solemn yet elegant, and sometimes live performances are held here. Wuhan Madame Tussauds Wax Museum is also located here, and fans who want to take intimate photos with celebrities and stars can go and have a look. There are many places to shop and taste delicious food on Han Street. Among them, Han Street Wanda Plaza has attracted a large number of internationally renowned brands. In addition, fast fashion brands such as ZARA, H&M, UNIQLO, C&A from around the world have also opened specialty stores here.

Wuhan Garden Expo Park (Natural Museum) is located north of Jinshan Avenue, east of Jinnan 1st Road, and west of Gutian 2nd Road and Gutian 4th Road. It is the venue for the 10th China International Garden Expo (referred to as the Garden Expo). After the successful hosting of the 10th Garden Expo, Wuhan Garden Expo will be preserved as an urban park forever. Citizens can easily appreciate the beauty of gardens from all over the country without leaving Wuhan, making it a great place for leisure and relaxation. The Garden Expo Park is divided into two major areas: the South and the North. To fully explore the park, it takes at least half a day to a day. Hankou Village: Rebuilding the complete old streets of Wuhan and tasting authentic cuisine. Hankou Village is located in the service area of the east entrance of the Garden Expo Park, and through the real reconstruction of the Han Kou architectural complex in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, it makes you feel like you are in the old Han Kou street market. There are many shops and traditional snack shops in Wuhan here, making it a great place to dine at the Garden Expo Park. Yangtze River Civilization Museum: Experience the high-end 4D interactive "Yangtze River Tour". The 4D experience area of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum is personally operated by the visual director of Avatar. Here, you can transform into an explorer, ride a rail car, and depart from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, passing through the snowy plateau, Sanxingdui, the Battle of Red Cliffs, the Three Gorges, the magnificent scenery of China, and celebrating the future, experiencing the majestic momentum of the Yangtze River flowing through half of China. International Garden Art Center: Appreciating Classic Garden Art. The International Garden Art Center is located on the west side of the main entrance (north entrance) of the Garden Expo Park. If you buy a ticket from the north gate to enter the park, the first thing you see is the International Garden Art Center. The highlight of this place is the real-life "time travel" design. During the tour, you can enjoy experiences such as corridors, walkways, pavilions, and pavilions, and immerse yourself in the beauty of representative Chinese gardens such as Yuanmingyuan, Humble Administrator's Garden, Yellow Crane Tower, and Yuelu Academy. In addition, strolling in the park, you will also see well-known domestic landscapes such as the replica Taiyuan "Chicken Claw Archway", a miniature version of Chengdu Guihu Park, Yinchuan Feilongguan, and Hangzhou Santan Yinyue. To the north of the park, there are exotic foreign exhibition halls such as the French Garden, New Zealand Garden, Korean Garden, Brazilian Garden, and Dutch Garden, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of world gardens without having to go far away. The Rural Park is located in Wuhan City and is a theme park showcasing traditional Chinese rural culture. The park has restored various traditional buildings and agricultural cultures, allowing visitors to personally experience the daily life and traditional handicrafts of rural China.
opening_hours: Open from 08:30 to 17:30 throughout the year

summary: The Bamboo Raft Gallery is located in Wuhan and is a unique attraction that combines natural landscapes with cultural arts. This place attracts many tourists with its exquisite bamboo architecture and peaceful environment, making it an excellent place to experience traditional culture and enjoy natural beauty.

summary: Wuhan Wildlife Kingdom is located in Wumei Mountain, surrounded by West Lake and beautiful scenery in Caidian District. It is surrounded by mountains and waters, with abundant natural resources, covering an area of about 2250 acres. The total investment for the third phase is 1.5 billion yuan, integrating wildlife breeding and breeding, animal and plant protection research, tourism and viewing, science education, and interactive experience. As a large-scale immersive experience wildlife park in Central China, the park plans to introduce more than 250 species of animals, with a total of over 10000 individuals, including 25 rare and protected animals. The park takes "natural mountains and rivers as the background, kindred culture as the gene, and animal spirits as the context" to build Wuhan Wildlife Kingdom into a landmark theme park where humans and nature (animals) coexist harmoniously. Lu Xun Square is located within the Donghu Tingtao Scenic Area in Wuhan, on the left side of Changtian Tower. There is a half body statue of Lu Xun built on the square, surrounded by lush pine and cypress trees, colorful flowers, green trees, and solemn and dignified surroundings. The square echoes the Xingyin Pavilion to the south, with one side commemorating the great patriotic poet Qu Yuan of ancient times and the other side commemorating the leader of the modern New Culture Movement, Lu Xun.

Xingyin Pavilion is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, and is a landmark building of the entire Donghu Lake. The Xingyin Pavilion is surrounded by water on all sides, and can be reached by the Tingtao Pavilion via the Lotus Wind Bridge. The other side is connected to the land by the Falling Feather Bridge. Xingyin Pavilion was built in 1955, named after the phrase "Qu Yuan was released and swam by the river and pool, singing along the banks of the river" in the poem "Fisherman's Father" in Chu Ci. This pavilion is an antique brick and wood building, actually constructed with reinforced concrete. The pavilion is 22.5 meters high, square in plan, with four corners and a spire, three stories of cornices, covered with green tiles, antique. A statue of Qu Yuan stands in front of the pavilion, with a height of 3.6 meters, a pedestal height of 3.2 meters, and a total height of 6.8 meters. He looked up at the sky with his head held high, taking a step to walk as if he were reciting the "Tianwen" by the edge of the river. On all sides of the platform, there are beautiful trees and flowers scattered, and the island is surrounded by weeping willows and palm trees, embellished with elegance and a broad artistic conception. Inside the Xingyin Pavilion, there are columns and spiral staircases that allow visitors to climb up layer by layer. There are windows on the second and third floors for visitors to admire. Climbing up to the Xingyin Pavilion and looking around, there is even a magnificent scene.

Changtian Tower is located within the Donghu Tingtao Scenic Area in Wuhan, with the left side leading to Bitan for fish watching and the right side being Lu Xun Square. Changtian Tower was built in 1956 with a total area of 1775 square meters. It is a palace style building with a brick, wood, and cement structure. The small building has two floors, with a width of 7 rooms and a depth of 2 rooms. The building is open and clean, with interesting railings and straight colonnades at both ends, leading to the left and right pavilions. The front of the building is spacious, and behind it is a small courtyard with flower walls and moon doors that lead to the back mountain. Tourists can gaze out of the window and see the vast expanse of blue waves, wanting to catch up with the blue sky, feeling the emotion of 'autumn water grows together and the sky becomes one color'.

shortFeatures: In memory of the nine women of the rebels
summary: Jiunvdun is located on the northwest bank of Wuhan East Lake in Tingtao Scenic Area. According to legend, nine women who participated in the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom rebel army died bravely here, and their remains were buried here by the villagers. At that time, in order to avoid persecution by the Qing government, it was called a pier instead of a grave. There is a 70-square-meter platform in front of the tomb of Jiunvdun, surrounded by guardrails, and a magnificent monument in the middle. The monument was built in 1952, made of granite, and is more than 8 meters high. It is engraved with inscriptions and inscriptions written by Dong Biwu, Soong Ching Ling, Guo Moruo, He Xiangning, Zhang Nanxian and others. There are six copper bells hanging at the top, and the wind blows the bells, just like the fierce battle of martyrs and heroes running on the battlefield.

Kezhuxuan is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan. It was founded in 1958, taking inspiration from Su Shi's saying "I would rather eat meat than live without bamboo". This is an ancient architectural corridor imitating bamboo art, with single-layer eaves, blue tiled walls, colorful eaves, staggered pavilions, and winding corridors, exuding an antique charm. It stands quietly in the Cangbai Park, deep in the green shade, surrounded by emerald bamboo, elegant and unique, appearing quaint and elegant. The emerald bamboo and camphor trees exude a scholarly atmosphere everywhere. Around the Kezhu Pavilion, there are old camphor trees that have been planted for a hundred years. Behind the pavilion, there are hundreds of bamboo poles, swaying in the wind with an audible sound. There is a Zhou Cangbai Memorial Room inside the building, which displays images, texts, and physical materials related to Zhou Cangbai, including the piano used by Mr. Zhou before his death.

Huguang Pavilion is located on a small island in the center of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, north of Moshan Scenic Area and south of Tingtao Scenic Area. It is the main garden building of the central island of the lake. Huguang Pavilion was built in 1931, originally named "Zhongzheng Pavilion", and renamed "Huguang Pavilion" after liberation. The Huguang Pavilion is a typical tower style building connected to the land by a ten mile long embankment. The attic has three floors, with green eaves and antique style tiles. Ascending to the attic, one can take in a panoramic view of the surrounding lakes and mountains. The Huguang Pavilion is connected to the Xuhai Beach Bathing Beach, where visitors can climb up to enjoy the scenery and play in the sand and water below, creating endless fun.

The Fable Garden is located in the Tingtao Scenic Area of Donghu Lake in Wuhan, and is a fable sculpture garden based on ancient Chinese fables. More than 20 ancient allegorical story sculptures with profound meanings have been built, including Yu Gong moving mountains, covering his ears and stealing bells, fox pretending to be a tiger's power, Mr. Dongguo, playing the flute for numbers, self contradiction, blind people touching elephants, playing the qin for cows, waiting for rabbits by the trees, praying with his arm as a carriage, and oil sellers. They are vivid and lifelike. Fable sculptures are mainly composed of large blocks, with various variations of characters depicted using vertical and parallel lines to depict detailed patterns. The relief group named "Yu Gong Moves the Mountain" is 40 meters long and 6 meters wide, with a magnificent momentum. These sculptures, with their antique, vivid, and simple shapes, not only bring joy to tourists, but also have a great educational significance.

shortFeatures: Pavilions and pavilions with character layout
summary: The pavilions and pavilions with the layout of fish watching in Bitan are ingenious, which not only reflects the architectural features of Chu's preference to build pavilions near the water, but also has a kind feeling of holding water with your hands. The winding Jiuqu Bridge is connected with the green tile pavilion, forming the most beautiful place in East Lake. East Lake has been raising goldfish since 1951, and now it has bred more than 80 varieties of goldfish, including a "red high head" with a big red hydrangea on its head; A "lion's head" with wings and a wide and raised head; "Goose Top Red" wearing silver armor and a little red tassel; The "Mo Long" covered in pure ink paint, light, brave and enchanting; Short tail, round body, colorful "five-flower egg ball" and so on. Visitors can watch fish or fish here.

Like Xintiandi in Shanghai, Wuhan Tiandi, which is close to Hankou River Beach, is a characteristic block transformed from old buildings. Strolling along the pedestrian walkway, the red brick small western-style buildings, antique wooden windows, antique blue bricks, and wooden or bamboo chairs placed outdoors all exude a strong nostalgic atmosphere. Many young people like to come here to take photos. Wuhan Tiandi gathers delicacies from all over the world. You can not only eat the New Element Restaurant opened by Li Na, a tennis elder sister, but also the South Restaurant of Shanghai Delicate Dim sum Restaurant, the Creative Sichuan Restaurant with pepper, and the Bali lobster and Yitang lobster that you must eat in summer in Jiangcheng. In addition to dining venues, a fashionable shopping center called Yifang Shopping Center has been built here, featuring over 300 global fashion brands and integrating international cuisine, IMAX theaters, LIFESTYLE bookstores, children's experiential play, and family consumption, conveying the spirit of fashion at the forefront.

Welcome to Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, a subsidiary of Haihe An Group. Let's step into the unique nature of whales, experience the wonderful polar scenery and deep-sea world, and meet cute marine, land, and air animals. The park is located in Dongxihu District, Wuhan City. It is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, a science popularization education base in Hubei Province, and a practical education base for primary and secondary schools in Hubei Province. It is a large-scale comprehensive marine theme park in central China. Featuring 6 themed kingdoms, 1 dinosaur island in the Great Lake, 1 water park, 1 360 ° naked eye 3D "Magic Ocean" dome theater in Central China, 1 coral breeding center in Central China, 6 performances, 3 characteristic themed areas, and 20 core animal venues, with over 100000 rare animals of thousands of species, allowing you to freely travel through the North and South Poles, explore the sea, land, and air, and experience a one-stop leisure vacation. Since its opening in 2011, the park has focused on the inheritance of marine culture, science popularization culture, and animal conservation culture, creating a night tour themed product called "Polar Whale Night". It offers a variety of distinctive and customized science popularization travel products such as "Extreme Time Network Red Night Camp" and "Penguin Tour", as well as six science popularization museums, providing tourists with a 12 hour "whale" colorful experience of "North and South Pole Animal Display, Interaction, Science Popularization", covering various entertainment methods such as tourism, leisure, and parent-child vacation. It is a cultural and leisure tourism destination in Central China and a landmark representative of Wuhan's urban tourism. The park has rich and complete supporting facilities, providing one-stop services to meet the all-round needs of tourists. Wuhan Polar Ocean Hotel is a marine themed specialty hotel that integrates parent-child study, business meetings, tourism vacations, and dining banquets. It has 103 themed rooms such as "Little Mermaid", "Polar Penguin", and "Polar Bear", providing tourists with a comprehensive accommodation experience. Guests staying here can also enjoy VIP express access to the park, unlimited entry for 2 days with a package ticket, exclusive free parking, 2 multifunctional meeting rooms, self-service laundry room, fitness room, reading bar and other special benefits; Wuhan Jile Tang (Wuhan Polar Ocean Park Branch) offers a variety of leisure and entertainment options, including hot springs, steam baths, beauty spas, full-time star rated restaurants, children's playgrounds, book bars, cinemas, and game team building rooms. It caters to guests from all over the world and aims to create a one-stop urban micro vacation space for young and fashionable elites. Not only that, the park's own parking lot can also accommodate nearly 2000 vehicles at the same time; The supporting commercial street integrates various formats such as specialty catering, accommodation, supermarkets, parent-child entertainment, leisure, etc., to meet the full sensory leisure and entertainment needs of tourists. In November 2022, Wuhan Polar Ocean Park, as a representative of China Aquarium, successfully applied to become the organizer of the 13th IAC International Aquarium Conference in 2027 for the "Aquarium Industry Olympics"! Wuhan, also known as "Jiangcheng", has become a successful inland city since the first International Aquarium Conference was held in 1960. Full text 

shortFeatures: Hankou commercial district in history
summary:
Hanzheng Street is "the main street of ancient Hankou", the earliest central street in the history of Hankou, and a place where thousands of businessmen gather and commodities compete for flow. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is a commodity wholesale market with a wide range. It is mainly divided into different commodities. The prices of commodities here are still very cheap. However, when shopping here, on the one hand, you have to have a certain ability to identify commodities, because the authenticity and falsehood are uneven; On the other hand, you have to be able to counter-offer. Cheap is not that simple. 
At present, Hanzheng Street is being renovated and relocated, from Qiaokou District of Hankou to Hankou North. However, there are still many commercial ports at the original site, and it should take many years to completely relocate.

tagNameList: Close to nature; Treasure spots for kids.
shortFeatures: Experience the prairie charm through horseback riding and archery.
summary: Mulan Prairie - The only AAAA-level Mongolian-style scenic area in Central China, located in Niejiagang, Wangjiahe Town, Huangpi District, Wuhan, to the east of the famous Mulan Mountain and to the south of Mulan Lake, one of the top ten leisure resorts in Hubei. The scenic area is 36 kilometers from downtown Wuhan and 12 kilometers from the nearest highway exit, with very convenient transportation. The planned area of the scenic spot is 4,800 acres, divided into the Grassland Style Tourism Area and the Leisure Resort Area. It integrates grassland-style sightseeing, outdoor activities, water entertainment, business meetings, and leisure vacations. It is currently the only AAAA-level scenic area in Central China themed around grassland culture.

tagNameList: Climbing Heights and Mountains; Nature and Adventure
shortFeatures: Visit the Hua Mulan's Hometown
summary: The Mulan Mountain Scenic Area is located in the northern part of Huangpi District, Wuhan, just 50 kilometers from the city center. With an elevation of 582.1 meters, it is a national geological park, a provincial-level scenic area, and a provincial-level nature reserve. In November 2014, the Mulan Mountain Scenic Area was approved by the National Tourism Administration as a 5A-level tourist attraction, as the core scenic area of the Huangpi Mulan Cultural Ecological Tourism Zone. Mulan Mountain is known as the "back garden of Wuhan" and was praised by the Ming Dynasty poet Tu Da as "the most magnificent of Xiling, the ultimate view of the Three Chu regions."

tagNameList: Close to Nature; A Hidden Gem for Strolling with Kids
shortFeatures: The lush mountains and clear waters are like a scene from a painting; a summer resort with beautiful mountains and clear waters.
summary:
- Mulan Tianchi is a national forest park. The area is characterized by beautiful mountains and clear waters, and is an important part of the Mulan Cultural Ecotourism Area.
- The entire scenic area is divided into a sightseeing area and a leisure resort area. Due to the lower temperatures in summer compared to the city, it is ideal for a summer retreat.
- The area is crisscrossed with ravines and rich in forests, with flowing water throughout the year, presenting a wetland ecosystem where mountains and waters blend together.
- The main attractions in the area include waterfalls, stream pools, and strange rock formations. There is also a meadow with entertainment activities such as grass skiing and slideways.
- In early spring, Mulan Tianchi is a paradise for apricot blossoms, with thousands of acres of wild apricot flowers spread across the forest valleys, where the verdant hills and blooming apricot flowers create a picturesque scene.

poiName: Henan University Minglun Campus - West Playground
summary: The West Playground of Henan University Minglun Campus is an important part of Henan University, located within the Minglun Campus in Kaifeng City. This is not only a place for students to engage in sports activities and exercise, but also a venue for hosting various large-scale events and gatherings. The West Playground has become a vibrant place on campus with its spacious space and excellent facilities.

poiName: Rough Tea and Light Rice, Steamed Fresh (Yanjiang Store)
summary: Coarse Tea and Light Rice Steamed Fresh (Yanjiang Branch) is a restaurant located in Wuhan that is loved by diners for its unique steamed fresh dishes and the concept of coarse tea and light rice. The restaurant has an elegant environment and offers a variety of seafood and authentic Hubei cuisine, making it a great place to experience local cuisine.

The Moshan Scenic Area in Donghu Lake is another great place to enjoy cherry blossoms in Wuhan. Within the cherry blossom garden of the scenic area, the variety and scale of cherry blossoms far exceed those of Wuhan University. The environment for admiring flowers here is relatively less crowded with tourists and much more comfortable than the crowded Wuhan University. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center within the scenic area. Moshan Scenic Area is located in the southern part of Donghu Lake. In the cherry blossom garden within the scenic area, there are 78 precious cherry blossom trees. The East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden reasonably combines the planting of early, medium, and late flowering varieties. The flowering period is from February to March every year, and the flowering period can last up to one month. In addition to the cherry blossom garden, there are multiple botanical gardens in the scenic area with a wide variety of flowers and trees. Various flower appreciation festivals are held every year. As a national plum blossom research base, Donghu Plum Garden has a wide variety of plum blossom varieties. More than 20000 plum blossoms cover over 340 varieties, and the entire flowering period can last from early January to early March. The variety of Moshan Rhododendron Garden ranks first among the five provinces in central and southern China. In the spring of March, during the blooming season, the mountains and fields are covered in a sea of flowers, with various shapes and sizes that are dazzling. Moshan osmanthus has always enjoyed a high reputation among the people, known as the saying 'eight miles of Moshan, ten miles of fragrance'. There is also a Chu Culture Tourism Center in the scenic area, with main attractions including Chu City, Chu City, Fengbiao, Chu Tiantai, Zhurong Star Watching, Lisao Stele, Chu Talent Garden, and Southern Philosophy Garden. Full text 

Zhiyin Hao is the world's first drifting theater created by Wuhan Culture and Tourism Group in collaboration with director Fan Yue, using a ship as a carrier. It features the multi-dimensional experiential play of the same name, "Zhiyin Hao". Unlike conventional plays, 'Zhiyin Hao' does not provide a complete main storyline, but rather creates a journey through time and space for you to travel. We will scatter every character you may encounter on your journey in the large ship, living as if they were real in various areas such as dance halls, bars, cabins, and decks on the Zhiyin ship. shortFeatures: Named for its shape like a snake
summary: Snake Mountain is located on the south bank of the Yangtze River in Wuchang District, Wuhan City. Snake Mountain, also known as Huangyi Mountain, is meandering in the shape of a snake, with its head facing the river and its tail in a busy city. Across the river from Guishan in Hanyang, the south bank of Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge and the north bank of Guishan in Hanyang are the north-south intersection of a bridge. Snake Mountain is about 1790 meters long, 85 meters above sea level and about 2550 meters wide. There are many historic sites and places of interest on the mountain, all of which are steep, long and narrow, and the situation is very sinister. On the 2-kilometer-long mountain, there are many places of interest, more than 20 famous pavilions and pavilions, and more than 10 famous people, such as Cui Hao, Meng Haoran, Li Bai, Wang Wei, Lu you, and so on. They all successively visited and wrote poems, leaving behind famous sentences such as "cold flowers and beautiful rocks, pavilions with sparse forest belts", "warm clouds floating in the depths of peaches and birches, red makeup and green buildings across trees". During the period of the three Kingdoms, Snake Mountain was known as Jiangxia Mountain, also known as Zizhuling. It was called Huangheshan in the Northern Wei Dynasty, Shicheng Mountain in the Song Dynasty, Changshou Mountain in the Yuan Dynasty, and Jinhua Mountain and Lingshan in the Ming Dynasty. In the meantime, taking Snake Mountain as the name of the mountain, it is "wrapped as a hidden snake" in the Book of entry into Shu by Lu you, a poet of the Southern Song Dynasty.... " Therefore, later generations said that Snake Mountain is more; to the Qing Dynasty dry dew Jiangxia County Chronicles already has the name of Snake Mountain. In 1909, the inside and outside details of Hubei Province was officially named Snake Mountain. As early as 223 AD, Xiakou City was built on it by the three Kingdoms, which has been continuously expanded in successive dynasties, and there are many scenic spots. Chiduo's pavilions are located in more than 20 places, such as Yellow Crane Tower, Baji Tower, Baiyun Tower, Liuyun Pavilion, and so on, so it has the laudatory name of "Hubei Shengao Olympic area". Celebrities of previous dynasties, such as Cui Hao, Meng Haoran, Li Bai, Bai Juyi, Wang Wei, Lu you and so on, have successively visited the tour, sang songs, and left behind a lot of excellent works. The existing attractions are: the Yellow Crane Tower at the top of Snake Mountain; the Shengxiang Pagoda at the east end of the approach bridge of the Yangtze River Bridge; the Tomb of Chen Youren at the southern foot of Snake Mountain; the portrait Pavilion of Yue Wumu at the top of Snake Mountain, referred to as Yue Fei Pavilion; the ice hall at the south waist of Snake Mountain; the view of Changchun outside the East Gate of Wuchang at the tail of Snake Mountain, as well as many important stone inscriptions. Its places of interest are numerous. In addition to the Yellow Crane Tower, there are Baiyun Tower, Baji Tower, Jingchuntai, Qizhang Tower, Dougrandi Pavilion, Liuyun Pavilion, Xijia Pavilion, Xianzaoping Pavilion, Shizhao Pavilion, pressure Yunzhuang, glance Pavilion, and so on. Flying eaves worship ridges, towering in mid-air; resplendent, and mostly related to Taoism and myths and legends. The Changchun View at the end of Snake Mountain, built in the Yuan Dynasty, is the Taoist center of the mountain, as well as other pagodas, Baobingtang, Yongtai, Yue Feiting, Huangxing bronze statues and many important inscriptions by celebrities of past dynasties. Hundreds of millions of years ago, although there were many alternations between land and sea in Wuhan, Snake Mountain was unaffected. It fluctuated calmly and stood erect in the city of Wuchang. According to textual research, all the dynasties in the mountains have their relics, but unfortunately, most of them no longer exist. In 1924, in order to commemorate the Wuchang uprising, the original Snake Mountain was rebuilt into Shouyi Park, which is the earliest park in the three towns of Wuhan (three years earlier than Zhongshan Park). The head of Snake Mountain rests on the river, and it ends through the small East Gate. Since ancient times, it has been a necessary place for military personnel. In 223 AD, Soochow built a city on Snake Mountain to resist foreign enemies. In 1912, in order to commemorate the Wuchang uprising, the Rebel Army first broke the Zhonghe Gate (that is, the Rebellion Gate). At that time, the Rebel took the lead in occupying Snake Mountain and bombarded the Qing soldiers in Snake Mountain, which opened the way for the success of the first uprising. Although Snake Mountain is small, there are many places of interest. Since the Jin Dynasty, successive dynasties have continued to expand, including temples, temples, pavilions, beautiful mountains and rocks, shade foil, celebrities of all ages have climbed this mountain to watch and write songs and poems. Written with "cold light beautiful quiet stone, sparse forest belt Yin Pavilion", "peach blossom deep warm cloud float, across the book red makeup rely on Cui Lou" masterpiece. Since then, due to natural and man-made disasters, most of the landscape has been destroyed, and many sites no longer exist. From 1924 to 1984, Sheshan was under the jurisdiction of Shouyi Park. after years of construction and renovation, there were Yellow Crane Tower, Baiyun Pavilion, Luoyan Xuan, Wuchang Shouyi Monument, Shengxiang Pagoda, Guzhou City ruins, and Chen Youren's Tomb. Chen Youren was the leader of the peasant uprising army at the end of the Yuan Dynasty and established himself as emperor. After losing the decisive battle with Zhu Yuanzhang in 1363, Chen was killed by an arrow and was buried in Snake Mountain. The establishment of the hammer ice hall in Shouyi Park was built by Zhang Zhidong's students to raise funds in memory of Zhang Zhidong. After liberation, in order to meet the cultural life needs of the working people, the people's government, under very difficult economic circumstances, vigorously supported the continuous repair and construction of ancient architectural culture to make the landscape of Snake Mountain constantly new and reappear the glory of Snake Mountain in the past. Visitors cherish the memory of the heroes of the past. They all admire it. People can be called one of the great monuments and landscapes in Wuchang and a sacred place admired by the people of Wuhan.
