100 years ago, this was the location of Henan Gongyuan. In 1903 and 1904, the national imperial examination was held here, and the thousand year old imperial examination system came to an end here. Nowadays, on the north side of the School of Foreign Languages at Minglun Campus of Henan University, there are two well preserved pavilions with four corner steles, each of which houses a Qing Dynasty Henan Gongyuan stele. The Henan Gongyuan was built in the 16th year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1659) on the site of the former Zhou Wang Mansion in the Ming Dynasty (now in the Longting area of Kaifeng City). During the Later Zhou and Northern Song dynasties, this was the location of the Imperial Academy, with more than 5000 buildings and a Mingyuan Tower that was over 4 zhang high. Later, due to the perennial waterlogging around the Gongyuan, in the ninth year of Yongzheng's reign (1731), the temple was relocated to Shangshang Temple in the northeast corner of Kaifeng (now Henan University). The scale has expanded, and the number of buildings has increased to 11866. In the 21st year of the Daoguang reign (1841), the Yellow River surged into Kaifeng. In order to reinforce the city walls and prevent floods from flooding the city, local materials were used to demolish the houses of the imperial court, and bricks, tiles, and materials were used as flood control supplies. The following year, the Gongyuan was renovated, old houses were renovated, 10009 new buildings were built, 5 wells were drilled, and the appearance was completely refreshed. In 1912, a group of benevolent predecessors from Henan, represented by Lin Boxiang, founded the Henan Preparatory School for Studying Abroad in Europe and America, which became one of the three major study and training bases in China at that time. After going through stages such as Zhongzhou University, Fifth Sun Yat sen University, and Provincial Henan University, it was renamed Henan University in 1942 and became a comprehensive university with six colleges including liberal arts, science, engineering, agriculture, medicine, and law. It was one of the universities with strong academic strength and renowned both domestically and internationally at that time. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, the College of Agriculture, Medical College and School of Administration of Henan University were set up as Henan Agricultural College, Henan Medical College and Henan Political and Legal Management Cadre College respectively after the adjustment of colleges and departments. Water conservancy, finance and other departments were also transferred to Wuhan University, Zhongnan University of Economics and Law and other colleges and universities, and the campus was renamed Henan Normal University. After going through stages such as Kaifeng Normal University and Henan Normal University, the name of Henan University was restored in 1984. In 2000, Kaifeng Teachers College and Kaifeng Medical College were merged to form the new Henan University. Full text 

shortFeatures: Named after Qiu Chuji Road of Quanzhen School
summary: Changchun Temple in Wuchang, Hubei Changchun Temple is located on the southern slope of Shuangfeng Mountain in the northeast corner of Dadongmen in Wuchang, and in the middle of Huanghu Mountain (Snake Mountain). It is one of the famous Taoist jungles in my country and has been a venue for Taoist activities in the past dynasties. It is called "a blessed land in the south of the Yangtze River". The temple worships the Quanzhen School of Taoism, named after its founder, Qiu Chuji, the patriarch of Chongyang Festival, named "Changchunzi". The temple was built in the Yuan Dynasty by Qiu Chuji's disciples to commemorate Qiu Chuji (1148-1227 AD), the founder of Longmen Sect, one of the seven northern truth of Quanzhen Sect of Taoism. When the Yuan army went south, he "stopped killing with one word" to save the world and the people. It was called "Changchun View". Changchun Temple has a long history and Taoist origin, and is listed as a first-class cultural relics protection unit by Wuhan. It is not only a Taoist religious activity place for self-cultivation, ceremony and truth, but also a tourist attraction with quiet scenery and elegant architecture. It has a long history, quiet scenery, steep and beautiful mountains, and blessed places. Even in the history of Lushan Mountain in Jiangxi, there is a lower house of Changchun Temple. According to legend, in ancient times, this place was a lake branch, which was called "Songdao" because of its many pine trees. Chu worships witches, which is very influential. Therefore, after the Qin and Han Dynasties, this place was known as "Xiannong Altar", "God Altar" and "Taiji Palace", that is, the place where princes worship heaven and earth and ancestors. It is said that Laozi, the ancestor of Taoism, went to Lufu to "meet the five elders" at the invitation of his disciples. When he arrived in Ezhou, in the south of the Yangtze River, he turned west to Changsong Island, the hometown of lakes and ports, at the foot of Shuangfeng Mountain. In order to commemorate him, people will say that this pine island is Changsong Island, and an old womb will be built to commemorate him. Zhu Xi of the Southern Song Dynasty truly recorded this geomantic omen treasure land in his Ji Ji Altar in Ezhou: "Huanghu Mountain in the east of the city is an area of abandoned camp. Ten feet from east to west, twice difference from north to south, and four altars are painted according to politics and five rites". At the beginning of the Yuan Dynasty, Qiu Chuji, the founder of Quanzhen Longmen School, named Changchunzi, founded the Taoist jungle system in the ten directions, and was rewarded by Genghis Khan, the Taizu of the Yuan Dynasty, for many times, and was in charge of Taoism in the world. So Qiu Chuji sent his disciples to Wuhan, the land of Jinghu Lake, to establish a Taoist jungle. For the sake of discipline, his disciples built Changchun Temple in Songdao to worship the real people of Changchun. Every year, the 19th day of the first lunar month is the Christmas of real people in Changchun, and Changchun Temple will hold a grand Qiu Zu Festival, which is called "Spring Festival Festival" in Wuhan folk customs, also known as "Yan Jiu Festival". Kong Shangren, the author of Peach Blossom Fan, wrote "Yan Jiuzhuzhi Ci" for this purpose: "It's the star bridge and the clouds, and the true fairy never meets the heart like a knot", which depicts this grand event. In the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Zhen, Wang Zhao of Chu, celebrated his birthday, and went to Changchun Temple in Huanghu Mountain to pray for his father Zhu Yuanzhang's longevity. He advised Changchun Temple to change the word "Changchun" to Changchun Mountain. Wang Baixin, a poet of the Qing Dynasty, said in "Poems of Watching Deer and Frequently Refining Teachers' Qi in Changchun": "The mountains and rivers face the ashes of robbery, and Jie Guankai Langyuan residence; Zifu Qiongtai is still ethereal, and the dead capital Jinque is so clear and empty". It is said that Changchun Temple has experienced several wars and restorations, and has experienced historical vicissitudes.

Wuhan Real Estate Group, which has never been a theater, has overcome a large number of technical and construction difficulties, and set a number of domestic records in the Qintai Grand Theatre project, leading the country in construction quality, speed and cost control. Crazy Maika is an offline authorized real-life experience hall for the Golden Eagle Cartoon program "Crazy Maika". Not only does it test an individual's quick reaction ability and physical fitness, but it also tests teamwork. Hunan University is located in Changsha, Hunan Province, China. It is a prestigious institution of higher education with a long history dating back to the founding of Yuelu Academy in 976 AD. Hunan University is renowned for its beautiful campus environment, rich cultural heritage, and outstanding academic achievements. There are many historical buildings and cultural heritage sites on campus, such as Yuelu Academy and Aiwan Pavilion, which are important windows for understanding ancient Chinese education and culture.

summary: The Imperial Library is located within the Yuelu Academy and was later renamed as the Sutra Pavilion and the Zunjing Pavilion. In the fourth year of the Xianping reign of the Northern Song Dynasty, Emperor Zhenzong of Song bestowed the Guozijian Yi Shu, as well as books such as "Records of the Grand Historian," "Jade Chapters," and "Tang Rhyme," marking the beginning of imperial books bestowed by emperors throughout history. The Yushu Tower is a three story building in the style of the Song Dynasty, with an antique charm. Due to its quiet environment, it is an ideal place for reading and research. The current Imperial Library is the library of Hunan University, providing a database for teachers and students to study science.

The Longping Rice Museum is the first large-scale rice themed museum in China and even in the world. It is located in Furong District, Changsha City, with a main building area of 11000 square meters and nearly 6000 square meters of exhibition space. It is mainly divided into five different functional areas: exhibition area, storage area, public service area, and technical and administrative management space, with a commercial supporting area of 6000 square meters. The museum has planned three major exhibitions with rice as the theme, namely "Rice Fragrance for Thousands of Years - Exhibition of Chinese Rice History and Culture", "Dreams Come True - Exhibition of Yuan Longping and Hybrid Rice", and "Strange Journey - Exhibition of the Life of Rice". The display covers the entire rice cultivation area and rice cultivation remains. The three displays showcase the past, present, and future of rice, complementing each other and opening up a magnificent picture of the emergence, development, and impact of rice to the audience. Viewers can not only learn about the long history of rice culture in the Chinese nation, but also perceive the rapidly changing trend of rice technology development. They can also learn about the patriotic, dedicated, and unremitting spirit of scientific researchers represented by Yuan Longping.

Taking a cruise on the Xiangjiang River, you can explore the golden path of the Xiangjiang River. You can also enjoy the scenery in the paintings, immerse yourself in the scenery, and guide the country.

The Heimufeng National Forest Park is located in the northeast corner of Wangcheng County, Changsha City, Hunan Province, only 19 kilometers away from Changsha. It has beautiful scenery and pleasant climate, and has been known as the "heavenly paradise" since ancient times. Heimufeng National Forest Park is a relatively large forest park in the suburbs of Changsha, with an area of 4079 hectares and a main peak elevation of 590.5 meters. Climbing to the summit, surrounded by vast mountains, rushing towards the horizon, admiring the sunrise in the morning and the sunset in the evening, it is refreshing and delightful. The air here is fresh, the water quality is excellent, the mountains are high and the forests are dense, there is no scorching heat in summer, and no severe cold in winter. It is known as the big "oxygen bar" for urbanites. Heimu Peak has a flourishing cultural heritage. The ink still lingers to this day. The great Tang poet went up the mountain to seek beauty, so the Taoist called this mountain "Dongyang Mountain" and listed it as one of the twenty-four "Thirty six Dongtian" in the country. The "Black Deer Ancient Temple" on the mountaintop has a history of more than 1200 years, with an endless fragrance and renowned reputation.

It was originally 511 meters long, but today it is about 400 meters wide and 9 meters wide. It was the widest street in the past. Chaozong Street has historical and cultural monuments such as the former site of Jinjiu activities, the True Jesus Church Hall, the hotel and stage of the Republic of China in Ziyuan, the remains of War of Resistance against Japan's air defense facilities, the former site of Cultural Bookstore and the former residence of Qu Hongyu.

The Moshan Cableway was put into operation in 1994, with a total length of about 1000 meters, and is a cableway in Hubei Province. The cableway has 78 cabins, available in three colors: pink, bright yellow, and indigo. The speed is 0.8 meters per second, and the one-way travel time is 18 minutes. Tourists have ample time to enjoy the panoramic view of Donghu Lake and Moshan Mountain. The number of brackets is 10, and the brackets can reach up to 28 meters, with a ground distance of 32 meters. Scenic spots such as Qianfan Pavilion, Zhubei Pavilion, and Chutai Terrace can be seen along the line. The Moshan Cableway has reappeared in a brand new appearance, becoming a beautiful scenic line within the Moshan Scenic Area. Compared with the cableway of the past, the equipment of today's Moshan cableway has made qualitative improvements and leaps in safety, carrying capacity, ornamental value, and aesthetics. The carrying tool has also been upgraded from the original open two person hanging chair to a four person enclosed colored hanging box. The interior adopts a design where tourists cannot open the hanging box door from the inside, thus ensuring the safety of tourists.
The Moshan slide has a total length of 700 meters and is characterized by integrating entertainment, fitness, sports, and competition.

Tianxin Pavilion is a city tower in the ancient city of Changsha, and the surrounding city walls are the only section of ancient city walls in Changsha. There is also a archway near Tianxin Pavilion called "Chonglie Gate", built in 1946 to commemorate the soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the three major battles in Changsha during the Anti Japanese War. Tianxin Pavilion is located within Tianxin Park and was first built in the eleventh year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty (1746). The Tianxin Pavilion that tourists see today was rebuilt in 1983. The main building of Tianxin Pavilion is chargeable (including Tianxin Pavilion and the surrounding ancient city walls), while Tianxin Park is open for free. The overall architecture of Tianxin Pavilion is supported by 46 red painted columns, chestnut tiles and pink walls, and a solid gray white stone foundation. 62 stone lions are carved on the stone railings in front and behind the pavilion, and 32 wind horses and copper bells are hung on the pavilion, making a sound in the wind. There is a screening room next to the Tianxin Pavilion, which shows a film about the history of Tianxin Pavilion every hour, with a duration of about 7 minutes (equipment maintenance on Monday afternoon). The paid area also provides explanation services. Across from Tianxin Pavilion is the Bamboo Slips Museum, which can be visited together.

Here, there are numerous internationally renowned brands and high-end restaurants, making it a paradise for fashionistas and food enthusiasts.

Pozi Street Food City is located in the center of Changsha city and is one of the famous food streets in Changsha. There are all kinds of authentic Hunan snacks and special food here, such as Stinky tofu, sugar and oil baba, fish head with chopped pepper, etc. It is a paradise for food lovers.

Shaping is the birthplace of Hunan embroidery in China, with a long and rich history. Whether it is the embroidery unearthed from the Warring States Chu tomb in Changsha Martyrs Park or the Han tomb in Mawangdui, Changsha, it proves that Hunan embroidery has a history of more than two thousand years in Shaping. Shaping Town has beautiful scenery and is quaint and elegant. Shaping Xiangxiu Culture Square in the town is a comprehensive cultural square for tourists to gather and distribute, relax, entertain and shop. The square has antique style buildings such as the Xiang Embroidery Museum, Xiang Embroidery Celebrity Hall, Xiang Embroidery Craft Experience Hall, Xiang Embroidery Wedding Hall, and Embroidery Township Restaurant, with green tiles and red walls, and high eaves and teeth. In the center of the square is a cultural performance area, which regularly presents Hunan embroidery themed programs for tourists, interpreting the modern version of the story of the Changsha King's selection of concubines, allowing tourists to experience the romantic and passionate aspects of Hunan culture. Another scenic spot is the 1.3 kilometer long Ming and Qing style Shaping Commercial Old Street. The old street is paved with green bricks and mud tiles, with wooden windows and squares. Every household has embroidered women's flying needles, and there are a wide variety of high-end and daily Xiang embroidery products, emitting a strong atmosphere of the Ming and Qing dynasties. Walking on the streets, you can perform a realistic version of "time travel" and return to the ancient charm of the Ming and Qing dynasties.

It has six floors, a building area of 86000 square meters, and an exhibition area of 28000 square meters. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Museum) gathers precious historical relics and ancient art masterpieces discovered from various parts of Jiangxi, and collects a large number of cultural relics from the province. The Jiangxi Provincial Museum (New Building) has established an exhibition system that combines permanent and temporary exhibitions, consisting of 8 permanent exhibitions and 3 temporary exhibition halls. poiName: The National Archaeological Site Park of Nanchang Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis
summary: The Han Dynasty Haihun Marquis State Site in Nanchang consists of the capital city of Haihun Marquis State, Zijin City, the first generation Haihun Marquis Liu He Cemetery, and the western and southern tomb groups of the city site. It is a typical Han Dynasty capital settlement site discovered in China. Since the archaeological excavation of Liuhe Cemetery began in 2011, more than 10000 precious cultural relics such as gold, bronze, iron, jade, lacquered wood, ceramics, bamboo weaving, grass weaving, textiles, bamboo slips, and wooden slips have been unearthed, which is rare in recent archaeological work in China. Among them, as many as 480 gold artifacts were excavated and unearthed. At the same time, the discovery of precious cultural relics such as Confucius' clothing mirror, gilded patterned bells, chimes, jade seals, etc., has great value. The Haihun Hou State Archaeological Site Park is divided into six functional areas: the Site Museum Area, the Tomb Exhibition Area, the Zijin City Exhibition Area, the Archaeological Reserve Area, the Entrance Functional Area, and the Historical Experience Ecological Leisure Area. Highlight 1: The design of the Han Dynasty Haihun Hou Tourist Center in Nanchang incorporates elements from the jade bi unearthed from Liu He's tomb. poiName: The Nanyue King Museum of The Western Han Dynasty
summary: The Western Han Nanyue King Museum is located in Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, and is the exhibition area for the royal tombs of the Nanyue King Museum (a research center for the history of Western Han Nanyue). In June 1983, the tomb of the King of Nanyue was excavated and unearthed. The museum was built based on the original site of the tomb, mainly displaying the original site of the King of Nanyue's tomb and its unearthed cultural relics. Compared to other museums, its highlight lies in the precious "Silk Thread Jade Robe". The Silk Thread Jade Robe of the King of Nanyue is one of the earliest and most complete sets of jade robes excavated in China, which is definitely worth a visit. Also, this museum was built on the site of the cemetery, so it contains the tomb of the King of Nanyue. To the east of the museum is a three story comprehensive exhibition building, and to the north is a two-story main exhibition building. The three buildings are connected as a whole by a surrounding corridor that connects them up and down. The museum has a total of 10 exhibition halls, with permanent exhibitions including cultural relics exhibitions and porcelain pillow exhibitions, as well as occasional temporary exhibitions. The cultural relics exhibition is the main body of the museum, mainly consisting of unearthed cultural relics from the tomb of King Zhao Xu of Nanyue, with over 10000 pieces of various burial objects unearthed from the tomb. The exhibition is divided into five units: Emperor Wen's Golden Seal, Treasures of the Main Chamber, Martyrdom in the Tomb, Treasures in the Imperial Treasury, and Bell and Ding Food. There are a large number of jade artifacts in the accompanying collection, such as the Qingyu Jiao Cup, eleven sets of jade accessories, and fifty-eight jade sword ornaments, all of which are significant discoveries in Han jade. The treasures among jade artifacts are undoubtedly the "Silk Thread Jade Robe", "Carrying Plate High Foot Cup", and "Dragon and Phoenix Pattern Heavy Ring Jade Pendant". The dragon and phoenix patterned heavy ring jade pendant is a decorative jade artifact unearthed from the right eye of the tomb owner. It is carved from blue and white jade and is divided into two rings: the inner ring is intricately carved with a swimming dragon, and the outer ring is intricately carved with a phoenix bird. Its design has been selected as the emblem of the Nanyue King Museum of the Western Han Dynasty. Full text 

The Sacred Heart Cathedral in the Stone Chamber is the largest church in Guangzhou, as well as one of the largest Gothic buildings in China and one of the four all stone Gothic church buildings in the world. Many people come here to take outdoor photos as souvenirs, and new couples often come here to take wedding photos (only for outdoor shooting, not for indoor shooting). This church was once the Governor General's Office of Guangdong and Guangxi in the late Qing Dynasty. In 1863, it was rebuilt as a church by the invading British army. The spire of the church is 58.5 meters high and has a magnificent atmosphere. The entire body is made of granite. During non Mass hours, the church can be visited freely, but photography is prohibited inside the church. During Mass, walking around the church is not allowed. It has almost all the compositional elements of Gothic churches, including early architectural style stained glass windows and mid to late architectural style double bell tower spires. There is a pair of towering double pointed stone towers on the front of the church, with four large copper bells imported from France in the middle of the towers. Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is located in the city center. It is smaller than Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, but it is the birthplace of Guangzhou city. Shangxiajiu is equivalent to the front gate fence of Beijing, while Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is more like Wangfujing Street in Beijing. When you come to Guangzhou, you can also position it as the starting point for exploring this city. It starts from Zhongshan Fifth Road in the north and ends at Huifu Road in the south, with a total distance of about 440 meters. This street, which symbolizes the commercial center of Guangzhou and runs north-south, is lined with shops and bustling with people, seemingly always maintaining a thriving vitality. Shopping malls include Guangbai Department Store and Tianhe City Department Store. The business here has flourished since the 10th century in Guangzhou city and continues to this day. Whatever you want to buy, you can basically find it here. Even if you don't have the intention to shop, it's quite interesting to take a walk on the cobblestone road and explore the ordinary alleys of the ancient streets. This' Three Dynasties Ancient Road 'showcases the blue and gray bricks of the Song Dynasty, the yellow sandstone slabs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, as well as the red, yellow sandstone, and linen stone pavement. In addition, the "treasure of the entire street" is undoubtedly the millennium old road ruins lying quietly under the tempered glass cover. The Miyin Temple (Miyin Scenic Area) in Ningxiang County, Changsha City, is located in the Lushan Scenic Area, about 70 kilometers west of Ningxiang County. It is a Buddhist holy land mainly composed of the "Millennium Ancient Temple Miyin Zen Temple" and the "Great Compassion, Thousand Hands, Thousand Eyes Guanyin Holy Statue". Miyin Temple was founded in 807 AD, and its name is derived from the "Secret Heart Seal" of Zen Buddhism. The founder was the Tang Dynasty monk Lingyou Chan, who later received assistance from Prime Minister Pei Xiu to build and request Tang Xuanzong to give him the name and write "Secret Seal Zen Temple". There have been many eminent monks in the temple, and five out of the eight presidents of Buddhist associations since the founding of the People's Republic of China have come from the temple, enjoying a high position in the Buddhist community. The couplet "Fayu Lai Heng Yue, Zong Feng Qi Yang Shan" from the gate of Miyin Temple reveals the origin of the Miyin Temple's Buddhist sect. The walls of the Wanfo Hall in the main hall are adorned with 12988 Buddha statues, one of which is made of pure gold and is a great wonder in Buddhist temples. In the Thousand Hand Thousand Eye Guanyin Culture Park in the temple, there is a statue of the Thousand Hand Thousand Eye Guanyin, which is about 100 meters high. The statue of Guanyin can only appreciate its appearance and cannot enter its interior. The three sides of the statue consist of thirty-three Guanyin statues, which are intricately carved. The overall design of the scenic area is based on the Buddhist holy tree "Bodhi Tree", with five platforms set up on both sides of the central axis: Dazhi Platform, Dayuan Platform, Daxi Platform, and Dashan Platform. The five platforms respectively house Manjusri Bodhisattva, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, Medicine King Bodhisattva, and the five Buddhas symbolizing the five directions, achieving Buddhahood under the Bodhi tree, fully adhering to the origin of Zen Buddhism's saying of "one flower and five leaves". The "Golden Snake Secret Realm" created with huge investment in the Year of the Snake is the largest ecological themed snake park, showcasing over 20 species and more than 300 rare snakes, including the world's largest golden python. Hundreds of thousands of square meters of pristine forest secrets, unique dome shaped snake watching methods, and innovative multimedia viewing experiences bring visitors a brand new world of snakes, discovering the friendly, beautiful, and auspicious side of snakes and providing unprecedented snake watching experiences.

The Great Buddha Temple in Guangzhou was first built during the Southern Han Dynasty (917-971 AD) and was named Xinzang Temple. It was built in response to the twenty-eight mansions in the sky by King Liu Jian of Southern Han. In the Ming Dynasty, it was expanded into Longzang Temple and later renamed as the Patrol Office. In the first year of the Shunzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1649), the government office was destroyed by fire. In the spring of the second year of Kangxi's reign, Prince Shangxi of Pingnan donated his own salary and rebuilt the palace in the style of the official temple in the capital, incorporating the Lingnan local style, which has high cultural and artistic appreciation value. The the Shakya ManiHall faces south from the north, with a building area of 1200 square meters. It is still the best in Lingnan. Although it has been eroded by wind and rain for more than 300 years, its style and features still exist. The high-quality wood donated by King Annam (now Vietnam) for the beam and column frames is still basically intact to this day. In the eleventh year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign (1733), the governor of Guangzhou, Liu Shuxuan, selected the Great Buddha Temple as the place for preaching and built a preaching pavilion in front of the temple. At the same time, Wei Tuo Hall, Jia Lan Hall, and the east and west gates of "Buddhist Realm" and "Zen Forest" were built on both sides of the main hall. At this time, the temple expanded its scope, Buddhist affairs flourished, and its reputation spread far and wide, becoming one of the five major jungles of Guangfu.

shortFeatures: Jiangxin Island in Huangpu area
summary: Changzhou Island, located on the eastern edge of Guangzhou, is an island in the middle of the river on the Pearl River in Huangpu area. It is named Changzhou Island because of its long and narrow shape. There are historic sites everywhere, profound cultural heritage and rich tourism resources. Whampoa Military Academy founded by Dr. Sun Yat-sen has made it a place that attracts worldwide attention and a tourist attraction in Guangzhou.

The gray black architectural style displays the solemnity of the memorial hall, and standing on site will unconsciously evoke a sense of solemnity and awe in the heart, as well as a sensory visual impact of the architectural design. On the long corridor stand sculptures of various revolutionary heroes, and the theme design of the museum is divided into six exhibition halls. Each exhibition hall is connected like a historical time shuttle, replaying the rise and fall of history. Each scene of characters and events is vivid and lifelike, making people feel like they are there.

poiName: Pearl River Night Cruise Xidi Pier
summary: The Pearl River Day Tour Xidi Wharf starts from the Xidi Wharf in Guangzhou and slowly travels along the the Pearl River to enjoy the beautiful scenery on both sides of the the Pearl River.

poiName: Xifang Coutyard Cultural and Creative Industry Park
summary: The Xifang Dayuan Cultural and Creative Industry Park is located in Santang Community, Qiaojie, Panyu City. The park preserves rare red brick and tile style architectural complexes, garden style buildings, and factory workshops full of reform and opening up atmosphere, which have certain cultural value.

shortFeatures: Enjoy the river view during the day and watch the lights at night
summary: Zengjiang Gallery is located on Landscape Avenue in Zengcheng District. The gallery takes Zengjiang as the main line and is distributed along the bicycle leisure greenway. It has strong Lingnan characteristics and has all kinds of tourism infrastructure such as road signs and warning signs along the way. With the approval of the Ministry of Water Resources, Zengjiang Gallery has become one of the eleventh batch of national water conservancy scenic spots in the country.

The cruise of Zengjiang Gallery can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Zengjiang Gallery in the daytime, and watch the lights on both sides in the evening. The cruise passes through 1978 Movie Town, Zengjiang Bridge, Yanta Park, Zengjiang Gallery, Renmin Bridge, Loong Boat Wharf and other scenic spots. While enjoying the beautiful scenery of Zengjiang Gallery, you can also listen to Zengcheng's historical and cultural stories! Take a cruise at Zengjiang Gallery and listen to the stories of Zengcheng!

1978 Movie Town is located on the east bank of Zengjiang River in Guangzhou. Through creative development and renovation of the original sugar paper factory in Zengcheng, as well as surrounding old factories, warehouses, scattered residential buildings, and old villages, a new cultural and creative area with memorable elements has been formed. The project mainly attracts cultural and creative industries such as film, music, advertising, and design, aiming to create a characteristic town with the film industry as its core. It is the first tourism cultural and creative industry park in Guangdong Province.

The 1978 Cultural and Creative Park is located on the east bank of Zengjiang River in Guangzhou. The park mainly has cultural and creative industries such as film, music, advertising, and design. At present, the creative park is centered around the film industry and is striving to create a better and more distinctive cultural and creative park.

Liantang Village, located in the north of Licheng Street in Zengcheng City, was formed during the Southern Song Dynasty. There are farmhouses, greenways, lotus ponds, etc. in the scenic area, with superior natural conditions. It integrates leisure sightseeing, entertainment and fitness, and is a good place for citizens to relax and entertain.

The South China Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is one of the three largest botanical gardens in China. Its huge garden scale and many rare plant species also make it one of the "top ten tourist attractions in Guangzhou". The botanical garden has dozens of stunning viewing areas, with a great environment that is perfect for strolling or taking children on a family trip. The viewing area includes rhododendron garden, ginger garden, bamboo garden, relict plant area, aquatic plant garden and other parks. The rarest ones are relict plants, which have existed on Earth for more than 100 million years and have not yet become extinct. Due to the abundance of plants, the air here is particularly good. Although corresponding plants and flowers can be seen in the botanical garden all year round, the best season is spring, with a warm feeling of blooming flowers. The South China Botanical Garden currently has over 100 species (including varieties) of azaleas. Every March, azaleas of different colors and shapes can be observed in places such as the azalea garden, palm garden, and relict plant area. Walking into the South China Botanical Garden Biological Garden, you can see a sea of purple red flowers from afar. The cherry blossoms of 'Chinese Red' bloom on the trees, like fire and rosy clouds. The purple red flowers from January to March are extremely beautiful against the backdrop of the blue sky. The point worth recommending is that there are not many tourists here, it is very quiet, and it is very suitable for bringing children to experience nature and learn about some types of flowers. Due to the beautiful scenery, locals often take wedding photos here. The entire environment of the botanical garden is like a large garden, which can take up a whole day. Due to the large size of the area, it is recommended to take an electric scooter to explore. Electric scooters can be called and stopped at any time, from one point to another, until they cover the entire botanical garden, which is very convenient. Full text 

shortFeatures: View Lingnan Architecture and Experience Water Town Style
summary: Litchi Bay is located in Pantang, Xiguan, Liwan District, Guangzhou. You can take a walk or take a cruise in Litchi Bay. The beautiful water town here was once the first scene in Lingnan, and it was also the birthplace of the famous Liwan Tingzi porridge. Here you can see the architectural style with Lingnan characteristics on both sides of the strait.

shortFeatures: Taste fresh and delicious seafood
summary: Nineteenth Yong, going out to sea is Lingdingyang. There are no beaches on the seaside, only stone dams. Once it rushed to Nineteenth Yong, it was built by reclamation and embankment in the former educated youth era. Now it belongs to Nansha Port Area of Nansha Development Zone, Guangzhou. It is a migratory bird nature reserve, fruit and vegetable production base and seafood wholesale market in Guangzhou, rich in papaya, carambola, banana, sugarcane, lotus root, etc.

The Nansha Coastal Wetland Scenic Area is a wetland ecological tourism and leisure area that integrates ecological sightseeing, popular science education, cultural film and television, and leisure vacation.

Puzhou Garden is located in the southeast of Nansha New City, adjacent to Dajiao Mountain to the south and Puzhou Mountain to the north. The whole park is divided into two major areas, east and west. The eastern area is connected to the scenic spots of Puzhou and Dajiao by the axis line; The western area has ups and downs, and the garden road has twists and turns. It integrates the essence of the eastern garden. The two areas are naturally transited by the lake surface, and become a whole. The main attractions include: Shuishi Garden, Palm Garden, Science Popularization Garden, Di Garden, Yin Sheng Garden, Rose Garden, Shuixiang Street, and Beer House.

Gathering together, Yang Fan sets sail and plays with the sea. When you are tired of living in cramped spaces, tired of karaoke, tired of traditional tourist attractions, do you yearn for a healthy, fashionable, and unique way of playing? Come to Nansha Yacht Club and enjoy the infinite charm of sailing journey. Enjoy the blue sea and sky, encounter romantic relationships, create pure happiness and unforgettable moments between family and friends, harvest beautiful moments and sweet memories. Experienced captains will provide you with professional guidance and safety protection during the voyage. Blow the sea breeze, bask in the sun, and give yourself a whole body and mind relaxation.

poiName: Ping An Finance Center Sky Observation Deck, Shenzhen
tagNameList: Walking baby treasure land; Observation deck
shortFeatures: Experience the suspended observation platform with a bird's-eye view of Shenzhen and Hong Kong
summary: FREE SKY Cloud Sightseeing Floor is located on the 116th floor of Ping An Financial Center, the fourth tallest building in the world. It is proud of Shenzhen's new landmark at an altitude of about 547.6 meters, and has a 360-degree bird's-eye view of Shenzhen's different landscapes and urban features in all directions. The cloud sightseeing layer integrates sightseeing and entertainment, cultural creativity and popular science education, and is a new landmark of urban sightseeing with cultural connotation. At the same time, the sightseeing floor is connected with a huge transportation network and rich tourist lines, which will become an unmissable choice for many tourists to visit Shenzhen. The sightseeing floor covers a number of functional spaces, such as transparent viewing spots, interactive experience areas, characteristic exhibition areas, etc., and displays the young culture with rich Shenzhen characteristics with advanced intelligent multimedia facilities. This is an excellent place to taste the prosperity and natural reflection of Shenzhen. You can enjoy the unique experience of enjoying the city scenery at Dapeng Fuyun, and the 360-degree cloud overview is shocking.

poiName: Shenzhen Reform and Opening-up Exhibition Hall
summary: The Shenzhen Reform and Opening up Exhibition Hall, located in Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China, uses high-tech means such as photos, physical objects, videos, models, and interactive experience projects to comprehensively, vividly, and three dimensionally showcase the magnificent history and brilliant achievements of Guangdong's 40 years of opening up.

tagNameList: Monuments and sites; Ancient town and village
shortFeatures: Feel the glory of the former coastal fortress
summary: Nantou Ancient City (Xin'an Ancient City) is located north of Nantou Tianqiao in Nanshan District, Shenzhen City, covering an area of about 70,000 square meters. At present, it is the largest tourist attraction of historical relics in Shenzhen, also known as "Nantou Ancient City". Nantou Ancient City, located on the east bank of the Pearl River estuary, has been the administrative center, coastal defense fortress, distribution center of maritime traffic and foreign trade in the coastal areas of Lingnan in past dynasties, and is also the historical source of Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macao. The simple and magnificent ancient city of Nantou is a precious relic of Lingnan ancient culture. It has experienced and recorded the historical situation of Shenzhen and Nantou. Nantou City has a long history and has undergone several changes. Today, it has become the political, economic, commercial and cultural center of Nanshan District, Shenzhen.

The Shenzhen Golden Coast Yacht Pier is located on Seafood Street. Tourists can take a yacht to explore magnificent landscapes such as Seafood Street, Yantian Port, Dameisha Seaside Park, Xiaomeisha, Xiashawan Beach, Nanao Fishing Port, Chepingzhou Nature Reserve, Yazhou Island, Ji'ao Island, Shatoujiao, etc. from the sea, and enjoy multiple sea views.

Dameisha Seaside Park is located in Yantian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, surrounded by mountains on three sides and facing the sea on one side. The endless sea and soft sandy beaches have always made it popular, and visitors continue to flock to it. If you want to get rid of this crowded crowd, it's better to choose the way of taking a boat tour. On the vast sea, you can quietly enjoy the unbeatable beauty of Dameisha and laugh at the clouds rolling and relaxing in the sky.

Elephant Legend is an interactive experience hall in Guangzhou with the theme of elephants. Visitors can observe and understand the living habits of elephants up close, participate in various interactive activities related to elephants, and experience the wisdom and charm of elephants.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

poiName: Pearl River Night Cruise Canton Tower Fortune Pier
summary: The Fortune Wharf of the Pearl River Tower is one of the embarkation points for the night tour of the Pearl River. It is located on the new central axis of Guangzhou city, facing the CBD of Pearl River New Town across the river and close to the Guangzhou Tower.

shortFeatures: The First Talent Theme Park in China

summary: Daxia Valley is a theme park located within the OCT scenic area in eastern Shenzhen, and is also one of its core tourist areas. Daxia Valley is a fusion of natural scenery and thrilling amusement projects, making it a choice for young people to gather and travel. It usually takes one day to visit the Great Xia Valley. It is recommended to take the jungle cable car to the Cloud Sea Highland after entering the scenic spot in the morning. This is the essence of the Great Xia Valley. The 110 meter high Natural Eye Observation Tower on the Cloud Sea Plateau and the "Peak of Extreme" all glass observation deck extending beyond the cliff offer panoramic views of the entire Eastern Overseas Chinese Town, making it the observation deck of the Great Hero Valley. After playing on the mountain, take the Cloud Sea Cableway down the mountain to the Ecological Canyon at noon or afternoon. This is a place where thrilling and exciting amusement projects are concentrated, including rapids, wooden roller coasters, 4000 miles from the center of the earth, deep-sea exploration, hurricane rescue, jungle shuttle, phantom whirlwind, children's amusement park, mountain and sea mysterious realm performances, etc. Among them, the most exciting ones are the wooden roller coasters and rapids. After playing exciting amusement projects, continue walking and you will come to Haifeide (a small town). Haifeide (a small town) is a characteristic block with the theme of world wine culture. The buildings in the town are full of exotic charm, and there are many copper sculptures related to wine on the street. Full text 

The characteristic block of Haifeide Town is themed around wine culture, with warm and simple buildings combining logs and bricks, and rich American characteristics. The series of bronze sculptures showcases the entire process from grape picking to red wine making, showcasing the charm of a wine town in Napa Valley, California in the 19th century. Strolling through it, both floors are exotic buildings, with numerous shops along the street and a huge LED canopy overhead, constantly playing spectacular scenes of space, ocean, and forest alternating and changing. The red wine experience hall and homemade beer house are must visit places here, and the lakeside food gallery has many unique and delicious dishes.

Dongmen Old Street can be said to be the "root" of modern Shenzhen, a relatively old commercial pedestrian street in Shenzhen. Thousands of shops are densely packed among them, with various buildings standing shoulder to shoulder. For a long time, "Dongmen" has become a banner of Shenzhen's commercial and trade industry, reflecting and guiding Shenzhen's consumer trends and fashion. Dongmen has always been a popular place with numerous shops and snack shops, making it very lively. There are two sets of bronze bells on the east and west squares of the old street, which ring once in the morning and once in the evening, and have become symbols of the east gate.

The tourist destination for Diwang sightseeing refers to Diwang Building, a well-known landmark in Shenzhen with a total height of 383.95 meters and an actual building height of 324.8 meters. Climbing up to the 69th floor, you can overlook Hong Kong to the south and Shenzhen to the north. Diwang Sightseeing, also known as the Window of Shenzhen and Hong Kong, is a themed high-rise tourist attraction. Accompanied by melodious music, taking the elevator only takes fifty seconds to reach the top floor of the 69th floor of the Diwang Building. The scenic area features novel and exciting multidimensional dynamic movies, documentary digital overlay slides, and fifteen interesting landscapes. Standing at an altitude of over 300 meters, the winding Shenzhen River looks like a giant dragon waiting to take off, and like a gorgeous green ribbon tightly linking Shenzhen and Hong Kong. summary: Dameisha Seaside Park is located in the eastern part of Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, on the coast of the South China Sea. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, facing the sea on one side, and an open sandy beach stretching 1800 meters in the middle. The park is full of vibrant subtropical seaside scenery, and both Shenzhen residents and tourists love to come here to enjoy leisure time by the seaside. The center of the park is Sun Square and Moon Square, connected by a 'Sunshine Corridor'. There are polished stone benches in the corridor for tourists to rest, and many couples come here for walks and dates. Dameisha Seaside Park is divided into swimming area, sports area, leisure area, entertainment area, barbecue area and other parts. There are amusement projects such as motorboats, beach bikes, bungee jumping, etc. to choose from. Making plans with family and friends to gather here, watching the sea, swimming in the sea, or playing water sports are all very interesting. If you want to go swimming in the sea, the park can provide cold and hot water shower and bag storage services. It is particularly important to note that when swimming, please do not exceed the shark prevention net and pay attention to safety. The park provides 24-hour voluntary rescue services within the shark prevention net. Accommodation around the park is also convenient. You can find high-end restaurants to roadside stores, ordinary hotels to five-star hotels, and specialty dishes are seafood and Roast squab. Additionally, Dameisha is often overcrowded. If you don't like crowds, you can choose to walk along the boardwalk by the beach, which is relatively quiet and comfortable to listen to the sea breeze. Walk east along the coastline for about two kilometers, and you will reach Xiaomeisha. Xiaomeisha charges a fee but has fewer tourists and a better environment. Next to Xiaomeisha is Xiaomeisha Ocean World. If you are interested, you can also visit it together. Full text 

The Wenhua Dong Method Spa Center is located in Guangzhou and is a venue that provides high-end spa services, renowned for its elegant environment and professional services. We offer a variety of spa and massage services here, aimed at providing guests with a relaxing and rejuvenating experience.

The new Jiangxi Science and Technology Museum is a smart venue that showcases technological empowerment and humanistic care. The new museum has set up a children's science park, permanent exhibition hall, short-term exhibition hall, technology visual effects cinema, science education laboratory, science popularization theater and other on-site demonstration and experience halls. Among them, the Children's Science Park is themed around "Wonderful Journey" and has 5 experience areas, namely the Life Block, Story Kingdom, Future World, Health Zone, and Mini Space. Each experience area simulates different scenarios, and children can engage in various immersive learning and exploration activities such as role-playing, game interaction, and experiencing life in different exhibition areas.

Luzui Mountain Villa is located in Yangmeikeng, Nan'ao. The villa stands between the sea where water and sky merge, and the towering Qiniang Mountain Range. The wooden houses and small buildings in the mountains and forests are arranged in a staggered manner, combined with the mysterious and enticing primitive ecological scenery, appearing simple and peaceful.

Curtain Opening (Guangzhou Tower) Wax Museum is located at the east entrance of the first floor of Guangzhou Tower, a landmark in Guangzhou. It is the sixth themed wax museum in the world by Curtain Opening. Through various presentation methods such as imaging technology, artificial intelligence, and innovative scene design, we create a wax museum that integrates sightseeing, interaction, and experience for the audience, allowing them to immerse themselves and linger on. Since its establishment, the Curtain Opening Wax Museum has opened wax museums with different themes in Guangzhou, Xiamen, Lijiang, Changsha, Dalian, Lhasa, and overseas Malaysia. The Curtain Opening (Guangzhou Tower) Wax Museum, based on Guangfu Culture, has ten themed exhibition areas showcasing more than 70 celebrity wax figures, gathering outstanding figures from various fields at home and abroad. Each wax figure is exquisitely crafted and lifelike; Each exhibition area is full of excitement, where visitors can take intimate photos with celebrity wax figures and participate in diverse scene interactions to experience the wonderful journey of the wax museum.

poiName: Dusit Devarana Hot Springs & Spa Conghua
summary: Conghua Duxi Taili Resort Hot Springs is located about a 60 minute drive from the center of Guangzhou, and is a unique feature of Duxi Taili Resort Hotel. It has a unique Thai style SPA hot spring club, including indoor and outdoor hot spring swimming pools, 23 aromatherapy pools, leisure pools, fish therapy pools, and Taili Spa Center with 5 characteristic massage rooms. Professional Thai style SPA services are provided by technicians from Thailand, bringing guests a relaxing experience. Full text 

Happy Coast is a part of OCT, with water as its theme. Qushui Bay integrates restaurants, bars, traditional and modern buildings, making it a commercial area that combines shopping, dining, and entertainment. There are shopping centers, ocean dream halls, and joyful coastal water show theaters. Among them, the Ocean Dream Pavilion is currently the only oceanarium in the center of Shenzhen. The Water Show Theater will have a deep blue secret water show performance, and in the evening, there will be a music fountain, which is very exciting.

Lizhi Bay is located in the hinterland of Xiguan in the old city area of Guangzhou, and it is also the origin of Xiguan's current name, "Liwan District". There is a poem that describes the scenery of Lizhi Bay as "a bay with green water and red Lizhi on both sides". Litchi Bay has a beautiful environment, crisscrossing water systems, and numerous historical sites. Taking a boat tour is a great way to enjoy the scenery. There are two types of boats here, one is rowing boats and the other is painting boats. You can take the bus at both Wenta Square and the entrance of the Liang Clan Ancestral Hall, mainly passing through the first, second, and third phases of Lizhi Bay and Liwan Lake. Along the coast, you will pass by several famous people's former residences, as well as important attractions such as Wenta, Chen Lianbo Mansion, Haishan Xian Guan Long Corridor, Shide Yinhe, Lixiang River Square, and the Eight Harmony Hall in the third phase, as well as more than ten small bridges spanning the bay, allowing you to experience the cultural charm of Lizhi Bay at once.

shortFeatures: High-rise building with reinforced concrete structure
summary: Nanfang Building is a comprehensive department store and one of the 12 large department stores in China. In 1983, the total sales volume reached 270 million yuan, ranking first among the 12 largest department stores in China. Nanfang Building is a large state-owned enterprise with more than 2,000 employees. Before 1978, the store developed slowly. There were more than 1,000 source points in the store and 29,500 kinds of goods. The underground shopping mall of Nanfang Building, characterized by exquisite, famous brand, specialty and short-door goods, enjoys the reputation of "Southern Boutique Collection" and is the largest underground shopping mall in China. Nanfang Building Department Store is also preparing to further form Guangzhou Shopping and Tourism Center based on Nanfang Building.

shortFeatures: High-rise buildings imitating American skyscrapers
summary: Aiqun Building, also known as Aiqun Hotel, was completed and opened in 1937, and maintained its status as the "tallest building in Guangzhou" for 30 years from 1937 to 1967. In 1984, a revolving restaurant was added, which once won the crown of Guangzhou buildings. It was praised by the press at that time as "opening a new era of high-rise buildings in Guangzhou", and was famous for its latest, perfect and luxurious equipment. Nowadays, the facilities in the hotel are more complete. The former Aiqun Building has a great influence at home and abroad, and is known as the "crown of South China".

shortFeatures: The Republic of China has many historical features and cultural buildings
summary:
Dongshankou is a holy land of literature and art, where art spaces, life aesthetics shops and studios take root and sprout, growing a literary atmosphere with Dongshankou characteristics. 
Walking in the Dongshan western buildings, you can feel the uneven and undulating terrain here like a hills. 
The number of western buildings in Dongshan is amazing, among which the more famous ones are five gardens.

Kui Garden is located in Yuexiu District, Guangzhou City. It is a century old Western style building and was once a famous private garden in Guangzhou during the Republic of China period. The unique architectural style within the park blends elements of Chinese and Western cultures, and has now become one of the cultural landmarks of Guangzhou.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

summary: Jianyuan was the residence of the Jian brothers of Nanyang Tobacco Company at that time. The Jian brothers founded Nanyang Tobacco Company to promote domestic products and fight against European and American tobacco companies. On the outer walls of Jianyuan, typical Chinese green glazed pottery and bamboo bamboo slips can be seen for decoration. In front of the porch stands a pair of majestic stone lions, and the garden in front also has a fountain and flower garden, which is a perfect example of the combination of Chinese and Western styles. Nowadays, Jianyuan has become a private residence and is not open to the public. The former flower garden has become a parking lot and has lost its former charm.

poiName: The Museum of Site of the 3rd National Congress of the Communist Party of China
summary: The first and second floors of the memorial hall showcase themed spaces related to the Party, the third floor features Party classrooms and office spaces, and the fourth floor introduces natural sunlight to create a simple and open coffee and book bar atmosphere, allowing the public to better read the Party's history and culture.

The new building of Guangzhou Cultural Center is designed with the theme of "Ten Miles of Red Clouds, One Bay of Water, Eight Bridges, Painting Boats, and Sixteen Pavilions". It cleverly combines traditional architecture and garden space to recreate the beautiful scenery of Lingnan water town gardens, including Hanmo Garden, Quyi Garden, Guangfu Garden, Guangxiu Garden and other theme garden buildings, as well as the large garden landscape formed by them together. It is a city living room rich in Lingnan ecological characteristics and cultural heritage.

shortFeatures: Moon-viewing resort with wide vision
summary:
· Jiangxin Island on the Pearl River, located beside Haixinsha, between Guangzhou Bridge and Haiyin Bridge. 
Surrounded by water and pleasant scenery, it is a concentrated place of high-grade residential buildings and villas in Guangzhou. 
There are Ersha Island Sports Park, Guangdong Tennis Hall, Swimming Association, etc. on the island, which is the sports training base of Guangdong Province. 
Guangdong Art Museum and Xinghai Concert Hall are also located in Ersha Island, and the cultural and artistic atmosphere is blowing on our faces. 
It is bordered by green grass in the north and blue waves of the Pearl River in the south. It is a place where the soul returns.

The beach sand in Tung Chung is very fine, the coastline is short, and the seawater is very blue. The beach has a large area, and other parts of the beach are covered with rocks, making it a paradise for many hiking enthusiasts. The Dongxichong coastline is a "relatively beautiful and classic coastline hiking route" in Shenzhen, with a long coastline of Ping Shan and the sea, and mountains crisscrossing and stretching. It has a super beautiful sea view, allowing you to enjoy the blue sea and sky while hiking. If you walk from east to west, half of the mountain road and half of the coastline are fast, it will take more than 2 hours to complete, but the general travel time is within 5 hours.

Jinxiu Zhonghua Folk Village consists of two parts: Jinxiu Zhonghua and Zhonghua Folk Village. The former has many miniature representations of well-known Chinese landscapes, allowing you to "explore China in one day". The latter has 24 village buildings where you can experience folk customs, and you can also watch folk performances of 56 ethnic groups. The two parks have been merged, just purchase one ticket. It is generally recommended to visit Jinxiu Zhonghua in the morning and Folk Village in the afternoon, as the large-scale performances in Folk Village are usually held in the afternoon. If you want to browse quickly for half a day, you can also consider combining walking with an electric scooter. The shuttle bus format is fixed, with the stop at the Confucian Temple in Jinxiu Zhonghua and the stop at Mosuo Village in Folk Village. It takes about 25 minutes to browse the entire scenic area. The docking time is 2 minutes. Splendid China mainly looks at miniature scenic spots and photographs. Nearly one hundred Chinese scenic spots are scaled down by 1:15, which can be called the collection of essence of China's natural scenery and human history. The mini version of the Great Wall, the Terra Cotta Warriors of the Qin Dynasty, the Mogao Grottoes of Dunhuang, Huangguoshu Waterfall and other places of interest can all be seen here, so it is said that "you can travel all over China in one day". The Chinese Folk Village offers a unique blend of 56 ethnic groups in China, where you can witness colorful ethnic costumes, the architectural styles of 24 villages, and various folk performances, making it a sight to behold. All 24 villages are built in a 1:1 ratio, giving people a sense of immersion. The architectural styles of ethnic minority villages are even more unique, such as the stone villages of the Buyi people, the wooden houses of the Mosuo people, the bamboo buildings of the Dai people, the Mongolian yurts, and the Tibetan monasteries. People take pictures of them from time to time. There are also many participating projects in the park that you can experience firsthand, such as the Wupeng boat, wooden boat, Dulong tribe zip line, horseback riding, archery, etc. You can check the official website link in advance for the performance schedule and introduction. Full text 

Happy Harbor is located in the southern coastal area of Bao'an Central District, with a coastline of 45 kilometers west of Shenzhen. Formerly known as Bao'an Binhai Cultural Park, Happy Harbor is a contemporary art and cultural block that integrates sea views, parks, ecology, and commerce. The project covers a total area of approximately 380000 square meters, including a seaside cultural park covering an area of approximately 270000 square meters, a 128 meter high "Bay Area Light" Ferris wheel, a 20000 square meter "Bay Area Sound" performing arts center, an 80000 square meter east and west coast experiential commercial district, and a 10000 square meter JW Marriott Hotel Light Wing and other diverse formats. In the future, it will be developed into an "International Bay Area Heart Coastal Living and Creative Land" that integrates coastal leisure, cultural tourism, art experience, and ecological office.

The "Light of the Bay Area" Ferris wheel is located at the eastern end of Shenzhen Happy Harbor. It was carefully crafted by OCT Group, in collaboration with the "London Eye" construction team, the European STARNETHENGINING team, and Juma Group, integrating advanced design and construction technologies from around the world. The Ferris wheel has a total height of 128 meters and 28 imported cabins, each with an area of approximately 16.8 square meters, capable of accommodating 25 people. Adopting a fish fin shaped irregular large stand with a design inspired by the ocean, not only does it offer a broad perspective, but it also represents a breakthrough in the artistic direction of the structure. summary: The Guangzhou Uprising Memorial, also known as the site of the Guangzhou Commune, was originally the Guangdong Provincial Public Security Bureau of the Republic of China. It is located at No. 200, Uprising Road, Guangzhou, China. This was the site of the Soviet government established by the Guangzhou Commune, which was led by Zhang Tailei of the Communist Party of China during the Guangzhou Uprising. After the failure of the uprising, the Soviet government was abolished. Although the Guangzhou Commune lasted only three days, it was the first Soviet government established in a major Chinese city and is known as the "Eastern Paris Commune." After the People's Liberation Army captured Guangzhou in 1949, the Public Security Bureau was taken over by the People's Government of Guangzhou and became the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau. In 1956, the Guangzhou People's Government opened the southern building as the Guangzhou Uprising Exhibition Hall. In 1987, the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau transferred the southern building, middle building, and gatehouse to the cultural heritage department, which then carried out repairs and restoration, establishing the Guangzhou Uprising Memorial. Ye Jianying once inscribed the words "Site of the Guangzhou Commune." Due to limited office space, the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau did not transfer the northern building and detention center until the end of 2005. In 2006, renovation work on the memorial began, during which relics such as shells and handguns were unearthed in the northern building. The memorial re-opened in 2007. Although the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau ultimately transferred all the site buildings, both the Public Security Bureau and the Guangzhou National Security Bureau are still located next to the Guangzhou Uprising Memorial and share the same address.

summary: In July 1924, the Guangzhou Peasant Movement Institute was established. It held six sessions in total. The first and second sessions were held at the Huizhou Guild Hall on Yuexiu South Road, while the third, fourth, and fifth sessions were at No. 1 Donggao Avenue. In March 1926, the sixth session moved to the Panyu Academy on Zhongshan Fourth Road. Comrade Mao Zedong served as the director, Xiao Chunu was the director of academic affairs, and comrades such as Zhou Enlai, Qu Qiubai, Wu Yuzhang, Peng Pai, Deng Zhongxia, and others were instructors, teaching various courses related to peasant movements. The institute trained a group of important cadres for the Chinese revolution, and many key figures in the later peasant movement had studied there. The original site of the institute was a Confucian temple built during the Ming Dynasty, and in the Qing Dynasty, it became the site of the Panyu Academy. The old site faces south and consists of a group of ancient brick-and-wood buildings, including the Dacheng Gate, Lingxing Gate, Dacheng Hall, Chongsheng Hall, east and west ear rooms, the east wing, and the east and west colonnades. In 1953, the original site of the Peasant Movement Institute was repaired and restored to its original appearance. Today, it includes Comrade Mao Zedong's office, the academic affairs department, the military training department, the administrative department, the reading room, classrooms, student dormitories, and the canteen.

The Guangzhou Uprising Martyrs' Cemetery, located at 92 Zhongshan 2nd Road, Guangzhou, is a memorial park built in 1954 to commemorate the martyrs who bravely sacrificed their lives during the Guangzhou Uprising in December 1927. The cemetery serves as a site for remembrance, tourism, and science popularization.

On the night of December 11, 1927, under the leadership of Zhang Tailei, the then Secretary of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China, along with Ye Ting, Ye Jianying, Su Zhaozheng, Nie Rongzhen, and Xu Xiangqian, the Guangzhou Uprising was launched to resist the violent persecution and massacre by the Kuomintang reactionaries. Over 150 Koreans, including Cui Yongjian, and personnel from the Soviet consulate in Guangzhou also participated in the uprising. Due to the enemy's strength, the uprising ultimately failed. In the six days from December 14 to 19, more than 5,700 Communist Party members and revolutionary masses were brutally killed.

After the founding of the People's Republic of China, the Guangzhou Municipal Government constructed this memorial cemetery in Huanghuagang, where the martyrs fell. It opened to the public in 1957. 

The cemetery covers an area of 180,000 square meters and is divided into two parts: the mausoleum area and the park area. The mausoleum area includes the main gate, the mausoleum avenue, the Guangzhou Uprising Memorial Monument, the Guangzhou Commune Martyrs' Tomb, the tomb of Marshal Ye Jianying, and Hero Square.

The main gate is built with white granite as the base, and the roof is made of orange-red glazed tiles, with a stone wall engraved with the words "Guangzhou Uprising Martyrs' Cemetery" handwritten by Zhou Enlai. The mausoleum avenue is wide and straight, lined with tall pine and cypress trees, and twenty flowerbeds with vibrant red flowers, creating a solemn and dignified atmosphere. At the north end of the avenue stands the Guangzhou Uprising Memorial Monument, which has a unique and meaningful design. The front of the monument is inscribed with the name of the monument in gilded characters, written by Deng Xiaoping. Surrounding the monument are bas-reliefs depicting scenes of the Guangzhou Uprising.

In the park area, the "Blood Sacrifice Xuanyuan Pavilion," "China-Korea People's Blood Ties Pavilion," "China-Soviet People's Blood Ties Pavilion," an artificial lake, and arched bridges are scattered amidst green trees and blooming flowers. In the morning, the rising sun shines brightly over the martyrs' tombs, creating a magnificent scene. This view, known as the "Red Tomb Sunrise," was selected as one of the "New Eight Views of Yangcheng" and in 1986 was awarded as one of the "Top Ten Tourist Attractions in Guangzhou" by the Guangzhou Municipal Government.

In March, thousands of azaleas bloom brightly, with over 1,000 varieties of rhododendrons and Mao azaleas planted on the grassland, most of which were planted by the park's staff before 1985. Many of these azalea trees have grown to over a meter tall. The best time to view the flowers is before the Qingming Festival.

The cemetery was built in 1933 with donations from overseas Chinese to commemorate the fallen soldiers of the 19th Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army in the 1932 "January 28" Battle of Shanghai against Japan. The entire cemetery has a grand architectural scale, rigorous layout, and a solemn and elegant shape. The north-south tomb passage forms a very obvious central axis, and the main buildings are all made of granite stones. It is a cemetery with a rich ancient Roman architectural style.

This bronze seated Buddha statue has a plump and elegant face, with ears hanging down from the shoulders and the right hand showing the "Fearless Seal", demonstrating the Buddha's wish to save sentient beings. To worship the Buddha, you must first climb 268 stone steps to reach the Buddha. Seeds can sprout in the fruits of trees and grow into seedlings, then leave the mother plant and fall into the mud to develop and grow.

Pangui Tower is located in Siming District, Xiamen City. It is a viewing platform surrounded by the sea on three sides, like a sailing ship sailing in the wind. People can enjoy the beautiful sunset scenery here.

Shangli Reservoir is located on Shangli Wenzeng Road in Siming District, Xiamen City, adjacent to Xiamen Garden and Botanical Garden, surrounded by Xiguling, Dongpingling, and Huangcuoling on three sides. The reservoir was first built in 1924 and is one of the oldest reservoirs in Xiamen. Its completion solved the problem of difficulty for Xiamen residents to drink water at that time. Beside the reservoir, aquatic plants such as reeds and plantains sway and sway in the gentle breeze, while distant mountains stretch out and are covered in lush greenery. At the end of the reservoir, the iconic building of Shangli Reservoir Dam is still preserved. The large pond downstream of the dam has a curved blue water, surrounded by lush vegetation.

tagNameList: Featured exhibition hall; Venue exhibition hall
shortFeatures: Art lovers and literary paradise
summary: Guan Shanyue Art Museum is a national art museum named after Mr. Guan Shanyue, a famous Chinese painter, educator and master of Lingnan School of Painting. The foundation stone was laid in January 1995, and the museum was completed and opened on June 25th, 1997, on the eve of Hong Kong's return. Located in the central area of Futian, Shenzhen, it is adjacent to the beautiful Lianhua Mountain in the north and the municipal square in the south. It has a beautiful environment, convenient transportation, unique architectural shape and simple and elegant colors. Together with large-scale cultural facilities such as Shenzhen Concert Hall, Central Library, Children's Palace and Shenzhen TV Center, it forms a new cultural landscape of Shenzhen. Mr. Guan Shanyue was very concerned about Shenzhen's art cause during his lifetime, and donated 813 representative works of his various historical periods and all the systematic materials of his life, art and educational practice to Shenzhen people. Shenzhen Municipal Government highly praised Guan Lao's selfless dedication, and spent 67 million yuan to build Guan Shanyue Art Museum, so as to treasure his works forever for the world to study and appreciate. The art museum covers an area of 8,000 square meters, with a building area of 15,100 square meters. It has 8 indoor standard exhibition halls, a central rotunda and an outdoor sculpture Guangchang exhibition hall with a total area of 4,000 square meters and a total length of 600 meters. It can hold large-scale art exhibitions of different types and themes simultaneously or separately. The exhibition hall has soft lighting, wide vision, and is quite magnificent. In addition, it also has modern large-scale painting gallery, 6-storey multi-functional office building, conference hall, lecture hall, VIP room, tea house, restaurant, artist gallery, children's painting garden and painter's home and other supporting facilities, equipped with advanced central air conditioning, constant temperature and humidity and automatic fire prevention and anti-theft monitoring system. Guan Shanyue Art Museum has three internal institutions and promotion planning groups: office, exhibition department and research collection department. The function of the office is to be responsible for secretarial, personnel, administration and other aspects of the library to ensure the normal operation of the whole library. The exhibition department is mainly responsible for the design and display layout of various exhibitions, from the overall design of exhibition layout to the production of specific signs, invitations and catalogs. The collection department mainly studies Mr. Guan Shanyue's works in various periods, and at the same time studies contemporary art and art gallery studies. The promotion group focuses on promoting and planning various exhibitions, actively cooperates with various media, introduces major events to the audience, and makes full use of our own resources and conditions to promote the development of art education in Shenzhen, especially children's art education.

On December 20, 2005, the police held a farewell ceremony and officially handed over the Central Police Station. The original site is adjacent to the former Central Magistracy and Victoria Prison, which also have a long history, and is planned to be developed into a historical and cultural tourism area. In April 2011, the Hong Kong Jockey Club announced that it had completed archaeological surveys in the area and discovered some artifacts believed to be from the late Qing Dynasty to the early 20th century, including containers, pottery pipes, copper coins, fragments of porcelain bowls, suspected tunnel buildings, and foundation remains. The Greater Bay Area No.1 launched by China Merchants Shekou Cruise Home Port is a bay area cruise ship with routes to the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge and Shenzhen Bay.

Shekou Cruise Home Port is a modern international cruise home port, sea gateway, and comprehensive hub that integrates "sea, land, air, and rail" in China. Under the guidance and support of the Shenzhen Municipal Government, with the concept of creating a "sea reception room", we creatively launched the Bay Area sea tour business and created a sea scene for the lifestyle of middle and high-end customers. On August 26, 2020, China's first comprehensive high-end bay area micro cruise ship "Greater Bay Area No.1" set sail; In June 2021, the "Greater Bay Area No.2" micro cruise ship set sail. At present, there are three sea tourism routes operating in the Bay Area: the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge route, the Shenzhen Bay route, and the Qianhai Bay route. 1、 Starting from September 1, 2020, the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge route will be newly launched, passing through Shekou Cruise Home Port - SCT Terminal - Neilingding Island - White Dolphin Island (Western Artificial Island) - Niutou Island - Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge. By taking a micro cruise ship in the Greater Bay Area, you will have a panoramic view of the home port from the sea. 2. Inner Lingding Island and LingdingOcean. Inner Lingding Island was originally named Lingdingshan or Lingdingshan because it lived alone in the sea. Later, it was renamed Lingdingshan to distinguish it from Outer Lingding Island. The Neilingding Island Futian Nature Reserve was established in October 1984 and upgraded to a nature reserve in May 1988, with a total area of approximately 921.64 hectares. The Western Island artificial island covers an area of 100000 square meters and is built with plain concrete both domestically and internationally. It is known as a "landmark" on the Lingdingyang Island and started construction and became an island in the same year. The Hong Kong Zhuhai Macau Bridge connects Lantau Island, Macau Island, and Zhuhai City in Guangdong Province. The project route starts from the artificial island near the Hong Kong International Airport at the Hong Kong Port, connects to the Zhuhai/Macau Port artificial island and the Zhuhai Connection Line to the west, and ends at Hongwan, Zhuhai, with a total length of approximately 55 kilometers (including approximately 41.6 kilometers from the Zhuhai Macau Port to the Hong Kong Port). The micro cruise ship will also cross the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Qingzhou Channel Bridge, offering a close-up view of the glory of the "Seventh Wonder of the Modern World". The Qingzhou Navigation Bridge, also known as the 'Chinese Knot', is one of the three navigable spans of the Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge. It has a main span of 458 meters and a tower height of 163 meters. It is also the highlight of the entire bridge. Finally, the micro cruise ship slowly sailed back on this blue sky. On the way, you can also enjoy a distant view of SCT Pier and feel the mystery and magnificence of the marine industry. Located on the east bank of the the Pearl River estuary, SCT is a specialized container terminal in Shenzhen. Imagine the machines in front of you building and dismantling like Lego bricks every day, connecting the scenery of every corner of the world. 2、 The Shenzhen Bay route passes through Shekou Cruise Home Port - SCT Terminal - Shenzhen Bay Bridge - Shenzhen Bay Park. poiName: Duddell Street Steps and Gas Lamps
summary: Coming out of Lan Kwai Fong in Central and walking along Snow Factory Street for 5 minutes, there is an old street listed as a Hong Kong heritage site, Gas Lamp Street (Duddell Street). Here, there are the only remaining gas lamps in Hong Kong, and many movies and TV dramas have been filmed here. Heartbroken love, drunkenness, passionate love, and heart wrenching stories all appear on this stone staircase, which is a must visit for Hong Kong drama fans. Gaslamp Street itself is a small street with only one end open to traffic. At the junction of this street and Xuechang Street, there is a granite staircase connecting to this street. On both sides of the stone staircase, there are four gas lamps, which are currently the only four gas lamps in Hong Kong. They are extremely precious and have been listed as a statutory monument by the government. Nowadays, gas lamps are lit from 6pm to 6am every day for street lighting purposes. During the day, you can follow the scenes from Hong Kong dramas and walk on the stone steps. Looking up, there is a huge shade of trees blocking the scorching sunlight. At night, the gas lamp is already on, blowing a slightly cool night breeze, and you can sit on the stone steps for a while. In addition, there is a very unique Starbucks located next to the stone steps, with a decoration style reminiscent of Hong Kong ice rooms in the 1960s and 1970s. There are old-fashioned signs outside the windows, old-fashioned ceiling fans on the ceiling, and posters of old-fashioned ice rooms hanging on the walls. Moreover, the food provided in the store is a collision of Chinese and Western cultures, which is very distinctive. Full text 
