The Elephant Trunk Hill Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin, at the confluence of the Li River and Taohua River. It is named after a giant elephant with a long and comfortable nose, drinking the sweet springs of the Li River. In the Qing Dynasty, Lang Zhongshu of the Ministry of Works wrote in his book "Xiangshan Ji": "The uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the mountains, the uniqueness of the mountains in western Guangdong lies in the stones, and the relative image of the provincial capital is even more unique." Xiangbi Mountain, with its vivid image, is a typical representative of Guilin's landscape and was designated as the emblem of Guilin in 1995. In the 2014 CCTV Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Horse, Hungary's Attraction Dance Troupe showcased Elephant Trunk Hill in their creative dance "Symbolic China". The main attractions in the scenic area include Xiangshan Shuiyue, Puxian Pagoda, Sanhua Wine Cellar, Love Island, and Yunfeng Temple Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Exhibition Hall. Xiangshan Water Moon "is a great wonder of Xiangbi Mountain. In the Song Dynasty, a scholar from Jibei once wrote the poem" Harmony with Water Moon Cave Rhyme ":" There is a bright moon at the bottom of the water, and the moon floats on the water. The moon does not go away when the water flows, and the water still flows when the moon goes away. "If you can come here on a night when the moon is in the sky, the wonderful picture of the moon on the top, in the cave, and underwater will be presented to you. There are more than 50 precious cliff carvings in the cave, including Zhang Xiaoxiang's "Preface to the Poetry of Chaoyang Pavilion" from the Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda's "Inscription on Fushui Moon Cave", and Lu You's poetry. Following the winding rocks of Elephant Trunk Hill, one can see from afar a Puxian Pagoda built in the Ming Dynasty among the green trees. The pagoda is 13.6 meters high and has a history of more than 400 years. It is a solid brick pagoda in the style of a lama. To the north of the pagoda is a statue of a bodhisattva carved with blue stone lines. The upper end of the statue is inscribed with the six character mantra "Nanwu Samantabhadra Bodhisattva", hence the name Samantabhadra Pagoda. There is a record in Buddhist scriptures that the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is a six toothed white elephant. Therefore, the construction of the Samantabhadra Pagoda on the top of Mount Xiang truly confirms this statement in Buddhist scriptures. [Sanhua Wine Cellar] Elephant Trunk Mountain is a natural large wine cellar, with two-thirds of the mountain being hollow. It is warm in winter and cool in summer, with a year-round temperature of 19 degrees Celsius and humidity above 90%. Since the Song Dynasty, it has been used as an official cellar to store Sanhua wine. Sanhua liquor is colorless and transparent, with a fragrant and spicy taste. It draws on the essence of the Li River and the soul of the Li River, becoming a representative liquor of Chinese rice aroma and known as the "king of Chinese rice wine". Cellar wine was designated as a tribute to the imperial court as early as the Northern Song Dynasty and is one of the three treasures of Guilin. Up to now, nearly a thousand tons of wine have been stored in the cave. Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangbi Mountain Scenic Area, adjacent to the Li River, and is another scenic spot for distant observation of Xiangbi Mountain. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, making it a great place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name "Love Island". poiName: The Sun Pagoda And The Moon Pagoda
summary: The Sun Moon Twin Towers are two pagodas located in the center of Guilin's Shanhu Lake. The Sun Tower is a copper tower and the Moon Tower is a glass tower. The two towers are connected by a 10 meter long underwater tunnel at the bottom of the lake. Every night, the two towers emit two colors of gold and silver under the light, and the reflection in the lake is particularly beautiful. The Japanese tower is 41 meters high and has nine floors. Its entire body is decorated with pure copper, shining brilliantly. All components of the copper tower, such as the tower body, tile surface, raised corners, columns, beams, and ground, are completely decorated with copper murals. There is an elevator inside the tower for tourists to enjoy sightseeing, and on the first floor of the Sun Tower, there is a copper bell for praying for blessings, which can be struck to pray. At the same time, there are tea houses on the first and second floors where you can enjoy tea and the scenery. The Moon Tower is 35 meters high with seven floors and is a glass tower. It is connected to the Sun Tower through a underwater tunnel that is over 10 meters long. The carved and painted doors and windows on each floor of the Moon Tower symbolize different themes and are rich in traditional Chinese charm. In its underground palace, there is a large mural of Guilin's Ming Dynasty blue and white plum vases, and on the first floor of the lake, there is a "Tai Chi drum" that can be played to showcase its grandeur. The surroundings, interior walls, doors and windows of the twin towers are filled with colorful patterns, mainly in yellow, green, white, blue, and black. These murals mainly reflect the culture of northern Guangxi, with various flowers, plants, and 'Yao Wang seals' as the main patterns, reflecting the cultural characteristics of ethnic minorities pursuing exquisite living. If you are not planning to spend money to climb the tower and just want to see or take photos of this Guilin landmark, you can watch it along the coast of Shanhu Lake. The ideal time to watch is at night, when the lights of the twin towers will light up, one with golden yellow lights and the other with silver white lights. Full text 

shortFeatures: Reach the summit and gaze at the natural reclining Buddha.
summary:
Yao Mountain's main peak has an elevation of about 909.3 meters, with a relative height of about 760 meters, making it the highest peak in Guilin. It was originally an island in the ancient sea of Guilin and is the only earth mountain in the area. The terrain is undulating, with a majestic atmosphere. The mountain is covered in ancient pines and cypresses, creating a green expanse to the horizon.

Yao Mountain is famous for its ever-changing and colorful scenery throughout the four seasons. In spring, azaleas bloom, and peach blossoms are enchanting, competing in beauty with flowers carpeting the fields. In summer, the trees offer shade, and after summer rains, the sea of clouds over Yao Mountain is a unique sight in Guilin. It is also the only mountain in Guilin where you can observe a sea of clouds, which changes unpredictably and resembles the mythical Penglai. In autumn, the forests are dyed in layers of gold. In winter, the mountain is covered in snow, creating a silver sea that showcases the northern scenery. Therefore, “Yao Mountain Winter Snow” has become a famous sight in Guilin. The Ming dynasty's Yan Zhenzhi wrote in "Yao Mountain Winter Snow": "The north wind blows from the east, scattering distant snow, which falls on the peak of Yao Mountain, looking the most extraordinary." It is now said that “If you don’t reach the top of Yao Mountain, you won’t see the scenery of Guilin.”

The Yao Mountain Scenic Area features the richest karst landform types and the world’s largest natural reclining Buddha landscape. On the mountain, the Jade Milk Spring flows from the White Stone Cave, with crystal-clear water that flows year-round. You can drink from this heavenly spring to relieve the fatigue of your journey. On the way down, you can also take a slideway, weaving through the sea of flowers and forests, experiencing the thrill of flying close to the ground. Yao Mountain also houses the best-preserved Ming dynasty princely tombs in the country—the Jingjiang Prince Tombs, which are grand and magnificent. There are over 300 tombs in the Ming Jingjiang Prince Tomb complex, and the plum vases unearthed here are famous worldwide.

Xiangshan Temple is located at the foot of Xiangshan Mountain in the western corner of Quanzhou County, Guilin City, Guangxi. It was originally named "Jingtu Temple". It is known as the "Xingtang Xiansong". Xiangshan Temple was founded by the Tang Dynasty monk Wuliangshou Buddha in 756 AD. The four emperors of the Song Dynasty were enfeoffed five times in succession, and Emperor Huizong personally paid his respects; In the early Qing Dynasty, the famous painter Shi Tao lived in the temple as a monk for 21 years, and there were stone carved flower paintings left in the temple; Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty personally inscribed on the cliff the words' Longevity, Compassion, and Shadow '. There are also scenic spots such as Feilaishi, Xibo Spring, Miaoming Pagoda, Shoufo Hall, Yuantong Treasure Hall, and animal stone carvings in the release pond in the temple. At its peak, the temple had a building area of 18000 square meters. As one of the oldest Buddhist temples in Guangxi, Xiangshan Temple attracts numerous tourists from home and abroad to worship and visit, especially during the three major Buddhist festivals, which are crowded with people. The Miaoming Pagoda is located at the foot of Xiangshan Temple and was built during the Chunyou period of the Song Dynasty to bury the body of Quanzhen. At that time, the incense was very popular, and Emperor Huizong of the Northern Song Dynasty came to pay his respects when he visited Nanyue. Emperor Gaozong of the Southern Song Dynasty bestowed the name "Miaoming Pagoda", which is one of the oldest temple pagodas in Guangxi. Miaoming Tower is a seven level floating chart, 26 meters high, with a bottom diameter of 6.8 meters. Its unique structure is majestic and spectacular. It is eight sided on the outside and six sided on the inside, hollow, with curved walls and spiraling upwards. More than 20 inscriptions from various dynasties are inscribed internally; The top of the tower is gourd shaped, with dozens of copper bells hanging from it; The wind blows and the bell rings, joyfully stirring the void; Looking far from the railing, one can see the clear breeze, Yuhua Mountain, Sanjiang River, and the new appearance of the ancient city, which is refreshing and enjoyable. The Miaoming Pagoda, with its beautiful scenery, can be called an "art treasure trove". It has dozens of cliff carvings, poems, and Fanglan stone tablets from various dynasties, especially the stone carved orchids signed by the Qing Dynasty monk Shitao. Kangxi personally inscribed "Longevity, Compassion, and Yin" with the inscription "Miaoming Pagoda" by contemporary Quanzhou Wenqiao native Ren Chundao, shining brightly on the cliffs. After more than a thousand years of history, the Miaoming Pagoda still stands tall in southern Chu. Climbing the tower for sightseeing has become a great pleasure for both domestic and foreign tourists. The existing Buddhist cultural relics in Xiangshan Temple include various stone carvings, Guanyin statues, Miaoming Pagoda, etc; In addition, there is a famous natural heritage site called "Xiti Rock Spring". Longyan Cave is located in Dongguayuan, a branch of Yuechengling in Quanzhou County, Guangxi Province, 5 kilometers away from Quanzhou County. It was once one of the eight scenic spots in the city. There is a circular giant rock in Longyan Cave, which is carved in the middle and washed away by spring water, making a loud noise. The rock wall echoes like the sound of a dragon grinding, hence the name Longyan. Inside Longyan Cave, there are five stories of high-rise buildings (partially six stories), an auditorium, a restaurant, a square, and a power station, with a total construction area of 13000 square meters, using fully air-conditioned units. The hole is shaped like a horn mouth, like a giant dragon roaring loudly. The cave entrance slopes towards the sky, with a height of about 40 meters and a width of 30 meters. The cliffs are covered with stone curtains and waterfall curtains. poiName: Solitary Beauty Peak Prince City Scenic Area
summary: The Duxiu Peak Wangcheng Scenic Area can be traced back to over 600 years ago during the Hongwu period of the Ming Dynasty. It was once a fiefdom city built by Zhu Yuanzhang for his nephew Zhu Shouqian. Today, it is a national 5A level scenic spot in Guilin, and Duxiu Peak is its iconic attraction. The natural landscape and historical and cultural landscapes in the scenic area complement each other, making it a "city within a city's scenery" and a carrier of Guilin, a world-renowned historical and cultural city of mountains and waters. The famous saying "Guilin's scenery is the best in the world" originated from the stone wall of Duxiu Peak. It covers the three major historical and cultural systems of Guilin and is a typical representative of Guilin's history and culture. Walking into the scenic area is like entering the gate of Guilin's history and culture. Therefore, the famous saying "Guilin's scenery is the best in the world, and after reading all the royal cities, one knows Guilin" has been widely spread by the world. As early as the Southern and Northern Dynasties, the great literary scholar Yan Yanzhi began to write and recite poetry at the foot of Duxiu Peak, which opened up the literary style in the Lingnan region. During the Tang Dynasty, the first official university in Guangxi's history was established here. During the Song Dynasty, Wang Zhenggong engraved the timeless famous line "Guilin's landscape is the best in the world" on Duxiu Peak, which has become a representative advertising slogan for Guilin. During the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang's military advisor Liu Bowen was interested in the wind and water treasure land of Duxiu Peak, and later built the Jingjiang Palace. In the Qing Dynasty, the Jingjiang Palace was converted into the Guangxi Gongyuan, becoming a large imperial examination center in the southwest region. A total of 585 successful candidates and 4 top scorers emerged, with one top scorer being the "Three Yuan Ji". During the Republic of China period, Sun Yat sen launched the Northern Expedition and established the Jingjiang Palace as the main base for the expedition. In 1954, Guangxi Normal University moved in. Duxiu Peak · Wangcheng is not only a place of outstanding people and land, but also the political, economic, and cultural center of Guangxi throughout history. Duxiu Peak is located in the center of Guilin city. It stands tall and rises from the ground, making it the top of all the mountains in Guilin and the king of all the mountains. Climbing to the summit, one can overlook the entire city of Guilin, with a majestic atmosphere of "overlooking all the mountains", and is known as the "pillar of the southern sky". As early as the Southern Dynasties period, the great literary scholar Yan Yanzhi wrote a poem titled "Not as outstanding as the Duxiu Peak, between the E and E towns" to describe the magnificent momentum of Duxiu Peak. Jingjiang Wangfu is a well preserved site of feudal lords in China and a core tourist attraction within the Duxiu Peak Wangcheng Scenic Area. The Jingjiang Wangfu Museum, also known as the "Carrier Hall," was the place where ancient princes handled government affairs. Nowadays, the museum displays the history of Jingjiang Wangfu and the entire Guilin. Visitors can gain a deeper understanding through high-tech full range projection and 3D projection, and also experience ancient printing techniques firsthand at the "Wangfu Tuofang". On the cliff of Duxiu Peak, there are about 200 cliff carvings, all of which have been preserved throughout the ages. The famous ancient saying "Guilin's scenery is the best in the world" comes from here. A large number of precious Buddha statues and Tai Sui stone carvings, as well as the Five Blessings series that was featured in the 2017 CCTV Spring Festival Gala, all come from the cliff carvings of Duxiu Peak and are now national key protected cultural relics. The Royal Palace Secret Topography has a history of over a hundred years and is a colorful wind water rubbing technique developed by the third generation Prince Jingjiang Zhu Zuojing. It has now been listed as an intangible cultural heritage. Tourists can experience ancient printing techniques here and learn how to make secret rubbings for the royal palace, which has important value for the inheritance and development of Chinese history, culture, and folk art. shortFeatures: A thousand-year-old town with numerous historical sites
summary:
Daxu Ancient Town is one of the "Four Great Market Towns" in ancient Guangxi, founded in 200 AD. The old Daxu Street is narrow, with smooth flagstone pavement beneath your feet. The old houses on both sides are mostly two-story buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties, made of blue bricks and tiles. Many ancient workshops, such as bamboo weaving, straw sandal workshops, herbal medicine clinics, and old barbershops, are still preserved, and the historical changes can be seen everywhere. The ancient town is very quiet, with mostly elderly people and children remaining in the old houses, adding to its peaceful and untouched atmosphere.

When visiting Daxu, the Wanshou Bridge is a must-see. The bridge, built during the Ming Dynasty, has a stone surface that has been polished smooth and shiny over time. To the west of the bridge is the Li River, offering a great view of both the river and the opposite Luosishan Mountain. In the evening, one can sit by the river, enjoy the cool breeze, and eat fresh river fish — simple and natural.

Daxu Ancient Town has not yet been fully commercialized. Those who appreciate ancient charm should visit, and it is recommended to combine it with a trip to Crown Cave and Gudong Waterfall.

Dongli Ancient Village Scenic Area (also known as Lishui Renjia) is located on the banks of Chaotian River in Dawei Town, Lingchuan County, only 19 kilometers away from the city center of Guilin. This is not only a vibrant traditional cultural and artistic village of the Li River, but also a luxurious rural living complex that can provide immersive cultural experiences. Taking traditional Chinese culture and Eastern aesthetics as the main thread, we are committed to rural revitalization. Over the past decade, we have outlined a poetry and wine life like a paradise on earth, presenting a return to simplicity and authenticity of "seeing mountains, seeing water, and remembering nostalgia". 【 Inheritance and Creation 】 Folk handicrafts, like blood vessels, have mostly evolved into a family inheritance work in the long river of history, passed down from father to son, and from son to son The handicraft workshops and craftsmen in Dongli Ancient Village are all related to ordinary life. At first, they may just be for livelihood, but over time, these survival skills are overlaid with layers of emotions and cultural meanings, becoming a unique cultural landscape. Unique handicrafts, accompanied by the atmosphere of history and the warmth of handmade crafts, have been passed down from generation to generation here, never stopping. Nature is the first textbook and an interesting teacher, and Dongli Ancient Village is an extremely suitable classroom for nature education. The joyful chirping of birds and insects in the mountains and forests, and the swaying of fish and shrimp in the rivers, allow children to break free from the siege of electronic products, return to nature, integrate into nature, and release innocent feelings that are different from the natural aesthetics of the city. The traditional architecture of Dongli Ancient Village, with its green bricks and tiles, was reconstructed after a detailed investigation and careful study of the cultural history, architectural forms, and living conditions of key villages in the Guilin area, especially the ancient commercial roads of Hunan and Guangxi and the ancient villages along the Li River. Whether it's bricks, tiles, doors and windows, or upturned eaves and horsehead walls, every word, painting, carving, and moment inside the house reflects the exquisite craftsmanship of the craftsmen. Every building can be traced back and is full of stories. Mountains are spiritual because of water, and people live because of water. The mountains and rivers make tourists drunk, and even poems are imprinted in the liver and intestines. Delicious food is often the result of the nurturing of green mountains and clear waters. Where there is soil and water, there are local products. Dongli Ancient Village has always followed the traditional farming concept of "not eating from time to time", obtaining fresh seasonal ingredients on site. The local delicacies made by experienced foodies are endless and delicious. The homestay in Dongli Ancient Village has been renovated from an old building from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Every brick, tile, and wood has its origins, which can be found in various ancient villages in northern Guangxi. The homestays in Dongli Ancient Village include the essence of all the ancient buildings in northern Guangxi around, such as the Deyue Tower in Liugong Village, Yangshuo, the Hongyin Bridge in Quanzhou, the Qin Family Courtyard in Xing'an, and the representative residential buildings in 12 counties and districts of Guilin, such as Lingchuan, Guanyang, Pingle, etc. Compared to those single homestays, the bricks, tiles, plants, and trees here are full of deep affection. The old furniture, objects, and utensils, coupled with modern hardware facilities, allow guests to experience the intangible cultural heritage and authentic scenery of northern Guangxi while staying, providing a unique humanistic experience. summary: The Gudong Waterfall Scenic Area attracts tourists' attention with its unique natural scenery. The waterfall presents a dual charm of strip-shaped and blocky forms. The strip-shaped waterfall dances lightly in the wind, with soft and graceful lines. In places with large drops, it is like a silver spear breaking through the air, showing the interweaving of strength and softness. The color hierarchy of the waterfall is distinct, with alternating shades of blue, white, and brown. The block shaped waterfall is smooth as new, with a blend of blue and white, making people feel as if they can see the fusion of water and stone, creating a leisurely atmosphere. Standing in the forest area, towering ancient trees and red maple trees stand out among the lush greenery, as if they are the color palette of nature. The ancient vines entwine the ancient trees, and the stream flows gently, adding endless wildness. The air here is fresh, filled with fragrant flowers and bird songs, like a natural oxygen bar, making people feel relaxed and happy. As a natural park near Guilin city, the Gudong Waterfall Scenic Area has vast land and unique waterfall landscapes. The blending of mountains and waters here, with ancient towns, countryside, and forests intertwined, provides tourists with a perfect destination that combines exploration, sightseeing, and leisure. Whether it's climbing high and looking into the distance, or exploring the depths, this is the perfect choice, making people linger and forget to leave.

Guilin Le Man Di Golf Course is an American hilly course with a total area of 2400 acres and 36 holes, divided into A, B, C, and D courses. The overall planning of the stadium conforms to the building principles stipulated by the USGA in the United States, and is specially tailored to the beautiful scenery of Guilin's mountains and waters. The shape of the golf course is also designed by American golf course expert David, who was hired at a high cost to showcase the magnificent scenery of northern Guilin's mountains and waters. Le Man Di Golf Course has been built over ten years, leaning against the curves of Linghu Lake and merging with distant mountains. For a player, this stadium has an irresistible appeal, which is to challenge the limits of pressure. What constantly challenges players is its unpredictable changes, perhaps narrow and deep lanes, or worrying sand pits and ponds, which require players to readjust on the next hole after conquering one hole. However, they later realize that this is not without organization and admire the compatibility of the course with mountains, peaks, rivers, and water. Field A is a hilly golf course dominated by mountain scenery, surrounded by mountains on all sides and featuring carefully selected flowers, grass, trees, and artificial lakes, providing a swing environment for players; The B field features a valley shaped golf course with lake views as the main feature. The golf lanes are designed along the natural lake shore, with abundant water obstacles, providing players with a challenging swing space. The new C field adheres to the hilly style of the stadium, cleverly utilizing natural landscapes such as terrain and mountain views, integrating flowing water, waterfalls, small bridges, and characteristic plants, creating a natural scenery. The entire stadium has a magnificent landscape, a wide view, and a panoramic view of lakes and mountains. It is one of the best golf courses in Guangxi and even the western region. summary: Rongshan Lake Scenic Area is located in the center of Guilin City. It is a Lianxin Lake connected by water bodies. shortFeatures: Dongcheng Tower of Guizhou City in Tang Dynasty
summary: Between Jiefang Bridge and Fubo Mountain in the northern section of Binjiang Road in today's urban area. Founded in the Tang Dynasty, it is the Dongcheng Building of Guizhou City in the Tang Dynasty, with a stone tablet of "Xiaoyao Building" written by Yan Zhenqing. Yan Zhenqing (709-785), whose courtesy name is Qing Chen, was a native of Xi'an, Shaanxi Province today. He was a scholar in the Kaiyuan period of Tang Dynasty. He once worked as the censor in the palace, the prefect of Pingyuan (now Shandong Province), and then became the prince Taishi and the duke of Lu County. He was known as "Yan Lugong" in the world. His calligraphy is dignified, vigorous and powerful, and original, which is called "Yan Ti". Yan Zhenqing has never been to Guilin. According to legend, this tablet was re-engraved according to the hook copy of the tablet in Puzhou (now Yongji, Shanxi). Because it is located in Dongcheng Building, this building is called "Xiaoyao Building". The first year of Chongning in Song Dynasty (1102). Guangnan West Road was reassured by Cheng Jie to rebuild the building and renamed it "Xiangnan Building". The "Records of Xiangnan Building" on the stele yin of the existing "Xiaoyao Building" records the process of building repair and the reason for name change.

poiName: Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park
summary: The Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park Scenic Area is located within the Yalong Bay National Tourism Resort. The main filming locations for the movie "If You Are the One II" and the TV series "Dear, Loved" are in Sanya, Hainan. The park is positioned as an international coastal ecological sightseeing and ecological vacation forest park, and is praised by experts as a model of third-generation forest tourism products. The trees in the park are lush, and you can see the dense vines and gurgling streams. You can also encounter the century old vines and towering banyan trees, and hear insects singing and birds singing, which is extremely wild. Shu Qi, Ge You, Yang Zi, and Li Xian walked across the "Crossing the River Dragon Rope Bridge" known as the Lover's Bridge, the "Cliff Sky Pool" at the edge of the cliff, the trial room in "If You Are the One II" witnessing romantic love, and the internet famous glass wharf are all must visit check-in spots for couples. Strolling along Tianjie, enjoying the slow life of Tianjie at 18 ° N latitude, walking on the panoramic sea view glass bridge, taking in the beautiful scenery of Yalong Bay, facing the sea, backed by green mountains, and blooming all year round. The panoramic sea view glass wharf is located at the top of the Yalong Bay Tropical Paradise Forest Park, with a highest elevation of 450 meters. It is a panoramic sea view glass wharf. The glass wharf is built along the mountain, with a total length of 400 meters, composed of 130 tons of ultra white imported laminated glass. It includes attractions such as Lingkong Platform, Colorful Sky Ladder, Colorful Lotus Viewing Platform, Rainbow Road, Mountain Oath and Heart to Heart Connection. The road surface of the wharf is entirely paved with 3M * 3M large single transparent glass. Walking on the wharf, you can look up at the sky high and clear clouds, overlook the rainforest valley more than 100 meters deep below, and have a panoramic view of Yalong Bay in front. While feeling scared, you can also enjoy the joy of soaring in the sky. Rainforest Float, also known as the "forest float and water float roller coaster". The floating slide is made of high-strength tempered double-layer laminated glass, with a total length of 3100 meters and a drop of 280 meters, equivalent to a rapid slide down from a 93 story rooftop. The Feipiao has 28 bends throughout its journey, with a total length of 600 meters, including 17 C-shaped bends, 11 S-shaped bends, and multiple consecutive S-shaped major bends. Rainforest drifting is like a roller coaster floating on water, sometimes soaring over the top of the rainforest, sometimes crossing deep forests, sometimes overlooking beautiful mountains and seas, and sometimes exploring the wonders of the rainforest. On the winding trail that stretches for more than 1000 meters in the valley, vines are densely covered, streams are gurgling, and various orchids compete and bloom. Along the hiking trail in the valley, towering banyan trees, century old vines, wild bamboo shoots, and six wonders of the tropical rainforest can be seen everywhere. Walking in the rainforest, you can feel the refreshing coolness. Here, you can unload the hustle and bustle, cross the rainforest boardwalk, breathe fresh air, and enjoy the happy time of leisure. The filming location for the movie "If You Are the One II" and the TV drama "Dear, Loved" is "Crossing the Yangtze River Dragon Bridge". Walking on the cable-stayed bridge, looking up at the undulating mountains, overlooking the vast ocean, listening to the birds singing and smelling the fragrance of flowers, it feels like being in a fairyland of the sea and sky. shortFeatures: A village with vigorous ancient banyan trees and plain tiles
summary:
Rongjin Ancient Street is located in Rongjin Village, 25 kilometers southeast of Pingle County, and belongs to Zhangjia Town Administrative District. The tourism resources of Rongjin are mainly Lianli Ancient Banyan, Wall Ancient Banyan and Rongjin Ancient Street, which is a potential tourist area combining natural tourism resources with cultural tourism resources. Rongjin ancient banyan group is composed of 8 ancient banyan trees that are more than a thousand years old, especially Lianli ancient banyan trees in Beijiekou and the ancient banyan trees on the wall in Dongjiekou are the most distinctive and rare. Lianli ancient banyan trees are not only simple and vigorous, with lush branches and leaves. What's even more amazing is that its strong air roots resemble tree trunks. It is connected with branches and trunks to form a strange combination group with several arches (medium-sized cars can pass under the arches), which is eye-opening and full of praise. The ancient banyan tree on the wall of Dongjiekou is a banyan tree on the wall, which makes people admire that it is difficult to tell whether the wall or the banyan came first. Therefore, Lianli ancient banyan and ancient banyan on the wall are the most distinctive scenic spots in Rongjin tourism resources. At the same time, several large ponds facing the street in Rongjin are arranged along the street to form a combination of water bodies with great ornamental value, and Rongjin River and Shajiang River flow along the edge of the village. The graceful phoenix-tailed bamboo bushes and their reflections on both sides of the river are very charming. Coupled with the fields around the village, Rongjin tourist area is like an idyllic scenery in the south of the Yangtze River. Rongjin's cultural tourism resources are mainly concentrated in Rongjin Street, the main street of an ancient village with a length of about 200 meters and a width of about 5 meters, which has been relatively intact for nearly a thousand years and is full of the atmosphere of Nanxiang in China. All the streets are southern folk two-story houses with large wood and blue brick structures. Although they are dilapidated, the whole street is complete, with blue bricks and plain tiles and cornices, which shows the unique and simple architectural features of villages and towns in the south of the Yangtze River in China. Rongjin's economy is dominated by agriculture, with few industries, so it is basically pollution-free.

The Gongcheng Yao Museum has a total area of over 2000 square meters, displaying more than 1600 cultural relics, over 700 photographic materials, and more than 10 video materials. The incredibly powerful "Yao people crossbow", the colorful "colorful cloth", the Mo Yao people's "dyeing method", and the craftsmanship of using five colored velvet and mixed embroidery of flowers have all added brilliance to the colorful cultural treasure trove of our country. The Hunan Guild Hall is located on Taihe Street in Gongcheng County and is a key cultural relic protection unit in Guangxi. The guild hall was built in the 11th year of the Tongzhi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1872 AD), with funds raised by the Sanxiang Association during the prosperous period of waterway commerce. The land area is 184 square meters. Composed of a gatehouse, stage, main hall, and side rooms. The entrance of the guild hall has a stone carved couplet that reads: "The guest hall can stop at Qixi, Sanxiang, and Tonglian Zili. The layout of the entire guild hall is rigorous, with red walls and yellow tiles, lush greenery and flowing gold, and flying eaves connecting to the sky, which is magnificent. The decoration of the main hall is magnificent, with numerous murals and floral decorations. The front and rear eaves are intricately carved, and the painted eaves and walls are innovative. The theater stage in the museum stands in a convex shape, with an area of 105 square meters. The base is built with bluestone, and 36 shallow water tanks are buried at the bottom of the stage to enhance the sound effect. The stands can accommodate over 1000 people. There is also the "First Pot of Eight Guis" purple clay pot in the museum, as well as various tea arts and cultural performances. poiName: Guilin Qian Jia Dong Sceneic Area
summary: Qianjiadong Cultural and Tourism Resort is located in Guanyang County, Guilin City, northeastern Guangxi, spanning Guanyang Town and Xinxu Town in Guanyang County, with a planned area of 2500 acres. The resort is centered around the historical and traditional Chinese culture of the Yao ethnic group, known as the "birthplace of the Yao ethnic group in the world" Qianjiadong. It also features natural landscapes such as Qianjiadong, known as the "number one water cave in Asia," and Xiaolong Village, known as the "beautiful leisure countryside in China." The resort aims to create a comprehensive travel destination that combines cultural exhibitions, landscape tours, cultural tourism, health vacations, folk experiences, educational research, and performing arts exhibitions. Qianjiadong is the birthplace of the Yao ethnic group in the world and a period of prosperous life for the Yao people in history. It is said that Qianjiadong is a mountain basin with only one stone cave leading to the outside world. Since ancient times, 12 Yao people have worked hard and multiplied on this beautiful and rich land, developing into a thousand households and named it "Qianjiadong". Here, the four seasons are distinct, with green mountains and clear waters, making it a rare pure land. Relying on such superior resource conditions, Qianjiadong Cultural and Tourism Resort has created a cave tour that includes historical exploration of the Yao ethnic group - Qianjiadong; Panwang Ancient Village and Yao Family Style Street, full of Yao ethnic customs, as well as scenic spots such as Yaoshan Hunting Ground, Tongxin Forest, Yaowang Flying Rope, and Panwang Mountain Bath. The resort is equipped with Qianjiadong Resort Hotel, National Academy, Agricultural Culture Exhibition Hall, Yao Culture Exhibition Hall, Parent Child Farm, etc., which can provide tourists with various tourism services such as sightseeing, leisure, vacation, study, and performing arts. The Thousand Family Cave, the hometown of King Pan, and the Three Saints Cultural University, as a cultural holy land, health treasure, and tourist destination, the Thousand Family Cave Cultural Tourism Resort will unveil its mysterious veil to the world. Qianjia Cave, also known as the "Number One Water Cave in Asia", was once explored by a geological expedition team for seven days and seven nights without reaching its end. At present, the developed tourism length is about 4 kilometers, half of which is dry road and half is water road. It is the core attraction of Qianjiadong Cultural Tourism Resort, and the negative oxygen ion content of this cave is as high as 23000/cm ³. Qianjia Cave is different from other caves because it has undergone millions of years of changes and condensed thousands of years of development history of the Yao ethnic group. It is a themed cave that integrates natural scenery, geological science popularization, and Yao ethnic history and culture, and is a flowing epic of the Yao ethnic group. The attractions included in Qianjiadong include: the cultural corridor of the 12 surnames of the Yao ethnic group, the statue of King Pan, the time tunnel, the Hall of King Pan, the Xu Yuan Pool, the dreamlike secret realm, the view of the Yao Mountain fire, the candlelight shining on the Yao Mountain, the Yao people listening to the road, the thousand reminders, the Yao children's paradise, the Eight Trigrams Lotus Pile, the Millennium Yao Village, the Yao Mountain terraces, the floating bridge, the dock, the statue playing in the water, the cloud sea and starry sky, the cool breeze cave, the firefly starry sky, the dragon escorting guests, the ancient jungle, the dock corridor, and the boardwalk. This is a place with many tourist attractions in the entire scenic. At Qianjiadong, in addition to experiencing the amazing craftsmanship of nature, you can also listen to the touching historical stories of the Yao ethnic group and learn about their great and arduous history of change over thousands of years. According to the legend of Panwang Ancient Village, Panwang transformed into the Dragon Dog Stone and guarded the Panwang Palace day and night. If there is a natural disaster and the Dragon Dog Stone disappears, it will be the day when King Pan goes on a tour. He will visit the place where the Crown Prince lives, either giving away doctors and medicine, or leaving clothes and food. After a week of patrol, he transformed into a dragon dog and returned to the Panwang Cave. Yaojia Oil Tea House is a small house mainly used for making oil tea for tourists to taste. Its oil tea is a famous snack with Yaojia characteristics in Qianjiadong. Regarding the production of oil tea, the first step is to use tea leaves for making oil tea. Generally, tea leaves from century old tea trees in the mountains are collected; The production is also natural. After drying in the shade, it can be stored on the fire pit at home for a long time; While tapping the oil tea, adding old ginger and garlic from the mountains further enhances its health benefits. Pour the boiled oil tea into a bowl, and then add fried rice, soybeans, peanuts, etc. A bowl of oil tea will make you feel relaxed, gentle, full of saliva, and won't doze off all day. Oily tea is also very popular for guests. When guests arrive at home, young men and women get together and knock on the oil tea. Everyone does his or her job. Some people light fires, and some are responsible for cooking rice and soybeans, peanuts. They are very busy... Oil tea is not only good for health, but also can be used as breakfast.. Yaoshan Hunting Ground is an important place for Yao people to hunt. It has archery, electronic shooting range, hunting culture exhibition area, bonfire barbecue area, Panwang Feisuo, Panwang Ancient Road, observation deck, and RV campsite. The hunting activities of the Yao people are often accompanied by religious beliefs. The Yao people living in the mountains have a custom of worshiping nature. While they obtain prey, they also thank the gods for their gifts and the mountain gods who govern the mountains. When eating, serve a portion to the mountain god and sprinkle a glass of wine over it. Yao people used to use shotguns filled with gunpowder and iron sand for hunting. In ancient times, there were no guns, and only bows, crossbows, and other weapons were used (note: hunting rifles are strictly prohibited in Guanyang now). There were also some homemade tools, as well as traps and clamps for wild animals. Bring your hunting tools and come to the Yaoshan Hunting Ground. Regardless of whether there is a harvest or not, the important thing is to have the courage to hunt. Tongxin Forest includes millennium ginkgo trees, beautiful ancient forests, twin twin spring wells, academician Yuan Longping workstation, and health examination center. Walking into Tongxin Forest, I saw many different trees, including camphor trees, maple trees, and banyan trees, but most of them were ginkgo trees. The ginkgo trees here are all as thick as hugging each other, with two of them being nearly a thousand years old. According to local elders, these two ginkgo trees are one male and one female, and are the ancestors of this ginkgo forest. The Agricultural Culture Exhibition Hall is a cultural tradition formed by farmers in long-term agricultural production, serving agriculture and providing entertainment for farmers themselves. It runs through various aspects of farming, sowing, harvesting, and storage in the four seasons of spring, summer, autumn, and winter, and is a widely existing cultural type in China. Agricultural culture determines the characteristics of Han culture. The characteristics of the Qianjiadong Agricultural Culture Exhibition Hall are: firstly, it is "authentic". All the exhibits displayed in the exhibition hall are real utensils collected from the people and used by farmers in the past; The second is' ancient ', some of these exhibits have a history of hundreds of years. By observing these ancient utensils, one can imagine the scenes of people's labor and life at that time; The third is "completeness". These exhibits cover everything from farming, irrigation, harvesting to storage, from food, weaving, yarn washing to baby care, from carpenters, bricklayers to weavers, from men, women, and children to all kinds of products. summary: Haikou Guanlan Lake Huayi Feng Xiaogang Film Commune is a unique Chinese film themed tourist destination created by Guanlan Lake Group in collaboration with Huayi Brothers and renowned director Feng Xiaogang. The Film Commune includes six independent scenic spots: 1942 Fanghua Scenic Area, Nanyang Scenic Area, Old Beijing Scenic Area, Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area, and Yingren Xingguang Avenue. In each district where film scenes are gathered, there are also unforgettable film scenes with different brands and characteristics of catering, entertainment, shopping, cinemas, cafes, bars, boutique hotels... With a strong nostalgic atmosphere, the tourism and business districts that convert day and night, the whole project integrates architectural tourism, film tourism, and business tourism, and fully demonstrates the Chinese urban street customs and the evolution history of urban street buildings that have changed in different time and space in the last century. 1942 · Fanghua Scenic Area, based on the scenes in the movies "1942" and "Fanghua", makes the world on the screen accessible. The 1942 scenic area features the streets of Chongqing in the movie "1942" as its blue color. The 91 buildings combine the typical architectural styles of the four major cities in the Yangtze River Basin from the 1920s to the 1940s, namely Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, and Chongqing. Among them, 25 buildings are completely restored from old photos, including the Xishan Bell Tower, Chongqing Guotai Theater, Shanghai Rongguangda Theater, and so on. Behind each building, there is a passing story that evokes memories and reminiscence. Fanghua Scenic Area is a movie set area specially planned and constructed for the 2017 Chinese New Year movie "Fanghua". 80% of the scenes in the movie are taken from here. The scenic area is equipped with screen walls, basketball courts, rehearsal halls and practice rooms, swimming pools, changing rooms, prop rooms, military supply warehouses, etc. In order to ensure the accurate restoration of the historical background of the scene, the scenic area strictly follows the authentic display of the 1970s Chinese style and era characteristics from design to construction and furnishings, from the ubiquitous red slogans in the scenic area to even a tile in the swimming pool, making people feel like they are there. The Nanyang Scenic Area is located on a water bank over 300 meters long, featuring 70 Nanyang style buildings that blend Chinese and foreign architectural styles. Among them, the contemporary memorial archway, wharf, bell tower, small bridge and other Nanyang architectural clusters are very interesting. Nanyang Street fully highlights the "the Belt and Road" and Hainan's regional characteristics. It not only truly restores the architecture and streets of Nanyang style, but also presents the business customs of Nanyang market, such as martial arts schools, pawnshops, western-style clothing shops, medicine shops, herbal tea shops, cake houses, etc. At the same time, all-weather performances enable tourists to experience three-dimensional and diversified cultural tourism experience, and fully reproduce the grand occasion and prosperity of "going to Nanyang", one of the three major migrations in Chinese history. The old Beijing scenic spot gathers the essence of the old Beijing style architecture cluster, and truly restores the historical charm of the old Beijing city from the founding of New China to the 1970s. The tall bell and drum towers, the ancient buildings of the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the magnificent Soviet style buildings reflect the grand, dignified, and simple architectural aesthetic style, more authentically reflect the cultural connotation of old Beijing, especially the elements of Beijing Hutong in the movie "Old Guns", which shows the full Beijing flavor. The Beautiful Countryside Shishan Village Scenic Area features a distinctive architectural complex of Shishan villages in the Haikou volcanic area, relying on natural volcanic craters and centered around lighthouses to create a beautiful countryside in Haikou. The scenic area is based on the concept of immersive experience, and has built traditional handicraft scenes such as sugarcane pressing, brown sugar boiling, and Li ethnic brocade making in Hainan into real scenes. It has also created a squirrel theater and animal farm for children, and the agricultural market at the exit sells local specialty agricultural products from Haikou, fully mobilizing the interest and participation of tourists. Based on the "Bird's Nest" from the movie "If You Are the One 2" and modified hotels and themed guesthouses imitating volcanic dwellings, the aim is to allow tourists to revisit the scenes in the movie and provide them with a unique accommodation experience. The Movie Star Avenue is located in the long corridor at the entrance of the Film Commune, consisting of handprints and signatures of top domestic film and television stars and directors. Thoroughly examining and drawing inspiration from Hollywood and Hong Kong's Avenue of Stars, a 1.2-meter-high ArtDeco style pedestal is crafted from a single piece of marble through manual cutting, carving, and polishing, making it convenient for tourists to take photos in front of their favorite celebrities' handprints. The first batch of 80 celebrity handprints and signatures were presented, and most of the celebrities and directors have personally visited the film company, including Feng Xiaogang, Ge You, Jackie Chan, Andy Lau, Xu Fan, Song Dandan, Yao Chen, Li Bingbing, Liao Fan, Duan Yihong, Tsui Hark, Guan Hu and other top domestic celebrities and directors. summary:

Haijian Nantian Stone is the earliest cliff carving in the Tianya Haijiao Tourist Area. The combination of stone and characters gives people a rustic and vigorous texture, as well as an eternal association of time and space. In the 53rd year of the Kangxi reign of the Qing Dynasty (1714), three imperial censors were ordered by Emperor Kangxi to inscribe the stone carving "Hai Jian Nan Tian" on the coast of Xiamaling. After verification and recognition, the three imperial censors were Miao Shou, Langzhong Chuo Er Dai, and French Jesuit Tang Shangxian. "Hai Jian Nan Tian" is a survey relic of the "Imperial Map" and a historical witness to the scientific and technological exchanges between China and France in the 18th century.

There is a pair of naturally intersecting rectangular boulders on the sea directly in front of the Tianya Haijiao Square, with the words "day" and "month" engraved on the top respectively. They were inscribed by Mr. Fan Jingyi, the former editor in chief of the People's Daily, hence the name "Sun Moon Stone". They are interdependent and never separated, so they are also known as the "love stone" and become a symbol of loyal love.

The Underground Fallen Stone Forest is located in Jiuxiang Scenic Area, formerly known as Bat Cave. It is named after the stalactites inside the cave that hang upside down from the top and resemble bats. The entire landscape seems to have freed itself from the influence of gravity and grown in a peculiar way, resembling a hanging stone forest from afar, hence its name. But why do the stalactites here bend? That's because the temperature difference inside and outside the cave creates different directions of wind, and in addition, these stalactites themselves have capillary straws that can transport water and form water droplets. When calcium carbonate is about to precipitate, it is blown away from the vertical direction by the wind, thus forming a state of lateral escape and oblique exit. The air in the cave where the underground rock fall forest is located is fresh and smooth, with a cool and pleasant temperature, as if equipped with natural air conditioning. Full text 

shortFeatures: Exquisite ancient painting art
summary: The famous "Lijiang Mural" is the product of the great opening of Naxi society in Ming Dynasty. Its painting lasted for more than 300 years from the early Ming Dynasty to the early Qing Dynasty. The late Ming and early Qing Dynasties were the heyday of Lijiang murals, which has a history of 500 years. During these long years, Lijiang has experienced the rule of more than ten generations of chieftains and officials. Among the chieftains and officials, there are enlightened people and fatuous people; There are those who flourish and those who decline; There are believers in Buddhism, believers in Taoism and Lamaism. With the preference of the rulers, various religions in Lijiang often have an alternate development process one after another, and temples in Lijiang often rise and fall, which directly affects the rise and fall of murals. In 1962, the investigation report of Yunnan Cultural Relics Task Force wrote as follows: "Lijiang murals were distributed in Wande Palace in Yangxi, Conversion Hall in Dayan Town, Hantan Temple, Dajue Palace in Shuhe, Mu's former residence in Yajiao Village, Fuguo Temple in Zhishan, Baisha Liuli Hall, Dabaoji Palace, Dharma Protection Hall, Dading Pavilion and Xuesong Temple in Xuesong Village." At that time, there were more than ten existing murals in Lijiang. The existing 55 murals are distributed in four temples, such as Dabaoji Palace, Liuli Hall, Dading Pavilion and Dajue Palace in Shuhe, which are religious buildings around the ancient city. Among them, the murals located in Dabaoji Palace in Baisha Village, five kilometers north of Dayan Ancient City, were announced by the state as the fourth batch of national key cultural relics protection units in 1996.

Impression of Lijiang "is divided into two parts:" Snow Mountain Chapter "and" Ancient City Chapter ", including six parts:" Ancient Road Horse Gang "," Duijiu Snow Mountain "," Heaven and Earth "," Jumping Song Group "," Encouragement and Sacrifice to Heaven ", and" Prayer Ceremony ". The "Snow Mountain Chapter" describes a dialogue with the mountains, depicting people coming from all directions to Lijiang to experience the close relationship between life and nature; The "Ancient City Chapter" tells the conversation with ancestors, in which it is discovered that there has always been a sacred kingdom deep in people's hearts throughout history. Zhiyun Temple is located in Lashi Township, Lijiang. It was first built during the Yongzheng period of the Qing Dynasty and was renovated during the Guangxu period. It is one of the five famous temples in Lijiang. The temple is very quiet and has a delicate appearance. There are two to three hundred year old trees such as mulberry trees, locust trees, ginkgo trees, cherry blossoms, etc. inside the temple, and the environment is very quiet and ancient. Zhiyun Temple has one large courtyard and five small courtyards. The courtyard is a two entry courtyard with a mountain gate, a Buddhist temple, a supporting hall, a monk's hall, a kitchen, a bathroom, etc. The Buddhist temple is rectangular in shape, with a triple eave pavilion style building and a square shaped diamond pointed pavilion in the center. It is clearly different from the tower style buildings in Tibetan areas, reflecting the characteristics of the fusion of Han, Tibetan, Bai, and Naxi architectural art. The ground floor is the Dharma Hall, and the upper two floors are the scripture storage buildings. Six towering 12 meter tall pillars stand tall among them, with twelve carved dragons and painted phoenixes at the southeast, northwest, and southeast corners, towering and magnificent, exuding an extraordinary aura.

summary: Four kilometers away from Yunjinghongcheng, its ancient name was Yunpa Scandium. It was the seat of the Dai Palace, the department of the former supreme ruler of Xishuangbanna, Zhao Pianling (meaning the owner of a land or the king of a local dynasty). Yunpa Scandium, also known as Xuanwei Street, is the seat of the capital of Jinglong Jindian Kingdom (also known as Mengli Kingdom), which flourished in the history of Xishuangbanna. According to historical records, Xishuangbanna area was under the jurisdiction of Dali during the Song Dynasty. At that time, there were many tribes called "gang" in Dai language in Xishuangbanna. Tribal leaders fought for territory with each other, fighting constantly, and the people had no peace. Therefore, Dali issued a list to recruit talented warriors to quell tribal disputes, and rewarded them with being the king of one party. The leader of Mengjingzhen (now Jingzhen, Mengzhe Township, Menghai County), who has high martial arts skills and extraordinary intelligence, Payazhen (meaning the leader with superior martial arts skills) volunteered to reveal the list. Methods of appeasement, conquest by force and annexation were adopted to quell tribal disputes and make tribes form alliances. Payazhen unified the backward ministries and was made a general by Emperor Xiaozong of the Song Dynasty. Later, it approved the establishment of Jinglong Golden Palace Kingdom (Mengle Kingdom). The emperor of the Song Dynasty gave Hutou Jinying ceremonial weapons and costumes, and ordered him to be the king of one party. He was called the Supreme Buddha Lord of Jinglong Golden Palace Kingdom, also known as Zhaofa Long Mohan (meaning Golden Hat King). It is said that after Payazhen was sealed, the capital was first built in Jinglan (now Manjinglan, Jinghong Town, Jinghong City). Because Jinglan is located in the center of Pingba, the terrain is flat and open, and it is difficult to defend against the attack of foreign enemies, so the capital was moved to Yunpa Scandium, a treasure land surrounded by water on three sides, backed by green hills, which is difficult to attack and easy to defend, making Yunpa Scandium the center of Xishuangbanna ruled by feudal lords of past dynasties. There is a street about two kilometers long and 30 meters wide-Xuanwei Street (named after King Mengyu was named the messenger of consolation), where "Drinking Han" is located. There are eight villages nearby, including Mangangjing, Manlongdong, Mankongzhang, Manpassa, Manle, Manwa, Manga and Kongke. There are five Buddhist temples and some pagodas, including Walong, Wazhuangdong, Wazhangpei, Wazai and Wamanle. Horse racing, Xuanwei Street once had a prosperous period. Later, due to the flooding of the Lancang River, markets, lawns, roads and villages were destroyed, and Xuanwei Street went from prosperity to desolation. During the ten-year turmoil and "breaking the four old" period, the former "Jianhan" Dai Palace was destroyed, destroying hundreds of years of cultural relics and historic sites.

The Wenchang Pavilion is located at the Laodongmen Site in the urban area of Guiyang. It is a three story pagoda shaped building that was originally built in 1609 as a place to worship the Taoist deity Wenchang Emperor. Due to the fact that the corners of attic buildings in China are all even and equal, the Wenchang Pavilion, which has nine corners, has become unique and is also an ancient building on par with Jiaxiu Tower. Wenchang Pavilion is located on the broad and tall East Gate Moon City, with ancient and magnificent architecture. There are side halls on both sides of the attic, and the front is a study room connecting the side halls. The layout is in the shape of a quadrangle courtyard. There are 9 corrugated woods on the second and third floors of the pavilion, 9 corners on the roof, 54 columns, and 81 beams, all of which are multiples of 9. In ancient times, "9" usually represented high power and high rank, and the designer's ingenuity is evident. Although Wenchang Pavilion is no longer a place of Taoism but has become a local teahouse, this classic and unique ancient building is still worth visiting for tourists who love history and architecture.

The Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, located in the suburb of Xi'an, is the mausoleum of Ying Zheng, the first emperor in Chinese history. Among the mausoleums of Chinese emperors, it is famous for its grand scale. At present, the imperial tomb has not been excavated, and you can wander around the tomb to think of ancient times. The Imperial Mausoleum was built between 246 BC and 208 BC, lasting for 39 years. The imperial tomb embodies the ritual system of "treating death as if it were life", completely modeled after the layout of the Qin capital Xianyang at that time. It has two rammed earth city walls inside and outside, symbolizing the imperial and palace cities of the capital Xianyang. The tomb mound (also known as the Da Feng Tu Dui, the burial mound of Emperor Qin Shi Huang) is located in the southern part of the inner city, in the shape of a covered bucket, and is currently about 50 meters high. After more than two thousand years of vicissitudes, the main relic on the ground of the imperial tomb is only the towering tomb. At present, the scenic area outlines the outline of the city wall through planting vegetation belts, as well as prominent signs and tags, allowing tourists to understand the direction, scope, and location of the city wall in the past. Up to now, the underground palace of the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor has not been excavated due to the constraints of existing scientific and technological conditions. Legend has it that in the underground palace of the First Emperor, various precious stones are used as the sun, moon, and stars, gold and jade are used as mountains and rivers, mercury is used as rivers, lakes, and seas, and the South China Sea mermaids refine oil into lamps that will last for thousands of years. Tourists can also visit the Bai Xi Qi Pit (also known as 9901 Accompanying Burial Pit) located in the southeast and the Wen Guan Qi Pit (also known as 0006 Accompanying Burial Pit) on the southwest side of the Fengtu Pile inside the imperial tomb. The Baixi Qikeng is named after the various postures of the pottery figurines.

poiName: Bronze Chariot and Horse of Qinling
summary: Copper chariots and horses were discovered 20 meters west of the imperial tomb of Emperor Qin Shi Huang. These are two large painted bronze chariots and horses, one in front and one behind, placed in a wooden coffin. Although it was crushed by soil when unearthed, there were no major changes in its original position, and the components of the chariot and horse were basically complete. This is a bronze chariot and horse that was discovered early, large in size, and well preserved in the history of archaeology in China. Archaeologists have restored it and it was exhibited to the public in 1983. Copper chariots and horses were one of the burial objects of Emperor Qin Shi Huang, symbolizing a part of his royal carriage. The copper chariot and horse are made by reducing the proportion of half of the real copper chariot and horse. The car cover and the interior and exterior of the carriage are painted with exquisite patterns, and the gold and silver decorations on top weigh up to 14 kilograms. The No.1 copper chariot is a standing chariot, also known as a tall chariot. The carriage is rectangular in shape with a single shaft and two wheels. The doors are located at the back of the carriage, and there is a circular copper umbrella on the carriage. Under the umbrella stands the imperial official, who controls the carriage with both hands and drives four horses in front. The carriage was equipped with weapons such as copper crossbows, copper shields, and copper arrowheads, which played a role in opening roads, guarding, and launching expeditions in the emperor's convoy. The second car is an Anche and also has a single shaft and two wheels. The total weight is 1241 kilograms, assembled from 3462 components of different sizes. The carriage consists of two compartments, one front and one rear, with windows between them. The door for boarding is located at the back and has an oval shaped hood. It is a precious bronze artifact unearthed in China, with complete equipment, high grade, and exquisite craftsmanship.

The civil figurine pit is part of the Terra Cotta Warriors Museum in Xi'an, which is located on the east side of the the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor. Here, a large number of terracotta warriors are displayed, representing the image of civil officials during the Qin Dynasty, including officials, scholars, etc., reflecting the political and cultural life of the Qin Dynasty.

The Tang Yutang Site, also known as the Tang Huaqing Palace Yutang Site Museum, is one of the main attractions in the Huaqing Pool Scenic Area. The site was discovered in 1982 and is located in the northern part of Huaqing Pool, backed by Lishan Mountain and facing Huaqing Pool. It is a hilly area that overlooks the scenery of Huaqing Pool and basks in the purple sunshine. At that time, archaeologists cleared up five groups of royal bathing pool sites of the Tang Dynasty, including Xingchen Tang, Lianhua Tang, Begonia Tang, Prince Tang and Shangshi Tang; In addition, there are more than 3000 pieces of bathing pool palace foundations, stone walls, palace plinths, lotus square bricks, round ceramic water pipes and other building materials, which is the only group of bathing pool found in China for royal use. Entering the ruins area, one is greeted by the enchanting Guifei Pool, commonly known as Haitang Tang. Here, a square shaped protective building with a spire shaped like Xi'an Bell Tower has been built. Haitang Tang was first built in 747 AD by Emperor Xuanzong of Tang specifically for Yang Guifei. The pool wall is entirely made of bluestone and is a two-story tabletop structure. There are special long stones in the pool prepared for Yang Guifei's bath, engraved with the character "Yang". To the east of the Noble Consort Pool is the imperial soup exclusively used by Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, also known as Lotus Soup. There is a double lotus base inside, symbolizing the desire to be a connected branch on the ground and to forever be a lotus with parallel stems.

Lotus Soup is specially for Li Longji, Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty. Covering an area of 400 square meters, it is a dual-use bathing pool that can be bathed and bathed. There are double row foundations around the pond shore, and it is said that these double holes, double seats, and double rows have the meaning of lotus flowers, which is in line with the oath of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Yang Guifei to "be a pair of winged birds in heaven and a pair of connected branches on earth".

shortFeatures: Yang Guifei's special soup pool
summary: Haitang Tang is Yang Guifei's special soup pool, which is named after a blooming begonia flower on the plane of the soup pool. The soup pool is wide from east to west and narrow from north to south. The top and bottom are divided into two floors, and 16 coupon stones form a blooming "begonia flower". Tangchi is about 5 meters long from east to west and 2.9 meters wide from north to south.

Xingchen Tang is a soup pool for Emperor Taizong Li Shimin of the Tang Dynasty and several later emperors to bathe. It is the oldest pool among the five groups of soup pools unearthed, more than 100 years earlier than the imperial concubine pool. It is said that there is no shelter above and around the original site. At that time, bathing was in the naturally formed soup lake. Generally, bathing at night can look up at the stars in the sky, so it is called "Star Soup". There is an ancient source of hot springs behind Xingchen Soup, so Xingchen Soup is the closest to the water source, with the best water quality, the largest water flow and no pipeline, and the water directly flows into the soup pool.

"Shangshi Soup" is a bathing place awarded by Emperor Xuanzong to officials of Shangshi Bureau, and other internal officials can also take a bath. I feel honored to be able to bathe here and bathe in the grace of the emperor. The technology of soup pool is simple. It is divided into two pools, east and west, by a stone beam, and there is no peculiar shape. There are three groups of lower pool steps in the pool, indicating that there are many people bathing here. There is a row of holes at the bottom of the pool, which are said to be used for rubbing toes. The steps in the soup pool are also exquisite, saying that the bigger the official, the fewer steps there are.

The Tang Pear Garden Site is located in the Huaqing Pool Scenic Area. It was first built in the 11th year of the Kaiyuan era (723 AD) and is currently one of the excavated Tang Pear Garden sites, also known as Suijia Pear Garden. It has now been converted into the Tang Pear Garden Site Museum. The Pear Garden Site Museum is the first national museum dedicated to pear garden culture. The museum consists of five parts: Xiaotang Site, Pear Garden Model, Pear Garden Cultural Relics, Pear Garden Music and Dance, and Pear Garden Ancestor. It systematically displays 85 precious cultural relics and 15 music and dance murals unearthed from the Pear Garden Site.

Lishan is located in Lintong District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Huaqing Pool. Now the two attractions have been merged. Lishan has lush trees and has been a popular tourist destination since ancient times. The mountain is divided into East and West Xiuling, and West Xiuling is home to most of the scenic spots in Lishan, including the "Beacon Tower" for playing with feudal lords and the "Military Advice Pavilion" for the Xi'an Incident. Lishan Mountain is not high. After entering the scenic area through the east gate (Zhaoyang Gate), it takes more than an hour to walk to the highest scenic spot on the mountain, the "Beacon Tower". There is a cableway near the entrance (for an additional fee), and the cableway station is the "Old Mother Hall". However, most tourists walk up the mountain to experience the fun of climbing through the forest. Lishan is divided into two areas: East and West Xiuling. West Xiuling is home to most of Lishan's attractions, including the Beacon Tower, Changsheng Hall Ruins, Evening Light Pavilion, Laomu Hall, Laojun Hall, Bingjian Pavilion, and Sanyuan Cave. The Bingjian Pavilion (formerly known as the "Capturing Jiang Pavilion") and the Old Mother Hall enshrine the "Old Mother of Lishan" (also known as the "Goddess N ü wa"), who is said to have once refined stones and repaired the sky in Lishan; The historical allusion of King You's "beacon fire plays with the lords" happened on the beacon tower at the mountaintop. After passing the beacon tower, head east to Dongxiu Ridge, where the main attractions include "Shiweng Temple" and Yuxian Bridge. It is said that both the temple and the bridge were built in the Tang Dynasty. At the foot of Mount Li is the famous' Huaqing Pool '. Under the sunset in the evening, overlooking Huaqing Pool and the entire Lintong from the "Evening Light Pavilion" on the mountain, is one of the famous scenic spots in Guanzhong, known as "Lishan Evening Light". It takes about 40 minutes to take the "Youwu" shuttle bus from the foot of Lishan Mountain to the Terra Cotta Warriors. Full text 

shortFeatures: Stone pavilion commemorating the revolution
summary:
Bingjian Pavilion is located next to the tabby stone in Xixiuling halfway up Lishan Mountain. Chiang Kai-shek's hiding place is famous for the "Xi'an Incident". 
· In order to commemorate the "Xi'an Incident", initiated by Hu Zongnan in 1946, all the non-commissioned officers of the Seventh Branch of Whampoa Military Academy raised money to build a stone pavilion, named "Zhengqi Pavilion". After the founding of New China, it was renamed "Chiang-shek Pavilion", and it was only changed to "Soldier Remonstrance Pavilion" in 1980s. 
The stone pavilion is 4 meters high and 2.5 meters wide. It seems inconspicuous, but it has a different meaning because it is closely related to major events in Chinese history.

shortFeatures: Nuwa Palace on the second peak of Lishan Mountain
summary:
Laomu Hall has been a famous Taoist temple on Lishan since ancient times. Laomu Lishan is an ancient god worshipped by our Taoism. 
According to the existing Monument of Chuangxiu Mountain Road in the temple, it was built in Qin Dynasty. Including the mountain gate, the Sanxian Hall, the sacrificial hall, the main hall, the wing room and other buildings. The main hall is dedicated to the golden statue of Lishan Mother (Nuwa). 
There are still an iron pot and an iron cylinder cast in the 16th year of Wanli in the Ming Dynasty in the Laomu Hall, and an iron chime cast in the Ming Dynasty in front of the statue of the Laomu. The main hall contains the Monument of Teaching Sutras by the Mother of Lishan, which was erected in the first year of Guangde of Tang Dynasty, which describes the story of Li Quan, a famous Taoist priest in Tang Dynasty, who met his mother at the foot of Lishan Mountain and taught him Yin Fu Jing.

The Lishan Beacon Tower is located on Lishan Mountain in Lintong District, Xi'an City, Shaanxi Province, China. It was one of the important facilities used in ancient China to transmit military information. Lishan is famous for its beautiful natural scenery and rich historical and cultural relics, and the beacon tower is one of the symbols of Lishan's historical and cultural heritage.
opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

summary: Located in the new urban area of Xi'an City, the Centennial Museum of Yisu Society covers an area of more than 4000 square meters and has more than 10 exhibition halls. It focuses on the experience of opera culture, and shows the development history, social influence and artistic achievements of Qin Opera of Yisu Society for more than 100 years.

poiName: Qin Fengyun Shaanxi Opera Tea House
summary: Come to Shaanxi, take you back to old Shaanxi in an hour. Revisit the classics of time and appreciate the culture of Qin. Qinfeng Garden can accommodate a small theater of 130 people, where you can learn about the ancestors of the Hundred Plays, enjoy tea and opera, and enjoy the rich life of the Qin people. With respect and belief in the inheritance of traditional culture, we have carefully crafted a cultural feast for your trip to Shaanxi. Step into the ancient capital for thousands of years, appreciate the tune of the Great Qin Dynasty, enter the sacred land of pear gardens, and appreciate the beauty of hundreds of operas

shortFeatures: Named in memory of Dr. Sun Yat-sen
summary: Zhongshan Gate in Xi'an is a city gate on the east side of Xi'an City Wall. It was built by Feng Yuxiang in 1926. It was named Zhongshan Gate in memory of Dr. Sun Yat-sen, and it is commonly known as Xiaodongmen by the masses. The nearby streets are also generally known as Zhongshan Gate. Zhongshan Gate has two gates, north and south, the south gate is named Dongzheng Gate and the north gate is named Arc de Triomphe.

shortFeatures: The North Gate of Xi'an Ancient City Wall
summary: Anyuan Gate is the north gate of Xi'an City Wall. It was built when the city wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, and its official name was Anyuanmen. During the Revolution of 1911, the rebel army attacked Mancheng and the north gate tower was burned down.

shortFeatures: Enshrined with the statue of Kuixing
summary: Wenchang Gate, located on the south side of Xi'an Forest of Steles Museum, is one of the newly opened city gates after the founding of New China. This section of the city wall has a Kuixing Building, which houses the statue of Kuixing. It is the only facility on the Xi'an city wall that has nothing to do with military defense. Kuixing is one of the twenty-eight constellations in ancient Chinese astronomy. Folk myths and legends dominate the rise and fall of the literary movement. In the minds of Confucian scholars, Kuixing has a supreme position. In the Ming and Qing Dynasties, Xi'an Fuxue and Confucius Temple were built next to the city wall, where the Forest of Steles Museum is now located, so Kuixing Tower was also built on the city wall. It was restored when the city gate was opened in 1986. Here, visitors can see Kuixing Zunrong holding a vermilion pen in his right hand, an ink fog in his left hand, and stepping on the head of a big fish at his feet. Outside Wenchang Gate, you can go west along Shuncheng Lane to Ji Bei Zhenbei Memorial Park, which was built in 1986 to commemorate the 1250th anniversary of Ji Bei Zhenbei's introduction of Tang culture into Japan. In the garden, a monument to Ji Bei Zhenbei was built on the site of the former Tang Guozijian with a piece of natural granite that has not been chiseled.

Hanguang Gate is a city gate located west of the southern wall of the imperial city of Chang'an during the Sui and Tang dynasties. It was first built in the early Sui dynasty and has been closed during the Tang, Five Dynasties, Song, and Yuan dynasties. In the early Ming dynasty, it was enclosed within the expanded city wall. Hanguangmen was an important passage in the eastern starting city during the heyday of the Silk Road from the 6th to the 10th century AD, and is known as the "starting point of Silk Road diplomacy". The Xi'an city wall has a total of 18 gates, while the southern city wall has 7 gates from west to east. The Hanguang Gate is one gate located to the west of the city wall. Hanguangmen has a history of 1400 years. The reason why it is called "Han Guang" comes from the meaning of "Kun is thick and carries things, virtue is boundless. Han is broad and bright, and the quality of things is excellent" in the "Yi Kun".

shortFeatures: Ocean Park with Regional Folk Customs
summary: Xi'an Huaxia Wenlv Ocean Park is a rare large-scale comprehensive ocean venue that integrates marine culture with local folk customs and vividly displays marine cultures from all over the world. It is a larger folk aquarium in China. Integrating regional folk customs into marine culture, the style of the whole venue takes the Maritime Silk Road as the main line, integrates rare marine life and animals on the earth, and integrates amusement viewing, scientific research and education, world fishing village culture and marine culture dissemination. The Ocean Park has five theme areas: Polar Whale and Dolphin, Dream Ocean, Sea Beast Show, Flying over the Silk Road Exploration and Happy Coast. It contains 15 distinctive cultural theme areas, and hundreds of craftsmen have created beautiful cultural theme scenes by hand, so that people can be there, travel all over the world, experience diverse marine cultures and return to the Maritime Silk Road.
