summary: The Dream Aquarium gathers marine animals and plants from all over the world, creating eight distinctive themes including the Yellow River Culture Zone, Jiaodong Fishing Village Zone, Quanzhou Ancient Fishing Village Zone, Haikou Dan Ethnic Fishing Village Zone, Java Island Fishing Village Zone in Indonesia, Buryatia District in Russia, Red Sea Arab Fishing Village Zone, and Venice Folk Customs Zone. It greatly restores the authentic marine fishing village cultural scenes of the local area and allows visitors to appreciate the unique and beautiful seaside scenery. The clever interweaving of themed cultural areas and underwater animal displays will allow visitors to explore mysterious and unpredictable marine creatures while experiencing unique folk cultures from around the world firsthand.

The permanent exhibition of Shaanxi Archaeological Museum is themed "Huazhang Shaanxi, the Holy Land of Archaeology", and is divided into four chapters: "Archaeological Process", "Cultural Genealogy", "Archaeological Discoveries", and "Cultural Protection Technology".

poiName: Pit No. 2 of Qin Terracotta Warriors Relics Hall
shortFeatures: There are more than a thousand well-preserved pottery figurines
summary: The scenic spot is the burial pit of Emperor Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum. In April, 1976, about 20 meters north of the east end of No.1 pit, the No.2 Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit was discovered. The plane of the No.2 terracotta pit is curved. From the trial excavation, it can be inferred that more than 1,300 pottery figurines and horses are buried in the No.2 terracotta pit. Compared with No.1 pit, No.2 pit is richer in content and more complete in arms, which is the essence of Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit.

The Datang Furong Garden, a national 5A scenic spot, is located in Qujiang New District in the south of Xi'an City, facing the Big Wild Goose Pagoda from afar. It covers an area of 998 acres, including 300 acres of water area, 440 acres of green space, and a building area of nearly 100000 square meters. Mr. Zhang Jinqiu, an academician of the CAE Member, is responsible for the overall planning and architectural design of the park, and Mr. Akiyama, a Japanese landscape master, is responsible for the landscape design. It is a large-scale cultural theme heritage park that comprehensively displays the style and features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Since its official opening to the public on April 11, 2005 (the third day of the third lunar month), we have been committed to creating high-quality and high standard branded tourist attractions. The Tang Dynasty Furong Garden aims to build a "historical garden, spiritual garden, natural garden, humanistic garden, and artistic garden". It has specially invited an expert group composed of more than ten Tang history, Tang poetry, Tang painting, Tang architecture experts, doctoral supervisors, researchers, and tourism experts from the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society to re explore and organize the historical and cultural content of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. The entire garden landscape has been re planned and positioned, divided into imperial culture area, female culture area, poetry culture area, imperial examination culture area, tea culture area, song and dance culture area, drinking culture area, folk culture area, diplomatic culture area, Buddhist culture area, Taoist culture area, children's play area, gate landscape culture area, water show performance area. Fourteen scenic cultural areas, including the district, fully reproduce the splendid civilization of the Tang Dynasty's prosperous era. There are more than 20 scenic spots in the garden, including Ziyun Tower, Lady Hall, Luyu Tea House, Apricot Garden, Caixia Corridor, Qujiang River Streaming Drinks, Beauty Walk, Tang Poetry Gorge, and Juyu Terrace, which collectively display the splendid spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the splendid and unparalleled culture and art. It is known as a tourist resort "shocking countrymen people and surprising the world". The theme performance of the park is a large-scale water dance light and shadow show called "Chasing Dreams in the Great Tang Dynasty", taking a boat tour to reach the dreamlike holy land together; The large-scale multidimensional situational dance drama 'Dreaming Back to the Tang Dynasty' is grand and magnificent, as if it were a dream; The Tang Dynasty court Yan music "Drum" interprets the human intangible cultural heritage Dongcang drum music; And boutique cultural tourism event brands and projects such as the Spring Festival Gala, Shangsi Festival, Qujiang Flower Moon Banquet, etc. Daily free performances at various scenic spots are a warm invitation from the Tang Dynasty royal family to visitors, allowing them to experience the sacred and magnificent royal culture in a stunning way. As a theme park with excellent quality, personality, and rich cultural connotations, the Tang Dynasty Furong Park is also a cultural window for Xi'an to showcase Chang'an's ancient historical heritage and the prosperous era of the Tang Dynasty to the world, and a cultural gateway to attract the world to understand China

The Xi'an Stele Forest Museum is located near Wenchang Gate. The museum consists of stele forests, stone carving art, and other parts. The stele forest, which is composed of steles and epitaphs from various dynasties, is the highlight of the museum. It includes inscriptions by calligraphy masters such as Yan Zhenqing, Liu Gongquan, and Huai Su, as well as two Tang Dynasty steles, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing". Among the collected inscriptions, there are numerous exquisite works in the Beilin Museum, where you can enjoy inscriptions and epitaphs from various dynasties. The inscriptions and epitaphs collected here span over 2000 years. Among them, there are treasures such as Yan Zhenqing's "Yan Qinli Stele" and "Yan Family Temple Stele", which are standard "Yan style"; Liu Gongquan's "Da Da Master Xuanmi Pagoda Stele" is a typical representative work in the "Liu style"; The Tang Dynasty monk Huairen selected the "Preface to the Holy Teachings of the Three Treasures of the Tang Dynasty" from the ink left by King Xizhi of Jin; The famous cursive calligrapher Huai Su's "Thousand Character Classic" has a bold and unrestrained writing style. The "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing" are very popular. In addition to the stone carvings by calligraphers, the two stone inscriptions, "Shitai Xiaojing" and "Kaicheng Shijing", are also popular among tourists. The "Shitai Xiaojing" is a Confucian classic, and the inscriptions were written by two emperors in four different fonts. Specifically, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, wrote the inscriptions in clerical script, annotated them in small characters in regular script, and annotated them in running script on the side of the stele after it was carved. The inscription on this stele was written in seal script by Emperor Suzong of Tang, Li Heng. The Kaicheng Shijing was carved in the second year of the Kaicheng reign of Emperor Wenzong of Tang Dynasty (837 AD), consisting of twelve sutras including poetry, books, rituals, Yi, and Spring and Autumn Annals. When browsing at the Beilin Museum, you can also enjoy exquisite stone carvings such as the Four Gods Tomb Gate, the Six Horses of Tang Zhaoling, Confucius Meeting Laozi, and the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird in the "Stone Carving Art Museum" inside the museum. After playing, you can also purchase "stele stickers" that are printed with the original inscriptions, but the prices of these "stele stickers" here are not cheap, ranging from a few hundred yuan to a thousand yuan. If your requirements are not very high, you can purchase stele stickers on the Shuyuan Gate pedestrian street next to the Beilin Forest, which are relatively cheaper in price. Full text 

The Archaeological Exploration Center is located on the west side of Yudao Square in Daming Palace National Heritage Park. It was converted from a pharmaceutical factory warehouse and underwent functional replacement while maintaining its original appearance as much as possible. The exhibition area of the center is about 3500 square meters, and through the world's leading 2D and 3D media exhibition technology, visitors can personally experience the fun of cultural relic restoration. The entire center is divided into four indoor exhibition halls, an outdoor activity area, and a cinema. The first indoor exhibition hall mainly introduces daily necessities such as clothing, coins, and bronze mirrors. The second exhibition hall mainly simulates archaeological investigations, excavation scenes, and multimedia interactive archaeological games, allowing visitors to experience knowledge of archaeological exploration, investigation, and excavation. The third exhibition hall uses interactive games to allow visitors to understand the classification and methods of cultural relic restoration, and uses the Tang Dynasty's "Banquet Picture" as an example to simulate and demonstrate the living scenes of Tang people. The fourth exhibition hall is dedicated to cultural relic restoration and world cultural heritage, as well as a rubbing experience area. The outdoor activity area provides visitors with a place to learn about pottery and to personally participate in pottery making. Tourists can experience a magical journey through cultural heritage sites such as the Daming Palace in the air at the cinema.

Riding a bicycle on the ancient city wall is a great way of sightseeing, and while cycling, you will have a feeling of time travel. At present, there are bicycle rental services available in the east, south, west, and north gates, and bicycles can be returned at any of the above gates after cycling. Full text 

Jinli Ancient Street is a well-known commercial pedestrian street in Chengdu, consisting of a large number of antique style buildings in the late Qing Dynasty architectural style. It has numerous residential buildings, bars, and famous restaurants, including the famous attraction Wuhou Temple. Jinli Ancient Street is separated from Wuhou Temple by a wall, and tourists usually come here to take a stroll after visiting Wuhou Temple. It is filled with the unique hustle and bustle and casualness of Chengdu. In the ancient street, the blue tiles are arranged in a staggered manner, and the bluestone board road winds its way. On both sides of the street, there are many shops with local characteristics, such as handmade leather bags, colorful cloth lanterns, etc. There are also many old Chengdu craftsmen making sugar paintings and dough figurines. In addition, various kinds of food here will make you salivate. There are Zhangfei beef, tofu pudding, beef coke cake, Bobo chicken, etc., with different flavors. Jinli Ancient Street lights up with big red lanterns at night, and bars and tea houses are bustling with activity. One of the more famous ones is the Lotus Mansion Bar, where local singers come to sing every night. If you get tired of strolling, you can take a break here. Full text 

shortFeatures: Visit Du Fu's Former Residence and Experience the Cultural Sacred Site
summary: In the past, there was a small path in front of Du Fu's thatched cottage, lined with flowers and trees. He once wrote in his poem: "The flower path has never been swept for guests, the humble door is now opened for you." Today’s flower path is a red-walled alley connecting the Du Fu Thatched Cottage Memorial Hall and the original Caotang Temple. At the end of the flower path stands the "Caotang Screen Wall," where the characters "Caotang" were inlaid with blue-and-white porcelain shards by Zhou Shanpei, the Governor of Sichuan’s Quanye Dao during the late Qing Dynasty. These characters have been damaged and repaired several times. When Chairman Mao visited the cottage in 1958, he gazed at these two characters for a long time. As one of the symbols of the cottage, many visitors stop here to take photos as a memento.

The Sichuan opera performance with the "Shu style and elegant charm" in Chengdu is a shining pearl in the treasure trove of Chinese opera. It is a popular folk art among the people of southwestern provinces such as Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou. In terms of the vocal style of traditional Chinese opera, Sichuan opera is composed of four major vocal styles: Gaoqiang, Kunqiang, Huqin, and Qianqiang, as well as a local folk lantern opera. These five types, except for lantern opera, were introduced to Sichuan by opera troupes from other provinces from the late Ming Dynasty to the mid Qing Dynasty. Sichuan Opera is a shining pearl in the treasure trove of Chinese opera. The Sichuan style and elegant charm have once gathered many famous Sichuan Opera performers. In recent years, they have reunited with famous Sichuan Opera performers to jointly launch a nightly "Classic Opera, Folk Art Performance". Shufeng Yayun was founded in 1998, based in the Land of Abundance and facing both domestic and international markets, showcasing authentic Western Sichuan folk arts and classic operas in all aspects. It is a large-scale multi-functional pear garden destination that integrates traditional Chinese art performances, folk characteristic skill performances, and opera and drama supplies. "Sichuan Style and Elegant Charm", a Sichuan featured performance, integrates the essence of Bashu Quyi, covering the culture of the Three Kingdoms and Bashu folk stunts: Sichuan Opera, face changing, spitting fire, puppet, tea art, rolling lights, etc., which are unique in Sichuan culture. The charm of Shu has been passed down through the ages, and the elegance has been passed down for a hundred years. Shu style and elegant charm, located in the ancient architectural complex of Qingyang Palace on the ancient path of Qintai in Chengdu, Sichuan, China, adjacent to the ancient famous Qingyang Palace partition wall, with Du Fu Thatched Cottage and Wuhou Temple complementing each other from afar. The architecture of Shu style and elegant charm is ancient and rustic, with the generous and leisurely spirit of ancient Western Shu. It was once a century old pear garden with ups and downs. The Sichuan Opera Actors Guild Hall, which has been a gathering place for famous actors for a long time, is currently a folk pear orchard with deep roots in Sichuan. The elegant Sichuan style gongs, drums, zithers, and flutes show their elegance without a word. Playing, playing, and singing, the essence of Qupai comes at once. Life, dan, jing, mo, and ugliness all come on the stage. Kun, gao, hu, tan, and opera come one after another. Here, there are authentic Sichuan opera skills such as face changing, spitting fire, and dressing up, as well as famous lantern rolling and hand shadow plays in the prosperous era of China. There are also staff headed puppets that are exquisitely crafted, with drums and music playing together to create a soul stirring sound, and traditional melodies lingering in the background. One night, a thousand year experience of Western Shu culture - Shu style and elegance welcome you. Shufeng Yayun used to be a gathering place for famous Sichuan opera actors. In recent years, it has reunited with famous actors in Sichuan and launched a nightly "Classic Opera, Folk Art Performance". Not only did it gain fame, but it was also widely reported by media both domestically and internationally. In the blink of an eye, it brings back the charm of the pear orchard from the past, and the traditional sound lingers around. The Western Shu civilization has been passed down from generation to generation, with unique advantages. Face changing, spitting fire, and rolling lanterns are well-known in China, and the puppet with a staff head is exquisitely crafted with exquisite skills; My daughter's clear voice is indescribable. Listening to the guqin playing, I couldn't help but dream back to the Three Kingdoms. Upon hearing the sound of the erhu, it changed to the floating clouds and the wild dogs. The Qin and Han Museum of Shaanxi History Museum is located in the core area of ​​Qinchuangyuan and Weihe Science and Technology Innovation Belt in Qinhan New Town, Xixian New District. It is an important part of the large-scale comprehensive cultural tourism project Daqin Civilization Park. It is a collection of cultural relic protection, display and exhibition, academic research, science education, It is a modern museum with a strong traditional style that integrates tourism services and other functions.




The Qin and Han Museum of Shaanxi History Museum adopts the appearance of a high platform building. The exhibition area is located on a high platform on the first floor, and public activity areas such as tourism services are located in the "hall" on the high platform. It can not only meet the use requirements of different functions of the museum, but also It also presents the high-platform architectural modeling characteristics of the Qin and Han palaces of "high pavilions and beautiful palace rooms".




Spreading out the plane of the museum area, each unit is distributed according to the layout of "Wei River runs through the capital, with Xiang Tianhan, crossing the bridge to the south, and Fa Qiangniu", with Yaoguang, Kaiyang, Yuheng, Tianquan, and Tianquan among the Big Dipper. The five stars of Tianji form a symmetrical layout and are connected to each other through overhead corridors. The axis determined with Yuheng as the center is set on the extension of the central axis of Palace No. 1 of Qin Xianyang Palace. Among them, the main building adopts the form of a high platform to meet different functions. At the same time, it also shows the characteristics of Qin and Han palaces such as "high terraces and pavilions, beautiful palaces and rooms, complex roads and empty roads, horizontal bridges and waves, lofty towers, and combination of palaces and gardens." The origin of high platform construction is very early, such as the Lutai of the Yin Shang Dynasty and the Lingtai of the Zhou Dynasty. From the Warring States Period to the Qin and Han Dynasties, the style of building platforms was very popular. The museum adopts the appearance of a high platform building, with the exhibition area located on a high platform on the first floor, and public activity areas such as tourism services located in the "hall" on the high platform.




The interior is divided into five exhibition halls with an exhibition area of ​​about 11,300 square meters, including the main exhibition hall "Qin and Han Civilizations", the ruins exhibition hall "Cities and Tombs", the art exhibition hall "Technology and Beauty", the temporary exhibition hall and the public archaeological center.

The core main exhibition hall explains the achievements and role of this period in the development of Chinese civilization at multiple levels and angles from the aspects of politics, economy, military, culture, science and technology, and foreign exchanges of the Qin and Han dynasties - this is not only the ancient politics of our country The era when the system was created was also the era when academic thought was laid, and it was also the era when the Chinese nation, with the "Han" as the main body, was formed.

The exhibition halls on both sides are the permanent special exhibitions "City and Mausoleum" and "Technology and Beauty", which not only echo and in-depth explanation of the basic display of "Qin and Han Civilization", but also display the splendor and splendor of Qin and Han civilization from the aspects of archeology and art respectively.

Specifically, "Cities and Tombs" aims to explore the role of capitals and mausoleums as the true carriers of civilized society through the analysis of four major sites in Yongcheng, Yueyang, Xianyang, and Chang'an based on the results of archaeological excavations. position in an ongoing process of development.

"Technology and Beauty" mainly uses material remains such as sculptures, murals, portrait stones, and ceramic models to show the rich and diverse image world of people during the Qin and Han Dynasties, and also reveal people's understanding of the universe, life and death at that time.

The temporary exhibition hall extended outwards can realize the multi-purpose effect of one hall. Temporary exhibitions, academic conferences and lecture salons can be held here, and it is planned to be built into a Qin and Han archaeological and historical research center.

Nowadays, museums are also getting rid of the boring traditional exhibitions and adding a large number of perceivable and immersive technological means to make cultural relics come alive. For example, the digital exhibition hall and public archaeological center in the Qin and Han Museum use digital technology to present the food, clothing, housing, transportation, and social customs of the Qin and Han Dynasties, and then combine it with the display of archaeological results to tell archaeological stories in an all-round way and popularize archaeological knowledge.

Chengdu Tiantai Mountain Tourist Attraction is located in Qionglai, the first city of Chengdu in the west of the ancient southern Silk Road. It is about 110 kilometers away from the urban area of Chengdu. The main peak, Yuxiao Peak, is 1812 meters above sea level. It is the world natural heritage of the Habitat of Giant Pandas in Sichuan Province, a national scenic spot, a national forest park, a national AAAA level tourist attraction, and one of the eight firefly viewing places in the world. Tiantai Mountain, formerly known as Dongmeng Mountain, is said to have been the place where Emperor Yu worshipped the heavens during his flood control efforts, and there is a saying that "Yu paid tribute to Mengshan". In history, Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism coexisted on the mountain, with over 100 temples, Taoist temples, and government offices located throughout the peak period. The scenic area is a box shaped inclined mountain, roughly in the shape of the English letter U, resembling a "chair" sitting from west to east. The mountain forms three levels of terraces from low to high: one rooftop, two rooftop, and a main rooftop, presenting three distinctive scenic groups: "one rooftop and one sky, and nine heavens on multiple rooftops". The scenic area is known for its "strange mountains, strange stones, beautiful water, secluded forests, and beautiful clouds". It has "90 miles of long rivers, 800 rivers, 9000 strange stones, and 2000 peaks", with a forest coverage rate of about 95% and a wide variety of flora and fauna. The Jinlong River winds down from its highest peak, Yuxiao Peak, and transforms into many water features such as Long Beach, Diexi, Waterfalls, and Haizi, as well as wonders such as low mountains, cloud seas, and Buddha lights. It enjoys the reputation of "returning from Jiuzhai without looking at the water, and returning from Tiantai without playing with the water". It is a mountainous summer resort characterized by high mountains playing with water and night watching fireflies, a biodiversity science popularization natural scenic spot, and also the first mountain on the west side of the South Silk Road from Chengdu. There are attractions in the scenic area such as Changhong Waterfall, Xiangshuitan Waterfall, Shenfeng Cave, Guanyin Bridge, Inverted Boots Stone, Silver Peak, Small Mill, Flower Stone Forest, Sandaowan, Leiyin Temple, Cedar Forest High altitude Plank Road, Embroidered Ball Flower Sea, Xiushui Sanyun, Eighteen Mile Fragrant Grass Gully, Red Army Long March Qionglai Memorial Hall, Sichuan Red Army Long March Digital Exhibition Hall, etc. Recommended one-day tour route for Tiantai Mountain Scenic Area (Qiqu Mountain and Water): Tourist Center → (by car) → Xiaojiawan Mountain Gate → (by walk) → Dengle An → (by car) → Sandaowan → (by car) → Zhengtiantai → (by walk) → Shibali Xiangcaogou/Xiushui Sanyun → (by walk) → Zhengtiantai → (by car) → Tourist Center. The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is located inside Jianfu Temple, named after its shape resembling the Big Wild Goose Pagoda and being smaller than it. Compared to the hustle and bustle of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the Small Wild Goose Pagoda is much quieter. Under the Small Wild Goose Pagoda, there are many exquisite stone sculptures from various dynasties, such as stone Buddhas, stone lions, stone horses, and horse tie stakes, placed outdoors. Tourists who enjoy folk cultural relics should not miss them. The Little Wild Goose Pagoda was built during the reign of Tang Jinglong (707 AD) to accommodate the "eminent monk Yijing" who came back from India to translate Buddhist scriptures. At the beginning of its construction, it had fifteen floors, but due to multiple earthquakes, it now has thirteen floors. There are wooden stairs inside the tower that spiral upwards to reach the top of the tower. Jianfu Temple was founded in the first year of Tang Ruizong's civilization (684 AD), originally located in Kaihua Fang, Chang'an City, Tang Dynasty. It was later destroyed and rebuilt at its current address. The temple preserves a large iron bell cast in 1192 AD (the third year of the Jin Mingchang era). In the Qing Dynasty, the bell would ring here every morning, which is the famous "Yanta Morning Bell". Nowadays, on New Year's Day every year, there is an event held here to ring bells and pray for blessings. In 2007, the Xi'an Museum was built inside the Jianfu Temple, adding a lake surface and new landscaping.

The Shuilu'an Wall Sculpture Museum is located at the foot of Wangshun Mountain, about 10 kilometers southeast of Lantian County. The Water and Land Hall of the Water and Land Temple was built from the 42nd year of the Ming Jiajing reign (1563 AD) to the 1st year of the Ming Longqing reign (1567 AD). The 13 walls inside the hall are intricately carved with a large number of clay painted statues, wall sculptures, and hanging sculptures, totaling more than 3000 statues. Their shapes, postures, expressions, costumes, and other complex and varied forms. It is a long-standing and well preserved group of painted clay sculptures in Shaanxi Province. The content, structure, and painting of the clay sculptures are very unique, preserving various historical, artistic, and cultural information, and have high artistic, historical, and Buddhist research value. As a famous temple of the Six Dynasties, it is renowned for preserving ancient exquisite and rare colored sculptures, and is known as the "second Dunhuang of China".

The Xi'an Bell Tower is a relatively large and well preserved bell tower in China. It was first built in the 17th year of the Ming Hongwu reign (1384 AD). The Bell Tower is located in the central area of Xi'an and is one of the landmarks of the ancient city. It radiates four streets east, south, west, and north from its center and connects with the east, south, west, and north gates of the Xi'an city wall. The Drum Tower in Xi'an was originally located on Guangji Street in the west. As the city center moved eastward, in the tenth year of the Wanli reign of Emperor Shenzong of the Ming Dynasty (1582), the bell tower was relocated to the east of the Drum Tower, to its current location. The bell tower is typical of the architectural art style of the Ming Dynasty. The lower part is a square base of brick structure, and the top is a triple four sided cusp structure, covered with dark green glazed tiles, and the cusp is wrapped with real gold and platinum. There are about 6-meter-high doorways in the center of each of the four sides of the base, which are interconnected. In the past, it was a passage where the east, south, west, and north streets intersected, and people and vehicles passed through the doorways. Now, the doorways have been closed, and there are highway turntables built around them. There are underground passages for people to pass through. The entrance to the clock tower is located in this underground passage, with stairs that spiral up to the top. There is a replica of the "Jingyun Bell" inside the bell tower. The original was cast in the second year of Jingyun reign of Emperor Ruizong of Tang Dynasty (711 AD) and is now collected in the Beilin Museum in Xi'an. Standing on the bell tower, you can see the four main streets extending from the tower: East, South, West, and North. Surrounding the bell tower are the bustling commercial district of Xi'an and the nearby Drum Tower. When tourists visit the clock tower, they can also enjoy wonderful ancient performances. There are 6 performances per day, and specific performance times can be found on the official website. Between the bell tower and the drum tower is the Bell and Drum Tower Square, with a music fountain. Full text 

There is actually such a cool treasure trove hidden just over an hour's drive away from the city center of Chengdu! The scenic area is bordered by Tiantai Mountain to the west and Dayi Huashuiwan Hot Spring and Xiling Snow Mountain to the east. The forest coverage rate is over 95%, and the flora and fauna resources are abundant. The ecological climate and environment are extremely favorable, making it an important component of the habitat for giant pandas. Nanbao Mountain is located in the subtropical humid climate zone, with an average annual temperature of 16 ℃. The scorching heat and high temperatures in the city during summer are insulated from here. This time, we departed from Chengdu and arrived at the hometown of Zhuo Wenjun. We strolled through the lush valleys of Nanbao Mountain, experiencing the freshness of the mountains and exploring the magnificent wonders of nature. The scenic area features canyon waterfalls, green mountains and colorful forests, and historical relics as the environmental tone, with the love culture of Zhuo Wenjun and Sima Xiangru as the core, creating six themed cultural areas. Spring outings, summer retreats, autumn health preservation, winter snow appreciation, suitable for all seasons! The Nanbaoshan Scenic Area boasts lush forests, lush vegetation, and diverse species. The mountains and forests here are refreshing and comfortable, with plenty of wild fun. Especially for children, it's like a big playground, a huge encyclopedia! This stone bridge is a section of the northern section of the Tea Horse Ancient Road, commonly known as the "Linqiong Road" or "Qingyi Road". During the Western Han Dynasty, Tang Meng was ordered by Emperor Wu of Han to build the Southern Barbarian Road, which was often subjected to military punishment, violence, and public anger. In 129 BC, Sima Xiangru, who was appointed as a Zhonglang general, was sent as an envoy to the Southwest barbarians to pacify Bashu and quell grievances. Later, he used this ancient tea and horse road to facilitate trade, opened up the southwestern border, and made immortal contributions to the expansion of the Han Dynasty's territory. Traveling along the water, with cascading waterfalls along the way, the scenery is beautiful and the legacy is extraordinary. In many places, the water flow is light and gentle, and the water is close to the trail. Tourists can play in the spring and enjoy the cool breeze. The Nanbaoshan Waterfall cascades down from the mountaintop, with magnificent water and sound. The appearance of the Tiangang Running Cave is a combination of strange stones, arranged in a staggered manner. The cave is lined with stalactites, shining with colorful light, stunning and dreamy. There are caves and halls in the cave, accompanied by murmuring water sounds. The stones and water blend seamlessly into the natural world. According to legend, Yuan Tiangang wrote works on physiognomy such as "Five Elements Xiangshu" and "Pushing Back Diagram" in this cave. After leaving the cave, there was a huge golden turtle in the pool in front of us, with several cute little turtles on its back. Ascending from the Nanbaoshan Waterfall, we actually entered the Tiangang Cultural District. As the name suggests, the scenery, architecture, culture, and legends here are all related to the master Yuan Tiangang. The Changsheng Palace is located in the Huaqing Pool Scenic Area, east of the Evening Light Pavilion on the west side of Lishan Mountain, also known as the Jingling Platform. It is one of the main buildings of the Tang Dynasty Huaqing Palace. The Changsheng Hall was built as early as the sixth year of the Tianbao reign of the Tang Dynasty (748 AD) to enshrine the spirit tablets of seven emperors from the Tang Dynasty, including Emperor Gaozu Li Yuan, Emperor Taizong Li Shimin, Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi, Empress Dasheng Wu Zetian, Emperor Zhongzong Li Xian, Emperor Ruizong Li Dan, and posthumously honored Emperor Xuanyuan Laozi Li Er. Therefore, during the Tang Dynasty, this hall was also known as the Seven Holy Temples. The Hall of Longevity is more well-known for the story of Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Princess Yang. It was the place where they made their vows on Qixi. Bai Juyi wrote in his Song of Everlasting Regret that "on July 7, when there was no one whispering at midnight, the Hall of Longevity would like to be a bird in the sky and a branch in the earth." In this way, the Hall of Longevity became a sacred place for classical romantic love in China. In 2005, the Changsheng Hall was rebuilt and used as an exhibition hall for Tang Huaqing Palace cultural relics. After 2008, it was planned to become the main performance venue for 'Song of Everlasting Regret'. The sentimental love story between Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty and Princess Yang is displayed through the contents of the imperial concubine's entry into the palace, the pear garden spring dawn, the imperial concubine's taking a bath, the Qixi vows and An Shi's turmoil. The display content combines the main building of Changsheng Hall with scenes that restore historical allusions, transforming the story narrative that was originally on paper into an alternative experience that people can feel in real space.

Flying Shuang Hall is located on the north bank of Jiulong Lake in Huaqing Palace Scenic Area, facing the lake. It was once the bedroom of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang Dynasty and Yang Guifei. It is said that it was named Flying Shuang Hall because every winter, Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty brought Yang Guifei to Huaqing Pool to bathe in the hot spring. When the heavy snow was flying all over the sky, the snowflakes were evaporated in the air by the hot spring before they touched the ground, and the falling snow turned into frost.

summary: The Zhongnan Mountain · Nanwutai Scenic Area is located in the Zhongnan Mountain Range, where the mountains rise and fall. Since ancient times, it has been a famous Buddhist mountain and a place to escape the heat. Formerly known as Taiyi Mountain, it is the 'Divine Beauty Zone of Zhongnan'. There are five peaks on the mountain, namely, Qingliang, Wenzhu, Xianshou, Lingying and Guanyin. Because it is located to the south of Mount Wutai (Yaowang Mountain) in Yaoxian County, Shaanxi Province, it is named Nanwutai. As one of the places of Buddhism, Nanwutai has numerous temples, with over 40 temples of various sizes dating back to the Ming and Qing dynasties. These temples of different sizes are distributed on various platforms, with orderly layout, exquisite construction, and captivating appeal. But now most of the temples on the mountain have been destroyed and no longer exist. There are still Guanyin Temple, Wufo Hall, Yuanguang Temple, Xilin Temple, Shengshou Temple, and so on. Among the numerous temples in Nanwutai, Shengshou Temple has a long history and a large area. Shengshou Temple is located on the northwest hillside of Nanwutai, one kilometer southwest of Taigoukou Village, Wutai Township. It is also called Kumbum Monastery because it is located in the Tasi Valley. The Shengshou Temple Pagoda was built in the Sui Dynasty, with a square seven story structure and a height of 23 meters. It is said that the Big Wild Goose Pagoda was built after this pagoda and is one of the earliest surviving Buddhist pagodas in Xi'an. The natural scenery of Zhongnan Mountain · Nanwutai Scenic Area is quite beautiful. At the same time, the scenic area also utilizes more than 300 acres of terraces around the karst caves and in the mountains to plant herbs, vines, and woody plants, such as more than 10 flower varieties such as tree roses, centella, marigolds, cherry blossoms, and wisteria. After exploring the scenery inside the cave, while marveling at the exquisite craftsmanship of nature, you can also touch the softness and fragrance of the French style town, and enjoy the leisure and comfort brought by nature. In addition to the natural and magical nature of caves, the brilliance and romance of mountain flowers, the magic of Tianyan Cave Flower Ridge lies in the strange pine trees and rocks that cover the mountains. The towering pine and cypress trees stand tall amidst the mountains, lush and lively; Various shaped stone forests and towering trees in the rugged and tenacious rocks can also be seen everywhere. A gentle breeze blows through the mountains, with waves of forest and cascading emerald sea waterfalls, instantly creating the feeling of being in a tropical rainforest. However, the trees in the forest are always tall and large, with dense leaves displaying the vitality of life, like a big umbrella covering the sky and the sun. Walking in the forest, one can only feel the shade, without the stuffy feeling of Chongqing summer. In addition, the scenic area also adapts to local conditions and creates outdoor expansion projects such as forest sports, camping experiences, and live chicken eating around its forests. Jingangbei Happy Village is located on the banks of Jialing River at the foot of Jinyun Mountain in Beibei District, Chongqing. The mountains here are layered, the greenery is fresh, and the streams are gurgling, showcasing the distinct historical and regional characteristics of "a stone road, a millennium Jingangbei". As an ideal livable place, it perfectly matches the clean and refreshing urban atmosphere of Beibei. There is a beautiful legend: it is said that the great disciple of Shakyamuni Buddha, Venerable Gaya, wanted to establish a dojo on Jinyun Mountain and asked a strongman to come and help. During the transportation process, the strongman accidentally left a huge stone in the mountains. Later, the Tang Dynasty engraved the word "Diamond" on the monument, so the village was named the Diamond Monument. As can be seen, the project retains the original architectural remnants of the Diamond Stele, and after restoration, it will present architectural traces from various periods including the Qing Dynasty, the Republic of China, the 1970s and 1980s, and the early 21st century. The drainage system of the Qing Dynasty will be unblocked, and the graffiti on the walls and the smoke and fire marks on the walls during the Republic of China period will be preserved, highlighting its unique cultural temperament. Chongqing is a famous hot spring capital, and Beibei's Beiwenquan is the top hot spring in Chongqing. There are over 1600 years of written records about the North Hot Springs. During the reign of Emperor Yongzheng of the Qing Dynasty, Zhang Penghui, the Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall, even named the North Hot Springs "First Spring". Imagine soaking in a pool of steaming hot soup, admiring the sunset glow of Jinyun, and spending a leisurely weekend. What a pleasant and comfortable experience? Starting from the urban area of Beibei, it can be reached within 5 kilometers. Overall, the Jingangbei Hot Spring Settlement has utilized the natural and cultural resources of the village, constructing characteristic hot springs, foot baths, spas, health preservation, and homestays, allowing tourists to immerse themselves in traditional villages while experiencing modern elements. Here, there are 12 hot springs with different styles and characteristics in this settlement. Every drop of spring water comes from the Wentangxia North Hot Spring. It is worth mentioning that the water temperature is between 35 ° C and 37 ° C, and it belongs to the weakly alkaline sulfuric acid type mineral spring. Specifically, the private hot spring pools equipped in some rooms are also a major highlight. While ensuring privacy, you can also enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Diamond Stele. At the same time, live dance dramas, live performances by bands, dances, and other performances are gathered here. There are also high-value NPC interactions and characteristic music hot springs, which combine health and leisure perfectly, subverting the traditional new way of soaking in hot springs. Of course, you can also choose the Jialing River Small Three Gorges Water Loop Tour Experience Project, take a cruise to experience the scenery along both sides of the Jialing River Wentang Gorge Guanyin Gorge, and look up to see the verdant mountains and towering ancient trees; Looking down, one can see the murmuring stream and winding path. With a casual snap, time freezes in this moment. The Diamond Stele at night is even more surprising. Under the light, the village buildings seem like a fantasy world in Spirited Away. The bluestone roads and brick houses complement each other, and the authentic life of the ancient town of Bayu unfolds like an ink painting scroll in the misty rain. Full text 

poiName: Everlasting Regret Song and Dance Performance
summary: The Song of Everlasting Regret "is a large-scale historical dance drama set against the backdrop of the love story between Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Yang Guifei, located in the Huaqing Palace Scenic Area in Xi'an. This performance reproduces the prosperity and tragic love of the Tang Dynasty through exquisite dance, gorgeous costumes, and stunning stage effects.

Wuhou Temple, located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China, is a temple built to commemorate Zhuge Liang, the Prime Minister of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period. It is the only temple in China where monarchs and ministers worship together, and also the most influential museum of Three Kingdoms relics in the country. There are many precious cultural relics and inscriptions in the Wuhou Temple, showcasing the history and culture of the Three Kingdoms period.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

shortFeatures: View marble portraits and stone carvings in the hall
summary: It was built to commemorate Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei in Taoyuan during the Three Kingdoms period. Originally named Sanyi Temple, it was built by Zheng Jiaolin, the admiral of Sichuan, in the early years of Emperor Kangxi of Qing Dynasty. The original site was located in Admiral Street, but it was later moved to Wuhou Temple due to urban construction needs. Sanyi Temple is now a courtyard house, which consists of a worship hall, a main hall and corridors on both sides. The statue of Liu Guanzhang in the temple is made according to the description of Romance of the Three Kingdoms. The image is young, full of vitality and monochrome cloth, which is in line with the image of Liu Guanzhang at the beginning of his business after "marriage in Taoyuan".

Kongmingyuan is a cultural tourism scenic spot with Zhuge Liang, a famous military strategist and politician during the Three Kingdoms period, located in Chengdu. Through rich exhibitions and interactive experiences, visitors are presented with the life stories, military talents, and significant position of Zhuge Liang in Chinese history.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 18:00 throughout the year

summary: The tomb of Liu Bei is located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Lady Gan and Empress Mu Wu were also buried together here, forming a joint tomb for the couple. The architecture of Huiling Mausoleum consists of a screen wall, a mountain gate, a divine path, a sleeping hall, and a tomb. Huiling Fengtu has a height of 12 meters and a circumference of 180 meters, forming a circular shape. The tomb is surrounded by walls, and the existing brick walls were built in the fifth year of the Qing Dynasty's Daoguang reign, with the words "Mausoleum of Emperor Zhaolie of Han" written on them. Huiling has a history of more than 1780 years, and there are no records of theft in historical books. It has not been excavated to this day.

The mausoleum of Liu Bei, the ancestor of Shu Han and Emperor Zhaolie of Han Dynasty, where Mrs. Gan and Empress Mu were buried together successively, is the only preserved imperial mausoleum during the Three Kingdoms period. 
The building of the mausoleum consists of Zhaobi, mountain gate, Shinto, bedroom hall, etc., and a large plaque of "Han Zhaolie Mausoleum" is hung at the gate. 
Hidden in the verdant bamboo forest, the "red wall bamboo shadow" in the depths of Chengdu's famous brocade official is also the most tender part of the solemn Wuhou Temple.

The red walled passageway can be said to be the gentle part of the solemn Wuhou Temple. The passageway of the red walled bluestone road leads to a generation of kings who have been sleeping for more than 1700 years.

The Jinli Folk Memory Wall is located on the famous Jinli Ancient Street in Chengdu, and is a wall that showcases Chengdu's traditional folk culture. The wall depicts historical figures, traditional festivals, and folk stories of Chengdu, making it a great place to learn about the local culture of Chengdu.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

summary: The Poetry and History Hall is located inside the Du Fu Thatched Cottage in Chengdu, and was built to commemorate the great Tang Dynasty poet Du Fu. The hall displays Du Fu's poems and related cultural relics, which is an important place to understand Du Fu and his poetic art.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

shortFeatures: Appreciate Du Fu's stone carvings
summary:
The Ministry of Industry Temple is the last and most important one of the five main buildings. Because Du Fu was once awarded the title of "Yuanwilang of the Ministry of Industry of School Inspection", he was known as "Du Gongbu", so the temple commemorating him was called the Temple of the Ministry of Industry. 
In front of the shrine of the Ministry of Industry, there is a couplet written by He Shaoji, a native of the Qing Dynasty: The spring breeze in Jinshui is occupied by the public, but the thatched cottage people will return on a day. The middle is a clay statue of Du Fu built in the Qing Dynasty, accompanied by poets Lu You and Huang Tingjian who once lived in Shu. The bust of Du Fu, a stone carving in the Ming Dynasty in the temple, is the earliest stone carving in the thatched cottage. 
There are also stone carvings "Shaoling Thatched Cottage Picture" embedded in the Qianlong and Jiaqing years of Qing Dynasty embedded between the walls. The carvings are fine. After liberation, the old appearance of the thatched cottage was restored based on this picture.

The former residence of thatched cottage, which was restored and rebuilt in 1997 according to the description of Du Fu's poems and the pattern of Ming Dynasty, is the landmark landscape of Du Fu's thatched cottage. 
The residential hut in western Sichuan is the main room in the middle, the bedroom on the left and right, and the kitchen on the east. Each room is equipped with corresponding furniture, tables and chairs, stone mills, water tanks, etc., which reproduces the pastoral style of the poet's former residence. 
Surrounded by streams and trees, it creates a strong poetic atmosphere, and you can also experience the interest of the countryside.

Eighteen Stairs, once a street on the Yuzhong Peninsula in Chongqing, symbolizes the true mountain city of old Chongqing. In 2015, the Eighteen Stairs area began to be demolished, and today's Eighteen Stairs are littered with ruins and walls. There are two pedestrian streets in Yuzhong Peninsula, Chongqing. One is the first street in the west of China known as "Monument to the people's Liberation", and the other is not far from Monument to the people's Liberation, called "Eighteen Ladders". Enjoy the prosperity of modern cities at Monument to the people's Liberation; At the Eighteen Stairs, one can experience the true mountain city and old Chongqing. The old Chongqing city is divided into the upper half and the lower half. The Eighteen Ladders are located at Jiaochangkou in Yuzhong District and are an old street that runs from the upper half (mountain top) to the lower half (mountain foot). This old street is entirely paved with stone steps, steep and winding, connecting the bustling commercial district on the mountaintop with the old city area by the river below. There are a large number of ordinary people living around the old street, and the street emits a strong urban atmosphere. Ear pluckers, foot trimmers, carpenters, tailors, Shaobing (Baked cake in griddle) sellers, needle and thread sellers, mahjong players, as well as the indispensable Bangbang Army in the mountain city, are scattered everywhere, with dogs and cats lying on the ground casually dozing. The Eighteen Stairs is a true portrayal of the life of old Chongqing citizens. The origin of the Eighteen Stairs can be traced back to the Ming Dynasty. There was originally a well here, and nearby residents ate water from it. The well was located exactly eighteen stone steps away from the residents' homes, so people called it the "Eighteen Stairs".

The Luo Zhongli Art Museum is located within the campus of Sichuan Academy of Fine Arts University City. It was designed and built by renowned artists such as Luo Zhongli and Hao Dapeng. The exterior walls are adorned with colorful patterns made of broken porcelain pieces, which are both dazzling and avant-garde, making them very eye-catching. The art museum displays works by Luo Zhongli from various periods, as well as some works by art students. If you love art, don't miss it.

The Nanshan Tree Observation Deck is located on Nanshan Mountain in Nan'an District, Chongqing. It includes a tree observation pavilion and a wilderness leisure area, and can accommodate thousands of people at the same time. It is one of the places to enjoy the night view of the mountain city. Standing on the observation deck, looking from afar, the lights of thousands of households in Yuzhong District, Chongqing; Surrounded by two rivers, shining brightly; A long bridge spanning over, with a clear outline; The entire city, layered and arranged in a staggered and colorful manner, is magnificent and dazzling against the backdrop of the night sky.

shortFeatures: A park with night views of five urban areas
summary: Chongqing Yihuali Night Scene Park is a good night scene viewing spot on Nanshan Mountain. It is also a night scene park in Chongqing where you can see the night scenes of five main cities such as Yuzhong, Nan'an, Jiulongpo, Banan and dadukou districts at the same time. It is also an important part of the development of Nanshan ecological belt in the development layout of "three districts and two belts" of Nan'an District Government.

shortFeatures: "Slow Life" Alley
summary:
It is one of the many "slow life" alleys in Chengdu, and it is also the silhouette of Chengdu's leisurely and warm temperament.

Today, this alley, which is less than 200 meters long, is full of characteristic coffee shops, water bars, grocery stores, etc.

summary: Zhao Gongming God of Wealth Cultural Scenic Spot is located in zhouzhi county, Xi'an. This temple of God of Wealth is the ancestral temple worshipped by Zhao Gongming, the god of wealth in China. The planning and layout of Zhao Gongming Caishen Temple is based on the concept of Sishui Guitang and Wulu Caishen Temple, with Sanjin Caishen Main Hall as the core building courtyard, and side halls and small temples forming a system of gods, forming a comprehensive exhibition park of folk auspicious gods.

Zhouzhi Water Street Shasha River is located in Zhouzhi County, Xi'an. It is the longest water street in China, integrating leisure, waterfront, children's entertainment, and ecotourism. Its highlights include rich water features, antique architecture, and nighttime light shows, allowing tourists to fully enjoy the charm of the water town and natural scenery, making it the perfect choice for family outings.

Chongqing Delicious Street is a street of food culture. In Southwest Mandarin, the word "good" in "delicious" is pronounced as four sounds, meaning "greedy". "Delicious" means "greedy". Due to continuous evolution, "Delicious Street" is no longer just a restaurant street in its original sense, but a food culture street formed by adding local characteristics and supporting food culture. Chongqing Gourmet Street is located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It gathers many traditional Chongqing food. Because it is close to Monument to the people's Liberation, the business here is very prosperous. The delicious street is full of people every day. The special food includes Wang Ma's hand shredded roasted rabbit, Chen Changyin Fried Dough Twists, hot and sour noodles, crispy potatoes, Sichuan Tangguozi, Shuixin Xuan Cake, etc. For foodies who come to Chongqing for sightseeing, this is a must visit place.

The garden features a rose garden, orchid garden, plum garden, camellia garden, bonsai garden, and the Golden Eagle Garden, with flower exhibitions throughout the year. The most lively time is in spring, from March to April, when visitors flock to the garden to enjoy cherry blossoms.

If you miss the flowering season, don’t worry. The garden also has a greenhouse that showcases various tropical plants, offering a visual feast.

It is worth mentioning that the movie *Back to 1942*, directed by Feng Xiaogang, was filmed in the garden. Locations such as the stone bridge and Spanish-style villa can be found within the botanical garden.

Crossing the bridge that spans the road leads to another section of the garden, where you’ll find the orchid garden and camellia garden. The main entrance on this side also leads to the Golden Eagle Viewing Platform. Of course, if you don't wish to visit the Golden Eagle, there is a small path on the left that leads down to the road.

The Nanshan Botanical Garden offers cherry blossom viewing from January to April, with over 30 varieties of cherry blossoms blooming in turn.

Huangjueping Graffiti Art Street is located in the Huangjueping area of Jiulongpo District, Chongqing. It originated from Huangjueping Hospital and ends at 501 Art Gallery. shortFeatures: Take a boat tour and see the islands arranged in the shape of the character 'longevity'
summary:
Changshou Lake is located in the eastern part of Changshou District. It is an artificial lake formed by intercepting the Longxi River in the 1950s, and it is named after its location within Changshou District. The lake features numerous harbors and waterways, with over 200 islands, making it the largest lake tourism scenic area in Chongqing.

The lake’s surface is vast, with crystal-clear water reflecting the sky like a painting, creating a spectacular view. In late spring and early autumn, when shallow clouds cover the sun, the misty water stretches endlessly, blending seamlessly with the sky, offering a completely different charm. The islands within the lake are lush with greenery and home to many garden attractions. Bathing Island is one of the "Eight Scenic Spots of Changshou Lake," known for its "Bathing and Water Play." Its bay is winding, surrounded by water on all sides, resembling a dazzling pearl set in the lake. The island features exquisite pavilions, delicate bridges, lush trees, and the sounds of birds and flowers. Being here feels like stepping into a romantic, almost otherworldly, waterscape.

At night, the lake’s light-filled boats create a sparkling reflection on the water, resembling a scattering of stars. The rippling waves turn the lights into colorful, winding trails. Onboard, people enjoy gentle songs, graceful dances, fine wines, and delicacies. The combination of lights, reflections, music, and laughter creates a vivid, three-dimensional lakeside night scene.

poiName: Changshou Lake Scenic Area - Tianci Changshou Lake

Tourists can enjoy the lake and mountain scenery here, participate in various water activities, and experience the harmony between tranquility and nature.

There used to be a giant drum on the upper floor, which beat the drum to tell the time every day, hence the name "Drum Tower".

poiName: shan xi li shi bo wu guan da tang yi bao zhan tang dai bi hua zhen pin zhan
summary: The Tang tomb murals are a unique and precious collection of Shaanxi History Museum, with nearly 600 exquisite murals from more than 20 Tang tombs, covering an area of over 1000 square meters. summary: Lishan Ancient Hot Spring Experience Hall is located 10 meters to the left of the exit of the Terra Cotta Warriors. The water temperature is 43 ℃ all the year round. It has an enviable natural endowment that makes emperors reluctant to leave, and Lishan Hot Springs is one of them. Looking back at history, in the famous poem "Song of Everlasting Regret" by Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi, it is written that "spring cold bestows a bath in the Huaqing Pool, and the hot spring water washes away the condensed fat." Yang Guifei, one of the Four Great Beauties, was nourished by the Lishan Hot Spring and fell even more shyly. Throughout the year, after a busy day, people drag their tired bodies and soak themselves in the hot springs, washing away the dust and fatigue all over their bodies, and resurrecting with blood. When traveling and feeling physically and mentally exhausted, why not sit down and soak in a hot spring foot bath, feeling the comfort and relaxation from the bottom of their feet to the bottom.

The corner tower of the city wall refers to the southwest corner of the city, which is circular in shape. According to legend, the city plan modified by the emperor's imperial pen was announced to the world, and it is said that most of the cities built in the era followed this style. Another theory suggests that when the Xi'an city wall was originally planned, all four corners were right angles. Later, when dealing with the wall foundation, the ruins of the ancient Tang city were unexpectedly discovered in the southwest corner. The ruins were semi-circular in shape, and in order to save time and labor, the original foundation was used.

Yuxiangmen is a city gate on the wall of Xi'an, located within the West Ring Road and north of Andingmen (West Gate). In 1927, for the convenience of transportation, this gate was specially built on the Ming City Wall. It was named after General Feng Yuxiang in commemoration of his victory in the siege of Xi'an in 1926. In 1926, warlord Liu Zhenhua besieged the city of Xi'an for eight months, and more than 40000 people died in the cold and hunger in Xi'an. Feng Yuxiang led his army to defeat Liu Zhenhua and relieve the siege of Xi'an. Yuxiang Gate is one of the earliest excavated city gates in Xi'an, in addition to the four natural city gates of east, south, west, and north. It is also an important passage in the northwest of the ancient city.

The Xi'an City Wall - Enemy Tower is an important component of the ancient city wall of Xi'an, located in the four corners of the city wall. It was an ancient building used for defense and observation of enemy situations. On both sides of the tracks are old and dilapidated houses, with intricate wires hanging overhead, roofs covered in moss, and a dam hanging flower bed sheets. The strong atmosphere of urban fireworks is reminiscent of the slow pace of life in the 1980s. summary: Jinyun Mountain is located within the Beibei District, Shapingba District, and Bishan County of Chongqing, approximately 45 kilometers from the central area of Chongqing and about 15 kilometers from Beibei District. It is a segment of a branch of the Huaying Mountain anticline. The nine peaks of Jinyun Mountain rise steeply, with ancient trees towering and dense bamboo forests, creating a tranquil and beautiful environment, earning it the nickname "Little Emei." Jinyun Mountain stands majestically on the banks of the Jialing River in Beibei District, near the Wentang Gorge, and is a "folded" mountain range formed by the Yanshan Movement around 70 million years ago. From north to south, the mountain features nine peaks, including Chaori Peak, Xianglu Peak, Shizi Peak, and Juyun Peak. Among them, Yujian Peak is the highest, with an elevation of about 1,050 meters, while Shizi Peak is the most rugged and spectacular. Each of the other peaks also has its own unique charm.

Laojun Cave is located on the mountain about 2km east of Shangxin Street in Nan'an District, and is one of the scenic spots in Nanshan Scenic Area. Laojun Cave was built in the Tang Dynasty, formerly known as Guanghua Temple, and was a Buddhist temple. In the ninth year of Wanli in the Ming Dynasty (1581), it was changed to a Taoist temple, named "Taiji Palace" (commonly known as "Laojun Cave"), and later became the first Taoist temple in eastern Sichuan. During the years of Daoguang, Tongzhi and Guangxu of Qing Dynasty, it was cultivated and expanded several times. 
The whole Taoist temple is built on the mountain, and the walls are chiseled to form images. From the mountain gate, it is arranged layer by layer along the steep cliffs and steep walls with the word "Xuan", and it spirals up to the top of the mountain. There are 13 halls in the temple, including Sanqing Hall, Zhenwu Hall, Lingzu Hall, Sanfeng Hall, Doumu Hall, Wenwu Hall, Qixing Hall, Lu Zu Hall, Cihang Hall, Jade Emperor Hall and Caishen Hall. These halls mostly imitate the style of Chinese gardens, with hanging mountains and buckets, and cornices and corners. 
There are many images of Buddhist and Taoist stories carved on cliffs in Laojundong Taoist Temple, among which two stone reliefs, Jiulong Monument and Banan Rock, have the most artistic value.

As a key livelihood project in the city, Qingdao Science and Technology Museum is a public welfare infrastructure for carrying out science and technology popularization work and exhibition activities. It is a popular science platform and important battlefield for the popularization of scientific knowledge and the improvement of scientific and cultural quality for the whole nation. Its aim is to provide high-quality free and open services and rich and colorful exhibition and teaching activities for the general public.
opening_hours: Opens at January 1-December 31 Wednesday-Sunday 09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 16:00)

summary: Shengli Shopping Plaza is located in the center of Dalian city and is a large commercial complex that integrates shopping, dining, and entertainment. This place gathers many well-known domestic and foreign brands, making it a paradise for shopping enthusiasts.

The Fenhe Scenic Area in Taiyuan City starts from the upper reaches of Shengli Bridge in the north and ends at the lower reaches of Naninner Ring Bridge in the south, with a total length of about 6 kilometers. It is distributed in several major districts of Taiyuan City, including Yingze, Jiancaoping, and Wanbailin. Local people often go to Yingze District, which has attractions such as Huxin Island and Fenshui Pavilion, and is close to the bustling Changfeng Street and Qinxian Street. There are six scenic areas, four squares, ten gardens, and 14 distinctive scenic spots distributed on the belt shaped green platforms on both sides of the Fenhe Scenic Area. Along the west bank of the Fen River, there are three squares: Jin Fen Ancient Rhyme, Pear Garden Music, and Five Ring Radiance, which respectively reflect the long historical context of the Three Jin Dynasties, the profound opera culture, and the vibrant sports and fitness scenes. Along the east bank of the Fen River, there are scenic spots such as Fen River Late Ferry, Yanqiu, beach with clear water, Beyond Time and Space, Source of Life, and Ritai, which allow visitors to appreciate the combination of modern civilization and nature. On the lake surface of the scenic area, there are colorful rubber dams, large music fountains, bird islands, oases, duck houses, etc., presenting a picture of rippling waves and the same color of water and sky. As night falls, more than 8000 lighting fixtures of over 80 different styles spread across various scenic spots, complementing the four light belts of Binhe East and West Road, presenting a colorful three-dimensional scenery. The Fen River Scenic Area is a place for Taiyuan citizens to relax and take leisurely walks. Walking along both sides of the Fen River, taking a stroll, breathing in the air by the river, and seeing the flowers, plants, and local squares on both sides is also very pleasant. Full text 

Qingdao Wanda Plaza is a large shopping center located in Qingdao, Shandong Province, China. It integrates shopping, dining, and entertainment, providing a wide range of brand choices and leisure experiences.

poiName: Qingdao Site Museum of the Former German Governor's Residence
summary: The Qingdao German Governor General's Building Site Museum, also known as the Guest House, is a German castle style building with a palace style wooden structure inside. The interior furnishings can still be seen today. The Governor's Building is located at the southern foot of Signal Mountain and is currently a high-level reception hotel in Qingdao. The architectural style and color of the guesthouse are very unique: the yellow walls are irregularly decorated with granite stones, and the red dominated roof is interspersed with blue and green roofs. A decoration from an ancient German warship - the Norman dragon head - protrudes from the eaves, standing in front of the building as if entering a fairy tale world. The exterior of the guesthouse is colorful and particularly suitable for photography, but photography is prohibited inside. In this building, you can feel the rigor of German design, such as the fact that all wooden furniture cannot even fit a razor blade into the joints between the boards. A century has passed without any quality problems, and the heating inside the building can still be used today. The thick soft carpet on the ground, along with crystal lamps, mirrors, and ivory pianos, can all make you feel the atmosphere of a European court. There are four floors in the building, with the ground floor being a semi underground room that was originally used by the governor's servants. Now there is a coffee shop, and the fourth floor is an office area that is not open to the public, so only the second and third floors are truly available for tourists to visit. Because entering from the entrance of the guesthouse means being on the second floor, it is customary to refer to the second floor as the first floor and the third floor as the second floor. The second floor is mainly used by the governor to entertain guests. Crystal mirrors are placed in the restaurant; A magnificent crystal lamp hangs from the top of the hall, and a fireplace in one corner is embedded with green jade; There is a precious ivory piano in the banquet hall, and the chandelier is adorned with gemstones; There is a road leading to a large flower room on the second floor, and all the furnishings are magnificent and magnificent! The third floor mainly consists of the governor's bedroom and office. The first room I saw upstairs was the bridge room; There is a nursery ahead, and all the items inside have no edges or corners. The light from the chandelier is very soft and will not harm the child's eyes; There are also crystal mirrors in the bedroom of the governor and his wife, and it is worth noting that there is a gun cabinet with only a keyhole but no handle. It requires two hands to forcefully turn the two wooden mechanisms next to it to open the cabinet door, which can prevent children from accidentally opening it - even with a key, it cannot be turned off due to weak force. These designs are meticulous, clever, and thoughtful. Behind the guesthouse is Signal Mountain Park, which can be visited together. Climbing to the top of Signal Mountain, you can overlook the Guest House and Qingdao city, enjoy the sea view, and have a broad view. Full text 

poiName: Qingdao West Coast Ecological Sightseeing Park
tagNameList: Resorts; Treasure place for walking babies
summary: Qingdao West Coast Ecological Sightseeing Park is located on the west side of Lingshan Bay Film and Television Culture Industry Zone in Qingdao West Coast New District, No.3666 Jiaozhou Bay East Road, at the intersection of Jiaozhou Bay East Road and Shanhai Road. It has a unique natural environment and geographical location. The park is the first phase of Huashan Tourist Resort (about 4,000 mu), covering an area of about 1,500 mu. It is invested and operated by West Coast Modern Agriculture Development Co., Ltd., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Qingdao West Coast Development Group. Taking "flower sea, garden, mountain and water system" as ecological elements and focusing on "slow life" as the main line, the theme of "parent-child entertainment, creative agriculture, leisure sports and film and television services" is highlighted.

Carnival Hisense Plaza Village is located in Qingdao and is a comprehensive commercial square that integrates shopping, entertainment, and dining. There are not only various international brand stores here, but also facilities such as cinemas and children's play areas, making it a great place for families and friends to gather.

Yunxiao Road Food Street is definitely a must visit place for foodies in Qingdao. The street is 960 meters long and located on the north side of May Fourth Square. It gathers hundreds of restaurants and hotels, many of which are excellent old shops with good reputation and affordable prices. It is a food street that gathers major Chinese cuisines. No matter day or night, the food street is always bustling with traffic and crowds. Especially during lunchtime and dusk dining hours, the streets stretch for miles with heavy traffic and crowds of people. Inside the shops, the streets are filled with fragrant and colorful scents, creating an enticing atmosphere. In order to cope with the peak passenger flow, most food and beverage shops have added seats along the street outside their doors. At night, the entire street is brightly lit and bustling, and the scene of street stalls at night is even more spectacular.

The Tianjin Yangliuqing Folk Culture Museum showcases the historical and cultural characteristics of Yangliuqing Ancient Town, inheriting the essence of traditional Chinese culture. The exhibition of Yangliuqing Folk Culture Museum takes the perspective of canal culture as the entry point, with Yangliuqing woodblock New Year paintings as the main line. The unique canal culture and rushing camp culture of Yangliuqing are interwoven, reflecting the folk history and culture accumulated in the ancient town for thousands of years. The exhibition hall utilizes a large number of old objects, photos, paintings and other physical objects from folk production and life, providing viewers with visual and spiritual cultural enjoyment, fully showcasing the prosperity of traditional Chinese folk culture represented by New Year's painting culture, courtyard culture, canal culture, folk culture, etc.

Yangliuqing Square is located in the center of Yangliuqing Town, covering an area of 72000 square meters and consisting of a main square and a sub square. The main square consists of a heart and two lung lobes, with flower beds and sculpture fountains forming the heart of the square; The European style sparse forest grassland surrounds the east and west sides, resembling two huge lung lobes, with five uniquely designed entertainment and leisure parks embedded within. The secondary square is a curved building consisting of 64 Roman columns arranged neatly at the southern end of the square, with the main and secondary squares seamlessly integrated. There are three sculptures standing in the square, which are the core of the square. The main sculpture "Gate of Hundred Blessings" is a 16 meter high seal script with the character "fu", and the ground is embedded with 99 characters of fu; On both sides are yellow "Light of Civilization" and blue "Infinite Development". The 388 column large single column music fountain forms a water curtain of tens of meters, majestic and graceful, decorating the "Gate of Hundred Blessings" with an especially enchanting charm.

The Shijia Courtyard is located in Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and is a well preserved group of Qing Dynasty residential buildings. The Flower Hall is a part of the Shijia Grand Courtyard, renowned for its exquisite wood, brick, and stone carving art, showcasing the unique charm of Qing Dynasty architecture.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

summary:
Panshan Ski Resort is located 8 kilometers west of Jixian County, southeast of Panshan Scenic Area, and only 80 kilometers away from Beijing, with convenient transportation. 
The ski resort has opened six ski trails, including four primary ski trails with a length of 160 meters and a width of 40 meters, two intermediate ski trails with a width of 500 meters and a width of 80 meters, and a beginner practice area and a children's snow play area. 
The ski resort is the second large-scale mountain ski resort in Tianjin, with the largest Yahao Ski School in Tianjin, with all kinds of facilities.
