summary: By taking the Yunsong Cableway, you can directly reach the peak of Panshan - the Hanging Moon Peak. The cableway runs for 28 minutes and offers a panoramic view of Jiangjunshi, Pangu Temple, Shuangfeng Temple, as well as an upward view of Yunmao Temple and Dingguang Buddha Relic Pagoda along the way.

shortFeatures: Climb to the summit to enjoy the sunrise and sunset, misty clouds and smoke
summary:
Heading eastward from Panshan Yungao Temple, climbing up the stairs, only one person can pass through the stone steep, and the steep situation makes people feel creepy today. The four characters "Go to the sky and fifth" are engraved on the east cliff. Then there is the "Breathing Rock", on which "A glance at all the mountains" is engraved, written by Chen Guorui. Continue to go up, that is, you will reach the peak of Panshan Mountain-Hanging Moon Peak. 
In the early morning of the moon-hanging peak, you can enjoy the surging sun and the rising sun in Ran Ran; In the evening, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of colorful clouds and forests; In the rain, you can enjoy the ethereal and ever-changing clouds.

The original name of Wanfo Temple was "Stone Buddha Hall", located on the south slope of Panshan and the west gate of Shiqu Garden. It is composed of four parts, namely, the screen wall, the iron bell and the the Shakya ManiHall. There are large stone carvings of the Three Holy Buddhas enshrined in the Wanfo Hall of Panshan Wanfo Temple. There are 10960 Buddha statues in the hall, and the walls on the northeast, west, and northeast sides of the hall, from the skirt wall edge to the top, are the Ten Thousand Buddha Wall. There are 10960 cave style small Buddha niches, each of which houses one Buddha statue.

The Jinsheng Cableway is located within the Panshan Scenic Area, where visitors can not only enjoy the scenery of the mountains and forests, but also overlook attractions such as Tiancheng Temple and Wansong Temple.

shortFeatures: The stream flows down like strands of silk fluttering
summary: Shuxia, located in Panshan Scenic Area, was inscribed by Liu Bingnan, a famous calligrapher in Taiwan Province. Shuxia is a wonderful mountain and river, and the stream flows down, just like washing the canyon.

Qianxiang Temple is a Buddhist temple with a long history located in Jizhou District, Tianjin, China. The temple is famous for its unique stone carved Buddha statues, which are carved on cliffs in various shapes and lifelike. Qianxiang Temple is not only a pilgrimage site for Buddhist believers, but also an important place for tourists to learn about ancient Chinese Buddhist culture and stone carving art.

Wansong Temple is located in Panshan Scenic Spot, Jixian County, Tianjin, formerly known as "Li Jing'an". Li Jing, a famous general in the early Tang Dynasty, once lived here, hence its name. Song Luo, a poet in the early Qing Dynasty, thought that the former sages should not be called by their first names, so he changed his name to "Wei Gong'an". During the Emperor Kangxi period of the Qing Dynasty, it was renamed "Wansong Temple" and is still in use today.

San Pan Mu Yu is one of the famous natural landscapes in Tianjin, located in Jizhou District. It attracts many tourists with its unique landscape and rich cultural heritage. Here, the mountains and waters are beautiful, and the scenery is picturesque. Especially in the evening, the scenery under the sunset is even more stunning, hence the name 'San Pan Mu Yu'.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

summary: Yunlou Liying is a famous tourist attraction in Tianjin, attracting numerous visitors with its unique architectural style and beautiful natural scenery. Not only does it have a rich historical and cultural background, but it also boasts breathtaking natural landscapes, making it an unmissable place for tourists to experience the charm of Tianjin.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

summary: Zhouzhuang Wansan Winery is located on a small "heart" shaped island surrounded by water in Zhouzhuang Town, Jiangsu Province. It was transformed from an old Huangjiu factory and showcases and experiences traditional Huangjiu brewing techniques, as well as the production and sales of Huangjiu derivative products, cultural and creative activities, and enterprise team building activities. A unique immersive exhibition hall that combines visual, olfactory, and auditory experiences to tell the story of Wansan Huangjiu. The natural wood colored space integrates our longing for a natural way of life, telling the ancient legendary story of the richest man Shen Wansan in a modern and minimalist style. There are also cultural activities such as lectures and videos. The open new Chinese style wine tasting space offers a wide view, with green grasslands, lakes, and trees all in sight, bringing a wine tasting experience that is close to nature. The bar offers a variety of creative cocktails, showcasing the various possibilities of Huangjiu. You can also personally mix a glass of your own exclusive QingPar wine according to your preferences. The unique irregular spatial structure allows visitors to experience the ancient history of Huangjiu and witness a flowing feast of wine culture along the spatial lines. At the same time, combining space with sensory listening, explain the ingenious brewing process of Wansan Huangjiu, and experience an immersive exhibition experience. The brewing workshop of Wansan Huangjiu is operated by experienced winemakers, showcasing the twelve brewing processes of ancient Huangjiu. The workshop window is transparent, allowing you to observe the brewing process up close and experience the ritualistic craftsmanship of Wansan Huangjiu. At the same time, everyone also has the opportunity to personally experience the Huangjiu brewing process inside. A place for various beautiful things, with a variety of green Par wine and traditional yellow wine for you to choose from, paired with delicious snacks, as well as a series of cultural and creative derivatives, including cold soap made from yellow wine, and Jingdezhen customized porcelain stationery and tableware inspired by the water towns of Jiangnan, interpreting the aesthetics of life in various forms. There are also beverage and experience areas in the space for everyone to rest, and you can also experience handmade projects such as flower carving wine bottle drawing, woodworking, leather goods, etc. Full text 

Canglang Pavilion is one of the four famous gardens in Suzhou, located near San Yuan Fang in the south of Suzhou city. The Fish Viewing Area is a famous scenic spot within Canglang Pavilion, where visitors can observe various fish species and experience the tranquility and harmony of classical gardens.

Canglang Cultural Industry Block is located in Suzhou City and is a comprehensive cultural area that integrates culture, art, and creativity. This place gathers numerous cultural and creative enterprises, art studios, and specialty shops, making it a great place to experience the combination of traditional Suzhou culture and modern creativity.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 21:00 throughout the year

summary: Hangzhou City Balcony is located in the core area of Qianjiang New Town. There are three city balconies, one main and two auxiliary balconies. Each balcony is an open and vibrant modern city park, which integrates various functions such as leisure, tide watching, recreation and relaxation. The main balcony is located on the central axis of the core area, with the Qiantang River embankment as the bottom line and tens of meters away from the river surface. It is about 322 meters long. Most of it is overhead on the river surface, and the farthest point protrudes from the river embankment for about 80 meters. The whole balcony is divided into upper and lower floors, and the building area of the first floor alone is 24,000 square meters.

Shanghai Sun Island Forest Hot Spring is located in the Sun Island Hot Spring Health Center, and is hidden in the open-air and indoor hot springs on the 2,500-acre beautiful island. It has 8 open-air functional hot springs, 5 special healing energy rooms, 1 indoor constant temperature swimming pool and several indoor private hot spring houses, as well as an indoor children's playground and entertainment area, which provide Chinese warm drinks and seasonal fruits. It combines multiple experiences such as hot spring bathing, sweat steaming, and resting. While bathing, you will be in a thousand-acre forest oxygen bar, experience the feeling of nature and respect, and integrate with the elegant and deep forest hot springs to eliminate fatigue and warm up in winter.

Tai'an Bridge is located in Shanghai, China and is a bridge with a long history. It is famous for its unique architectural style and rich historical background. It is not only a transportation hub, but also an important symbol of Shanghai's history and culture.
opening_hours: Open all day throughout the year

summary: The Wang Chang Memorial Hall is located in Shanghai and was established to commemorate the famous scholar Wang Chang of the Qing Dynasty. The museum displays the life stories, academic achievements, and influence of Wang Chang on future generations, making it an important place to understand the academic culture of the Qing Dynasty.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

poiName: Lin'an Tuankou Ludi Ancient Hot Spring
shortFeatures: With a history of 1300 years
summary: The Lin'an Tuankou Reed Ancient Hot Spring is also known as Tianmushan Hot Spring. The real spring of Ludigu Hot Spring comes from within the hotel, so this hotel is called "Lin'an Tuankou Ludigu Hot Spring Resort Hotel". Water of the hot spring is very clean and each pool is very private. There are two large swimming pools and children's pool. There are many recreational facilities attached to the spring center.

Hongye Valley is located at the junction of the Imperial Garden and the southwest slope of Fengxiang Peak. Due to the lack of human intervention for many years and the erosion of mountains and rivers, the exposed rocks here showcase a landscape of cliff melting and strange rocks, while the rest are dense forests and wetlands. The unique climate environment makes the rocks here rugged, ancient maple trees stand tall, and ancient vines entangle. The construction of this scenic spot fully considers the harmonious combination of landforms, water bodies, plants, facilities, etc., pays attention to the restoration of the ecological functions of Qixia Mountain, continuously beautifies, optimizes, and colors the environment, and draws water to build ponds to improve the ecological environment of the area. Hongye Valley covers an area of about 50000 square meters, with beautiful natural scenery and unique rocks and red leaves. It is a new red leaf viewing area that integrates mountains, rocks, water, forests, and pavilions.

Suyun Thirteen Gardens is designed by Professor Chen Wei, an expert in ancient architecture at Southeast University. Adhering to the design concept of "recreating high-quality Jiangsu gardens with the past", it authentically reproduces the classic ancient garden architecture of thirteen prefecture level cities in Jiangsu, allowing visitors to enjoy the classic gardens of Jiangsu in one day. Full time and immersive Chinese style performance tour "Su Yun Seeking Fragrance" is performed every day in Su Yun Thirteen Garden. Led by the talented scholar Li Yu from Jiangsu, tourists meet historical literati, experience the unique charm of different cities, and embark on a journey of Su Yun culture in the gardens of Jiangnan. One city, one garden, one story, one step, one scenery, one stunning sight. Suyun Thirteen Gardens innovatively integrates experiential commercial scenes with immersive cultural exhibitions. Through the interweaving of artistic life and cultural imagination, visitors can experience the classic aesthetic philosophy of Jiangsu gardens, depict the colorful cultural picture of Jiangsu, and experience the natural, humanistic, and beautiful Suyun elegant life.

Hangzhou Xinyifang Pedestrian Street is located in Maiyu Bridge, Gongshu District, Hangzhou. It starts from Hushu Road in the east and ends at Moganshan Road in the west, along both banks of the Yuhangtang River, with a total length of 500 meters. The pedestrian street draws inspiration from the ancient Jiangnan riverside street market and is designed to be built along both sides of the Yuhangtang River. It is constructed in the form of eight individual buildings with traditional Chinese cultural architectural features, extending from east to west, connecting Hushu North Road and the Beijing Hangzhou Grand Canal to the east and Moganshan Road to the west. The total length is about 500 meters and the total construction area is over 20000 square meters. Water pavilions, squares, pavilions, corridors, sculptures, etc. are built between the buildings along the street. The pedestrian street is 16 meters wide, with a 3-meter-wide arcade on one side and buildings extending partially into the river along the river. The two sides are connected by three distinctive ancient bridges, Luting Bridge, Caoying Bridge, and Guijin Bridge, forming a unique landscape of "rivers on the streets and streets on the rivers". There is a boat dock in Hexi, where people can take boats while shopping, presenting a beautiful picture of Jiangnan style before their eyes.

Junlan Banshan Tangquan, as a rare fluoride spring in eastern Zhejiang, is known for its refreshing hot springs and beautiful autumn flowers filling the mountains. The spring water gushes out from the underground rock layers of Changleli Mountain, creating a natural oxygen bar in the hundreds of acres of forest. 18 hot spring pools are built along the mountain, soaking in Fuquan and overlooking Qianhu Lake, creating a unique scenery! Half mountain open-air forest hot spring, a brand new way of hot spring bathing, spacious and comfortable leisure space, equipped with a health grass hut, cinema, leisure area, children's play area, game console, book bar, and fruit self-service area; Featured soaking pools: various health medicine pools; The cool breeze blowing through the bamboo forest feels like being in a paradise on earth, a place that truly interprets the exotic charm - Junlan Banshan Tangquan.

shortFeatures: Visit Nanjing Lovelorn Museum
summary: Bulao Village is located at the southern foot of Laoshan National Forest Park and connected with Ningchu Expressway. It is one of the eight "pearls" of beautiful countryside that Pukou District, Nanjing has made great efforts to build.

Ginkgo Lake Amusement Park is located in Jiangning, Nanjing, and is a large-scale theme park project in the province. It not only has cool theme parks, but also an ecological zone. The amusement park is mainly divided into a play area, a children's theme museum area, a dinosaur valley area, and an ecological leisure area. Among them, the amusement area is equipped with more than 20 large amusement facilities, including pirate ships, roller coasters, 360 degree gyro spinning "flying saucers", 60 meter high free fall equipment, etc. Four 3D cinemas will be set up in the children's theme museum area. More than 100 dinosaurs in Dinosaur Valley, equipped with photoelectric and other devices, reproduce real scenes. The ecological leisure area has planted many cherry blossoms, azaleas, and other plants. Camellia, cherry blossoms, peonies, plum blossoms, peach blossoms, and lush green tea gardens emit a refreshing fragrance. The Qinglong Lakers Residence Forest has been built, and there is also a golf club, which is very suitable for families to go and play. There are 30000 camellias, 10000 cherry blossoms, and peonies growing here, with clusters of plum blossoms and peach blossoms, and green tea gardens emitting a refreshing fragrance. On the winding mountain road, tall cedars highlight a layered sense of intensity with the mountain terrain, while golden acacia trees adorn the area. Health plants such as ginkgo and Cryptomeria, honey plants such as palm and holly, bird loving plants such as ivy and Bauhinia, and aromatic plants such as thyme and dandelion all gather here, singing birds and fragrant flowers, creating a unique paradise. Playing golf: "Jinling is a beautiful land and the capital of ten emperors." The golf club located next to Ginkgo Lake fully utilizes its unique natural and cultural environment, as well as millions of osmanthus and ginkgo trees, becoming a high standard golf course. The scene of Ginkgo Lake Ball is exquisitely designed, featuring a thousand year old tree, a thousand acre camellia viewing area, sand pits, greens, a clear reflecting pool, undulating hills, and the unique ginkgo trees of the golf course. Let you fully enjoy the fun of swinging while being intoxicated by the beautiful environment around you. The clubhouse of the stadium also has a well-equipped equipment store, a unique leisure restaurant, an outdoor bar, and various creative activities to meet the needs of football players. On top of exquisite facilities, with a sincere heart, Nanjing Ginkgo Lake Stadium will promise high-quality service with high-level management anytime, anywhere. Full text 

The Bund International Architecture Exhibition Group is located on the west bank of the Pujiang River, starting from Waibaidu Bridge in the north and ending at Jinling East Road in the south. With a length of about 1800 meters, 52 historical buildings with different styles and strong exotic colors are lined up in a row, becoming one of the major attractions of the Bund. You can glimpse the century old historical changes of Shanghai Bund from here. The Bund, since Shanghai was designated as a commercial port in the 1840s, has become the political, financial, commercial, and cultural center of foreign powers in Shanghai, where foreign banks, businesses, and associations gather. Strolling along the eastern coast of Zhongshan, you will see various historical buildings in different styles, such as the Customs Building, the South and North Towers of the Peace Hotel, the former HSBC Building, the Asia Building, the Waldorf Astoria Hotel, and the Beneficial Building. Combined with Gothic spires, Baroque columns, Spanish balconies, and ancient Greek domes, it is as if you have traveled to a foreign street in the last century. At night, the lights are bright and pleasing to the eye. Most of the buildings have now been converted into commercial office buildings such as the headquarters of China Pacific Insurance Company, the Consulate General of Thailand in Shanghai, the Shanghai headquarters of China Merchants Group, the headquarters of Pudong Development Bank, Shanghai Customs, the Shanghai Federation of Trade Unions, and the Shanghai Foreign Exchange Trading Center, which are not open to the public. Some buildings have also become consumer centers, such as the famous 18th Bund, which was the headquarters of Standard Chartered Bank in China. The first and second floors are the flagship stores of many international famous brands, such as Cartier, and upwards are the "18 Creative Center on the Bund", the Cantonese restaurant "Tanwailou", the Michelin 3-star three-star chefs restaurant, and the open-air river view bar, which are the must see places to enjoy the nightlife in Shanghai. Full text 

The 90 meter outdoor sightseeing corridor is located on the high-rise of a famous building in Shanghai, providing a unique perspective that allows tourists to overlook the beautiful scenery of the entire Shanghai city. This is an ideal place for photography enthusiasts and tourists seeking exciting experiences.
opening_hours: Open from 08:00 to 22:00 throughout the year

summary: The Shanghai Eternal Scene Area is located in the World Expo Park on the banks of the Huangpu River, and is a completely new scenic area that subverts imagination. Wandering through the streets of time and space, the streets of eternal love, and the markets of heaven, it feels like a world apart. Magical Forest, Forest Ranch, Love Valley, Elf Valley, Children's Playground, and other scenic spots step by step. There are over ten theaters and performance venues, including the Eternal Love Theater, Performing Arts Theater, Forest Theater, Cliff Theater, Punk Square, Music Square, and Guozhuang Square. Large scale interactive experience projects such as "Battle of Shanghai", "Olivia", "Liaozhai Jinghun", horror research institute, fantasy space, virtual space, multimedia light and shadow show, etc., are thrilling and soul stirring! The scenic area is full of internet celebrity check-in points, and the experience of changing into thousands of outfits allows you to have a versatile life. There are big plays every day, trendy parties every week, and people of all ages can have fun, whether it's sunny or rainy. The large-scale song and dance performance 'Eternal Love in Shanghai' is a must see for a lifetime, based on the magnificent history of Shanghai and depicting the past and present of Shanghai. 3000 tons of Huangpu River water flow into the sea, with tens of thousands of stage machinery and equipment reaching the sky and earth, providing a visual feast and soul stirring experience! It's a heavyweight bomb of magic art!! Shanghai Eternal Scene Zone, give me one day, give you back a thousand years! More than two thousand years ago, Shanghai became the fiefdom of Huang Xie, one of the "Four Young Masters of the Warring States Period" and the Prince of Chunshen. He led the people to gradually develop this place from a fishing village in the East China Sea to a land of fish and rice in Jiangnan. In order to commemorate the immortal achievements of Lord Chunshen and the great wisdom of the Shanghai ancestors, later generations referred to Shanghai as "Shen" and the fishing tool bamboo fence "Hu". The first performance of 'Jiangnan in Shanghai' depicts the leisurely flow of the Pujiang River for thousands of years, nurturing the Jiangnan in poetry and painting. Jiangnan, you are a painting, misty with mist and rain, painted with ink and blue; Jiangnan, you are a song, with gentle words from Wu Nong, depicting the endless vicissitudes of life in the world. A ship, an umbrella, a relationship, this is the Jiangnan region of Shanghai. In the second episode of "Shanghai Beach", it is said that "the river and sea connect to Tianjin, and the city is in the southeast." In 1843, Shanghai officially opened up as a port to the outside world, and foreign firms flooded in one after another. From then on, the poetic and picturesque Jiangnan region of Shanghai became a bustling beach where Chinese and foreign cultures coexisted. The third episode of 'Modern Times' was held in Shanghai in the 1920s and 1930s, where Eastern and Western cultures intersected. Let's experience the modern era of the Ten Mile Market on the neon lit night in Shanghai. The fourth episode of 'The Age of Awakening': Shanghai is the starting point of the Chinese revolution. Young people full of revolutionary ideals, represented by Chen Yannian and Chen Qiaonian, have marched forward and dyed this land red with their youth and blood. Let's revisit those magnificent and tumultuous years. Full text 

The Xitianmu Mountain Scenic Area is known as the Great Tree Kingdom, with the "Great Tree King" with a tree diameter of over 2 meters, ancient ginkgo trees known as "living fossils", towering golden pine trees, and willow trees that can be as large as ten circles This place is quiet, beautiful, and suitable for hiking. You can go up to the observation deck of the Five Dynasties Hall and enjoy the beautiful scenery below. In spring and summer, I see green trees providing shade, and in autumn, I see the layers of ginkgo and golden pine trees gradually staining.

Located at the mouth of the Yangtze River, facing Shanghai across the Yangtze River, Chongming Island is the third largest island in China. There are a lot of geological relics and mudflat on the island. The island itself is a large geological park. Therefore, the scope of Chongming Island National Geopark covers the entire Chongming Island. Here, you can go to Dongtan Wetland Park to watch the sunrise and migratory birds, go to Xisha Wetland Park to enjoy the sunset, or go to Dongping National Forest Park to camp and ride bicycles with your family, enjoying various fun activities away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Chongming Island does not have those high-rise buildings, it is more rural and fields, with fresh air and refreshing plant fragrance, which is very suitable for weekend vacations. At the northwest end of Chongming Island, there are Xisha Wetland and Mingzhu Lake Park. Xisha Wetland is a great place to enjoy the sunset, and standing by the river, you can overlook the boats passing by on the Yangtze River. Autumn and winter are good seasons for watching migratory birds; Mingzhu Lake is adjacent to the Xisha Wetland, making it a great place for cycling around the lake and relaxing. At the eastern end of the island, there is Dongtan Wetland Park, which faces the sea and is a great place to watch the sunrise and bird watching. In the central part of Chongming Island, there is Dongping National Forest Park, where the forests are lush. You can ride bicycles, play paintball, slide grass, barbecue, and camp here, making it suitable for outings with family and friends. There are also many farmhouses on Chongming Island where you can come and eat farm vegetables, fish, and pick seasonal fruits. You can also choose a different way of traveling by cycling around the island, getting close to nature while also advocating for environmental protection. There are "one meter bike" rental points at the entrance of the main scenic spots on Chongming Island. Chengqiao Town in the southern part of Chongming Island is a bustling area on the island, with famous attractions such as Chongming Academy (Chongming Museum) and Yingzhou Park, as well as various hotels, restaurants, and hotels. Visiting Chongming Island usually takes 1-2 days. Whether by bus, boat or self driving, it is very convenient to go there, but the time spent on the road is still relatively long. So if you want to take a one-day trip to Chongming, it is recommended to drive or join a group. It takes about 2 hours to drive from the city center to the attractions on the island. Full text 

The Shanghai Museum has a collection of bronze artifacts from various eras since the Xia Dynasty, many of which are national treasures that have been passed down and recorded repeatedly, forming a complete system, complete variety, and many exquisite collections. The "Ancient Chinese Bronze Museum" in the East Pavilion is the sixth exhibition renovation in 50 years, presenting the audience with a relatively complete display of ancient Chinese bronze ware both domestically and internationally. At present, there are more than 500 selected exhibits on display, reflecting the development and evolution of ancient Chinese bronze ware from the late summer of the 18th century BC to the mid Qing Dynasty of the 19th century AD. The exhibition hall takes the development history of Chinese bronze craftsmanship as a clue and is divided into seven sections: the emergence period, the cultivation period, the peak period, the transformation period, the renewal period, the integration period, and the retro period. The exhibits fully demonstrate the characteristics of bronze craftsmanship in different periods and jointly showcase the brilliant brilliance of Chinese bronze art. There is also a section on bronze ware production technology, vividly showcasing how ancient laboring people used their astonishing intelligence and nimble hands to create the splendid and magnificent Chinese bronze culture. Compared with the People's Square building, the bronze exhibition hall in the East Hall has been adjusted and upgraded in terms of panel structure, panel content, unit descriptions, instrument descriptions, and exhibits. The Shanghai Maglev Train starts from Longyang Road Station on Metro Line 2 in the west and ends at Pudong Terminal 1 and 2 Station in the east. The total length of the line is 30 kilometers, with a single track running time of only 7 minutes and 20 seconds. It is the world's first high-speed maglev train to be put into commercial operation, with a departure interval of 15 to 40 minutes. The maglev train utilizes the principle of "repulsion between the same sex and attraction between the opposite sex" to give the magnet the ability to resist gravity, causing the body to completely detach from the track and float about 1 centimeter away from the track, creating a miracle of near zero altitude space flight. The design speed of Shanghai maglev train is 430 kilometers per hour, but the actual speed is about 380 kilometers per hour. The turning radius is 8000 meters, and it is almost a straight line when observed with the naked eye. The smallest radius is also 1300 meters. Passengers will not feel uncomfortable. The entire track is equipped with internationally advanced isolation devices within a 50 meter radius on both sides. The windows of maglev trains are deceleration glass, allowing passengers to better enjoy the scenery outside. The deceleration glass has a curved deformation at the edge in contact with the vehicle body, precisely because this curvature can cause the external scenery to deform when passing through the curvature, thereby affecting the visual perception of passengers inside the car and producing a deceleration effect. And there are gradually fading black decorative edges on the edges of the windshield, which also have a certain effect. Full text 

poiName: Soong Ching Ling Memorial Residence In Shanghai
summary: The Memorial Hall of Soong Ching ling's Former Residence is located in Shanghai, the hometown of Soong Ching ling. It is a quiet place amidst the hustle and bustle of Huaihai Road. The main building consists of the Soong Ching ling Cultural Relics Museum, garage, and main building. The main building was the residence of Soong Ching ling before his death, located in the center of the courtyard, surrounded by gardens and lawns, and surrounded by more than 30 century old camphor trees. Soong Ching ling had a special fondness for camphor trees, as described in the Chinese text "The Camphor Trees in Soong Ching ling's Former Residence" in the eighth volume of the Su Education Press. This milky white building was originally a German private villa. From 1949 to 1963, Soong Ching ling worked and lived here for nearly 15 years. It was an important place for her to engage in state affairs activities, leaving many precious historical moments and a large number of cultural relics. The first thing you see when you enter the Memorial Hall of Soong Ching ling's former residence is a white statue of Soong Ching ling. Behind the statue is the Soong Ching ling Cultural Relics Museum, which houses more than 15000 pieces of Soong Ching ling's cultural relics, including photos, correspondence, Soong Ching ling's university graduation certificate, books, daily necessities, gifts for state events, items belonging to Soong Ching ling's relatives, and the Sun Yat sen seal carefully preserved by Soong Ching ling after enduring hardships. Next to the cultural relics museum is a garage, where two cars are parked. One is a "Red Flag" brand sedan transferred from Beijing to Shanghai for Song Qingling's use, and the other is a "Jim" brand sedan gifted by Stalin. The main building on the south side maintains the original decoration of Soong Ching ling before her death. The ground floor consists of a hall, a living room, a dining room, and a library. The walls of the hall are adorned with the traditional Chinese painting "Running on a Horse" gifted by Xu Beihong, while the back wall of the living room is adorned with the portrait of Sun Yat sen; The second floor is the bedroom and office, with a set of rattan furniture given to Song Qingling by her parents as a dowry when she got married. The sofa and coffee table were used by Mr. Sun Yat-sen. The former residence provides free volunteer explanation services every hour, and the specific explanation time will be posted on the notice at the entrance of the scenic area. There is no catering service provided within the scenic area, but there are many places to eat on Huaihai Road, one of the bustling streets in Shanghai outside the scenic area. There is a shopping point at the entrance of the scenic area - the tourist center, which mainly sells souvenirs made around the concept of "universal love" of Sun Yat sen, the husband of Soong Ching ling. Currently, there are 26 farmhouse tourism operators in the village, with 300 beds and a small conference reception center. summary:
Linwudong is named after the cave is as flat as a house, and the stones standing in the cave are like a forest. It ranks ninth among the top ten caves in Taoism, and is called the ninth cave in the world. It is also known as "the secluded and empty sky of the left god". Taoist cultural relics such as golden dragons, jade slips and idols of the Tang Dynasty have been unearthed in Linwudong. Thousands of ancient poems praised: "A mountain flies in Taihu Lake, and thousands of beauties are hidden deep in the forest house cave".  
There are holes in the cave, which are connected, secluded and deep, curved and folded. There are stone scenes such as stone room, dragon bed, silver room, stone bell, stone drum, golden court, jade pillar, Baizhi, Jinsha, dragon basin, geofanmen, stone swallow, hidden spring, milk spring, etc., among which it is unpredictable and confusing. 
 
There are many talented people in the history of Taoist culture, and they often live far away from the world and buried hills. Located on the south side of Linwu Cave, also known as Wujie Jingshe, it is the seclusion place of Wujie lay people in Song Dynasty. He was the magistrate of Pingjiang (now Suzhou) less than two months before he was dismissed from office, so he built a garden to live in seclusion, claiming to be his residence "Daoyin Garden". His "The Record of Daoyin Garden" is engraved at the entrance of the forest house cave. 
 
The best time to travel here is in early spring, which is a wonderful place to enjoy plum blossoms. As soon as you enter Xishan Island, along the lakeside hills, plum blossoms are blooming all over the mountains and plains, and they are snow-white. People enter the forest, like entering the ocean of flowers. "There are flowers and branches everywhere in the mountains, and I don't know how far and near it is." It is warm in winter and cool in summer, and Linwudong has a constant temperature and wonderful scenery, so it was praised as a fairyland on earth by the ancients. 
 
 
Roaming route: Rain Cave-Gefan Cave-Tianhou Bie Palace-Bing Cave-Dragon Cave-Yanggu Cave 
 
[food] 
 
The "Three Treasures of Taihu Lake" (whitebait, white shrimp and plum ectenes) abundant here can be tasted according to your preference, and it is enough to accompany two or three farm dishes.

Among them, more than 300,000 varieties of peonies are planted, and more than 2 million varieties of more than 100 varieties of trees, shrubs and various plants are planted. In terms of environmental layout, it is known for plants, which are natural and smooth, highlighting the gardening style of traditional royal gardens. China National Garden is based on the history and culture of Sui and Tang Dynasties, with peony culture as the main content, and integrates history and culture, peony culture and garden landscape. Peonies with beautiful crowns, plants in various shapes, mountains with strange stones, pavilions with different customs, lakes with rippling clear water, buildings with ancient rich charm... The goal is to create a peony themed scenic area with a modern atmosphere and international perspective, integrating peony cultivation, culture, big data research, and peony industry. As one of the highlights of the Mudan Pavilion scenic area, the Mudan Museum is located on the first and second floors of the main attic of the Mudan Pavilion scenic area. It adopts a display mode that combines physical exhibition with interactive experience, cultural relic display with scene reproduction, controllable natural light with artificial light, and traditional exhibition with digital technology. Luxiang Ancient Village is located on the west side of Dongshan Peninsula, which extends into the Taihu Lake Lake, adjacent to the Taihu Lake. It is the hometown of Prime Minister Wang Ao during Zhengde's reign of the Ming Dynasty. The TV drama "Orange is Red" was filmed in the back mountain of the village. There are not many tourists in the ancient village, and the stone paved streets winding through the alleys. Most of the Ming and Qing Dynasty buildings used as scenic spots have beautiful Su style small gardens. Loquat trees and orange trees planted by every family bring seasonal fruits, and the fresh lake food of the Taihu Lake Lake can not be missed. Several shops on Zishi Street, the main street in the village, have started to open up early. You can have a bowl of Su style noodles and buy some specialty white jade cake. For dinner, it is necessary to taste the "the Taihu Lake Lake Three Whites" white fish, whitebait and white shrimp in the farmhouse. In autumn, you can eat the Taihu Lake Lake hairy crabs. Four season green products are famous for their Biluochun tea in April, loquat in May, and oranges in autumn. However, don't randomly pick the fruits of the villagers' labor. If you want to eat, you can purchase them from the villagers. Although the ancient village is large, the main attractions are concentrated in the short Purple Stone Street and the nearby alleys. There is Luxiang Community Museum Center between the north entrance and the south entrance. The north entrance where the memorial archway stands is the main entrance. After entering the village, you can see a pool of water. On the left, you will pass the pavilion "Cold Valley Ferry" near the water, and then follow the signs to reach Zishi Street. The three Ming Dynasty memorial archway built to flaunt Wang Ao Lianzhong Jieyuan, Huiyuan and Tanhua stand on the street, which are the landmark buildings of the ancient village. The life of the ancient village is full of flavor. In the morning, you can see the hawkers selling vegetables under the Huiyuan memorial archway. When the vendors change to sell the fresh lake food of the Taihu Lake Lake, the day when the ancient village faces tourists can be regarded as the official start. Huaide Hall and Huaigu Hall are both located on Zishi Street. Huaide Hall is also a folk collection museum, but the small house is filled with antiques collected from various places. The mini garden even uses stone slabs engraved with patterns and characters as steps. There are exquisite carvings on the doors and windows of Huaigu Hall, and the private garden of Linli Garden is delightful. There is a nine python screen in the back building. The former residence of Wang Ao, Huihe Hall, is located in Wenning Lane to the south of Huaigu Hall. It is a large-scale house in the village, with a library, private school, and stove. There are beautiful gardens at the end of the central axis and on the west side. At the other end of the alley behind Huihe Hall is Cuihe Hall, where you can see the brick carved gatehouse, but it may not be open. There is Suigao Hall (Dongting Merchant Gang Exhibition Hall) in Kangzhuang Lane south of Wenning Lane. The Baojian Hall in the southern alley provides accommodation, but the prices are not cheap. The symmetrical layout of Dream Garden and Hui Garden is a highlight. From the steps beside Hangu Ferry, you can go up the mountain to look at the ancient village of Luxiang. In the evening, you can go to the fishing village of the Taihu Lake Lake opposite the ancient village to see the fishing boats at the port and the sunset on the Taihu Lake Lake. Full text 

summary: The Wulongtan Scenic Area is located in the southwest of Ningbo city, not far from the city, but you can enjoy the beautiful mountain scenery. As the name suggests, the major attractions within the scenic area are the five pools of water, accompanied by lush mountains around them, which are refreshing and pleasant in summer and autumn seasons. The mountain is neither high nor low, it is just suitable for relaxing the mind. The Longtan Flying Waterfall Scenic Area, which has been developed in the scenic area, offers views of the Five Well Longtan, mountain streams and waterfalls, as well as ancient dragon sacrificial altars and other landscapes. During the tour, you can walk back and forth throughout the entire journey, or take the sightseeing bus within the scenic area to the tourist square near Mitsui Longtan halfway up the mountain. From here, walking up the mountain is relatively easy. If you walk the whole way here, it takes about an hour to see the scenery. There is a statue of a woman and four children on the square at the entrance of the scenic area, telling the legend of the origin of the Five Dragon Pool. From here, follow the signs on the hiking trail towards the depths of the valley. After walking for about 40 minutes, you can see a huge red "dragon" stone carving on the rocks from afar. In front of the stone carving, a large waterfall pours down, called "Baizhang Waterfall". Here, not far ahead is the Five Dragon Divine Hall, where you can faintly hear the sound of pools and streams ahead. In the following journey, follow the hiking trail up the mountain to visit Wujing Longtan one by one. The road is not very flat, but it is not too difficult to walk. In order, they are Fuze Lake, Zhaoze Lake, Runze Lake, Bailong Lake, and Chilong Lake. Although they are both combinations of waterfalls and ponds, they have different shapes, with some ponds being green and others being blue. Many people find the fourth well charming, while the fifth well exudes momentum. The water flow in the fifth well does not flow straight down like other waterfalls, but instead oscillates left and right in the cavity between two huge rocks, and finally falls into the pool. 4、 There is a bamboo corridor tea room between Wujing Longtan, where you can drink tea and rest your feet when you are tired from walking. In summer, visitors can often be seen playing in the water and washing their faces by the stream, which is very cool. Further up the fifth well, there is a dragon altar at the source of the pond, where locals pray for good weather. Although it is newly built, the towering dragon shaped totem pole also has a certain aura. There is a incense burner in front of the altar, where visitors can also pray for blessings. Most people will turn back down the mountain at the Dragon Sacrificial Altar. If you walk up the mountain, it is recommended to return to the sightseeing station and take a bus out of the scenic area, which saves time and effort, and does not require a U-turn. Full text 

Yanwu Bridge, located on Huandao Road, has a deck elevation of only 5 meters. It is considered to be the nearest bridge to sea level in the world at present. At high tide, the sea water is almost flush with the bottom of the bridge. 
Standing on the closed viewing platform, you can have a panoramic view of the endless stream on the bridge and the boats coming and going on the sea. You can also look up at the nearby Twin Towers and overlook Gulangyu Island on the other side. 
Dusk and night are the most fascinating times of Yanwu Bridge. At sunset, the bridge outlines black lines in the orange-red sea sky, and locals walk or exercise under the bridge. After nightfall, the starting point lights on the bridge, and from a distance, it is a dazzling band of light that staggered and circled.

The Natural Color Art Museum is a non-profit art and cultural institution privately invested and managed by Mr. Chen Hanxing. It is mainly dedicated to promoting the exploration of Chinese contemporary art in experimental aspects and attempting to actively explore cross disciplinary approaches in various art forms, including painting, sculpture, installation, performance art, photography, video, architecture, design, music, and more. The art museum is located by the canal, built by the water, covering an area of 13 acres. The main shape is composed of three connected cubes, and the facade is made of more than one million green bricks with concave and convex tiling. The green and gray texture gives the entire building a restrained and tense atmosphere, complementing the surrounding natural ecology such as rivers, lakes, and residential buildings. The art museum has clear functional zoning, including entrance hall, themed exhibition area, image hall, office area, artist studios and apartments, member clubs, cafes, art shops, etc. The spaces are cleverly connected and relatively independent, suitable for exhibitions and themed solo shows. The concept of environmental protection and ecology are fully highlighted in the architectural philosophy, and the large-scale application of ancient wood and bricks makes the entire building ancient and natural. Traditional elements and contemporary concepts are ingeniously combined here.

shortFeatures: Fuzhou political and cultural center
summary: Wuyi Square is located at the southern foot of Yushan in the center of Fuzhou, covering an area of about 4.5 hectares and a green area of 31,373 square meters. In the Qing Dynasty, it was the "South Teaching Field" for military training. After the Revolution of 1911, it was the stadium of the masses. After it was converted into an assembly square in the 1970s, it has been the center of Rongcheng. May Day Square is the political and cultural center of Fuzhou, and an important place for citizens to enjoy the cool air. The flag-raising ceremony of New Year's Day and National Day in Fuzhou is held here every year. The square has a strong political and cultural atmosphere, with a musical fountain in the middle, a group of white sculptures in the pool, and eight dancing girls about 5 meters high, which means that "daughters of Bamin" live happily in the land of Bamin.

Jiuxian Temple is not only one of the Taoist temples in Fujian Province, but also the carving site of the official version of the Daoist Canon "Zhenghe Wanshou Daoist Canon" in China. It holds an important position in the history of Taoism in Fujian and even in China. According to the "Religious Chronicles of Fuzhou City", Yushan Jiuxian Temple was originally the site of the Ming King Bao Palace during the Five Dynasties period. It was rebuilt in the second year of Chongning in the Song Dynasty (1103) and named Tianning Wanshou Temple. It was renamed Jiuxian Temple in the early years of Zhizheng in the Yuan Dynasty (1341) and rebuilt during the Kangxi period of the Qing Dynasty (1662-1722). In 1922, it was destroyed by fire and later rebuilt through donations from believers and mountain pilgrims in various places. The dragon and phoenix bluestone columns in front of the pavilion are masterpieces of famous craftsmen in the Qing Dynasty. Today, the Nine Immortals Temple in Yushan is also known as the Heavenly Lord Hall.

The Qigong Temple is located to the east of Shanbai Pagoda Temple, on the side of Bushan Jingshe, and was established to worship the famous anti Japanese general Qi Jiguang. Zhejiang General Qi Jiguang (1528-1587) was an outstanding military strategist of the Ming Dynasty, with the courtesy name Jing and the pen name Nantang. He was born in Penglai, Shandong. In the 41st year of the Jiajing reign (1562), he led troops to support Fujian's resistance against the Japanese and won three major battles in Hengyu, Ningde, Niutian, Fuqing, and Lindun, Putian, dealing heavy blows to the Japanese pirates. When the class teacher returned to Zhejiang, officials and gentry from Fuzhou held a banquet on the distant platform of Shanping to welcome the wind, and erected a monument to commemorate his achievements. Later generations built the Qigong Temple here, but it was later abolished. The current temple was rebuilt in 1918. The temple hall is built on a stone hill, with five pine trees next to it. In front of it is the Pingyuan Terrace, with a pedestrian bridge spanning between the terraces. In the east of the hall, there are strange stones stacked on top of each other, and there is a stone in the middle that looks like a bed, with the words "Drunken Stone" engraved on it. It is said to be the place where Duke Qi lay drunk. On the stone bank is the Drunken Stone Pavilion, and to the north of the pavilion is the Penglai Pavilion, as well as the Rongshou Rock, Bushan Jingshe, and other attractions. The main hall of the temple is decorated with a statue of Duke Qi, and four historical paintings are hung on the walls on both sides of the hall, depicting the achievements of Duke Qi in resisting the Japanese invasion, leading troops to assist Fujian, achieving three victories in fierce battles, and celebrating the Pingyuan victory.

summary: There is also a beautiful legend about the origin of drinking water rock. According to legend, more than 900 years ago, Master Shen Yan, the founder of Yongquan Temple, sang sutras here. In the first year of Jiaqing, they took Lantau Island as their nest, went in and out of the Pearl River Estuary, and engraved the words "Wanhai Pingbo" and "God's Palace" on Dong'ao Island. It is said that when they left, they buried 18 boxes of treasures near the stone carvings, and divided them into "eighteen lines of hidden treasures and eighteen lines of treasures", waiting to return in the future. Where the treasure is hidden has always been a mystery. As a result, such a ballad was left on the island: "Eighteen boxes of jewelry, eighteen lines of boxes, who can get it, drink porridge early and slaughter sheep late".

The project is planned as a Hainan ecological tourism cultural theme park that integrates cultural performance, tourism, leisure, catering, folk museums, and folk culture inheritance. It is the leading project of the Hainan Flower World, the last stop for tourists from outside the island and the ideal scenic spot for leisure and vacation of Haikou and Qiongbei citizens. The scenic area was awarded the national AAA level scenic spot on November 23, 2012. The fantasy future song and dance show in the scenic area covers various art forms such as ethnic dance, magic, acrobatics, laser dance, and mirror people. It dances youth and calls for the future, creating a spiritual feast that is popular, healthy, appealing to both the refined and the popular, and full of positive energy. The museum was built in the late Ming Dynasty and has a history of more than 400 years; The four characters "Shuxiangmen Di" on the main entrance plaque were personally inscribed by Emperor Kangxi in the 46th year of his reign, and it has a history of 315 years. The Qiongzhou Cultural Style Street Scenic Area revolves around the core of the Li ethnic culture in Hainan. Some Feng Shui experts blamed the ground breaking for injuring the dragon's veins, and the dragon's blood flowed out. On the other hand, the test results of well water showed that the redness of well water was due to iron sulfide and mercury compounds. In any case, because of the red well water, the district gained the name of Hung Hom.

The pavilion has 31 sloping surfaces, embedded with colored glass, and various flowers are printed with gold and silver powder. There are golden chickens and brightly colored exotic flowers carved on the corners of the eight pavilions. At the top of the pavilion is a lotus flower canopy and a wind chime, with a gentle breeze carrying a pleasant sound. On the mountaintop about two miles north of the Octagonal Pavilion, there stands a towering Buddhist pagoda, facing the Octagonal Pavilion from afar. Between the Jingzhen Buddhist Temple and the Octagonal Pavilion, there is a huge ancient tree with a tall trunk that only a few people can embrace, embellishing the beautiful scenery of the Octagonal Pavilion.

The museum is located on the northeast side of Hanyuan Hall in Daming Palace Ruins Park. It is a comprehensive museum with the theme of displaying the history and culture of Daming Palace in Tang Dynasty. 
The official palace, as a symbol of the majesty of the Tang Dynasty, is the most prominent and magnificent building complex in the Tang Dynasty. 
The circumference of the palace wall is about 7.6 kilometers, with 11 gates on all sides. There are more than 40 proven bases such as halls, terraces, buildings and pavilions.  
In the northeast corner of the museum, there is a miniature landscape of Daming Palace restored according to the scale of 1:15. The tallest miniature palace is about 2 meters high. You can "walk" on the landscape street and integrate into Daming Palace in the prosperous Tang Dynasty.

The Xuanzheng Hall Site is located in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, China and is an important part of the Tang Dynasty's Daming Palace. The Xuanzheng Hall is the main political activity venue in the Daming Palace, where the emperor holds court meetings and handles government affairs. The site is now an archaeological excavation site and has important value for studying Tang Dynasty politics, culture, architecture, and other aspects.
opening_hours: Open from 09:00 to 17:00 throughout the year

shortFeatures: The place where ancient emperors held their daily affairs
summary: Behind the Xuanzheng Hall is the Purple Chen Gate, and inside the door is the Purple Chen Hall, which is the main hall of the sleeping area. Zi Chen Hall has Bathing Hall and Greenhouse Hall in the east, Yanying Hall and Hanxiang Hall in the west, which are juxtaposed from east to west, and are the daily activities of the emperor. There is a horizontal street in the north of Zi Chen Hall, and the north of the street is the bedroom hall area where the concubine lives. Zi Chen Hall is the third hall, and it is the main hall of the inner office of Daming Palace. Most of the emperor's daily affairs are held in this hall, so it is also called the Hall of the Son of Heaven. Excluding the inner garden, it is about 1,200 meters from Danfengmen to Zichen Hall, which is slightly longer than the distance from Tiananmen Square in the Forbidden City in Beijing to Baohe Hall. Entering Zichen Hall is also called "entering the pavilion" because you must pass through the east and west upper pavilion gates around the former Xuanzheng Hall. It was a great honor for ministers at that time to be able to "enter the cabinet" to discuss military affairs with the emperor. Participation in the court was the most important political activity of officials in Beijing in the Tang Dynasty. According to the regulations of the system, there are three different times and forms of participating in the Tang Dynasty. One is the grand dynasty meeting held on the Yuan Day and the winter solstice, which is the most solemn and requires "big furnishings". At that time, the emperor will "wear the crown (the winter solstice will wear the crimson gauze robe), and the imperial palace will be used, and the canopy will be straightened. The police and guards are as usual ", and they accept the court to attend the court and congratulate them (Volume 97 of Kaiyuan Ritual of the Tang Dynasty, Emperor Yuanzheng receives congratulations from the courts in the winter solstice). On that day, "the crown prince offered his birthday, the second public offered his birthday, the second middle book ordered to play the tables of various states, the assistant minister of Huangmen played auspicious auspicious, the minister of household affairs played the contributions of various states, the minister of rites played the contributions of all fans, the Taishi ordered to play the clouds, and the attendant played the ceremony, and then the middle book ordered to offer his birthday with the official, and all the people in the hall shouted long live" (Tang Liudian, Volume 4, Ministry of Rites). There are the largest number of participants in the court, including princes and relatives, civil and military officials above Beijing and Kowloon, local court envoys, descendants of Zhou and Sui Dynasties, and guest envoys from Fan countries. After the court congratulations, there is a banquet. The Zheng and Winter Dynasties were originally held in Taiji Hall of Taiji Palace, but after Emperor Gaozong lived in Daming Palace, it was held in Hanyuan Hall. In the late Tang Dynasty, it was also held in Xuanzheng Hall behind Hanyuan Hall.

The Linde Hall is located in the west of the Daming Palace, northwest of the Zichen Hall. It was built during the Linde period of Emperor Gaozong of Tang Dynasty and was a place where the emperor held palace banquets, watched music and dance performances, and met with envoys. In the third year of Chang'an (703 AD), Empress Wu Zetian once met and hosted a banquet here to entertain the Japanese envoy to Tang, Su Tianzhen. At that time, it would have been a very honorable thing to attend a banquet at the Lin De Hall, just like attending a state banquet today. The foundation of the Linde Hall site is 130 meters long from north to south and over 80 meters wide from east to west. The original three adjacent halls were built on a high pedestal, as well as east and west pavilions, Yuyi and Jielin buildings, surrounded by corridors, connecting various parts together. The site has unearthed a large number of black tube tiles, as well as a small amount of glazed tiles, Chi Shou stone carvings, stone pillar fragments, and lotus square bricks. This is a single palace with a complex structure in ancient China.

Xi'an Incident Memorial Hall is a special memorial hall built on the basis of General Zhang Xueliang Mansion and General Yang Hucheng Zhiyuan Villa, the important former sites of Xi'an Incident, with a total area of 9,141 square meters. It was built and opened to the outside world on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the Xi'an Incident in December 1986. Over the past 20 years, the museum has received nearly 2 million visitors. It has been named as the first batch of 100 patriotism education demonstration bases in China, youth patriotism education bases in Shaanxi Province and Xi'an, national defense education bases, red scarf practice education bases and one of the 100 classic red tourism scenic spots in China.

poiName: Liyuan Liyuan Guild Hall-Chuan Opera Changing Face (wenshuyuan store)
summary: During the Qing Dynasty, a new term emerged in the history of Chinese opera: Pear Garden Guild Hall. Traditional Chinese opera has always been known as "Pear Garden", and opera actors are also known as "Pear Garden Children". Previously, the Pear Garden Guild Hall was a union organization and spiritual home for opera artists. With the development of the times, opera has become a treasure of traditional Chinese art and an important form of folk culture. There are a wide variety of interesting theater genres, with performances that include singing and dancing, speaking and singing, literature and martial arts. It integrates singing, acting, recitation, and fighting, and is unique in the history of world theater. Liyuan Guild Hall, co founded by renowned Sichuan opera actress Hu Xuemei and folk entrepreneur Liao Xiaojian (formerly a Sichuan opera actor), is located in Wenshufang, the central leisure and tourism area of Chengdu. The association originated after the Wenchuan earthquake in 2008. As an entertainment fan, the association spontaneously organized "Huimin Performance" and became a spiritual pillar for countless theater fans during a special period, insisting on "living for oneself and singing for the audience". Today's Liyuan Association is not only a national intangible cultural heritage "Sichuan Opera Exercise Base", but also jointly established the Intangible Cultural Heritage Sichuan Opera Inheritance Public Welfare Fund with the Chengdu Charity Federation, contributing its own strength to the inheritance of Sichuan Opera culture. The pioneering "Intangible Cultural Heritage Sichuan Opera Parent Child Special Session" has attracted numerous families to enter Sichuan Opera and learn about it. The Pear Garden Guild Hall focuses on Sichuan opera and promotes the reputation of "viewing the world through Sichuan opera". Here, you can step into the front and back of the house, get up close with artists, and watch a variety of Sichuan opera performances: face changing, spitting fire, rolling lanterns, Kung Fu tea art, puppetry, hand shadow play, and more, experiencing the charm of traditional culture. The Pear Garden Guild Hall attracts friends and gathers famous domestic opera masters and actors to stop here. While presenting authentic Sichuan opera culture to tourists visiting Sichuan, we will also create special performances of classic local operas and showcase folk skills. The Pear Garden Guild Hall is located in Gaoyuan, where you can watch plays, enjoy tea, and taste local specialty snacks; If you are a "theater fan", you can play a famous role here and experience the "one minute on stage, ten years of achievement off stage". If you come for the "hobby", welcome to join the "children of the pear garden", and we will carry forward the Chinese opera culture together. Full text 

The Qing Si Palace is located in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, China. It is a historic ancient building that attracts many tourists with its unique architectural style and profound cultural heritage.

The Taiye Pool Site is located within the Daming Palace National Heritage Park, north of the Yuan Hall, Xuanzheng Hall, and Zichen Hall. It was an important royal pool garden during the Tang Dynasty. The Taiye Pool was first excavated in the eighth year of the Zhenguan reign (634 AD) and officially put into use in the second year of the Longshuo reign (662 AD) until it was abandoned at the end of the Tang Dynasty and later buried on flat ground. The Daming Palace is divided into a front palace and a back palace. The back palace is arranged around an ether pool and is a royal garden scenic area of the palace. The Taiye Pool is divided into the East Pool and the West Pool, with the West Pool being the main one. Archaeologists have discovered a large number of pillar holes along the bank of the Taiye Pool, which are densely distributed along the pool shore and are water pavilion buildings that ride on the shore and cross the water. Exquisite and rich relics such as brick and stone components, ceramics, copper and iron ornaments, bones, glass beads, shell carving fragments, and clay blocks have been unearthed here. On the south bank of Taiye Pool in Daming Palace today, there are ruins such as Pear Garden and Qingxi Hall, while on the north bank, there are landscapes such as Tang Garden, Tangren Palace music painting, New Hairpin Flower Ladies painting, and Zhenlian painting.

It was called "Beiya" at that time. This place became the main garrison of the Beiya Imperial Army of the Tang Dynasty.

The Sanqing Hall of Daming Palace is located in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, China, and is one of the important buildings within the Daming Palace National Heritage Park. As one of the main buildings of the Daming Palace, the Dafu Hall was once the place where the emperor held grand ceremonies and received foreign envoys. The excavation and research of the site provide valuable physical materials for us to understand the architectural style and court life of the Tang Dynasty.

poiName: Hot Air Balloon Flight Experience in the Botanical Garden of the Chinese Academy of Sciences
summary: Before modern hot air balloons were introduced to China in 1982, the pioneer of hot air balloons - the "Kongming Lantern" - had been released in Xishuangbanna for thousands of years. Hot air balloons are classified as relatively safe aircraft by the International Federation of Aeronautics and Astronautics, and are classified as civil aircraft in China. Like airplanes, they also need to obtain nationality certificates and airworthiness certificates issued by the country. Hot air balloons are also a fashionable and romantic aviation sport, and as a popular low altitude tourism project today, they are flourishing abroad. In recent years, the hot air balloon project has also emerged in China, attracting countless people with its novel, unique, fashionable, romantic, huge and colorful appearance accompanied by a high-altitude and windward flying experience. Relying on the unique natural scenery of tropical botanical gardens throughout Asia, hot air balloons take off from the Baihua Garden and Folk Museum sites, with blue skies, white clouds, and gentle breezes waiting for your embrace; The colorful flowers and rainforests of the four seasons, the uniquely shaped Huludao, the ancient and mysterious maze of plants, and the distant and nearby mountains, rivers, and human fireworks can all be seen at a glance. At that moment, floating in the air, overlooking the earth; At that moment, away from the hustle and bustle, feel pure; At that moment, time and space froze, and the body and mind were baptized! The hot air balloon flight experience project is a tourism experience project introduced and cooperated by Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and is operated by Yunnan Yunying General Aviation Co., Ltd. Yunnan Yunying General Aviation Co., Ltd. is a nationwide aviation company initiated and established entirely by retired Air Force officers. Bring flying closer to the public and integrate it into daily life! Retired Air Force officers and soldiers continue their love for the sky and flying, taking you on a leisurely stroll through the blue sky and white clouds. Yunying Navigation, Accompany You to Fly! Xishuangbanna Wild Elephant Valley is located within the Mengyangzi Nature Reserve and the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve, 22 kilometers away from Jinghong City. It is a national park in China with animal and environmental protection as its main themes. According to archaeological discoveries, Asian elephants were widely distributed in the Yangtze River Basin, Guangdong and Guangxi provinces, and even as far north as the Yellow River Basin. With the harsh climate and geographical environment, Asian elephants were forced to migrate southward. Currently, Xishuangbanna is the habitat of Asian elephants in China. The Wild Elephant Valley, located at the junction of the east and west areas of Mengyang Nature Reserve, is the central channel for the exchange and gathering of wild Asian elephants living in the two areas. The Wild Elephant Valley offers a variety of tourist attractions, including high-altitude observation trails, rainforest sightseeing cable cars, Asian Elephant Museum, Asian Elephant Breeding Base, and Asian Elephant Performance School, allowing visitors to safely observe Asian wild elephants and their living environment without disturbing their daily lives. It has become a place in China where visitors can communicate closely with Asian wild elephants and is known as the "bridge between humans and Asian wild elephants". Wild Elephant Valley is rich in natural resources, gathering tropical rainforests, subtropical evergreen broad-leaved forests, and numerous rare animal and plant populations. It is a comprehensive ecological tourism scenic spot that integrates ecological tourism, scientific research and teaching, and leisure vacation. It has won many honorary titles, such as the first batch of "National Ecotourism Demonstration Area" in China, and the gold medal of "50 places worthy of foreigners to visit in China". At the same time, Wild Elephant Valley also undertakes multiple ecological conservation research projects, such as the "National Science Popularization Education Base", "China Yunnan Asian Elephant Source Breeding Base" (a cooperative project between Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve Administration and World Wildlife Fund WWF), and Xishuangbanna Wild Butterfly Breeding Research Base. · Located behind Liu Bei's Hall, a few steps down is a hall with a plaque of "Wuhou Temple" hanging. Wuhou Temple is lower than Zhaolie Temple in Han Dynasty, symbolizing the ancient relationship between monarch and minister. 
The statues of three generations of Zhuge Liang's grandparents and grandchildren are enshrined in the main hall. The statue of Zhuge Liang hangs the plaque of "Jingyuan Hall" in a shrine to express Zhuge Liang's lifelong sentiments. 1、 The large-scale landscape live performances of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" and "Impression: Liu Sanjie" are directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. They combine the scenery of the Li River, the culture of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, and the creations of Chinese elite artists. They are the first new concept of "landscape live performances" in China, pioneering large-scale live performances and becoming a model for the successful operation of the domestic cultural industry. Impression: Liu Sanjie "was directed by Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, planned by Mei Shuaiyuan, and co created by four main creators; Inherited from the legend of Guangxi singer Liu Sanjie, but not limited to her own story, it uses the composition and techniques of Chinese traditional painting to blend with real mountains and waters, combined with the unique rhythm and melody of ethnic minority songs, to integrate and present the natural scenery along the Li River, the lives and labor of fishermen and villagers, and the folk customs of ethnic minorities through visual effects and artistic arrangement. The performance as a whole lacks a continuous storyline and accurate lyrics translation. Instead, it uses Liu Sanjie as a guide to showcase the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and Dong in Guangxi, as well as the hundred households and ten thousand elephants around the Li River, through freehand imagery and familiar mountain songs. Since its performance in March 2004, "Impression: Liu Sanjie" has accumulated over 8000 shows and is a benchmark for live performances in China. 2、 Preface to the Performance Chapter of "Impression: Liu Sanjie": The Origin of the Landscape Legend Performance. Classic scene: The landscape stage lights up, and Liu Sanjie comes on a bamboo raft. Singing mountain songs, singing from here to there... "Mountain songs rise from the water, crossing the peaks, and composing legendary dreams in the night sky. Song fairy Liu Sanjie came by boat, singing loudly, born from the mountains and waters. Chapter 1: The Charm of Red Impressions/Mountain Song Performance. Classic Scene: Duet, Red Silk. Ethnic minority men and women wield torches and sing mountain songs across the shore, expressing their respect for the mountains, rivers, and streams, as well as the continuous friendship between young people, representing the traditional culture of ethnic minority singing. Fishermen dressed in raincoats and bamboo hats, waving bamboo poles, swim freely on the Li River. The dancing red silk symbolizes the dense and heavy fishing nets, combined with the diverse array changes of bamboo rafts, showcasing the daily hard work of Li River fishermen and conveying the impression of harmonious coexistence between local cultural life and natural scenery. Chapter 2: Life Chapter of Green Impressions/Home Performance. Classic Scene: Dong Ethnic Song (performed by Dong ethnic girls in the original voice). The sunset accompanied by cooking smoke, shepherd boys jumping and leading cattle herds, fish eagles sitting obediently on bamboo rafts fishing with fishermen, village women washing clothes by the river, and boys playing and laughing at the village entrance... depict the daily life of the people of Lijiang. Scene after scene of rural scenery reflects Liu Sanjie's life situation, and she realizes the beauty and tranquility of the hometown of mountain songs. Chapter 3: The Night Chapter of Golden Impressions/Fishing Fire Performance. Classic scene: Fishing fire on the Li River. The shining oil lamps on the bamboo rafts of fishermen resemble the sparkling stars in the sky, known as the Li River Fishing Fire. The night sky is accompanied by warm light, recording the hard work and harvest of fishermen, presenting the natural inheritance of ancient labor methods. Chapter Four: Love Story of Blue Impressions/Love Song Performance. Classic Scene: Crescent Moon Elf Dance, Bathing, Wedding. The elves guarding the mountains and waters dance on the crescent moon, illuminating the Li River in the night sky and gently protecting the lights of thousands of households. The girls bathed and changed their clothes by the river, greeted the sisters to be married, put on their wedding clothes for her, and said goodbye; The bride dressed neatly, bid farewell to her family, boarded the groom's small boat, bowed three times to the mountains and waters, and bid farewell with deep affection. Chapter 5: Silver Impressions/Colorful Performance at the Grand Ceremony. Classic Scene: Silver Robe. In the darkness, ethnic minority girls dressed in specially made silver lantern costumes (Miao ethnic costumes), holding hands, slowly walked onto the Li River. They shine with the colors of festivals all over their bodies, either as a whole, alternately, in groups of three or two, or alone. Through changes in formation and combinations of light and shadow, they form a painting with the mountains and rivers, dance together in the same sky and earth, abstractly showcasing the beautiful scenery and festive atmosphere of local cultural customs. Epilogue: The final chapter of the Heaven and Earth Song Performance. Classic scene: All actors take their curtain call (fishermen actors from five surrounding natural villages including Maozi Village, Xingping Village, Tianjiahe Village, Mushan Village, and Mushan Zha Village). The fishing fire gradually fades away, the lights go out, and Liu Sanjie's mountain songs are still sung in the sky and earth. "Impression: Liu Sanjie" expresses gratitude to the mountains and waters, and to the guests from all directions! 3、 Highlight of "Impression: Liu Sanjie" (Part 1) Unique Natural Geography and Scenery. The reason why "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is so shocking is precisely because of the support and infiltration of the mountains and waters in Guilin and Yangshuo: the Li River water area within a radius of two kilometers, and the twelve background mountain peaks led by Shutong Mountain, are far different from traditional construction, making it a famous landscape theater both inside and outside. （2） The representative ethnic theme "Impression of Liu Sanjie" showcases the customs and traditions of ethnic minorities such as Zhuang, Yao, Miao, Dong, as well as the myriad of families; During the performance, there will be traditional live duels of ethnic minorities in Guangxi, local fishing and farming, weddings, festival celebrations, and details of daily life in the original environment. （3） The widely spread Liu Sanjie culture was portrayed and dramatized in the 1961 film "Liu Sanjie", which became a classic symbol and memory of the legendary singer Liu Sanjie in people's hearts. Impression: Liu Sanjie "refers to and sorts out various materials, striving to achieve wide collection and integration of the cultural essence represented by Liu Sanjie through artistic techniques and poetic arrangement, polishing Liu Sanjie into the cultural business card of Guangxi. （4） The high-end celebrity art creation team "Impression: Liu Sanjie" is the world's first new concept landscape live performance. It is directed by famous directors Zhang Yimou, Wang Chaoge, and Fan Yue, and planned by national first-class screenwriter Mei Shuaiyuan. The performance plan has undergone 109 revisions over 5 years and 5 months, with the participation of 67 famous Chinese and foreign artists. The performance lasts for 70 minutes and has more than 600 performers.

1、 Basic information: Yangshuo Ruyifeng Cableway Scenic Area is a high-altitude tourism and leisure project jointly invested and built by Shaanxi Junjing Cableway Investment and Construction Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Shaanxi Tourism Group, and Guilin Ruisheng Tourism Development Co., Ltd. The total investment of the project is 260 million yuan. The scenic area is located in Meng Village, Gaotian Town, Yangshuo County, adjacent to National Highway 321, 5km away from the Gaotian entrance and exit of Baomao (Guiwu) Expressway, and about 5km away from core scenic areas such as Yulong River, Moon Mountain, Shili Gallery in Yangshuo and Yinziyan Scenic Area in Lipu. 2、 Project Construction The project will build Yangshuo Mountain Top Natural Park, which is composed of the natural karst natural landscape "three peaks and two valleys" (Yuanbao Peak, Ruyi Peak, Xianglian Peak, Caixi Valley, Baihua Valley), cableway, Ruyi Cloud Top Viewing Platform, Ruyi Cable Bridge, Walk in the Forest, glass walkway Road, Digital Experience Hall and other creative landscapes. The lower station of the cableway is located in Xingtianle International Tourism Resort, and the upper station leads directly to Yuanbao Peak.
