Xianggong Mountain is located on the west bank of the Li River in Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, between the Huangbu Reflection and Jiuma Huashan scenic spots. The light and shadow, sea of clouds, sunrise, and colorful clouds here have attracted countless photographers and photography enthusiasts to come and shoot. The works taken by Guilin photographers here have won the Bronze Award at the 10th International Film Festival. Climbing up Mount Xianggong and looking into the distance, one can see towering peaks like stalagmites. The clear Li River meanders through the peaks, forming a large hook. Amidst the morning mist, it resembles a clear and vivid ink painting. Xianggong Mountain is not very high and can be reached in about 20 minutes. However, due to its remote location, the scenery is very primitive, and the journey up and down the mountain is steep. It is important to pay attention to safety during the trip. At the foot of the mountain, you can enjoy the scenery of Jiuma Huashan. From here, you can take a ferry to the other side of the river and travel to Xingping Ancient Town for sightseeing.

Zizhou Island is located on the east bank of the Li River in the center of Guilin city, facing Elephant Trunk Hill across the river. It is one of the ideal angles for viewing Elephant Trunk Hill and is one of the earliest known garden sites in Guilin's history. Zizhou Island was rebuilt in 2011, restoring the beautiful scenery of "Zizhou Smoke and Rain" and "Zizhou Red Leaves in Guilin Autumn". It has formed 10 new landscapes, including flying waterfalls and rainbows, poetry and painting history, maple leaves and leaves, misty rain and blue, bamboo forest clear scenery, camphor trees surrounded by greenery, secluded umbrella covers, ginkgo trees flowing with gold, stone pavilions flowing with fragrance, and mountains and rivers with water and moon. It has become a new highlight for Chinese and foreign tourists to visit Guilin's scenery and appreciate Guilin's culture.

This place is located in Xingping Ancient Town, Yangshuo County. It has a round arch with an ancient Chinese style, and the lintel is engraved with the words "Rongtan Jiajing". The trees are lush and the scenery is beautiful, making it a great place to visit.

Drifting is a recommended way to explore the Yulong River. Taking a bamboo raft and boating on the river, the scenery on both sides is picturesque and very enjoyable. Sitting on a slow bamboo raft, watching the undulating mountains and pastoral scenery on both sides. Along the way, you will also pass through small towns and many ancient bridges, with a clear river below, quiet and relaxing. There are 6 docks along the Yulong River drifting route, and the order of the docks is: Jinlongqiao Pier, Yulongqiao Pier, Jiuxian Pier, Jima Pier, Shuiyedi Pier, and Wanjing Pier.

In the Yulong River basin, drifting through three connected mountain peaks on the right bank of the Li River, like a two humped camel with a necked back, it seems to be walking towards the river, known as a camel crossing the river. Qing'e Ancient Ferry is located at the scenic spot. The representative works of the famous Chinese art master Xu Beihong, "Spring Rain on the Li River" and "Crossing the Green River", were created here.

Yangshuo Gongnong Bridge is located in the middle of Shili Gallery, which is on the 321 National Highway. It is the essence of Yangshuo karst landscape. Standing on the Workers' and Peasants' Bridge and looking out from both sides, one can see the undulating peaks and the contrasting mountains and waters in front of them, as well as the classic landscape of "Camels Crossing the River", which is a free viewing spot. Gongnong Bridge is located at the confluence of Yulong River, Jinbao River, and Tianjia River, and is the endpoint of Yulong River drifting. This area is lined with strange peaks and has beautiful scenery. Many tourists who ride bicycles to visit the Ten Mile Gallery stop here to take photos. In the hot season, many tourists also go down to the river to tread water and feel the coolness.

Moon Mountain is a unique scenery within Yangshuo, located at the end of the Ten Mile Gallery landscape belt. Moon Mountain is an arched peak with a large hole running through it below the top, resembling a bright moon that blends seamlessly with nature. Looking at this Moon Mountain from different angles, the shape of this cave constantly changes, which is very interesting. Moon Mountain is about 380 meters high, and visitors can follow an 800 level hiking trail to reach the Moon Cave at the top of the mountain. The Moon Cave has a large area, with a height and width of 50 meters each, while the mountain walls are only a few meters thick. The top of the cave is covered with stalactites of various shapes, two of which resemble Wu Gang and Jade Rabbit in the Moon Palace. In fact, Moon Mountain can be admired from a distance. Across from the scenic area, there is a rest area with a gathering of restaurants, which is one of the locations where you can view Moon Mountain from afar. Due to its unique geological environment, Moon Mountain has also become a gathering place for rock climbing enthusiasts.

2 kilometers away from the wharf of Xingping Town along the Li River is Xingping Fishing Village, which is said to have been relocated by high-ranking officials and nobles on Xingping Weir. Xingping Fishing Village is an ancient village built in 1506 AD during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. It has a history of over 400 years since its establishment. The houses in the village have a similar architectural style to the ancient buildings in the Wei area, with green bricks and black tiles, sloping roofs, horsehead walls, flying eaves, painted buildings, carved windows, and rows upon rows. They have a unique structure and typical characteristics of summer residences in northern Guangxi during the Ming and Qing dynasties. With a history of nearly 500 years, they are still well preserved. The entire building complex covers an area of 1.5 hectares and is surrounded by 48 traditional residential buildings in front of the Li River. Across the river, there are layers of mountains and valleys, including Liyu Mountain, Jinwa Mountain, Yuanbao Mountain, Jiandao Mountain, and Bijia Mountain, each with its own unique charm that touches the heart.

Yansha Hot Air Balloon Base has professional high-altitude flight instructors to provide you with high-quality, safe, and professional flight services. Sitting on a hot air balloon and enjoying the beautiful scenery of the Yulong River from a high altitude, from a divine perspective, one can truly experience the "panoramic landscape" and appreciate the beautiful scenery of "the river is a clear ribbon of vines, the mountains are like jade hairpins". It is also possible to fully appreciate the wonder of "people living in the Blue Lotus Peak". You can also take 360 ° selfies on a hot air balloon, making your social circle envious and popular.

With the design concept of ocean, hot spring, health, entertainment, and world cultural tour, it has gathered 108 hot spring pools of various styles in the world, gathering the essence of Chinese and foreign hot spring culture: Japanese hot sea, ancient Rome, Dead Sea salt bath, Tang Palace Huaqing Pool, and various dry and wet sauna facilities, so that you can enjoy the world's hot spring bathing culture with different styles in a one-stop manner, and experience the hot spring tour accompanied by the sea breeze and sunshine. Rich and colorful content. As the sun sets, the distant mountains seem to be draped in a colorful coat, occasionally changing between warm and cold colors. poiName: "New Dreams of Lijiang" Large-scale Landscape Show
summary: The Dreamy Li River is the first landscape performance in Asia, featuring a combination of ballet and acrobatics. It is the first of its kind in Asia and takes place on a super large panoramic stage that is 1:1 with the audience, as well as a special lifting stage. Composed of four parts: "Landscape Cultivation," "Life and Eternity," "Wonders of the River Bottom," and "Oriental Charm," it takes the audience into a colorful fairy tale world. The main feature of the program is its innovative arrangement, which incorporates elements of modern dance into the ancient acrobatic art by nationalizing it on the basis of classical ballet, especially endowing acrobatic art with lyrical and dramatic elements. The "Dreamy Li River" includes high difficulty acrobatics performances such as "paragliding", "flying in the sky", "rolling lights", "kicking people" and "drilling circles" performed by award-winning acrobats both domestically and internationally.

Tianlai Butterfly Spring is a scenic spot located along the Ten Mile Gallery, only three or four kilometers away from Yangshuo County and Moon Mountain. It is also a popular destination for many tourist groups. The interesting part of the scenic area is the song and dance performances of the Miao and Dong ethnic groups, and there is also a small-scale cave that can be visited. A huge butterfly sculpture can be seen on the stone wall from a distance outside the entrance of the scenic area, which is also the symbol of the scenic area. There is a small karst cave in the scenic area, where there is a stalactite that looks like a butterfly and has spring water flowing out, hence it is called Butterfly Spring. However, here you can't see large groups of wild butterflies dancing gracefully. Instead, you can see a butterfly exhibition. The photos taken from the Ten Mile Gallery observation deck have a great perspective, and the suspension bridge and slide in the mountains are popular among children. Visiting caves and climbing mountains doesn't take too long, and after descending the mountain, you can directly go to watch performances. Compared to natural landscapes, the ethnic song and dance performances here are more exciting, with displays of Zhunzhai flowers, golden flowers, and hall masters, which can give people a strong sense of ethnic customs. After the performance, you can also go take photos with the actors, but there will be a certain fee for taking photos. There is an area at the foot of the scenic area that sells ethnic souvenirs. If you are interested, you can also purchase some to give back to your friends and family.

Yangshuo Vanilla Forest is located on the banks of the Yulong River in Yangshuo. Here, you can enjoy the beauty of flowers, smell the fragrance of flowers, taste floral tea, and reminisce about floral events; We also offer Taiwanese style cuisine, where you can experience DIY crafts such as handmade soap and vanilla fabric. It is also a base for wedding photography and outdoor weddings. The theme park provides a great place for parents, children, and couples to interact, and enjoy the scenery of flowers, fragrant seas, mountains, and rivers while choosing various aromatic products and cultural and creative products they like.

This pedestrian street has a variety of delicious food and snacks, local specialty restaurants, various small commodities, clothing and department stores, etc. At night, the crowd is dense, and the lighting is also good!

Despite its steep terrain, Laozhai Mountain still attracts many photography enthusiasts to climb up. Laozhai Mountain has an altitude of over 300 meters. Although it is not high, it has more than 1100 steps. After walking up the Round Arch Mountain Gate, you will encounter two iron ladders near the top. Following the iron ladders, you can reach the top of the mountain and overlook Xingping Ancient Town. Don't take the wrong path. Looking into the distance from the mountaintop, the Li River bends at the foot of the mountain, and boats shuttle by. The distant mountains are layered and particularly enchanting. Especially in the evening, the thousands of acres of alluvial plain formed by the vicissitudes of life on the other side of the river, the continuous mountains, are slightly red in the sunset, with a hint of green in the red. This is the "Xingping Sunset" praised by the famous painter Xu Beihong.

poiName: 【 wu xi 】 《 ling shan ji xiang song 》 yan chu
summary: Lingshan Jixiang Song "is a music epic live action drama that uses sound, light, and electricity to comprehensively interpret. It tells the story of Siddhartha Gautama (Shakyamuni Buddha), the prince of the ancient Indian kingdom of Lumbini, who gave up his luxurious life in pursuit of the truth of the universe and life, went through various tests, and finally became a Buddha. The stage for the performance is a 270 degree circular curtain, which is full of shock.

Located in the south of Huishan Mountain and the middle of Qianrong Avenue in Binhu District, the Taihu Lake Happy Park of Wuxi Zoo is built near the mountain, with a total area of 520000 m2 and a total investment of 450 million yuan. It is a comprehensive theme park that integrates animal ecology display, science education, animal protection in different places, leisure tourism, and is equipped with multiple sets of large-scale amusement facilities. There are 112 species and over 1200 rare wild animals from all over the world inhabiting the exhibition area. On September 28, 2020, Wuxi people's own amusement park, "A-Xiong Amusement Park," was grandly opened. Wuxi Zoo combines multiple features of urban zoos and wildlife parks, combining free range and captive animal husbandry, making it a paradise for families to enjoy their holidays. A-Xiong Amusement Park: The total area of "A-Xiong Amusement Park" is over 50000 square meters, divided into four areas: Forest Workshop, Musical Note Garden, Honey Castle, and Starry Sky Islands. It has set up 8 sets of amusement facilities, including Crazy Taxi, Phoenix Dance Carnival, Super Fire Brigade, Jungle Mover, Sweet Melody, Space Shuttle, Starry Sky Adventure, and Wilderness Exploration. It changes its original positioning of being mainly thrilling and exciting, and is mainly aimed at children and family parent-child visitors. And implant the well-known cultural theme of "Ah Xiong Bai Bai" in Wuxi households, creating a "Wuxi people's own paradise", making it cultural, storytelling, emotional, and endowed with sustainable development attraction and vitality. The supporting commercial complex Honey Castle, as well as the music interactive and themed sculpture display Music Note Garden, bring more joy and experience to Wuxi citizens and children. Moe Pet Park: The Moe Pet Park in the park is mainly based on the theme park architectural style, with new exhibition methods for cute pet animals, amphibious crawling halls, animal interactive science popularization, and cute amusement facilities as the main content, accompanied by theme park restaurants. It is a large-scale comprehensive tourist area that integrates sightseeing, entertainment, and education. The Cute Pet Park covers an area of 4000 square meters and is located at the golden intersection of zoo transportation. With a brand new animal venue, new amusement projects, and a brand new themed restaurant, it provides visitors with a brand new travel experience.

The Li River turns at Yangshuo Bridge, and the beach area on the east bank is called "Baishawan". The sand and gravel on the beach are as white as snow. If fishermen catch fish at night, clusters of pine trees will light up on bamboo rafts, reflecting the light beams in the river, and complementing the moonlight and silver beach, it is very beautiful. This scene is called 'Baisha Fishing Fire'.

Qixingyan, also known as Qixia Cave during the Sui and Tang dynasties, and Xianliyan and Bixuyan during the Song dynasty. Located on the belly of Mount Putuo in Guilin Seven Star Park, it runs from east to west, with the entrance on the southwest half of Tianji Peak and the exit on the east foot. It was originally an ancient underground river channel dating back one million years, but was later suspended in mid air due to crustal changes and land uplift. The cave is divided into three layers: the upper layer is 8-12 meters higher than the middle layer, and the remaining traces are still recognizable; The lower layer is 10-15 meters away from the middle layer and is still a developing underground river channel; The middle level is currently available for sightseeing. The middle layer is 1100 meters long (with a run of 814 meters) and covers an area of 1.75 hectares. The temperature inside the cave remains around 20 ℃ throughout the year, forming a bead shaped underground corridor. During the tour of karst caves, with the help of various high-tech technologies such as lasers, light guides, and multimedia, visitors can enjoy a variety of scenic spots with different shapes, including ancient banyan welcoming guests, border village scenery, gatherings of heroes, Milky Way magpie bridges, secluded stone forests, peacocks opening their screens, and peach blossom escorting guests in over 40 places. In addition to the karst landforms inside and outside the cave, there are over 120 stone carvings, including ancient and modern poems and travelogues exploring beauty and wonder, as well as calligraphy by calligraphers.

The two character plaque "Huaqiao" in Guilin Huaqiao was inscribed by General Zhang Aiping, former Vice Chairman of the Military Commission and Minister of National Defense of China. It was built during the Jiaxi period of the Southern Song Dynasty (1237-1240 AD) and has a history of 770 years. It is an ancient multi arch stone bridge in Guilin.

The Fubo Mountain Scenic Area is located on the banks of the Li River in Guilin, and is the core tourist area of the 5A level scenic spot of "Two Rivers, Four Lakes, and Xiangshan". The scenic area is famous for its historical relics, integrating the six beauties of mountains, water, caves, stones, courtyards, and cultural relics. The scenery changes with each step, and the twists and turns are exquisite. It is a microcosm of Guilin's landscape and is known as the "Fubo Scenic Area". Fubo Mountain has an elevation of 213 meters and a relative height of 63 meters. Due to its half land and half river basin, the surging waves are blocked by the mountain, forming a huge backflow. The ancients took it as "the foot restrains the waves", meaning to subdue the waves, and it is known as the "guardian deity of the Li River". In the 18th year of the Jianwu reign of the Eastern Han Dynasty (42 AD), Emperor Guangwu sent General Fubo Ma Yuan to invade Jiaozhi Commandery. People built a temple on the mountain to commemorate Ma Yuan, and named the mountain after General Fubo. General Ma Yuan once kept Guilin safe, so Fubo Mountain is also known as the "Fubo Safe Land". The main scenic spots in the scenic spot include Ping'an Rong Square, Fubo Wanzhao memorial archway, Guishui Pavilion, Princess Bell Pavilion, Huanzhu Cave, Sword Test Stone, Cliff Inscriptions (Mi Fu's self portrait, Deer Singing Banquet Poems), Cliff Inscriptions (Tang Dynasty Buddhist statues, Taoist statues), Thousand Buddha Rock, Thousand People's Pot, Tingtao Pavilion, Yuan Dynasty River Embankment, etc. [Fubo Evening Boat] Fubo Evening Boat is a stone like memorial archway built after liberation, and the banner "Fubo Evening Boat" is written by Mr. Chu Tunan, a contemporary cultural celebrity. In ancient times, the water level of the Li River was high, and when ancient people visited Fubo Mountain, they had to come by rocking small boats. In the evening, standing by the river, you can see a very beautiful scenery, with green mountains and clear waters, bamboo rafts, fish eagles, and curling smoke from cooking. You can also hear the temple bell ringing from afar. So there is a poem written by Peng Ershu, the governor of Guangxi, which goes like this: "Under the Fubo Mountain, there are boats tied to the river, painting horns, ringing bells, and smoke breaking at dawn. Countless green mountains float out of the water, and the midstream night rain hangs with sails." This describes a famous scene on the Fubo Mountain at that time - the Fubo Evening Boat. At the foot of the mountain is the famous Princess Bell Pavilion in the scenic area. The large iron clock inside the pavilion was cast in 1669 AD and weighs 2524 kilograms. The top of the bell is a double dragon button, and the upper layer is inscribed with the Buddhist "Paramita Heart Sutra". The body of the bell is inscribed with inscriptions, which read "Emperor's Diagram Consolidates", "Emperor's Way is Prosperous", "Buddha's Day Shines", and "Dharma Wheel Always Turnes". It was built by the only Han Chinese person in the history of the Qing Dynasty, Gege and Shuo Gege, to commemorate her father's achievements in pacifying western Guangdong. The Thousand Person Pot is located on the corridor by the river and is also a very famous historical relic in the scenic area. Cast in the second year of the Kangxi reign of the Qing Dynasty, 1663 AD, it was cast in Foshan, Guangdong along with the Great Iron Bell by Heshuo Gege Kong Sizhen. On both sides of the edge of the pot, some vague inscriptions can be seen. It was a ritual vessel from the Dingyue Temple in the past, used as a incense burner for pilgrims to insert incense. There is a damaged mark on the bottom of the pot, which was destroyed by Japanese artillery fire during the Anti Japanese War. There is a folk saying in Guilin that goes, 'Turn the pot around and you will have wealth of thousands or millions.'. Huanzhu Cave Sword Test Stone and Mi Fu Self Portrait: Huanzhu Cave is 4-6 meters high and 127 meters long. Inside the cave, there are 45 niches and 219 cliff statues with different shapes, as well as 108 cliff carvings. It is a key cultural relic protection unit in Guangxi and a place of historical and cultural gathering. It is worth mentioning that there is a magical stone pillar in the cave, shaped like a floating pillar, with a large upper part and a small lower part, only one line away from the ground. We call it the Sword Testing Stone or the Top Scholar Stone. There is a folk saying that goes: "If a rock is connected, there will be a top scholar." This means that every time this rock is connected to the ground, Guilin will produce a top scholar. Since the establishment of the imperial examination system, Guilin has produced a total of 8 top scholars. The self portrait of Mi Fu is a precious stone carving inside the entire Huanzhu Cave. The inscription on the stone carving reads' Pan Jingchun, Mi Fu (f ú), in May of the seventh year of Xining, we traveled together on a dark day. '. It was inscribed by the great calligrapher of the Northern Song Dynasty, Mi Fu, and his friend Pan Jingchun after visiting the Huanzhu Cave. Years later, the literati Fang Xinru visited the Huanzhu Cave and discovered the inscription of Mi Fu, which excited him greatly. Coincidentally, at that time, Mi Xiu, the great grandson of Mi Fu who had collected this self portrait, was serving in Jingjiang Prefecture. Therefore, Fang Xinru lent out the portrait and engraved it on the right side of Mi Fu's title. Mi Fu's surviving works are very rare. In the Huanzhu Cave, we can not only see Mi Fu's inscription but also his self portrait, which is a rare cultural relic under key protection in Guangxi. Gui Shui Pavilion: "Gui Shui surrounds the East City and never sees any swords or soldiers. Guishui means Li River. During the Southern Song Dynasty, the poet Fan Chengda served as the governor of Jingjiang and built the Guishui Pavilion on the north side of Fubo Mountain, facing the water. He also wrote a poem, "May the river flow with the Han people, washing the eaves and spears for the ruler to the north," hoping for peace in all directions and a peaceful and happy life for the people.

Climbing up to the Xianggong Mountain observation deck, a magnificent panoramic view of the Li River with majestic mountains and waters suddenly came into view. Looking up in the distance, the peaks are arranged in an orderly manner, and the clear Li River winds through the embrace of the mountains, which is very spectacular.

Yuantouzhu Scenic Spot of the Taihu Lake Lake - Zhongdu Mountain is an island at the junction of the Taihu Lake Lake and Wuli Lake (Li Lake), also known as Zhongdu Mountain or Zhongdu Mountain. With the word "Zhong", it means that there is Beidu Mountain (Guanshe Mountain) in the north and Nandu Mountain (Chong Mountain) in the south. They form a big buffalo, which lies at the edge of the Taihu Lake Lake.

The Xishan Scenic Area in Guilin is located in the center of the city, covering an area of 1.25 million square meters. It became a tourist destination as early as the Tang Dynasty more than 1000 years ago and is one of the earliest developed tourist attractions in Guilin. The scenic area is composed of Xishan peaks, West Lake, and hidden mountains, with peaks surrounding and towering inside. West Lake and Taohua River complement each other, forming a magnificent scenery of mountains and rivers. As dusk approaches, the setting sun hangs over the mountain peaks, with ever-changing clouds, countless golden lights, and purple air evaporating. It is known as the "West Peak Sunset" among the famous old eight scenic spots in Guilin. In addition, according to records, there were thirty-six West Lakes in the Tang Dynasty, with Guilin West Lake being the largest. The lake water was clear and transparent like a mirror, and the mountains were green and colorful, reflecting the water. It was the West Lake that connected mountains and waters throughout China; The lotus fragrance ripples in the lake, the smoke waves curl up, and a small mountain lingers in between, which is called Hidden Mountain. There are many caves in the Hidden Mountain, including Beigan, Chaoyang, Baique, Jialian, Nanhua, and Xiyang, collectively known as the "Six Caves of Hidden Mountain". In the "Hidden Mountain Inscription" written by scholar Ruan Yuan in the Qing Dynasty, it is said: "One mountain is empty, and six caves penetrate each other." The six caves take on different postures and are often connected to springs, becoming the underground "Dragon Palace", known as the "Eight Gui Cave Wonderland". Guilin Xishan Scenic Area also has a rich and profound cultural heritage, and is the original site of Xiqinglin Temple, the first of the five major Zen forests in southern China during the Tang Dynasty. There are over 1000 existing Tang Dynasty stone carvings and cliff sculptures, which have a history of more than 1000 years and are the earliest and most numerous cliff carvings in Guilin city. Throughout history, there have been countless travelers to this place, including Tang Dynasty officials Jianzhen, Li Bo, and Rong Yu, Song Dynasty officials Mi Fu, Fang Xinru, and Fan Chengda, Ming Dynasty officials Xu Xiake, Yuan Chonghuan, Dong Chuance, Xu Beihong, Lao She, and others.

Yaoshan Scenic Area is the highest peak in Guilin City, only 8 kilometers away from the city center, and is known for the reputation of "not reaching the top of Yaoshan Mountain, not seeing the scenery of Guilin". Taking the Yaoshan Cable Car within the scenic area, with a total length of 1416 meters, one can easily reach the top of the mountain at an altitude of 909 meters in just a few minutes, and enjoy the magnificent scenery of Guilin. Whether it's the lush spring and summer, the colorful autumn leaves, or the snow covered winter, Yaoshan can bring you breathtaking natural scenery.

To the east of Shunchun Shenjian lies Yingshan Lake, located between the mountains of Xi and Hui. In ancient times, it was called "Qin Huangwu". In 1958, the people of Wuxi engaged in voluntary labor for ten months, excavating 50000 cubic meters of soil and turning Qinhuangwu into an artificial lake of 14000 square meters. The clear and mirror like water surface blends the scenery of the two mountains of Xi and Hui into one. The emerald peaks, ancient pagodas, and beautiful pavilions reflect in the lake, making the scenery even more beautiful and moving. It reflects the wonderful charm of water being secluded by the mountains and the mountains being alive by the water. The lake and mountain colors are fully absorbed, creating a unique feature of real mountains and fake water. Therefore, it is named "Yingshan Lake".

Yaohu Town is located in Yixing, Jiangsu, which was formerly known as Yangxian. When the great literary figure Su Dongpo visited Yixing, he found spiritual resonance and a spiritual home in the mountains and waters of Yangxian, and left behind the excellent poem "Yangxian Tie", expressing his desire to buy farmland and retire in Yangxian from the beginning, saying "I will grow old in Yangxian, only for the good of the mountains and rivers. Yaohu Town is based on local cultural elements such as mountains, water, pottery, bamboo, and tea. It is a diversified town that integrates ecological nature and traditional culture. Its uniqueness lies in creating an immersive all encompassing scene that combines activities and performances, shaping a unique experience that combines intangible cultural heritage handicrafts with Zen lifestyle aesthetics. In addition, Yaohu Town is also a vacation tourism destination that combines themed vacations with exhibition activities. Its rich tourism formats and differentiated products provide tourists with high-quality, pure ecological, full-time, and diverse experiences and services. Here, tourists can personally experience the poetic life of the beauty of nature, culture, and life.

Shushan Ancient South Street is located in Dingshu Town, Yixing City, with the Lihe River to the south and Shushan Mountain to the north. The street is thousands of kilometers long and only three to four meters wide. The buildings on the street are all two-story brick and wood structures. The natural balance of the street scenery continues day after day, telling the story of the old street being as wet as a gentle rain in the south of the Yangtze River. A vegetable picking woman sitting against the door, an old man playing chess shirtless with a hand cranked fan, a strong man holding a purple clay pot, a small dog wagging its tail and walking on the street corner, a mahjong player playing in the dim light; These scenes create a typical ancient street in Jiangnan during the Ming and Qing dynasties, flowing with the poetic charm of Taodu along the Li River that runs through the ancient town of Taodu. As one of the first batch of ancient architectural protection units in Jiangsu Province and a cultural relic protection unit in Yixing City, Shushan Old Street Hutong is said to have been a bustling "purple clay street" in the past. More than half of the residents here are engaged in the production and operation of purple clay. They use their own houses, with the back house serving as a production workshop and the front house facing the street displaying goods and setting up shops for operation. There are over thirty purple clay pottery shops in the entire old street, indicating the prosperity of the purple clay industry at that time. In addition to pottery shops, the old street also has tea houses, cloth shops, hardware stores, and small department stores, all centered around the family. They live a peaceful and self-sufficient life without discrimination between the elderly and the young. The Li River next to the old street is filled with wooden boats of all sizes, including fishermen, rural farmers transporting vegetables, and more importantly, ceramic product transport ships. Through this river, ceramics from the south street are transported to all directions.

The Dingshan Great Wall is an irregular quadrilateral with a total length of several kilometers. The walls on both sides are made of blue bricks, leaving a series of battlements. In the middle is a granite paved pedestrian walkway with four rest pavilions.

poiName: ya da • yang xian xi shan xiao zhen zhong xin
summary: Yada Yangxian Xishan Town Center is located in Yixing City, Wuxi City. It combines the ancient and elegant charm of Jiangnan Old Street with the trendy and fashionable elements of modern cities. From an aerial view, the center of the entire town is adorned with white walls and black tiles, arranged in a staggered and undulating manner. From afar, it is surrounded by mountains and rivers, while nearby streams surround it. Tea fields and bamboo forests are densely distributed around, forming a delicate and graceful painting of Jiangnan.

The demon slaying relief records the story of Buddha's demon slaying and enlightenment. The entire wall is forged from purple copper, 26 meters wide and 8 meters high, making it a rare artistic treasure. Tourists can see the Buddha sitting upright in the middle of the sculpture, touching the ground with one hand, as the "Demon Slayer Seal". The Buddha's two sides respectively show scenes of the demon king slandering and slandering the Buddha, and intimidating the Buddha with demon soldiers and generals. The Buddha remained unmoved and defeated the demon king's attacks one by one. After seven days and seven nights, he finally overcame obstacles such as money, power, women, fear, slander, etc., and finally achieved enlightenment, becoming a true enlightened person, shaking the heavens and the earth.

The amphibious off-road mountain bike base is located in the center of the Ten Mile Gallery in Yangshuo County, with a unique geographical location. The off-road site is located in the undulating mountains, and the development of the scenic area is based on the concept of harmonious coexistence between humans and nature, with a focus on protecting the ecological environment. The entire journey is about 10 kilometers and takes about 50 minutes, including mountain roads, waterways, jungles, and riverside landscapes. It features continuous undulating roads, S-shaped fields, downhill platforms, and more... allowing you to drive and experience the thrilling and exciting scenery all the way through the picturesque mountains and waters! The entire process is led by professional coaches.

The Feilada Climbing Base is located at the entrance of Yulonghe Ecological Park in Yangshuo County, Guilin City. The route includes vertical climbing up the cliff, downward climbing, side climbing crossing, and rope climbing, with two types of U-shaped foot handrails. The route combines various climbing forms such as high-altitude monkey bridges, cable bridges, ladders, zip lines, and circular observation bridges, allowing participants to experience a brand new high-altitude extreme sport. High altitude Monkey Bridge: A broken bridge made of wooden boards up to 40 meters high suspended on a rock wall. When walking, people are completely suspended in the air, and they need to maintain a good rhythm with their friends up and down. Perhaps they can also swing over it together. Circular Viewing Bridge: When you reach a high place, a semi-circular viewing platform with a diameter span of 8 meters allows you to take a break. Here, you can not only enjoy the mountains and rivers from a high vantage point, but also interpret the eternal love of Songcheng across the street. After resting, you can also pose with teammates in various styles, and receive countless likes on both social media and short video platforms. High altitude zip line: With a length of 400 meters and a height of 50 meters, the two sections of zip line allow you to truly fly once (once is not enough? Then do it again!), which is a heartbeat sensation that you will never experience in your lifetime.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

poiName: Journey to the Center of the Earth

summary: On both sides of the street are various shops, tea houses, bookstores, and handicraft shops. This is not only a shopping paradise, but also a great place for cultural experiences.

The memorial hall established based on the former site of the "Eight Offices" is located at No. 14 Zhongshan North Road, Guilin City. It is a thematic memorial hall showcasing the comprehensive resistance against Japanese aggression and the nationwide resistance against Japanese aggression in Guangxi. Opened to the public in January 1977, the museum was named by Marshal Ye Jianying. There are currently over 2000 cultural relics and more than 5000 precious historical photographs in the collection.

Jupeng Fei's Dream World - Haixi's large-scale coastal joyful kingdom, takes you into a colorful fairy tale world. Thrilling amusement experience, international style performing arts, children's science education. Jupeng Fei Dream World Theme Park is a new generation of large-scale theme parks carefully crafted by Jupeng Fei Group, integrating participation, viewing, entertainment, and fun into a modern theme park. The whole park is divided into six main theme areas: Happy Time Square, Warrior Challenge Zone, Colorful Windmill Park, and Cultural Performing Arts Theater. There are dozens of thrilling and exciting amusement projects suitable for all ages, as well as exciting amusement equipment such as the Coastal Leap Extreme. A comprehensive and three-dimensional leisure experience, allowing you to feel the infinite passion, boundless joy, and both real and illusory coastal world! Dream Water World is currently a large-scale multi-functional water themed amusement park in Fujian Province, integrating a series of fashionable water sports, thrilling water entertainment, and spa fitness projects. As a coastal water park that is closely related to the 100 meter golden beach, Dream Water World has introduced new and popular water projects from home and abroad, such as the super large space bowl, super loudspeaker, thrilling high-altitude slide, passionate wave making pool, dream big water house, etc. At the same time, it also has leisure projects such as swimming pool and spa, allowing visitors to enjoy the beautiful scenery of the coastal area while having fun.

The Celebrity Wax Museum is a comprehensive exhibition hall that combines sculpture, scenery, music, and performance to showcase various forms of artistic expression. It encompasses history, cultural significance, and multiple themes. The museum has created nearly 100 silicone sculptures of world celebrities, football stars, and other figures in the form of realistic sculptures. The museum is divided into four exhibition halls, among which the fourth exhibition hall's "Ancient City Storm" is themed around Zheng Chenggong, showcasing his moving scenes. The fourth exhibition hall also has a puppetry performance hall with Minnan characteristics.

The Food Fantasy Museum is located at 58 Quanzhou Road, Gulangyu Island, Xiamen City. The entire museum is the work of food model maker Sean Lau. The design and production of the museum originated from the Food Fantasy Museum in Penang, Malaysia. It has won the 2017 InPenang Museum of the Year, 2019 InPenang Tourist Attraction of the Year, and the TripAdvisor Excellence Award for two consecutive years. Exaggerated yet realistic, surrealistic Xiamen cuisine and Chinese culinary culture dishes are presented before our eyes. The food inside is not only huge, but also has many different and crazy creative faces, with high simulation degree. You can interact with the food and take pictures freely, and use your creativity to take various interesting photos, which is very interesting. The exhibited food artworks in the museum are carefully created by artists and have extremely realistic forms. You can enjoy a large collection of Chinese cuisine from Xiamen and other parts of China, which will stimulate your appetite. It's not just about pretending to be real, every exhibit has been endowed with extremely interesting and imaginative ideas by the creators, and each surrealistic dish is constantly stunning. Here, there are huge sand tea noodles - you can even swim in the noodle bowl, and there are also giant durians enough for 10 people to eat! There are more crazy scenes created by different foods, where you can unleash your imagination and interact with the food. Take a casual photo and you will get super interesting pictures!

Internet celebrity check-in points, with a total of ten themed pavilions: there is reverse art that allows you to easily achieve the world of flipping by climbing eaves and walls. Sakura Valley, small and large houses, time traveling trains, infinite starry sky, magic mirrors, flowing waterfalls, dreamy waterbeds, as well as Xiamen's unique Zheng Chenggong Bo Bing Experience Hall, Teresa Teng Records, and more. It is a scenic spot suitable for all age groups to enjoy beautiful photography.

One of the top ten luxury homes on Gulangyu Island, a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit, a key architectural style, and the famous' Filial Piety Building '. It was built by the Philippine Tobacco King for his mother. The building has bright colors and unique shapes, and some characteristics of Rococo are harmoniously combined with traditional Chinese crafts, which is rare in the Gulangyu villa group. It is graceful and elegant, with the same charm as before. Due to being repeatedly selected by film directors, it has filmed many movies here, such as "Liao Zhongkai", "Autumn in Spring", "Tulou Family", etc. Now, as an intangible cultural heritage exhibition hall, it is open to the public to explain the architectural features of Fanpo Tower, various intangible cultural heritage art treasures collected in the museum, the history of the tobacco king's wealth, and the strange stories of giving silver dollars at the entrance to show filial piety to his mother.
opening_hours: Open at 09:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

summary: Li Qingquan Villa is located on Qishan Road in Gulangyu Island, built in 1926. The building is situated on the mountain and faces the sea, with a view of most of the Xiagu Strait. Li Qingquan Villa is one of the well protected old houses on Gulangyu Island, which has always been inhabited by its descendants. The layout of the villa is basically complete, and you can still vaguely feel the details of life back then. A three story villa that combines Chinese and Western styles, with a Roman style large column on the front. The villa is solemn and stable, and the courtyard is paved with colorful granite pebbles to create a path. The entire villa exudes a unique and beautiful charm. In the courtyard, precious southern fir trees and flowers are planted, with a European style fountain in the center and rockery pavilions, adding a touch of natural warmth to the villa.

The Nanxun Tower is located in Jimei District, Xiamen City. It consists of a main building and two side annex buildings, forming a Y-shape and standing on a high point on the west bank of the Xunjiang River. The main building is a 15 story Western style building with a Chinese style square pavilion on the roof. At the top of the tower, there are two words' Jimei '. The wings of the attached buildings on both sides spread like wings, soaring like clouds. The Nanxun Tower is entirely constructed with fine-grained granite and green tiled eaves. Whether in architectural style or facade decoration, it is a landmark building of Jimei.

The site of Zheng Chenggong's martial arts training ground is located on the large playground in front of the Lu Xun Memorial Hall at Xiamen University. It is the site of Zheng Chenggong's former military training ground for soldiers. Zheng Chenggong once gathered soldiers here for daily drills and inspections. Yanwu Pavilion is one of the main buildings. Chen Jiageng chose the site of Yanwu Pavilion to establish Xiamen University, symbolizing the continuation of the legacy of his predecessors and the promotion of patriotism and national prosperity.

Love Island is located on the north side of Xiangshan Scenic Area and is another great viewing spot for Xiangbi Mountain. In 1983, in order to protect the Li River, the Guilin Municipal Government used sediment to accumulate and form a small island during river dredging. The island has a beautiful environment and lush vegetation, and was a good place for locals to date in the 1970s, hence the name Love Island.

poiName: Guilin Xingping Li River (Background of 20 Yuan RMB Note)

summary: The Mulong Lake Scenic Area is located in the northern part of Guilin City, Guangxi. It starts from the Li River in the east, ends at Zhongshan North Road in the west, is adjacent to Diecai Mountain in the south, and faces Dongzhen Road in the north. It is an important part of Guilin's two rivers and four lakes ring water system. The Mulong Lake Scenic Area relies on the unique natural ecological environment of the Li River and the beautiful Diecai Mountain, as well as numerous historical and cultural relics such as the ancient Song City with a long history. The scenic area is built based on the blueprint of the "Qingming Riverside Scene". The dazzling night view, magnificent Tang and Song architecture, beautiful scenery of Mulong Lake, and rich cultural relics make Mulong Lake Scenic Area a brilliant and beautiful scenic spot in Guilin city. The "Mulonghu ASEAN Park" is a themed scenic area newly created by Mulonghu Park in 2012, with the cuisine, customs, and culture of the 10 ASEAN countries as the background. The scenic area showcases the long-standing culture and colorful customs of the 10 ASEAN countries to tourists through three sections: ASEAN Food Square, ASEAN Style Theater, and ASEAN Tourism Culture Characteristic Commodity Street. Tourists can taste 100 authentic classic cuisines of the 10 ASEAN countries in Guilin for the first time, appreciate the beautiful Southeast Asian cultural performances, and browse the rich and colorful tourism cultural products of the 10 ASEAN countries. Appreciate the spectacular and beautiful night view of Mulong Lake in the Guilin Two Rivers and Four Lakes Project, known as the "Venice of the East".

The clear and rippling Yanzi Lake is embedded in the vast green fields, like a young girl's bright eyes full of affection. Willow trees hang by the lake shore, gently brushing against the surface of the water. A huge water turning cart, creaking and swaying with the passage of time, also singing ancient rural songs. Looking ahead, the mountains in the distance are verdant, the village trees smoke, the roads crisscross, and the houses are scattered, just like the picturesque Peach Blossom Land of Tao Yuanming's "fragrant grass, colorful fallen petals" and "beautiful fields, ponds, mulberry trees, and bamboo trees". Taking a small boat tour of Yanzi Lake is undoubtedly a pleasure.

The Riguangyan Temple is located at 60-62 Huangyan Road, Gulangyu Island. It was first built in the year of Wanli Bingxu, which is the 14th year of Wanli. In September 1999, the overall planning and renovation were completed.

The Railway Culture Park used to be a railway track, which was later converted into a park and still retains the railway track inside. The park is about 3 meters wide and 4.5 kilometers long, very special. The environment here is very good, with trees on both sides of the road, which is very suitable for walking and exercising. There are four scenic spots distributed on both sides of the railway, namely Wanshou Area, Huxiyan Scenic Area, Wanshi Mountain Scenic Area, and Xiagang Old Town. But it also resembles an ancient wine pot, so it is also known as Hushan. There is a pot body, a pot mouth, and a stone under the pot mouth, just like a wine glass. The word "Hushan" is engraved on the spout (south of the mountain), with the inscription "Tomb of the Thunder Wine Man" next to it.

Xijingyu Village is surrounded by mountains on all sides, with green trees covering the houses, fragrant flowers and fruits, and pleasant scenery. Donggang Yacht Terminal is located in the Donggang Business District of Dalian City, with over 200 yacht berths. The water and geological conditions here are good, and the port area is protected by a breakwater.

Sun Dianying's former residence is located in Heping District, Tianjin, and was built in the 1930s. The overall exterior design of the old residence is staggered and orderly, in a typical British classical style.

The Tianta Lake Scenic Area is located on the south side of Tianjin city, adjacent to the Water Park Scenic Area. It is a scenic spot mainly composed of the Tianjin Radio and Television Tower. The Tian Tower, also known as the Tianjin Radio and Television Tower, is 415 meters high and was Asia's tallest when it was built. It is known as the "Tower in Water" in the world. There are various entertainment and sightseeing services inside the Tian Tower, the main of which is the observation deck inside the tower. The 270 meter high observation deck is the key point inside the tower. Climbing onto the platform, you can enjoy the entire scenery of Jinmen, especially the beautiful night view of the city with lights on at night, which is a popular destination for photography enthusiasts. There is a telescope on the observation deck, but a usage fee of 2 yuan is required. In addition, there are souvenirs such as stamps and commemorative coins available for purchase on the tower. In addition to the sightseeing platform, the revolving restaurant is also a highlight inside the Sky Tower. The restaurant rotates every 45 minutes, allowing you to enjoy the city scenery outside while dining. However, the prices here are also very high, with a cup of coffee costing about 70-80 yuan. You can choose whether to dine or not according to your personal situation, and it's good to ask for the price before ordering. In addition to climbing the tower, you can also enjoy a boat tour in the lake next to the tower in the Tianta Lake Scenic Area, which usually costs around 30 yuan per hour. In winter, this place will turn into a small ice skating rink, suitable for bringing children to play.

The Yuan Mansion has been commissioned by British and German engineers and designers to design a European classical style building. Three stories high, brick and wood structure, with a total of 54 rooms and a building area of 2089 square meters. The design feature of this building is that it has so-called "hiding places" and "escape places". The 'invisible place' is a small door on the right side of the second floor, with a reinforced concrete staircase and iron railing inside. It can reach the top of the building and the basement. If the small door is closed, there is no way to go up and down. The 'escape point' is located on the third floor pavilion with an iron staircase that leads directly to the remaining door of the backyard, allowing for escape and escape. In addition, there is a specially designed octagonal house between the second and third floors of this building, with several windows facing the Haihe River. No matter how the tide rises or falls, the river water seems to flow into the octagonal building, symbolizing countless sources of wealth flowing into the Yuan family.

poiName: British Style Area on Tai’an Road
summary: Tai'an Road English Style Zone, also known as Tianjin English Style Zone, is an old street in Tianjin with a history of over a hundred years and a tourist scenic area with English style.

The Anligan Church (also known as the Church of England) is located next to Nathan's old house in Tianjin. Its architectural style has a typical British style, which is unique and distinct from other churches in Tianjin. It took 10 years to build the church, and it was officially completed in 1903. All the priests of the church were British. In May 1935, the church caught fire and suffered severe damage to the chapel. The renovation project was completed in June 1936. The unique architectural style here attracts many photography enthusiasts to take photos here.

The Tianjin Lishunde Grand Hotel was first built in the second year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1863), located on the east side of Victoria Road and Victoria Garden, which were the main roads of Tianjin at that time. Today, it is located at 199 Jiefang North Road and 33 Taierzhuang Road in Heping District, Tianjin. As one of the few surviving mid-19th century buildings in the original Tianjin, it is one of the few. The Lishunde Hotel has specially opened a hotel museum of over 700 square meters to tell the history of the hotel. At present, the Lishunde Museum is open every day for hotel guests to visit for free. The museum has restored the restaurant and menu from that time, containing over 3000 antiques, cultural relics, and old objects that have been well preserved. Lishunde, with a long history, is a reflection of Tianjin's opening as a port. After a deep understanding, I will definitely like Tianjin more.

The Bank of China Museum is located in Heping District, Tianjin City. Through seven thematic systems, it reviews the progress and growth of Bank of China and Tianjin over the past century, marking a new posture for this financial museum to showcase the century long historical and cultural accumulation of Bank of China and the original aspiration of financial service to the country. The museum collects precious exhibits from various periods since the establishment of Bank of China, allowing visitors to personally experience the financial development and social changes in Tianjin over the past century.

The Haihe Bund Park integrates leisure, entertainment, shopping and food. It is adjacent to the Haihe River in the south, with an irregular trapezoidal plane and a 5m high arc mountain, which mainly meets the needs of flood control.

The An Family Courtyard is located on Kuiyi Street in Yangliuqing Town. It was first built during the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi period and was the residence of An Wenzhong. The Anjia Courtyard was built during the Tongzhi period of the Qing Dynasty and consists of three courtyards. The courtyards are connected in a four in one layout in the north, covering a total area of two acres. The terrain is very high and it is a typical northern mansion. The reason why Anjia Courtyard is praised is because Anjia has produced a remarkable figure in history, An Wenzhong. At the age of sixteen, An Wenzhong accompanied the army westward, passing through 153 stations, carrying a shoulder pole to provide daily necessities for the officers and soldiers. Under the leadership of An Wenzhong, the merchants of Yangliuqing formed a huge Tianjin business gang, which not only promoted economic prosperity but also enhanced national unity at that time. An Wenzhong is a model of three thousand households in Yangliu rushing to the big camp to challenge their fate of poverty and become wealthy.

The "Porcelain Courtyard - China Porcelain Art Park Art Museum" is a private art museum in Tianjin that uses ancient porcelain as a carrier to tell the local stories of Tianjin and promote traditional Chinese culture. Our museum is located in the Grand Canal basin of Xiqing District, adjacent to Yangliuqing Ancient Town, covering an area of 1600 square meters. The current assessed value of the main building of this exhibition hall is 9.8 billion yuan. Each piece of ancient porcelain is carefully selected and pasted by professional technicians, which takes more than ten years to polish and present, interpreting the spirit of Chinese craftsmen who never tire of craftsmanship. Our museum provides comprehensive services to tourists from multiple perspectives, including sightseeing, cultural exchange, art appreciation, historical research, science education, and cultural dissemination. China has been the hometown of porcelain since ancient times. Porcelain is an important creation and great invention of the Chinese people and a great contribution of the Chinese nation to the world civilization. Porcelain is widely used in daily life. The emergence of porcelain can be traced back to the flourishing of the Shang Dynasty in the Tang Dynasty. The production technology and artistic creation have reached a certain level, and overseas officials and nobles all take pride in having porcelain at home. It played an important role in international cultural and commercial exchanges, and thus earned the reputation of "Porcelain Country" during the prosperous Tang Dynasty. The original intention of our museum with the theme of "porcelain" is to let every visitor understand the long and rich history of Chinese culture. And the fragments of Tianjin's history are slowly pieced together in front of tourists by sticking them together with porcelain tiles. This exhibition hall is divided into three areas in the form of porcelain carved paintings: Tianjin Development Brief History Area, Jinmen Ten Scenic Exhibition Area, Tianjin Port Culture Promotion Area, and Folk Story Inheritance Area. Presenting Tianjin's history and local culture in a brand new way, allowing tourists from all over to understand Tianjin's past and present through micro level graphics and text. Our museum has collected ancient porcelain from three generations of people. We started preparing in 2008 and started construction in 2016. Since then, we have used over 700 million pieces of ancient porcelain from the Tang, Song, Yuan, Ming, Qing dynasties and five famous kilns, which took 500000 working hours. The process of constructing the exhibition hall embodies the spirit of great craftsmanship that is highly respected. It also adds another unparalleled porcelain culture and art museum to Tianjin.

In the late Qing Dynasty, the new policy was reformed and the new army was trained. The Tianjin Small Station Training Park was the location of the "new army" military academy in history. Yuan Shikai once supervised the training of the "New Army" here. After the Sino Japanese War, the small station training park built a city wall, a military academy, a barracks, Yuan Shikai's Xingyuan and the New Army's training supervision office, as well as a small station training history museum, a military museum, a cinema, and a shopping street. In addition, there are supporting facilities such as a tourist service center and a tourist rest area, making it a story themed historical and cultural tourism area that combines education, leisure, shopping, and conference functions. The exhibition hall displays various cold and hot weapons, military clothing, and military supplies. The exhibits include ancient Chinese cold weapons, modern hot weapons, military clothing and supplies from different periods, and tens of thousands of precious photos, which have become prominent features of the exhibition hall of Tianjin Xiaozhan Military Training Park.
The Tianjin Xiaozhan Military Training Historical Figures Museum has exhibition halls and screening halls, where people can learn about the background and history of Xiaozhan's military training.

poiName: Tianjin Yangliuqing Wood New Year Picture Museum
summary: The Tianjin Yangliuqing Woodblock New Year Painting Museum is located at No. 111 Sanhe Li, Tonglou, Hexi District, Tianjin. It is a public welfare exhibition hall with the theme of collecting, researching, and displaying Yangliuqing Woodblock New Year paintings with strong characteristics. The exhibition hall is an antique architectural exhibition area with an area of 1724 square meters, displaying 619 Yangliuqing Woodblock New Year paintings and collecting over 10000 New Year paintings and more than 6400 ancient prints since the Ming Dynasty. The Yangliuqing Woodblock New Year Painting Museum ranks first among Chinese New Year painting museums in terms of architectural specifications, number of exhibits, and rich collection. The exhibition hall is divided into 7 exhibition halls, including "Historical Transmission", "Opera Stories", "Ancient Edition Treasures", "Ladies' Dolls", "Secular Life", "Dai Qi Painting Workshop - Protection and Development", and "Chinese New Year Painting Collection". Each exhibition hall in the museum is designed according to the theme of the New Year painting and the exhibition line, with physical landscapes that echo the New Year painting works, restoring the folk customs of the New Year culture and making the exhibition content three-dimensional and vivid.

poiName: jin gu jiu shi chen jin shi ju qing ti yan ( chi feng dao dian )
summary: Jincheng has been in its prime for a hundred years, and it's a dream that has been passed down through generations. In the old days, the nine rivers were unparalleled, and everything passed through the mist of condensed incense. Yuan Haowen, a poet from the Jin Dynasty, once exclaimed in his poem "First Arrival at Jinmen": "The flowers and moon in southern Beijing are unparalleled, and the bustling city of Jibei is the first." The immersive drama tour block of "Jingu Old Stories" condenses the century old Tianjin city, with a view of 1300 square meters of Jingu Old Stories Street. The performance revitalizes the dream of a hundred years and gives me an instant return to you. Welcome to the immersive drama tour block of "Jingu Old Stories". It is said that "5000 years of history can be seen in Xi'an, 1000 years of history can be seen in Beijing, and 100 years of history can be seen in Tianjin", which is half of Tianjin's modern history. Tianjin was named after Emperor Yongle of the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Di, who crossed the river during the "Jingnan Campaign" and established a "guard" in Tianjin to protect the army in Beijing. Therefore, Tianjin is also known as the "Tianjin Guard". For more than 400 years, countless nobles and high-ranking officials have used Tianjin as a place to settle in and out of the capital, making this city, which was once only a guardian of the capital, the economic center and political sub center of modern northern China. In 1860, Britain, France, and Russia forced the Qing government to sign the Treaty of Beijing, and Tianjin was forced to open a port, becoming an important base for foreign powers to dump goods, plunder raw materials, and export capital in China. There are over 3000 small western-style buildings in Tianjin, including more than 800 former residences of famous people. Fan Zhuzhai's former residence is one of them. It was one of the founders of Beiyang Cotton Mill and served as the fifth manager of the Hua Accounting Department of the French Oriental Credit Union Bank. It is also the former residence of Fan Zhuzhai, one of the eight major families in Tianjin. Based on the original appearance of the old residence, establish an immersive drama and tourism district called "Jingu Old Stories" to showcase and tell the story of Tianjin's century old commercial and social life. Let's travel back a hundred years to Tianjin in the 1920s. Here, you can see the former glory of the Imperial Palace Dance Hall, stroll around the Chamber of Commerce Club, visit the Fairy Palace Hair Salon, Hezhutang Pharmacy, Chunhe Theater... Give me a moment and give you back a hundred years!

The giant dragon flies from the top of the 450 meter mountain, and the tree lined path is full of dangers. summary: The Jinyi City Aquarium is located on the basement level of Zone C of Jinyi City, with the main entrance and ticket office located at the east gate of the shopping center. Walking down the stairs, the fantastic and colorful ocean world scenery at the entrance always catches the eye of newcomers. The total construction area of the Ocean Park is 5000 square meters, with a total of 9 themed areas. In the over 20 meter underwater tunnel, you can also feel sharks, zebrafish, turtles, and other schools of fish flying overhead up close. In addition, the Hawaiian beach area set up inside the museum completely forgets that you are still in the noisy and complex city.

Donghuaqiangzi Street is located in the old city area of Jinan, starting from the west entrance of Guluzi Street in the north, ending at the north entrance of Mashi Street in the south, facing Qushuiting Street in the east, and facing Xihuaqiangzi Street in the west. This street was originally the courtyard wall of the government school. The wall was made of brick with patterned patterns, commonly known as the Flower Wall. The street was named after the East Flower Wall. In the past, whenever Confucius was worshipped, cigarettes would smoke around the temple, bells and drums would ring in unison, and people from all walks of life would come to pay their respects. Donghuaqiangzi Street, adjacent to the Fu Wen Temple, is bustling with various businesses and shouts. Visitors can visit Furong Street to the south or follow Qushuiting Street to Daming Lake to the north. Therefore, Donghuaqiangzi Street is bustling with traffic and people, making it very popular. Time has passed, and now the roads on Donghuaqiangzi Street are flat and clean. The residential houses on the east side of the street have been repainted, with white walls and blue tiles, giving them a touch of antique charm. The courtyard wall of the Fu Wen Temple on the west side of the street is still built into a flower wall. Through the flower wall, one can see the Fu Wen Temple architectural complex with flying eaves and arches, blue tiles and vermillion, magnificent and magnificent. The pond is rippling with clear waves, and the five hole white jade stone bridge lies horizontally on the blue waves. Donghuaqiangzi Street, along with nearby Furong Street, Qifengqiao Street, Wangfuchizi Street, Qushuiting Street, and others, have become a part of the Quancheng Historical and Cultural Belt with their unique historical and cultural connotations, and have become a popular cultural landscape among people.

The Nanfeng Theater is located on the northeast bank of Daming Lake and is also known as the Zeng Gong Temple. It was built in memory of Zeng Gong, a literary figure of the Northern Song Dynasty and one of the Eight Great Masters of the Tang and Song Dynasties. Zeng Gong, with the courtesy name Zigu, was born in Nanfeng, Jiangxi and is commonly known as Mr. Nanfeng. In the fourth year of the Xining reign of the Song Dynasty (1071 AD), he was appointed as the governor of Qizhou (now Jinan). He implemented new laws, punished bullies, reduced corv é e labor, reformed education, and ultimately led to a peaceful scene in Qizhou where "grain in the city is easy to obtain, but there are still no police officers in the city". After Zeng Gong left, the people still remembered and chose a site to build a temple to commemorate him. The ancestral hall consists of three main halls, each with a wooden statue of Zeng Gong standing inside. The statue features an elegant and graceful figure, holding a scroll. It is carved from a thousand year old camphor tree in Zeng Gong's hometown of Nanfeng, Jiangxi. In front of the entrance of the hall, there is a pillar holding couplet that reads "The author of the Northern Song Dynasty's One Lamp Biography, the two characters' Nanfeng 'belong to Mr.". Across from the ancestral hall is a relatively large ancient theater building that still exists in the urban area of Jinan. There are five halls on the east side of the North Hall, displaying the calligraphy works of calligrapher Sun Mofo and his descendants Tianmu's traditional Chinese paintings. On the east side of the Nanfeng Temple is the Mingchang Bell Pavilion, which hangs an iron bell cast during the Mingchang period of the Jin Dynasty - the Mingchang Bell, symbolizing the eternal prosperity of Minghu Lake; On the south side, there is a four sided long pavilion called "Yuhe Hall", with red columns and blue tiles, high upturned eaves, lattice doors and windows, surrounded by circular corridors and railings, and a curved pool on three sides. The pool water ripples and is filled with lotus flowers in summer. The south of the pavilion is adjacent to the lake, with reeds, lotus flowers and lotus flowers on the surface. The scenery is elegant and pleasant, making it a great place to listen to the rain and observe lotus flowers.

Wanzhu Garden, also known as Zhangjia Garden, was once the private garden of Shandong Governor Zhang Huaizhi. It is located west of Baotu Spring Park and was founded in the Yuan Dynasty. It was named after the abundance of bamboo in the garden. It is now a garden within a garden in Baotu Spring Park. Wanzhu Garden has 3 sets of courtyards, 13 courtyards, 186 houses, as well as 5 bridges, 4 pavilions, 1 garden, and famous springs such as Wangshui Spring, Donggao Spring, and Baiyun Spring. There are various flowers and trees planted in the park, such as papaya, pomegranate, magnolia, bamboo, cypress, banana, etc. The finished character arrangement of the Front, East, and West courtyards is an ancient architectural complex that combines the characteristics of Beijing Wangfu, Southern Courtyard, and Jinan Siheyuan. It is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit.

Zhangqiu City Museum is a local comprehensive museum located in a typical Zhangqiu residential building of the late Qing Dynasty. The museum has a clever layout and reasonable design, with a front and back hall that runs north-south and is symmetrical from east to west. It covers an area of 1139.97 square meters and has 43 rooms. The museum has held exhibitions such as Zhangqiu Brief History Exhibition, Zhangqiu Revolutionary Cultural Relics Exhibition, and Zhangqiu Prehistoric Culture Exhibition. There are a total of 9 exhibition rooms with a display line of 108 meters, showcasing more than 700 cultural relics. The Zhangqiu Museum has published introductions to the Zhangqiu Museum, Zhangqiu Cultural Relics Chronicle, Zhangqiu Ancient Culture Sequence, Xiaojingshan Site Investigation Report, etc. It has also organized exhibitions such as the "Exhibition of Fine Cultural Relics Excavated from Luozhuang Han Tomb and Weishan Han Tomb" and the "Third National Cultural Relics Census Picture Exhibition".

The Daming Lake Underwater World is located on the beautiful Daming Lake in Jinan, a spring city. It is a modern marine life exhibition hall that integrates marine tourism, underwater sightseeing, and science popularization. Raising over 500 species of aquatic and marine animals, it is a large-scale marine biology themed exhibition hall and a youth marine science education base in Jinan city. The main building of Daming Lake Underwater World is divided into two floors, underground: freshwater biological area, live coral viewing area, underwater sightseeing tunnel, 3D ocean experience hall, underwater mermaid performance area, and dreamy jellyfish palace; First floor: Ocean Performance Theater, Crocodile and Turtle Viewing Area, Mermaid Fun Area. Da Ming Lake Underwater World has launched many special performance projects such as "Human Shark Dance", "Mermaid Performance", "Underwater Ballet", "Ocean Theater Sea Lion Games", etc. Currently, it is preparing fashionable tourism experience projects such as "Underwater Exploration" and "Underwater Wedding". As a "Underwater World" ocean themed exhibition hall in Jinan City, Daming Lake Underwater World is creating a "Spring City Ocean" belonging to Jinan with a brand new appearance. The underwater tunnel is a wonderful part of the underwater world, with deep blue seawater and groups of colorful schools of fish above; Sometimes a flying ray swims overhead, and sometimes a beautiful sea turtle swims overhead. Suddenly, when they turn around, they see sharks swimming behind them, as well as Baogong fish, round swallows, hawksbill turtles, nurse sharks, silver pomfret... surrounding them, as if they are in the vast and magical depths of the sea.

Baotu Spring Park is located in the bustling area of Jinan city center, with Qianfo Mountain to the south, Daming Lake scenic area to the north, and Quancheng Square to the east. It is a characteristic garden with spring water as its theme, and the famous one in the park is Baotu Spring, which is known as the "number one spring in the world". It is located at the top of Jinan's "72 famous springs" and has a history of more than 2000 years. It has also appeared multiple times in literary works, with the representative being "Baotu Spring" by Lao She. And tourists come here to witness the magnificent scene of the three springs of Baotu Spring erupting. Baotu Spring is the main attraction in the park, with three streams of clear and pure water that gushes day and night, reaching several feet in height during peak hours. There are large stone blocks around the spring, surrounded by railings, which allow you to overlook the spectacular scene of the three springs gushing in the pool from the edge of the railing. There is a stone tablet standing next to the spring, inscribed with the words "First Spring". Its color is dark green and it was inscribed by Prince Zhonglin of Licheng during the reign of Emperor Tongzhi of the Qing Dynasty. In addition, there are more than 30 famous springs scattered near Baotu Spring, including Jinxian Spring, Shuyu Spring, Xibo Spring, Liuxu Spring, Huanghua Spring, Dukang Spring, and Bailongquan, forming the Baotu Spring group. Due to the heavy rainfall in July and August, this is the best season to enjoy the spring water. In addition, the Baotu Spring Scenic Area has also launched a boat tour route. After visiting the Baotu Spring Scenic Area, tourists can board the boat at the Baotu Spring Boat Show if they are interested. The boat passes through the Ximen Bridge in the old city area of Jinan, passes through the east gate of Wulongtan Park, and enters the first passenger ship lock in Jinan's history - Wulongtan Ship Lock, where they can experience a drop of more than 2 meters. Sitting on the east side of the ship, you can still see the relief of the "Eight Scenic Spots of Jinan". There are many aquatic plants along the shore, and the river water is clear to the bottom. The cruise ship finally crossed the Yanbo Bridge and entered the Daming Lake Scenic Area.

poiName: The First Fairy Mountain on the Sea
summary: The "Number One Famous Mountain on the Sea" stone carving is located in the Jufeng Tourist Area and was inscribed by Chinese calligrapher Mr. Wu Zhongqi at the age of 95.
Rainbow Bridge is located in the beautiful city of Qingdao. Originally built to cross railways, it was later named Rainbow Bridge because colorful lights were hung on the bridge.

The design concept of the "Heluo Ancient City" project is based on the Heluo culture, with Ming and Qing architecture as the main carrier, supplemented by Sui and Tang architectural styles, showcasing the humanistic and traditional architectural culture of Luoyang for thousands of years. As a comprehensive urban cultural and tourism complex, "Heluo Ancient City" integrates food, accommodation, transportation, tourism, shopping, and entertainment. After completion, it will be a relatively large tourist hub and secondary consumption place in Luoyang city.

The Guangzhou Market Pedestrian Street is located in Jianxi District, Luoyang City. It features interactive cultural and creative activities, immersive theaters, dessert shops, beverage shops, and a variety of delicious food and snacks. At night, the street is brightly lit and lively.

poiName: Huanghe Shenxianwan Dahe Fengyun Sceneic Area
summary: The Yellow River Shenxian Bay Leisure Tourism Resort is located in the northeast of Shijing Town, Xin'an County, Luoyang City. It is surrounded by mountains and waters, with beautiful scenery. The scenic area is developed and constructed in three phases, including the Great River Fengyun, Leisure Agriculture, and Comprehensive Vacation areas. The industries involved in the park include famous flowers, seedlings, fruits, planting, breeding, and leisure tourism services. At present, the park has planted more than 100000 high-quality fruit trees and green tree species such as peaches, pears, grapes, large cherries, and soft seed pomegranates, with an agricultural industry area of over 2000 acres. Here, you can experience super cool and exciting karting, the speed and passion of the flying fairy, the age friendly Angry Birds, the bold and unrestrained horse racing, the exotic style of the Luo team, and more. Children can have intimate contact with Australian imported alpacas, beautiful peacocks, mischievous monkeys, and experience bamboo rafts wandering the rivers and lakes. Of course, wearing ancient costumes is also a good experience.

Liansan Island is located in the Yellow Sea, about 7.5 kilometers southwest of Qingdao Economic and Technological Development Zone, with an altitude of 6.1 meters, a length of 0.5 kilometers, a width of 0.1 kilometers, a coastline of 1.08 kilometers, and an area of 0.03 square kilometers. Liansan Island is mainly composed of three small islands that are connected by rising tides and separated by falling tides. The rising tides are separated, and the three islands stand proudly, while the falling tides make them stand shoulder to shoulder, working together as one, which is truly remarkable. Three small islands are arranged in a straight line, from north to south, from big to small, like three huge pearls extending deep into the South China Sea. The scenery of Liansan Island is unique, the environment is beautiful, there are more than ten kinds of strange stones, and seaweed is scattered on the rocks. The surrounding waters are rich in sea treasures such as yellow croaker, blackhead fish, eight banded fish, sea cucumber, abalone, etc., making it a good place for people to fish. Liansan Island is now not only a breeding base, but also a popular tourist destination for Chinese and foreign friends.

Qingdao Zangma Mountain International Tourism Resort combines natural beauty with a variety of recreational facilities. Here, there are various European style villas and small buildings, estate landscapes full of European style, as well as amusement parks, RV campsites, etc. In addition to enjoying the beautiful scenery, you can also experience leisure estate life firsthand. When you arrive here, the first thing that catches your eye is the beautiful blueberry town. Various European style small buildings are neatly arranged, and every decoration is full of design and romance. There is also a 2000 acre high-quality blueberry sightseeing and picking garden for tourists to pick. Millennium Valley is a large amusement park here and also a popular place in the entire scenic area. It offers gliding experiences and sightseeing planes. Paying in the air for this beautiful Tibetan horse mountain is sure to have a unique flavor. There are also camping and recreational facilities such as RVs here. There is also a horse riding enthusiast's amusement park called the Royal Racecourse in Zangma Mountain, where there are various experiential activities such as equestrian performances, competitions, and horseback riding. In winter, you can also experience the ski resort here. Of course, in addition to the beautiful scenery, there are also many delicious foods here. On the folk street, you can find almost all kinds of specialty snacks from all over the country.

Qingdao Mangrove Resort World is located on Binhai Avenue, near Huanghe Road. The total area is 800000 square meters, with 5 hotels of different styles, allowing for intimate contact with the sea within less than 100 meters.
The Kunming Museum of Contemporary Art is located in 1903 Park and is a museum with a strong contemporary art atmosphere.

Zhenqing Temple was first built in the Yuan Dynasty and was originally named "Zhenwu Temple". In the sixth year of the Ming Xuande reign (1431 AD), it was rebuilt and renamed "Zhenqing Temple". In the ninth year of the Ming Zhengtong reign (1444 AD), the front hall and east and west corridors of Zhenqing Temple were added. It was rebuilt in the fifty fourth year of the Qing Qianlong reign (1789 AD).
