The Zhenqingguan architectural complex is a relatively complete ancient architectural complex that covers a large area of Kunming city and preserves many buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties. The research on the architectural history, art history, religious history, and cultural exchange history between Yunnan and the Central Plains is of great value. The Zhenqing Temple consists of buildings such as the Front Hall, Ziwei Hall, and Laojun Hall. The three halls are all facing north and south, built on the same axis from south to north. On both sides of the central axis are the east-west corridors connecting the front hall and the Ziwei Hall. The Ziwei Hall is a three room wide civil structure building with a single eave gable roof, covering an area of 320 square meters. The entire building retains the architectural style of the Ming Dynasty, and the hall enshrines the Ziwei Emperor (Ziwei means the sun). Behind the Ziwei Hall is the Laojun Hall (with symmetrical east and west wing rooms on both sides), which has been repaired multiple times in history and still retains the architectural style of the Yuan Dynasty. The hall enshrines the Grand Master Laojun. Taishang Laojun, also known as Laozi, with the surname Li and the name Er, is believed to be Laodan. He was a philosopher during the Spring and Autumn period and the founder of the Taoist school.

The East Temple Pagoda is about 40.57 meters high, with a regular quadrilateral base and a side length of about 12 meters. The West Temple Pagoda is a thirteen level hollow brick pagoda with a square eaves, over 30 meters high, and has a three story tower base.

The Huiguang Temple Pagoda was also built during the Nanzhao period, commonly known as the West Temple Pagoda. During the reigns of Ming Hongzhi and Qing Daoguang, local damage occurred due to earthquakes, but it was repaired and preserved intact. The tower is square in plan and has thirteen levels of hollow brick towers with dense eaves. Each level of the tower is equipped with a voucher hole Buddha niche, and the two sides of the niche are decorated with relief small towers. The eaves are made of stacked green bricks, and the four corners of the outer eaves are upturned. Except for the top of the pagoda, there is a big Peng golden winged bird placed at each corner.

poiName: The Original Classroom of the National Southwest Associated University
summary: It is a well preserved classroom at Southwest Associated University, with adobe walls, iron roofs, and seats previously used by teachers and students, giving it a strong sense of history.
Tianchi is located on the west side of Jiaozi Mountain, at an altitude of about 4100 meters, and is the soul of the scenic area.

Wan'an Mountain Rainbow Grand Canyon is one of the two major scenic spots promoted by Wan'an Mountain Ecological Demonstration Zone. The scenic area has three tourist routes: Qutian Gorge, Baihua Creek, and Bailing Valley, with more than ten scenic spots including Feilai Waterfall, Baihua Creek, February Lake, Shilin Gorge, and Pangu Rock, and has a unique Danxia landform.

The Longfeng Mountain Scenic Area in Luoyang covers an area of over 5000 acres and is planned to consist of five major sections: "Songyun Ancient Town, Ecological Homestay Hotel, Elderly Care Center, and Leisure Farm".

Luoyang Longfengshan Ancient Town is located in Yichuan County, Luoyang City, Henan Province, covering an area of about 5000 acres. It is a tourist destination that integrates landscape scenery, historical culture, and folk customs. The ancient town is set against the backdrop of Song culture, based on the historical and cultural heritage of Yichuan, and incorporates elements of the Republic of China to create a large-scale comprehensive tourist resort. The attractions of the ancient town include Yishuiyao Ancient Town, homestay village, specialty hotels, amusement park, windmill flower sea, and study base. In addition, the ancient town also offers more than 40 amusement facilities, including children's playground, ice and snow world, Ferris wheel, castle horror, cliff swing, roller coaster, etc., suitable for tourists of different ages. In addition, the ancient town also has rich cultural activities and traditional handicraft exhibitions, such as dragon and lion dances, Henan opera performances, pottery making, etc., allowing tourists to experience the charm of traditional culture.

Going to the sea - Long Island people call it 'going to the sea', which means that during low tide, the water level of the sea drops and some marine creatures are left on the beach for people to pick up. Friends who want to go to sea can take a look at the Long Island Tide Table. The time to rush to the sea is one or two hours before and after low tide.

The Dongba Wishing Wind Chime is located in the Shuhe Tea Horse Ancient Town Scenic Area in Lijiang. In Dongba's traditional culture, the wishing wind chime is a symbol of blessings. The wishing wind chime is a long corridor composed of a long wooden frame, covered with wishing signs from tourists around the world, expressing their beautiful wishes.

Qiyi Street is a road from Sifang Street to the southeast of the ancient city, with lively shops along the street. This street is also one of the famous food gathering places in the ancient city. There are many snack stalls on the side of Qiyi Street, with various Lijiang style and national style snacks, suitable for shopping and eating while walking.

One of the Eight Scenic Spots of Shuhe River. The May Fourth Movement once established schools. In the 1930s, night schools were established where many villagers received cultural education and ignited the flame of their minds, hence the nickname "Stone Lotus Night School". The temple is built along the mountain, with a high and open terrain, suitable for sightseeing and wandering. It is a place for literati and poets to climb high and look far away. There is a stone cave inside that enshrines Buddha statues. Walking in is very cool and gives a calming feeling. Standing outside the temple, you can overlook the entire Shuhe Ancient Town.

Sifang Tingyin Square is located to the south of Shuhe Ancient Town, and the four characters "Sifang Tingyin" on the gate tower are very large; The word 'Sifang' is a pun, both derived from 'Sifang Street' and implying that it encompasses all directions and rivers. Every year, various large-scale activities in Shuhe, such as Snow Mountain Music Festival, Qixi Festival, model contest, bonfire party and various artistic performances, are held here. Sifang Tingyin also reflects the Naxi ethnic group's ability to listen to the sounds of the east, west, north, and south, absorb the essence of world culture, and embrace the broad mindedness of all ethnic groups.

The soft time of Lijiang and the Naxi ancient village under the Wenbi Peak not only constitute the campsite environment of Xingtuobang, but also serve as the inspiration for the campsite's starry sky themed culture The builders of Xingtuobang Campsite introduced that Lijiang is located at the intersection of Sichuan, Yunnan, and Tibet, and is an important destination on the western Yunnan tourism loop. It is the best choice for Xingtuobang's "dream gathering place". Xingtuobang Campsite aims to create a nomadic camping lifestyle in the form of a travel RV campsite, integrating the essence of "soft time" and heartfelt tourism into the "reluctant Lijiang". It has both the harmonious beauty of natural growth and the fashionable atmosphere brought by outdoor campsites, motorcycle elements, and more.

Fuguo Temple is the mother temple of the five major temples in Lijiang, and is one of the largest Karma Kagyu temples in Yunnan. The temple is surrounded by winding paths, lush trees, and beautiful scenery.

The Zhongyi Market is close to Dayan Ancient Town and is a place for local people to buy and sell in the Old Town of Lijiang. Only when you come to the Zhongyi Market can you hear the long lost Naxi dialect. Only here can you see so many Naxi elderly people wearing blue Naxi clothes and wearing stars and moon. Of course, a group of Naxi elderly people are jumping every day in Sifang Street, but that is a job assigned to them by relevant departments after they retire. At Zhongyi Market, the fresh and cheap local fruits and vegetables, the incomprehensible Naxi language conversations between small vendors and shoppers, and the backs of people carrying bamboo and vines to buy vegetables. At Zhongyi Market, there is also the life of Lijiang, real, wet, and alive!

Locke's former residence is located in Xuesong Village, south of Yulong Snow Mountain. It was the residence of American explorer Locke in Lijiang. There is an exhibition of the relics left by Locke's life in Lijiang a hundred years ago, which can reveal the explorer's love for Lijiang and the charm of Lijiang a hundred years ago. Joseph Locke was a famous Austrian American explorer. In 1922, he entered Yunnan from the Thai Burmese border as a writer and explorer for National Geographic magazine. After arriving in Lijiang, he lived there for more than 20 years because of his love for the area. He used Xuesong Village as his main base to gather local scenery, taking photos of animals, plants, and folk customs. He has written famous works such as "The Naxi Ancient Kingdom in Southwest China" and "The Naxi English Encyclopedia", introducing the customs of Yunnan, China to the world. The novel 'The Disappearing Horizon' was also written based on his exploration experience. The Locke Residence is a small building with one courtyard and three bedrooms, and it was also the former headquarters of the National Geographic Society's Yunnan Expedition in China. The living room where Locke lived for more than 20 years is located upstairs. At present, a large number of photos taken by Locke back then, as well as some of his relics left in Lijiang, are exhibited here. During the visit, visitors can feel the love of explorers for this place a hundred years ago, and also see some of the charm of Lijiang a hundred years ago.

poiName: Exhibition Hall of the Sword of Goujian

summary: Lingbo Gate is one of the entrances and exits of Wuhan University, famous for watching the sunrise.

poiName: Yellow Crane Tower Park - Millennium Bell
summary: The Millennium Bell, also known as the Millennium Auspicious Bell, is located on a high platform east of the Yellow Crane Tower along the axis of the mountain ridge. It is derived and transformed from an ancient bell stand.

tagNameList: Mountain Climbing; Historical Architectures; Nighttime sightseeing
summary: Located on the Lion Peak to the west of the Old Town of Lijiang, the Wangu Building is the manor building of the ancient Chieftain Mu's family. The pavilion is carved with scenery, and the appearance is very grand. With high terrain, Wangu Tower is a good place to watch and shoot the panorama of the Old Town of Lijiang. From the west side of the Old Town of Lijiang, you can climb the Lion Mountain, which takes about half an hour to one hour to reach the area of the Everlasting Tower. Although you can overlook the ancient city from an angle on the way up the mountain, it is not as open and spectacular as the Everlasting Tower. Standing in the scenic area, the gray roofs of the ancient city are laid out in a staggered pattern, and in the distance stands the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain with white peaks. The scenery is picturesque, and many widely circulated photographic films are taken from here. The Wangu Tower itself is also a building worth visiting. This attic has 13 upturned corners, symbolizing the thirteen peaks of the Jade Dragon; There are 2300 auspicious patterns in the carvings, such as wearing stars and the moon, all of which are very exquisite and represent the 23 ethnic groups living in Lijiang; In addition, there are dragon patterns, coffered ceilings, stone carvings, etc., each with its own characteristics. Don't miss them when visiting.

Zhiyin Jiuzhen Scenic Area is located in Jiuzhen Mountain National Forest Park, Yong'an Town, Caidian District, Wuhan. With the theme of "Water and Wood Jiuzhen, Health and Wellness Park", it relies on the cultural heritage of Zhiyin's hometown and the mountain and water resources of Jiuzhen Mountain to construct an ecological leisure tourism resort that combines movement and stillness, and integrates mountains and waters. The total area of Jiuzhen Mountain National Forest Park is over 20000 acres, with a forest vegetation rate of 92%. The vegetation is lush, the gullies are crisscrossing, the mountain springs are murmuring, the birds are singing and the flowers are fragrant, and the scenery is charming throughout the four seasons. The oxygen ion content in the air is more than ten times that of the city center area, forming an excellent natural oxygen bar. Jiuzhen Mountain is the highest peak in the Jianghan Plain, with nine consecutive peaks winding and undulating like a floating dragon. It was formerly known as the "Town Mountain of Hanyang County". Legend has it that this place is the residence of the great king Bodhisattva and was once a Taoist holy site in the Jianghan Plain and surrounding areas in history. During the Song Dynasty, there was a temple called Jiuzhen Temple built on a mountain. It is said that nine real people gathered here to refine pills, and the incense was very strong in ancient times. Spring outings to pick ferns, summer solstice to watch lotus flowers pick watermelons, autumn to climb high and pick honey oranges, winter solstice snow to watch rime, allowing tourists to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Jiuzhen, appreciate the culture of kindred spirits, and appreciate the picturesque countryside while personally experiencing rural life and the joy of harvesting agricultural fruits.

The Luoyan Scenic Area is located on the east bank of Donghu Lake in Wuhan and is an important part of the Donghu Scenic Area. The scenic area has undulating hills, vast water bodies, numerous peninsulas, and intersecting harbors, creating a very beautiful natural environment. Every year, the scenic area attracts a large number of migratory birds to winter, and a large number of cormorants inhabit the pond cypress on the island, which is very spectacular and can be called the "bird hunting land" of Wuhan. The scenic area includes eight major landscapes, including Qinghe Ancient Bridge, Magpie Bridge Meeting, Yanzhou Suoqiao, Luzhou Ancient Ferry, Zhao's Garden, Ancient Tree Wonders, Yanqiping Sand, and Luzhou Falling Geese, full of romantic feelings.
Romantic Lighthouse: Every seaside city has a beautiful lighthouse, and the lighthouse in Weihai is located in Yuehai Park.

The Memorial Hall of the Fifth National Congress of the Communist Party of China was established in 2007 and is located in the Tanqiu Campus of Zhonghua Road Primary School in Wuchang District, Wuhan. It complements the old site of the Agricultural Lecture Hall on the same street, forming a "red scenic spot". The memorial hall is lush with trees and has a building area of approximately 4000 square meters. The museum displays the venue for the opening ceremony of the Fifth National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the bedroom of Chen Tanqiu and his wife, and the teaching classrooms of Chen Tanqiu and Wu Xiuquan. It consists of three exhibition areas: "Peak and Crisis", "Contribution and Limitations", and "Response and Transformation". At present, the Memorial Hall of the Fifth National Congress of the Communist Party of China has collected more than 110 cultural relics and historical materials, and some of them are exhibited to the public. Through the use of high-tech means, the heartbreaking historical scene around 1927 has been reproduced.

Wuhan University Library is renowned for its long history, rich collection of books, and elegant environment. The library originated from the Hubei Ziqiang School Library founded by Governor Zhang Zhidong at the end of the last century, and was officially established in 1917. The museum currently has five branches, including the Humanities Branch, Science Branch, Engineering Branch, Information Science Branch, and Medical Branch, all of which are "research level literature collection units" in Hubei Province. In August 2000, Wuhan University merged with Wuhan University of Water Resources and Electric Power, Wuhan University of Surveying and Mapping Technology, and Hubei Medical University, and the libraries of the four universities were also merged into the new Wuhan University Library. The current building area of the school is 41925 square meters for the library and 16601 square meters for the reference room, with a total area of 58526 square meters. Wuhan University Library is planning to expand a new library of 35000 square meters. After the completion of the new library, its service functions will be further improved. The old library of Wuhan University and its surrounding architectural complex have been listed as the fifth batch of national key cultural relics protection units.

Mulan Flower Village takes "rural tourism" as its theme and strives to create a flower world that can be enjoyed 365 days a year. The scenic area has three main theme flower seas: the Left Bank of Paris, Van Gogh Impressions, and Rainbow Flower Fields, allowing you to enjoy the wonderful scenery of blooming flowers. The Left Bank of Paris is characterized by flat puzzles and three-dimensional shapes, creating a constant flow of flowers every day and flowers to be enjoyed every month. Tulips, lavender, Sanger flowers, and other plants are planted here, blooming in the countryside 365 days a day. Castle scenes from Hayao Miyazaki's anime and classic characters from fairy tales are interspersed, making people feel like they have entered a dreamlike kingdom. Van Gogh's impression is mainly based on a sea of flowers, cleverly utilizing different flowering periods to plant lavender, tulips, February orchids, Gesang flowers and other flowers. Different seasons can bring you different pure color romance. The Rainbow Flower Field is exactly the opposite of Van Gogh's impression, planting various red, yellow, purple, and green flowers. At every solar term, it always allows you to experience the splendor of being in a colorful world. In the rows of terraced fields, various flower varieties are colorful and compete with each other, forming three-dimensional color blocks like a colorful ribbon with a fragrant sky, which is shocking.

Ziwei Urban Countryside is invested and built by Wuhan Haifan Ecological Agriculture Co., Ltd. It is located on Cangbu Street in Xinzhou District and is a core agricultural demonstration park. The park cultivates over a thousand ancient trees and collaborates with Chengdu Tianxiang Company to introduce precious varieties of crape myrtle, planting tens of thousands of plants to create a "crape myrtle characteristic cultural park". Ziwei Urban Countryside has also reached an agreement with the Lotus Variety Base - Donghu Lotus Variety Park, introducing rare lotus varieties and planting more than 30000 high-quality osmanthus trees, making "viewing lotus, viewing Wei, and enjoying Gui" a major feature of the park and a "new landmark" for flower viewing tours in Wuhan's New Flower City. In addition to the beautiful pastoral scenery, the park also has an interactive entertainment area, which is an important venue for large-scale entertainment activities and a "carnival" for tourists to relax and entertain. Here, a variety of interactive entertainment activities are provided, including introduced amusement facilities, rural entertainment activities, and cutting-edge life experience activities. The sightseeing train area leading directly from the entrance of the scenic area to the hinterland of the park has a dedicated joyful bicycle rental area, with two person couple bikes, three person family bikes, and other options for tourists to freely choose from. Riding and entertaining in the sea of flowers, experiencing the fragrance of flowers, it is not pleasant.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

summary: The Ziwei Flower Sea Scenic Area is located on Dongjing Street in the Wuhan Economic and Technological Development Zone (Hannan District) and is a modern agricultural technology demonstration park. The Ziwei Flower Sea Scenic Area features a "flower sea" for sightseeing, with a year-round theme flower sea that allows you to wander among the colorful flowers and experience a super stunning immersive color feast. The scenic area has created a series of amusement facilities according to the needs of tourists; Here, you can experience various recreational activities such as water parks, boating, fishing, picking, flower watching, camping, and more, bringing you endless joy. In 2023, the Ziwei Flower Sea Scenic Area will undergo a new upgrade, creating a starry night view of the flower sea. Multiple themed flash mob events will be held from time to time. It is a gathering place for flower sea scenes that integrates entertainment, food, performing arts, technology, culture, and other elements, aiming to provide tourists with a more diverse and colorful gaming experience.

Yue Fei's bronze sculptures are located in the east of the Yellow Crane Tower Park, 612 meters east of the Yellow Crane Tower and 338 meters east of the Baiyun Pavilion, adjacent to the Stone memorial archway Group.

The Liangzi Lake Scenic Area is located on Liangzi Lake Avenue. The main attraction, Liangzi Lake, was originally named "Niangzi Lake" and is the central lake of the Wuhan urban circle. The main attractions in the scenic area include Qingshan Island, Liangzi Island, Tianzi Mountain, etc.
You can experience galloping horses, grassland performances, horse racing competitions, ancient costumes, and more.

The Lingbomen Scenic Area is located on Donghu South Road in Wuchang District, named after the Lingbomen located on Donghu South Road near Wuhan University. Lingbo Gate is composed of several rows of stacked bridges that extend into the lake and encircle it, making it a popular attraction for students and tourists from other places to set foot in Donghu Lake.

poiName: ji nuo shan xiang me zhuo sen bu lu ma bang yu lin chuan yue
summary: Explore the mysterious Mojosenburu Rainforest Wonderland! Welcome to one of the world's precious treasure trove - Xishuangbanna Tropical Rainforest! Let us take you on a journey full of surprises and adventures. The humid air is filled with dense green, and the ubiquitous tropical plants and trees make up this breathtaking ecosystem. In the tranquility of the rainforest, you will personally experience the power and beauty of nature. Lost in the dense canopy, you will encounter various peculiar creatures. Colorful birds soar in the sky, while butterflies dance among the flowers. This is a true animal kingdom waiting for your discovery. Rainforest is one of the rich and diverse ecosystems on Earth, with countless species of plants and animals. Here, you can learn the mysteries of nature and feel the subtle balance of ecosystems. Protecting this oasis is the responsibility of each and every one of us, let us work together to make the rainforest last forever. Join our exploration team and explore the depths of the rainforest. You will follow an experienced guide through dense forests, clear streams, and explore the secrets hidden behind the green leaves. This will be a wonderful journey that you will never forget. The rainforest will bring you endless surprises and inspirations. Come and join our Mojosenburu Rainforest Adventure, get in touch with nature and discover the wonders of life! Let's protect the rainforest together and inherit the treasures of nature!

The Naval Academy is located in the Liugong Island Scenic Area of Weihai. It was built in the 16th year of the Guangxu reign of the Qing Dynasty (1890 AD) and covers an area of about 20000 square meters. There are still east and west gates, screen walls, buttresses, small stages, and stables. This is currently the only naval academy in China that can be traced. At that time, the overall office of the Naval Academy was led by Admiral Ding Ruchang. In the winter of 1889, 36 students were recruited from Shanghai, Fujian, Guangdong and other places, with an additional 10 students joining the school, for a total of 46 students. In May 1890, the Naval Academy began teaching courses in English, geometry, algebra, piloting, astronomy, and was equipped with four training ships: Agile, Kangji, Weiyuan, and Haijing for teaching purposes. The Naval Academy was established for four years and graduated a class of 30 driving students. After the Sino Japanese War of 1894-1895, Liugong Island fell and the Naval Academy was destroyed by the flames of war. Weihai Naval Academy was restored and opened in June 2004.

The Wuhan Art Museum is located between Zhongshan Avenue and Baohua Street in Jiang'an District, Wuhan City. This used to be the location of Hankou Jincheng Bank, the headquarters of the Japanese occupation army stationed in Wuhan, Wuhan Library, and Wuhan Children's Library. Now it is the location of Wuhan Art Museum. The exterior of the art museum retains the original style of Hankou Jincheng Bank, and only the interior has been scientifically renovated. The overall layout is in the form of a central courtyard corridor, with seven exhibition halls covering an area of approximately 2600 square meters. All exhibition halls adopt slide type movable display boards and walls, making exhibition display and layout more flexible and visually varied. There are also artist studios, training classrooms, restoration rooms, libraries, art salons, and other places in the museum. The museum houses over 1000 art pieces, involving nearly 200 artists from across the country, covering various categories such as traditional Chinese painting, oil painting, watercolor, sculpture, photography, and more. This building standing in the center of the city has become an "art island" in the middle of the road.

poiName: Moshan Meiyuan Pier of East Lake
summary: The Moshan Meiyuan Pier for East Lake Cruise is located in the Moshan Scenic Area of Wuhan, adjacent to the scenic area. There are many surrounding attractions, such as the East Lake Meiyuan, Moshan Scenic Area, East Lake Cherry Blossom Garden, Wuhan Botanical Garden, etc. It is one of the important piers for East Lake cruise ships and also the intersection of multiple routes. At present, the operating routes include Xingyinge Port to Moshan Meiyuan Port, and Luoxia Shuixie Port to Moshan Meiyuan Port. After arriving at Moshan Meiyuan Pier by taking the East Lake cruise ship, tourists can walk 10 meters to reach the Wuhan East Lake Greenway. The Greenway is built around the lake and has a total length of over 100 kilometers. It is the main road for visiting the East Lake Ecological Scenic Area. The entire journey can only be taken on foot or by bicycle (there are official electric bicycles available for riding, which require additional payment). Strolling here, you can experience the vast and magnificent lake scenery and overlook the city core with towering buildings. 50 meters away from Moshan Meiyuan Pier is the Donghu Meiyuan Scenic Area. Every year from January to February, when the plum blossoms bloom, it attracts many tourists from both inside and outside the city to come and enjoy. The south gate of Moshan Scenic Area and Donghu Cherry Blossom Garden Scenic Area are located 100 meters southeast of Donghu Meiyuan Pier. Moshan Scenic Area does not require admission tickets and is one of the best choices for Wuhan people to go on outings. Donghu Cherry Blossom Garden is one of the three major cherry blossom viewing destinations in the world. Every year from March to April, tourists from all over the country gather in Wuhan to witness the lush beauty of cherry blossoms.

Yiwu Ancient Tea Mountain is one of the six ancient tea mountains with a particularly large tea garden area and high yield. It has an altitude of 656-2023 meters. The difference in altitude is significant, forming a three-dimensional climate with two climatic characteristics: warm and humid, and warm. Different climatic conditions in residential areas result in different ecological environments.

poiName: man duan fo si ( xi bei men dian )
summary: The Manduan Buddhist Temple was first built in the year 312 of the Dai calendar, and the existing main hall is a Qing Dynasty building. Manqian Buddhist Temple faces west and east, with a gate pavilion and a Buddha tablet. Composed of precepts, Buddhist pagodas, monk's quarters, and drum houses. The Buddha Hall is the main building of the Manqian Buddhist Temple, with a vertical layout and four bays on each side and eight bays in depth. The architectural modeling and decorative art of Manchufo Temple embodies the essence of ancient Dai architectural technology and historical culture.

The Dai ethnic village is located in the Xishuangbanna Dai Ethnic Park Scenic Area, 28 kilometers away from the capital Jinghong City. Including five Dai villages within the scenic area: Manjiang, Manchunman, Manting, Manzha, and Manga, they are under the jurisdiction of the Manting Office in Menghan Town. A typical Dai village has a "ganlan" style bamboo building, with bamboo fences between households forming their own courtyards.

poiName: Van Gogh Star Sky Art Museum (Wuhan Flagship Store)
summary: Classic Return: Thank you to Van Gogh Starry Sky Art Museum (Wuhan flagship store). After bidding farewell, the classic returns! The upgraded 3.0 super scene presents a new top check-in spot. 10000 simulated sunflower flowers are used to create the largest sunflower flower sea in the current single store in China, as seen in 'The Disappearance of Her'. The breathtakingly beautiful "Van Gogh painting tour" offers an immersive experience of Van Gogh's many classic works. Numerous classic scenes are waiting for you to unlock, and there are also limited edition customized souvenirs to take home! The trip to Wuhan was worth it
opening_hours: Opens at 09:30-18:30(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

poiName: Wuhan Natural History Museum·Behring River Lifer Museum
summary: The Beilin Dahe Life Hall of Wuhan Natural History Museum is located north of the Yangtze River Civilization Museum, with a building area of 29000 square meters and an exhibition area of 18000 square meters. The entrance is the Beilin Honor Wall and the Guide Service Functional Area. The first floor is the Prologue Hall, Dahe Shichang, Dahe Zhenling Exhibition Area, Collection Warehouse, and Specimen Restoration Room; The second floor is dedicated to contemplation of the great river, exploration of the great river, Beilin cultural and creative exhibition area, and a caf é; The third floor consists of exhibition halls, science popularization spaces, and office areas. The permanent exhibition "Song of Life on the Journey of the Great River" is set against the backdrop of the great river, with the theme of life and the donation of specimens by Beilin as the basis. The exhibition concept is based on the dialogue between the Yangtze River and the world's great rivers, focusing on the key content of the river, biology, and human beings. It fully utilizes nearly 3000 ancient organisms, animal and plant specimens, and modern exhibition methods to showcase the geological background related to the great river, the life history of the river itself, the biodiversity, connectivity, and differences of representative great rivers in the world, as well as the natural laws of ecosystem succession and life evolution. Thus arousing people's awareness of paying more attention to rivers, loving rivers, and protecting rivers.

The Mawangdui Exhibition Hall mainly displays cultural relics unearthed from the Mawangdui Han Tomb, Shang and Zhou bronze ware, Chu cultural relics, ceramics from various dynasties, calligraphy and painting, and modern cultural relics. In order to fully display these cultural relics and treasures in this art hall, Xiangbo people scientifically and deeply excavated the connotation of cultural relics, utilized modern exhibition art, and carefully created the "Changsha Mawangdui Han Tomb Exhibition".

The Fire Palace Archway is located at 127 Pozi Street, Changsha. The archway was originally the gatehouse of Qianyuan Palace. It was first built in the 12th year of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty and was renovated in the 6th year of the Daoguang reign. The archway is made of bricks, and the roof is a "mountain" shaped pavilion tower building. The walls are decorated with dragons, phoenixes, and human reliefs. It is now a cultural relic protection unit in Changsha City.

Xishuangbanna Rongchuang Water World is located in Jinghong Industrial Park. Thanks to the "tropical rainforest" style of Banna, the park's various water play facilities and slide designs are inspired by the appearance of rainforest plants, making it an ideal place for summer leisure and summer retreat. Tourists can experience the diving slide, which is high and fast, thrilling and exciting. You can also sit on an inflatable boat with a few friends, play in the water on the slide, and have endless fun. It's very suitable to invite friends to play in the water and escape the heat in the hot and humid summer.

Base Introduction: "Tianyuan Bug Fun · Yunnan Bug Valley" is located in the beautiful water pipeline of Bapo, Jinuo Township, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna, 16 kilometers away from the city center of Jinghong. Xishuangbanna is truly a "kingdom of animals" and "kingdom of plants". "Yunnan Worm Valley" is based on the Tianyuan Forest Dendrobium planting base, which has a wide variety of animal and plant resources, including many rare, ancient, peculiar, and endangered animals and plants. These are the unique primitive forest resources of Xishuangbanna. As the Xishuangbanna Education Base of China Association for Scientific Exploration, Xishuangbanna Youth Science Popularization Education Base, Yunnan Insect Society Insect Observation Base, and Chinese Academy of Sciences Insect Observation Point. While carrying out activities such as exploring natural ecological resources, studying insects, educating and cultivating traditional Chinese medicine, and promoting health tourism, "Yunnan Insect Valley" actively spreads the protection of natural ecological environment and promotes the unique natural resources of Xishuangbanna. Carry out ecological education and sustainable development education, allowing you to truly experience and understand the real tropical rainforest in person! ﻿

The Lancang River originates from Tanggula Mountain on the Qinghai Tibet Plateau and flows abroad through Xishuangbanna. It is also one of the important scenic areas in Xishuangbanna. Generally, tourists who come to Banna come back here to see the scenery, and the best way to visit the Lancang River scenery is by boat drifting. The entire journey of drifting on the Lancang River takes less than two hours. Along the way, you will pass by the magnificent Xishuangbanna Bridge, Dai ethnic villages with stilt houses, shallow waters where you can have water fights, and other attractions. In the middle of the island, you can also enjoy tropical fruits, drink rice wine, and experience the Dai ethnic customs.

The Dadugang 10000 acre tea plantation is located in Dadugang Township, Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Prefecture. From March to October every year, it is the landscape period of the 10000 acre tea garden in Dadugang. After a spring rain, tea leaves begin to sprout one after another. At this time, the tea garden is full of green and lush greenery everywhere. In the early morning, the tea garden is shrouded in smoke and clouds. After being washed by dew, the tea tips shine with a crystal clear light. Under a ray of sunshine at dawn, the tea pickers begin their day of hard work. Bathing in the afternoon sunshine, tasting a cup of aged Pu'er tea, watching the tea leaves float in the water, the scorching water temperature creates a strong and vibrant tea aroma, and the faint fragrance emitted by the tea trees fills the nose, making people feel relaxed and happy. Entering the tea garden, under the sunshine, the lush greenery covering the mountains and fields may not be as strong and fragrant as the roasted tea leaves, but it is still enough to make people feel refreshed.

The Ethnic Cultural Paek is located on the beautiful quicksand river in the south of Jinghong, covering an area of 1000 mu. In the past, the Ethnic Cultural Paek was a research base for research and planting. In 1988, the state government officially transformed it into a Ethnic Cultural Paek, integrating the precious tropical plants of Xishuangbanna with the rich national style, and becoming a microcosm of the beautiful Xishuangbanna.

In 1898, famous comrades were born here, and their residence is a traditional Hunan residential building with a pond in front of it. A plaque reading "Former Residence of Famous Comrades" hangs at the main entrance of the former residence. The former residence was once destroyed, but the current one has been restored to its original appearance. There is a Comrade Liu Shaoqi Memorial Hall near the former residence, which contains some daily necessities of Liu Shaoqi's life.

Comrade Liu Shaoqi was born here in 1898 and conducted research here in 1961. The scenic area has the former residence of Comrade Liu Shaoqi and a Comrade Liu Shaoqi Memorial Hall, which is a place to learn about Comrade Liu Shaoqi's life. There is also a Soviet made plane in the scenic area, which was the one Liu Shaoqi flew on back then. Compared to the natural scenery within the scenic area, most tourists come for the "hometown of Liu Shaoqi". There is a bronze statue of Comrade Liu Shaoqi in the scenic area; In the Comrade Liu Shaoqi Memorial Hall, the life achievements of great figures are displayed; Comrade Liu Shaoqi's former residence is an ordinary brick and wood farmhouse. In the newly built Huaming Garden, there is a Soviet made Il-18 aircraft.

The former residence of Yang Kaihui was first built in the late Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty, in 1795. It was the site of early revolutionary activities by Mao Zedong and Yang Kaihui, and was an ordinary farmhouse building with a brick and wood structure. The courtyard houses face west to east, surrounded by mountains and water. There is a lotus pond and a small stream in front, backed by bamboo forests. In the distance, the fragrance of ripe rice fills the air, and the rustic scenery of the mud brick walls, small green tiles, and gate gate houses is hidden. In 1966, the former residence was restored and opened to the public. In 1983, it was announced as a cultural relic protection unit in Hunan Province.

poiName: Yang Kaihui Lifetime Achievement Exhibition Hall

summary: Life is full of problems, and the rainforest knows the answer. Welcome to Xishuangbanna, where you can put aside the busyness and fatigue of city life and experience hiking through the Little Elephant Rainforest. Follow the Jino hunters and venture deep into the primitive jungle, tracing streams, drilling forests, climbing mountains, sliding on muddy slopes, crossing the unknown and encountering wonders under the huge banana leaves. Listen to the chirping of birds and insects, feel the breathing of plants, discover the footprints of wild hunters and muntjacs, search for mountain crabs hiding in small streams and the motionless bamboo leaves on green vines, learn basic rainforest survival skills, and meet sentient beings, nature, and oneself in the strange and diverse rainforest. (Encountering mountain crabs while tracing the river) In the rainforest, no matter how confident you are in life, there will always be moments of helplessness. Just taking two easy steps, you face a choice. Crossing the rainforest is not to defeat nature, but to challenge yourself. Learning the survival wisdom of nature in a primitive state requires wisdom, persistence, a state of mind that enjoys excitement, challenges, and difficulties, as well as adapting to the environment, knowing awe, and learning to bow down, in order to find your own answers and successfully navigate through the fog of life. The Elephant Eye in the Little Elephant Rainforest: From a satellite map, the Little Elephant Rainforest looks like a lying elephant, so it is named Little Elephant Rainforest. It is about 30 kilometers away from Jinghong city and an hour's drive away. (Small Elephant Rainforest View) The Small Elephant Rainforest is not an ordinary scenic area or park, and there is no artificial development. As a private rainforest for the Little Elephant's journey, there will be no bustling tourists around you on the way. You and your companions can enjoy this peaceful rainforest to the fullest. Since its launch in 2015, nearly 10000 people have safely crossed the rainforest, some as young as four years old, while others as young as 70 years old are physically strong and often engage in outdoor hiking. Crossing during the rainy season (June to October) takes about 4 hours, while crossing during the dry season (November to May of the following year) takes about 3 hours. To ensure your experience and protect the rainforest ecology from excessive disturbance, the Little Elephant Rainforest is currently limited to 100 people per day. Advance reservations are required, and two or more people can travel alone with a dedicated guide. When the number of people is large, the guide ratio is not less than 5:1. The guides of the Little Elephant Rainforest are all local villagers, who are the last generation of hunters of the Jino tribe. Forty years ago, the Jino tribe was still in the late primitive society, engaged in slash and burn farming, hunting and harvesting. They are the indigenous people familiar with the rainforest. With a knife, a spark, and a pack of salt, they can survive in the vast rainforest for many days. The rainforest feast after the crossing is over, with fresh ingredients from the original ecology, primitive production techniques, and cups, bamboo chopsticks, and bamboo spoons made on site using fresh bamboo as tableware. Many guests refer to it as "a unique, delicious, and memorable meal they have ever had in their lifetime" and "a feast that reaches the depths of their souls". Highly recommended, not to be missed. In 2018, Longxiang Tourism Company, Xishuangbanna Tropical Rainforest Protection Foundation, and Xiaoxiang Future Growth Plan jointly launched the "Returning Rubber to Forests and Restoring Rainforests" public welfare project in Jinuo Township. Using Xiaoxiang Rainforest as the base, they mobilized villagers to cut down the surrounding high-altitude rubber forests and replace them with diversified tree species. The foundation raised funds from society to distribute seedling management fees to villagers. Longxiang Tourism Company led villagers to develop ecological travel through "Xiaoxiang Journey", achieving diversified and sustainable income growth. Xiaoxiang Rainforest Crossing is one of the important projects, and villagers serve as guides and chefs to obtain easier and richer income. As of 2022, a total of 503 acres have been restored, with over 20 species and more than 30000 trees planted. Management fees of over 900000 yuan have been distributed to 36 households participating in the project. Through tourism and agricultural product sales, villagers have increased their income by over 1.5 million yuan. At the beginning of 2023, Rainforest Crossing became a new popular tourism project in Jinuo Township, with 8 travel agencies and 4 to 5 village groups learning to carry out rainforest crossing, directly benefiting thousands of villagers. We have created a new career for young people of the Jino ethnic group. In 2022, the Little Elephant Rainforest Hiking Project won the "Annual Ecological Protection&Community Economic Development Award" at the Voyage New Travel Sustainability Awards. The judging panel composed of multiple celebrities and experts believes that the Elephant Future Growth Plan's Elephant Rainforest Crossing "allows people to understand the rainforest, establish national cultural confidence, and raise awareness of ecological environment protection. The "Elephant Rainforest" and "Elephant Future Growth Plan" call for the protection of endangered wild Asian elephants and explore sustainable development supported by good commercial practices. Protecting the rainforest is protecting ourselves. Welcome, join us on a journey to protect the elephant rainforest and the tropical rainforest of Xishuangbanna, protect the homeland of wild Asian elephants, and help local people preserve and inherit the wisdom and methods of rainforest survival that is about to disappear. The fee paid by each guest, in addition to the labor fee distributed to the villagers on the same day, includes 60 yuan directly used for the protection and management of the elephant rainforest, and 5% donated to the Tropical Rainforest Conservation Foundation to support the public welfare cause of rainforest restoration.

The Tanhe River Bronze Museum is located in Ningxiang City, which is known as the "hometown of peace". It officially opened on September 30, 2016 and is a bronze culture themed museum. The museum has a building area of 8662 square meters and a total of 5027 cultural relics, including 4 first-class cultural relics, 6 second-class cultural relics, 176 third class cultural relics, and 4841 general cultural relics. The museum displays bronze artifacts unearthed in Ningxiang as carriers and relies on the archaeological achievements of the Tanhe River site. Following the exhibition theme of "The Development History of Chinese Bronze Civilization - The Reproduction of the Tanhe River Country - Interpretation of Bronze Civilization", it reproduces the glorious history of the Tanhe River in Ningxiang during the Shang and Zhou dynasties.

The Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Museum is a public welfare infrastructure for carrying out science popularization work and activities in society. Located next to the Cultural Park, at No. 9 Shanmuchong West Road, covering an area of 124000 square meters, including a construction area of 28113 square meters, with a total investment of over 300 million yuan. The content of Hunan Science and Technology Museum is divided into four parts: first, science popularization exhibitions, including permanent exhibitions and short-term exhibitions; The second is science popularization reports, lectures, and training education; Thirdly, scientific experimental education; The fourth is film and television (including educational films with an inner diameter of 18 meters and 4D dynamic educational films). There are 9 exhibition areas including Material Space, Energy World, Information Harbor, Earth Home, Life Experience, Mathematical Enlightenment, Space Exploration, and Children's Science Park. The content covers manufacturing, energy, materials, information, environment, mathematics, physics, life, astronomy and other fields, with a total of 351 exhibits/sets.

Huanglong Grand Canyon is located in Gugang Town, Liuyang, an excellent tourist city in China, just over an hour's drive from Changsha and only 20 minutes from Liuyang city center. It is currently one of the drifting destinations that is close, attractive, exciting, and far away from Changsha.

poiName: mei lan liu guo wen hua cheng

summary: The location of Menghan Manting Buddhist Pagoda Temple still retains the traditional Buddhist tradition of one village and one temple. Manting Buddhist Pagoda Temple and the white pagoda in the temple were built quite early, with a long history and magnificent grandeur. There is a pagoda tree in the temple that is regarded as a sacred tree by the locals.

The Ming Xiaoling Museum is located in the Zhongshan Scenic Area of Xuanwu District, Nanjing City. It is a special exhibition hall about the Ming Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang, the world cultural heritage Ming Xiaoling, and Nanjing Ming culture. The new museum adopts the architectural style of the Jiangnan region in the Ming and Qing dynasties, with typical elements such as white walls, gray tiles, carved wooden doors, sloping roofs, horse head walls, and lattice windows. This makes the overall building harmonious with the surrounding cultural relics of the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, such as the Great Golden Gate and Sifang City, as well as the lush natural environment. This is also in line with the construction concept of "harmony between man and nature" in the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum more than 600 years ago. The Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum is the joint burial tomb of the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang, and the empress Ma. It is named Xiaoling because the empress was posthumously named "Xiaoci". It is a large imperial tomb in Nanjing and one of the ancient imperial tombs in China. As the first Ming dynasty tomb in China, the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum is magnificent and represents the achievements of architecture and stone carving art in the early Ming Dynasty. It directly influenced the form of imperial tombs in the Ming and Qing dynasties for more than 500 years. The Ming and Qing imperial tombs, which are distributed in Beijing, Hubei, Liaoning, Hebei and other places according to the historical process, were all built according to the regulations and models of the Southern Capital Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum. They have a special position in the development history of imperial tombs in China and are therefore known as the "first imperial tomb of the Ming and Qing dynasties".

The Old Gate East memorial archway is the main entrance of the Old Gate East Historic District, which is a landmark building here. A stone tablet below the memorial archway is engraved with the history of Nanjing City, which has a lot of historical and cultural details.

The Nanjing Couple Garden was personally planned and designed by Mr. Zhu Youjie, a famous Chinese garden design master. The garden has a rich variety of plants, a serene atmosphere, and a strong artistic conception. The Flower Park is located in the northeast of the city, adjacent to Xuanwu Lake to the south and backed by Purple Mountain to the east. The park has functions such as sightseeing, viewing, leisure, entertainment, and wedding celebrations, as well as content for youth plant science popularization knowledge internships.

Liangzhou is located in Xuanwu District, Nanjing City, and is one of the five continents of Xuanwu Lake. It has attractions such as the Temple of the Lake, the Scenic Tower, the Friendship Hall, and the Jinling Bonsai Garden.

Mingjing Lake, located within Qixia Mountain, is naturally formed, with peach blossom streams and mid peak streams flowing down into the lake. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, the lake area here was larger than it is now. Water lilies and lotus flowers were widely planted in the lake. At that time, willows and maple trees on the shore complemented each other, and it was often a place for literati to drink and write poetry. In 1751, Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty came to Qixia Mountain on his first southern tour. When he saw the scenery of Mingjing Lake, he immediately wrote "Seven Wonders, Mingjing Lake" with his brush and ink; Rainbow is not sunshine, mirror is not copper. The bends of the creek and the bridge are intertwined. Xi Biming distinguishes between truth and falsehood, using his false illusions to cover up the vacuum. The stone Guanyin Bodhisattva, several meters high in the lake, smiles kindly at all beings in the world. A rainbow pavilion is built in the center of the lake, and a rainbow like curved bridge runs through it. The lake water is clear and transparent, just like a mirror; Ripples suddenly rise, and waves of light float. The red leaves around are reflected inside, beautiful beyond measure.

Zhongshan Port is located on the south bank of the Yangtze River in Nanjing, also known as Xiaguan Port. Before the opening of the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge in the past, people used to take ferries across the river through Zhongshan Pier, with Pukou Railway Station (Nanjing North Station) on the opposite bank. Transportation at the pier was extremely busy. Until the opening of the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge and the closure of Pukou Railway Station, only some locals still take ferries at Zhongshan Pier. However, due to the strong Republican style of Zhongshan Pier and Pukou Railway Station, it has attracted many literary and artistic youth and photography enthusiasts to come here for photos and nostalgia. Its tourism significance is gradually outweighing its transportation role. The "Ningpu Line" ferry still operates from Zhongshan Port to Pukou Port today. From 5:00 to 23:00, the ferry departs every 20 minutes, with a 15 minute one-way fare of 2 yuan. Pukou Port is adjacent to Pukou Railway Station. Take a ferry and take a look at the old railway station. Here, you can embark on a nostalgic journey of the Republic of China.

Nanjing Yuzui Wetland Park is located at the southern end of Hexi New City in Jianye District, Nanjing, at the confluence of the Yangtze River, Jiajiang River, and Qinhuai New River. The total area is 640000 square meters, with wetlands as the theme, cleverly integrating ecological water treatment systems, treehouses, wetland workstations and other facilities to create a wild urban ecological park.

The former residence of Gan Xi, also known as Gan Family Courtyard or Gan Xi Mansion, was built by Gan Fu in Jiangning during the early years of the Qing Dynasty's Daoguang reign. Gan Xi was the second son of Gan Fu and a famous literati of the late Qing Dynasty. He had passed the imperial examination and had a wealth of works throughout his life. It was discovered in the cultural relics census conducted by the cultural relics department of Nanjing in 1982. In order to effectively utilize and reproduce the style of Jiangnan residential buildings during the Ming and Qing dynasties, the cultural relics department repaired some buildings and built the Nanjing Folk Customs Museum. The museum was opened to the public in November 1992, designated as a cultural protection unit in Jiangsu Province in 1995, and listed as a patriotic education base under the jurisdiction of the government in 2001. The outer side now forms a distinctive folk culture old street with the historical old street of Xinanli.

The Confucius Temple Yuhua Stone Museum is located at 122 Gongyuan Street, Confucius Temple, Nanjing, with an area of 1400 square meters. It is a professional museum for appreciating customs and cultural heritage of Yuhua Stone. The exhibition content of the museum covers the scientific origins, cultural origins, and appreciation of art of Yuhua stone; The exhibition focuses on exquisite and exquisite Yuhua stones, collector's famous stones, and special and ingenious themes; The exhibition scene presents the aesthetic characteristics of Yuhua Stone, the fragrance of cultural context, and the poetic and picturesque atmosphere. Yuhua Stone condenses time, tells history, and accumulates into culture, representing the "most Nanjing cultural symbol". Meet at Yuhua Stone and enjoy the beautiful scenery at Qinhuai Confucius Temple Yuhua Stone Museum.

tagNameList: Military Sites; Historical Sites; Nighttime sightseeing
summary: Its ancient military defense facilities, such as the principle of "catching turtles in a jar" and the 27 caves of fighters garrison, are particularly attractive to military fans. You can overlook the city view of Nanjing when you climb the city gate. The origin of its name is that it was called Jubao Gate in the Ming Dynasty and was built in the second to eighth year of the Hongwu reign (1369-1375). It was renamed in 1927. The height of the city wall is about 21 meters, and the width of the north, south, and east to west of the walled city is approximately 120 meters. The entire building is built entirely of bricks and stones, using a mixture of tung oil, lime, and glutinous rice juice as mortar, layer by layer, and is extremely sturdy. On the side of each brick and stone, there is the prefectural office and year/month/day of the brick maker. Weng City is composed of three urn cities and four ticket gates that run through it. Each ticket gate has a "Qianjin Lock" that can be activated up and down and a double leaf wooden door, but now they have all been destroyed in the war. In the past, when enemy soldiers invaded the city gate, the "Qianjin Lock" inside the gate quickly landed, cutting off the enemy's retreat route. The defenders and ambush troops were deployed in all directions, annihilating the enemy separately, just like closing the door and catching a dog or catching a turtle in a jar. The first gate of the city was originally divided into three levels, and the upper level was originally built with a wooden structure with triple eaves and a gable style dysprosium building. It has been repeatedly built and destroyed, but it no longer exists. The middle floor of the gate is a brick structure, and there are seven parallel caves of fighters garrison on the north side. In the middle of the lower floor, a coupon gate was built to lead to the urn, and three caves of fighters garrison were built on the left and right sides. On the east and west sides of the caves of fighters garrison Barbican City, there are seven caves of fighters garrison. There are 27 caves of fighters garrison in the whole urn, which can hide 3000 soldiers and 10000 loads of grain. Its "caves of fighters garrison" is a rare unique building in the ancient city gate of our country, which plays a very important role in material reserves and troop ambush in ancient wars.

Pukou Railway Station, also known as Nanjing North Station, was founded in 1914 and is a "century old railway station" that fully preserves its historical style. It is listed as one of the nine railway stations of Chinese literature and art. Here, you can see the beige main building of the train station, the arched rain corridor connecting to the ferry terminal, the former waiting hall (with the gate closed and only visible through the window), and the platform used by passengers to board and disembark trains. You can also walk on the railway tracks to play and take photos. There are old-fashioned green trains parked on the tracks, and walking on the tracks at dusk is very romantic. The witness of history: Many important historical events in modern China occurred here, as seen in Zhu Ziqing's' Back View '; Mr. Sun Yat sen's spirit arrived here to hold a welcoming ceremony. The scenery of Pukou Railway Station in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China attracted a large number of film and television crews to shoot outdoor scenes, and it truly became a stage for multiple plays. In recent years, movies and TV dramas filmed at Pukou Railway Station include "Sun Yat sen", "Deep Love in the Rain", "Golden Powder Family", and so on.

Xinan Li is located on Zhongshan South Road in Nanjing, covering an area of 12300 square meters, at the intersection of Zhongshan South Road and Shengzhou Road. Based on the national key cultural relics protection unit, the existing large-scale and well preserved Qing Dynasty private residence "Ganxi Former Residence" in Nanjing is the cultural core, supplemented by exquisite and high-end leisure retail, trendy catering, exclusive services and other formats, creating a unique Jinling historical style urban fashion commercial district.

The Wang Dao Xie An Memorial Hall is located in Wuyi Lane on the south bank of the Qinhuai River at the Confucius Temple in Nanjing. It is a thematic exhibition hall that showcases the culture and art of the Six Dynasties and the family backgrounds of Wang and Xie. There are buildings such as Laiyan Hall and Jianjin Tower in the museum, displaying precious cultural relics from the Six Dynasties period. This was once the barracks of the Jianye Forbidden Army, the capital of Eastern Wu. Because soldiers were dressed in black at that time, the alley was named "Wuyi", and to this day, there is still a glimpse of the "Wuyi Well" in the alley. During the Eastern Jin Dynasty, Wuyi Lane was a residential area for high-ranking officials and nobles in the imperial court. The houses in the alley are towering and arranged in rows. During the Six Dynasties period, representative figures of the Wang Xie family, including Wang Dao and Xie An, lived here. During the Tang Dynasty, Liu Yuxi visited this place and wrote the timeless masterpiece "Wild grass and flowers by Zhuque Bridge, sunset slanting at the entrance of Wuyi Lane. In the past, swallows flew into ordinary people's homes in front of Wang Xietang".
opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-22:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

summary: The story of Li Xiangjun and the talented scholar Hou Fangyu is well-known in the ancient capital of the Six Dynasties. Naturally, when you come to this land of golden powder in the Six Dynasties, how can you not read the legend of the Eight Beauties of Qinhuai? The former residence of Li Xiangjun, also known as the "Meixiang Tower", is a typical Qing Dynasty river hall and river house building with three entrances and two courtyards. The style is exquisite and elegant, displaying some ancient calligraphy, painting, seal carving, and also restoring Li Xiangjun's living conditions at that time. Let's unfold 'Peach Blossom Fan' and reminisce about the entanglement of a chaotic era. The Li Xiangjun Former Residence Exhibition Hall is located at the southern end of Laiyan Bridge in Confucius Temple, at No. 38 Chaoku Street. The hall faces south and north, with three entrances and two courtyards, facing the food street, backed by the Qinhuai River, with blue bricks and small tiles, horsehead walls, hanging corridors, and lattice windows. It is a typical Jiangnan residential style. There are sedan halls, information halls, Meixianglou former residence exhibitions, tea culture, fan culture exhibition halls, calligraphy and painting exhibition rooms, river halls, ancient water gates, etc. in the museum. The Meixiang Tower in the museum is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit with a history of more than 300 years. It is the former residence of the famous Li Xiangjun in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties. Li Xiangjun, who rebelled against the Qing and restored the Ming dynasty, spared no effort to maintain national integrity by touching the pillar with his head and performing a tragic drama with a blood splatter fan, which is admired by future generations. The former residence currently has a boudoir, study, living room, and piano room. The river hall of Meixiang Building is also a representative building. The carved beams and painted rafters in the hall are exquisite and vivid. Each work has auspicious meanings, has a strong atmosphere of Ming and folk culture, and is well preserved.

The former residence of Qin Dashi is a well preserved former residence of the top scholar in Nanjing. It was originally a mansion bestowed by Emperor Chongzhen of the late Ming Dynasty to Grand Secretary He Ruchong. Qin Dashi originally lived in Qin Zhuangyuan Lane. After retiring in the 28th year of the Qianlong reign, he still lived in his original residence. Seven years later, he bought this mansion and the old residence in Qin Zhuangyuan Lane was converted into the Qin Family Ancestral Hall. The entire building of Qin Zhuangyuan Mansion originally had five roads and nine entrances, stretching south to Changle Road, north to Chaoku Street, east to Pipa Lane, west to Wuding Bridge, and a garden behind it. It was named "Zhan Garden" after Ouyang Xiu of the Song Dynasty, who said, "Looking at the Jade Hall, as if it were in the sky. The park is lush with trees, with towering rockeries. There was originally a "Hundred Sons Living Together Hall" in the mansion, surrounded by four types of trees: cypress, catalpa, paulownia, and reed. This is a representative building of the Nanjing Prefecture during the Ming and Qing dynasties. Qin Dashi was the top scholar during the Qianlong period (1714-1777), with the courtesy names Luyi, Jianquan, Jianquan, and Qiutian Laoren. He once served as a trial lecturer to teach the prince how to read. He was proficient in seal script, clerical script, cursive script, regular script, and calligraphy, and his works of poetry and painting were considered excellent. He was commissioned by Emperor Qianlong to write the "Selected Works of the Ming Dynasty". The calligraphy art of the Qing Dynasty saw great development. Many calligraphers have emerged, and the stars are brilliant. The famous calligraphy critic of the Qing Dynasty, Bao Shidou, selected 91 calligraphers from the Qing Dynasty in his book "Yizhou Shuangji", among whom was Qin Dashi. It can be seen that the calligraphy of Qin Dashi was highly regarded during the Qing Dynasty. The current collection includes twelve calligraphy stone tablets by Qin Dashi, which were written by him after his retirement from office and were approximately between the 34th and 41st years of the Qianlong reign. The font size is uniform, the layout is neat, yet each has its own form and spirit, and all styles are well prepared, pleasing to the eye.

Chaotian Palace was a Confucian temple in the Qing Dynasty. The entire architectural complex includes Jiangning Prefectural School, Chaotian Palace, and the Nanjing Museum, which was converted from several main halls of Chaotian Palace. Currently, Jiangning Prefectural School is the Jiangsu Kunqu Opera House, which can only be viewed from the outside. The only places that tourists can visit inside are Chaotian Palace and Nanjing Museum. The history of Chaotian Palace can be traced back to the Spring and Autumn Period. Wu King Fuchai melted iron and forged swords here, and the history of building a Confucian temple can be traced back to the Northern Song Dynasty. In the Ming Dynasty, it was named Chaotian Palace and was a place for the royal family to worship Taoist gods and learn the etiquette of meeting the emperor. Later, it was destroyed in war. In the fifth to ninth year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1866-1870 AD), it was rebuilt on the original basis and became a Confucian temple. Jiangning Prefectural School also moved from Jiming Mountain here. The Chaotian Palace is adjacent to the artificial canal "Yundu" in the south, surrounded by "Wanren Palace Wall", with a pan pool in the wall, and on the east and west sides are the memorial archway of "Depai Tiandi" and "Daoguan Ancient and Modern" respectively. The main buildings, from southeast to northwest, are Lingxing Gate, Dacheng Gate, Dacheng Hall, and Chongsheng Hall. The roof is covered with yellow glazed tiles, and the four pairs of dragon statues under Lingxing Gate are lifelike. In front of Dacheng Gate stands a statue of Confucius. Behind the Chongsheng Hall is the back garden, near the Feiyun Pavilion on the east is the Qianlong Imperial Stele Pavilion, and the Jingyi Pavilion on the west is the highest point of Yeshan. On one side of the Chongsheng Hall of Nanjing Museum is the main exhibition hall of Nanjing Museum, which mainly displays the basic exhibition "Dragon and Tiger Dwelling - Nanjing Urban History Exhibition". The exhibits are arranged in chronological order, with the first layer featuring exhibits from ancient times to the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the second layer featuring exhibits from the Republican era. On the third floor is the "Yutang Exquisite Artifacts - Exhibition of Fine Treasures in the Collection". The "Treasure of the Town Hall" blue and white plum vase from the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties is located here, with the exquisite painting "Xiao He Chases Han Xin under the Moon" on the vase. The Nanjing Museum has designated the Dacheng Hall and Chongsheng Hall as special and temporary exhibition halls, and any exhibitions currently being held at the Chaotian Palace will be displayed on signs at the entrance. The venues for special and temporary exhibitions may change from time to time. For specific locations, please call the scenic area management department at 025-84200177.

Huan Yuan was originally a post office of the Qing Dynasty. In 1936, Huan Yuan was converted into a temporary residence and a plan to suppress the Communist Party was deployed, which triggered the "Xi'an Incident".

Defu Lane is a famous bar street in Xi'an city. Defu Lane was originally an old residential area, which gradually became a leisure and cultural street in the 1990s. At the entrance of the alley stands a magnificent three door stone archway, with large blocks of bluestone paving the path on both sides, and antique buildings arranged in a staggered manner. On the streets less than 200 meters long, one after another, there are coffee shops, bars, and tea houses of all sizes, all named with a certain atmosphere. Nowadays, Defu Lane and the antique Shuyuanmen Ancient Culture Street complement each other from east to west, becoming a street with a very "foreign flavor" in the traditional cultural area.

Tangshan Ziqing Lake Forest Hot Spring is located in the Nanjing Tangshan Ziqing Lake Ecotourism Hot Spring Resort, and is a masterpiece carefully planned and designed by internationally renowned hot spring designers. It showcases the fusion style of Southeast Asian hot spring culture and Northeast Asian hot spring culture. The hot spring area is filled with smoke, towering trees, blooming mountain flowers, gurgling water, and a stunning paradise like a paradise on earth. It is a natural scenery of Tangshan, with mountains, waters, forests, and real hot springs! The Ziqing Lake Ecotourism Hot Spring Resort has a natural ecology and beautiful scenery, with mountains and waters complementing each other, creating a natural beauty with towering trees and fresh and mellow air. Therefore, it is known as a natural oxygen bar; The original wetland landscape area of the resort is filled with rare plants such as Li's River, Water Pine, and Water Cedar, as well as various precious wild waterfowl and birds such as egrets, wild ducks, and swans. Throughout the year, different birds can be enjoyed playing in the Ziqing Lake and dancing gracefully in the sky. The entire forest hot spring area is surrounded by mountains and lakes, with dozens of hot spring pools of different shapes and functions crisscrossing in the hundreds of acres of mountains and forests. The layout is extraordinary and the atmosphere is vivid, which can satisfy nearly a thousand people to soak comfortably without interference. Kiss the Little Fish Pool, Rose Pool, Milk Pool, Red Wine Pool, Mineral Sand Pool, Waterfall Pool, Human Crocodile Bathing and Sighing for Observation, Magical Legend Pool, Featured Petal Pool and dozens of other hot spring pools, all for free! Each spring pool uses natural high-temperature hot spring water unique to Tangshan. In the hot spring area, there are grass topped wooden spring houses, exotic tea bars, natural landscape SPA rooms, stone millstone paths, and misty flowing water walls, all of which are ingeniously combined with natural environment and human fashion. What's unique is that while soaking in the hot spring, you can enjoy the life dynamics of the nationally protected animal, the Yangtze alligator, in the same pool; You can also enjoy the fun of soaking in hot springs, swinging and playing golf. The sky above, the earth bathed in springs, surrounded by green trees, and the harmony between heaven and man. The Xiangzi Temple near the south gate of Xi'an is said to be the former residence of Han Xiangzi, one of the Eight Immortals, and also the place where he became a monk. Therefore, throughout history, Xi'an Xiangzi Temple has been the birthplace of Xiangzi culture. Xiangzi Temple is still the existing Taoist ancestral temple in Xi'an city. Xiangzi Temple consists of a temple area, a south courtyard, and a north courtyard. It is said that this is the inner courtyard of the official residence of Han Yu, the uncle of Han Xiangzi. In order to practice and cultivate his nature, an underground secret room was once built here, also known as Xiangzi Cave, where he practiced and nurtured his nature. Decades ago, while digging an air raid shelter inside the Xiangzi Temple, a dark room was discovered, which is said to be the Xiangzi Cave from that time.

Xuanwu Lake Scenic Area - Xuanwu Gate is located in Xuanwu Lane, Xuanwu District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province. It was opened in 1908 and was originally named Fengrun Gate. Later, it was named Xuanwu Gate due to its proximity to Xuanwu Lake.

Sifang City, located inside the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, also known as the "Shengong Shengde Stele Tower", was built in the 11th year of the Yongle reign of the Ming Dynasty (1413 AD). The building has a square floor plan and the roof has been destroyed, commonly known as Sifang City. Located on both sides of Lingyuan Road, opposite to Da Jinmen. The surrounding walls are shaped like barriers. There is a large stone beast in the city, with its head held high and tail trailing, as if it were alive. It carries the Great Ming Xiaoling Divine Merit and Virtue Stele on its back. The inscription on the stele is in regular script, with a length of 2746 words and a size as big as a fist. It records the merits of Ming Taizu throughout his life and was erected by his father Zhu Yuanzhang in the third year of Yongle reign of Ming Chengzu Zhu Di (1405 AD). The stele has a height of 8.84 meters, a height of 4.78 meters, a width of 2.24 meters, and a thickness of 0.83 meters. It is the largest existing stone stele on the ground in the Nanjing area.

The Wuliang Hall is the only remaining Ming Dynasty building in Linggu Temple, with a history of over 600 years. The temple was originally dedicated to the Infinite Life Buddha, hence it was once called the Infinite Hall. Due to the fact that the building is constructed with brick and stone arches, without the use of an inch of wood, it is commonly referred to as a beamless hall. It is precisely because of the Liangtai that it was able to survive in the war that it is one of the five existing Liangtai temples in China with a long history and a large scale. The Wuliang Hall is 50 meters long from east to west and 34 meters wide from north to south. The roof of the hall is double eaved with nine ridges, covered with gray black tube tiles. There are three Lama pagodas standing on the main ridge. Inside the hall is a brick built dome with five rooms and three entrances, each with one entrance. The three entrances on the sides are each a large vertical tube shaped dome, and the middle dome is large, with a width of 11.4 meters and a height of 14 meters. The front and rear coupons are relatively small, with a width of 4.88 meters and a height of 7 meters. The brick stacks on the upper end of the inner walls of the east and west mountains are stacked inward, protruding layer by layer, reaching up to 1 meter in length. They seem to fall without falling, which is truly remarkable. In 1933, the Nationalist government built a cemetery for fallen soldiers at the former site of Linggu Temple, and the Wuliang Hall was converted into a cemetery memorial hall. At present, the Wuliang Hall has been converted into a wax museum for celebrities of the Xinhai Revolution, exhibiting wax figures of dozens of celebrities before and after the Xinhai Revolution.

Zhongshan Academy is an affiliated institution of the Memorial Hall, with a construction area of over 800 square meters. It faces north and south and is a two-story palace style building with double eaves and flying corners, red columns and green tiles, creating a magnificent atmosphere.

The Giant Panda Pavilion of Hongshan Forest Zoo is located near the north gate of the zoo. poiName: Fangshan Tangshan National Geopark Museum in Jiangning, Jiangsu
summary: The Jiangsu Jiangning Tangshan Fangshan National Geopark Museum is located within the Tangshan National Geopark in the Tangshan Resort, covering an area of approximately 74.7 hectares. The Site Park is mainly positioned for geological research, popular science education, and cultural tourism. It consists of three parts: the Nanjing Homo erectus Fossil Archaeological Site (Ancient Ape Cave), the Cultural Tourism Complex (Nanjing Homo erectus Fossil Site Museum), and the Time Tunnel. The first phase of the site museum is based on the "Tangshan Geology" and the "Evolution of Life" as the clue, with the core of the Nanjing Homo erectus in the Middle Pleistocene, interpreting the geological changes and human evolutionary history of the vicissitudes of the world. Jiangsu Jiangning Tangshan Fangshan National Geopark Museum will take you on a journey back to the evolution of life in the Nanjing area over 600 million years. Restoring the living environment of human ancestors in Nanjing, revealing how this magical land has nurtured and continued human genes and civilization.

summary: The Ancient Ape Man Cave is a natural karst cave. It was discovered during the excavation of rocks in 1993 and is called the "Hulu Cave" due to its resemblance to a gourd. The karst cave can be divided into six major areas, namely the entrance stone carved spring landscape, the ancient human stone carving garden at the foot of the mountain, the exhibition hall of ancient human historical materials, the cliff carving landscape of the site entrance, the natural karst cave landscape, and the bamboo garden leisure area. The stalactites inside the cave have various shapes and mature development, especially the red and white stalactites, which are rare in the world. But what is precious in the cave are two skulls dating back 580000 to 620000 years, confirming that this is a complete ancient ape human activity site discovered in Jiangnan so far and belongs to the same period as Zhoukoudian in Beijing. As a result, the human history in Nanjing has been pushed forward by more than 200000 years, and it also confirms that the Yangtze River Basin is one of the birthplaces of the Chinese nation. More than ten species of fossils, including spotted deer and spotted deer, were discovered in the cave. These animals mostly grew during the Middle Pleistocene, 150 million years ago. Now, on the mountaintop of the cave, two or three giant bronze statues of ape men hunting have been cast as the giant symbols of the ape man cave. Throughout the scenic area, small stone age buildings such as thatched cottages, stone tools, nest dwellings, and cave dwellings can be seen everywhere, full of historical significance.

Tangshan is located in the eastern suburbs of Nanjing, integrating steles, springs, caves, lakes, and temples into a unique blend of cultural and natural scenery. In the Leigong Mountain of Zhenxi, there is a huge karst cave group with a total area of tens of thousands of square meters. The relatively complete fossilized stones of ancient human heads unearthed from the cave have been scientifically identified as Nanjing hominids born about 300000 years ago, confirming that the Yangtze River Basin is one of the birthplaces of the Chinese nation. In addition, the hot springs in Tangshan Scenic Area are a unique experience here that you can give a try.
