Xiaopiyuan Mosque Beida Temple is also known as a worship temple. The overall construction of the temple is exquisitely crafted and aesthetically pleasing.

Ziyun Tower is located in the center of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden, and is the main building of the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden. It is also a large-scale imitation of Tang royal architecture in China. The Ziyun Tower in history is said to have been built in the 14th year of the Kaiyuan reign of the Tang Dynasty. It is a jade tower with a golden hall and towering mountains. During the Qujiang Festival, Emperor Xuanzong of Tang would climb to this tower to enjoy singing and dancing, give banquets to officials, and appreciate the grand scene of people visiting Qujiang. The current Ziyun Tower was rebuilt based on historical records and is divided into a four story main building and a north-south square. The plaque north of Ziyun Tower was written by calligrapher Huang Miaozi. The main building is 39 meters high and adopts the architectural form of a double eaved pavilion roof. The eaves on each level are designed with pheasant tails and feature three layers of gold jewelry, making them even more magnificent. On the second and third floors, there are spacious flat seats, pavilions and arches, and pavilions with flying bridges, creating a magnificent atmosphere. The first floor of Ziyun Tower reflects the prosperity of the Zhenguan reign during the 23 year reign of Emperor Taizong of Tang, Li Shimin; The second floor is the prosperous Kaiyuan era of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji; The third floor is the performance area; The fourth floor is the treasure of the Tang Furong Garden - the Tang Museum. The third floor of Ziyun Tower regularly performs the world intangible cultural heritage - Dongcang Drum Music - every day. Dongchang drum music is an extension of the royal court music of the Sui and Tang dynasties, known as the "living fossil of music". The Tang Dynasty Museum on the fourth floor exhibits exquisite cultural relics from the Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties unearthed in Shaanxi Province. Every night in front of Ziyun Tower, you can also enjoy the great Asian water screen movie - Qitian Dasheng. The performance combines music fountains, lasers, and flames, making it a "wedding of water and fire" that will create a brand new audio-visual experience for you. In addition, you can also enjoy lion dance performances in the south square of Ziyun Tower, laser performances, music fountains, and more in the north square.

The Nanjing Purple Mountain Insect Museum is a natural themed museum that integrates insect taxonomy research, insect ecology exhibition, and natural science education. The Nanjing Purple Mountain Insect Museum has been completed at the foot of Zhongshan Mountain. The main exhibition areas include the Prologue Hall, Nanjing Local Insect Hall, Insect Diversity Hall, Lepidoptera Insect Hall, Insect Culture Hall, Insect Behavior Hall, Social and Aquatic Insect Hall, and Live Insect Exhibition Area. Through natural ecological simulation landscaping, multimedia technology applications, large-scale live ecological boxes, etc., the museum showcases the basic forms, living environments, main groups, and relationships with humans of insects.

The Liu Shaoqi Tianhua Investigation Memorial Hall is located in Tianhua Village, Qingshanpu Town, Changsha County. It was first built in 2009 and officially unveiled and opened to the public in 2011. Its main purpose is to commemorate Liu Shaoqi's 18 day investigation in Tianhua in 1961. The entire memorial hall consists of an exhibition hall and an old residence, covering an area of 4800 square meters.

Chang'an ancient music, also known as "Xi'an drum music", "Xi'an ancient music" or "Changgu music" by Xi'an people, is one of the ancient music genres that reproduces Chinese music for thousands of years through a set of instruments. It has been passed down for over 1300 years since the Tang Dynasty and is known as the "living fossil of music" in the music industry. It has been passed down in the Guanzhong Plain centered around ancient Chang'an and is an excellent ancient music genre that has been preserved among the people to this day. During the prosperous Tang Dynasty, song and dance flourished, and members of the Li Tang royal family often created and performed music in the palace. They were divided into ten parts according to their ethnic states, namely: banquet music, Qing Shang, Xiliang, Goryeo, Tianzhu, Kucha, Shule, Anguo, Kangguo, and Gaochang; According to the form of performance, it can be divided into seated geisha and standing geisha. When the emperor and nobles entertain guests, beautiful music is played constantly.

The theme of this Bai Lu Zhou Park Lantern Festival is "Bai Lu Ya Ji, the Capital of Literature". The Mochou Lake Scenic Area is located outside the Shuiximen in the west of Nanjing City. It is a classical garden in Jiangnan and a scenic spot of the Six Dynasties. There are many varieties of crabapples in the Mochou Lake scenic area, including the stick stem crabapple, papaya crabapple, Xifu crabapple, and drooping silk crabapple, which bloom from March to April every year; Every summer, tens of thousands of lotus flowers compete for beauty on the lake. The name originates from Mochou Lake, which was formerly known as Hengtang. Due to its proximity to Shitou City, it is also known as Shicheng Lake. According to legend, Mo Chou was a beautiful girl from Luoyang during the Southern Qi Dynasty. She was poor and sold herself to bury her father. She married far away to Jinling and was not allowed to marry her uncle or aunt. She committed suicide by throwing herself into the lake. Therefore, it is named Mochou Lake. The Shengqi Tower in Shengqi Tower Park was first built in the early years of the Ming Hongwu era and was renovated in the tenth year of the Qing Tongzhi era (1871). It is said that this is the place where Ming Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang played chess with General Xu Da. Xu Da secretly placed a flag with the words "long live", but when he won the game, he only said that the game was a draw, which greatly impressed Zhu Yuanzhang. Therefore, he gave Mo Chou Lake to Xu Da, and this building was called the "Shengqi Building". To the west of the Shengqi Building in Yujintang is the former residence of Mo Chou, Yujintang. The three characters "Yujintang" were inscribed by Liu Haisu. In the center of the front hall hangs Chen Dayu's landscape painting of "Jinling's First Scenic Spot". In the middle of the back hall is the living room, with a statue of Mo Chou sitting at the round table embroidering flowers. On the left is her bedroom. The hall is adorned with antique style rosewood and mother of pearl furniture from the late Qing Dynasty. On May 5, 2012, Mo Chou's former residence was designated as a municipal level cultural relic protection unit. The west of Yujin Hall is the north and south halls. There are lotus appreciation pavilions surrounded by cloisters in the east and west. In the middle is the lotus pond. There is a White Marble statue of Mochou on the stone of the pond, which is more than 2 meters high. I saw her walking towards me with a mulberry basket in her hand and a long skirt dragging down the ground like a fairy of Lingbo. Her pair of resentful eyes seemed to be telling visitors from all directions about her misfortune.

As a spiritual and cultural landmark of Nanjing, Pioneer Bookstore has experienced more than 20 years of ups and downs in Nanjing. In November 1996, Pioneer Bookstore was founded across from St. Paul's Church on Taiping South Road, with an area of only seventeen square meters. Later, the bookstore moved to Guangzhou Road next to Nanjing University, and moved to Guangzhou Road twice, and finally moved here. In 2004, the flagship store of Pioneer Bookstore Mount Wutai opened, in an underground parking lot transformed from an air raid shelter, with an operating area of nearly 3680 square meters.

Lanpu and Yuexiu Park in Guangzhou are located in the city center, with convenient transportation and direct access by subway. Perhaps because across the road is Yuexiu Park, there are relatively few visitors to Lanpu, which makes the park very quiet. Lanpu is a great place to admire orchids. It is a specialized orchid park in the Lingnan region, cultivating over 200 varieties of orchids and nearly 10000 pots of orchids, including precious orchid species such as Dahuasu, Dafengwei Su, Dendrobium, and Xiandian Baimo. The orchid planting in Orchid Garden is divided into three grids. The first and third grids are mainly planted with orchids, which have light and fragrant flowers; The second grid is dominated by parasitic orchids, with bright flowers but little fragrance. Of course, for tourists, most of them don't care about the variety of orchids. Just take a look and take photos. The flowers are brightly colored and most of them are extremely photogenic. At its entrance, there are two couplets that read 'Fragrant in the Upper Country, Splendid in the South', and the horizontal sign reads' Orchid Garden ', which is very imposing. Strolling into the garden, one can see the elements of Jiangnan gardens everywhere, such as arches, stacked mountains, stone masonry, long corridors, and water pavilions. It suddenly feels like coming to a garden in Suzhou. The entire orchid garden is quiet and deep, with a very good environment, and the air is particularly elegant and high-quality due to the fragrance of orchids. Orchids are classified according to their flowering time, including spring orchids, summer orchids, autumn orchids, cold orchids, and New Year orchids. If you want to see magnolia, its flowering period is from February to March. If you want to see more orchids, spring would be more suitable. In addition to enjoying flowers, most people come here for tea and small Dim sum. Although Lanpu is small, it has many tea rooms with different tea resources and styles. The decoration of the tea rooms is mostly high-end, unique and elegant, very stylish. When the spring is warm and the flowers are blooming, sitting in the tea house with friends and enjoying a small drink, the feeling must be excellent.

Jiulong Lake Ecological Park has over 20000 acres of undulating mountains and 4500 acres of water, with superior ecology and beautiful scenery. The park projects include the Money Maze, Celebration Square, Lakeside Park, Observation Deck, Royal Garden, etc. There are thousands of plants and over 210 species of wild animals growing in the scenic area, combining ecology and culture. Multiple hiking trails are distributed among the green mountains and rivers, with a total length of over 50 kilometers. It is a great place to get close to nature and relax.

The interactive three-dimensional ecological rainforest exhibition area "Rainforest Fairy" covers an area exceeding the projects "Jurassic Forest" and "Golden Snake Secret Realm" in the same region. It innovatively integrates international advanced exhibition concepts and fully follows the concept of natural layering in the natural rainforest ecosystem to observe animals, opening an unprecedented and unimaginable exploration door for you. At the "Rainforest Wizard of Oz", tourists can delve into the giant ant nests of giant anteaters and observe their magical process of feeding with their tongues; Traverse the magical glass passage and catch a glimpse of mini plush monkeys playing overhead! Don't worry about missing out on the graceful and graceful climbing posture of the orangutans living in the treetops. The unique aerial wooden boardwalk allows you to fully enjoy their wonderful artistic gymnastics performances! In addition, there are dozens of "rainforest residents" such as gibbons, gibbons, flying hornbills, honeysuckers, and big billed birds that come into close contact with you.

White Deer Village is located in Lantian County, where there is the White Deer Plain Film and Television Base, as well as the Guanzhong style tourist and exhibition areas, all of which are based on the novel "White Deer Plain".

Buckwheat Flower Sea is located in Yukou Village, Jiujianfang Town, with a thousand acre buckwheat demonstration garden, forming a spectacular ground flower sea landscape. Buckwheat is planted here according to the slope, and in summer, light pink and white flowers cover the hillside, complementing the surrounding green mountains and creating a beautiful scenery. Buckwheat Flower Sea is not only suitable for taking photos and checking in, but also incorporates rural tourism elements. Tourists can experience the rural scenery, taste Lantian's characteristic buckwheat noodle soup, stay in nearby homestays, and enjoy the dual charm of nature and culture. In addition, the Buckwheat Flower Sea also has a Buckwheat Museum, showcasing the history of buckwheat cultivation and industrial development, making it a great place to learn about Lantian agricultural culture.

Shuilu'an is a famous temple of the Six Dynasties, with ancient colored sculptures inside. It is a treasure trove of ancient Chinese sculpture art and is known as the "second Dunhuang of China". The Water and Land Temple was originally the Water and Land Hall of Wuzhen Temple, and was an important venue for holding the "Water and Land Grand Study" and "Water and Land Dojo" at that time.
Turning the world upside down is enough! Wandering in the air, filled with joy and childlike innocence.

Sitting on the newly upgraded Pegasus family roller coaster, wearing high-tech VR glasses, "Happy Ambassador" Mengqi appears in front of you with popular Wang heroes Zhuang Zhou, Wang Zhaojun, and Da Qiao. Mengqi uses the skill of devouring nightmares to take you into a magical dream world, crossing the mysterious underwater, icy land, and vast starry sky together.

The 107/108 sightseeing floor is the highest point of indoor sightseeing in the Guangzhou Tower. The two floors of sightseeing hall with the theme of white clouds and stars respectively have a panoramic view of the new central axis of the city and the vast the Pearl River. Each floor is equipped with a fully transparent tempered glass "suspended corridor" for aerial viewing, which is a place for taking photos and souvenirs.

On December 20, 2016, the Guangzhou Metro Museum was grandly opened, and visitors only need to make an online appointment to visit the site with a QR code. Here is an introduction to how the subway is built using shield tunneling machines, as well as the 3D projection. The three-dimensional subway projection as soon as you enter the door is stunning! There is also an on-site subway driving simulation experience, which is full of fun.

The Southern Han Second Mausoleum Museum is a specialized museum built on the site of the Southern Han Second Mausoleum. The Southern Han Second Mausoleum refers to the De Mausoleum of Liu Yin, one of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms, and the Kang Mausoleum of Liu Yan, the founder of the Southern Han Dynasty. It was excavated from 2003 to 2004 and was named one of the top ten archaeological discoveries in China in 2004. It is a landmark historical site of the Southern Han Dynasty and became the sixth batch of national key cultural relics protection units in 2006. The total area of the museum is 85317 square meters, including the museum area and the Kangling Site area. The total construction area is 21678 square meters, with an exhibition hall area of about 3900 square meters, a library area of about 300 square meters, and other indoor public activity spaces of about 1700 square meters. The museum has two basic exhibitions: "Yunshan Zhushui Jian - Archaeological Discoveries of Guangzhou" and "Han Feng Tang Yun - History and Culture of Southern Han in the Five Dynasties". The former showcases the human social landscape of Guangzhou during the pre Qin period through archaeological materials, as well as the urban development and changes, historical and cultural accumulation, and continuous overseas communication history of Guangzhou over 2200 years since its establishment in the Qin Dynasty. At the same time, it comprehensively presents the urban archaeological process and archaeological heritage protection achievements of Guangzhou to the audience. The latter, through archaeological discoveries and existing South Han cultural relics and historical sites, presents the historical and cultural features of the Five Dynasties South Han Kingdom to the public in a three-dimensional and comprehensive manner through physical objects, pictures, videos, multimedia interactions, and other means. There is also a highly distinctive public education activity facility in the museum - the "Public Archaeological Activity Center", with a total area of nearly 1200 square meters. The center includes an archaeological knowledge exhibition hall, a simulated archaeological experience area, a cultural relic restoration experience area, a cultural relic rubbings experience area, a virtual display area, a reading room, and a science popularization lecture hall. In addition, the Nanhan Kangling Site has completed its preservation and exhibition project and is officially open to the public. Friends are welcome to visit the Kangling Site and witness the true appearance of the thousand year old imperial tomb in Guangzhou.

Tianhe Park is a large comprehensive park located in Yuancun, Tianhe District, with convenient transportation. The park is mainly characterized by natural ecological landscapes, with a comfortable environment, stretching lawns, undulating hills, lush forests, and sparkling lakes. Inside, there are exquisite Lingnan style gardens - Yuehui Garden, as well as the commemorative Deng Shichang Mausoleum, making it an excellent choice for leisure.
