summary: Walking into the African corridor, the incoming heat wave brings the scorching sun, which in Greek means' scorching sun 'in Africa. The African Corridor is adjacent to the tropical rainforest area, sweeping away the humidity of the rainforest. The first thing tourists see is the home of a very familiar animal - the mongoose brother. There are three families with a total of 30 mongoose brothers living here. These diligent and elf like small animals are known as coal digging machines among animals, and can repair a tunnel for escaping in one night. The neighbors of the small tailed mongoose's house have a Japanese hippopotamus from the primitive forests of West Africa, which is the smallest hippopotamus in the world. The unique glass pavilion allows visitors to enjoy the rarely seen lower body of the hippopotamus and see them swimming in the pool with short hands and feet. In contrast, the animals in the herbivorous animal corridor are much more elegant, quietly grazing, but being overshadowed by the colorful macaws and hornbills nearby. Watching African animals and learning about African culture cannot do without the dance of African indigenous people. At the Africa Square, there are daily indigenous dance performances, taking tourists into the African world.

In the eucalyptus forest full of Australian atmosphere, you can see rare monotremes up close - the cute red kangaroo; There is also the second largest bird on Earth - the emu, which looks like an ostrich. Don't confuse them; Don't miss out on the elegant black swan.

Koala Square is located within the Chimelong Tourist Resort in Guangzhou. These national treasures from Australia are blooming and scattering in the Chimelong Wildlife Park. Not only are there twins "Huanhuan" and "Lele", but also the koala family with "six generations living together".

The Huaqing Yutang Baojichi Outdoor Hot Spring Area is located on the south side of the Xi'an Huaqing Yutang Hotel in Lintong District, Xi'an City. It is adjacent to the Lishan National Forest Park to the south and the Huaqing Palace, a national 5A level tourist attraction to the north. Relying on the 6000 year old Imperial Hot Spring and Lishan Natural Oxygen Bar, it inherits the essence of Tang Dynasty bathing culture, backed by the natural oxygen bar, with lush forests and fresh air. There are bathing pool outdoor hot springs of different sizes and styles in Baoji Pool. The selection of bathing pool materials is exquisite and elegant. There are also elegant and refined modern celebrities who like beige. The Tang Palace's ancient style lounge features elegant seating, offering Tang Dynasty style health tea drinks and fruit snacks. Savor the unique Tang culture bathing and health preservation concept in the leisurely stillness of time.

Yunfoshan Ski Resort is located on the south bank of Miyun Reservoir, a water source protection area in Beijing. It is surrounded by mountains on three sides and has a beautiful environment. It is also a large-scale ski resort in North China. There is one advanced road with an international standard length of 1000 meters, three intermediate roads with a length of 300-700 meters, four primary roads with a length of 100-300 meters, and one snowmobile road with a length of 600 meters. There is also a 1.5-kilometer-long cross-country fitness ski slope jointly developed with foreign countries. And it has opened up various recreational skiing projects such as loop skiing, horse sledding, dog sledding, snow carving, etc., suitable for skiing enthusiasts of all ages. Yunfoshan Ski Resort built a new U-shaped snowboard ski slope in 2004. Snowboarding, as a popular amateur skiing sport, also promotes a healthy and fashionable lifestyle. In addition, the snow equipment hall here can accommodate 3000 people to replace snow equipment and snow boots at the same time. To ensure the dryness and hygiene of snow clothing and snow boots, a high-temperature steam disinfection and drying room has been built in the hall. Two 1000 meter long aerial cableways transport 3800 people per hour. There are also more than 20 senior skiing instructors on site to provide guidance, which can quickly improve skiing skills.

Zhengyang Gate was first built in the 17th year of the Yongle reign of the Ming Dynasty, originally named Li Zhengmen. Because it is located directly in front of the Forbidden City, it is also known as the "front door". Zhengyang Gate is one of the "Nine Gates of the Capital" in old Beijing, affectionately known as the "Qianmen Tower" by Beijing people. It is also one of the well preserved old city gates in Beijing. Zhengyang Gate consists of three parts: City Tower, Arrow Tower, and Weng City. The Wengcheng has been demolished, and the city tower and arrow tower are separated on both sides of Qianmen Street. Climbing up the city tower, you can learn about the history and local customs of Beijing in the exhibition halls on each floor. Zhengyangmen Arrow Tower is a relatively tall arrow tower in Beijing. The city cave below used to not allow ordinary people to walk, but now visitors can walk towards Qianmen Street from here.
The Falun Hall is located inside the Yonghe Temple and was built during the Qianlong period in 1744 AD. It is a place where the temple's monks hold major events.

Madame Tussauds Wax Museum in Beijing is located on Qianmen Street and is the branch of Madame Tussauds Wax Museum in Beijing. It displays numerous extremely realistic wax figures, and visitors can take photos with many celebrities and celebrities from home and abroad. The Madame Tussauds Wax Museum in Beijing has a total of 8 exhibition areas, where many historical and modern domestic and foreign celebrities such as Michael Jackson, Obama, Putin, Feng Xiaogang, Jackie Chan, Jay Chou, etc. can be seen. There is also a unique "Chinese Spirit" exhibition area in the Beijing Pavilion, where celebrities from various industries such as Lang Ping and Cui Jian can see it, which is the focus of tourists' group photo tours.

Lao She Teahouse has become a comprehensive cultural enterprise that combines Chinese opera culture, food culture, tea culture, and Beijing flavor culture, integrating various forms such as old Beijing Qing Teahouse, dining Teahouse, wild tea stall, and book Teahouse. The tea house is divided into three floors with a business area of over 2600 square meters. The "Qianmen Sihe Tea House" located on the second floor is modeled after the ancient and classic Beijing traditional architecture of a quadrangle courtyard; While preserving the original appearance of the old Beijing quadrangle courtyard, it also embodies the characteristics of "solemnity in the north and simplicity in the south". The various wing rooms are arranged in a staggered and varied manner, combining traditional art with modern technology.
The Lantian Ape Man Site Memorial Hall has multiple exhibition areas, such as the Gongwangling Site Exhibition Area and the Chenjiawo Site Area, showcasing various fossils and stone tools.

Wangchuan Cave is located in Wangchuan, Lantian County, Xi'an, 40 kilometers away from Xi'an City, with beautiful scenery. Wang Wei, a great poet and painter of the Tang Dynasty, lived in seclusion in Wangchuan for a long time. His carefully crafted "Wangchuan Villa" and "Wangchuan Twenty Scenes" are unique in ancient Chinese garden art. The beautiful poems about the mountains and waters of Wangchuan, which were later collected and recorded in the "Wangchuan Collection," have gained worldwide acclaim. Wangchuan Cave Scenic Area integrates landscape scenery, natural cave scenery, and leisure vacation. The tourist area is divided into Lingyun and Xishui caves, where stalactites hang upside down and bamboo shoots stand tall in various shapes. Lingyun Cave is located at the waist of Zhaobi Peak, with a depth of 527 meters. It is divided into two layers, ten Dongting Lake, and the milk stones form lifelike "sunset camel bells" and "fairy showers". Xishui Cave and Lingyun Cave are opposite each other in a distance, with a depth of 270 meters. Inside the cave, there are more than 40 painted clay sculptures, which showcase a strong Taoist culture. It is said that Han Xiangzi, one of the Eight Immortals, once attained enlightenment here, and is therefore regarded as the 55th blessed land of Taoism. For thousands of years, from the fifth to the seventh day of the second lunar month, pilgrims from hundreds of miles around would gather here to hold grand religious activities.

poiName: hua yang huan xian dan xia di mao guan jing dian
summary: The Huayang Ring Road Danxia Landscape Observation Site is located in Lantian County, Xi'an City, Shaanxi Province. There is a road about 100 meters long, with red cliffs on both sides of the road. Some professionals say that the red soil layer here was originally buried underground. Due to the continuous uplift of Mount Li and erosion by wind and rain, the red soil layer was exposed from the ground, forming this Danxia landscape.
The Bird's Nest Cultural Center is located in the Bird's Nest and features an art space, a national cultural exhibition area, an art caf é, a fitness center, and more.

Jinshui Bridge is a group of bridges on the Jinshui River in Beijing during the Ming and Qing dynasties, consisting of Inner Jinshui Bridge and Outer Jinshui Bridge, built during the Yongle period of the Ming dynasty.

The Renshou Hall is located inside the east gate of the Summer Palace and is the main political activity venue within the park. During the reign of Emperor Qianlong in the Qing Dynasty, it was named Qinzheng Hall, and during the reign of Emperor Guangxu, it was rebuilt and renamed Renshou Hall. It is the main hall where Empress Dowager Cixi and Emperor Guangxu sit and listen to politics. The Hall of Benevolence and Longevity faces the east and is seven rooms wide. The ound ridge roof rests on the top of the mountain. There are south and north side side halls on both sides. In front of the Hall of Benevolence and Longevity, there are the north and south Jiuqing rooms outside the door, which constitute the political activity area in the Summer Palace. The plaque of Renshou Gate is written in both Chinese and Manchu characters. The left and right side halls in the courtyard are called the North and South Nine Ministers' Rooms, which were originally the duty rooms of the Six Departments of the Nine Ministers of the Qing Dynasty. The Renshou Hall takes the phrase "the benevolent live a long life" from the Analects of Confucius, which means that those who implement benevolent policies live a long life, and is used to promote Empress Dowager Cixi herself. Inside the hall, there is a Nine Dragon Throne carved from rosewood. Behind the throne, there is a palm fan woven with peacock feathers and a screen engraved with over two hundred different characters for "longevity". There are also many precious flower baskets displayed in the hall, which are over one meter high and all kinds of flowers are carved from precious stones. The large "longevity" hanging on the warm pavilion wall of the main hall is written on a pattern painted with bats and colorful clouds, called "Hundred Bats Holding Longevity".

The upper reaches of the Gusu River have been flowing for thousands of years. The antique style buildings with pink walls and black tiles, gently swaying bamboo forests and willows, winding and deep ancient paths, and flower embankments with shimmering waves and flowing shadows, create a dreamlike atmosphere under the backdrop of lights, allowing you to fully enjoy the ancient canal, water and land gates, and ancient bridges of the narrow roads. Listening to a few strings is as peaceful as Zen, the melody breaks the intestines; Wen Qiwu Tianya Song Girl is very enchanting. During the day, boats and boats frequent the moat, while the ancient canal at night adds a touch of tranquility and allure. On this warm evening, accompanied by the sunset, the cruise ship takes you slowly away from the "Ancient Canal Tourist Pier" by the Xinshi Bridge. Along the way, Pingtan accompanies the meal, and the sound of silk and bamboo is melodious, lingering like threads.

Shentangyu Natural Scenic Area is a serene and fairyland like paradise. The local area is rich in dozens of materials, and it is said that a divine doctor once came here to open a medicine hall to relieve the people's illness and pain, hence the name "Shentangyu". The naturally formed 'stone waterfall' is formed by the erosion of nearly 10000 square meters of granite through rainwater, resembling a silver river flowing down or a still waterfall, with a magnificent momentum. The Yanqi River, formed by the convergence of mountain springs, runs through the entire area and is the source of Yanqi Lake, with continuous flowing water throughout the four seasons. Clear springs and streams can be seen everywhere here, and the naturally formed Longtan has a water depth of 4 meters, clear to the bottom, and numerous swimming fish. There are also many places with wide water surfaces such as Mandarin Duck Pool and Crocodile Pool, which are good places for tourists to swim and row boats. The appearance of Jigong Divine Crown is realistic and lifelike, with peaks and stones such as Yingzui Peak, Camel Ridge, Divine Turtle Stone, Phoenix Terrace, and Stone Crowd all crafted with exquisite craftsmanship, full of wit and humor. The infrastructure in the scenic area is also relatively complete, and tourists can enjoy food and lodging in the countryside and experience the local customs. At night, people can also light bonfires and sing and dance wildly in outdoor dance venues.
The Pati Pier Square is located on Yuejiang West Road in Haizhu District. Every night, many people come here to take a walk along the river, making it a great place to relax and unwind.

Kunqu originated in the Kunshan area of Suzhou. Since the Ming Dynasty, Kunqu Opera has become popular throughout the country. At that time, people, whether they were nobles, literati, or ordinary people, all loved Kunqu Opera. People explore the beauty of love in the melody of 'The Peony Pavilion', experience the cruelty of reality in the lyrics of 'The Palace of Eternal Life', and express the bitterness of joys and sorrows in the tenderness of 'The Peach Blossom Fan'. Kunqu Opera is a highly influential vocal opera genre in the middle of the Ming Dynasty to the middle of the Qing Dynasty. Many opera genres have developed on the basis of Kunqu Opera and are known as the "ancestor and teacher of the hundred operas", with the elegant title of "mother of Chinese opera". Nankun mainly uses Suzhou vernacular. Suzhou Pingtan is a general term for Suzhou Pinghua and Suzhou Tanci, which is a traditional form of storytelling and storytelling that uses the Wu dialect, represented by Suzhou dialect, as a means of speaking and performing. It originated and became popular in Suzhou, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Shanghai.

Zhengjia Rainforest Ecological Botanical Garden is located on the seventh floor of Zhengjia Square, with a total area of approximately 15000 square meters. It is an indoor aerial rainforest ecological garden. The park showcases a "natural ecosystem" with biodiversity, allowing you to experience the charm of the rainforest firsthand. There are over 800 species of animals and plants here, including insects, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and more. There are also plants such as baobab trees, konjac with wart stalks, and blood sealed throats. The park is divided into eight exhibition areas, where not only can you embark on a fascinating exploration of plants, interact with cute pets up close, but you can also experience the 360 ° jungle skywalk overlooking the entire rainforest park, or cross the high mountain boardwalk to feel the danger and excitement of a 15 meter aerial waterfall cascading down. There are also a large number of multimedia interactive areas in the park, making your exploration journey more cool and fun; There is also a 'Nature Center' that helps visitors unravel the natural ecology beneath tree roots, allowing them to experience the wonders of the microscopic world in a tree root space magnified 100 times.

poiName: Jinji Lake Music Fountain, Jinji Lake Scenic Area
summary: Jinji Lake Scenic Area is a national 5A tourist attraction. Jinji Lake is a tributary of the Taihu Lake Lake, with more than 10 inlets and outlets. It is adjacent to Dushu Lake in Suzhou to the south. The water area of Jinji Lake is about 7.4 square kilometers. Jinji Lake Scenic Area mainly includes Jinji Lake Bridge Waterfall, Water Ferris Wheel, Ligong Dike, Peach Blossom Island, Oriental Gate and other scenic spots. There is also the Jinji Lake Music Fountain, where live performances give people a noble, passionate, and magnificent atmosphere. When watching the performance, one will feel a surge of enthusiasm. It can be viewed from different angles, just like a group of people singing and dancing around a circular fireplace, which is very cheerful. At the same time, when you look up, you will be deeply shocked by the magnificent modern buildings such as the "Oriental Gate" and "Suzhou Central South Center" around you, and you will feel how small you are in this small Jiangnan city of Suzhou.

Tinglin Garden is located in the northwest corner of Kunshan City. It was built as Ma'anshan Park in 1906 and later renamed Tinglin Garden in memory of Gu Yanwu, a Kunshan native who proposed the idea that "every man has a responsibility for the rise and fall of the world". Yufeng Mountain in the north of the park, also known as Ma'anshan, is a mountain in Kunshan City. To the east of the south are exhibition halls and amusement parks, and to the west is a lake. Most outsiders come to Tinglin Garden to see the "Three Treasures of Kunshan": Kunshi, Qionghua, and Bingti Lotus; Local people often come to the park for walks and exercise. There are many century old trees in the park, and the environment is very good. On the east side of Ma'anshan East Road on the south side of Tinglin Garden, there are four main gates from east to west: East Gate, Southeast Gate, West Gate, and Northwest Gate. The East Gate is the main gate, and visitors usually start their tour from the East Gate. The "Tinglin Three Museums" Kunqu Opera Museum, Gu Yanwu Memorial Hall, and Kunshi Museum are all concentrated at the East Gate. The Kunqu Opera Museum is a stage where performances of Kunqu Opera, Yue Opera, and other genres are held during holidays and every Sunday. There is a sculpture of Gu Yanwu standing at the entrance of the Gu Yanwu Memorial Hall. The museum provides a detailed introduction to Gu Yanwu's body and displays related books, daily necessities, and more. Kunshi is from Yufeng Mountain in Tinglin Garden. It looks a bit like a mini version of the Taihu Lake Stone, but it is more transparent than the Taihu Lake Stone. The "Spring Clouds Emerging from Xiu" and "Autumn Water Waves" in the Kunshi Museum are currently well preserved large ancient Kunshi stones. In mid to late April every year, Tinglin Garden holds the Qionghua Art Festival. Qionghua is the city flower of Kunshan, and the Qionghua can be enjoyed in the Qionghua Garden on the north side of Kunshi Pavilion in Tinglin Garden; Enter the "Danshi Qiongfang" on the north side of Lingfeng Pavilion through the southeast gate; A few steps north from the east gate entrance, there is also a Qionghua King tree, which is over 300 years old. Every year from July to August, Tinglin Garden holds a lotus exhibition. Lotus flowers can be seen on the lake in the west of the park, while lotus flowers can be seen in the square pond on the south side of Kunshi Pavilion. Several flower heads form a lotus flower with thousands of petals, which is beautiful and rare. In autumn, you can smell the fragrance of osmanthus flowers in the park. The Yufeng Mountain in the north of Tinglin Garden is not high, with an altitude of 80.2 meters. It takes about half an hour to an hour to climb up and down the mountain. At the top of the mountain, you can overlook the panoramic view of Tinglin Garden and enjoy the scenery of Kunshan City. Tourists with children can visit the following places for sightseeing. Turn left at the entrance of the east gate of the park, and you will find amusement parks, national defense education parks, zoos, and Wan She Valley. The amusement facilities in the amusement park require additional payment, approximately around ten yuan per item. The National Defense Education Park displays airplanes, tanks, and other equipment. The zoo requires an additional 20 yuan ticket, as there are not many animal species inside. Wan Snake Valley requires an additional 15 yuan ticket to exhibit various snakes. The lake in the western part of the park is suitable for boating, and the price varies depending on the type of boat, around 20-30 yuan. There is an artificial beach near the west gate in the lake area called Baibu Sand, where you can play with sand. In addition, there is a temple in the lake area that resembles a haunted house and requires an additional 15 yuan ticket purchase. There are several small shops selling drinks, food, and toys in Tinglin Garden, as well as a tea room. There is also an Austrian noodle shop across from the Kunqu Opera Museum, where the taste of noodles is good. Outside the east gate of the park, Tinglin Road, which is perpendicular to Ma'anshan East Road, is a bustling place in Kunshan. Kunshan specialties such as Kunshi, Wan San Ti, and Aowei sauce duck can be purchased there.

The World Flora Grand View Garden is a theme park for viewing flowers and plants from around the world. There are both outdoor flower planting areas and indoor greenhouse cultivation areas here, which can be visited all year round. There are also some free simple amusement projects in the park, and it's also great to bring children over to learn about plants. There are currently 7 greenhouses open to the public in Daguan Garden, and over a dozen flower squares outdoors. You can see many flowers everywhere. Tropical plant greenhouses are very popular in indoor venues, where you can see many rare and special plants, and after horticultural pruning, the entire park is very beautiful. In addition, there are many cacti with different shapes in desert plant areas, which are also popular places for tourists to take photos. There are flower plazas with themes from various countries in the outdoor area, which can be visited one by one. The entire park has a depth of about 1 kilometer. It takes about 2-3 hours to take a walk and explore. While playing in the park, some places also sell flowers at prices similar to those outside, so you can choose your favorite ones to buy back. There are several restaurants and small shops in the park, but the prices are slightly higher. It is recommended to bring some snacks and drinking water before visiting.

Beijing Yunmeng Mountain Scenic Area is located in Miyun District, Beijing, about 80 kilometers away from the city center. It is a famous scenic spot, national forest park, and national geological park in Beijing. In 2000, it was rated as a scenic spot in Beijing, and in 2009, it was designated as a national forest park and a national geological park. Yunmeng Mountain is known as the small Mount Huangshan Mountain in the north, which combines the majesty of Mount Taishan Mountain, the danger of Huashan Mountain, the wonder of Mount Huangshan Mountain, and the beauty of Emei. It is a famous mountain known for its peaks, rocks, ponds, waterfalls, clouds, and pine trees, and for its magnificence, danger, wonder, beauty, tranquility, and vastness. Its natural scenery is very beautiful. The Northern Qi Great Wall, stretching for hundreds of miles with the words' Qingkong Cangling, Langyao Jinfeng ', and the Ming Great Wall and Miyun Reservoir complement each other, making it a rare scenic spot in Beijing where you can enjoy mountains, waters, the Great Wall, clouds, waterfalls, and stone pines.

The Yexian Pagoda Tourist Scenic Area is located in the northeast of Miyun County, Beijing. The scenic area covers an area of 1150 acres and includes two parts: Yexian Pagoda Forest and Yexian Pagoda Park. The main building of the scenic area, the Yexian Pagoda, also known as the "Yexian Lamp", was first built in the Liao Dynasty and has undergone multiple disasters and renovations throughout history. The Yexian Pagoda we see today was renovated in 2001 and is known as one of the "Eight Scenic Spots Outside Yanjing". The tower is about 12 meters high and has an octagonal plan. It has two levels, upper and lower. The tower has brick carved fake windows and brick carved flower decorations, which are very exquisite. In addition to Yexian Tower, there are also Longevity Pavilion, Puzhao Temple, Pure Water Guanyin, Music Fountain, Kuixing Pavilion, Three Immortals Cave, Tianwai Stone, the Shakya ManiHall, Water Bottle, Cultural Wall, Wishing Pool, Auspicious Pavilion, Ten Thousand Buddhas Hall and other landscapes in the scenic spot.
opening_hours: Opens at Daylight saving time 08:30-17:30(Admission ends at 17:00),Opens at Standard time 08:30-17:00(Admission ends at 16:30)

summary: Guangzhou Heying Tianxia Leisure Farm is located in Xihe Town, Chengjiao Street, Conghua District, Guangzhou City. The total planned area is 673 acres, of which the first phase of development of the 23 ° 8 ′ North Latitude Forest Camp covers an area of 200 acres. With the goal of creating a Chinese study tour and wild luxury parent-child campsite, integrating study education, parent-child leisure, campsite experience, cultural and creative agriculture, forest school, agricultural courses, parent-child tourism, and wild luxury vacation, it is a natural education and study leisure base in Guangzhou that showcases the characteristics of study tours and parent-child campsites

Beijing Longmai Hot Spring Resort is located in Xiaotangshan Town, Changping District, on the central axis of the Forbidden City, 20 kilometers away from the city center. It is close to neighboring scenic spots such as Yongguan Great Wall, Ming Thirteen Tombs, Mangshan Forest Park, Yinshan Tallinn, and Jundushan Ski Resort, with extremely convenient transportation; It is a resort that integrates accommodation, dining, entertainment, conferences, and leisure vacation. Longmai Hot Springs covers a total area of 280 acres and is divided into hotels and resorts, with over 800 guest rooms; There are over 20 well-equipped conference rooms of various sizes; Three distinctive pavilions, seven uniquely styled Chinese restaurants, offering a variety of delicious dishes from Sichuan, Shandong, Guangdong, and other regions cooked by renowned chefs, as well as a variety of sports and children's castle playgrounds. Beijing Longmai Hot Spring Resort welcomes friends from all walks of life with warm and thoughtful standardized services!

poiName: Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression
summary: The Memorial Hall of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression (hereinafter referred to as the Hall of Resistance against Japanese Aggression) is located in Wanping City beside Lugou Bridge, the original site of the July 7th Incident, which marks the beginning of the all-around war of resistance against Japanese Aggression. As a large-scale comprehensive thematic memorial hall that comprehensively reflects the history of the great Anti Japanese War of the Chinese people, the Anti Japanese War Hall is a national youth volunteer service demonstration base, the first batch of red tourism classic scenic spots in China, the first batch of clean government education bases in China and Beijing, the national education base for caring about the next generation of party history and national history, the national defense education base in China and Beijing, and the cross-strait exchange base. At the same time, the Anti Japanese War Museum is also a permanent unit initiated and established by the International Association of World War II Museums, as well as the Secretariat of the China Anti Japanese War History Society, the Beijing China Anti Japanese War Research and Peace Education Foundation, and the Director's Secretariat of the Memorial Hall Professional Committee of the China Museum Society. The Anti Japanese War Museum was established under the care of the Party, approved for construction by the central government in 1985, completed in July 1987, and officially opened to the public. Since its establishment, the museum has actively promoted the great spirit of the Anti Japanese War, and its social visibility and global influence have been increasing day by day. So far, it has received over 37 million visitors from home and abroad. At present, the Anti Japanese War Museum has a collection of nearly 30000 cultural relics and receives over one million visitors annually (reaching 1.46 million in 2019). At the same time, the Anti Japanese War Museum has also received political leaders from more than ten countries and over 300000 visitors from more than 80 countries and regions. It has held anti Japanese themed exhibitions in countries such as the United States, Russia, Japan, Belarus, Poland, as well as in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and other regions of China. The International Association of World War II Museums, initiated and established, has been joined by 49 museums from 15 countries. Through mutual visits, exhibition exchanges, mutual learning of collections, academic discussions and joint commemoration, the Anti Japanese War Museum has increasingly become an important window for people around the world to understand the history of China's Anti Japanese War.

The National Library is the largest library in Asia, divided into the South, North, and Ancient Books sections. Each area is divided by glass, and various bookshelves are concentrated in the middle of the library, creating a stunning scene. Whether it's capturing layered architectural exteriors or experiencing a rich cultural atmosphere, it's a great choice. The main building of the library is a twin tower high-rise building, with a podium of 5 floors above ground and 1 floor underground. The library has a building area of 60000 square meters and a designed collection capacity of 20 million books, with abundant collection resources. In addition to borrowing books here, the library also regularly holds traditional culture lectures. If interested, you can follow the information updates on the library's official website.
The Beijing Unicorn Starry Sky Art Museum has nearly 1000 square meters of large-scale light and shadow, with a grand and magnificent scene and exquisite lighting, making it a visual feast.
The 488 meter outdoor viewing platform is located at a height of 488 meters above the antenna mast of Guangzhou Tower, which is the highest point that tourists can reach for sightseeing.

Shidu is a natural scenic area with mountains and water, and its unique karst topography is rare in the north. Here, there are numerous cliffs, waterfalls, and streams, and the Juma River flowing through Shidu is clear. On both sides of the river, there are many entertainment activities such as live CS and bungee jumping, and you can also ride bamboo rafts and play drifting in the river. Overview of Shidu: Shidu is a general term for the entire valley, originally referring to the ten ferry crossings on the valley. Now, there are 18 villages along the river from east to west, ranging from Yidu to Shibadu, still collectively known as Shidu. Every crossing has beautiful mountain and water scenery for viewing and playing. The main scenic spots developed in Shidu include Gushanzhai Scenic Area in Liudu, Donggang Lake Scenic Area in Fifteenth Ferry, and Juma Amusement Park located in Shidu. The transportation within Shidu is convenient, with buses leading directly to each sightseeing stop. You can take the bus to play one by one, or come by car. Gameplay Introduction: It takes about two days to play Shidu. On the first day, you will visit Gushanzhai Scenic Area, then go to Shidu Juma River Amusement Park to experience drifting entertainment, and on the second day, you will visit Donghu Port Scenic Area. Accommodation is recommended to choose nearby farmers in Shidu. It would be very comfortable to arrive here the night before and have plenty of time the next day. If there is more time, you can continue to head west to visit the famous Yesanpo Scenic Area in Hebei. Gushanzhai Scenic Area is located across from Liudu Village and is a large canyon about 10 kilometers long. It is mainly used to enjoy the scenery of strange peaks and rocks. The steep and beautiful stone walls on both sides of the valley include attractions such as Yixiantian, Tafeng, and Tathagata Peak. There is a waterfall community in the Beijing area in the mountains, and there is also a tens of meters long iron suspension bridge, which is very exciting to walk on. Donghu Port Scenic Area is famous for its numerous waterfalls and pools. The three layered waterfalls here have a drop of over 100 meters, which is very spectacular. In addition, there are many uniquely shaped mountain peaks and cliffs in the Donghu Port Scenic Area, such as the Couple Peak and Chang'e Accompanying the Golden Cicada. The cloud ladder built on the rock wall is even steeper and more dangerous, and the view is very broad after climbing. What's interesting in the scenic area is probably playing in the water. The water surface here is relatively wide, and you can play on bamboo rafts. There are also beach baths, beach volleyball, and other activities, making it particularly comfortable to experience. Juma Amusement Park Shidu Juma Amusement Park is a scenic spot mainly focused on amusement, with mechanical projects such as aerial flying people and disco turntables, as well as water-based entertainment projects such as speedboats and water unicrafts. Along the river, you can also experience bungee jumping, and brave people who crave excitement can go and challenge themselves. In addition, drifting can be experienced at the Eight Ferry, Fourteen Ferry, Seventeen Ferry, and Eighteen Ferry. You can choose where to play according to your own route. The drifting content and price are roughly the same, with a length of about 2-3 kilometers and a time of about two hours. Drifting and playing in beautiful mountains and clear waters in summer is definitely a wonderful experience. There are many accommodation options within the Shidu Scenic Area, each with multiple local farmhouses. It is recommended to stay near Shidu Village as transportation is convenient and the nearby farmhouses are also affordable. The tourist reviews are very positive. When visiting the Shidu Scenic Area, dining is mostly done at nearby farmhouse restaurants where you can enjoy authentic farmhouse cuisine. In addition, the local trout is very famous, don't forget to taste it.

Pofengling is located in Fangshan District, Beijing. Here, large areas of yellow croaker grow, and in autumn, the mountains are covered in red leaves and the forests are dyed. The scenery is very charming, comparable to Fragrant Hills. More importantly, there are fewer people here and the scenery is more pleasant. The Pofengling Red Leaf Scenic Area is surrounded by lush greenery, with the villas of Li Lianying, the eunuch of the feudal dynasty, and Cao Kun, the warlord. Mount Huangshan Dian Village at the foot of the mountain is the civilized village of the capital. The farm yard is simple and elegant, like a paradise in the world. Climbing up the winding stone path to the Autumn Wind Pavilion, looking around, the slopes and peaks shrouded in clouds and mist are covered in colorful summer clothes, dazzling and dazzling. Its dreamlike colors make people feel like they are in a fairyland. Overlooking the mountain path, winding paths lead to secluded surroundings, with few people and beautiful scenery, it is very pleasant. The roads up and down the mountain in the scenic area are well built, with a total length of about 6200 meters, making walking very convenient. Sitting piers and small tables are thoughtfully placed on both sides of the trail for visitors to relax. If late autumn Fragrant Hills is like "thousands of mountains are red, layers of forests are dyed", then Pofengling is like "red leaves and green midstream, colorful exercises dance in the sky". Red, yellow, green, pink, blue sky, and white clouds complement each other, looking from afar, like colorful exercises dancing in the sky, becoming a flowing ocean of colors.

poiName: Dream Back To The Tang Dynasty Golden Version
summary: This is the Tang Dynasty Furong Garden, and our story begins more than a thousand years ago, taking you back to the Tang Dynasty together, watching the ancient and modern bright moons, reading about the prosperous era's weather. The whole play also showcases the different styles of the prosperous Tang Dynasty from various dimensions such as the palace, the market, legends, and history. This drama is divided into four major chapters: four different stories. In the first chapter, "The Rise of the Tang Dynasty", a grand polo match is being held in the royal garden "Furong Garden". Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, Li Longji, invites distinguished guests to enter Ziyun Tower to enjoy the horse dance performance, showcasing the prosperity of the Tang Dynasty. The second chapter, "Harmony and Harmony of the Tang Dynasty", is a small messenger who travels along the Silk Road connecting Chang'an and Rome, delivering letters to people from far away countries, shouldering a bridge to communicate love and yearning, from the age of 17 to the age of 70. The colorful road of harmony and harmony shows the inclusiveness and diversity of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. The third chapter "Romance of the Great Tang Dynasty": Emperor Xuanzong of Tang reminisces about the past of "harmony between the qin and the se" with Yang Guifei. In front of the Palace of Eternal Life, he vows a mountain alliance, time flows by, and his love remains deep and unchanged. The love stories tirelessly written by the literati embody the beauty and romance of the Tang Dynasty. The fourth chapter, "The Spirit of the Tang Dynasty," Yan Zhenqing's "Sacrifice to My Nephew Manuscript," is not only the second line of writing in the world, but also has a touching story of the "spirit of Tang Dynasty literati" behind it, which showcases the spirit of literati and the heroic demeanor of generals during the country's crisis, as well as the iron blood and pride behind the prosperity and flourishing of the Tang Dynasty. More than a thousand years ago, Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty met the "character in the drama", and today, more than a thousand years later, the "character in the drama" also meets "you". Whether it's Chang'an in the past or Xi'an today, they are always filled with magical encounters! The ancient and modern moon gathers in Chang'an. So please listen attentively to its story!

Suzhou Jinji Lake Art Museum will fully utilize its public welfare functions, including exhibition, art collection, external exchange, academic research, and public education. It will carry out exhibitions, displays, collections, and collections of art works and literature, conduct academic research, educational promotion, and public cultural services, and undertake the social responsibility of inheriting culture. The art museum has four departments, namely: Exhibition Academic Department, Comprehensive Management Department, Art Business Department, and Creative Design Department.

The Ming Thirteen Tombs are located at the southern foot of Tianshou Mountain in Changping District, Beijing. They were first built as long tombs in May of the seventh year of Yongle (1409 AD) and continued until the last emperor of the Ming Dynasty, Chongzhen, entered the Siling Mausoleum. During this period, for more than 230 years, 13 magnificent imperial tombs with golden walls, 7 imperial consort tombs, and 1 eunuch tomb were built here. A total of 13 emperors, 23 empresses, 2 crown princes, over 30 concubines, and 1 eunuch were buried, making it the most well preserved and buried imperial tomb complex in the world today. The Ming Thirteen Tombs have magnificent architecture, complete system, long history, and high historical and cultural value. The mausoleum architecture of Changling covers an area of approximately 120000 square meters. Its planar layout is in the shape of a front and back circle. The square part in front of it is composed of three connected courtyards. The tomb gate of Changling faces north and south. Entering the Mausoleum Gate, there is a stele pavilion on the right-hand side, which is to the east. There is a wooden frame and a large stone monument standing inside the pavilion, with a unique shape. At the top of the monument is a dragon with its head protruding outside; The Stele is a divine beast with a dragon head turtle covered in scales and armor. Passing through the Mausoleum Gate and heading north, you will arrive at the Gate of Zhen En. After passing through the Ling'en Gate, there are two divine silk furnaces on each side, and in front of them is the magnificent Xie'en Hall. The Xie'en Hall is the main hall of Changling, and its architectural style is consistent with that of the Taihe Hall in the Forbidden City. The beams, columns, and rafters are all made of whole wood, including golden nanmu. The diameter at breast height of the columns is over 1 meter, which is a rare rare and excellent wood in the world. Entering the main hall, in the center was a tall bronze statue of Emperor Chengzu of the Ming Dynasty, Zhu Di. This was the image of Zhu Di in his old age, sitting on the throne with a serious expression. Some unearthed cultural relics from the Dingling Mausoleum are also exhibited in the main hall, and many display cabinets are placed along the walls of the hall. There are gold, silver, porcelain, jade, and other items that visitors can feast their eyes on and see what the Ming emperors used. Come out from the back door of the Hall of Benevolence and continue northward to the Lingxing Gate, then the Five Sacrifices, and then the tall Soul Tower. The inscription of "Changling" on the plaque of Soul Tower is striking. Every tomb in the Ming Tombs has Soul Tower, and most of them are well preserved, which is related to their solid masonry structure. Behind the Soul Tower is the treasure city, and under the loess is the underground palace where the emperor was buried. This is the end, behind us is Tianshou Mountain.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

summary: The Mingzhao Mausoleum is located at the eastern foot of Dayu Mountain in Changping District, Beijing, adjacent to the Dingling Mausoleum. It is the joint burial site of the 12th emperor of the Ming Dynasty, Emperor Muzong Zhu Zaiyang, and his three empresses. The regulation of the Zhaoling Mausoleum is of medium scale among the Thirteen Tombs, but compared with the Lingbao City models of Tai and Kang, it appears more exquisite and spectacular. Its Shinto branches off from Changling Shinto Qikong Bridge from north to west, with a length of about 2 kilometers. A stele pavilion will be built near the tomb, and three parallel single empty stone bridges will be built behind the pavilion. The overall layout of the Linggong Palace is in the form of a front and back circle. There are two courtyards in front of the Baocheng, a corridor under the Fangcheng, and five rooms of the Leng'en Hall and Supporting Hall, as well as three rooms of the Leng'en Gate. The great feature of Zhaoling is that it took the lead in forming a complete "mute courtyard" system. The sealing soil inside the treasure city is particularly full, almost as high as the treasure city wall. A rammed earth tomb is built in the center, and a brick wall is used to block it before sealing, connecting with the inner walls of the treasure city walls on both sides of the square city, forming a closed crescent shaped courtyard. Now we are heading to the Zhaoling Mausoleum, where we can see the restored Ling'en Hall, Ling'en Gate, Liangxie Palace, Shenggong Shengde Stele Pavilion, Sacrificial Pavilion, Divine Kitchen, Divine Treasury, and so on. In addition, there are "Historical Materials Exhibition of Emperor Zhaoling and Empress Dowager of the Ming Dynasty" and "Historical Materials Exhibition of Ming Dynasty Imperial Family Tombs" respectively in the left and right annex halls, introducing the relevant deeds of Zhu Zaiyang and his three empresses and concubines, as well as the burial regulations of Ming princes and concubines.
opening_hours: Open at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

summary: Mao'er Hutong starts from Nanluogu Lane in the east and ends at Di'anmen Outer Street in the west. It is connected to Doujiao Hutong to the north and Dongbu Bridge Hutong to the south. Because there were hat making workshops here during the Qing Dynasty, it was called Hat Alley. In Mao'er Hutong, you can enjoy many old Beijing courtyard houses and feel the strong atmosphere of old Beijing life here. The well preserved quadrangle courtyards here include: No. 5 Mao'er Hutong, No. 9 Mao'er Hutong (Keyuan), No. 11 Mao'er Hutong (Wenyu Residence), No. 13 Mao'er Hutong (Feng Guozhang's Former Residence), No. 21 Mao'er Hutong (Zitong Temple Wenchang Palace Site), No. 37 Mao'er Hutong (Wanrong's Former Residence), No. 45 Mao'er Hutong (Qing Commander's Office), etc. The top of Mao'er Hutong intersects with Nanluogu Lane, and there is also the famous Ju'er Hutong in the past. At the end is Cigarette Bag Hutong, so if you want to visit here and experience the atmosphere of old Beijing, Mao'er Hutong is a good choice.

Mao Dun lived here from 1974 to 1981. The former residence is a two courtyard house. There is a golden black marble horizontal plaque with the words' Mao Dun's Former Residence 'embedded on the screen wall inside the door. There are three north rooms, three east and west wing rooms, and six inverted rooms in the front yard. The Western Chamber was originally Mao Dun's reception room and library. The east wing serves as the dining room, while the rest is for the housing of family members and service personnel. There are six north rooms and two west rooms in the backyard. The north room was originally Mao Dun's studio and bedroom. After Mao Dun's death, the former residence was converted into an exhibition hall and opened to the public. There are two exhibition rooms in the front yard of the former residence, displaying physical objects and pictures of Mao Dun before his death, including manuscripts, works, letters, handwriting, and literary publications edited by Mao Dun, totaling more than 400 items. At the entrance to the exhibition hall, there is a half length White Marble statue of Mao Dun, 83 cm high, placed on a black marble base. There are 15 houses in the front yard, and the west wing was originally a reception room and a library, with its original layout maintained. The interior furnishings are old items used by Mao Dun during his lifetime. The exhibition room contains physical objects and pictures of Mao Dun from his youth to his death, including manuscripts, initial versions of his works, letters, handwriting, and two volumes of essays from elementary school. There are 6 main rooms in the backyard, with a black lacquer carved urn containing the ashes of Lady Mao Dun and Lady Kong Dezhen.

The Guo Moruo Memorial Hall is located in Qianhai, Xicheng District. The courtyard of Guo Moruo's former residence has an irregular shape, with two small hills in the front yard. The residential courtyard is located in the north of the courtyard and is a two entry quadrangle. There is a tall ginkgo tree and a sitting statue of Guo Moruo in the front yard, and there are wintersweet and crabapple trees planted in the second courtyard. There are shelves in the backyard for climbing plants such as grapes and wisteria. The main entrance is a hanging flower gate, and upon entering, there is a courtyard consisting of a main room and east and west wing rooms. Both the main room and the east and west wing rooms have eaves and corridors, and there is also a copying corridor connecting the eaves and corridors. The front main rooms are the living room, office, and bedroom, passing through Xiaoyue Jiyuan. In the middle of the back row is the place where Guo Moruo and his wife polish calligraphy, all of which still maintain the appearance of Guo Moruo when he was alive.

Baihua Mountain Nature Reserve is about 120 kilometers away from the city center of Beijing by car, making it very convenient to drive there. The scenic area is mainly focused on natural scenery. Hiking and hiking in the forest and sea of clouds, breathing fresh air in nature, is extremely enjoyable. There is a flower meadow on the mountaintop, where colorful flowers bloom every summer, very beautiful and suitable for photography. Notice before departure: Mentougou Baihua Mountain Nature Reserve has the same name as Fangshan Baihua Mountain Scenic Area. In addition, many tourists also confuse it with Fangshan Baicaopan Scenic Area and Yesanpo Baicaopan Scenic Area. In fact, several scenic spots are located in the Baihua Mountain Range, which has a main peak on both sides of Beijing and Hebei. Mentougou Baihua Mountain Nature Reserve is the main peak on the Beijing side, and the Beijing Fangshan Baicaopan Natural Scenic Area and Fangshan Baihua Mountain Scenic Area are also located on this main peak. It is a mountain peak with three scenic spots on three sides for a fee, and can be connected at the top of the mountain. The famous Baihua Grassland can be reached from these three scenic spots. The Yesanpo Baicaopan Scenic Area is located on the Hebei side and is a separate scenic area that is not connected to the other three scenic areas. The alpine meadows on Yesanpo are another concept, and it is important to distinguish them before traveling. Overview of the Tour: Visiting the Baihua Mountain in Mentougou is relatively simple. Once visitors enter the scenic area, they begin to climb the mountain (the original cableway in the area has been abandoned). It takes about 2-3 hours to reach the Baihua Grassland at the top of the mountain for sightseeing. After sightseeing, they can descend the mountain and enjoy the entire scenic area for about half a day. The hiking trail is mainly composed of stone steps and wooden boardwalks, with many birch forests and pine trees along the way. The environment is beautiful, and it feels great to breathe the fresh air from nature on the way. On the road, there are also scenic spots to admire, such as the sunset at Songting and the pine waves at Changling. The main attractions are beautiful forests and pavilions, as well as handsome mountains. When climbing, you can enjoy them one by one. In autumn, the mountains are covered in red leaves and forests, making it one of the few less crowded places in Beijing to enjoy the red leaves. After arriving at the mountaintop area, the most important thing is to visit the Hundred Flowers Meadow. From June to August every year, wildflowers bloom on the mountaintop meadow, and colorful flowers cover the grassland. The scenery is very beautiful, and taking photos here is very good. And every autumn, this place is golden and the scenery is particularly beautiful. In addition, there are often wonders such as sea of clouds at the mountaintop, which can be photographed. Catering and accommodation: You can return to the city on the same day or stay overnight at the foot of the mountain while visiting the Baihua Mountain Scenic Area in Mentougou. There are many rural households providing accommodation and dining in Bamuyan Village, about 8 kilometers away from the entrance of the scenic area. The conditions here are average, and most of the bathing is done in public bathrooms. However, the local farmers are enthusiastic and simple, and there are also farm dishes to taste. It's great to experience rural life here.

Shuanglong Gorge is located in Qingshan Cuigu, 2.5 kilometers south of Huocun, Zhaitang Town, Mentougou District. The scenery can be summarized in sixteen words: "Ten mile stream, Baitan waterfall, thousand acres of red apricots, and ten thousand hectares of forest sea. The scenery of Shuanglong Gorge is picturesque all year round: from January to March, you can step on the ten mile glacier and enjoy the hundred hanging ice waterfall; from March to April, you can enjoy the thousand acres of apricot blossom tide like the sea; from April to May, you can enjoy the ice waterfall during the hiking season; from June to October, you can enjoy the ten mile stream, Baitan waterfall, thousand acres of apricot garden, ten thousand leaning forest sea, green mountains and green valleys, a paradise; from November to December, you can also experience the thrilling adventure of primitive forest climbing, riding on a unique forest train in the mountains, the fragrance of flowers coming towards you makes you feel relaxed and happy. Like a fairyland. Taking a small train into the scenic area, walking through streams and canyons, the scenery is very beautiful. If you come between December and May of the following year, there is still a chance to enjoy the first ice waterfall, which is as white as jade and stretches across here, very spectacular. Be sure to bring your camera here to capture this rare ice waterfall landscape. But it is particularly important to pay attention to safety, as it can be very troublesome if you accidentally fall. In addition to the ice waterfall cloth, the scenic area also has a unique forest train. When you board the train, it's like arriving at the "Taking Tiger Mountain with Wisdom" Jiapi Gully, which you won't experience anywhere else.

poiName: Xishan Island in the Taihu Lake

summary: Shigong Mountain is located at the southeastern end of Xishan Island, surrounded by water on three sides and backed by a cluster of mountains on one side. The mountain is covered with lush green cypress trees, resembling green snails swimming in the water and jade floating in the lake. The scenery is infinitely beautiful and can be called a fairyland on earth. There is also a very interesting story about the origin of the name of the scenic spot. Legend has it that there were two strange stones at the foot of the mountain by the water, shaped like an old man and an old woman. People vividly called them Shigong and Shipo, and this mountain was named Shigong Mountain because of this. Shigong Mountain is not high, with an altitude of only 50 meters. There is no steep mountain scenery here, but there are strange and rugged rocks, towering and undulating scenery. The pavilions and towers on the mountain are staggered in height, with landscapes such as Guiyun Cave, Fuyu North Hall, Laihe Pavilion, Duanshan Pavilion, Yixiantian, Mingyue Slope, etc. The lake and mountain colors can be seen in the painting. On the southwest lake surface of Shigong Mountain, one can vaguely see the remnants of Tianmu Mountain, forming a magnificent scene of islands within islands, lakes in the lake, mountains outside the mountains, and sky outside, attracting countless tourists from all over the world.

The Beisi Pagoda is 76 meters high, with eight corners and nine floors, and stands tall in the south of the Yangtze River. Originally, climbing high could overlook the scenery of the whole city, but currently the scenic area is undergoing renovation and visitors are not allowed to enter. There are still some Bao'en Temple buildings rebuilt during the Ming and Qing dynasties around the tower. The Beisi Pagoda is a Chinese tower style Buddhist pagoda, first built in the Three Kingdoms period. It is said to have been built by Sun Quan to repay his mother's kindness, hence the name Bao'en Temple Pagoda. There is a Guanyin Hall in the east of the tower that is not stained with dust, commonly known as the Nanmu Guanyin Hall. It was first built in the 23rd year of the Shaoxing period of the Southern Song Dynasty, and the existing hall was rebuilt during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty. It is a well preserved Ming Dynasty building in Suzhou. There is a long corridor in the south of Guanyin Hall, displaying the largest lacquer sculpture in China, the "Prosperous Era Breeding Map" also known as the "Gusu Prosperous Map", which is 32 meters long and 2 meters high. There is a rare Yuan Dynasty stone carving "Zhang Shicheng Memorial Monument" behind the tower. There is an ancient bronze Buddhist temple and a scripture pavilion in the north of the tower. The ancient bronze Buddha Hall used to be used to cast the third generation Buddha in bronze. It was built on a flush gable roof with a single eave. The Guanyindou gable, beams and ridges are decorated in Huizhou architectural style. The Sutra Pavilion is a double eaved gable mountain pavilion style, originally known as the Efanxiang Hall. There is a garden in the northeast of the tower, with steep mountains and rocks, winding pools of water, and pavilions, pavilions, corridors, and bridges all in their respective places, called Meipu.

poiName: bei yuan men gao jia da yuan pi ying xi

summary: The Customs Museum is located on Jianguomen Inner Street in Dongcheng District, Beijing. The museum systematically showcases the development history of China's customs from ancient times to the present through more than 1800 collections. The "Customs 902" boat is particularly special in the exhibition area, and the museum has set up a separate underground level for its exhibition. It is a 'hero boat'. Many exhibits in the museum are of high value. The "Chinese Lighthouse Map" drawn in 1894 indicates the distribution of lighthouses in the coastal areas of China, and is also the only unique edition in the country. In addition, the exhibits also include precious cultural relics such as bronze swords from the Warring States period, a standing statue of Guanyin from the Song Dynasty, a fossil of Confucius' bird, ivory handicrafts, snow leopard specimens, and Northeast tiger skins. Moreover, the Customs Museum also publicly exposes in detail the smuggling methods used in various periods, such as in the 1980s when smugglers hid watches in unripe coconuts, which was shocking.
opening_hours: Open at  09:00-16:30(Tickets available until 15:45; admission ends at 16:00)

summary: The Yinding Bridge is located at the junction of Qianhai and Houhai, and is a north-south single arch stone bridge. Although Xiaoqiao may not be eye-catching, it was the protagonist of the "Silver Ingot Mountain View" of the Eight Scenic Spots in Yanjing in the past. In the past, standing on the bridge, one could admire the sunset over the western mountains, but now they have all turned into high-rise buildings. This is also a "transit station" for traveling between the Prince Gong's Mansion, the Temple of Fire, and the Lotus Market, with tourists standing on the bridge all day long. Crossing the bridge and heading west into the northern edge of Houhai, you can freely choose a coastal bar at night to experience the charm of Beijing's nightlife.

The Suzhou Cultural and Art Center, known as the "Suzhou Bird's Nest," embodies the fusion of traditional Suzhou elements and modern architecture. It is an iconic cultural highland, diverse art hall, international communication platform, and spiritual home for the people in Suzhou. Suyi opened on October 1, 2007, consisting of Suzhou Grand Theatre, Suyi Cinema, Suyi Ballet, Suzhou Jinji Lake Art Museum, Park Cultural Center, Suyi Training, Commercial Center, etc. Suzhou Cultural and Art Center is a "Jiangsu Province Cultural Industry Demonstration Base"; Suzhou Grand Theatre is a member of the Asia Pacific Theater Performing Arts Center Alliance; Suyi Cinema has always been the top grossing cinema in Suzhou.

The Thousand Person Stone is located next to the Sword Pool on Huqiu Mountain. According to legend, in the Southern Dynasties, the high monk "Shenggong" of the Liang Dynasty said this. In the Tang Dynasty, Lu Guangwei wrote in his book "Wu Di Ji": "There is a stone by the edge of the Tiger Hill Pool (Sword Pool) that can seat a thousand people, called the 'Thousand Person Stone'." In the Song Dynasty, Ye Tinggui wrote in his book "Hai Lu Chu Shi, Zheng Shi, Tomb Gate": "There is a flat stone on the side of the Tiger Hill Stream that can accommodate a thousand people, called the 'Thousand Person Stone'. It is said that because of the teachings of Sheng Gong, it is said here." In the Qing Dynasty, Chen Weisong wrote in his poem "Xin Yan Guo Zhuang Lou, Tiger Hill Feeling Old": "The Gan Hall carved a thousand person stone pavilion, and at night we once remember traveling together

Xishan Dajue Temple is a thousand year old ancient temple, which was one of the eight major water courtyards in Xishan during the Liao and Jin dynasties. Today, it is famous for its clear springs, ancient trees, magnolias, and elegant environment. Dajue Temple is built along the mountain, facing west and east, maintaining the custom of the Khitan people of the Liao Dynasty to respect the sun and worship the sun. The temple architecture is magnificent and quaint, with a rigorous and orderly layout. In addition to conventional buildings, there are also imperial palaces of the Qing Dynasty, including the "Siyi Hall" (Nanyulan Courtyard) named by Emperor Yongzheng and the "Qiyun Pavilion" named by Emperor Qianlong, which shows its high status. The standing figures of the twenty heavens on the north and south sides of the the Shakya ManiHall are vivid and vivid. Although they have been eroded and peeled off by wind for more than five hundred years, their superb techniques and exquisite paintings can still make people feel the dignity of Buddhism and the royal style. There are many ancient and famous trees in the temple, including 1000 year old ginkgo trees, 300 year old magnolias, ancient sagebrush trees, pine and cypress trees, especially magnolias. Along with the lilacs in Fayuan Temple and the peonies in Chongxiao Temple, they are known as the three major flower temples in Beijing. Every April, Dajue Temple holds the Dajue Temple Jade Orchid Culture Festival. In addition to admiring the blooming magnolia flowers, exhibitions and cultural activities are also held.

The Beijing Yanqing Baili Landscape Gallery Scenic Area is located in Qianjiadian Town, northeast of Yanqing District. It is the core area of Yanqing Ecological Conservation Zone, with a total area of 371 square kilometers, 40 kilometers away from Yanqing urban area and 110 kilometers away from the urban area. It is adjacent to Huairou District in the east, borders Chicheng County in Hebei Province in the north, and is connected to Xiangying, Liubinbao, and Zhenzhuquan townships in the southwest and southeast respectively. The Luanchi, Huaqian, and Huasha highways pass through the town and form their own circular roads, with convenient transportation. In 2007, they were rated as one of the top 10 self driving routes in Beijing. The scenic area includes twelve spatial nodes in one ring road and three zones, covering 112 miles of the riverside ring road, hence the name "Hundred mile Landscape Gallery". On September 17, 2010, approved by the National Tourism Administration and the National Tourism Scenic Area Quality Rating Committee, it became a large-scale national 4A level tourist attraction covering the entire town of Beijing, achieving the integration of town and scenery. It is now one of the four major parks of Yanqing Global Geopark. The environment inside the scenic area is excellent, and the climate belongs to the semi humid zone of warm temperate continental monsoon climate. The air is rich in negative oxygen ions, with an average annual temperature of 8 ° C and an average annual precipitation of 477.2 millimeters. The scenery changes picturesque throughout the four seasons, making it a true summer resort and green oxygen bar. The picturesque Bai River Valley and the magnificent Heihe Canyon have nurtured rich tourism resources such as silicified wood clusters, majestic dripping waterfalls, mysterious Wulong Canyon, majestic Chaoyang Temple, ancient Guandi Temple, and lush primary secondary forests in Datan.

poiName: Former Residence of Soong Ching Ling
summary: The former residence of Soong Ching ling was once the residence of Mingzhu, a great scholar during the Kangxi reign of the Qing Dynasty. Mrs. Soong Ching ling lived here for nearly 20 years. You can learn about the life of Ms. Soong Ching ling by visiting her belongings, letters, etc. before her death. Strolling in the antique garden courtyard, taking good photos. The antique courtyard of the former residence is not large in size, with a length and width of about 150 meters. After entering the courtyard, you can walk there. The entire courtyard is surrounded by the flowing water introduced by the Houhai, located on the two larger water surfaces of Hounan Lake and Houhu Lake inside the courtyard. The main building is located at the center of the water flow, similar to an island in the center of a lake. The buildings here are all antique and very elegant. There are various trees between the lake and the buildings, including famous trees such as the century old crabapple and the phoenix national locust, which are very beautiful. Strolling among the trees and water currents in the courtyard, it feels very peaceful and tranquil, and taking photos is also a great filming location. There are currently two special exhibitions in the former residence, one showcasing the original living conditions of Soong Ching ling and the other showcasing Soong Ching ling's life. The exhibition of the original living conditions of Soong Ching ling is located in a building on an island in the middle of the lake. It is a restoration of the original living and working environment of Soong Ching ling during her lifetime, providing a good understanding of her living and working environment. The exhibition hall of Song Qingling's life is located on the west side, not on the central island of the lake. Here, more than 20000 cultural relics and graphic materials are used to showcase the life of Ms. Soong Ching ling, showing her appearance in different periods. Volunteers often provide free explanations in the museum, and if you encounter any, you can listen carefully.

tagNameList: Outdoor Skiing; Other Experiences; Nighttime sightseeing
summary: The Shougang Ski Jumping Platform is the world's first ski jumping platform built in the central urban area of a city. Against the backdrop of blue sky and white clouds, with industrial style buildings as the background, the scene of athletes competing instantly spreads throughout the world, and every frame will be frozen as a wonderful scene in history. The four hyperbolic shaped 70 meter high cooling towers adjacent to the large jumping platform became the backdrop of the competition, and their unique appearance quickly became the focus of media cameras. The cooling tower is a supporting equipment of the original Shougang Power Plant. The four cooling towers were first built in 1978 and the latest in 1991, and operated until the main steel flow in the old Shougang plant area was shut down. At that time, the original Shougang Power Plant adopted power generation processes commonly used by steel plants, such as coal combustion, blast furnace pressure difference, and dry quenching. The main function of a cooling tower is to complete heat exchange between hot water and air, reduce the temperature of circulating water, and provide sufficient cooling water for power plant generation. In order to deeply explore the cultural value of industrial heritage in the park and construct high-level Olympic competition venues, Shougang Group conducted extensive research on the site conditions, competition needs, and post competition utilization. Multiple rounds of planning schemes were carried out, and the final approval plan was formed. After the main steel process in Shougang's old factory area was shut down, four cooling towers were used as distinctive landmarks for protection. The reinforced cooling tower retains the stunning industrial characteristic space and can be implanted with new functions in the later stage, injecting new artistic vitality.

Zhuosidao Hot Spring faces the banks of a flowing river, surrounded by forests. With a rigorous and clever layout, the scenery of clear lakes and beautiful waters, the realm of bird songs and fragrant flowers, and the essence of poetry and painting, it brings you a pure world where you can fully release your body and soul. There are 32 unique hot spring pools, including bubble pools and mineral sand baths, as well as an infinity pool and a children's water park for you to experience. The hot spring area has 32 unique hot spring pools, including Baihua Pool, Butterfly Love Pool, Mineral Sand Bath, Bubble Pool, Rose Pool, Milk Pool, Four Seasons Soup, etc. With a rigorous and clever layout, beautiful lake and water scenery, the realm of bird songs and floral fragrance, and the essence of poetry and painting, it brings you a pure world where you can fully release your body and mind. The architecture of the park adopts the natural freehand landscape style of garden art, constructing pavilions and corridors, cascading water management, surrounding lakes and chiseling pools, and arranging flowers and trees in a timely manner. If it's a hot summer, come to a hot spring hotel. In addition to soaking in the hot springs for nourishment, you can also take a swim in the infinity pool to dissipate the heat and cool down. Experience the realm of 'those who fly kites against the sky, watch the peak and calm down; those who are knowledgeable in worldly affairs, gaze into the valley and forget to return'. Looking around, it's all a refreshing sky blue, allowing you to enjoy a cool and exciting water gaming experience without having to go to the beach. A clean water playing environment allows more families and children to experience the joy of water immersion. The hotel also has a children's water park, allowing your child to fully unleash their water playing nature, play freely in the water, and have fun. If you're tired from playing, you can take a nap on the nearby lounge chair and enjoy a pleasant and wonderful time.

Huadu Vanilla World is located in Huashan Town, Huadu District, close to Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport. It is a rare park in China with vanilla as its theme. This place is surrounded by mountains and waters, with a superior ecological environment. It has areas such as lavender kingdom, aromatherapy garden, rose garden, international vegetable orchard, children's handicraft classroom, and children's science education park. This is the Vanilla Kingdom, which collects many world-renowned herbs such as basil, rosemary, sage, lavender, chamomile, etc. Not only can you learn a lot about vanilla here, but you can also see beautiful flower seas such as roses, lavender, and honeysuckle. In addition, there are many motorized gaming devices in the park that are suitable for children to play. Huadu Vanilla World not only has beautiful scenery to enjoy, but also delicious food to taste. Here, you can enjoy unique herb hotpot, cuisine with various herbs added, and specialty farmhouse dishes with flowers as the main ingredient. If you are interested, you can taste them.
