summary: Jiulongtan: There is a Jiulong Opera Pearl Area and a Bamboo Sea Leisure Area in the scenic area, and large areas of white tea trees and ginkgo trees are planted. At a glance, the ocean is full of ginkgo trees. Combined with the surrounding bamboo sea and tea gardens, a comprehensive scenic area with beautiful scenery, strong leisure and entertainment features, and even a golf training ground has been created.

Suzhou Center is the core component of Suzhou Central Plaza, which is divided into two buildings. The northern district focuses on international fast fashion, family, and parent-child activities, while the southern district focuses on light luxury and dining. There are numerous brands gathered here, as well as an aerial ecological park, which forms a unified urban architectural image with the Oriental Gate and Jinji Lake.

poiName: jing shan xi yang guan jing chu
summary: Jingshan Sunset View is located in Suzhou, where people can enjoy the beautiful scenery of sunrise and sunset as well as the beautiful the Taihu Lake Lake.

The East Village is located in the north of Xishan Island, Suzhou, with Qingshan Mountain to the south and the Taihu Lake Lake to the north, facing Hengshan, Yinshan and Shaoshan Islands. Dongcun was established in the late Qin and early Han dynasties. It was named after Dongyuan Gong, one of the Four Heroes of Shangshan, who once lived here in seclusion. In ancient times, it was called Dongyuan Village, abbreviated as Dongcun. Existing ancient residences: Fangzhu Hall, Shensi Hall, Ruimu Hall, Renyu Hall, Yansheng Hall, Xuepu Hall, Liugeng Hall, Shaoyi Hall, Xiaoyou Hall, Rende Hall, Dunhe Hall, Cuixiu Hall, Langrun Hall, Jingxiu Hall, etc. There are also historical sites such as Qixian Lane Gate, Yong'an Bridge, and Dongyuan Temple. Jingxiu Hall - The Golden House of Emperor Qianlong in the Qing Dynasty, where delicate treasures were hidden. Due to economic and transportation constraints, the preservation of the ancient village style in Dongcun is better than other areas in Xishan. Most of the roads in the village are still in their original stone and blue brick appearance, and the ancient houses on both sides are mostly from the Qianlong and Jiaqing periods of the Qing Dynasty.

Suzhou Dinghui Temple is located in Dinghui Temple Lane, Fenghuang Street, the ancient city of Suzhou. The environment is quiet. Since ancient times, celebrities have gathered together. It has a strong cultural heritage. The two old ginkgo trees in front of the the Shakya ManiHall remember the vicissitudes of the Dinghui Temple. Today's Dinghui Temple, located west of Fenghuang Street, is bustling with traffic and exudes a modern atmosphere; Adjacent to Su Gong Lane to the east, the winding paths are deep and the ancient charm of Tang and Song dynasties still exists. The Dinghui Temple Lane in front of the mountain gate is named after the temple. The people in the alley live and rest every day accompanied by the morning bell and evening drum of Dinghui Temple. Although they are in the bustling city, they are rare and peaceful. In this land and water, Dinghui Temple is like a Zen monk, carrying the legacy of Tang and Song dynasties, walking towards us, entering our lives and souls, bringing us peace and tranquility. Approaching Dinghui Temple, one can feel the pulse of Gusu's history; Tasting Dinghui Temple reveals that Suzhou is truly a historic and cultural city.

This street is the main street outside Fengmen Gate, with a Guoji Town style urban and rural trade center attached to Fengmen Gate. The majority of the buildings on the street still retain the style of the early Qing and late Ming dynasties' Zhenhe households.

Yinshan Tallinn is located in the northern part of Beijing, in the Thirteen Tombs Special Zone. It is about 60 kilometers away from the center of Beijing by car and is a great place for tourists who love to visit ancient times. The scenic area was originally the location of the famous Fahua Zen Temple. Later, the temple was destroyed, leaving only the ancient pagodas inside the temple. Among them, the five ancient pagodas from the Jin Dynasty on the square are relatively well preserved, with ancient and magnificent tower bodies. Visiting here feels very quaint and has a profound historical charm. The area of Yinshan Tallinn Scenic Area is not large, and the main tourist area is the square where the five ancient pagodas are located. Here, you can take photos of the ancient pagodas, and the pictures taken of the quaint and spectacular scenes are very beautiful. Tallinn is backed by the Silver Mountain. Since ancient times, this small mountain has been known as the "Silver Mountain Iron Wall", which means that when it snows, the mountain is white and the steep cliffs on one side will not snow. Nowadays, visitors to the scenic area can also climb small hills to enjoy the steep mountain walls and numerous small unnamed ancient pagodas in the mountains. In addition, taking panoramic shots of the five ancient pagodas on the mountain is also very good.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

summary: The China Museum of Paleontology is a museum that systematically introduces the origin and phylogenetics of vertebrates. It is a natural science themed museum that uses paleontological fossils as carriers to systematically popularize knowledge of paleontology, paleoecology, paleoanthropology, and evolutionary theory. The basic exhibition in the museum consists of four parts: "Dinosaur World (Electromechanical Simulation)", "Ancient Fish Hall", "Ancient Reptile Hall", "Mammal Hall", etc. Through physical objects and other display methods, the museum systematically introduces the origin and evolutionary history of prehistoric vertebrates to the audience, showcases the ancient vertebrate fossils preserved in the marine and terrestrial strata deposited in China at various periods, and the research achievements in this scientific field. The precious exhibits on display at the Paleozoological Museum include the Latimai fish specimen known as the "living fossil", as well as exquisite fossils such as the majestic Yellow River elephant skeleton that has been included in elementary school textbooks. Recently, the museum has added valuable exhibits such as feathered dinosaurs, Kongziniao and other bird fossils, as well as the world's first pterosaur embryo, which have caused a sensation in the world.

Taoran Pavilion Park is a garden style park built around Taoran Pavilion, one of the "Four Famous Pavilions". The center of the park is the Green Lake, surrounded by weeping willows and beautiful surroundings. In addition to Taoran Pavilion, many pavilions have also been built in imitation of historical famous pavilions from all over the country in the park. Strolling through the park, you can enjoy a panoramic view of famous pavilions from all over the country. The area of Taoranting Park is not large, with a length and width of about 1 kilometer. The park has entrances in several directions, including east, west, north, and south, and visitors can walk and enjoy the park. It takes about 2-3 hours to play. The center of the park is a circular lake with an island in the center. Except for the lake area and the central island, the surrounding area is roughly divided into three parts: southwest, southeast, and north. In summer, take a boat ride, and in winter, ice skate on the lake. The circular lake is divided into three parts: East Lake, West Lake, and South Lake by three bridges on the surface of the lake, with an island in the center of the lake. On the lake, you can go boating. The park offers various types of boats, including regular pedal boats, as well as unique naval boats, big yellow duck boats, etc. 4-6 people can ride on the boats, with prices ranging from 60-150 yuan per hour. Every winter when the lake surface freezes, an artificial ice and snow rink will be opened on the lake, where visitors can come to ice skating, play snow circles, and more. Huxin Island: The location of Taoran Pavilion is Huxin Island, which is the location of Taoran Pavilion and Compassionate Temple. Taoran Pavilion is one of the four famous pavilions in Chinese history. Compassionate Temple is now a small museum that showcases the life of Li Dazhao and the achievements of the May Fourth Movement through revolutionary relics, pictures, and textual introductions. There is also a high stone tomb on the island in the middle of the lake, which is the joint burial tomb of revolutionary martyr Gao Junyu and talented woman Shi Pingmei. Their love story is very touching, so many people come here to pay their respects. In addition, the island in the center of the lake and the surrounding trees are lush with weeping willows, creating a beautiful environment. Strolling and taking photos here are great, and there are also many people exercising around the lake in the evening. The southwest side of Huaxia Mingting Garden is the key area of the park, Huaxia Mingting Garden, which is the location of imitation famous pavilions from all over the country. Here, you can see replicas of over a dozen historic pavilions, including the Orchid Pavilion, the Exile Immortal Pavilion, and the Drunken Weng Pavilion. Each pavilion has a unique shape and distinctive features. And the surrounding trees are lush, making it great to stroll among them. The northern area of the children's play area is located near the north gate, where there are also some pavilions, water pavilions, trees, etc., where you can stroll and enjoy the scenery. However, the main content is the children's play area next to the north gate, which has more than ten entertainment projects such as small trains, space walks, bumper cars, etc., each costing about 15-40 yuan, suitable for bringing children to play. In addition, there are two free stone slides here, called Big Snow Mountain and Small Snow Mountain. Many local tourists not only bring their children to play, but also personally experience the feeling of reminiscing about childhood. There are also some pavilions in the southern area, and the main landscape of this part is trees. The trees here are relatively dense, and there is a beautiful ginkgo forest at the Tanying Liujin scenic spot. You can see many ginkgo leaves every autumn, and the sightseeing photos are very good.

The Baiyun Mountain Cableway starts from the east side of Yuntai Garden at the southern foot of Baiyun Mountain and goes up to the top park of Baiyun Mountain. It is one of the cableways with advanced technology and equipment in the world today. Riding the cableway roller coaster, you can overlook various scenic spots in the scenic area and enjoy unlimited scenery.

This trail is shaded by green trees, with birds chirping and flowers blooming, and the air is fresh and pleasant. In addition, there are multiple observation decks, rest pavilions and other facilities along the trail, which are convenient for tourists to rest and take photos.

Dongshan Lake Park (commonly known as Donghu Park) is one of the four major artificial lake parks in Guangzhou, with an area of approximately 33 hectares, including a land area of about 12 hectares and a water area of about 20 hectares. It is a district level comprehensive cultural rest park. The mountains and waters in the park are interdependent, and the lake water is clear to the bottom. There are 5 peninsulas and 1 isolated island in the lake, connected by nine curved bridges, five hole bridges, and arch bridges, and integrated with unique pavilions, corridors, pavilions, pavilions, and flower stands. The garden features Bauhinia and Willow Embankment as the main scenery, with 110 species of trees and shrubs and over 10000 plants. Therefore, every spring, the scenery is very charming. Guangzhou Dongshanhu Park has entertainment infrastructure such as dining lounges, dance halls, table tennis rooms, electronic game rooms, ice rinks, amusement parks, and small shops, as well as recreational areas such as fishing and kayaking areas. In spring and autumn, Donghu Park also holds large-scale flower exhibitions for visitors to enjoy.

Daluo is a small town in Menghai County, located on the southern border of Xishuangbanna. It is peaceful and leisurely, where you can experience traditional handicrafts such as sugar making, brewing, papermaking, and pottery making. You can also visit the Daluo Port to experience exotic customs. There is the Daluo Border Trade Tourism Development Zone at the Daluo Port, where you can go for a stroll, buy some local specialties, or go for a small stroll across the border at the port. There is a scenic spot called "A Forest of Solitary Trees" worth visiting. It is a place where ancient banyan trees have been formed for nearly a thousand years. A large tree is covered with countless trunks, and on the branches of the tree, there are roots that look like roots and branches, forming a "forest". The scenery is very spectacular.

Qintai Road is named in honor of the legendary figures and love incarnations of the Western Han Dynasty, Zhuo Wenjun and Sima Xiangru. Zhuo Wenjun and Sima Xiangru opened a wine shop on the ancient Qintai Road, and Zhuo Wenjun personally sold wine on the platform. Zhuo Wenjun, who applied light makeup, stood on the earthen platform where wine jars were placed, selling wine with a calm and composed demeanor. And for the sake of eternal love, Sima Xiangru also did not play the qin. He was dressed in short pants like the hotel staff, washing dishes and doing odd jobs, chatting and laughing happily. In this way, although life was a bit difficult, the two of them were happy and content, not burdened by the mundane world at all! Today, Qintai Road is a jewelry street in Chengdu, where large jewelry stores gather and there are also some restaurants suitable for wedding banquets. Therefore, it is called Love Road by the locals. With a total length of 900 meters, it is based on the Han and Tang Dynasty antique architectural complex, and takes the love story of Sima Xiangru and Zhuo Wenjun as the main line, showcasing the customs and traditions of the Han Dynasty, such as etiquette, dance music, and banquets. Shu style and elegant charm - located almost in the middle of Qintai Road, the Sichuan Opera House, which has been popular in recent years, is also a tea house. There are large bowls of tea, as well as performances such as face changing and fire breathing, making it a popular tourist destination. Shufeng Yayun used to be a gathering place for famous Sichuan opera actors. In recent years, it has reunited with famous actors and launched a nightly "Classic Opera, Folk Art Performance". Not only did it gain fame, but it was also widely reported by media both domestically and internationally.

The Yin'an Hall is commonly referred to as the Yinluan Hall, which is only open during major events and important festivals, playing a ceremonial role. There are seven roof figures hanging on the eaves of Yin'an Hall, and five princes.

The Zongshendao, also known as the Thirteen Tombs Shendao or Changling Shendao, is the leading part of the Changling Mausoleum architecture, located in the Ming Thirteen Tombs Scenic Area in Changping, Beijing. The Shinto Way, with a total length of about 7.3 kilometers, was built in the early years of the orthodox Ming Dynasty. From south to north, the original stone memorial archway, Sankong Bridge, Dahongmen, Shengong Shengde Stele Pavilion, Shixiangsheng, Lingxing Gate, South Wukong Bridge, Qikong Bridge, North Wukong Bridge and other series of Shinto tomb facilities and bridge and culvert buildings. Except for the damaged bridges and culverts, everything else is well protected. The Stone memorial archway is the first building on the Shinto, and it is a large wooden structure stone archway with high architectural level that exists earlier in China. Composed of carved and assembled white and blue stones, it is exquisitely crafted, transparent, and ethereal. Dahongmen is the main entrance of the mausoleum area, with a single eaved pavilion roof covered with yellow glazed tiles and a stone carved ice tray eave below, creating an exquisite and atmospheric design. The four walls and platform of the Shenggong Shengde Stele Pavilion are original artifacts from the Ming Dynasty. Inside the pavilion stands the "Great Ming Changling Shenggong Shengde Stele" carved from white stone. The four corners of the pavilion are ornamental column, 10.81 meters high, and are octagonal ornamental column columns. There is a divine beast squatting at the top, with its head held high and a long hissing sound - the squatting dragon. Within an area of more than 800 meters north of the Stele Pavilion, there are 12 pairs of stone beasts and 6 pairs of stone figures to display the majesty of the emperor's carriage. At the end of the stone statue is the Lingxing Gate, which has three gates. There are two pillow stones on the gates, which can be installed with two door frames, symbolizing the idea of "opening and closing six doors". When the emperor and empress enter the tomb, they must pass through this gate, so it is often called the Dragon and Phoenix Gate.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

summary: The Suzhou Street in the Summer Palace is located in the northwest suburbs of Beijing. It is a shopping street built on both sides of the Houhu Lake, modeled after the water town of Jiangnan. It was built during the Qianlong period, modeled after the water town of Jiangnan, and was a water street for emperors and empresses of the Qing Dynasty to visit the market. The street is more than 300 meters long, with a small river in the middle. Along the bank, there are tea houses, restaurants, money shops, pharmacies, pawnshops, silk shops, printing houses and other shops. After arriving at the Summer Palace, visitors can shop along the coast or by boat, full of the rich fun of antique tourism.

The Wangong Causeway is close to the East the Taihu Lake Lake, echoing the Suzhou Bay Bridge from afar. From an aerial perspective, a stark contrast between modernity and history is presented. Wan Gongdi is named after Wan Qingxuan, a water conservancy expert in the Qing Dynasty who built the pond road from Sanliqiao to Dapu Bridge. Now this road has become a national cultural relic protection unit and one of the important heritage sites of the Grand Canal, known as the "Nine Mile Stone Pond".

Dayuan Central Park, located in the residential area of Dayuan Cluster in Gaoxin South District, Chengdu, is a super large open park in the area. Composed of lake scenery, green forests, flower forests and other landscapes, the functional positioning is mainly focused on walking and static leisure activities.

Ba Jin's former residence is located on Wukang Road in Xuhui District, and the iron gate under the shade of trees appears particularly low-key and unremarkable. Mr. Ba Jin, a literary magnate of the first generation, and his family have lived here for more than forty years, and Ba Lao's novels "League Member", prose collection "Endless Emotions", translated works "Memories and Reflections", and "Random Thoughts Record" were completed here. The former residence consists of a three story main building and two small auxiliary buildings, with a garden next to the buildings. The main building was first built in 1923 and used to be the Soviet Union's business representative office. In 1955, Ba Jin and his family moved here to settle down. Nowadays, the living room, dining room, study room, etc. inside the building have been restored according to Ba Jin's living arrangements. The garden is filled with various plants, many of which were planted by Ba Jin himself in the past. The first floor of the former residence is mainly a display room, where you can see Ba Jin's works and used items. You can also visit the kitchen and balcony, where Ba Jin wrote in his late period. The second floor consists of a bedroom and a study. The bedroom is clean and the study displays many books from Ba Jin's collection. Although visitors cannot enter, they can have a clear view of the room from the entrance. The third floor is the Ba Jin Archives Room, which is not open to the public. After visiting the building, you can come out and take a walk in the garden. The garden is not big, but the environment is good. It can be considered a quiet place amidst the hustle and bustle in the city. There is a consultation room nearby selling Ba Jin's works, which can also be stamped with commemorative badges.

The Shanghai World Financial Center stands within the Lujiazui Financial and Trade Zone and is the fourth tallest building in China, shaped like a bottle opener. On the 100th floor of the sightseeing hall, you can look up at the Oriental Pearl TV Tower spire. Stepping on the suspended sightseeing corridor, overlooking the scenery on both sides of the Pujiang River through the transparent glass underfoot, it's like strolling in the clouds. The Shanghai World Financial Center is 492 meters high, with 101 floors above ground and a total of 6 entrances. The basement level 2 to the above ground level 3 are shopping malls and dining areas, and no admission tickets are required. The 7th to 77th floors are offices, and the 79th to 93rd floors are Park Hyatt hotels. Gate 2 is the entrance to the sightseeing hall, located on Dongtai Road near Huayuan Shiqiao Road. Enter the ticketing area on the B1 floor through the entrance, and then take the high-speed elevator with a speed of up to 8 meters per second. It only takes 66 seconds to travel from the basement level 2 to the 94th floor. The 94th to 100th floors are the observation hall. Visitors can start from the 94th floor, take the escalator to the 97th floor, walk over the observation bridge, and take the elevator to the 100th floor. Of course, they can also go in the opposite direction. You can also buy and mail postcards on the 94th floor. 100th floor: Located at 474 meters, the unique feature is a suspended sightseeing corridor about 55 meters long. The corridor is equipped with three transparent glass floors, allowing clear views of cars and pedestrians passing through the ground. 97th floor: located at 439 meters, the open glass ceiling design here is very unique. When the weather is clear, the glass ceiling slides to both sides to open, and the entire sightseeing hall is like a floating "sky bridge" in the air. 94th floor: Located at 423 meters, with a height of 8 meters, the space is very spacious and offers a panoramic view of the Pujiang River scenery. There are also commemorative shops, cafes, and climbing commemorative photos. Various exhibitions and events can also be held here.

Jinmao Building is located in Lujiazui Financial and Trade Zone, with a height of more than 420 meters. It is the third tallest building in Shanghai center and the World Financial Center. The 88th floor observation hall of the building is one of the famous high-altitude observation platforms in Shanghai, and the night view seen here is particularly charming. Taking the elevator that runs 9 meters per second from the ground floor lobby, it only takes 45 seconds to reach the 340 meter high 88 story building. The glass curtain wall inside the sightseeing hall provides a wide view, allowing for a panoramic view of the city scenery. It is recommended to go for sightseeing in the afternoon or late afternoon, as the charming sunset can be seen on good days. Under the night sky, Lujiazui and the Bund are quite beautiful under the rendering of lighting. In addition, there are coin operated telescopes available for use in the sightseeing hall. The 53-87 floors of the building are the Grand Hyatt Jinmao Hotel, especially the hotel atrium, where dozens of corridors shine brilliantly under the neon lights. Standing in the observation hall on the 88th floor and looking down at the atrium, it feels like a time and space tunnel. There is a glass walkway outside the 88th floor of Jinmao Tower, which is more than 340 meters above the ground and has a total length of about 60 meters. It is a relatively high unguarded aerial walkway outside the building. Strolling here feels like stepping on clouds, offering a 360 degree panoramic view of Shanghai without any obstruction.

The Bund Sightseeing Tunnel connects the Bund and the Lujiazui commercial district in Pudong, and is the first pedestrian tunnel across the river in China. Tourists can take a fully transparent sightseeing bus to cross the Huangpu River in a tunnel with constantly changing colors, as if traveling through time and space. The inner walls of the tunnel are constantly changing in various strange colors, and the sound effects are combined with the changing landscape in front of us, creating a sense of immersive shock. The tunnel includes themes such as "Time Tunnel Zone", "Shuttle Zone", and "Magma Spray Zone", with dazzling light and shadow effects that make people feel as if they have entered another world. In addition, the tunnel has added leisure and amusement projects such as "Sound Fantasy World" and "Deep Sea Rare Exhibition", which are suitable for tourists to bring their children and have fun together on holidays. Surrounding the tunnel are the Global Curiosity Museum and the 3D Magical Fun Museum, which are suitable for tourists to take photos and scenery. Later, tourists can also experience snacks and shopping in the Nanjing Road Walkway. Tourists with time can also visit the surrounding Oriental Pearl TV Tower, the Bund and other landmark attractions in Shanghai.

Jiudu River is a mountain town with mountains, water, and the Great Wall. It has rich natural and cultural landscapes. There are attractions in the scenic area such as Zhongtianyu, Baishu Lake, Dafoshan, Baiyunchuan Ancient Road Observation Site, and Jinshengyao General's Tomb.

Florence Town - Shanghai Famous Outlets "opened in January 2015. As the second outlet project of Italian retail giant RDM Asia in China, it settled in Pudong, Shanghai and became a popular destination for fashion enthusiasts in Shanghai and the surrounding Jiangsu and Zhejiang regions. Shanghai Florence Town has introduced over a hundred globally renowned brands, including Burberry, Armani，Bottega Veneta， Etro，Salvatore Ferragamo， Moncler，Bally，Ermenegildo Zegna，Montblanc，Max Mara，Lane Crawford，Coach，I.T，Moschino, Michael Kors, Tory Burch, Swarovski And UGG, among which 7 are for ALL MANKING, ACNE STUDIOS, CELINE, ETRO, FENDI, LA PERLA, LANE CRAWFORD, MARC JACOBS, MONNALISA, VICTORIA'S SECRET and other Outlet stores are newly opened in the East China region.

The Shanghai World Expo Cultural Park is located in the core area of Pudong Binjiang, adjacent to the Huangpu River in the northwest, east to Lupu Bridge and Changqing North Road, and south to Tongyao Road and Longbin Road, with a land area of about 2 square kilometers. The Shanghai World Expo Cultural Park is positioned as a world-class city center park that promotes ecological and natural sustainability, cultural integration and innovation, and allows citizens to gather and share together. In combination with the completed Houtan Wetland Park, the Shanghai World Expo Cultural Park will renovate the four reserved venues for the World Expo, and build new facilities such as the Expo Garden, the Shenyuan Garden, the Twin Mountains, the Shanghai Greenhouse, the World Flower Garden, the Grand Opera House, and the International Equestrian Center to create a unique riverside park green space in the future Shanghai center urban area. The Shanghai World Expo Cultural Park features historical water systems, industrial memories, and World Expo textures as representative elements, overlaid with forests, wetlands, and lawns, forming a multi-layered landscape structure system of "water, surface, culture, and nature"; The landscape extension of the Expo texture has achieved the continuation of the Expo spirit, presenting a transformation from the Expo site to the ecological experience area in the city center; Stacking mountains and waters, striving for nature, integrating elements of Jiangnan culture, and showcasing the characteristics of Jiangnan gardens, Shenyuan interprets the integration and symbiosis of forests and gardens in the form of a garden within a garden; The colorful forest composed of preserved and newly planted trees depicts a continuous picture from urban forests to natural forests. The park's northern area, which is currently open, covers an area of 85 hectares and is mainly composed of scenic areas and attractions such as Dance Square, Quiet Forest, Time Imprint Avenue, Expo Garden, Music Forest, Central Lake, Houtan Riverside, and Shenyuan.

poiName: Storm is Coming-Captain Jack's Stunt Stunt Adventure
summary: At the Van Diego Theatre, the audience will be deeply attracted by Captain Jack and his group of cunning pirates, immersed in the adventure of treasure searching. Captain Jack not only met a beautiful red haired star, but also encountered a Royal Navy admiral and his subordinates. A thrilling and thrilling fight was staged in the midst of fierce winds and heavy rain. This pirate style humorous performance premiered at Shanghai Disneyland and ended with a stunning finale of repelling the admiral amidst a realistic whirlwind.

The cave in Shihua Cave Scenic Area maintains a constant temperature of 13 degrees Celsius throughout the year, making it a great place for weekend summer vacations in the suburbs of Beijing. The stone flowers in the Stone Flower Cave are diverse in form and numerous in quantity. The open part of the cave is equipped with colorful lights, which together with various stalagmites and stone flowers form a fantastic and magnificent landscape. It is very suitable for viewing and photography. Transportation Strategy: The existing Fangshan No. 43 bus in Shihua Cave can reach the entrance of the scenic area. If you drive here, you can only go to the Nancheying Village parking lot about 1 kilometer outside Shihua Cave. There is no parking lot further forward, and sometimes local villagers will close the road. It takes about 15 minutes to walk here to reach the entrance of the scenic area. You can also take a shuttle bus operated by local villagers, which costs about 20 yuan per person (not far away, unless there are elderly, children or other physically weak people who do not need to take it). The sightseeing route refers to the seven levels inside Shihua Cave. Currently, the area open to tourists is one to four levels, with 16 halls and more than 100 landscapes. After entering, you can walk to the first level for sightseeing. The walking route is about 2.5 kilometers long and usually takes 2 hours to enjoy. Tourists who like photography need more time. In addition, the scenic area has tour guide services that can help explain the image and legendary stories of stone flowers. The tour guide price is 100 yuan per group of 5 or less, and 10 yuan per additional person for groups of 5 or more. The first floor: Viewing the Stone Flower Cave starts from the first floor, which features a landscape consisting of more than ten stalagmite groups such as "Lion Welcoming Guests", "Carp Creek Water", and "Penglai Fairy Island". One of the more special ones is the ten Buddha statues located near the entrance of the cave, with a total of ten Buddha and Bodhisattva statues. In addition, at the "Yaochi Stone Lotus" deep inside the cave, there is a rare lunar milk stone landscape in China, forming milky white lotus like flowers that are very beautiful and can be appreciated as a highlight. Second floor: The tour route at the second floor is 1352 meters, which is the longer and larger scale tour route within the fourth floor. It is relatively open and the scenery is also magnificent. There are landscapes such as "Bamboo Fence Cottage", "Stone Waterfall", "Dragon Palace Curtain", and "Sky Soaring Mandarin Duck Pillars", which are quite atmospheric and fantastic, making photography inside the cave very suitable. Third and fourth floors: The scale of the third and fourth floors is relatively small, and the stone flowers here are quite unique. Unlike the mature and larger landscapes on the first and second floors, most of them are small and growing stalagmites and stone flowers. Here, there are landscapes such as the "Dragon Maiden Embroidery Platform", "Fairy Mirror", and "Flower Bamboo Shoots Tower" that can be enjoyed one by one. After viewing, exit the cave from the step located on the right side of the fourth floor. About 1 kilometer outside the Shihua Cave scenic area, there are several rural homestays and small hotels in Nancheying Village. After visiting, you can come here to eat rural dishes or stay, and the standard room is usually around 100 yuan.

Ji Xiaolan's former residence is a two in quadrangle, which is a municipal cultural relics protection unit in Beijing. Its layout is north facing south, and the street gate is a auspicious and wishful gate tower on the gable roof, located in the southeast corner of the whole residence. There is a vine in the front yard, which is said to have been planted by Ji Xiaolan himself in the past. The front of the backyard is the 'Yuewei Thatched Cottage'. The plan of the "Grass Hall" is in an inverted "convex" shape, with a screen set up in the center of the north side of the hall, and a horizontal plaque hanging on top of it reading "Yuewei Grass Hall Site", written by the famous calligrapher Mr. Qigong. Yuewei Caotang Notes "is a work by Ji Xiaolan that seeks out old news, and is on par with Pu Songling's" Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio ". This is also the study where he wrote at his desk. The eye-catching feature inside the "Yuewei Caotang" is the long dry tobacco bag pot displayed in the display cabinet. As is well known, Ji Xiaolan has become addicted to smoking and has a huge craving for it. His dry tobacco bag pot is specially customized and is nicknamed "Ji Da Tobacco Bag".

The History Museum of Shanghai Jiao Tong University is located on the second and third floors of the old library, with a total exhibition area of approximately 600 square meters. The museum has three exhibition halls. The time span of the first exhibition hall ranges from the establishment of Nanyang Public School to the liberation of Shanghai, divided into three periods: the establishment of Nanyang Public School, the construction of a modern engineering university, and the integration of science, engineering, and management at Jiaotong University; The time span of the second exhibition hall is from the liberation of Shanghai to the present day. These two exhibition halls display nearly 700 precious cultural relics, documents, photographic materials, etc., reflecting the school's development process and fruitful achievements in academic research over the past century. The third exhibition hall is the performance exhibition of academicians from the "two academies" of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The photo data, literature and material objects of nearly 200 academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the CAE Member who studied or taught at Jiaotong University were displayed. Their biographies and main achievements were introduced in order of their birth dates. The third exhibition room also has the "Professor Lin Tongyan Exhibition Room", which displays more than 300 photos, works, papers, and image materials of Mr. Lin Tongyan, a famous alumnus of Jiaotong University, internationally renowned structural engineer, educator, and Chinese American scholar.

The Shanghai Bund Art Museum is adjacent to the Bund and Garden Bridge of Shanghai. The building is the Asian Cultural Society Building built in 1932. The "Shanghai Museum" was once located here. Art museums often have different exhibitions where you can see works by Chinese and foreign artists, including abstract paintings, sculptures, and small scene arrangements. The Bund Art Museum in Shanghai combines architectural elements of Chinese and Western cultures, with an elegant and exquisite decorative art style. It has become a high-end photography destination in Shanghai and is deeply loved by literary and artistic youth. The exhibitions in the art museum are mainly regular thematic exhibitions, with themes and exhibits changing every few months. You can follow the guide to learn more about the content of the exhibits. In addition, there are also some exhibits on the walls inside the caf é, while the outdoor part is a rooftop where you can enjoy the surrounding city scenery or sit here for a cup of coffee and take a nap.
Here, people can enjoy tea while watching Kunqu opera performances, which is very interesting.

Dongyuan is located on Baita East Road in the northeast of the ancient city. The park is narrow and elongated in a strip from north to south, with Loumen to the north, and adjacent to Youyuan Garden across the river to the south. It borders the Outer City River to the east and Cang Street to the west. Covering an area of 270 acres, including 90 acres of water surface and a building area of 1400 square meters. Dongyuan, originally named Chengdong Park, was the first new comprehensive park built in Suzhou after its liberation. The East Garden lawn is lush green, surrounded by cedars like forests. The buildings on the east side, such as the Hanbi Tower and the Spring and Autumn Cool Pavilion, are situated by the water and waves, exuding a simple and elegant charm; Surrounding corridors, rockeries, ponds, and flowers and trees form a peaceful courtyard; The towering pink wall on the west side, known as the "Mingxuan" in Chinese classical gardens exported to the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, has become a bond of friendship between the Chinese and American people.
opening_hours: Opens at Off season 07:30-22:00,Opens at Peak season 07:30-22:30

summary: The "Happy Captain" Huangpu River Cruise Series is a high-end cruise ship on the Huangpu River, which has become a beautiful scenery on the river with its unique design and exquisite decoration. Departing by boat, the bustling scenery along the river is fully visible. In addition, high-quality catering services are also provided here, where you can enjoy delicious food while admiring the beautiful scenery. The "Captain" series of cruise ships is full of creativity in both appearance and interior, with antique pirate ship shapes and oval shaped spacecraft like "Space Fortresses". Tour route: Shiliupu Three Zone Wharf ->Pudong Binjiang Avenue ->Lujiazui Scenic Area (Shanghai center, World Financial Center, Jinmao Tower, Oriental Pearl TV Tower, etc.) ->North Bund ->Garden Bridge of Shanghai ->Bund Scenic Area ->World Architecture Cluster ->New Shiliupu Scenic Area ->Shiliupu Three Zone Wharf. The Captain Cruise, a popular online celebrity in the film "Beyond the Magic City", has appeared multiple times in various movies, TV dramas, and promotional videos due to its beautiful appearance. The antique pirate ship is also a popular check-in spot for internet celebrities and is a magnificent scenic spot on the Huangpu River. Unlocking the beautiful scenery of the Bund, you can enjoy a full view of the Bund scenery, enjoy both sightseeing and dining, and enjoy a 2-hour long tour time. The diverse architectural complexes of various countries in Puxi showcase simplicity and elegance, while the modern Lujiazui represents Shanghai's trend of embracing all rivers and leading the way. Featured self-service dining, popular cruise ships in the magic city showcase authentic culinary culture, bringing traditional local dishes and exquisite Cantonese cuisine to tourists. The buffet is dazzling with a variety of dishes, suitable for all ages, gradually becoming a new landmark for weeding on the Pujiang River.

The 351 meter space capsule is located in the high sphere of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower. Take the "time machine" to connect with the space capsule, and take a bird's eye view of the whole city from the highest point of the tower.

Some people say that Sinan Road is the "harem" of Huaihai Road, hidden behind the bustling streets, like a solitary lotus in the world, quiet and peaceful, narrating the history of old Shanghai and the stories of the past at a slow pace. Sinan Road is named after the French composer Jules in the early 20th century Masnan is a famous French road, a clean and romantic one-way street, and two rows of French wutong trees covering the sky, connecting Huaihai Road and Xujiahui. The garden villas on both sides of the road have different styles, English, French, and Spanish, reflecting their pre liberation identity. It is said that there are more than twenty garden style western-style houses on Sinan Road, which gather almost all the residential styles of old Shanghai - it is a living book of urban history. Walking here, it feels like returning to that hurried and chaotic era that still remains prosperous. Nowadays, Sinan Road not only preserves various former residences, but also the Sinan Mansion, which has been transformed into a hotel. Along the street, there are also some specialty small shops. You can have a cup of coffee at a caf é or go to the "Aniang Noodle Shop" to enjoy a bowl of authentic yellow croaker Aniang noodles for 20 yuan, and then visit antique shops to savor the unique history and romance of Shanghai in nostalgia.

Dushu Lake is located in Suzhou Industrial Park, with an area of approximately 11.52 square kilometers. Dushu Lake has a pleasant scenery and clear water, making it one of the larger freshwater lakes in Suzhou area. The Dushu Lake Tunnel runs through the bottom of the lake, connecting the east and west of the lake.

Zhoupu Flower Sea is located in Zhoupu Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, with Shenjiang Road to the west and Yaodun Road to the south. This is relatively close to Shanghai Disneyland, so we can arrange to play together. The park features ecological flowers as the main landscape, with flowers blooming all year round. When these different colors and varieties of flowers bloom simultaneously, a stunning rainbow flower field is formed, which looks very pleasing to the eye and is a great place for weekend outings with family. The area of flowers and seedlings planted in the park exceeds 100000 square meters, with over a hundred varieties planted. The characteristics of flower cultivation are mainly reflected in the continuous adjustment of flower varieties and shapes every season, and the use of large stripes and color blocks to achieve a huge visual impact, allowing tourists to enjoy different flower sea landscapes in different seasons. Being immersed in it feels like lingering in a sea of flowers, full of shock and beauty. In spring, tulips and lavender are in full bloom, and every summer, 300 acres of horsewhip grass come in, comparable to Provence. In addition to admiring flowers, there are also areas such as a children's playground and animal area within the park for play. On the other side, there is a small river where you can rent a pedal boat. In addition, there is a barbecue area by the river, which is very suitable for tourists who love outdoor barbecue. The barbecue area is made into pavilions, with reserved square holes in the middle of the tables for grilling ovens. Garbage bins are placed next to each pavilion, and there is also a pool and tap water nearby for barbecuing personnel to clean, which is very thoughtful.

Red Bean Villa is located in Furong Village, Guli Town, Changshu City, Jiangsu Province. Originally named Biwu Villa, it was built in the late Song and early Yuan dynasties and has a long history. It became famous for the poetry and prose of Qian Qianyi and the famous Jiangnan socialite Liu Rushi, as well as their romantic relationship that caused a sensation. With the changes of history, the villa has gone through vicissitudes, and all the old buildings have been destroyed, except for the tenacious survival of the red bean tree. In order to recreate the legendary romantic story of Qianliu, the Guli Town Government and Suqi Group rebuilt Hongdou Mountain Villa on the site of the original villa, and implanted numerous amusement projects, creating multiple romantic themed amusement areas, allowing tourists to love and enjoy here, and enjoy the romantic heartbeat time. Red Bean Villa is a one-stop tourist attraction that integrates cultural tourism, parent-child vacation, leisure vacation, and team building and expansion.

Zootopia Park, themed "Zootopia", is the eighth largest theme park of Shanghai Disneyland and will officially open on December 20, 2023. After the "Zootopia" park is located in Shanghai, it will become another unique highlight of Shanghai Disneyland. New attractions, entertainment performances, merchandise, and dining options will provide visitors to Shanghai Disneyland with more exciting experiences. The new theme park will lead visitors into the lifelike "Zootopia" metropolis of mammals, where "every animal has infinite possibilities". Tourists will also follow the protagonists of this Oscar winning film - Judy and Nick - on a crazy and exciting adventure journey.

The Huangpu River is known as the "mother river of Shanghai", and Pudong and Puxi use it as a boundary to form important landmarks such as the world-renowned Bund and the Lujiazui Financial Center. Watching the magnificent night view of Pujiang River is an indispensable stop for tourists coming to Shanghai. You can also take a cruise on the river and enjoy the scenery on both sides. The Huangpu River, with a total length of about 113 kilometers and a river width of 300 to 700 meters, flows through all districts of Shanghai. It is the symbol and symbol of Shanghai and gathers the essence of Shanghai's urban landscape. The Bund and Binjiang Avenue along the Huangpu River are both excellent tourist attractions, with fewer tourists visiting Binjiang Avenue compared to the Bund. Strolling along the riverbank, the Bund International Architecture Exhibition Complex on the west bank of the Pujiang River, filled with rich exotic colors, stands in sharp contrast to the modern skyscrapers towering into the clouds on the east bank. You can glimpse Shanghai's century long development history from it. The night view of Pujiang is also worth watching. At night, both sides of the Huangpu River are ablaze with lights. You can start from the the 16 Pu on the second Shandong Road in Huangpu District, and take the Pujiang River cruise ship to drive on the river, with a panoramic view of the beautiful scenery along the way. The Yangpu Bridge and Nanpu Bridge across the Huangpu River, the classic Garden Bridge of Shanghai like a jade belt, the Pudong Binjiang Avenue with beautiful environment, and the Shanghai International Conference Center with unique shape have formed a beautiful scenery line under the creation of gorgeous lights, which makes people dizzy. The ship offers Chinese, Western, buffet and other services, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Pujiang while enjoying delicious food. The sailing time of the cruise ship is from 11:00 to 21:30 every day, once every hour from 11:00 to 13:00, and once every half hour from 13:00 to 21:30. The single voyage time is about 60 minutes. If you don't want to spend too much time taking a cruise, taking a ferry between Pudong and Puxi is also an affordable choice to experience the Pujiang style, which is more nostalgic. The ferry runs back and forth from Jinling East Road Ferry Terminal next to the Bund to Dongchang Road Ferry Terminal in Pudong from 7:00-22:00, with a one-way journey of about ten minutes and a departure every 15 minutes. There are also ferries that run between Fuxing East Road Ferry and Dongchang Road Ferry. Fuxing East Road Ferry operates from 7:00-19:00, while Dongchang Road Ferry operates from 7:00-18:45, with one ferry every half hour.

Located in the urban area of Qingpu, Qushui Garden is one of the five classical gardens in Shanghai (Yu Garden, Guyi Garden, Zuibai Pool, Qiuxia Garden, Qushui Garden). The Qushui Garden is small and beautiful, but it has rockeries, stone bridges, pavilions and ponds. The ancient trees in the park are dense, the flowers and plants are lush, and the mountain walls are covered with ivy. Strolling through the center of the park, one can often see elderly people singing and playing chess here; The eastern part of the garden is adjacent to the Huancheng River, where you can sit on the long corridor by the river and enjoy the riverside scenery, feeling infinitely comfortable. Qushui Garden was first built in the reign of Emperor Qianlong of the Qing Dynasty. It was adjacent to the Chenghuang Temple in Qingpu. At first, it was an affiliated garden of the Chenghuang Temple, but it was rebuilt on the original site due to repeated wars. Entering from the south gate on AD Road, to the left is the West Garden, which is mainly composed of buildings. The buildings here are magnificent, including the Deyue Pavilion, Youjue Hall, and Sunset Red Half Tower. Among them, the sunset red half building is built on a rockery made of the Taihu Lake Lake rocks, and the downstairs is a winding cave, which is very interesting. Zhongyuan is known for its mountains and waters, and is the central main part of Qushui Garden. There are attractions such as Lotus Pond, Ninghe Hall, and Flower God Hall here. Beside the Lotus Pond, there are pavilions and pavilions such as Xiaohao Liang, Yingxi Pavilion, and Jue Dui Feilai where you can enjoy the scenery of the pond. In summer, you can also admire the lotus flowers. There is a large rockery called "Xiao Feilai" in the north of the Lotus Pond. This is the center of the garden, and standing at the top of the mountain, the "Nine Peaks Viewing Pavilion" can overlook the surrounding landscape from a high altitude. Dongyuan is adjacent to the Huancheng River to the east, and its characteristic is full of wildness. Following the stone path filled with potted plants and accompanied by greenery, one can reach pavilions such as Tinglu Pavilion, Mudan Pavilion, Jiyun Pavilion, and Green Wave Corridor. The Green Wave Corridor is a long corridor built along the river, winding for more than 100 meters. Sitting here, listening to music and blowing the river breeze, is very comfortable. Standing on the other side of the river and looking towards the Green Wave Corridor, the river surface reflects green trees, blue sky, and a long corridor, which is also quite beautiful. The Shigu Wenwen Art Garden is located in the northwest of Qushui Garden and is a place where Shigu Wenwen and related calligraphy works are exhibited. Shigu script is one of the earliest surviving stone inscriptions in China, with characters carved on ten drum shaped granite blocks, each with a poem. There are ten stone drum imitations arranged in the flower garden of Shuyi Garden, and the bases are all attached with modern written poetry and prose for the convenience of tourists to read. If you are interested, you can go and take a look.
Hexin Garden was a private garden during the Qing Dynasty, with a serene environment and buildings that highlight the beauty of symmetry, showcasing the ingenuity of ancient architecture.

This scenic spot is located in Shanghai, which originated in the Sui Dynasty, was built in the Song Dynasty, and flourished in the Ming and Qing Dynasties. During the peak of Panlong, there were ten bridges called "Nine Dragons and One Phoenix". In the renovation of the ancient town, in addition to repairing the two ancient bridges of Xianghua Bridge and Fenglai Bridge, Panlong Tiandi also built eight new bridges based on the research of the ancient bridge form in Jiangnan, connecting the water market.

The Shanghai Jiushi Art Museum is located at 27 The Bund, within the famous Bund World Architecture Complex. The building where it is located was originally the Jardine Matheson Building and is now a historically protected building in Shanghai. This museum is the core venue of the Jiushi Art Museum community, based on the foundation of Shanghai style culture and art, and hosts comprehensive and international art exhibitions. Together with the Jushi Art Space and Jushi Art Salon at No. 18 on the Bund, it forms the Jushi Art Museum community.

The Shami Building, formerly known as the Shami Bank Building, was built in 1918 and is a typical classical European style building in the New Renaissance style. The sculptures and curves on the exterior wall both exhibit Baroque style. Although many years have passed, its appearance is still magnificent and well preserved. It has now become a popular filming location for Instagram and Xiaohongshu. However, the Shamei Building is mostly closed due to construction closures, making it difficult to enter and allowing for external visits.

The 88th floor observation hall of Jinmao Tower is one of the famous high-altitude observation decks in Shanghai, located in the Lujiazui Financial and Trade Zone. Taking the elevator that runs 9 meters per second from the ground floor lobby of Jinmao Tower, it only takes 45 seconds to reach the 340 meter high 88th floor observation hall. The fully transparent glass curtain wall allows you to overlook the city scenery from 360 degrees. It is recommended to pay attention to the weather in advance and choose a sunny day to go. In the evening, you can see the charming sunset, and the Lujiazui and Bund under the night sky are particularly beautiful under the rendering of lights. There is a coin operated telescope (1 yuan per session) available for use in the sightseeing hall.

Yiyuan was a private garden built by the wealthy gentleman Gu Wenbin during the reign of Emperor Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty. It was built later in Suzhou gardens and was able to draw on the strengths of various gardens, forming its collection style characteristics. Due to its compact layout and appropriate techniques, it has high ornamental value. The whole park covers an area of about nine acres and is narrow from east to west. The garden scenery is divided into two parts according to local conditions, east and west. The middle is separated by a complex corridor, with walls and windows that connect the east and west scenery, increasing the depth of field. The east of the corridor is mainly composed of courtyard buildings, surrounded by curved corridors and decorated with flowers, trees, and stone peaks. From the empty windows of the curved corridors, it becomes a richly meaningful traditional Chinese painting. Langxi is the main scenic area of the entire garden, with the pond water in the center and surrounded by rockeries, flowers, and buildings. The water surface gathers in the middle, and the east and west ends are narrow and elongated, with curved bridges and water gates built to show the endless flow of the pond water. The rockery in Chibei is stacked with beautiful lake stones, and although the mountain is not high, it has peaks, caves, and valleys, which complement the trees and pavilions. The main hall is the Lotus Fragrance Pavilion, which is a four sided hall in the style of a mandarin duck hall. To the north is the pond water, to the south is the courtyard, to the right is a small bridge flowing water, and to the left and right are pavilions, pavilions, caves, and ravines, which leads to various scenic spots in the west. There are also dozens of calligraphy and painting stones by famous figures from various dynasties in the eastern and western parts, which can be observed and appreciated, known as the "Yiyuan Fa Tie".
opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

summary: On the west side of the Twin Towers Park is the Wu Zuoren Art Museum, which covers an area of 1430 square meters. Mr. Wu Zuoren's ancestral home is Anhui, and his father settled in Suzhou during the late Qing Dynasty. He was born and lived in Suzhou for more than 20 years, and has a deep affection for Suzhou. In 1989, Mr. expressed his willingness to donate his art works to Suzhou for a long-term exhibition without compensation. The Suzhou Municipal Party Committee and Government have decided to build the Wu Zuoren Art Museum to celebrate Mr. Wu Zuoren's contributions to the Chinese art industry and express gratitude for his love for Suzhou. The art museum was completed at the end of 1993. The art museum has the first batch of 90 works donated by Mr. Wu Zuoren to his hometown Suzhou, 10 works by Mrs. Xiao Shufang, Wu Zuoren's wife, and 10 works by his grandfather and siblings, totaling 110 works. Among them, there are 18 oil paintings, 17 Chinese paintings, 15 calligraphy paintings, and 40 watercolor sketches, reflecting the style of the Wu family's artistic family.

Located in Nianbang Village, Yangchenghu Town, Xiangcheng District, Suzhou City, it is adjacent to Yangcheng Lake to the east and has the Guanjing River flowing through the temple. The temple is surrounded by water on three sides, with a long corridor and water pavilions in the temple. The scenery is beautiful, with rivers and alleys crisscrossing, willows lining the banks, and green trees providing shade. It is the only temple in the Yangtze River Delta region that combines the architectural style of the Northern School. The temple was first built in the mid Tang Dynasty and was originally named Jishan An. At that time, incense was popular and pilgrims were scattered throughout the Jiangnan region. During the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty, this temple was renamed "Wanglu An", meaning that there were royal officials and nobles who stayed here. Therefore, it is still known as Guanjing Bridge and Guanjing River to this day. Later, it was said that Emperor Yongzheng of the Qing Dynasty went to Jiangnan to search for his father and stayed overnight here, so it was renamed "Huangluo An". Huangluo Temple is a famous Buddhist destination in Suzhou and also the location of the Suzhou Buddhist Association. It has a long and ancient cultural history and is an ideal place for religious activities and tourism and leisure.

Peninsula Countryside, located in the Yangcheng Lake Peninsula National Tourist Resort in Suzhou, is a rural slow life experience spot within easy reach of urbanites. More than 50 types of vegetable plants are planted in a 60 acre field, integrating various plant landscapes such as vegetable gardens, vegetable terraces, camphor forests, and leisure grasslands. Through careful combination and plant landscape design, ordinary vegetables on the ground have become edible "landscapes" with greater aesthetic and ecological value. Here, not only can you experience the fun of farming picking, plant printing, and DIY fruit and vegetable bouquets while holding a basket, but you can also claim the "Peninsula Fields" and realize the rural dreams of urbanites; Or step into the cute pet paradise and have intimate contact with small animals; You can also stroll in the fields, with golden rapeseed flowers in spring, plump wheat waves in summer, and light mist sharing weeds in autumn, feeling the beautiful natural scenery. Peninsula Countryside is a fun filled vegetable and plant exploration paradise where you can explore healthy lifestyles. It is a pastoral farmer's slow life experience, allowing the soul to return to nature and enjoy the "desired life" within reach.

The Shanghai Insect Museum is affiliated to the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai Institute of Life Sciences. Its predecessor was the Insect Department of the Museum Heude in Shanghai, established by French priest P. Heude in 1868. It was completed in Xujiahui in 1883, but due to the large number of specimens that could not be stored, a new Museum Heude was built on Luban Road (now Chongqing South Road) in 1930. At that time, the storage of animal and plant specimens produced in China was known as the "British Museum of Asia". The Shanghai Insect Museum has hosted dozens of projects funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, conducting systematic classification research on five major categories of insects including protozoa, locusts, termites, scale insects, flies, and flies. It has put forward many unique insights into insect classification systems and participated in various scientific expeditions nationwide, winning awards. There is a Helena butterfly in the museum, known as one of the most beautiful butterflies in the world. This butterfly is produced in countries such as Brazil and Peru. It is rare in quantity and extremely precious. Not only does it have a graceful body and spread its wings like a peacock's screen, but its wings also glow and change color, sometimes deep blue, sometimes deep blue, sometimes light blue. The white veins on its wings are like jewelry embedded in them, shining brightly and very charming. Each specimen is worth 360000 yuan, but there are only three in China.

Dishui Lake is an artificial circular lake located in the center of Lingang New City, Pudong New Area. The lake water originates from the Huangpu River and is directly connected to the East China Sea through a sluice gate. Dishui Lake is home to three islands with different locations - North Island, West Island, and South Island. The North Island will be developed into an "entertainment island", the West Island will be positioned as a business and tourism accommodation area, and the South Island will be a water leisure and entertainment island with facilities such as yacht clubs and yacht harbors. You can rent a bicycle or take a speedboat to tour Dishui Lake at the entrance of the scenic spot. And there is an "O" shaped building in the center of Dishui Lake, which is the origin of the name Dishui Lake. It looks like a drop of water, and it is said that this building will rotate on its own. It looks different at different times, which is very interesting.

The Disney Pixar Toy Story Park was opened in April 2018 and is the seventh park of Shanghai Disney Resort. The park includes three new amusement facilities - Spring Dog Spinning, Hugging Dragon Racing, and Woody Cowboy Carnival, a unique themed area for meeting Disney friends - Friendship Station, as well as El Toy Store and Toy Box Banquet Square, which offer immersive shopping and dining experiences.

Entering Shanghai Disneyland, the first step is onto Mickey Avenue, which is the first welcoming avenue in the world of Disney parks with Mickey and his companions as the theme. Minnie, Donald Duck, Daisy, Goofy, Pluto and other companions will gather here. This colorful street is divided into four blocks, where you can warmly embrace and take photos with your favorite Disney friends. The time is around 10am to 6pm, depending on the weather conditions of the day, and additional fees will be charged. Jumping from a height of 55 meters, most tourists cannot be as carefree as a coach. The Pudong Lujiazui Sky Pedestrian Corridor is approximately 543 meters long, starting from the second floor of Guojin Center in the west, crossing Yincheng Middle Road, crossing Dongtai Road along the north side of Jinmao Tower to the east, following the Global Financial Center to reach the Lujiazui Ring Road, and connecting with the Lujiazui Circular Sky Corridor. From the corridor, one can overlook the beautiful scenery of the entire Lujiazui Financial City. Citizens can take a leisurely stroll in the air through the aerial corridor, conveniently shuttling between various shopping malls and subway stations.

Fuxing Park is one of the earliest parks established in Shanghai. More than 80 years ago, this was originally a fertile farmland inhabited by hardworking and poor farmers. Fuxing Park is a French style park with a regular garden layout and a natural style that gradually changes towards the southwest. In recent years, a large number of flowers and trees have been added, with a total of 140 species and over 10000 shrubs, including towering plane trees, as well as precious trees such as seven chestnut trees, oak trees, and maple trees. The Fuxing Park is also very lively at night. The French atmosphere matches the colorful night life. The sound of high-heeled shoes will suddenly come from a peaceful corner, or under the French wutong tree late at night, there are young people waiting for a taxi at the roadside. I always sleep very late here at night in Shanghai.

Jing'an Sculpture Park is the only specialized sculpture park in the center of Shanghai, which serves as an urban public product with ecological, artistic, and cultural functions. Originally just a small green area, this place has now become a park. Although the space is not large and there are not many sculptures, the environment is pleasant, and the selected sculptures are often replaced. This is also a small place where nearby residents often come to exercise.

Yu Garden Starry Dream Hall is a collection of fashionable exhibition hall design. The whole hall is divided into the first floor of the basement. There are 16 main attractions on the second floor of the basement. There are more than 20 scenic spots in total size, with a total construction area of 800 square meters. B1 is a holy place for taking photos and punching cards with the main theme of freshness and elegance, and every angle of view can enter the mirror with light and color. The B2 floor is the highlight of the entire Starry Sky Pavilion, revised by the experienced designer Lemon and his team throughout the entire process. The entire venue resembles a Tai Chi diagram, divided in half by a curved wall in the middle, with the cathode being the gloomy and gentle Jellyfish Pavilion and the anode being the light of the forest. The B2 building has a total area of 455 square meters, and the entire scene is created by mirrors, with six sides of reality and virtuality complementing each other, resembling the boundless feeling of Tai Chi. Experience the vastness of the starry sky in 360 degrees, and experience the changes of light and shadow in infinite space. Double layered linkage, 16 new themed works, over 30 photo points, allowing you to experience the beauty of stillness and movement.

Dishui Lake Children's Park is located in Lingang New City, at the southeast end of Shanghai, on the east coast of the East China Sea at the intersection of Hangzhou Bay and the Yangtze River estuary. The total area is 5.56 million square meters. It is a sports park that integrates sports, leisure, and landscape recreation, dedicated to creating outdoor play spaces and meeting the needs of children of different ages as activity venues!

Here, you can taste the taste of your hometown and enjoy the vitality of Shenzhen. Starting from here, let's explore Shenzhen's night economy together.

Hua · Art Museum is a design themed art museum that was officially established on September 1, 2008 in Shenzhen Overseas Chinese Town. It is adjacent to He Xiangning Art Museum and three major cultural tourism attractions, "Splendid China", "Chinese Folk Culture Village", and "Window of the World". Hua Art Museum focuses on and promotes design as its main development direction, including graphic design, spatial design, product design, clothing design, digital, imaging, animation and other design fields. At the same time, it will also pay attention to contemporary art and various diverse art activities, actively exploring and reflecting the relationship between design and contemporary art. Committed to introducing cutting-edge design concepts from both domestic and international sources, discovering and showcasing innovative design trends, discovering and cultivating art and design talents, providing the public with a rich and diverse window of design and artistic culture, and promoting the development of China's design field through planning and hosting special exhibitions, holding public lectures, organizing academic forums and domestic and international exchange and learning activities, and conducting design education. The main building of the Hua Art Museum was renovated from an old warehouse, and a hexagonal steel structure overlapped with a glass curtain wall to create an independent skin outside the old building, preserving the history and significance of the past architecture under the cutting-edge architectural appearance. The Hua Art Museum has a building area of over 3000 square meters, including a controllable temperature exhibition hall area of 2000 square meters, and also has a controllable temperature painting library, providing a professional environment and conditions for art display and collection.

poiName: Former Residence of Lu Xun in Shanghai

summary: In the southeast corner of Lu Xun Park in Hongkou District, there is the Shanghai Lu Xun Memorial Hall. The building is a simple and elegant two-story courtyard style building, giving the impression of blue tiles and white walls, simple and peaceful. Here, you can visit Mr. Lu Xun's manuscripts, as well as precious items such as clothing, daily necessities, letters, photos, and books from his lifetime, allowing people to understand him from various details. The Shanghai Lu Xun Memorial Hall was opened in 1951 and was the first character themed memorial hall after the founding of the People's Republic of China. Arriving here, you can see the name of the museum on the mountain wall. In front of the courtyard of the museum, there is an inner garden called "Hundred Grass Garden". The garden is lush with branches and leaves, and the corners are covered with Polygonum multiflorum. There is a water well in the garden, as well as a boat with a black canopy. The stone well railing and boat with a black canopy are all from Shaoxing, the hometown of Lu Xun. On the first floor of the memorial hall, there is a cultural celebrity library called "Chaohua Library" and a special exhibition hall called "Benliu Art Garden", and there are often various forms of special cultural exhibitions. The second floor is the exhibition hall of Lu Xun's life, which is the main exhibition area. The cultural relics in the collection are mainly collected over the years, as well as donated by Lu Xun's wife Xu Guangping and his friends during his lifetime. You can see Mr. Lu Xun's manuscripts, clothing, daily necessities, and numerous precious photos. Through detailed graphic and textual introductions, you can learn about Mr. Lu Xun's life stories. The plaster facial mask of Mr. Lu Xun collected in the museum is worth seeing. It was made by a Japanese friend from Mr. Lu Xun's remains on the day of his death. The whiskers and eyebrows stuck on it are the only original objects left by Mr. Lu Xun. In addition, you can also see the scene of Neishan Bookstore in the museum, as well as various versions of books by Mr. Lu Xun's works. In addition, the tomb of Lu Xun is located in the nearby Lu Xun Park and can be visited for worship. The memorial hall is adjacent to Tian'ai Road and Shanyin Road, which are two tree lined alleys filled with romantic and artistic atmosphere. You can also go for a walk. And the former residence of Lu Xun on Shanyin Road is the former residence of Mr. Lu Xun in Shanghai, which can be visited on the way. It takes about 7 minutes to walk there.

Sweet Love Road is a romantic love road in Shanghai, with wooden frames every two meters on both sides of the road engraved with 28 famous Chinese and foreign love poems, forming a "love wall". There is also a love mailbox at the intersection, where many young people come specifically to deliver postcards stamped with love stamps, mailing romance and true feelings to them. Sweet Love Road is a small road in Hongkou District, starting from Sichuan North Road in the south and adjacent to Lu Xun Park in the north, only about 600 meters long. Because of the romantic love story of the Cowherd and Weaver Girl that has been passed down here, and the older generation believes that couples who hold hands and walk this path can harvest eternal and happy love. At the intersection of Sweet Love Road, there stands a pair of bronze statues of a couple, and two rows of tall water spruce trees stand neatly on the roadside, providing shade in summer. There are charming houses along the roadside, and there are also many unique small shops and coffee shops along the street. Take your significant other and walk around here, experiencing the rare tranquility of this city together and reliving the feeling of first love. The love mailbox here is very popular, with a love postmark printed with the English word "LOVE". Sending postcards or letters to "him" or "her" from this mailbox is a simple and romantic way of blessing.

Lu Xun Park, formerly known as Hongkou Park, was a place where Mr. Lu Xun often came for walks. In 1956, on the eve of the 20th anniversary of Lu Xun's death, the Lu Xun Tomb was built in Hongkou Park. After its completion, Lu Xun's coffin was solemnly relocated from the Western Suburban International Cemetery to this place. There is a statue of Lu Xun sitting on the lawn in front of the tomb, with a serene face and deep and divine gaze. There is an inscription on the tombstone: 'Tomb of Mr. Lu Xun'. Under the tombstone lies the base coffin of Lu Xun, which is paved with smooth granite. In addition, the park also has commemorative attractions such as the Lu Xun Memorial Pavilion and Lu Xun Memorial Hall, as well as natural attractions such as the Cherry Blossom Garden, Plum Pavilion, and Plum Garden. It integrates commemorative visits, cultural entertainment, and scenic tours, and has even become an important venue for nearby elderly people and children to exercise, relax, and go hiking. Plum blossoms are mainly planted in the plum garden of Lu Xun Park and the green space at the exit of Line 8, mainly in varieties such as Gong Fen, Meiren Mei, and Green Calyx. Starting from February each year, nearly a hundred plants in the park open one after another, adding a touch of beauty to the Spring Festival. Nearly a thousand Yoshino Sakura trees have been planted in the park, with a flowering period of mid to late March. The flowers bloom first and have five petals, initially a light red color that gradually turns white. They have a large number of flowers and are highly ornamental. Nowadays, Lu Xun Park has undergone a new renovation and restored the style of an "English style park", and a new "lake island" has been developed. The famous landscape in the park and Shanghai's first sand filter water dispenser built in 1929 are also open to tourists.

Fengjing Ancient Town is located in the southwest corner of Shanghai and is a typical water town in Jiangnan. As early as more than 2000 years ago, Fengjing Ancient Town already had people living there. The boundary river in the town was the boundary river between the states of Wu and Yue during the Spring and Autumn Period. Due to its location spanning the two borders of Wu and Yue, Fengjing Ancient Town is known as the "Famous Town of Wu and Yue". The ancient town is crisscrossed by rivers and has as many as 52 bridges, among which the Zhihe Bridge, built in the Yuan Dynasty, has a history of nearly 700 years. Compared to other popular water towns in Jiangnan, Fengjing doesn't have as many tourists. You can leisurely enjoy the scenery of small bridges and flowing water here. There are two main streets in the ancient town, one is called South Street in the south section, Middle Street in the middle section, and North Street in the north section (although they are named three different sections, they are connected streets), and the other is Heping Street. The two streets intersect at the Fengjing Sanqiao Bridge, forming a "D" shape. Fengjing Sanqiao is the center of the ancient town, at the confluence of two rivers, where you can see Qingfeng Bridge, Zhuxing Bridge, and Beifeng Bridge at the same time. Fengjing is the birthplace of Jinshan Farmers' Painting, and you can enjoy a series of paintings with a local flavor at the Jinshan Farmers' Painting Exhibition Center in Shengtang Lane, South Street. There are many art galleries and ancestral homes of famous painters in the ancient town. The Ding Cong Comic Exhibition Hall on North Street displays furniture used by Mr. Ding, while on the second floor, satirical comics can be seen depicting characters vividly. At the Lv Jiren Painting Gallery on Heping Street, you can see paintings by Chen Yifei's classmate Lv Jiren, and there are many Chinese watercolor paintings by Mr. Cheng Shifa in his ancestral home. Generally, tourists enter from the main entrance on the south side of the ancient town, walk to South Street, and slowly stroll along the river to explore the ancient town. Walk northeast from South Street and pass through Zhihe Bridge to reach Middle Street. At the head of Zhongda Street, you can see the boundary between Wu and Yue, with boundary markers erected. In front of you is an inconspicuous small river that used to be the boundary between Wu and Yue. Continue northeast and cross Fengjing Third Bridge to reach North Street. On North Street, you can visit the Shiwang Temple, which was built in the Ming Dynasty and has red walls, as well as the Ding Cong Comic Exhibition Hall. On the south, central, and north streets, there are also long corridors with sheds. There are several sections of such corridors in the ancient town, which are antique and provide shade on sunny days and shelter on rainy days. Step on the bluestone road, return to the location of Fengjing Sanqiao, and then visit another street, Heping Street. First, visit the Three Hundred Gardens (Bai Lan Guan, Bai Deng Guan, Bai Xing Guan), next to which is the Lv Jiren Painting Museum. Walk a little southeast, the former site of the People's Commune is worth a visit, with old-fashioned hot water bottles and telephones from that era, and red suns painted on the walls. Further ahead is the Fengjing Ancient Theater, which faces the street and the river. During peak tourist seasons and holidays, there are free traditional theatrical performances on the theater. Sitting by the window at the Chen She Teahouse across from the theater, enjoying tea and listening to the play, is very relaxing. Walk along the street to visit the ancestral home of Cheng Shifa, and finally cross the bridge to the production street on the other side of the river. There is also a former site of a modern fire department - the East District Fire Administration Association. There is a boat dock above the South Street of Fengjing Ancient Town, where you can also experience the charm of the water town by taking a boat. The first delicacy in the ancient town is Ding Ti. There is a Ding Ti workshop by the Zhihe Bridge on South Street, which introduces the development and production techniques of Ding Ti in the ancient town. The "Wowo Li Restaurant" (meaning "my own home" in Fengjing dialect) on the production street near Sanqiao in Fengjing is a restaurant with a good environment in the ancient town. It has a long courtyard that creates the appearance of a small bridge flowing water, and its signature dishes are snail stuffed meat and Wuyue tofu. In the long corridor of the production street facing the river, there are numerous shops selling Fengjing roasted food, glutinous rice cake, and more. Among them, smoked silk is very distinctive, meaning "smoked toad" in the local dialect of Shanghai suburbs. The taste is great, but first you need to have the courage to taste it. About 4 kilometers away from the ancient town and close to Zhonghong Road, there is also a Chinese peasant painting village, which is quite unique and can be visited together with Fengjing Ancient Town.
