summary: Shanghai Huanghe Road is a place where food and culture blend together. In the heart of Shanghai, a bustling city, lies a street full of stories and flavors - Huanghe Road. Although its name reminds people of China's mother river, in fact, this street located in Huangpu District, adjacent to Nanjing West Road, is famous for its rich and diverse food culture, becoming a food paradise that diners eagerly explore. In addition to delicious food, the Yellow River Road also carries rich cultural connotations. This used to be a part of the bustling commercial district of Shanghai Beach, witnessing the changes and development of modern Shanghai history. The architectural styles along the street are diverse, including well preserved historical buildings and fashionable shops full of modern atmosphere, showcasing the unique charm of Shanghai as a city. While enjoying delicious food, tourists can also stroll around the streets and alleys, experiencing the perfect fusion of the city's historical heritage and modern atmosphere.

Fangsheng Bridge is a landmark attraction of Zhujiajiao Ancient Town, spanning across the Caogang River and connecting the north and south parts of Zhujiajiao Scenic Area. Fangsheng Bridge is a five arch stone bridge in the Shanghai area that is long, large, and high. Standing at the top of the high bridge arch, one can admire the large white walled and black tiled houses, as well as the wooden boats passing under the bridge. The entire ancient town can be seen in full view, making it a place for filming. When the sun sets in the west, enjoying the sunset on the bridge or taking photos of the release bridge under the sunset by the river are both very artistic. The Release Bridge, as the name suggests, encourages people to do good deeds and accumulate virtue. This bridge was first built in the fifth year of the Longqing reign of the Ming Dynasty (1571). The stone arch bridge was donated by a monk named Xingchao from Cimen Temple with his savings from fifteen years of begging. Every lunar first and fifteenth day, monks and pilgrims would organize a "aquatic animal" release ceremony under the bridge. This custom has been passed down to this day. However, now there are often vendors selling small fish or turtles at the bridgehead for tourists to "experience" the release, which appears very commercialized. The Fangsheng Bridge that we see today was rebuilt in the 17th year of the Qing Dynasty's Jiaqing reign (1812). The entire stone bridge is majestic, with Longmen stone engraved with eight coiled dragons, creating a realistic image. There are four welcoming stone lions on the top of the bridge, looking up and opening their mouths, with a charming and silly appearance. There is a bamboo pillar in the middle, and a carved stone slab is embedded in the center of the bridge deck. There is a stele pavilion built on the east side of the bridge, where you can take a rest after wandering. There is a stone barge built by the water, which is used for boats to dock.

North Street, also known as the "First Street" and known as the "First Street of Ming and Qing Dynasties in Shanghai", has a history of more than 400 years and a total length of more than two miles. It starts from Fangsheng Bridge in the east and ends at Meizhou Lane in the west for more than 300 meters. It is the representative essence of Ming and Qing architecture. Here, old style residential houses are arranged in rows, with pink walls and grey tiles arranged in a staggered manner. The narrow streets lead to secluded paths, and the stone paths stretch endlessly. Old and famous shops stand on both sides, presenting a picturesque picture of the ancient charm of the Jiangnan water town. North Street is backed by the Caogang River and adjacent to the Fangsheng Bridge. As early as the early days of the ancient town's formation, it was convenient for both water and land transportation, and merchants gathered here, making it a hub for trade. Tea houses, taverns, north-south grocery stores, rice shops, and meat shops are all well-equipped, making it a thriving and ancient commercial center that has been thriving for over a century. It is often referred to as the "three mile long street with a thousand shops". Nowadays, there is still a century old shop called "Han Dalong Sauce Garden" preserved on the street, and the ancient style still exists; The century old hotel "Maosun Pavilion" has just opened; The ancient tea house of the ancient town, the crown of the Shanghai suburbs; Traditional handicraft workshops with a complete range of categories; Antiques, ceramics, flowers and birds, calligraphy and painting, local specialties, handicrafts, and specialty snack shops are all readily available. The streets are filled with store signs fluttering in the wind, with red lanterns hanging high, creating a prosperous scene. North Street is only three to four meters wide, with a narrow section of only two meters. On both sides, there are small brick and wood buildings, and the drip eaves are almost connected, forming a unique landscape of "One Line Street". On both sides of the residential buildings, there are flying eaves and upturned corners, the walls of Mashan, and the storefronts are decorated with grid style floor to ceiling long windows. The old-fashioned vermilion painted door panels exude a strong sense of antiquity and elegance. The "Yunqiao Fishing Music" antique architectural complex, one of the ten scenic spots in the original ancient town, has also sprung up at the entrance of North Street and Meizhou Lane, shining again. Suggested travel time: 1.5 hours

The original site of Baoguo Temple, Guanwang Temple, is also a famous ancient temple by Dianshan Lake. It was built in the Ming Dynasty and rebuilt in the 13th year of the Chongzhen reign (1640). To this day, a stone tablet from the Chongzhen era is still preserved in the temple. Due to the worship of the famous Three Kingdoms general Guan Yu, it is named "Guan Wang Temple". Over a hundred years ago, the Guanwang Temple was bustling with incense and Buddhist activities were unprecedented. In the following years, there were several wars and most of the buildings were destroyed. By the late 1940s, only the East and West Halls remained. There are two stone tablets in the hall, a large copper bell with a golden Maitreya the size of a thumb on it. The golden Maitreya shimmers with golden light and is priceless. Later, it was stolen and the copper bell was destroyed in 1958. Since then, most of the Guanwang Temple has been damaged, and the incense offerings have gradually declined. However, people have not forgotten the grandeur of Guanwang Temple, and the ancient ginkgo tree behind the temple is a witness to history. In the early 1980s, Guanwang Temple underwent renovation and became increasingly popular. In 1989, Guanwang Temple was designated as the lower house of Shanghai Jade Buddha Temple and named Baoguo Temple. In 1991, a new Guanyin Hall was built, with two floors and a construction area of 950 square meters. The upper floor is a Jade Buddha Hall, and the lower floor houses a camphor wood Guanyin Buddha statue that is over one and two feet high. The current Baoguo Temple covers a total area of 38.5 acres, with a building area of over 5000 square meters. It has a magnificent atmosphere and is crowded with pilgrims, comparable to the ancient temples of Suzhou and Hangzhou.

The Nantou Ancient City Museum showcases the urban history of Shenzhen in 1677, displaying over 300 cultural relics and narrating the city's history dating back to the sixth year of Xianhe in the Eastern Jin Dynasty (331 AD). The display is mainly divided into two parts: one is the indoor display, which comprehensively showcases the urban development history and resistance to foreign aggression of Shenzhen, with the historical changes and cultural history of Nantou Ancient City as the background. The second part showcases the ancient ruins area, ancient city area, and ancient buildings, with a large number of cultural relics and historical buildings, reflecting the prosperity and lively scene of the ancient city in the past.
Lingding Bay, also known as Lingding Bay and the Pearl River Estuary, is a trumpet shaped estuary with a wide water area.

The Neilingding Island Futian Nature Reserve was established in October 1984, with a total area of approximately 921.64 hectares. It consists of two areas: Neilingding Island and Futian Mangrove Forest. Among them, Futian Mangrove is a nature reserve with a relatively small area of forest and wildlife types. Neilingding Island is located in the southwest of Shenzhen, about 9 kilometers northeast of Shekou. The area is 4.84 square kilometers. Due to living alone in the sea, it was named Lingdingshan, and later changed to distinguish it from Wailingding Island. The Neilingding Island Reserve is located in the east of the Neilingding Bay at the mouth of the the Pearl River, with a total area of about 554 hectares and Jianfeng Mountain at an altitude of 340.9 meters. The peaks of Neilingding Island are lush with green hills, surrounded by lush greenery, and the beautiful water flows endlessly. There are a wide variety of plant species, including 619 vascular plants, among which white cinnamon wood and wild lychee are the main protected plants in the country. Wild animal resources are also abundant, with the main protected species being the national second-class protected macaques, totaling over 900. In addition, there are also major protected animals such as otters, pangolins, black eared kites, pythons, and tiger frogs.

Longjing Wencha is one of the ten scenic spots in New West Lake, with Longjing Spring being one of the three famous springs in West Lake. Longjing tea brewed from Longjing Spring is even more unique. Every year around Qingming Festival, many tourists come to visit, drink tea, and ask for tea, which can be called the first pleasure of spring outing. There are two Longjing wells in total, one is the Old Longjing and the other is the Lower Longjing. Old Longjing has Longjing Spring and the abandoned Longjing Temple, as well as eighteen tea trees that were reportedly harvested during Emperor Qianlong's visit to Jiangnan, known as the "Eighteen Imperial Teas". After the renovation, the residential buildings in Xialongjing have become a unified agricultural settlement, with many farmhouses opened, making it a place for vacation and leisure.
Tianchi is located on a mountain with a high altitude, with a large area of clear and blue water. The surrounding mountains are gentle and the scenery is beautiful.

The Bund in Shanghai is a famous scenic spot located on the banks of the Huangpu River and is one of the iconic architectural complexes in Shanghai. The Bund Viewing Platform is a viewing area that offers a panoramic view of the beautiful scenery on both sides of the Huangpu River. It is located at the southern end of the Bund and offers views of high-rise buildings, historical buildings, and night light shows on both sides of the river. The architectural design of the viewing platform is simple and elegant, using glass curtain walls and steel structures. The entire platform has a large area and can accommodate many tourists to enjoy at the same time. If you want to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Shanghai, the Bund Observation Deck is a good choice.

Wulin Night Market is a foodie's paradise, famous for selling various snacks. Various snack stalls can be seen everywhere on the streets and alleys, and people eat a variety of delicious food in their hands and mouths. The short 300 meter Wulin Night Market has become a golden signboard of Hangzhou's "night economy".

The Twenty Four Histories Academy is an Oriental Academy developed by OCT Culture Group, a subsidiary of the large cultural and tourism group OCT Group, with an investment of over 100 million yuan. It is planned around the "Twenty Four Histories" IP and has built five major cultural and artistic contents, including a series of exhibitions of Twenty Four Histories literature, a group of characteristic bookstores such as Dongpo Bookstore, a small cool hat parent-child picture book house, a flower tea party collection, and a memory folk music evening party. Simultaneously organizing three major cultural and artistic competitions, namely essay writing, picture books, and music, with the aim of "making reading better", integrating reading, travel, socializing, and education to create a cultural and artistic home for urbanites. The academy is located in Gankeng Ancient Town Cultural Tourism Zone, Longgang District, Shenzhen, covering an area of 30000 square meters. It adopts the aesthetic of Eastern garden architecture as the spatial creation technique, combines natural and architectural resources, and is tailored to local conditions, nestled among mountains, waters, forests, and springs. In the future, the Twenty Four Histories Academy will be deployed nationwide, combining local cultural and historical themes to create cultural landmarks and artistic homes, reproducing the grand cultural pattern of the Twenty Four Histories and the millennium charm of Chinese academies, and contributing to the great rejuvenation of Chinese culture as a model of academies.

When you arrive at the Chenghuang Temple, you can't help walking along the zigzag bridge. It's also fun to see the carp under the bridge and the pavilion in the lake beside the bridge, or take photos or feed. The Nine Bend Bridge has nine bends and eighteen bends, with each bend having a different angle size, ranging from angles greater than 90 degrees to angles less than 90 degrees. The current bridge deck of Jiuqu Bridge is made of granite slabs, with a seasonal flower carved on each slab at each bend, such as narcissus in January, apricot blossom in February, peach blossom in March... until December wintersweet; And a lotus flower is carved on each of the two stone slabs at the end of the Nine Curve Bridge. On a bridge deck in front of the Huxinting Tea House, a lotus flower is carved in the middle, and colorful clouds are carved at the four corners. The White Marble lotus fairy sculpture in the pool is graceful and graceful, welcoming visitors with a smile. The Jiuqu Bridge provides access to the Huxinting Tea House.

Yuyuan Road is a famous road in the western district of Shanghai. This long old street leads from Jing'an Temple all the way to Zhongshan Park, and gathers old western-style houses from the 1920s and 1930s in Shanghai. Walking on the street is full of Shanghai elements. The Wang Mansion at No. 31, Lane 1136 has now become a children's palace, the peculiar European style air tower at Lane 520 is the old residence of comic book writer Gu Bingxing, and the Spanish garden style Yongquan Fang at Lane 395 is unique. Nowadays, in addition to many excellent historical buildings, Yuyuan Road is also lined with distinctive small shops. Walking on Yuyuan Road, I just passed by a Taiwanese ice cream shop, and the next one might be a Western style dessert shop. Walking one step further, I can also pass by the former residence of a historical celebrity.

1933 Laochangfang is a unique creative park transformed from a slaughterhouse. Many specialty shops, restaurants, and studios have settled in it, and it often hosts drama performances, fashion shows, exhibitions, etc., becoming an art base. This is also the filming location for the popular movie "Tiny Times", which is very suitable for taking photos. Laochangfang has a superior geographical location, adjacent to Sichuan Road Commercial Street. The entire building blends Eastern and Western characteristics, and the spatial layout of the building is unique. The square factory area surrounded by four buildings in the southeast, northwest, and central areas is connected to a 24 sided main building through stairs. The outer and inner circular building structure, criss crossing corridors and bridges, together with spiral staircases and umbrella shaped columns, create a maze like effect that surprises people repeatedly.

A public fitness and leisure attraction open 24/7, where you can hike around the mountains and lakes. The air is fresh, the water quality is clean, and you can overlook Tianping Mountain and Lingyan Mountain with beautiful and charming scenery! Suitable for morning exercise, evening running, and walking!

Qibao Ancient Town is a nearby town in Shanghai, and Qibao Old Street is a famous tourist attraction in the ancient town. The architecture of the entire old street is antique and full of Ming and Qing architectural styles. Various snacks can be seen everywhere on the street, as well as folk attractions such as Qibao Pawnshop, Wine Shop, Cricket Cottage, etc. It is suitable for visitors to stroll around and experience the charm of ancient towns in Jiangnan. Qibao Ancient Town has been a bustling market since the Northern Song Dynasty. Nowadays, many of the old streets and alleys are remnants of the Song Dynasty, and most of the buildings on both sides of the old street are two-story imitations of the Ming and Qing dynasties, with red walls and black tiles, white wood doors and windows, and narrow streets covered with blue bricks and stone slabs, which are very charming. Qibao Old Street is divided into two sections by a river, with North Street mainly featuring various shops selling handicrafts, accessories, antiques, calligraphy and paintings, as well as attractions such as Cotton Mill and Zhang Chongren Memorial Hall. South Street is dominated by specialty food, including Stinky tofu, kebabs, Zongzi, gorgon cake, Zhati, etc. There are also many interesting small attractions in Qibao Old Street, such as old shops, pawnshops, and cotton spinning halls, all of which have wax figures and realistic scenes. You can also go to the Shadow Puppetry Art Museum to watch a shadow play. In addition, there are attractions such as Zhang Chongren Memorial Hall, Cricket Grass Hall, Zhou's Micro Carving Hall, Qibao Distillery, Bell Tower, Qibao Temple, etc.

Zuibaichi is located in the old city area of Songjiang and is a typical Jiangnan garden. The garden is lush with ancient trees and has a peaceful environment. Walking in it can enjoy the rare elegance and tranquility in the bustling city. The Drunken White Pool is not big, but it is equipped with pavilions, towers, rockeries, and ponds. Through the flower windows in the corridor, you can see the unique floral garden scenery. In summer, you can come to escape the heat and admire lotus flowers. In late autumn, you can come to watch the annual chrysanthemum exhibition. In the park, you can also see hundreds of plaques, inscriptions, and stone carvings by famous artists. Zuibai Pond is one of the oldest of the five classical gardens in Shanghai (Yu Garden, Guyi Garden, Zuibai Pond, Qiuxia Garden, Qushui Garden). It was formerly a private house garden in the Song Dynasty, and later became the residence of Dong Qichang, a calligrapher and painter in the late Ming Dynasty. The existing garden was built on the old site by Gu Dashen, a painter in the Qing Dynasty. Drunken White Pool has now become a park, divided into two parts: the inner garden and the outer garden. The outer garden is newly built, while the inner garden is the original classic garden. Walking deep into the park from the west gate of Renmin South Road, you can reach the inner garden. Entering the outer garden, you are greeted by a brick carved wall, with carvings showcasing the scenic spot of Zuibai Pool. Traveling eastward along the tree lined road, you can visit the recently relocated Qing Dynasty classical residential building "Carving Hall", where the wooden carving "Red Cliff Battle" is worth a visit. Moving forward, there is a stone arch bridge that offers a panoramic view of the open lotus ponds in the north and south, especially during the summer and autumn when the lotus flowers are in full bloom and fragrant. There is also a large lawn in the outer park, as well as a rockery waterfall called "Five Color Spring" and a tea room called "Reading Hall". Passing through the cedar forest, one can enter the inner garden through the western corridor. In the center of the garden is a rectangular lotus pond, known as the Drunken White Pond. Walking leisurely in the corridors around the pond is very pleasant. Although the inner garden is small, it is lush with flowers and trees. There are many ornamental pine and bamboo trees in the garden. There is a large camphor tree over 300 years old in the north of the pond, a peony garden in the east of the pond, and golden and silver osmanthus in the backyard of Xuehaitang in the west of the pond. Around the pond and in the pavilion, there are often various potted flowers and plants, especially the chrysanthemum exhibition in mid November every year, which is worth a visit. You can see hundreds of varieties of chrysanthemums. In addition, there is a pot view garden next to the south of the inner garden, and the scenery inside is also quite good. The corridors in the inner garden connect various buildings, mainly including Xuehai Hall, Sifang Hall, Chishang Grass Hall, Sedan Hall, Letianxuan and other structures. These buildings are mostly from the Qing Dynasty and have an antique style, with various mahogany furniture still arranged according to the ancient interior layout. Under the eaves of the thatched cottage on the pond hangs a plaque inscribed by the painter Cheng Shifa, reading 'Drunken White Pool'. There is a stone inscription gallery in the southern part of the inner garden, where you can see many stone inscriptions by famous calligraphers and painters, such as Zhao Mengfu's "Red Cliff Ode" from the Yuan Dynasty, Zheng Banqiao's "Difficult to Confuse" from the Qing Dynasty, and Dong Qichang's banners from the Ming Dynasty. These are all characteristics of Zuibaichi.

Thames Town is located in Songjiang, Shanghai, and is a villa area with a strong British atmosphere. It is situated with Gothic churches, Victorian terraces, castles, fountains, squares, and many cafes, galleries, and art museums. This is still a popular shooting location for wedding photos, and the movie "Tiny Times" was also filmed here. The center of Thames Town is a commercial area with many shops, restaurants, etc., which can be freely walked on the streets. Or visit the nearby Songjiang Art Museum and Songjiang Urban Planning Exhibition Hall. When you get tired of browsing, you can sit down at a coffee shop, drink coffee, flip through magazines, bask in the sun, and slowly savor the pace of British style life. The northern, southern, and western parts of the town's commercial area are all residential areas, consisting of British style detached houses, townhouses, and multi story apartments, which are not open to tourists.

Zhao Gong Causeway is one of the three embankments of West Lake, also known as Xiaoxin Causeway. Built by the Zhao surname Lin'an Prefect in the second year of Chunyou in the Southern Song Dynasty (1242), from Su Causeway to Quyuan, the embankment is 250 zhang long and is known as the "Su Causeway with flowers and willows on the banks". Later, the embankment was abandoned and the Jinsha Causeway was built in the Qing Dynasty, later changed to a road. The current Zhao Gong Causeway was built in 2003.

The North Peak is located behind Lingyin Temple in Hangzhou and is a famous mountain range around West Lake in Hangzhou. Although the altitude of Beigao Peak is only over 300 meters, it was mistakenly identified as the peak of Hangzhou for a long time because it is considered a relatively high mountain range around West Lake. There are hiking trails and cable cars in the mountains of Beigao Peak, and many locals and hiking enthusiasts come to climb and stroll along the way, surrounded by lush trees. Looking around from the mountaintop, West Lake and mountains all come into view, making people feel relaxed and happy.

The Zhejiang Natural History Museum, formerly known as the West Lake Museum, was founded in 1929. The museum, with its rich collection resources and rigorous scientific professional academic support, interprets the era's proposition of harmonious development between humans and nature through exhibitions in three major sections: "Stories of Earth Life," "Rich and Strange Biological World," and "Green Zhejiang. Here, you can see the origin of life, understand the mysteries of the ocean, discover the world of plants, and have a wonderful encounter with ancient fossils. Enhance your knowledge and cherish this beautiful blue planet even more.

Cenbu Village by Dianshan Lake is known by insiders as the current spectacular firefly observation site in the city. "It is the area where two types of fireflies were discovered in Shanghai." In other areas, only yellow winged fireflies can be seen, flying slowly as if holding small lanterns; The striped firefly here is three times its size, fast and bright, like a shooting star passing by.

The plan adheres to the six principles of "ecological priority, minimal intervention, repairing the old as before, emphasizing culture, putting people first, and sustainable development", with the protection and improvement of the regional ecological environment as the fundamental starting point, and the connotation of Wuchang water town culture and Hongshi culture. Four major "villages" (functional blocks) will be built successively, including Xixi Wuchang Folk Culture Village, Xixi Popular Rest Village, Xixi Agricultural Culture Village, and Xixi Art Collection Village. The total area is 3.3 square kilometers, and it now has famous attractions such as the Hong Family Ancestral Hall, the Opera Corridor, and the Dongguan Lotus Pond. It is a national wetland park that integrates urban wetlands, agricultural wetlands, and cultural wetlands.

Get ready, carry your jetpack and dive and hover in the high sky of Tomorrow's World. If you have ever fantasized about a solo flight journey, come and try the transportation of Tomorrow's World - the space exploration journey will leave you amazed. The jetpack aircraft is connected to a giant sphere through 16 robotic arms, and novice pilots work in pairs, carrying jetpack aircraft powered by rockets, ready to take off.

The Xianghu Flower Sea is located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, where flowers are lush and beautiful. There are many types of fresh flowers planted in the Flower Sea, including sunflowers, cosmos flowers, hydrangeas, rapeseed flowers, etc. It is a great place for you to relax, vacation, and take photos.

summary: Xixi Plum Villa is located in the southeast of Xixi Wetland Park, adjacent to the Hezhu essence "Autumn Snow Nunnery" scenic spot, and together with the nearby Plum Bamboo Villa, Xixi Thatched Cottage, Xixi Water Pavilion, etc., it forms the Xixi Plum Bamboo Leisure Area. Surrounded by plum blossoms in the forest, it is one of the main plum viewing areas in Xixi, recreating the artistic conception of "travelers exploring the secluded and asking questions, deep in the snow fragrance is Xixi". The current Xixi Meishu is a group of rural farmhouse style buildings, mainly including Xixi Meishu, Xiangxue House, Tanchun Pavilion, Gongshan Xiaozhu, etc. The main building has a wooden surface and adobe walls, simple and natural, full of rural atmosphere; The roof is designed as a suspended mountain top, with staggered heights and varying shapes, complementing nature. Xixi Meishu is gradually becoming a plum blossom viewing destination that integrates sightseeing, science education, and leisure life, and is one of the highlights of Xixi's characteristic leisure.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:00-17:30(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 17:00)

summary: The Chongqing Yangtze River Cableway South Station is the starting point of the Yangtze River Cableway on the south bank, located at No. 4 Shangxin Street, Nan'an District, Chongqing, near the Longmenhao Street Office. The Yangtze River Cableway is one of the iconic attractions in Chongqing, known as the "aerial corridor of the Yangtze River for thousands of miles". It is a popular mode of urban transportation in Chongqing and a popular choice for tourists to experience the characteristics of the mountain city and enjoy the city scenery. There is a film and television cultural wall inside the South Station, displaying stills from films, TV dramas, and variety shows filmed in Chongqing, such as "Zhou Yu's Train" and "Crazy Stone". Secondly, there is a moon invitation platform that provides a resting area for tourists.

The Half Mountain Cliff Line is located in Chongqing, with a total length of more than 20 kilometers. It passes through five parks along the way, including Liziba Anti Japanese War Site Park, Eling Park, and Fotuguan Park. There are observation platforms and post stations along the way.

poiName: gu gong wen wu nan qian ji nian guan
summary: The Memorial Hall for the Southward Migration of Palace Museum Cultural Relics is located in Chongqing, covering an area of over 2000 square meters. It includes a cultural lecture hall, a Purple Forbidden Academy, and an exhibition hall. The museum showcases the magnificent feat of the southward migration of Palace Museum cultural relics through exhibits such as graphics, images, and videos.

poiName: Lai Fushilian Zhe Menghuan Xingkong Art Museum
summary: The globally popular internet celebrity art museum "Falling in Love with the Dreamy Starry Sky Art Museum" has appeared in Chongqing, igniting a crowd of countless trendy men and women competing to check-in for family outings, close friend travel photos, and couple dates. Have you made an appointment today? High aesthetic photography of landmark slay in Chongqing exudes a sense of technology, luxury, art, and modernity, creating a romantic new paradise under the starry sky in the city. Located in the new landmark of Chongqing - Chaotianmen Raffles City Mall, the location is superior and the transportation is convenient. Bring your lover, friends, and camera to check in during holidays and give you a pleasant holiday.

Meijiawu is located on both sides of Meiling Road in the western hinterland of West Lake Scenic Area, nearly 10 kilometers away from downtown Hangzhou, and is one of the main production areas of Longjing tea. Surrounded by green mountains, the village is full of lush tea trees, and the fragrance of tea leaves is refreshing. Taking a walk here and breathing in fresh air feels great. Nowadays, almost every villager in Meijiawu makes a living by growing and selling tea. Tea houses, tea societies, and many farmhouses can be seen everywhere in the village. Due to its proximity to the city center of Hangzhou, many tourists from the surrounding area invite three to five friends on weekends to drive here and enjoy authentic Longjing tea, local farm cuisine, and even play a few rounds of mahjong if interested, which is quite pleasant. If you come to Meijiawu during the tea picking season from March to April, you will see tea farmers busy in the fields. This is the season for picking and making new tea, and if you are interested, you can also experience the process of picking and making tea firsthand. If you come in April or May, you can enjoy the newly launched Longjing, especially before and after the Qingming Festival holiday, where many tourists from Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Shanghai flock to it. Actually, avoiding the crowds during holidays and enjoying this tranquility is the wise choice. In addition to the excellent Longjing, Meijiawu also boasts cultural landmarks such as Ligeng Hall. Ligeng Hall is an ancient Ming and Qing dynasty mansion in the village. The three characters "Ligeng Hall" were inscribed by calligrapher Zhang Zhao, who wrote the book "Record of Yueyang Tower" inside Yueyang Tower. Today, it is also an antique tea house and restaurant. If you want to climb the mountain, you can also take the small path on the east side of the southern end of Meijiawu and go to the filming location of "Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon" called "Yunqi Bamboo Trail" to enjoy the beautiful scenery of West Lake.

The sixth tallest mountain top Ferris wheel in the world, focusing everyone's attention, with a super large diameter of 110.5 meters and an area equivalent to a football field. In the dazzling lights and wonderful music, slowly rising to an altitude of 470 meters, overlooking the beautiful scenery of the Jialing River bank.

The flagship store of Duoyun Academy is a comprehensive bookstore, located on the 52nd floor of Shanghai center, with a height of 239 meters. The bookstore covers an area of approximately 2200 square meters and integrates multiple functions such as a study room, exhibition hall, venue, lecture hall, and living room. The flagship store of Duoyun Academy offers a wide range of book selection and cultural and creative products, catering not only to urban white-collar workers in Lujiazui Financial City, but also to tourists and book lovers from all over the world.

poiName: On Top of the Pyramid: The Civilization of Ancient Egypt
summary: The "Top of the Pyramid: Ancient Egyptian Civilization Exhibition" is the fourth exhibition in the "Dialogue with the World" cultural relics and art exhibition series of Shanghai International Import Expo. It was grandly unveiled on July 18, 2024 at the People's Square Pavilion and opened to the public on July 19. As the largest global and high-level exhibition of ancient Egyptian cultural relics in Asia, the exhibition gathers 492 sets of 788 precious cultural relics from different periods of ancient Egyptian civilization. More than 95% of the cultural relics cooperate with the Egyptian government capital. The exhibition will last for 13 months, fully revealing the appearance of ancient Egyptian civilization and its archaeological discoveries to the audience, and promoting mutual learning between Chinese and Egyptian civilizations.

Shanghainese always have an inexplicable emotion when it comes to Suzhou River, with a touch of vicissitudes and emotion. The once bustling and luxurious scenery on both sides has been replaced by new buildings, and the grievances of ten mile foreign companies have long disappeared from the historical stage, only the quiet river remains. As the witness of modern Shanghai, Suzhou Creek has left many representative historical buildings, such as Garden Bridge of Shanghai, Shanghai Post Office, the former British Consulate and the former site of Shanghai General Chamber of Commerce, forming a special nostalgic landscape of modern Shanghai. The rise of industry along the Suzhou River once led to serious pollution of the river water. The black and odorous river once affected people's environment and life, and even caused the disappearance of fish and shrimp in the urban section of the river, known as the "blooming black peony". After a series of renovation projects, the dormant Suzhou River finally woke up, with green trees on both sides. Not only has the water quality been significantly improved, but it has also become a new landmark in Shanghai, along with historical buildings and creative parks along the bank, and opened up a night cruise tour route on the Suzhou River. Suzhou Creek is 125 kilometers long. It originates from the Taihu Lake Lake and joins the Huangpu River near Garden Bridge of Shanghai. It is the second largest river in Shanghai. Before the opening of Shanghai as a port, Suzhou Creek was always called Wusong River. To be exact, the lower reaches of Wusong River to the east of Beixin Jing was called "Suzhou Creek". It is said that foreigners found that they could take a boat from this river to Suzhou, hence the name. The Suzhou River, which has flowed for 5000 years, records the historical changes of Shanghai from ancient times to the present, and its long journey from prosperity to defeat and then to restoration represents the development footprint of Shanghai Beach over the past century.

According to the novel experience of the protagonist Ning Caichen in "Nie Xiaoqian", the haunted house also blends the shocking scenes from the novel "Ghost Blows Out the Lamp", and creates ten major scenes in reverse, namely Liaozhai Ghost Shadow, Broken Bridge Ghost, Mysterious Hanging Well, and Mortuary Curse. Tourists feel like they have experienced a thrilling encounter. Opening the wooden door of Lanruo Temple in Song City, a deep and ancient aura wafted in waves. Xiaoqian's vengeful soul lingers in the old house. As we walked into the clouds one by one, horror had already permeated our bodies... Using sound, light, and electricity to recreate the mysterious scenes in Liaozhai stories and experience the experiences of ancient gods and ghosts.

The cemetery covers an area of 2.14 square kilometers and is mainly composed of the following parts: Martyrs' Group Carvings, Martyrs' Poetry and Stele Forest, Large Relief Carvings, Martyrs' Tomb, and Exhibition Hall. The exhibition hall covers an area of 1159 square meters and displays 490 pictures, 108 physical objects, and landscape paintings from the "11.27" massacre. There are exhibitions on the historical facts of the struggle of the Red Rock Soul - Bai Gongguan, the revolutionary martyrs in Zhazidong, and 6 special exhibitions.

The Huguang Guild Hall is located on the ancient Dongshuimen side of the Yangtze River in Yuzhong District, Chongqing. It consists of three major guilds surrounded by high walls: the Yuwang Palace, the Qi'an Public Office, and the Guangdong Public Office. The Chongqing Huguang Guild Hall was first built during the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty. After continuous renovation and expansion from Qianlong to Guangxu, it has now reached its current scale and has a history of nearly 300 years. At the end of 2003, the governments of Chongqing and Yuzhong District invested nearly 200 million yuan to carry out protective restoration of the core area buildings of Huguang Guild Hall, which was completed in September 2005. The central area of the guild hall covers an area of 18418 square meters. As a commercial organization of foreign officials, gentry, and merchants who raised funds during the Kangxi period of the Qing Dynasty, it is a large-scale and well preserved ancient guild hall complex in China. Three hundred years ago, the large-scale immigration movement, represented by the "Huguang Filling Sichuan" movement, involving more than ten provinces, forged the broad mindedness of Chongqing people who are tolerant, open, united, and enterprising, as well as their character traits of perseverance, courage, enthusiasm, and honesty. The Chongqing Huguang Guild Hall not only preserves the material culture of the guild building, but also embodies the intangible culture of immigrant spirit. In the past, present, and future, Chongqing Huguang Guild Hall is an important cultural symbol that Chongqing people are proud of. The scale of the clubhouse building is grand, the layout is arranged in a staggered manner, the halls are majestic and spectacular, and the style is simple and elegant. It is not easy for it to survive in the bustling area with high-rise buildings, and it has great historical, artistic, and scientific value. The Huguang Guild Hall, also known as the Yuwang Temple, Yuwang Palace, and Chu Temple, enshrines the great Yuwang to prevent floods; The Qi'an Public Office, also known as the Emperor's Palace, worships the Emperor (also known as the Blessed Lord) to pray for happiness, auspiciousness, and peace; The Guangdong Public Office, also known as Nanhua Palace, enshrines the ancestor Huineng of Nanhua. Immigrants from various provinces, mainly from Hubei and Guangxi, settled in Bashu, and various local beliefs also entered Sichuan with the immigrants, thus forming a unique folk belief pattern in Sichuan during the Qing Dynasty. During this period, the belief in Dayu in the Bashu region also exhibited a unique phenomenon of "Shu produced but Chu worshipped". Since its opening, Chongqing Huguang Guild Hall has received over ten million tourists from home and abroad, becoming a business card of Chongqing city and a monument to Chinese immigrant culture, enjoying a high reputation both at home and abroad; It embodies the reverence and pride of the ancestors of Bashu towards Chinese culture, and is an important carrier and proof of the inheritance of Chinese civilization on the land of Bashu. It is a splendid stage where history and modern culture complement each other. There are tens of thousands of wooden, stone, brick and other carved works of art in the hall building, all of which are exquisitely crafted and breathtaking. Before the restoration of the guild hall, a large number of sculptures from the Ming and Qing dynasties were preserved, with themes mainly including Journey to the West, The Story of the Western Chamber, Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Investiture of the Gods, and the Twenty Four Filial Piety stories. There were also patterns of dragons, phoenixes, animals, and various exotic flowers and plants, which should be a tribute to the totems of immigrants' hometown. It is an outstanding representative of southern sculpture art in China during the Ming and Qing dynasties. In 2003, with the support of the National Cutural Heritage Administration, the Tourism Administration and other departments, experts and teams in Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Beijing, Sichuan and other parts of the country spent nearly two years repairing and restoring the sculpture art preserved in the guild hall, making it reappear in the world. The carved works in the museum have a wide variety of themes, beautiful forms, gilded colors, and lifelike appearance, giving people a sense of aesthetic enjoyment with their antique charm. Everywhere they appear, they demonstrate the elegant aesthetic cultivation and superb craftsmanship of ancient people. As one of the earlier specialized museums on immigration in China, the Huguang Fill Sichuan Immigration Museum showcases the historical background, economic factors, and routes of immigrants entering Sichuan from different perspectives, with the background of "Huguang Fill Sichuan". It vividly and comprehensively reflects the history of "Huguang Fill Sichuan" and has great research and educational value in folk customs, guild hall culture, architecture, and garden culture. By drawing on the strengths of others, innovating, utilizing modern multimedia technology, and combining sound, light, and electricity through a series of interactive experiential activities, visitors can experience the hardships of their ancestors' entrepreneurship and embark on the path of immigration. The scene of people from various provinces such as the Two Lakes and Guangdong entering Sichuan by water and land was restored, and the influx of commercial immigrants was systematically introduced, gradually making Chongqing a city for immigrant trade and commerce. The Dongshuimen City Wall was first built during the Hongwu period of the Ming Dynasty and has a history of over 600 years. Facing the Yangtze River, standing alone in the middle of the river, with natural dangers and majestic momentum, it presents a typical ancient city wall with mountain city characteristics, and has high architectural scientific and artistic value. The long historical process of the creation and evolution of Dongshuimen and its city walls records the changes of the former water dock and the mother city of Chongqing, as well as reflecting Chongqing's long history and rich culture. In 2000, it was announced by the Chongqing Municipal People's Government as the first batch of municipal level cultural relics protection units, and in 2013, it was announced as a national key cultural relics protection unit. The rich historical and cultural heritage and unique ancient architectural forms of Chongqing Huguang Guild Hall have attracted numerous film and television shooting agencies to come and shoot, becoming a popular outdoor filming base for film and television. Since its restoration and opening up, it has provided outdoor filming locations for numerous films, variety shows, and photography programs such as "Smart Battle at Shajiabang," "Drunken Gold," "Spy Wars," "Chongqing 1950," "High Quality Bodyguard," "Lu Zuofu," "Eight Minutes of Warmth," "Lie Detector," "Extreme Challenge," "Twelve Flavors," and "Chinese New Year.

summary: The Heilongjiang Music Museum was established in January 2006 and is the first privately-owned museum in China that focuses on music culture. It collects, protects, displays, and inherits local music culture in China. The collection of exhibits includes historical materials on music of northern Chinese ethnic minorities living in the Heilongjiang River Basin, information on ethnic minority musicians, over 500 historical photos, various musical instruments (including shamanic drums over a century old, guqin, sihu, various bronze bells, religious instruments such as Gangdong, Guanzi, wooden fish, suona, Qing Dynasty war drums, etc.), and more than 300 folk art exhibits. There are over a hundred historical materials, more than two thousand photographs, and over a thousand pieces of information, works, manuscripts, handwriting, records, instruments, and other materials of music masters who were born, lived, studied, and worked in Harbin over the past century, witnessing the development of Harbin's music history.

Jiaochangkou is one of the neighborhoods with local characteristics. Although the area is not large, there are authentic Chongqing cuisine everywhere. The surrounding transportation is convenient and there is a large flow of people. It is one of the check-in places for tourists in Chongqing.
Harbin Ice Songhua River Cruise has North Seven Boarding Station, Nine Stations, etc. Everyone can reach Sun Island. Tourists can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Songhua River on board.

The St. Yville Church is located in Daoli District, Harbin City. It was originally a military Orthodox church of the Amur Military Region outside the Russian Empire. The church is dedicated to the statue of Our Lady of Yville.

The Chongqing Natural History Museum is a municipal cultural institution under the supervision of the Chongqing Municipal Commission of Culture, representing the country in fulfilling its responsibilities of collecting, displaying, conducting scientific research, and popularizing natural specimens. Our museum has been successively named as the "National Science Popularization Education Base", "Chinese Society of Paleontology Science Popularization Education Base", and "National Land and Resources Science Popularization Base". In May 2006, the former site of the Western Chinese Academy of Sciences (Beibei Exhibition Hall of Chongqing Natural History Museum) was designated and announced as a national key cultural relic protection unit. The new Chongqing Natural History Museum is located at the foot of Jinyun Mountain in Beibei, Chongqing, covering an area of 216 acres, with a building area of 308.42 million square meters and an exhibition area of 16252 square meters. The design concept of the new building originates from the natural phenomenon of "root wrapped stone", the root of Chongqing's city tree "Huangjue tree", winding and intertwining in the rocks of the Ba Yu land, reflecting the vigorous vitality of nature and a beauty of nature. The cultural, extensional, and inclusive aspects contained in 'root stone' can interact well with the integration of architecture, representing the environmental protection concept of green ecology. The basic exhibition of the new museum consists of six major exhibitions: "Animal Planet", "Dinosaur World", "Landscape City", "Earth Mystery", "Life Stream", and "Ecological Home". It mainly showcases the evolution of the Earth, life evolution, biodiversity, and the magnificent mountains and rivers of Chongqing, focusing on the relationship between natural resources, environment, and human activities, advocating the concept of harmonious coexistence and sustainable development between humans and nature. In addition, our museum will also plan outdoor spaces reasonably in the future, with the theme of "experiencing nature, learning nature, and discovering nature", setting up corresponding outdoor exhibition items, and forming a project feature of "combining the museum and the park, integrating with nature".

Chongqing 1949 Grand Theater, located in Ciqikou Ancient Town Scenic Area, Shapingba District, Chongqing, is a large-scale live action theater tailored for the play "Chongqing 1949" and is currently the world's first single indoor theater. The total construction area of Chongqing 1949 Grand Theatre is 25000 square meters, with a building height of 28.6 meters, and can accommodate 1497 spectators. Chongqing · 1949 "is set on the eve of the liberation of Chongqing in 1949, telling the story of" numerous Communist Party members who were imprisoned in Zhazidong and Baigongguan, enduring various forms of torture and suffering, unyielding and willing to die, "reproducing the grand scene of liberating Chongqing and defending the city. The story takes place on the day of the liberation of Chongqing. A group of revolutionary martyrs, in order to uphold their great ideals and noble beliefs, fell on the road to break through darkness and rush towards dawn, accompanied by the sound of the liberation of Chongqing. "Sacrifice precious life for the cause of the liberation of the Chinese people", thus, "condense into the 'Red Rock Spirit'". This is a grand work that embodies the requirements of "having bones, morals, and warmth" in literary and artistic works, and "striving to showcase the beauty of faith and nobility". It is a red historical drama that shoulders the mission of "promoting the spirit of Red Rock and inheriting the red gene" in the era. Chongqing • 1949 "presents a new interpretation of the" Red Rock Classic "from a broader temporal and spatial dimension. At the same time, it presents different narrative scenes from multiple dimensions, forming a spatial atmosphere with montage interpretation, allowing the audience to receive a spiritual baptism of red culture through a highly immersive experience and comprehensive, three-dimensional sensory impact.

Yuanmingyuan Road is a north-south road located in Huangpu District, Shanghai. It starts from Dianchi Road (formerly known as Renji Road) in the south and ends at Suzhou Road in the north. The road is 462 meters long and 16 meters wide. On one side of this pedestrian street are urban public green spaces and the Shanghai Peninsula Hotel, while on the other side are renovated and restored historical buildings. Walking on Yuanmingyuan Road, I feel a bit of the old street flavor, and now it has become a place for young couples to take wedding photos.

Fumin Road starts from Yan'an Middle Road in the north and ends at Changle Road in the south, a short and concise road. Walking south from Changde Road, passing through the wide Yan'an Middle Road, you will arrive at the not too wide Fumin Road. At the beginning, the road was not so narrow, but at the intersection of Julu Road and Fumin Road, you would find that the road became noticeably narrower, only two cars wide. There are also more small shops on the road, and the golden I-shaped area composed of Julu Road, Fumin Road, and Changle Road is a place where small shops gather, many of which have their own characteristics. Wutong trees beside the road are dark, as if there are attractive secrets waiting for you to explore. The deeper and quieter you walk, the buildings by the roadside that have accumulated time emit the scent of time.

Changle Road was called Shipu Road in old Shanghai, a road with people, stories, and history. From literati to politicians, from Wang Jingwei to Zhang Ailing, these names are closely related to this path. Changle Road starts from Huashan Road and ends at Chongqing Road. Seen from its not so wide road, it seems a bit too long. To sum up, it can be divided into three sections: the first section is from Changle Huashan Road to Changle Changshu Road, which is far away from civilians. On both sides of the road are flower garden houses with deep courtyards. The tall and closed iron doors look mysterious and dignified. They are low-key hidden behind the wutong trees, which always makes people wonder whether his master will be the descendant of the declining family in old Shanghai or an artist living in seclusion. The second section is from Changle Road Shaanxi Road to Changle Road Ruijin Road, which has a century old petty bourgeois plot. The Huamao Apartment, where Zhang Ailing once lived, is located on this road. Across from the Huamao Apartment, there are various introverted and distinctive bars, clothing and accessory shops. There are handicrafts and toy dolls that girls like, as well as design clothing, shoes, and bags that trendsetters love. The section from Changle Road Ruijin Road to Changle Road Chongqing Road is the third section. To its left is the Square Park, which was originally the Yanzhong Green Space, while to its right is the blurry color and the old house where even the electricity meter is still shared up and down. Changle Road has an endless stream of trendy and personalized small shops, with "trendy" becoming its characteristic, attracting designers, celebrities, trendsetters, and foreign fashionistas of different styles to settle in. After wandering around, you can easily find famous and delicious restaurants here, such as the popular Paul's Restaurant and Ah Mao Restaurant.

‌Huanghe Road Citywalk‌ is a fun and exploratory activity. It is not just a stroll along a street, but also a journey of cultural and historical exploration. On Huanghe Road in Shanghai, you can experience the splendor of the last century and feel the Shanghai street scene depicted in the TV series "Flower". Huanghe Road is not only famous for its food, but also for its rich historical background and cultural heritage, making it a must-visit place for tourists.

Now, both sides of the road are filled with various personalized fashion, shoe, and hat shops, making it a fashionable street suitable for shopping, with prices similar to shopping malls.

This is truly a short boutique art street.

Nanchang Road is very close to the bustling Huaihai Road, but still quiet and leisurely, hiding the old residences of celebrities. Having a cup of afternoon tea at a caf é, sweeping through various restaurants of all sizes, and making friends on weekends is worth a visit.

The Deshou Palace Site is located at the foot of Fenghuang Mountain in Hangzhou and was the residence of Emperor Gaozong Zhao Gouchan in his later years. Afterwards, Emperor Xiaozong of Song also expanded the Deshou Palace, which was then called "Beinei" or "Beigong". It covers an area of over 17000 square meters, with a layout consistent with the imperial palace and exquisite garden scenery in the backyard. It is still in the stage of development.

It is built on the basis of the original "Chongqing Wildlife World". The scenic area takes "animals" as the core element, with rich project settings, including a wild animal world, a joyful world (i.e. entertainment paradise equipment theme+two comprehensive theaters and other performances), a water park, a global village (commercial shopping theme), a lava city (high-tech digital imaging experience theme, under construction), as well as two river holiday hotels and animal themed hotels. It has formed a large-scale and comprehensive tourism and vacation group in the western region. 1、 The Wildlife World has over 10000 rare birds and animals from 430 species across five continents worldwide. It has the world's first gold, silver, and white tiger free range, the first Australian animal free range, and the largest African animal free range introduced in China at once. At present, there are two boutique tourist routes in the car area and pedestrian area. In the driving area, you have three ways of sightseeing to choose from. According to the classification and layout of primates, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals, more than 150 rare wild animals at home and abroad, such as tigers, lions, chimpanzees, pythons, and red pandas, were displayed to us. You can also take your child to feed cute little animals such as giraffes, squirrel monkeys, ring tailed lemurs, and white rabbits together. 2、 Entertainment Paradise is a joyful playground that combines equipment amusement, exploration, and other participatory and experiential themes. The Dongshuimen Yangtze River Bridge is a cross river passage connecting Yuzhong District and Nan'an District in Chongqing. It is a double tower single cable plane steel truss cable-stayed bridge. The total length of the bridge is over 1000 meters, with a three span layout and a unique exterior construction.

The Pingzhou Island area is administratively part of the Islands District. The island is located southeast of Discovery Bay and northeast of Mui Wo on Lantau Island, with an elevation of 95 meters above sea level. It offers a panoramic view of Hong Kong Disneyland and Discovery Bay. Pingzhou is shaped like a "concave" character, with the sunken area being Dongwan. The south and north sides are respectively called Nanwan and Beiwan. There is a road connecting Dali Island on the island, and the northeast end has a "fishing stone". Shops in Pingzhou are concentrated in the dock area. Pingzhou has cars, but they are all used for special purposes. Generally, only bicycles can be used for transportation, and external transportation relies on ferries.

Tap Mun is located north of Tolo Harbour in the Chi Mun Strait, surrounded by mountains on all sides, forming a deep bay harbor to the south. The eastern end of Tap Mun is a bow island with a lion rolling ball; At the southern end is the entrance of the tower, and across from it is Gao Liu Bay located on the Sai Kung Peninsula; The western and southwestern ends are respectively the Wan Chai Peninsula and the Tai Tam Sea. Tamen Seaside Street is the main street that reflects the charm of a fishing village. You can enjoy the sea breeze, see the fishing boats and rafts on the sea, eat authentic seafood at seaside restaurants, and buy some seafood from Tamen as gifts.

Putai Island is the main island of the Putai Archipelago, with an area of 3.69 square kilometers. The geology of Putai Island is mainly composed of rocks. There are tourist attractions such as Coffin Stone, Buddha's Hand Rock, Linggui Mountain, and Wu's Abandoned Residence on the island. In addition, the Putai Island Stone Carvings have been listed as a statutory monument in Hong Kong. The seabed of Luozhoumen on the north side of Putai Island is located at a depth of 66 meters below sea level in the Hong Kong waters.

The Central Promenade is located near Man Kwong Street in the Central and Western District of Hong Kong, with a length of 1.4 kilometers. It is adjacent to Victoria Harbour and has beautiful scenery. Sports events are also held here from time to time.

Kowloon Night Tour: Immerse yourself in the neon lights of Hong Kong after dark. The Kowloon night tour will pass through the bustling city center of Kowloon, visiting attractions such as Nathan Road in Tsim Sha Tsui, bustling Temple Street Night Market, Canton Road, Clock Tower, and Hong Kong Coliseum. The journey ends at the Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade, which is a great place to watch the exciting free performance "Symphony of Lights". The performance starts at 8:00 every night. The convertible bus will pass through Repulse Bay, Deep Water Bay, Stanley, Aberdeen, and Victoria Harbour, allowing you to enjoy the magnificent scenery along the coastline while riding. When you arrive in Stanley, you can freely visit the characteristic attractions of Stanley such as Stanley Market, Murray Building, Pok Kong Pier, Chek Lap Kok Promenade and Stanley Main Beach, and take an open top bus back in 1 hour.

Harbin Bund Snowman Pier is an amusement park located at the intersection of Youyi West Road and Shangjiang Street in Daoli District, Harbin, covering an area of 156000 square meters. The scenic area leverages the advantages of the Bailijiang Beach Yacht Terminal and fully utilizes the frozen river surface and dock shoreline resources to create a large-scale comprehensive theme park in the city that integrates snow viewing, leisure, and entertainment. The amusement projects at the Bund Snowman Pier include dozens of exciting entertainment items such as internet famous check-in snowmen, ultra long ice slides, hovercrafts, crazy octopus, ice and snow four-wheel drive vehicles, internet famous carousel, small train check-in, snowman stage, etc. The 100 meter long ice slide adopts a steel structure base bracket, which not only ensures safety but also provides players with the thrill of high-speed experience. In addition, there are various sculptures based on fairy tales in the scenic area, such as various snowmen, beautiful snow altars, pure eternal light corridors and other snow sculpture buildings, showcasing the wonderful ice and snow culture.
