poiName: Harbin Laodao Wai Minsu Culture Exhibition hall
summary: The Harbin Laodao Folk Culture Exhibition Hall has a rich collection of precious cultural relics and has held exhibitions and educational activities, attracting many tourists to visit.
The St. Nicholas Church is an all wooden structure, a 1:1 replica of the former St. Nicholas Church in Harbin, with an antique charm.

St. John's Cathedral was built in 1849 and has a history of nearly 200 years. The light yellow English style building appears peaceful and solemn in the bustling city of Central. It is now the main church of the Anglican Diocese of Hong Kong and Macau, and has an undeniable position in the local area. The exterior of the church follows the garden road towards Taiping Mountain, and soon you can see the St. John's Cathedral nestled among green trees. This is a building that blends early 13th century British and ornate Gothic architectural styles, featuring numerous colonnades and cross decorations. The central hall is the nave, with side halls on either side. The entire church is white, and the stone tower is beige with four small spires. In front of it, there is also the coat of arms of Queen Victoria. Every 15 minutes, you can hear the deep and deep ringing of the large bell inside the clock tower. The interior of the church can be accessed from the west gate of the cathedral. The interior decoration is magnificent and elegant, with a baptismal basin at the entrance and a three in one mosaic painting on the ground. The floor is also decorated with various patterns. Upon closer inspection, there is a painting of an eagle under the cross, which is the symbol of St. John to indicate the identity of the church. Every window of the church is decorated with beautiful stained glass, depicting biblical characters and stories. The outdoor light shines through the glass, creating a serene atmosphere. There is a monument outside the main entrance to mourn the martyrs during the World War, and there is also a tombstone next to it. In addition, a commemorative stone can be seen embedded on the north wall of the church, commemorating Captain William's martyrdom in Guangzhou in 1857. There is also a small garden outside the church, where after being baptized by religion and history, you can take a walk in the shade and relax.

Huayuan Street is a section of road located between Dundas Street and Prince Edward Road in Mong Kok, adjacent to Tung Choi Street (Women's Street). The entire street is divided into two sections, north and south. The southern section is habitually called Sneaker Street by locals, mainly selling sneakers. There are more than 50 sneaker specialty stores on this street, and various out of print and limited edition sneakers can be found here. The northern section of Huayuan Street is very similar to the Women's Street facing the street. The center of the street is filled with small stalls, and the entire long street is bustling at night. Various daily necessities such as cotton pajamas, stationery, umbrellas, and toys are available, and the types of goods are more popular than Women's Street. Garden Street or Food Street. You can find many snack shops on the streets and alleys, such as curry fish eggs, bowl wings, fish meat, roasted wheat, and fried rice dumplings, as well as various fruits. Having a dental feast while sweeping the streets can be said to be a perfect combination of shopping and food.
There are attractions such as Wangfu Stone and Lion Pavilion in Lion Rock Country Park. The most distinctive attraction is Lion Rock, which is rich in flora and fauna resources.
The exhibition center is located in the North Wan Chai reclamation area and hosts large-scale exhibitions and concerts every year. It is one of the well-known landmarks in the area.

The Harbin Institute of Technology Museum is located in a creamy yellow two-story building on Company Street - the "Old Earth Wooden Building" of Harbin Institute of Technology. Although the museum may not be grand or majestic, it is profound, subtle, dignified, and elegant. Its iconic arched doors and Gothic style reliefs on the exterior walls make this century old building a precious cultural relic, telling the stories of the history of Harbin Institute of Technology. The exhibition area of the museum is over 2000 square meters, with the first floor being the school history exhibition hall, which includes four parts: the early history of the school, the cradle of engineers in the Republic, the leapfrog development in the new era, and the advancing Harbin Institute of Technology; The second floor is dedicated exhibition halls, including well-known alumni exhibition halls, glorious revolutionary tradition exhibition halls, scientific and technological achievements exhibition halls, and temporary exhibition halls. Each exhibition hall takes historical development as the main theme, and through a large amount of text, pictures, and physical objects, truly condenses and reproduces the 90 year development process of Harbin Institute of Technology.

The venue is located north of HK International Airport in Chek Lap Kok, Lantau Island, Hong Kong. It is an exhibition and conference venue for HK and was completed in 2005. It is a public-private partnership development project, with renowned architect Lu Yuanxiang as the chief architect of the project. After receiving high praise from previous editions of the "Children's Book Fair and Super Parent Child Products Exhibition", the 5th "Children's Book Fair and Super Parent Child Products Exhibition" sponsored by 11 SKIES will return in May 2024 with great success. It will continue to promote diverse cultural, artistic, and creative industries (such as children's literature and related creations) through exchanges with cities in the Greater Bay Area and other countries under the theme of "World of Cultural and Artistic Exchange for Children", bringing endless opportunities and business opportunities to the industry. There will be over 700 booths on site, covering areas such as "Children's Education", "Infant and Child Special Zone", "Parent Child Department Store", and "Chinese Culture Experience Hall". For three consecutive days, provide parents and children with children's books, stationery, and baby products for purchase; In addition, we also provide play booths for children to fully unleash their energy, showcasing education, entertainment, and shopping in one exhibition!

The Hong Kong Macau Ferry Terminal is located on the third floor of the Shun Tak Centre in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. It is one of the cross-border ferry terminals in Hong Kong, mainly providing high-speed passenger ferry services between Hong Kong and Macau, as well as routes to Zhuhai, Shenzhen Shekou, Zhongshan and other places. It takes about an hour to take a one-way ferry to Macau, with a ticket price of around HKD 180. There are many trips available, with one taking 20-30 minutes. If you want to enjoy the view, it is recommended to choose a window seat at the service desk before boarding. In addition, there is also an aerial express helicopter airport on the rooftop of the pier, where you can take a flight to Macau in about 16 minutes.

The Tianxinghai Upstream Service allows tourists and citizens to take the newly modified "World Star" cruise ship to explore the beautiful coastal scenery of Hong Kong waters. The new route launched by Haishang is provided by a new generation of smoke-free and environmentally friendly ferries. Haishang services are no longer limited to Victoria Harbour. The "World Star" ferry will depart from Victoria Harbour and take a brand new route, taking tourists and citizens to explore different attractions in Hong Kong waters. The Star Ferry has always been regarded as one of the symbols of Hong Kong, and has won numerous awards from various organizations and international media to recognize its unique style and experience. Among them, the globally renowned travel review website TripAdvisor has awarded the Star Ferry the "TripAdvisor Annual Excellence Award" for two consecutive years; National Geographic Travel Magazine praised taking the Star Ferry to visit Victoria Harbour as one of the "50 must visit attractions in life"; The US website Global Post also listed the Star Ferry as one of the "31 Reasons to Live in Hong Kong".

North Point is located at the northern end of Hong Kong Island, near MTR North Point Station and Fortress Hill Station, and is an old town area full of the flavor of old Hong Kong. There are a lot of snack shops around. The eggs in the north corner of Yinghuang Road and the Maiji food, squid, barbecue and Potsticker in Baobuli Street are all delicious. The fruits here are also very cheap. You can also see trams coming and going on the road, which is very nostalgic.
Lanting Shuihui is located in Harbin and is a bathing and sweating place with complete internal facilities, providing tourists with a place to relax and unwind.

poiName: yu ren ma tou tang quan
summary: Yuren Wharf Bathing is located at No. 28 Changjiang Road, Nangang District, Harbin City, a beautiful ice city with a business area of over 5000 square meters. Healthy and fashionable, business rooms, children's playground, green health massage, exquisite cuisine, health steaming, leisure hall, health tea art, leather shoe care, specialty back rubbing, it is a comprehensive business bath. It is a luxurious and brand new comprehensive bathhouse in the local area. It is an ideal place for your family gatherings, business banquets, and class reunions. We will also continue to uphold the concept of health and leisure, and create a high-quality healthy business bathing center that is green, comfortable, warm, free, quiet, and elegant.

The Liangzhu Scenic Area is located in the western suburbs of Ningbo and is a love themed park set against the backdrop of the Liangzhu love story. It is also the birthplace of the Liangzhu story. The park is mainly centered around the Liangshan Temple, and is connected by the legend of Liangzhu to create landscapes such as the Wansong Academy, Liangshan Uncle Ancient Tomb, and Liangzhu Cultural Sculpture. Although most of the gardens in the park are later built antique buildings without a strong historical atmosphere, the Jiangnan style garden ornaments can also be called exquisite. Many couples come here to witness their love, and sometimes blind date events are held in the park. It can be said to be a quite romantic place. The park area is not too large and can be enjoyed on foot. To the right of the entrance of the scenic area, cross a small bridge and you will arrive at the "Eighteen Farewell Road" that runs through the park. Follow this main road all the way down and you can circle the park to reach the exit. Crossing the bridge and encountering a building is the Liangzhu Love Post Office. There are only two post offices with love as the theme in the country, the other one is in the Summer Palace. As soon as the post office was built, it quickly became one of the highlights in the park. Similar to the "Love postmark" on Shanghai's Tian'ai Road, you can also stamp it here with a "Love postmark" to send out your love and emotions, or buy a "Love Passport" and leave a mark on it every anniversary. The post office also provides scheduled mail delivery services, allowing you to send a love email on every wedding anniversary, and different commemorative days in different years will be stamped with different distinctive postmarks. Continuing along the trail, not far away is the Liangzhu Academy (Wansong Academy) where Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai studied together for three years. The academy is an ancient building from the Ming and Qing dynasties, with plum blossoms planted in the courtyard and a bamboo forest behind it. It is quaint and elegant. The Butterfly Art Museum exhibits a large number of butterfly specimens from around the world, which is worth a visit. Continuing through Fenghuang Mountain and Guanyin Hall until reaching the edge of Yao River, you will arrive at the residence of Zhu Yingtai's family. The architecture of Zhu's mansion is very grand, exuding the temperament of officials, nobles, and wealthy families everywhere. Especially the large sedan chair in the Sixin Hall, with intricate carved patterns. Walk not far towards the exit and arrive at the tomb of Liang Shanbo. The horizontal stele in front is inscribed with the words' Imperial Decree to Seal the Tomb of Liang Shengjun Shanbo ', and there is a clear crack in the middle of the stele, which is said to have cracked during Zhu Yingtai's memorial service to Liang Shanbo. There is a monument of Zhu Yingtai standing behind the tomb, and there is a place to sell flowers next to it. You can pay according to your own wishes and offer it on the tomb as a tribute. Next to the ancient tomb is the Liangshan Temple, which is also the main building of the park. The entire temple is divided into three sections, namely the mountain gate, the main hall, and the rear hall. Entering the mountain gate, the first thing that catches the eye is a butterfly love ceramic mural, depicting the entire story of Liang Zhu and his two sworn brothers from Grass Bridge to Butterfly Transformation. There is a magnificent ancient stage opposite the main hall in the temple, and sometimes there are singing and acting performances, which are very impressive. Inside the main hall, there are statues of Liang and Zhu, and this is also a place where people pray for a free and happy marriage. Walking to the square where the Liangzhu Music Fountain is located, in the center of the square is a sculpture of Liangzhu transforming into a butterfly, which is one of the landmarks of the scenic area and can be photographed here. In the adjacent Liangzhu Culture Museum, there are exhibitions such as Love Tree and Liangzhu themed reliefs, as well as interactive projects to participate in. If you want to learn about the history of Liangzhu culture and its influence on folk culture, why not come here for a visit.

Discovery Bay is a coastal area located in the northeast of Lantau Island in the New Territories of Hong Kong. It includes several bays, namely Renshu Bay, Crab Land Bay, Caiyuan Bay, Tai Pak Bay, Erbai Bay, Sanbai Bay, and Sibai Bay. Fresh air, sunny beaches, and global cuisine, D'Deck has nearly 20 restaurants offering dishes from various countries, arranged on the seaside promenade next to the beach in Dabaiwan. You can enjoy delicious food while admiring the vast scenery of the sea and sky.

tagNameList: Film Studios; Buildings by Famous Architects
summary: Xiangshan Film and Television City, located along the central coast of Zhejiang Province, is situated in the picturesque Datang Port Ecotourism Zone of Xinqiao Town. It consists of the cities of the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period. The Shendiao Xialu City was designed and planned by the chief architect of Shendiao Xialu, Qian Yunxuan. It was completely designed and built in the style of the Song Dynasty, covering an area of 400000 square meters. It has six major zones: the entrance area, the attraction area, the Xiangcheng area, the mountain scenic area, the lake scenic area, and the construction area. It has formed eight scenic spots including the ancient battlefield, workshop area, village blocks, Guiyun Village, the tomb of the living dead, Lujiazhuang, Xiangyang City, and the Mongolian yurt, with more than 160 individual buildings. At the same time, it has five major courtyards and a national artificial banyan tree forest covering an area of 1400 square meters and a man-made cave of 3500 square meters. The ancient battlefield covers an area that is rare among many film and television cities in the country. There is frequent interaction between film and television celebrities in the scenic area. In addition to being able to see celebrities filming on set, the film and television base also holds occasional celebrity and fan meetings, allowing tourists to have "zero distance" contact with celebrities. Watching movies and TV shows, inviting celebrities to take photos, asking for their signatures, and interacting with them have become one of the main contents of visiting film and television bases.

The Republic of China City is the third outdoor location of Xiangshan Film and Television City, following the "City of the Condor Heroes" and "City of the Spring and Autumn Period and Warring States Period". The total construction area is 38000 square meters, and the film and television shooting scene is mainly characterized by the architectural features of the Republic of China period, including government office areas, embassy areas, commercial streets, hotels and other venues with Republican architectural features. The construction of the "Republic of China City" will change the scene characteristics of Xiangshan Film and Television City, which is mainly focused on shooting historical dramas, and meet the diverse themes and cross era filming needs of the crew.

poiName: Spring and Autumn and Warring States Movie Town
summary: The design of the Spring and Autumn Period and Warring States Period City is based on the theme concept of director Chen Kaige's film "The Orphan of Zhao". The entire city is full of the charm of the Qin and Han dynasties, and is divided into several blocks: city towers, city walls, Taoyuan Palace, poverty-stricken areas, Gongsun Mansion, Zhuangji Mansion, Tu'an Mansion, Zhao Dun Mansion, military camp area, streets, squares, etc. The architectural style is exquisite, majestic, and distinctive. The Spring and Autumn Period and Warring States Period Cultural Park mainly presents maps of the Spring and Autumn Period and Warring States Period, historical evolution videos of the entire period, images of the Five Hegemons of the Spring and Autumn Period, and portraits of representative figures from the three schools of Taoism, Confucianism, and military to tourists, with strong sound, light, and electrical technology; The Qipao Pavilion displays nearly 200 different styles and styles of Qipao from the 1920s to the present in China, reproducing the entire development process of Qipao history.

The Republic of China Grand Courtyard located in Xinan faces the former residence of Chiang Kai shek across the river, and is a themed cultural park that gathers the charm of the Republic of China in China. Here, we showcase the culture of the Republic of China, the Jiang family culture, the military culture of the Republic of China, and the traditional culture of Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism. If the remains of Fenghao House are the imprints of the significant history of the Republic of China, then what is portrayed here is the complex and diverse folk customs of the Republic of China, which enhances visitors' intuitive understanding of the culture of the Republic of China. The total area of the Republic of China Grand Courtyard is nearly 20000 square meters, and the interior is divided into seven exhibition halls. Here, a large number of precious objects with characteristics of the late Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China have been collected from scattered folk. The scenic spots turn back time and recreate the rich Republican atmosphere of neighborhoods and markets. The main building of the Republic of China Grand Courtyard is an exhibition hall, surrounded by corridor style buildings. There are numerous shops here, resembling a commercial workshop street of the Republic of China, almost a living version of "Tian Gong Kai Wu". Here, oil springs gush from the oil making workshop, bamboo pulp flows from the paper making workshop, and there are also rail cars, carp jumping over the dragon gate, moon boats, and tug of war boats - allowing visitors to fully enjoy themselves.
opening_hours: Opens at 08:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:30)

summary: The observatory is mainly responsible for local meteorological observations, as well as earthquake, timing, astronomy, and radiation monitoring.

The High Court of Hong Kong is a court of the Hong Kong judiciary, located adjacent to the Admiralty Government Offices. The Hong Kong High Court, which often appears in TVB TV dramas, is not very tall in architecture, but gives people a sense of solemnity and solemnity. Some publicly available cases are open for people to attend, where they can feel the majesty and democracy of Hong Kong's rule of law.

Tianxia Yuyuan is located in Dayin Town, Yuyao and is a popular man-made attraction among locals. Traces of jade can be found almost everywhere in the entire jade garden, and it is also a quite large park where the lake and mountain scenery, combined with artificially built temples and towers, can be considered beautiful and delicious. Upon entering the scenic area, the first thing that catches the eye is the water surface of Xiuhu Lake. On the small island in the middle stands a yellow jade, which is said to be priceless. This jade is also a symbol of the scenic area, suitable for taking commemorative photos of this visit. From here, there are five major scenic spots along Xiuhu: Xiyin Temple, Nantian Temple, Fenghuangtai, Xiuhu, and Yuyuan Gate Tower. You can walk or take the scenic electric scooter to get around. To the left along the lake, you can go to the jade exhibition hall, where there are many exquisite jade artifacts on display that are worth carefully studying. The Xiaoziyuan next to it is a Suzhou style garden, which can be walked around freely. To the right along the lake is the Scholar's Pavilion. There is a water corridor here, where you can walk to the lake and enjoy the scenery. Take a standard photo of Xiuhu Lake and the Jade Buddha Pagoda across from it. Climbing up to the Jade Buddha Pagoda and overlooking the panoramic view of the entire Jade Garden, it feels very spacious. Not far into the Jade Buddha Pagoda is the Xiyin Zen Temple, whose architecture imitates ancient palaces and is majestic. There are more than 20 jade Buddhas enshrined inside, all carved from Xiuyan flower jade, which is very unique and is also a scenic spot worth visiting in the entire Tianxia Jade Garden. Starting from Xiyin Temple and passing through the lush bamboo forest, one can admire the South Temple of Heaven, which was built in a 1:1 ratio with the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests at the Temple of Heaven in Beijing. In addition, it is not far from the Hemudu Site Museum, and there is plenty of time to visit together.

poiName: Hong Kong Avenue of Comic Stars
summary: The Hong Kong Comic Star Avenue is located in Kowloon Park and mainly displays 24 cartoon character painted sculptures with a height of about 1.8-3 meters, including Old Master Q, McDull, Chan Ho Nam, Bruce Lee, as well as copper handprints of 10 well-known Hong Kong comic artists. In addition, the Comic Star Avenue also has exhibits introducing the history, achievements, production process, and development of Hong Kong comics.
There are many exotic small restaurants, bars, and specialty handicraft shops on Rongshuwan Street. While tasting delicious food, people can also enjoy the beautiful sea view.

The headquarters building of the Independent Commission Against Corruption is located on Java Road and was designed and constructed by architect Guan Shanming. It includes multiple areas such as lecture rooms, exhibition halls, and simulated video interview rooms.

The seawater here is clean and clear, making it an ideal family vacation spot for swimming, diving, snorkeling, and playing in the sand. Besides the beach, there are many other attractions and activities here. You can stroll here and enjoy the beautiful sea view and natural scenery, or enjoy the sunshine and sea breeze on the beach.
This is a building with a long history, and the temple is very clean and tidy. It enshrines the goddess Tianhou, and many people come to pray.

poiName: Art Museum, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
summary: The Heritage Museum of The Chinese University of Hong Kong is located on the central campus of The Chinese University of Hong Kong. Appreciating the Chinese art and cultural exhibits in the museum amidst the rich humanistic atmosphere of the university campus will give you a different experience of China's long-standing cultural and artistic heritage. The Cultural Relics Museum is committed to collecting, preserving, researching, and exhibiting Chinese cultural relics such as painting, calligraphy, and various types of arts and crafts, and often holds exhibitions on cultural relics, art, and archaeology with different themes.

tagNameList: Campgrounds; Military Sites; Historical Sites; Islands/Peninsulas
summary: Donglongzhou, also known as Nantang Island, is located south of Qingshui Bay. There are gun emplacements left over from the Qing Dynasty and ancient cliff carvings on the island. In addition, Donglongzhou is also a site for rock climbing and hiking tourism, and many tourists enjoy camping or watching the sunrise over the sea.

Maozao Village was originally surrounded by thatched grass, with clear pond water and pots resembling lids on the mountain, hence the name of the village. There are numerous ancient trees with a history of over a hundred years in the village, and the natural resources are abundant. It is one of the top ten green new landscape villages in Ningbo City.

Wan Chai is a unique community where old and new coexist, blending the essence of old traditions with new developments. It is one of the regions with a long history and rich traditional cultural characteristics. Wan Chai has several well-known commercial buildings and skyscrapers, among which representative ones include Central Plaza and Times Square. Here, unique historical buildings, historic sites, and cultural relics are also preserved, such as the ancient post office in Wan Chai, the Hongsheng Ancient Temple that witnessed the development of the waterfront a century and a half ago, and the Beidi Temple that enshrines the bronze statue of Beidi.

poiName: bo gu yan shui lian dong
summary: The rock wall is as steep as a knife, the strange rocks are rugged, and the shape resembles a pigeon, hence the name. Boguyan fully demonstrates the magical charm of the "Water Curtain Cave".

Cicheng County Yamen was founded in Kaiyuan 26 of the Tang Dynasty (AD 738). It was built by the first Supervisor of the County Fangguan. It lasted to 1954 and has a history of more than 1200 years. Originally built on Fubi Mountain, due to foreign invasion and natural disasters, it has been repeatedly rebuilt and destroyed. The existing county government office was rebuilt according to the detailed drawings in the "Cixi County Annals" during the Guangxu period, covering an area of over 40000 square meters.

The Cicheng Confucian Temple is located at No. 55 Zhucang East Road, the center of Cicheng Town, Jiangbei District. It was built during the Qingli period of the Song Dynasty and was destroyed by the Jin invaders in the fourth year of Jianyan. It was rebuilt in the twelfth year of Shaoxing and has been repaired throughout history. In the eleventh year of the Xianmo reign, the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom army entered the city and destroyed Minglun Hall. In the eighth year of the Tongzhi reign, Minglun Hall was rebuilt. In the 18th year of the Guangxu reign, the Tiyun Pavilion and six study rooms were rebuilt. What is currently preserved is the architecture of the late Qing Dynasty. According to the measurement of the Qing Ministry of Works in the reign of Emperor Guangxu, it covers an area of 18.56 acres and has 137 houses such as shrines and pavilions. The layout is complete and the atmosphere is grand. The surrounding red high walls are inscribed with the four characters "Palace Wall Ten Thousand Rens", making it one of the well preserved Confucian temples in China.

The School Scholar Hall, also known as the Examination Hall or the Examination Shed among the people, was a place for selecting talents at the grassroots level under the feudal imperial examination system. Since ancient times, Cicheng Town has been surrounded by beautiful mountains and rivers, with a rich cultural heritage that inspires students. In the fifteenth year of the reign of Emperor Daoguang of the Qing Dynasty (1835), the local local scholar Zheng Tingrong and his son generously donated 24000 silver dollars to build the Cixi School Hall. The entire building faces north and south, consisting of 117 rooms including the main gate, ceremonial gate, main hall, corridors, and side rooms. From the perspective of layout design, it can be divided into a front yard and a back yard, which is a typical example of a Qing Dynasty architecture with three entrances and two courtyards. Forward is the main gate and the ceremonial gate, with a screen wall and two east-west gates in front of the main gate; On the right side of the gate, there are four small houses, and on the left side, there is a temple dedicated to the Earth God. There are six gatehouses built on the right side of Yimen. The second entrance is divided into two corridors on the left and right, which are the examination rooms. The middle of the bungalow is the entrance for candidates to enter the examination shed, commonly known as the "Dragon Gate". The door and window structures of the test room are identical. There are 69 rooms in total. Every three rooms are built with a ground wall, and a small courtyard is left outside. Only the south entrance and exit, lighting and ventilation can ensure that the entire test room has sufficient light sources, and can also avoid the pain of wind and rain. Each examination room has four examination tables and four chairs. During the exam, these ten square meters of space need to be divided into four compartments, with one person sitting in each compartment, resembling rows of birdcage style buildings, known as title houses. It can be imagined that back then, numerous students gathered here, sitting at their desks, holding their pens, displaying their papers, and taking exams to seek fame in this small examination shed. The main hall consists of five main rooms, with four side rooms on each side. There is a courtyard and five main rooms in the three entrances, and there are also five rooms facing south as the pre examination area, where candidates submit their papers and examiners seal them. Three Han (Yu) Changli Temples were built in the west, and three Huang (Zhen) Wenjie Temples were built in the east. There are five kitchens built in the northeast corner. The construction project was completed and put into use after one year of construction. The examination shed is equipped with all the necessary items for the examination room (such as test cases, screens, etc.), and is known as the "unprecedented" success of the Cixi imperial examination system.

Tantoushan Island is located between the Damu Ocean and the Maotou Ocean on the Xiangshan Peninsula, with an area of approximately 11 square kilometers and a coastline of 50 kilometers. The volcanic eruption has created undulating peaks on the island, and the rich vegetation has added a lot of wildness to hiking in the mountains. In the middle of the island, there are two beaches only tens of meters apart. The east beach faces the East China Sea and the west beach faces the mainland, so it is called "sisters Beach". Both beaches are sandy and delicate, and visitors can enjoy the wonder of the "Sand Embankment Dragon Well" here. The Dawang Palace, located at the southern end of the island, is a large natural village on Tantoushan Island. The people here are simple and honest, and it is a place for tourists to rest. Whether choosing to live in a residential area or tasting local seafood, visitors can experience the feeling of being at home. Tantoushan Island has also prepared numerous beach activities for people who love outdoor sports, ranging from beach volleyball, beach football, beach kites to wave tug of war, with all kinds of activities available. Besides enjoying the scenery, tourists can also fully satisfy their personalized needs.

A forest themed restaurant allows you to dine under the shade and in a beautiful environment, ensuring that every meal is full of fun. There are Lion King musical performances, boats to take you on a whitewater adventure, and rafts to take you to the tree house to see the life of Mount Taishan. There are also street performances in the forest, with bursts of drums and different musical rhythms, making everyone dance and fully display their wild side! The tribal drummer, dressed in colorful costumes, beats a beautiful rhythm and presents a highly distinctive trio to the guests, inviting you to join their jungle party! Let's dance to the beat together and take a dynamic photo of the drummer performing hard!

This is the Lingxiao Pavilion located on the locally elevated 360 degree observation deck, also known as the Skyscraper 428. Tourists can stand on the observation deck at an altitude of 428 meters and overlook the beautiful scenery of Hong Kong.

poiName: West Kowloon Waterfront Promenade East Gate

summary: Little World is a type of amusement facility located within Disneyland, where people ride small boats around the colorful world amidst the singing of children from all over the world.
This is a cruise project where people can take boats along the river to enjoy various wildlife and embark on exciting and fun adventure journeys.

Symphony of Lights is a local laser light and music show, completed in collaboration with skyscrapers and landmark buildings located on both sides of Victoria Harbour. It is a large-scale global light and music performance. Every night at 8 o'clock, people can see the urban buildings on both sides of Victoria Harbour transformed into a stage of sound and light interweaving with neon lights and music, showcasing the dazzling night scenery of the local city. The colorful lights emitted by each building illuminate the sky over Victoria Harbour, accompanied by music and narration, creating a dreamy, magnificent, and impactful atmosphere. The sound and light show starts at 8 o'clock every night and lasts for about 13 minutes. During these 13 minutes, performances can be watched for free on both sides of Victoria Harbour. A good place to watch is from the Star Avenue to the Tsim Sha Tsui seaside outside the Cultural Center, the Golden Bauhinia Square waterfront promenade in Wanchai, or the sightseeing ferry in Victoria Harbor. At the Tsim Sha Tsui Seaside Garden and the Golden Bauhinia Square Seaside Promenade, you can hear the live broadcast of the music and narration of Fantastic Scent Chanting the Xiangjiang River. On Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, English is played next to it, Mandarin is spoken on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, and Cantonese is played on Sundays. A regular performance on weekdays usually consists of five segments, where people can enjoy the gradient effect of colored lights on the exterior walls of buildings, the dancing of lasers and searchlights in the dark, and the colorful rotating light patterns resembling a kaleidoscope. If you choose the "Symphony of Lights" Victoria Harbour tour, you can be on a sightseeing cruise ship, enjoy the night view on both sides of Victoria Harbour, and also enjoy a sound and light show on the water surface, which can be said to kill two birds with one stone. People stand on the seaside side of Tsim Sha Tsui to watch the performance, and when they look around, they can see landmark buildings on Hong Kong Island such as the Bank of China Tower, HSBC, and the International Financial Center. With these buildings as the background, the performance will be even more spectacular. Located on this coastline, the seaside observation deck next to Tsim Sha Tsui Clock Tower and Star Ferry Pier is a great place to watch performances. If there are special festival days, you can also see fireworks set off on the rooftops of buildings and at sea. Since the end of 2007, the annual Rainbow Ode to Fragrant River has expanded into a large-scale New Year countdown event, starting with a regular light show. Before entering the new year, there will also be a fireworks display, with the fireworks set off accompanied by flickering laser lights. At midnight to welcome the new year, seven colored fireworks are sprayed out, which is very beautiful and stunning.

The Hall of Mental Cultivation was built during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty and is located on the west side of the Qianqing Palace in the inner court. It is an I-shaped hall with a front hall that is 7 bays wide and 3 bays deep. Each room is equipped with two square columns, giving it the appearance of nine rooms. The Hall of Mental Cultivation was the first palace in the Forbidden City to be fitted with glass. The emperor's throne is located in the center of the Ming Dynasty, with a plaque inscribed with the words "Zhongzheng Renhe" by Emperor Yongzheng. The "Dongnuan Pavilion" on the east side of the Ming Dynasty houses a throne, and to the west, it used to be the political office of Empress Dowager Cixi. The Xinuan Pavilion on the west side of Mingjian is divided into several rooms, including a small room for the emperor to read memorials and have secret conversations with ministers, the Sanxi Hall for Emperor Qianlong's study, as well as the Small Buddha Hall, Meiwu, and other places dedicated to offering Buddha and resting for the emperor. Now the Hall of Mental Cultivation is fully displayed in the original palace style and can be visited.

Introduction to the Ice Lantern Ice and Snow Carnival: The 38th Ice Lantern Ice and Snow Carnival in Longqingxia, Beijing is divided into four major areas, creating a "four week space": welcome and guidance area, light tour area, ice sculpture art area, and canyon ice surface area. Groups of ice lanterns and colorful lights not only contain people's rich wisdom and creativity, but also bring beautiful enjoyment to visitors. Combined with the clever design of sound, light, and electricity, the ice lantern art in Longqing Gorge is full of charm. The dazzling combination of colorful lights with rich technological content and design sense creates a dreamlike fairy tale world, and also makes tourists feel as if they are in the vast starry sea. Flying Dragon in the Sky "through drone flight performance. There is a hundred meter snow sculpture in the snow sculpture art area - the Dragon King's Rain Scene. In the Ice Sculpture Art Zone, there are Fengguan Island icebergs, integrating the game characters and scenes with the Longqing Gorge landscape, and innovating the unique secondary element scenes, aiming to attract the Z era, the post-00s, and the post-10s, and drive parents to revisit. In winter vacation, college students are invited to cosplay, play the anime game roles, and take photos with tourists. There are also Dragon Palace themes: the Sea God Needle, the Ocean World theme (fun ice sculptures featuring popular check-in scenes), mermaids, and flying swordfish. Experience the charm of the frozen 'CBD' at the spectacular ice waterfall.

The ski resort is located in Yanqing County, 80 kilometers away from downtown Beijing. It is a ski resort that uses artificial snow making and is also the first large-scale and well-equipped ski resort in the surrounding areas of Beijing. The ski resort adopts internationally advanced snow making equipment, with spacious ski slopes and a double decker cable car and four trailer cable cars. It can transport 600 skiers up the mountain per hour and is guided by experienced domestic coaches on site. It is suitable for skiers of all levels, including beginner, intermediate, and advanced. The ski resort also offers entertainment and fun activities for children, such as dog sleds and snow rings. In addition, the ski resort also has many popular recreational activities such as snowmobiles, horseback riding, archery, and gliding. In addition, the ski resort also has snow hot spring projects that are comparable to advanced ski resorts abroad, as well as a series of comprehensive service facilities such as catering, accommodation, and shopping.

poiName: quan wan xi yue hai bin chang lang
summary: This is a beautiful coastal corridor with pleasant scenery around it. There are also rest chairs along the way for tourists to rest, providing a great place for citizens to relax and play.

Yalu Ancient Tropical Botanical Garden was originally named Changli Jinyuan (Beijing) Tropical Botanical Garden, and was renamed to its current name in October 2014. It is currently the largest scenic area in Beijing with a wide variety of tropical plants and fruit trees. It is a comprehensive tourist attraction that combines tropical plant sightseeing, tropical fruit picking, science education, catering, accommodation, conferences, health and entertainment. Opened in October 2006, covering a total area of 300 acres with an investment of approximately 200 million yuan, it is located in Changziying Town, Daxing District. The sightseeing hall collects about 300 tropical and subtropical species, including tropical fruit trees, tropical beverage plants, tropical ornamental plants, tropical medicinal plants, palm plants, tropical endangered plants, tropical rare plants, and vegetable crops, and continuously introduces new varieties from both domestic and foreign sources. It is currently the tourist hall with a relatively complete range of tropical and subtropical species in Beijing. Tropical economic crops include coffee, cocoa, egg yolk fruit trees introduced from Cuba, phoenix trees with leaves like feathers of a phoenix and flowers like crowns of a phoenix, panda faces with silly textures, hence the name "Golden Panda Tree", yellow pear trees with grimace like textures, camphor trees that filter toxic air, mimosa trees that make people shy at first touch, bachelor trees that can be enjoyed together on Singles' Day, mysterious fruits that change people's taste, durian honey introduced from abroad, Indonesian fruit trees, Jiabao fruit trees with grapes attached to their trunks, breadfruit trees with a taste like bread, cinnamon trees that clear the lungs and slow down coughs, Jin Buyi trees that stop bleeding and slow down inflammation, and other famous rare fruit trees, trees, and trees. Horticultural plant varieties, as well as wild plant resources and rare species such as dinosaur trees from the same era as dinosaurs.

It includes dozens of unique pools, including tropical rainforest baths, cave baths, and ice and fire baths; Including a kilometer long fan-shaped fitness pool; Including two children's play pools of varying sizes, filled with ocean balls, various children's entertainment facilities, and interactive activities such as Bubble Carnival that children enjoy on weekends; Including dry and wet steaming, emperor salt bed, and stone slab warm bath, all are one ticket for free play; Also includes afternoon tea, free mineral water, and free tea water; You only need to bring your swimsuit and swim cap when you come. We provide slippers, bath towels, and a full set of bath and body care here, so you can use them with confidence! What sets us apart here is the presence of over a hundred tropical plants, and banana trees can even bear fruit! Our Longxi Hot Spring Water World is a natural oxygen bar that allows you to relax from the inside out!
This food street is a popular destination for local residents and tourists to taste delicious food, and it gathers a variety of local specialty snacks.

The Yunju Ski Resort is located in a natural valley area shielded by mountains, and its unique geographical environment makes it a natural shelter and creates a "microclimate". In winter, the temperature of the ski resort differs by 5 degrees from that of the city, and natural snowfall remains unchanged for a long time. The entire scenic area is "wrapped in silver and particularly enchanting", showcasing the beauty of northern China. Besides skiing, summer has also become a desirable destination for anglers. The Yunju Ski Resort is adjacent to the thousand year old temple - Yunju Temple, nestled in the embrace of the majestic Taihang Mountains. It is a blessed place where the Taihang Mountains embrace and the Buddha shines brightly. Climbing to the summit, looking north from the protective wall entrance, the spire of the pagoda at Yunju Temple seems within reach. The majestic Taihang Mountains are adorned with verdant cypress trees, resembling rows of soldiers marching through armor. Yunju Ski Resort has 8 senior, intermediate, and junior ski slopes, and is now open for junior, intermediate, and senior ski slopes. There are a total of 6 ski slopes, with a total length of 5000 meters, a maximum drop of 98 meters, and a maximum slope of 25 degrees. Two of the ski slopes, "Izumo" and "Feixian", have a total length of 1600 meters and a slope of 25 degrees at the peak, meeting the standards of advanced ski slopes in China. They resemble auspicious and sacred Hadas, winding down from both sides of the peak and drawing two beautiful curves in the scenic area. The silver shimmer on the surface of Yunju Lake is a paradise for ice skating and ice spinning enthusiasts, as well as a playground for children to play.

Yunju Temple is located in Fangshan District, Beijing, about 70 kilometers away from the city center by car. It was founded in the Sui Dynasty and has a long history. Since ancient times, people have carved scriptures on the stone slabs of Yunju Temple, and the small mountain of Shijing Mountain on the back of the temple is also named after it. Nowadays, Yunju Temple is a popular place for worshipping Buddha and praying for blessings, and the incense here is very strong. The embodiment of the spirit is the physical Buddha relics discovered in the temple. Many pilgrims come here to pay their respects and pray for themselves and their loved ones. Offering incense in the temple requires purchasing incense from the temple, which costs about 10 yuan. There is an exhibition room for stone tablet scriptures on the small hill behind Yunju Temple, some of which are still displayed outside the underground palace. You can freely stroll around and watch the stone tablet scriptures. In addition, there is a millennium old pagoda on the back mountain, built in the Tang Dynasty, full of vicissitudes and suitable for photography.

Miaofeng Mountain Scenic Area is located in Ximentougou District, Beijing, 55 kilometers away from the city center, with a total area of approximately 20 square kilometers. The scenic area is famous for its "ancient temples", "strange pines", "strange rocks", and "exotic flowers". Belonging to the remaining branches of Taihang Mountain, the main peak has an altitude of 1291 meters and is steep. It has seasonal landscapes such as sunrise, sunset, rime, and mountain markets, as well as thousands of acres of roses. There are also large-scale traditional worship events in North China. Miaofeng Mountain has become one of the scenic spots around Beijing. In 2005, it was rated as a national AAA level tourist attraction.

Yangmei Zhuxie Street is located southwest of Qianmen Gate, starting from Coal Market Street in the east and ending at Yanshou Street in the west. In the Ming Dynasty, it was called "Xiejie" because its direction tilted from northeast to southwest, hence the name. Yangmei Zhuxie Street used to be a cultural street, where Liang Shizheng, a Grand Secretary of the East Pavilion during the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty, and modern literary figure Shen Congwen both lived. Nowadays, there is a back door of Qingyun Pavilion on the street, made of green bricks, with a stone plaque reading "Qingyun Pavilion" on the door. Some design studios and independent brand stores have also moved in here, where you can feel the unique cultural charm.

Regarding Baishi Street, before the Opium War, many foreign ships had anchored in the Jinxingmen area of Qi'ao Island. In October 1833, a serious conflict broke out between foreign opium sailors and villagers of Qi'ao Village. Foreign opium smugglers organized more than ten armed sampans and fired at Qi'ao Village. Qi'ao villagers fought back and repelled their attack. On the eve of the Opium War, the Chinese people spontaneously fought against the invasion of foreign colonialists on a larger scale and at an earlier time. It was eight years earlier than the Sanyuanli Anti British War in Guangzhou and played an important role in the history of modern Chinese foreign relations. To this day, the village still retains the command center that resisted the invaders back then - the Temple of the Heavenly Queen and the Battery. The people of Qi'ao Island fearlessly defeated the invading colonial aggressors in 1833, forcing them to surrender and compensate with three thousand taels of silver. The local villagers built a 2-kilometer-long granite 'Baishi Street' with compensation to ensure that future generations will remember the glorious history of the descendants of the Yellow Emperor's victory against foreign aggression and inspire them to love their motherland even more. Currently, it is well preserved on the island.

The mangrove forests in Zhuhai are mainly distributed on Qi'ao Island, Hengqin Island, and Hongqi West Embankment. Among them, the wetland area in Dawei Bay, northwest of Qi'ao Island, is relatively large and is currently a well preserved and concentrated forest area in the city, with tree heights of 4-6 meters. It is not only a resource of Zhuhai, but also a mangrove wetland in the the Pearl River Delta, and one of the few mangrove areas close to big cities in China. The Qi'ao Mangrove Reserve is located in the northwest of Qi'ao Island. The reserve has 695 species of vascular plants and 347 species of wild animals, including 15 species of true mangrove plants and 9 species of semi mangrove plants. Mangrove forests growing on beaches are not only windproof and sand fixing forests, but also excellent habitats and breeding grounds for birds and marine organisms. They are also one of the three major migration routes for migratory birds in China, with tens of thousands and over 90 species of migratory birds inhabiting them in autumn and winter.

Dong'ao Island is more famous for the Qiuzi Spring Scenic Area. The White Marble statue of Goddess of Mercy as a gift in the scenic area brings infinite hope to many young couples. It is said that a young man and woman caught a red scaleless fish, which is the daughter of the South China Sea Dragon King. In order to repay them, they fulfilled their wish to have children by drinking the spring water from the mountaintop every day. This news quickly spread, and strangely enough, there are currently three pairs of twin twins living in this area. Many newlyweds come here to drink water and pray for twins.

Mangzhou Wetland Park is shaped like a peninsula and has six functional areas: ecological promotion and exhibition area, wetland original ecological conservation area, wetland ecological exhibition area, wetland leisure experience area, seawall original ecological plant viewing area, and management service area. There are also many modern buildings such as three moon gazing towers and a nine curved wooden wharf. At Mangzhou Park, you can feel the tranquility and tranquility, making it a great place for leisure and fitness.

The Iceberg Roller Coaster offers a rare combination of drifting experience, allowing you to take a drifting boat deep into polar glaciers, visit polar bear villages in snowy areas, observe precious brown bears up close, and experience the thrill of the roller coaster running wildly in the deep valleys of icebergs and floating in icy snow lakes!
The children quickly climbed onto the observation tower and paid attention to the movements of the sea ahead. Let's help each other and contribute to the protection of the ocean!

Yunju Temple is located in Shuitou Village, Dashiwo Town, Fangshan District, southwest Beijing, 70 kilometers away from the city center. The Yunju Temple, Shijingshan Cave, and Tang Liao Pagoda Group constitute a treasure trove of Chinese Buddhist cultural characteristics. Yunju Temple was first built in the late Sui and early Tang dynasties, initially named "Zhiquan Temple" and later renamed "Yunju Temple". The temple covers an area of 0.07 square kilometers and has undergone successive renovations, forming five large courtyards and six entrance halls. It was destroyed by Japanese artillery fire in the 1940s and underwent two large-scale repairs after liberation. Yunju Temple is a national 4A level tourist attraction and a key cultural relic protection unit.

The Shougang Industrial Site Park is located in Lianshi Lake, the largest lake of Yongding River in Shijingshan. Shijingshan District is divided into three sections from north to south according to the natural flow of Yongding River, and three theme parks are built. The middle section is the Shougang area, and a total area of 70 hectares of Shougang Waterfront Park - Shougang Industrial Site Park is constructed. In January 2018, it was selected for the first batch of China's industrial heritage protection list.

JD Grand Canyon is about 90 kilometers away from the center of Beijing by car, and it is very convenient to travel back and forth in one day from Beijing for sightseeing. The Grand Canyon boasts beautiful mountains and clear waters, surrounded by towering peaks, making it perfect for relaxing, exercising, sightseeing, and taking photos. There are also glass walkway, cableway, slide and other entertainment projects in the scenic area, which are very exciting. The suitable season for visiting JD Grand Canyon is summer, which is suitable for escaping the heat and cooling off, while other seasons are relatively cold. The general route for tourists to visit scenic spots is to first walk and explore the canyon, which is about 3 kilometers long. There are some landscapes in the canyon that can be visited. Then take the cableway at the end of the canyon to reach the top of the well platform, where you can enjoy the mountain scenery from the observation deck. Then take the slide or sightseeing bus directly back to the ticket office of the scenic area, or return to the cableway station and take the cableway back from the original route inside the canyon. However, the slide is a highlight within the scenic area, and most tourists choose to take the slide down the mountain. Play the entire scenic area for about 3-4 hours. There is a lake at the entrance of the scenic area where you can experience boating activities, with a fee of approximately 30 yuan per person. Further walking inward, you will enter the canyon, which requires climbing upwards for about 3 kilometers and can be completed in 1 hour. There are many trees in the canyon, as well as several ponds and waterfalls. The environment is good and very cool, suitable for relaxing and exercising in summer. There are also landscapes and entertainment such as Guanyin Temple, Sleeping Buddha, and Tiesuo Bridge in the valley, which can be visited one by one. It should be noted that most of the entertainment activities along the way require additional fees, so be sure to inquire before playing. The end of the canyon is where you can take the cableway to reach the top of the well platform. The terrain on Jingtai Mountain is flat and the view is very wide. There are several observation decks at the top of the mountain, which can overlook the distant mountains and hills, which is very spectacular. After playing at the top of Jingtai Mountain, you can go down the mountain with three options: a slide, a sightseeing bus, and returning along the original cable car route. However, most tourists choose to take the slide, which is four kilometers long and takes about 15 minutes to slide from the top of the mountain to the bottom. It is very exciting and also a highlight project in the scenic area.

Shilin Gorge is mainly characterized by natural scenery such as canyons, cliffs, stone forests, and waterfalls, with beautiful mountains and clear waters and a beautiful environment. There are also amusement projects such as carousel, VR tank, cute pet amusement park, bumper car, etc. inside the scenic area. Outside the scenic area, there are resorts, farmhouses, etc. It is a good place for weekend vacation and entertainment in the suburbs of Beijing and also one of the summer resorts. The sightseeing time and route refer to the Shilin Gorge Scenic Area, which is relatively large with a depth of about 5-6 kilometers. It is mainly composed of a Shilin Mountain and a canyon. Shilin Mountain is divided into a front mountain and a back mountain. Tourists can climb from the front mountain to the top, descend from the back mountain, and then return to the entrance of the scenic area along the canyon's boardwalk. The altitude of Shilin Mountain is about 700 meters, and it takes about 3 hours to climb. The entire journey takes about 5-6 hours to walk and play. The entrance to the exciting entertainment project scenic area is located on the east side. Upon entering, you will first arrive at the location of an entertainment project, which includes VR tanks, cute pet amusement parks, bumper cars, carousels and other amusement projects. Those interested can experience them. Along the way, the scenery is beautiful, and then you can climb from the front mountain through the boardwalk. The mountain is over 700 meters high and takes about 3 hours to climb. It requires a certain amount of physical strength. If the physical strength is not enough, you can also choose the cableway, which can take tourists to a place several tens of meters away from the top of the mountain. The scenery of Qianshan is mainly forest scenery, and you can also overlook Shilin Lake at the foot of the mountain from the mountain, which is very beautiful. On the way to climb the mountain, you will pass by several scenic spots such as Songshupo, Guanhu Pavilion, and Mu Shuai Tree, which you can enjoy. After reaching the mountaintop area, the view is wide and you can overlook the stone forest scenery below, steep and beautiful, very spectacular. There are also attractions such as the first drum in China, the first bell in ancient and modern times, and the first gong in northern China. You can ring the bell and drum by yourself, which is quite interesting. After visiting the mountaintop, you can descend from the back mountain and see attractions such as Lover's Valley and Lingzhi Pavilion. After reaching the foot of the mountain, I returned along the boardwalk in the canyon. Along the way, there were towering and steep cliffs on both sides, as well as many strange shaped boulders, which were very fantastic and magnificent. Rivers, waterfalls, and other attractions are scattered throughout it, and it is also very beautiful. Every summer, this place is even cooler and more pleasant, making it a great place to escape the heat. On the way, you will pass by attractions such as Jiutian Waterfall, Yixiantian, and Yinyutan, which you can visit one by one.

Beijing Pinggu Tianyunshan Tourist Scenic Area is located in Huangtuliang, Huangsongyu Township, Pinggu District, Beijing, 10 kilometers away from Jingdong Cave. There are peaks, strange rocks, and beautiful mountains and forests here. There are flowing waterfalls in the mountains, and the environment is very good. The Cuiping Peak, Lianhua Peak, Siguniang Mountain, Yuping Peak and other peaks in the scenic area have their own characteristics and are worth visiting. Zhenlu Temple, Niangniang Temple, and Tianhe Palace have added profound cultural heritage to the scenic area, allowing visitors to climb mountains to visit ancient times, worship Buddha, and pray for blessings.

Wanping City is located east of Lugou Bridge. In the 13th year of the Chongzhen reign of the Ming Dynasty (1640), this city was built and originally named Gongbei City. Wanping Plain was one of the capital cities under the jurisdiction of Shuntian Prefecture in the Ming Dynasty, and was renamed Gongji City in the Qing Dynasty. On December 1, 1928, the Wanping County Office was relocated to the original Gongji City of Lugouqiao and renamed Wanping City. It has now been renamed Lugouqiao Town. Wanping City is a bridgehead with city wall architecture similar to Beijing. There are two city gates. There are battlements and observation holes on the outer side of the city wall, with shooting holes below, and each battlement has a cover plate. Wanping Plain was one of the capital cities under the jurisdiction of Shuntian Prefecture in the Ming Dynasty, and was renamed Gongji City in the Qing Dynasty. Because Wanping was built for military purposes at that time, although its city system was small, its shape and structure were different from ordinary county towns when it was first built. The interior of the city did not have facilities such as streets, alleys, markets, bell and drum towers that are typical of county towns. There are only two gates in the city, east and west, and both have moats and city walls. The entire city wall is relatively thick and strong, mainly conducive to defending the capital. Wanping City is a well preserved two door fortress in North China. The Ming Dynasty, in order to defend the capital and defend itself from entering the capital, ordered the eunuch Wu Jun to oversee the construction of this city from 1638 to 1640, known as the "Gongji City". In December 1928, the Wanping County Government moved into the city and was renamed Wanping City. The city is divided into two gates, the Shunzhi Gate to the east and the Yongchang Gate to the west (changed to the Weiwei Gate in the Qing Dynasty). The city is 640 meters long from east to west and 320 meters wide from north to south, with a total area of about 20 hectares.
Zhuhai Gongbei Pedestrian Street is an old street that is not long and is mostly filled with local shops. Tourists are also mostly old Zhuhai people, making it a place for daily leisure walks.

The Xiqu Garden is located in the northeast corner of the Summer Palace. Due to its small and exquisite size, it stands out in the Summer Palace and is known as the "Garden of Gardens". There is a Zhiyu Bridge in Xiqu Garden, which is close to the water surface for easy observation of fish and is a symbol of Xiqu Garden. This small garden was built during the reign of Emperor Qianlong in the Qing Dynasty, imitating the Jichang Garden at the foot of Huishan in Wuxi. It is an independent district with a southern garden style. There are thirteen pavilions, terraces, halls, and pavilions in the park, which are connected by a hundred corridors and five bridges of different forms.

poiName: Summer Palace Ice and Snow Carnival
summary: The Summer Palace Ice and Snow Carnival is located on West Lake in the Summer Palace, adjacent to the west gate of the Summer Palace. With a design that is close to nature, we have created ice and snow amusement projects such as ice and snow bikes, snow turns, and yo yo balls. Most tourists come as families or in groups of three or five friends, and come to the Summer Palace Ice and Snow Carnival to experience the ice and snow amusement projects together and enjoy the fun of ice and snow.

The Yuanmingyuan Exhibition Hall is located in the Yuanmingyuan Ruins Park in Beijing, on the west side of the Yuanyingguan Site in the Xiyanglou Scenic Area. The exhibition hall consists of two exhibition halls, with the majority of the first and second halls focusing on the construction and grandeur of the Yuanmingyuan; The second exhibition hall contains relevant materials on the death and revival of the Yuanmingyuan. There are 150 exhibits on display in the exhibition hall, including panoramic bird's-eye oil paintings that recreate the grandeur of the Yuanmingyuan, panoramic sand tables, "Forty Scenes of Yuanmingyuan" and "Twenty Scenes of Western style Buildings" that showcase the beautiful national forest architectural landscape of Yuanmingyuan in the past, as well as architectural models of some scenic spots, historical photos and related books and some physical objects that reflect the theme of Yuanmingyuan's robbery and recovery.

Xishan Hot Spring Resort is located in Haidian District, Beijing, and is a comprehensive hot spring scenic area adjacent to the Summer Palace, Yuanmingyuan, and Tsinghua University. The spring water of the hot springs comes from the original ecological rich mineral hot springs created 3000 meters below the Xishan Mountains. There are more than 20 indoor and outdoor pools for bathing and health preservation, including sweat baths, fish therapy, children's pools, medicinal springs, public springs, quiet springs, strange springs and other different styles of pools. It has a unique Southeast Asian style and is a beautiful destination for vacation, leisure and health preservation. The resort covers an area of over 60000 square meters and includes six major entertainment areas, making it a leisure scenic spot suitable for all ages. The scenic area includes six major areas: 1 Underground Level 1: Beijing Lying Health Space is filled with cherry blossoms, Hanfu time travel, Werewolf killing, boiling tea around the stove, playing chess, Go, and Gomoku, all of which are free. The 2500 square meter large leisure space includes a thermal steamer, tent area, sleep bank, health tribe, and movie watching area, with plenty of leisure options to choose from! 2. First floor hot spring area: King Hot Spring in the hot spring center, Women's World, infinity pool, indoor hot spring constant temperature water park or dreamy macaron color scheme, panoramic creation of Tibetan medicine characteristic hot spring hall, kissing fish pool, spa area, waist strengthening pool, as well as different types of red wine pool, fruit pool, etc. for you to choose from. The outdoor hot spring area is also filled with bird songs and fragrant flowers. 3. Activity area on the second floor+child care: The 2500 square meter Magic Space is open to all ages in terms of facilities, scenes, and experience modes. It features party billiards and starry sky camping that adults enjoy, as well as mini kitchens and sand mining activities that children love to play in. The Magic Space also has a specially designed stage for both adults and children to participate in magic activities. Every day, various exciting performances are held throughout the venue. Candy Club's child care upgrade is free of charge throughout the day, allowing children to play with our happy partners and adults to have a more relaxed time. The magical space is designed with the concept of "traveling through a circus" to create a space for children to explore freely, allowing parents to have a better parent-child experience with their babies. 4. Second floor restaurant area: The Four Seasons Restaurant can accommodate more than 600 people for dining at the same time. The Four Seasons Restaurant is paired with the Happy Bar, which is quiet and elegant. There are nearly a hundred buffet items, and you can choose between lunch and dinner. Crayfish, salmon, and Beijing roast duck are must try! There are also Chinese hot dishes, dessert area, and noodle area. Wine and beverage area, unlimited food! Free late night snacks are also provided! 5. Fifth floor club: Blue Parrot Sports Club, a 2500 square meter club, is a paradise for adults and children to play! There are many trendy electronic areas, ball sports, archery, plum blossom stakes, bowling, go karting, rock climbing, zip lines, and sports arenas... Experience speed and passion, and enjoy the whole day! 6. Magic Space sets up different themed activities for different seasons and holidays, equipped with candy club childcare, mini kitchen (for a fee), cute pet playground, treasure hunting playground (for a fee), city avenue, M-show activities, billiards (for a fee), free werewolf killing activities, children's handmade DIY activities, etc. A group of happy partners accompany you to have fun!

The ski resort covers an area of 80000 square meters and has 2 primary tracks, 1 intermediate track, and 1 teaching track. It adopts a magic carpet transportation mode and has 4 magic carpets. It is one of the ski resorts in the suburbs of Beijing that is friendly to junior skiers and is closer to the city, combining skiing and leisure vacation. It fully meets the needs of junior skiers and family snow vacations. The ski resort has a 1500 square meter ski equipment hall, equipped with more than 3000 sets of professional ski equipment, international hardware facilities, and a professional service team. It is committed to creating a beginner's paradise and ski training ground with a better skiing experience in the suburbs of Beijing, allowing every skier to experience professional, caring, safe, and meticulous service at the ski resort. The ski resort is equipped with a snow amusement park, which integrates various snow activities such as snowmobiles, snow rings, and snow turns, allowing snow enthusiasts to not only experience the fun of skiing, but also experience the infinite joy of skiing here. In addition, the ski resort is open for night skiing, which has become a popular skiing fashion among lake fans. The white snow trails and warm yellow lights complement each other, allowing you to experience the romance and dreams of a snowy night under the starry sky. Jingzhi Lake Ski School is equipped with over a hundred professional full-time coaches, and has developed a complete teaching system suitable for Chinese skiing beginners by integrating international advanced teaching methods such as the New Zealand Ski Coach Alliance (NZSIA) and the British Ski Coach Association (Bass). This allows skiing enthusiasts to quickly master skiing skills in the international skiing guidance and teaching process, enabling skiing novices to fully experience a warm, comfortable, professional, and safe skiing experience on their first snow trip, leaving behind beautiful memories of their skiing experience. In order to better serve novice skiers, during the 2021-2022 snow season, the ski school has launched a service commitment of "refunding the same day's teaching fee if the teaching is not satisfactory", which greatly improves the satisfaction of skiing experience and truly fulfills the promise of "falling in love with skiing starts from the Lake of Tranquility"!

poiName: jing zhi hu du jia qu
summary: Jingzhi Lake Scenic Area is located in Taoyukou City level Tourist Resort, Xingshou Town, Changping District, Beijing, 28 kilometers away from the Asian Games Village, with convenient transportation. Located between mountains and waters with an average altitude of 86 meters, the Jingzhi Lake Municipal Forest Park covers an area of over 5000 acres. It is situated in front of the Taoyukou Reservoir and backed by the undulating Yanshan Mountains, with a clear blue sky and year-round air quality; Sitting in a garden full of fruit trees, you can enjoy peach blossoms in spring, pick morning dew in summer, step on red leaves in autumn, and ski in winter. Here, far away from the hustle and bustle and pollution of the city, one can immerse oneself in tranquility and peace, which is a choice to "replenish oxygen" for the body and mind.

When Yong'an Temple was first built, the buildings inside the temple included Zhengjue Hall, Pu'an Hall, Shengguo Hall, Zongjing Hall, Corner Room, Shunshan Room, and White Pagoda. Take a jungle roller coaster ride with your family and travel through the jungle under cool guidance, experiencing the great adventure of battling piranhas and bumblebees, and experiencing a unique journey of rapid descent and high-speed turns in an instant.

The Rossini Watch Museum is located in Rossini Watch Industrial Park, No. 68 Keji 6th Road, High tech Zone, Zhuhai City, Guangdong Province. It is the first watch culture museum in South China, showcasing and interpreting watch culture and international level modern watchmaking craftsmanship, and presenting a panoramic view of China's ancient statistical time culture and modern watch manufacturing technology. The Rossini Watch Museum is located in the new Rossini headquarters park, which integrates design and research and development, production and manufacturing, brand operation, sightseeing and tourism, and has many characteristics such as science popularization, viewing, participation, entertainment and leisure.
