poiName: Van Gogh Star Sky Art Museum (Zhuhai Flagship Store)
summary: The Van Gogh Starry Sky Art Museum is an indoor art exhibition with the theme of the new generation of Van Gogh Starry Sky. It fully adopts advanced technologies such as spatial visual illusion and viewing effects, completely transforming the famous paintings that were originally presented on a flat surface into a realistic 4D cool scene that can be touched, entered, and enjoyed freely. Interactive products such as Dream Time Tunnel, Dream Mirror Maze, Kiss of the Century, Nordic Starry Sky, Interstellar Travel, and Love in the Starry Sky are all showcased. Among them, the Magic Mirror Maze is quite mysterious, completely subverting the existing art exhibition form and presenting a magical space for tourists, creating one of the trendy and fantastic internet celebrity check-in destinations in Zhuhai and a fun and interesting parent-child entertainment world.
Boyuan Tea Village is located in Taiping Town, Wanli, Nanchang. The environment here is beautiful and the scenery is pleasant, making it a great place for leisure and entertainment.

Nanchang Rongchuang Cultural Tourism City is located on the banks of Jiulong Lake in Honggutan New District, Nanchang City, covering an area of 160 hectares. It has six major formats including Rongchuang Amusement Park, Sea World, Film World, Rongchuang Mall, high-end hotel cluster, and Binhu Bar Street. It is a landmark vacation city with Ganpo characteristics that integrates vacation, tourism, culture, commerce, and other contents.

Yudushan Scenic Area is located in the deep mountains northwest of Yanqing County, with beautiful scenery, tranquil environment, and a primitive natural atmosphere. The streams in the scenic area flow continuously throughout the four seasons, with different scenery in spring, summer, autumn, and winter, swaying and colorful. It is a good place for traveling around Beijing. The core attraction of Yudu Mountain Scenic Area, Yudu Mountain, has an elevation of about 930 meters. It was named "Yiduo Mountain" because the villagers saw it as a pile of firewood. Almost all the mountains here are connected by mountains, and only this mountain is independent, so some villagers also call it "Lidui Mountain", which means to exist independently from the group. After the development of the scenic area, it was named "Yudu Mountain". Later, in order to express the natural beauty of the scenic area with mountains and water, it was renamed "Yudu Mountain" based on its homophonic sound. Climbing up to the top of Yudu Mountain, you can see three straight and upright pine trees on the opposite mountain, arranged in a straight line. People call them "Three Incense Burners". There used to be a small temple on the mountaintop called "Jade Emperor Temple", but now the temple has been destroyed, leaving only the wall foundation and broken bricks. If you have enough physical strength, you can also hike along the red ribbon sign from the three-way intersection, where the ups and downs and the dark green interweave into a beautiful landscape painting, allowing you to get up close to the original ecological scenery here.

The World Trade Center is located on the east side of Dongdaqiao Road on the Yingbin National Highway, serving as the gateway to the western district of Beijing's CBD. It has been designated as a key government project by the Chaoyang District Government and has become the flagship business of the CBD. The World Trade Center is positioned as a leisure shopping venue that combines food, entertainment, spatial art, and fashion information showcases to meet the full sensory journey of viewing, listening, smelling, tasting, and touching. It provides popular fashion retail formats and commercial service facilities for middle and high-income white-collar workers in the CBD, integrating regional themed restaurants, home living Spa、 Food court and brand flagship store are equivalent to one. The World Trade Center consists of two commercial corridors and two office buildings on the north and south wings, as well as outdoor venues such as a staircase square. The commercial corridor is built entirely of stone, with a modern style and a rich and elegant connotation.

No matter how you look at it, the new building of CCTV headquarters is renowned worldwide for its unique design. It was designed by OMA under the leadership of German Ole Scheeren and Dutchman Koolhaas. The building has an avant-garde appearance and was selected as one of the top ten architectural wonders in the world in 2007 by Time. The CCTV new site park consists of three buildings: the CCTV main building located on the southwest side, the TV Culture Center located on the northwest side, and the Energy Service Center located on the northeast corner. The main building, also known as the "Big Pants" in folk culture, consists of two towers rising from a common platform and converging at the top to create a three-dimensional visual experience, breaking through the conventional vertical shape of skyscrapers. The main building is mainly divided into five areas: administrative management area, comprehensive business area, news production and broadcasting area, broadcasting area, and program production area, among which the program production area is partially open to the public.

The Xiangshan Temple Site is located within Xiangshan Park in Beijing. Xiangshan Temple has a long history. According to records, there were already two temples in Ji'an and Xiangshan during the Tang Dynasty. In 1186, the two temples were merged and named "Dayong'an Temple" by Emperor Zhangzong of Jin. During the Jin, Yuan, and Ming dynasties, Xiangshan Temple was continuously renovated. In the Qing Dynasty, Emperor Kangxi converted Xiangshan into a palace and Xiangshan Temple became a royal temple. Yuanxiangshan Temple was built along the mountain, with a staggered and magnificent layout, and was once the crown of all temples in Xishan. To the north of the ancient temple stands the first four pillar, three room soaring archway of Xiangshan Yong'an Temple, and a shopping street has been added. A large White Marble screen was added in front of the hall, on which were engraved Guanyin, Samantabhadra, ancient Buddha burning lanterns and Buddhist scriptures inscribed by Emperor Qianlong. Unfortunately, in 1860 and 1900, the ancient temple was burned down by the British and French Allied Forces and the Eight Nation Allied Forces respectively. Only relics such as the Zhi Le Hao, Ting Fa Song, Suo Luo Shu imperial stele, and stone screen remain, as well as some ancient pine and cypress trees and ginkgo trees, which still reveal some of the grandeur of the past.

Shuangqing Villa is located on the southeast side of Xiangshan Park in Beijing. It is named after the two clear springs in the courtyard and is one of the 28 scenic spots of Xiangshan that Emperor Qianlong inscribed. During the Qing Dynasty, this was the former site of the royal garden "Songwu Mountain Villa" in Jingyi Garden. Later, it was converted into the Shuangqing Villa by the civilian educator Xiong Xiling. The villa area has an elegant environment, attracting visitors with its lush bamboo forests, sun blocking ginkgo trees, tall pine and cypress trees, and quaint buildings. In 1949, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China worked in Jingyi Park. There is a hexagonal red pavilion in the center of the courtyard, next to a pool of water, and two air raid shelters built by the People's Liberation Army behind the mountain.

poiName: Zhongguo Ke Xueyuan Zhiwu Yanjiusuo Beijing Botanical Garden
summary: The Beijing Botanical Garden of the Institute of Botany of the Chinese Academy of Sciences is located in Xiangshan South Road, Haidian District, Beijing, bordering the Beijing Botanical Garden in the north and Xiangshan Park in the west. Compared to the Beijing Botanical Garden in the north, people prefer to call this place Nanzhi. The Beijing Botanical Garden of the Institute of Botany of the Chinese Academy of Sciences was built in 1956 with the approval of the Central People's Government under the initiative of academician Yu Dejun and other older botanists. Its positioning is: (1) a reserve of national strategic plant resources; (2) Research base for ex situ conservation and sustainable utilization of plant diversity in northern China; (3) National Science Popularization Education Base. The botanical garden currently has a land area of 74 hectares, including an exhibition area of 20.7 hectares. It has 15 specialized parks and 1 tropical plant exhibition greenhouse, collecting and preserving more than 7000 species of plants; We have established a North China branch of wild plant germplasm resources (including seed bank, plant in vitro bank, and DNA material bank) to support and serve the "135" plan of the Institute of Botany and the construction of the Institute of Ecological Grassland and Animal Husbandry Characteristics. The botanical garden focuses on collecting and preserving wild plant resources from temperate regions in northern China and regions with similar global ecological environments. It focuses on investigating, collecting, and conserving rare and endangered plants, endemic plants, and native plants in North China, while also conducting research on the collection and functional evaluation of important resource plants, the excavation and regulation of key genes, and the creation and application of excellent germplasm. Guided by the "Science Popularization of High end Scientific Research Resources" plan and the "Science and China Science Education" plan of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the Botanical Garden has carried out in-depth public science education activities. It has received more than 250000 public science popularization visits annually, more than 3000 surgical education visits in primary and secondary schools, and has been awarded the titles of National Science Popularization Education Base, National Science Popularization Base, National Forestry Science Popularization Base, National Wildlife Protection Science Popularization Education Base, National Youth Science and Technology Education Base, National Primary and Middle School Students Research Practice Education Base, Beijing Science Popularization Base, Beijing Primary and Middle School Students Society Large Classroom Resource Unit, etc.

poiName: Xiangshui Lake Great Wall Natural Scenic Area
summary: Xiangshui Lake Great Wall is a natural scenic area with both ancient Great Wall and beautiful mountain and water scenery such as canyons and waterfalls. Tourists can climb the Great Wall, stroll among the mountains and waters, and also stay in rural areas to experience the fresh and peaceful rural life in the mountains. It is a good place for outdoor trips around Beijing. Overview of the Scenic Area: The Great Wall of Xiangshui Lake in Beijing is located in Dazhenyu Village, Bohai Town, Huairou District, 10 kilometers away from Mutianyu Great Wall. The scenic area covers an area of 18 square kilometers, with numerous peaks and abundant water sources; The pond and waterfall are connected, and the water quality is clear; The trees are dense and the resources are abundant. The vegetation coverage rate is 95%, and the negative oxygen ion content is 9300/cm3. The Great Wall of Xiangshui Lake was built in the second year of the Yongle reign of the Ming Dynasty (1404) and is known for its unique dangers. Among them, the (Tianshi Jintang) Cliff Carvings, the Tiangou Xiongguan Grinding Stone Mouth, the Great Wall Link Beijing Knot, the Jade Tower, and the towering Lu'an Ridge are all located within the scenic area. In recent years, Xiangshui Lake Scenic Area has launched the "Plum Blossom Great Wall," "Herbal Great Wall," "Colorful Great Wall," and "Red Great Wall" cultural Great Wall four part series based on the Great Wall Cultural Belt, making it a historical film of Huairou Great Wall, a business card of Great Wall tourism, and a chip of Great Wall spirit. Nowadays, the highly anticipated "Beijing Great Wall Plum Blossom Festival", the 2.5-kilometer-long "Cool Valley Outside the Great Wall", the thousands of acres of dried and fresh fruit picking garden, and the Great Wall Red Pavilion, which promotes patriotism, have all gathered into the four major tourism brands of Xiangshui Lake Scenic Area and are increasingly favored by more and more citizens. It is particularly worth mentioning that at the 2019 World Horticultural Exposition, the Great Wall plum blossom green calyx variety "Jade Bone Qingjia" exhibited in Xiangshui Lake Scenic Area won the gold medal. Xiangshui Lake Scenic Area has convenient transportation and complete service facilities. There is an elegant and unique antique style villa built in the scenic area, surrounded by mountains and waters. It has 60 guest rooms, as well as a large conference room that can accommodate 110 people and a small conference room that can accommodate 50 people. It can accommodate 110 people for conference accommodation and 400 people for meals at the same time. It is an ideal place for conferences, training, study tours, and vacations. There are two ways to play the Great Wall of Xiangshui Lake. One is to travel back and forth on the same day without staying in the scenic area. You can directly purchase tickets to enter the scenic area. It is recommended to go up the mountain directly from the "winding path" to travel around the entire scenic area. Another way is to stay overnight in the scenic area, where the accommodation is concentrated in Zhuanghu Village, located deep on the road within the scenic area, about 2 kilometers away from the entrance. If you want to stay, you can agree with the ticket office on the first day not to buy tickets and directly enter the village for accommodation. Purchase tickets the next day when visiting the scenic area. The highlight of the trip is the observation of the Great Wall, which is the main content of visiting the Xiangshui Lake scenic area. The Great Wall of Xiangshui Lake is divided into the relatively primitive and quaint Lu'an Ridge, and a small section of the renovated and mature Moshikou Pass Great Wall. The height of the Great Wall at Moshikou Pass is not high, and the road is very good, suitable for the elderly and children to go, while the Great Wall at Lu'anling is relatively steep, taking about 1.5 hours to walk. Moreover, the city wall has not been repaired and the road conditions are very poor, mainly for young people to hike and play. Although the Great Wall here is not as steep as Badaling or Jiankou, its value lies in the fact that there are few tourists, allowing for a peaceful and leisurely stroll. The Health Grand Canyon is also an important landscape within the scenic area, which is a cool and warm valley. The valley is densely forested and the environment is very beautiful. The key landscape is the multiple ponds along the way in the canyon, which are home to many rainbow trout and other fish. They look very lively and lovely, and strolling in the canyon is also very comfortable and extraordinary. In addition, there are also some natural scenery such as waterfalls and ponds on the "winding path leading to secluded" mountain road next to the entrance of the scenic area, which can be enjoyed along the way. Catering and accommodation in Zhuanghu Village are the main choices for tourists' accommodation, with dozens of rural households offering accommodation. These farmhouses are nestled by mountains and rivers, with a good environment, and most of the owners are simple and enthusiastic, which can make people experience the warm rural life. Tourists can also dine at the farmhouse where they stay, famous for its delicious dishes such as rainbow trout and grilled lamb, which are relatively affordable and recommended for tasting.

poiName: Jazz Bar at Fairmont Peace Hotel
summary: The Shanghai Peace Museum is located inside the Peace Hotel, exhibiting a collection of antique grade items such as copper ice cream jars, copper thermos bottles, and silver spoons engraved with the words "Huamao Hotel" (predecessor of the North Building of the Peace Hotel), as well as calligraphy and paintings by famous artists such as Wu Changshuo, Fu Baoshi, and Liu Haisu. This is the first museum established in the form of a hotel in China.

Cuandia Village is located within the Cuanbai Scenic Area. Also known as Chuanxia Village, the village is mainly composed of old buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Nowadays, there are several rural homestays in the village, where you can experience the rural life of sleeping on the heated kang and eating rural dishes on weekends. There are also scenic spots such as Yixiantian next to the village that can be visited together. Usually, it involves taking a walk in the village to view old buildings, taking a sunrise and panoramic view of the village at the observation deck, and experiencing rural life in the countryside. The duration of the trip is about 1-2 days. The main road in the village is about 600 meters long, and the ancient buildings are mainly located on the north side of the road. There are more than 70 courtyards in the village, with nearly 700 buildings inside, most of which are old buildings from the late Qing Dynasty and can also be visited. The more magnificent ones include the Caizhu Courtyard, Wudao Temple, Guandi Temple, etc.

Longmen Jian is located on the northwest side of Yanjiatai in Qingshui Township, Mentougou District. The Longmen Jian Scenic Area is mainly composed of the Grand Canyon, with dozens of unique landscapes. Longmen River is divided into two streams, east and west, each stretching for more than ten miles. Entering the Longmen Gorge, the peaks on both sides face each other, and the spring water in the gorge is clear and transparent. There are also landscapes such as General Stone, Yixiantian, Jianjian Peak, Heilongtan, Tingyin Pavilion, and Shitiantai.

The Shanghai Automobile Museum has an exhibition area of approximately 12000 square meters, divided into a history museum, a collection museum, a technology museum, a children's car park, a temporary exhibition area, and a business and leisure area in the Wujia Automobile Study. It currently displays nearly a hundred classic antique cars and gathers nearly 50 domestic and foreign car brands, spanning over 130 years of automotive development history. By integrating exquisite exhibits, precious historical materials, and rich multimedia interactions, we aim to provide both parent-child entertainment and aesthetic lifestyle experiences, creating a multifunctional one-stop automotive culture and leisure space for the audience. This also provides a good platform for domestic and foreign automotive manufacturers, cultural institutions, and private collectors to showcase and exchange ideas. The History Pavlion History Museum (first floor) follows the chronological order and integrates various important stages in the development of automobiles into 9 themed exhibition areas. Through the introduction of classic representative vehicles and a series of important events, it showcases the milestones of world automobile development and reflects the significant impact of automobile evolution on human society. The Collection Pavilion (second floor) showcases nearly 40 classic car models and a range of refueling equipment and daily necessities from the late 19th century to the 1980s, vividly reflecting the close connection between human society and modern cars, allowing visitors to appreciate the traces left by the times, the brilliance of technology and art. Technology PAVILION Technology Museum (third floor) creates a colorful world of automotive technology for the audience with rich content, intuitive display projects, and lively interactive installations in automotive construction, power, safety, comfort, and automotive intelligence. MAGIC MOTOWN Children's Car Park (4th floor) welcomes you to take the time shuttle bus to "Modu", which is a "dream car city" exclusively for children. Provide an interactive space for families with children aged 2-10 to explore the world through immersive parent-child experience scenarios. HOME STUDY My Jia Car Study (5th floor) includes rich functional areas such as parent-child reading, car culture classes, and research material borrowing. The bright environment design and comfortable seats provide a relaxing space for readers who need to read quietly.

The Shanghai Poly Grand Theatre is located in Jiading New City, Jiading District, Shanghai, adjacent to the Shanghai International Circuit. It is one of the iconic cultural facilities in the Shanghai area. The theater is built by the lake and is located in the administrative and cultural center of Jiading New City in Jiading District. It is a theater in China with a water feature theater. The surrounding environment is beautiful, the facilities are complete, and the transportation is convenient, providing world-class artistic enjoyment for art enthusiasts. The theater held its opening performance on September 30, 2014 and officially put into operation on October 1. It is the first well-known high art hall in western Shanghai.

Wenquan Temple is located in Shiquan Village, Qingshanhu District, Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province. It was first built in the early years of the Qianlong reign of the Qing Dynasty. For nearly 300 years, the temple has been bustling with incense, and the sound of Buddhist scriptures and chants continues to educate countless sentient beings.

Nanjing Meigang is located in Xuanwu District, Nanjing City, and is a historic garden scenic area. Every winter, the plum blossoms in Meigang bloom, becoming a popular destination for Nanjing citizens to admire flowers. In addition, there is an ancient pavilion in the park called "Meigang Pavilion", which is one of the cultural relics protection units in Nanjing. At Meigang, tourists can stroll along the park paths, admire the plum blossoms, experience the traditional cultural atmosphere, and feel the ancient Jiangnan garden style.

Entering the store, one can immediately understand the meaning of "Zhongshu". There are books on two floors, up and down, and in all directions. tagNameList: Buildings by Famous Architects; Museums; Nighttime sightseeing
summary: The Zhendan Museum is a cultural mission of Zhendan Group's founder, Chairman Chen Yongtai, to give back to society. The Zhendan Museum is located on the banks of the Huangpu River in the Lujiazui Financial District of Shanghai, and was officially opened in October 2013. The museum area consists of six floors and covers an area of 6316 square meters. The Zhendan Museum integrates collection, research, exhibition, operation, and dissemination, adhering to the concept of "protecting, inheriting, and dedicating" to Chinese culture. At the same time, it cooperates with the School of Archaeology and Museology at Peking University to promote the study of ancient artifacts. The collection in the museum mainly consists of Buddhist statues, jade artifacts, pottery, blue and white porcelain, and portrait stones. A research center for ancient artifact studies has been specially established to analyze and study cultural relics from the perspective of ancient artifact studies, revealing the rich connotations of historical artifacts to the audience from multiple angles and perspectives. The Zhendan Museum inherits the lifeline of history, providing a new place for the public to appreciate art, promote education, and enjoy leisure life. It also stands as a cultural landmark facing the world in Shanghai. The Zhendan Museum was designed by international architectural master Tadao Ando, using glass curtains to construct a minimalist and clear geometric form. At night, it stands out in the dazzling night view of the Huangpu River in Shanghai with a deep, calm, and restrained blue jewelry box.

The Pilu Temple in Nanjing was first built between 1522 and 1566. It was originally named Pilu An and is one of the famous temples in Jinling due to the worship of Pilu Zana Buddha in the temple. The Chinese Buddhist Association, the Chinese Buddhist Research Association, the Chinese Religious Association, and the Capital Hospital are all located here. Pilu Temple is a "Golden Bright Dojo" that upholds the spirit of Golden Bright, solemnly upholds the country, and promotes holy teachings. It is unique in the Buddhist capital of Jinling.

The former site exhibition hall of the comfort station in Liji Lane, Nanjing consists of eight light yellow two-story buildings with a total construction area of over 3000 square meters. Six of them are exhibition halls, and two are office buildings.

The Herbalist Pagoda is located in Jiming Temple, with a height of 44.8 meters, seven levels and eight sides, arch of wooden architecture double eaves, and copper temple tube tiles, magnificent and spectacular; Medicine Buddha originated from Sanskrit and has the meaning of dispelling disasters and prolonging life. Yaoshi Tower is the Leifeng Tower in the TV series "The Legend of the White Snake".

Kuixing Pavilion is located next to the Panchi Lake of Confucius Temple in Qinhuai District, Nanjing City. It is situated in the core area of the Qinhuai Scenic Belt of Confucius Temple and is one of the core landscapes and iconic buildings of Nanjing Confucius Temple.
Tianxia Wenshu Fang: Xiawenshu represents the meaning of "refinement is here", praising Confucian culture represented by Confucius as the center of Chinese culture.
The Sui Han Pavilion is named after the pine, bamboo, and plum trees planted around it.

The former residence of Jiang Shoushan, also known as Jiang Wanwan's former residence or San Tiaoying Ancient Architecture, was the former residence of Jiang Shoushan, a famous wealthy businessman in Nanjing during the late Qing Dynasty. The former residence is made of green bricks and black tiles, stretching for a hundred meters and stacked layer by layer. The entire courtyard, from the front to the back, is built with each entrance higher than the next, and the back is a building, taking the meaning of "rising step by step". It is commonly known as "ninety-nine and a half rooms" among the people and has very high cultural value. It is a precious historical and cultural resource and precious historical and cultural wealth. It is an important part of the ten mile Qinhuai Scenic Belt of Confucius Temple and even the historical and cultural city of Nanjing. It is now a provincial-level cultural heritage unit.

There are 84000 lamps in this hall, symbolizing the "84000 Dharma Gate". In the center of the hall is the Brahma tree where the Buddha's Nirvana is located, with the Nirvana Buddha lying quietly in the center, and the five Buddha treasures behind him looking solemn. This makes Nanjing a sacred place where Buddha's light shines brightly, according to historical records.

The "Yangtze River Love" cruise ship is currently a twin body riverside passenger ship on the Yangtze River in China. It is also a large luxury cruise ship independently designed and built in Jiangsu Province, with a length of 95.7 meters, a width of 19.6 meters, a height of 21.8 meters, and a total tonnage of 5796. The first floor multifunctional hall can accommodate 190 people, equipped with ultra wide LED screens, sound system, and lighting; The second floor of the ship features a large outdoor deck and an immersive column free themed hall that can accommodate 26 tables for banquets and dining. The accompanying digital interactive concierge corridor and 270 degree holographic projection are the preferred options for cruise ship banquets; Ship's third floor private room, leisure booth area, simulated cockpit, VIP observation area in the front cabin; Fourth floor tea art private room, outdoor leisure booth area, VIP observation area in the front cabin; The top-level creative lawn deck aims to provide tourists with a higher quality and more personalized riverside travel experience. A unique venue is the perfect choice for various events such as weddings, birthdays, brand launches, and team building.
