The multifunctional hall on the first floor has a french window, which can accommodate 160 people and is equipped with large LED screen, sound and light; The second floor leisure booth area and private rooms have a comfortable environment and a 300 degree panoramic view; Three levels of sun deck, wide view, spacious and clean. Featuring elements of cultural history, dining, entertainment, etc., it provides a comprehensive immersive experience of riverside tourism that includes immersion, sound, sight, and sensation. The Yangtze River Love Cruise sightseeing area is divided into four floors: the first floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a reception hall, a multifunctional hall, and a main service desk. The second floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a sightseeing deck, dining rooms, and a themed banquet hall. The third floor of the cruise ship is equipped with private rooms, a leisure booth area, and a VIP observation area in the front cabin. The fourth floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a tea room, a leisure booth area, and a VIP observation area in the front cabin. Creative lawn deck on the top floor of the cruise ship. The Yangtze River Legend Cruise sightseeing area is divided into four floors: the first floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a reception hall, a multifunctional hall, and a main service desk; The second floor of the cruise ship is equipped with leisure booths, a central water bar, a snack bar, and VIP private rooms; The third floor of the cruise ship is equipped with a sunny water bar, a sunny deck, and outdoor booths.

The Muyan (Mufu Mountain Yanziji) Scenic Area (Muyan Provincial Forest Park) is located in the north of Nanjing, spanning the Xiaguan and Qixia districts, and facing the city by the river. The scenic area covers an area of 708.4 hectares, with a peripheral protection zone of 171.5 hectares. It is an important green barrier in the northern part of the main city of Nanjing and an important component of the Yangtze River Scenic Area that reflects the historical and cultural landscape and natural environment of Nanjing. The natural and cultural landscapes of Muyan are rich, with beautiful mountains and wide waters, profound cultural heritage, and a collection of famous scenic spots. It is known as the "ancient beauty of Jinling, and the northern suburbs are among them". It boasts six of the ancient "48 Scenic Spots of Jinling": the Shogunate Climbing, the Damo Ancient Cave, the Yanji Sunset, the Yongji River Flow, the Jiashan Wen Jing, and the Hualong Beautiful Land. The names "Jinling" and "Baixia" all originate from the Shogunate Mountain. In addition, there are also scenic spots such as Tao Xingzhi Tomb, Yanziji, and Toutai Cave. Mufu Mountain, the main component of the Muyan Scenic Area, is the precious "green lung" of Nanjing, lush and green.

The Pearl Spring Scenic Area is located in the northwest of Nanjing city, 7 kilometers away from Pukou Railway Station. The core attraction Pearl Spring is green and clear, and the Great Wall built along the mountain allows tourists to become heroes without going to Badaling. The scenic area is equipped with a wildlife park, amusement park, water world, and other facilities, making it perfect for family outings. Pearl Spring Pearl Spring Scenic Area has multiple entrances, with the main entrances being the East Gate and the West Gate. The West Gate is close to the most important attraction, Pearl Spring, so visitors can enter the scenic area through the West Gate. In the 18th year of the Wanli reign of the Ming Dynasty (1590 AD), there was a severe drought in Nanjing. Farmers living in Pukou were still able to harvest crops due to the existence of Pearl Spring. As a result, the spring water became famous and was hailed as the "first tourist attraction in the north of the Yangtze River". Even now, the Ming Dynasty cliff carvings "Wanhu Mingzhu" can still be seen by the lake. Pearl Spring, also known as Rain and Rain Spring, Xike Spring, is a fun place to clap hands by the lake, and strings of pearl like water bubbles will keep popping up. The Great Wall runs north from Pearl Spring, all uphill roads leading to the Great Wall. The Great Wall was built in the 1990s, resembling the Badaling Great Wall. The wall is 3000 meters long and is built on the Furong Peak, Miaogao Peak, and Shizi Peak, which are arranged in a straight line from west to east. The highest peak, Miaogao Peak, has an elevation of 255.5 meters. Climbing up the Great Wall Castle on Miaogao Peak, one can overlook the scenery below. Although the Great Wall is not very high, it is a continuous staircase that can be quite tiring. If you climb slowly, it takes about 2 hours to play along the Great Wall. You can also take the cableway directly to Miaogao Peak. Additional tickets are required for the cableway, and the price will be based on the scenic area. Tourists with children can go to the wildlife park in the scenic area. There are not many animal species, mainly "fierce beasts", so they are tigers, lions, and black bears. You can see the little babies of these animals, which are very cute. The most beautiful performances in the zoo are two. The Dream Theater is indoor, with performances such as lion feeding and tiger walking on plum blossom stakes. The performance time is 10:30 14:30. There are many water amusement projects on the east side of Jingshan Lake in the Pearl Spring of the Water World. The popular ones are bamboo rafts, which can be used for water fights. The amusement park in the scenic area has bumper cars, roller coasters, and rapids, all of which require additional fees ranging from 10-60 yuan. Near the east gate of the scenic area is the Water World, similar to the Happy Water Cube Water Park, but unlike it, the water in the amusement facilities is authentic spring water. Dining in the camping barbecue area can be done at Dingshan Pavilion; You can also prepare some barbecue food and go to the camping barbecue area, which provides paid picnic stoves and tents. Therefore, going camping and hiking with three or five friends at the Pearl Spring Scenic Area on weekends is also a good choice. In addition, you can also visit the Buddha Art Museum in the scenic area, and there is Zhaofu International Golf on the east side of the scenic area. The Famous Stone Art Museum, Sifang Art Museum, and Foshou Lake outside the scenic area can also be visited together.

poiName: Pukou Zhenzhuquan Yesheng Dongwu Ecological Park
summary: The Pukou Pearl Spring Wildlife Ecological Park is located in the Nanjing Pearl Spring Tourist Resort, only 7 kilometers away from Pukou Port and the Yangtze River Bridge. There are direct bus lines in Nanjing. The park covers an area of 600 acres and has 100 tigers, 50 lion kings, 60 black bears, and nearly 10000 species of animals including fierce beasts, rare birds, amphibians, and herbivores. It is a considerable wildlife ecological park in East China.

Guanyin Temple is located at the western foot of Donglu Mountain in Lishui and was first built in the Yuan Dynasty. In 1999, it was rebuilt and renamed Donglushan Guanyin Temple, covering an area of over a thousand square meters. Guanyin Temple, originally named "Guanyin Temple at the western foot of Donglu Mountain", was founded in the Yuan Dynasty and has a history of more than 700 years. During the Xianfeng period of the Qing Dynasty, it was destroyed by war. It was rebuilt in the eighth year of the Guangxu reign (1882) and later destroyed. Reconstruction after 1999. In 2000, Donglushan Guanyin Temple became the lower house of Jiming Temple and was approved by the provincial and Nanjing municipal governments as a key construction temple. Buildings such as Tianwang Hall, Yuantong Treasure Hall, Drum Tower, Bell Tower, Zhaifang, and Liao House were built. In December 2010, the newly built Yuantong Hall was completed and a Buddha statue consecration ceremony was held.

Lingyan Mountain has been known as a famous local mountain since ancient times. Lingyan Mountain is characterized by towering rock formations and lush forests and grasses, and is named after the saying 'there is always a spirit of auspiciousness between the rocks'. There are many scenic spots in Lingyan Mountain, including Lingyan Temple, Wenfeng Pagoda, Yanyue Rock, Mopanshi, and Agate Stream. Lingyan Temple, the main scenic spot, was built in the Xiantong period of the Tang Dynasty, and now it was restored after being built in 2002. There are main buildings such as Shanmen Temple, the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Bell Tower, Drum Tower, etc. The temple is built close to the mountain, presenting a garden landscape layout, and the environment is quiet and quiet. Located in the southwest of Lingyan Zen Temple, the Agate Stream has been famous for producing the "one of China's unique" Yuhua agate stones since ancient times, and is one of the earliest and more authentic production areas for Yuhua stones. Searching for Rain Flower Stones in the Agate Stream of Lingyan Mountain, discerning pearls with discerning eyes, and finding them by chance, is one of the great joys of life.

The Nature Wild Insect Museum is located in Lujiazui, Pudong, west of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower Tower. Here, you can enjoy various living insects and insect specimens, including rare insects with peculiar appearances that you may have never seen before. You can also see various amphibians and reptiles, such as lizards, frogs, turtles, etc. Bringing children here will definitely broaden your horizons. The insect museum has two floors, and if you bring your children to take a slow look, it will take about two hours to finish. Please note that it may be a bit stuffy indoors in summer. Firstly, you will arrive at the upper level where there is a fish feeding area where you can feed koi and observe animals such as Yangtze alligators, snakes, and cute mini monkeys. Then, you will see various live insects and arthropods, including spiders, scorpions, bamboo worms, unicorns, and various reptiles. Coming downstairs, you can see reptiles, including various lizards, turtles, frogs, and a wide variety of butterfly specimens. Here, there are also small animals such as Totoro, rabbits, goats, owls, bats, etc. You can feed them to goats, rabbits, and even touch them. On weekends at 11:00 and 14:30, as well as during Golden Week and holidays at 11:00, 13:30, and 15:00, in the small animal display area, you can see interesting animal knowledge introductions, including Totoro, Lizards, etc. Children can also participate in interactive activities on stage.
opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

summary: Introduction to Shanghai Jigao Tuwowo Parent child Park Jigao Tuwowo Parent child Park is a family style parent-child park that focuses on the experience of large non powered amusement facilities, combined with parent-child play, educational popularization, and leisure entertainment. It is located in the Lavender Park of Shanghai International Tourism Resort, adjacent to the Disney Station of Metro Line 11, covering an area of nearly 50000 square meters. It gathers about 20 imported non powered amusement equipment brands from around the world, more than 100 parent-child amusement projects, and boasts a 200000 square meter lavender flower sea. It has year-round festival performances, hundreds of parent-child interactive study courses, and rich IP peripheral products. It is said that there are still twelve super powered rabbit elves living here, responsible for guarding the colorful dreams of children Project Overview: Project Name: Ji Gao Tu Wo Wo Parent child Park Project Nature: Non powered Theme Park Design Area: Nearly 50000 square meters Landscape Style: Modern and Simple Natural Ji Gao Tu Wo Wo Parent child Park Overall Introduction Ji Gao Tu Wo Wo Parent child Park is located in the Lavender Park of Shanghai International Tourism Resort, with non powered equipment as the main form of play, combined with parent-child amusement, educational popularization, and leisure entertainment. Different from general power parks and public parks, it aims to create a children's playground with complete equipment, rich amusement functions, vivid science education, comfortable landscape environment, leisure experience, and educational significance, becoming an important project to promote the development of non power parks in China. Ji Gao Tu Wo Wo Parent Child Park includes three major areas: Tu Bao Kingdom, Growth World, and Creation Bay. Set up eleven amusement and leisure experience sections with different styles, including Forgotten Corner, Rabbit Treasure Castle, Racing Field, Magic Sound Valley, Exploration Bay, Cute Rabbit Home, Happiness Street and Flying Home, Cloud Street, Dreamcatcher and Smart Corner. All equipment in the park is provided by Jigao Group. There are over 20 global high-end amusement brand equipment, Jigao's newly independently developed large-scale non-standard equipment such as rabbit pulling radish, super zip line, sky castle, and innovative interactive equipment, all of which are eye-catching. Zone A: Rabbit Treasure Kingdom is the first of the three major areas of Tuwowo Parent Child Park. It is a joyful kingdom for cute babies and their parents. The Rabbit Treasure Kingdom includes seven themed play areas, including Forgotten Corner, Rabbit Treasure Castle, Racing Field, Magic Sound Valley, Exploration Bay, Cute Rabbit Home, and Happiness Street. Here, everyone can explore freely in the Forgotten Corner and discover the secrets of dinosaur remains; Take a photo with the internet famous big rabbit at Tu Bao Bao Bao Bao and slide down from the carrot. You can also experience the joy of speed with your parents on the racetrack; Experience the magical music fountain in the Magic Sound Valley, play on various swings, and listen to the wind blowing by your ears; Explore the Bay with infinite imagination and feel the joy of family harmony. If you get tired of playing, you can stop at Mengtu Home and Xingfu Street to enjoy a variety of delicious food and exquisite and interesting shopping experiences. Zone B: Growth World Growth World is a romantic and magical area within the Tuwowo Parent Child Park, where scenery never seen before in the city gathers. The growing world includes four themed play areas: Aviator, Cloud Street, Dreamcatcher, and Smart Corner. Among them, the pilot area has an ultra long zip line that makes the heart beat faster, and countless screams will be collected here; Yunzhong Street is a super romantic sky castle and a comprehensive tower combination amusement equipment; The dream catcher area has a large crawling area and rainbow colored bouncing pillows; Smart Corner is a mini water conservancy project that requires the wisdom and hands-on ability of cute babies. Here, cute babies can control the water flow and have endless fun. Zone C: Create Bay Create Bay has multiple large-scale events every year, with a variety of colorful activities that provide visual feasts, auditory sublimation, and taste jumps, fully meeting the leisure needs of a family of three generations. Let both children and friends experience novel and interesting leisure experiences.
opening_hours: Opens at November 1, 2024-April 30, 2025 Wednesday-Sunday 09:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

summary: The concept of immersive theater originated in the United Kingdom. Unlike traditional theater, the audience no longer sits in fixed seats to watch the performers perform on stage, but freely shuttles through a theatrical space, actively exploring the plot and fully immersing themselves in the theater context. Sleep No More is one of the classic works. Regarding Sleep No More, the Shanghai version of "Sleepless Nights" is set in the 1930s at the MacKinnon Hotel. In this mysterious 5-story building in the center of Shanghai, there are over 90 theater spaces, more than 3000 drawers, and movie level stage design. The MacKinnon Hotel is a time and space where reality and dreams intertwine. Entering the MacKinnon Hotel, the audience dons a white ghostly mask and transforms into ghosts, freely exploring the space, touching the furnishings and props inside the hotel, perceiving different musical scents, closely following the performers to experience the joys and sorrows of the characters, and creating a unique experience within an epic story. The story synopsis is adapted from Shakespeare's work Macbeth, a tragedy about the intersection of power and jealousy. The ambitious Scottish general Macbeth, under the influence of three wizards and the instigation of his wife, gradually murdered his colleagues Banquo, King Duncan, and the nobleman Macduff and his wife, ultimately leading to their defection and separation. As a unique version of 'Sleepless Night' in Asia, the Shanghai version incorporates elements such as' Legend of the White Snake 'and' Butterfly Dream '.

Jinjiang Amusement Park is located near Shanghai South Station and is the first large-scale amusement park in Shanghai. There are exciting roller coasters and flywheels here, as well as nostalgic monorails, fast-moving bikes, and activities suitable for teenagers such as horse riding and 4D cinemas. There is a large Ferris wheel built in the park, which can be turned to a height of 108 meters to overlook the entire city scenery. The main entrance of Jinjiang Amusement Park is located at the intersection of Hongmei Road and Humin Road. Upon entering, you will see the Step by Step Soul (Ghost House). Continuing to the left side, you can first experience the thrilling giant suspended spiral roller coaster in the park, challenge your courage, and feel the excitement of overturning the river. Next up are a series of thrilling projects waiting for you, such as motorcycle roller coasters, wave rolling, magic windmills, and crazy flywheels. After finishing the addiction, you can go to the Volcano Cinema to watch a dynamic movie, and then sit on the "Shanghai Grand Wheel" to enjoy the city scenery from a high place. Next to the Ferris wheel, there are romantic leisure projects such as collision boats and canyon drifting. Teenage tourists can play with less thrilling but fun activities such as bumper cars, spin sleds, hurricane flying chairs, monorails, and rapids. There are also small activities suitable for children, such as spinning cups and sambata. Attention should be paid to the high number of visitors to Jinjiang Amusement Park during holidays, and long queues for many entertainment projects are common. Especially in summer, heatstroke prevention measures should be taken. There is Jinlun Cuisine and Le Restaurant in Jinjiang Amusement Park, which mainly serves Chinese and Western fast food. There are also small shops selling drinks and snacks, as well as souvenir shops. The prices are slightly higher than outside the park, but they are still acceptable. Jinjiang Amusement Park sometimes holds lively park parties and themed food festivals. You can pay attention to the official website's dynamic information in advance.

Shilin Night Market is located next to Jinjiang Amusement Park. Although the area is not very large, there are still quite a few types of delicious food, such as flame beef, big intestine wrapped small intestine, taro ice, and so on. Looking around, the streets are full of delicious food. A must visit place for foodies to taste delicious food.

poiName: bo li zhan qiao ( nan bao gong yuan )

summary: The Nanjing Museum of Paleontology is a modern museum that integrates exhibition, collection, research, and education. It is an important base for the popularization and education of natural sciences. The Museum of Paleontology tells a story about the evolution history of Earth and life. Based on paleontological fossils, with a focus on ancient invertebrates, plants, and microfossils, it is currently one of the largest paleontological museums in the world. The museum has a rich collection of fine exhibits, among which the fossil specimens of "Chengjiang Fauna" and "Jehol Biota", including "Chinese Loong Bird", are more precious and can be regarded as fine fossils.
opening_hours: Opens at January 1-December 31 Wednesday-Sunday 09:00-17:00(Admission ends at 16:00)

summary: The Xiaoxihu Scenic Area is located between the Confucius Temple and the Laomen East Scenic Area. This place preserves a relatively primitive appearance, mainly consisting of low rise residential buildings, several of which have been transformed into hotels, restaurants, and cafes. The overlapping years make it very suitable for photography.

The 95 meter high altitude VR roller coaster of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower Tower, with the theme of flying over the high altitude of the Oriental Pearl TV Tower Tower, has transformed the original indoor roller coaster into the popular VR (virtual reality) technology, breaking through the limitations of the traditional roller coaster's vision and sense, and opening a new era of more exciting, more shocking, and more interesting VR intercity high altitude adventure.

The Bund Source is located at 33 Zhongshan East Road and was the former location of the British Consulate General in Shanghai. Including the main building of the former British Consulate (now One Bund Source) and the auxiliary building of the former British Consulate. The main building of the British Consulate was first built in 1849 (the 29th year of the Daoguang reign), and the remaining intact building is the one rebuilt in 1872 (the 11th year of the Tongzhi reign). The facade is in the style of the British Renaissance, and in front of the house is a typical English garden; The roof is a Western style four slope roof, but it is made of locally sourced Chinese style small blue tiles. The architectural style of the auxiliary building is more magnificent than that of the main building, with increased facade and interior decoration.

For many tourists, instead of spending 100 yuan to take a specialized Pujiang tour boat, it is more cost-effective to buy a two yuan ticket at the ticket office of Jinling East Road Ferry next door. As long as it does not exceed the last flight time in the evening, the boat will ferry you to Dongchang Road across the street. This "Dongjin Line" is currently the most cost-effective means of transportation on the Huangpu River, but compared to the old ferry that used to be able to stand on the deck and enjoy the river breeze, air-conditioned boats now can only watch and shoot night scenes through glass, which is inevitably a small regret.

poiName: yu yuan · hai shang li yuan
summary: Yu Garden · Haihai Pear Garden was originally a stage overlooking Yu Garden, but now it is an air courtyard of nearly 1000 square meters. By the Nine Curve Bridge of Huxin Pavilion, amidst the bustling crowd, one searches for a way to reach the location of the Pear Garden on the sea. Suddenly, the world becomes clear and the hustle and bustle recedes, complementing the modern urban experience of "slow living". Elements such as gardens, Kunqu opera, tea ceremony, Tai Chi, calligraphy and painting, and celadon blend seamlessly, imbuing modern life with an inner style and becoming a rare cultural living room on the sea. Visiting Yu Garden, listening to Kunqu Opera, tasting boat spots... In this air courtyard living museum, celebrities and Hongru have a spiritual engagement with traditional Chinese culture. Looking at Shanghai, there is no cultural space as gifted and dazzling as the Sea Pear Garden. Yu Garden · Sea Pear Garden is located in the core of Yu Garden area, facing the sky. The sea pear garden has a unique scenery: when you raise your head, you can see the modern city view of Lujiazui Financial District, and when you bow down, you can see the bustling market and green tile cornices of the old city. The fusion of classical and modern styles, this place is not only a great place to appreciate the art of music, but also a place to hold banquets with unique charm. Tables, chairs, doors and windows, soft furnishings with curtains, decorative displays, and landscaping... all elements follow the principles of antiquity, elegance, and grandeur. The traditional architecture presented on the immersive stage, such as pavilions, naturally combines with the performance area, achieving a wonderful atmosphere of elegance and enjoyment. Tasting tea and smelling the fragrance, savoring delicious vegetarian dishes, listening to a beautiful melody, traveling through ancient and modern times, an elegant and wonderful cultural life experience is waiting to be staged.

Yulinglong is a stone peak in Yu Garden in Shanghai, which is located on the lawn in front of the Yuhua Hall in Yu Garden. It, together with Ruiyun Peak in Suzhou and Crepe Cloud Peak in Hangzhou, is called the three famous peaks in the south of the Yangtze River.

Chenxiang Pavilion, formerly known as "Ciyun Temple", covers an area of 2378 mu, and is a distinctive Bhikhuni temple, with the Shakya ManiHall, Guanyin Pavilion, Jialan Hall, Yingci Master Memorial Hall, etc. The agarwood pavilion is famous for enshrining the "agarwood Guanyin". The current Guanyin Pavilion enshrines a statue of Guanyin in the Ruyi Wheel, made of Hai Qiong Shui agarwood, which was later donated by Hong Kong believers. There is a four pillar, three door, double eaved archway in front of the pavilion, with the words "Chenxiang Pavilion" inscribed by Sha Menghai on it. In the middle of the the Shakya ManiHall is the "Three Saints of Huayan". In the center is Lushena Buddha, with Manjusri and Samantabhadra standing on either side, and two heavenly gods, Brahma and Emperor Shakyamuni, guarding him. This type of offering is also rare in temples in Jiangnan. The Guanyin Pavilion houses the agarwood Guanyin, also known as the "Ruyi Wheel Guanyin".
In 1927, Feng Yuxiang visited Huaqing Pool and built a women's bathhouse called Xiangning Pool because he had observed Huaqing Pool multiple times during his stay in Shaanxi.

Huahua Marine Ecological Park is located on the west side of Zhujing Town in Jinshan District, Shanghai, adjacent to the beautiful Xiuzhou Pond to the north. The scenic area consists of a flower sea, a plum garden, a cherry blossom garden, and an autumn scenery garden, and is a flower viewing theme park that integrates science popularization, exhibition, and sightseeing. Meiyuan consists of three distinctive small gardens: Meixi Xiangling, Meiying Qulu, and Meigong Tanmei. There are more than 10 high-altitude plum blossom viewing points in the park, such as Shuying Slope, Ningxiang Terrace, Yanyu Pavilion, etc. In addition, a distinctive small bridge is also built here, with winding and meandering garden roads, dense lawns on the island, and meandering Meixi River. There are many varieties of plum blossoms in the garden, covering five major categories: Gongfen, cinnabar, green calyx, Jiangmei, and Meiren plum. There are more than 3000 plants and over 60 early, middle, and late varieties planted, mainly in white, pink, and red colors. The viewing period is from mid February to mid to late March. The Cherry Blossom Garden is composed of Cherry Blossom Pond, Haitangwu, and Yulanting. Mountain cherry blossoms, morning cherry blossoms, evening cherry blossoms, crabapples, beautiful plum blossoms, and Erqiao Yulan compete to become the island owners. The winding and uneven garden roads connect the 9 islands, with streams winding around the islands and water blooming flowers, whispering incessantly. From the sky, it looks like colorful butterfly wings, spreading their wings and ready to fly. The flower viewing period is from mid March to mid to late April. The Flower Sea is composed of 19 petal shaped islands, Huaxianling, Huamanpo, Huazhiwu, Huayinxi, and Huaxiu. In spring, there are more than 30 flower varieties in the flower sea, including Yumei people, cornflowers, dwarf snow wheels, high snow wheels, Xilin grass, Lu Bing flower, and Tian Tian Xing. The viewing period is from mid April to mid May; In autumn, there are more than 10 flower varieties such as Gesanghua (Persian chrysanthemum, sulfur chrysanthemum), Difu, Mexican sage, centella, Qianrihong, sunflower, etc. The viewing period is from late September to mid October. Autumn Scenery Garden consists of Maple Forest Trail, Maple Leaf Island, Starry Sky Lawn, Knight's Paradise, and Autumn Maple Pavilion. There are more than 20 autumn colored leaf trees planted in the park, such as various chicken claw maple horticultural varieties, Norwegian maple, American red maple, flower leaf triangle maple, light leaf elm, soapberry, Chinese parasol tree, Chinese parasol tree, Chinese parasol tree, maple, Chinese parasol tree, persimmon, Chinese elm, big leaf elm, etc., as well as a large number of osmanthus, osmanthus, silver osmanthus and various ornamental grasses. The viewing period is from mid November to mid to late December. In addition to its beautiful scenery, the Flower Blooming Sea Ecological Park also offers a variety of experiential projects for tourists to relax and enjoy.

Shanghai Old Street, formerly known as Fangbang Middle Road, showcases the historical and cultural evolution of old Shanghai from the Ming and Qing dynasties to the influx of Western culture through its west to east architectural style and layout. The commercial operation of the entire street is dominated by traditional characteristic industries, highlighting traditional folk culture and creating a Shanghai style cultural atmosphere. Shanghai's old street is divided into two sections, east and west, with Guanyi Street as the boundary. The eastern section has been decorated and renovated to preserve the residential characteristics of the late Qing Dynasty. The two sides of the old street have been restored with lattice windows, door panels, Fan's railings, floor to ceiling swing doors, etc., accompanied by eaves and upturned corners on the roof, lace dripping water, and horsehead walls. The exterior of the houses in the western section is modeled after Ming and Qing architecture, highlighting the folk customs of the old city of Shanghai. Shanghai Old Street has century old shops such as Tong Hanchun, Lao Tongsheng, Wu Liangcai, Wan Youquan, Qiu Tianbao, Old Shanghai Teahouse, Deshun Restaurant, Chunfeng Deyi Building, Xishi Tofu House, Ding Niangzi Buzhuang, Rongshun Hall, Boyintang, etc. At the same time, traditional shops such as Danfeng Tea House and Famous Doctor Hall have also been opened. It, along with the "Star Street" on the north side, presents you with a "Along the River During Qingming Festival" picture of the various businesses and daily life in old Shanghai.

Located on Jinshajiang Road in Putuo District, Shanghai, it is a representative characteristic block of Italian Venetian town style, with unique architecture, road signs, etc. It is a great place for taking photos and checking in.

Shenyuan is a newly built Jiangnan garden located within the Shanghai World Expo Cultural Park, situated deep within the park and connected to it by several stone bridges. Shenyuan Garden is equipped with various elements of Jiangnan gardens such as pavilions, terraces, ponds, and rockeries. Although modern materials are used, the classical architectural style is still magnificent.
opening_hours: Opens at 09:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

summary: Fenxiang is located in Beilin District, Xi'an City, adjacent to Nanyuanmen in the west, Nandajie in the east, and Defu Lane, a bar street in Xi'an, to the south. Fenxiang is only 329 meters long, but it has become lively because it connects several famous streets in Xi'an. There are different opinions about the origin of Fen Lane. One theory suggests that it was originally a street selling for free, another suggests that it was once a place selling rouge, water powder, and other speculations suggest that this street was the one where the emperor selected his concubines. On both sides of Fen Lane, there are numerous shops with unique styles and various tempting snacks, attracting many girls to come here for shopping. Therefore, many people say that there are many beautiful girls in Fen Lane. Strolling around here, you can always see beautiful girls walking through it. In addition, the Xi'an Antique Bookstore is also located on this street, and these words on the plaque were inscribed by Mr. Lu Xun at that time. Here, you can find many newly printed ancient books, Chinese and foreign history, philosophy, classical literature, cultural relics and archaeology, calligraphy, picture books and other various books.

poiName: lou guan tai shuo jing tai
summary: The Sutra Terrace is the central architectural complex of the Lou Guan Terrace, which was first built during the Tang Dynasty's Wude period. It is surrounded by ten thousand peaks and has three open screens. It is said that Laozi once preached scriptures here.

poiName: Zhongnan Mountain Ancient Building Scenic Spot
summary: The Zhongnan Mountain Ancient Lou Guan Historical and Cultural Scenic Area is the core engine of the Xi'an Lou Guan Chinese Dao Culture Exhibition Area, and it is also an important measure for the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee and Provincial Government to implement the "Cultural Strength" strategy, and for the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee and Municipal Government to fully implement the "Guanzhong Tianshui Economic Zone Development Plan". The scenic area was opened on March 1, 2012 and is one of the famous Taoist holy sites in China, known as the "Number One Blessed Land in the World", "Taoist Ancestral Temple", and "Taoist Source Immortal Capital".

Shahe Wetland Park is located in Zhouzhi County, Xi'an City. It is a large-scale comprehensive theme park that integrates leisure, waterfront experience, children's entertainment, and ecological tourism. The Shahe Wetland Park is built based on the Shahe River. The total length of Shahe River is 43.4 kilometers, of which 4.6 kilometers pass through Zhouzhi County. Previously, sewage flowed freely here, causing serious damage to the ecological environment. In recent years, through renovation and treatment, the original polluted river has become a clear stream. After the completion of Shahe Wetland Park, it not only embodies the charm of Jiangnan water towns, but also features Chinese folk customs, highlighting the ecological characteristics of large water and green areas and the rich cultural features of folk customs. It has turned the two banks of Shahe into a recreational area that is friendly to people and water. The quaint architecture stands on the riverbank, with willows leaning against it, flowers red and willows green, and small bridges flowing water, making visitors feel like they are in the water town of Jiangnan.

The Qinling National Botanical Garden is a mega comprehensive botanical garden that combines four functions: species conservation, scientific research, public education, and ecotourism. The Qinling National Botanical Garden, with a drop of over 2000 meters, has a large area, clear vegetation zoning, and natural scenery. Strolling leisurely among the beautiful scenery with family and friends, experiencing the harmony between humans and nature, and appreciating the charm of nature.

Dongshuiguan is a cultural relic protection unit in Nanjing, with a history of over 1000 years. It is located outside Tongji Gate, on the west side of Longpan Middle Road, and is a water gate where the Qinhuai River flows into Nanjing City. It was first built during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. After Ming Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang established his capital in Nanjing, he built it as Tongji Water Pass. The Shuiguan is a brick and stone structure with three layers, each layer containing 11 coupons, totaling 33 coupons. The coupons are also known as the "Yanyue Cave". The first layer was destroyed due to the war at that time, while the middle and lower layers still exist. In ancient times, the upper two layers were used to house the defending soldiers and store supplies, while the lower layer was used to regulate the water level of the Qinhuai River and prevent floods. The iron fence in the middle was used to prevent enemy attacks from the waterway, so this place is open to water but not navigable. Dongshui Pass integrates the water gate architecture with the city wall architecture, which is rare in the history of national architecture and can be regarded as a masterpiece. Dongshuiguan Relics Park is composed of four parts: sluice, bridge, caves of fighters garrison and city wall, forming a beautiful picture composed of Qinhuai stone boat, stone boat Liufang, waterfront platform, stone bridge sunset, and ship lock site. It has now become a place for citizens to relax, entertain, and exercise.

The former residence of Wu Jingzi is located at the junction of Qingxi River and Qinhuai River in Nanjing, adjacent to the ancient Taoyedu, and is called Qinhuai Water Pavilion. The exhibition hall covers an area of 800 square meters and is divided into two parts: south and north. The southern part is the site of the ancient Taoyedu, named after the great calligrapher Wang Xianzhi of the Jin Dynasty who once welcomed his beloved concubine Taoye here. For thousands of years, literati and scholars of all dynasties have often recited poems and verses here, reflecting on the past and leaving behind many beautiful lines and vivid folk legends; The northern half is the former residence of Wu Jingzi, displaying various versions of the "Scholars" work, reflecting representative life fragments of Wu Jingzi's life and becoming another battlefield for studying Wu studies.

Taoyedu is a well-known ferry crossing in ancient Nanjing, located at the confluence of Qingxi River and Qinhuai River. It is said to have been named after the great calligrapher Wang Xianzhi of the Eastern Jin Dynasty, who welcomed his beloved concubine Taoye here. In ancient times, the Qinhuai River had a relatively wide water surface and often capsized when encountering wind and waves. To comfort his beloved concubine Taoye, Wang Xianzhi gave her a song called "Taoye Song": "Peach leaves return to peach leaves, crossing the river does not require a boat, but crossing is not painful. I welcome you by myself." After singing this song, Taoye no longer feels afraid when crossing the river. To thank Wang Xianzhi for his deep affection, he also gave back a poem: "Peach leaves reflect red flowers, graceful without wind. Spring flowers reflect on me, and I feel my own love." Since then, Taoye Ferry has become the love ferry in the hearts of Nanjing people.

San Ying Hot Spring Resort Hotel is located in Baishuizhai Provincial Scenic Area, Zengcheng, Guangzhou. It is adjacent to Nankun Mountain National Forest Park and Conghua Shimen Mountain National Forest Park, and boasts scenic views such as Baishuizhai Waterfall and Wofo Mountain. About 70 kilometers away from the city center of Guangzhou, the 2-hour transportation circle radiates to core cities in the Pearl River Delta such as Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Macau, Dongguan, and Huizhou, with a regional radiation of 130 million people. San Ying Hot Spring Resort Hotel is themed around hot spring health preservation and health spa, with unique indoor and outdoor hot spring treatment and soaking areas. It has nearly 70 outdoor hot spring pools, divided into ten areas: dynamic entertainment area, sun and moon Qiankun area, Wuchang and Liude area, magical legend area, fashionable and special color area, auspicious and five blessings area, famous flower area, famous wine area, and Zen path area; There are a total of 13 international conference rooms and one international banquet hall that can accommodate 800 people. It is a comprehensive vacation and health tourism destination that integrates guest room accommodation, hot spring health preservation, leisure vacation, catering and meetings, health and entertainment, and team development. The origin of San Ying Hot Springs: He Xiangu, originally named He Sunu, with ancestral roots in Zengcheng, Guangdong. It is said that He Sunu is a famous medicine immortal. When she was thirteen years old, one day she went alone to Shiren Ridge in Nankun Mountain (now Paitan Town) to collect medicine. She accidentally slipped and fell into a deep pool of misty spring water, fainting. When she woke up and climbed ashore, she found that she did not feel any pain on her body. It turns out that the collected medicine soaked in the hot spring had a magical effect. Because He Su Nv can identify various immortal herbs and elixirs in the mountains, pick them for nearby people, and predict human affairs. Therefore, people around her regarded her as a divine figure and respectfully referred to her as' He Xiangu '. He Xiangu often uses the opportunity of treating people to persuade them to do good and stop evil, as evidenced by the "Song of Persuasion to the World": "Evil people are afraid of heaven, but good people do not deceive heaven; good and evil will be rewarded tomorrow, far away from their children and grandchildren. Later, that pond was praised as the" Three Ying Hot Springs "by people.

Jiangnan Sanmin Cultural Village is located in the central northern part of Chongming Ecological Island and is a cultural village where many folk collections can be seen. This is very close to Qianweitai Village, you can play together or stay overnight in the scenic area and go to Dongping Forest Park the next day. Teams can play some expansion projects and play live CS (for an additional fee). There are many exhibition halls in the scenic area, which some visitors summarize as "things that my grandfather used, things that my father knows, and things that my children and grandchildren don't understand". Here, not only can you see old cigarette labels, Jiangnan carved beds, and dressing boxes, but you can also learn about the textile process of Chongming earth cloth. In addition to visiting the exhibition hall, visitors can also experience some old activities here, such as riding water wheels, walking on stilts, and pushing iron rings (for an additional fee), which can evoke many memories for people who have experienced that era. The treasure of the town hall in the cultural village is the "Chinese Loong" in the Chinese Dragon Palace, which has won the Guinness World Record. The physical giant dragon has a total length of 36 meters. The dragon scale is made of 50-500 years old carved boards. Visitors here should not miss it. If you live here, the colorful lights in the village at night are also a major attraction, and the guest rooms in the scenic area cost around 200 yuan per night.

poiName: Cuihua Mountain·Qinling Zhongnanshan Unesco Global Geopark
summary: Cuihua Mountain is located in the northern branch of the Qinling Mountains in the southern part of Xi'an City. In addition to its beautiful lake and mountain scenery, the mountain also boasts landscapes such as cliffs, peaks, giant rocks, caves, and barrier lakes, making it known as the "Natural Museum of Landslides". There is also the "Xi'an Cuihua Mountain Ski Resort" in the scenic area, which is a ski resort in Xi'an. The Cuihua Mountain Scenic Area consists of three parts: Bishan Lake Scenic Area, Tianchi Scenic Area, and Landslide Stone Sea Scenic Area. The scenic area is very large, and it is not realistic to visit it all in one day. Ordinary tourists will spend one day exploring one of the hiking routes. There is a "scenic guide map" at the entrance of the scenic area for reference, and tourists can choose a suitable tour route according to their own situation. Cuihua Mountain also has a long historical and cultural background. This place has been designated as the royal "Shanglin Garden" and "Imperial Garden" by successive dynasties, and the Han and Tang dynasties built the Taiyi Palace and Cuiwei Palace here. In addition, literati and scholars throughout history such as Wang Wei, Zuyong, Sima Guang, etc. have left over 100 cliff carvings for Cuihua Mountain. Hikers who enjoy outdoor activities usually camp overnight in the scenic area. Currently, there are only farmhouses near Tianchi Scenic Area in the scenic area, and many backpackers choose to bring their own tents and food. There is a "snack street" next to Tianchi in the scenic area, which can provide catering at a higher price than outside the mountains.

poiName: Zhanglong Huanle Shijie Zhongxin Yanyi Square

summary: Baoqu Rose World is located in Xihe Village, Conghua District, Guangzhou City, with vast green fields. It is a theme park featuring rose culture and a multifunctional comprehensive rose theme park that integrates production, exhibition, science popularization, and leisure tourism. The entire park has introduced over 300 varieties of roses, including the bright red crimson fan rose, the red edged yellow background Abans, as well as the pink Eden and peach colored Peach King. In addition, there are flowers such as Lu Bing flower, rapeseed flower, cosmos, and drunken butterfly flower in the colorful flower field. Every spring in April and May, the entire park is in full bloom, with colorful flowers that attract bees and butterflies, while also making countless tourists linger and forget to leave. Baoqu Rose World also features public spaces such as the European style Flower Fairy Square, the captivating Jiujiu Rose Wall, and the beautiful Rose Corridor, allowing people to fully enjoy the romantic Rose World. In the newly developed Baoqu Farm, you can also taste fresh and sweet fruits and vegetables, as well as Baoqu Farm's flagship products - half person high treasure mustard greens and treasure vegetable chips. All fruits and vegetables are cultivated and grown with natural organic fertilizers, without adding any chemical fertilizers, making it a truly original ecological garden.

Guangzhou University City is located on Xiaoguwei Island and the southern bank of Xinzao Town in Panyu, Guangzhou. It is adjacent to Luoxi Island to the west, Biological Island to the north, and Changzhou Island to the east. It faces Pazhou Island and Yingzhou Ecological Park across the river. It is about 17 kilometers away from the center of Guangzhou and about 17 kilometers away from the planned Guangzhou New City. It is located on the axis of Guangzhou's southern development and in the urban area. There are modern historical sites and cultures represented by Huangpu Military Academy in the surrounding area; Traditional and modern Lingnan garden culture represented by Yuyin Mountain House and Baomo Garden; Modern urban culture represented by Pazhou International Convention and Exhibition Center and Guangzhou Bio Island. The overall planning area of Guangzhou University City is 43.3 square kilometers, with a planned total population of 350000 to 400000 people. Based on the principle of resource grading and sharing, the spatial structure hierarchy is from city to cluster to campus. The Xiaoguwei Island, recently constructed in Guangzhou University City, covers an area of approximately 17.9 square kilometers and is divided into five campus clusters. Each cluster consists of teaching areas, living areas, resource sharing areas, and public green spaces. It will accommodate 10 universities including Sun Yat sen University, South China University of Technology, South China Normal University, Guangdong University of Foreign Studies and Trade, Guangdong University of Technology, Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine, Guangdong Pharmaceutical College, Xinghai Conservatory of Music, and Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts, with a total of about 140000 students. It is a center for talent training, scientific research, and exchange in the South China region. A new urban area that integrates learning, research, and production development. The main external transportation arteries of Guangzhou University City (Xiaoguwei Island) include the north-south main road in the middle of Xiaoguwei and the central express line; The internal traffic presents a circular radial network, with the main roads being the outer ring, middle ring, inner ring, and connecting radial lines. The design red line width of the main road is 60 meters, second only to the road design red line width of 40 meters. To maintain a good ecological environment on Xiaoguwei Island, Guangzhou University City (Xiaoguwei Island) advocates public transportation, cycling, and walking.

Forest Sea Water Park has switched to winter hot spring mode, and from now until February 28, 2025, the park will provide free parking lots, storage cabinets, slippers, bath towels, tea and other services for forest friends; The projects that have been opened for operation include the Ancient Sea Water Kingdom Forest Hot Springs, Fishing and Shrimp Hunting, Cute Pet Paradise, Coconut Grove White Beach, Endless Swimming Pool, and Tianyang Lake Cruise. Looking forward to your experience. Ancient Sea Water Kingdom: Here, winter can be as warm as summer, unaffected by weather changes. The three-level play space meets the needs of different groups of people. On the first floor, there are projects suitable for parent-child interaction, such as a fantasy ark, mini space pool, and wave making pool. On the upper floor, there are two slides that are more suitable for adults to travel through time and space and spin around. Forest Hot Springs: It has 48 hot spring pools with internet famous features and functions, including the Bird's Nest Hot Spring, Colorful Hot Springs, Dynamic Hot Springs and other hot spring pools. In addition, there are hot spring SPA, slate bath, swimming pool, sauna room and other areas. If you're tired from playing, you can soak in hot springs here to soothe your body and mind. Catching Fish and Shrimp: Chasing fish in the stream, children can experience the fun of rolling up their pants, holding fishing nets, crossing ponds, and catching fish and shrimp with their parents or friends in the forest sea. If you are very good at catching loot, you can also bring your own small fish home. Cute Pet Paradise: A popular place among children in the park, where there are various cute animals such as lambs, alpacas, guinea pigs, ponies, and white rabbits. You can take photos and interact with cute pets inside, or purchase "snacks" to feed them on site. Tianyanghu District: A natural mineral lake with an area of approximately 130000 square meters, featuring exciting water leisure activities such as boating, parent-child kayaking, and pedal boats, allowing you to experience a variety of outdoor sports at once. There is also a water stage in the center of the lake, providing you with a stunning audio-visual feast during the break of swimming and resting. Coconut Grove White Beach: A check-in spot suitable for all ages and genders. Tiffany's blue water surface and pristine white sand beach make for a stunning sight with just a snap, giving off a feeling of being on vacation in Bali. Children can crawl freely on the huge pink climbing frame, or bring sand tools to sit on the beach and build their own little castles, or dig and dig on the small beach~

Guangzhou Rongchuang Water World covers an area of approximately 34000 square meters and is one of the few super large indoor constant temperature water worlds in southern China. With the design theme of "Maritime Silk Road", it is divided into three major themed areas: Maritime Adventure Zone, Underwater Treasure Zone, and Adventure Port Zone, showcasing the maritime culture and exotic charm of the southern region. The Water World boasts a variety of cutting-edge water entertainment facilities, including a tornado wind with a combination of loudspeakers and large waves, a fantastic drifting experience across 450 meters of rapids, an immersive 4D cinema in the water, and a super large double wave wave wave making pool, all designed to meet various water leisure and vacation needs. Newly created sky ocean and dream light and shadow shows, rich water carnival performances, and enjoy non-stop water fun all day long.

poiName: Memorial Museum of Generalissimo Sun Yat-sen's Mansion
summary: The Sun Yat sen Grand Marshal's Memorial Hall is located at No. 18 Dongsha Street, Zhizhi Road, Haizhu District. Its predecessor was a cement factory established by Guangdong Governor Cen Chunxuan in the late Qing Dynasty to supplement military expenses. The Sun Yat sen Grand Marshal's Memorial Hall consists of two yellow three story buildings, namely the South Building and the North Building, connected by a corridor in the middle, as well as East West Square and the main entrance. These two main buildings combine the Lingnan architectural style, such as vase style guardrails, louvered doors and windows, making the entire Xiaohuang Building look very spectacular. There are now long-term exhibitions in the museum, such as the restoration of "The Hundred Years of the General's Office", the basic exhibition of "Sun Yat sen Establishing Political Power Three Times in Guangzhou", "Famous Figures of the General's Office", "Panay's Architectural History in Guangzhou", and "Lingnan in Panay's Eyes". Sometimes there are also special temporary exhibitions. Generally, the tour starts from the north tower and ends at the south tower, and the entire tour takes about an hour. The North Tower displays Mr. Sun's revolutionary trajectory in Guangzhou, namely the basic exhibition of "Sun Yat sen Establishing Political Power Three Times in Guangzhou", as well as a large amount of historical materials on the establishment of Guangzhou city. On the railing of Sun Yat sen's office in the north building, there are also the words "Qiushi" personally inscribed by Sun Yat sen. The South Building has restored the original appearance of various rooms where Mr. Sun worked and lived. On the third floor, there are "Mr. Sun Yat sen's Office", "Grand Marshal's Mansion Conference Room", "Sun Song Bedroom", "Dining Room", "Washroom", "Wireless Telegraph Room" and the small guest room where Soong Mei ling once lived. The four rooms on the second floor are the "Staff Office", "Secretariat" (Liao Zhongkai's office), "Headquarters Bulletin Editing Room", and "General Councilor Room" (Hu Hanmin's office). The first floor also has various rooms, such as the "Medical Officer's Room", "Military Service Office", "Weapon Storage", and so on. The corridors on the first to third floors of the South Tower are a restored display of "The Hundred Years of the General's Mansion".

Conghua Fengyunling Forest Park is located in the northeast of Fengyunling, Conghua District, Guangzhou City. It is adjacent to the urban main road to the east, a resort area to the northeast, and Fengyunling to the west, with beautiful scenery. The park has lush forests and good air quality. There are stone steps up the mountain, but some are steep, and it takes about 40 minutes to climb from the main entrance. Suitable for weekends and family and friends to come here and breathe fresh air.

Beiji Camping Site 1 is located in Furongzhang Nature Scenic Area, Fubin Road, Huadu District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province. It is surrounded by mountains and water, with beautiful scenery, and is a holy place for outdoor experiences in the suburbs of the city, close to nature. Beiji Camping has complete facilities such as accommodation, catering, leisure and entertainment, and parent-child play. Each area is named after the 24 solar terms, reflecting the concept of "returning to nature, history, and the soul". We now have recreational and leisure facilities such as RV camping, Orion king size bed tent, courtyard tent, leisure bar, sunny lawn, outdoor stage, outdoor swimming pool, children's play, and viewing corridor.

Jinye Hot Springs is located in the northern suburbs of Zengcheng City, which is rich in hot springs. It is adjacent to Nankunshan Town in Huizhou to the east. The location of the hot springs is built against the mountains, with a wide view and a good geographical environment. It has a castle like atmosphere amidst the mountains and fields. Jinye Hot Spring is a hot spring area consisting of more than 20 different types of hot spring pools, VIP pools, massage rooms, and SPA hot spring villas. It has abundant hot spring resources and is known as the "Peach Blossom Spring" of Guangzhou due to its high peaks and deep valleys, year-round misty clouds, lush vegetation, and a wild atmosphere.

Guangzhou Rongchuang Cultural and Tourism City is located in Huadu District, Guangzhou City. The project covers a total area of approximately 2.2 million square meters, with a net land area of approximately 1.59 million square meters and a total investment of 50 billion RMB. It has 8 major business formats, namely South China Indoor Ski Resort - Guangzhou Hot Snow Miracle, South China Indoor Temperature Controlled Water Park - Guangzhou Rongchuang Water World, Large Outdoor Theme Park - Guangzhou Rongchuang Theme Park, Guangzhou Rongchuang Sports World, Guangzhou Rongchuang Mao, Binhu Bar Street, Resort Hotel Cluster, and Showground.

The No.1 Hall of Guangzhou Gymnasium is located within the Guangzhou Gymnasium in Baiyun District. The Gymnasium is the venue for gymnastics, basketball and other events of the 9th National Games, as well as the grand closing ceremony. The No.1 Hall is also often used as a venue for concerts.

Colorful Australia Tour World is built on the basis of mountains and rivers, with "Kangaroo" as the IP, integrating parent-child, sports, education and other content, presenting Australia's unique cultural landscape. Efforts will be made to build a 5A characteristic leisure and vacation scenic spot, a demonstration base for tourism and agriculture between China and Australia, an Australian health and elderly care experience demonstration zone, and a science and education exchange base.

Mibu Village is located in Conghua District, Guangzhou City, on the banks of the Liuxi River. With its beautiful natural environment, there are many high-end boutique homestays with themes of rural rice fragrance, leisure, cultural and creative, and health preservation.

Those who have read Jin Yong's martial arts novels will surely be familiar with the Tomb of the Living Dead at the foot of Zhongnan Mountain, where the Return of the Condor Heroes disappeared from the martial arts world. In "The Return of the Condor Heroes", this is the main venue for Xiaolongnu's activities, as well as the place where Xiaolongnu met, fell in love with, and lived in seclusion with Yang Guo, which can be regarded as a witness to their love. In fact, the Tomb of the Living Dead is the place where the founder of Quanzhen Taoism, Wang Chongyang, practiced and practiced. The Tomb of the Living Dead is located 40 kilometers southwest of Xi'an city, in Chengdao Palace, which is 4 to 5 miles away from Chongyang Palace. After Wang Chongyang's failure to resist the Jin Dynasty, he dug a cave and called it the "Tomb of the Living Dead". He hung a square plaque on it and wrote, "Wang harmed the insane spirit throne. He lived here for two years and also wrote a seven part poem called "The Tomb of the Living Dead, Dedicated to Ning Bo Gong". The poem states, "The living dead are like the living dead, and getting dead in life is a good reason. The silence in the tomb is truly empty, cutting off the dust of the world." It describes his special way of cultivating in the tomb of the living dead. Today, the tomb mound from the past is preserved here, with the words "Tomb of the Living Dead" engraved on a stone tablet in front. Someone once opened a tomb passage here, and there was indeed a basement inside, but it has been resealed for protection. Although it is not possible to explore the underground palace, martial arts fans with a "divine eagle complex" can still come here to see the places where Wang Chongyang, Xiaolongnu, and Yang Guo have lived after visiting the Chongyang Palace.

poiName: Tianren Shanshui RV Camping Site (Tianren Shanshui Earth Art Garden Store)
summary: The RV camping site in Tianren Shanshui Art Park offers a variety of styles of RVs, located in the mountains and on large lawns.

Guangzhou Hehui Hot Spring Hotel is located in Paitan Town, Zengcheng District, Guangzhou City. The hotel blends seamlessly with nature and has a unique geographical location, making it destined for customers to embark on a novel journey upon entering the hotel. The combination of the natural environment and residential space of Qingshan Cuifeng allows people to quickly escape from the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy the tranquility and freedom of relaxation hidden in the wilderness. The outdoor hot spring of the hotel is based on the theme of the five Taoist behaviors, and adopts the secret recipe specially prepared by the imperial physician for Concubine Yang. According to the five elements combined with herbal essence, the hot spring area is composed of five elements: gold, wood, water, fire, and soil. There are 21 characteristic pools, indoor cold and hot health pools, dry and wet steam rooms, etc. Guangzhou Hehui Hot Spring Hotel has a significant emphasis on parent-child elements. The children's club has a variety of amusement equipment, including large rotating slides, trampoline climbing, puzzle making, musical instrument books, art classes, reading rooms, and provides free childcare services for children aged 4-14.

Rainbow Bridge -- North Bund is located in the riverside area in the south of Hongkou District, adjacent to North Henan Road and Zhabei in the west, connected to Yangpu District in the east, connected to Dalian Road in the south, crossed by Suzhou Creek and Huangpu in the south, and adjacent to Haining Road, Zhoujiazui Road in the north. It is a plate with solid market foundation and fairly complete central business functions in the central urban area of Shanghai center. With the completion of the North Outer Beach waterfront, nearby residents can personally feel the ever-changing changes at their doorstep. Now, walking along the colorful trail, they can enjoy the beautiful scenery around them.

The Yabuli Snow Mountain Cold Zone Hot Spring at Yabuli Hot Spring International Resort Center is sourced from 1800 meters underground, with a drilling depth of about 2280 meters and a hot spring outlet temperature of about 52 ℃. It is a very high-quality cold zone hot spring. The hot spring area consists of more than 30 hot spring pools with different functions, including indoor hot spring pools, outdoor hot spring pools, Jiutian Yao Pool, children's play pool, fish pool, etc. The Jiutian Yao Pool, located on the central axis of the outdoor hot spring area with a huge drop, is a major highlight of Yabuli Hot Springs. There are many trees and dense forests near the hot springs, with green pines and white birch trees covering the steep mountains, providing you with a fairyland like experience of soaking in hot springs between mountains and waters. Let you feel the nourishment of art and culture in your mind while relaxing your body. The snow capped mountains and hot springs in winter are particularly unique, with a temperature difference of nearly 70 ℃ in the icy and snowy weather that can bring you a unique feeling of being caught between ice and fire.

Once glorious and with the passage of time, that unforgettable memory still lingers in the hearts of that generation, and the forest train is a representative work of that era and the main means of transportation at that time. The forest train is the crystallization of the new generation of tourism development trend, and also represents the transportation background of post modern mountainous areas. The Yabuli Forest Train is a piece of history, a culture, as well as an industrial heritage and a typical characteristic tourism resource. It is located within the Yabuli Ski Resort and is connected to the Xuexiang Highway. It is a scenic railway that connects the Yabuli tourist town "Qingyun Town" with the Yabuli Ski Resort. Built in 1963, it was later renovated with the development of the tourism industry. The current tourism and sightseeing products have a total length of 9 kilometers, winding through forests and green grass. The starting station is Yabuli Ski Resort, passing through Haohanbo Reservoir, Transportation Manor, larch forest, birch forest, private gardens, deer farms, African lion gardens, ordinary households, Yaxue Service Center, Kanto Club, hot spring health resort center, boardwalk entrance, and wooden villa group. In summer, breathe fresh and feel the breath, and in winter, travel through forests and snowy plains to experience ice and snow culture.

summary: Shanghai Lavender Park is located south of the ecological park, adjacent to Xingyuan Lake, and is a narrow themed planting park. Nearly 200000 lavender plants are planted in the park, and the spectacular lavender landscape is showcased during the peak flowering period in May and June every year. In addition, the colorful flower fields, rose garden, patterned horticulture, and crabapple flower corridor in the park are also good places for tourists to relax and enjoy flowers. The square building adopts a novel plain concrete water pipe as the spatial structure of the building, which, together with the wooden exterior wall, creates a unique and simple entrance gate of the vanilla garden. The lavender flower field is located on the south side of the colorful flower field. Lavender is an evergreen aromatic shrub, known as the "fragrant herb". Whenever the flowers bloom and the wind blows, the entire lavender field rises and falls like deep purple waves layer by layer, and people in the flowers look like fairies. Rose Garden: The rose garden is located to the northwest of the lavender field, and is planted with a variety of rose varieties such as shrub roses, dwarf roses, climbing roses, and spreading roses. Some of them have a flowering period that lasts from summer to winter, greatly extending the season for garden viewing. Grand Lawn: The wedding grand lawn is adjacent to the south of the rose garden and the southwest of the lavender garden. Here, beautiful lawn wedding venues, backgrounds, and services are prepared for tourists. WILD WEEKEND Camping Party: Come outdoors for a wild weekend, breathe with the blue sky and white clouds, look out in your own tent, warm breeze brushing your face, laughter and joy.
