Handmade Studio: In addition to what you see in your eyes, there are also lavender flowers, handmade flower garlands, soap, sachets, and other things that touch the hearts of young girls.

The main body of the Holy Elephant Square is surrounded by 12 different shaped holy elephants carrying sutras on their backs. These 12 six toothed white elephants are the mounts used by Shakyamuni Buddha. Each elephant is 6 meters long, 2.5 meters wide, and 4 meters high, plus a 9-meter pillar on its body, making a total height of 13.9 meters. The granite used to make the stone elephants was mined from a mine in Quanzhou, Fujian. Choosing the number of 12 represents the cycle of time and the endless life. The six sides of the sutra on the body of the holy elephant are engraved with representative scriptures and works of Tibetan Buddhism, Chinese Buddhism, and Southern Buddhism. It is currently the largest group of granite carved stone statues in China.

poiName: Nanyue Kingdom Royal Garden Exhibition Hall
summary: On September 8, 2021, the Nanyue King Museum (Western Han Nanyue National History Research Center) was formed by the merger of the former Nanyue King Museum and the former Nanyue Palace Museum. The Nanyue Palace Museum belongs to the palace exhibition area and is located on Zhongshan 4th Road in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province. It has a protected area of about 53000 square meters and is the only major site project in Guangdong Province that has been listed as a key protected site during the national "Eleventh Five Year Plan" period.
opening_hours: Open at 09:00-17:30(Tickets available until 17:00; admission ends at 17:00)

summary: Lanxue Hall is the main hall in the eastern part of Humble Administrator's Garden, facing north and south, with a central hall partition separating the front and back. On the north side of the pre art lacquer sculpture "Humble Administrator's Garden Panorama" board is a huge emerald bamboo painting.

Yuanxiang Hall is a four sided pavilion and the main building in the middle of the Humble Administrator's Garden. It was built on the site of the former Ruoshu Hall during the Qing Dynasty's Qianlong reign, and the bluestone roof foundation was the original object at that time. The name of the hall is derived from lotus flowers. In summer, lotus leaves and fields in the pond, with lotus breeze blowing on the face and a fragrant aroma far away, are a great place to appreciate lotus flowers.

Liuting Pavilion is a single story pavilion, small and lightweight, with windows on all sides and a front platform, making it a great place to enjoy autumn lotus and rain. The Liuting Pavilion originated from the Tang Dynasty poet Li Shangyin's line "Autumn shade does not disperse, frost flies late, leaving withered lotus flowers to listen to the sound of rain".

There is a unique cave, named after Tang Zhang's poem "To the Moon", which separates the half pavilion in the Humble Administrator's Garden and the western corridor: "There are thirty-six unique caves, and the crystal platform hall is cold layer by layer.

The Nine Lion Peak is made of the Taihu Lake Lake stones. It is one of the representatives of many lake stone peaks in the Lion Forest. It is named after the nine lions in the shape of mimicry. Fengshi is exquisite and unique, full of wit and humor. The swaying green bamboo creates a unique and majestic melody, constantly changing and unpredictable.

Located at 45 Renmin Road, it was listed as a cultural relic protection unit in Jiangsu Province in 1957. The Suzhou Confucian Temple, also known as the Prefectural School, was first built in 1035 during the Northern Song Dynasty. It was established by Fan Zhongyan during his tenure as the governor of the state, using the old site of the Qian family's southern garden in Wu Yue during the Five Dynasties period. "The left side is the Guangdian, the right side is the Gongtang, the Panchi Lake is in front, and the study room is next to it. Fan Zhongyan reformed the old system and integrated official schools with temples dedicated to Confucius, creating a new pattern of left temple and right school. This system was later imitated by various regions. In 1089, Fan Chunli, the son of Fan Zhongyan, expanded the land in the southern garden gap. In the fourth year of Jianyan in the Southern Song Dynasty (1130 AD), it was destroyed in a war and left completely intact. In the eleventh year of Shaoxing (1141), Pingjiang Prefect Liang Rujia was rebuilt. From then on, until the third year of the Qing Dynasty's Tongzhi reign (1864) to the seventh year, Jiangsu Governor Li Hongzhang and Ding Richang successively repaired and expanded more than 30 times over a period of more than 700 years, with inscriptions and chronicles available for reference. During the Southern Song Dynasty, there were 230 buildings. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, the land covered over 150 acres, approximately 100000 square meters.

poiName: shan tang jie gu xi tai
summary: The ancient stage on Shantang Street was built next to the bustling street, serving as a place for the common people to "watch white opera". Frequently organize various cultural and artistic activities as well as temple fairs. The architectural style of the ancient stage is modeled after the Tang Dynasty. The two side rooms display stills of representative Kunqu opera works, as well as Kunqu opera masks and costumes. Famous performers and fans often perform on stage.

Among the several water tour routes in Zhouzhuang Ancient Town, the popular one is the ancient town water lane tour. The boats on the water lane tour are rowing boats with open awnings on all sides, and boatmen rowing boats. The boats pass through the old water lanes in the ancient town and cross under ancient bridges. You can enjoy the scenery on the boat, which is also a scenic line in the eyes of others. Cruise route: Ancient Town Water Lane Pier - Fu'an Bridge - Taiping Bridge - Qinglong Bridge - Fuhong Bridge - Tongxiu Bridge. Hiring a boatman to sing on board may require additional payment.
People can drive small tractor trucks here and explore the jungle in search of novelty.

Shangfangshan National Forest Park is located about 5 kilometers southwest of Suzhou city and is the core scenic area of Shihu Scenic Area. Here, the green mountains and clear waters create a picturesque Jiangnan countryside scenery. You can enjoy hiking and cherry blossoms, as well as visit several historical sites worth visiting. The Hundred Flowers Festival is held here from late March to early May every year, showcasing various flowers and birds. In early spring, Shangfang Mountain is a sea of cherry blossoms. At this time, local residents often set up tents on the large lawn in the park to enjoy flowers and play, or enjoy fun and delicious food in the barbecue area. However, by late April, the cherry blossoms had basically withered. The entire scenic area is mainly composed of Shangfang Mountain, sightseeing orchard area, and forest recreation area. The open-air "Golden Light Buddha" on Shangfang Mountain is very eye-catching, but the cable car that used to go to the Golden Light Buddha has now been suspended. Tourists can climb up the steps along the trail, and the mountain altitude above is only 92 meters. Hiking and climbing can be used as exercise. The Lengjia Pagoda of the Song Dynasty is a landmark and higher point on Shangfang Mountain, as well as historical sites such as Zhiping Temple, Shihu Thatched Cottage, and Qianlong Imperial Road. In addition, there are peacock gardens, various botanical gardens, and dedicated expansion and barbecue areas here. Guide: Enter the park from the main entrance located on the northern section of Wuyue Road. To the right is the historic Zhiping Temple and Shihu Thatched Cottage. If you go straight to the right, you will reach Shifo Temple, Fancheng Ancestral Hall, and the north entrance. From the main entrance, walk left to reach the Golden Buddha, Peacock Garden, and Expansion Base. Along the way, you will also pass through several large lawns and botanical gardens. Continuing further, you can climb the Shangfang Mountain to visit the Lengjia Pagoda.
opening_hours: Opens at 07:30-17:00(Tickets available until 16:30; admission ends at 16:30)

summary: Guangfu Scenic Spot is located on the shore of the Taihu Lake Lake, 28 kilometers west of Suzhou City, and includes three main scenic spots, namely, Xiangxuehai, Situ Temple, and Tongguanyin Temple. The distribution of various scenic spots is scattered, although they are all accessible by bus, it is still better to drive by oneself. There aren't many attractions on weekdays, but once it's the Plum Blossom Festival from February to March, Xiangxuehai, which is far more famous than Guangfu, is crowded with people because it can enjoy the plum blossoms. You can drive from the highway all the way to the entrance of the scenic spot, so it's recommended to avoid holidays. In addition, it is also a good choice to enjoy the scenery of the the Taihu Lake Lake, eat the fresh lake food and experience a handful of fisherman's entertainment. The essence scenic spot Xiangxuehai is located in Dengwei Mountain. It has been a plum blossom appreciation resort for 300 years. The words "Xiangxuehai" are the inscriptions of Song Luo, the governor of Jiangsu Province in the Qing Dynasty. There is a poem monument of Qianlong near the Plum Blossom Pavilion. The Wenmei Pavilion on the mountainside offers tourists tea and plum blossoms, while the Guanmei Pavilion on the mountaintop overlooks the entire sea of flowers. The mountain is not high, making it easy to climb to the top. During the Plum Blossom Festival (February March), white plum, red plum, green plum, and black plum blossom bloom in competition, with many varieties. If it weren't for the Plum Blossom Festival, you could enjoy the white flowers and yellow stamens of the wooden lotus in June, and the fragrance of osmanthus flowers in autumn. The Situ Temple, rebuilt in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, is only separated from Xiangxuehai by a road. Inside the temple, Deng Yu, the great Situ of the Eastern Han Dynasty, is enshrined, and stone carvings of the Ming Dynasty's "Lengyan Jing" and "Diamond Sutra" can be seen. There is a Suzhou garden style backyard behind Situ Temple, where you can also enjoy plum blossoms. The four ancient cypresses in the cypress garden are worth a visit. Each one is over two thousand years old, and its branches are intertwined with each other. Several of them have been struck by lightning and are still growing. The Copper Guanyin Temple is located about 2 kilometers away from the Fragrant Snow Sea in Guangfu Ancient Town. It is named after a bronze Guanyin statue excavated during the Song Dynasty. The Guangfu Temple Bridge at the gate is an old object of the Song Dynasty. The the Shakya ManiHall and the Western Hall were built in the 12th year of Daoguang's reign in the Qing Dynasty (AD 1832). You can overlook the Guangfu Ancient Town by climbing the seven storey Guangfu Tower. Although the riverside of the ancient town is also a water town with white walls and black tiles, it has been renovated. On the other hand, the large cherry blossoms on the back mountain of Tongguanyin Temple, after withering, bring a lot of psychological comfort to tourists. In the southwest of the scenic spot, from the Taihu Lake No. 1 Bridge to the Taihu Lake No. 2 Bridge and the Taihu Lake Fishing Port Village, countless fishing boats stop by the the Taihu Lake Lake, giving people a free view of fishermen's customs. You can eat fish while sitting on the boat. Package a boat for 400 yuan to 600 yuan. Eating lake food on the boat will cost you extra. A table will cost several hundred yuan. The more expensive the ingredients you choose, the more expensive the meal will be. "the Taihu Lake Three Whites" white fish, whitebait, and white shrimp are a must. The aquatic products wholesale market between "Madaowan" and "the Taihu Lake No.2 Bridge" bus station is always crowded. Dried fish, dried shrimps and hairy crabs are worth buying. If you want to buy specialty products, the candied fruits sold at specialty stalls around Xiangxuehai are also good, especially those with the word "mei", such as green plums, yangmei, and preserved plums. There are some ordinary hotels in the center of Guangfu Town, and there are several hotels with lake view rooms near the Taihu Lake Lake. However, since you can return to Suzhou on the same day, it is not necessary to stay in Guangfu unless you want to spend a few days on vacation near the Taihu Lake Lake. In addition, the scenic area also has attractions such as Shibi Yonghui Zen Temple (Shibi Jingshe), Shideng An (Shideng Jingshe), Sheng'en Temple, etc., which are only visited by tourists who travel in depth.

poiName: Pingjiang Road Xianyayuan Kunqu and Pingtan Theater
summary: Suzhou Pingjiang Road Xianyayuan Kunqu Pingtan Museum is located in the core area of Pingjiang Road, presenting Kunqu and Pingtan art in the form of tea house singing. Elegant environment, garden style decoration, full of ancient style and charm. The actors in the museum are professional and perform classic songs such as' Slow Sound 'and' Night Mooring at Maple Bridge ', providing visitors with an immersive experience of Su style culture. The highlight lies in its unique performance form and strong cultural atmosphere, making it a great place to experience Suzhou's traditional culture.

The original name of Nanhu Lake is Shangshuiyu (Zhangyanyu Lake), commonly known as Nanbaidang. No matter how crowded the core attraction of Zhouzhuang Ancient Town is near Shuangqiao, walking to the edge of Nanhu Lake always gives a feeling of sudden enlightenment. You can take the Quanfu Long Bridge, visit Nanhu Autumn Moon Garden, or pay to take a boat tour. Nanhu Lake is said to have a connection with the idiom "water shield perch". Nanhu Autumn Moon Garden is the main scenic spot by Nanhu Lake, divided into four categories: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The spring, summer, and autumn scenic areas are filled with garden scenery, among which the Si Lu Tang and Ji Ying Zhai were built in memory of Zhang Han, who was the one who proposed the allusion of "the thought of water bass". The Liu Bin Guest House and Dream Pavilion were built in memory of Liu Yuxi. The winter scenic area is centered around Quanfu Temple, which is a typical garden temple. The temple buildings and pavilions are mostly floating on the water, known as the "Buddhist Kingdom in the Water", and the scenery is very beautiful. The Quanfu Long Bridge, which runs east-west, spans over Nanhu Lake. It is a modern stone arch bridge with a slender and beautiful shape, and lights up at night to enjoy the night view. Near the bridgehead of Quanfu Changqiao is the upstream dock of Huanzhen Water. Cruise boats on the upstream of Huanzhen Water circle around the outskirts of Zhouzhuang Ancient Town. Another starting and ending dock is near the old street of Taiwan in the Love Ferry style town.

Qiyuan, commonly known as "Xijia Garden", is one of the gardens in Suzhou that is built along the mountain and by the water. Qiyuan consists of three parts: courtyard, garden, and Liuyi courtyard. Among them, Liu Yijing, Kangxi's hand planted Yangmei tree, and Imperial Wharf are the "Three Treasures" of Qiyuan. In the whole garden, the composition of four halls, corridors, turning lakes, rockeries and new buildings is balanced and harmonious, especially the "Imperial Wharf" in the garden, embedded in the rippling the Taihu Lake Lake, which is very poetic.

The Taiping Bridge was built during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty and rebuilt in the 36th year of the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty (1771 AD). It is a single arch stone bridge with a lotus pedestal pattern engraved on it. Vines grow in the crevices of the bridge body, making it very photogenic. The painting "One Day in Zhouzhuang" by Japanese female painter Shingen Hashimoto depicts the Taiping Bridge and includes herself in it. Standing on Nanshi Street across from Taiping Bridge, you can capture the Taiping Bridge at the mouth of the North South City River and the T-shaped mouth of the Hougang River, as well as the water town households surrounded by bamboo fences and potted plants at the bridgehead of Taiping Bridge. The photos taken are very flavorful. A cruise ship passing in front of the bridge and through the bridge opening is also a good material for photography. The Taiping Bridge is not far from the Shuangqiao Bridge. If you choose the right angle, you can also take a panoramic photo that includes the Shuangqiao Bridge.

The total planned area of Shawan Dishuiyan Forest Park is 7290 acres, with an ecological public welfare forest area of 6121.5 acres. The park mainly includes pine forest, wetland pine forest, mixed coniferous and broad-leaved forest, acacia forest, eucalyptus forest, mixed broad-leaved forest, bamboo forest, etc. Due to long-term mountain closure for afforestation, the average forest canopy density of Dishuiyan forest can reach 75%, and the vegetation coverage can reach 95%. In front of the park is the Drip Water Rock Bird Nature Reserve. Since its establishment in 1997, it has become a paradise for wild birds. The park now has various bird species such as grey herons, white egrets, owls, monkey faced eagles, mountain sparrows, yellow warblers, and pheasants. The spring water in the small reservoir is clear and sweet. A small reservoir has been built above Drip Water Rock, with a total area of 712.5 acres including the planned Longwan Creek water surface. Water flows down the river through the overflow outlet all year round, and at the foot of the square mountain below Drip Water Rock, a small pool is formed with clear water like a mirror. At sunset in the reservoir, the sunlight reflects on the water surface, creating a pleasant scenery with mountain and water colors.

GRANDVIEW PENGUIN SNOW WORLD, produced by Zhengjia Planet, is located in the atrium on the 7th floor of Zhengjia Square. The project covers an area of about 5000n square meters and integrates ice and snow landscapes, ice and snow amusement, characteristic performances, animal interaction, polar science popularization and other experiences in both the South and North Pole. It is an indoor ice and snow park with real ice, real snow and real penguins. Adhering to the corporate mission of creating happiness and joy for humanity and injecting imagination into cities, in the Zhengjia Penguin Ice and Snow World, we fully restore the super scenes and experiences of the North and South Poles, solving the pain points of tourists unable to reach them. With love and companionship, we embark on an imaginative journey of ice and snow exploration, lighting up everyone's expectations for exploring polar nature and planting the seeds to protect this blue planet.

Guangzhou Ketianxia International Tourism Resort is located in Taohua Town, Conghua, Guangzhou. It is backed by Dajin Peak, surrounded by mountains on all sides, and surrounded by trees, cleverly blending with the valley terrain. The main peak of Dajin Peak is 666 meters above sea level, with abundant forest vegetation and a forest coverage rate of over 80%; The negative ion content in the air is high, and the overall negative oxygen ion content in the project is higher than 20000/cm ³. In some areas, the negative ion content is even close to 30000/cm ³, making it a natural oxygen bar. The project is located in Taohua Town, Conghua District, Guangzhou, adjacent to the main urban area of Conghua. It is only 1 hour away from the Pearl River New Town CBD, 40 minutes from Baiyun Airport, 50 minutes from Guangzhou High speed Railway North Station, 10 minutes from Guangzhou Metro Chicao Station, and only 1.5 hours from the central area of Shenzhen. It occupies the core of Guangdong Hong Kong Macao Greater Bay Area, with obvious regional advantages. The project covers an area of approximately 6000 acres, with the theme of "Love and Forest". It revolves around four major systems of culture, exploration, wonder, and healing, and focuses on creating nine major business formats, including cultural and tourism complexes, children's animation industry, children's experiential education industry, happy wedding industry, outdoor expansion education industry, biotechnology health industry, Love Wooden House Hotel, Forest Health Homestay, and Allardo Hotel Shangri La Hotel. It fully promotes the spirit of craftsmanship in the world and creates a benchmark cultural and tourism project in the Guangdong Hong Kong Macao Greater Bay Area.

Furong Pavilion: A square shaped mountain top scenic building facing the water in the east of the Humble Administrator's Garden, located north of the main hall Lanxue Hall and at the east end of the large lotus pond. The lotus pond is roughly rectangular in shape, long from east to west and narrow from north to south. Therefore, there is a deep water feature in front of the west facing small pavilion, where lotus plants are planted in the water. The lotus is also known as hibiscus, and the name of the small pavilion comes from this. Furong Pavilion has become a very distinctive scenery in the east, especially on summer nights when the bright moon shines in the sky, the bright moon, the gentle breeze, the moonlight shadows, and the fragrance of lotus flowers are all present, which can truly bring viewers a beautiful feeling. The interior decoration of Xiaoxie is also extremely exquisite. The west side of the small pavilion facing the water is decorated with carved round light covers, the east side is a floor to ceiling door, and the north and south sides are quaint window frames, exuding the elegant atmosphere of Suzhou garden buildings.

Ecological Design Town is a new industrial park in the Guangdong Hong Kong Macao Greater Bay Area, built under the background of China Switzerland low-carbon city cooperation. It is located in the Liuxi Hot Spring Resort in Conghua, Guangzhou, with the goal of creating a "global ecological design source center" and "China's ecological design capital". By introducing ecological design industry, cultural and creative technology industry, etc., it has formed an ecological design industry cluster area integrating industry, culture, leisure, tourism, sports, education, and recuperation.

Wuzhishan has a mild climate, with an altitude of over 1100 meters and a general temperature between 10 ° C and 15 ° C. It has abundant rainfall, low temperatures, and high humidity, making it a great place for the development of high-tech ecological flowers and people's leisure and summer vacations. Here, there are both temperate breezes and tropical sunshine, with low temperatures and high humidity. The sunshine is abundant, and the temperature varies between minus 3 degrees Celsius and 28 degrees Celsius throughout the year. The altitude of the mountain ranges from 500 to 1100 meters, with low mountains in the middle and high mountains around, making it less susceptible to natural disasters such as typhoons, floods, and cold waves. It is suitable for the growth, cultivation, and reproduction of flowers and other plants at different altitudes and in different climates. Among them, the spectacular and beautiful granite rocks, intersecting canyons, towering strange rocks, and spacious sky beds have become good tourist attractions; There are over a thousand species of wild plants, and there are still primitive secondary forests. Various rare plants and flowers are hidden deep in the forest; Wild animals mainly include wild boars, bison, wild sheep, pangolins, and thrushes; Adequate water resources, no environmental pollution, and good water quality. Different levels of small streams crisscross, and dangerous rapids and waterfalls can be seen everywhere, forming a wonderful scenery within the ecological zone. Note: Guangzhou Liuxihe Forest Park is divided into two major scenic areas, namely Liuxihu Scenic Area with Liuxihu as its theme and Wuzhishan Scenic Area with river tracing and mountain climbing as its theme. The two are 4 kilometers apart and there are currently no scenic area vehicles connecting them.
opening_hours: Open at 08:00-17:00(Tickets available until 16:00; admission ends at 16:00)

summary: San Ya Tang You Gu, located in the Wuzhishan Scenic Area, is a subtropical mountain rainforest with a mild climate, abundant rainfall, natural ecology, and fresh air. The forest coverage rate in Yougu reaches 98%. A 2500 meter long upstream path has been opened through the central part of the valley, creating unique landscapes such as green bamboo, subtropical mountain rainforest, millennium old vines, Feiliu Xianqiao, Tongtian Cave, Bishuitan, and Yougu Beach, as well as five cultural landscapes including ancient charcoal kilns and Sanyatang Dam. There are not many artificial decorations in the scenic area, everything looks very primitive, which also allows a large number of green plants in the scenic area to be preserved. The environment is quiet and the air is very fresh, making it a natural oxygen bar. There is also a place in the scenic area that sells dry goods, all of which are picked from the mountains and are of good quality and affordable. On Yougu Mountain, unique stone houses, guest rooms, restaurants, and other service facilities have been built. In this valley, you can enjoy playing with the mountains and waters, eating mountain treasures, visiting the villa, soaking in mountain springs, barbecuing in the wild, and having bonfire parties. It is a great place for people to strengthen their health, explore and get close to nature. Before arriving at the secluded valley of Sanyatang, there is a magnificent Nanshan Waterfall with clear water that reaches the bottom. The surrounding green trees and bamboo forests are environmentally friendly, and the sky is blue with white clouds, creating a beautiful landscape painting.

Huanglongxi Happy Countryside has a large wild water play area in Longxi Valley, covering nearly 10000 square meters. It integrates amusement and water play, popular projects, leisurely entertainment, and immersive experiences, covering four theme water play areas: Ziwei Diexi, Banyan Pool, Shuishan Forest, and Taohuatan. This is a summer paradise and water play paradise for the citizens of Rongcheng. In the rice paddies and water play area, bottle feeding fish is not only experiential, but also fun and ornamental. Huanglongxi Happy Garden is a free and poetic Eden, which is praised as "rural Türkiye". The scenic area has seven themed areas including Dahe Terraced Fields, Chuanjiang Caohai, Wuyang Tea Valley, Luxi Ranch, and Colorful Forest, which can satisfy your romantic fantasy of rural life. The scenic area boasts spectacular terraced fields, leisurely pastures, cascading tea mountains, and dreamlike grass and flower seas, among other agricultural landscapes, reproducing the prosperous agricultural scenery of Tianfu and vividly interpreting the rural life of Sichuan and Sichuan. Here, you can escape the hustle and bustle of the city's fast-paced lifestyle, wander through the fields, experience the leisurely feeding of alpacas on the pasture, feel the purity of nature, and enjoy a relaxing environment. The viewing time for rapeseed flowers is from late February to mid March. Recommended viewing locations include outdoor squares, terraced fields, villages in Western Sichuan, and rural trains; From late February to mid March, you can enjoy beautiful peach blossoms at flower restaurants, terraced fields, Lover's Bay, Taohua Lake, Haitang Lake, Taohua Slope, and other places; In March, you can enjoy pear blossoms on Pear Blossom Avenue; From late April to late May, you can see large patches of horsewhip grass on the Romantic Road and swim in the purple ocean. The Blue Jacaranda Avenue has planted multiple Blue Jacaranda trees, and it is recommended to come and admire the flowers from late May to early June every year. Huanglongxi Happy Countryside combines natural conditions to create three exploration paths in the "Jungle Adventure" project: the Dragon Line, Mountain Line, and Village Line. These paths cleverly connect animals, nature, villages, and people, with one safety rope and one exploration mobile rope taking you through a suspended bridge, swinging on a swing, and exploring the wild world. Here, everything is available for eating, drinking, and entertainment, and there is constant joy throughout the year. It is a dream destination for families to travel. The tour map of Huanglongxi Happy Countryside is as follows

A Republican building in Taikoo Li, with walls and floors made of small green bricks, and a front and back courtyard structure, is a typical form of modern urban housing in western Sichuan. It is now a luxury watch store.

poiName: Wolong China Giant Panda Garden Shenshuping Base of Ccrcgp
summary: Wolong China Panda Garden Shenshuping Base is located in Gengda Town, Wolong Nature Reserve. It consists of areas such as Shenshuping Panda Breeding & Visiting Area, Captive Panda Wilderness Training Area, and Field Release Area. It contains a Tourist Reception Center, Science Education Center, Scientific Research Office, and other related establishments. The base not only provides a comfortable habitat for captive panda populations around the world, but also provides the public with the opportunity to get close to the pandas.

Since its operation, the Chengdu City Tour sightseeing bus has opened a total of 5 routes, namely the Cultural and Museum Observation Light Line, Panda Direct Line, D025 Panda Line, Chengde Line Guobao Line, and Dongke Station Panda Line.

Chengdu Zoo exhibits over 300 species of animals including mammals, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and ornamental fish throughout the year. In the river, you can see tigers, lions, golden monkeys, giraffes, red crowned cranes, elephants, and other animals. The most popular area is the Panda Pavilion. The Panda House consists of two outdoor sports fields, three air-conditioned rooms, an indoor exhibition hall, and several operating rooms. The museum has a long history and has exhibited giant pandas since its opening. In the process of raising and breeding giant pandas, Chengdu Zoo was the first to conduct research on artificial insemination of giant pandas in the 1980s and made significant breakthroughs. Since the 1980s, panda cubs have been born every year. The zoo is located far from the city center, adjacent to the Zhaojuesi Bus Center Station. It takes about 40-50 minutes to take a taxi from Chunxi Road in the city center. Next to the zoo is Zhaojue Temple, and if you have plenty of time, you can also visit it together.

Music Hundred Flowers Valley is located in Wulong Mountain, Xindu Vanke. It is a mountain music themed flower sea project in the suburbs of Chengdu, integrating tourism and sightseeing, photography, banquet and catering, science education, and cute pets and children. Various cultural landscapes in the scenic area are integrated with earth art, and flowers bloom all year round in the mountains, with colorful scenery everywhere. Just take a photo here and you will be amazed by your friends' circle. As soon as you enter the park, the first thing that catches your eye is a sea of flowers covering the mountains and fields. There are many types of flowers, especially autumn flowers. What attracts your attention are the various forms of flower carving art. The unique shapes, cute or artistic, seem to immerse you in the fragrant world of flowers and plants. In addition, you can also have intimate contact with deer here, which is an ideal place for traveling around Chengdu. Since it is the 'Music Hundred Flowers Valley', how come it lacks the artistic charm of various music elements?! There are hundreds of authentic instrument exhibitions here, including various Chinese and foreign ethnic instruments, as well as rare displays of endangered techniques In addition to hundreds of musical instruments, there are also thousands of wind chimes that combine into beautiful blessing sounds, sending messages with the wind.
opening_hours: Open at 09:00-18:00(Tickets available until 17:30; admission ends at 17:30)

summary: The Haohai Cube Aquarium is located in the Haibin City Shopping Center in Chengdu and has broken two Guinness World Records. The underwater tunnel is about 40 meters long and provides a panoramic view of marine life in the sea trough. Tourists can camp in the tunnel at night and listen to the sound of the waves, as if they were in a dragon palace, which is breathtakingly beautiful. The Jellyfish Wonders Jellyfish Pavilion is quite outstanding. Watching jellyfish swimming in a large fish tank, accompanied by embellished lighting, it is magnificent and moving. There are fluorescent jellyfish walls painted by art masters, magical jellyfish mazes, and colorful lighting. The exquisite mirror scenes involve the interplay of light and shadow mottled glass, as if one is in a mysterious dreamland. The themed and characteristic exhibition areas include China Pavilion, Cold Sea Zone, Tropical Zone, Amazon Zone, Coastal Zone, Penguin Pavilion, Seal Paradise, Jellyfish Wonders, Seahorse Adventure, Shark Town, General's Mansion, Dream Journey, Shark Theater, Sea Lion and Seal Performance Theater, Mudanjiang Giant Monster, etc. These exhibition areas are presented here with unique features. Shark Town is located in the newly built Shark Town, which is peaceful and tranquil. However, there are groups of lemon sharks swimming freely here. They are violent and ferocious by nature, and can instantly tear their prey into pieces. Close contact with them will make you shudder! The Ocean Theater Haohai Cube Ocean Hall has been upgraded in 2017, adding an ocean theater that can accommodate 350 people to watch performances at the same time. Here, you can see smart and cute sea lions waving to you in a friendly manner, as well as adorable seals wriggling their chubby bodies and agile movements in the water circle. The Fantasy Journey "Through the Mysterious Island" and "Fantasy Journey" are new and heavyweight experience projects created by Haohai Cube Aquarium, which are included in the ticket price and do not require additional payment. With the characteristics of "new, adventurous, and fantastic", and the combination of modern technology elements and marine culture, a new tourism IP belonging to the Haohai Cube has been created, providing tourists with a rich gaming experience. In addition, there are other rich marine creatures and entertainment projects in the museum, where you can observe various fish and amphibians up close, suitable for family outings!

Passing through the wave of cars, I arrived at the TIT Creative Park located on Xingang Middle Road and immediately felt refreshed. This seems to be a secluded paradise, with no more traffic in the park. Walking on the wide red brick road, one instantly has the interest of leisurely strolling in the courtyard. Exhibition boards have been set up in the park, specifically introducing the past and present of the TIT Creative Park. When renovating the park, efforts were made to preserve the original buildings and historical information within the factory area, emphasizing the reuse of abandoned industrial facilities. For example, many mechanical equipment were moved to open spaces or grasslands and directly transformed into sculptures, which appeared novel and unique to outsiders. At the same time, the park has introduced elements of innovation, fashion, and modernity, balancing economic feasibility and attracting a large number of fashion design masters from various schools to set up studios here. A WeChat studio is also located within the park.

Lotus Wind Four Sided Pavilion, named after lotus flowers, is located on a small island in the middle of the garden, surrounded by water on all sides. The lotus pavilion is pure and planted, with willow branches swaying along the shore.

The Meiren Leg Peninsula is one of the three major peninsulas of Yangcheng Lake. From the air, the "Meiren Leg" stretches 13.5 kilometers from north to south, resembling a delicate jade leg of a beautiful woman, extending into the blue waves of Yangcheng Lake. The Meiren Leg Scenic Area is mainly distributed in the following tourist attractions: firstly, ecological sightseeing spots: from Meiren Leg, you can overlook the famous island in the lake: Lianhua Island; Beauty Leg Ecological Zone; Yangcheng Lake 10000 acre crab pond; The second is the tourism service center: the Yangcheng Lake tourism distribution center is located on the Lotus Island pier of Meiren Legs; Thirdly, the Beauty Leg Scenic Area is dotted with ecological farms and farmhouses, with beautiful environments and natural ecology. The Beauty Leg Scenic Area has natural scenery that makes urbanites yearn for and intoxicated. Especially in spring, the spring atmosphere is harmonious, with spring flowers blooming on the island and willows forming rows. The red is enchanting and charming, the pink is delicate and beautiful, the green is graceful and graceful, and the golden rapeseed flowers are clustered one after another. Many people take advantage of weekends to rest and drive to "Beauty Legs" to enjoy the beautiful scenery of spring.

The Jinguli Art Museum is located in Gusu District, Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province. The venue is spacious and full of artistic atmosphere. There are numerous artistic works in the exhibition hall, all of which are unique, innovative, and interesting. The second floor of the exhibition hall is the performance venue for Kunqu Opera, where visitors can change into costumes and personally experience the charm of Kunqu Opera on stage. This is a great place for you to relax and enjoy art tours.

Located on the Xishan Island of the Taihu Lake Lake in Suzhou, the Great Ruyi Holy Land is 800 miles away from the Taihu Lake Lake in the south and the first ethereal peak of the 72 peaks of the Taihu Lake Lake in the north. It is surrounded by mountains shaped like green dragons and white tigers in the east and west, surrounded by the left and right. Its geographical location is a Buddhist cultural holy land integrating incense burning, landscape scenery, leisure and vacation, and self-cultivation. Xishan Island of the Taihu Lake Lake in Suzhou has many temples and incense sticks since ancient times. It is a holy land of Buddhism handed down from generation to generation. The Great Guanyin Temple in the scenic area was first built in the second year of the Yuanjia reign of the Southern Dynasty (425 AD). It is an ancient Guanyin temple in China and has formed an inseparable bond with six emperors. Throughout history, literati and scholars have come here to admire this place, leaving behind a large number of poems and calligraphic works. The rebuilt Great Guanyin Temple on the original site is magnificent, exquisite and elegant, completely subverting the style of traditional temples and representing the new trend of Buddhist art today.

Mudu Shantang Street is the main street of Mudu Ancient Town, starting from Zhongshi Street in the east and connecting to Lingyan Mountain in the west. The main attractions and cuisine of the ancient town are concentrated here. It is said that during the Spring and Autumn Period, King Fuchai of Wu built the Guanwa Palace on the top of Lingyan Mountain to please Xi Shi. Labor and supplies gathered here, so many families settled in the mountain ponds and gradually developed into towns. Although Mudu Shantang Street has a layout similar to Shantang Street in Suzhou city, consisting of ancient houses, old streets, small bridges, and flowing water, the former was formed much earlier than the latter. The tourist center (ticket office) is located at the western end of Shantang Street, and the main attractions along the street from west to east are Yanjia Garden, Hongyin Mountain House, Gusong Garden, and Bangyan Mansion. The Nanmu Hall and Shangxian Hall in Yan Family Garden are very grand; You can see a large stage in Hongyin Mountain House; The carved flowers in the lobby of the Ancient Pine Garden are very beautiful, and there is also a Ming Dynasty arhat pine in the garden; The Bangyan Mansion is renowned for its exquisite brick, wood, and stone carvings. Accompanied by the Xiangxi River on Mudu Shantang Street and the Xujiang River on the south side, they converge under the ancient and sloping bridge in the east. Xiangxi is said to have been named after Xi Shi bathing in spices at Guanwa Palace and flowing into the river to make it fragrant. Xujiang River is an artificial canal excavated by Wu Zixu and his followers. You can take a boat tour along the river and enjoy the scenery on both sides. The boat dock is not far from the tourist center at the west end of Shantang Street, and the fare is 10 yuan. Three people set sail. Other attractions on Shantang Street include Mingyue Temple and Gusu Twelve Sisters Cultural Park (free), while the Ming and Qing Dynasty Ancient Porcelain Museum is located across the river. The delicacies on Shantang Street include dried glutinous rice, and the signature jujube paste sesame cake is even better than another famous Suzhou restaurant, Caizhizhai; If you walk east along Shantang Street until you reach Zhongshi Street, Shijia Restaurant is also very famous. Its signature dish, Barb Lung Soup, is made by simmering fish liver in chicken soup. The fish liver is tender and the soup is extremely delicious.

How can you not take a boat tour when visiting the ancient town? Sitting in a boat, visiting the ancient town on both sides, the houses are built by the water, and the pink walls and black tiles with upturned eaves sweep into the bottom of the lake, reflecting a beautiful picture of a dragon lying at the bottom of the water.

Dianshan Lake is a freshwater lake and the source of the Huangpu River, the mother river of Shanghai. Dianshan Lake has beautiful scenery and is surrounded by ancient towns such as Zhujiajiao and Jinxi, as well as well-known attractions such as Dongfang Green Boat. It is known as the "Oriental Geneva Lake".

Taicang Alps International Resort is located in Taicang City, Suzhou, covering an area of 1 square kilometer with a total construction area of approximately 1.3 million square meters. It is a multicultural international high-end living and vacation complex specially designed by Fosun Tourism Culture Group for avant-garde groups, integrating ice and snow sports, cultural performances, music and food, experiential new retail, and parent-child space. The resort has four themed experience areas: Alpine Snow World Ski Resort, Alpine Snow World Ice and Snow Park, Club Med Mediterranean Day Ark Taicang Resort, and Alpine Time Realm. Alpine Snow World · Ski Resort Alpine Snow World is a large-scale indoor ski resort in East China created by Fosun Tourism Culture Group. It is divided into two main theme areas: Alpine Snow World · Ski Resort and Alpine Snow World · Ice and Snow Park. The Alpine Snow World Ski Resort is equipped with 6 snow trails with varying slopes, up to 280 meters in length, and 8 magic carpets running simultaneously. Among them, the 41m wide mountain top trail provides more challenging sliding speed and steep slopes as an advanced ski trail, making it the home ground for skiing "veteran players" to showcase balance and control! During the process of freestyle skiing, skiing enthusiasts can also overlook the entire ski resort. The 32m wide forest trail has a gentle and continuous mid slope, making it a training ground for skiing enthusiasts to improve their skiing skills! A sufficiently wide ski slope will meet all training needs, and various techniques such as jumping and drifting on snow can be passionately practiced. With each successful skill training, skiing enthusiasts will experience a thrilling and exhilarating feeling. As a glacier park with terrain ski slopes, it is the main battlefield for showcasing various skiing skills such as Tubing and Freestyle! The advantage of terrain design allows experienced skiers to showcase their skills, such as mushroom slalom and other satisfying flying techniques. The 21m wide snow trail is further divided into two zones: single board track and drift track, providing dual enjoyment at the same time. Hill Road - Adult Beginner Road, with a total width of 32m. Spacious gentle slopes can help beginners in skiing practice basic skiing skills such as balance and braking steadily. Every step of growth and transformation for beginners in skiing will be witnessed one by one on this ski slope. Kaka Beginner Village - Children's Ski Beginner Course. The setting of 25m width and gentle slope is suitable for children's height and physical fitness. Children skiing beginners will learn and practice skiing skills under the guidance of a coach to ensure safety. The Alpine Snow World Ski Resort regularly updates its rich and innovative facilities in Kaka Novice Village, allowing children skiing beginners to learn and progress while playing. In addition, Alpine Snow World Ski Resort caters to the needs of different types of skiing enthusiasts, bringing together a team of 100 professional and star level coaches, introducing an international certification system, and launching officially authoritative certification for single and double board skiing training. With diversified advanced training paths and services, it provides all types of skiing enthusiasts with carefully professional and optional one-on-one teaching content throughout the year, ensuring that skiing enthusiasts can achieve professional advancement and leap in their learning and exercise. At the Alpine Snow World Ski Resort, skiing enthusiasts will experience high-quality international luxury skiing on slopes that meet different needs, and personally feel the sense of achievement and smoothness of flying through the snow. Alpine Snow World · Ice and Snow Park Ice and Snow Park has created more than 20 entertainment projects specifically for vacationers, such as snow hunting, snow circle speed skating, polar slides, snow demon secrets, snow trail cross-country, elk exploration, snow mountain crossing, small carpenter's joyful big wheel, Luoluo Penguin Base Camp, etc. Vacationers can experience the tension and excitement of shooting in 'snow hunting'; You can also slide down from a 6-meter platform in "snow ring speed skating" and meet the goddess Aurora in a wonderful way, feeling the wind and heartbeat; Or go to the "Snow Mountain Crossing" to see the Alpine style village scenery, and meet mysterious people in the "Snow Demon Secret Realm" in a wonderful way; Go to the 'Little Carpenter's Joyful Wheel' and experience the joy of galloping in the pristine forests of the Alps; Experience the novelty of riding a motorcycle on snow while riding an ATV in "snow off-road"; On the 1000 square meter ice mirror like "Ice Mirror Lake", put on ice skates and slide freely, showing off a dynamic posture; Experience a close and loving interaction with the "White Eyebrow Gentleman" Papua penguin at the "Lolo Penguin Base Camp"... In addition, there is a large "Ice Palace Adventure" experience area in the Ice and Snow Park that integrates ice sculptures, mazes, and caves. The 9.5 meter long "Wind and Snow Cave" is inspired by the snow, frost, and steep ice, with dense snow mist covering the surrounding area like clouds. The vacationer will transform into an explorer, braving the strong wind to cross the ice cave and travel to polar space in one second. The ice palace is surrounded by a long accumulated layer of ice and snow, and eight exquisite ice sculptures of different styles are also distributed among them. At the same time, vacationers will also enjoy multiple exciting and stunning performance shows: Fun Alps, Aurora's Dream, Happy Guardians, ALPS Snow Splashing Party, Snow Monster Romance, Figure Skating Show, Happy Farewell... Experience pure Alpine ice and snow in a romantic, dreamy, mysterious, and joyful atmosphere! Club Med Mediterranean Day Ark · Taicang Resort Club Med Mediterranean Day Ark · Taicang Resort is created by the world-renowned French Club Med Mediterranean Club, which has a history of more than 70 years. It is also the second global high-end urban vacation product line "Mediterranean Day Ark" under its brand, after Nanjing Xianlin. Taicang Resort is inspired by the design of "Snow Mountain Journey", integrating wooden houses and snowflake elements, echoing the theme of Alpine ice and snow in the resort area. 299 exquisite and comfortable guest rooms, with overall natural wood tones and lively and bright geometric elements, provide a warm and unique stay experience, and a variety of room types meet the accommodation needs of families and teams. Taicang Resort adheres to the vacation concept of Club Med Mediterranean Club's "exquisite all inclusive package", serving as a G. that conveys and creates happiness O Happy Butler will lead guests to release their joyful love for life; The new mini club's childcare service not only liberates parents' hands, but also provides children with a safe and comprehensive vacation. In addition, Taicang Resort is equipped with sports facilities such as spinning bikes, boxing experience, outdoor cycling, beach games, yoga, and gym. The design inspiration comes from the international buffet restaurant of Edelweiss, which also complements the diverse geometric elements and bright colors, presenting a French elegant dining environment. The restaurant focuses on Alpine cuisine and features a classic cheese area, French dessert area, local specialty food area, and 7 food islands with Club Med characteristics. The sky bar on the top floor of Taicang Resort is designed with the concept of a snow mountain cabin tavern, equipped with ski themed decorations and mountain cable car seats. The bar customizes a special snow mountain themed wine list, bar cuisine, and outdoor cigar bar services for guests. Guests can relieve the fatigue of skiing during the day here, enjoy a drink, and overlook the charming night scenery of the Alpine resort. Taicang Resort has a conference and banquet area with a total area of 2000 square meters, adhering to the brand concept of Club Med "Enjoy Joy While Working", providing a rich selection of conference facilities for business team members. The grand banquet hall named after the fairy tale town of Annecy in southern France can also provide Alpine themed wedding services for couples. In response to the demand for large-scale business conferences and events, Taicang Resort has also set up a "Ultimate Private Enjoyment Package" service. Different G. every night The O Show will also allow guests to fully immerse themselves in the rich conference experience. Alpine Time Realm has a total construction area of 71000 square meters and is an immersive experience block that integrates parent-child entertainment, food shopping, art and fashion, and business leisure. Its aim is to create a 360 ° composite consumption home with a micro vacation mode. The Alpine Time Realm highly restores the cultural and natural landscapes of Alpine architecture, villages, forests, rivers, etc., with a layout of "blocks+individual buildings", taking guests into a comfortable and pleasant Alpine vacation time. Within the territory of Time, there are several top tier outdoor skiing brand clubs from both domestic and international markets, Michelin one star restaurants, and gourmet restaurants from various countries. Vacationers can satisfy their taste buds in all aspects at Michelin starred restaurants and experience the joy of one-stop shopping at high-end ski equipment gathering places.

Jinlan Beach is located by the beautiful Dianshan Lake; There is a service hall, beach volleyball, football, and rest pavilion. Observation area, etc., with beautiful scenery; There are also kayaking/paddleboarding options available. Only a 10 minute drive from Jinxi Ancient Town. It is a great place for leisure vacation.

The Museum of Life Secrets is an exhibition hall for plastinated specimens of living organisms. Visitors can not only see specimens of animals and human bodies, but also the structures of muscles, bones, and internal organs. It is a great place to learn biological knowledge. The exhibition hall has three floors. The first floor is the "Soul of the Ocean" exhibition hall, which displays specimens of marine organisms such as flip flops, dolphins, whales, and turtles, as well as sliced penguins, dolphins, and sharks. The second floor is the "Spine Kingdom" exhibition hall, where you can see the skeletons of peacocks and ostriches, as well as specimens of animals such as horses, deer, crocodiles, and bears. In addition, there is a 7D movie theater on the second floor, where the chairs shake during the viewing, and the movie playback effect is similar to that of a 4D movie. The third floor is the "Human World" exhibition hall, which is a more exciting exhibition hall showcasing human specimens. Some visitors may find the taste slightly heavy, so this floor is more suitable for tourists who want to learn knowledge or enjoy curiosity. The Mystery of Life Museum has interesting souvenirs such as shark teeth for sale, which you can choose for yourself.

poiName: 《 zhi ci zhou zhuang 》 xing jin shi duo wei kong jian ju
summary:
The immersive multi-dimensional space drama "Only Zhouzhuang" aims to immerse the audience in a "journey of encounter with oneself" in the form of a dream within a dream. The play breaks the pattern of traditional drama and stage performance, explores the issues of space and time in deconstruction and reconstruction, and integrates Song Dynasty aesthetics with multi-dimensional technological creativity, leading the audience to travel beyond the three-dimensional space, so as to gain a super-sensory experience of emotion and soul.

The story tells about a young traveler named Zhou He who comes to Zhouzhuang for a gathering of astronomy enthusiasts. In his dream, he witnesses the dreams and life of a Song Dynasty man of the same name in Zhouzhuang 900 years ago, and has a dialogue across time and space with many Zhouzhuang celebrities. In 70 minutes, you will enter the dreams of contemporary Zhou He and Song Dynasty man Zhou He, follow the four chapters of "Old Dreams, Paintings, Expeditions, and Finding Paths", enter the world of Song Dynasty aesthetics, enter the quaint water town 900 years ago, and witness the respective pursuits of old friends in Zhouzhuang.

Old Dream: Welcome to Zhouzhuang! At an offline gathering of astronomy enthusiasts, you met a young man named Zhou He, who casually picked up a copy of "Zhouzhuang Town Chronicles" at the front desk to read before going to bed. That night, all the guests of the hotel miraculously entered the same dream, and you entered Zhou He's dream. With the sound of rain outside the window, Zhou He read a book in his dream and returned to the water town nine hundred years ago, meeting a Song Dynasty man with the same name as himself. Come, let's dream together. Highlights: A full-scale immersive drama performance in the immersive dome light and shadow space brings you a shocking visual enjoyment.

Into the Painting: Dreams within dreams, you walk along with a lantern, following Zhou He's footsteps, and enter the dream of the Song Dynasty man of the same name. The dream is full of memories, including the banquets and prosperity of Tokyo in the past, the acquaintance and separation with the court singer Tao Xi, and the promises and entrustments of others. When he woke up from the dream, Zhou He, a Song Dynasty man, had an answer to the question of whether to stay or go, "There are beautiful scenery outside the Jiangnan water town, why do you stay here alone, brother Zhou?" Just because "this place where my heart is at peace is my hometown" Highlights: The official court musicians who played the twelve drums and whistles were restored on site, and the court dancers of the Song Dynasty danced against the backdrop of light and shadow, showing the prosperous court scene.

Going to war: Zhou He, a modern man, chases the light in the fragments of time, witnessing the half-life story of Zhou He, a Song Dynasty man, who stayed in Zhouzhuang. In order to protect the water town, he sent his son Zhou Xi to the army. He looked at the sword under the lamplight while drunk, and dreamed of blowing the horn in the camp. Zhou Xi was brave and good at fighting, and led 300 warriors from Zhouzhuang to join the anti-Jin team heading north. Highlights: Take a "warship" and be in the fierce anti-Jin battle, and feel the war atmosphere of wind and rain, thunder and lightning, and artillery.

Finding the way: The ginkgo tree planted by Zhouzhuang elders to commemorate the warriors who fought against the Jin Dynasty has become a sacred tree for the people of the water town to pray for blessings. In the dream, time and space disappear, and the modern man Zhou He takes over the guide fish lantern and waits under the ginkgo tree. Zhang Han, Zhou Digonglang, Shen Wansan...old friends from the village come into the dream and tell the feeling of "only this Zhouzhuang". At dawn, each of us wakes up from our own dream, recalling this "lucid dream" where we once met each other. I hope that all the white alienation can at least meet and embrace in dreams. Highlights: Hundreds of blessing lotus lanterns on the sacred tree illuminate the lost people one by one, which is both real and dreamlike.

The Bangyan Mansion is located on Xiatang Street and is the former residence of modern political commentator Feng Guifen. The mansion faces south and north, facing the Xujiang River, with a front and back garden structure, and has a typical style of early Qing Dynasty Jiangnan residential garden architecture. Feng Guifen was one of the two successful candidates in the imperial examination in the 20th year of the Daoguang reign (1840), so the local people called her residence "Bangyan Mansion". The Bangyan Mansion has a front house and back garden structure, covering an area of nearly ten acres, and is a typical Qing Dynasty garden architectural style. The "Three Carvings of Jiangnan" (brick carving, wood carving, and stone carving) are its main features. The garden is centered around a pool, with pavilions, pavilions, corridors, pavilions, bridges, and yellow stone rockeries scattered among them, arranged in a staggered manner with green trees covering the area, full of poetic and picturesque charm.

The Chengdu Sichuan Cuisine Museum is located in Gucheng Town, Pixian County, northwest of Chengdu. The Chengdu Sichuan Cuisine Museum is a tourism project developed based on ancient Shu culture and in line with retro fashion. Sichuan cuisine has existed since ancient times and is an important component of Chinese cuisine. Kong Daosheng and others in the late Qing Dynasty officially proposed the concept of Sichuan cuisine. After thousands of years of integration and development, the beauty of Sichuan cuisine has spread throughout the world and gained the admiration of diners. Sichuan cuisine culture refers to the spiritual wealth of technology and craftsmanship, nutritional science, visual arts, poetry and literature embedded in Sichuan cuisine, as well as various carriers formed by Sichuan cuisine, such as vessels, utensils, relics and relics. The Chengdu Sichuan Cuisine Museum extensively uses ancient building materials from the Han, Ming, and Qing dynasties, and is designed and constructed using retro techniques. The park also carefully arranges and displays many ancient artworks, agricultural tools, etc., which are of great appreciation value. The Sichuan cuisine culture exhibited and displayed at the Chengdu Sichuan Cuisine Museum is a popular culture and an important part of Sichuan's local culture. The Collection Hall showcases the historical Sichuan cuisine culture through cultural relics, classics, and graphic displays, providing insights into the origin, evolution, development, and formation of Sichuan cuisine culture. Here, you can see the different utensils used in Sichuan cuisine at different times, understand the productivity, people's living habits, and aesthetic needs at that time. The interactive demonstration hall showcases the knife skills, cooking techniques, and cooking process of Sichuan cuisine on site, which is the core content of intangible culture of Sichuan cuisine. They are dynamic, experiential, and artistic, and can only be displayed through demonstrations. Tourists can participate in interactive activities; The aroma and taste of Sichuan cuisine can be personally experienced by tourists through their taste buds; Tourists can also learn about the dining styles of Sichuan cuisine: snacks, elegant rooms, and banquets. Zaowang Temple is another tourist attraction of Sichuan Cuisine Museum. Zaowang is a component of traditional Sichuan cuisine culture and Sichuan folk culture. In folk culture, the position of the Kitchen God is to 'speak good deeds from heaven and ensure peace in the lower world'. Respectful to the Kitchen God and fond of food and drink, tourists can appreciate the saying 'one meal at a time, thinking hard won', cherish life, and live in harmony with nature and society. The Tea and Leisure Restaurant experienced the characteristics of Sichuan cuisine culture, which is characterized by "tea and rice accompanying each other, and food interdependent". Sichuan cuisine culture is a Yanji culture, integrating banquet, entertainment, and leisure. Drinking tea and savoring tea is an integral part of Sichuan cuisine culture.

The Ruins Hall was built on top of the archaeological excavation site of the Jinsha Site, with a large construction area and a large-span steel structure to ensure the integrity of the site as much as possible. It showcases the ancient relics discovered in China so far, which have a long history, are well preserved, and are rich in buried sacrificial vessels.

On the east side of the Ministry of Works Temple, there is a pavilion with a thatched roof, known as the Shaoling Thatched Cottage Stele Pavilion. This is one of the representative buildings of the Du Fu Thatched Cottage. It is a pavilion with a thatched roof, and there is a stone monument inside the tree, engraved with the four characters "Shaoling Thatched Cottage". The strokes are strong and graceful, and were written by Prince Guo Yunli. Du Fu often referred to himself as Du Ling Bu Yi and Shao Ling Ye Lao in his poetry. Therefore, later generations also referred to Du Fu as Du Shaoling, and Du Fu Thatched Cottage as Shaoling Thatched Cottage. The pavilion is backed by a lotus pond and surrounded by vibrant flowers, plants, bamboo, and wood, creating a beautiful and pleasant scenery. In the late Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty, the people of the Ming Dynasty built a grass pavilion in the temple of the Ministry of Works, named "Qiankun Grass Hall", which symbolized the thatched cottage of Du Fu's Grass Hall at that time to commemorate the poet.

Madam Huanhua, surnamed Ren, was born in Chengdu (some say Wushan), Shu Commandery. She was a female general of the Tang Dynasty and a concubine of Cui Xu, the military governor of Xichuan. In the third year of the Dali reign of the Tang Dynasty (768 AD), Cui Xu submitted a memorial to the court. Yang Zilin, the governor of Luzhou, took the opportunity to attack Chengdu. Lady Huanhua recruited troops to resist the battle and defeated Yang Zilin to preserve Chengdu. The court conferred the title of Duke of Ji upon Cui Xu and bestowed upon him the name Cui Ning. At the same time, Lady Huanhua was conferred the title of Lady of Ji. During the Five Dynasties period, the "Holy Lady Temple" was built by the Huanhua River. In the 20th year of the Guangxu reign of the Qing Dynasty (1894), the Huanhua Lady Temple was rebuilt and its statue was sculpted. Since then, there have been many damages. The temple was renovated in 1983.

Xiguan Mansion refers to a typical old-fashioned residential building in Guangzhou built by wealthy merchants gathered in the old town area of Liwan during the late Qing Dynasty. The well preserved ones are mainly concentrated in the areas of Duobao Road, Fengyuan Road, and Longjin West Road. The characteristics of Xiguan Mansion are high walls made of stone feet and water polished green bricks, wooden rafters with black light that can be seen, Manchu windows with reddish brown indigo and magnificent flowing colors, antique tiger button copper locks, dilapidated old rooftops and railings covered with lush green clusters of flowers, with auspicious banners posted to worship the Guan Emperor and the God of Wealth, and incense burning at the door corners. The Xiguan Mansion in this area can only be viewed from the outside and cannot be visited from the inside. If you want to have a deeper understanding, you can go to the Liwan Museum. The museum site was once the former residence of Mr. Chen Lianzhong, a comprador of the British HSBC Bank. It is a typical Xiguan Mansion and there are many related introductions to take a look inside.
