summary: The Beifurshi Street Character Library is located in Jinjiang District, Chengdu City. It was built during the Qing Dynasty and is also known as the Xizi Pagoda. Because ancient people valued characters as precious as gold, any paper containing ink treasures must not be discarded at will and must be incinerated in the font library. The font library is about 7.6 meters high and covers an area of approximately 4.39 square meters.

Citizen Square South Square is the main square of Citizen Square, with a very large area. The square often holds various activities, including light shows. The Lianhua Mountain to the north is an important scenic spot in Shenzhen. There is also a new Shenzhen Museum on the South Square.

poiName: Zhen Spa Hot Spring of East Tai Lake Grand Hotel
summary: Located in the East the Taihu Lake Lake area of Suzhou, the Treasure SPA Hot Spring of East the Taihu Lake Lake Hotel has a wide view and pleasant landscape. The hot spring water in the hotel belongs to natural carbonated hot springs. There are a total of 12 outdoor swimming pools (the number of open pools per day is subject to the actual situation of the hotel, please consult the hotel in advance for details), as well as supporting projects such as geothermal steam rooms, salt and stone steam rooms, and island style outdoor swimming pools.

poiName: Window of the world-Gate of China
summary: Zhonghua Gate is a rare Chinese element in the Window of the World. Zhonghua Gate is one of the Three Treasures of the Yonghe Palace in Beijing. Yonghe Palace was originally the residence of Prince Yongzheng, the fourth son of Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty, and Qianlong was also born here. Baofang has four pillars and nine roofs, shining brilliantly with auspicious patterns of dragons and phoenixes, reflecting the style of the prosperous Kangxi and Qianlong periods. The four characters' Respect for Relatives in the World 'in the center were written by Emperor Qianlong.

poiName: Window of the world-France Eiffel Tower
summary: The Eiffel Tower in France stands tall in the Place de Mars, built to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the French Revolution. It was completed in 1889 and was designed by Gustave Named after Eiffel. Except for the four cement tower piers, all the steel frame structures are 325 meters high and weigh about 9000 tons, combining grandeur and graceful softness.

poiName: Window of the world-The Russia Winter Palace
summary: The Winter Palace is located on the Neva River in St. Petersburg and was designed by renowned architect Rastrelli. It was first built between 1754 and 1762.

poiName: Window of the world-England Tower Bridge
summary: The Tower Bridge of London, built in 1894, is connected at both ends by four stone towers. The two main towers are 35 meters high, square and heavy, with a quaint style that looks like two crowns from afar, magnificent and majestic. The bridge is divided into two levels. The lower level uses water to open and close for ships to pass through, while the upper level is a pedestrian walkway with glass windows, allowing visitors to enjoy the view of the Thames River. The design resembles the entrance of the River Thames into London, hence it is known as the "main gate of London".

Shekou Industrial Zone is located in the southeast of Shenzhen Nantou Peninsula, bordering Shenzhen Bay in the east and Pearl River estuary in the west, facing Yuen Long and Liufu Mountain in the New Territories of Hong Kong across the sea. It belongs to Nanshan District and covers an area of 10.85 square kilometers. It is an outward oriented economic development zone fully developed by China Merchants Group.

Manshan Island, located in the southeast waters of the Taihu Lake Lake, is a lake island surrounded by water on all sides and the third largest island of the Taihu Lake Lake. Facing Sanyang Village and Situ Temple in the northeast and the Taihu Lake Lake Bridge in the southeast, it is an important part of Guangfu Scenic Area in the Taihu Lake Lake Scenic Area. It belongs to Guangfu Town, Wuzhong District, and its ecological environment is very superior. Manshan Island is surrounded by mountains to the north and south, with continents to the east and west. There are lakes within the continents and mountains outside the mountains. Manshan Island is a corner forgotten by "God", but on the contrary, it has achieved the temperament of Manshan Island, which is quaint, pure, and natural. Walk along the Love Causeway and feel the spectacular sunset of the Taihu Lake Lake; Dongdong Mountain and Dongtou Mountain are distributed in the north and south, offering a panoramic view of the island's scenery.

Gu Yanwu's former residence is located in Qiandeng Ancient Town, Kunshan City, Jiangsu Province, covering an area of 60 acres and a building area of 5450 square meters. The former residence is the main body of the entire mansion, facing east and falling west, and is a five entry ancient Ming and Qing architecture. From east to west, there are water wall doors, entrance halls, clear halls (sedan halls), Ming halls (main halls, Nanmu halls), and residential buildings. On the north side, there is a back lane connecting the stove, reading building, and backyard. The former residence is connected to the Millennium Stone Street in front, and later to the Gu Yanwu Cemetery and Gu Garden. This area mainly reproduces Mr. Tinglin's home life and reading scenes. Each hall displays a statue, handwriting, works, life stories, and research results on Mr. Gu Yanwu and his works at home and abroad. During the Cultural Revolution, the former residence and tomb of Gu Yanwu were destroyed. In 1984, 1987, and 2000, Kunshan City allocated funds for reconstruction and renovation respectively. The renovated Gu Yanwu Former Residence scenic area includes three major areas: Gu Yanwu Former Residence, Gu Yanwu Tomb (Pavilion, Forest, Ancestral Hall, and Tomb), and Gu Garden, making it the first Ming and Qing Dynasty mansion with a thousand lanterns. In addition, there is a former residence of Gu Yanwu located in the west courtyard of Baoguo Temple on Guang'anmen Inner Street in Xuanwu District, Beijing. It was built with funds raised by He Shaoji, Zhang Mu and others in the 23rd year of the Qing Dynasty's Daoguang reign (1843). There are buildings such as Buddha Hall, Enjoyment Hall, and Stele Pavilion. Gu Temple was once destroyed by the Eight Nation Alliance, and later Zhang Zhidong rebuilt Zhaozhong Temple. In 1921, Wang Shitong and others rebuilt it. It is a key protected cultural relic in Beijing. Gu Yanwu, originally named Jiang, with the courtesy name Ning Ren and the pen name Tinglin, was born in 1613 in Qiandeng Town, Kunshan. He participated in the restoration of society in his youth and joined the anti Qing struggle when the Qing army marched south. We firmly reject the study of imperial examinations and regulations, and have extensively reviewed historical records, county chronicles, as well as collections and memorials from various dynasties, compiling records related to farmland, water conservancy, mineral resources, transportation, etc. We have written extensively in academia. His proposal of 'the rise and fall of the world is the responsibility of every individual' inspires every generation of benevolent individuals and has become the motto of generations of Chinese and Huang descendants who aim to serve their country. Gu Yanwu also wrote 370 volumes of works throughout his life, with "Ri Zhi Lu", "Tian Xia Jun Guo Li Bing Shu", and "Zhao Yu Zhi" as the three major works. Gu Yanwu himself has also been recognized by contemporary historians as one of the 72 great men of the past two thousand years.

One of the eight major coastlines in China and a beautiful beach for tourism in Shenzhen. Xiyong Beach is located in the Xiyong community of Nan'ao South on the Dapeng Peninsula. With a coastline of 5 kilometers, Xiyong Beach boasts the soft and natural beaches of Shenzhen, allowing visitors to experience the Southeast Asian island culture without having to travel abroad. No.1 Beach: The camping area is equipped with wild luxury tents and starry sky tents for overnight stays, allowing visitors to immerse themselves in the experience of the stars, the sea, and the sunrise. Barbecue area: Self service BBQ, sea breeze brushing your face, hands-on barbecue with friends, chatting about youth while feeling the collision of taste buds, making life full of memories. No.2 Beach: RV camping is aimed at high-end consumer groups, introducing "Dudu" RVs that can stay overnight, allowing tourists to immerse themselves in the beauty of natural ecology and meet their pursuit of high-end travel services. Dark Night Starry Sky: From 20:00 to 22:00 at night, during statutory holidays and weekend evenings, a "Dark Night Community" light off ceremony will be held on the beach to create a completely dark space and create a holy land for stargazing and moon watching in the Greater Bay Area. No.3 Beach: The camping area is equipped with luxurious tents for overnight stays. Sitting quietly under the sky, enjoying the ebb and flow of the tides with light music, and enjoying afternoon tea, you can also stay camping and experience the vast stars in the sky. Beach 4: Electric Music Party Moon God Club, from 20:00 in the evening to 02:00 the next day, a Pattaya style electric music carnival party in Thailand, with energetic and passionate DJs playing discs, a gathering place for spicy girls and trendsetters, experiencing an alternative way of vacation. Surfing base: In summer, when you go to the beach for sightseeing, in addition to visiting attractions and playing on the beach, there is also a water sport that you cannot miss, which is surfing. Riding a surfboard, rolling on the waves, riding the pleasure of the waves, and rushing into the clear sea water. This is what summer should be like. Beach Sports: Full range, full-time, beach volleyball, beach soccer, fun sports, outdoor sketching, kite flying, sand digging and sea racing Sunrise: It is the light that shines on the earth, giving us hope for tomorrow. Sunrise is the light that spreads over all things, giving us growing warmth. Please cherish every sunrise, let's go to the beach in Xichong now to watch the sunrise together! Mei'an Seaview Restaurant: Located in the No.1 Tourist Service Center of Xichong Beach, it is a seaside restaurant in Xichong. Stepping into the restaurant, the ocean themed atmosphere creates a dreamy feeling of being at the beach of love. The romantic and beautiful decoration style, exquisite cuisine, and clear air make people feel relaxed and happy.

Pengzhou Bailushang Academy is located in Bailu Town, Pengzhou City. It is a French Catholic church building, founded in 1895, and was once a theological and philosophical college that trained Catholic missionaries. It is a building similar to the Harry Potter School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, with a grand scale, carved railings, arched window frames, curved steps, and a mixture of Gothic and Roman architecture, making people feel like they are in a foreign land. Pengzhou Bailu Shangshu Academy has gone through a hundred years and was damaged in the 2008 earthquake, but its main building has been preserved. Due to its Western style architecture and standing in a mountain valley, it has attracted the attention of countless photographers. The post earthquake reconstruction has made this place a tourist development site and welcomed visitors from all directions.

Pengzhou Longxing Temple is located in the urban area of Pengzhou, with the ancient city on its back and adjacent neighborhoods. It was originally a famous ancient temple surrounded by red walls, towering ancient cypress trees, and lush bamboo groves. Longxing Temple has a history of thousands of years and has gone through many ups and downs. It has changed its name five times and by the 1940s, it covered an area of over 80 acres, with a vast territory and a large scale, and had more than 100 monks. The main buildings are the Heavenly King, the Buddha, the the Shakya ManiHall and the Sutra Pavilion, which are all arranged on the north-south axis. The layout is neat and the style is simple. In addition to the guest hall, ancestral hall, ring hall, abbot room, monk's room, five view halls, a total of more than 150 rooms, it is a complete group of Buddhist temple buildings. There are corridors connecting the halls and buildings, providing shade from the sun and rain. It is solemn, beautiful, exquisite, and practical. It is a "ten sided jungle" on the plain of western Sichuan, a large temple for preaching, known as the "Seven Buddha Holy Land" and renowned in Western Sichuan.

Danjingshan is located in Danjingshan Town (ancient Jiulong), Pengzhou City, Sichuan Province, and is the forefront scenic area of Longmen Mountain. The air here is fresh and suitable for hiking and exercising. It is also a good choice to come here during the peony flowering period to admire the flowers. Tourists usually hike up the mountain to play here, with lush trees, bird songs, and fragrant flowers along the way. It can both relax the body and mind and exercise the body. On the way up the mountain, locals will sell some honey and other specialty products, and tourists who like them can try them.

Haiwozi Ancient Town is a newly emerging town under the jurisdiction of Pengzhou City, Chengdu. It was one of the founding centers of the ancient Shu Kingdom, and the capital of Shu King Bai was established in "Qushang", now known as "Haiwozi". The ancient town was established in the 55th year of the Qianlong reign (1790 AD).

Tianya Haijiao is located in Jinxiu Zhonghua Folk Village, No. 9003 Shennan Avenue, Nanshan District, Shenzhen. It is a unique landscape in the Chinese Ethnic Village, modeled after the Tianya Haijiao in Hainan and constructed in a scaled down building.

The China Merchants History Museum is located along Shanshan Road in Shekou, covering an area of 3430 square meters and a building area of 6153 square meters. The total exhibition area is nearly 2000 square meters. The entire exhibition hall adopts a neoclassical style design, which is implicit, stable, concise, and modern. Among the historical relics of China Merchants Group collected in the museum, nearly 400 literary relics are exhibited, which vividly reproduce the wind and rain footprints of China Merchants Group for more than 130 years, and also reflect the difficult process of China's national industrial and commercial enterprises for more than a century. It is of great significance for studying the history of China Merchants Group, the development history of national industrial and commercial enterprises, and modern economic history.

As a supporting sports center in the new central area of Bao'an, the newly designed facilities cover a considerable area, with various sports facilities such as football fields, tennis courts, basketball courts, swimming pools, and a large square outside where you can fly kites. It is a good sports venue!

OCT Longquanyi Happy Countryside is located on Section 4 of Automobile City Avenue in Longquanyi District, Chengdu, adjacent to Dong'an Lake Sports Park. It covers an area of 450 acres and is the second joyful countryside in China created by the Overseas Chinese Town Group. Joyful Countryside revolves around the attributes of urban countryside, creating seven sections: Sichuan Impression, Luxi Ranch, Fantasy Time, Panda Waves, Bamboo Forest Secret Realm, Starry Sky Lawn, and Splendid Linlang. It integrates various projects such as splendid flower scenery, cute pet interaction, parent-child play, swimming in the waves, delicious food, and secret adventure. It is an exquisite version of the Joyful Countryside walking paradise in the suburbs of the city that is loved by people of all ages. Here, there is a unique and diverse rural landscape, with beautiful flower clusters and colorful seasons. Here, joy and childlike innocence are everywhere. You can have an unexpected encounter with cute animals up close, as well as experience treasure hunting and fantasy amusement. Everyone can have a unique park experience here, making it a dream destination for family outings.

The Longquan Mountain Observation Deck is located in Longquanyi District, Chengdu City. The view from the observation deck is wide and offers a panoramic view of the entire Longquanyi urban area. At sunset, the stunning sunset scenery here is truly breathtaking. Every spring when peach blossoms are in full bloom, birds sing and swallows dance everywhere here, and the fragrance of flowers is overwhelming, truly breathtaking.

Jiguanshan Natural Park is located on the western edge of the Chengdu Plain, and the park has not yet been fully developed, so the related tourism facilities are not very complete. It is a park for outdoor sports and experiencing the original ecological nature. Jiguan Mountain is a great place for outdoor exploration. The roads here are mostly dirt roads, and you can enjoy various flowers, plants, trees, and wild animals along the way, full of primitive ecology and a feeling of primitive forest. In autumn, you can admire the fiery red maple leaves here, and in winter, you can come here for skiing.

Yuantong is a famous ancient town. In its history, Yuantong was an important dock on the Wenjing River and was once bustling. It is appropriate to summarize Yuantong ancient town as "ancient". Resting at the stilted house next to the old stone arch bridge at the end of Banbian Street, watching the river flow by, imagining the prosperity of Yuantong 1600 years ago, one can sigh with the saying 'Time flies like this'. Yuantong Ancient Town was once an important dock in history. There are three rivers converging here, hence the name Huijiang. The existing historical sites and ancient scenery in the town include: Luo's Mansion (now Supply and Marketing Cooperative), Huang's Mansion (now Town Government), Huang's Ancestral Hall (now National Taxation Office), Yuantong Tianzhu Hall, Wang Guoying's Former Residence, Tiegan Bridge, Workers', Peasants' and Soldiers' Bridge, etc.

Jiulonggou Scenic Area has suffered damage and is currently not open, but the scenery outside the scenic area is also good. The Chongzhou Jiulonggou Scenic Area is mainly composed of three parts: Jiulonggou Water Stone Scenic Area, Daxian Mountain Primitive Forest Scenic Area, and Ancient Temple. At the peak of Liuding Mountain, one can enjoy the sea of clouds, sunrise, moonlight, and Buddhist light. The ancient temple scenic area is hidden in dense forests and is a relatively well preserved large-scale ancient temple in the mountains and forests of Chengdu. The primitive forest belt of Daxian Mountain is inhabited by rare animals such as giant pandas, golden monkeys, and antelopes.

The first floor of the Dafen Art Museum has two comprehensive conference halls, an academic lecture hall, a collection room, and an oil painting exhibition hall. The second floor is an exhibition gallery and five relatively independent exhibition halls. The third floor is a painter's studio, a caf é, and a rooftop plaza. The underground parking lot can provide 97 parking spaces.

Shenzhen Rose Town is like being in a fairy tale world. There is a unique European style here, and the scenic area has created classic European, Chinese, and Korean style streets in the form of "dressing up and wearing hats", as well as six major themes including the world's seven major church groups, Disney Dream Castle, and pastoral scenery. A love hall that witnesses lifelong companionship, a fairy tale love world theme, a backyard of dating love and affection, and a garden flower sea full of romantic love atmosphere. It is a dream world that couples yearn for.

The Happy Coast Ocean Wonderland is located on the west side of the second floor of the Happy Coast Shopping Center. The venue is not particularly large, mainly consisting of three areas: Jellyfish World, Coral House, and Happy Sea Lion Theater. In addition, there are also places where you can buy ocean themed decorations and dine. The Jellyfish World showcases over 20 different and colorful jellyfish species, such as Purple Striped Sea Thorn, Colorful Jellyfish, Ghost Jellyfish, White Cloud Jellyfish, Egg Yolk Jellyfish, and more. Coral House not only has corals of various colors, but also colorful marine fish that shuttle through it. The Joyful Sea Lion Theater hosts daily performances of Uruguayan sea lions, and people can also get up close and take photos with the adorable sea lions.

The Dapeng Peninsula Geopark is a rare fully free national geopark in China. The park boasts unique ancient volcanic geological relics, distinctive coastal landscapes, and rare flora and fauna resources, forming a combination of mountains, seas, and air landscapes that blend tranquility, beauty, and uniqueness. Its distinctive feature of "mountains and seas depend on each other, water and fire blend together" is unique. Visiting the Dapeng Peninsula Geopark, climbing Mount Qiniang to see the sea, and visiting the Yangmeikeng volcanic site are all good choices. There is also a Geopark Museum in the scenic area, which uses new technology to introduce the unique ancient volcanic landforms and coastal scenery of the Geopark.

The island covers an area of approximately 2.7 square kilometers and has three beaches. The shells on the beaches are very beautiful, and the seawater here is very clean. People can dive into the sea and enjoy the beautiful underwater world.

Jiulong Lake Resort is located in the northeast of Huadu District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province. Surrounded by mountains, the reservoir is surrounded by winding mountains, with peaks overlapping and competing for uniqueness. The forest is dense and continuous, the air is fresh and pleasant, and there are endless birds and animals; The reservoir has nine bends and ten curves resembling the movement of a dragon, hence it is known as the "Nine Dragon Lake". Jiulong Lake Resort includes a 27 hole membership golf course, a European style town, a European estate, a mountaintop square, a hotel complex, a large villa complex, Jiulong Lake Art Gallery, and a lure fishing base SPA、 The project areas such as water parks and lakeside parks have extremely superior natural and ecological environments, elegant and unique cultural landscapes, and are a paradise for large-scale leisure, entertainment, business, conferences, banquets, tourism, and vacations. Jiulong Lake European Town is composed of dozens of European style buildings with exotic charm, as well as creatively designed garden villas, nestled among green trees and flowers, with small houses of love.

summary: Guanlong Island is a typical inland waterway island with flat terrain, wide views, and stunning surrounding scenery. It is a tourist destination that combines tropical seaside scenery with Lingnan water town characteristics.

Xiaomeisha Seaside Boardwalk is located in Yantian District, Shenzhen, built along the sea with a wide view. Walking on the boardwalk, you can see the reefs and listen to the waves, feeling comfortable and leisurely.

The Shenzhen Book City Center is located on the north central axis of the central business district (CBD) of Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China. It is situated on Fuzhong Road in Futian District, adjacent to Lianhua Mountain to the north, Shenzhen Civic Center to the south, Shenzhen Music Hall and Shenzhen Library to the west, and Shenzhen Youth Palace to the east. It is the flagship store of the "Shenzhen Book City" brand. The bookstore consists of three levels of space: underground, mezzanine, and above ground. The underground level is mainly used as a parking area, with nearly 600 parking spaces. The ground buildings are divided into two zones, north and south. The area between Hongli Road and Fuzhong Road is called the "North Zone", and the area south of Fuzhong Road is called the "South Zone". The two zones are connected by a connecting body that spans Fuzhong Road. On both sides of the bookstore are four green cultural parks with an area of 10000 square meters each, namely "Poetry, Books, Etiquette, and Music". The roof of the bookstore is covered with green plants on both sides, except for a 25 meter wide walking axis. The soil layer on the roof allows for the growth of lawns and trees. The first and middle floors have a large vertical shared hall, with vertically extending skylights on both sides of the roof. There are two gardens in the south and north areas, one square and one round, respectively, taking the meaning of "round sky and square earth", which leads directly to the sky and connects to natural light and green plant landscapes. The central city of Shenzhen Book City is an experiential book city, introducing the concept of "BookMall" which combines bookstores and shopping malls. Nearly 20000 square meters have been planned in the hypermarket for displaying and selling publications and cultural products. In addition to a central bookstore, there are also specialty stores such as the "Humanities and Social Sciences Bookstore" (first floor of the North District), "Economic Management Bookstore" (first floor of the North District), "Art and Design Bookstore" (first floor of the South District), "Life and Leisure Bookstore" (first floor of the North District), "Science and Technology Bookstore" (first floor of the North District), "Music Joy Time and Space Theme Store" (first floor of the North District), "Youth Theme Store" (first floor of the North District), "Foreign Language Original Bookstore", and the 24-hour "Starlight Joy Reading Stack" (first floor of the South District), combining nearly 300000 varieties of products. It also integrates projects such as quality catering (Starbucks, illy coffee, Ziyuan Tea House, Noodle King, Ajisen Lamian Noodles, Kesongfang, Wonderland Forest, Pizzahut, etc.), leisure and entertainment, creative products and cultural boutiques to provide one-stop, diversified cultural consumption choices and experiences.
Shenzhen Bay Park Area C - Sunrise Theater is located within Shenzhen Bay Park, facing east and with an open area, making it a great viewing spot for beautiful sunrises.

poiName: Mysteries of the Deep Blue Waters
summary: The water stage performance of 'Deep Blue Secret Realm' was held at the Water Show Theater on the Happy Coast, which is a futuristic and seamlessly integrated super large water stage with the sea. The theater utilizes international advanced multimedia art and technology achievements such as water curtains, fountains, lasers, projections, flames, music, and fireworks, combined with natural mangrove forests, to delicately and vividly showcase the beautiful world in the forest. Deep Blue Secret Realm "tells the story of a pure, beautiful, and adventurous urban girl named Feifei and a long nosed monkey elf named Golden Monkey who grows up in the mangrove forest. During the performance, seawater directly flows into the dance floor, blending with the images to create stunning 3D audio-visual effects.

There are many unknown historical sites and relics to the west of West Lake, and Yuhu Bay is one of them. The surface of the Yuhu Bay Lake is open and closed, with a winding coastline that connects to Xiaonan Lake through the Junyuan Bridge and the water port in Huagang Park. This bay has existed since ancient times and is known as the Chishanshui Tune. In the past, the spring water and clear clouds in the bay were beautiful, and one could often hear fishermen and woodcutters singing and answering, creating a leisurely scene. There is a poem in ancient times that praises it: "Bathing in the spring water at the head of Huwan, calling on the clear clouds at the entrance of Yuankou. Fishing songs echo each other, and woodcutters sing leisurely." Huang Gongwang, Zhang Yu, and other literati and painters have left their traces here. After experiencing the vicissitudes of time, Yuhu Bay later became a land. After recent renovations, the old sites such as Huangmilou Shuixuan, Zijiu Caotang, Wuzhuangyuan Fang, Jihong Bridge, Santai Mengji, and Yucen Poetry Society have reappeared and are very beautiful.

Yangmeiling Village is located west of Shuile Cave and south of Wengjia Mountain. It is said that in ancient times, there was a "Jinpo Yangmei" in this area, which had a sweet taste and was well-known far and wide. It has been gradually restored now, and eating Yangmei on Yangmeiling will become a major feature of the village. Yangmeiling Village is a traditional mountainous Fujian opera, with many old houses, giving people a feeling of not being in Hangzhou. Along the way, there are heavy mountains and obstacles, and the vegetation is moist and beautiful. The clear flow is sometimes tight and sometimes slow, comparable to the West Tianmu Mountain. The historical site is Li'an Temple. The famous "Nine Streams and Eighteen Streams" in Hangzhou originate from Yangjiawu in Yangmeiling, and then converge into nine small streams including Qingwan, Hongfa, Fangjia, Baizhang, Tangjia, Foshi, Yunqi, Zhutou, and Xiaokang, before flowing into the Qiantang River through Xucun; The Eighteen Streams are located in the southwest of Yanxia Cave, originating from Longjing Village in Longjing. They pass through the forest foothills and converge with many small streams such as Poet Island and Sun Wenlong to form a stream. The Nine Streams and Eighteen Streams are named after this.

Li'an Temple is located next to the ancient road in Yangmeiling Village, Jiuxi Scenic Area, Hangzhou. It was formerly known as the "Yongquan Zen Temple" and was named after the famous mountain spring scenery "Fayu Spring" that is on par with Hupao Spring. During the Ming and Five Dynasties, the eminent monk Fuhu Zhifeng once resided here, and the Wuyue King built the temple for him. The Li'an Temple is grand in scale and ornate in decoration. It has many buildings, such as the mountain gate, the Imperial Stele Pavilion, Maitreya Hall, the Shakya ManiHall, Zen Hall, Dharma Hall, Sutra Pavilion, Abbot, Qizhu Temple, Songwei Pavilion, etc. The unique architectural style, combined with the elegant scenery of the surrounding mountains and rivers, has inspired countless literati and left many poems here.
